title_en: Cascading failure evolution path online identification method considering alternating current and direct current influences
abstract_en: The invention discloses an online identification method of a cascading failure evolution path considering the influence of alternating current and direct current, which aims at a manually set cascading failure initial failure set or a cascading failure initial failure set formed by equipment failure probability, utilizes transient time domain simulation to simulate direct current commutation failure caused by initial alternating current failure under the influence of alternating current and direct current interaction, safety control action caused by direct current continuous commutation failure locking, new energy cascading network disconnection and two-three line-defense action of a power grid, determines lower-stage evolution failure according to equipment overload and voltage out-of-limit and dynamically searches a safety control current value control strategy, and simulates equipment successive disconnection through multi-evolution branch static safety analysis, so that the complex cascading failure evolution path under the influence of alternating current and direct current interaction is accurately identified, and the problem of accurate prejudgment of the cascading failure evolution path of an ultra-high voltage power grid under the online mode is solved. The method can provide a support means for the scheduling personnel to comprehensively master the cascading failure evolution path and the accident risk, and has good application value.
assignees: NARI TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD;NARI GROUP CORP

title_en: Interconnected micro-grid layered distributed optimization scheduling method
abstract_en: The invention provides a hierarchical distributed optimal scheduling method for an interconnected micro-grid, which comprises the following steps: s1, establishing a cloud-edge cooperative interconnected micro-grid operation communication framework; s2, constructing an optimized scheduling model of an interconnected micro-grid system with the upper layer cooperatively interacting with a large power grid; s3, constructing a microgrid operator economic dispatching model for processing source load uncertainty at a lower layer; s4, decoupling an optimized scheduling model of the interconnected micro-grid system and an economic scheduling model of a micro-grid operator based on a target cascade method, and establishing a decoupled distributed optimized scheduling model of the interconnected micro-grid system to enable the system to calculate and operate in a distributed mode; s5, carrying out parallel solution on the distributed optimized scheduling model of the interconnected micro-grid system; and S6, performing distributed optimal scheduling control on the interconnected micro-grid system based on the result obtained by the solution in the step S5. The invention can realize the cooperative interaction between the interconnected micro-grid system and the large power grid, reduce the influence of renewable energy and load fluctuation on the system scheduling operation, support the local privacy protection of micro-grid operators and improve the system operation calculation efficiency.
assignees: STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;UNIV TIANJIN

title_en: Power accident cause analysis method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a power accident cause analysis method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an accident report of the power accident, and extracting a plurality of causative events in the accident report; determining the relation among a plurality of causative events according to the sequence and the frequency of occurrence of the plurality of causative events, and constructing an accident causative network; the importance of the network nodes is analyzed through the topological property of the accident cause network, the cause risk of the electric power accident is calculated by utilizing the cascading failure theory, and a risk management and control suggestion is generated, so that the specific cause of each type of accident can be effectively found, and the cause which plays a greater role in directly causing the accident can be conveniently determined. Therefore, the problems that the related technology cannot find the specific key cause of each type of accident, is not beneficial to determining the key cause from the perspective of the direct cause of the accident, does not fully consider the dynamic process of the domino effect, and is insufficient in simulating the actual occurrence process of the accident are solved.

title_en: Wind power generation power prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind power generation power prediction method and system, and relates to the technical field of new energy power generation control. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring wind turbine generator set information, wind condition information and topographic information; constructing a wind speed model based on a back propagation neural network and predicting to obtain a primary wind speed prediction result; determining the coordinate and relative position relation of the wind turbine generator according to the topographic information, and determining the wake flow superposition condition; correcting the primary wind speed prediction result and reconstructing a wind speed model; carrying out wind speed prediction by using the reconstructed wind speed model to obtain a final wind speed prediction result; and predicting wind power generation power through a wind power prediction model according to the final wind speed prediction result. The method solves the problem that wind power generation power prediction is inaccurate because wind speed is difficult to accurately calculate due to the characteristics of complex and changeable topography, frequent wind speed and direction changes, high turbulence intensity and the like in low wind speed areas.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY WENSHANG POWER SUPPLY COMPANY;JINING POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Power data center station network fault diagnosis method based on dependent network model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power data center station network fault diagnosis method based on a dependent network model, which comprises the following steps: constructing a cascading failure model of a power data center station dependent network according to log information of terminal equipment accessing the power data center station; calculating initial load and capacity of each side in the network, simulating a random network fault and updating a network state, calculating current load of each side in the updated network, and deleting the side from the network if the current load is larger than the capacity of the side; repeating the state updating, the load calculating and the deleting until all sides in the power data middle station network meet the capacity that the current load is smaller than or equal to the sides, or all nodes in the network are isolated nodes; and calculating the current network model function value, and giving a quantized research and judgment result. The invention is oriented to complex power data center station scenes, captures and acquires the real-time change of the node state through the modeling of the dependent network model, and effectively supports the state sensing and fault analysis of the node state.
assignees: INFORMATION COMMUNICATION BRANCH STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Method for realizing multi-channel data acquisition of earthquake waves and sound waves by network remote control
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for realizing multi-channel data acquisition of earthquake waves and sound waves by network remote control, which comprises the steps of adopting a high-sensitivity sound wave sensor array to acquire sound wave signals of all directions and multiple angles in a target area, establishing a sound wave signal propagation attenuation model according to the physical characteristics of sound wave propagation, carrying out attenuation compensation and amplitude normalization processing on the acquired original sound wave signals, adopting an adaptive filtering algorithm to carry out noise reduction processing on the normalized sound wave signals according to the characteristics of complex background noise, further adopting a wavelet transformation algorithm to carry out time-frequency domain analysis and feature extraction on weak signals on the basis of adaptive filtering noise reduction, adopting a time-frequency domain joint analysis method to further verify the authenticity of the signals for the identified suspected target signals, and carrying out positioning and parameter estimation on the confirmed target signals according to the results of signal identification and verification to acquire key parameter information of the signals.
assignees: ZHONGZHEN HUACHUANG SHENZHEN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power equipment operation state prediction and anomaly simulation method based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power equipment operation state prediction and abnormal simulation method based on digital twinning, and relates to the technical field of power grid operation. According to the method, the prediction and abnormal simulation of the running state of the power equipment are realized by establishing a digital twin model and real-time data analysis of the power equipment. The method comprises the steps of constructing a digital twin model by analyzing the physical structure, the operation characteristics and the load distribution of the power equipment, performing multidimensional analysis on real-time data by utilizing edge calculation, extracting electrical characteristics and behavior patterns, generating an equipment state data set, constructing an abnormal causal chain model based on the model and the data set, identifying a fault mode caused by uneven load or overload, and evaluating the influence of the abnormal state on the stability and the efficiency of the power system through virtual simulation and fault propagation analysis to obtain an abnormal influence index of the power equipment. The accuracy of power equipment fault prediction is improved, the stability and efficiency of a power system are optimized, and support is provided for intelligent operation and fault early warning.
assignees: BEIJING ZHIDAKE INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Post-disaster coupling recovery analysis method for urban infrastructure system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a post-disaster coupling restoration analysis method for an urban infrastructure system, which comprises four parts, namely disaster analysis modeling, structural damage analysis, functional loss estimation and functional restoration prediction, wherein after a disaster happens, a load model with time space variability and correlation in an urban scale range is established by using a random field theory, the damage states of all monomers and infrastructure system subcomponents of an urban building community under the action of random loads are calculated based on the established load model, then a system theory method is used for researching the cascade effect generated by functional coupling between the urban building community and all types of infrastructures, the functional loss of the building community and the infrastructure system is evaluated, and finally the post-disaster restoration time and restoration tracks of all infrastructure systems are predicted; the method realizes the quantitative analysis of the post-disaster functional loss and recovery process of the urban infrastructure system, is a key step of quantitative evaluation of the toughness city, and can provide a theoretical basis for developing a decision model for improving the toughness of the city.

title_en: Three-dimensional geoelectromagnetic forward modeling method for pre-training model cyclic transfer learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional geomagnetic forward modeling method for pre-training model cyclic transfer learning, which solves the problem of time consuming forward modeling in the prior art and comprises the following steps: randomly generating a three-dimensional ground model; forward computing is carried out on the three-dimensional ground model to obtain three-dimensional forward response data; constructing a three-dimensional deep learning network for extracting self-attention mechanism features; inputting training sample pairs into a three-dimensional deep learning network extracted from self-attention mechanism features, adopting cyclic sharing network weights, combining three-dimensional forward modeling response data of any parameter in any polarization direction, adopting back propagation to calculate gradients, and updating parameters of the three-dimensional deep learning network through an optimizer; establishing nonlinear mapping between the three-dimensional ground model and three-dimensional forward response data of any parameter of any polarization direction to obtain a trained three-dimensional deep learning network; and inputting the verification sample pair into the trained three-dimensional deep learning network to obtain three-dimensional geoelectromagnetic forward data.

title_en: Potential landslide identification method and system based on surface deformation cause analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a potential landslide identification method and system based on ground surface deformation cause analysis, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining radar data and preprocessing to obtain ground surface deformation phase data, constructing and training IDANet-1 networks, predicting to obtain ground surface deformation abnormal areas, respectively processing terrain DEM data, multi-time-phase MODIS data and optical image data to obtain ground surface subsidence type, glacier snow melting type and mine subsidence type ground surface deformation areas, performing difference set operation on the ground surface subsidence type ground surface deformation areas after collecting operation to obtain a landslide type ground surface deformation target, training IDANet-2 networks by using a landslide type ground surface deformation identification data set, and inputting wide area comprehensive remote sensing data into a IDANet-2 network model for reasoning to obtain wide area potential landslide hidden danger distribution information. According to the technical scheme, multi-layer cascade connection of multi-source multi-mode remote sensing data is realized, the ground deformation information is accurately identified, and the identification efficiency of potential landslide hidden danger in a large area is effectively improved.

title_en: Hydraulic engineering full life cycle management system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydraulic engineering full life cycle management system, which comprises a model construction module, a high-order potential energy encoder module, a tensor coupling dynamic propagation module, a potential energy trend predictor module, a risk assessment module, a feedback adjustment module, a decision support module and a model training and optimizing module, wherein the model construction module is used for constructing a tensor potential energy evolution network model, the high-order potential energy encoder module is used for generating potential energy representation of a current life cycle stage, the tensor coupling dynamic propagation module is used for capturing time sequence and space dependency relationship and generating a hidden state tensor, the potential energy trend predictor module is used for generating a potential energy predicted value at the next moment, the risk assessment module is used for triggering risk early warning and generating a risk grade, the feedback adjustment module is used for dynamically adjusting a risk threshold and tensor potential energy evolution network model parameters, the decision support module is used for providing an emergency response and resource optimizing scheme, and the model training and optimizing module is used for optimizing tensor potential energy evolution network model parameters. According to the invention, dynamic monitoring, risk prediction and early warning of hydraulic engineering are realized through the tensor potential energy evolution network model, and the management safety and accuracy are improved.

title_en: System for Alarm Broadcasting of Indoor and Method thereof
title_ko: 옥내용 경보 방송 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 유선통신과 DMB 방송으로 이중화된 매체를 이용하여 경보신호를 수신한 후, 이에 따른 경보 상황을 건물 내 사람들에게 전달하는 옥내용 경보 방송 시스템 및 그 방법에 관한 것으로, 외부의 경보신호를 수신받는 경보신호수신부 및 상기 경보신호수신부를 통해 수신된 경보신호를 분석하여 유효성 판단과 중복성 판단의 검증과정을 거친 후, 유효한 경보신호라고 판단되면 상기 수신된 경보신호를 미리 설정된 수행 시나리오에 따라 건물 내부로 알리도록 하는 메인제어부를 포함하여 구성된다. 
본 발명의 옥내용 경보 방송 시스템 및 그 방법에 따르면, 기존방식의 경보 전파에 음영지역으로 존재하던 건물 내 거주민들에게 경보상황을 전파하기 위한 옥내 경보 방송수신기를 설치하고, 건물 내에 구비하고 있는 옥내 비상 방송설비나 구내 방송시설을 이용하여 거주민들에게 경보상황을 전달함으로써, 경보상황에 대하여 능동적인 대처를 할 수 있도록 하여 인명피해와 재산 손실을 줄이거나 방지하는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Power distributing board having system for sensing and checking deterioration of electrical equipment insulator
title_ko: 전기설비의 절연물 특성 열화 감시 및 진단 시스템을 내장한 수배전반
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a switchgear having an insulation object feature deterioration monitoring and diagnosing system of an electrical facility embedded therein. The switchgear comprises: a detection unit comprising an ultraviolet detection sensor, an ultrasonic detection sensor, and a helical antenna; a photographing unit made of a plurality of cameras; a first operation unit generating first deterioration information of internal devices; a second operation unit generating second deterioration information of the internal devices; and a determination unit that determines deterioration of an insulation object of the internal devices. Therefore, the switchgear can quickly respond to an emergency situation in which an electrical facility abnormality occurs.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 전기설비의 절연물 특성 열화 감시 및 진단 시스템을 내장한 수배전반이고, 상기 전기설비의 절연물 특성 열화 감시 및 진단 시스템은, 수배전반 내부기기들의 절연물의 열화에 의하여 발생되는 자외선을 검출하는 자외선 감지센서와, 수배전반 내부기기들의 절연물의 열화에 의하여 발생되는 초음파를 감지하는 초음파 감지센서와, 수배전반 내부기기들의 절연물의 열화에 의하여 발생되는 전파를 감지하는 헬리컬 안테나로 구성되고, 수배전반 내부에서 발생되는 자외선, 초음파 및 전파 발생량에 따라 전기신호를 발생시키는 검출부; 복수 개의 카메라로 구성되어 상기 수배전반 내부기기들의 절연물을 포함하는 절연물 이미지를 촬영하는 촬영부; 상기 검출부에서 검출된 전기신호를 연속적으로 공급받아, 이를 기초로 생성되는 열화상태 변화율값 및 열화상태 변화누적값을 연산하며, 상기 열화상태 변화율값 및 열화상태 변화누적 값을 이용하여 상기 검출부에 의하여 검출된 내부기기들의 제1 열화정보를 생성하는 제1 연산부; 상기 절연물 이미지에 포함된 절연물 영역에 대하여 픽셀 당 RGB (Red Green Blue) 값을 확인하고, 픽셀당 RGB 값에서의 R 색상, G 색상 및 B 색상 간의 관계를 이용하여 내부기기들의 제2 열화정보를 생성하는 제2 연산부; 및 상기 제1 열화정보 및 제2 열화정보와 기준 열화정보를 비교하고, 비교 결과를 기초로 소정의 열화판정 알고리즘에 의하여 내부기기들의 절연물의 열화를 판정하는 판정부를 포함하여 구성되는 전기설비의 절연물 특성 열화 감시 및 진단 시스템을 내장한 수배전반에 관한 것으로, 수배전반의 열화에 따른 자외선, 초음파, 전파 및 온도 정보 등을 종합적으로 감지하여 검출하고, 신뢰성, 실용성 및 경제성이 있는 열화감시 및 진단방법을 통해 전기설비 이상 발생 시 긴급상황에 신속하게 대처할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: A kind of information physical emerging system vulnerability assessment method under cascading failure mode
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of information physical emerging system vulnerability assessment methods under cascading failure mode, include the following steps: S1, according to Complex Networks Theory, establish information layer model and physical layer model；S2, according to information layer model and physical layer model, the dependence of Information Level and physical layer is modeled using interdependent theory, obtains coupling model；S3, according to coupling model, electric power CPS cascading failure is modeled using seepage theory, whole surviving nodes of output coupling model；S4, vulnerability assessment index is established, and according to the surviving node of vulnerability assessment index and coupling model, the fragility of electric power CPS is assessed；The present invention solves the problems, such as that step of the existing technology is complicated, validity is low, practicability is low and lacks versatility, avoids the serious consequence of power loss, causes huge economic loss and social influence.
assignees: INFORMATION & TELECOMMUNICATION COMPANY STATE GRID SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: A kind of depth calculation model for Fault Diagnosis of Aircraft Engine Gas Path
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of depth calculation models for Fault Diagnosis of Aircraft Engine Gas Path, belong to field of computer technology, include the following steps: that (1) is split pretreatment to continuous boat volatility data；(2) space characteristics of data object block are extracted using convolutional neural networks；(3) the local nonlinearity feature in multi-layer perception (MLP) learning data object block is utilized；(4) using Recognition with Recurrent Neural Network extract data object block in it is long when dependence characteristics；(5) using method, i.e. joint error back-propagation algorithm end to end, training depth mixed model.The present invention implements the characteristics of considering aero-engine model, merge the spatial character of gas circuit performance data of its generation, nonlinear characteristic and it is long when dependency characteristic, construct the road fault diagnosis model of getting angry that navigates, and using classification task as target, devises joint error back-propagation algorithm and trained end to end for depth mixed model.

title_en: Method and system for determining optimal energy distribution strategy of traffic network layer
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for determining an optimal energy distribution strategy of a traffic network layer, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining basic parameters of a high-ratio electric automobile traffic power basic coupling complex network graph model; establishing a coupling complex network visual topological graph model; constructing and updating an adjacency matrix of an undirected graph, an adjacency matrix of a directed graph, an adjacency matrix of a three-dimensional graph, a side maximum capacity matrix and a node maximum storage energy value matrix; calculating traditional complex network indexes based on a topological structure; calculating a mixed complex network index based on energy flow characteristics and a topological structure; constructing a power grid attack fault simulator based on the high and low dynamics based on the traditional complex network index and the mixed complex network index; and verifying by adopting the fault simulator according to the traffic network layer energy distribution strategy to obtain the traffic network layer energy optimal distribution strategy. The method can reduce the risks of road congestion, power grid congestion and cascading faults, and enables the charging station to be more reasonable in planning.

title_en: Dynamic network analysis-based micro-grid disturbance propagation dynamics modeling method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic network analysis-based modeling method for micro-grid disturbance propagation dynamics, which specifically comprises the following steps: 1) acquiring and preprocessing real-time meteorological and electric energy quality data of a microgrid; 2) estimating the running state of the micro-grid with measurement uncertainty; 3) sorting key nodes of the microgrid; 4) perturbation space-time distribution of the micro-grid; according to the method, the micro-grid operation data is subjected to state estimation by adopting a micro-grid operation state estimation method of content measurement uncertainty, so that the accuracy of obtaining internal operation information of the micro-grid system and sensing the operation state is improved; evaluating the susceptibility degree of electrical nodes in the system under the current operation condition by adopting a disturbed microgrid key node sorting method based on a structure hole theory and ListNet; on the basis, based on a structural perturbation and mutation dynamic network analysis method, the interaction mode and strength among nodes in the microgrid network are objectively mapped.

title_en: Complex power grid priority protection set determination method fusing associated structure holes
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for determining a priority protection set of a complex power grid fusing associated structure holes, which comprises the following steps: s1: acquiring data information of a power system; s2: constructing a self-dual bipartite graph; s3: establishing a fault line breaking model; s4: calculating a disconnection sensitive factor; s5: calculating an improved betweenness centrality index; s6: calculating the characteristic index of the associated structure hole; s7: calculating the improved betweenness centrality index after normalization; s8: calculating the normalized associated structure hole characteristic index; s9: calculating a distribution weight coefficient; s10: compute node v i The comprehensive index of (a) is fragile potential energy; s11: compute node v i+1 The comprehensive index of (a) is fragile potential energy; s12: computing the comprehensiveness of all nodesThe index is fragile potential energy; s13: arranging the fragile potential energy in a descending order to obtain a priority protection set; the method can effectively identify the fragile line of the power grid, solve the problem of relevance between power transmission lines after the power grid fault occurs, and reduce the occurrence probability of cascading faults.

title_en: Evolution optimization method for gas pipe network regulation and control scheme
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evolutionary optimization of a gas pipe network regulation and control scheme, which aims to optimize gas supply ratio of each pressure regulating station on the premise of meeting the load demand of a gas pipe network, sets the maximum value of the individual number of a population as N, randomly selects the gas supply ratios of the pressure regulating stations of two feasible schemes as chromosomes, and performs cross/variation calculation on the chromosomes until N offspring are generated to form the population, thereby completing the first generation evolutionary reproduction; selecting two optimal individuals from the population as chromosomes through an evaluation function, and performing cross/variation calculation again until N offspring are generated to form the population, thereby completing the second generation evolution and propagation; and carrying out multi-generation evolution and propagation according to the method until the algorithm is converged, wherein the optimal individual in the final generation of population is the optimal solution of the air supply ratio of each pressure regulating station. And optimizing the regulation and control scheme by taking the optimal solution as a target, and providing required key capacity for intelligent regulation and control and safe and high-quality gas supply of the gas pipe network.
assignees: BEIJING AEROSPACE TOPOLOGY HIGH TECH LTD RESPONSIBILITY COMPANY

title_en: Transmission monitoring system for intelligent substation relay protection overhaul test
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power system automation, in particular to an intelligent substation relay protection overhaul test transmission monitoring system. According to the invention, through the application of an information gain algorithm and a Gini coefficient, the accuracy of fault mode identification is enhanced, the combination of a random forest algorithm and a cyclic neural network improves the accuracy of equipment state prediction, the dynamic threshold adjustment of a Q learning and fuzzy logic algorithm improves the sensitivity of fault prediction, the network analysis of a graph theory algorithm improves the identification efficiency of equipment and fault propagation paths, the decision optimization of a system dynamics model and Monte Carlo simulation ensures the scientificity of maintenance strategies and the effectiveness of emergency response, and the application of a linear programming and network flow analysis method improves the overhaul test efficiency.
assignees: XUANCHENG POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Photovoltaic network topology automatic modeling method, system, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photovoltaic network topology automatic modeling method, a system, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: detecting ground point cloud data, and extracting point cloud data from which interference data are removed; clustering the point cloud data by adopting an improved neighbor propagation algorithm to obtain multi-source data; adopting an improved D-S algorithm to fuse clustered multi-source data; performing interconversion and phase identification; according to the fusion result and the phase identification result, carrying out dynamic evolution of the distributed photovoltaic network topology model to complete model construction; the invention can make topology modeling finer and more accurate and more close to the change condition of the actual network.
assignees: NANJING NARI INFORMATION COMM TECH CO LTD;STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID JILIN ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO;STATE GRID JILIN ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Regional comprehensive energy system optimal scheduling method
abstract_en: An optimization scheduling method of a regional comprehensive energy system comprises the following steps: constructing an area comprehensive energy system operation communication framework based on cloud management side ends; establishing a double-layer distributed scheduling model of an area comprehensive energy system considering waste heat recovery based on a ladder-type carbon transaction mechanism, establishing an optimized scheduling model aiming at low carbon and economical efficiency by considering the situation that the area comprehensive energy system participates in demand response and electricity purchasing and selling, and establishing an optimized scheduling model considering waste heat recovery by considering the characteristics of subsystem energy coupling equipment waste heat in a lower layer; and introducing consistency constraint and an augmented Lagrange penalty function, and adopting a target cascade analysis algorithm to realize decoupling of the double-layer model, so as to realize efficient solution in a plurality of iterative processes. According to the invention, the user is guided to participate in the power grid interaction by the method for adjusting the flexible resource output, and the economical efficiency and the low carbon performance of the system operation are improved on the premise of protecting multiparty privacy and benefit appeal.

title_en: Prediction method of internal magnetic field of aluminum electrolysis cell based on physical information network PINN
abstract_en: The invention discloses a prediction method of an internal magnetic field of an aluminum electrolysis cell based on a physical information network PINN, which comprises the following steps of inputting relevant data of a magnetic field to be predicted into a trained PINN model and outputting prediction data, wherein the specific content of constructing the trained PINN model comprises S1, constructing a physical model of an internal magnetic field of a target aluminum electrolysis cell, S2, constructing a PINN model, constructing a loss function according to the physical model of the internal magnetic field of the target aluminum electrolysis cell, calculating physical loss in a reverse propagation process through iterative training and reverse propagation through the loss function, finishing training if preset conditions are met, and obtaining a PINN model for predicting the internal magnetic field of the target, and S3, finishing verification of the PINN model to obtain the trained PINN model.
assignees: INNER MONGOLIA DATANG INT HOHHOT ALUMINUM & POWER CO LTD;UNIV HUNAN

title_en: Power grid cascading failure risk prediction method, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a power grid cascading failure risk prediction method, equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of power system safety. The power grid cascading failure risk prediction method comprises the steps of obtaining voltage or power flow of a target line, determining risk measurement results of the target line at different time phases by adopting risk measurement indexes based on fluctuation of the voltage or the power flow, and determining risk prediction results of the target line by weighting and accumulating the voltage or the power flow at each time phase based on the risk measurement results. When predicting the risk, the method divides the voltage or the power flow into time periods, and weights and accumulates the voltage or the power flow in each time period based on the risk measurement result of the voltage or the power flow in the time period, namely, the contribution degree of the voltage or the power flow data to the line risk is considered in the time dimension and the risk dimension.

title_en: Method for predicting running state of power supply network and related equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power supply networks and discloses a method for predicting the running state of a power supply network and related equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining a vulnerability function of a target node in the power supply network; the method comprises the steps of determining damage conditions of target nodes based on vulnerability functions and exposure degrees of the target nodes, calculating comprehensive reliability measures of the target nodes based on the damage conditions, constructing a probability map model based on the comprehensive reliability measures and relations between the target nodes and adjacent nodes, and predicting operation states of a power supply network based on the probability map model. According to the prediction method, the vulnerability function of the node is determined, and then the damage condition of the node is evaluated by combining the exposure degree of the node. And then, determining the comprehensive reliability measure of the node by using a heuristic search algorithm. The relationships between the nodes are then analyzed to construct a probability map model. And finally, carrying out state reasoning through a belief propagation algorithm, and predicting the running state of the whole power supply network.
assignees: UNIV TSINGHUA;HEFEI INST PUBLIC SAFETY RES TSINGHUA UNIV

title_en: Failure chain quantitative analysis and risk assessment method and system based on multi-level security model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a failure chain quantitative analysis and risk assessment method and system based on a multi-level security model, and aims to solve the defects that accident cause analysis of a complex social technology system is inaccurate and effective verification of a risk assessment result is lacking. The method comprises the steps of systematically constructing a multi-level causal model, extracting a multi-dimensional failure chain (MDFC), quantifying multi-dimensional risks of the MDFC, constructing a directional weighted failure propagation network based on the MDFC, and analyzing structural characteristics of the MDFC to identify key risk factors. The method has the core innovation that the reverse accident cause tracing and the forward risk propagation path analysis based on the weighted network are combined, and mutual verification and iterative optimization are realized by comparing the two path analysis results, so that the understanding of an accident evolution mechanism is deepened, and the reliability of evaluation is improved. The system vulnerability can be more comprehensively disclosed, powerful support is provided for formulating accurate risk control measures, and the overall safety level of a complex system is improved.

title_en: Construction worker adventure behavior propagation simulation method and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a simulation method and a storage medium for the risk taking action of a construction worker, which belong to the field of software of a risk taking action spreading algorithm of the construction worker, and are technically characterized in that S100, input parameters such as an infection rate beta, a recovery rate alpha, an awareness rate gamma, a forgetting rate delta and a control rate kappa, S200, a relation network structure matrix G is determined according to the total number N of the construction worker and the working relation of the worker, S300, initial values of the input parameters are S  1 (0)～S N (0),I 1 (0)～I N (0),R 1 (0)～R N  (0), S400, parameters obtained in S100, S200 and S300 are input into a risk taking action spreading dynamic model of the construction worker based on the relation network structure and SIRS, the parameters are spread on the model, and t-S (t), t-I (t) and t-R (t) curves are output to display the risk spreading process of the construction worker.

title_en: Intelligent fire-fighting-oriented AI driving resource scheduling method and system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of public service data processing, and provides an intelligent fire-fighting oriented AI driving resource scheduling method and system. The method comprises the steps of acquiring first data through an intelligent sensor, carrying out multi-source data fusion, generating a first tensor formed by a space map through a neural network and modeling processing, extracting node characteristics and edge characteristics from the first tensor, carrying out linear transformation on the node characteristics and the edge characteristics based on a learnable weight matrix and an activation function to determine a risk propagation matrix of a fire condition, generating an alternative strategy based on the risk propagation matrix and resource data, minimizing total loss of the alternative strategy to generate a resource allocation strategy, determining a scheduling strategy based on the resource allocation strategy of adjacent areas and a preset inter-area cooperation protocol through Nash equilibrium, and sending a generated scheduling instruction to a target terminal. The accurate prediction of risks is realized through multi-source data fusion and space-time modeling, the fire spreading risks and the emergency response cost are effectively reduced, and the efficiency and the effect of fire-fighting resource scheduling are improved.
assignees: XIAN JIANRONG IND GROUP CO LTD

title_en: System and method for predicting power grid abnormality deduction and evaluating scheduling efficiency in extreme scene
abstract_en: The invention provides a power grid abnormal deduction prediction and scheduling efficiency evaluation method and system in an extreme scene, wherein the method comprises the following steps: S1, acquiring core characteristics of each extreme scene and power grid operation parameters and preprocessing; S2, performing time feature extraction based on preprocessed power grid operation parameters, converting the current power grid topology into a graph structure based on graph theory, performing space feature extraction according to the power grid topology graph structure, fusing the extracted time feature vector and the space feature vector to obtain a fused multi-mode feature vector, S3, performing deduction prediction on the abnormal probability of the power grid in the extreme scene by taking the multi-mode feature vector and the extreme scene core feature vector as input of an abnormal deduction prediction model, and S4, constructing an evaluation dimension and index system and dynamically evaluating the dispatching efficiency of the power grid in the extreme scene. The invention reduces the prediction deviation of the extreme scene and remarkably improves the capability of predicting cascading failures under disasters such as typhoons, ice disasters and the like.
assignees: STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Individualized water and fertilizer application decision-making method for potted flower planting
abstract_en: The invention provides a potted flower planting personalized water and fertilizer application decision method, which comprises the steps of acquiring key physiological and environmental parameters of plants through multi-mode non-invasive sensing, constructing a five-dimensional observation tensor aligned in time and space, performing noise suppression, sampling frequency normalization and feature standardization on multi-source data to generate a multi-dimensional state feature sequence, constructing a multi-dimensional health risk propagation chart based on the multi-dimensional state feature sequence, performing evolution deduction on a risk path by utilizing a graph neural network and a space-time attention mechanism to realize precise spatial positioning and time prediction of health crisis, combining historical response characteristics and a risk mode, generating a personalized water and fertilizer adjustment instruction by adopting a meta-learning strategy, and performing early warning, dynamic adjustment efficiency and personalized adaptability of strategies on the health risks of the plants by continuously feeding back optimized threshold values and adjustment parameters.
assignees: GUANGZHOU HUIXING AGRICULTURAL DEV CO LTD

title_en: Apparatus, system and control method for people counting
title_ko: 피플카운팅 장치, 시스템 및 제어방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a people counting apparatus and a system and control method thereof and, more specifically, to a people counting apparatus including a lighting function and a disaster detection function, and a system and control method thereof. According to the present invention, the people counting apparatus detects a counting target passing a detection area and determines whether the counting target is a person to generate information about the number of counted persons, thereby counting the number of people passing the detection area. The people counting apparatus provides the lighting function lighting a predetermined range including the detection area. The people counting apparatus transmits the information on the number of people counted on the basis of an ad-hook network to other nodes or gateways, thereby facilitating installation and operation regardless of indoor or outdoor. The people counting apparatus provides a disaster detection function to detect occurrence of disaster situations such as building collapses, earthquakes, fires, and gas leaks and is configured to supply auxiliary power when operating power supply is cut off or the disaster situation is detected, thereby propagating information about a disaster situation or a rescue target even when operating power is cut off due to a disaster. The people counting apparatus comprises a sensing unit, a lighting unit, a control unit, and a communication unit.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 피플카운팅 장치, 시스템 및 제어방법에 관한 것으로, 구체적으로는 조명 기능과 재난 감지 기능을 구비하는 피플카운팅 장치, 시스템 및 제어방법에 관한 것이다. 
또한, 본 발명은 감지 영역을 지나는 카운팅 대상을 감지하고 카운팅 대상이 사람인지 판정하여 카운팅된 사람의 수에 대한 정보를 생성함으로써, 감지 영역을 지나는 사람의 수를 카운팅할 수 있고, 감지 영역을 포함하는 소정의 범위에 빛을 비추는 조명 기능을 제공하며, 애드훅 네트워크를 기반으로 카운팅된 사람의 수에 대한 정보를 타 노드 또는 게이트웨이에 송신하도록 구비됨으로써, 실내나 실외의 구분없이 설치 및 운용이 용이하며, 건물 붕괴, 지진, 화재 및 가스 누출을 포함하는 재난 상황의 발생 여부를 감지하는 재난 감지 기능을 제공하며, 동작 전원 공급이 차단되거나 재난 상황이 감지되는 경우 보조 전원을 공급하도록 구비됨으로써, 재난으로 인해 동작 전원이 차단된 상황에서도 재난 상황이나 구조 대상에 대한 정보의 전파가 가능하다.
assignees: CHEJU HALLA COLLEGE IND ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION

title_en: Inertial monitoring system of the power system and operating method for the same
title_ko: 전력 계통 관성 감시 시스템 및 그에 따른 운영방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an inertial monitoring system of a power system and an operating method thereof, and particularly, provides an inertial monitoring system of a power system comprises: a power generation and transmission system; a power control system which controls the power generation and transmission system; a power system data processing module which receives various data generated on the power network of the power generation and transmission system and provides power system information including generator information such as generator operation status, facility capacity, and output to the power control system; and a system inertia monitoring module which receives power system information including generator information such as generator operation status, facility capacity, and output and inertia index data from the power system data processing module, determines the necessity of reserve power, calculates the total amount of required reserve power, and provides the same to the power control system, and an operating method thereof. Therefore, the inertial monitoring system of a power system uses power system data to calculate system inertia and critical inertia in real time, and manages frequency stability using the results, in order to improve the reliability of the power system and prevent large-scale power system chain failures and load shedding by under-frequency relays (UFRs) and other wide-area blackouts.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 전력 계통 관성 감시 시스템과 그 운영방법에 관한 것으로 특히, 발전 및 송전 시스템과; 상기 발전 및 송전 시스템을 제어하는 전력제어 시스템과; 상기 발전 및 송전 시스템의 전력 네트워크상에서 발생되는 각종의 데이터를 수신하여 상기 전력제어 시스템측에 발전기 운전상태, 설비용량, 출력량 등 발전기 정보를 포함한 전력계통의 정보를 제공하는 전력계통 데이터처리모듈; 및 상기 전력계통 데이터처리모듈로부터 발전기 운전상태, 설비용량, 출력량 등 발전기 정보를 포함한 전력계통의 정보들과 관성지수 데이터를 입력받아 예비력의 필요성을 판단하고 필요예비력의 총량등을 연산하여 이를 상기 전력제어 시스템 측에 제공하는 계통관성 감시모듈을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 전력 계통 관성 감시 시스템과 그에따른 운영방법을 제공하여, 전력계통의 신뢰도를 향상시키고 대규모 발전기 연쇄 고장 및 저주파수계전기(Under Frequency Relay: UFR)에 의한 부하차단 예방 등 광역정전을 예방하기 위하여 전력계통 데이터를 이용하여 실시간적으로 계통 관성 및 임계 관성을 연산하고, 그 결과를 이용하여 주파수안정도를 관리할 수 있도록 한다.

title_en: Smoke control system with adjustable neutral zone position
title_ko: 중성대 위치조절형 제연시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smoke control system with an adjustable neutral zone position. The smoke control system includes: an upper damper installed on a path connecting a vertical shaft with outside air on an upper side; a lower damper installed on a path connecting the vertical shaft with the outside air on a lower side; a differential pressure measuring sensor measuring differential pressure between the vertical shaft and the outside air; and a control part separately controlling opening rates of the upper damper and the lower damper such that the pressure of the vertical shaft located at the same height as a fire floor becomes positive pressure using the measurement value of the differential pressure measuring sensor in the event of a fire. Therefore, smoke from the fire floor can be displayed to the outside air, and, in accordance with the composition, without applying an intake/exhaust mechanism of an air blower to a building, the spread of smoke to the other floors can be prevented due to a smoke chimney effect at a low cost, and, as a result, a smoke control system can be created at a lower cost than a pressure smoke control facility using an air blower.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 중성대 위치조절형 제연시스템에 관한 것으로서, 그 구성은, 상측의 수직샤프트와 외기를 연결하는 경로 상에 설치되는 상부댐퍼; 하측의 상기 수직샤프트와 외기를 연결하는 경로 상에 설치되는 하부댐퍼; 상기 수직샤프트와 외기 사이의 차압을 측정하는 차압측정센서; 및 화재 발생시 상기 차압측정센서의 측정값을 이용하여 화재층과 동일한 높이에 위치한 상기 수직샤프트의 압력이 양압이 되도록 상기 상부댐퍼 및 상기 하부댐퍼의 개도율을 각각 조절하도록 제어하는 제어부;를 포함하여, 상기 화재층의 연기가 외기로 배출되도록 하며, 상기의 구성에 따르면, 건축물에 송풍기의 급배기 방식을 적용하지 않고, 저비용으로 연돌 효과로 인한 연기의 타층 전파 방지를 할 수 있어, 송풍기를 이용한 가압 제연설비에 비해 저비용으로 제연시스템을 구현할 수 있다.

title_en: Method for reconstructing running track of main road vehicle based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for reconstructing a running track of a main road vehicle based on multi-source data fusion. The method aims to comprehensively and accurately reproduce the time-space distribution and the evolution rule of the main road traffic state, so that the estimation and prediction precision of the traffic state parameters is improved, and the signal control benefit is improved. Based on the variational theory of three-dimensional shock waves, firstly, estimating the slopes of a forward arc and a backward arc by adopting fixed-point detector data, and establishing an initial artery space-time network diagram; secondly, estimating a queuing propagation curve profile by fusing floating car data and signal timing data; and finally, reconstructing a complete running track of the vehicle based on a shortest-path algorithm under the constraints of three dimensions of the floating vehicle track, the queuing boundary and the signal timing. The method solves the technical problems that the vehicle running track is difficult to accurately estimate in the current congestion state and the research based on the sampling track data has high permeability requirement at present.

title_en: Daily power load prediction method and prediction device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a daily power load prediction method and a prediction device, belonging to the field of short-term load prediction of a power system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: sampling S ephemeris history load data to obtain S first load sequences at any tth moment in a day to be predicted; normalizing the first load sequence, and obtaining a target load sequence of each day in S days from a normalization result; respectively obtaining effective influence factor sequences of each day in S days and the day to be predicted and normalizing; the target load sequence and the normalized effective influence factor sequence are used as input, and a trained daily power load prediction model is used for predicting a load value at the t-th moment in the day to be predicted; the daily power load prediction model comprises a cascaded composite network and a second RBF neural network, wherein the composite network is formed by an ELMAN neural network, a BP neural network and a first RBF neural network in parallel. The invention can improve the prediction precision and the data utilization efficiency of the daily load of the power system.

title_en: Multi-beam feed network design method based on 180-degree directional coupler
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-beam feed network design method based on a 180-degree directional coupler, which comprises the following steps: s1: according to the requirements of application scenes, executing a feed network structure design scheme to obtain a feed network cascade structure; s2: executing a device optimization design scheme according to the feed network cascade structure to obtain an optimization result; s3: determining the power distribution ratio of the 180-degree directional coupler according to the optimization result; s4: obtaining the specific structure of the 180-degree directional coupler according to the power distribution ratio; s5: and cascading a plurality of 180-degree directional couplers to obtain a final comprehensive multi-beam feed network. The method for designing the multi-beam feed network based on the 180-degree directional coupler can solve the technical problem that the existing multi-beam feed network cannot simultaneously consider the number of network ports and the beam forming requirement.

title_en: Robust optimization scheduling method, device, equipment and medium for gradient water-light complementary distribution
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of optimal scheduling of a multi-energy complementary power generation system, in particular to a robust optimal scheduling method, device, equipment and medium for cascade water-light complementary distribution, which comprises the following steps: taking peak-valley difference of a receiving end power grid, minimum hydropower intra-day adjustment power and minimum light rejection into consideration, and establishing an objective function of a step water-light complementation two-stage distribution robust model before and in the day; establishing two-stage constraint conditions of a day-ahead stage and a day-in stage; based on a data driving method, establishing a confidence set considering 1-norm and ++norm constraint uncertainty probability distribution; based on piecewise linearization and McCormick relaxation, converting the distributed robust model into a mixed integer linear programming model; and solving the mixed integer linear programming model by adopting a column and constraint generation algorithm to obtain the gradient water-light complementary distribution robust optimization scheduling method. According to the invention, the peak shaving capacity of complementary operation can be improved, and the operation risk caused by uncertainty of photovoltaic output prediction can be reduced.

title_en: Power distribution network measurement data super-resolution sensing method based on transfer learning
abstract_en: The application relates to a power distribution network measurement data super-resolution sensing method based on transfer learning. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a high-frequency time sequence, preprocessing to obtain training sample data, constructing a cascade model based on a graph attention network and a transducer network, inputting the training sample data and an incidence matrix into the cascade model, pre-training the cascade model, enabling the incidence matrix to represent a topological connection relation of a power distribution network, dividing the pre-trained cascade model into a learner part and a decision maker part, performing migration learning training, and reserving model parameters reaching a training target to obtain a final super-resolution perception model, wherein the learner part comprises all layers except the linear output layer of the transducer, the decision maker part comprises the linear output layer of the transducer, and inputting real-time measurement data into the super-resolution perception model to obtain a super-resolution measurement generation result.

title_en: Betweennesss algorithm-based local energy shortage risk cascade effect evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for evaluating a local energy shortage risk cascade effect based on a Betweennesss algorithm, and relates to the field of energy resource management, wherein the method comprises the following steps of S1, obtaining energy pressure indexes of all areas and energy dependency of all departments, calculating according to the energy pressure indexes to obtain energy shortage probability, and calculating according to the energy shortage probability and the energy dependency of all departments to obtain initial energy shortage risk; S2, combining the initial energy shortage risk with a multi-region input-output model to construct a virtual energy shortage risk transmission network, and S3, evaluating and identifying key transmission nodes of the local energy shortage risk cascade effect in the virtual energy shortage risk transmission network based on Betweenness algorithm. The method has the advantages of wide application range and high calculation mode, fills the blank of the prior research, and can provide effective method and data support for improving the toughness of the trade network for coping with the energy shortage risk.

title_en: A system that shares image with location of fire place and position of fire extinguisher when a fire occurs
title_ko: 화재시 발생장소 및 소방기구의 위치 및 영상을 공유하는 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for sharing a position and an image of an occurrence place and a fire extinguisher when a fire occurs capable of quickly taking an initial action against fire occurrence. According to the present invention, the system comprises: a user device held by members in a large-scale industrial facility, operated by execution of user operation of a first finder to propagate fire occurrence situation information when a fire occurs, and enabling each member to share the propagated fire occurrence situation information with each other; and a service control server receiving the fire occurrence situation information of the first finder to provide fire occurrence position information and map information including location information of a fire facility based on location information of the user device of the first finder.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 화재시 발생장소 및 소방기구의 위치 및 영상을 공유하는 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 보다 구체적으로는 화재시 발생장소 및 소방기구의 위치 및 영상을 공유하는 시스템으로서, 대규모 공장이나 여러 개의 구획으로 구성되는 대규모 산업시설에서의 구성원들이 휴대하며, 화재발생 시에 최초 발견자의 사용자 조작 실행에 따라 구동되어 화재발생 상황 정보를 전파하고, 각 구성원들이 전파되는 화재발생 상황 정보를 공유하는 사용자 디바이스; 및 상기 사용자 디바이스와 무선통신 방식으로 연동하며, 최초 발견자의 화재발생 상황 정보를 수신하여 그에 대응하는 화재발생 초기 대응이 가능하도록 화재발생 최초 발견자의 사용자 디바이스의 위치 정보에 기초한 화재발생 위치 정보와 소방시설의 위치 정보가 포함된 맵 정보를 제공하는 서비스 관제서버를 포함하는 것을 그 구성상의 특징으로 한다. 
본 발명에서 제안하고 있는 화재시 발생장소 및 소방기구의 위치 및 영상을 공유하는 시스템에 따르면, 대규모 산업시설의 구성원들이 휴대하는 사용자 디바이스를 통해 특정 앱을 실행하는 상태에서, 화재발생을 최초 발견한 구성원이 화재발생 사실을 나머지 구성원들과 공유할 수 있도록 구성함으로써, 대규모 산업시설에서 발생되는 화재발생에 대한 신속한 초기대응이 가능하고, 그에 따른 화재 확산을 막아 2차적인 인명 및 재산 피해가 최소화될 수 있도록 할 수 있다. 
또한, 본 발명에 따르면, 특정 앱을 실행하는 사용자 디바이스들 간에 화재발생을 전파하여 서로 공유하되, 화재발생을 최초 발견하여 전파한 구성원의 사용자 디바이스의 위치 정보를 기반으로 정확한 화재발생 장소와 근처의 소방시설의 위치를 건물의 도면 맵 정보로 제공하고, 그에 따른 화재발생 초기에 성공적인 화재진압 대처가 가능하도록 할 수 있다. 
뿐만 아니라, 본 발명은, 화재 최초 발견자가 특정 앱의 동영상 촬영 및 음성 기능을 이용하여 특정 앱을 공유하는 구성원들이 화재현장으로 도우러 오면서 현장상황을 정확하게 파악하며 올 수 있도록 초기 화재현장을 지속적으로 전파할 수 있도록 할 수 있다.

title_en: Underground coal mine distributed object positioning system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of underground coal mine distributed object positioning systems in mine communication and safety in production field, floor control work station including being set to ground, underground location computer, underground interchanger, optical fiber, bus, reference mode, destination node, the power supply of underground coal mine scene is mainly solved by requirement of explosion proof, cable laying, the limitation such as tunnel condition, the problem of bringing inconvenience to the power supply of mine position computer, the utility model is by introducing distributed frame in traditional mine positioning system, so that the function of position computer moves down and is distributed across underground, improve the timeliness of positioning system, propagation delay time caused by reducing because of transmission network congestion, system emergency rescue efficiency and anti-interference ability can under equal conditions be significantly improved, greatly simplify Distributed localization computer time complexity, reduce energy Consumption, more conducively practical application of the object locating system in underground coal mine.

title_en: Urban well lid anti-theft monitoring method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to an urban well lid anti-theft monitoring method and device, and belongs to the technical field of monitoring of the municipal industry. According to the technical scheme, the urban well lid anti-theft monitoring device comprises a remote monitoring upper computer (1), a main monitor (2), slave monitors (3) and well lid monitors (4), wherein the main monitor and the slave monitors are connected through in-situ wireless networks; the slave monitors and the well lid monitors are connected through in-situ wireless networks; the remote monitoring upper computer and the main monitor are connected through the wireless or wired network. The slave monitors transmit all monitored information of all well lid monitors to the main monitor in a cascading mode, the main monitor transmits the information to the remote monitoring upper computer through the remote network, and the monitoring information of well lids is obtained. The urban well lid anti-theft monitoring method and device have the advantages that whether an urban road well lid is lost or not is known in time, the remedial measure is taken in time, and casualties and vehicle and property losses are reduced.

title_en: Reservoir water level prediction method based on cyclic neural network and attention mechanism
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of reservoir operation control, and discloses a reservoir water level prediction method based on a recurrent neural network and an attention mechanism, which comprises the following steps: collecting flow and water level data to form a data set, and classifying the data set; converting the water level and flow values of the data set to obtain a standard data set; constructing a cyclic neural network model with an attention mechanism, and defining a target function; selecting data of a standard data set to train the recurrent neural network model; verifying and testing the trained recurrent neural network model; and predicting the water level of the key section by using the trained recurrent neural network model. The calculation precision of the model can be continuously improved along with the accumulation of the reservoir operation data, the dependence on the accuracy of the boundary condition is low, and the problem of low calculation precision of the traditional hydrodynamic method can be effectively solved; in reservoir flood season scheduling, the key section water level can be accurately predicted, and technical support is provided for flood control and prosperity scheduling decisions of large-scale reservoirs or cascade reservoirs.

title_en: Electric power information physical system modeling method based on alternating current power flow model
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for modeling a power information physical system based on an alternating current power flow model, which is characterized by comprising the following steps of: the method comprises the steps of power network modeling, information network modeling and interaction flow of the power network and the information network, and the modeling of the power information physical system is realized by considering the load flow characteristic of the power network and the monitoring and control function of the information network. Compared with a modeling method based on a complex network theory, the method provided by the invention can better reflect the dynamic characteristics of the power grid, and the optimal economic dispatching algorithm adopted by the information grid not only meets the supply and demand balance of the power system, but also considers the economic operation of the system, can quantitatively reflect the influence of various parameter changes of the power information physical system on the system, and can be widely applied to the fields of safety analysis, cascading failure propagation process, vulnerability assessment and the like of the power information physical system. Has the advantages of scientific and reasonable method, strong applicability, good effect and the like.

title_en: Air conditioner room energy consumption amount prediction method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to an air conditioner room energy consumption prediction method based on deep learning, which comprises the steps of obtaining input parameters of air conditioner room energy consumption, temperature and humidity, building operation business and the like at different time, training and normalizing data through an LSTM network memory model, calculating a minimum loss function by adopting a time back propagation algorithm, updating a weight value, finally repeatedly calculating to obtain an optimal network weight parameter set, obtaining an optimized model, and predicting the air conditioner room energy consumption. The air conditioner room energy consumption amount prediction method based on deep learning has the advantages of improving relevance and accuracy of prediction data, improving training speed, improving use universality and the like.
assignees: SUZHOU INSTITUTE OF BUILDING SCIENCE GROUP COMPANY LTD

title_en: Network selection method and device
abstract_en: A network selection method and device are provided, the method comprises: the terminal equipment receives broadcast messages from non-forbidden PLMNs and broadcast messages from the forbidden PLMNs, wherein the broadcast messages of the forbidden PLMNs comprise disaster occurrence indications, and the disaster occurrence indications are used for indicating the non-forbidden PLMNs to have disasters. And under the condition that the terminal equipment fails to register the non-forbidden PLMN, the terminal equipment requests to register the forbidden PLMN according to the disaster occurrence indication. By adopting the method, the terminal equipment can select the network which ensures normal service, and the service interruption of the terminal equipment caused by the disaster of the non-forbidden PLMN can be effectively reduced.

title_en: Infectious disease propagation model modeling simulation method based on time sequence network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an infectious disease propagation model modeling simulation method based on a time sequence network, which constructs a novel time sequence network model with multiple interaction modes and researches a basic infectious disease propagation process on the model. The invention improves the time sequence network model by distinguishing the interaction mode of the common node and the leader node, considers the situation of many-to-many communication in real life by utilizing the concept of the leader node in the time sequence network model, and combines the time sequence network model with a single-to-single communication, so that the model is more suitable for the operation mechanism of the actual society. Has important guiding significance for controlling the spread of diseases and the negative information transmission.

title_en: Load optimization scheduling method, device, equipment and medium for cascade hydropower station
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, equipment and a medium for optimizing and scheduling load of a cascade hydropower station, wherein the method comprises the following steps: forecasting incoming water of the tap hydropower station and gradually optimizing the power generation process of the tap hydropower station; forecasting the incoming water of the current hydropower station by combining the optimization results of the gradual power generation process of the previous hydropower station, and gradually optimizing the power generation process of the hydropower station according to the respective forecasting results of the incoming water; uploading the optimized results of the gradual power generation process of each stage of hydropower stations to a power grid dispatching center, extracting the cascade load plan, and performing cascade intra-cluster dynamic distribution on the load of each stage of hydropower stations by adopting a coefficient discrimination method according to the real-time operation indexes of each stage of hydropower stations. The invention completes the generation plan making of the cascade hydropower station by the combination of water forecast and water fixed power optimized dispatching, which is more consistent with the operation practice of the hydropower station; on the premise of meeting the step load plan, the generating water heads of all the steps are maintained in a certain range by a coefficient discrimination method, so that the water energy utilization rate is improved.
assignees: DATANG XIANGCHENG TANG ELECTRIC HYDROPOWER DEV CO LTD

title_en: Power system external threat destructive power assessment method based on cascading failure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system external threat destructive power assessment method based on cascading faults, which is characterized in that network attack causes initial faults, load flow calculation is carried out to obtain node voltage and line load flow, if at least one of the node voltage and the line load flow is out of limit, recovery control is carried out, load flow calculation and recovery control are continuously carried out aiming at cascading faults until the faults do not have further evolution risk, and the difference between the initial load quantity and the final load quantity of the system is calculated and is used as an assessment index of the network attack destructive power; and obtaining the expected loss of the power system caused by the faults in the preselected fault set through repeated experiments. The invention can comprehensively consider the fault propagation path and the cumulative effect of faults, and simulate and evaluate the occurrence and the spread of cascading faults, thereby more comprehensively evaluating the damage force of external threat to the power system.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG

title_en: Medium-long term plan typical curve decomposition method applicable to cascade hydropower station with multiple power grid load demands
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for decomposing a typical curve of a medium-long-term plan of a cascade hydropower station, which is suitable for multiple power grid load demands, wherein the method is used for determining a decomposition criterion of the typical curve of the medium-long-term plan of the cascade hydropower station by considering the differentiation condition of different provinces, determining the typical output curves of the different provinces of the different power stations by using a flat peak ratio and Gu Fengbi so as to reduce the dimension of a solving problem, determining the income coefficient of the different provinces of the different power stations according to the differentiation condition of the provinces of each receiving end, and finally solving by using an intelligent optimization algorithm so as to obtain the flat peak ratio and the valley peak ratio of the different provinces of the different power stations so as to obtain the typical decomposition curve of the medium-long-term plan. Through the verification analysis of the cascade power station consisting of 4 huge power stations in a river basin in the southwest area, the invention can obtain a reasonable medium-long term plan decomposition curve of the cascade hydropower station suitable for the load demands of multiple power grids, and can effectively respond to the different peak shaving demands of different receiving end provinces and give consideration to the income of the cascade power station.

title_en: Regional power grid capacity expansion planning method, device and equipment considering hydropower station cooperation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a regional power grid capacity expansion planning method, device and equipment considering hydropower station cooperation, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring unit data of a target regional power grid, wherein the unit data comprises cost data and parameter data; based on the cost data and a preset cost rule, constructing a capacity expansion planning model of the target regional power grid; according to the parameter data and the cascade hydropower station attributes, constraining the capacity expansion planning model to obtain constraint conditions of the capacity expansion planning model; and calculating a capacity expansion planning model based on constraint conditions, and characterizing the obtained calculation result as an optimal configuration strategy of the target regional power grid. The invention can realize the determination of the optimal configuration combination of conventional power generation, energy storage and intermittent renewable energy under the condition of meeting the preset variable new energy permeation target, and effectively reduce the total cost of the water-wind-solar-energy-storage combined power generation system; by considering the time correlation of the natural inflow and the forced outflow of the hydropower station, a high-fidelity rule curve is constructed for the hydropower station.
assignees: LISHUI POWER SUPLY COMPANY STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Power grid operation situation analysis system combined with knowledge graph
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid operation situation analysis system combining a knowledge graph, which relates to the technical field of intelligent power grids and comprises a power grid data acquisition module, a power grid characteristic extraction module, a monitoring information event analysis module, a power grid graph construction module and a power grid event intelligent research and judgment module, wherein the power grid data acquisition module acquires power grid data, the power grid characteristic extraction module extracts characteristics, the monitoring information event analysis module outputs an overhaul label, a fault label, a related equipment list and a fault list, the power grid graph construction module generates a power grid knowledge graph, a fault propagation path and a threshold value are output, and the power grid event intelligent research and judgment module pushes abnormal data and fault information. According to the invention, automatic cleaning, intelligent fault research and judgment and cross-station propagation path analysis of mass monitoring signals are realized through natural language processing and machine learning technologies, so that manual intervention is reduced, fault identification accuracy is improved, grading alarms are pushed in real time, and power grid situation sensing and emergency disposal efficiency is remarkably improved.
assignees: POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL BRANCH OF INNER MONGOLIA POWER GROUP CO LTD;BEIJING YONGSHANG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Nuclear accident risk propagation model based on three-layer coupling network
abstract_en: The nuclear accident risk propagation model based on the three-layer coupling network comprises a three-layer coupling network model and a risk propagation dynamics model, wherein the three-layer coupling network model comprises an RMN layer based on a dynamic Gaussian plume model, an IN layer based on coupling of a traffic network and a communication network and an EN layer comprising four types of nodes, a coupling mechanism comprises an overrun of radiation dose rate IN a grid of the RMN layer, marking of damaged states by nodes at the same position of the IN layer, quantification of two-way dependency density of the IN layer and the EN layer through coupling strength epsilon, and the risk propagation dynamics model adopts a Caputo fractional derivative to construct a risk propagation dynamics model, and comprises a tri-state migration dynamics equation and the dynamic Gaussian plume model. The invention constructs a dynamic interaction system of a physical field-topological network-decision chain, quantifies the function dependency relationship of nodes by using a complex network theory, and describes the memory effect and the critical threshold of risk propagation based on a risk propagation dynamics model.

title_en: Digital twinning-based modeling method for underground pipe network of power grid engineering area
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of digital twinning, and in particular relates to a modeling method of an underground pipe network in a power grid engineering area based on digital twinning, which comprises the steps of initializing a digital twinning model of the underground pipe network, carrying out gridding on the digital twinning model, and calibrating static parameters; the method comprises the steps of carrying out state propagation on particles representing states of grid nodes based on a state transfer equation of a plurality of coupled physical fields to obtain predicted particles, evaluating engineering risk degrees of all the grid nodes, determining the engineering risk degrees based on construction risk coefficients, state uncertainty and safety margin, reallocating the particles according to the engineering risk degrees, fusing heterogeneous sensor data, calculating the weight of the predicted particles, calculating a state optimal estimated value of the grid nodes according to the normalized weight of the predicted particles, and updating the digital twin model. The method and the device realize non-uniform distribution of computing resources to the key areas, and improve model estimation precision and real-time performance of risk early warning.
assignees: State grid shanghai electric power design co ltd

title_en: Unexpcted accident monitoring system
title_ko: 돌발상황 감시 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An unexpected situation monitor system capable of rapidly dealing with the unexpected situation is provided to quickly detect the unexpected situation such as car accident and fire generated in a traffic facility by alarming the unexpected situation. CONSTITUTION: An unexpected situation monitor system(100) capable of rapidly dealing with the unexpected situation comprises an image photographing unit(10), an image distribution unit, an image analysis unit, an alarming unit and an image capturing unit. The image photographing unit photographs the image in an installation region. The image distribution unit receives an image photographed from the image photographing unit. The image distribution unit generates identification information. The alarming unit outputs the unexpected situation alarm.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 교통시설의 일정 구간별로 영상을 촬영하고, 촬영된 영상 내에 존재하는 이동체를 검출 및 식별하며, 식별된 이동체의 움직임 패턴을 분석하여 돌발상황을 검출하며, 돌발상황 검출시 돌발상황 발생 경보를 출력할 수 있도록 하는 돌발상황 감시 시스템에 관한 것으로, 교통시설에 일정 구간별로 설치되어 설치 지역의 영상을 촬영하는 영상 촬영부를 포함하는 돌발상황 감시 시스템에 있어서, 상기 영상 촬영부로부터 촬영된 영상을 수신하여 분배하는 영상 분배부와; 상기 영상 분배부로부터 분배된 영상을 전달받아 영상 내에 존재하는 이동체를 검출하고 검출된 이동체를 식별하여 이동체 식별정보를 생성하며, 식별된 이동체의 움직임을 추적하여 이동체 움직임 패턴 정보를 생성하는 영상 분석부와; 상기 영상 분석부에서 생성된 이동체 식별정보 및 이동체 움직임 패턴 정보를 이용하여 이동체를 인식하고, 인식된 이동체의 움직임을 추적하여 돌발상황 발생 여부를 판단하는 돌발상황 판단부와; 상기 돌발상황 판단부에서 돌발상황이 발생한 것으로 판단하면, 돌발상황 발생 경보를 출력하는 경보 출력부와; 상기 영상 분배부로부터 분배된 영상을 전달받아 이를 디지털 처리하여 디지털 처리된 영상을 실시간 저장하되, 상기 돌발상황 판단부에서 돌발상황이 발생한 것으로 판단하면, 일정 시간 동안 상기 영상 분배부로부터 전달되는 영상을 디지털 처리한 후 고화질 처리하여 저장하는 영상 녹화부를 포함하여 이루어짐으로써, 교량, 철도, 터널 및 도로 등의 교통시설에서 발생하는 차량 사고 및 화재와 같은 돌발상황을 신속·정확하게 검출할 수 있어 돌 발상황에 신속하게 대처할 수 있을 뿐만 아니라, 돌발상황으로 인해 발생할 수 있는 연쇄 사고의 발생을 사전에 예방할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: System for controlling the operation of wireless multicasting systems to distribute an alarm indication to a dynamically configured coverage area
abstract_en: The present Reverse 911 Alarm System implements a central alarm distribution site that is capable of generating an alarm indication to warn individuals of a hazard and propagating the alarm indication to selected individuals via their wireless subscriber devices by the use of wireless multicasting in the existing cellular communication network and/or wireless-based Local Area Networks which are operational in the coverage area of the hazard.
