The central alarm distribution site dynamically selects the wireless coverage area to encompass the present extent of the hazard and can also provide advanced warning to individuals located in an area that extends beyond the present hazard extent area. The present Reverse 911 Alarm System thereby integrates the operation of the wireless communication network with the 911 and Reverse 911 services to provide efficient and comprehensive distribution of alarm indications to the individuals who are impacted by an emergency situation.

title_en: Dynamic Asset Relationship Mapping and Risk Propagation Analysis Using Degree of Connections
abstract_en: A system generates a graph of assets in a network. The system defines connections between assets within the graph. The system identifies a risk event with an associated risk severity. The system determines a number of connections to traverse for generating a risk analysis pathway through the graph of assets in the network based on the associated risk severity associated with the risk event. The system generates a recommendation to address the identified risk.

title_en: Automatic active load adjustment method and system for cascade power station group
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for automatically adjusting active load of a cascade power station group, which comprises the following steps: s100, a daily active load plan curve of each power station power grid of a drainage basin is issued through a non-control network II area scheduling support system, a given daily active load plan curve text file is automatically extracted, then the daily active load plan curve text file is automatically read by a control network I area computer monitoring system, corresponding data safety check is carried out, and the daily active load plan curve is converted into an active load regulation curve meeting power grid active load regulation rules through an algorithm; and S200, automatically issuing an active load regulation curve to AGC centralized control active set values of each power station in real time according to requirements by a control network I area computer monitoring system, and automatically adjusting the active load. The method can realize automatic adjustment of the active load at the side of the power station in the convection area, replace manual adjustment of a load plan curve, reduce the operation frequency of dispatching personnel, reduce the working pressure of daily dispatching on duty, improve the working efficiency and safety and improve the load adjustment precision.

title_en: Distributed energy transaction method and system among multiple participating subjects
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed energy trading method and system among multiple participating subjects, which combines a game theory and an energy blockchain, complementarily optimizes the energy Internet through a blockchain technology, can effectively reduce the security guarantee cost without the advantage of a third party trust mechanism, promotes the efficient operation of a service, considers the game behavior generated by benefits between an energy user and an energy merchant and the physical constraints of energy quantity, security and the like, ensures that the trading process is safer and more reliable, reduces the network propagation overhead through improving PBFT algorithm, shortens the block consensus time, and can more meet the service requirement of the energy Internet on the trading efficiency.

title_en: Power system cascading failure key node identification method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power systems, in particular to a method and a system for identifying key nodes of cascading failures of a power system, comprising the steps of obtaining historical failure data in the power system, and quantifying the historical failure data to obtain initial failure data and final failure scale data; the method comprises the steps of extracting a high-nonlinearity mapping relation from initial fault data to a final fault scale, quantifying cascading fault risks of all nodes of the power system under different fault types based on the high-nonlinearity mapping relation from the initial fault data to the final fault scale, and identifying key nodes by utilizing quantified indexes according to the cascading fault risks of all the nodes under different fault types. And extracting a highly nonlinear mapping relation between an initial fault and a final fault scale in the historical fault through the LM optimized BP neural network, predicting the final fault scale according to the initial fault based on the mapping relation, and considering a critical node identification method in cascading faults.

title_en: Micro-grid distributed event-driven elastic control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a micro-grid distributed event driven elastic control method, which comprises the following steps: step 1, controlling primary droop of a micro-grid; step 2, determining whether bad data injection attack occurs in the process of interaction voltage and frequency states of the distributed generation units; step 3, updating the local trust value based on the consistency cooperation index; step 4, obtaining a comprehensive trust value based on a trust propagation mechanism, and updating communication link weight among the distributed power generation units based on the comprehensive trust value; and 5, establishing an event-driven distributed elastic control protocol based on the dynamic communication connection limit, and realizing the recovery of the frequency and the voltage of the micro-grid under the condition of network attack. According to the invention, the communication burden is reduced, meanwhile, the bad data injection attack is timely detected and isolated, and the node recovered from the attack can be added into the micro-grid again, so that the running elasticity of the micro-grid is improved, and the safety of the power system is improved.

title_en: Method for establishing rail transit network cascading failure model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for establishing a cascading failure model of a rail transit network, and belongs to the technical field of calculation, calculation or counting. The method comprises the steps of obtaining data, constructing a rail transit network model, removing fault nodes, generating a new rail transit network model, simulating node states considering the change of requirements and the action of time delay, and calculating a cascade failure influence index. The cascade failure model established by the invention can simultaneously consider the demand change and the time delay effect under the cascade failure state of the rail transit network, and reveal the cascade failure mechanism in the real world.

title_en: Method for reducing prediction power supply quantity error of power grid based on CNN-BILSTM algorithm
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for reducing the power supply quantity error of a predicted power grid based on a CNN-BILSTM algorithm, which comprises the following steps: acquiring data, cleaning the data, constructing characteristics, constructing an algorithm, improving a model (optimizing a data set), and verifying the model; according to the invention, based on a convolutional neural network-long and short term memory network (CNN-LSTM) algorithm, a two-way sequence propagation (BILSTM) is adopted for LSTM, so that the convolutional neural network-two-way long and short term memory network (CNN-BILSTM) is formed, the power supply quantity of a power grid is modeled and predicted through the algorithm, the model error is reduced by optimizing a data set under the condition of not damaging an original trained model, multiple training of the model is avoided, time and labor are saved, and the model error is effectively reduced.

title_en: Shock wave overpressure field reconstruction method based on physical information
abstract_en: The invention discloses a shock wave overpressure field reconstruction method based on physical information, which relates to the technical field of gun firing and comprises the following steps of establishing a multi-scene overpressure experience formula library comprising Henrych formula, M.A. Sadovsky formula and national defense design specification, embedding physical priori knowledge into a neural network for training through a weighted loss function, forming an attention module with channel-space cooperative reinforcement capability by fusing one-dimensional efficient channel attention, extruding an excitation network and reducing dimension CBAM, dividing a forward shock wave field and a post-muzzle wavefront subtask according to shock wave propagation characteristics, realizing regional prediction through dynamic feature routing, optimizing network parameters by adopting a low data quantity training strategy, and outputting overpressure peak field distribution. According to the invention, by constructing a physical data fusion constraint mechanism and an EC-SEAM mixed attention mechanism, the network physical interpretation and the near field mutation feature extraction capability are improved, and the dependence on the annotation data is obviously reduced.

title_en: Electric power communication network redundant path strategy acquiring method
abstract_en: The invention provides an electric power communication network redundant path strategy acquiring method. The method includes the following steps that: an electric power network fault propagation model is established according to the capacity load information of an electric power network node; a communication network model composed of a control center node and router nodes is established, an interdependent coupling network model of an electric power communication network is established according to connection relations between nodes in the electric power network fault propagation model and communication network nodes; and the minimum subnet of the interdependent coupling network model is obtained, wherein the minimum subnet describes the redundant path strategy of the electric power communication network. When the electric power communication network malfunctions, fault information occurrence can be suppressed according to the redundant route strategy, and therefore, cascaded power outage caused by fault propagation can be avoided or alleviated, and the reliability of an electric power communication network system can be improved.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: A kind of physical space type digital intelligent terminal
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of physical space type digital intelligent terminal, the digital intelligent terminal includes：Holographic display terminal is for demonstrating scientific experiment；Holographic digital culture propagates terminal for showing digital culture；Holographic health detection terminal realizes online medical treatment for being detected to basic fitness programme；Mark urban landscape brilliance displaying terminal is for being shown urban landscape brilliance；Multi-type network switching system is used to carry out intelligent switching to network according to flow of the people；Digital public security emergency response system is used to carry out continued power to wireless network transmitting module.
assignees: SICHUAN YOUFENER INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network blocking scheduling method
abstract_en: The application discloses a power distribution network blocking scheduling method, which is applied to a central controller of a multi-energy system and comprises the steps of obtaining system information, load requirements and energy market information of the multi-energy system; performing target optimization according to system information, load demand and energy market information under constraint conditions to determine equipment output and interactive power information of the multi-energy system, and reporting the interactive power information to a power distribution network dispatching center; and receiving safety constraint information sent by the distribution network dispatching center when the distribution network is blocked and judging the existence of the interactive power information and the node information of each node under the distribution network, and performing target optimization according to the safety constraint information to obtain the corresponding equipment output. The method can effectively solve the problem of reverse blocking of the power distribution network while realizing cascade utilization of energy. The application also discloses a power distribution network congestion scheduling method applied to the power distribution network scheduling center, a central controller and the power distribution network scheduling center, and the power distribution network congestion scheduling method, the central controller and the power distribution network scheduling center have the technical effects.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG;CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO

title_en: Method and device for evaluating importance of traffic node
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a method and a device for evaluating importance of traffic nodes, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining a plurality of local dynamic operational risks of a plurality of second nodes when each first node of a road network fails and path redistribution is carried out; determining each third node corresponding to each first node according to the local dynamic operational capacity risks; determining a plurality of first global operational performance dynamic risks when each third node fails and path redistribution is carried out; and determining the importance evaluation result of each first node according to the plurality of first global operational performance dynamic risks. The method and the device can evaluate the risk of the road network in the dynamic transition process from the steady state before failure to the steady state after failure, and evaluate the importance of the nodes by considering the influence of the failure of the first node and the failure of the subsequent cascaded third node on the global operation and energy risk index of the road network, thereby comprehensively and accurately evaluating the importance of each node of the road network.

title_en: Emergency signal priority and social vehicle dynamic path induction collaborative optimization method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency signal priority and social vehicle dynamic path induction collaborative optimization method, which is based on a complex network theory to construct a road network toughness capability index; and deleting the nodes with lower toughness. On the basis, an emergency rescue path double-layer planning model is constructed, and the upper-layer target is to maximize the reduction amount of emergency signals preferentially corresponding to the delay of emergency rescue vehicles, so that the travel delay of the emergency rescue vehicles is minimum; the underlying goal is to optimize traffic flow distribution such that travel time of social vehicles is minimized. And after the emergency vehicle passes through one intersection, updating the sub-network, the emergency rescue path, the emergency signal priority strategy and the social vehicle guidance scheme according to the traffic state of the current road network until the emergency vehicle reaches the accident site. The invention considers the negative influence of the emergency rescue task on the road network toughness capability, constructs a double-layer planning model to realize game balance between the emergency rescue efficiency and the social vehicle passing efficiency, and effectively avoids the occurrence of road network cascade failure and even secondary traffic accidents.

title_en: Offshore wind power and soft and straight cooperative black start optimization method based on target cascade analysis method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a target cascade analysis method based offshore wind power and flexible-direct cooperative black start optimization method, which comprises the following steps: establishing a black start optimization model of the offshore wind power transmission network and the flexible direct system transmission network; establishing an optimization model of the problem of the offshore wind power black promoter; establishing a problem optimization model of the soft and straight end black promoter; solving an optimization model of the offshore wind power black promoter problem and an optimization model of the soft and straight black promoter problem by adopting mixed integer quadratic programming; when a power failure accident is monitored, the problem of the black promoter is solved by the cooperation of the offshore wind power end and the flexible straight end. The invention comprehensively considers the coupling relationship between the onshore alternating current system and the offshore wind power plant, fully utilizes the power prediction information of the offshore wind power, can effectively improve the efficiency of the system for recovering to be normal through the black start process, can independently make decisions of all elements and is proved by strict convergence, the offshore wind power end and the onshore flexible straight end can realize parallel optimization, and the efficiency and the effectiveness of the black start are improved.
assignees: JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO RES INST;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Electric power traffic coupling network vulnerability assessment method based on probability map
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating the vulnerability of an electric power traffic coupling network based on a probability map, which comprises the following steps: establishing a Bayesian network model of the outage event of the power distribution network equipment under the typhoon disaster, and predicting the outage probability of the power distribution network equipment based on the Bayesian network; establishing an alternating current optimal power flow model, analyzing the overload condition of a power distribution network line, and carrying out load removal on a power system; evaluating the capacity of the coupling network for resisting external interference by using a power traffic coupling network vulnerability evaluation model based on a probability map; the method is supported by a probability chart, a vulnerability assessment model of the electric power traffic coupling network is established, and calculation of elasticity measurement of the electric power traffic coupling network is achieved; based on historical meteorological data, the method can realize prediction of a cascading failure propagation mechanism of the electric power traffic coupling network under typhoon disasters, ensure the accuracy and rapidity of real-time estimation, and provide a theoretical basis for emergency plans under typhoon weather.

title_en: Typhoon prediction method, system, equipment and medium based on space-time attention
abstract_en: The invention discloses a typhoon prediction method, a typhoon prediction system, typhoon prediction equipment and typhoon prediction media based on space-time attention, wherein the method obtains sea surface variable characteristics by inputting typhoon data to be predicted into a preset two-dimensional convolution network to learn the space characteristics of sea surface variables; inputting typhoon data to be predicted into a preset three-dimensional convolution network to learn spatial characteristics of atmospheric variables, and obtaining the characteristics of the atmospheric variables; the three-dimensional convolution network comprises a plurality of cascaded three-dimensional convolution layers, and a three-dimensional space-time attention module combining a spatial attention mechanism and a channel attention mechanism is arranged between at least one pair of adjacent two three-dimensional convolution layers; combining and connecting the sea surface variable characteristics and the atmosphere variable characteristics to obtain combined characteristics; inputting the combined characteristics into a preset long-period and short-period memory network for characteristic learning to obtain typhoon time sequence characteristics; and predicting the strength of typhoons according to the typhoon time sequence characteristics. The typhoon prediction method and the typhoon prediction device can improve accuracy of typhoon prediction.
assignees: PEOPLE'S LIBERATION ARMY NATIONAL UNIVERSITY OF DEFENSE TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Markov Process cascading failure path generation method and device starting from meteorological disaster
abstract_en: The invention relates to a Markov Process cascading failure path generation method and a Markov Process cascading failure path generation device starting from a meteorological disaster, wherein the method comprises the following steps: when extreme weather occurs, all line load flow states in a network topology structure of the power system are detected, the line load flow states are calculated through a load flow state outage model, the economic loss condition of the power grid is comprehensively considered according to the topology change and the load loss quantity, the risk index of a chain fault path is determined by combining the line outage probability and the economic loss condition of the power grid, the outage line is determined by the index, and a plurality of rounds of circulating processing are carried out to obtain early warning information.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;WUHAN QIYI ELECTRIC CO LTD

title_en: Main-auxiliary cooperative multi-level autonomous control method considering multi-type resources
abstract_en: The invention discloses a main-distribution cooperation multi-level autonomous control method considering multi-type resources, which comprises the following steps: (1) Analyzing and modeling the operation characteristics of multiple types of resources of the power distribution network; (2) Taking the internal autonomous characteristics of the hierarchy into consideration, and constructing a platform autonomous model; (3) Dynamically dividing a feeder line layer region based on a modularity function; (4) constructing a main-coordination cooperative multi-level autonomous control model; (5) And solving the main-coordination cooperative multi-level autonomous control model by adopting a target cascading method. According to the method, the operation characteristics of multiple types of resources of the power distribution network are fully considered, the internal autonomy and inter-regional coordination of multiple layers and multiple regions are considered, a main-cooperation multi-layer autonomy control model is built, a target cascading method is adopted for solving, a research object is decomposed into independent decision units, the independent decision units are independently decided and solved in a distributed mode, the optimization solving efficiency is remarkably improved, and the convergence performance is better.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ZHENJIANG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO RES INST

title_en: Power distribution network risk assessment method under storm-ice disaster common influence scene considering cascading failure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network risk assessment method under a storm-ice disaster common influence scene considering cascading failure, which comprises the following steps: acquiring power distribution network data and storm-ice disaster common influence scene data; modeling a storm risk source and an ice disaster risk source according to weather patterns and weather parameters to obtain the weather intensity of a scene affected by storm-ice disaster; according to the weather intensity of the scene affected by the storm and the ice disaster, and combining the fault rate function, the time-varying fault rate of different distribution lines of the distribution network under the weather of the scene affected by the storm and the ice disaster is obtained; constructing a cascading failure model under the scene of storm-ice disaster common influence according to the time-varying failure rate of different distribution lines of the distribution network under the scene of storm-ice disaster common influence, and obtaining the overload outage probability of the lines; and introducing the overload outage probability of the line into a fuzzy segmentation multi-target risk frame to obtain a comprehensive risk assessment result of the power distribution network. The invention can reflect the risk level of the system more comprehensively and carefully.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;UNIV ANHUI

title_en: Port group toughness assessment method, device, equipment, storage medium and program product
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of shipping networks, and discloses a port group toughness assessment method, a port group toughness assessment device, port group toughness assessment equipment, a port group toughness assessment storage medium and a port group toughness assessment program product. The method comprises the steps of collecting port and route information, constructing a port group shipping network based on hypergraph, taking each port and each ship as an intelligent body, constructing a port group shipping ABM model based on the port group shipping network, simulating a response mechanism and a dynamic evolution process of the port group shipping network under normal conditions and risk events to obtain network density and strong communication branch quantity at different moments, ship quantity in a waiting state and cargo delay time corresponding to each ship, constructing toughness indexes from three dimensions of structure, operation and service, and further calculating the port group toughness value. According to the method, the hypergraph theory is combined with the intelligent agent simulation, so that the influence propagation process of the risk event on the port group shipping network is more truly described, the toughness value is calculated based on multiple dimensions, and the accuracy of port group toughness assessment is improved.

title_en: Power grid abnormal situation sensing method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid abnormal situation sensing method and system, the method comprises the steps of obtaining power grid data in real time and calculating different power grid situation assessment indexes, weighting each power grid situation assessment index, correcting the weight of the abnormal index, then linearly weighting all power grid situation assessment indexes to obtain situation assessment values, constructing a prediction model with a double-layer gating cyclic neural network, an attention layer and an output layer cascade, inputting historical data of the power grid situation assessment indexes, outputting future situation assessment prediction values, inputting new historical data of the power grid situation assessment indexes into a trained prediction model to obtain corresponding future situation assessment prediction values, and matching the future situation assessment prediction values with pre-divided security levels to determine whether the abnormality occurs. According to the method, a deep learning framework is utilized to construct a model for predicting the running situation of the power grid based on the double-layer gated circulating neural network of the attention mechanism, so that a better prediction effect and higher accuracy are realized.
assignees: State grid hunan electric power co ltd;STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INST;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Intelligent integrated service method and system for anti-overflow anti-static controller
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent integrated service method and system for an anti-overflow anti-static controller, which relate to the technical field of risk prediction and comprise the steps of calling a fault time sequence tracking data set of a historical sample controller according to a model ID of a target controller, wherein the target controller is the anti-overflow anti-static controller; performing index fluctuation association analysis, constructing a fault fluctuation association tree, constructing a cross-level risk prediction network, performing polling backtracking of association sensing equipment to obtain an intersection index monitoring time sequence array, outputting scene matching probability distribution, performing risk prediction level verification, outputting an integrated risk prediction result, matching a fault propagation path map, and performing source parameter inhibition regulation. The invention solves the technical problems that the overflow-preventing anti-static controller in the prior art mostly judges whether faults occur by setting a fixed threshold value, lacks flexibility and adaptability, is easy to cause false alarm and leakage alarm, and further influences the running stability and safety of equipment.
assignees: JINAN TEMEIRUI ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Buried pipeline failure prediction method based on space random field and dynamic corrosion model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a buried pipeline failure prediction method based on a space random field and a dynamic corrosion model, which is characterized in that the space distribution of environmental parameters is analyzed by constructing the space random field model of soil pH value and resistivity, the actual condition of the soil environment is reflected more accurately, the corrosion process is described more accurately by simulating the non-stationary characteristic of corrosion pit growth in a dynamic gamma process, the spatial dependence of adjacent pipe section corrosion increment is quantized by adopting a Copula correlation model, the propagation rule of corrosion in space is understood better, the failure probability of the whole pipe network universe is calculated by a Monte Carlo simulation method, scientific basis is provided for pipeline maintenance and management, the transition of a high risk area is early-warned by utilizing a self-adaptive grid discretization technology to realize the accurate management and control of the service life of the pipe network, and compared with the traditional prediction model, the method can predict the failure condition of the buried pipeline more accurately and provide powerful guarantee for the safe operation of the pipeline.
assignees: PUYANG POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Network situation awareness method based on heterogeneous graph neural network
abstract_en: The invention provides a network situation awareness method based on a heterogeneous graph neural network, which comprises the steps of cleaning and standardizing structured data, constructing a unified semantic space based on a subject priori, forming a robust sample representation by adopting a cross-modal alignment and attention fusion method, aligning time, entities and link relations of different platform data, extracting a trigger-argument-role triplet, fusing explicit/implicit propagation evidence to construct a directed propagation graph, obtaining candidate paths through causality consistency, and screening key links by means of multipath reliability and saliency inspection, so as to realize origin positioning and cross-platform association. The method can realize network situation awareness with locatable origin, trackable path and interpretable result under multi-source heterogeneous and high-noise scenes, improves robustness through saliency control and multi-path fusion, improves decision reliability through calibration and uncertainty propagation, and can be applied to scenes such as public safety monitoring, public opinion research and judgment, compliance wind control and the like.
assignees: UNIV CHENGDU INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY;INFORMATION ENGINEERING UNIV OF PEOPLES LIBERATION ARMY OF CHINA

title_en: Wave matrix-based cascading super-surface electromagnetic transmission modeling and analysis method and cascading super-surface
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascading super-surface electromagnetic transmission modeling and analyzing method based on a wave matrix and a cascading super-surface, belonging to the technical field of high-frequency communication and artificial electromagnetic super-surface, wherein the method takes the wave matrix theory as a core, a cascading structure comprises a medium baffle plate and n thin sheet admittance layers, the total electric field is the sum of the forward and reverse propagation fields, a magnetic field expression is obtained by combining a 90-degree rotation matrix, a four-port network is equivalent, a wave matrix and a scattering and transmission matrix are associated, a total wave matrix is obtained by combining each layer of wave matrix, an isolation medium is introduced for correction, and parameters are solved to complete modeling. The cascading super-surface electromagnetic transmission modeling and analyzing method based on the wave matrix and the cascading super-surface can form a cross-building surface signal enhancement system frame, improve the transmission efficiency of electromagnetic waves penetrating through the glass curtain wall, reduce the deployment maintenance cost, further endow the super-surface with mechanical adaptability, enhance the compatibility with the glass curtain wall and support large-scale deployment of complex scenes.

title_en: Urban flood rapid mapping method and system based on multi-source data collaborative awareness
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of remote sensing science, in particular to a rapid urban flood mapping method and system based on multi-source data collaborative awareness. The method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source data to obtain a city flood sample list, dividing the city flood sample list into training samples and test samples, constructing a semantic segmentation network based on the city flood sample list, wherein the network comprises a spectrum feature perception module, a topography feature perception module, a heterologous feature fusion module and a multi-scale feature weighted decoding module, constructing a physical constraint loss function based on the semantic segmentation network, carrying out model parameter backward propagation and minimizing loss values, carrying out iterative training of the semantic segmentation network based on the training sample data and the physical constraint loss function, and finally carrying out quick drawing and accuracy verification of city flood. The invention can break through the limitation of the traditional single data source and network architecture, and promote the identification capability of the global and local flood characteristic information, thereby improving the accuracy of rapid drawing of large-scale urban flood.

title_en: System for Alarm Broadcasting of Indoor and Method thereof
title_ko: 옥내용 경보 방송 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an indoor warning broadcasting system which receives a warning signal by using a media dualized into wired communications and a DMB broadcasting, and transfers a warning situation to people in a building, and a method thereof. According to the present invention, the system comprises: a warning signal reception unit for receiving an external warning signal; and a main control unit for analyzing a warning signal received through the warning signal reception unit, verifying validity determination and redundancy determination, and notifying the received warning signal to the inside of the building according to a predetermined performance scenario if the warning signal is determined as a valid warning signal. Also, an indoor warning broadcasting receiver for notifying the warning situation to residents in the building which exists as a shadow area in a warning wave of a conventional method is installed, and the warning situation is notified to the residents by using indoor emergency broadcasting equipment or a premises broadcasting facility which are equipped in the building, thereby reducing or preventing death and injury, and property damage to actively cope with the warning situation.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 유선통신과 DMB 방송으로 이중화된 매체를 이용하여 경보신호를 수신한 후, 이에 따른 경보 상황을 건물 내 사람들에게 전달하는 옥내용 경보 방송 시스템 및 그 방법에 관한 것으로, 외부의 경보신호를 수신받는 경보신호수신부 및 상기 경보신호수신부를 통해 수신된 경보신호를 분석하여 유효성 판단과 중복성 판단의 검증과정을 거친 후, 유효한 경보신호라고 판단되면 상기 수신된 경보신호를 미리 설정된 수행 시나리오에 따라 건물 내부로 알리도록 하는 메인제어부를 포함하여 구성된다. 
본 발명의 옥내용 경보 방송 시스템 및 그 방법에 따르면, 기존방식의 경보 전파에 음영지역으로 존재하던 건물 내 거주민들에게 경보상황을 전파하기 위한 옥내 경보 방송수신기를 설치하고, 건물 내에 구비하고 있는 옥내 비상 방송설비나 구내 방송시설을 이용하여 거주민들에게 경보상황을 전달함으로써, 경보상황에 대하여 능동적인 대처를 할 수 있도록 하여 인명피해와 재산 손실을 줄이거나 방지하는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Cascading failure simulation method for thermoelectric coupling system under extremely cold disaster
abstract_en: The invention provides a cascading failure simulation method of a thermoelectric coupling system under an extremely cold disaster, which comprises the following steps: acquiring natural disaster meteorological data and system load data at the time t; calculating the line fault probability based on the Markov state space; randomly switching off the line according to the line fault probability, and updating the network topology of the thermoelectric coupling system; performing thermoelectric coupling load flow calculation based on the updated thermoelectric coupling system, and identifying a power out-of-limit circuit; and disconnecting the power out-of-limit line, updating the network topology of the thermoelectric coupling system, and calculating the load loss of the thermoelectric coupling system at the moment t. The method calculates the line fault probability of the thermoelectric coupling system under the extremely cold disaster based on the Markov state space, identifies the power out-of-limit line based on the power flow calculation, disconnects the fault line and the power out-of-limit line, can calculate the load loss of the thermoelectric coupling system under the disaster, and can simulate the cascading faults of the thermoelectric coupling system in the disaster occurrence process.

title_en: Risk identification method and system for label propagation algorithm of client network characteristics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a risk identification method and a system of a label propagation algorithm of client network characteristics, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining historical customer data information and preprocessing the historical customer data information; obtaining an account-level fund transaction table and a client-level fund transaction table according to the preprocessed historical client data information; obtaining a first point file and a first relation file according to the account-level fund transaction table and the client-level fund transaction table; constructing a network model according to the first point file and the first relation file; obtaining network characteristic information of the first client according to the network model; obtaining a risk conduction coefficient of the first client according to the network characteristic information of the first client; analyzing the risk of the first customer according to the risk transmission coefficient of the first customer. The method solves the technical problems that in the prior art, the identification rate of the client with the risk is low in risk identification, and the application method is obviously insufficient and limited.

title_en: Reservoir group scheduling decision behavior mining method and reservoir scheduling automatic control device
abstract_en: The invention provides a reservoir group scheduling decision behavior mining method and an automatic reservoir scheduling control device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: step 1, determining a research situation, collecting basic data of a reservoir group system, historical scheduling data and meteorological data of reservoir area sites, and determining influence factors and decision variables of reservoir group scheduling behaviors; step 2, determining a deep learning algorithm for excavating reservoir group scheduling decision behaviors; step 3, checking the accuracy of the reservoir group scheduling data; step 4, constructing a reservoir group scheduling decision behavior mining model coupling the reservoir basic principle and the deep learning model; and 5, calibrating the hyper-parameters of the model based on the training set sample, reversely propagating and updating the network parameters of the model based on the model loss function, determining the optimal hyper-parameters of the model according to the simulation precision of the model in the test set, and finally establishing the mapping relation between the influence factors of the reservoir group scheduling behaviors and the decision variables to realize the mining of the reservoir group scheduling decision behaviors.

title_en: Distributed computing method for collaborative perception of intelligent agent cluster situation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed computing method for collaborative awareness of an agent cluster situation. The algorithm comprises the confirmation and information propagation and cooperation methods of the information source, the dynamic construction of attribute state values which excite propagation based on the event and the type thereof, and the design of a mixed modulation process which is mutually influenced between attribute states. The essence of group situation collaborative perception is a process of dimension reduction-transmission-restoration of surrounding environment information, an individual firstly determines the source of battlefield dynamic information, screens main information, describes an emergency by using dimension reduction compression means, then carries out information transmission and cross verification through a local network structure of a cluster, and finally uses the received dimension reduction information to reevaluate and draw an information map of the individual. The algorithm of the invention is similar to the mechanism of biological hormone regulation and control and nerve information transmission, and provides a calculation method capable of carrying out dimension reduction processing on complex situation information and local cooperation of an intelligent agent under the condition of regional refusal of low communication.

title_en: Multi-precision residual error quantization method in power monitoring and identification scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-precision residual quantization method under a power monitoring and identification scene, which comprises the steps of selecting a data set and preprocessing images in the data set; training an identification network, and applying a multi-precision residual quantization method in a residual structure of a backbone network to obtain backbone network image characteristics; integrating the image features of the backbone network through the pooling layer and the feature arrangement layer, and optimizing the updating rule of the gradient during training the network to obtain a final power monitoring and identifying model; the method is suitable for target detection tasks under power monitoring and identification scenes, has universality for the identification network with a residual structure, introduces a concept of multi-precision quantization in the traditional residual structure, and removes partial calculation redundancy of cyclic convolution; in the back propagation part, the gradient updating rule in training is modified, so that the convergence speed is increased.

title_en: Equipment manufacturing supply chain risk propagation early warning method based on large language model semantic analysis
abstract_en: A device manufacturing supply chain risk propagation early warning method based on large language model semantic analysis belongs to the field of supply chain risk early warning. The risk propagation probability calculation module accurately calculates risk propagation probability of each node in a supply chain network, comprehensively considers risk propagation probability under forward, reverse, same-direction and same-level transverse situations, outputs node risk probability under dynamic propagation, the risk value determination module extracts associated risk factors from the obtained massive unstructured text data by means of a large language model by combining the output of the risk propagation probability calculation module, builds a risk factor judgment matrix by means of a fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method, integrates a bias correlation analysis method and determines comprehensive evaluation weight of the risk factors, the risk level early warning module establishes DPC-RF algorithm to operate in two stages based on the result of the risk value determination module, initially divides risk level clusters through DPC preliminary clustering, and then determines risk early warning levels of the nodes and generates early warning information by means of an RF model.

title_en: Cascade Transformer fusion method and system based on multi-source heterogeneous geological data
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of geological data, in particular to a cascade Transformer fusion method and system based on multi-source heterogeneous geological data. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a historical paper geological data set and a real-time multi-source geological monitoring data stream, generating a multi-source heterogeneous geological feature set based on the historical paper geological data set and the real-time multi-source geological monitoring data stream, carrying out multi-level feature extraction from coarse to fine and cross-modal attention fusion through a cascading Transformer network based on the multi-level geological data set and the multi-target collaborative optimization calculation based on the multi-level feature extraction from coarse to fine, generating a risk-resource integrated three-dimensional geological model for quantifying disaster risk probability and resource economic value by integrating geological priori knowledge rules, and carrying out optimization of hidden disaster targeting management and resource re-exploitation through a decision mapping engine based on the geological data set, and generating a collaborative optimization engineering scheme set. In the data cascade fusion process, the intelligent level and the comprehensive benefit of geological engineering activities are remarkably improved.

title_en: A kind of Model for Cascade Hydroelectric Stations management system towards transprovincially peak regulation demand
abstract_en: Towards a Model for Cascade Hydroelectric Stations management system for transprovincially peak regulation demand, be made up of load reconstructed module, conversion body module and output distribution display module three part.Wherein load reconstructed module is system input device, the workload demand comprised for each electrical network analyzes submodule and the power transmission amount proportion grading submodule two parts for each power station, by the workload demand analysis of each electrical network and the power transmission amount proportion grading in each power station, completion system load recombination function; Conversion body module is for belonging to switching device shifter, comprise distributing electric power submodule two parts between the interior output of power station distribution sub module of net and net to form, be connected with load reconstructed module by server, obtain the Back ground Information in each electrical network, each power station, and to complete in each electrical network net output of power station successively by the multiple stage computing machine included by module and distribute and distributing electric power function between the net of each power station; Output distribution display module is system output device, is connected with switching device shifter by client, realizes switching device shifter to the real-time control of output unit and renewal, completes the Presentation Function of output distribution process.

title_en: Flight operation risk network construction and control method based on unsafe events
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flight operation risk network construction and control method based on unsafe events. The method constructs a flight operation risk network based on civil aviation unsafe event data, and performs logic supplementary connection on the network according to flight operation actual services; and improving a risk propagation and control process based on an SIR virus propagation model, distinguishing risk propagation probabilities among different nodes according to the occurrence frequency of different unsafe events, and simulating the propagation process of the risk in the network. The propagation of risks in the network is controlled by two methods of controlling nodes and network attack, and the probability of risks of unsafe events is reduced by establishing defense for important nodes, so that a reliable and effective flight operation risk control scheme is provided. The flight operation risk network is constructed, so that the relationship among flight risk factors and the relationship between risks and accidents can be known, the risk propagation process is more consistent with the actual flight operation condition, and the reliability of the determined risk control scheme is higher.

title_en: Power supply control method and device and user equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a power supply control method, a device and user equipment, and relates to the technical field of power supply. The method comprises the following steps: predicting a first power generation amount obtained by a user through photovoltaic power generation in a time period to be predicted through a power generation prediction model of the user; and predicting a first electric quantity of the user in the period to be predicted through time sequence analysis; controlling the power supply of the user in the period to be predicted according to the first power generation amount and the first power generation amount; the power generation prediction model is obtained by training a back propagation BP neural network model. The scheme of the invention solves the problem of how to intelligently switch the photovoltaic power generation of a user and the power supply of a commercial power supply office, thereby fully utilizing the photovoltaic power generation.
assignees: CHINA MOBILE SHANGHAI INFORMATION COMMUNICATION TECH CO LTD;CMIM NETWORK CO LTD;CHINA MOBILE COMMUNICATIONS GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Power transmission section searching method based on variable-scale neighbor propagation clustering
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power transmission section searching method based on variable-scale neighbor propagation clustering, which comprises the following steps of: 1. establishing a power network model; 2. and searching the power transmission section by variable-scale neighbor propagation clustering. The method considers the requirements of the power network, and divides the whole power network by different scales through carrying out multiple scale-variable partition operations on the power topological graph, so as to search out more potential power transmission sections, and be beneficial to a dispatching department to adjust the operation mode in time, thereby avoiding large-area power failure accidents of the power grid, ensuring safe and stable operation of the power grid and optimizing dispatching.

title_en: Mixed cascade multi-terminal direct current transient overvoltage risk suppression strategy determination method
abstract_en: The application discloses a method for determining a mixed cascade multi-terminal direct current transient overvoltage risk suppression strategy, which can determine a transient overvoltage target suppression strategy for reducing energy absorption of an energy dissipation device and improve the safe and stable operation level of a mixed cascade direct current and a transmitting and receiving end alternating current power grid. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring first operation information of an actual hybrid cascade multi-terminal direct current control system and second operation information of a transmitting-receiving-terminal alternating current power grid; constructing a first simulation model and a second simulation model according to the first operation information and the second operation information; carrying out electromechanical-electromagnetic hybrid simulation by adopting a first simulation model and a second simulation model, simulating line faults at different positions of the receiving end alternating current power grid, and screening out fault line sets with risks according to energy absorption values of energy dissipation devices under different fault lines; and carrying out inhibition operation on each fault line in the fault line set by adopting a preset transient overvoltage inhibition strategy, and determining a target inhibition strategy corresponding to each fault line.
assignees: EAST CHINA BRANCH OF STATE GRID CORP OF CHINA;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Wind power ultra-short-term prediction method and system based on improved TCN-LSTM model
abstract_en: The application provides a wind power ultra-short-term prediction method and system based on an improved TCN-LSTM model, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a wind power plant power generation power data set, and preprocessing the wind power plant power generation power data set to generate a wind power preprocessing data set; establishing a TPA-TCN network according to a time convolution network and a time sequence mode attention mechanism; performing feature extraction on the wind power pretreatment data set according to the TPA-TCN network to generate a wind power feature data set; cascading the long-term memory network with the TPA-TCN network to construct a TPA-TCN-LSTM network model; and optimizing and iterating the super parameters in the TPA-TCN-LSTM network model according to a sparrow search algorithm to generate the TPA-TCN-LSTM network model with optimal parameters so as to predict wind power and solve the problem of low accuracy of real-time prediction of wind power.
assignees: LINCANG POWER SUPPLY BUREAU YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Earthquake response and damage evolution simulation method and equipment for ground fracture zone tunnel lining
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and equipment for simulating earthquake response and damage evolution of a tunnel lining with a ground fissure, and relates to the field of earthquake engineering. The invention is based on the constructed vibrating table model, a numerical simulation model is established by adopting a method for correcting lattice spring-discrete crack network coupling numerical values, then an MLSM-DFN model of a tunnel structure section of a ground crack zone is established based on the numerical simulation model, and the ground crack zone tunnel lining earthquake response and damage simulation are completed based on the model, so that the expansion and propagation rules of the ground crack can be completely and truly simulated, the activity development trend of the ground crack can be accurately predicted and quantified, and meanwhile, the influence factors and action mechanisms of the tunnel structure failure induced by coupling dynamics response can be accurately judged, so that a more definite theoretical basis and a more technical support are provided for better and targeted earthquake-proof design of the tunnel structure.

title_en: Sea island micro-energy network two-stage optimization method considering hydrogen energy cascade utilization
abstract_en: The invention relates to a sea island micro energy network two-stage optimization method considering hydrogen energy cascade utilization, which belongs to the field of comprehensive energy, and comprises the steps of constructing a sea island micro energy network integrating a hydrogen energy cascade utilization device, constructing a day-ahead stage objective function taking the maximum net profit of a day-ahead market as a target based on historical data of wind power, photovoltaic and photo-thermal power stations and energy supply equipment, storage equipment, a gas turbine and hydrogen fuel cell output of the sea island micro energy network, solving the day-ahead stage objective function based on the day-ahead supply and demand balance constraint, unit constraint and demand response constraint to obtain day-ahead market electricity, heat and gas transaction quantity, constructing a real-time stage objective function taking the minimum real-time market deviation adjustment cost of the sea island micro energy network as a target, solving the real-time objective function based on the uncertainty of real-time supply and demand balance constraint, unit constraint, demand response constraint, supply and demand cooperation, and electric, heat and gas transaction quantity of the day-ahead market to obtain an optimal solution of each unit output and a reduction quantity capable of reducing load on a demand side.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING TECHNOLOGY;UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER;BEIJING XINYUAN SMART INTERNET TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for dynamically analyzing domino accident evolution path of petrochemical device
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for dynamically analyzing a domino accident evolution path of a petrochemical device, wherein the method is used for mapping accident objects and information into a mathematical model after basic information of accident objects related to the petrochemical device is determined to form a network model, the influence of different types of accidents on equipment is quantitatively analyzed by considering the influence of the different types of accidents based on the network model of the petrochemical device, the dynamic upgrading probability of the equipment is determined, an equipment association relation diagram is formed based on the equipment distribution and the dynamic upgrading probability of the network model of the petrochemical device, the visual display of a domino accident chain is realized, a foundation is provided for establishing accident guarantee measures of different equipment, and the domino accident occurrence probability is controlled. The scheme can overcome the defects of the relevance and comprehensiveness of the existing accident analysis technology, quantitatively analyzes the dynamic evolution occurrence probability of the accident chain based on the domino accident dynamic evolution analysis logic, and is convenient for providing support for realizing flexible prevention and blocking.
assignees: CHINA PETROLEUM & CHEM CORP;SINOPEC SAFETY ENGINEERING RESEARCH INST CO LTD;SINOPEC NATIONAL PETROLEUM PROJECT RISK ASSESSMENT TECH CENTER CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution information physical risk assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a risk assessment method and a risk assessment system for distribution information physics, which relate to the technical field of distribution information physics system researches and comprise a comprehensive assessment method for defining information system risks and physical system risks, wherein potential threats of information flow interruption or tampering to safe operation of a distribution network are assessed, an evolution mechanism of cross-space cascading failures is revealed, validity under different attack scenes is verified through example simulation, and risk assessment of distribution information physics is completed. The method and the system can effectively quantify the cross-space propagation influence of the faults of the information system on the physical system, accurately evaluate the comprehensive risk level of the information system, the physical system and the information physical system, remarkably improve the accuracy and efficiency of risk evaluation, not only can identify high-risk nodes, but also can quantify the propagation mechanism of the cascading faults, and provide reliable support for the safe operation and planning design of the distribution information physical system, thereby improving the reliability and toughness of the distribution network.

title_en: Power grid key line identification method based on topology and operation characteristics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid key line identification method based on topology and operation characteristics, and belongs to the technical field of power grid key line identification. In the aspect of operation characteristics, an improved webpage link algorithm is adopted, the product of the initial load rate and the historical fault rate of each line is taken as an algorithm initial value, and the trend fluctuation caused by disconnection of each line on other lines is counted in sequence to construct a link matrix required by the algorithm. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a propagation matrix and a fragile matrix, obtaining a line key propagation value vector and a key fragile value vector of a power grid by adopting initial values and propagation/fragile matrix calculation, and obtaining a line key value by weighting and summing the key propagation value and the key fragile value of each line. The importance of the line on the local topology of the power grid is considered, the comprehensive degree of nodes at two ends of the line is constructed, a line key value correction coefficient is formed, and then a line comprehensive key value is constructed. And sequencing the comprehensive key values of all the lines, and identifying the line arranged in the front as a key line. The method can obtain the key degree of each line of the power grid and has certain effectiveness.

title_en: Multi-source heterogeneous system data collaborative distribution network graph real consistency checking system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data analysis, in particular to a power distribution network graph real consistency check system with data collaboration of a multi-source heterogeneous system, which comprises a topological feature extraction module, a cross-system topological alignment module and an anomaly tracing module, wherein the topological feature extraction module extracts multi-dimensional attribute features and topological connection relations of equipment nodes from the multi-source heterogeneous system to generate dynamic fingerprint vectors, the cross-system topological alignment module receives the dynamic fingerprint vectors and builds an intermediate semantic layer to output standard fingerprint vectors, a unified topological model is generated by analyzing the differential topological rules of the multi-source heterogeneous system, comparison difference values of the standard fingerprint vectors among different systems and equivalent connection relations of electrical connection features are calculated, the anomaly tracing module receives the comparison difference values and builds an anomaly propagation tree to generate an anomaly propagation path, and the anomaly root nodes are positioned by analyzing the coupling weights of the comparison equivalent connection relations and the comparison difference values.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INST OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Virtual power plant and power distribution network distributed cooperative regulation and control method considering shared energy storage
abstract_en: The application provides a distributed cooperative regulation and control method for a virtual power plant and a power distribution network, which considers shared energy storage, and belongs to the field of power system automation and scheduling. The method is based on three-layer distributed regulation and control frames of power distribution network-virtual power plant-shared energy storage, each layer of optimal scheduling sub-model is built respectively, the power distribution network adopts a second-order cone planning branch power flow model to minimize network loss and voltage deviation, an economic operation model is built by virtual power plant comprehensive demand response and a low-carbon target, the shared energy storage is modeled by taking maximized operation income as a target, finally, an Andersen acceleration thought is combined to improve a target cascade analysis method, and distributed collaborative solving is carried out on the three-layer model, so that convergence speed is improved. The method and the device can reduce the carbon emission and the comprehensive cost of the system and realize progressive regulation and control between layers while ensuring the safe operation of the power distribution network.
assignees: GAOMI CITY POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Power distribution network graph clustering toughness assessment method for decision-oriented under typhoon disaster
abstract_en: The invention relates to a clustering toughness assessment method of a power distribution network graph guided by decision under typhoon disasters, which relates to the technical field related to power distribution network toughness assessment and fault calculation, and comprises the following steps of firstly, constructing a typhoon-driven power distribution network multi-source coupling progressive fault mechanism model; the method comprises the steps of generating a typical cascading failure scene based on a multidimensional scene subtraction method, modeling a power distribution network based on cascading failure effect, and finally, making a decision-oriented toughness assessment index and assessing the toughness level of the power distribution network under typhoon disasters by using a graph clustering method. The method is simple and feasible, can effectively evaluate the capability of the power distribution network for resisting typhoon disasters, provides scientific decision basis for the operation and maintenance of the power system, thereby improving the toughness of the power distribution network in a targeted manner, and has good operability and wide applicability.
assignees: UNIV NORTHEAST FORESTRY;ECONOMIC RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV SOUTHEAST

title_en: Strategic mineral resource overseas supply chain risk space-time monitoring and early warning method and equipment based on complex network and improved SEIR infectious disease model
abstract_en: The application provides a strategic mineral resource overseas supply chain risk space-time monitoring and early warning method and equipment based on a complex network and an improved SEIR infectious disease model, which are applied to the technical field of data processing. The method comprises the steps of surrounding strategic mineral resource overseas supply chain risk monitoring and early warning, integrating supply chain multi-class data, identifying a critical path based on an algorithm, generating network topology information, modeling five risk causal relations by adopting a Bayesian network to obtain risk conduction information, preprocessing unstructured text, designing an NLP model to generate risk identification information, setting evaluation rules according to multi-level requirements to generate evaluation information, optimizing and improving SEIR model parameters to generate risk propagation prediction information, defining Agent behavior rules to generate evolution simulation information, and finally integrating multi-source data to generate full-flow intelligent early warning response information containing monitoring, early warning and plan matching to realize risk dynamic monitoring and efficient response.

title_en: Disaster connectivity analysis system, server, and method
title_ko: 재난 연계성 분석 시스템, 서버, 및 방법
abstract_en: The disaster linkage analysis system and method analyze the specific process of the accident damage generation and simultaneous or serial disaster for the preemptive disaster management about the composite trouble by using the artificial intelligence technology. In addition, in order to increase the understanding of the analysis result through the embodiment, information is provided in the form of a scenario and a map by dividing the correlation analysis result of the disaster by disaster and accident type. In addition, through the embodiment, the networking of disasters is the most important factor in the analysis of composite disasters, and the connection between disasters is analyzed based on the relationship between disasters, accident types, and vulnerable factors.
abstract_ko: 재난 연계성 분석 시스템 및 방법은 인공지능 기술을 이용하여 복합재난에 대한 선제적 재난관리를 위해 동시다발적 또는 연쇄적 재난과 사고 피해 발생의 구체적 과정을 분석한다. 또한, 실시예를 통해 분석결과에 대한 이해도를 높이기 위해, 재난의 연계성 분석 결과를 재난, 사고 유형별로 구분하여 시나리오 및 지도 형태로 정보를 제공한다. 또한, 실시예를 통해 재난의 네트워크화를 복합재난 분석의 가장 중점적 요소로 두고, 재난, 사고 유형과 취약요소의 관계성을 근간으로 재난 간의 연계성을 분석한다.

title_en: Method for manufacturing an elastic ceramic matrix composite
abstract_en: The present invention relates to: i. damage-resistant ECMCs that need to work and remain elastic between minus 120ºC and positive 300°C (350°C exceptionally); ii. ECMCs that need to be able to contain a flame of 1900ºC for more than 90 minutes (for example in the case of a fire); iii. composite structures and, in particular, highly stressed structures, for example helicopter engine compartments, aeroplane engine nacelles, aeroplane thrust reversers, jet engine afterbodies, heat shields of missiles intended to fly well beyond the sound barrier (hypersonic speed), structural components, heat shields and interior fire-fighting arrangements of aeroplanes, boats, trains and road vehicles, as well as industrial or leisure components. One of the characteristic problems of ceramic matrices is their fragility. Indeed, when a fracture starts, it propagates easily in the matrix. The present invention relates to elastic ceramic matrix composites (ECMCs), and differs in that: the ceramic matrix is split into solid "ceramic microdomains" (CMDs) (2); the CMDs are connected to one another by a dense network of "elastic microelements" (EMEs) (1); and the bonds between the EMEs and the CMDs are strong chemical bonds, preferably covalent.

title_en: A kind of method of Identification of Power System generation cascading failure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of method of Identification of Power System generation cascading failure.Consider generator speed governing and load responding, set up more realistic electric power system tide computation model, the method, in the model of Load flow calculation, overcomes the impact that traditional power flow algorithm can not reflect generator regulating action and load responding.From system cloud gray model champion angle, analyze the relation between voltage stabilization and fault in cascading failure.For the relation of quantitative analysis charge threshold level and system running state, by analyzing the change of Jacobian matrix element value, the critical value of derivation system voltage stability index and this index.Along with the increase of load, the risk of systems face cascading failure increases.In the process, system voltage stabilizes index can decline gradually, and critical value all the time critical value to maintain 0.5 (± 0.03) constant.In systems in practice, can not be changed in cascading failure by the charge threshold level calculated, choose 0.6 critical value of collapsing as line voltage in real system, whether identification electrical network faces the risk of having a power failure on a large scale.Therefore, the inventive method has good actual directive significance.

title_en: Appraisal procedure and system based on social networking application information disclosure model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of appraisal procedure and system based on social networking application information disclosure model.This method includes：The information communication process of social networking application is analyzed and is abstracted, establishes social networking application information disclosure model；Based on social networking application information disclosure model, social networking application information propagation risk is decomposed into every factor according to hierarchical relationship, and every factor is carried out by aggregation combination according to hierarchical relationship according to the correlation between every factor, generation deceptive information propagates risk evaluation model；Wherein, the hierarchical relationship of deceptive information propagation risk evaluation model specifically includes：System layer, physical layer and risk point layer；Initial data based on risk point in the risk point layer for propagating risk evaluation model by deceptive information, the deceptive information faced to the social networking application are propagated threat and assessed.

title_en: A method of network system robustness is promoted by optimizing the switch state of link
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of method for improving network system robustness by optimizing the switch state of network link, this method designs suitable network protective strategy to cascading failure phenomenon from the angle of complex network.Initially set up the model that electrology characteristic and network topological information combine；Then inhibit the propagation of cascading failure using the Preservation tactics of cutting corresponding link; it is damaged to reduce cascading failure to power grid bring; and considers that the number for cutting off link in actual operation cannot be too big, convert multi-objective optimization question for power network link state control problem；The multi-objective optimization question finally is solved using non-dominated ranking binary system differential evolution algorithm, the switch state of each link of power grid is controlled according to optimal link scheme.The present invention takes excision properly to connect the network protective strategy on side by the electrology characteristic of consideration power grid, can improve the robustness of power grid in the case that even number of edges amount is few in excision, so that cascading failure be effectively reduced to the harm of power grid bring.

title_en: Winged insect tracking and identifying method and device based on audio-visual coordination
abstract_en: The invention discloses a winged insect tracking and identifying method and device based on audio-visual coordination, relates to the technical field of winged insect identification and tracking, and aims to solve the problem that in the technical field of winged insect identification and tracking, the prevention and control of harmful winged insects are always a troublesome challenge, especially for greenhouse planting, if a small amount of scattered pests enter a greenhouse, the damage is not timely removed and captured, the propagation capacity of the pests can cause the small amount of pests to become insect disaster quickly, great loss is brought to farmers, the TCN network designed by the invention can effectively extract the characteristics of time sequence data, has better robustness and identification rate compared with the characteristics selected manually or the traditional machine learning method, and compared with the traditional non-machine learning method, the TCN network is driven by training data to perform characteristic learning, so that incomplete data information utilization caused by the manual characteristic screening process is avoided.

title_en: Method for evaluating cascade failure influence of urban infrastructure under extreme precipitation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascade failure influence assessment method of urban infrastructure under extreme precipitation, which belongs to the technical field of urban flood monitoring and comprises the following steps of S1, simulating an urban road network to obtain a simulated running road network; s2, collecting the depth and the range of urban inundation under extreme precipitation, and determining the affected nodes and road sections of an urban road network; s3, attacking the affected nodes and road sections and carrying out simulation to determine the failure state of the final road network; and S4, collecting urban infrastructure POI points, and evaluating the service capability change of the infrastructure before and after the road network failure and the cascade failure influence of the urban infrastructure under extreme precipitation. The method for evaluating the influence of cascade failure of the urban infrastructure under extreme precipitation, which is disclosed by the invention, solves the problem that the influence of the extreme precipitation disaster on the urban infrastructure under the extreme precipitation disaster is unknown in the field of urban disaster prevention and reduction at present.

title_en: Explosion-proof wireless emergency communication method and system
abstract_en: The application discloses an explosion-proof wireless emergency communication method and system, and relates to the field of emergency communication positioning. The method comprises the following steps: the control end sends an initialization instruction with unique emission frequency to the emergency communication device, and after each time of sending the initialization instruction, the control end receives the registration instructions returned by a plurality of emergency communication devices; the control end selects the transmitting frequency corresponding to the initialization instruction with the largest number of the register of the emergency communication device and the smallest register delay as the system transmitting frequency; and setting the wireless transmission frequency of all the network devices as the system transmission frequency. According to the method, the system transmitting frequency with the strongest signal penetrability can be found according to different environments to carry out networking by the self-developed transmitting frequency determining mode, so that positioning data under the disaster condition can be uploaded through high penetrability wireless signal cascade. When in post-disaster emergency rescue, the application scene range can be obviously enlarged, the reliability of signal transmission is greatly improved, and the communication quality is higher.

title_en: Risk propagation pattern graph-based contact network part association characteristic analysis method
