abstract_en: The invention discloses a contact net part association characteristic analysis method based on a risk propagation pattern diagram, which specifically comprises the following steps: acquiring historical fault associated data of contact net parts; defining a simultaneous fault incidence relation and a time sequence fault incidence relation; constructing a risk coefficient model of the fault association relationship; constructing a virtual path, acquiring a virtual path set between two parts, and acquiring a shortest virtual path set according to a reduction rule; mapping the set of shortest virtual paths into a risk association graph; defining the risk coefficient weight of each virtual path in the risk correlation diagram; constructing a risk propagation pattern diagram taking any fault part as a starting point, and evaluating risk levels of each fault association relation; the invention can evaluate the risk degree of the known fault association relationship and the risk degree of the potential fault association relationship, can reveal the association characteristics among the contact net parts under different time scales and provides decision basis for preventing occurrence of cascading faults.

title_en: Power distribution station house monitoring method, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution station room monitoring method, a device and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining power distribution station room electromagnetic interference intensity distribution and line real-time state data, and determining a sensor type selection scheme by combining equipment working conditions; the fault traveling wave arrival time difference, the line model parameters and the wave speed difference are used for calculating a fault propagation path, determining the position of a fault point and generating a positioning result, associating the sensor type selection and the fault positioning, judging whether the fault point is in a layout area or not, primarily judging the fault type, generating a recovery path candidate scheme based on real-time state data and the fault positioning result, fusing the fault traveling wave characteristics and the recovery path line state parameters, establishing a comprehensive evaluation model, taking power supply recovery efficiency and load loss rate as optimization targets, and determining an optimal recovery path scheme. The method has the following effects that the rapid and accurate positioning and intelligent power supply recovery of the faults of the power distribution network are realized, and the running reliability and efficiency of the power distribution network are improved.

title_en: Storage battery life prediction method based on optimized multilayer residual BP (back propagation) depth network
abstract_en: A storage battery life prediction method based on an optimized multilayer residual BP depth network comprises the following steps: s1, collecting real-time data of storage batteries in working states in the energy storage power station, and constructing an index system; s2, preprocessing the data according to the established index system, and initializing a multi-layer residual BP deep learning network; s3, solving a predicted value by forward propagation of a residual error network; s4, substituting the cost function into the cost function, calculating the network error, judging the error condition, if the requirement is not met, performing the step S5, and if the requirement is met, performing the step S6; s5, determining an error gradient, adjusting weight learning, and then turning to the step S3; s6, completing network learning to obtain a storage battery life model, and turning to the step S7; and S7, finishing the calculation. The method can predict the service life of the storage battery with high precision, and is helpful for guiding the scheduling scheme of the energy storage power station charging station, so that the running reasonability and the economical efficiency of the electric vehicle charging station with the energy storage system are effectively ensured.

title_en: Comprehensive protection method of electric-gas coupling system under heavy load distribution attack
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive protection method of an electric-gas coupling system under heavy load distribution attack, which comprises the steps of simulating bilateral collaborative LR attack by an attacker visual angle; considering the influence of the power grid cascading failure caused by bilateral collaborative LR attack on system load, establishing an electric-gas coupling system loss evaluation model, and uniformly measuring the load loss of the power grid and a natural gas grid in the electric-gas coupling system by adopting economic loss; solving an electric-gas coupling system loss evaluation model through a linearization method and KKT condition conversion, calculating economic loss caused by attack on the electric-gas coupling system, and determining the vulnerability of each load node in the system; analyzing the comprehensive vulnerability and the height degree of each load node under different attack resource degrees; and the comprehensive protection is carried out on the electric-gas coupling system by adopting a load node with high comprehensive vulnerability of strengthening protection and limiting the gas-to-electricity load reduction proportion. The invention improves the capability of the system for resisting attacks and reduces the economic loss of the IEGS.

title_en: Delay propagation-oriented high-speed train operation adjustment modeling and evaluation method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a delay propagation-oriented high-speed train operation adjustment modeling and evaluation method and device. The method is oriented to potential abnormal event disturbance in the daily transportation process of the high-speed railway, the dynamic interaction between the driving adjustment and the delay propagation is considered comprehensively, a two-stage optimization decision model is constructed, and a delay propagation evaluation method is provided. The method has the advantages that the model is subjected to pareto optimization considering cumulative weighting delay and train average adjustment times in the first stage, and is subjected to global equilibrium optimization based on the game theory in the second stage, dynamic operation grade coefficients of trains are constructed and an objective function is introduced by further considering heterogeneity of transportation scenes and schemes, and maximum train avoidance times and the number of affected trains are innovatively considered in constraint conditions and mathematical description is realized. In the aspect of delay propagation evaluation, the invention combines delay propagation characteristic definition and constructs two dynamic analysis indexes of train accumulated delay and instantaneous delay, and provides technical support for disclosing a networked propagation mechanism of train delay.

title_en: Systematic financial risk assessment method based on functional data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a systematic financial risk assessment method based on functional data in the technical field of systematic financial risk assessment, which comprises the following steps: performing functional processing on the calculation result by using a functional data analysis method; introducing a traditional discrete entropy weight method into a functional data analysis model; identifying systematic financial risk events by combining the functionalized financial risk index data and the entropy weight function of time-varying dynamics; clustering weekly industry systematic financial risk index functions, and determining real-time conditions of risks in a financial system; judging the propagation direction and the conduction path of the risk in the financial system by using a transfer entropy causal inspection method of a variable hysteresis term; and constructing a network model. The method of the invention is beneficial to improving the accuracy and the robustness of the systematic financial risk measure, wherein the introduced complex network method is beneficial to visualizing the conduction path and the infection intensity of the systematic financial risk among industries.

title_en: Self-healing control and energy efficiency optimization method and system for box-type substation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electric power automation, and particularly relates to a self-healing control and energy efficiency optimization method and system of a box-type transformer substation, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting three-phase current, voltage waveforms and temperature parameters of equipment in the box-type transformer substation, constructing a space-time correlation characteristic matrix, and extracting a dynamic operation mode; the method comprises the steps of constructing an impedance parameter nonlinear propagation model, calculating node credibility propagation values, constructing a multi-objective optimization model for dynamic weight optimization, solving a topology reconstruction strategy under asymmetric constraint conditions, optimizing voltage in energy storage scheduling parameters based on the topology reconstruction strategy, generating an inertia weight self-adaptive control instruction by combining an optical fiber self-healing ring network communication channel, and correcting the voltages in the dynamic weight and the energy storage scheduling parameters in real time through a closed loop feedback mechanism to complete dynamic performance compensation and energy efficiency optimization iteration. The invention realizes rapid and accurate fault diagnosis, self-healing control and dynamic energy efficiency optimization by monitoring and optimizing the operation parameters of the box-type substation in real time.
assignees: BEIJING HEROSAIL POWER SCI & TECH CO LTD;TAIHE POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Foam injection system for extinguishing fires and preventing smoke propagation in case of tunnel fires
title_ko: 터널 화재시 질식소화 및 연기전파 방지를 위한 발포폼 분사 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A foam injecting system for extinguishing fires and preventing smoke in case of tunnel fires are provided to seclude oxygen from outside and prevent diffusion of smoke, thereby minimizing damage of human life and property. CONSTITUTION: A foam injecting system for extinguishing fires comprises a fire detection tool(10), a mixer(20), a foaming form injection nozzle(30), a feed pump(40), and a controller(50). The fire detection tool senses fire break out existence and nonexistence in a tunnel. The mixer mixes foaming agent and water in a constant rate. The foam injection nozzle discharges the foam and is installed with constant intervals. The feed pump compulsorily transfers foams to a nozzle.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 터널 화재시 질식소화 및 연기전파 방지를 위한 발포폼 분사 시스템에 관한 것으로; 터널 안의 화재발생 유무를 감지하는 화재감지수단과, 발포제와 물을 일정비율로 혼합하는 혼합기와, 상기 발포제와 물의 혼합반응에 의해 발생되는 발포폼을 배출하되 터널에 설치되는 발포폼 분사노즐과, 상기 발포폼 분사노즐로의 발포폼을 강제이송하는 이송펌프와, 상기 화재감지수단을 통해 화재감지신호가 입력되면 상기 혼합기와 이송펌프를 구동하여 상기 발포폼 분사노즐로 발포폼을 배출하도록 제어하는 제어기로 구성되는 것을 특징으로 한다.  
본 발명에 따르면, 터널 내에서 밀폐공간을 형성하여 질식소화를 유도함에 따라 A급인 일반화재, B급인 유류화재, C급인 전기화재 이외에 금속화재 가스화재 등을 모두 소화할 수 있음은 물론, 밀폐공간을 형성함에 따라 화재연기 및 온도 전파 발생이 적이 터널내 시설물 피해를 최소화할 수 있다. 특히, 본 발명은 터널의 개방된 공간에서는 화재지점의 양측을 완전 밀폐하여 질식소화를 유도하고, 완전밀폐가 불가능한 지역은 제연경계벽을 형성할 수 있도록 운영함으로써 인명과 재산피해를 최소화할 수 있다.

title_en: Methods and systems for streaming buffer numerical propagation
abstract_en: Systems, methods, and instructions of computer-readable media may include obtaining, at a client machine, a user-selected configuration parameter for an orbit simulation; sending, from the client machine to a remote system, via a network connection, a first set of configuration parameters for the orbit simulation, wherein the first set of configuration parameters comprise the user-selected configuration parameter; receiving, at the client device from the remove device, via the network connection, a stream of orbital data comprising points along an orbit, wherein the points along the orbit are determined by the remote system based on the first set of configuration parameters; and presenting, at a display, a dynamic rendering of the orbit simulation, wherein the orbit simulation is based on the stream of orbital data.
assignees: SLINGSHOT AEROSPACE INC;MARCHAND BELINDA GRACE;LEDERMAN JOSHUA;KOENIG DANIEL;JONDROW MATTHEW

title_en: Urban flood cascade composite disaster event network construction and evaluation method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for constructing and evaluating an urban flood cascade composite disaster event network, which comprise the steps of acquiring a plurality of initial urban flood disaster text data, preprocessing the initial urban flood disaster text data, determining a plurality of target urban flood disaster text data, carrying out causal relation extraction on the target urban flood disaster text data, generating a plurality of dominant event text data and a plurality of display recessive event text data, analyzing the dominant event text data and the display recessive event text data, carrying out event fusion, determining a plurality of target event text data, constructing the target urban flood cascade composite disaster event network according to the target event text data, evaluating the target urban flood cascade composite disaster event network, generating urban flood disaster evaluation data, and solving the technical problems that the conventional urban flood network construction and risk evaluation technology is difficult to comprehensively and effectively evaluate risks brought by urban flood disasters.

title_en: Method for adjusting annual power generation plan of step hydropower under electric power market environment before month
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of hydroelectric power generation, and discloses a method for adjusting a cascade hydroelectric annual power generation plan before month in an electric power market environment, which comprises the steps of firstly constructing a power generation plan adjustment model, modeling benefits and operation requirements of hydroelectric power generation, inter-provincial power transmission and provincial power consumption, introducing opportunity constraint to describe risks of water level overrun of a hydropower station caused by runoff uncertainty, constructing two indexes of line disturbance rate and contract net adjustment rate to respectively manage influences of contract adjustment on a power transmission side and a power consumption side, modeling points on coupling relations between two types of power transmission modes of a network and a network-to-network and multi-provincial and multi-variety contracts, and then constructing The solving method is used for converting the power generation plan adjustment model into an SAA model and iteratively adjusting the risk level of the SAA model And finally, obtaining a contract adjustment scheme of the step hydropower. The invention can effectively solve the problem of contract adjustment, and the provided solving method can accelerate the obtaining of a feasible solution with high confidence on the basis of ensuring the solving precision.

title_en: Radion Frequency Repeater System of Disaster Broadcasting capable of Improving Quality using Noise Reduction of Digital Demodulation Signal
title_ko: 디지털 복조신호의 노이즈 리덕션 기능을 구현하여 전파음영지역의 방송품질을 개선한 재난방송 무선중계시스템
abstract_en: A disaster broadcasting wireless relay system having improved broadcasting quality in radio-shaded areas by implementing a noise reduction function of a digital demodulated signal according to the present invention includes: a disaster broadcasting receiving device installed inside a building in a radio-shaded area and equipped with a noise reduction FPGA module to reduce noise caused by the surrounding environments when receiving RF signals for disaster broadcasting to convert and output the digital demodulated signal from which noise has been removed into internet packet data; a main relay device installed to each floor constituting the interior of the building to receive the internet packet data outputted from the disaster broadcasting receiving device through a wired network and outputting the data into a short-range wireless signal; at least one sub-relay device installed to the floor in which the main relay device is installed to receive a short-range wireless signal outputted from the main relay device, modulate the signal into an RF signal for disaster broadcasting, and outputting the signal; and a user terminal having a disaster broadcasting reception communication module for receiving the RF signal for disaster broadcasting outputted through the sub-relay device. Therefore, according to the present invention, the disaster broadcast is easily delivered to radio-shaded areas, and the noise reduction function of the digital demodulated signal inputted to the disaster broadcasting reception facility is implemented, so that the reliability of a disaster broadcasting is improved.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 디지털 복조신호의 노이즈 리덕션 기능을 구현하여 전파음영지역의 방송품질을 개선한 재난방송 무선중계시스템, 본 발명에 따른 디지털 복조신호의 노이즈 리덕션 기능을 구현하여 전파음영지역의 방송품질을 개선한 재난방송 무선중계시스템은, 전파음영지역의 건물내부에 설치되며 재난방송용 RF신호를 수신하는 경우에 주변환경으로 인한 노이즈를 저감시키기 위한 노이즈 저감용 FPGA 모듈을 구비하여 노이즈가 제거된 디지털 복조신호를 인터넷 패킷데이터로 변환하여 출력하는  재난방송 수신장치; 상기 건물내부를 구성하는 층별로 설치되고 상기 재난방송 수신장치에서 출력되는 인터넷 패킷데이터를 유선망으로 수신하여 근거리 무선신호로 출력하는 메인중계장치; 상기 메인중계장치가 설치된 층에 적어도 하나 이상 설치되며 상기 메인중계장치에서 출력되는 근거리 무선신호를 수신하여 재난방송용 RF신호로 변조하여 출력하는 서브중계장치; 및 상기 서브중계장치를 통해 출력되는 재난방송용 RF신호를 수신하기 위한 재난방송수신용 통신모듈을 구비하는 사용자 단말기;를 구비할 수 있다. 
따라서, 본 발명은, 전파음영지역에 용이하게 재난방송을 전달할 수 있을 뿐만 아니라 재난방송 수신설비에 입력되는 디지털 복조신호의 노이즈 리덕션 기능을 구현하여 재난방송의 신뢰성을 향상시킬 수 있는 전파음영지역의 방송품질을 개선한 재난방송 무선중계시스템을 제공하는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Wireless communication auxiliary equipment system using CATV system, and main equipment and remote equipment therefor
title_ko: Catv 시스템을 활용한 소방무선통신보조설비 시스템과, 그를 위한 메인장비 및 리모트 장비
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a wireless communication auxiliary fire-fighting facility system utilizing a CATV system, a main device, and a remote device for the system. The wireless communication auxiliary facility system comprises: a main device which controls the overall wireless communication auxiliary facility system, receives disaster prevention signals from a wireless communication device of a central control room, removes frequency modulation and noise from the signals, and outputs the signals; a plurality of remote devices which are installed on underground and aboveground floors of a building where radio waves are not easily accessible, and communicate with firefighters' radios located on underground or aboveground floors of the building; a combiner which receives a signal, in which a disaster prevention signal of a first frequency band (f1) and an upward broadcast signal are combined, from a transmission line facility, separates the disaster prevention signal of the first frequency band (f1), and outputs the separated signals to the main device, receives and combines a disaster prevention signal of a second frequency band (f2) output from the main device and a downward broadcast signal from a head end facility, and outputs the combined signal to the transmission line facility; and a splitter which combines a disaster prevention signal of the first frequency band (f1) output from the remote device and an upward broadcast signal of the transmission line facility, receives a signal, in which the disaster prevention signal of the second frequency band (f2) and the downward broadcast signal are combined, from the transmission line facility, separates the disaster prevention signal of the second frequency band (f2), and outputs the separated signals to the remote device, wherein the main device uses different transmission and reception frequencies when communicating with the combiner, and the remote device uses different transmission and reception frequencies when communicating with the splitter. Therefore, the present invention provides a solution to communication disorders caused by phenomena such as howling and vibration, thereby enabling improvement of communication quality.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 CATV 시스템을 활용한 무선통신보조설비 시스템과,그를 위한 메인장비 및 리모트장비에 관한 것으로서, 그 무선통신보조설비 시스템은  무선통신보조설비 시스템을 전반적으로 제어하고,중앙통제실의 무선통신기기로부터 방재신호를 수신하여 주파수 변조 및 잡음을 제거하여 출력하는 메인장비; 전파 도달이 원활하지 않는 건물의 지하층 및 지상층에 설치되고, 상기 건물의 지하층 또는 지상층에 있는 대원무전기와 통신하는 복수의 리모트장비; 전송선로 설비로부터 제1주파수(f1) 대역의 방재신호와 상향 방송신호가 결합된 신호를 수신하여 제1주파수(f1) 대역의 방재신호를 분리하여 메인장비로 출력하고, 메인장비로부터 출력되는 제2주파수(f2) 대역의 방재신호와 헤드엔드설비로부터 하향 방송신호를 수신하여 결합한 후 전송선로 설비로 출력하는 컴바이너; 및 리모트장비로부터 출력되는 제1주파수(f1) 대역의 방재신호와 전송선로 설비의 상향 방송신호를 결합하고,전송선로 설비로부터 제2주파수(f2) 대역의 방재신호와 하향 방송신호가 결합된 신호를 수신하여 제2주파수(f2) 대역의 방재신호를 분리한 후 리모트 장비로 출력하는 분기기를 포함하고, 그 메인장비는 컴바이너와의 통신시 송신주파수와 수신주파수를 달리하고, 그 리모트장비는 분기기와 통신시 송신주파수와 수신주파수를 달리한다.

title_en: Set up the method for route under a kind of unidirectional link environment
abstract_en: Set up the method for route under a kind of unidirectional link environment, this method is applicable to AD Hoc network field, to reduce the influence of one way link in AD Hoc network information transfer.This method is passed through increasing neighbors information in the RREQ message format, make the existence of setting up the node affirmation one way link as early as possible in the process in route, the unnecessary energy loss that produces to reduce one way link to propagate message once more makes the AODV routing procedure can support one way link preferably and be easy to realize.And periodically send the Hello2 message by each node, reduce expense problems of too in the Hello method.Reduce energy loss in the occasion of the needs such as to make military operation, disaster relief and mobile meeting, sensor network of originally improving one's methods use AD Hoc network, can prolong the useful life of the additional node of noenergy.

title_en: Giant salamander Bionic reproduction facility
abstract_en: Giant salamander Bionic reproduction facility, relates to a kind of aquatic products propagation technique field, particularly relates to a kind of giant salamander Bionic reproduction facility.Giant salamander Bionic reproduction facility of the present utility model, is characterized in that setting up cultivation place on tableland or gentle slope, excavates small stream ditch within it; Above small stream ditch, weep pipe is set, aperture water supply drip is equidistantly set below weep pipe and falls, in weep pipe, valve is set; Small stream ditch delivery port position arranges filter screen and drainpipe, and drainpipe is connected with escape canal; Xi Gou excavates both sides several Ecology caves, and bottom is communicated with small stream ditch.Giant salamander Bionic reproduction facility of the present utility model, by the construction to cultivation place, small stream ditch and Ecology cave, simulation and reduction giant salamander fit ecotope that is raw and breeding, are conducive to growing of close salamander; The natural calamities such as storm flood can be avoided; Effectively can prevent the harm of natural enemy; Be convenient to manage and protect, giant salamander safety, water quality and safety thereof all can effectively be ensured.

title_en: A kind of emotion Internet communication dynamic model based on SIRS and the emotion propagation analogy method using the model
abstract_en: A kind of emotion Internet communication dynamic model based on SIRS of the present invention and the emotion propagation analogy method using the model, by improving original traditional viral transmission model, provide the kinetics equation of SIRS propagation model, the stability of the model is proved, it compares classics SIRS viral transmission and the simulation experiment result analysis is carried out to each emotion variable density, which can preferably react emotion propagation characteristic.The present invention by emotion this subjective psychology concept together with social networks action amalgamation, reasonable mapping that both model accurately reflects.It can be used for similar negative public sentiment event mood wave fission in propagation process.

title_en: Consider the real-time generation schedule optimization method of northern Shensi cascade cross-section limitation linkage adjustment
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of real-time generation schedule optimization method of consideration northern Shensi cascade cross-section limitation linkage adjustment, it include: based on all kinds of basic datas of real-time generation schedule, it constructs broad sense and gets in touch with the off line province's two-stage real-time generation schedule Coordination and Optimization Model of ray mode, cascade cross-section limitation combined optimization for real-time generation schedule and northern Shensi and unit original plan value and the initial trend value of section are provided；Based on all kinds of basic datas of real-time generation schedule, unit original plan and the initial trend value of section, building considers the real-time generation schedule Optimized model of northern Shensi cascade cross-section limitation linkage adjustment, it is minimum that optimization aim introduces northern Shensi virtual partition new energy abandonment amount, constraint condition introduces northern Shensi subregion and cascades section, the constraint such as Central Shanxi Plain subregion receiving ability, realize the combined optimization of unit output and stable cross section limit, Shaanxi Province northern Shensi subregion new energy consumption potentiality are sufficiently excavated, improve the utilization rate of northern Shensi cascade section, the lean for improving the scheduling of northwest regional power grid new energy is horizontal.
assignees: NARI TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;NORTHWEST CHINA GRID CO LTD;STATE GRID NARI NANJING CONTROL SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Emergency logistics network risk propagation method and system based on material reliability
abstract_en: An emergency logistics network risk transmission method based on material reliability comprises the steps of firstly, introducing emergency material reliability factors, constructing an emergency logistics network by combining a complex network theory, and analyzing risk transmission by combining an improved infectious disease model; further analyzing an emergency logistics risk propagation mechanism and an evolution rule from the network structure and the evolution rule thereof; and finally, analyzing and discussing the utility and risk propagation influence factors of the model by a simulation technology, and providing an emergency logistics risk management and control strategy according to the result. The invention also comprises a system for implementing the emergency logistics network risk propagation method based on the material reliability. According to the method, the main factors influencing the risk propagation of the emergency logistics are analyzed in combination with the actual situation, and a strategy for controlling the risk propagation of the emergency logistics is given, so that the loss caused by the risk is reduced.

title_en: Power grid cascading failure risk assessment method considering relay protection refusal influence
abstract_en: The invention provides a power grid cascading failure risk assessment method considering the relay protection refusal influence, and belongs to the technical field of power grid operation risk assessment. The method comprises the following steps: s1, selecting a target system, considering the influence of the running environment and running state of the relay protection equipment, and establishing a failure probability model of the relay protection equipment; s2, obtaining the action rejection probability of each relay protection device in the target system according to the action rejection probability model of the relay protection device established in S1; s3, obtaining the state probability of the target system according to the primary failure probability of the target system and the action rejection probability of each relay protection device; and S4, performing risk assessment on the cascading failure of the target system according to the improved state space segmentation method.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID NINGXIA ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV SOUTHEAST

title_en: Event-driven power distribution network information physical system risk assessment calculation method
abstract_en: The invention provides a risk assessment and calculation method for a power distribution network information physical system based on event driving. And then, based on a cross-space cascading failure evolution model, providing and establishing a distribution network operation quantitative risk assessment index. Finally, a risk assessment calculation method of the power distribution network information physical system based on event driving is provided. The invention discloses a risk evaluation calculation method of a power distribution network information physical system, which aims at extracting key elements of the power distribution network cross-information-physical space cascading failure, provides description on risk conduction of different levels and propagation and mapping relations of risks among the different levels, and provides a calculation evaluation method for the risks of the power distribution network information physical system based on an event-driven model.

title_en: Electric power system fragile line evaluation method and system considering cyber attack risk
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for evaluating a fragile line of an electric power system by considering cyber attack risks, which fully consider the influence mechanism of the cyber attack on the line vulnerability and the cascading process of line faults and provide the method for evaluating the fragile line of the electric power system by considering the cyber attack risks. By calculating the potential maximum power flow of the line under the network attack and carrying out comprehensive risk evaluation by using the line fault disguise degree index and the minimum tangential load, the screening and risk sequencing of the high-risk line are realized, and the defects that the network attack threat and the network attack physical consequence are not considered in the current evaluation method are overcome.

title_en: Transient model of transformer winding
abstract_en: The invention provides a transient model of a transformer winding. The model enables a winding to be equivalent to a multi-conductor transmission line, and innovation processing is carried out on discrete difference operation at the port of the transmission line based on a time domain finite difference method of a conventional multi-conductor transmission line, so that the model gets rid of the terminal characteristic of an external network, and can be independently packaged and modularized, and integration of a transient model of the transformer winding and an external complex transformer substation network is realized. Compared with the original time domain finite difference method, the algorithm of the transient model can reduce the error to 0.025%. The method lays a foundation for analyzing the propagation characteristics of the high-frequency signals in the transformer substation network and the influence of the topological structure on online diagnosis of winding deformation.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INST OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Proppant laying form prediction method and system based on cascade neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a proppant laying form prediction method and system based on a cascade neural network, wherein the method comprises the following steps: (1) Adopting a numerical simulation method to establish a crack grid model with the same experimental test scale, and calculating relevant parameters of proppant migration; (2) Grid node data of the vertical slit width section is obtained through calculation according to the slit grid model, and uniform grid surface data is obtained through an interpolation method; (3) Dividing the data obtained after interpolation in the step (2) into a training sample and a test sample, and constructing a cascade neural network model, (4) optimizing the grid size of the crack grid model, and adjusting the neural network parameters and hidden layer node numbers of the cascade neural network model until the error requirement is met; (5) And predicting the proppant laying morphology by using the cascade neural network model. The invention realizes the whole form and dynamic change prediction of the sand dike based on data driving and has the advantages of small error and high calculation efficiency.

title_en: Multi-layer collaborative optimization method, system, equipment and medium for power distribution network-energy storage-user
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network-energy storage-user multilayer collaborative optimization method, a system, equipment and a medium, belongs to the technical field of power distribution network planning, and aims to provide a novel power distribution network-energy storage-user multilayer collaborative optimization method, a system, equipment and a medium. Comprising the following steps: the distributed energy storage of the combined user and the centralized energy storage of the energy storage operators form a distributed energy storage set and a centralized energy storage sharing cloud energy storage mode; constructing a multi-layer collaborative operation optimization model, wherein the multi-layer collaborative operation optimization model comprises an upper-layer power distribution network model, a middle-layer shared energy storage model and a lower-layer user cluster model; and carrying out layered optimization solution on the multi-layer collaborative operation optimization model by adopting a target cascade analysis algorithm to obtain an optimal scheme, and carrying out optimization scheduling on energy storage of the cloud energy storage mode according to the optimal scheme. The layering optimization solution of the model is realized by adopting a target cascading analysis algorithm, so that the economic benefit of each participating main body is improved, and the influence caused by the grid connection of the distributed clean energy is reduced.

title_en: Guide plate optimization design method and device based on physical driving parameterized proxy model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deflector optimal design method and device based on a physical driving parameterized proxy model, which comprises the steps of firstly, confirming boundary conditions and basic physical properties of a flow field environment where a deflector is positioned and a value range of design parameters of the deflector, and defining physical field variables and performance indexes of requirements; then, a physical driving neural network model is established, partial differentiation of each physical field variable with respect to space-time coordinates is calculated based on back propagation, a control equation is carried in to calculate residual errors, and neuron weights are trained and adjusted; finally, parameterizing and solving flow fields around the guide plate by using the inference model obtained by training, and further solving the optimized guide plate placement position and geometric shape design parameters. The invention only uses one-step parameterized flow field unsupervised learning to replace a series of repeated manual operations of the traditional numerical simulation method, and the method does not need to collect any training data in advance, so that the overall modeling and simulation design period is greatly shortened.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG;SHANGHAI ADVANCED RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF ZHEJIANG UNIV

title_en: Equipment cascading failure risk assessment method and system based on distribution network twin model
abstract_en: A device cascading failure risk assessment method and system based on a distribution network twinning model are characterized by comprising the steps of generating N-1-k expected failure sets and N-I-1 expected failure sets for different initial expected outage elements when failure occurs according to failure states of equipment elements and topological relations among the equipment elements in a distribution network, wherein the distribution network topology is extracted to judge the topological connection mode of the initial expected outage elements in the distribution network, generating N-1-k expected failure sets or N-1-1 expected failure sets based on the topological connection mode, calculating failure probability of each equipment element in the distribution network, calculating low-voltage risks of all nodes and overload risks of all lines in the expected failure sets according to each expected failure set to generate distribution network cascading failure risk for each expected failure set, and sequencing importance of different expected failure sets based on the distribution network cascading failure risk of each expected failure set.
assignees: NANJING NARI INFORMATION COMM TECH CO LTD

title_en: Modeling method and system for urban environment
abstract_en: The application discloses a modeling method and a modeling system for urban environment, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a Fresnel zone according to longitude and latitude coordinates of a preset zone, extracting environment parameters affecting electric wave propagation in the Fresnel zone according to an electric wave propagation theory, obtaining potential variables in the Fresnel zone according to a preset algorithm, inputting the environment parameters and the potential variables into a preset prediction model to obtain a path loss prediction result, realizing accurate prediction of a point-to-point large-scale channel of the dense urban environment by the method, and the output prediction result can be applied to urban network planning and optimization.

title_en: Coastal city storm surge disaster toughness assessment method based on graph neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating the toughness of a storm surge disaster in an coastal city based on a graphic neural network, which is used for collecting multi-source heterogeneous data related to the storm surge disaster in the coastal city, and comprises geographic information data, infrastructure data and historical storm surge data, constructing coastal city infrastructure network structure data according to the geographic information data and the infrastructure data, then constructing a graphic neural network model, merging characteristic parameters of the historical storm surge data with the coastal city infrastructure network structure data, inputting the trained graphic neural network model, simulating the progressive influence of the storm surge disaster on coastal city infrastructure nodes, evaluating the state evolution of each node in the coastal city infrastructure network under the influence of the storm surge based on the propagation result of the graphic neural network, and respectively carrying out summarizing analysis on different functional areas based on the obtained toughness evaluation index data of each node to form an integral coastal city toughness evaluation result.
assignees: TIANJIN PORT ENG INST LTD CCCC FIRST HARBOR ENG CO LTD;CCCC FIRST HARBOR ENG CO LTD;TIANJIN PORT ENG QUALITY TESTING CT CO LTD

title_en: Enterprise risk early warning method and system based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of data management, in particular to an enterprise risk early warning method and system based on multi-source data fusion. The method comprises the steps of receiving an internal document and a knowledge base, extracting an enterprise data set, constructing a dynamic knowledge graph, executing multi-layer iterative message transmission based on a double-layer attention mechanism in an influence propagation model based on a space-time diagram neural network, generating a health state vector, inputting the health state vector into a multi-task decoding framework, purifying the characteristics of each risk task through an opposite unbiasing network, generating a risk specific vector, enabling the risk specific vector to pass through a plurality of task unbiasing terminals to obtain a risk estimated value, and updating the influence propagation model through a collision resolution optimizer based on gradient projection by the difference value of the risk estimated value and real loss. According to the invention, the systematic risk exposure is quantified through a double-layer attention mechanism, and the pseudo-correlation interference in the multi-source data is reduced through the antagonism unbiased network.

title_en: Electric power system tide shifts dangerous line method for fast searching
abstract_en: A kind of electric power system tide shifts dangerous line method for fast searching, methods described first according to graph theory and voltage phase angle search broken string circuit etc. phase angle parallel powerline, then look for the shortest path of the phase angle parallel powerlines such as the process between the Origin And Destination of broken string circuit, by the railway superstructures power flow transfer line set on the path, the line power after the active power transfer limit and power flow transfer further according to each power flow transfer circuit tries to achieve the power flow transfer hazard index of each power flow transfer circuit, power flow transfer dangerous line is finally determined according to power flow transfer hazard index.The present invention can start to the of short duration time of action in overload reserve protection, the dangerous line of power flow transfer rapidly and accurately be searched, to prevent cascading trip and large-scale blackout from providing technical support.In addition, this method also has the advantages that amount of calculation is few, and search speed is fast, suitable for the analysis and Control of bulk power grid.

title_en: Explosion diameter inversion method based on transient flow
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for realizing the inversion of the diameter of a burst pipe, in order to realize the location of the burst pipe in a pipe network, a high-frequency SCADA system is applied to monitor a pressure abnormal signal in the pipe network, and on the basis of the location of the burst pipe, a total monitoring signal is decomposed into branch monitoring signals from each propagation path according to the propagation characteristics of transient flow; inverting the propagation path and characteristics of the transient flow, namely inverting the local loss and the friction loss in the original propagation process to obtain the reciprocal of the local loss and the friction loss, converting the reciprocal of the local loss and the friction loss into gain, inverting the excitation signals from each path, and superposing the excitation signals to form a total inversion excitation signal; and according to the relation between the detonation excitation signal and the detonation diameter, the excitation signal takes the maximum amplitude, the detonation diameter takes the maximum value, and the detonation diameter is calculated. The comparison of the diameter of the detonation calculated by the method with the actual diameter of the detonation and the instantaneous flow attenuation method proves that the positioning precision of the method is higher, and the method can effectively solve the problem of the diameter inversion of the detonation.

title_en: City infrastructure group elasticity analysis method, electronic device, and storage medium
abstract_en: An urban infrastructure group elasticity analysis method, electronic equipment and a storage medium belong to the technical field of evaluation analysis. In order to solve the technical problems that the existing urban infrastructure analysis method is too simple, breaks away from the analysis of actual conditions and the like, the method for constructing the cascade failure model of the urban infrastructure group network comprises the steps of counting the operation data of urban infrastructures, and converting the operation data of the urban infrastructures into the operation function values of the urban infrastructures; establishing a city infrastructure group as an analysis basic unit based on the operation function value of the city infrastructure, and performing primary division on the city infrastructure group; performing secondary division on the primarily divided urban infrastructure group by adopting a DBSCAN algorithm to obtain a final urban infrastructure group; establishing a cascade failure model of the urban infrastructure group; and performing elasticity analysis on infrastructures in the urban infrastructure group and the urban infrastructure group. The elasticity analysis of the invention is more comprehensive, and the elasticity capability measurement of the actual system is more reasonable.

title_en: Multi-energy collaborative power supply self-adaptive online optimization method
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-energy collaborative power supply self-adaptive online optimization method, which not only considers the operation cost, but also comprehensively considers pollution cost and energy loss by establishing a multi-energy collaborative power supply optimization objective function and constraint conditions, optimizes the utilization of resources, reduces investment and operation cost, consumes clean energy sources such as wind power, photovoltaic and the like to the maximum extent, establishes a wind power prediction model and a photovoltaic power generation power prediction model, predicts wind power by a prediction method based on a BP-GA model or a support vector machine, predicts photovoltaic power generation power by a K-Cascaded-attention network, improves the accuracy of wind power and photovoltaic power generation power prediction, and dynamically planning and scheduling the multi-energy to obtain a multi-energy collaborative power supply scheme and improve the utilization rate of the energy.

title_en: Risk domain control method and system based on train formation operation risk cause analysis
abstract_en: The invention provides a risk domain control method and a system based on train formation operation risk cause analysis, which belong to the technical field of train operation control and realize adjacent train state information interaction based on a train-to-train communication technology, wherein a dynamic Bayesian network is utilized to construct a risk situation propagation model and carry out sensitivity analysis and sequencing on each risk node by taking a braking anti-skid system with low efficiency and a formation inter-train communication link failure as risk sources under abnormal weather and taking a formation train collision as an accident result, a nonlinear vibration theory and a Rayleigh equation are utilized to describe vibration characteristics and microscopic evolution processes in the risk situation change, a sensitivity weight value of a node with the largest influence on the occurrence probability of a collision accident is taken as a damping coefficient of the Rayleigh equation, and the relation between a control variable and the damping coefficient is explored based on damping control, so that the risk domain is converged in an initial safety state. The invention can realize the risk domain control oriented to train formation operation from the system level angle.

title_en: Lake and reservoir type water source protection area precise division method based on multi-time space scale index dynamic coupling
abstract_en: The invention provides a lake and reservoir type water source protection area precise dividing method based on multi-time space scale index dynamic coupling, which constructs a risk propagation network and a multi-scale index dynamic weight distribution model in a water source area through multi-time space scale decomposition and feature extraction, utilizes a cross-scale index association transfer calculation frame to realize information fusion among different time space scale indexes, constructs a time-space scale self-adaptive QQEM-PSR evaluation system based on a scale coupling feature space and a dynamic weight matrix, and solves the technical problems of difficult multi-time space scale index coupling, insufficient risk evaluation staticization and protection area boundary optimization and the like in the traditional method, thereby realizing precise division and dynamic optimization management of the water source protection area.

title_en: Urban physical examination accurate analysis method and system based on AI multi-modal data collaboration
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data analysis, in particular to an urban physical examination accurate analysis method and system based on AI multi-modal data cooperation, comprising the following steps of constructing a self-adaptive fractal space-time grid, and mapping an urban multi-modal data source into a space-time coding vector with fractal dimension; the method comprises the steps of establishing a physical field driven collaborative resonance network, extracting abnormal collaborative modes exceeding a normal resonance threshold, calculating a modal entropy chain value according to the real-time metabolic rate of an urban system, generating an optimal weight matrix through an unbalanced thermodynamic model, fusing the abnormal collaborative modes and the dynamic weight matrix, and generating a space-time causal map showing fault origins and propagation paths by using a causal discovery algorithm. According to the invention, the multi-mode data collaboration and causal analysis technology is utilized, so that the emergency response capability of the urban system in the face of sudden faults is improved, the stability of urban operation is ensured, and the space-time causal map provides comprehensive visual information for the fault propagation process.

title_en: Insulated union for explosion- proof
title_ko: 방폭용 절연 유니온
abstract_ko:
본 고안은 주로 가스 또는 증기지역, 화학약품이 사용되는 장소 및 정유시설이나 가스 정제시설 등 인화성 물질을 취급 항시 폭발 및 화재의 위험이 상존하는 지역에서 이용되는 전기 에너지를 필요로 하는 각종 기기들의 전원 케이블, 전기스위치 및 스위치박스, 컨넥터 등)의 라인에 연결되어 절연 기능을 하므로써 각종 전기기에 낙뇌와 같은 돌입되는 전기를 방지하여 전기기의 오동작과 파손을 방지할 수 있고,내부폭발 시 화염전파를 방지 할 수 있는방폭용 절연 유니온에 관한 고안이다. 
방폭용 절연 유니온은 기기에 고정되는 고정부재와 고정부재에 연결되는 연경부재와 이들을 고정시키는 나사캡으로 구성되며 연결부재는 내측 부재와 외측 부재로 분할 구성하여 절연부재 접착면을 구비시키며 외측부재와 내측부재 사이에 접착고정되는 절연부재는 양쪽으로 접착면이 구비되고 내면 중앙에는 보강 절연부가 구비된다.

title_en: Neural network algorithm-based material deformation and failure prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for predicting material deformation and failure based on a neural network algorithm, wherein the method comprises the following steps: step 1: acquiring experimental data of the mechanical property of the material, and dividing the experimental data into a training set and a testing set; step 2: establishing a multilayer feedforward neural network; and step 3: training the multilayer feedforward neural network by using a training set according to an error inverse propagation algorithm; and 4, step 4: testing the multi-layer feedforward neural network after training by using a test set; and 5: and predicting the deformation and failure behaviors of the material and guiding the manufacturing process. The invention establishes a brand new experiment-neural network-simulation-manufacturing research route, greatly reduces the calculation cost and improves the research and development efficiency.

title_en: Fault propagation diagnosis method for complex electromechanical system
abstract_en: The invention provides a fault propagation diagnosis method of a complex electromechanical system, which mainly comprises the following steps: constructing a topology network model facing the complex electromechanical system based on the existence of mechanical, information and electrical connection relations among all components in the complex electromechanical system; constructing a fault propagation network of the complex electromechanical system by combining a topological network model according to historical fault data and a fault diagnosis manual of the complex electromechanical system; calculating the topological attribute and the functional attribute of the complex electromechanical system, and further constructing a fault step-by-step propagation diffusion model so as to obtain a fault propagation path set; and finally, constructing propagation strength calculation methods of different fault propagation paths for judging the fault propagation paths. The fault diagnosis method constructed by the invention can effectively judge which parts are subjected to linkage influence after a certain part is in fault, and further, the extension of the fault can be effectively prevented by maintaining the parts in advance, so that the linkage loss of economic properties caused by the fault is avoided.

title_en: Power grid information physical system risk assessment method considering cascading failure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid information physical system risk assessment method considering cascading failure, which belongs to the field of electric power energy and comprises the following contents: firstly, explaining a cascading failure evolution mechanism of a power system, and establishing a power line operation reliability model based on a piecewise function form; then, establishing a power system cascading failure probability index based on a Markov chain method, a power system cascading failure consequence index based on a severity function and a power system cascading failure comprehensive consequence index based on a fuzzy analytic hierarchy process; furthermore, according to a deterministic method in reliability evaluation, a power system cascading failure analysis method considering the reliability of the stability control service is provided; finally, the feasibility and the rationality of the proposed method are verified in an example system; the invention can provide accurate reference for the operators of the power system and reduce the possibility of cascading failure and the consequences of disasters of the power system.

title_en: Charging station load small sample detection method based on graph neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a charging station load small sample detection method based on a graph neural network, which comprises the following steps: according to the graph theory, the electric power system is represented as a graph, and then the characteristic extraction capability of the encoder is utilized by utilizing the variational graph, and the low-dimensional vector representation of the electric vehicle charging station on each time slice is obtained; combining the low-dimensional vector with the load data label of the time slice to serve as a node of the input graph convolution neural network, and then constructing a support set and a query set and constructing a graph required by the required input graph convolution neural network; inputting the constructed graph into a graph convolution neural network, and performing iterative update solution by utilizing space-based graph convolution neural network operation; the information is propagated and shared in the network, and is stabilized after a plurality of recursions, and the node label information to be detected is a detection result. The invention fully considers the relation of time series and the influence of the space full graph, and captures more information to detect the load by considering the integrity of the power system.

title_en: Photovoltaic power generation scheduling method, equipment and storage medium based on virtual power plant
abstract_en: The application provides a photovoltaic power generation scheduling method, equipment and a storage medium based on a virtual power plant. The method comprises the following steps: a plurality of data acquisition devices are arranged at the photovoltaic power plant to acquire illumination data; confirming a plurality of power generation data of the photovoltaic virtual machine set based on the illumination data; based on the grid connection time and the grid connection power, confirming that a plurality of hydroelectric units in the cascade hydroelectric power plant are used as grid connection adjusting units, and confirming a load instruction of each grid connection adjusting unit; when the grid-connected time is reached, each grid-connected adjusting unit adjusts according to the corresponding load instruction; based on the net-withdrawing time and net-withdrawing power, confirming that a plurality of hydroelectric units in the cascade hydroelectric power plant are used as net-withdrawing regulating units, and confirming a load instruction of each net-withdrawing regulating unit; when the network-quitting time is reached, each network-quitting adjusting unit adjusts according to the corresponding load instruction. The technical problem that the load adjusting effect is poor when the photovoltaic power plant is connected with and disconnected from the grid is solved.
assignees: HUBEI QINGJIANG HYDROELECTRIC DEV CO LTD

title_en: Acceleration simulation solving method and system of controllable self-recovery energy dissipation device
abstract_en: The application provides an acceleration simulation solving method and system of a controllable self-recovery energy dissipation device, comprising the steps of S1, respectively establishing a circuit model for a linear network and a nonlinear network by equivalent of an inductance element between the nonlinear network and the linear network in a hybrid cascade direct current transmission system as a short transmission line, S2, obtaining the value of a current controlled voltage source based on the node voltage of one simulation time step on the linear network and the nonlinear network, the value of a controlled voltage source and an information interaction format, S3, carrying out node voltage solving based on the value of the controlled voltage source of the current simulation time step to obtain the node voltage of the current simulation time step, stopping if the iteration times are met, otherwise, jumping to S2, wherein the nonlinear network comprises the controllable self-recovery energy dissipation device, and the application divides the linear main circuit in the energy dissipation device and the circuit system into the network, reduces the calculated amount, solves the problem by using an iteration algorithm to ensure high-efficiency high-precision simulation of the nonlinear network and the linear network.
assignees: STATE GRID SMART GRID RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Power system cascading failure simulation method and medium based on comprehensive load model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system cascading failure simulation method and medium based on a comprehensive load model, wherein the method comprises the following steps: establishing a power transmission network differential algebraic model, wherein the power transmission network differential algebraic model comprises a generator, a speed regulator and an exciter differential algebraic model and a network tide algebraic model; establishing a relay protection logic model and a comprehensive load model of each power distribution network, wherein the comprehensive load model comprises a power distribution network equivalent branch impedance model, a static ZIP load model, a dynamic induction motor load model, a distributed power supply model and a reactive compensation capacitor model; and performing cascading failure simulation on the power system according to the differential algebra model, the relay protection logic model and the comprehensive load model of the power transmission network. The invention considers the influence of the dynamic process of the distributed power supply on the overall process of the cascading failure in the cascading failure simulation, thereby ensuring the accuracy of the cascading failure simulation data result and simultaneously ensuring the high efficiency of modeling work and simulation.

title_en: Public opinion event propagation analysis method, system and computer program product
abstract_en: The application belongs to an event analysis method, and provides a public opinion event propagation analysis method, a system and a computer program product, which aim at the technical problems that mathematical models are not fully used for exploring causes and propagation mechanisms in network space in the current research about the emotion of netizens, analyze propagation conditions of public opinion events by adopting different models at different stages of the public opinion events, divide progress of the public opinion events according to whether bifurcation occurs, describe the network public opinion events by using a mode of combining a chaotic dynamics model with an infectious disease model, analyze the propagation processes of the public opinion respectively at each stage, and further can fundamentally know reasons and essential reasons that the network public opinion events become network violent events, thereby making a strategy for controlling the trend of the public opinion according to the method. The comprehensive model provided by the application can be improved, the public opinion process which can possibly appear a web storm can be completely described, and in practical application, treatment suggestions can be given by combining data analysis.

title_en: Vulnerability assessment method based on mixed transmission allocation factors
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vulnerability assessment method based on mixed transmission allocation factors, which belongs to the technical field of interdependent network vulnerability assessment and comprises the steps of constructing a coupling system model comprising an electric power network layer, a hydrogen energy network layer and a logistics network layer, respectively calculating the transmission allocation factors of the electric power network layer, the hydrogen energy network layer and the logistics network layer, establishing an interlayer sensitivity coupling relation through a coupling weight matrix, forming a global mixed transmission allocation factor (MTDF) matrix by adopting a layered sensitivity calculation and cross-layer coupling mapping technology, realizing cross-layer influence quantification of new energy output fluctuation, automatically identifying key fragile nodes and establishing a cascading fault propagation model, and solving the technical problem of assessing the coupling vulnerability of a three-layer network of a green harbor electric power-hydrogen energy-logistics by calculating L2 norm to propose a vulnerability assessment index before and after a fault.

title_en: Cascade fault analysis method based on digital twin and physical power and related components
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascading failure analysis method and related components based on digital twin and physical power, wherein the method comprises the steps of establishing a double-layer coupling network model through a digital twin virtual network and a physical power network; setting a cascading failure propagation process through the load information of the digital twin virtual network and the physical power network and a preset load redistribution strategy, so as to construct a multi-layer network cascading failure model, updating the multi-layer network cascading failure model according to the communication delay between the digital twin virtual network and the physical power network to obtain a target cascading failure model, and carrying out cascading failure analysis on a specified power system by utilizing the target cascading failure model. The invention is based on the coupling symbiosis between the digital twin virtual network and the physical power network, and combines communication delay to construct the target cascading failure model, and the analysis accuracy and reliability of the cascading failure of the power system can be effectively improved through the target cascading failure model.

title_en: Data fusion-based taxi electricity utilization abnormality early warning system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rental house electricity consumption abnormality early warning system and method based on data fusion, and relates to the technical field of electricity consumption abnormality early warning; according to the invention, a non-invasive load decomposer, a distributed temperature sensor and a high-frequency current transformer are deployed at distribution boxes, sockets and cable nodes, space-time alignment of current, temperature and load data is realized through a sliding time window algorithm, LSTM model parameters are improved by adopting an optimization algorithm, the recognition accuracy of abnormal appliances is improved, a digital twin model is built, a distribution network topology is mapped into a graph structure, the abnormal propagation probability is dynamically calculated and a risk path is visualized, hierarchical early warning is realized through a dynamic weight model integrating current deviation degree, temperature rise gradient and load mutation, the recognition accuracy of complex abnormal modes is improved, the visual prejudgment of the risk propagation path is realized, and the complete closed loop from risk early warning to active protection is realized.
assignees: SHAOXING YUEDEAN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-mode traffic network robustness calculation method under typhoon disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-mode traffic network robustness calculation method under typhoon disasters, which comprises the steps of constructing an inter-city public traffic network comprising a plurality of traffic modes, generating an air pressure attenuation model and a typhoon continuous influence model by combining space-time dynamic characteristics of the typhoon disasters, calculating failure probability distribution and state of the inter-city public traffic network under the typhoon disasters based on a system vulnerability curve and a Monte Carlo simulation method, establishing a traffic network cascade failure model according to the failure probability distribution and state of the inter-city public traffic network under the typhoon disasters, simulating the structure and function loss process of traffic network sites and lines under the disaster conditions, designing a traffic network robustness index calculation system, and quantifying the performance change of the inter-city public traffic network from two aspects of topological structures and service functions. The invention can accurately quantify the influence of typhoon disasters on a traffic system.

title_en: Cascade water light and light storage complementary planning and scheduling method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a cascade water light storage complementary planning and scheduling method and system, which belong to the field of operation control of electric power systems, and comprise the steps of calculating target electric quantity of a cascade water light storage complementary system in each unit time period to be transmitted to a power grid according to total guaranteed electric quantity of the cascade water light storage complementary system in a unit time period in a scheduling period, calculating total regulated electric quantity of the cascade water light storage complementary system in any unit time period according to the total guaranteed electric quantity and total water light resource electric quantity of any unit time period, determining regulated electric quantity of each reservoir according to the total regulated electric quantity and preset quota coefficients corresponding to each reservoir in the cascade water light storage complementary system, and determining water level change quantity of each reservoir according to the regulated electric quantity and a potential energy analysis formula of each reservoir. According to the invention, the distribution scheduling model based on the reservoir power generation potential energy analysis expression is established, so that the reservoir optimization scheduling is converted from the traditional high-dimensional nonlinear programming problem into the algebraic solving problem, and the efficiency and stability in calculating the water level variation of the reservoir are improved.
assignees: HUADIAN JINSHA RIVER UPSTREAM HYDROPOWER DEV CO LTD;CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES;POWERCHINA NORTHWEST ENG CORP LTD;UNIV XIAN TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Multi-dimensional historical data-based distribution network material supply chain node load analysis method, equipment, medium and product
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, equipment, medium and product for analyzing the load of a power distribution network material supply chain node based on multidimensional historical data, and relates to the technical field of power distribution network material supply chain management, wherein the method comprises the steps of extracting the spatial characteristic and the temporal characteristic of the load of the supply chain node; the method comprises the steps of constructing a dynamic effective capacity model of a node according to physical attribute data, constructing a multi-factor demand generation model according to business logic data and time characteristics, predicting node load demands, defining a composite load index according to the dynamic effective capacity model of the node and a node load demand predicting result, quantifying the load state of the node to obtain a load quantifying result, constructing a power distribution network supply chain space-time network according to space characteristics and the load quantifying result, and identifying key bottleneck nodes by utilizing a node load pressure propagation algorithm. The application can reveal potential bottlenecks and risk points of the supply chain and provide data support for network structure optimization and emergency strategy formulation.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER;STATE GRID ECONOMIC AND TECHNOLOGICAL RESEARCH INST CO LTD

title_en: Information physical safety early warning method, device and equipment for liquefied natural gas receiving station
abstract_en: The application provides a physical safety pre-warning method, device and equipment for information of a liquefied natural gas receiving station. The method comprises the steps of respectively identifying nodes on each subsystem of each layer, determining a risk node and a connection mechanism of the risk node, acquiring a risk network structure according to the risk node and the connection mechanism of the risk node, respectively acquiring the risk entropy, the risk state and the energy influence value of each risk node by adopting an SIRS model, and respectively acquiring the propagation processes under two preset propagation mechanisms according to the risk entropy, the risk state and the energy influence value of each risk node so as to predict a risk path. Compared with the prior art, the method and the system for quantitatively analyzing the risk propagation by using the energy influence value realize quantitative analysis of the risk propagation according to the risk entropy, the risk state and the energy influence value, and complete the prediction of the risk path by performing qualitative analysis on the nodes in the station by staff according to the personal service level and the working experience.

title_en: Water, wind and solar energy storage multi-target scheduling method based on improved mixed particle swarm gray wolf optimization algorithm
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power system optimization scheduling, and particularly relates to a multi-target day-ahead peak regulation scheduling method of a step water-wind-solar-energy storage complementary power generation system. The method comprises the specific steps of establishing a mathematical model of a water-wind-solar complementary system, constructing a multi-objective optimization framework considering power generation benefits and peak regulation effects, constructing a prediction network by using a self-adaptive multi-time scale Improved LSTNet to conduct daily prediction on water inflow of a cascade river basin section, power generation of a photovoltaic power station and power generation of a wind power station to serve as input data of the model, solving the modeled model by adopting an improved multi-objective mixed particle swarm gray wolf optimization algorithm (IMOPSO-GWO), coordinating global exploration and local development capability through a convergence factor self-adaptive adjustment mechanism, introducing a dynamic mutation operator to enhance Pareto front search efficiency, and finally obtaining a daily scheduling scheme of the complementary system. The invention has remarkable effects in reducing the residual load fluctuation of the power grid and improving the power generation income by optimizing the output of the step hydroelectric generating set and the energy storage.

title_en: Power distribution network operation risk control method based on Bayesian optimization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network operation risk control method based on Bayesian optimization, which comprises the following steps of S1, utilizing power distribution network multi-source operation data to establish a node-side double-space coupling dynamic diagram, S2, based on the dynamic diagram, generating space-time embedded vectors through self-supervision tasks of multi-level space-time interaction of nodes and node neighborhood, S3, constructing a risk sensitive network with multi-scale dynamic clustering, predicting risk propagation tracks, S4, utilizing the risk propagation tracks to form a risk evolution link which is continuous and dynamic in a cross period and divide power distribution network risk control subdomains, S5, evaluating subdomain risk dynamic evolution, constructing a joint optimization state space, S6, constructing a distributed bidirectional information cooperation link between the neighborhood, S7, monitoring decision convergence conditions in real time and carrying out path switching. The invention improves the real-time performance and accuracy of the risk control of the power distribution network and ensures the safe and stable operation of the power distribution network.

title_en: Coal mine safety monitoring system based on big data
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of industrial big data, in particular to a coal mine safety monitoring system based on big data. The system comprises a sensor module, a dynamic topology construction module, a risk propagation calculation module and a cooperative control module, wherein the sensor module is used for acquiring mine data and preprocessing, the dynamic topology construction module is used for establishing a dynamic connection map between mine areas and constructing a risk conduction network, the risk propagation calculation module is used for calculating a risk conduction value and a target threshold value, the cooperative control module is used for judging abnormality, generating a cross-area equipment linkage instruction set, judging whether the instruction set is effective according to a risk attenuation rate, executing the instruction set if the instruction set is effective, and then generating an operation record and storing the operation record. Therefore, the problems that the multi-region risk conduction effect cannot be predicted in the monitoring of coal mine safety, the equipment control instruction is executed in isolation, the system-level linkage is lacked, and the historical accidents are not deeply related with the real-time data are solved.

title_en: Variable allocable safety guidance lamp system capable of emergemcy reacting
title_ko: 위급상황 대응이 가능한 가변 할당형 시선 유도등 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A variable allocable safety guidance lamp system capable of emergency reacting is provided to use a guide lamp as an emergency lamp by managing the guide lamp in emergency case. CONSTITUTION: In a variable allocable safety guidance lamp system capable of emergency reacting, an administration unit(110) provides a control command of a guidance lamp. The administration unit transmits/receives management information of a result and abnormal state. One or more main controllers(210,220) is formed inside a tunnel. The main controller receives the power source from a separate AC power line(201). The main controller controls the guide lamp according to the control command received through an additional control wire(202). The main controller reports normal state through a control lien and a wide area wireless network.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 터널이나 지하차도 등에 나열식으로 설치하여 진행로를 안내하는 시선 유도등 시스템을 역방향 보고 채널을 포함하여 구성하고 이러한 구성을 통해서 위급상황 발생 시 관리되는 시선 유도등을 재할당하고 이상 상태의 전파와 대응을 신뢰성 있게 제공할 수 있도록 한 위급상황 대응이 가능한 가변 할당형 시선 유도등 시스템에 관한 것으로, 고전압 교류 전력선과 제어 선로를 분리 구성하고, 기 설정된 수의 피난 유도등 겸용 시선 유도등을 관리하며 상기 제어 선로 및 별도의 무선 통신 기능을 통해 관리부와 복수 채널로 연결되는 메인 제어기를 복수로 구성하도록 하고, 선로 이상 시 메인 제어기가 관리할 수 있는 시선 유도등을 재할당 함으로써 선로가 파손되는 위급 상황 시에도 신뢰성 있게 유도등을 관리하여 시선 유도등을 피난 유도등으로 활용할 수 있는 효과가 있다.
assignees: DOMYEONG D & AMP E CO LTD

title_en: A kind of ad hoc network evacuation indication system and method based on wireless mode
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of ad hoc network evacuation indication system and method based on wireless mode, including presentation of information transmitting device, radio network gateway, wireless monitor module and backstage monitoring system, the wireless monitor module distribution multiple corners indoors, obtain the mobile phone signal of personnel nearby, the wireless monitor module by signal is by jumper connection or is directly connected to radio network gateway, and the radio network gateway signal link information shows transmitting device；Described information shows that transmitting device connects backstage monitoring system by network transmission module, backstage monitoring system signal connection trapped person's mobile phone and rescue personnel's terminal, operation principle of the present invention is simple, the position of trapped person can be positioned in real time, by ad hoc network cascade system data transmission to background system, when alert occurs, evacuation Way guidance can be sent to personnel near alert generation area by background system, and trapped person position is sent to rescue personnel.
assignees: JIANGSU WANYOU FIRE SAFETY REMOTE MONITORING SYSTEM CO LTD
