title_en: A kind of quick adaptive neural network optimization method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of quick adaptive neural network optimization methods, comprising: S1, initialize neural network optimizer parameter；S2, the gradient data that the initial parameter of the optimizer and neural network propagated forward come are as the input of the optimizer；S3, the gradient data according to neural network, the current time single order moment of momentum is calculated using current time gradient, last moment gradient and the last moment single order moment of momentum, calculates the current time second order moment of momentum using current time gradient, last moment gradient and the last moment second order moment of momentum；The initial learning rate of S4, the amendment optimizer；S5, the network parameter of the neural network is updated according to revised learning rate, the current time single order moment of momentum and the current time second order moment of momentum；S6, weight decaying is carried out to the gradient of the neural network, then the gradient after being decayed with weight continues to update the obtained network parameter of step S5.Optimization method performance of the invention is better than existing SGD method.

title_en: Dynamic prediction method for secondary domino accident of fire disaster in pressure storage tank area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic prediction method of a fire disaster secondary domino accident in a pressure storage tank area, which relates to the field of data processing systems specially used for prediction purposes, considers the influence of the fire accident of the pressure storage tank on the accident spread among adjacent storage tanks and the influence of coupling factors on the accident spread, evaluates the accident chain probability by combining a Bayesian network method, provides a determination method of the most probable accident chain and the most probable accident storage tank of the fire disaster secondary domino accident in the pressure storage tank area under the influence of time and space coupling, carries out effective risk evaluation on the pressure storage tank area, effectively controls and reduces the occurrence of the fire disaster secondary domino accident in the pressure storage tank area, has extremely important theoretical significance and application value for the prevention and control of the fire disaster domino effect in the pressure storage tank area, and provides guidance for the pressure tank area layout and the fire emergency treatment of chemical enterprises.

title_en: Forest fire risk prediction method based on graph convolution neural network
abstract_en: The invention provides a forest fire risk prediction method based on a graph convolution neural network. By establishing a characteristic representation method and a graph construction technology suitable for geospatial data and combining a graph convolutional neural network (GCN) which is a deep learning technology focusing on a graph structure, comprehensively considering the influence of weather, topography and vegetation space-time data characteristics of adjacent areas of a prediction target area on fire occurrence and propagation, a novel method which is different from a method for predicting forest fire risk by considering only the space-time data characteristics of the prediction target area is formed, so that a forest fire occurrence rule is better understood, and a technical approach is provided for realizing more accurate forest fire risk assessment.
assignees: AEROSPACE INFORMATION RESEARCH INSTITUTE CHINESE ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title_en: Comprehensive energy system scheduling method considering dynamic cascade and fault chain reaction
abstract_en: The invention provides a comprehensive energy system scheduling method considering dynamic cascade and fault cascade reaction, and belongs to the technical field of energy. The method comprises the steps of constructing a constraint model of the comprehensive energy system based on an equipment model, a dynamic operation constraint model, a coupling constraint model and a pipe network transmission inertia model of the comprehensive energy system, constructing an objective function considering economy, new energy consumption rate, environmental protection, flexibility and reliability based on a flexibility index calculation model and a reliability index calculation model of the comprehensive energy system, optimizing operation parameters of the comprehensive energy system based on an optimization objective and the objective function, calculating flexibility indexes and reliability indexes of the comprehensive energy system under any operation parameter based on a Monte Carlo method and a space-time chain reaction relation, and scheduling the comprehensive energy system based on an objective function value of the comprehensive energy system under the operation parameter and a target value of the operation parameter. The invention can obtain the scheduling effect considering economy, new energy consumption rate, environmental protection, flexibility and reliability.
assignees: STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ECONOMIC AND TECHNICAL RES INSTITUTE;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: NOx emission prediction method based on physical neural network ensemble learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a NOx emission prediction method based on physical neural network ensemble learning, which comprises the following steps of 1, establishing a physical prediction model according to a physical rule generated by diesel engine NOx, 2, collecting test data by using a diesel engine bench, carrying out data normalization on the collected data, training a feed-forward neural network by using normalization data to obtain a neural network prediction model by adopting a back propagation method, 3, fusing the physical prediction model of the step 1 and the neural network prediction model of the step 2 by a method of constructing a fusion loss function, constructing the physical neural network prediction model, training the physical neural network prediction model by adopting a back propagation method, and 4, fusing the models of the steps 1-3 by adopting an ensemble learning combination strategy to obtain an ensemble learning model, and predicting the emission amount of NOx by using the ensemble learning model. The method has higher prediction accuracy, and reduces the cost and difficulty of data collection.

title_en: Flexible power supply system and method based on photovoltaic energy storage
abstract_en: The application discloses a flexible power supply system and a method based on photovoltaic energy storage, which are characterized in that a time sequence analysis is carried out on historical power generation capacity and historical weather data of a photovoltaic power station by adopting an artificial intelligence technology based on deep learning, a time sequence dynamic change mode of the historical power generation capacity and the historical weather data in a global time domain is respectively captured by a local time sequence feature extraction and feature time sequence propagation aggregation mechanism, and a nonlinear association relation between the power generation capacity and weather conditions is excavated by carrying out multi-scale interactive response analysis on the historical power generation capacity and the historical weather data, so that decoding prediction of the photovoltaic power generation capacity is carried out. Therefore, the prediction accuracy can be effectively improved, complex and changeable weather conditions can be better adapted, and the requirements of the modern intelligent power grid on accurate prediction and efficient management are met.
assignees: HENAN FIVEWIN ARCH DESIGN CO LTD

title_en: Reliability analysis method and enhancement method for river and sea intermodal transportation network based on network destruction resistance
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for analyzing the reliability of a river and sea intermodal network based on network destructiveness and an enhancement method, wherein the analysis method comprises the steps of S1, obtaining the river and sea intermodal network to be detected, respectively constructing a non-cascade port failure model and a cascade port failure model according to the river and sea intermodal network, S2, respectively attacking the non-cascade port failure model and the cascade failure model in a random attack and deliberate attack mode, and calculating the relative size performance parameters of the maximum connected subgraph and the overall efficiency performance parameters of the network after being attacked. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages that after a single node fails, more accurate global influence can be obtained, and the like.

title_en: Hybrid pumping and accumulating optimized scheduling method and system considering peak regulation and risk avoidance
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of multi-objective optimization operation of a hybrid pumping and accumulating water-wind power complementary system, and discloses a hybrid pumping and accumulating optimization scheduling method and system capable of achieving peak regulation and risk avoidance, wherein historical data of a cascade watershed water-wind power station and a power grid load are obtained, scheduling initial data are generated through prediction, scheduling scene data capable of representing new energy uncertainty are generated based on the scheduling initial data and prediction errors, an optimization model is built, the optimization model is solved, scheduling instructions of the cascade watershed hydropower station and the hybrid pumping and accumulating power station are generated based on the solution of the optimization model, collaborative optimization for minimizing the power loss load risk of a hydropower side and meeting the peak regulation requirement of the power grid side is achieved through the optimization model, flexible regulation advantages of the hybrid pumping and accumulating are fully exerted, stable operation and reliability of the system are promoted, the speed and accuracy of the solution are facilitated through linearization processing, the real-time calculation efficiency of the system is guaranteed, and the scheduling decision making is more efficient.

title_en: River basin cascade reservoir joint scheduling optimization method and system under complex hydrologic condition
abstract_en: The application discloses a river basin cascade reservoir joint dispatching optimization method and system under complex hydrologic conditions, and relates to a hydropower dispatching technology, wherein the river basin cascade reservoir joint dispatching optimization method comprises the steps of arranging a hydrologic monitoring station along the river basin cascade reservoir and arranging vibration monitoring devices for units of all cascade power stations to form an Internet of things sensing network; the method comprises the steps of acquiring river basin data based on a constructed internet of things perception network, constructing a distributed hydrologic model according to the acquired river basin data, establishing a step scheduling model of each step power station unit, generating a Pareto scheduling optimal solution set by applying an NSGA-III algorithm based on the distributed hydrologic model and the step scheduling model, and carrying out visual display based on a three-dimensional model according to the Pareto scheduling optimal solution selected by a user. The method is used for meeting the condition that the combination of all hydropower stations reaches the expected optimal value as much as possible, and realizing the combined optimal scheduling of the auxiliary cascade power stations.
assignees: HUANENG TIBET YARLUNG ZANGBO RIVER HYDROPOWER DEVELOPMENT AND INVEST CO LTD

title_en: Distributed photovoltaic grid-connected area protection method and system
abstract_en: The invention is applicable to the technical field of photovoltaic grid connection, and particularly relates to a distributed photovoltaic grid connection area protection method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a distributed photovoltaic grid connection system based on a preset number of photovoltaic nodes, and acquiring sensing data by using sensing equipment which is pre-deployed in the photovoltaic nodes, wherein the sensing data at least comprises infrared thermal imaging data, high-frequency transient signal data and acoustic data, and each photovoltaic node corresponds to one group of sensing data; creating time windows and setting the risk state of the sensing data under each time window. According to the method, the risk precursor can be timely identified by calculating the similarity, the space-time propagation path and the influence range of the abnormal event are analyzed, the influence range of the fault node can be accurately calculated by counting the total number, the accuracy of fault isolation is improved, the running risk and loss are greatly reduced, a quantitative basis is provided for risk assessment and decision making, the non-fault influence is reduced, and the safe and stable running of the main power grid is effectively ensured.
assignees: ZHUCHENG CITY POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO WEIFANG POWER SUPPLY CO

title_en: Power distribution network operation risk assessment method based on traffic flow transmission theory
abstract_en: The power distribution network operation risk assessment method based on the traffic flow transmission theory comprises the steps of constructing a weather state transfer model to obtain probability distribution under different meteorological conditions, establishing a photovoltaic output probability density function based on Beta distribution to generate a photovoltaic output scene, establishing a space-time propagation model of photovoltaic disturbance in the power distribution network, introducing dynamic influence of line current on temperature, establishing a line resistance temperature correction model, establishing a power flow correction model based on LWR model output disturbance density on the basis of a power flow calculation result, constructing a comprehensive risk assessment index system comprising dimensions such as voltage out-of-limit, line overload and system loss, applying the established comprehensive risk assessment index system to an IEEE node system, carrying out simulation verification based on MATPOWER software packages under a MATLAB environment, and analyzing dynamic evolution characteristics of the power distribution network operation risk under the traffic flow transmission theory. The method realizes the whole process fine evaluation from disturbance generation to propagation diffusion through a multi-dimensional modeling and dynamic coupling mechanism.

title_en: Water-wind-light complementary scheduling scheme optimization method, system and equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a water-wind-solar complementary scheduling scheme optimization method, a system and equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps of defining a multi-dimensional index system for the economy and safety of a reaction scheduling scheme; the method comprises the steps of simulating a disturbance propagation process and influence degree based on a logic association network, calculating the size of each index of a scheduling scheme, inputting a disturbance scene to be simulated into the logic association network, simulating the propagation effect of disturbance in the logic association network based on the topology structure of the logic association network, selecting key indexes, determining the system disturbance risk of the disturbance scene based on the size and change degree of each key index after disturbance propagation, selecting the disturbance scene, calculating the system disturbance risk of each disturbance scene, calculating the comprehensive risk index of each scheduling scheme, sequencing the scheduling schemes and selecting an optimal scheduling scheme. The logic association network provided by the application can reflect the association between indexes, evaluate the linkage influence of disturbance on a plurality of indexes, and minimize the risk caused by disturbance.
assignees: THREE GORGES JINSHA JIANGCHUAN CLOUD HYDROPOWER DEV CO LTD

title_en: Group intelligent driven cascade reservoir autonomous negotiation scheduling method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a group intelligent driven cascade reservoir autonomous negotiation scheduling method which comprises the steps of firstly generating a scheduling basic data set, respectively packaging reservoir nodes of a cascade reservoir group into independent reservoir units, carrying out parallel calculation and distributed negotiation on each reservoir unit through a group fusion negotiation strategy based on interaction data of the local scheduling basic data set and a neighborhood reservoir unit, generating a preliminary scheduling scheme, adopting a distributed negotiation mode of a contract network protocol or a bidding mechanism based on the function type of the reservoir units by the group fusion negotiation strategy, determining a preliminary scheduling scheme by taking the minimum transaction cost among the reservoir units as a core objective function and combining flood control, power generation and ecological multi-objective weight coefficients, carrying out digital twin simulation verification, carrying out fine adjustment to obtain a final scheme, and carrying out intra-group coordination in priority and group linkage in case of abnormality. The method improves dispatching efficiency, ensures multi-objective balance of flood control, power generation and the like, and enhances risk resistance.
assignees: YELLOW RIVER INSTITUTE OF HYDRAULIC RES;Yellow River Laboratory

title_en: Intelligent bus shelter real-time bus prediction method and system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of intelligent bus prediction, in particular to a method and a system for intelligent bus pavilion real-time bus prediction. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a bus line vector data set, determining a bus operation chained topology table according to the bus line vector data set based on a bus network space-time topological coupling strategy, obtaining a real-time bad weather influence data set, building a bus station pressure propagation network according to the real-time bad weather influence data set and the bus operation chained topology table based on a traffic node load distribution strategy, predicting dynamic pressure influence and networking conduction paths of the dynamic pressure influence on each bus station and each bus line caused by the real-time bad weather, determining a dynamic coupling disturbance conduction network, and predicting the bus condition in the bus operation chained topology table in real time according to the dynamic coupling disturbance conduction network, and outputting and pushing prediction information. The method and the system accurately predict the operation state of the bus in the dynamic scene.
assignees: JIANGXI AODECHUAN AUTOMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Moving repeater
title_ko: 이동용 무선 중계기
abstract_en: A movable wireless repeater is provided to recover a communication network with independent battery power speedily without a power line in case the communication network is incapacitated due to a disaster or an accident. A movable wireless repeater comprises a case(100), an antenna support(110), a radio sensitivity measurement sensor, a display unit, and a control panel. A battery is embedded in the case. The antenna support, at which a pair of relay antennas(112,114) are installed, is mounted at the upper side of the center of the case. The radio sensitivity measurement sensor measures the sensitivity of radio waves which are received through the antennas. If radio sensitivity information is received from the radio sensitivity measurement sensor, the display unit displays it quantitatively. If the radio sensitivity information is inputted, the control panel controls the display unit.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 지하시설물이나 지상시설물에 재난 재해가 발생되거나 긴급한 사고의 발생으로 인한 통신선로의 파손시 독립적으로 운영되어 통신선로의 신속한 확보를 위해 사용되는 이동용 무선 중계기에 관한 것으로; 밧데리가 내부에 설치되는 케이스와, 상기 케이스의 중앙 상측에 구비되며 한쌍의 제1 및 제2중계용 안테나가 구비되는 안테나지지대와, 상기 제1 및 제2중계용 안테나를 통해 수신되는 전파의 감도를 측정하는 전파감도측정센서와, 상기 전파감도측정센서로 부터 전파감도정보가 수신되면 그 전파감도를 정량적으로 표시해주는 디스플레이수단과, 상기 전파감도측정센서의 전파감도정보를 입력받고, 상기 디스플레이수단을 제어하는 제어판넬로 이루어지는 것을 그 기본 구성으로 한다.

title_en: Remote controlled composite disaster response supplies smart storage box control system
title_ko: 원격제어형 복합재난 대응 물품 스마트 보관함 관제 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 방호물품 및 긴급 의약품의 위급사항대비 물품을 보관하는 스마트 보관함(100), 스마트 보관함(100)과 통신네트워크를 통해 연결되어, 스마트 보관함(100)으로부터 환경정보와 중량정보와 수량정보를 수신하여 실시간 모니터링하고, 도어락을 제어하고 재난전파정보를 전송하는, 재난상황 통제 관련 스마트 보관함 플랫폼(200), 및 스마트 보관함 플랫폼(200)과 통신네트워크를 통해 연결되어, 스마트 보관함(100)을 실시간 모니터링하고 원격제어하는 관리자 단말기(300)를 포함하여, 스마트 보관함 플랫폼(200)에 의해 스마트 보관함(100)의 본체(110)와 경광등(130)을 원격제어하여 위급사항에 대비하도록 하는, 원격제어형 복합재난 대응 물품 스마트 보관함 관제 시스템을 개시한다.

title_en: Dynamic reliability assessment method for power flow controller of in-phase power supply system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic reliability evaluation method for a power flow controller of an in-phase power supply system, which comprises the steps of calculating the junction temperature of a power element by taking account of the influence of the randomness and the impact of actual traction load on the junction temperature fluctuation of the power element, calculating the failure rate of a power module of the power flow controller by adopting a power loss and thermal network model, combining a physical model based on a failure mechanism and a linear fatigue damage accumulation model, and analyzing the reliability of PFC by adopting a dynamic reliability evaluation method taking account of the change of the failure rate of the element. The redundancy of the power module is analyzed, the number of the cascaded modules of the power flow controller is optimized, and necessary basis is provided for engineering design and operation maintenance of the same-phase power supply system.

title_en: Design change propagation risk prediction method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a design change propagation risk prediction method and device. Aiming at the problem that design resources are excessively consumed due to the avalanche effect of design change propagation in the process of variant design, a design change propagation highest risk path needs to be predicted before a variant design scheme is determined. Firstly, constructing a Product Development (PD) network model, wherein the method considers redundant connection and long-range connection among design nodes in the PD network model and the diffusion characteristic of a design change node set from the aspect that the PD network model follows the inherent characteristics of a small-world network model; and establishing a design change propagation maximum risk quantitative analysis model by using a small world network model analysis technology. The fragile link of the design change propagation path is effectively protected, and the design change propagation avalanche effect is prevented. The method can improve the variant design efficiency and save the design cost, thereby providing a basis for the adaptive dynamic planning of the variant design.

title_en: Matching short-term load prediction method based on intelligent sensing technology of Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distribution short-term load prediction method based on an intelligent sensing technology of the Internet of things, wherein the data source of the method is electricity consumption data collected by intelligent electric meters of all users under the same distribution in a certain geographic area. Firstly, data cleaning and completion are completed through a correlation coefficient, a per unit curve of electricity consumption data is obtained through per unit processing, then the per unit curves of similar days are obtained through combination after clustering through an affine propagation algorithm, finally, the per unit curves of the future days to be tested are obtained through weighted summation, and a complete daily load curve to be tested is obtained after combination with a basic value, so that the whole configuration short-term load prediction work is completed. The method is applied to the similar data of other distribution transformers for calculation and analysis, can make up for the current situation of lean operation and maintenance of the low-voltage distribution network, provides support for a reactive power compensation strategy control scheme of the low-voltage distribution network, provides basis for updating of low-voltage equipment and reconstruction of a low-voltage distribution system, and has low cost of required materials and manpower, high accuracy and good operability.

title_en: Real-time power load prediction system based on sparse pruning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real-time power load prediction system based on a sparse pruning method, which adopts connection sensitivity to express the importance of neural network connection and removes connection with smaller relevance to an objective function in the network back propagation process according to the connection importance, so that GRU neural network connection in the prediction system becomes sparse, the sparse GRU neural network only needs to carry out single pruning on the GRU neural network, and the prediction performance is optimized by using a fine tuning mode. Through actual tests, results show that 99.3% of parameters in the GRU prediction system are removed by a single pruning algorithm based on connection sensitivity, the classification accuracy of the system is not lost under the condition of realizing high sparsity, and the problems of parameter redundancy and huge calculation amount of the GRU prediction system in a training stage are solved.

title_en: Method for evaluating robustness of airway network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a route network robustness assessment method, which belongs to the technical field of route network robustness assessment and comprises the steps of determining route network nodes according to a target route network and route segment flow, determining a proper cascade failure model according to target route network characteristics, carrying out network attack on the route network nodes based on the cascade failure model, and calculating robustness indexes of the route network according to network attack results. According to the method, key nodes in the air path network are identified according to the air space air path network structure and the air segment flow pertinence, and the appropriate cascade failure model is combined, so that the robustness index of the target air path is calculated according to the network attack result through the common nodes and the key nodes of the network attack air path network, the robustness of the air path network after the network attack is evaluated, the robustness evaluation result is real, the actual situation of the air space in China is fitted, and the planning of the air path is facilitated.

title_en: Step hydroelectric dispatching method, system, equipment and storage medium based on TD3 algorithm
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of hydropower station scheduling, in particular to a step hydropower station scheduling method, a system, equipment and a storage medium based on a TD3 algorithm, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing a long-term optimized scheduling model based on basic data and running conditions of the cascade hydropower station; the method comprises the steps of converting a scheduling problem in a long-term optimized scheduling model into a Markov decision process, solving the Markov decision process by utilizing a double-delay-determination strategy gradient algorithm TD3 to obtain a long-term scheduling decision scheme of each power station in the cascade hydropower station, and outputting a long-term scheduling decision result based on an actual cascade hydropower station. According to the invention, the continuous action space value under the state can be output according to the state quantity, the problem of network overestimation is reduced, the problem of error accumulation is solved by adopting a delay strategy update and a noise smoothing target strategy, and the power generation benefit of the cascade hydropower station can be effectively improved.

title_en: Electric power construction process early warning method and system based on high-precision three-dimensional model
abstract_en: The invention discloses an early warning method and system for an electric power foundation construction process based on a high-precision three-dimensional model, and relates to the technical field of electric power foundation construction, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting multi-source data of an electric power foundation construction site and constructing the high-precision three-dimensional model comprising equipment space coordinates, construction time sequence labels and environmental parameters; the method comprises the steps of inputting a space-time diagram into a space-time diagram convolution network, outputting a risk propagation probability matrix of a three-dimensional space and a construction time sequence dimension, identifying high-risk nodes and associated construction stages, dynamically marking root coordinates and a risk diffusion range in a high-precision three-dimensional model, generating an early warning instruction containing a visual path, a root report and a treatment priority, and pushing the early warning instruction to a terminal through an edge node in real time. The method is based on a layered space-time attention-physical constraint graph convolution network, dynamically distributes inter-node cross-stage association weights, optimizes convolution kernel parameters in combination with physical connection strength, and remarkably improves space-time association of high-risk node identification.

title_en: Dynamic identification method for risk evolution law of complex water network system
abstract_en: The invention provides a dynamic identification method of a complex water network system risk evolution law, which comprises the steps of collecting basic information and identifying risk factors to obtain a risk factor sample set, dividing hydraulic engineering of a water network research area into three-level mutual feedback layered structures to construct a multi-target real-time risk scheduling model, solving to obtain a risk scheduling scheme set, combining the risk scheduling scheme set and aiming at the layered structures of the complex water network system, establishing a real-time scheduling risk propagation model and a global real-time risk propagation network model of each level, respectively identifying vulnerability nodes and key risk paths of each level based on the global real-time risk propagation network model, and carrying out cross-level node dominance mapping on the vulnerability nodes and the key risk paths of the whole water network system. The method comprehensively considers multiple uncertainties, improves the calculation efficiency and the accuracy of risk positioning, and has important significance for risk regulation and control of the water network system.

title_en: System and Method for Effective Communication Service Providing in Disaster
title_ko: 재난 발생 시 효과적인 통신서비스 제공 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: According to a system and method for providing an effective communication service in a case of a disaster of the present invention, if a defect is generated in a communication infrastructure due to natural hazards/disasters such as tsunami, flood, heavy snow, earthquake or big accidents. The system is operated in a mode for emergency communication by constructing a separate communication path, thereby propagating a disaster situation and confirming information on the safety of a family, an acquaintance, and the like.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 재난 발생 시 효과적인 통신서비스 제공 시스템 및 방법에 따르면, 해일, 홍수, 폭설, 지진 등 자연 재해/재난 또는 대형 사고에 의하여 통신 인프라에 결함이 발생하면, 별도의 통신 경로가 구축되어 긴급 통신을 위한 모드로 시스템이 동작하도록 함으로써, 재난 상황을 전파하고, 가족, 지인 등의 안부 정보를 확인 할 수 있도록 한다.

title_en: Explosion-proof toughened glass
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an explosion-proof toughened glass, including two curb plates, through first toughened glass fixed connection between two curb plates, first toughened glass's bottom is provided with first vacuum layer, one side and the curb plate fixed connection that first vacuum layer is close to the curb plate, the bottom on first vacuum layer is provided with second toughened glass. The utility model discloses a curb plate, first toughened glass, first vacuum layer, second toughened glass, first explosion-proof layer, the explosion-proof layer of second, first flame retardant coating, second flame retardant coating and second vacuum layer mutually support, the effectual effect of explosion-proof has been realized, when meetting the conflagration, the condition that toughened glass explodes can be effectively prevented from taking place, the glass piece of effectively having avoided exploding explodeing and splitting causes the condition emergence of injury for personnel in the fire scene, good syllable-dividing effect has also been played simultaneously, can effectively completely cut off low-frequency noise's propagation, bring very big facility for the user, explosion-proof toughened glass's practicality has been improved.
assignees: SHENZHEN CITY YINGLIAN OPTICS TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for determining power grid power failure key line based on cascading failure model
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for determining a power failure key line of a power grid based on a cascading failure model, which comprises the steps of obtaining a power grid model to be calculated and corresponding relevant model information thereof, and obtaining a topological structure of the power grid according to the power grid model and the corresponding relevant model information thereof; and determining the total number of days of cascading failure simulation mode simulation formed by the topological structure of the power grid, simulating by taking each day as a unit, obtaining the line number of the disconnected line output by each day of simulation after the total number of days of simulation is finished, further counting the number of the line numbers of the disconnected line output by each day of simulation, and outputting the disconnected line with the maximum number of the line numbers as the power grid power failure key line. By implementing the method and the device, the key line which has important influence on the cascading failure of the power system can be identified, and data support is provided for line capacity expansion.

title_en: Earthquake motion parameter prediction method based on artificial intelligence and earthquake motion empirical model mixing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a seismic motion parameter prediction method based on artificial intelligence and seismic motion empirical model mixing, and aims to solve the problem that the physical significance of prediction precision and attenuation relation cannot be simultaneously reserved by the existing method. The earthquake motion parameter prediction method comprises the following steps: selecting a traditional empirical formula of the seismic oscillation attenuation relation, and determining an operation form, an input parameter item, an output parameter item and an unknown coefficient in the traditional empirical formula; secondly, building a seismic oscillation data set; establishing a neural network combined with a traditional empirical formula; and fourthly, performing network training by combining the neural network with the seismic oscillation data set, calculating the gradient of unknown coefficients through back propagation of the neural network, and continuously reducing the loss function through continuous iterative training to obtain a training result of the optimal coefficients. And fifthly, predicting earthquake motion parameters. The seismic oscillation parameter prediction method comprises an empirical model, and is better in robustness. And an effective basis is provided for structural seismic design and seismic risk analysis.

title_en: Reaction diffusion model for negative information propagation and construction method thereof
abstract_en: A reaction diffusion model for negative information propagation is shown in a formula (1), and the construction method of the reaction diffusion model comprises the steps of dividing people in a social network into three types, carrying out negative information and positive information propagation processes, determining balance points and basic regeneration numbers of the reaction diffusion model, and determining local asymptotic stability conditions of the balance points of the reaction diffusion model. Because the invention adopts the positive information, the infected user I  2  (x, t) and diffusion coefficient d, solving the problem of the prior art that the infected user I with positive information  2  The problem that (x, t) and the diffusion coefficient d are not considered at the same time has the advantage of more clearly characterizing the user behavior in the social network, and the advantage that increasing the conversion rate of the positive information eventually leads to the elimination of the negative information. The model can be used as a target model for the following purposesThe propagation mechanism of the negative information is analyzed.

title_en: Hydropower station group peak-welting summer peak capacity analysis method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of cascade hydropower station group scheduling, in particular to a hydropower station group peak-to-peak summer peak capacity analysis method, which has important significance for relieving peak power supply pressure of a power grid and ensuring safe operation of a power system. The technical proposal is as follows: firstly, setting corresponding constraint conditions of a peak power generation scheduling model of a hydropower station according to an electric quantity plan issued by a power grid and an initial water level and incoming water prediction condition of a hydropower station, and ensuring electric quantity supply when hydropower participates in system peak regulation; on the basis, a rapid solving method based on hydropower station daily maximum power generation capacity trial calculation and hydropower station operation mode dynamic classification is provided, and the electric quantity distribution rolling calculation is utilized, so that the hydropower station peak problem is efficiently solved. According to the method, the working position can be dynamically adjusted according to the power generation capacity of the hydropower station, a reasonable hydropower mid-term peak operation result is obtained rapidly, reasonable arrangement of hydropower mid-term planning is achieved, and decision support is provided for the regional power grid hydropower station group peak-welcome summer scheduling operation.

title_en: Financial risk assessment management method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a financial risk assessment management method and a system in the technical field of risk management, and the method comprises the following steps: based on the financial data set, a decision tree classification algorithm is adopted to conduct subdivision and identification of historical risk events, correlation among risk events is learned and analyzed through correlation rules, potential risk patterns are revealed, and a risk pattern analysis result is generated. According to the invention, a huge financial data set can be processed more quickly and effectively by using a decision tree classification algorithm and association rule learning, the timeliness and accuracy of risk assessment are improved, a graph network analysis method and a dynamics principle are adopted, a risk propagation path in a complex financial network can be analyzed deeply, more comprehensive systematic risk assessment is provided, the randomness and uncertainty of financial data are processed effectively by using a Bayesian network model and an autoregressive moving average model, and the flexibility and adaptability of short-term and long-term financial behavior prediction are improved.

title_en: Water-wind-solar-energy-storage multifunctional complementary real-time intelligent operation method, device and equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water-wind-solar-energy storage multifunctional complementary real-time intelligent operation method, a device and equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring operation data of a river basin cascade hydropower station, a river basin cascade hydroelectric power station and a hybrid power station and a water, wind and light storage multifunctional complementary system; taking a day as a dispatching cycle, an hour as a dispatching time period, taking the minimum power grid residual load variance as a dispatching target, and simultaneously taking the operation constraint of a water-wind-light energy storage source and the constraint of an electric power system into consideration to construct a water-wind-light energy storage day-ahead joint optimization dispatching model; and carrying out water-wind-solar-storage multifunctional complementary real-time intelligent operation scheduling according to the water-wind-solar-storage day-ahead combined optimization scheduling model. According to the invention, the minimum power grid residual load variance is used as a scheduling target, and the water-wind-solar-storage combined optimal scheduling is carried out, so that the optimal running control scheme of the water and the wind power before and after the water-wind-storage bundling is realized, the peak-valley difference of the power grid residual load is reduced, the safety and the good digestion capability of the power grid are ensured, and the clean energy utilization rate is improved.

title_en: Digital safety emergency drilling and commanding platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of project management, in particular to a digital security emergency exercise and command platform, which comprises a risk assessment module, an event propagation prediction module, a resource demand and scheduling module, a response time management module, a cost benefit analysis module, a network flow abnormality detection module and a security hole priority ordering module, wherein the invention utilizes the network flow abnormality detection module to introduce a real-time monitoring and response technology, the method has the advantages that the real-time monitoring and quick response to the network security event are realized, the response time of the security event is shortened, the risk and influence of the security event on the organization are reduced, in addition, the response time management module is utilized by means of an automatic emergency response technology, the automatic identification and processing to the common security event can be realized according to the set rules and procedures, the efficiency and the accuracy of the emergency response are improved, and the human error and delay are reduced.
assignees: HEJIE TECH LIAONING GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Wind-solar-water-storage multi-energy complementary intelligent scheduling system and method based on energy storage big pump
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind-solar-water storage multi-energy complementation and intelligent scheduling system and method based on an energy storage big pump, wherein the system comprises a power generation module, a wind power station and a photovoltaic power station, wherein the wind power station and the photovoltaic power station are used for providing intermittent and unstable electric quantity output, a step reservoir power station utilizes the water level difference of a reservoir to generate power, and the energy storage module is used for pumping the electric quantity which is not incorporated into a power grid when wind power or photovoltaic power generation is excessive and pumping water from a downstream water reservoir to an upstream reservoir; the scheduling module is used for carrying out overall optimized scheduling of the wind, light and water storage system by utilizing the intelligent scheduling system according to weather forecast and load prediction information; the monitoring and control module is used for monitoring the running state of the system in real time, controlling energy distribution among wind power generation, photovoltaic power generation, energy storage pump stations and cascade reservoir power stations, and optimizing wind, light, water and multi-energy complementary scheduling. The invention ensures stable large-scale grid connection of photovoltaic and wind power generation, obviously reduces power waste and reduces operation cost.
assignees: UNIV TSINGHUA;NORTH UNITED POWER CO LTD;INNER MONGOLIA MENGDA POWER GENERATING CO LTD

title_en: Urban rail transit network cascade failure analysis method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a network cascading failure analysis method and system for urban rail transit, which belong to the technical field of rail transit and control science, and are characterized by acquiring self capacity of each station, identifying key stations of a time-varying network of the urban rail transit in each time step, marking the stations attacked by the key stations as failure stations, judging whether each station fails by comparing whether real-time loads of the stations of the time-varying network of the urban rail transit in each time step exceed self capacity of corresponding stations, marking the stations with the real-time loads exceeding the self capacity as failure stations, acquiring residual capacity of adjacent stations of the failure stations, redistributing real-time loads of the failure stations, and analyzing the cascading failure process of the urban rail transit network according to a redistributing result. The method can accurately grasp the dynamic change of the key stations of the urban rail transit time-varying network in the cascade failure process, so that the cascade failure process of the urban rail transit network is better analyzed.

title_en: Micro-grid cluster cascading failure control method, electronic equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a control method, electronic equipment and a medium for cascading failure of a micro-grid group. The method comprises the steps of establishing a micro-grid group longitudinal output model, analyzing distributed resource data according to a clustering algorithm to obtain micro-grid group output distribution, and performing cascading failure control through the micro-grid group output distribution. According to the application, through the research of the cascading failure analysis and emergency control of the power grid containing the micro-grid group, the safety and reliability of the power system are improved.
assignees: HETIAN POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID XINJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Power network key ring detection method based on simulated annealing algorithm
abstract_en: The invention provides a detection method of a power network key ring based on a simulated annealing algorithm, which comprises the following steps of 1, constructing a power network topology model; step 2, constructing a solution space, step 3, constructing an initial solution set, and step 4, detecting a key ring. The invention adopts a simulated annealing algorithm comprising a neighborhood search strategy to detect the key ring of the power network, can successfully detect the key ring of the power network, effectively improves the detection efficiency, is applicable to a large-scale network, expands the application range of the network, simulates the fault process of a real power network by adopting a cascade failure process, can detect the fragile structure of the power network, and provides effective support for the safety protection of the power network.

title_en: Intelligent building curtain wall early warning method based on multi-source data
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent early warning method for a building curtain wall based on multi-source data, which comprises the steps of collecting and preprocessing multi-source data to form a multi-mode data set, constructing a health sample, generating a sensing network diagram, mapping the multi-mode data into multi-dimensional tensors, executing layering decomposition, calculating crack energy and phase stability, establishing a structure-environment causal directed acyclic diagram, generating a counterfactual baseline and a residual sequence for environmental parameter intervention, constructing a physical constraint twin comparison learning model, inputting the health sample and a sample to be tested, generating an anomaly score, fusing a potential energy sequence and the anomaly score, updating a risk threshold, constructing a dynamic risk potential field, searching a propagation path, triggering early warning when a risk track or a margin triggering condition is met, and outputting a result to an operation and maintenance platform. According to the invention, through multi-source data fusion, causal inference and physical constraint twin contrast learning, early identification and intelligent early warning of hidden danger of the building curtain wall are realized.
assignees: GUANGDONG FENGYUE TECH ENGINEERING CO LTD;GUANGZHOU VOCATIONAL AND TECHNICAL UNIV

title_en: Electric vehicle cooperative scheduling optimization method, system and medium based on countermeasure evolution strategy
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric vehicle cooperative scheduling optimization method, system and medium based on an anti-evolution strategy, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining dynamic reconfiguration topological state, new energy fluctuation characteristics, vehicle group migration track data and total load time number of a distribution network, constructing a space-time four-dimensional characteristic tensor through deep tensor decomposition enhanced by graph rolling, designing a generator-discriminator cooperative evolution framework, generating a scheduling strategy by the generator, evaluating the safety margin of the scheduling strategy in real time based on a time-varying safety margin function by the discriminator, directionally optimizing the scheduling strategy through an anti-gradient counter-propagation mechanism with self-adaptive gradient penalty, establishing a federal double-path anti-facts reasoning model to quantify individual processing effects of electric price signals on users, feeding back to the generator, and outputting the pareto optimal scheduling strategy through iterative optimization by the generator. The invention constructs a new mechanism integrating dynamic topology awareness, user behavior intervention and resource collaborative optimization, and ensures safe and economic operation of the power grid.
assignees: STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LIMITED ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RESEARCH INSTITUTE;STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LIMITED;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Method for measuring and calculating cascade robustness of water supply network of dynamic emergency recovery mechanism
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for measuring and calculating cascade robustness of a water supply network of a dynamic emergency recovery mechanism, which comprises the following steps: loading basic hydraulic information and a topological structure of a water supply network; setting a tolerance parameter range and an iteration increment; calculating the maximum water pressure constraint condition of the node according to the tolerance parameter; calculating the cascade robustness of a dynamic emergency recovery mechanism water supply network of the single-node breakdown; iteratively calculating the robustness of a water supply network cascade system of a dynamic emergency recovery mechanism in which all nodes in the initial collapse node range collapse in sequence; iteratively calculating a robustness evaluation matrix of a water supply network cascade system of a dynamic emergency recovery mechanism in which all nodes collapse in sequence within a tolerance parameter range; and identifying the optimal emergency strategy and giving the priority sequence of the emergency strategy. The method can combine the water supply network entity flow attributes, consider the cascading failure and the dynamic emergency strategy, accurately calculate the robustness of the emergency strategy and give priority ranking of the emergency strategy.

title_en: Public opinion evolution analysis model integrating network playing and opinion dynamics and establishment method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a public opinion evolution analysis model integrating network playing and viewpoint dynamics and an establishment method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of social network analysis. The public opinion evolution analysis model combines the social network chess and the opinion dynamics theory, builds a public opinion evolution mathematical model (POEM) according to the related theory in the social science while considering more comprehensive factors, realizes scientific simulation of psychological activities of individuals in the public opinion propagation process, breaks through two major limitations of single behavior statistics and lack of behavior characterization in the opinion dynamics model in the traditional network game model, and utilizes the uncertainty mathematical theory to characterize psychological movement and decision behaviors of the social individuals in the public opinion evolution process, thereby more accurately describing the influence of the individual propagation behaviors on the social public opinion evolution.

title_en: Urban public transport network toughness measurement method in extreme stormwater weather
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for measuring toughness of an urban public transportation network in extreme stormwater, which comprises the steps of obtaining urban public transportation network station and line data, stormwater disaster information and passenger flow data, constructing a bus-subway double-layer transportation network, establishing a linear relation between stormwater rainfall intensity and passenger flow change based on the constructed bus-subway double-layer transportation network, calculating disturbance values of stormwater on stations and edges in the network, constructing a bus-subway double-layer transportation network cascade failure model considering passenger flow, representing a dynamic evolution process of the urban public transportation network in extreme stormwater, determining network performance measurement indexes by utilizing the constructed bus-subway double-layer transportation network cascade failure model, and measuring the toughness level of the urban public transportation network in extreme stormwater. The method is favorable for accurately measuring the toughness of the urban public transportation network and improving the coping capacity of the urban public transportation system in extreme stormwater weather.

title_en: Rapid prediction method for thermochemical energy storage carrier particle thermo-mechanical coupling process
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid prediction method of a particle thermal-force coupling process, which is characterized by scanning carrier particles based on a micro-focus computed tomography technology to generate a three-dimensional digital model, importing the three-dimensional digital model into a multi-physical-field simulation platform to establish a transient full-order model, generating training data sets and test data sets under different working conditions and corresponding temperature fields and stress fields based on the transient full-order model, decomposing and calculating the training data sets by utilizing an intrinsic orthogonal decomposition POD (point-of-sale) reduced-order model to obtain POD basis functions and spectrum coefficients, establishing a mapping model from an input working condition to an output spectrum coefficient based on a BP (back propagation) neural network, inputting the target working condition into the mapping model to output the POD spectrum coefficient, and reconstructing full-field physical quantity distribution at any moment under the target working condition by linear combination based on a calculation result and the POD spectrum coefficient. The method solves the problems of low calculation efficiency and high resource consumption of the traditional numerical simulation.

title_en: System and method for suspending HF antennas
abstract_en: A system and method for extending and holding aloft a long-wire radio antenna using an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV), optimizing high-frequency (HF) radio communication where ground-based infrastructure is impractical. The UAV-based system pulls an antenna wire from a reel vertically and hovers in place holding the antenna at a length resonant on the transmitting frequency, enabling effective skip propagation. The system includes mechanisms for precise impedance matching and standing wave ratio (SWR) tuning through automatic adjustments of antenna length, facilitated by onboard sensors and control systems. The antenna wire is connected to a reel anchored to the ground and connected to a wire-mesh ground plane. In one embodiment, the system constantly feeds electric power to the UAV, with filters isolating RF and power currents, enabling both antenna and power transmission functions on the same wire. This system addresses the challenges of maintaining HF communication in remote or disaster-stricken regions.

title_en: A kind of municipal daily water consumption Forecasting Methodology based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of municipal daily water consumption Forecasting Methodology based on deep learning, this method using daily water consumption for the previous period, max. daily temperature, intra day ward, when water consumption per month accounts for the data such as the false situation of annual ratio, section as input layer data, train the stack self-encoding encoder for including 1 hidden layer of K by successively greedy（SAE）, every layer of weight is obtained, the output of SAE may be considered non-linear, the compact character representation of data；Since prediction process is also a nonlinear process, the present invention is connecting a reverse transmittance nerve network on the basis of the SAE comprising 1 hidden layer of K（BPNN）Rather than directly it is predicted using the feature of SAE outputs.Optimization is tuned to network weight K+2 layers whole by back-propagation algorithm at the same time, so as to complete the training of deep learning network.The present invention make use of the powerful characteristic present ability of SAE and the superior predictive ability of BPNN at the same time, improve the accuracy of municipal daily water consumption prediction.

title_en: Power information physical system data propagation modeling method considering three defense lines of power grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data propagation modeling method of a power information physical system considering three defense lines of a power grid. The technical scheme adopted by the invention is as follows: establishing a data transmission architecture, wherein data transmission is divided into data transmission in an information space, an electric power space and between the electric power space and the information space, and nodes and communication channels exist in the spaces; aiming at a data transmission architecture, a data transmission model based on a transmission matrix is constructed, and model quantization is carried out on data transmission from an information space receiving end to a power space transmitting end; and solving the system data state vector under each time period based on the data propagation matrix and the system initial data state vector. The invention combines the information space and the security defense system of the power system by analyzing the influence of data propagation in the power information physical system, and can guide the development of three defense measures.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV ZHEJIANG

title_en: Method for identifying key line of electric-gas coupling system based on maximum flow theory
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric-gas coupling system key line identification method based on a maximum flow theory, which is based on the maximum flow theory and combines a complex network theory, improves the traditional line betweenness, overcomes the defect that energy or power between nodes of an integrated energy system is supposed to be propagated along the shortest path between the nodes, considers all possible transmission paths of the integrated energy system, and better accords with the characteristics of the integrated energy system. Meanwhile, considering from two aspects of structural importance and state importance of the line, a line comprehensive importance index reflecting the structural centrality and the transmission bearing capacity of the line is established, so that the identification of the key line of the comprehensive energy system is more accurate and reliable, and a new thought and a new method are provided for the identification of the key line of the comprehensive energy system. The method can be used for identifying the key line of the comprehensive energy system, can also be popularized and used for identifying the key line of a thermodynamic system, a traffic system, a logistics system and other large-scale complex systems, and has wide application value.

title_en: Resource abnormality prediction method, device and equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a resource abnormality prediction method, device and equipment, relates to the technical field of distribution, and can add popularization capability of information propagation and accumulation of higher-order risks of more than two steps of individual participants in a resource abnormality prediction process, so that accuracy of a resource abnormality prediction result is improved. The method comprises the following steps: setting a service performance process in combination with a distribution scene, and abstracting a historical distribution order into a heterogeneous graph with service meaning according to the service performance process, wherein the heterogeneous graph comprises multiparty nodes related to the service scene and different edge types formed by the nodes; describing vector characterization of multi-party nodes on different edge types in a heterogeneous graph by using a graph neural network aiming at the different edge types formed by the nodes; responding to a prediction instruction of the occurrence of the resource abnormality of the order to be distributed, and predicting the resource of the order to be distributed by utilizing vector characterization of multiparty nodes on different edge types in a heterogeneous graph with service meanings to obtain a prediction result of the occurrence of the resource abnormality of the order to be distributed.

title_en: Method for evaluating cascade failure influence of urban infrastructure under extreme precipitation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascade failure influence assessment method of urban infrastructure under extreme precipitation, which belongs to the technical field of urban flood monitoring and comprises the following steps of S1, simulating an urban road network to obtain a simulated running road network; s2, collecting the depth and the range of urban inundation under extreme precipitation, and determining the affected nodes and road sections of an urban road network; s3, attacking the affected nodes and road sections and carrying out simulation to determine the failure state of the final road network; and S4, collecting urban infrastructure POI points, and evaluating the service capability change of the infrastructure before and after the road network failure and the cascade failure influence of the urban infrastructure under extreme precipitation. The method for evaluating the influence of cascade failure of the urban infrastructure under extreme precipitation, which is disclosed by the invention, solves the problem that the influence of the extreme precipitation disaster on the urban infrastructure under the extreme precipitation disaster is unknown in the field of urban disaster prevention and reduction at present.

title_en: Power grid operation decision analysis method, system and equipment based on machine learning
abstract_en: The invention provides a machine learning-based power grid operation decision analysis method, a system and equipment, which relate to the technical field of data processing, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring historical power grid operation data; a trend increment module is constructed; an improved autoregressive model with a multi-layer gating circulating unit is built, and a trend increment module and the improved autoregressive model are connected in parallel to obtain a fusion prediction model; training the fusion prediction model, and performing super-parameter optimization by taking the minimized loss function as a target; acquiring real-time power grid operation data; inputting real-time power grid operation data into the trained fusion prediction model, and outputting a power prediction sequence; determining an error propagation coefficient positively correlated with the predicted time length of the fused power characteristic sequence, and calculating the total power dispatching amount in the preset time length by combining the error propagation coefficient and the instantaneous power demand; and performing power scheduling according to the instantaneous power demand and the total power scheduling amount. The error propagation influence in the prediction process is reduced, and the prediction accuracy is improved.
assignees: STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;BEIJING KEDONG ELECTRIC POWER CONTROL SYSTEM CO LTD;PINGTAN RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF XIAMEN UNIV

title_en: Cascade hydropower integration transformation and grid planning cooperative method for improving system flexibility
abstract_en: A cascade hydropower integration reconstruction and grid planning cooperative method for improving system flexibility is provided, and a typical scene generation method based on an improved generation countermeasure network and a K-means clustering method is provided for providing a typical scene set for a cascade hydropower integration reconstruction and line extension configuration model, and then a cascade hydropower integration reconstruction and line extension double-layer optimization model for improving system flexibility is established, wherein the cascade hydropower integration reconstruction and line extension double-layer optimization model comprises an upper-layer configuration model based on multi-objective whale algorithm solution and a lower-layer operation model based on a McCormick convex hull relaxation method. And finally, solving the double-layer model to obtain a gradient hydropower integration transformation and line expansion configuration scheme. The invention comprehensively considers the mutual influence of flexibility and economy, and ensures that the cascade hydropower integration transformation provides effective utilization of flexibility.
assignees: CENTRAL CHINA BRANCH STATE GRID CORP CHINA;UNIV WUHAN

title_en: Method, device, equipment and product for generating voltage sag propagation characteristics of power distribution network
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a method, a device, equipment and a product for generating a power distribution network voltage sag propagation characteristic, which are applied to the technical field of power system automation. The method comprises the steps of responding to a voltage sag event, collecting current electrical parameter values of each electrical connection point of a power distribution network and topology structure data of the power distribution network, wherein the topology structure data are used for indicating connection relations among the electrical connection points, generating a data feature matrix corresponding to the voltage sag event based on the electrical parameter values of the electrical connection points and the topology structure data, inputting the data feature matrix into a pre-trained voltage sag positioning prediction model to obtain predicted fault positioning corresponding to the data feature matrix, and inputting the predicted fault positioning into a digital twin model corresponding to the power distribution network to obtain propagation features corresponding to the voltage sag event. The method achieves the technical effect of determining the efficiency of the voltage sag propagation characteristics.
assignees: SHANTOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Universal repeated alarm suppression method for power transmission line monitoring system based on time sequence sample analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a general repeated alarm suppression method for a power transmission line monitoring system based on time sequence sample analysis, according to the method, through combining feature map analysis and time sequence sample modeling of a deep learning algorithm, the change condition of an abnormal region can be analyzed and judged, and whether to continue alarming or not is further determined. The invention makes repeated alarm effectively inhibited by comparing time sequence analysis with thermodynamic diagram. The method utilizes the weighted combination of the gradient map and the output layer characteristic map of the neural network counter propagation to generate the activation response thermodynamic diagram, thereby accurately identifying the region with the greatest contribution to the abnormal output result in the image. By global averaging pooling and ReLU activation functions, the system is able to pinpoint the region where the anomaly occurred. The technical means improves the accuracy of abnormal region identification and provides a reliable basis for subsequent alarm suppression.
assignees: Jiangsu electric power information technology co ltd

title_en: Power grid dynamic risk assessment method considering fault evolution under typhoon disaster
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power systems, in particular to a power grid dynamic risk assessment method considering fault evolution under typhoon disasters, which comprises the steps of establishing a typhoon wind speed space distribution model and a system element fault probability model, quantifying the influence of typhoon strength and paths on the output of a power transmission line and an offshore wind farm, generating a typical fault scene through Monte Carlo sampling and scene reduction based on information entropy, constructing comprehensive risk indexes of load rejection, wind rejection and line out-of-limit, analyzing a power grid abnormal propagation path driven by unit rescheduling and island processing, and outputting a space-time dynamic risk assessment result. By the dynamic entropy interval control technology, efficient screening of fault scenes is achieved, a fault-tide coupling evolution model is established, cascading fault propagation paths during typhoon passing are accurately depicted, the problems that power grid risks are not accurately quantized and fault evolution paths are not clear under extreme disasters are solved, and typhoon resistance of coastal power grids is remarkably improved.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO RES INST;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Water conservancy facility operation and maintenance method based on multi-source data
abstract_en: The invention relates to a water conservancy facility operation and maintenance method based on multi-source data, which comprises the steps of collecting multi-source heterogeneous data of the water conservancy facility to obtain a standardized multi-dimensional data matrix, extracting multi-mode features of the standardized multi-dimensional data matrix through a graph neural network fusion algorithm to obtain fusion feature vectors, carrying out fault diagnosis on the fusion feature vectors through a knowledge graph reasoning algorithm automatically constructed by a domain ontology to obtain fault diagnosis information, carrying out facility state evolution analysis through a space-time coupling degradation prediction model based on the fault diagnosis information to obtain a space-time degradation prediction result, carrying out state assessment of the water conservancy facility through a dynamic weight distribution algorithm optimized by double targets according to the space-time degradation prediction result to obtain an operation and maintenance state assessment result, and carrying out cross-river-field cascade fault prevention and control on the water conservancy facility based on the operation and maintenance state assessment result to obtain a cascade fault prevention and control scheme. The method improves the prediction precision of the degradation of the water conservancy facilities and enhances the risk resistance of the water conservancy infrastructure.
assignees: GANSU RUISHENG WATER CONSERVANCY AND HYDROPOWER ENG CO LTD

title_en: AI-based power equipment health state prediction system and method thereof
abstract_en: The present invention discloses an AI based system and method for predicting the health status of power equipment, belonging to the field of intelligent operation and maintenance of power equipment. The system includes a data acquisition and preprocessing module, a multimodal deep layered attention fusion module, a health status evaluation and prediction module, and a decision support and linkage module. The present invention innovatively proposes a multimodal deep layered attention fusion architecture, which extracts the temporal characteristics of dissolved gas concentration in oil color spectrum through the bottom layer temporal feature extraction network, associates the temporal and spatial patterns of infrared thermal images and ultrasonic spectra through the middle layer spatiotemporal pattern recognition network, and constructs a device family defect propagation model through the top layer device family relationship network, achieving full dimensional analysis of multimodal data and collaborative perception of device groups; At the same time, establishing information flow paths between different hierarchical networks through cross level information fusion mechanisms improves the comprehensiveness and accuracy of feature extraction.
assignees: QINGDAO HENGXING UNIV OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Analysis early warning method based on agricultural product price analysis model
abstract_en: The invention discloses an analysis and early warning method based on an agricultural product price analysis model, which relates to the technical field of intelligent agriculture and intelligent supply chain management and comprises the following steps of integrating climate data, historical yield, logistics cost and market transaction information of each main production area, and constructing a full-chain data set covering production to circulation; based on the full chain data set, the time-space correlation of climate influence between main production areas is captured by adopting a graph rolling network, and hysteresis characteristics of a production sequence are extracted by combining a long-period memory network. According to the method, a mixed model of a space-time diagram convolution network and a long-short-period memory network is constructed, the space-time correlation and hysteresis effect between climate data and yield sequences are deeply mined, and the propagation rule of climate stress factors such as continuous drought and the like between main yield areas is captured, so that the model can break through the limitation of the traditional method, the recessive influence of climate abnormality is explicit, and probability and visual accurate prediction of potential yield reduction risks in the future is carried out.
assignees: HUBEI AISINO INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Network information traceability analysis system for multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of data processing, and mainly relates to a network information traceability analysis system for multi-source data fusion, which solves the problem of heterogeneous data alignment and matching between different devices and systems by integrating information from different data sources and unifying data formats, time sequences and semantics; carrying out association analysis on the cross-domain data through a cross-domain event alignment and association scoring module, and uniformly associating different events distributed in a plurality of systems; analyzing the propagation path and key nodes of the attack by an attack-process link construction module; the system can effectively cope with complex cross-domain attacks in modern industrial environments, and improves the recognition precision and the emergency response efficiency of safety events.
assignees: BEIJING BANGZHIYAN NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Data driven modeling and optimization method for device for deasphalting by solvent
abstract_en: A data driven modeling and optimization method for a device for deasphalting by a solvent. The data driven modeling method for a device for deasphalting by a solvent comprises: (1) pre-processing of on-site data, the on-site data comprising production operation data, raw material and product property analysis data of said device; (2) screening of feature variables, the screening being performed according to technological principles and processes, (3) reduction of dimensionality of the feature variables by principal component analysis (PCA); and modeling according to a dimensionality-reduced data set by using a back propagation (BP) neural network for creating a yield model of deasphalted oil (DAO) as well as a desulfurization and residual carbon removal model, respectively. The optimization method comprises a step of optimizing the operating conditions of said device using the constructed data driven model of said device.
