title_en: Earthquake damage prediction and anti-locking system and method thereof
abstract_en: Propose a kind of for determining earthquake damage prediction and the anti-locking system (1) of the earthquake pair impact that the object be associated with diverse geographic location (A, B, C, D) causes or damage.The central location with filter module is selected and collects the earthquake related data of multiple network element.Store at least one and impact ratiometer (151), impact ratiometer (151) has the first data structure for the geography and/or terrain data coordinate storing diverse geographic location (A, B, C, D).Geographic position (A, B, C, D) is produced by the Strength co-mputation module (104) with coordinate processor with the geometric distance in focus/earthquake centre (2).The propagation computing unit of Strength co-mputation module (104) based on produced geometric distance and given seismic amplitude, utilize the parametrization stored comprising Changeable weight parameter to arrange to produce local intensity values, and the geometric distance produced being assigned to corresponding geographic position (A, B, C, D) utilizes second data structure of impacting ratiometer (151) to store.From multiple user receive following at least one: Changeable weight parameter and/or represent that at least one of different earthquake strength level of the impact that earthquake causes object or damage impacts at least one image parameter of the earthquake exposed structure of ratio and/or defining objects.Index computing module (105) is by determining the impact ratio of local strength of corresponding geographic position (A, B, C, D) place according to impacting ratiometer (151) and will be added by the impact ratio of the weight factor weighting distributing to corresponding geographic position (A, B, C, D) Impact Index producing geographic position (A, B, C, D) in each case in each case.

title_en: Cascade hydropower day-ahead scheduling method considering power grid section constraint
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of cascade reservoir group power generation optimizing and dispatching, in particular to a cascade hydropower day-ahead dispatching method considering power grid section constraint.

title_en: Comprehensive protection method of electric-gas coupling system under heavy load distribution attack
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive protection method of an electric-gas coupling system under heavy load distribution attack, which comprises the steps of simulating bilateral collaborative LR attack by an attacker visual angle; considering the influence of the power grid cascading failure caused by bilateral collaborative LR attack on system load, establishing an electric-gas coupling system loss evaluation model, and uniformly measuring the load loss of the power grid and a natural gas grid in the electric-gas coupling system by adopting economic loss; solving a loss evaluation model of the electric-gas coupling system through a linearization method and KKT condition conversion, calculating economic loss caused by attack on the electric-gas coupling system, and determining the vulnerability of each load node in the system; analyzing the comprehensive vulnerability and the height degree of each load node under different attack resource degrees; and the comprehensive protection is carried out on the electric-gas coupling system by adopting a load node with high comprehensive vulnerability of strengthening protection and limiting the gas-to-electricity load reduction proportion. The invention improves the capability of the system for resisting attacks and reduces the economic loss of the IEGS.

title_en: Earthquake prediction method and system based on optical fiber micro-vibration monitoring
abstract_en: The invention discloses an earthquake prediction method and system based on optical fiber micro-vibration monitoring, comprising the following steps of S1, adopting a dynamic self-adaptive acquisition frequency adjustment mechanism to acquire micro-vibration signals, acquiring data at the frequency of 1kHz in a distributed optical fiber sensing network, simultaneously acquiring the fluctuation condition of the data, setting a fluctuation threshold, and when the fluctuation condition of the micro-vibration signals continuously exceeds the fluctuation threshold in m continuous time windows, acquiring the frequency to be increased to 10kHz to acquire the data and count all micro-vibration signal data, S2, constructing a cross-correlation coefficient matrix of the micro-vibration signal data among different acquisition frequencies through all the micro-vibration signal data, acquiring direction information and propagation velocity information among different monitoring points based on corresponding values in the cross-correlation coefficient matrix to form spatial characteristic parameters, comprehensively capturing the spatial propagation characteristics of the signals, and effectively solving the one-sided problem of the traditional method.

title_en: Method and system for evaluating influence of construction disturbance on natural protected land biodiversity
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for evaluating the influence of construction disturbance on the biodiversity of a natural protected area, which relate to the technical field of computers and comprise the steps of acquiring species distribution data, construction disturbance data and environment data in the natural protected area; the method comprises the steps of constructing an ecological correlation network according to species distribution data to obtain a species interaction network, extracting network structural features according to the species interaction network to obtain a key species set, conducting disturbance propagation dynamics modeling according to the key species set and construction disturbance data to obtain an influence propagation path diagram, conducting biodiversity response prediction according to the influence propagation path diagram and environment data to obtain a variation trend of the biological community composition, conducting comprehensive influence assessment according to the variation trend of the biological community composition, and outputting an influence grade index by comparing deviation degrees of historical baseline states. The invention effectively improves the integrity and predictive evaluation accuracy of the influence of construction disturbance on the natural protected land biodiversity.

title_en: Flashover analysis tool
abstract_en: A method to minimize human intervention during decision making processes while controlling an electrical power system by identifying an initiating element that cause a tripping of the transmission overhead lines and identifying potential future protection system failures that can initiate a cascading of tripping or total national blackout. A method of producing flashover analysis signal as a protection system analysis including processing a neutral current, three phase current profile, three phase voltage profile, and a plurality of digital signal of a transmission line using an artificial neural network to calculate pickup time, reset time, DEF confirmation time or total fault clearance time. A method of producing flashover analysis signal including as a flashover signature analysis to identify the cause of the flashover as a current transformer explosion, tree encroachment, crane, lightning strike or polluted insulator.
assignees: ABDUL KARIM SAZALI;MOHD ZIN ABDULLAH ASUHAIMI;TNB RES SDN BHD;UNIV MALAYSIA TEKNOLOGI

title_en: The intelligence ice-melt of power grid regulation center and maintenance system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of intelligent ice-melt in power grid regulation center and maintenance system, including our department of control centre terminal, ice-melt application server, database server, office's terminal and power plant's terminal；Ice-melt application server is connected with cascaded switches I, cascaded switches II simultaneously, connected between cascaded switches I and cascaded switches II, cascaded switches I are connected with master firewall, cascaded switches II are connected with backup fire wall, master firewall is connected with backup fire wall, master firewall, backup fire wall are connected on a convergence switch together, and our department of control centre terminal is connected with convergence switch, and ground office terminal, power plant's terminal are connected by integrated data network with convergence switch；Database server is also connected with cascaded switches I, cascaded switches II simultaneously；The system can greatly improve intelligent ice-melt and overhaul efficiency, so as to further ensure that power network continues safe and stable operation.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING AND CONTROL CENTER OF GUIZHOU POWER GRID CORP

title_en: Power grid node classification method and computer readable medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power grid node classification method and a computer readable medium, wherein the power grid node classification method comprises the following steps: step 1: calculating the propagation strength according to the physical attributes and the propagation probability of the power grid nodes; step 2: calculating the network cohesion degree based on the power grid segmentation; and step 3: establishing a fuzzy representative point clustering model based on the degree of agglomeration; and 4, step 4: calculating an objective function value of the fuzzy representative point clustering model based on the degree of cohesion and judging whether an error condition is met, if so, executing the step 5, otherwise, returning to the step 1; and 5: sequencing objective function values to obtain a clustering center; step 6: and carrying out clustering division according to the clustering center to obtain a power grid node classification result. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of high classification accuracy, capability of providing theoretical support for power grid planning and the like.

title_en: Fault diagnosis method and system based on transformer data sample expansion
abstract_en: The invention provides a fault diagnosis method and a fault diagnosis system based on transformer data sample expansion, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring main transformer test data, performing data cleaning on the main transformer test data, and dividing the main transformer test data after the data cleaning into main transformer test training data and main transformer test data according to a preset proportion; carrying out normalization processing on the main transformer test training data; establishing a back propagation neural network model for transformer fault diagnosis through the normalized main transformer test training data and the loss function, and optimizing the back propagation neural network model for transformer fault diagnosis through the main transformer test data; and inputting the operation data of the transformer into the optimized back propagation neural network model for transformer fault diagnosis to obtain a fault result of the transformer. The invention aims at the unbalanced sample to realize the performance improvement of transformer fault category identification.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID LTD RESPONSIBILITY COMPANY;ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INSTITUTE OF GUANGDONG POWER GRID LIMITED RESPONSIBILITY COMPANY

title_en: Urban rail transit operation risk point association relationship chain construction method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for constructing an incidence relation chain of urban rail transit operation risk points, which belong to the technical field of urban rail transit operation maintenance, and are used for collecting and processing risk point data in a specific accident scene; based on an association rule Apriori algorithm, judging the association action relationship among the risk points, and constructing a risk propagation chain according to the association action relationship among the risk points; and based on the risk propagation chain, drawing a risk point propagation association relation chain under a specific accident scene by combining a graph theory model. The invention constructs an active risk prevention and control method for preventing accidents from the perspective of networked operation overall situation, and has important theoretical and practical significance for promoting the risk management of rail transit operation safety and guaranteeing safe and efficient operation.

title_en: Power grid vulnerability assessment method and device based on cascading failure model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid vulnerability assessment method and device based on a cascading failure model, which are characterized in that power grid parameters are initialized according to response signals, random disturbance event simulation is implemented on a power grid until the power grid evolves to a stable state based on the cascading failure model, an agent is triggered to read state data of the power grid, then the agent is controlled to decide an attack line number according to the state data, so that a system executes a corresponding attack event and evolves to the stable state, subsequent state data and load loss are output and fed back to the agent, the agent is used for carrying out attack line decision and training sample data storage, and the system is iteratively updated to an output test agent for carrying out vulnerability test assessment. Through random disturbance event simulation and evolution based on a cascading failure model, accuracy and practicality of sequence vulnerability assessment are improved, the outputted key sequence also realizes targeted hierarchical protection of the power grid key sequence, and loss caused by cascading failures to the power grid is reduced.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Wavefront sensor construction method based on coding and decoding combined optimization
abstract_en: The application provides a wave front sensor construction method based on coding and decoding combined optimization, which comprises the following steps: carrying out mathematical modeling on the propagation process of the optical wave to obtain a coding module, and constructing a network architecture comprising the coding module and the decoding module; based on a depth learning technology, carrying out joint training on the structure of the coding layer and a wavefront reconstruction algorithm to obtain optimized coding structure and reconstruction parameters; preparing an optimized coding layer by using a novel material, and replacing original protective glass on the surface of the wavefront sensor with the prepared coding layer; and carrying out physical calibration on the structure of the integrated coding layer, fine-tuning the network architecture based on the current application task, and adjusting a reconstruction algorithm of the wavefront sensor according to the fine-tuned reconstruction parameters. The method can construct a miniaturized and lightweight wave-front sensor to reconstruct wave-front with high quality and high efficiency by carrying out joint optimization on the coding layer structure and the wave-front reconstruction algorithm.

title_en: Multi-source monitoring data analysis method and system based on earthquake active source
abstract_en: The invention provides a multisource monitoring data analysis method and system based on an earthquake active source, which relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and by introducing a pre-trained earthquake wave reinforcement analysis network, the seismic wave strengthening analysis network is composed of a plurality of cascaded model functional layers, and each layer is embedded with a multi-stage knowledge migration unit, so that deep learning and efficient analysis of seismic wave data are realized. The multi-stage knowledge transfer learning mechanism not only can effectively extract key features in time period waveform data, but also gradually enhances understanding and identifying capabilities of seismic wave sequences through layer-by-layer knowledge transfer and node fusion. The method not only improves the accuracy and the robustness of seismic wave data analysis, but also remarkably enhances the sensitivity and the prediction precision of seismic monitoring. By generating the reinforced waveform data and the reinforced learning seismic wave sequence, more reliable and data support is provided for earthquake early warning, seismology research and earthquake disaster assessment.

title_en: Power equipment risk assessment method and device based on space-time diagram neural network
abstract_en: The invention provides a power equipment risk assessment method and device based on a space-time diagram neural network. The method comprises the steps of obtaining historical meteorological data of a place where target power equipment is located, coordinates of the target power equipment, service life, maintenance frequency and load rate, and coordinates of a plurality of first power equipment, predicting to obtain the meteorological data at future time through a space-time diagram neural network based on the historical meteorological data, calculating equipment vulnerability indexes based on the service life, the maintenance frequency and the load rate, calculating risk propagation coefficients corresponding to the first power equipment based on the meteorological data at the future time, the coordinates of the first power equipment and the coordinates of the target power equipment for each first power equipment, and determining probability of risk occurrence of the target power equipment based on the vulnerability indexes and the risk propagation coefficients corresponding to the plurality of first power equipment. The method and the system can improve the accuracy of equipment risk assessment in the power grid, adjust the assessment result and ensure the stability of the power grid.
assignees: DIGITAL TECH BRANCH OF HEBEI ZHONGXING JINENG ELECTRIC POWER DEVELOPMENT CO LTD;INFORMATION & COMMUNICATION BRANCH COMPANY STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Intelligent water affair integrated platform mass data intelligent analysis processing and decision support method based on GIS and Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of operation and maintenance of water service management networks, in particular to an intelligent water service integrated platform mass data intelligent analysis processing and decision support method based on GIS and the Internet of things, which constructs a pressure anomaly propagation map and corrects a hydraulic model by marking pipe explosion monitoring points and generating an initial influence domain, reversely tracking upstream nodes, the method is used for solving the problems of large estimation deviation of the traditional pipe explosion influence range and lack of accuracy of the valve closing instruction, improving the pipe explosion emergency response efficiency, reducing the water resource waste, guaranteeing the water supply stability and being suitable for urban water affair fine management.
assignees: SHANDONG HUATE WISDOM TECH CO LTD

title_en: Partial differential morphology and label propagation-based power grid partitioning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid partitioning method based on partial differential morphology and label propagation, which abstracts a power network into a weighted graph, and based on a selection strategy of electric centrality, namely k nodes with the largest electric centrality are selected as seed nodes to obtain a seed node set, unique labels are allocated to each seed, the morphology propagation and the label propagation are combined in the power grid partition, the morphology propagation is outwards propagated from the seed node set, the label propagation and the morphology propagation are operated in parallel to dynamically adjust the label attribution of the nodes, and when the cost of all the nodes is not changed any more, each node is endowed with a final label at the moment, so that the partitioning of the power grid is completed. The method can effectively realize the efficient partition control and management of the power grid, realize the accurate identification and reasonable division of the topological structure of the power grid, and provide scientific support for the planning and management of the power system.

title_en: Power system state dynamic evaluation method, system, equipment and medium for abnormal signal diffusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system state dynamic evaluation method, a system, equipment and a medium aiming at abnormal signal diffusion, belonging to the technical field of power system safety and scheduling control, comprising the steps of collecting multiple abnormal signals and constructing a directed multi-source heterograph; the method comprises the steps of carrying out system state modeling by utilizing a multi-stage dynamic propagation model based on the graph, combining the power grid topology and the weighted propagation weight, adopting an optimization graph search algorithm to identify an abnormal propagation path, evaluating the stability influence of the system according to the path identification result, and generating an intelligent auxiliary decision. The method realizes accurate simulation and path identification of multi-anomaly signal concurrent propagation of the power system by constructing the anomaly signal propagation path identification and diffusion model, combines an optimized graph search algorithm and a multi-dimensional evaluation system, improves the efficiency and accuracy of anomaly analysis in a large-scale power grid environment, and finally provides a scientific basis for rapid response for a dispatcher through an intelligent decision generation mechanism.

title_en: Risk analysis method and system for power grid fault
abstract_en: A risk analysis method and system for a power grid fault. The method comprises: according to a real-time monitoring and early-warning result of a mountain fire, determining affected electric transmission lines, and calculating a tripping probability of the electric transmission lines due to the mountain fire (S1); constructing initial fault combinations according to the tripping probability of all the electric transmission lines affected by the mountain fire (S2); calculating deterministic cascading fault combinations with the condition of the initial fault combinations (S3); according to the affected electric transmission lines, operating characteristics of protective elements for the affected electric transmission lines and the deterministic cascading fault combinations, generating probabilistic cascading fault combinations with the condition of the deterministic cascading fault combinations (S4); for each of the probabilistic cascading fault combinations, calculating a power grid stability margin with the condition of the probabilistic cascading fault combination (S6); and according to the power grid stability margin, calculating the degree of risk of each of the affected electric transmission lines (S7).
assignees: State grid hunan electric power co ltd;STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC COMPANY LTD DISASTER PREVENTION AND REDUCTION CENTER;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Dam deformation prediction system and method based on convolutional neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for predicting dam deformation based on a convolutional neural network. The convolutional neural network for dam deformation prediction fully uses the parallel computing capability of the network, two-dimensional data is input into a plurality of paths in parallel, and a plurality of convolutional layers and pooling layers are alternately cascaded in each path, so that different convolutional kernel sizes can be set for obtaining more characteristics; while the invention contemplates that the features extracted by these paths are not necessarily complementary, the system uses addition operations in combining the output results of these paths. The method improves the automation level of dam deformation prediction, and simultaneously improves the efficiency and speed of deformation prediction.

title_en: Digitization method of urban security risk assessment standard
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digitizing method of urban security risk assessment standards, which comprises the steps of identifying risk factors for historical accident time sequence data, carrying out relevance analysis to obtain a relevance function, further constructing an urban network topology structure, determining prior probability of nodes according to similarity of the nodes and pre-disaster data, generating a simulated accident scene, adding disturbance items to simulate burst risks, combining the prior probability of the nodes to obtain a risk propagation path, constructing a risk assessment model, assessing space-time influence ranges of the nodes on the propagation path, and carrying out weighted summation on assessment results of the nodes to obtain an urban security risk assessment result. The method is used for constructing the network topology structure by multi-stage analysis of the historical accident data, so that the risk propagation simulation is more accurate, the urban risk assessment can be accurately quantized, and meanwhile, the method has better interpretability.

title_en: Urban waterlogging disaster chain modeling and blocking method based on large language model and complex network analysis
abstract_en: A modeling and blocking method for urban waterlogging disaster chains based on large language models and complex network analysis belongs to the field of disaster prevention and reduction. The method comprises the steps of inputting multi-source media texts into data, automatically extracting disaster events and causal relations thereof by using a large language model, analyzing and calculating support, confidence and lifting degrees among the events through association rules, constructing a weighted directed disaster chain network for describing cascading propagation relations of urban waterlogging events, identifying key nodes and fragile propagation paths based on indexes such as centrality, connectivity and network efficiency of complex network theory calculation nodes and edges, designing progressive node and edge removal experiments, evaluating various intervention strategies, and determining an optimal disaster chain blocking scheme. The invention can realize automatic modeling and quantitative analysis from unstructured text data to disaster chain network, rapidly identify key transmission links and system weak points in waterlogging, and remarkably improve the identification precision, analysis efficiency and scientificity of prevention and control decisions of urban waterlogging disaster chains.

title_en: Blind fast network synchronization algorithm for reducing LTE public safety product costs
abstract_en: Systems and methods are provided for providing blind fast network synchronization for reducing LTE public safety products costs, comprising, in one embodiment: determining if location setup is required to mitigate timing offset due to propagation delay from the synchronization source and adjusting downlink timing, and when location setup is required then providing one of manual setup in terms of timing samples, limited power RACH based on SIB2 parameters, and based on observed time difference of arrival and position reference signal; coordinating network listening periods based on graphs and hash function to avoid common silence for two or more neighboring eNodeBs; and providing continuous synchronization using blind carrier estimation.

title_en: Method for analyzing the influence of human factor on cascading failure of power grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for analyzing the influence of a human factor on cascading failure of a power grid. The method comprises the following steps: 1) analyzing dispatching operation of a power grid dispatcher, and decomposing and obtaining the cognitive behavior according to the requirement of the current operation state of the power grid; 2) analyzing the failure mode included in the cognitive behavior; 3) solving the probability basic value HEP0 for occurrence of human failure; 4) analyzing the scene of task operation and determining the level of the behavior influence factor to obtain a failure probability correction factor; 5) solving the human failure probability under specific operation situation; and 6) taking the N-1 fault as the initial condition, performing reliability assessment for the system. The method for analyzing the influence of a human factor on cascading failure of a power grid improves the reliability in operating the power grid.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;MAINTENANCE CO STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV ZHEJIANG

title_en: Fire-fighting emergency broadcast output controller
abstract_en: The invention provides a fire-fighting emergency broadcast output controller including a main circuit board, a network controller module, output control modules, a power module, an RJ45 interface, an audio input interface, an audio output interface, and a local power supply interface. The network controller module, the output control modules, and the power module are inserted into the corresponding slots of the circuit board, the RJ45 interface, the audio input interface, the audio output interface, and the local power supply interface are arranged on the rear panel and are connected with the main circuit board via cables, at most 12 output control modules are arranged, and the network controller module and the output control modules are connected. The output controller realizes the flexible switching and distribution of audio input, the audio input can be one to one and one to more, the equipment functions are diversified, the switching is flexible, the number of the audio output to broadcast areas is greatly increased, and multiple equipment can be cascaded and the number of the broadcast areas can be expanded by times. The fire-fighting emergency broadcast output controller has the advantages of convenient use and flexible layout.
assignees: TIANJIN BEIHAI COMMUNICATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Wind power prediction method based on Quartiles and DBN
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for eliminating abnormal points of wind power and accurately predicting the wind power based on Quartiles and DBN. First a single step/multi-step prediction of wind speed at a specified future time scale is made. And then, completing data cleaning, and removing the corresponding wind power outlier at the specified wind speed interval based on a quartile method. The outliers are classified into four categories according to the v-p point distribution characteristics. In the preliminary elimination, first, second and other abnormal points are found out, and wind power outliers corresponding to the specified wind speed interval and outlier wind speed values corresponding to the specified wind power interval are cleared. And constructing a WTP model through the DBN deep neural network. Inputting cleaned data, and initializing parameters by using the stacked RBM. And (3) fine-tuning the parameters of the whole DBN network through BP back propagation, and completing the construction of the WTP model. Substituting the wind speed predicted value obtained before into a WTP model to obtain a single-step/multi-step wind power predicted value under the same time scale.

title_en: Intelligent water regime detection and early warning system based on single chip microcomputer
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water regime detection and early warning, and discloses an intelligent water regime detection and early warning system based on a single chip microcomputer, which comprises: the water level meter comprises a water level meter signal acquisition module, a data comparison module, a single chip microcomputer, a data recording module, a wireless matching module and a wireless data transmission module; the water level meter signal acquisition module is used for acquiring data signals sent by the water level meter; through the design of wireless matching module and wireless data transmission module, can automatically carry out automatic connection and send out the regimen early warning signal to the wireless network equipment around the lake shore when the water level in large-scale lake rises and surpasss the early warning value, thereby can appear the very first time of early warning at the regimen and carry out the early warning suggestion to pedestrian around the shore and the resident of living around the lake, thereby can make people in time prevent the regimen calamity that will appear, the untimely condition that leads to appearing serious harm takes place for the warning information propagation of the regimen has been avoided.

title_en: Remote sensing image change detection method combining U-shaped network and self-attention mechanism
abstract_en: The invention provides a remote sensing image change detection method combining a U-shaped network and a self-attention mechanism, which mainly solves the problems of large memory occupation and complex network structure in the prior art, and comprises the following implementation steps: 1) Acquiring a training sample set and a test sample set; 2) Constructing a U-shaped variation detection network model, wherein the U-shaped variation detection network model comprises a multi-scale feature extraction module, a layered self-attention mechanism, a fusion up-sampling module and a classifier which are sequentially cascaded; 3) Inputting the training sample set into a U-shaped transformation detection network model and performing iterative training on the training sample set by using a back propagation method; 4) And inputting the test sample set into the trained U-shaped change detection network model to obtain a remote sensing image change detection visual image and a numerical result. The invention realizes lightweight change detection, obtains multi-scale fine granularity characteristics, reduces the complexity of a network structure, improves the detection precision, reduces the calculation resources, and can be used for geological disaster detection, urban planning and forest destruction detection.

title_en: Nuclear power plant state prediction method based on interpretable machine learning
abstract_en: A nuclear power plant state prediction method based on interpretable machine learning constructs and trains a feedforward-backward propagation full-connected neural network model comprising an input layer, an output layer and a hidden layer in an off-line stage, calculates marginal contribution of each feature output by the trained feedforward-backward propagation full-connected neural network model through an SHAP interpretable algorithm in an on-line stage, and judges parameters with larger influence on target parameters in multiple parameters. The invention predicts the key parameters of the system under the accident condition of the reactor by using the multi-layer feedforward-back propagation fully-connected neural network added with the interpretable algorithm, and simultaneously judges the parameters with larger influence on the target parameters in the multi-parameters, thereby being capable of deeply mining the hidden value in the data generated in the nuclear power production and operation process, guiding the operation and maintenance decision and improving the utilization rate of the data asset.

title_en: Intelligent rapid aggregation method for air conditioner load groups
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent rapid aggregation method for air conditioner load groups, which comprises the following steps: step one: aiming at the load of a single air conditioner connected in a power grid, a typical air conditioner load model is established based on an equivalent thermal parameter model; step two: aiming at a large number of air-conditioning loads under the same node of an access power grid, designing an air-conditioning load group adjustable potential evaluation model, and evaluating the schedulable capacity of the air-conditioning load group; step three: forming an electric comprehensive distance based on the adjustable potential, active-voltage sensitivity and reactive-voltage sensitivity of the air conditioner load group, and generating an air conditioner load group history aggregation scheme library based on an affinity propagation clustering algorithm, wherein the method comprises the following steps: and constructing a voltage-power fitting model based on the generalized regression neural network based on the historical aggregation scheme library of the air conditioner load group. The invention generates an aggregation scheme by carrying out rapid intelligent aggregation on the air conditioner load groups in the system, thereby laying a model foundation for improving the voltage stability and economy of the system.
assignees: STATE GRID HUNAN COMPREHENSIVE ENERGY SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network reliability assessment method and device
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of power grid systems, and particularly discloses a power distribution network reliability assessment method and device. According to the application, by acquiring one or more reliability index data which are strongly related to the reliability of the power distribution network in the current period, obtaining entropy values and weight data corresponding to the one or more reliability index data through an entropy value method, calculating the reliability evaluation result of the power distribution network in the future period by applying a back propagation neural network to the obtained entropy values and weights, accurately predicting the reliability of the power distribution network, and improving the reliability of the power distribution network under the development of distributed power generation.
assignees: NO 709 RES INSTITUTE OF CHINA STATE SHIPBUILDING CORPORATION LIMITED

title_en: Quick evaluation method for earthquake damage performance of high-speed railway bridge based on machine learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of bridge earthquake damage performance evaluation, and particularly discloses a quick evaluation method for the earthquake damage performance of a high-speed railway bridge based on machine learning, which comprises the steps of collecting multisource data of a bridge structure of the high-speed railway, a historical earthquake database and a BI M model of the bridge structure in real time through a heterogeneous data collection system; the method comprises the steps of constructing a multi-mode feature space containing time-frequency domain features, space features and partial features of probability features, constructing a hierarchical machine learning framework based on a dynamic Bayesian network damage propagation model, a mixed model of a multi-scale convolutional neural network and a long-short-time memory network and an uncertainty quantification and dynamic updating mechanism, establishing a vibration loss performance evaluation model based on the hierarchical machine learning framework, evaluating the vibration loss performance of the multi-mode feature space by adopting the vibration loss performance evaluation model to generate damage probability distribution, effectively mining potential vibration loss-related information behind data, and more accurately simulating and predicting the vibration loss condition of a bridge in an earthquake.

title_en: Urban infrastructure cascade fault analysis method based on high-order network model
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of urban construction, and provides a method for analyzing cascading faults of urban infrastructure based on a high-order network model. The method comprises the steps of constructing a multi-layer network model of an urban infrastructure system, characterizing interaction among a plurality of network nodes in the multi-layer network model by adopting a simple replica structure to obtain a high-order network model of the urban infrastructure system, setting a node fault mechanism and a region fault mechanism of the high-order network model, performing cascading failure simulation on the high-order network model under a preset cascading failure situation, and finally identifying high-risk nodes in the high-order network model according to cascading failure simulation results based on network comprehensive factors of cascading failures of the defined high-order network model so as to improve elasticity of the urban infrastructure system corresponding to the high-risk nodes. By means of the method, the high-risk nodes of the urban infrastructure are more effectively identified, and the elastic risk-resistant capability of the urban infrastructure system is improved to provide support and basis.
assignees: UNIV CHINA MINING & TECHNOLOGY BEIJING;STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Method and system for interpolating missing value of reduction current voltage monitoring data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, in particular to a method and a system for interpolating missing values of reduction current and voltage monitoring data, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining isolated missing values of historical load data in a micro-grid; estimating a target missing value based on a neighboring value of the isolated missing value, carrying out data randomness restoration on the historical load data based on the target missing value by adopting a missing value interpolation network to obtain restored load data, wherein the missing value interpolation network is obtained by combining a particle swarm algorithm and a back propagation neural network, training the missing value interpolation network based on the restored load data to obtain a trained network, and carrying out load prediction on the micro-grid based on the trained network to obtain the load data of the micro-grid. The method can accurately repair the data randomness of the historical load data, and improves the accuracy of load data prediction.
assignees: TIANTAI POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network node power quality dynamic management demand quantification method
abstract_en: The application discloses a power quality dynamic management demand quantification method for nodes of a power distribution network, which belongs to the technical field of power quality management of the power distribution network and comprises the steps of constructing a voltage out-of-limit characteristic curve and a harmonic out-of-limit characteristic curve of each node, extracting node power quality management demand characteristic indexes, constructing power quality problem characteristic vectors of the nodes based on the node power quality management demand characteristic indexes, introducing ideal worst management state vectors, constructing worst node reference characteristics, constructing initial management priority indexes based on the worst node reference characteristics and the power quality problem characteristic vectors of the nodes, introducing voltage influence factors and harmonic propagation factors, correcting the initial management priority indexes based on the voltage influence factors and the harmonic propagation factors, and identifying key nodes with most urgent management demands on different time sections in the power distribution network based on the corrected initial management priority indexes. The method can effectively improve the accuracy of power quality control of the power distribution network.

title_en: Digital power grid supply chain security risk assessment method, system, equipment and medium based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital power grid supply chain security risk assessment method, system, equipment and medium based on artificial intelligence, which belong to the technical field of power security and comprise the steps of acquiring open source component dependency relationship data of a digital power grid system and constructing an initial dependency graph; calculating confidence scores of all the dependency edges in the initial dependency graph, determining a noise filtering threshold value to generate a filtered dependency graph, carrying out propagation calculation on component risks based on the filtered dependency graph by adopting a graph neural network, outputting risk propagation values of all the components, respectively extracting code feature vectors, safety feature vectors and power industry context feature vectors of all the components, fusing the code feature vectors, the safety feature vectors and the power industry context feature vectors to generate component comprehensive risk vectors, and determining risk ratings of all the components according to the risk propagation values and the component comprehensive risk vectors. The invention improves the accuracy and reliability of the safety risk identification of the digital power grid open source software supply chain.

title_en: Subway station cascade failure risk early warning method based on dynamic passenger flow deduction
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of urban rail transit operation management, and particularly discloses a subway station cascade failure risk early warning method based on dynamic passenger flow deduction, which comprises the steps of carrying out hierarchical division on facilities in a subway station according to service facility functions, establishing a directional connection relationship between facilities based on passenger travelling paths, and setting passenger flow weights to construct a directional layered network model; the method comprises the steps of generating joint coupling parameters based on path association and passenger flow volume, establishing a dynamic state evolution model, determining a facility state by combining a facility bearing upper limit and the current passenger flow volume, updating a network structure, adjusting the passenger flow volume, deducing a comprehensive state at the next moment, predicting the congestion risk of the subway station according to the comprehensive state, and describing the in-station structure by means of facility layering and directed modeling, introducing passenger flow weight and joint coupling parameters, describing facility dependence, realizing cascade deduction by combining bearing judgment and passenger flow adjustment, and realizing subway station congestion risk prediction based on the dynamic state.
assignees: DEQING RAIL TRANSIT GROUP CO LTD;HANGZHOU METRO CONSTRUCTION MAN CO LTD

title_en: Power equipment state prediction method, equipment and medium based on data analysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power equipment state prediction and discloses a power equipment state prediction method, equipment and medium based on data analysis. The method comprises the steps of obtaining and fusing time sequence operation data, wide area monitoring data and local scanning data of the power equipment to generate a unified equipment comprehensive state image. On the basis, the device is divided into a plurality of state evaluation units, a dynamic evolution model is built for each unit, and the evolution track of future state parameters is predicted. By identifying abnormal segments in the trajectory, potential points of failure inside the device are located. And analyzing space-time correlation among the abnormal points, constructing a global fault risk propagation network, and identifying key nodes and vulnerable paths to determine maintenance priority. The method realizes early accurate early warning of the local hidden trouble of the equipment and simulation of the system-level fault chain reaction, and improves the prospective of state prediction and the accuracy of maintenance decision.
assignees: ZHEJIANG ENERGY GROUP ENERGY SERVICES CO LTD

title_en: Static engine and neural network for a cognitive reservoir system
abstract_en: Implementations described and claimed herein provide systems and methods for developing a reservoir. In one implementation, observed data points in a volume along a well trajectory and well logs corresponding to observed data points are received at a neural network. Feature vectors are generated using the neural network. The feature vectors are defined based on a distance between each of the observed data points and randomly generated points in the volume. A 3D populated log is generated by propagating well log values of the feature vectors across the volume. Uncertainty is quantified by generating a plurality of realizations including the 3D populated log. Each of the realizations is different and equally probable, core values are generated from the realizations, and a static model of the reservoir is generated by clustering the volume into one or more clusters of rock types based on the core values.

title_en: A kind of power system weak link identification method based on cascading failure
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of power system weak link identification method based on cascading failure, cascading failure model is incorporated into the state analysis of risk assessment, consider and originate fault progression as the influence after cascading failure to power network, suit large-scale blackout dynamic, the chain rule of development, the weak link for influenceing large-scale blackout can be recognized by means of cascading failure process analysis procedure analysis, the element to be played a crucial role in large-scale blackout really is filtered out, the weak link result drawn is more comprehensively accurate, has more reference value；The maturation theory of the invention effectively inherited based on Monte Carlo Analogue Method risk assessment, without carrying out the derivation of complex relationship formula, without enumerating for failure is carried out, when especially system is larger, advantage of the invention will be apparent from.

title_en: The compact reservoir physical parameter intelligent Forecasting of data-driven
abstract_en: Present disclose provides a kind of compact reservoir physical parameter intelligent Forecastings of data-driven, construct learning sample collection using 3-D seismics Wave data and well-log information, pre-process to learning sample collection；The machine learning network model that building convolution is mixed with inner product operator, uses convolution operation to pretreated 3-D seismics Wave data, inner product operation is used to additional space position, along network propagated forward；The training that machine learning network model is carried out using learning sample collection, until the network model for obtaining meeting error requirements；Centered on sampled point, multiple data are acquired in a plurality of directions as sampled data, using sampled data as the input variable for the machine learning network model trained, compact reservoir physical parameter is predicted in realization.Disclosure substitution relies on the inversion method of empirical model, realizes the compact reservoir physical parameter intelligent predicting of data-driven, solves the problems, such as small-sample learning between well logging-earthquake.

title_en: Cable formula seabed earthquake monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cable type submarine earthquake monitoring system, which comprises: a main subsystem and a plurality of secondary expansion subsystems; the main subsystem is formed by connecting two earthquake monitoring shore base stations on the shore with a plurality of primary ocean bottom earthquake monitoring stations in series to form an energy and data gathering connection network of the ocean bottom earthquake monitoring system; the secondary expansion subsystem consists of a primary ocean bottom earthquake monitoring station and a plurality of secondary ocean bottom earthquake monitoring stations which are cascaded layer by layer; the primary ocean bottom earthquake monitoring station is used for acquiring earthquake data and carrying out digital processing on the acquired data, receiving the data transmitted by the secondary ocean bottom earthquake monitoring station connected with the primary ocean bottom earthquake monitoring station, summarizing all the data and transmitting the summarized data to an earthquake monitoring bank base station; the secondary ocean bottom earthquake monitoring station is used for acquiring earthquake data, carrying out digital processing on the acquired data, receiving the data transmitted by the secondary ocean bottom earthquake monitoring station connected with the secondary ocean bottom earthquake monitoring station, and transmitting all the data to the upper-stage ocean bottom earthquake monitoring station through the expansion submarine cable after being aggregated.

title_en: Power transmission and distribution coordination planning method considering generalized load random characteristics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power transmission and distribution coordination planning method considering generalized load random characteristics, which decomposes a power transmission and distribution coupling system into a plurality of small systems according to a physical structure and then constructs a distributed decision framework of power transmission and distribution iteration interaction. Firstly, fitting a probability density function of generalized load containing distributed new energy according to actual measurement data, randomly sampling generalized load values by using a Monte Carlo sampling method, and sequentially connecting the generalized load values into a power distribution network with new energy power generation. And independently operating each power transmission system and each power distribution system, and solving the boundary power between power transmission and power distribution. The invention provides the method for realizing information transfer between the power transmission system and the power distribution system by using the mean value and standard deviation of boundary power as shared variables and using a probabilistic target cascading algorithm, and writing the target function with the Lagrange penalty function by using the lowest total running cost of the system as a target column, thereby not only not reducing the calculation precision, but also greatly improving the calculation speed.

title_en: Power battery cascade utilization decision-making method and system based on scene matching
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power battery recycling and discloses a scene matching-based power battery cascade utilization decision method, which comprises the steps of obtaining cascade utilization standard use parameters of various practical application scenes on a power battery, and basic parameters and performance parameters of the power battery; and comparing the obtained power battery performance parameters with the cascade utilization standard use parameters of the power battery in various practical application scenes based on the trained neural network classification model, thereby obtaining a decision result of the cascade utilization of the power battery. The invention also discloses a corresponding system. The invention can not only process big data more quickly and comprehensively and improve decision efficiency and accuracy, but also effectively solve the problems of disassembly depth decision of various retired power batteries and matching decision with various practical application scenes.

title_en: Resource abnormality prediction method, device and equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a resource abnormality prediction method, device and equipment, relates to the technical field of distribution, and can add popularization capability of information propagation and accumulation of higher-order risks of more than two steps of individual participants in a resource abnormality prediction process, thereby improving the accuracy of a resource abnormality prediction result. The method comprises the steps of setting a service performance process in combination with a delivery scene, abstracting a historical delivery order into a heterogeneous graph with a service meaning according to the service performance process, describing vector representation of the multi-party nodes on different edge types in the heterogeneous graph by using a graph neural network according to the multi-party nodes involved in the service scene and the different edge types formed by the nodes, and carrying out resource prediction on the to-be-delivered order by using the vector representation of the multi-party nodes on the different edge types in the heterogeneous graph with the service meaning in response to a prediction instruction of resource abnormality of the to-be-delivered order to obtain a prediction result of resource abnormality of the to-be-delivered order.

title_en: Power information physical system safety assessment method considering wind power and cascading failure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a safety evaluation method of an electric power information physical system considering wind power and cascading faults, which comprises the steps of constructing a mathematical model of the electric power information physical system, starting network attack aiming at the electric power information physical system, designing a wind power randomness model based on a Markov-Monte Carlo method after the cascading faults occur, acquiring active and reactive power injection of each node in the electric power system according to wind power at each cascading fault simulation moment, calculating voltage of each node and power transmission line trend in the electric power system by using an improved linearization alternating current power flow calculation method, updating running temperature of the power transmission line according to the power transmission line trend at each simulation moment, calculating the disconnection probability of the power transmission line, and providing cascading fault safety evaluation indexes considering output and load fluctuation of a wind turbine generator set simultaneously according to entropy theory, wherein the influence of the power transmission line disconnection on subsequent evolution of the cascading faults can be analyzed, and the dynamic safety of the system in the cascading fault process is evaluated.

title_en: Urban infrastructure cascade fault analysis method based on high-order network model
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of urban construction, and provides a method for analyzing cascading faults of urban infrastructure based on a high-order network model. The method comprises the steps of constructing a multi-layer network model of an urban infrastructure system, characterizing interaction among a plurality of network nodes in the multi-layer network model by adopting a simple replica structure to obtain a high-order network model of the urban infrastructure system, setting a node fault mechanism and a region fault mechanism of the high-order network model, performing cascading failure simulation on the high-order network model under a preset cascading failure situation, and finally identifying high-risk nodes in the high-order network model according to cascading failure simulation results based on network comprehensive factors of cascading failures of the defined high-order network model so as to improve elasticity of the urban infrastructure system corresponding to the high-risk nodes. By means of the method, the high-risk nodes of the urban infrastructure are more effectively identified, and the elastic risk-resistant capability of the urban infrastructure system is improved to provide support and basis.

title_en: System for providing power supply service for cost saving based on Time of Use (TOU) and method therefor
title_ko: 계시별 요금제를 기초로 비용 절약을 위한 전력 공급 서비스를 제공하기 위한 시스템 및 이를 위한 방법
abstract_ko: 계시별 요금제(TOU: Time-of-Use)를 기초로 비용 절약을 위한 전력 공급 서비스를 제공하기 위한 시스템이 제공된다. 상기 시스템은 사용자장치에 제공할 서비스 내역을 포함하는 스마트계약서를 서비스 개인키로 서명하여 트랜잭션을 생성하고, 생성된 트랜잭션을 블록체인네트워크로 전송하는 서비스서버와, 상기 블록체인네트워크를 형성하는 복수의 노드장치를 포함한다. 여기서, 상기 복수의 노드장치 중 채굴에 성공한 노드장치는 상기 트랜잭션으로부터 스마트계약서를 추출하여 추출된 스마트계약서를 포함하는 블록을 생성하고, 상기 생성된 블록을 상기 복수의 노드장치로 전파하고, 상기 복수의 노드장치는 상기 블록을 검증하고, 검증에 성공하면 블록체인에 상기 블록을 연결하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Insulated union for explosion- proof
title_ko: 방폭용 절연 유니온
abstract_ko: 본 고안은 주로 가스 또는 증기지역, 화학약품이 사용되는 장소 및 정유시설이나 가스 정제시설 등 인화성 물질을 취급 항시 폭발 및 화재의 위험이 상존하는 지역에서 이용되는 전기 에너지를 필요로 하는 각종 기기들의 전원 케이블, 전기스위치 및 스위치박스, 컨넥터 등)의 라인에 연결되어 절연 기능을 하므로써 각종 전기기에 낙뇌와 같은 돌입되는 전기를 방지하여 전기기의 오동작과 파손을 방지할 수 있고,내부폭발 시 화염전파를 방지 할 수 있는방폭용 절연 유니온에 관한 고안이다. 방폭용 절연 유니온은 기기에 고정되는 고정부재와 고정부재에 연결되는 연경부재와 이들을 고정시키는 나사캡으로 구성되며 연결부재는 하부 부재와 상부 부재로 분할 구성하여 절연부재 접착면을 구비시키며 하부부재와 상부부재 사이에 접착고정되는 절연부재는 하부와 상부에 접착면이 구비되고 내면 중앙에는 보강 절연부가 구비된다.

title_en: A kind of transmission line forest fire detection method based on depth space-time characteristic of field
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of transmission line forest fire detection method based on depth space-time characteristic of field, comprise the following steps：Vibe algorithms detection moving target is used to the video got from front end camera；Static depth spatial feature and dynamic optical flow depth degree temporal signatures are extracted to motion target area piecemeal, cascade sort is carried out using the good depth CNN neural network models of training in advance, to detect accurate mountain fire region.The present invention is similar in color the interference of moving target due to by the way of depth dynamic characteristic of field is combined, can be very good exclusion using depth static state spatial feature, so as to lift accuracy rate, has stronger practical value.
assignees: Jiangsu electric power information technology co ltd;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Village System biomass cogeneration power plant develops the construction method of network
abstract_en: The present invention proposes the construction method of Village System biomass cogeneration power plant development network, belongs to steam power plant's network model constructing technology field.The present invention is according to thermal demand distribution with multiple biomass cogeneration power plant network planning schemes of the GIS instruments generation with different heat energy propagation thresholds, the production capacity magnitude of measuring and calculating biomass cogeneration power plant, heat energy delivery efficiency, heat energy transmission loss, electric energy delivery efficiency, electric energy output loss, contrast filters out the programme with optimal efficiency of energy utilization, and then built in Village System region in the link of biomass thermal Electricity Federation electricity production factory and improve efficiency of energy utilization as much as possible, realize and save the energy, reduce the purpose of non-renewable energy resources consumption.

title_en: Short-term electric vehicle charging load prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a short-term electric vehicle charging load prediction method and system. When the daily load prediction model is established, the data mining is carried out on the samples in the sample library by using a neighbor propagation method, so that the prediction efficiency of the prediction model can be effectively improved. Meanwhile, the method fully utilizes the characteristic extraction advantages of the convolutional neural network, converts the charging load numerical value in the sample into image data by utilizing an RGB color mapping method, and simultaneously considers the influences of seasons, weather, temperature, holidays and traffic volumes on the charging load, thereby greatly improving the prediction accuracy of the prediction model. On the basis, the weight and the threshold of the convolutional neural network are subjected to multi-objective optimization by using a non-inferior ranking genetic algorithm, and then the convolutional neural network is trained based on the optimal initial weight and the optimal initial threshold, so that the problem of long network training time caused by initialization random giving of neurons in the network can be effectively solved, and the prediction speed of a prediction model is further improved.

title_en: Power system load power protection control method, system, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a load power protection control method, a system, equipment and a storage medium for a power system. The power system load power protection control method comprises the following steps: establishing an element model of the power system; determining risk indexes of various fault states in the power system according to the element models and the operation reliability indexes; and determining a load power protection control strategy of the power system by combining the operation reliability index, the risk index and the risk degree of the cascading failure. The technical scheme of the embodiment of the invention relieves the technical problems that the technical support means cannot meet the service requirement and the adaptability of the solution scheme is not strong and the like caused by the fact that most power distribution network scheduling depends on experience scheduling or blind scheduling in the prior art, improves the reliability and lowers the economic cost brought by comprehensively considering various factors, is beneficial to establishing an optimal control decision scheme and forms a whole set of real-time monitoring, evaluation, early warning and control system.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD CHAOZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU

title_en: Cascading failure simulation method for thermoelectric coupling system under extremely cold disaster
abstract_en: The invention provides a cascading failure simulation method of a thermoelectric coupling system under an extremely cold disaster, which comprises the following steps: acquiring natural disaster meteorological data and system load data at the time t; calculating the line fault probability based on the Markov state space; randomly switching off the line according to the line fault probability, and updating the network topology of the thermoelectric coupling system; performing thermoelectric coupling load flow calculation based on the updated thermoelectric coupling system, and identifying a power out-of-limit circuit; and disconnecting the power out-of-limit line, updating the network topology of the thermoelectric coupling system, and calculating the load loss of the thermoelectric coupling system at the moment t. The method calculates the line fault probability of the thermoelectric coupling system under the extremely cold disaster based on the Markov state space, identifies the power out-of-limit line based on the power flow calculation, disconnects the fault line and the power out-of-limit line, can calculate the load loss of the thermoelectric coupling system under the disaster, and can simulate the cascading faults of the thermoelectric coupling system in the disaster occurrence process.

title_en: Water damage risk analysis method based on wavelet neural network prediction model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water damage risk analysis method based on a wavelet neural network prediction model, which is based on a BP neural network topological structure, takes a wavelet function as a transfer function of a hidden layer node, and comprises the steps of constructing the wavelet neural network, wherein an error is reversely propagated while a signal is forwardly propagated; training a wavelet neural network; and (4) predicting by using a wavelet neural network. The neural network is first trained. The input layer has 15 nodes which represent 15 data before the predicted node, the hidden layer has 31 nodes, the output layer has 1 node, 12 points can be predicted backwards when prediction is made, each 1 point is predicted and is regarded as a known point, and the next predicted point is obtained by continuously taking the known point as input until 12 predicted points are obtained. The average relative error can reach 1.98%. The model has the advantages of high precision and capability of realizing short-term and medium-term dynamic prediction.
assignees: NORTH CHINA INST SCIENCE & TECH;INST DISASTER PREVENTION

title_en: Household air conditioner load prediction method based on building load prediction and matching
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of air conditioner load prediction, and discloses a household air conditioner load prediction method based on building load prediction and matching, wherein the method uses TRNSYS to establish a building load calculation model, and combines meteorological parameters and the building model to calculate building load; building an air conditioner load matching function for matching the building load with the household air conditioner load by combining the household air conditioner load; and taking the meteorological parameters as input and the building load as output, establishing a building load back propagation neural network prediction model, and matching the building load calculated by the back propagation neural network load prediction model with the household air conditioner load through an air conditioner load matching function to realize the load prediction of the household air conditioner. The method is suitable for household electricity behavior analysis, is used as the basis of household electricity intelligent management strategies, and has good application prospects.

title_en: Fault emergency scheduling method and system for cascade hydropower station equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a fault emergency dispatching method and system for cascade hydropower station equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring historical operation data and real-time operation data of each level hydropower station in the cascade hydropower station; determining important power flow sections of hydropower stations of all levels in a power grid topology; analyzing and monitoring equipment faults based on important tide sections and combining real-time operation data with power grid topology; calculating the power generation loss of the faulty hydropower station according to the fault analysis result of the equipment fault analysis monitoring; combining the real-time operation data and the power loss and adopting a genetic algorithm to generate an initial emergency scheduling scheme of the cascade hydropower station; predicting maintenance recovery time for recovering all the faulty hydropower stations to a normal running state; and combining the real-time operation data, the power loss and the maintenance recovery time, and adopting a second generation genetic algorithm to generate an optimal emergency scheduling scheme of the cascade hydropower station. The invention has the effect of safely and rapidly carrying out real-time emergency dispatch.
assignees: WUHAN HUAFEI INTELLIGENT ELECTRICAL TECH CO LTD;CHINA YANGTZE POWER CO LTD

title_en: Output distribution method and system for economic operation of hydropower station
abstract_en: The application discloses an output distribution method and system for economic operation of a hydropower station, comprising the following steps of S1, obtaining a 96-point power generation plan of each step power station in a whole factory and water level information of a source reservoir, searching a reservoir flow-optimal output relation curve according to the water level of a superior reservoir or a drainage basin at the current level of the hydropower station, S2, searching the optimal output flow of the current level of the hydropower station according to the output of the given superior power station and the output flow-optimal output relation curve of the current reservoir level, S3, obtaining Mao Shuitou of the hydropower station at the current output flow of the hydropower station according to the water level of the reservoir and the output flow, and S4, obtaining the flow and the output of each unit of the current hydropower station. The application can obtain the optimal operation solution of the cascade hydroelectric generating set, effectively ensure the stable and safe operation of the hydropower station and the power grid, fully reduce the energy consumption and improve the energy utilization efficiency.

title_en: Wind power equipment fault tracing method and system based on fault decoupling multi-level model
abstract_en: The invention provides a wind power equipment fault tracing method and system based on a fault decoupling multi-level model, which relate to the technical field of fault intelligent diagnosis, and are used for collecting fault analysis information of wind power equipment, constructing a fault decoupling multi-level network model, obtaining a fault propagation path set of the fault decoupling multi-level network model, obtaining node propagation strength and link propagation strength based on reliability features and topological features of all nodes and links among the nodes in the fault decoupling multi-level network model, calculating propagation strength of each propagation path in the fault propagation path set according to a path propagation strength function, the node propagation strength and the link propagation strength, calculating a path node attribute update value, obtaining path indexes of each propagation path according to the path node attribute update value and a path index function, selecting propagation paths meeting preset accuracy and preset confidence in the fault propagation path set as fault propagation paths, and sequencing the fault propagation paths according to a preset path index order to determine a fault source. The invention is beneficial to improving the accuracy of fault source positioning.

title_en: Operation and maintenance management method and system for railway power supply and distribution
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of railway power supply and distribution, in particular to an operation and maintenance management method and system for railway power supply and distribution, which are used for solving the problem of low operation and maintenance management efficiency caused by poor accuracy of fault identification and positioning. The method comprises the steps of receiving equipment operation data of a railway power supply and distribution system acquired by a sensor network through the Internet of things, inputting the data into a pre-trained pattern neural network model, identifying fault equipment identification and fault modes, determining a target fault propagation path according to the fault equipment identification, the fault modes and a multi-level power supply and distribution knowledge graph, wherein the multi-level power supply and distribution knowledge graph comprises an equipment-level knowledge graph, a regional-level knowledge graph and a system-level knowledge graph which are mutually related, predicting fault severity according to the target fault propagation path by adopting a fault severity assessment model, determining a corresponding operation and maintenance management report, and carrying out corresponding processing according to the operation and maintenance management report. The technical scheme provided by the invention improves the efficiency of operation and maintenance management.
assignees: FIRST ENG CO LTD OF CHINA RAILWAY ELECTRIFICATION BUREAU GROUP

title_en: Landslide early warning and monitoring method and system based on NBIOT
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and detection, in particular to a landslide early warning and monitoring method and system based on NBIOT. The method comprises the steps of collecting data including rainfall data, soil humidity data and displacement data, conducting data processing and analysis, conducting integration and time synchronization processing on the collected data, comparing the integrated data with a preset alarm threshold, triggering a local alarm mechanism when the data exceeds the preset alarm threshold, otherwise, uploading the data to a cloud, conducting cloud data processing, conducting data preprocessing and building and training a BP neural network model, conducting random initialization on weights and threshold values of the neural network, extracting historical data to serve as training sample input, conducting training on the BP neural network through a back propagation algorithm, adjusting the weights and the threshold values, adjusting network structures or parameters to meet performance requirements, and conducting landslide probability prediction through the model. According to the technical scheme, the monitoring precision and timeliness can be improved, and the early warning accuracy is improved.

title_en: Electric power-traffic coupling charging network toughness assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for evaluating toughness of an electric power-traffic coupling charging network, and belongs to the technical field of electric power system analysis. According to the method, an electric power-traffic coupling charging network is built, a Bezier curve is combined to simulate a typhoon path and a Holland wind field model to calculate wind speed, dynamic traffic flow distribution, alternating current optimal power flow and cascading fault models are built, a Monte Carlo simulation is utilized to generate a fault data set, a dynamic Bayesian network is utilized to train a fault prediction model, a dynamic probability map is output after the actually measured wind speed is input, and dynamic toughness indexes are calculated to evaluate the toughness of the electric power-traffic coupling charging network. According to the method, the problem of fault propagation and insufficient dynamic evaluation among the systems is considered, and the toughness evaluation precision of the power-traffic coupling charging network under typhoon disasters is improved.

title_en: Deep learning-based seismic data noise identification method and device
