abstract_en: The invention discloses a natural disaster risk relieving method and device for an electric power system, which comprises an hour-level composite cascade event set generating module, a risk relieving module, a distributed resource evaluating module, a natural disaster influence module and a power grid control module, wherein the hour-level composite cascade event set generating module is used for generating an hour-level data set under various natural disaster scenes, capturing cascade effects of different disasters, providing data support for risk influence quantification of the electric power system and strategy generation of the risk relieving module, the distributed resource evaluating module is used for evaluating availability and power generation potential of distributed resources in a three-level area, analyzing the power generation potential of the distributed resources during various natural disasters by combining weather and disaster factors, the natural disaster influence module is constructed, the influence of the various natural disasters on the electric power system is simulated based on the hour-level composite cascade event set, the damage degree of the disasters on loads, power generation facilities, power transmission and distribution lines and the like is analyzed, the risk relieving module is constructed, a disaster emergency scheme is formulated for an area with the risk influence on the basis of a three-level collaborative mechanism, the power generation potential of the distributed resource evaluating module is used, and the power grid is quickly restored and stably operated by scheduling various distributed resources, repairing the power grid and load adjusting.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and storage medium for evaluating power grid risk under extreme weather
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of risk assessment of power systems, in particular to a power grid risk assessment method, device, equipment and storage medium under extreme weather, and the method comprises the steps of analyzing an abnormal action mechanism of extreme weather factors under tropical weather on power grid equipment to obtain a wind power abnormal output space-time matrix under the extreme weather, sampling by power transmission line fault probability to obtain a line fault state space-time matrix, comprehensively obtaining an abnormal state matrix of a power grid, combining the abnormal state matrix with power flow redistribution to obtain a power grid abnormal coupling process considering the extreme weather and the power flow redistribution, rescheduling a unit and island processing in the power grid abnormal coupling process to obtain a power grid abnormal propagation path, determining an abnormal propagation path evolution flow, obtaining abnormal propagation paths of different power grids through simulation, determining risk assessment indexes aiming at the abnormal propagation paths of different power grids, and calculating to obtain a risk assessment result considering the abnormal space-time evolution of the power grid.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO RES INST;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: BIM-based power management and control method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power management and control, in particular to a BIM-based power management and control method and system, comprising the following steps: and extracting construction information and material characteristic parameters of the building power equipment from the BIM model, calculating a material thermal stress accumulation value by combining a temperature change curve in the operation data, and estimating the damage degree based on the fatigue parameter to obtain a thermal damage estimation result of the power equipment. According to the invention, damage identification precision is improved by analyzing the construction information and the operation data of the power equipment, a power supply path is optimized based on the comparison of a damage value and a endurance limit, overload is prevented by dynamically adjusting power distribution by utilizing real-time load data, fault propagation is deduced by combining a fault node power supply line, a power flow direction and impedance parameters, prediction capacity is improved, a recovery scheme is optimized by adjusting the capacity and the power attenuation ratio of a standby power supply path, intelligent coordination of monitoring, evaluation, adjustment and recovery is realized by depending on BIM data dynamic update, and power grid operation efficiency and strain capacity are improved.
assignees: ZHONGZHIXIN JIANGSU ENERGY STORAGE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Measuring system for air quality
title_ko: 공기질 측정 시스템
abstract_en: An air quality measurement system comprises: a measurement module for measuring indoor air quality, and including a floating matter detection sensor for detecting the size, number, and concentration of floating matters by irradiating laser beams to floating matters (particle) floating in air; a data communications network for transferring information of the indoor air quality measured by the measurement module; a data collection server for receiving the information of the indoor air quality through the data communications network, and collecting outdoor weather information and outdoor air quality information; a control server for receiving each air quality information collected by the data collection server; a database for providing correspondence information to the control server by holding the correspondence information corresponding to each information of air quality; and a user terminal for receiving each of the information of air quality and the corresponding information from the control server. Accordingly, extremely ultra-fine dust of PM 1.0 may be detected early, and a service performer or a beneficiary may recognize a current state. Therefore, various service scenarios can be provided, so that service performance or service indication can be performed, a service beneficiary can recognize a situation early through a warning alarm or an alarm indication in the event of exposure of a harmful substance causing serious damage to a human body or occurrence of a fire, and the situation can be quickly propagate to promote subsequent tasks.
abstract_ko: 공기질 측정 시스템은 공기 중에 부유하는 부유물(Paticle)에 레이저를 조사하여 상기 부유물의 크기, 수 및 농도를 감지하는 부유물 감지센서를 포함하고, 실내 공기질을 측정하는 측정모듈, 상기 측정모듈에서 측정되는 상기 실내 공기질의 정보를 전달하는 데이터 통신망, 상기 데이터 통신망을 통해 상기 실내 공기질의 정보를 수신받고, 실외 기상정보 및 실외 공기질 정보를 수집하는 데이터 수집서버, 상기 데이터 수집서버에서 수집된 상기 각각의 공기질 정보를 수신받는 관제서버, 상기 각각의 공기질의 정보에 대응하는 대응정보를 보유하여 상기 관제서버에 대응정보를 제공하는 데이터 베이스 및 상기 관제서버로부터 상기 각각의 공기질의 정보 및 상기 대응정보를 수신받는 사용자 단말기를 포함한다. 이에 따라, PM1.0의 극초미세먼지를 조기에 감지할 수 있고, 서비스 수행자나 수혜자가 현재의 상태를 파악할 수 있고, 이에 따라 서비스 수행이나 서비스 지시를 할 수 있으며, 인체에 심각한 손상을 일으키는 유해물질의 노출이나, 화재시에 서비스 수혜자가 경보알람 또는 경보표시를 통해 조기에 상황을 인지할 수 있고, 이를 신속히 전파하여 후속 작업을 도모할 수 있는 다양한 서비스 시나리오가 제공할 수 있다.

title_en: an antifire structure for a duct and electric pipe space with an excellent air permeability and fire resistance
title_ko: 통기성 및 차화성이 우수한 덕트 및 전기시설물 스페이스용 차화 구조물
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an anti-fire structure for a duct and an electric facility space having excellent air permeability and fire resistance which normally maintains the flow of air in a duct space effectively and can prevent a fire from spreading through a duct and an electric facility space when the fire occurs. The anti-fire structure for a duct and an electric facility space having excellent air permeability and fire resistance comprises: an anchor member installed and fixed on the inner circumferential surface of a duct and an electric facility space; a first member crossing the internal space of the duct and the electric facility space to divide the internal space of the duct and the electric facility space into a plurality of areas, wherein both ends thereof are connected to and fixed on the anchor member; a second member wherein one end thereof is connected to and fixed on the first member, and the other end thereof is connected to and fixed on the anchor member or another first member to individually divide a plurality of ducts and electric facilities; a plurality of third members connected to and fixed on one or more among the anchor member, the first member, and the second member, and coming in contact with and surrounding the outer circumferential surfaces of the individually divided ducts and electric facilities; and an anti-fire member having a sheet form with a vent hole formed therethrough in the longitudinal direction of the duct and the electric facility space, and mounted to cover an area formed between two or more among the anchor member, the first member, the second member, and the third members.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 평소에는 덕트 스페이스 내 공기의 흐름이 원활하게 유지되고 화재 시에는 덕트 및 전기시설물 스페이스를 통한 화재의 전파를 차단할 수 있는 통기성 및 차화성이 우수한 덕트 및 전기시설물 스페이스용 차화 구조물에 관한 것이다. 본 발명은 덕트 및 전기시설물 스페이스의 내주면에 설치되어 고정된 앵커 멤버, 덕트 및 전기시설물 스페이스의 내부 공간을 가로질러 덕트 및 전기시설물 스페이스의 내부 공간을 복수 개의 영역으로 나누고 양단이 앵커 멤버에 연결되어 고정되는 제1 멤버, 일단이 제1 멤버에 연결되어 고정되고 타단이 앵커 멤버 또는 다른 제1 멤버에 연결되어 고정되어 복수 개의 덕트 및 전기시설물을 개별적으로 구획하는 제2 멤버, 복수 개로서 앵커 멤버 제1 멤버 및 제2 멤버 중 어느 하나 이상에 연결되어 고정되고 개별적으로 구획된 덕트 및 전기시설물의 외주면에 접하여 에워싸는 제3 멤버 및 덕트 및 전기시설물 스페이스의 길이 방향으로 관통되어 형성된 통기구를 가지는 시트 형태로서 앵커 멤버 제1 멤버 제2 멤버 및 제3 멤버 중 2 이상의 사이에 형성된 영역을 커버하도록 장착되는 차화 멤버를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Apparatus for disseminating an emergency situation based on network separation and method therefor
title_ko: 망 분리 기반의 비상 상황을 전파하기 위한 장치 및 이를 위한 방법
abstract_en: A device for disseminating emergency situations is configured to perform a plurality of operations in which weights between a plurality of layers are applied to a field image through a detection network including a plurality of layers connected with learned weights to calculate an output value which indicates with probability whether a situation in the field image is a normal situation or an emergency situation, and includes a detection unit which detects a scene video as the emergency situation video, if the probability indicates that the situation in the scene video is the emergency situation.
abstract_ko: 비상 상황을 전파하기 위한 장치는 감시영상장치로부터 현장 영상을 수신하면, 학습된 가중치로 연결되는 복수의 계층을 포함하는 검출망을 통해 상기 현장 영상에 대해 복수의 계층 간 가중치가 적용되는 복수의 연산을 수행하여 현장 영상의 상황이 정상 상황인지 혹은 비상 상황인지 여부를 확률로 나타내는 출력값을 산출하고, 상기 확률이 현장 영상의 상황이 비상 상황임을 나타내면, 해당 현장 영상을 비상상황영상으로 검출하는 검출부를 포함한다.

title_en: Power system sequence recovery method and device based on deep reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system sequential recovery method and device based on deep reinforcement learning. Based on the electric power network after cascade failure, the recovery capability of the electric power network system to cascade failure in the system recovery process is evaluated through the bus recovery sequence obtained after deep reinforcement learning, reinforcement learning is combined with the electric power network, the recovery problem of the electric power network is considered in the angle of an defender, and the combination of the reinforcement learning and the neural network expands the realization range of the electric power network, so that the recovery optimal strategy of the large-scale electric network can be found.

title_en: Evaporation waveguide beyond-view-range emergency communication modeling method and system based on ray tracing
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of wireless communication networks, and provides an evaporative waveguide beyond-view-range emergency communication modeling and system based on ray tracing. The method comprises calculating vertical distribution of atmospheric thermodynamic temperature, atmospheric pressure and water vapor pressure, inverting evaporating waveguide parameters to obtain distribution of refractive index in vertical direction, tracking ray track according to the distribution of refractive index in vertical direction, comparing height of each ray at horizontal distance of receiving antenna with height of receiving antenna to obtain possible intrinsic rays meeting preset condition, determining whether possible intrinsic rays are intrinsic rays, screening the intrinsic rays to find several intrinsic rays with obviously different paths as exit angle The central ray of the ray tube calculates the maximum height difference of all rays in the ray tube at the horizontal distance of the receiving antenna to obtain the vertical cross section width of the ray tube, thereby calculating the propagation factor and the path loss of each intrinsic ray.

title_en: Water diversion serial cascade power station scheduling method based on real-time cooperative fault response model
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of optimal scheduling of hydropower stations and discloses a scheduling method of a diversion serial cascade power station based on a real-time collaborative fault response model, which aims to solve the problem that the stability of a power grid is affected in the existing scheduling scheme, and mainly comprises the steps of constructing an objective function and constraint conditions of planned load and actual output of the diversion serial cascade power station, and constructing a mixed quadratic programming model according to the objective function and the constraint conditions to obtain the real-time collaborative fault response model of the diversion serial cascade power station; and solving a real-time collaborative fault response model by utilizing a solver based on the boundary conditions to obtain the planned output of each generator set, and carrying out real-time scheduling on the diversion serial cascade power station according to the planned output of each generator set. The application improves the dispatching accuracy of the diversion cascade power station and the stability of the power grid.

title_en: Pollution tracing system and method based on drainage system water quality and water quantity monitoring analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pollution tracing system and a pollution tracing method based on drainage system water quality and water quantity monitoring analysis, which particularly relate to the technical field of water quality and water quantity monitoring, wherein water quality and water quantity parameters are collected in real time through a distributed sensor network, a denoising processing and anomaly detection algorithm are combined to ensure data quality, a multivariate dynamic analysis method and a space-time correlation model are utilized to identify anomaly change characteristics of pollutant concentration, a nonlinear superposition effect correction model is constructed to eliminate false peak interference at a junction, a real pollution source is positioned, a pollution propagation process is simulated based on a diffusion path and flow characteristics by combining a geographic information system and a drainage basin model, the geographical position of the pollution source is accurately determined, and finally, a tracing result is visually output to a user terminal to generate a pollution tracing report, scientific treatment advice and multi-level alarm signals are provided, and effective technical support is provided for pollution treatment and emergency response.

title_en: Repeater
title_ko: 환경 감시 기능이 통합된 재난 통신망 스마트 중계 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster communication network smart repeater in which an environmental monitoring function is integrated. More particularly, the present invention relates to a disaster communication network smart repeater in which an environmental monitoring function is integrated into an existing disaster communication network repeater. To this end, disclosed is a disaster communication network smart repeater in which an environmental monitoring function is integrated, which comprises: a plurality of disaster communication network repeaters which are connected to a base station or a user′s terminal to provide a communication network service, and are arranged at preset distances to quickly relay and propagate the situation in the event of a disaster; a plurality of sensor network modules which are connected to each other through a sensor network so as to be connected to each of the plurality of disaster communication network repeaters, and which detect disaster information and environmental information based on an installation location and transmit it to the connected disaster communication network repeater through the sensor network; and a first server connected to and connected to the plurality of disaster communication network repeaters to exchange the disaster information and environmental information.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 환경 감시 기능이 통합된 재난 통신망 스마트 중계기에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는 기존의 재난 통신망 중계기에 환경 감시 기능을 통합한 환경 감시 기능이 통합된 재난 통신망 스마트 중계기에 관한 것이다. 이를 위해 기지국 또는 사용자의 단말과 접속되어 통신망 서비스를 제공하며, 재난 발생시 상황을 신속히 주변에 중계 전파하도록 기 설정된 거리마다 배치되는 복수의 재난 통신망 중계기, 복수의 재난 통신망 중계기의 각각과 연결 접속되도록 센서 네트워크망으로 서로 연결 접속되며, 설치 위치에 기반한 재난정보 및 환경정보를 감지하여 접속된 재난 통신망 중계기에 센서 네트워크망을 통해 전송하는 복수의 센서 네트워크 모듈부, 복수의 재난 통신망 중계기와 서로 연결 접속되어 재난정보 및 환경정보를 주고받는 제1 서버를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 환경 감시 기능이 통합된 재난 통신망 스마트 중계기가 개시된다.

title_en: Direct current transmission simulation platform based on RTDS
abstract_en: An RTDS-based direct current transmission simulation platform, comprising: the system comprises an operator control layer, a field layer and an RTDS simulator; the operator control layer is connected with the control layer through an in-station local area network and transmits a control instruction to the control layer; the control layer is connected with the field layer and transmits the command of the switching action and the information of the switching state, the alternating current quantity and the direct current quantity to the field layer; the field layer is connected with the RTDS simulation layer, converts the optical signal of the RTDS simulation layer into an electric signal and sends the electric signal to the control layer; the RTDS simulator comprises a layered access simulation subsystem and a hybrid cascade simulation subsystem, and switching between the layered access simulation subsystem and the hybrid cascade simulation subsystem is realized by selecting DFTs in different engineering original files. The simulation platform reasonably distributes the functions of the pole control layer and the valve group layer of the control system, improves the expansibility of a control system device, achieves the purpose of being applied to a conventional direct current simulation system and a hybrid cascade simulation system, and saves the test research cost and the reconstruction cost.
assignees: XUJI GROUP CORP;XUJI ELECTRIC CO LTD

title_en: Ultra-short period wind power prediction method based on wind speed factor control model
abstract_en: The invention provides an ultra-short period wind power prediction method based on a wind speed factor control model. The ultra-short period wind power prediction method includes performing an ultra-short period prediction according to an ARIMA (autoregressive integrated moving average) model; performing the ultra-short period power prediction according to a BP (back propagation) neutral network model; completing the ultra-short period wind power prediction based on the wind speed factor control model. In this way, at the premise that the ARIMA model and the BP neutral network model are evaluated, the ARIMA model and the BP neutral network model can be switched according to the running environment, so that accuracy of the ultra-short wind power prediction is improved.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: A kind of water supply network cascade robustness measuring method of dynamic emergency recovery mechanism
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of water supply network cascade robustness measuring method of dynamic emergency recovery mechanism, including：Load the basic hydraulic information of water supply network and topological structure；Set tolerance parameter area and iteration incremental change；According to the maximum hydraulic pressure constraints of tolerance parameter calculate node；Calculate the dynamic emergency recovery mechanism water supply network cascade robustness of single node collapse；Iterate to calculate the dynamic emergency recovery mechanism water supply network cascade system robustness that all nodes in the range of initial crashed node collapse successively；The dynamic emergency recovery mechanism water supply network cascade system robustness evaluation matrix that all nodes collapse successively in iterative calculation tolerance parameter area；Optimal emergency policy is recognized, emergency policy trap queuing is provided.The present invention can combine water supply network entity stream attribute, it is considered to cascading failure and dynamic emergency policy, accurate to calculate emergency policy robustness, provide emergency policy priority ordered.

title_en: Water resource risk assessment method aiming at multiple risk sources of cascade reservoir group
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water resource risk assessment method aiming at multiple risk sources of a cascade reservoir group, which comprises the following steps: identifying the structural characteristics of a cascade reservoir group system of the water transfer project; identifying risk sources corresponding to the reservoirs of all units in the water diversion project respectively; constructing a nested Bayesian network risk assessment model of the water diversion project step reservoir group according to the structural characteristics and the risk source, and obtaining the risk level of the water diversion project water resource through model analysis; carrying out sensitivity analysis through a nested Bayesian network risk assessment model, finding out key factors of risks, and making remedial measures; the method comprises the steps of utilizing a model to analyze the overall risk level of the stepped reservoir group of the water diversion project after renovation, stopping analysis if the overall risk level reaches an acceptable risk level, and searching a new risk key factor for further analysis if the overall risk level does not reach an expected risk level until the acceptable risk level.

title_en: Fault propagation analysis method and system based on causal layered topology network model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of failure analysis of electromechanical equipment, and discloses a failure propagation analysis method and a system based on a causal hierarchical topology network model, so as to more accurately determine an actual failure hierarchical propagation path of a source failure node in a specific failure mode. The method comprises the following steps: according to the propagation relation of signals among all longitudinal nodes when the electromechanical equipment actually works, all the longitudinal nodes are connected through directed edges to form a topological network, the directed edges comprise transverse causal edges and longitudinal causal edges, and a fault propagation model based on a causal hierarchical topological network is established; and then, aiming at a specific fault mode, starting from fault disturbance borne by a bottom-layer element, calculating whether each potential directed edge can propagate the fault mode of the node due to the fault to the node due to the fault one by one, and obtaining a fault actual layered propagation path based on a fault propagation model of the causal layered topology network.
assignees: PEOPLE'S LIBERATION ARMY NATIONAL UNIVERSITY OF DEFENSE TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Method, device, equipment and medium for identifying weak link of power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, equipment and a medium for identifying weak links of an electric power system, wherein the method comprises the steps of establishing a basic operation model of the electric power system to obtain a planning scheme that a power grid meets all loads when lines are in a normal operation state; the accident tolerance of the planning scheme is verified by establishing a power system fault selection model; establishing an operation model of the power system for coping with the fault, and acquiring the load loss amount; and carrying out simulation analysis in a standard system, and outputting a weak link identification result of the power system. Firstly, establishing a basic operation model of the power system; establishing a power system fault selection model on the basis; and then establishing an operation model of the power system for coping with the fault, and finally carrying out system joint evolution calculation to verify the effectiveness and the practicability of the modeling method. The weak link in the power system is effectively identified by establishing a system planning model of cascading failures based on robust optimization and failure simulation ideas, and compared with the existing model, the calculation efficiency is improved.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECHNICAL RES INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID NINGXIA ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG

title_en: Intelligent maintenance method and system for rail transit based on adaptive control
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent maintenance method and system for rail transit based on adaptive control, which comprises a camera detection unit, an ultrasonic flaw detection unit, an impact detection unit and a prediction model unit, wherein in the prediction model unit, a first kalman filtering estimation value is calculated in the back propagation process of an RNN (radio network) model; the second Kalman filtering estimation value is calculated in the back propagation process of the LSTM network model; meanwhile, the weight of the fusion layer is updated in a self-adaptive mode through a second kalman filtering estimation value, and the updated fusion estimation risk factor is obtained.
assignees: NANJING METRO OPERATION CONSULTING TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Economic dispatching method for cascade hydropower, photovoltaic and full-power variable-speed pumped storage
abstract_en: The invention discloses an economic dispatching method for cascade hydropower, photovoltaic and full-power variable-speed pumped storage, which is used for carrying out economic dispatching and optimal allocation among the cascade hydropower, photovoltaic and full-power variable-speed pumped storage according to the running state, water supply mode and running state of each unit; the method is based on a combined operation system consisting of step hydropower, photovoltaic and full-power variable-speed pumped storage, wherein the step hydropower, photovoltaic and full-power variable-speed pumped storage units are all converged in the same transformer substation; according to the cascade hydropower, photovoltaic and full-power variable-speed pumped storage combined operation system, the system is connected into an alternating current power grid in a region after converging, and according to the operation condition of a circuit connected with the cascade hydropower and photovoltaic combined operation system and the alternating current power grid, a grid-connected state and a grid-off state are set; the cascade water and light accumulation combined operation system is provided with three water supply modes, including a water-rising mode, a water leveling mode and a water-withering mode. The method has the advantages of reducing the operation cost and improving the economic benefit.
assignees: POWERCHINA HYDROPOWER DEV GROUP CO LTD;SICHUAN XIAOJINCHUAN HYDROPOWER DEV CO LTD

title_en: Construction method of industrial brain system for industrial chain
abstract_en: The invention provides a construction method of an industrial brain system for an industrial chain, which comprises the steps of constructing the industrial brain system based on an autonomous cognition thinking atlas functional module, an autonomous interactive decision functional module and a dynamic behavior active regulation functional module, wherein the autonomous cognition thinking atlas functional module is used for autonomously executing sensing, cognition, decision and regulation tasks on various situations of ductile seepage phase transition of an industrial chain supply chain network, the autonomous cognition thinking atlas functional module is used for real-time sensing, measurement, cognition and storage of the ductile seepage phase transition of the industrial chain supply chain network, the autonomous interactive decision functional module is used for ductile situation identification, event accurate positioning and situation comprehensive research and judgment of all elements, and the dynamic behavior regulation module is used for regulating the vulnerability and risk propagation dynamic behavior of the industrial chain supply chain network according to a generated decision scheme. Thus, various situations of the ductile seepage phase transition of the complex giant chain network are accurately identified, measured, predicted in disaster and actively regulated and controlled in behavior.

title_en: Integrated disinfection monitoring management system based on quantitative risk assessment
abstract_en: The invention provides an integrated disinfection monitoring management system based on quantitative risk assessment, and belongs to the technical field of disinfection monitoring. The environment and behavior parameter collection module is used for constructing a first data set, a second data set and a third data set, constructing a prediction risk model by utilizing a convolutional neural network, respectively constructing an ith regional environment bacteria breeding coefficient, a bacteria propagation coefficient and a behavior breeding bacterial coefficient based on the first data set, the second data set and the third data set, combining the ith regional environment bacteria breeding coefficient and the behavior breeding bacterial coefficient, constructing a comprehensive disinfection behavior coefficient, and evaluating to generate a corresponding strategy. The bacteria in the station are monitored through multidimensional linkage, and a proper disinfection scheme is adopted according to the bacteria breeding degree.
assignees: THE SECOND AFFILIATED HOSPITAL ARMY MEDICAL UNIV OF PLA

title_en: Whole-process standardized closed-loop safety control method and system for power enterprises
abstract_en: The invention discloses a whole-process standardized closed-loop safety control method and system for an electric power enterprise, which relate to the technical field of safety control for the electric power enterprise and comprise the steps of acquiring image characteristics and sensor characteristics in real time based on multi-source heterogeneous data and executing unified coding. And constructing a working and equipment node diagram based on the synchronous time sequence, and modeling hidden danger trend by adopting a space-time neural network. And triggering preventive intervention based on the classified classification of the hidden danger prediction results, and updating data backflow after the intervention is completed. The method establishes the dynamic evolution risk prediction capability, so that a safety management and control system can identify potential high-risk nodes and key propagation paths in advance, and the prospective and systematicness of hidden danger prevention and control are remarkably improved. The safety control mechanism of the power enterprise with dynamic optimization and standardized closed loop in the whole process is formed, the continuous evolution of four integration of hidden danger identification, intervention, feedback and optimization is realized, and the stability, the intelligence and the reliability of the system under a complex operation environment are greatly improved.

title_en: Intelligent weather risk early warning system for mining industry
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mining safety management, in particular to a mining-oriented weather risk intelligent early warning system which comprises the steps of acquiring multi-source heterogeneous data such as mining area weather, geology and the like in real time by constructing a mining area multi-field coupling monitoring network, providing rich and accurate data bases for subsequent risk analysis, dynamically synthesizing mining area sceneries of weather threat factors by combining mining scene metadata and time sequence features through condition antagonism, accurately capturing weather risk features under different mining scenes, and helping a manager to quickly know mining area risk conditions by establishing a geologic body-weather field coupling risk propagation topological graph and generating a regional risk potential energy thermodynamic diagram, identifying medium and high risk areas by spatial clustering analysis, generating scene self-adaptive regulation and control instructions, improving pertinence and effectiveness of emergency response, and being beneficial to quickly controlling risks and reducing losses.

title_en: Agricultural full-industry chain tracing method and system based on big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for tracing an agricultural full-industry chain based on big data, which relate to the technical field of agricultural tracing and comprise the steps of constructing a static knowledge graph in a graph database based on a full-chain data set, setting and initializing nodes, edges and initial weights, predicting environmental changes through an LSTM model, dynamically adjusting the nodes and the edge weights through reinforcement learning, generating a dynamically updated knowledge graph, constructing a multi-factor risk conduction matrix according to the dynamically updated knowledge graph, defining an initial risk propagation path, integrating the full-chain data set through a Bayesian network model, calculating the conditional probability of the initial risk propagation path, generating an optimized risk propagation path, and predicting the risk probability through the optimized risk propagation path by using a random forest model.

title_en: Subway freight network operation robustness evaluation method based on cascade failure
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of underground transportation, and particularly relates to a subway freight network operation robustness evaluation method based on cascade failure. The method comprises the steps of establishing a subway freight network cascade failure redistribution policy, constructing a subway freight network cascade failure load redistribution model, constructing a subway freight network robustness assessment index, combining the established subway freight network cascade failure redistribution policy, the constructed cascade failure load redistribution model and a proposed robustness assessment index system, designing an assessment algorithm for the robustness of the subway freight network, and realizing quantitative assessment of the operation robustness of the network under the cascade failure situation. The invention can provide scientific basis for planning and operation management of the subway freight system, and effectively improve the reliability and safety of the urban comprehensive transportation system.

title_en: Grid division-based power distribution network information physical system risk analysis method, system, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a grid division-based power distribution network information physical system risk analysis method, a grid division-based power distribution network information physical system risk analysis system, a grid division-based power distribution network information physical system risk analysis device and a grid division-based power distribution network information physical system risk analysis storage medium, and relates to the field of power system risk analysis, wherein the method comprises the steps of analyzing power distribution network related data, establishing a multi-source data space-time corresponding relation, and dividing operation data of a power distribution network physical system and an information system into unit grids and grid groups; the method comprises the steps of searching potential faults to generate a fault event set, carrying out batch simulation on the fault event based on a multi-thread programming framework by adopting a grid group parallel computing technology, quantifying load loss under different faults and generating load loss data, calculating feeder risk coefficients and system risk coefficients based on the load loss data and the introduced defense resource parameters, and quantitatively analyzing risk propagation paths.

title_en: Ship emergency situation alarm system and method using hull communication
title_ko: 선체 매질 통신을 이용한 선박 비상상황 알람 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are a system and a method for providing a ship emergency situation alarm using hull communication which can quickly monitor various accidents. According to an aspect of the present invention, the system for providing a ship emergency situation alarm using hull communication comprises: a sensor-type safety helmet which is worn by a hull worker, and senses an emergency situation in a hull to output a signal; an emergency situation receiving unit to receive the signal outputted from the sensor-type safety helmet through the hull as a medium; and an emergency situation transmitting unit which is connected to the emergency situation receiving unit via a wired/wireless network, uses a signal transmitted from the emergency situation receiving unit to determine whether an emergency situation occurs, and distributes alarm information when an emergency situation occurs.
abstract_ko:
선체 매질 통신을 이용한 선박 비상상황 알람 시스템 및 방법에 관하여 개시한다.  
본 발명의 일 측면에 따르면, 선체 작업자가 착용하며 선체 내 비상상황을 감지하여 신호를 출력하는 센서형 안전모; 상기 센서형 안전모로부터 출력된 신호를 선체를 매질로 하여 전송 받는 비상상황 수신부; 및 상기 비상상황 수신부와 유무선 네트워크를 통해 연결되며, 상기 비상상황 수신부로부터 전송된 신호를 이용하여 비상상황 유무를 판단하고 비상상황 발생 시 알람 정보를 전파하는 비상상황 전파부를 포함하는 선체 매질 통신을 이용한 선박 비상상황 알람 시스템을 제공한다.

title_en: Disaster roaming method, apparatus and system
abstract_en: Provided in the embodiments of the present application are a disaster roaming method, apparatus and system. By means of the present application, service interruptions of a user equipment can be reduced, and the service interruptions can be minimized, thereby improving the user experience. Specifically, a user equipment determines a first PLMN according to stored information of a disaster roaming public land mobile network (PLMN), the information of the disaster roaming PLMN comprising identification information of at least one PLMN that allows disaster roaming performed by the user equipment, and the first PLMN being a PLMN among the at least one PLMN; the user equipment sends a registration request message to the first PLMN, the registration request message comprising disaster roaming indication information which is used for indicating that the user equipment requests disaster roaming registration; and the user equipment receives a registration acceptance message sent by the first PLMN.

title_en: Method of propagating information on power grid energy flows, device, and machine-readable instruction code
abstract_en: To make information on an energy flow composition available for an electric power system (40), devices (31-36) of a communication system (30) exchange data specifying the energy flow composition. The devices (31-36) are operative to exchange the data by means of a message exchange that generally follows the energy flow paths in a power grid (10) of the electric power system (40).

title_en: Cascade hydropower station short-term multi-objective optimization scheduling method considering peak shaving requirements
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of hydropower dispatching operation, and relates to a short-term multi-objective optimization dispatching method for a cascade hydropower station in consideration of peak shaving requirements. Aiming at adjusting the peak load of a power grid and improving the hydroelectric generation efficiency, considering both the complex operation requirement of the cascade hydropower station and the constraint of a unit vibration region, constructing a multi-target short-term optimization scheduling model of the cascade hydropower station by using mixed integer nonlinear programming, solving the model by using an improved normalization method plane constraint method, and obtaining a Pareto solution set containing a plurality of non-inferior solution schemes to provide powerful support for the final decision of a scheduling staff; in addition, the invention also uses a membership value calculation method based on fuzzy evaluation to evaluate each solution in the solution set, and selects a decision proposal scheme for the reference of dispatchers. The invention starts from the practical situation of short-term optimal dispatching of hydropower station, comprehensively considers the complex power generation operation constraint of the power station, gives consideration to the comprehensive operation benefits in multiple aspects, and meets the complex dispatching operation requirement of the cascade hydropower station.

title_en: Computer-implemented method, computer-readable storage medium, and computer system for providing technical selection parameters for energy supply systems
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a computer-implemented method of providing technical selection parameters for an energy supply system providing electrical energy to a facility connected to a public power grid that may experience service interruption, comprising the steps of: inputting a power consumption schedule of the facility (S1); inputting a photovoltaic production capacity limit and an energy storage unit capacity limit (S9); estimating a ratio of self-sufficient or self-consuming or internal profitability (S11); displaying a plurality of energy supply system configurations on the user interface device (S13); wherein each configuration is associated to a sensitivity parameter allowing to determine an optimized technical choice parameter of the energy supply system with respect to the reliability of the public power grid. The invention also relates to a computer readable storage medium having stored therein instructions intended to be executed on a computer system for implementing the computer implemented method.

title_en: Dynamics-based synchronous cross information propagation analysis method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a synchronous cross information propagation analysis method and a system based on dynamics, which comprises the following steps: dividing the state of a network user into three user states of a susceptible state, a forwarding state and an immune state; constructing a cross information synchronous propagation dynamic model of the user changing between different user states along with the propagation of the two pieces of information; collecting two pieces of information of which the release time interval is smaller than a set value, dividing the user states of network users of the two pieces of information, inputting a plurality of user states of the two pieces of divided information into a cross information synchronous propagation dynamic model, and predicting the total number of individuals of different crowds changing along with time. The above method and system consider the interaction between two pieces of information.

title_en: Two-step ring-opening planning method and system for receiving end alternating current electromagnetic ring network containing direct current feed
abstract_en: The invention provides a two-step ring-opening planning method for a receiving-end alternating-current electromagnetic ring network with direct-current feed, which carries out priority sorting on optimization targets according to importance differences to form a two-step optimization framework. The first step aims at the 'direct current cascading failure avoidance' target with obviously stronger importance and priority, and the second step aims at other loop-opening targets by taking the result generated in the first step as a constraint condition. The method can be used for electromagnetic ring network ring opening planning of an alternating current-direct current hybrid power grid, comprehensively considers the ring opening requirement of a new electromagnetic ring network related to direct current, and achieves the aims of avoiding direct current cascading failure, controlling short-circuit current level, tide, load balancing and the like.

title_en: Subsynchronous oscillation monitoring device point distribution method, device and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device and a medium for distributing subsynchronous oscillation monitoring devices, and belongs to the technical field of electric power systems and automation thereof. In order to effectively inhibit the diffusion of oscillation, a subsynchronous oscillation monitoring device needs to be configured in the power grid. According to the invention, new energy grid connection points with low grid connection short circuit are obtained through off-line calculation based on the power grid mode data, secondary and supercurrent components are respectively injected into the side of each station to the power grid, and the subsynchronous oscillation propagation characteristics in the power grid are obtained, so that key nodes which are strongly related to the subsynchronous oscillation in the power grid are identified, and a monitoring device is configured. The invention comprehensively considers the local weak node of new energy grid connection and subsynchronous oscillation propagation characteristics, provides a point distribution scheme of the oscillation monitoring device, and ensures the capability of the power grid to cope with subsynchronous oscillation risks while taking the economical efficiency of the monitoring system into consideration.

title_en: TimesNet-Crossformer-LSTM-based short-term power load prediction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a short-term power load prediction method based on TimesNet-Crossformer-LSTM, which comprises the steps of 1) screening features of an imported data set, normalizing selected features, 2) dividing a training set, a verification set and a test set, inputting the training set and the verification set into a model for training, 3) extracting information from an input time sequence by the model, extracting a relation between a period and a period in the time sequence, 4) adjusting parameters of a neural network by adopting an Adam algorithm, training the network by utilizing back propagation, evaluating training effects of model parameters by observing loss values on the verification set, 5) selecting tanshark as an activation function of the model according to an ablation experiment result, 6) inputting the test set into the trained model, obtaining a point prediction result, and evaluating the model prediction effect by four evaluation indexes. Compared with the prior art, the method has higher precision in the short-term power load prediction task.

title_en: Urban illumination control integration gateway system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of urban illumination control, and provides an urban illumination control fusion gateway system which comprises a multi-mode sensing network module, a causal reasoning diagnosis module, a survivability topology reconstruction module, a physiological adaptation dimming module and a disaster chain blocking module. The multi-mode sensing network module collects structural displacement, environmental data and weather forecast of the lighting facility through the unmanned plane, the ground nodes and the weather radar. The causal reasoning diagnosis module analyzes the aging reasons of the facilities through causal graph modeling. The survivability topology reconstruction module optimizes the power supply network topology. The physiological adaptive dimming module generates a color temperature-brightness parameter according to the people stream and the atmospheric optical characteristics. The disaster chain blocking module identifies disaster propagation nodes and triggers reinforcement instructions. The invention can improve the reliability, energy conservation and safety of the lighting system and optimize the comfort and emergency response capability of urban environment.

title_en: Information fusion operation and maintenance system between zero carbon park industries
abstract_en: The invention discloses an information fusion operation and maintenance system between industries of a zero carbon park, in particular to the technical field of dynamic control of carbon emission, which is used for solving the problem of carbon accounting distortion caused by state deviation of an existing static carbon emission model and a physical system; an initial carbon bank model containing energy efficiency reference parameters is established through a design stage, an operation boundary characteristic spectrum is obtained through multi-working-condition dynamic calibration in a construction stage, thermodynamic tracks are synchronously collected, topological fragile nodes are identified based on Lyapunov exponent stability analysis and optical flow method thermal gradient analysis, a carbon bank cascade conduction effect is quantized by combining an equipment energy topological network, a dynamic carbon bank model correction instruction is generated to update energy efficiency parameters, and finally double-instruction cooperative management and control is executed in an operation and maintenance stage, so that full-period carbon data flow closed loop is realized, and the effect of continuously reducing carbon bank intensity in a park is achieved through multi-source information fusion and conduction chain modeling.

title_en: Node electricity price joint probability prediction method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power system electricity price prediction and discloses a node electricity price joint probability prediction method which comprises the steps of constructing a dual-state monitoring system, simultaneously tracking physical states and market fluidity indexes of a power grid to generate physical constraint state vectors and market fluidity state vectors, designing critical early warning indexes through nonlinear combination of physical constraint degrees and fluidity levels, introducing a state space mapping algorithm to divide a physical fluidity state space into a stable region, a metastable region and a critical region, constructing refined representation of a system state, tracking physical constraint changes to influence market fluidity by influencing behaviors of market participants based on a propagation mechanism model of a directed causal graph, and modeling extreme price distribution by applying condition extremum theory aiming at the identified critical state.

title_en: Low-altitude economy oriented vertical take-off and landing facility unmanned aerial vehicle image location method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a low-altitude economy oriented image location method and system for a vertical take-off and landing facility unmanned aerial vehicle, and belongs to the technical field of image data processing and modeling. According to the method, oblique photogrammetry and laser radar scanning are carried out on a building roof through an unmanned plane to obtain high-overlapping-rate image and laser point cloud data, a live-action three-dimensional grid model and an obstacle surface three-dimensional model are constructed after pretreatment, a preliminary layout scheme is screened according to the clearance height of a roof available area based on the model, then airspace safety simulation and noise propagation simulation are carried out on each scheme, a minimum interval distance and noise intensity distribution diagram is calculated, and a final site selection scheme is screened according to airspace safety and noise constraint. The invention realizes the automation and the accurate site selection of the vertical take-off and landing facilities in the complex roof environment.

title_en: Method for detecting smoke or fire by using infra-red laser in a wide space
title_ko: 광역 화재감지를 위한 적외선 레이저 연기 검출 방법
abstract_en: The present invention suggests a method of detecting smoke to detect a fire in a wide area including a tunnel and an airport etc. using infrared ray and visible ray laser. A system which forms the method of detecting smoke comprises; an infrared ray laser transmission and reception device; a visible ray laser which facilitates the infrared ray laser transmission and reception matching at long range; and a Zigbee wireless communication network which spreads a fire alarm. If smoke is generated between an infrared ray laser transmission device and an infrared ray laser reception device, that the size of a reception signal becomes smaller than a standard value is checked and the smoke is detected. If the infrared ray laser transmission device is a long way from the infrared ray laser reception device, it is difficult to match a signal because a fairly great change is formed in a reception side with a small change of a transmission side. The present invention suggests a method which uses infrared ray laser to detect wide area smoke and uses a visible ray for the effective matching. The present invention developed a smoke detection system which transfers an alarm though the Zigbee wireless network when smoke is detected.
abstract_ko:
본 발명에서는 적외선과 가시광선 레이저를 이용하여 터널, 공항 등의 넓은 공간에서의 화재를 감지하기 위하여 연기검출 방법을 제안한다.  
본 발명에서 제안하는 연기검출 방법을 구현하는 시스템은 적외선 레이저 송수신기와, 원거리에서 적외선 레이저 송수신 정합을 편리하게 하기 위한 가시광선 레이저, 그리고 화재 경보를 전파하기 위한 Zigbee 무선통신 네트워크로 구성된다. 
적외선 레이저 송신기와 수신기 사이에 연기가 발생하면 수신 신호의 크기가 기준값보다 작아지기는 것을 확인하고 연기를 검출한다.  
적외선 레이저 송신기와 수신기 사이의 거리가 먼 경우에는 송신 측의 작은 변화에도 수신측에서는 상당히 큰 변이가 생겨 신호를 정합하는데 어려움이 있다. 
본 발명에서는 광역 연기 검출을 위하여 적외선 레이저를 이용하고 효율적인 정합을 위하여 가시광선을 이용하는 방법을 제안하며, 연기가 감지되면 Zigbee 무선네트워크를 통하여 경보를 전달하는 연기검출 시스템을 개발하였다.

title_en: Method for predicating short-period output power of photovoltaic power generation based on BP (Back Propagation) neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for predicating the short-period output power of photovoltaic power generation based on a BP (Back Propagation) neural network. According to the method, the BP neural network is adopted for predicating the output power of a photovoltaic power generation system, and the influence of weather factors on the output power of the photovoltaic power generation system is subjected to statistical analysis. The method comprises the following steps of firstly mapping weather types as day types used as the input data of the BP neural network, and utilizing power generation power during each time period of a prediction day as output data; then determining the quantity of hidden layer nodes through formula calculation and repeated cut-and-try operations according to the quantity of input and output units; performing normalization treatment on the input data, performing reverse normalization treatment on the output data, and training the BP neural network by utilizing the treated operating data; and finally predicating the power generation power of the predication day by utilizing a trained model, thereby obtaining the predication result. The data processing method and a prediction model can be used for effectively predicating the short-period output power in photovoltaic power generation under multiple weather types.

title_en: Ultra-high-voltage AC/DC hybrid grid stability analysis method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultra-high-voltage AC/DC hybrid grid stability analysis method based on risk assessment in the technical field of electric power system reliability. The method, on the basis of reasonably setting system fault and carrying out analog simulation, introduces risk assessment indexes, comprising important components of low-voltage risk, power angle difference risk and frequency instability risk and the like. The method is characterized by, after determining a component outage model, selecting system failure states and calculating probability thereof; carrying out simulated assessment on the consequence of each selected state; and finally, calculating risk indexes and analyzing stability of a power grid. Compared with a conventional power grid stability analysis method, the method combines the accident occurring probability and the consequence of each index loss and combines risk and benefit, and quantitatively reflects system safety indexes, so that the method is more suitable for stability analysis of a complex hybrid grid when having cascading failure or large-area blackout.
assignees: STATE GRID INNER MONGOLIA EASTERN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ECONOMIC AND TECH RES INST;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Cascading failure evolution path tracing and predicting method and device based on knowledge graph
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascading failure evolution path tracing and predicting method and device based on a knowledge graph, which can be applied to an alternating current-direct current power grid cascading failure risk assessment and early warning system. The method extracts key characteristic quantities by combining a physical mechanism and a correlation analysis method, automatically learns and judges the incidence relation between characteristic events through a machine learning algorithm, realizes the matching and judgment of the upper and lower incidence relation of the characteristic events by constructing a knowledge graph of two levels, judges the result and the time sequence characteristics according to the incidence relation of the characteristic events, and identifies the cascading failure evolution path based on a depth-first search strategy. The method introduces an intelligent learning and analyzing engine to replace thinking and judgment of scheduling personnel, and provides effective technical support for tracing and prejudging the complex cascading failure.

title_en: Method and system for analyzing influence of social network community structure on information propagation
abstract_en: The invention provides an analysis method and a system for the influence of a social network community structure on information propagation, wherein the analysis method is based on a zero model and comprises the following steps: constructing an information transmission tree; applying an information propagation tree zero model to generate an information propagation tree randomized copy; respectively realizing community discovery of the information dissemination tree and the information dissemination tree randomized copies; the expansion importance profile measures communities of the information propagation tree and the information propagation tree randomized copies, and further analysis of community structures on information propagation influence is achieved. According to the technical scheme, the propagation of specific information in the online social network is taken as a research object, and the role of the community in information propagation is explored.

title_en: Three gorges reservoir dam front drift prediction method based on improved neural network model
abstract_en: The invention relates to a three gorges reservoir dam front floating quantity prediction method based on an improved neural network model, which comprises the following steps: collecting three gorges reservoir entering flow, exiting flow and dam front floating amount data and dividing training and testing sets; setting a particle swarm algorithm and improved neural network structures and parameters; training the improved neural network by using a training set, and optimizing and solving the weight and the threshold of the improved neural network by using an improved particle swarm algorithm in the training; calculating a prediction error and judging whether the prediction error is qualified or not; the trained improved neural network is used for real-time prediction of the forward drift of the three gorges reservoir dam. According to the invention, after the training process of the error counter propagation neural network is optimized and improved by utilizing the particle swarm algorithm, the improved error counter propagation neural network is used as a front drift amount prediction model of the three gorges reservoir dam, so that the connection weight of the prediction model is more approximate to an optimal ideal value, and the prediction precision of the drift amount and the adaptability to the uncertainty of the data information of the reservoir dam are improved.

title_en: Analysis method and system for power grid data
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for analyzing power grid data, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring power system data of a plurality of time sections of the power grid to be analyzed according to the constructed bus branch model, the set combination model and the safety constraint combination model; and carrying out safety analysis on the power system data of the plurality of time sections by using parallel graph tide calculation and LU decomposition technology to obtain an analysis result of the power grid to be analyzed. By implementing the method and the device, the problem of low accuracy of analysis of the power grid data in the prior art can be solved, so that when power grid dispatching is performed, dispatching actions are more targeted and timely, and early or late dispatching actions are avoided; the parallel graph tide calculation and LU decomposition technology are adopted, so that the method has higher calculation speed and calculation efficiency and better numerical stability when facing a large-scale matrix, and reduces the propagation of numerical errors.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Thermal management method of Ka frequency band microstrip waveguide conversion and power synthesis device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a thermal management method of a Ka frequency band microstrip waveguide conversion and power synthesis device, which relates to the technical field of thermal management, and comprises the following steps: performing digital modeling to generate a power simulation model; collecting a waveguide synthesis test sample of the target integrated device; inputting the waveguide synthesis test sample into a power simulation model for power density test to generate a power density distribution network; performing temperature propagation analysis based on the power density distribution network to generate a temperature distribution network; generating an optimal fluid channel network; thermal management control is performed based on the optimal fluid channel network. The technical problems that the existing Ka frequency band microstrip waveguide conversion and power synthesis device is difficult to accurately simulate the power distribution and heat generation conditions of the microstrip-waveguide conversion and power synthesis device under high-frequency and high-power conditions, and further heat dissipation requirements cannot be met are solved, the stability and service life of the device are poor, and the technical effects of improving the heat dissipation efficiency and stability of the device are achieved.
assignees: HEBEI LINGKUN ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Virtual power plant emergency control method for flexible resources in disaster by considering multi-energy coupling
abstract_en: The emergency control method of the virtual power plant of the flexible resources in the disaster which considers the multi-energy coupling considers the lowest voltage and power fluctuation after the power grid topology reconstruction and the flexible resources aggregation and the optimal overall index of the toughness-oriented scene in the pre-disaster stage, models and evaluates the toughness of the electric-gas multi-energy coupling system after the optimal aggregation of the flexible resources, and then performs emergency control operation on the virtual power plant of the flexible resources by considering the electric-gas coupling cascade fault caused by disaster diffusion. The invention can form a tie line switch action scheme and a flexible resource aggregate forming scheme with compact electrical structure and flexible resource in the pre-disaster stage, and considers the flexible resource virtual power plant emergency scheduling model in the disaster with multi-energy coupling, thereby improving the toughness of the system while reducing the total operation cost.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Power load prediction model establishment method based on convolution two-way long-short-term memory network and attention mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power load prediction model building method based on a convolution two-way long-short-term memory network and an attention mechanism, which is characterized in that a one-dimensional convolution network is used for fully extracting characteristics of original complex power load data, and the characteristics of factors influencing load, the trend, periodicity, randomness and the like of load change can be more fully mastered by considering multi-element characteristics, and compared with the traditional LSTM, the two-way structure of BiLSTM can more comprehensively capture the two-way dependency relationship in load sequence data through forward propagation and backward propagation, so that the understanding of the model on the data is improved. In addition, the invention applies the attention mechanism widely applied in the natural language processing field to the research of multi-element short-term power load prediction, and the attention mechanism can focus on key information in a load sequence to further improve the prediction precision, and experiments are carried out on a real multi-element load data set, so that the precision of multi-element short-term load prediction can be effectively improved by adding a one-dimensional convolution network and the attention mechanism.

title_en: Improved DBSCAN abnormal node identification method based on space-time fusion characteristics
abstract_en: The invention discloses an improved DBSCAN abnormal node identification method based on space-time fusion characteristics in the technical field of power systems, which comprises the steps of constructing a distribution area adjacent matrix, extracting five spatial topological characteristics such as node approximate centrality, intermediate centrality and hierarchical depth, combining 16 time sequence characteristics such as voltage fluctuation index, current peak-valley difference and power integral to form space-time dual characteristic representation, adopting Principal Component Analysis (PCA) to perform dimension reduction treatment on the fusion characteristics, and reserving variance information of more than 90% to reduce calculation complexity. According to the method, the propagation rule of electricity stealing disturbance in a power grid is effectively described through space-time feature fusion, the problem of dimension disaster is solved through PCA dimension reduction, the adaptation of DBSCAN to complex topological scenes is improved through dynamic parameter optimization, the false detection rate is reduced by more than 50% compared with that of the traditional detection technology, the calculation efficiency is improved by 80%, and the method can be widely applied to the fields of electricity stealing screening, abnormal electricity behavior monitoring and the like of high-loss areas and provides technical support for the safe operation of an electric power system.

title_en: Knowledge graph-based multi-scale safety monitoring method for power grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid multi-scale safety monitoring method and system based on a knowledge graph, and belongs to the technical field of operation and control of power systems. The method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source heterogeneous data of a power grid to construct a heterogeneous time sequence knowledge graph, calculating real-time Risk Propagation Indexes (RPIs) of nodes according to the current running state of the power grid, dynamically generating a self-adaptive multi-scale graph hierarchical structure based on the RPIs, performing state-aware space-time feature learning on each hierarchy to generate hierarchical state embedding, performing cross-scale causal inference on an embedded input prediction model to predict a future safety event sequence and a propagation path of the future safety event sequence, and finally generating a safety situation assessment report and a preventive control strategy. The method solves the problems of single analysis scale and solidification of a hierarchical structure in the prior art, realizes active and accurate prediction of the security situation of the power grid through a risk-driven dynamic multi-scale analysis framework, and remarkably improves the prediction and defending capacity of cascading failures.

title_en: Dynamic prediction and analysis method and system for water supply network node pressure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for dynamically predicting and analyzing the pressure of a node of a water supply network, which relate to the technical field of intelligent monitoring of the water supply network and comprise the steps of obtaining topological structure data, historical pressure and flow time sequence data of the water supply network, and generating a pressure flow characteristic matrix through multidimensional analysis; the method comprises the steps of carrying out time sequence dimension reduction on a feature matrix, extracting time dimension features to construct an optimized feature vector, inputting the optimized feature vector into a variable structure depth neural network for training to obtain a pressure prediction model, analyzing the feature matrix to identify peak time, dividing the feature vector in the peak time, constructing a pressure propagation space topological graph based on the feature vector in the peak time, calculating the relevance of pressure propagation time delay to generate a correction coefficient, inputting the feature vector into the prediction model to obtain an initial prediction value, and combining the correction coefficient and topological structure data to generate a dynamic pressure prediction result. The invention improves the accuracy of the pressure prediction of the water supply network.
assignees: NORTH CHINA MUNICIPAL ENGINEERING DESIGN & RESEARCH INST CO LTD

title_en: Methods and systems for forecasting estimated time of restoration during service interruption
abstract_en: Machine learning may be used to forecast an estimated time of restoration (ETR) during a service interruption. To forecast an ETR, the collection of information from the multiple sources may be provided as inputs to a machine learning model, such as a deep long-short term memory recurrent neural network, a predictive model, and/or the like. The machine learning model may be trained to optimize the temporal cost function of sustained service interruptions and forecast ETRs for service interruptions (in minutes). The machine learning model may process data/information in real-time and provide an ETR when inputs are not yet available in the repair/resolution process, and update (reforecast) the ETR in real-time as the inputs late become available.

title_en: Online determination system and method for optimal operation mode of heat pump cascade heat supply unit
abstract_en: The invention discloses an on-line determining system and a method for the optimal operation mode of a heat pump cascade heat supply unit, which adopt field operation data, take the lowest coal consumption under the conditions of fixed heat supply load and power supply load as an optimization objective function, adopt a univariate comparison method, sequentially adjust the operation backpressure of the unit and the steam pressure of middle-exhaust steam extraction to a heat pump, compare the standard coal consumption of the unit with a reference working condition, and if the standard coal consumption of the unit is greater than the reference working condition, the original reference working condition is still used as the reference working condition; if the parameter is smaller than the preset reference value, the operation working condition corresponding to the parameter is used as a new comparison reference working condition, the operation back pressure of the unit and the steam pressure of the middle-exhaust steam extraction to the heat pump are continuously adjusted, and next iteration optimization is carried out. The method takes the lowest standard coal consumption as a target function on the premise of meeting the dispatching of the power grid and the heat supply network, obtains the optimal control values of the running back pressure and the middle exhaust steam extraction pressure of the heat pump cascade heat supply unit under boundary conditions of different heat supply loads, power supply loads, return water temperatures and the like on line, and realizes the lowest running cost and the maximum profitability.

title_en: Training method and device for space-time perception building equipment operation risk identification model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of risk identification, in particular to a training method and a training device for a space-time perceived building equipment operation risk identification model, comprising the steps of carrying out different behavioral pattern cluster analysis on extracted building equipment state space-time perceived characteristics, and calculating the similarity between a low-frequency behavioral cluster and a high-frequency behavioral cluster to obtain a risk cluster similarity matrix so as to determine a risk space-time comprehensive weight; and constructing a device risk propagation network by traversing nodes in the space-time perception graph neural network, and training a risk identification model according to the space-time perception characteristics of the building device state and the device risk propagation network to obtain a building device operation risk identification model. According to the invention, the time-space sensing characteristics of the state of the building equipment and cluster information obtained by cluster analysis are fused, so that the risk identification model not only can learn the time-space dynamic characteristics of the operation of the equipment more comprehensively, but also can analyze the performance of the characteristics under different behavioral modes, and the identification accuracy of the operation risk of the building equipment is improved.

title_en: Information propagation prediction method, system and medium
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of network information processing, and discloses an information propagation prediction method, an information propagation prediction system and a medium. The prediction method comprises the steps of constructing entity attributes and state variables according to topic propagation data in a social network, respectively constructing corresponding differential propagation dynamics equations and cellular automata based on the entity attributes and the state variables, analyzing stability and parameter sensitivity of a propagation state vector field according to the propagation dynamics equations, and analyzing propagation network structures and entity differences through cellular automata simulation. The invention solves the challenges in the traditional information propagation dynamics simulation, namely, realizes the stability analysis of the propagation state of the macroscopic population and the differential analysis of the propagation capacity of the microscopic entity while ensuring the grasping of the propagation trend of the macroscopic level and the effective mapping of the individual propagation behavior characteristics of the microscopic level, and provides a reliable tool for accurately analyzing the evolution trend of the information propagation.

title_en: System and method for dynamic deployable wireless services
abstract_en: A system and method for intelligently and dynamically deploying a plurality of mobile robotic machines capable of carrying out a complex series of actions automatically to propagate wireless network connectivity comprising, at least, a mechanical framework, sensors, actuators, communications capability, an energy source, a propulsion means, a control mechanism, and a payload. The payload may comprise electronic or mechanical communication equipment to propagate services such as wireless networking services, in for example, a first responder or emergency environment, or electronic and mechanical jamming services in a military or anti-terrorism environment.

title_en: A kind of Multifunctional security equipment based on 4G network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of Multifunctional security equipment based on 4G network, this equipment includes: double-core CPU, also including formaldehyde sensor, Temperature Humidity Sensor, Infrared Remote-Control Sending diode, gas security, cigarette propagated sensation sensor, power management module, photoconductive resistance, battery, mike, voice recognition unit, loudspeaker, communication module, photographic head, WIFI module, above-mentioned modules is all connected with double-core CPU；This advantage is: realize the multiple household safety-protection sensors such as photographic head and cigarette sense, combustion gas, humiture, formaldehyde are concentrated one, one equipment just can solve the problems such as fire prevention, antitheft, gas leakage preventing, video intercom, environmental monitoring, the intelligent domestic system of overturning over all uses distributed sensor, wiring to install complicated problem；And there is the network communications technology of WiFi and 4G, the APP connecting user mobile phone end sends warning message to owner, property, the fire department very first time quickly and easily.

title_en: Enterprise power distribution network energy saving evaluation system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an enterprise power distribution network energy-saving evaluation system and relates to the technical field of power distribution networks.
