The intelligent electric energy meter comprises an intelligent electric energy meter, a Z-wave wireless network, an electric power information acquisition terminal, an Ethernet and a power distribution network energy-saving evaluation terminal; the electric power information acquisition terminal is a computer with a built-in program and is used for electric power information acquisition and calculation; the power distribution network energy-saving evaluation terminal is a computer with built-in evaluation software and is evaluated by adopting a propagation neural network method. In addition, the invention also provides an energy-saving evaluation method for the enterprise power distribution network. The method adopts the advantage of the self-learning capability of the propagation neural network, the multi-factor energy-saving evaluation of the enterprise power distribution network is efficient in evaluation and high in reliability of evaluation results, relevant factors influencing energy saving in the enterprise power distribution network can be effectively analyzed, energy-saving reconstruction is facilitated, the power utilization efficiency of enterprises is improved, the power utilization cost is saved, and the cost is saved.

title_en: Mid-term peak regulation scheduling method for cascade reservoir group coupled with water flow time lag
abstract_en: The invention provides a cascade reservoir medium-term peak regulation scheduling method coupled with water flow delay aiming at frequent fluctuation of power grid daytime load and complex hydraulic connection of a cascade reservoir group. Firstly, constructing a multi-target model of power grid medium-term dispatching by using the targets of optimal power grid peak regulation and maximum cascade power generation capacity; then, a middle-stage segmental water flow delay description method and a parameter determination method are provided based on a water quantity balance principle, and a calculation method of scheduling period and delay period cascade comprehensive benefits under the influence of water flow delay is determined according to the middle-stage segmental water flow delay description method and the parameter determination method; and finally, fitting complex nonlinear constraints in the model by using a polynomial. The calculation result of taking the 11-seat cascade hydropower station in the laneway river as a research object shows that the calculation result of the method is more consistent with the actual operation condition by introducing the water flow time-lag factor, so that the scheduling plan deviation influenced by the hysteresis is effectively reduced, the water and electricity utilization benefit is improved, and the method has a good medium-term peak regulation effect.
assignees: CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO;UNIV DALIAN TECH

title_en: Method and system for field infrared camera deployment, control and site selection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a field infrared camera deployment, control and site selection method and a system, which relate to the technical field of infrared camera application and comprise the following steps: acquiring a digital map and a digital terrain model of an area to be monitored; determining an infrared camera layout area; determining a signal propagation environment in an infrared camera arrangement area, and establishing a field wireless signal propagation model according to the signal propagation environment; calculating the communication distance of the field infrared camera according to the communication parameters of the camera end and the field wireless signal propagation model; and arranging infrared cameras in the infrared camera arrangement area according to the communication distance of the outdoor infrared cameras and the digital terrain model. The invention relates to a field infrared camera distribution and control site selection method and system, which are based on a determined monitoring area and a novel field infrared camera with a wireless networking function, and realize visual distribution and control site selection of the novel field infrared camera by combining topographic data. Therefore, a data wireless recovery network is constructed, and the monitoring timeliness is effectively improved.
assignees: UNIV ELECTRONIC SCI & TECH CHINA;CHENGDU PANDA BREEDING RES BASE

title_en: Cascading failure modeling method for power information physical system under distributed denial of service attack
abstract_en: The invention provides a cascading failure model of a power information physical system under distributed denial of service attack, which simulates a dynamic evolution process of power network cascading failure under the condition that power network circuit overload information and scheduling information issued by a control center are lost due to distributed denial of service attack by constructing the cascading failure model. The invention provides an optimal load shedding control method in the dynamic process of cascading failures, which is characterized in that distributed denial of service attacks are applied to a communication channel of a power information physical system, the attacks lead to the loss of power grid state information in an uplink communication channel and scheduling information in a downlink communication channel, the power grid cascading failure evolution process under the distributed denial of service attacks is simulated, and the load loss rate and the node loss rate of the remaining power grid after the cascading failures are finished are counted, so that the influence of the network attacks on the power grid is analyzed.

title_en: Linkage method, device and equipment for emergency handling of overseas oil and gas pipeline accidents
abstract_en: The application provides a linkage method, device and equipment for emergency handling of accidents of overseas oil and gas pipelines, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring all mechanisms along the line corresponding to overseas oil and gas pipeline accidents and all tasks to be treated; each mechanism is expressed as a mechanism unit, each task to be treated is expressed as a task unit, and each mechanism unit and each task unit establish a mechanism emergency linkage network model; taking a preset target mechanism unit as an activation starting moment in the model, and performing activation propagation between the mechanism unit and the task unit of the mechanism emergency linkage network model according to preset execution logic; recording the activation propagation paths and sequences between each mechanism unit and each task unit when all task units enter an activation state, and calculating the accumulated sum of benefits of each propagation scheme as the propagation scheme; and determining the propagation scheme corresponding to the maximum profit accumulation sum as a target propagation scheme for emergency treatment. And the completion of all emergency treatment tasks in the shortest time is realized.

title_en: Reverse remote language propagation model based on hypergraph
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of inverse remote language propagation, in particular to an inverse remote language propagation model based on hypergraph, which comprises the following steps: constructing an OSN anti-rumor high-order system propagation model based on hypergraph; analyzing the hypergraph OSN high-order network principle and composition; constructing a heterogeneous differential equation set of a hypergraph OSN (open-system analysis) anti-rumor high-order system propagation model and verifying the positive and the bounded nature of a model solution; calculating basic regeneration number of model or judging whether rumors are automatically dead threshold R  0  The method comprises the steps of carrying out a first treatment on the surface of the And carrying out numerical simulation verification on the model. The reverse remote speaking propagation model based on hypergraph carries out microscopic analysis on the rumor propagation of OSN from the angles of hypergraph and complex network theory, establishes a high-order information propagation model of OSN, and focuses on multilayer network based on hypergraph modeling toAnd model heterogeneity, emphasizes combinations of network structures, and emphasizes the characteristics of multi-level, and multi-dimensional networks of online social networks.

title_en: Novel rapid dynamic thermal simulation method based on discrete event simulation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of heat supply pipe network dynamic simulation, and discloses a novel rapid dynamic thermal simulation method based on discrete event simulation, which is used for simulating a heat supply pipe network by considering heat loss and time lag of water in pipes, accurately and rapidly calculating heat propagation of each pipe, and playing a key role in planning and optimizing a pipe network system. The discrete event simulation is applied to the simulation of the regional heating network for the first time, can effectively and accurately process the changed inlet temperature and flow, and is also applicable to the working condition of zero flow. The variable space-time discretization is automatically determined by input data, and the numerical value diffusion of transmission delay and temperature is not considered during calculation, so that the rapid calculation of heat loss and temperature drop can be rapidly calculated. The model is efficient and flexible, achieves unprecedented efficiency on the premise of ensuring precision, and is suitable for various large-scale dendritic and annular pipe networks. The pipeline model can be used for fast dynamic thermal simulation of a variable-time and variable-space step large-scale central heating pipe network.

title_en: Mechanical-non-mixed three-dimensional macroscopic basic diagram construction method based on cellular automaton model
abstract_en: The invention relates to a machine non-mixing three-dimensional macroscopic basic diagram construction method based on a cellular automaton model, which is characterized in that interaction logic and quantization characteristics of a motor vehicle and a non-motor vehicle in a machine non-mixing process are analyzed, a vehicle motion rule at a machine non-mixing road section and an intersection is established, and a microscopic traffic simulation model based on the cellular automaton is constructed so as to obtain a macroscopic basic diagram; firstly, a macroscopic basic diagram theory is extended to a three-dimensional space, and the relationship between road network traffic output and motor vehicle density and non-motor vehicle density is established, so that macroscopic features of the machine non-mixed dual-mode traffic system can be more comprehensively described; according to the invention, a three-dimensional macroscopic basic diagram of the mixed traffic is constructed through data analysis, theoretical modeling and traffic simulation means, the formation, propagation and dissipation mechanisms of traffic jam under the interference of the non-motor vehicles are explored, the road network performance reduction caused by the non-motor vehicle interference and the generated traffic flow additional delay are quantified, and technical support is provided for efficiently using urban road resources and the like.

title_en: Relay protection fixed value risk assessment method based on neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a relay protection constant risk assessment method based on a neural network, which belongs to the field of relay protection cascading failure type identification and risk assessment, and comprises the steps of collecting historical data of a power system to form a historical data sample set, processing the collected data, substituting the processed data into a model for training, screening the trained data as experience data for relay protection constant risk assessment.
assignees: BAOTOU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH COMPANY INNER MONGOLIA POWER GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Wind-solar-load multi-stage scene tree generation method based on source-load uncertainty feature extraction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a source load uncertainty feature extraction-based wind-light load multi-stage scene tree generation method which comprises the steps of extracting wind-light load scene features based on a constructed stacked sparse self-encoder model to obtain a wind-light load scene feature set, clustering the wind-light load scene feature set based on a density peak value improved neighbor propagation algorithm to obtain a wind-light load typical day curve serving as a root node of a scene tree, generating the wind-light load scene tree year by year based on different load growth modes according to the root node of the scene tree, and reducing the scene tree by a Sinkhorn-distance scene tree reduction method to reduce the scale of the scene tree. The wind-solar-load multi-stage scene tree generated by the method can reflect the time sequence information of the new energy output and the load, represents the randomness and the fluctuation of the new energy output and the load, can reflect the uncertainty of the long-term growth of the new energy output and the load, and has important significance for planning and building a power grid.

title_en: Multi-traffic subarea distributed collaborative optimization method and system based on double-layer architecture
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-traffic subarea distributed collaborative optimization method and system based on a double-layer framework, which relate to the technical field of traffic control and automatic control and comprise the steps of constructing a weighted directed graph by utilizing a road network model, dividing the weighted directed graph into a plurality of traffic subareas, constructing an upper-layer multi-subarea collaborative optimization model based on a macroscopic basic graph of each traffic subarea to obtain the optimal accumulated number of vehicles of each traffic subarea under collaborative control, taking the optimal accumulated number of vehicles of each traffic subarea as the constraint of a lower-layer single-subarea optimization control model, optimizing each intersection timing in the traffic subarea to obtain the optimal timing scheme of a controlled road network, solving the optimal accumulated number of each subarea under collaborative control by the upper layer based on the double-layer cascading framework, and carrying out cascading and continuous parameter updating on the conditions of each intersection in the subarea by the subarea boundary control, thereby carrying out multi-subarea collaborative optimization.

title_en: Multi-mode data-based power distribution network fault knowledge graph construction method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, equipment and a medium for constructing a power distribution network fault knowledge graph based on multi-mode data, belonging to the technical field of intelligent power grids, comprising the following steps: based on the regional monitoring space-time record, the meteorological environment parameters and the equipment operation state data, the change matching of the spatial position signals and the meteorological parameters is carried out, the time period is divided, analysis is carried out according to the spatial position association, and the data overlapping property is screened to obtain the multi-mode data association distribution table. According to the method, the multi-mode data integration and the abnormal feature extraction are realized through matching and screening of the time-space record, the meteorological parameters and the equipment state data, the cross analysis of the signal fluctuation and the meteorological conditions is combined, the abnormal signal classification and the path association are optimized, the fault propagation rule is accurately analyzed, the efficiency of the power distribution network abnormal recognition, the fault positioning and the propagation analysis is obviously improved through integral optimization, the operation reliability and the fault processing capability are enhanced, the data redundancy and the error are reduced, and the safety and the stability of a power grid are improved.

title_en: Intelligent decision support and risk early warning method, device and equipment for drilling construction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a drilling construction intelligent decision support and risk early warning method, device and equipment, which are used for collecting drilling sound wave response data, carrying out harmonic analysis to identify a reservoir resonance node, constructing a reservoir energy conduction network, tracking a fluctuation propagation path based on the energy conduction network, identifying a construction risk region through stress wave spectrum characteristics, extracting porosity and permeability data to carry out phase difference analysis to generate seepage-construction mismatch factors, actively generating a construction optimization window, constructing a geological potential gradient field to determine an overflow influence range, carrying out tensor coupling on multidimensional risk factors to generate a three-dimensional construction decision matrix, generating an optimal construction scheme through energy minimization and risk-efficiency dynamic balance treatment, monitoring construction parameter response change in real time, identifying abnormal parameter combination symptoms, generating a grading risk early warning instruction, and realizing intelligent decision support and risk early warning of drilling construction.
assignees: GUANGDONG YINGGEER GEOLOGICAL EQUIPMENT TECH CO LTD;UNIV CHENGDU TECHNOLOGY;GUANGDONG PROVINCE COMMUNICATIONS PLANNING & DESIGN INST GROUP CO LTD;CHINA RAILWAY MAJOR BRIDGE RECONNAISSANCE & DESIGN INST CO LTD

title_en: Geological disaster real-time monitoring system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster real-time monitoring system based on the Internet of things, which relates to the technical field of geological disaster intelligent early warning, and aims to acquire original data such as earth surface displacement, rainfall, and earth sound signals through a multi-source sensing acquisition module, extract disturbance characteristics and calculate disturbance entropy and energy indexes through an edge intelligent processing module, construct a regional topological map through a graph neural network, predict propagation paths and risk probabilities of induction factors, fuse weather prediction and the topography factors to construct a multidimensional mapping model, identify disaster development trend, judge whether to enter a critical state and trigger early warning based on a causal reasoning map, dynamically adjust sensor sampling frequency and communication priority through combining historical abnormal similarity, realize resource optimization configuration, and the intelligent monitoring and early warning system has the advantages of high identification accuracy, high response speed, low energy consumption and strong deployment adaptability, and is suitable for intelligent monitoring and early warning of geological disasters such as landslide and debris flow.

title_en: Oneself weather data transmitter and weather data reception indication method and system of net radio structure
title_ko: 그물 무선망 구조의 자체 기상정보 송신기와 기상정보 수신 표시 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A self weather information transmitter of a network structure, a weather information receiving method, and a device thereof are provided to rapidly recognize the climate modification. CONSTITUTION: A self weather information transmitter of a network structure comprises the following: a transmission device capable of transferring climate data to a specific direction; a sun light collecting plate for charging the solar cell with rechargeable battery; and an antenna. All the equipments are arranged on an instrument screen for the durability. The antenna receives the data formed by an algorithm creating packet data transferred from the transmission device after being encrypted.
abstract_ko:
최근 정부에서는 세계인류의 녹색선진국을 건설하기 위한 핵심추진10대 과제중 기후변화재해에 대해 적극 대응하기 위한 대책등 기상에 대처할 수 있는 방법과 방안을 강구하고 있다. 실제적으로 실생활에서의 현지역에 실시간으로 기상을 국민이 접할 수 있는 네트워크 시스템이 구축되어 있지는 않다. 생활 활동을 시작하기전에 외부기온을 알고 싶어 하는데 내가 위치한 현재의 기상을 쉽게 바로 인지할 수있다면 에너지 절감을 위한 여러 행동을 할 것이다. 이러한 표시장치는 다소 제한적으로 독립된 방식으로는 있지만 전지역에 이러한 정보를 실시간에 전송해주고 이를 일반적으로 보편화된 장치로 수신을 할 수 있다면 기상변화에 바로 적응/대응 할 수 있을 것이다. 이를 위한 방법을 설계한 그물 무선구조망(Netted structure network)화된 현지기상 정보표시 방법 및 장치에 대한 것으로 자세히 말하면 일정 송신기능을 지닌 현지기상 송신기(자가 송신기능을 내장한 소형 백엽상)에서 송출하는 정보를 동일한 고주파수로 여러 지역에 분포시켜두고 이를 어떠한 곳에서도 정보표시해줄 수 있는 수신기로 받아 공용아파트 등과 같은 곳에서 기상정보를 실시간 표시함으로 현재 위치한 기상정보인 현지 기상의 변화에 적응할 수 있도록 하여 경제적 국가녹색성장에 기반적인 체계 구축이 되는 방법 및 장치가 될 것이다. 기상정보수집을 위한 독립전원 생성과 경제적 효율성과 저탄소의 효율을 위해 기상정보를 수집하는 백엽상에 자가 발전기능(태양광을 활용한 전원생성)을 내장시켜 고주파수대역(5Km 전송능력)의 송신기능을 추가한 백엽상을 전국에(5Km 반경 범위)  분포시켜 두고, 발신된 정보를 수신할 수 있도록 하면 전국 어느 지역에서도 현지 실시간 기상정보와 계절별 지수를 알 수있으며 이를 전파하는 다양한 유무선방법으로 실생활을 보다 윤택하게 할 것이다. 
       
     그물무선망, 기상정보, 무선전송, 표시장치, 백엽상

title_en: Flange Cover for Back Fire Prevention
title_ko: 역화방지용 플랜지 커버
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a flange cover for backfire prevention, which is installed to surround a flange connection unit of a pipe piping, and protects the flange connection unit from external impact and the environment by directing leaking chemicals or fluids in a specific direction, and applies a backfire preventer for an explosive environment to prevent fire from spreading through the pipe piping in the event of a fire, thereby protecting human life and facilities. The flange cover comprises: a cylindrical body (10) which forms a space in which a flange connection unit of a pipe piping (100) is accommodated, and both ends are closed; a pipe receiving unit (20) provided on both sides of the body so as to accommodate the pipe piping (100); and a backfire preventer (50) provided on a lower side of the body (10) to block an external flame from spreading into the inside of the body (10). The body (10) and the pipe receiving unit (20) are formed by being divided in half and integrated by a connecting member.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 파이프 배관의 플랜지 연결부를 감싸도록 설치되어 누설되는 화학물질 또는 유체를 특정 방향으로 유도함으로써 플랜지 연결부를 외부 충격 및 환경으로부터 보호하고 폭발 환경에 대비한 역화방지기를 적용하여 화재발생시 파이프 배관을 통해 화재가 전파되는 것을 방지하여 인명과 시설물을 보호할 수 있도록 한 역화방지용 플랜지 커버에 관한 것으로,  
파이프 배관(100)의 플랜지 연결부가 수용되는 공간을 형성하며 양단이 막혀 있는 원통 형상의 바디(10); 파이프 배관(100)이 수용되도록 바디의 양측에 구비되는 배관수용부(20); 바디(10)의 하측에 구비되어 외부의 화염이 바디(10)의 내측으로 전파되지 않도록 차단하는 역화방지기(50);를 포함하고, 상기 바디(10)와 배관수용부(20)는 반으로 분할 형성되어 연결부재에 의해 일체화되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Enhancements for Minimization of Service Interruption
abstract_en: A user equipment (UE) is configured to identify a disaster condition applies to a first public land mobile network (PLMN), select a second PLMN for disaster roaming services, wherein one or more tracking areas (TAs) of the second PLMN are in a forbidden list stored locally at the UE and wherein the second PLMN and the first PLMN have a roaming agreement for disaster roaming services and register with the second PLMN for disaster roaming services in the one or more TAs of the second PLMN from the forbidden list.

title_en: Earthquake damage prediction and prevention system and method thereof
abstract_en: Proposed is an earthquake damage prediction and prevention system (1) for determining an impact or damage caused by an earthquake to objects associated with different geographical locations (A,B,C,D). A central unit with a filter module selects and collects earthquake related data of a plurality of network units. At least one impact ratio table (151) is stored with a first data structure for storing geographical and/or topographical data coordinates of the different geographical locations (A,B,C,D). The geometric distances of the geographical locations (A,B,C,D) from a hypocenter/epicenter (2) are generated by an intensity calculation module (104) with a coordinates processor. Local intensity values based upon the generated geometric distances and a given earthquake magnitude by means of a stored parameterization comprising variable weight parameters are generated by means of a propagation calculation unit of the intensity calculation module (104), whereas the generated geometric distances are stored assigned to the corresponding geographical locations (A,B,C,D) by means of a second data structure of the impact ratio table (151). At least one of the variable weight parameters and/or at least one impact ratio for different earthquake intensity levels indicative of the impact or damage caused by an earthquake to the object and/or at least one object parameter defining earthquake exposed structures of the object are received from a plurality of users. By means of an index calculation module (105) the impact index for the geographical locations (A, B, C, D) generated by determining in each case from the impact ratio table (151) the impact ratio for the local intensity at the respective geographical location (A, B, C, D), and adding up the impact ratios weighted in each case by the weighting factor assigned to the respective geographical location (A, B, C, D).

title_en: Photovoltaic generating system confidence capacity evaluating method
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of photovoltaic generating system confidence capacity evaluating method, four factors including proposing influence photovoltaic generating system confidence capacity: the timing dependence that photovoltaic permeability, data sampling time interval, photovoltaic-load power output fluctuation and photovoltaic are contributed with load fluctuation；Using sequential Monte Carlo simulation calculation Power System Reliability, confidence capacity is solved by Secant Method；Establish three layers of error backward propagation method between four factors and confidence capacity；Utilize the inputoutput data collection training neural network obtained under different irradiation modes；The generalization ability for the neural network completed using training obtains the photovoltaic generating system confidence capacity under specified criteria；Photovoltaic generating system confidence capacity evaluating method proposed by the present invention can be used for the planning and designing of the generating and transmitting system containing photovoltaic, and no longer need to individually carry out sequential Monte Carlo emulation to each specific photovoltaic generating system, solve the problems, such as that versatility is not strong in the prior art.

title_en: Method for analyzing risk of abandoned water in power generation dispatching of cascade hydropower station group by considering runoff forecasting
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of hydropower dispatching operation, and relates to a method for analyzing water abandoning risk of power generation dispatching of a cascade hydropower station group by considering runoff forecasting. The method comprises the steps of considering forecasting factors such as early runoff, early rainfall, forecast rainfall, months and the like, and constructing a neural network forecasting model; determining a runoff transfer interval by combining a forecast-actual runoff correlation diagram; constructing a minimum model of the cascade hydropower station group middle-term waste water by taking the minimum cascade waste water as a target and considering various constraint conditions, and performing simulated dispatching by taking forecast runoff and runoff transfer upper limit as input; and determining the conditions of residual storage capacity, a water abandoning interval, space-time distribution of step water abandoning and the like by taking the water abandoning amount obtained by the runoff forecasting simulation scheduling as a lower limit value of the risk and taking the water abandoning amount obtained by the runoff transfer upper limit simulation scheduling as an upper limit value of the risk. The method is beneficial to quantitatively analyzing the power generation scheduling risk of the hydropower station group in the flood season step, determining more reasonable hydropower risk control decision and reducing unreasonable water abandonment of the drainage basin step.

title_en: Method and system for identifying major event of power grid cascading failure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for identifying a large event of a power grid cascading failure, and belongs to the technical field of power system safety. The method comprises the following steps: 1.1, acquiring a power grid running state by using a power grid real-time state tracking technology; 1.2, screening an expected event set according to a preset index; 1.3, selecting risk elements in the set of expected faults, and exiting the operation of the risk elements and checking; 1.4, carrying out tide calculation aiming at the whole network, obtaining a calculation result, cutting off risk elements if the calculation result is not converged, and listing faults of the risk elements to be cut off as large events to be evaluated; 1.5, when the power grid is determined to have no overload or 3 overload lines are disconnected, obtaining the result index of an expected event, when the power grid is determined to have overload and 3 overload lines are not disconnected, disconnecting an overload element as a lower event, and entering 1.4; and determining the big event according to the big event evaluation index. The invention enables the major event of the power grid cascading failure to be identified in advance, and corresponding prevention and control measures are adopted aiming at the identification result.

title_en: Intelligent training method, evaluation method and system for weak evaluation of power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a training method, an evaluation method and a system for a power system weakness evaluation intelligent agent, and belongs to the field of power system weakness evaluation. The method is based on a deep reinforcement learning algorithm and a power system cascading failure model, an agent based on a deep Q network decides an attack line which most easily causes the power system to crash, a power flow transfer process after the attacked line exits from running is simulated based on the power system cascading failure model, and the power transmission line with the most serious power flow out-of-limit is automatically cut. And continuously utilizing the intelligent agent to decide the attack line until the outage line or the loss load reaches a certain threshold value, judging the breakdown of the power system, and outputting an attack sequence decided by the intelligent agent. In the process, experience samples required by reinforcement learning are stored and the updating agent is trained. According to the method, the intelligent agent obtained by deep reinforcement learning algorithm training can be used for effectively deciding the attack sequence which most easily causes the breakdown of the power system under the current tide working condition, so that the weakness degree of the power system is evaluated.

title_en: Transparent fusion perception visualization scene construction method and system for low-voltage power distribution network
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of intelligent power grids, and provides a method and a system for constructing a transparent fusion perception visualization scene of a low-voltage power distribution network, wherein the method and the system comprise the steps of synchronously acquiring voltage, current and equipment state data by utilizing power line carrier communication, an intelligent ammeter and a power distribution terminal, and establishing a circular queue with time marks aligned; the method comprises the steps of constructing a tree topology structure based on three-phase attributes, generating a connection matrix, dividing users into visual levels with different transparencies through electric distance calculation, realizing gradual change coloring and special effect warning of an overload circuit through combining current saturation mapping, fusing physical positions and electric parameters through polar coordinate system conversion, generating dynamic particle flows to intuitively display current distribution, and analyzing a voltage distortion propagation path through waveform similarity backtracking when voltage is in sag, positioning disturbance sources and triggering pulse diffusion animation. The transparent fusion sensing of the running state of the low-voltage distribution network is realized, the real-time early warning of line overload and the second-level positioning of disturbance sources are realized, and the intelligent operation and maintenance efficiency is improved.

title_en: Coal mine fluidization exploitation dynamic disaster prevention and control method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for preventing and controlling dynamic disasters in coal mine fluidization exploitation, and relates to the technical field of disaster prevention and control. The method comprises the steps of establishing a risk map based on multi-field information of a mining area, setting a focus intensity upper limit, a path attenuation target and an energy absorption displacement target, performing in-situ transformation under control index constraint to form a distributed microcrack network, calculating a residual dynamic carrier spectrum to weaken the focus, constructing an artificial barrier and an energy absorption band with abrupt wave impedance change according to the residual dynamic carrier spectrum to realize propagation energy cutting, configuring a flexible energy absorption protection system according to the residual dynamic carrier spectrum and a propagation attenuation coefficient, monitoring microseismic, stress and displacement data in real time, and realizing parameter self-adaptive correction through threshold triggered linkage treatment. The method constructs a source-diameter-field integrated active prevention and control system, realizes dynamic regulation and closed-loop management of the fluidized mining process, and obviously improves the intrinsic safety and the intelligent level of deep mining.

title_en: Power consumption prediction method and prediction system for cement raw material grinding system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for predicting the power consumption of a cement raw material grinding system, which provide a basis for reducing the power consumption of the cement raw material grinding system by predicting the power consumption in real time, take a long-short term memory network as a basic model, adopt an encoding and decoding structure and establish a power consumption prediction model comprising an encoder and a decoder; inputting system variables into an encoder, mining the nonlinear relation among the variables, converting system variable data into feature codes containing the nonlinear relation among the variables, inputting the feature codes and historical power consumption data into a decoder together, mining the relevance between the system variables and the historical power consumption, and obtaining a predicted value at the next moment; meanwhile, model parameters are corrected by adopting a back propagation algorithm, the convergence precision is improved, and then the trained model is used for predicting the power consumption in real time. The invention can be used for accurately predicting the power consumption of the cement raw material grinding system.

title_en: Wind power plant power generation power prediction method and system based on behavior feature deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind power prediction method and a system based on behavior characteristic deep learning, which are applied to the technical field of machine learning and new energy, and comprise the following steps: the method comprises the steps of data acquisition, data preprocessing, matrix construction, data division, gradient extraction, 3D-CNN network training, training end judgment and wind power plant generation power prediction. Compared with a scheme for extracting the space-time characteristics of the power data of the wind power plant in stages, the method can integrally extract the space-time characteristics of the power, ensures the integrity of the characteristics, and is beneficial to the back propagation and the back optimization of an algorithm; a wind power prediction model is established for an actual wind power plant, the output power of the wind power plant is predicted according to the requirements of medium-short term prediction, the prediction accuracy is high, and the average relative error and the root mean square error are low.
assignees: NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER UNIV BAODING

title_en: Signal-free area network coverage equipment based on ad hoc network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of network equipment, in particular to an ad hoc network-based no-signal area network coverage device, which comprises a broadband transmission module, a narrowband transmission module, a universal transmission module, a short-distance data transmission module and a public network interface module; the circuit control board in the device comprises a double-frequency bidirectional signal amplifier, a wireless broadband data transmission link and a narrowband data transmission link. The invention can increase the production data return distance of the non-moving signal area through the double-frequency bidirectional signal amplifier: and the unmanned aerial vehicle automatically patrols and examines the position transmission communication guarantee. The emergency information communication backhaul guarantee is based on broadband transmission equipment, narrowband transmission equipment, universal transmission equipment, a short-distance data transmission module and public network interface equipment, the propagation characteristics of wireless broadband signals and narrowband signals are fully utilized, equipment development is carried out through automatic adjustment of network data transmission strategies and reasonable layout of communication nodes, and no-signal area network coverage and reliable transmission online rate are realized.
assignees: YUXI POWER SUPPLY BUREAU OF YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Flood control dispatching simulation method and system suitable for multistage serial-parallel cascade reservoirs
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood control dispatching simulation method and system suitable for a multistage serial-parallel cascade reservoir, comprising the steps of collecting and arranging basic data; the method comprises the steps of extracting river network water systems, dividing sub-watershed, generating topological structures based on cascade reservoir serial-parallel connection relations, performing standardization treatment, constructing a model based on three layers of nested circulation on the basis of the cascade reservoir topological structure relations, realizing simulation of warehousing flood and flood control calculation processes of the cascade reservoirs step by step from upstream to downstream, simulating cascade reservoir flood control scheduling processes under different schemes through setting schemes, and performing scheme comparison analysis and effect evaluation. According to the invention, the data base plate and the water rain condition monitoring information are fully utilized, the cascade reservoirs with complex series-parallel connection relations such as series connection, parallel connection or series-parallel connection can be adapted, the simulation of the cascade reservoir flood forecasting and flood control scheduling process is realized, reliable guarantee is provided for scientifically and reasonably formulating a cascade reservoir scheduling scheme, and technical support is provided for improving flood control and disaster reduction capability.

title_en: Coal mine safety monitoring system based on big data
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of industrial big data, in particular to a coal mine safety monitoring system based on big data. The system comprises a sensor module, a dynamic topology construction module, a risk propagation calculation module and a cooperative control module, wherein the sensor module is used for acquiring mine data and preprocessing, the dynamic topology construction module is used for establishing a dynamic connection map between mine areas and constructing a risk conduction network, the risk propagation calculation module is used for calculating a risk conduction value and a target threshold value, the cooperative control module is used for judging abnormality, generating a cross-area equipment linkage instruction set, judging whether the instruction set is effective according to a risk attenuation rate, executing the instruction set if the instruction set is effective, and then generating an operation record and storing the operation record. Therefore, the problems that the multi-region risk conduction effect cannot be predicted in the monitoring of coal mine safety, the equipment control instruction is executed in isolation, the system-level linkage is lacked, and the historical accidents are not deeply related with the real-time data are solved.
assignees: SHAANXI YINHE COAL IND DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Wind power project investment estimation method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a wind power project investment estimation method and device, comprising the following steps: acquiring engineering characteristic factor data related to kilowatt investment of a wind power unit; and inputting the engineering characteristic factor data related to the kilowatt investment of the wind power unit into a pre-trained error back propagation neural network model, and determining the estimated value of the kilowatt investment of the wind power unit. The technical scheme provided by the invention improves the capacity and accuracy of model optimization, further improves the precision and generalization capacity of investment estimation, realizes rapid and reasonable estimation of wind power project investment, provides scientific and objective basis for investment decision and project establishment, and has important social significance.

title_en: Vulnerability coupling link identification method between power grid control system and power primary equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of safe and reliable operation guarantee of smart power grids, and discloses a vulnerability coupling link identification method between a power grid control system and power primary equipment, which comprises the following steps: step 1, establishing a network model of the dependent coupling of a smart grid control system and power primary equipment, wherein the network model comprises a power network and an information network; step 2, constructing a fragile point identification method based on node centrality, so as to obtain a node electrical centrality index between nodes in the power network and a near centrality index of effective information length between nodes in the information network; step 3, calculating a comprehensive risk measurement index DLC  C (P i ,C i  based on a power grid-information network; and 4, calculating the comprehensive risk measurement index DLC  C (P i ,C i , and finding out and removing the key vulnerability coupling link of the power grid-information network. The method and the device for controlling the intelligent power grid control system improve the robustness of the intelligent power grid control system to the greatest extent and reduce the probability of cascade faults.

title_en: Complex product system risk source identification method based on zero model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a complex product system risk source identification method based on a zero model, which comprises the steps of firstly constructing a complex network according to functional index items in a complex product system, and then calculating the function index items as metering indexes of the nodes, and dividing the function index items into different groups according to the node degree centrality. And constructing a zero model for the group with the same degree centrality, and judging the importance degree of the functional index item by comparing the variation of the modularity with the zero model of the network construction. And finally, selecting a functional index item with short risk propagation time as a complex product system risk source by using a linear threshold model. The method can identify the risk source from the system structure of the complex product system, and provides a new thought for identifying the risk source, thereby improving the safety of the complex product system.

title_en: Earthquake response and damage evolution simulation method and equipment for ground fracture zone tunnel lining
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and equipment for simulating earthquake response and damage evolution of a tunnel lining with a ground fissure, and relates to the field of earthquake engineering. The invention is based on the constructed vibrating table model, a numerical simulation model is established by adopting a method for correcting lattice spring-discrete crack network coupling numerical values, then a MLSM-DFN model of a tunnel structure section of a ground crack zone is established based on the numerical simulation model, and the earthquake response and damage simulation of the tunnel lining of the ground crack zone are completed based on the model, so that the expansion and propagation rule of the ground crack can be completely and truly simulated, the activity development trend of the ground crack can be accurately predicted and quantified, and meanwhile, the influence factors and action mechanisms of the tunnel structure failure induced by coupling dynamics response can be accurately judged, so that a more definite theoretical basis and a more technical support are provided for better and targeted earthquake-resistant design of the tunnel structure.

title_en: Oil-gas pipe network running state risk perception early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a risk perception early warning method and a system for the running state of an oil-gas pipe network, wherein the method comprises the steps of fusing multidimensional features of the running state of the pipe network according to real-time running data of the oil-gas pipe network to generate a space-time feature matrix; the method comprises the steps of inputting a space-time feature matrix into a deep Gaussian process model, carrying out probabilistic modeling on abnormal features in the running state of a pipe network, outputting a risk feature vector with confidence, constructing a three-dimensional risk concentration distribution field according to the risk feature vector, predicting the propagation path and the diffusion trend of the risk concentration distribution field, constructing a self-adaptive early warning threshold generation model based on the generation of an countermeasure network aiming at a prediction result, generating a multi-level early warning threshold changing along with the running state of the pipe network, and realizing risk perception early warning of the running state of the oil-gas pipe network according to the comparison result of the real-time risk feature and the early warning threshold. By utilizing the embodiment of the invention, dynamic risk assessment and self-adaptive early warning can be realized, and the safety and emergency response capability of the pipe network are enhanced.

title_en: Automatic monitoring data processing method for pipe network pressure
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of pipe network data processing, in particular to an automatic pipe network pressure monitoring data processing method. The method comprises the steps of obtaining pipe network structure data, constructing a pipeline topology network based on the pipe network structure data to generate a pipeline topology network, screening a main pipeline and branch pipes of the pipeline topology network to obtain pipe network circulation data, deploying pipe wall microwave resonators on the main pipeline and the branch pipes based on the pipe network circulation data, capturing pipeline circumferential deformation harmonic waves in real time through the deployed microwave resonators, analyzing longitudinal wave propagation delay of the pipe network circulation data, constructing a pipe body structure dynamic resonance map by combining the pipeline circumferential deformation harmonic waves, and resolving pipe network internal pressure and pipe wall equivalent stress of the pipeline topology network through the pipe body structure dynamic resonance map. The invention improves the accuracy of monitoring and identifying the pipe network pressure by combining the pipeline topology analysis, the microwave resonator monitoring, the dynamic resonance spectrum and the bidirectional fluid-solid coupling analysis.

title_en: Water pump controller parameter self-adaptive adjustment control method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent control of water pumps and discloses a water pump controller parameter self-adaptive adjustment control method and a system, wherein the water pump controller parameter self-adaptive adjustment control method comprises the steps of acquiring weather early warning data, pressure pulsation signals of all pump stations and pipe network topology data, and generating a time-space synchronous disaster monitoring data set through a data fusion algorithm; the method comprises the steps of inputting a disaster monitoring data set into a deep space-time diagram neural network, outputting a pipe network damage probability distribution diagram, generating a pulsation propagation prediction model comprising propagation delay and attenuation coefficients based on a fluid dynamics equation and the pipe network damage probability distribution diagram, calculating a PID controller parameter cooperative regulation scheme of each pump station by minimizing an objective function comprising pressure deviation, flow fluctuation and parameter regulation quantity, and acquiring system response data in real time to realize self-adaptive optimization of a control strategy. The invention realizes the stable operation of the water supply system under the disaster condition.

title_en: Carry-over storage year-end fluctuating level prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a carry-over storage year-end fluctuating level prediction method and system. The method comprises the following steps of: 1, establishing a carry-over storage year-end fluctuating level prediction model, and storing the carry-over storage year-end fluctuating level prediction model in a model library; 2, optimizing a scheduling target through a prediction server according to the maximum total cascade energy, and calculating and selecting a corresponding carry-over storage year-end fluctuating level prediction model; and 3, calling a model solution algorithm in an algorithm library through the prediction server, solving the carry-over storage year-end fluctuating level prediction model, and obtaining the year-end fluctuating level rule. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages that the solution process is simple, the benefits in the later scheduling period after the carry-over storage year-end are considered, and the accuracy of the prediction method can be improved; and compared with a BP neural network and other methods, the method is suitable for a reservoir with short runoff data series.
assignees: GUIZHOU WUJIANG HYDROPOWER DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Multitiered network minimum dominant set building method
abstract_en: Multitiered network minimum dominant set building method of the invention, is realized by following steps: it is empty set that a) initialization, which dominates set D,；By the association probability of connected node i and j be initialized as section (0,1] in random value；B) construct belief propagation equation, calculate each node be in be occupied shape probability of state；C) node adds, and by node according to the arrangement of state probability values descending is occupied, the node of preceding r ratio is added in dominant set；D) connects the deletion of side and node；E) pinches leaf algorithm process；F) iteration again；G) is until obtaining an effective dominant set D.Multitiered network minimum dominant set building method of the invention, belong to the marginal probability of multitiered network minimum dominant set by the belief propagation equation calculation multitiered network node of building, and pinch leaf algorithm using multitiered network to reduce computational complexity, can Fast Construction go out the approximate minimum dominant set of extensive multitiered network.
assignees: SHANDONG COMPUTER SCIENCE CT NAT SUPERCOMPUTER CT JINAN;UNIV CIVIL AVIATION CHINA

title_en: Short-term load prediction method based on BP neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of load prediction of an electric power market, in particular to a short-term load prediction method based on a BP (back propagation) neural network.

title_en: Deep reinforcement learning-based economic scheduling method for cogeneration system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a combined heat and power system economic dispatching method based on deep reinforcement learning, which comprises S1, aiming at a combined heat and power system operation model, describing the operation model by using a Markov chain model, strictly converting an objective function and a constraint target in an optimization method respectively, and giving a proof; s2, improving the DPPO algorithm in the deep reinforcement learning to train the intelligent agent under various operation states, firstly, before each training round begins, the operation environment will randomly generate operation data in a reasonable operation range; the intelligent agent in the turn generates a control strategy according to the current internal neural network parameters, and interacts with the operating environment; and after the round is finished, the accumulated reward in the maximized round is used as the target for back propagation, and the network parameters of the intelligent agent are optimized, so that the intelligent agent learns the economic dispatching strategy for different operation states of the cogeneration system. The invention greatly improves the convenience of use. And has better convergence performance.

title_en: Method for identifying dressing specification of distribution network field operating personnel
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for identifying dressing specifications of distribution network field operators, which comprises the following steps of image classification: intercepting a distribution network field operation video as an image book set, and dividing the image book set into a verification set and a training set according to a proportion; formation of training data set: training a target detection and image instance segmentation model by using a Mask-RCNN algorithm, and verifying the trained model by using a verification set to obtain a detection, identification and segmentation model; intercepting images from an original image by using a personnel position coordinate, a work clothes category and a work clothes pixel segmentation image obtained by Mask-RCNN inference to form a training data set for image recognition; constructing a classification model: constructing an image recognition model based on a MobileNet-v2 algorithm, and recognizing whether the working clothes worn by an operator are standard or not; identification of dressing regulations: the method is characterized in that a target detection model, an image instance segmentation model and an image recognition model which are constructed by adopting Mask-RCNN and MobileNet-v2 algorithms are cascaded to realize the detection, the recognition and the segmentation of whether an operator wears a working garment normally or not.
assignees: INF CT YUNNAN GRID POWER CO LTD

title_en: Wind, light and water multi-energy complementary day-ahead risk scheduling method considering output stationarity
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind, light and water multi-energy complementary day-ahead risk scheduling method considering output stationarity, which comprises a power grid next-day load forecasting process, a wind power plant and photovoltaic power plant next-day output process, a cascade hydropower station warehousing runoff and interval inflow process; obtaining a typical load process and the probability thereof, and a typical wind-solar combined output process and the probability thereof by adopting a scene reduction algorithm; establishing a risk-controllable day-ahead power generation planning model of the wind-solar-water complementary system with three targets; step four: and constructing a double-layer nested optimization framework to solve the model. The invention can effectively deal with the uncertainty of load prediction and wind-light output prediction under the condition of ensuring the system output stability.

title_en: Simulation method for botnet propagation model analysis and target construction for Internet of things equipment
abstract_en: A simulation method for botnet propagation model analysis and target construction for Internet of things equipment comprises the following steps: constructing a network topology structure for botnet virus transmission; finding out the Internet of things equipment with weak password holes, and acquiring and analyzing equipment firmware; simulating the acquired firmware information by using a QEMU simulator through a system level simulation technology, and simulating a target topological structure; and (5) completing the propagation reproduction of the botnet and packaging the botnet into a target. According to the method, through analysis of Mirai propagation processes, functions of resisting restarting, preventing process death and the like of malicious codes are achieved, a QEMU simulator is used for simulating firmware, and a constructed target scene is focused on customization of typical botnet virus simulation and propagation model analysis.

title_en: Risk analysis method for predicting domino effect accident probability of LNG storage tank
abstract_en: The invention provides a risk analysis method for predicting domino effect accident probability of an LNG storage tank, which comprises the steps of firstly analyzing a damage unit of the domino effect accident according to factors such as layout characteristics of an LNG storage tank area and the like, and judging accident results of the damage unit according to structural characteristics of the damage unit; judging a propagation mode according to the accident result, and further determining the probability of other unit damage caused by the propagation mode; dividing all potential accident units according to domino effect grades, and mapping the potential accident units into a Bayesian network; and finally, analyzing by utilizing the reasoning calculation characteristics of the Bayesian network. The invention has reasonable conception, the constructed model is more scientific and reasonable, the problem of uncertainty of the transmission sequence is solved, the analysis result is more practical, and the analysis and research of the transmission sequence with the maximum possibility are facilitated.

title_en: Intelligent electricity-saving scene building method based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of three-dimensional modeling of computer graphics, and particularly relates to an intelligent electric field protection scene building method based on digital twinning. The invention comprehensively collects the running, state and power grid topology data of the equipment. And (3) deeply analyzing the equipment relationship by combining the improved graph neural network with multi-scale and time sequence characteristic modeling. The key is that the electricity-keeping scene is constructed by comprehensively considering the equipment fault probability, fault propagation and load fluctuation based on the digital twin model. And the dynamic simulation simulates the evolution of the power grid, and the influence of the scene on the stability of the power grid is accurately evaluated. The method can dynamically adjust the scene according to the actual working condition, effectively improve the scientificity and effectiveness of the construction of the electricity-protecting scene, ensure the stable operation of the power grid and provide powerful support for electricity-protecting work of the power system.
assignees: SHANDONG LURUAN DIGITAL TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Emergency communication optimization method for low-orbit satellite heterogeneous network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency communication optimization method for a low-orbit satellite heterogeneous network. The method comprises the steps of calculating the propagation loss of a communication link in a low-orbit satellite heterogeneous network and the gain in the line array direction, calculating the intensity ratio of a received signal and a signal to interference plus noise of a ground terminal, optimizing the transmitting power of a ground base station to maximize the energy efficiency of the low-orbit satellite and the ground network, solving the optimizing problem of the transmitting power through a continuous convex approximation algorithm, and introducing regularization factors to the optimizing problem of the transmitting power and the limiting condition thereof. According to the invention, the antenna array radiation gains of the satellite base station and the ground base station and the signal transmission path length are respectively calculated, and the energy efficiency maximization of the whole network is realized by adjusting the transmitting power, the beam forming strategy and the resource allocation through an optimization algorithm based on the channel complex impulse response function expression and the path loss characteristic.
assignees: NANJING CHINA SPACENET SATELLITE TELECOM CO LTD

title_en: Earthquake geological disaster monitoring and early warning device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a seismic geological disaster monitoring and early warning device which comprises an intelligent sensing system, an analysis system and an execution and feedback system, wherein the intelligent sensing system is used for collecting geological parameters, facility states and environmental factors in real time through a multi-mode sensor array, the distributed optical fiber sensing and capturing pipeline strain, an MEMS accelerometer is used for monitoring vibration, an InSAR satellite is used for providing deformation data, the analysis system is used for constructing a complex network modeling engine, a directed weighting network model is used for fusing a historical transition probability matrix and real-time deformation rate parameters, the two-channel causal reasoning engine is combined, the two-channel causal reasoning engine comprises a physical causal channel and a data causal channel, the physical causal channel is embedded into a coulomb rupture criterion to calculate fault stress accumulation rate and Darcy law to simulate pore pressure propagation, the data channel is used for generating a counterfactual causal link through CausalGAN and combining a time causal convolution network to trigger hierarchical early warning based on analysis results of the analysis system.

title_en: Power distribution network cascading failure prediction and failure defense method, system, equipment, medium and product
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power systems, and discloses a method, a system, equipment, a medium and a product for predicting and defending cascading faults of a power distribution network, wherein the method determines the fault probability of target equipment of the power distribution network through environmental data of the power distribution network when typhoon disasters occur, constructs a dynamic Bayesian network based on a power supply chain according to a power supply chain and a fault propagation path of the power distribution network, predicts the predicted probability state distribution of the power supply chain at the future time by using the dynamic Bayesian network, and according to the predicted probability state distribution, the predicted cascade fault propagation probability of the power supply chain is determined, the power distribution network fault defense optimization problem is converted into a Markov decision process problem, and according to the predicted probability state distribution and the predicted cascade fault propagation probability, the Markov decision process problem is solved based on a deep reinforcement learning algorithm, so that an optimal fault defense strategy is obtained, and the power distribution network is effectively defended against faults.
assignees: FOSHAN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CORP

title_en: Deep learning-based supply chain prediction and dynamic adjustment system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of supply chain management, in particular to a deep learning-based supply chain prediction and dynamic adjustment system, which comprises a data acquisition module, a data preprocessing module, a prediction model construction module, a risk assessment module, a decision support module, an execution module, a simulation and optimization module and a monitoring and reporting module, wherein the prediction model construction module utilizes a deep neural network comprising an LSTM (link state machine) and an attribute mechanism to construct a demand prediction model, the risk assessment module innovatively introduces a topological data analysis method, and generates three sub-modules to realize accurate identification and quantification of risks through topological feature extraction, risk propagation modeling and intelligent response, the decision support module generates an optimal inventory strategy and a supply chain adjustment scheme based on prediction data and a risk assessment result, and the execution module is integrated with an ERP (enterprise resource planning), a WMS (wireless local area network) and a provider system through an API (application program interface), and an automatic execution purchase plan), so that high-precision prediction and dynamic adjustment of a supply chain are realized.

title_en: Wireless social networking algorithm and system supporting direct device commmunication, ad-hoc communication,group communication and broadcasting
title_ko: 단말기간 직접 통신, 중계, 그룹 통신, 방송이 가능한 무선 소셜 네트워킹 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A wireless social networking method supporting direct communication, relaying, group communication, and broadcasting between terminals and a system thereof are provided to establish bidirectional topology within a short time, thereby enhance usability. CONSTITUTION: A plurality of participants join a group conversation using limited resources. Users who are not able to join the conversation listen to the conversation using a broadcasting function which does not limit the number of listeners by establishing a group communication network. A plurality of wireless communication networks independently operate small groups like a wireless social group game. In case of an emergency situation, a plurality of the independent wireless communication networks, which operates separate small groups like a wireless social group game, are connected together and cooperates on emergency message receiving and rescue activities.
