abstract_ko:
본 발명은, 인프라가 없는 상황에서도 무선 단말기만을 이용하여  주변의 사용자들을 연결시켜주는 단말기간 직접 통신, 중계, 그룹 통신과 방송이 가능한 무선 소셜 네트워킹 네트워킹 방법 및 시스템 구성에 관한 것이다. 
재난 현장에서 모든 인프라가 마비되어 통신망이 두절된 상황에서도 단말기 만으로도 재난 안전에 관한 통신망 구축과 재난 방송이 가능하고 단말기 만으로도 다이알링 전화, 그룹 안내 방송, 전파가 차단되는 지하 구조물까지 단말기간의 중계에 의한 통화 소통이 가능한  단말기간 직접 통신, 중계, 그룹 통신과 방송이 가능한 무선 소셜 네트워킹 네트워킹 방법 및 시스템 구성에 관한 기술이다. 
마지막으로 미래의 5G 이동통신에서 증가하는 트래픽을 소화하기 위해 그룹 게임, 사용자 간의 소셜 정보 교환은 직접 단말기 간에 이루어지게 하여 네트워크의 트래픽 부담을 덜어주는 단말기간 직접 통신, 중계, 그룹 통신과 방송이 가능한  무선 소셜 네트워킹 네트워킹 방법 및 시스템 구성에 관한 기술이다.

title_en: A Safe Room Equipped With Virus Sterilization Air Shower And Indoor Air Purification Using Ion Wind
title_ko: 바이러스 살균 에어샤워장치와 이온 풍을 이용한 실내공기 정화장치 기능이 설치된 세이프 룸
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a safe room for safely escaping from a disaster such as earthquake, fire, a raid, and the like and, more specifically, to a safe room, which has an inside front surface with non-combustible materials, has an oxygen tank, water, a pressure measurement device of the oxygen tank, a battery charging device, and the like, and is equipped with a virus sterilization air shower room and a household indoor virus sterilization and purification function. Since it is important for evacuees to survive safely in case of a fire, it is required to not only have a public facility that can accommodate people under the Korean Fire Protection Act but also have a multi-purpose safe room that can enable an emergency escape, serve as a safe room in case of a disaster, and be used for other purposes at ordinary times. An objective of the present invention is to provide a safe room serving as a safe place for waiting for rescue from the outside when quick escape is not possible in case of a disaster such as an earthquake while being used, at ordinary times, as a room for removing viruses contaminated when going out and being used as a virus sterilization air purifier of a household. Accordingly, the present invention can generate radio waves to enable a person to inform a position of the person in a specific situation where the person cannot move in a fire, wait for rescue workers while receiving oxygen, protect the life from a raid, and wait for rescue from the outside.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 지진이나 화재, 강도의 침입 등의 재난으로부터 안전하게 대피하기 위한 세이프 룸에 관한 것이며, 보다 상세하게는, 내측의 전면이 불연재가 설치되며, 산소통과 생수; 상기 산소통의 압력측정 장치와 배터리의 충전장치 등이 설치되며, 바이러스 살균 에어샤워 룸과 주거공간의 실내 바이러스 살균 정화 기능이 설치된 세이프 룸에 관한 것이다. 
이처럼 화재 발생 시 대피 자는 안전하게 생존하는 것이 중요하기 때문에 우리나라의 소방법 상에 사람을 수용할 수 있는 공공시설은 물론, 일정 크기 이상의 건물에는 비상 탈출을 할 수 있고, 재난 시 대피할 세이프 룸이 필요함과 동시에 평상시 다른 용도로 활용 효과가 가능한 다목적 세이프 품이 필요하며, 본 발명의 목적은 일상에는 외출 시 오염되는 바이러스 제거룸과 주거공간의 바이러스 살균공기정화기의 목적으로 활용하다가 지진 또는 재난 시신속한 탈출이 불가능할 경우, 안전한 곳에서 외부로 구조를 기다릴 안전한 세이프 룸을 제공하며, 화재현장에서 이동할 수 없는 특수 상황에서 자신의 위치를 전파로 발생시키며, 산소를 공급받으면서 안전요원들을 기다리는 한편, 강도의 침입으로부터 생명을 보존하며, 외부로부터 구조를 기다릴 수 있는 세이프 룸을 제공하는 데 있다.

title_en: Blind Fast Network Synchronization Algorithm for Reducing LTE Public Safety Product Costs
abstract_en: Systems and methods are provided for providing blind fast network synchronization for reducing LTE public safety products costs, comprising, in one embodiment: determining if location setup is required to mitigate timing offset due to propagation delay from the synchronization source and adjusting downlink timing, and when location setup is required then providing one of manual setup in terms of timing samples, limited power RACH based on SIB2 parameters, and based on observed time difference of arrival and position reference signal; coordinating network listening periods based on graphs and hash function to avoid common silence for two or more neighboring eNodeBs; and providing continuous synchronization using blind carrier estimation.

title_en: Circuit on power system state transition probability prediction analysis method under vile weather
abstract_en: The invention discloses the circuit on power system state transition probability prediction analysis method under a kind of vile weather, comprises the following steps：A：Build with line fault probability as dependent variable index and with meteorological factor as the regression model of independent variable index；B：Calculate the flow transferring relativity factor of other each branch roads after certain branch road breaks；C：Obtain each branch road cascading trip probabilistic model；D：Obtain line status transition probability model under bad weather condition.The present invention can realize each membership transition probability assessment under bad weather condition, so as to obtain high-risk fault branch information, it is ensured that electrical network is run in inclement weather with security and stability.

title_en: Harmonic stability analysis method for high-speed railway vehicle network system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a harmonic stability analysis method for a high-speed railway vehicle network system, which comprises the steps of firstly establishing a mathematical model of a dual-port network of a long-distance high-speed railway traction network; establishing an admittance model under a complex frequency domain of the motor train unit converter based on a harmonic linearization theory; and finally, solving the closed loop stability of the train network system based on the impedance analysis theory of the cascade system, and analyzing the network side parameters of the train network system and the parameter stability of the motor train unit control system according to the generalized Nyquist stability criterion. The invention applies the impedance model based on the harmonic linearization theory, and can also apply the linear control theory even on the premise of a nonlinear car network system, so that the system model is clear and concise; harmonic characteristics of the high-speed railway vehicle network system are obtained based on a harmonic linearization theory, and therefore harmonic stability analysis is conducted on the system.

title_en: Power distribution network edge side load prediction method based on k-nearest neighbor mutual information feature simplification
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network edge side load prediction method based on k-nearest neighbor mutual information feature simplification, which establishes a load prediction training and verification data set through preprocessing modes such as complementing missing values, performing independent heat coding on weather date types and the like, and then performing forward and backward propagation training on a daily total load prediction cyclic neural network; after the total daily load is predicted, estimating mutual information between the multidimensional input vector and the multidimensional output vector, performing feature selection to simplify operation and save edge calculation energy consumption, and taking weather and date data after feature simplification, the total daily load and time-sharing load data as a new data sample to train a time-sharing load prediction network; and finally, inputting the relevant information of the predicted day into a time-sharing load prediction network after training is completed to obtain the total daily load and the time-sharing load predicted value of a certain day in the area. The method is simplified integrally, improves the efficiency of the edge computing task in the area to a certain extent, and perfects the edge computing architecture of the power distribution Internet of things.

title_en: Dynamic parameter identification method and device for power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for identifying dynamic parameters of a power distribution network. The method comprises the following steps: preprocessing the collected operation data of the power distribution network and the external environment data to generate a dynamic parameter identification sample of the power distribution network; discretizing a dynamic parameter identification sample of the power distribution network to obtain a discretized sample; based on a pre-established probability map model, acquiring parameters of the probability map model according to the discretized sample; the probability map model is a two-time slice probability map model; and acquiring dynamic parameters of the power distribution network based on a confidence propagation algorithm according to the observation variables and the probability map model after acquiring the parameters. According to the method, the dynamic parameters of the power distribution network can be deduced by utilizing the probability graph model under the condition that part of measured data or external environment data are missing, and the method is beneficial to improving the parameter identification precision under the condition that part of power distribution area operation modes are suddenly changed or external environment is suddenly changed.

title_en: Method for analyzing coupling rule of wind farm harmonic waves in power grid
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for analyzing the coupling rule of wind farm harmonic waves in a power grid, which comprises the following steps: step one: detecting parameters of wind power plant harmonic waves based on a windowed interpolation FFT algorithm, and obtaining images and waveforms of the harmonic waves; step two: when n harmonic couplings exist at a certain node of the power grid, constructing a harmonic coupling expression; analyzing influence factors of harmonic wave propagation in a power grid; establishing a harmonic coupling simulation model of the power system containing the wind power plant, simulating, displaying waveforms of the harmonic coupling expressions in the second step, and analyzing simulation results through influence factors in the second step. And the specific rule of coupling the harmonic waves of different wind power stations on the power grid is obtained by coupling the harmonic waves generated by different wind power stations on the power grid through model simulation, and finally, guidance can be provided for power grid dispatching.

title_en: Method and device for identifying fragile line of power transmission network under ice disaster and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device and a storage medium for identifying a fragile line of a power transmission network under ice disasters, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining the ice coating thickness of each line in the power transmission network under ice disasters; determining the fault probability of each line according to the thickness of each ice coating; on the basis of the fault probability of each line, adopting Monte Carlo simulation to obtain a plurality of line cascading fault accident chains, and constructing a cascading fault incidence matrix according to the line cascading fault accident chains; wherein each element in the cascading failure incidence matrix is: the associated weight of the fault line corresponding to the element and another fault line; determining the node weight degree of each line according to the cascading failure incidence matrix; and taking the first M lines with the maximum node weight degrees as fragile lines. By implementing the method, the fragile line in the power transmission network under ice disasters can be effectively identified.

title_en: Photovoltaic equipment generated power prediction method and system
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a method and a system for predicting the generation power of photovoltaic equipment, and relates to the technical field of new energy generation control. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring photovoltaic equipment data, illumination related data and topographic data; constructing a solar radiation intensity model based on a back propagation neural network according to the acquired data, predicting the current solar radiation intensity, and obtaining a preliminary radiation intensity result; determining the sea distance according to the acquired data, carrying out weight distribution on the water vapor salt fog and the attached salt fog based on the sea distance, and calculating the radiation intensity loss rate influenced by the salt fog; correcting the primary radiation intensity result by the loss rate of the radiation intensity influenced by the salt fog, and reconstructing a solar radiation intensity model according to the correction result; predicting the radiation intensity by using the reconstructed solar radiation intensity model to obtain a final radiation intensity result; and predicting the photovoltaic power generation power according to the final radiation intensity result. The influence of salt mist on the photovoltaic power generation power is considered, and the accuracy of photovoltaic power generation power prediction is improved.

title_en: Multi-heat source cooperative heat supply energy cascade utilization optimization method
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-heat source cooperative heat supply energy cascade utilization optimization method. The multi-heat source energy cascade control method based on the heat load demand gap is established by orderly combining four energy supply forms of a heat supply secondary network, a ground source, a water source and an air source, the multi-energy heat supply control system based on an autonomous controllable hardware architecture is used for realizing multi-stage optimal utilization of heat supply energy, the dependence degree on a single heat source is reduced to the greatest extent, the diversification of heat supply carriers is obviously promoted, and a new clean energy heat supply mode is realized.

title_en: Chemical industry park safety management system and method based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The application provides a chemical industry park safety management system and method based on the Internet of things, which are used for generating a dynamic monitoring data set by collecting multi-source monitoring data in a chemical industry park, applying space-time causal constraint to multi-hop connection paths in a device topological graph of the chemical industry park to generate path confidence distribution, constructing entity characteristic embedding of each device in the chemical industry park, determining a time-varying causal association matrix through all entity characteristic embedding and the path confidence distribution, dividing risk device groups with different risk levels, constructing risk propagation tensors of a device risk partition topological network in the chemical industry park through each risk device group, generating dynamic risk vectors through the time-varying causal association matrix and the risk propagation tensors, and early warning safety risks in the chemical industry park based on the dynamic risk vectors. By adopting the scheme of the application, the space-time registration of the multisource monitoring data of the sensing node of the Internet of things can be realized, and the time-varying causal relationship among the devices can be mined to realize dynamic security risk early warning.

title_en: Big electric net overload centralized decision-making real time emergency control method
abstract_en: Big electric net overload centralized decision-making real time emergency control method, concrete steps comprise: main frame reads in the real time data of operation of power networks from EMS and security control device by communication interface; Main frame adopts the emergency control scheme that goes out optimization based on the algorithm computation of the integrated performance index of the elimination circuit of optional control measure such as generator and load and transformer overload; Main frame is issued to security control device by communication interface with controlling schemes, utilizes the function of security control device to realize this controlling schemes.The present invention has made full use of the function of existing EMS and security control device, from the electrical network overall situation, the centralized decision-making and the real time emergency control method of the apparatus overload problem of big electrical network have been solved, its accuracy of judgement, reliable to overload, consider failure cause comprehensively, and be swift in motion, do not have the problem that cascading failure takes place in traditional action to individual node.

title_en: Hadoop framework-based short-term load prediction method for distributed BP neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Hadoop framework-based short-term load prediction method for a distributed BP (Back Propagation) neural network. The method specifically comprises the steps of obtaining an initial load data set; dividing the load data set into small data sets and storing the small data sets in data nodes of a distributed file system; initializing BP neural network parameters and uploading a parameter set into the distributed file system; training the BP neural network according to a current load sample, and obtaining correction values of a weight and a threshold of the BP neural network in the current data set; performing statistics on sum of weight and threshold parameters of all layers and between the layers of the network according to a key value of a key value pair; judging whether the convergence precision or the maximum iterative frequency is reached or not in a current iterative task, and if yes, establishing a distributed BP neural network model, or otherwise, performing correction of the weight and threshold parameters of the network; and inputting prediction day data and obtaining load power data of a prediction day. According to the method, the load prediction speed is increased and the requirements of load prediction precision are met.

title_en: Cascaded Hydro-power Stations burden with power automatic adjusting method and system
abstract_en: The present invention discloses Cascaded Hydro-power Stations burden with power automatic adjusting method and system, comprising steps of S100, each power station power grid day burden with power Plan Curve in basin dispatch the publication of support system by the area non-controlling net II, automatically extract the day burden with power Plan Curve text file assigned, then it is read automatically by the control net area I computer supervisory control system, and corresponding data safety check is carried out, day burden with power Plan Curve is converted to the burden with power adjustment curve for meeting electric network active load adjustment rule by algorithm；By burden with power adjustment curve, real time down carries out burden with power adjust automatically to the active setting value of each power station AGC collection control as required automatically for S200, the control net area I computer supervisory control system.Watershed power station side burden with power adjust automatically can be achieved in the present invention, instead of manually Load adjustment Plan Curve, reduces dispatcher and operates the frequency, reduce scheduler routine operating pressure on duty, improves work efficiency and safety, and Load Regulation precision can be improved.
assignees: DADU RIVER HYDROPOWER DEV CO LTD

title_en: Multi-energy collaborative optimization method and system for data center
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for multi-energy collaborative optimization of a data center, and relates to the technical field of optimization of energy systems of the data center. Firstly, acquiring a data network load based on a network load prediction model; then classifying the data network load and determining the priority of the processing sequence; constructing a multi-energy collaborative optimization model of the data center based on a data center comprehensive energy system comprising a waste heat recovery unit; and finally, solving the multi-energy collaborative optimization model, and optimizing the data center based on the solution result. The invention realizes the collaborative optimization scheduling of data network load and various energy sources in the data center, realizes the cascade utilization of energy, simultaneously recycles the waste heat resources of the data center, reduces the energy consumption of the data center and improves the energy utilization efficiency.

title_en: Cascading failure risk key line identification method based on graph neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascading failure risk key line identification method based on a graph neural network, which comprises the steps of collecting historical power grid operation data; confirming the cascading failure risk grade after each line is shut down through cascading failure simulation; constructing a graph topology by using power grid topology data, constructing node characteristics by using loads, new energy predicted values and power generation plans, constructing edge characteristics by using power grid flow data, and using cascading failure risk types after each line is disconnected as edge labels of each line; training the model using the Adam algorithm; collecting power grid operation data in real time every 15 minutes, constructing graph topology, node characteristics and edge characteristics, inputting the graph topology, the node characteristics and the edge characteristics into a trained graph neural network, and obtaining a cascading failure risk grade of each line, wherein the line with the highest grade is a cascading failure risk key line; the method solves the technical problems that the traditional weak line identification method is difficult to meet the real-time requirement in the fault development analysis process and the like.

title_en: Multi-scale direction sensing SAR target detection method based on global information fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-scale direction sensing SAR target detection method based on global information fusion, which mainly solves the problems of low detection precision and efficiency caused by insufficient global information and insufficient direction sensing characteristic extraction in the existing SAR target detection method. The implementation scheme includes the steps of obtaining a training sample set and a testing sample set of SAR images, constructing a multi-scale direction sensing SAR target detection network comprising two feature extractors and detection heads, training a target detection network model through back propagation iteration by using the training sample set, and inputting the testing sample set into the trained network model to obtain a target detection result. The first feature extractor designed by the invention utilizes a bidirectional attention mechanism to extract the direction and position information of an object, so that the object has stronger robustness under different target postures and angles, and the second feature extractor designed by the invention realizes the organic fusion of global and local features, ensures the improvement of target detection efficiency and can be applied to environment monitoring and disaster assessment.

title_en: New energy battery fire disaster rapid inhibition system and preparation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a new energy battery fire fast inhibition system and a preparation method thereof, wherein the new energy battery fire fast inhibition system comprises a microcavity array module, a carbon nanotube anode is electrically connected with a high-voltage pulse generator, a graphene cathode film and the carbon nanotube anode are arranged at intervals in parallel, a vacuum maintenance system module is coated with a Zr  84 V 10 Fe 6  getter on the side wall of a microcavity, the thickness of the vacuum maintenance system module is 15+/-2 mu m, a temperature control triggering module comprises an LSPR temperature sensor, a high-voltage pulse generator and an FPGA controller, the LSPR temperature sensor is attached to the inner cavity surface of the microcavity array module, when the detection temperature is more than 80 ℃, the FPGA controller triggers high-voltage pulses, the FPGA controller calculates a thermal runaway propagation model in real time based on an LSTM neural network, the precision is more than 95%, the high-voltage pulse generator outputs 0-5kV adjustable pulses, and the response time is less than or equal to 0.8ms. The invention breaks through the physical limit of the traditional fire extinguishing technology, realizes the response speed of <1ms level, constructs a three-dimensional fire extinguishing network, and achieves the free radical clearance of 99.9%.

title_en: Facility system capacity assessment method considering internal coupling relation and cascade failure
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of protection engineering, in particular to a facility system capacity assessment method considering internal coupling relation and cascade failure, which comprises the following steps of S1, modeling a facility system based on a complex network theory; S2, constructing a facility system capacity evaluation calculation model considering internal coupling relations and cascade failures, S3, simulating the propagation of the cascade failures based on point failures and the propagation of the cascade failures based on edge failures in the facility system capacity evaluation calculation model, S4, and obtaining the functional level of the facility system through the evaluation calculation model based on system functional association according to simulation results. According to the invention, the functional level of the facility system is calculated through the evaluation calculation model based on the system functional association, so that an accurate evaluation result is obtained.
assignees: RES INSTITUTE FOR NATIONAL DEFENSE ENGINEERING OF ACADEMY OF MILITARY SCIENCE PLA CHINA

title_en: Apparatus, system and method for propagating the traffic emergency using sensor network
title_ko: 위급상황 발생 지점의 예측 거리 표시가 가능한 센서네트워크를 이용한 교통 위급상황 전파 장치, 시스템 및방법
abstract_en: An apparatus, a system and a method for notifying a traffic emergency using sensor network are provided to have a sensor node installed in a vehicle and a sensor located on a road to prevent accidents by informing other drivers behind an accident site about the accident in real time. A system for notifying traffic emergency by using a sensor network grasps a direction of a vehicle by using a reference node number of a reference message, and maintains and manages an indication value of the direction of the vehicle(S710). A node installed in a vehicle senses an urgent brake operation or other emergency operations in the vehicle and generates an emergency message after recognizing an emergency situation(S720). A controller of the node installed in the vehicle determines the delivery distance of the emergency message after receiving the speed of the vehicle from speed measuring unit(S730). The controller of the node installed in the vehicle generates and transmits an emergency message including a reference node number, a direction indicating value, and a message delivery distance(S740).
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 도로의 중앙선을 따라 설치되는 센서 네트워크 노드와 차량내 노드가 센서 네트워크를 형성하여, 교통 사고나 기타 위급상황이 발생하였을 때, 도로를 운행 중인 차량들에 즉각적인 경고를 제공하는 센서 네트워크를 이용한 교통 위급상황 전파 장치, 시스템 및 이를 통해 수행되는 교통 위급상황 전파 방법에 관한 것이다. 
     본 발명에 따른 교통 위급상황 전파 시스템은 도로의 중앙선에 설치되어 기준 정보를 송신하는 복수 개의 기준 노드와, 차량에 설치되어 위급상황을 운전자에게 알려주고 후방 차량에게 위급상황을 전파하는 차량내 노드로 구성되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Method for setting contact-priority in emergency situation, apparatus thereof, and recording method thereof
title_ko: 긴급상황에서의 연락우선순위 설정방법, 연락우선순위 처리장치, 및 기록매체
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A contact priority setting method in an emergency situation, a contact priority processing apparatus, and recording medium thereof are provided to efficiently utilize a communication network in an emergency contact system. CONSTITUTION: A contact object person processing unit(240) consecutively sets up a contact priority about a caller between a location of a caller terminal and a location where an emergency situation happens or between a location of the caller and a location of an emergency situation spreading terminal. The contact object person processing unit sets a caller with the set contact priority as a contact object person. A transmitting unit(250) transmits a contact object person information according to a contact priority and the calling number information of a certified contact object person to an emergency situation spreading terminal. [Reference numerals] (210) Reception unit; (220) Verification unit; (230) Authentication unit; (240) Contact object person processing unit; (250) Transmitting unit; (260) Database; (270) Caller identification system; (280) Location information system; (290) Caller terminal; (291) Emergency situation messenger terminal
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 긴급연락체계에서 긴급상황 응답대상자의 연락우선순위 설정방법에 관한 것으로서, 발신자번호표시 시스템으로부터 복수의 발신자단말의 발신자번호정보를 수신하는 단계, 상기 수신한 발신자번호정보를 응답대상자번호정보와 비교하여, 상기 발신자단말의 발신자가 상기 응답대상자인지를 판단하는 단계, 상기 발신자가 상기 응답대상자인 경우, 상기 발신자에 대한 인증절차를 수행하는 단계, 상기 발신자번호정보를 이용하여 위치정보 시스템으로부터 상기 인증절차에서 인증된 발신자의 위치정보를 수신하는 단계 상기 발신자의 위치정보를 이용하여 발신자단말의 위치와 긴급상황이 발생한 위치 사이의 거리, 또는 상기 발신자단말의 위치와 긴급상황전파자단말의 위치 사이의 거리가 가까운 순서대로 상기 발신자에 대한 연락우선순위를 설정하고, 상기 연락우선순위가 설정된 발신자를 연락대상자로 설정하는 단계, 및 상기 연락우선순위에 따른 연락대상자와 상기 인증된 연락대상자의 발신자번호정보를 상기 긴급상황전파자단말에 송신하는 단계를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하며 긴급연락체계의 통신망을 효율적으로 활용할 수 있다.
assignees: REPUBLIC OF KOREA AIR FORCE LOGISTICS COMMAND 83TH INFORMATION AND COMM MAINTENANCE DEPOT

title_en: System for managing and monitoring
title_ko: 인파 관리 및 모니터링 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 인파를 영상촬영하여 영상정보를 생성하는 AI기반 CCTV(110), 영상정보의 전체 이미지프레임을 M×N 크기의 ROI 영역으로 그리드분할하고, 밀집도 적응적인 실시간 군중계수 네트워크 모델을 통해서, ROI 영역의 입력영상을 입력으로 하여 각 ROI 영역별 객체를 인식하여 인구 밀집맵을 산출하는 제1분석을 수행하여 위험 단계를 각각 예측하고, 제1분석에 따른 인구 밀집맵이 미리설정된 기준 인구 밀집맵을 초과하거나 기준 인구 밀집맵에 대해 초과가 예상되는 특정 ROI 영역에 대해 인구 밀집맵을 조절하는 제2분석을 수행하여 특정 ROI 영역에 대해 객체를 인식하여 인파가 급증하는 이상징후를 식별하도록 하는, 인파 식별부(120), 인구 밀집맵에 따른 위험 단계 및 이상징후에 해당하는 위험경고정보를 생성하고, 제2분석에 상응하는 특정 ROI 영역에 해당하는 특정 밀집지역을 집중 관리하는, 모니터링부(130), 및 디지털 사이니지(141)를 통해 위험상황을 전파하고 안전가이드를 제공하도록 하는 현장안내부(140)를 포함하여, 인파가 급증하는 위험상황을 정확하게 파악하여 안전사고를 예방하도록 하는, 인파 관리 및 모니터링 시스템을 개시한다.

title_en: Method and apparatus for propagating public safety multicast and broadcast services among public safety personnel
abstract_en: Public safety user equipment (PS UE) that establishes a first wireless communication channel over a primary network to at least one multimedia multicast or broadcast service management entity and establishes one or more alternative wireless communication channels over one or more alternative networks (310). The public safety user equipment receives at least one multimedia multicast or broadcast service message over the first wireless communication channel (320), Then, the PS UE extracts data contained in the multimedia multicast or broadcast service message and storing the data in a local cache (330). The PS UE receives a cache request from the one or more user equipment over one or more alternative wireless communication channels (340) and then the PS UE transmits the stored data to the one or more PS user equipment (350).

title_en: Method and system for predicting power grid cascading failure set
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for predicting a power grid cascading failure set, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining a basic operation mode tide data file, a transient and medium-long term model data file and a security control strategy configuration file, establishing a secondary system model, and forming a whole-process dynamic simulation input model file; performing multi-entropy index calculation of betweenness correction based on a basic operation mode flow data file to generate a power grid fragile element set; performing iterative sand heap model simulation based on a basic operation mode tide data file to generate an expected critical threshold value of the occurrence of the blackout; generating a steady-state fault sequence set by taking the power grid fragile element set as an initial fault and referring to an expected critical threshold value; injecting a steady-state fault sequence set and a full-process dynamic simulation input model file into PSD-FDS software together, executing full-process dynamic simulation calculation, and outputting secondary system protection action information; and forming a power grid cascading failure set based on the effective cascading failure set and the secondary system protection action information.

title_en: Method and system for field infrared camera deployment, control and site selection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a field infrared camera deployment, control and site selection method and a system, which relate to the technical field of infrared camera application and comprise the following steps: acquiring a digital map and a digital terrain model of an area to be monitored; determining an infrared camera layout area; determining a signal propagation environment in an infrared camera arrangement area, and establishing a field wireless signal propagation model according to the signal propagation environment; calculating the communication distance of the field infrared camera according to the communication parameters of the camera end and the field wireless signal propagation model; and arranging infrared cameras in the infrared camera arrangement area according to the communication distance of the outdoor infrared cameras and the digital terrain model. The invention relates to a field infrared camera distribution and control site selection method and system, which are based on a determined monitoring area and a novel field infrared camera with a wireless networking function, and realize visual distribution and control site selection of the novel field infrared camera by combining topographic data. Therefore, a data wireless recovery network is constructed, and the monitoring timeliness is effectively improved.

title_en: Power system toughness assessment method considering delay cascading failure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating toughness of a power system considering a time delay cascading failure, which comprises the steps of (1) sampling a line failure, setting the line failure as a system initial failure, establishing a cascading failure simulation model frame considering time sampling, (2) establishing a cut load constraint for the frame in the step 1 under each broken line condition according to power grid line and load data, (3) referring to a recovery mode of the power grid after the failure in actual operation, establishing a line failure recovery time model for the frame in the step 1, and establishing a power grid constraint considering a motor climbing rate, (4) sampling a plurality of accident chains, integrating the total load rate of the power grid to change with time, and realizing toughness evaluation for a certain determined power grid under fault impact. The invention can realize the cascading failure typical mode evaluation aiming at the power grid system by taking the development of the cascading failure in time as the purpose, thereby providing reference for the prevention of the power grid cascading failure loss.

title_en: Power distribution network state characterization method based on graph mask reconstruction
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power systems, in particular to a power distribution network state characterization method based on graph mask reconstruction, which comprises the following steps of S1, modeling a topological structure of a power distribution network as an abnormal graph; S2, reconstructing a path through a path mask predictor, S3, reconstructing node attributes through a node attribute mask predictor, and S4, optimizing the model. The power distribution network state calculating method based on the heterogeneous graph mask modeling can accurately model topological relation and state variables of the power distribution network, the model can capture complex graph structures containing semantics, node attributes and edges of a more efficient predictive graph, the state of the power distribution network can be rapidly and accurately calculated through a pre-trained graph neural network model, power distribution topological data of the power distribution network are abstracted into heterogeneous graph structures, and the method has high efficiency, intuitionistic and flexible performance data and higher accuracy in a state estimation task compared with a back propagation network and a convolution neural network.

title_en: Method for evaluating fluctuation defending capacity of cascade hydropower station on new energy source end of power grid
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of multi-energy power system dispatching, and relates to a method for evaluating fluctuation defending capacity of a cascade hydropower station on a new energy source end of a power grid. The technical proposal is as follows: firstly, constructing a reference model with the maximum final energy storage of the cascade hydroelectric dispatching as an objective function, taking the final energy storage of the cascade hydroelectric dispatching solved by the model as a final energy storage control reference value, and then constructing an disturbance optimizing evaluation model with the maximum requirement for regulating the extreme electric quantity for optimizing the defending capability of the target cascade hydroelectric station to the fluctuation of the new energy source end. The framework can be used for analyzing and quantifying the defending capability of the step hydropower on the fluctuation of the new energy source end, and the result can provide guidance for power and electric quantity balance scheduling and planning in extreme weather. The invention makes quantitative evaluation on the defending capability of the cascade hydropower station to the fluctuation of the new energy source end for the first time.

title_en: Construction method based on dynamic evaluation model of petroleum engineering safety risk
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of model construction, in particular to a construction method based on a dynamic risk assessment model of petroleum engineering safety. The method comprises the steps of obtaining geological data of an oil engineering area, carrying out multidimensional sensor deployment on the geological data of the oil engineering area to generate an oil exploitation sensor deployment network, carrying out environment sensing data acquisition based on the oil exploitation sensor deployment network to obtain standard oil exploitation environment acquisition data, carrying out oil exploitation geographic elevation conversion on the standard oil exploitation environment acquisition data to generate oil exploitation geographic elevation data, carrying out multi-level oil exploitation influence evaluation based on the oil exploitation geographic elevation data to generate oil exploitation multi-level influence data. According to the invention, the dynamic sensing and instant response capacity of the petroleum engineering safety risk is improved by carrying out data integration, dynamic monitoring and risk propagation path analysis on the petroleum engineering stage data and carrying out petroleum engineering safety risk assessment.

title_en: Filling station equipment monitoring system and method based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of monitoring of gas station equipment, in particular to a gas station equipment monitoring system and method based on the Internet of things; the method comprises the steps of collecting multidimensional operation parameters of equipment and node dynamics of business flow in real time, constructing a bidirectional coupling graph model of equipment and business, extracting high-order characteristics of physical association and business logic interaction between the equipment by utilizing a graph convolution network, predicting equipment fault risks by adopting a dynamic health scoring mechanism, backtracking a risk propagation chain by combining an attention mechanism, mapping multidimensional data into interpretable fault diagnosis information by an abnormal semantic generation network, introducing a double-layer reinforcement learning game mechanism, coordinating equipment maintenance and risk suppression strategies in an inner layer, and integrating business efficiency and safety targets in an outer layer to generate optimization actions such as resource scheduling, oil allocation and the like to form a perception-diagnosis-decision closed loop. The invention realizes full-time sensing of the equipment state, active fault early warning and cross-domain collaborative optimization, and remarkably improves the operation and maintenance efficiency and safety of the gas station.

title_en: Construction environment abrupt change risk field prediction method fusing geological meteorological data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a construction environment abrupt change risk field prediction method for fusing geological meteorological data, which belongs to the technical field of construction engineering risk prediction and comprises the steps of obtaining geological data, meteorological data and construction progress data of a construction area, and generating graph data containing multi-modal characteristics after structuring the multi-modal heterogeneous data. The invention adopts the space-time self-adaptive graph neural network prediction model based on the attention mechanism, can dynamically calculate and distribute weights of different characteristics according to the real-time environment and construction data, and captures the space-time propagation relationship of risks among geographic nodes by utilizing the message transmission mechanism of the graph. The method can deeply fuse data of different modes, realizes accurate prediction of abrupt change risk of construction environment, triggers corresponding early warning according to the risk level, improves the accuracy and timeliness of risk prediction, and provides scientific support for intelligent decision of construction engineering.

title_en: Method for predicating output power of photovoltaic power generation system based on BP (Back Propagation) neural network model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for predicating the output power of a photovoltaic power generation system based on a BP (Back Propagation) neural network model. The method comprises the following steps of selecting influencing factors of the output power of the photovoltaic power generation system; generating input vectors according to the historical data of the selected influencing factors, and utilizing the historical data of the output power of the corresponding photovoltaic power generation system as output, thereby obtaining training samples; training a BP neural network by utilizing the training samples, thereby obtaining the trained BP neural network; generating test input vectors according to real data at the to-be-predicated moment of the selected influencing factors, inputting the test input vectors into the trained BP neural network, so that the output is the predicted value of the output power of the photovoltaic power generation system at the to-be predicated moment. According to the method for predicating the output power of the photovoltaic power generation system, modeling prediction is performed; the invention provides a predication method based on the BP neural network; the favorable nonlinear function approximation capability of the BP neural network is utilized, so that the precision and generalization capability of a prediction model are improved.

title_en: A kind of photovoltaic power generation power prediction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of photovoltaic power generation power prediction methods, include the following steps:S1 obtains data, and the historical data of all photovoltaic generation powers and corresponding meteorological data are read from system database;Each data variable in data set is normalized (- 1,1) S2 data predictions;S3 establishes prediction network model;S4:Training pattern is trained model using error back propagation training method according to pretreated sample data;S5:Test and assessment models;S6:Preservation model will be saved in by testing, assessing qualified model in computer ROM bit cell in step S5;S7:Predict that the predicted value of photovoltaic generation power is calculated in photovoltaic generation power, the photovoltaic power generation power prediction model preserved from invocation step S6 in computer ROM bit cell.

title_en: Method and system for analyzing forest fire cascading failure risk of power transmission line of power grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for analyzing forest fire cascading failure risks of a power transmission line of a power grid, wherein the method comprises the following steps: establishing a virtual topology of the power transmission line of the power grid according to the power transmission line database and the map database of the power grid; determining a tidal current limit value of each power transmission line according to the heat capacity limit of each power transmission line, and establishing a corresponding relation between tidal current and load on each power transmission line; calculating the mountain fire trip probability of each power transmission line, and calculating the trip probability of the corresponding power transmission line: when the power flow of the tripped power transmission line is transferred to other power transmission lines, the load needs to be cut off when the power flow of other power transmission lines does not exceed the power flow limit value of the other power transmission lines; and combining the mountain fire trip probability of each power transmission line and the total load shedding amount of the power grid as risk evaluation indexes of mountain fire cascading faults of the power transmission lines of the power grid. The method can predict the risk of each power transmission line to the power grid due to the cascading failure caused by the forest fire.
assignees: State grid hunan electric power co ltd;STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD DISASTER PREVENTION & MITIGATION CT;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Power system state estimation method combining particle filtering and convolutional neural network
abstract_en: The invention provides a power system state estimation method combining particle filtering and a convolutional neural network, which comprises the following steps: an off-line learning part measures fusion data by using a historical RTU/PMU, analyzes probability distribution of system injection power, generates a training sample by using Monte Carlo sampling through a Bayesian estimation-based particle filter algorithm, and trains a convolutional neural network; and the online state estimation part is used for preprocessing the real-time PMU measurement data, establishing a network according to a convolutional neural network structure and a weight value obtained from the training of the offline learning part, and then completing the state estimation of the power system through forward calculation and backward propagation. Compared with the Newton method iterative algorithm of the traditional least square estimation, the method can effectively improve the calculation speed and improve the precision and the robust capability of state estimation.
assignees: UNIV WUHAN;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST OF STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Product supply chain risk propagation method based on complex network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a product supply chain risk propagation method based on a complex network, which comprises the following steps: firstly, the method comprises the following steps: constructing a complex product collaborative network: the method comprises the steps that a complex product collaborative network is constructed according to the collaboration among enterprises in the complex product collaborative network process, a supply chain network is divided into four levels, the collaboration exists between the upper level and the lower level from a part supplier, a part supplier and a first-level supplier to a main manufacturer from top to bottom, a single enterprise can be associated with a plurality of enterprises on the upper layer or the lower layer, and the cross-level collaboration does not exist among different levels; secondly, constructing a complex product cooperation mechanism network risk transfer model: describing by adopting a load-capacity model in the cascade failure, introducing a concept of supply chain risk flow, leading the node to be attacked and failed, and terminating the cascade failure process until no other overloaded enterprises or the whole network are paralyzed in the whole complex product cooperative network after the load is redistributed; and thirdly, simulating cascade failure.

title_en: Method for identifying key node set of shield machine cutterhead production supply chain network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for identifying a key node set of a supply chain network for shield machine cutterhead production, and belongs to the technical field of supply chain risk propagation. According to the method, a complex network model of a shield machine cutterhead production supply chain is established, a proper propagation model is selected to simulate and analyze a risk propagation process in the shield machine cutterhead production supply chain network, a key node set in the shield machine cutterhead production supply chain network, namely a node set with the largest risk propagation, is identified by using a deep reinforcement learning method, and a function of protecting risks in the shield machine production process in advance is achieved. According to the method, the complex modeling is carried out on the shield tunneling machine cutterhead supply chain network, the CML propagation model is applied to simulate the risk propagation condition, the property of the supply chain network can be analyzed, the importance of the node set is rapidly measured through the propagation result, the key node set on the network is identified through the maximum propagation influence range, and the method provides favorable support for risk protection on the shield tunneling machine cutterhead supply chain network.

title_en: Cascade hydropower station power generation risk benefit balanced scheduling method based on forecast runoff correction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascade hydropower station power generation risk benefit balance scheduling method based on forecast runoff correction, which comprises the steps of providing an improved orthogonal mode decomposition method IVMD for effectively reducing the runoff forecast error, constructing a prediction model of the runoff forecast error based on a long-short term memory network LSTM, and correcting the forecast runoff; simulating the scheduling operation of the cascade hydropower station based on the corrected forecast runoff, counting a risk error sequence of insufficient generated energy, quantifying the risk of insufficient generated energy of the cascade hydropower station based on the VAR, and establishing an association relation between the risk of insufficient generated energy and the forecast runoff and hydropower station decision; and constructing an optimized scheduling model with balanced power generation risk benefits by taking minimum risk of insufficient power generation and maximum power generation as targets, and making a power generation plan of the cascade hydropower station. The invention effectively ensures the completion rate of the power generation plan of the cascade hydropower station by reducing the uncertainty of the runoff forecast and optimizing the scheduling decision.

title_en: Typhoon cascading waterlogging sensitivity assessment method and system for coastal water network area
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a typhoon cascading waterlogging sensitivity assessment method and system for a coastal water network area, wherein the method comprises the steps of dividing a target area into sub-watershed areas, and dividing a water network grid by combining the target area and the sub-watershed areas; the method comprises the steps of obtaining index data of a sub-river basin, calculating rain Hong Chao coupling sensitivity based on the index data, dynamically weighting the rain Hong Chao coupling sensitivity, calculating a comprehensive sensitivity index, defining encountering indexes of grid indexes in a water network grid, calculating the sensitivity index based on the encountering indexes, dynamically weighting the sensitivity index, calculating a rain Hong Chao encountering sensitivity index, and generating a sensitivity evaluation graph of a target area by spatial superposition based on the comprehensive sensitivity index and the rain Hong Chao encountering sensitivity index.
assignees: THE ARCHITECTURAL DESIGN & RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF ZHEJIANG UNIV CO LTD

title_en: Engineering supply chain risk conduction analysis system and method based on graph neural network
abstract_en: The invention provides an engineering supply chain risk conduction analysis system and method based on a graph neural network, which are used for acquiring supply chain operation data from supply chain nodes of multiple levels, constructing a graph structure model among the supply chain nodes according to the operation data, identifying and quantifying the association relation among the nodes, simulating the occurrence of risk events of the supply chain nodes on the graph structure model, calculating the probability and influence value of risk propagation from the occurrence node to other nodes based on the graph structure model, identifying a main risk propagation path, detecting an abnormal subgraph mode in the risk propagation process of the graph structure model by using a Motif abnormality detection module, carrying out representation learning and association prediction on the graph structure model by using a self-supervision graph neural network, mining potential hidden risk association, and automatically identifying a hidden high-risk link and a key propagation path by constructing a multi-level supply chain association graph and introducing risk disturbance simulation.

title_en: Distributed blocking processing method, device and equipment for power distribution network
abstract_en: The application relates to a distributed blocking processing method, a distributed blocking processing device, computer equipment, a computer readable storage medium and a computer program product. The method comprises the steps of inputting the example data of the power distribution network during operation into a target distributed blocking processing model, and carrying out data analysis on the example data through the target distributed blocking processing model to obtain a power distribution network distributed blocking processing result. The target distributed blocking processing model is obtained by carrying out model optimization on an initial distributed blocking processing model based on a target cascade analysis algorithm, the initial distributed blocking processing model is obtained by carrying out model coupling on a power distribution network double-layer model through the target cascade analysis algorithm, and the power distribution network double-layer model is obtained by constructing power distribution network parameters based on a power distribution network. By adopting the method, the regulation and control requirement of the blocking phenomenon of the power distribution network can be met efficiently.

title_en: Space-time self-adaptive power prediction system and method for mountain area distributed photovoltaic power generation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a space-time self-adaptive power prediction system and a space-time self-adaptive power prediction method for mountain area distributed photovoltaic power generation, in particular to the technical field of fault prediction and health management, which are used for solving the problems that in the prior art, the accuracy of power prediction and equipment health state assessment is affected due to the fact that environmental characteristic data reconstruct benchmark drift is caused by equipment performance attenuation; the method comprises the steps of constructing a space-time data sequence by acquiring historical data of a photovoltaic unit, constructing a space-time correlation network of power generation among devices and evaluating the performance stability of a reference device group, analyzing a performance attenuation space-time mode to identify common characteristics and individual characteristics when the stability does not meet the conditions, analyzing a propagation path of the performance attenuation on the space-time correlation network based on characteristics, evaluating critical points, performing reference correction on environmental characteristic data by utilizing the common characteristics and the critical points, and finally performing power generation prediction and device health state evaluation by using the corrected environmental characteristic data, thereby realizing the improvement of prediction accuracy and health management reliability.
assignees: STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD QIMEN COUNTY POWER SUPPLY CO;MATERIAL CO OF STATE GRID TIBET ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Flashover analysis tool
abstract_en: According to the present invention, there is provided a method to minimize human intervention during decision making process while controlling the electrical power system by identifying the initiating element that cause a tripping of the transmission overhead lines and capable of identifying the potential future protection system failures that can initiate a cascading of tripping or total national blackout. A method of producing flashover analysis signal as a protection system analysis comprising processing a neutral current (7), three phase current profile (4, 5, 6), three phase voltage profile (1, 2, 3), and a plurality of digital signal (8) of a transmission line using an artificial neural network to calculate pickup time, reset time, DEF confirmation time or total fault clearance time. A method of producing flashover analysis signal comprising as a flashover signature analysis (50) to identify the cause of the flashover as a current transformer explosion (39), tree encroachment (41 ), crane (44), lightning strike (47) or polluted insulator (46).
assignees: TNB RES SDN BHD;UNIV MALAYSIA TECH;ABDUL KARIM SAZALI;MOHD ZIN ABDULLAH ASUHAIMI

title_en: APSO-BP-based double-counterweight-disc automatic balance control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an APSO-BP (active power generation-back propagation) -based automatic balance control method for a double-counterweight plate, which combines a BP neural network, fully utilizes balance data of each time, fits and optimizes balancing parameters and realizes automatic balance control. The input parameters are the initial positions A1 and B1 of the two balance blocks, the rotating speed N and the unbalanced force The optimization objective is the system vibration response The optimal output is the target positions A2, B2 of the two weights. On the premise that initial positions, rotating speeds and initial values of system vibration response are obtained, a BP neural network is used for fitting system vibration values, and optimization is carried out by combining self-adaptive particle swarm to obtain the optimal target positions of the two balancing weights. The particle swarm can be optimized by utilizing an improved method for adaptively adjusting the weight value according to the fitting input-output relationship of the neural system, so that the global optimization is facilitated, the convergence speed is accelerated, and the control accuracy of the automatic balancing system and the data validity are improved.

title_en: Power distribution network flexibility assessment and resource allocation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network flexibility evaluation and resource allocation method and system, which are characterized in that characteristics presented under different time scales are considered in the operation process of a power distribution network, a corresponding operation scene set is obtained by respectively solving a specific uncertainty method, then respective flexible capacity models are built by comprehensively considering multi-type flexible resources such as a micro gas turbine, an energy storage device and a demand response load, finally a flexible resource optimization allocation method combining planning and operation is designed, decoupling and information transmission of a planning layer and an operation layer are realized by adopting a target cascading method, and multi-type flexible resource allocation is realized under the condition that flexible supply and demand balance is met through repeated iteration.

title_en: Power grid operation decision analysis method, system and equipment based on machine learning
abstract_en: The invention provides a power grid operation decision analysis method, a system and equipment based on machine learning, which relate to the technical field of data processing, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining historical power grid operation data; the method comprises the steps of building a trend increment module, building an improved autoregressive model with a multi-layer gating circulation unit, connecting the trend increment module and the improved autoregressive model in parallel to obtain a fusion prediction model, training the fusion prediction model, carrying out super-parameter optimization with a minimum loss function as a target, obtaining real-time power grid operation data, inputting the real-time power grid operation data into the trained fusion prediction model, outputting a power prediction sequence, determining an error propagation coefficient which is positively correlated with the prediction duration of the fusion power feature sequence, calculating the total power scheduling amount within a preset duration by combining the error propagation coefficient and the instantaneous power demand, and carrying out power scheduling according to the instantaneous power demand and the total power scheduling amount. The error propagation influence in the prediction process is reduced, and the prediction accuracy is improved.

title_en: Intelligent verification method for multidimensional scene perception
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent verification method for multi-dimensional scene perception, which comprises the steps of obtaining service data, edge computing environment information and network state information of a power supply station, constructing a multi-dimensional scene feature vector, constructing a meta-confidence coefficient model based on the multi-dimensional scene feature vector by adopting a feature progressive strategy, generating initial confidence coefficient, decision advice and decision context information of an edge computing result based on the meta-confidence coefficient model, receiving cloud verification results, constructing a timing memory module and an error propagation diagram by combining the decision context information, generating a verification feedback optimization instruction and predictive feedback buffer data, updating the meta-confidence coefficient model based on the verification feedback optimization instruction and the predictive feedback buffer data, and executing a final decision by combining the initial confidence coefficient and the decision advice to generate a service execution report. The invention solves the problems of cold start and asynchronous verification inefficiency through a characteristic progressive structure and a predictive feedback buffer mechanism.

title_en: Water-electricity coupling system toughness assessment method considering drought risk evolution
abstract_en: The invention discloses a toughness evaluation method of a water-electricity coupling system considering drought risk evolution, and relates to the technical field of water-electricity coupling systems. The method comprises the steps of S1, modeling a water-electricity coupling system network, S2, modeling drought risk propagation of the water-electricity coupling network based on seepage, and S3, performing system simulation and toughness assessment on the water-electricity coupling system network based on the two models. According to the method, a heterogeneous weighted double-layer network model is built, a trans-scale dynamics modeling method is developed, a seepage theory and physical flow are dynamically combined, a disaster cascade propagation bi-directional seepage equation is built, a toughness assessment framework based on the seepage theory is provided, the laws of different coupling effects of the hydro-electric system are revealed, and scientific basis can be provided for risk assessment, toughness improvement and emergency management strategy formulation of key infrastructure.

title_en: Charging facility site selection method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a charging facility site selection method and a system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining a preset primary factor and a preset secondary factor of site selection of a charging facility according to expert opinions; determining a causal relationship between a preset primary factor and a preset secondary factor according to the prior knowledge; constructing a Bayesian network model according to a causal relationship between a preset primary factor and a preset secondary factor, and calculating joint probability distribution of each node in the Bayesian network model as the probability of station establishment rationality of the node position; verifying the constructed Bayesian network model by adopting sensitivity analysis and propagation analysis, generating a first-level factor influencing site selection of the charging facility, and judging whether a preset first-level factor is consistent with the first-level factor influencing site selection of the charging facility; and if the maximum joint probability of each node in the Bayesian network model is consistent with the maximum joint probability of each node in the Bayesian network model, selecting the position of the first-choice station, and synthesizing uncertainty factors in the actual site selection process based on the Bayesian network model, so that the method has practicability and guidance for site selection of charging facilities.
assignees: GLOBAL ENERGY INTERCONNECTION RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID EV SERVICE CO LTD;STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Wind power prediction method based on DE-BP neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind power prediction method based on a DE-BP neural network, which is implemented according to the following steps: step 1, acquiring and processing wind power related data; step 2, adjusting the weight and the threshold of the BP neural network by using a gradient descent method and back propagation, and establishing the BP neural network; step 3, searching the optimal values of the initial weight and the threshold of the BP neural network established in the step 2 by using a DE algorithm to obtain a DE-BP neural network model; and 4, using the DE-BP neural network model for wind power prediction to predict the wind power. The wind power prediction method based on the DE-BP neural network solves the problems that the prediction method in the prior art is easy to fall into a local optimal value and the convergence rate is too slow.
assignees: UNIV XIAN TECHNOLOGY;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Sub-synchronous oscillation monitoring device point distribution method, device and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a point distribution method, a point distribution device and a point distribution medium of a subsynchronous oscillation monitoring device, and belongs to the technical field of power systems and automation thereof. The proportion of wind power access in a power system is continuously increased, the risk of subsynchronous oscillation of a power grid is continuously increased, and a subsynchronous oscillation monitoring device needs to be configured in the power grid to effectively inhibit the dispersion of oscillation. According to the method, a new energy grid-connected point with low grid-connected short circuit ratio is obtained through off-line calculation based on power grid mode data, secondary and super current components are respectively injected into each station side and a power grid side, and the propagation characteristic of secondary synchronous oscillation in the power grid is obtained, so that key nodes strongly related to the secondary synchronous oscillation in the power grid are identified, and a monitoring device is configured. The invention comprehensively considers the local weak nodes of the new energy grid connection and the sub-synchronous oscillation propagation characteristics, provides a distribution scheme of the oscillation monitoring device, gives consideration to the economic efficiency of the monitoring system and ensures the capability of the power grid to deal with the sub-synchronous oscillation risk.
assignees: STATE GRID NARI NANJING CONTROL SYSTEM CO LTD;EAST CHINA BRANCH OF STATE GRID CORP OF CHINA

title_en: Optimized scheduling method, device, equipment and medium for cascade water wind-solar complementary system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of optimal scheduling of power systems, in particular to an optimal scheduling method, device, equipment and medium of a cascade water wind-light complementary system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: establishing constraint conditions of step water wind-solar complementary system scheduling, wherein the constraint conditions comprise: electric power characteristic constraint, hydraulic characteristic constraint and water-electricity coupling characteristic constraint of the cascade hydropower station, and water-wind-light coupling characteristic constraint and output characteristic constraint of the cascade water-wind-light complementary system; according to constraint conditions, taking the maximum sum of the medium-long-term scheduling effect and the short-term scheduling effect of the cascade water-wind-solar system as an objective function, and constructing a cascade water-wind-solar complementary system scheduling model; and solving the scheduling model by using a linearization method to obtain an optimized scheduling result. According to the invention, a step hydroelectric-wind power-photovoltaic complementary system power generation scheme meeting the constraint can be provided, the overall utility of the system is improved, the waste wind and the waste light are reduced, the resource integration of a new energy power generation system is realized, and the safe and stable operation of a power grid is ensured.
assignees: UNIV HOHAI;YALONG RIVER HYDROPOWER DEV CO LTD

title_en: Multi-dimensional state monitoring method for sewage treatment equipment based on cascade long-term and short-term memory neural network
abstract_en: A sewage treatment blower state monitoring method based on a multidimensional cascade neural network belongs to the field of urban sewage treatment and equipment management. Aiming at the problem that the multidimensional state of the blower for urban sewage treatment cannot be monitored efficiently at present, the invention designs a model for monitoring the state of the blower for sewage treatment based on a multidimensional cascade neural network, thereby realizing the efficient monitoring of the multidimensional state of the blower in an urban sewage treatment plant; the result shows that the prediction model can rapidly and accurately monitor the multidimensional state of the blower, has higher state prediction precision, and ensures the safe and stable operation of equipment of a sewage treatment plant.

title_en: Modeling and risk assessment method and system for cascading failure of power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a modeling and risk assessment method and a system for cascading faults of a power system, and relates to the technical field of power system risk assessment, wherein the modeling and risk assessment method comprises the steps of constructing a cascading fault simulation model, determining initial fault conditions, judging whether line power flow overload exists or not, and calculating system power flow and voltage; calculating a node load loss rate based on the node voltage and the line power flow, and evaluating the system load loss rate; and analyzing the influence of different attack combinations on the system load loss rate, and evaluating the risk of cascading failures. Aiming at the problem of simultaneous tripping of the power transmission line under the condition of cascading failure, a cascading failure model is established, a weighted random disturbance mechanism is introduced, the influence of different attack scenes on the power grid is quantitatively analyzed and evaluated, the critical point of the system is obtained, multi-level cooperative protection and fault tolerance measures are provided, the risk resistance and the reliable operation capability of the power grid are obviously enhanced, and the method has important significance in improving the safe and stable operation of the power system.

title_en: Point-to-point marking method and system based on defect-free state change
abstract_en: The invention discloses a point-by-point marking method and a point-by-point marking system based on defect eliminating state change, which relate to the field of association analysis and comprise the following steps: collecting data of a power distribution network, establishing a topology model of the power grid, and analyzing the topology structure change of the power grid in different states; based on a topological model and running state data of a power grid, establishing a correlation model of states among all nodes of the power grid, and analyzing a fault propagation path and an influence range; identifying the influence degree of the fault propagation path analysis node based on the state association model, and marking the key node; and constructing a genetic algorithm optimization model, expressing a node marking scheme as a chromosome in the genetic algorithm, and defining an fitness function to evaluate the quality of the chromosome according to the analyzed node influence degree. According to the invention, by establishing the power grid topology model and the state association model, analyzing the fault propagation path and the node influence degree, designing the genetic algorithm to optimize the key node mark, improving the accuracy of fault identification and processing, and enhancing the running stability and reliability of the power grid.

title_en: Emergency communication optimization method for low-orbit satellite heterogeneous network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency communication optimization method for a low-orbit satellite heterogeneous network. The method comprises the steps of calculating the propagation loss of a communication link in a low-orbit satellite heterogeneous network and the gain in the line array direction, calculating the intensity ratio of a received signal and a signal to interference plus noise of a ground terminal, optimizing the transmitting power of a ground base station to maximize the energy efficiency of the low-orbit satellite and the ground network, solving the optimizing problem of the transmitting power through a continuous convex approximation algorithm, and introducing regularization factors to the optimizing problem of the transmitting power and the limiting condition thereof. According to the invention, the antenna array radiation gains of the satellite base station and the ground base station and the signal transmission path length are respectively calculated, and the energy efficiency maximization of the whole network is realized by adjusting the transmitting power, the beam forming strategy and the resource allocation through an optimization algorithm based on the channel complex impulse response function expression and the path loss characteristic.
assignees: NANJING CHINA SPACENET SATELLITE TELECOM CO LTD

title_en: Power coal blending method based on improved counter-propagating neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent coal blending, and discloses a power coal blending method based on an improved back propagation neural network, which comprises the steps of obtaining coal blending historical data of different furnace types of a power plant and dividing the coal blending historical data into a plurality of categories; preprocessing the coal blending historical data of different furnace types, dividing the coal blending historical data into a training set, a verification set and a test set, training a preset BP model to obtain a basic model, carrying out model test on the basic model, establishing a target model, collecting raw coal information as input of the target model, and outputting a coal charging proportioning scheme with the lowest comprehensive cost after analysis and calculation of the target model. According to the invention, a BP model is optimized by utilizing a dynamic cuckoo search algorithm, a coal proportioning scheme with the lowest comprehensive cost of coal in a furnace is obtained under the influence of factors such as a production process, a boiler design, coal type characteristics and the like, and the problems that the calculated index coefficient is fixed and cannot be further popularized and a global optimal solution cannot be obtained when an exhaustion method is used for obtaining the optimal solution are solved.
assignees: NINGXIA BAOFENG ENERGY GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent analysis and fault intelligent diagnosis method and system for photovoltaic power station
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of fault diagnosis and discloses an intelligent analysis and fault diagnosis method and system for a photovoltaic power station. The method comprises the steps of collecting electrical and environmental data of a photovoltaic power station through a sensor network, transmitting the electrical and environmental data to a data processing unit for preprocessing and standardization, extracting multidimensional features and constructing a feature matrix. And inputting the feature matrix into a multi-scale pulse neural network for fault diagnosis to obtain fault type and position information. And evaluating the fault severity according to the fault result, generating a maintenance scheme, and finally sending the maintenance scheme to the terminal equipment through the management system.
