According to the intelligent fault diagnosis method based on the pulse neural network, the intelligent fault diagnosis system based on the pulse neural network is introduced, and fault propagation analysis, maintenance priority allocation, path planning and resource matching optimization are combined, so that the problems of low fault diagnosis precision and low maintenance resource scheduling efficiency in the prior art are solved, and the operation and maintenance efficiency and the equipment reliability of the photovoltaic power station are improved.
assignees: XIAN THERMAL POWER RES INST CO;HAINAN ZHOUSHINENG PHOTOVOLTAIC POWER GENERATING CO LTD;XIAN TPRI THERMAL CONTROL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power grid fault rapid diagnosis system fusing AI algorithm
abstract_en: The invention provides a power grid fault rapid diagnosis system fused with an AI algorithm, which relates to the technical field of power grid fault diagnosis, and comprises the steps of acquiring three-phase voltage and current data of a power distribution network and real-time output data of distributed photovoltaic, and inhibiting data noise by utilizing a self-adaptive morphological filter so as to extract fault characteristic data under photovoltaic disturbance; and analyzing the fault propagation relationship among all nodes in the power distribution network topological structure by combining a graph neural network with causal reasoning enhancement to generate a fault tracing path. Therefore, the accuracy of fault feature extraction under the photovoltaic disturbance environment can be effectively improved, meanwhile, the precision and the efficiency of fault tracing and positioning are improved, and quick and accurate power grid fault diagnosis is facilitated, so that the operation safety and reliability of the power distribution network are guaranteed.
assignees: JIANGSU ZHENGTU ELECTRIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Searching method suitable for cascading failure chain containing direct current system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a searching method suitable for a cascading failure chain of a direct current system, which belongs to the technical field of power systems and comprises the steps of S1, preparing early-stage data and converting formats, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting full basic data of a power grid and uniformly converting multi-format data, S2, constructing an accident chain model with non-direct current characteristics, S3, setting failure searching constraint and termination criteria, including limiting a searching range and defining an accident chain termination criterion, S4, dynamically iterating to search the cascading failure chain, S5, screening and verifying a high-risk failure chain, and S6, outputting a searching result. The method is suitable for the searching method of the cascading failure chains of the DC system, achieves the screening of high-risk chains by calculating the risk values and simulation verification, and finally outputs the failure chain evolution diagram and the risk parameter table, so that the high-risk cascading failure chains in the AC-DC series-parallel power grid can be accurately positioned, clear failure evolution paths and risk parameters are provided for power grid dispatching personnel, scientific prevention and control strategies are assisted to be formulated, and the occurrence probability of blackout accidents is effectively reduced.
assignees: KAIFENG POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Attention mechanism-based environmental risk early warning method and system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence early warning, and provides an environmental risk early warning method and system based on an attention mechanism, which are used for improving the accuracy and pertinence of environmental risk early warning. The method comprises the steps of dividing multi-dimensional environment risk characteristics with labels through a hierarchical structure to obtain multi-level risk characteristics, determining updating weights, adjusting hierarchical parameters of an initial pyramid network to construct an environment risk early warning pyramid network, embedding attention gates and feature cross models in each hierarchical network, matching environment monitoring data to be processed to corresponding hierarchical networks according to types, extracting key risk characteristics through the attention gates, mining nonlinear association through the feature cross models to obtain a risk characteristic matrix fused with multi-dimensional association information, inputting a time sequence cascade prediction model to conduct progressive reasoning to generate an environment risk conduction reasoning graph, and combining the hierarchical weights and risk node association assignment to generate a hierarchical risk early warning result.
assignees: BEIJING CHAOYANG ENV GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Power grid fault risk positioning method, device, equipment and medium based on energy margin
abstract_en: The application discloses a power grid fault risk positioning method, device, equipment and medium based on energy margin, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining basic energy margin of each node in a power grid according to power grid operation data; the method comprises the steps of correcting a basic energy margin based on a hybrid neural network of a long-term memory network and a reverse propagation network to obtain a corrected dynamic energy margin, constructing a graph neural network according to a power grid topology, determining node characteristics of the graph neural network based on the dynamic energy margin to generate vulnerability scores of all elements in the power grid based on the graph neural network, constructing a two-dimensional risk assessment matrix according to the dynamic energy margin and the vulnerability scores, and judging risk grades of all elements in the power grid to perform risk positioning. The method and the system can improve the instantaneity and accuracy of power grid fault risk positioning.

title_en: Control federation for utility grids
abstract_en: In one embodiment, a federation device receives one or more grid control-based signals over a computer network, applies one or more utility grid control policies to the one or more grid control-based signals, and federates the one or more signals and/or the one or more utility grid control policies into one or more federated control-based signals. The federation device then propagates the one or more federated control-based signals to one or more grid-related devices.

title_en: System for propagating messages for purposes of demand response
abstract_en: A system having a utility, a communications intermediary and demand response resources. The utility may be connected to the communications intermediary via a network. The demand response resources may be connected to the communications intermediary via another network. A single dispatch destined for the demand response resources may be sent to the communications intermediary. The dispatch may be disaggregated at the communications intermediary into a multitude of dispatches which may be dispersed to their respective destined demand response resources. The demand response resources may send telemetries to the communications intermediary that aggregates the telemetries into a single telemetry. The single telemetry may be sent to the utility.

title_en: Identification method for critical risk factors and critical risk transmission path of cascade hydropower station based on Bayesian risk network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for identifying key risk factors and a risk transmission key path of a cascade hydropower station based on a Bayesian risk network, and relates to the field of hydraulic and hydroelectric engineering. Based on the Bayes risk network model of the cascade hydropower station, a key risk factor and risk transfer key path identification method is provided, and theory and method support are provided for applying the Bayes risk network model of the cascade hydropower station to risk identification and prevention control. The method is simple and clear, has strong operability, and has important application prospect in risk identification and prevention and control of cascade hydroelectric engineering and similar system engineering of civil engineering by using the Bayesian network.

title_en: Rumor propagation risk analysis method and device, storage medium and computer equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a rumor propagation risk analysis method and device, a storage medium and computer equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring social data of a social network platform user; calculating the effective distance between users according to the social data; obtaining the length of the shortest effective path between users by using the effective distance between users; the propagation risk of the users is analyzed according to the length of the shortest effective path between the users. According to the application, the propagation effective distance between users is quantified by using the user social data of the social platform, so that the shortest length of the effective path between users is determined, and the propagation risk is quantitatively analyzed.

title_en: Power distribution network switch state identification method based on probability map model
abstract_en: The invention provides a power distribution network switch state identification method based on a probability map model, which comprises the following steps: a plurality of interconnected distribution transformers are equivalent to a load group, and a simplified circuit diagram of a physical model of the distribution network is obtained; analyzing the dependency relationship between the voltage correlation among the load groups and the switching state in the power distribution network, and constructing a probability graph model with the voltage correlation and the switching state as nodes; calculating initial probability distribution of each node and conditional probability distribution among the nodes based on historical operation data of the power distribution network, and finishing learning of a probability graph model; analyzing influence propagation among nodes in the probability graph model, and determining necessary observation variables to enable states of the remaining nodes in the network to be inferred through effective traces; and under the condition that necessary observation variables can be observed, the on-off state of the whole power distribution network is obtained through a confidence coefficient propagation algorithm. The method can deduce the running state of the whole power distribution network by using an artificial intelligence algorithm under the condition that partial distribution transformer data are difficult to obtain.

title_en: Toughness assessment method for storage tank facility defense system under multi-disaster coupling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a toughness assessment method of a storage tank facility defense system under multi-disaster coupling, which comprises the steps of obtaining basic information, analyzing safety barrier performance degradation and equipment vulnerability under natural disasters, identifying initial accident scenes and accident expansion possibility, constructing a dynamic Bayesian network to obtain node probability values of all equipment at different time points, assessing system functions according to possible economic losses of a system in a tank area at different time points, assessing system toughness according to the system functions, and drawing a system toughness time-varying curve. Due to the cascade effect of multi-disaster coupling accidents, the performance of the original defense system can be reduced due to natural disasters, so that the toughness of the system is reduced, and the further expansion of the accidents is difficult to resist. By adopting the method, the system toughness assessment at different stages of accident evolution under multi-disaster coupling can be realized, and theoretical basis and decision support are provided for multi-disaster coupling accident prevention and control and defense system optimization.

title_en: Multi-level multi-target cooperative scheduling method and system for cascade hydropower station group
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-level multi-target collaborative scheduling method and system for a cascade hydropower station group, which are characterized in that three levels of a power grid, a cascade, a power station and the like are considered, optimal scheduling models of different scheduling levels of the power grid, the cascade and the power station are respectively built, a nested coupling mechanism among the multi-level scheduling models is provided on the basis, collaborative optimization of different scheduling targets of the power grid, the cascade and the power station is realized through mutual nesting among the different levels, different algorithms are adopted for the different scheduling level models to realize efficient solution of the models, and a future refined scheduling scheme of the cascade hydropower station is obtained. Under the premise of guaranteeing the drainage basin water quantity scheduling requirement and the clean energy consumption requirement, the method realizes the cooperative optimization of the power generation benefit, the thermal power running stability and the running state of the hydroelectric generating set of the cascade hydropower station.

title_en: Simulation method for botnet propagation model analysis and target construction for Internet of things equipment
abstract_en: A botnet propagation model analysis and target construction simulation method for Internet of things equipment comprises the steps of constructing a network topology structure for botnet virus propagation, finding out an Internet of things equipment with weak password holes, acquiring and analyzing equipment firmware, simulating target firmware by using a QEMU simulator through a system level simulation technology on acquired firmware information, simulating a target topology structure, completing propagation reproduction of the botnet, and packing the botnet propagation reproduction into a target. According to the method, through analysis of Mirai propagation processes, functions of resisting restarting, preventing process death and the like of malicious codes are achieved, a QEMU simulator is used for simulating firmware, and a constructed target scene is focused on customization of typical botnet virus simulation and propagation model analysis.

title_en: Flood control dispatching simulation method and system suitable for multistage serial-parallel cascade reservoirs
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood control dispatching simulation method and system suitable for a multistage serial-parallel cascade reservoir, comprising the steps of collecting and arranging basic data; the method comprises the steps of extracting river network water systems, dividing sub-watershed, generating topological structures based on cascade reservoir serial-parallel connection relations, performing standardization treatment, constructing a model based on three layers of nested circulation on the basis of the cascade reservoir topological structure relations, realizing simulation of warehousing flood and flood control calculation processes of the cascade reservoirs step by step from upstream to downstream, simulating cascade reservoir flood control scheduling processes under different schemes through setting schemes, and performing scheme comparison analysis and effect evaluation. According to the invention, the data base plate and the water rain condition monitoring information are fully utilized, the cascade reservoirs with complex series-parallel connection relations such as series connection, parallel connection or series-parallel connection can be adapted, the simulation of the cascade reservoir flood forecasting and flood control scheduling process is realized, reliable guarantee is provided for scientifically and reasonably formulating a cascade reservoir scheduling scheme, and technical support is provided for improving flood control and disaster reduction capability.

title_en: Propagation trend deduction method and system based on multi-agent cooperation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence and discloses a propagation trend deduction method and a propagation trend deduction system based on multi-agent cooperation; the method comprises the steps of constructing a social network environment with a plurality of agents, defining image vectors for the agents, generating a social adjacency matrix, enabling an internal cognitive module of each agent to be responsible for processing internal states of the agents, enabling an external behavior module to define parameterized actions of the agents for interaction with the social network environment and other agents, enabling an embedded vector obtained based on the internal states and external information of the agents to serve as input of a decision model, integrating a social context bias matrix into an attention mechanism of a decision encoder of the decision model to reflect social local atmosphere, generating an internal position based on the embedded vector, and outputting external actions in combination with the social environment to drive propagation simulation and trend deduction. The method has remarkable advantages in the aspects of processing multi-modal information, describing individual heterogeneity and realizing large-scale prospective prediction.

title_en: Process to reduce the probability of large cascading failures in a transmission network
abstract_en: Described is a system for decreasing the frequency of large cascading failures in a transmission network. Based on sensors distributed throughout the transmission network, the system determines if a cascading failure is present in a transmission network. Following determination of the cascading failure, the system activates at least one switch of a plurality of switches distributed in the transmission network in order to switch transmission lines, thereby altering connectivity in the transmission network.

title_en: Static engine and neural network for a cognitive reservoir system
abstract_en: Implementations described and claimed herein provide systems and methods for developing a reservoir. In one implementation, observed data points in a volume along a well trajectory and well logs corresponding to observed data points are received at a neural network. Feature vectors are generated using the neural network. The feature vectors are defined based on a distance between each of the observed data points and randomly generated points in the volume. A 3D populated log is generated by propagating well log values of the feature vectors across the volume. Uncertainty is quantified by generating a plurality of realizations including the 3D populated log. Each of the realizations is different and equally probable. core values are generated from the realizations, and a static model of the reservoir is generated by clustering the volume into one or more clusters of rock types based on the core values.

title_en: Hilbert fractal medium-short wave antenna
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a Hilbert fractal medium-short wave antenna, which belongs to the field of antennas and comprises a radiation part, a grounding grid part and a feed part. The radiation part comprises a metal support rod, a Hilbert fractal structure and a wave trap, so that the original surface current distribution path is cut off, and a cascade inductance is introduced to inhibit the high-frequency skin effect. The grounding grid system is of a double-layer structure, wherein the middle grounding grid intercepts space waves, and the bottom grounding grid is connected with ferrite magnetic beads in series to absorb common mode noise. The feed system is internally provided with a balun and pi-T mixed matching network, and the standing wave ratio is less than or equal to 1.5. The working bandwidth of the antenna is 526.5KHz-28MHz, the interference suppression depth is-35 dB, and the antenna is suitable for portable emergency communication and fixed monitoring stations.
assignees: NO 202 STATION NAT RADIO AND TELEVISION ADMINISTRATION

title_en: Power system energy efficiency test management system and test method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system energy efficiency test management system and a test method. The whole system includes three layers, the first layer is a network management layer, a PXI or IPC/PC104 main control computer is managed in a centralized manner by a server, and an Ethernet local area network is formed by a concentrator and cascaded to other local area networks. The second layer is a measurement and control layer provided with a PXI system or IPC/PC104 system of an embedded controller, serves as a client of a centralized management system, also serves as a main control computer for on-site measurement and control equipment and functions as a gateway. The third layer comprises various monitoring and test equipment units mounted on an operation site of monitored equipment, and the types and the number of the units are determined according to monitoring requirements. Remote energy consumption real-time dynamic monitoring, energy consumption management and energy efficiency analysis work for power equipment at all levels of a power system are realized, and real-time energy management and energy consumption of the power system are realized.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID SHANDONG ENERGY SAVING SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Wind power prediction error interval evaluation method based on TCN
abstract_en: The invention relates to a TCN-based wind power prediction error interval evaluation method, which comprises the steps of obtaining wind power original data, normalizing the wind power original data, and dividing the wind power original data into a training set and a testing set; initializing the weight of the TCN network, and setting parameters of iteration times, the number of residual modules, the number of network layers, expansion coefficients, the size of a convolution kernel, a learning rate and the number of hidden layer neurons; inputting the training set data into the TCN network in a batch mode, calculating the output error of the effective historical length, and reversely propagating the error to update the TCN network parameters; completing training until the TCN network precision meets the artificially given error or reaches the iteration times; test data are input and a prediction result is output, so that real-time error prediction of wind power is realized. Error prediction can be realized by depending on the flexible receptive field and learning ability of the TCN, thereby providing a basis for real-time scheduling.

title_en: Stepped hydroelectric and photovoltaic short-term complementary scheduling method and system with unit as scheduling unit
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a cascade hydroelectric and photovoltaic short-term complementary scheduling method and system with a unit as a scheduling unit, and relates to the technical field of clean energy. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a model for optimizing and scheduling the maximum consumable electric quantity of the cascade water-light complementary system in a short period by taking one day as a scheduling period based on predicted output data of the photovoltaic power station; and carrying out model conversion and solving. Therefore, the unit is taken as the minimum dispatching unit, power station constraint, unit constraint and power grid constraint faced by the complementary system are considered in a refined mode, a short-term optimized dispatching model with the maximum electric quantity consumption capability of the cascade hydroelectric complementary system is established, and the overall electric quantity consumption level and dispatching plan performability of the complementary system are improved through hydraulic and electric redistribution of cascade hydroelectric power.
assignees: QINGHUA SICHUAN ENERGY INTERNET RES INSTITUTE;UNIV QINGHUA;ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INSTITUTE OF SICHUAN PROVINCE ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY OF STATE GRID

title_en: New energy power grid cascading failure prediction method based on machine learning and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a new energy power grid cascading failure prediction method based on machine learning and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps of: constructing a high-ratio new energy power grid cascading failure database based on historical cascading failure actual measurement data and simulation data; extracting characteristic indexes capable of representing complex network topological characteristics and system running states from a macro level, a medium level and a micro level based on a cascading failure database; analyzing the correlation between the extracted characteristic indexes and the system cascading failure operation state, and selecting the characteristic indexes with strong correlation to form a complex network cascading failure characteristic index set; based on a long-term and short-term memory neural network, a mapping relation between a complex network cascading failure characteristic index and a system running state in a historical cascading failure process is learned, and a high-occupancy-ratio new energy power grid cascading failure prediction model is constructed. The method can accurately and quickly predict the cascading failure of the high-proportion new energy power grid, is beneficial to effectively preventing and controlling the cascading failure of the complex-structure power system in the high-proportion new energy form, and improves the safe and stable operation capacity of the power grid.
assignees: STATE GRID XINJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Residential electricity risk assessment method based on large-scale power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a residential electricity risk assessment method based on a large-scale power distribution network, and relates to the field of fusion application of power system analysis and risk assessment theory. 1. Establishing a power system partitioning method aiming at avoiding cascading failures, and determining a partitioning range of a power distribution system; 2. the concept of the claim-free electric quantity risk index is provided, and even if cascading failures occur, the comprehensive loss of a user can be minimized; 3. aiming at inherent diffusion properties of cascading failures, a risk economic index evaluation method of the power system is provided, wherein the risk economic index evaluation method is used for taking risks into account. When a power failure fault occurs, the power grid is partitioned according to the topological structure of the power grid, so that the number of connecting lines among the areas is reduced, and the diffusion path of cascading faults is reduced; the concept of the electric quantity free of claim is put forward, and the comprehensive loss of resident users is reduced; providing a state screening method based on a random matrix, and screening out fault states with the power outage quantity larger than the claim-free electric quantity according to the similarity of the states; the rationality of loss assessment is improved.

title_en: Power data price determining method and device based on neural network and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a power data price determining method, a device and a storage medium based on a neural network, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a value evaluation index of the power data to be processed; inputting a value evaluation index of the power data to be processed into a power data price determining model to obtain the price of the power data to be processed; wherein the power data price determination model is obtained based on the steps of: initializing parameters of a Back Propagation (BP) neural network model based on a value evaluation index of sample power data; optimizing a BP neural network model by using SSA; and determining a power data price determining model based on the optimized BP neural network model. According to the power data price determining method, device and storage medium based on the neural network, the power data price determining model is designed based on the BP neural network optimized by SSA, accuracy of pricing the power data is improved, and power data resource waste is reduced.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING POSTS & TELECOMM;STATE GRID ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD;STATE GRID JILIN ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO;ECONOMIC TECH INSTITUTE STATE GRID JILIN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Power network fault propagation analysis method based on dynamic evolution of fragile community network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power network fault propagation analysis method based on dynamic evolution of a fragile community network, which comprises the following steps: constructing a topological dual network model, a fault concentric circle network and an initial fragile community network, and setting boundary nodes and internal nodes of the fragile communities; constructing a fault chain model, and updating a topology dual network and a fault concentric network; repartitioning the fragile communities, updating the fragile community network, and forming a network evolution fault chain model; setting fault propagation intensity; defining an electrical distance between branches and fault propagation attenuation; setting a field propagation effect; screening a potential recovery node set, and calculating and setting the recovery probability of the potential recovery node; evaluating node vulnerability, and adding nodes with higher vulnerability ranks to a node priority protection set; the method can effectively analyze the vulnerability of the high-order structure of the power grid and the vulnerability of the multidimensional state, is suitable for evaluating the vulnerability of the large-scale complex power grid, and is beneficial to ensuring the safe and stable operation of the power system.

title_en: Network construction energy storage, location and volume selection method for supporting transient stability of high-proportion new energy power grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a network construction energy storage site selection and volume determination method for supporting transient stability of a high-proportion new energy power grid, which comprises the steps of obtaining power grid measurement data, extracting space-time characteristics through segmented Hankel matrix recursion decomposition and dynamic weighted graph decomposition, constructing characteristic tensors through multi-scale tensor fusion, analyzing transient response characteristics based on layered sparse principal component mapping, constructing stability indexes through multi-scale coupling evaluation, obtaining node scores through self-adaptive weight fusion, screening candidate nodes through affinity propagation clustering, evaluating supporting capacity through multi-time scale influence propagation, optimizing capacity configuration through score planning constraint, realizing real-time evaluation based on recursive state estimation, generating response strategies through multi-time scale layered decision, and realizing cooperative control through distributed consistency optimization. The invention effectively improves the transient stability of the high-proportion new energy power grid.
assignees: STATE GRID XINJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO;ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE STATE GRID XINJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Multi-dimensional grid service package gridding configuration and positioning synchronization method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-dimensional grid service package gridding configuration and positioning synchronization method, which relates to the technical field of data processing, and comprises the steps of obtaining a plurality of grid service packages, collecting on-site multi-mode information, carrying out dynamic parameter configuration after determining an operation and maintenance scene, and establishing a plurality of gridding configuration spaces; the method comprises the steps of constructing a configuration evaluation module based on multidimensional evaluation factors, introducing propagation constraint functions, optimizing and optimizing a configuration space by combining the evaluation module, carrying out accurate parameter configuration on a power grid service package based on an optimizing result, and realizing positioning synchronization. The method solves the technical problems of lack of flexibility, insufficient equipment cooperation and slow response of the traditional power grid service package configuration method in the prior art when facing complex operation and maintenance scenes, and achieves the technical effects of improving the operation and maintenance efficiency, resource utilization and emergency response capability of the power grid through power grid service package configuration optimization based on multidimensional evaluation factors.
assignees: BEIJING CHINA POWER INF TECH;NANJING YUNAN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-day electricity price prediction method, system, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure provide a multi-day electricity price prediction method, system, electronic device, and storage medium, which employ a hybrid model combining time series processing advantages of an LSTM network and nonlinear prediction capabilities of XGBoost models to cope with highly nonlinear and time series characteristics of electricity market price, divide an overall prediction task into a plurality of time periods, use a plurality of horizontally cascaded prediction models to take charge of different prediction time period ranges, concentrate each model on electricity price prediction for a specific prediction time period, and select an optimal model to output a final prediction result, which can more sensitively identify abnormal fluctuations in price data, and rapidly react when price fluctuations occur. The method has the advantages that the unique extremum theory and change point analysis are applied, the prediction accuracy and stability of the peak electricity price under the condition of price fluctuation are improved, the frame is simple, the realization and maintenance are easy, and the prediction complexity and cost are reduced.
assignees: HUANENG CLEAN ENERGY RESEARCH INST;HUANENG HENAN CLEANING ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: Equipment manufacturing supply chain risk propagation early warning method based on large language model semantic analysis
abstract_en: A device manufacturing supply chain risk propagation early warning method based on large language model semantic analysis belongs to the field of supply chain risk early warning. The risk propagation probability calculation module accurately calculates risk propagation probability of each node in a supply chain network, comprehensively considers risk propagation probability under forward, reverse, same-direction and same-level transverse situations, outputs node risk probability under dynamic propagation, the risk value determination module extracts associated risk factors from the obtained massive unstructured text data by means of a large language model by combining the output of the risk propagation probability calculation module, builds a risk factor judgment matrix by means of a fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method, integrates a bias correlation analysis method and determines comprehensive evaluation weight of the risk factors, the risk level early warning module establishes DPC-RF algorithm to operate in two stages based on the result of the risk value determination module, initially divides risk level clusters through DPC preliminary clustering, and then determines risk early warning levels of the nodes and generates early warning information by means of an RF model.

title_en: Power system risk assessment method based on hierarchical regional graph neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electronic digital data processing, and discloses a power system risk assessment method based on a hierarchical regional graph neural network, which comprises the steps of dividing a power system into a plurality of regions and constructing a local graph structure for each region; establishing a connection relation among areas to form an area level graph, acquiring multi-source heterogeneous operation data of the power system as input features of corresponding nodes, adopting a graph neural network to learn and aggregate node features in each local graph to obtain area feature representations of the corresponding operation areas, aggregating the area feature representations in the inter-area connection graph based on a graph attention mechanism, fusing risk information, and respectively generating risk assessment results of node levels, area levels and system levels according to the feature representations of the nodes and the areas and the risk information. The problems of layering of an effective area, undefined risk propagation mechanism and lack of multi-level output are solved, and the purposes of multi-source data fusion, multi-level evaluation and dynamic adaptation to topology change are achieved.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG;LINFEN POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID SHANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Clairvoyant type soundproof and fireproof door
title_ko: 투시형 방음문
abstract_en: The present invention takes precautions against fire by construct new skyscrapers, high-rise apartments, and factories, and focuses on development of products supplemented with facilities. The present invention relates to a fireproof door for acquiring a checking window which enables a flame position and a fire propagation state to be recognized at the other side so that an evacuator can easily determine excavation passage. The fireproof door is provided with an inner panel, an outer panel, and a reinforcement material disposed between the inner and outer panels. Moreover, the fireproof door comprises: front and rear reinforcement glass members formed on the fireproof door by forming a perforator on the inner panel and the outer panel; a fixing molding member configured to fix the front and rear reinforcement glass members at four sides; and a coolant (extinguishing liquid) inserted between the front and rear reinforcement glass members.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 초고층빌딩, 초고층아파트, 공장 등이 새롭게 건설됨으로서 화제의한 대비책을 강구 및 시설물을 보충한 제품개발에 역점을 두고 있으며, 그 중에 본 발명은 방화문에 역점을 두고 개발하여 상대쪽에서 화염위치와 전파상태를 알 수 있도록 하여 대피자가 대비통로 등을 쉽게 결정할 수 있는 확인창을 얻기 위한 것이바, 내측판넬과 외측판넬과 상기 내/외측판넬 사이에 보강재를 구비한 방화문에 있어서, 상기 방화문에 내측판넬과 외측판넬 
에 천공구를 형성하여 형성한 전/후방 강화유리부재와 상기 전/후방 강화유리부재를 사면에서 고정하도록 구성된 고정몰딩부재와 상기 전/후방 강화유리부재의 사이에 삽입 구성된 냉각재(소화액 등)를 구성한 특징이 있다.

title_en: Cross-basin hydropower station group peak shaving optimization scheduling method considering water abandoning risk
abstract_en: The invention discloses a peak shaving optimization scheduling method for a cross-basin hydropower station group considering water abandoning risks, which comprises the following steps of: s1, constructing a hydropower station group peak regulation optimization scheduling model; s2, calculating the water abandoning risk of each cascade hydropower station; s3, coordinating and distributing the generated energy of each power station based on the water abandoning risk of each power station; and S4, calculating the optimal solution of the peak regulation optimal scheduling model of the hydropower station group based on the electric quantity distribution of each power station to obtain the output process line of each power station, and finishing the combined peak regulation scheduling of the hydropower station group. The risk of water abandonment of the hydropower station is quantitatively analyzed through runoff frequency, peak shaving electric quantity of different basin hydropower station groups is coordinately distributed based on the water abandonment risk value, the water abandonment risk of each power station can be fully considered, runoff compensation and electric power compensation benefits of the different basin hydropower station groups are brought into play, the risk of water abandonment of hydropower is greatly reduced when a power grid hydropower system peaks shaving, and the electric quantity of water abandonment of hydropower is reduced.

title_en: Electric traffic coupling network vulnerability assessment method based on probability map
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric traffic coupling network vulnerability assessment method based on a probability map, which comprises the following steps: establishing a Bayesian network model of a power distribution network equipment outage event under a typhoon disaster, and predicting the power distribution network equipment outage probability based on a Bayesian network; establishing an alternating current optimal power flow model, analyzing the overload condition of a power distribution network line, and carrying out load shedding on a power system; evaluating the capability of the coupling network for resisting external interference by using a probability graph-based electric traffic coupling network vulnerability evaluation model; the method takes a probability graph as a support, establishes an electric traffic coupling network vulnerability assessment model, and realizes calculation of electric traffic coupling network elasticity measurement; based on historical meteorological data, the method can be used for predicting the cascade fault propagation mechanism of the electric power traffic coupling network under typhoon disasters, ensures the accuracy and rapidity of real-time estimation, and provides theoretical basis for emergency plans under typhoon weather.

title_en: Power network self_organized criticla quantitative evaluating method based on multi-layer variable-weight theory
abstract_en: The invention discloses cascading failure in power system prevention and the power network self_organized criticla quantitative evaluating method based on multi-layer variable-weight theory in defence field, including：It is determined that the key index collection of influence power network self_organized criticla；Determine the self-organized criticality of power network under each running status in sample set；Original physical index set is divided into physical layer and factor layer and based on positive and negative preferable variable-weight theory, in calculating sample set under each running status physical layer index weight；The expression formula and dimension of level of factor are calculated based on principal component analysis, it is ensured that level of factor information is not overlapped；The uniformity judgment matrix and the principal component information representation factor built based on physical layer index weights, calculate the weight of factor layer index；It is input with factor layer index using sum of ranks than comprehensive estimation method, calculates assessed value；Can each factor of comprehensive description to the Influencing Mechanism of power network self_organized criticla, the self-organizing critical condition of qualitative assessment power network, and calculating speed is very fast.

title_en: Communication method and communication device
abstract_en: The application provides a communication method and a communication device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: receiving a registration request from a terminal device, wherein the registration request is used for requesting registration to a first core network device; transmitting first request information to the second core network equipment based on the registration request, wherein the first request information is used for requesting to start disaster roaming; the first core network device is located in a first network, the second core network device is located in a second network, and the first network and the second network share access network devices. The disaster roaming mechanism under the architecture of the shared network is provided, the service interruption time of the terminal equipment is reduced, and the communication reliability is improved.

title_en: SAR image change detection method based on hybrid convolution
abstract_en: The invention discloses a SAR image change detection method based on mixed convolution, which mainly solves the problems that the prior art is difficult to extract the global information of an image and lacks a reliable label training network under the condition of no label, and the scheme is as follows: constructing three-channel input and initial labels; building a graph convolution enhanced convolutional network (GECN) formed by cascading a feature extraction module, a progressive fusion module and a label updating module; training the GECN by using three-channel input and labels; and inputting the tested SAR image into the trained GECN to obtain a change detection result. According to the invention, the multi-scale features of the local and global information of the SAR image are obtained through the feature extraction module, so that the feature extraction capability of the GECN network is improved; more reliable labels are obtained through the label updating module to train the GECN, the generalization performance of the GECN is improved, and the method can be used for urban planning layout, natural disaster assessment and military dynamic reconnaissance.

title_en: System and method for optimizing supply chain of hydrogen distribution network
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates generally to the production, transportation, distribution and storage of hydrogen fuel, and more particularly, to a system and method for optimizing the supply chain of a hydrogen distribution network. The centralized server triggers the production facility to produce gaseous/liquid hydrogen. A centralized server stores the produced gaseous/liquid hydrogen in Liquid Organic Hydrogen Carrier (LOHC) molecules at a storage facility based on hydrogenation of chemicals. The centralized server sends instructions for transporting the hydrogenated LOHC molecules from the production facility to a warehouse with tanker trucks, and the centralized server dehydrogenates the hydrogenated LOHC molecules at low pressure at the warehouse to release hydrogen. The centralized server compresses the released hydrogen at the warehouse and fills the compressed hydrogen into a high pressure pipe trailer/flat tank cascade. The centralized server determines the optimal route of the transport vehicle from the warehouse to the retailer/consumption site and stores the compressed hydrogen gas into the low pressure tank/high pressure buffer tank at the retailer/consumption site. The centralized server outputs information corresponding to the inventory of low pressure tanks/high pressure buffer tanks at the retailer/consumption site.

title_en: SCADA-based gas pipe network operation data transmission system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of gas pipe networks, and discloses a gas pipe network operation data transmission system based on SCADA, which comprises a main dispatching control center and a main dispatching control center, wherein the main dispatching control center is used for data operation and transmission control of a total natural gas station; the sub-dispatching control center is used for assisting in data operation and transmission control of the global total natural gas station and the local natural gas station; and the disaster recovery backup center is used for asynchronously copying and receiving the database data, the file system data, the operating system data and the like after disaster is suffered by the main scheduling control center and the sub scheduling control center. In the invention, after the main dispatching control center stops service, the operation of the disaster recovery center is manually or automatically switched to ensure that the business of the sub dispatching control center is not interrupted. After the service of the main dispatching control center is restored, the main dispatching control center can be manually or automatically switched back, and lost data is returned from the backup center of the sub dispatching center to the main dispatching control center, so that the situations of data loss and service interruption are avoided.

title_en: Power system information physical collaborative attack optimization modeling method for multiple protection cooperation refusal of transformer substation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power systems, in particular to a power system information physical collaborative attack optimization modeling method for multiple protection cooperation refusal of a transformer substation, which comprises the following steps: s1, constructing a transformer substation model and configuration of protection and circuit breakers: describing the configuration modes and the interrelation of relay protection devices and circuit breakers of a transformer substation; s2, cooperating with the attack strategy and the system state change after attack: the network attack and the physical attack are combined to cause refusal of the internal protection device of the power system; s3, constructing an abstract graph model: describing the corresponding relation between the relay protection device and the circuit breaker; s4, modeling short-circuit fault propagation: establishing a mathematical model of short-circuit fault propagation, and describing fault propagation and isolation processes; s5, collaborative attack optimization modeling: and establishing an optimization model of the collaborative attack. The invention is beneficial to improving the protection capability of the power system and the scientificity and effectiveness of coping strategies.

title_en: Building construction fire-fighting detection method and system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building construction fire control detection method and system based on the Internet of things, which relate to the technical field of electric digital data processing and specifically comprise the following steps: dividing the areas and grading the sensitivity of the areas of the building construction sites according to the manual marking results; according to the environmental data collected by the wireless sensor network, node cluster grouping and node energy coefficient calculation are carried out, and leader node election is completed through energy coefficient sequencing; video recording is carried out on the fixed monitoring area to obtain video data, and the video data is sent in real time; establishing an environment data set, calculating according to the D-S model to obtain a confidence level probability model, and carrying out probability screening through a confidence interval to obtain a fire judgment result; processing video data by a frame difference method, extracting image characteristics, and obtaining a fire judgment result according to a back propagation neural network and a fixed threshold detection method; and (5) performing on-site acousto-optic alarm, cloud platform alarm reminding and sending notification to a fire department based on the fire judgment result to complete fire detection and early warning.

title_en: New energy automobile supply chain network risk node identification method, system and equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a new energy automobile supply chain network risk node identification method, a system and equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps of taking a new energy automobile supply chain enterprise as a node, constructing an adjacency matrix, and further constructing a new energy automobile supply chain network; the method comprises the steps of calculating network indexes of all nodes in a network, calculating immune transmission evaluation indexes of all nodes in the network, wherein the immune transmission evaluation indexes are used for reflecting the influence intensity of infection transmission caused by a single node, calculating the survivability indexes of the nodes by simulating attack through traversing the nodes, sequencing the nodes based on the network indexes, the immune transmission evaluation indexes and the survivability indexes, and determining key nodes in the nodes according to sequencing results. According to the method, potential hidden key nodes in the new energy automobile supply chain network can be found through comprehensive and multidimensional fusion risk propagation key node identification, and risk prevention of the new energy automobile supply chain network is optimized.
assignees: JIANGSU ZHIXIN TRACING INFORMATION TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: N/N-1 power flow embedded graph convolution neural network-based operation mode power flow coupling relation characterization method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an operation mode power flow coupling relation characterization method based on an N/N-1 power flow embedded graph convolution neural network, which comprises the following steps of 1) providing a graph convolution forward propagation strategy based on N/N-1 power flow embedded graph convolution, deducing a design graph convolution module forward propagation expression by an N/N-1 power flow physical model, 2) constructing a neural network architecture based on cooperation of a plurality of layers of graph convolution and convolution modules, and 3) training to obtain an operation mode power flow coupling relation model to characterize a power flow coupling relation in an N/N-1 state of a power system. The power flow coupling relation model of the operation mode constructed by the invention can represent the power flow coupling relation in the N/N-1 state with high precision, so that the key problems of fault diagnosis, stability evaluation, optimal control and the like in the power system can be analyzed later.
assignees: UNIV CHONGQING;INST ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCES STATE GRID CHONGQING ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CHONGQING ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Water and electricity weak flexible power grid flood period daily peak regulation and compensation model method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a daily peak regulation and compensation model method for a hydropower weak flexible power grid in a flood season, which comprises the steps of obtaining daily planned load curves, wind power, hydropower and thermal power parameters of the power grid, subtracting the wind power load from the power grid load, updating the residual equivalent loads of water and thermal power, constructing a daily total water rejection minimum model of a cascade power station, subtracting the residual load of the power grid from the water power output, updating to obtain the residual load of thermal power, constructing a total cost minimum model of thermal power, calculating to obtain the output plan of each thermal power unit, compensating the opportunity cost loss and the deep peak regulation caused by shutdown of the thermal power units participating in the deep peak regulation, introducing a peak regulation contribution coefficient to distribute peak regulation benefits, obtaining the compensation amount of each power station, and distributing the deep peak regulation benefits of the deep peak regulation power station. The invention compensates the opportunity cost loss and the depth peak shaving caused by shutdown of the thermal power generating units participating in the depth peak shaving, obtains the compensation amount of each unit, and realizes the depth peak shaving benefit distribution of the depth peak shaving power station.

title_en: Substation foundation settlement prediction analysis system and method based on industrial cloud platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of online monitoring, in particular to a transformer substation foundation settlement prediction analysis system and method based on an industrial cloud platform, the method comprises the steps of establishing a digital grid unit of a three-dimensional space of a transformer substation, collecting real-time working condition data and ground water level data of all equipment in the transformer substation, and predicting and obtaining real-time settlement rate and accumulated settlement of each grid unit; and constructing a double risk propagation network, calculating a settlement risk probability value and a global risk entropy value, and generating a three-dimensional visual maintenance navigation. The method solves the problems of low accuracy of predicting the settlement risk of the transformer substation caused by insufficient integration of multi-source dynamic data and incapability of quantifying time-varying coupling effect of a static load model in the prior art.
assignees: TAIAN ZHONGDING POWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Cascade Transformer fusion method and system based on multi-source heterogeneous geological data
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of geological data, in particular to a cascade Transformer fusion method and system based on multi-source heterogeneous geological data. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a historical paper geological data set and a real-time multi-source geological monitoring data stream, generating a multi-source heterogeneous geological feature set based on the historical paper geological data set and the real-time multi-source geological monitoring data stream, carrying out multi-level feature extraction from coarse to fine and cross-modal attention fusion through a cascading Transformer network based on the multi-level geological data set and the multi-target collaborative optimization calculation based on the multi-level feature extraction from coarse to fine, generating a risk-resource integrated three-dimensional geological model for quantifying disaster risk probability and resource economic value by integrating geological priori knowledge rules, and carrying out optimization of hidden disaster targeting management and resource re-exploitation through a decision mapping engine based on the geological data set, and generating a collaborative optimization engineering scheme set. In the data cascade fusion process, the intelligent level and the comprehensive benefit of geological engineering activities are remarkably improved.

title_en: Landslide hazard prediction method, device, equipment and medium based on machine learning
abstract_en: The application discloses a landslide hazard prediction method, device, equipment and medium based on machine learning, and relates to the field of geological hazard monitoring; the landslide disaster prediction method comprises the steps of distributing corresponding time period feature weights for each environmental monitoring data according to a time period where a first monitoring window is located, fusing various environmental monitoring data according to the time period feature weights to construct fused feature vectors, inputting the fused feature vectors into a landslide displacement prediction model to obtain predicted displacement, and determining landslide disaster prediction results of a to-be-predicted area according to the predicted displacement and a plurality of preset displacement risk thresholds, wherein the landslide displacement prediction model is trained based on an initial displacement prediction model constructed by fusing a long-short-period memory neural network and a reverse propagation neural network. By implementing the landslide disaster prediction method and device, the accuracy of landslide disaster prediction can be improved.
assignees: SOUTH SURVEYING & MAPPING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multiconductor transmission line system analysis method and design method
abstract_en: To enable the analysis of noise characteristics of a multiconductor transmission line system having branches to be easily carried out.SOLUTION: The present invention analyzes the noise characteristic of a multiconductor transmission line system including a plurality of conductor lines 12, 13, each having branches, by using a propagation model in which it is assumed that a noise signal propagates by being multiple reflected between a first terminal network 31 and a second terminal network 32 via a uniform line group 30. The propagation model constitutes the uniform line group 30 by lines 33-39 bridging over between the first terminal network 31 and the second terminal network 32, and the first terminal network 31 and the second terminal network 32 are constituted by terminal elements located on both sides of it, when it is assumed that each of conductor lines 12, 13 is laid so as to reciprocate between the first terminal network 31 and the second terminal network 32, taking a characteristic impedance change position including branches 20, 21 from a parallel-running section 14 as a turnaround point.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Power grid vulnerability analysis method based on reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid vulnerability analysis method based on reinforcement learning, and relates to the technical field of power system safety. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, establishing a reinforcement learning model and a power grid cascading fault model, and simultaneously setting a certain proportion of circuits as key circuits; then, selecting a group of non-key lines in the power grid to be sequentially removed by using a reinforcement learning model according to the state of the power grid cascading fault model, recording the states of the power grid before and after line removal, optimizing parameters of the reinforcement learning model by taking maximum power grid damage as a target, and repeating the steps for a plurality of rounds; and finally, obtaining the attack sequence and the maximum damage which can be caused by sequential attack and can enable the power grid to be damaged to the maximum when part of the key lines cannot be removed. The method fully considers the condition that partial elements of the power grid are additionally protected in the actual scene, and improves the search efficiency of the optimal attack sequence by using the reinforcement learning method.

title_en: Power accident cause analysis method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a power accident cause analysis method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining an accident report of a power accident, extracting a plurality of cause events in the accident report, determining the relation among the plurality of cause events according to the sequence and the occurrence times of the plurality of cause events, constructing an accident cause network, analyzing the importance of network nodes through the topological property of the accident cause network, calculating the cause risk of the power accident by utilizing a cascade failure theory, and generating a risk management and control suggestion, thereby effectively finding the cause special for each type of accident and being convenient for determining the cause playing a larger role in directly triggering the accident. Therefore, the problems that the related technology cannot find the specific key cause of each type of accident, is unfavorable for determining the key cause from the perspective of the direct cause of the accident, does not fully consider the dynamic process of the domino effect, and has insufficient simulation on the actual occurrence process of the accident and the like are solved.

title_en: Baseline load prediction method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a baseline load prediction method, a baseline load prediction device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining historical load data, historical day data and prediction day data determined by indexes, determining principal components in the indexes and corresponding principal component comprehensive scores of a matrix formed by the historical day data by adopting a principal component analysis method improved based on an entropy method, calculating weather similarity of the prediction day and the historical day according to the historical day data and the prediction day data corresponding to the indexes divided by the principal component comprehensive scores, determining a historical day set similar to the prediction day according to the weather similarity and the time similarity of the prediction day and the historical day, and obtaining the prediction day load data according to the historical load data, the historical day set, the weather matrix and the prediction day data by adopting a back propagation neural network. The invention solves the problem of low quality of data obtained by preprocessing the data before the baseline load prediction in the related technology.

title_en: Flexible power grid regulation and control method and system based on wind, light and small hydropower
abstract_en: The application discloses a flexible regulation and control method and a flexible regulation and control system for a power grid based on wind, light and small hydropower stations, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a head loss prediction model according to historical operation data of each hydropower station in the cascade small hydropower stations; the method comprises the steps of constructing a target hydropower prediction model by using a photovoltaic power generation prediction model and a wind power generation prediction model, constructing a bus topology diagram by using each hydropower station in a cascade hydropower station as a bus topology node, using a water flow line between each hydropower station as a data transmission line in a bus, constructing an optimized objective function according to the head loss prediction model, the target hydropower prediction model and the bus topology diagram based on minimum energy consumption and minimum path overlapping rate, and outputting a hydropower station scheduling strategy. The application has the beneficial effects of reducing the dependence of hydroelectric power on a single path while reducing the energy consumption, and improving the redundancy and stability of a power grid.

title_en: Urban rail transit network cascade failure analysis method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a network cascading failure analysis method and system for urban rail transit, which belong to the technical field of rail transit and control science, and are characterized by acquiring self capacity of each station, identifying key stations of a time-varying network of the urban rail transit in each time step, marking the stations attacked by the key stations as failure stations, judging whether each station fails by comparing whether real-time loads of the stations of the time-varying network of the urban rail transit in each time step exceed self capacity of corresponding stations, marking the stations with the real-time loads exceeding the self capacity as failure stations, acquiring residual capacity of adjacent stations of the failure stations, redistributing real-time loads of the failure stations, and analyzing the cascading failure process of the urban rail transit network according to a redistributing result. The method can accurately grasp the dynamic change of the key stations of the urban rail transit time-varying network in the cascade failure process, so that the cascade failure process of the urban rail transit network is better analyzed.

title_en: A kind of automotive safety method for prewarning risk and system based on multi-source information
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of automotive safety method for prewarning risk and system based on multi-source information, including：Obtain multi-source automotive safety information；The multi-source automotive safety information includes：Vehicle failure pattern information, complains sales volume ratio, road traffic accident information, technological service notice information, domestic and international call back message and network public-opinion propagation effect force parameter at automobile behaviour in service information；A possibility that the reason of being associated analysis to the multi-source automotive safety information, determine vehicle failure parameter, vehicle failure belong to batch problem parameter and vehicle failure menace level parameter；A possibility that parameter, vehicle failure belong to batch problem based on the reason of the vehicle failure, parameter and vehicle failure menace level parameter, calculated automotive safety risk class.It follows that the present invention realizes the judgement of the automatic quantization to automotive safety risk class, in this way, the workload of technical staff is not only alleviated, but also obtained result is more objective and accurate.

title_en: Landslide prediction method and system based on elastic waves
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide prediction method based on elastic waves, which is applied to the technical field of landslide prediction and comprises the following specific steps: constructing a multi-target landslide probability prediction model; acquiring elastic wave signals transmitted in the side slope; picking up the signal characteristics of the elastic wave signals by using a characteristic extraction network; and the signal characteristics are brought into an equation of the multi-target landslide probability prediction model to judge whether landslide occurs or not. The invention discloses a landslide prediction system and a method based on elastic waves, which are used for constructing a multi-target landslide prediction model, determining a prediction result by utilizing the wave speeds of the elastic waves at different moments, greatly improving the prediction precision, dividing the elastic wave propagation process into different time periods by utilizing a division principle, respectively calculating the wave speeds, judging whether the landslide occurs, substituting historical data into the multi-target landslide probability prediction model, determining the wave speed threshold of the elastic waves with the landslide, and determining whether the landslide occurs according to the duration time of the different wave speeds and the current wave speed.

title_en: Virus transmission inhibition method
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a method for inhibiting viral transmission, comprising the steps of: constructing a trust value model of an interactive trust value mechanism, and giving trust values for all links; evaluating infection parameters according to the current network infection condition, and calculating a strategy parameter threshold value for adopting a corresponding virus propagation inhibition strategy; receiving infection feedback information; and responding to the infection feedback information, and adjusting the current network security level according to the trust value. The method provided by the disclosure can reduce the damage of the network structure on the premise of inhibiting the spread of the network viruses, and can adapt to the change of the network security environment to dynamically adjust the network structure.

title_en: Multi-level and multi-target cooperative scheduling method and system for cascade hydropower station group
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-level and multi-target cooperative scheduling method and a system for a cascade hydropower station group, wherein the method considers three levels of a power grid, a cascade, a power station and the like and respectively establishes an optimized scheduling model of the power grid, the cascade and the power station at different scheduling levels; on the basis, a nesting coupling mechanism among the multi-level scheduling models is provided, and the collaborative optimization of different scheduling targets of 'power grid-cascade-power station' is realized by nesting different levels; and aiming at different scheduling level models, different algorithms are adopted to realize efficient solution of the models, and a day-ahead fine scheduling scheme of the cascade hydropower station is obtained. The method realizes the collaborative optimization of the generating benefit of the cascade hydropower station, the thermal power running stability and the running state of the hydroelectric generating set on the premise of guaranteeing the water quantity scheduling requirement and the clean energy consumption requirement of the basin.

title_en: Electric heating energy network toughness assessment method and system in extreme weather
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for evaluating toughness of an electrothermal energy network in extreme weather, which belong to the field of toughness evaluation, and comprise the following steps: establishing a line fault model of an electric heat energy network in extreme weather; the line fault model comprises an external force fault model and an overload fault model; simulating extreme weather by adopting a Monte Carlo simulation method, and cutting off fault lines caused by the extreme weather based on an external force fault model; balancing islanding, calculating power flow, and cutting off overload lines based on an overload fault model; reconstructing an electrothermal energy network based on a two-stage optimization model, balancing power, and calculating the weight of a cascading failure graph edge; and establishing a cascade fault diagram of the electric-thermal energy network, and calculating element-level toughness indexes and system-level toughness indexes. The method considers the influence of continuous disturbance and cascade faults on the electrothermal energy network, more accurately identifies the weak links of the electrothermal energy network, and improves the toughness of the electrothermal energy network.

title_en: Risk assessment method, system, equipment and medium suitable for high-voltage power grid maintenance VR simulation system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a risk assessment method, a system, equipment and a medium suitable for a high-voltage power grid maintenance VR simulation system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: extracting spatial position information and conductive properties of an electric correlation model in a high-voltage power grid overhaul scene, and constructing a current conduction model in the scene; extracting spatial position information and voltage attributes of a high-voltage power grid in a high-voltage power grid overhaul scene, and constructing an electric field propagation model in the scene; estimating the position of a worker in a virtual system according to coordinate information of the VR helmet and the handle, judging the possibility of forming a conductive path between an object at the position of the worker and the ground by combining a current conduction model in a scene, and obtaining a related risk index I; estimating the behaviors of the staff according to the coordinate information of the VR helmet and the handle, calculating the maximum electric field intensity of the limbs of the staff by combining an electric field propagation model in a scene, and obtaining a related risk index II; and combining the first risk index and the second risk index to calculate and obtain a safety risk index of the current behavior of the staff at the current position. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of quantifying risk indexes, enabling an evaluation result to be close to reality and the like.
assignees: WEIHAI POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Operation and maintenance method for power transformation main equipment and related device
abstract_en: The application provides an operation and maintenance method for power transformation main equipment and a related device, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining m pieces of equipment characteristic information and m pieces of running state data corresponding to m pieces of power transformation main equipment; the method comprises the steps of constructing a dynamic graph model according to m pieces of equipment characteristic information, adjusting the dynamic graph model according to m pieces of running state data to obtain a dynamic graph neural network model, determining fault propagation paths of each of m pieces of power transformation main equipment according to the dynamic graph neural network model to obtain m pieces of fault propagation paths, determining m pieces of fault probability according to the m pieces of fault propagation paths, determining an operation and maintenance scheme according to the m pieces of fault propagation paths and the m pieces of fault probability, and guiding operation and maintenance personnel to maintain the m pieces of power transformation main equipment. The accuracy and the flexibility of fault prediction of the power transformation main equipment can be improved.

title_en: Distribution network fault type identification method, system, equipment and storage medium based on distributed sensing
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power system fault detection, in particular to a distributed sensing-based power distribution network fault type identification method, a distributed sensing-based power distribution network fault type identification system, distributed sensing-based power distribution network fault type identification equipment and a storage medium. And constructing an IEEE33 node power distribution network simulation model, configuring 33 distributed sensing nodes among the nodes, realizing full-network coverage type acquisition of power distribution network fault information, and comprehensively capturing the complex changes of fault current distribution and propagation paths after the distributed power supply is accessed. The method comprises the steps of constructing a fault feature matrix by extracting effective values, positive sequence, negative sequence and zero sequence components of a voltage and current signal, converting an original electric signal into a feature vector with definite physical meaning, adopting a random forest classifier comprising 120 decision trees, and optimizing parameter configuration by combining grid search, so as to realize intelligent automatic identification of various fault types.
