The invention can still keep high-precision fault type identification under the complex power distribution network environment of large-scale access of the distributed power supply by establishing a confidence evaluation mechanism and a result post-processing verification system.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD;UNIV TSINGHUA

title_en: Multi-energy complementary scheduling method for multi-pumping and storage collaborative operation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of grid-connected power generation, and discloses a multi-energy complementary scheduling method for multi-pumping and storage cooperative operation, which comprises the steps of constructing a multi-target multi-energy complementary power generation scheduling model; the method comprises the steps of inputting predicted output values of a wind-solar power station and a nuclear power station, cascade hydroelectric power generation capacity and load demand values of a power grid into a multi-energy complementary power generation scheduling model to obtain an initial cascade hydroelectric and thermal power output process, inputting a unit state obtained through an operation sequence decision scheme of a pumping and accumulating unit into the multi-energy complementary power generation scheduling model to optimize a thermal power output sliding window and an operation process of the pumping and accumulating unit, and carrying out cascade hydroelectric power total load distribution again through the multi-energy complementary power generation scheduling model according to a cascade hydroelectric power output plan. The invention has the advantages that the new energy is consumed as much as possible under the condition of ensuring the high matching between the power supply and the load by the regulation capability of the cascade hydroelectric power station and the pumped storage power station group, the peak regulation depth of the thermal power is reduced, the flexibility margin of the system is released, and the invention provides reference for the collaborative scheduling operation of flexible resources under the large-scale new energy grid-connected background.

title_en: Wind-light power uncertainty evaluation method and system under Sha Chenwu haze meteorological conditions
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of wind-light power evaluation, and particularly relates to a wind-light power uncertainty evaluation method and system under sand-dust haze meteorological conditions, wherein the core flow comprises the steps of firstly acquiring key meteorological parameters such as sand-dust concentration, PM2.5 and the like, and extracting multi-scale space-time evolution characteristics by utilizing an improved space-time convolution neural network; and secondly, combining improved dynamic time warping and mutual information theory, and dynamically identifying nonlinear space-time correlation between meteorological changes and power fluctuation. On the basis, a probability model is built by combining a Bayesian neural network with a Monte Carlo Dropout algorithm, the separation and quantification of the cognitive uncertainty and the accidental uncertainty are realized, and finally, four-dimensional risk indexes such as power fluctuation entropy, prediction confidence interval width, conditional risk value, risk propagation coefficient and the like are calculated, and the comprehensive risk indexes are weighted and fused to realize the real-time and comprehensive assessment of the power generation risk of the new energy.
assignees: STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CO ELECTRIC POWER RESEARCH INSTITUTE;STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;IEC INT STANDARDS PROMOTION CENTER NANJING

title_en: Cascade reliability index determination method for multi-level inter-city road network
abstract_en: The application provides a cascading reliability index determining method of a multi-level inter-city road network, which comprises the steps of constructing the multi-level inter-city road network of a target area, calculating initial load and capacity of any first node of the first node set, triggering cascading failure of the multi-level inter-city road network by utilizing an attack strategy based on the betweenness centrality to determine initial failure nodes from the first node set, simulating a cascading failure propagation process by utilizing a multi-path load distribution model driven by identifying equal impedance lines by taking the initial failure nodes as a starting point until the propagation process is finished, and determining the number of newly-increased failure nodes, the network efficiency ratio, the global node cascading failure rate and the local node cascading failure rate of each round in the cascading failure propagation process as cascading reliability indexes of the multi-level inter-city road network. The application improves the authenticity and accuracy of the cascade reliability index of the multi-level inter-city road network of the target area.

title_en: Flashover analysis tool
abstract_en: According to the present invention, there is provided a method to minimize human intervention during decision making process while controlling the electrical power system by identifying the initiating element that cause a tripping of the transmission overhead lines and capable of identifying the potential future protection system failures that can initiate a cascading of tripping or total national blackout. A method of producing flashover analysis signal as a protection system analysis comprising processing a neutral current (7), three phase current profile (4, 5, 6), three phase voltage profile (1, 2, 3), and a plurality of digital signal (8) of a transmission line using an artificial neural network to calculate pickup time, reset time, DEF confirmation time or total fault clearance time. A method of producing flashover analysis signal comprising as a flashover signature analysis (50) to identify the cause of the flashover as a current transformer explosion (39), tree encroachment (41 ), crane (44), lightning strike (47) or polluted insulator (46).
assignees: TNB RES SDN BHD;UNIV MALAYSIA TECH

title_en: Probabilistic model for cyber risk forecasting
abstract_en: A system and method are presented for forecasting the risk of cyber-attacks on targeted networks. The described technology quantifies linear and non-linear damages to network-dependent assets by propagating probabilistic distributions of events in sequence and time in order to forecast damages over specified periods. Damage-forecasts are used to estimate probabilistically time-varying financial losses for cyber-attacks. The described technology incorporates quantities and dependencies for pricing insurance, re-insurance, and self-insurance, assessing cost-benefit tradeoffs for sequenced implementation of security control measures, and detecting attacks in the targeted network.

title_en: Intelligent disaster recovery for database connection failures
abstract_en: Embodiments of the invention provide techniques for disaster recovery in the event of a database connection failure. In one embodiment, a network address for a secondary server may be stored in multiple data objects of a client computer. In the event of a failed connection to a primary server, the network address of the secondary server may be retrieved from one of the data objects stored in the client computer. When an updated network address for the secondary server is received, it may be propagated to the data objects of the client computer.

title_en: Method and system for minimizing risk of cascading failures of power grid under multi-fire disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid cascading failure risk minimization handling method and a power grid cascading failure risk minimization handling system under a multi-fire disaster.

title_en: Remote sensing image small target detection method based on context and cascade structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote sensing image small target detection method based on context and a cascade structure, and belongs to the technical field of image processing. The method comprises the following steps: 1) Acquiring a training sample and a test sample; 2) Constructing a remote sensing image small target detection network model; 3) Training a remote sensing image small target detection network model; 4) And acquiring a detection result of the remote sensing image small target. According to the invention, the context module frame is introduced, so that the target area is used for context sensing capability, the problem of difficult small target positioning is effectively solved, the quality of the prediction boundary frame is improved through the cascade structure, higher detection precision is realized, and the method can be used in the fields of resource exploration, natural disaster early warning, city planning, unmanned aerial vehicle target identification and the like.

title_en: Fire risk prevention and control method for complex electrical equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire risk prevention and control method for complex electrical equipment, which comprises the following steps of (1) constructing a system risk side topology network model of the complex electrical equipment by combining historical electrical fire accidents with a physical structure working principle of equipment to form a coupling relation between risk points and basic attribute distribution of the risk points, (2) calculating a risk propagation Score value between the risk points according to a generalized risk fuzzy ordering theory to quantify coupling strength between risks, and (3) constructing a complex electrical fire prevention key path generation algorithm considering risk propagation characteristics to form a key propagation path set so as to prevent and control the fire of the complex electrical equipment. The method can be used for clearing accident links of electrical fires of complex electrical equipment and realizing accurate prevention and grasp of system risk situations. Experimental results show that the method has good prevention effect and can effectively block fire disasters of complex electrical equipment.

title_en: Geothermal pipe network intelligent monitoring method and system based on edge calculation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geothermal pipe network monitoring, in particular to a geothermal pipe network intelligent monitoring method and system based on edge calculation; the method comprises the steps of collecting sound pressure signals, vibration signals and pressure signals in real time, carrying out first-order differential calculation based on the pressure signals to obtain a differential pressure change sequence, inputting the sound pressure signals and the vibration signals into a micro-seismic intelligent recognition model, outputting micro-seismic risk quantization scoring indexes, generating execution regulation and control instructions, recording execution feedback data to form a micro-seismic scoring feedback data set, carrying out time sequence reconstruction on the differential pressure change sequence by using a nerve differential equation model, identifying an abnormal propagation source point and a shortest propagation path, constructing a water hammer propagation response structure, transmitting the micro-seismic scoring feedback data set and the water hammer propagation response structure to a cloud platform, and carrying out real-time monitoring and early warning on the state of a geothermal pipe network. The invention realizes the intelligent monitoring and tracking of the slight earthquake abnormal state and the water hammer effect of the geothermal pipe network.

title_en: Trans-regional ammeter anomaly detection method and system based on transfer learning and ammeter
abstract_en: The application discloses a trans-regional ammeter anomaly detection method and system based on transfer learning and an ammeter, belonging to the technical field of ammeter detection, and comprising the steps of constructing a layered characteristic extraction network and inputting ammeter data into the layered characteristic extraction network; the method comprises the steps of carrying out cross-regional feature alignment on feature data extracted from a hierarchical feature extraction network, classifying the abnormality of an ammeter in a target region through a classifier after the cross-regional feature alignment is carried out, carrying out time sequence analysis on the abnormality data through a time sequence abnormality positioning network, and identifying the association among a plurality of abnormal events after the abnormality positioning to construct an abnormality propagation diagram. In the implementation process of the technical scheme, the characteristic data are subjected to cross-regional characteristic alignment through a layered characteristic extraction network, the abnormal condition of the ammeter in the target region is classified and positioned through a classifier, then the association among different abnormal events is identified through an association analysis technology, and the abnormal detection effect of the ammeter is improved.

title_en: A kind of earthquake calamity audio life detection equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of earthquake calamity audio life detection equipment, mainly include：Detection device and main control device, detection device between wireless network and main control device by being transmitted；Using special microelectronics processor, the small vibrations propagated in air or solid can be recognized, main control device is placed on behind safety zone, detection device is controlled to enter rescue region by direction controlling touch screen, camera captured in real-time transmits terrain graph, micro- vibration sensor probe and speech transducer probe transfer information to microseismic signals display screen and sound wave display screen, micro- vibration sensor probe perceives the faint seismic signal that surface layer is transmitted, and speech transducer probe can carry out voice call with rescuer；Voice signal is directly passed to detection personnel by main control device；According to signal intensity infinite approach rescuer, the then detailed rescue plan of rapid development.

title_en: The recognition methods of Cascade Reservoirs weakness step, crucial step and controlling step based on Bayes risk network
abstract_en: The invention discloses the recognition methods of a kind of Cascade Reservoirs weakness step based on Bayes risk network, crucial step and controlling step, it is related to Hydraulic and Hydro-Power Engineering field, solution is the problem of how Cascade Reservoirs risk prevention system aspect identifies Cascade Reservoirs risk.Based on Cascade Reservoirs Bayes risk network model, the recognition methods of Cascade Reservoirs weakness step, crucial step and controlling step is proposed, is supported for Cascade Reservoirs Bayes risk network method is provided into theoretical and method for Cascade Reservoirs risk identification, assessment and prevention and control.This method is simple and clear, workable, there is important utilization prospect in the risk identification of Cascade Reservoirs, assessment and prevention and control.

title_en: Power transmission network risk assessment optimization method based on transient energy imbalance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power transmission network risk assessment optimization method based on transient energy imbalance, which comprises the following steps: step SS 1: establishing a transient energy function of the alternating current-direct current hybrid power system based on an energy transfer relation of the alternating current-direct current hybrid power system; step SS 2: and based on historical operating data of the power grid, performing risk assessment optimization on the transient energy function of the AC-DC hybrid power system in the step SS1 based on a BNG model. Aiming at the problem of neglecting safety influence caused by fault prediction and cascading faults in the current network risk evaluation model, in order to accurately evaluate the target network risk, a transient energy function of an alternating-current and direct-current hybrid power system is established based on the energy transfer relation of the alternating-current and direct-current hybrid power system, a transient energy efficiency variable is introduced based on historical operation data of a power grid, the variable is blended into the calculation of the probability to obtain the prior risk probability of each node in the network, and therefore the network risk is statically evaluated.
assignees: BEIJING KEDONG ELECTRIC POWER CONTROL SYSTEM CO LTD;CENTRAL CHINA BRANCH STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Dynamic network management method for elastic management of infrastructure project
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of dynamic networks, in particular to a dynamic network management method for flexibly managing infrastructure projects. Which comprises the following steps; carrying out numerical quantification on the interdependencies and establishing a snapshot network model; establishing a dynamic network model; analyzing the centrality of the dynamic network; analyzing the correlation between the network measurement and the key performance index of the project; and (4) adaptive network development. The method can effectively reduce the vulnerability risk caused by complex interdependence and the potential cascade interruption of the project performance to ensure the elasticity of the project; by means of a dynamic network modeling method, the time-space interdependence relation of contractors in an infrastructure project site is simulated and analyzed, force of a meta-heuristic optimization technology is utilized, vulnerabilities caused by interdependence are actively detected, the contractor network is correspondingly and rapidly adjusted, the adaptability is then reflected on a working time table, and the capability of the whole project for recovering possible cascade dis performance interruption is improved.

title_en: Clustering parallel communication method for underwater sensor network
abstract_en: The application discloses an underwater sensor network clustering parallel communication method based on repeated calculation and improved K-means clustering, which aims at the defects that the underwater energy propagation model and the cluster head node broadcasting parallel transmission time slot allocation information are not considered in the current underwater LEACH protocol based on the K-means clustering, so that the self energy consumption is increased and the network communication speed is influenced, and the application proposes that the underwater energy propagation model is adopted in the K-means clustering to optimize the clustering quantity, and the cluster head node and the network clustering are determined according to the underwater energy propagation model; meanwhile, each node obtains own parallel transmission time slot by repeatedly calculating, namely independently running the same determining algorithm at the same time, and cluster head nodes are not required to broadcast parallel transmission time slot allocation information, so that the energy consumption of a network is reduced, and the service life of the network is prolonged. The application can be applied to the underwater sensor network of the network structure such as underwater ecological monitoring, early warning detection, disaster monitoring and the like.

title_en: Minimizing service disruption
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to minimizing service disruption. A User Equipment (UE) may detect a disaster condition and its solution based on broadcast information, RRC messaging, NAS messaging, capability to connect to allowed PLMNs, and an indication from a barred PLMN. In a disaster condition, the UE may perform an enhanced PLMN selection procedure, wherein, for example, if the disaster situation applies to the current location of the UE, the UE will prioritize forbidden PLMNs for the disaster roaming connection without regard to the PLMNs in the disaster situation. For disaster roaming connections, the UE may be configured by the otherwise barred PLMN with information about what services the UE may access and what types of authentication procedures the network can perform with the UE. When the end of the disaster condition is detected, the UE moves back to the allowed PLMN.

title_en: Power grid cascading failure prevention control method and system considering power flow transfer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid cascading failure prevention control method and system considering tide transfer, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting power grid state data in real time: collecting power grid state data in real time from a power grid monitoring system, wherein the power grid state data comprises power flow data of all lines, generator output data and load data of each node; n-1 fault scan is performed: n-1 fault scanning is carried out based on the tide data of all lines, and weak and heavy-load lines of the power grid are identified; constructing mirror image simulation data: mirror image simulation data are built based on the power grid state data and used for realizing power flow transfer ratio matrix calculation through power flow calculation; and obtaining power grid cascading failure control based on the power flow transfer ratio matrix. The invention can reduce the influence of cascading faults on the power grid and improve the stability and reliability of the power system.
assignees: GUANGXI GUANGTOU BEIHAI POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Distributed optical fiber sensing mass target data screening method based on image processing
abstract_en: A distributed optical fiber sensing mass target data screening method based on image processing is characterized in that space-time two-dimensional vibration signals are mapped into gray images, a multi-mode fusion technology is utilized, a lightweight convolutional neural network is combined to achieve efficient classification, a dynamic increment learning mechanism and a spatial propagation attenuation correction algorithm are introduced, and the problems of single characteristic representation, model update lag and insufficient positioning accuracy of a traditional method are solved. The method is suitable for the fields of perimeter security protection, pipeline monitoring, geological disaster early warning and the like, and can be used for screening and target recognition of mass vibration data under complex environment interference in real time. The invention breaks through the limitation of traditional time-frequency domain analysis through signal imaging characterization, obviously improves the distinguishing capability of similar events, simultaneously reduces the false alarm rate and the operation and maintenance cost by depending on a dynamic model optimization technology, effectively suppresses the influence of optical fiber attenuation on the positioning precision by combining a space correction algorithm, and provides reliable technical support for intelligent upgrading of a distributed optical fiber sensing system.

title_en: Tap reservoir characteristic water level planning method and system for cascade small hydropower station
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tap reservoir characteristic water level planning method and system for small-scale hydropower stations. The method comprises the steps of dividing a year into three periods according to the water inflow condition of local small hydropower stations, respectively calculating warehouse-in flow corresponding to the three periods according to relative flow, namely a dead water period, a rich water period and a flat water period, calculating the required power generation amount of each period step small hydropower station through time integration according to photovoltaic daily power generation data and local power grid load requirements, determining the power generation adjustment time of the corresponding period according to the required power generation amount of the small hydropower station and the small hydropower station basic information, calculating the power generation adjustment warehouse capacity according to the warehouse-in flow, determining the maximum water storage warehouse-out time of the corresponding period according to the local hydrologic information, calculating the warehouse-out capacity according to the local reservoir requirements and the calculated adjustment warehouse-out capacity and the calculated warehouse-out capacity, setting the characteristic water level, and constructing a dam for the tap reservoir. The invention ensures the stability of small hydropower generation and improves the adjusting capacity of the whole river basin.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER CORP;UNIV HOHAI;STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Intelligent power distribution operation and maintenance management system based on 5G transmission
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power distribution operation and maintenance management, and discloses an intelligent power distribution operation and maintenance management system based on 5G transmission. The system comprises a 5G real-time acquisition module, a multidimensional feature fusion module, a dynamic topology generation module, an abnormal propagation analysis module and a strategy optimization feedback module. The system comprises a 5G real-time acquisition module, a multi-dimensional feature fusion module, a dynamic topology generation module, a state fluctuation analysis module, a strategy optimization feedback module and a strategy optimization feedback module, wherein the 5G real-time acquisition module acquires running state data streams such as current and voltage waveforms of power distribution equipment, equipment temperature sequences and environment monitoring indexes through a 5G network, the multi-dimensional feature fusion module separates equipment state features, calculates mutual information quantity and generates equipment state feature tensors, the dynamic topology generation module constructs an association strength matrix according to the feature tensors to generate a hierarchical connection path and a dynamic equipment topology map, the state fluctuation analysis module extracts a state fluctuation sequence, identifies an abnormal transmission path and marks a core transmission node, and the strategy optimization feedback module generates a maintenance strategy priority queue according to the state fluctuation sequence, feeds back an execution result to update the dynamic topology map, so that the intellectualization and the accuracy of power distribution operation and maintenance management are improved.
assignees: WENZHOU JIANLI ELECTRIC APPLIANCE CO LTD;BEIJING RAILWAY ELECTRIFICATION COLLEGE

title_en: Response method and device based on intelligent customer service dialogue state tracking of charging and computer equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to a response method, a response device, computer equipment, computer readable storage media and computer program products based on intelligent customer service dialogue state tracking. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a predefined intention slot structure definition set and a historical dialogue data set, inputting the definition set and the historical dialogue data set into a graph neural network model to generate a state graph structure, obtaining semantic input contents of a user in a current round, generating a node context sensing embedded set and a node semantic response strength set by combining an initial node embedded set, determining candidate state scores by combining a platform service state set and a node frequency scalar set, generating candidate state subgraphs and candidate state score vectors according to the candidate state scores, executing graph neural network propagation on the candidate state subgraphs, and determining a current dialogue state, a corresponding slot set and a state propagation path to generate a response strategy for responding the semantic input contents. By adopting the method, the response accuracy to the user request can be improved.

title_en: Power grid data processing method and device for offshore wind power, terminal equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid data processing method, a device, terminal equipment and a storage medium for offshore wind power, belonging to the field of offshore wind power, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a topological structure of a receiving end power grid, a thermal power and wind power output curve, line transmission capacity limitation, a target line and a target node; the method comprises the steps of calculating static load bearing margin of an alternating current line, carrying out cascading failure simulation based on a target line to obtain line transmission capacity after failure, calculating cascading failure toughness margin based on the line transmission capacity after failure, calculating three-phase short-circuit current for a target node, calculating short-circuit capacity adaptation degree based on the three-phase short-circuit current, carrying out weighted calculation on the static load bearing margin of the alternating current line, the cascading failure toughness margin and the short-circuit capacity adaptation degree to obtain an adaptability evaluation value, and determining an operation state of a receiving end power grid.

title_en: Intelligent monitoring and early warning method, device and equipment of supply chain and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of supply chain monitoring and discloses an intelligent monitoring and early warning method, device, equipment and storage medium of a supply chain, wherein the method comprises the steps of deploying a plurality of types of internet of things sensors at each target node in the supply chain, collecting supply chain state data, and executing time sequence analysis and anomaly detection in an edge server to obtain local early warning information; the method comprises the steps of carrying out graph neural network analysis based on local early warning information and a preset supply chain network structure to obtain a node risk representation vector and a risk propagation probability matrix, carrying out early warning strategy calculation through a multi-agent deep reinforcement learning algorithm according to the node risk representation vector and the risk propagation probability matrix to obtain an early warning strategy set, and carrying out risk propagation simulation calculation on the early warning strategy set and the supply chain network structure to obtain comprehensive early warning decision information. The risk propagation path and the risk propagation speed can be accurately identified, and the accuracy of risk propagation prediction of a supply chain is improved.
assignees: CHENGTIAN INT SUPPLY CHAIN SHENZHEN CO LTD

title_en: System for rescue request during emergency and method therefor
title_ko: 위급상황 구조요청 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present invention relate to a system and a method for requesting rescue in emergency. In emergent abscondence such as child-missing, abduction, and kidnap, when an absconder has a confirmation medium having his/her personal information and physical information recorded therein, information identical to or matching with the personal information and physical information of the confirmation medium is transmitted through a communication network to people within a particular distance from the absconder, so people can recognize the absconder and help rescuing the absconder. The system according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: a mobile electronic device for storing user information for authenticating a user, and transmitting a help request signal having an identification function to an external server though a communication network in emergency; and an emergency managing server for storing the user information of the mobile electronic device, detecting corresponding user information of a received help request signal when the help request signal is received from the mobile electronic device, generating help request information based on the detected user information, and transmitting the generated help request information through a communication network to an electronic device disposed within a predetermined radius from the mobile electronic device based on position information of the mobile electronic device.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시예들은 미아 발생, 유괴, 납치 등에 기인한 위급한 실종 상황 발생 시 실종 당사자가 자신의 개인정보 및 신체정보를 기록한 확인 매체를 소유하고 있는 동시에 이러한 확인 매체의 개인정보 및 신체정보와 동일하거나 매칭되는 정보가 실종 당사자를 중심으로 소정 거리 내에 있는 사람들에게 통신망을 통해 전파되어 다수의 사람이 실종 상황을 인식하는 동시에 실종자의 구조에 도움을 줄 수 있게 하는 위급상황 구조요청 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로서, 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 위급상황 구조요청 시스템은 사용자 본인의 확인을 위한 사용자 정보가 저장되며, 비상상황 발생 시 식별 기능이 있는 도움요청 신호를 통신망을 통해 외부의 서버에 전송하는 모바일 전자장치와, 상기 모바일 전자장치의 상기 사용자 정보가 저장되어 상기 모바일 전자장치로부터 도움요청 신호 수신 시 수신된 도움요청 신호의 해당 사용자 정보를 검출 후 검출된 사용자 정보를 기반으로 도움요청 정보를 생성하고 생성된 도움요청 정보를 상기 모바일 전자장치의 위치정보를 기준으로 상기 모바일 전자장치로부터 사전 설정된 반경 내에 위치한 전자장치에 통신망을 통해 전송하는 위급상황 관리서버를 포함하여 구성된다.

title_en: Large power grid disturbance propagation characteristic evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention provides a large power grid disturbance propagation characteristic evaluation method, which combines the characteristics of energy transmission evolution and the large power grid disturbance propagation characteristics of disturbance tracks to evaluate: firstly, dividing a disturbance propagation process after a fault into a transient energy injection stage, a transient energy conservation stage and a transient energy gradual attenuation stage according to the change characteristics of transient total energy after the fault; secondly, determining an evaluation object according to transient energy change characteristics of each stage; performing simulation calculation by adopting a time domain simulation method, performing simulation calculation by adopting the time domain simulation method, selecting related items of transient energy from simulation results of different stages, and defining the related items as observation indexes; judging the influence elements with disturbance, and generating an influence element set; thereby acquiring key factors affecting transient energy transmission; so as to realize the evaluation of the disturbance propagation characteristics of the large power grid.

title_en: Smart grid robustness assessment method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and equipment for evaluating robustness of a smart power grid, which relate to the technical field of smart power grid safety analysis and solve the technical problems that the traditional power system safety evaluation method only starts from the angle of electrical characteristics or only starts from the angle of a network topology and can not accurately describe the robustness under the evolution rule of the cascade fault of the power network, and the technical scheme is as follows: based on the perspective of a topological structure or electrical characteristics alone in the past, the structural robustness of the power supply and demand service function of the power grid and the functional robustness of the electrical topological structure characteristics are considered, and the structural robustness and the functional robustness are combined with efficacy subgraphs under different interference modes, so that the static and dynamic combined intelligent power grid robustness assessment method is obtained from the aspects of the inherent advantages of the anti-destruction capability of the intelligent power grid and the outward appearance of the service viability. The evaluation method is a result under multi-aspect quantitative analysis, and can more comprehensively and comprehensively reflect the actual robust characteristic performance of the intelligent power grid.

title_en: Method and device for optimizing park energy system operation based on load clustering
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a device for optimizing the operation of a park energy system based on load clustering, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring energy consumption data of a park user; performing cluster analysis on the energy consumption data to obtain energy requirements and typical energy consumption behaviors of park users; positioning the energy grade requirement of a user according to the energy requirement and the typical energy utilization behavior; combining a preset energy grade dividing result and the energy grade requirement to obtain a corresponding energy cascade utilization energy supply structure; and constructing an energy pipe network model according to the energy cascade utilization energy supply structure, and generating an optimized operation strategy of an energy system based on the energy pipe network model. The invention can optimize the operation of the energy system.

title_en: Man-machine terminal picture data interaction method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a man-machine terminal picture data interaction method and a system, which relate to the technical field of data interaction and comprise the following steps: installing a traveling wave sensor, acquiring fault electromagnetic waves, determining a time stamp and traveling wave propagation speed, and determining a fault area through a fault positioning algorithm; acquiring traveling wave signal data of fault electromagnetic waves according to a fault region, simultaneously acquiring power grid topology data, extracting traveling wave characteristics and topology characteristics, determining structural characteristics, identifying the shortest path of nodes in a power grid topology graph, and combining clustering coefficients to perform characteristic fusion to obtain a comprehensive topology vector; the method comprises the steps of encoding a comprehensive topological vector based on a graph neural network, carrying out node feature fusion on traveling wave features and the encoded comprehensive topological vector, generating initial node features, updating the initial node features through the graph neural network by combining a attention mechanism introduced in advance, generating input node features, combining the traveling wave features, carrying out fault location through a random forest module in the graph neural network, and determining a fault position.

title_en: Real-time monitoring and optimizing method and system for virtual power plant platform source network charge storage equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a real-time monitoring and optimizing method and system for virtual power plant platform source network charge storage equipment, which relate to the technical field of intelligent optimization scheduling of virtual power plants and comprise the steps of collecting equipment operation data, carrying out noise reduction and feature compression to obtain feature data, identifying equipment fault types based on the feature data, decoupling and reconstructing the feature data in time and space dimensions to obtain an equipment association matrix, constructing an equipment topological graph based on the equipment association matrix and trusted fault types, carrying out bidirectional tracking on the equipment topological graph according to fault diffusion probability to generate a fault propagation path, carrying out hierarchical sequencing on equipment on the fault propagation path, outputting a fault influence prediction result and an equipment priority list, and carrying out collaborative scheduling optimization on equipment in the virtual power plant by adopting a hierarchical reinforcement learning algorithm to realize collaborative scheduling optimization of the virtual power plant equipment.

title_en: Power transmission network fault positioning system based on edge agent cooperation decision
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power transmission network fault positioning system based on edge agent cooperative decision, and belongs to the technical field of power system fault diagnosis. The system comprises a token relay communication module, a consensus arbitration module and an unknown event cognition module, wherein the token relay communication module is used for carrying out orderly token directional relay transfer among edge intelligent agents according to the physical propagation direction of fault energy wave fronts, the consensus arbitration module is used for diagnosing and arbitrating the health degree of a preliminary positioning conclusion through joint evaluation of decision entropy and physical space correlation so as to inhibit error consensus caused by systematic deviation, and the unknown event cognition module is used for stopping positioning and generating a structured characteristic sketch report when detecting an unknown fault in a semantic gap with a local knowledge stock. The invention fundamentally improves the reliability, robustness and safety of fault location by constructing a complete-flow ordered cooperative mechanism.

title_en: Integrated Method and System for Flood Disaster Response
title_ko: 홍수 재난 대응을 위한 통합 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an integrated method and a system for coping with flood disasters and, more specifically to an integrated method and a system for coping with flood disasters which establish a database required for a situation such as flood disasters, evaluate facilities such as a bank, etc. in advance by using the database, and generate beforehand information for visualizing a flood in 3D. According to the present invention, information can be propagated rapidly such that the generated information can be provided quickly. Also, an efficient 3-dimensional geographic information system (GIS) space analysis is performed to enable simulation of a flood. Since various data collected before the flood is standardized in a database, data standardization and expansion can be realized, which improves convenience in using the data and addresses a problem due to non-compatibility between conventional and current systems. And, it is convenient to collect or reprocess new data and manage legacy data. When a new system or a new module is to be included, it can be easily combined or connected organically, which facilitates maintenance of the conventional system. With respect to related parties, a task can be easily performed since there is no need to change a manual when a new system is utilized. The integrated method for coping with a flood disaster comprises a data acquisition step; a facility evaluation step; a bank vulnerability evaluation step; a flood visualization step; a space analysis 3D visualization step; a dynamic presentation step; and an information propagation step.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 홍수 재난 대응을 위한 통합 방법 및 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는, 홍수 재난 등의 상황에 있어 필요로 하는 데이터베이스를 구축 하고, 이에 의한 시설물, 제방 등을 미리 평가하고, 흉수의 가시화를 위하여 3차원으로 미리 정보를 생성하고, 생성된 정보를 신속하게 제공하기 위하여 빠를 정보 확산을 가능하며, 효율적인 3차원 GIS 공간분석을 수행하여 그에 따른 홍수 시율레이션이 가능하여, 홍수 재난 발생 전 수집된 다양한 데이터를 구축 및 표준화를 통해 데이터 표준화 및 확장 성을 충분히 고려할 수 있으며, 사용 용이성이 증가할 수 있고, 기존의 시스템과 신규 시스템의 연결이 용이하지 않아서 발생하는 문제를 절감 할 수 있으며, 신규데이터를 수집하거나 재가공할 시, 레거시 데이터를 관리함에 있어서도 편리할 수 있고, 시스템이나 신규 모듈 등의 구축이 있을 시, 이를 병합하거나 유기적으로 연결하기에 용이할 수 있고, 신규 시스템이나 신규 모듈 등의 구축이 있을 시, 이를 병합하거나 유기적으로 연결하기에 용이하므로 기존 시스템을 유지 보수하기에 편리하며, 유관기관의 측면에 서는 시스템을 활용할 때 매뉴얼 변경 등의 불편한 사항이 줄어들기 때문에 업무 수행이 용이할 수 있게 하는 홍수 재난 대응을 위한 통합 방법 및 시스템에 관한 것이다.
assignees: KOREA INST CIVIL ENGINEERING & BUILDING TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Information and communication facility integrated management system and its management method
title_ko: 공동주택 건축물의 정보통신 시설 통합 관리 시스템 및 그 관리방법
abstract_en: Provided are an information and communication facility integrated management system of an apartment house building and a management method thereof, which can monitor, analyze, and manage objects to be controlled in a plurality of specific areas efficiently and effectively. The information and communication facility integrated management system includes a control server that analyzes a disaster when the disaster occurs to calculate a range on which the disaster has influence, sets a disaster information propagation region based on address information of a smart grid facility, which includes a telegraph pole, a collection device, a watt-hour meter AMI modem, and a power communication network, or a smart city facility including a streetlight, a security light, and a CCTV pole, and transmits the disaster information. For the information and communication facility integrated management system, a monitor facility installed at a field performs a handling process including installation and transfer at the field, and the monitoring of a specific area at the field.
abstract_ko: 공동주택 건축물의 정보통신 시설 통합 관리 시스템 및 그 관리방법을 제공한다. 정보통신시설 통합관리 시스템은 안전재난 발생 시 이를 분석하여 안전재난의 영향력이 미치는 범위를 계산한 후 전신주, 수집장치, 전력량계AMI 모뎀, 전력 통신네트워크를 포함하는 스마트그리드시설물 또는 가로등, 보안등, CCTV주를 포함하는 스마트 시티시설물의 주소 정보를 기반으로 안전재난 정보전파 영역을 설정하고, 안전재난 정보를 전송하는 관제서버를 포함하되, 상기 정보통신시설 통합관리 시스템은 현장에 설치되는 모니터설비에 의하여 상기 현장에서의 설치와 이송을 포함하는 취급과정 및 상기 현장에 대한 특정구역의 감시가 수행된다.

title_en: Cascade hydropower station multi-object optimal scheduling mixed searching method coupling peak shaving and navigation demands
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of comprehensive development and utilization and optimized scheduling of water resources, in particular to a cascade hydropower station multi-object optimal scheduling mixed searching method coupling peak shaving and navigation demands. The function of a navigation counter regulation power station can be fully performed, the peak shaving of a power grid and river channel navigation application requirements are taken into account, and a cascade operation plan which is practical and more reasonable in scheduling is obtained. According to the technical scheme, the minimum of the maximum value of the redundant loads of the power grid and the minimum of the variance of the counter regulation power station downstream river channel water level process are adopted as objects, in the NSGA-II searching process, for the complex constrains of the climbing upper limit, the output fluctuation control limit, the machine starting and shutting down minimum lasting time, the term end water level control and the like, time coupling constraint handling strategies, end water level correction strategies and improved genetic manipulation operators are put forward, so that the searching and solving efficiency of the method can be improved, a calculating result meeting engineering application request is obtained, and the method is suitable for being adopted and popularized in the scheduling operation of a cascade hydropower station with navigation requests.

title_en: Dam deformation prediction system and method based on convolutional neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for predicting dam deformation based on a convolutional neural network. The convolutional neural network for dam deformation prediction fully uses the parallel computing capability of the network, two-dimensional data is input into a plurality of paths in parallel, and a plurality of convolutional layers and pooling layers are alternately cascaded in each path, so that different convolutional kernel sizes can be set for obtaining more characteristics; while the invention contemplates that the features extracted by these paths are not necessarily complementary, the system uses addition operations in combining the output results of these paths. The method improves the automation level of dam deformation prediction, and simultaneously improves the efficiency and speed of deformation prediction.

title_en: RQD based on three-dimensional laser scanning and BQ inversiontOptimal threshold t solving method
abstract_en: RQD based on three-dimensional laser scanning and BQ inversion t The optimal threshold t solving method belongs to RQD t The optimal threshold value t solving field comprises the following steps: (1) three-dimensional laser scanning of the structural surface is rapidly acquired; (2) knotDrawing a texture polar point diagram and a trend rose diagram; (3) calculating the rock mass based on the BQ index; (4) generating and sectioning a rock three-dimensional fracture network model; (5) RQD t Drawing an anisotropy map; (6) and solving the optimal threshold t based on BQ inversion. The invention combines three-dimensional laser scanning, a neighbor propagation algorithm, a BQ theory, a fracture network model, a generalized RQD theory and inversion calculation to realize RQD t Solving the optimal threshold t, and providing an RQD of three-dimensional laser scanning and BQ inversion t And solving the optimal threshold t. The method is clear, the obtained threshold t can reflect the real rock mass quality and is suitable for the rock mass RQD t The optimal threshold value t of (a) is solved.

title_en: Market clearing method, system, equipment and readable storage medium for water-electricity coupling
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of electric power markets and discloses a hydropower coupling market clearing method, a hydropower coupling market clearing system, hydropower coupling market clearing equipment and a readable storage medium, wherein the market clearing method comprises the following steps: acquiring operation boundary conditions, market declaration information and water regime information of a power grid; establishing unit operation constraint, system balance constraint and network constraint of the power grid according to operation boundary conditions and market declaration information based on a future state network topology model of the power grid; establishing power generation water constraint according to the water regime information, and establishing power generation amount constraint according to the power generation water constraint and the market declaration information; based on a future state network topology model and market declaration information of the power grid, the method uses the minimization of power generation cost as an optimization target, and carries out market clearing calculation under the conditions of meeting unit operation constraint, system balance constraint, network constraint and power generation amount constraint to obtain a clearing result. Clear calculation of the power grid containing the cascade hydropower is realized, and technical support is provided for the deep reformation of the power market.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Method for predicting required power by considering wind resistance change in vehicle team following vehicle running
abstract_en: The invention relates to a demand power prediction method considering wind resistance change in the process of fleet following and driving, which belongs to the technical field of energy management of hybrid electric vehicles and comprises the following steps of S1, measuring the front and rear vehicle distances in real time by using a binocular vision ranging cascade algorithm based on YOLOv and an improved BP neural network algorithm, S2, realizing future vehicle distance prediction by using a self-adaptive PSO-GRNN on-line vehicle distance prediction method considering cold starting, and S3, considering the influence of wind resistance coefficient change on demand power change under the fluid dynamics in the process of fleet following and driving, and correcting the rear vehicle wind resistance based on the front and rear vehicle distances measured in the step S1 and the future vehicle distances predicted in the step S2. According to the invention, based on the vehicle distance prediction model, the wind resistance coefficient under the vehicle following working condition is dynamically corrected to accurately calculate the required power, and meanwhile, the optimal vehicle following distance is provided to optimize the power distribution of the hybrid electric vehicle, so that the fuel economy and the complex vehicle following scene adaptability are improved.

title_en: Geological disaster networking monitoring and early warning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster networking monitoring and early warning method, which relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and early warning, and comprises the following steps of S1, collecting original data of multiple types of monitoring equipment in a monitoring area, extracting a high-amplitude mutation area and a frequency drift factor according to time and frequency distribution of the original data, constructing a high-frequency disturbance sensing matrix, and generating a disturbance characteristic index map for representing spatial distribution of unnatural disturbance sources. According to the invention, the high-frequency disturbance perception matrix and the disturbance index map are constructed, so that the active recognition and modeling of the unnatural disturbance are realized, disturbance propagation analysis and residual difference are combined to strengthen precursor signal characteristics, the risk level is accurately judged through trend recognition and causal analysis, finally, the early warning model parameters are dynamically optimized by means of response regulation factors, a closed-loop mechanism of disturbance recognition, signal purification, trend extraction, risk judgment and strategy adjustment is formed, and the early warning stability, accuracy and practicability of the system in a high-disturbance environment are remarkably improved.
assignees: NANJING KENTOP CIVIL ENGINEERING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Disaster prevention strategy determination method, device, equipment and medium for main-distribution network
abstract_en: The application discloses a disaster prevention strategy determination method, device, equipment and medium of a main-distribution network, relating to the technical field of power system elasticity evaluation and comprising the steps of determining a target topology model of a system based on a preset island balance strategy and topology information of the main network and the distribution network in a power system with the cooperation of the main-distribution network; the method comprises the steps of carrying out random fault scene generation based on a preset improved Monte Carlo algorithm, carrying out trend analysis and cascading fault simulation analysis of a fault scene based on a fault generation result and a target topology model, analyzing fault coupling conditions of a main-distribution network based on a fault scene analysis result, a system collapse threshold and a seepage theory, determining a critical threshold curve in a two-dimensional failure space, and determining a criticality index corresponding to each component in the main-distribution network and a comprehensive toughness evaluation index of the system based on the critical threshold curve to determine a target disaster prevention strategy. The application can identify critical conditions of the cooperative failure of the main-distribution network and identify weak links of the system, thereby enhancing the resistance of the system.
assignees: STATE GRID CHONGQING ELECTRIC POWER CO;INST ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCES STATE GRID CHONGQING ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Construction progress dynamic optimization method and system based on BIM and computer vision
abstract_en: The invention discloses a construction progress dynamic optimization method and a construction progress dynamic optimization system based on BIM and computer vision, which particularly relate to the technical field of building construction management and comprise the following steps of automatically registering a BIM model with a construction site image; the method comprises the steps of processing a construction site image by adopting a visual recognition algorithm to generate a visual recognition result, constructing a four-dimensional dynamic BIM model, mapping the visual recognition result to a corresponding component in real time through multi-feature similarity calculation, monitoring progress deviation by utilizing a key path dynamic recognition and deviation propagation matrix, and combining a Bayesian network and Monte Carlo simulation prediction risk. According to the invention, by fusing BIM and computer vision technology, a construction progress optimization system integrating automatic registration, dynamic monitoring, risk prediction and intelligent decision is constructed, the problems of low efficiency, delay in progress monitoring, fuzzy risk prediction and rough resource allocation in traditional manual inspection data acquisition are solved, and accurate monitoring, risk early warning and resource optimization configuration of construction progress are realized.
assignees: ZHEJIANG LIDE ENG CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Wind power credible capacity assessment method and device based on cascading failure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind power credible capacity assessment method and device based on cascading faults, which comprise the steps of obtaining grid network frame topological structure information of a target power system, conventional attribute information of a conventional unit and wind power attribute information of a wind power unit, obtaining actual power grid operation information of a target area in a preset time period, constructing representative scenes of the target power system before, during and after cascading faults based on the information, respectively carrying out fault evolution operation simulation on the target power system in the representative scenes before, during and after faults, determining a power grid state feature matrix of the target power system in the representative scenes of all faults based on simulation results, and determining wind power credible capacity by means of alternate iteration based on the power grid state feature matrix by using an upper layer model and a lower layer model.
assignees: EAST CHINA BRANCH OF STATE GRID CORP OF CHINA

title_en: The techic of sensing and tracking spreaded forest fire
title_ko: 지능형 산불확산 추적 검지 기술
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A technique of sensing and tracking spread forest fire is provided to detect sensing of the fire, propagation range of fire in real time. CONSTITUTION: The monitoring forest fire central processing apparatus(410) has the radio forest fire sensor. The real-time distribution and diffusion information of the forest fire are transferred to the forest fire hunting scanning and tracking controller server. The radio forest fire sensor provides the route notice for the forest fire suppression as the radio communication in real time. The forest fire scanning and hunting control server(420) trace the diffusion rate of the forest fire and direction of the forest fire. The forest fire scanning and hunting control server deliver the route information request(461) to each concentration processing unit(410). The forest fire detection sensor(400) transmits the forest fire sense information to the monitoring forest fire central processing apparatus.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 과학적인 산불방지 통합 시스템을 위해 지능형 디지털 센서를 이용하여 산불 및 주변환경의 변화를 센서가 감지한 경우 무선네트워크를 통해 산불감지센서와 산불검지 및 추적제어 서버와 통신하여 지능적 대처를 할 수 있는 시스템으로, 기존 센싱 정보를 서버에 단순하게 전송하던 방식에서 벗어나, 지능을 가진 센서를 통해 산불 경로 및 산불확산 범위, 속도 등 다양한 정보를 산불 관리자에게 알려 주어 산불의 조기진압 및 전략적 산불 진압을 할 수 있다. 
       
     지능형 산불확산 검지

title_en: Seismic vibration isolation system for building, and method for constructing this same
title_ko: 건축물 기둥용 면진 시설물 및 이의 시공 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a vibration isolation facility for a building column and a construction method thereof. An objective of the present invention is to prevent a movement of ground from propagating to a column by an effective separation movement of the ground and the column during an earthquake to prevent shaking of the column and collapse of a building. According to the present invention, the vibration isolation facility for a building column comprises: a moving plate (11) seated on ground and fixed by an anchor settled in the ground to move with the ground; a plurality of ball transfers (12) installed on the moving plate to move with the moving plate; a movement absorption plate (13) fixed on a lower end of the column to be placed on the ball transfers and prevent movements of the moving plate and the ball transfers from propagating to the column; and a link (14) wherein both vertical ends thereof are connected to the movement absorption plate and the moving plate. The present invention includes a column installation groove (20) formed on the ground, opened upwards, and sealed by a cover. A lower portion of the column is inserted and installed in the column installation groove.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 건축물 기둥용 면진 시설물 및 이의 시공 방법에 관한 것으로, 지진 시 지반과 기둥의 원활한 분리 거동을 통해 지반의 거동이 기둥으로 전파되는 것을 막아 기둥의 흔들림과 건축물의 붕괴를 막아주는 것을 목적으로 한다. 
본 발명에 의한 건축물 기둥용 면진 시설물은, 지반에 안착되며 지중에 정착된 앵커를 통해 고정되어 지반과 함께 거동하는 거동판(11)과; 상기 거동판의 위에 설치되어 상기 거동판과 함께 거동하는 다수의 볼 트랜스퍼(12)와; 상기 기둥의 하단부에 고정되어 상기 볼 트랜스퍼 위에 올려지며 상기 거동판과 상기 볼 트랜스퍼의 거동이 기둥에 전파되는 것을 차단하는 거동흡수판(13)과; 상하 양단부가 상기 거동흡수판과 상기 거동판에 각각 연결하는 링크(14)를 포함한다. 본 발명은 지반에 상부를 향해 개방 형성되며 덮개를 통해 밀폐되는 기둥 설치홈(20)을 포함하며, 상기 기둥은 저부가 상기 기둥 설치홈 안에 삽입 설치된다.

title_en: Serious gaming for interdependent critical infrastructure (ci) resilience determination
abstract_en: Serious gaming for interrelated critical infrastructure (CI) resilience improvement includes receiving from a serious gaming participant a selection of an anomalous event for a geographic region for which a hierarchy of CI elements has been modeled, and a specified change in allocation of at least one resource in a corresponding one of the CI elements. A previously determined cascading impact upon the CI elements resulting from the anomalous event is then retrieved and compared to a hypothetical cascading impact produced by a simulation of the model with the specified change. A visualization of the comparison is transmitted to the serious gaming participant so as to show the result of the hypothetical change in resources upon the cascading impact of the event in the hierarchy of CI elements.

title_en: Water body dissolved oxygen detection device based on machine vision
abstract_en: The invention discloses a machine vision-based water body dissolved oxygen detection device, which comprises: the sampling device is used for sucking a water sample from a water body to be detected and storing the water sample in a sample storage bottle; the dropping device is used for storing a plurality of titrated solutions or reagents and reacting with dissolved oxygen in the water sample; the quartz glass reaction vessel is used for receiving the water sample output from the sample storage bottle and the solution or the reagent output from the dropping device and carrying out reaction in the quartz glass reaction vessel; the information processing module comprises a shooting module and a control panel, wherein the shooting module is used for shooting liquid in the quartz glass reaction vessel, an image obtained by shooting is input to a processor of the control panel, the processor is used for processing the image, RGB components of the image are extracted, the RGB components are converted into HSI components, and then the HSI components are used as input quantities to be input into a trained neural network to obtain the concentration of dissolved oxygen; the neural network is trained by an error back propagation method.

title_en: Dangerous chemical transportation path dynamic risk prevention and control system and method based on space-time fusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of intelligent traffic safety, in particular to a system and a method for preventing and controlling dynamic risks of a dangerous chemical transportation path based on space-time fusion, which are used for calculating a multidimensional risk index matrix through a risk index quantization module and realizing accurate assessment of dynamic risks of a road section by combining a space-time environment sensitivity prediction matrix generated by an environment sensitivity analysis module and a risk propagation probability cloud picture of a risk diffusion prediction module; the system establishes a collaborative risk factor assessment model, adjusts a safety threshold according to historical accident data to generate a time-space road network risk scoring matrix, determines an early warning level according to the safety threshold, selects prevention and control measures, optimizes a transportation path, makes an emergency response plan for a high-risk road section and outputs an intelligent decision instruction set.

title_en: Distributed photovoltaic and energy storage cooperative power distribution network voltage fluctuation suppression method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for suppressing voltage fluctuation of a distribution network by cooperation of distributed photovoltaic and energy storage, and relates to the technical field of voltage fluctuation suppression, comprising the following steps of constructing a disturbance propagation reachability matrix among nodes based on real-time operation data of the distribution network, and identifying a voltage disturbance path set; the method comprises the steps of constructing a disturbance irreversible structure diagram based on a voltage disturbance path set, identifying a unidirectional amplification chain, calculating disturbance excitation probability according to historical disturbance data of a unidirectional amplification chain source node, generating a disturbance active propagation domain, constructing an energy storage intervention buffer zone in the disturbance active propagation domain, and generating a collaborative strategy activation condition by simulating disturbance propagation to evaluate reverse blocking capacity of energy storage in the energy storage intervention buffer zone. According to the invention, through disturbance path simulation evaluation, energy storage redundant configuration and power consumption are reduced, and the inhibition efficiency and adaptability of the system are improved.

title_en: Substation foundation settlement prediction analysis system and method based on industrial cloud platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of online monitoring, in particular to a transformer substation foundation settlement prediction analysis system and method based on an industrial cloud platform, the method comprises the steps of establishing a digital grid unit of a three-dimensional space of a transformer substation, collecting real-time working condition data and ground water level data of all equipment in the transformer substation, and predicting and obtaining real-time settlement rate and accumulated settlement of each grid unit; and constructing a double risk propagation network, calculating a settlement risk probability value and a global risk entropy value, and generating a three-dimensional visual maintenance navigation. The method solves the problems of low accuracy of predicting the settlement risk of the transformer substation caused by insufficient integration of multi-source dynamic data and incapability of quantifying time-varying coupling effect of a static load model in the prior art.

title_en: A kind of enterprise evaluation method and system based on risk conduction model
abstract_en: The present invention, which provides one kind, can be based on enterprise and employee's risk conduct the relation, be capable of the enterprise evaluation method of accurate evaluation business risk, comprise the following steps, and obtain nodal information, establish risk conducting networks；Obtain the risk initial value of node；Definition node risk propagation function and relational risk propagation function；Training risk conduction model.Invention obtains preferably model parameter, and then can obtain accurate business risk value during business risk is assessed by establishing network risks conduction model, and to model iteration.
assignees: CHONGQING SOCIALCREDITS BIG DATA TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power communication network maintenance drilling method and system based on fault simulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power communication network maintenance drilling method and device based on fault simulation, wherein maintenance task information is obtained, corresponding equipment and optical cable resources are obtained based on maintenance contents in the maintenance task information, and maintenance preview simulation is carried out; simulating and setting corresponding faults according to the correlation between the maintenance task information and the equipment and the optical cable, and presenting the diffusion and the propagation of the faults on the network topology and the operation state; and analyzing the fault influence according to the fault alarm to realize the maintenance drilling. The method and the device finally realize the maintenance rehearsal of the power communication network based on fault simulation, improve the pertinence and effectiveness of the maintenance rehearsal analysis, and improve the efficiency of related operation and maintenance personnel in the maintenance work of the power communication network.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION COMPANY;NANJING NARI INFORMATION COMM TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for establishing strip mine slope displacement prediction model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of strip mine excavation engineering, in particular to a method for establishing a strip mine side slope displacement prediction model, which comprises the steps of obtaining side slope deformation monitoring sample data, determining a topological structure of a BP (back propagation) neural network, and determining the number of neurons of an input layer, a hidden layer and an output layer; determining the population scale and the dimension of the particle swarm according to the topological structure of the BP neural network to determine a fitness function and a system error; the sample data is brought into each particle, the forward propagation calculation of the network is carried out, and the fitness value of each particle is calculated one by one; comparing fitness function values, and replacing the individual optimal solution after the variation and the global optimal solution after the variation if the fitness value of the individual optimal solution of the particles after the variation or the fitness value corresponding to the global optimal solution of the particle swarm is smaller than that before the variation; and initializing a BP neural network by using vector elements corresponding to the global optimal solution after iteration is stopped, wherein the BP neural network is the prediction model of the slope displacement of the strip mine.

title_en: Plant propagation algorithm-based power distribution network distributed power supply optimization planning method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a plant propagation algorithm-based power distribution network distributed power supply optimization planning method, which comprises the following steps: carrying out power flow analysis on the power distribution network to obtain the power loss and the bus voltage of the power distribution network; according to the power loss and the bus voltage, constructing an objective function by taking maximum reduction of the power loss and maximum reduction of the voltage drop as optimization objectives, wherein the constraint condition of the objective function comprises economic constraint after deployment; and solving the objective function by adopting a plant propagation algorithm to realize the planning of the distributed power supply in the power distribution network. The invention can ensure the economical efficiency of the distributed power supply deployment and installation.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI ENERGY INTERNET RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Dynamic safety margin assessment method for novel electric-gas interconnection power system
abstract_en: The invention provides a dynamic safety margin assessment method for a novel electric-gas interconnection electric power system, and relates to the technical field of electric power systems. Measuring and summarizing measured values of nodes at all sampling moments based on the multi-time scale characteristics of the novel electric power system with electric-gas interconnection, and performing data conversion and standardization treatment; constructing a heterogeneous data detection matrix, obtaining a characteristic value and a maximum characteristic vector by carrying out singular value decomposition on the heterogeneous data matrix, and further processing the characteristic value and the maximum characteristic vector to correspond to the node state so as to form a sample data set; building a depth map convolution neural network model and building a distributed perception learning module; training the model by inputting the processed data set; after the mean value of the real-time operation data is removed, the obtained left and right singular matrixes are input into a trained model to detect the safety margin of the electric-gas coupling network. The invention can achieve the purpose of timely and effectively evaluating the operation safety margin of the system and avoiding major accidents such as power failure cascading failures.

title_en: Double-cluster management method based on openGauss database
abstract_en: The invention relates to a double-cluster management method based on openGauss databases. The method is based on openGauss providing cascading flow copying capability from hadr _main_standby to castade_standby, dividing a part of standby in a single-cluster scheme into a new cluster, and selecting one standby in the new cluster as hadr _main_standby, wherein the standby performs flow copying from primary; the rest of the standby in the new cluster is taken as a cascade_standby, and the cascade flow copy is carried out from hadr _main_standby. The double-cluster high-availability scheme provided by the invention can easily realize the deployment of double clusters and the switching among clusters. When the main cluster fails, the standby cluster can be manually lifted to be the main cluster, so that service can be continuously provided, and disaster recovery is realized. The method not only can lighten the flow replication pressure of primary, but also can greatly reduce the network resource occupation caused by flow replication in a disaster recovery scene in different places, and simultaneously provides a simple method for improving the standby cluster to the master cluster.
assignees: GUANGZHOU MASS DATABASE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method, device, equipment and medium for analyzing failure disaster chain of gas pipeline
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a device, equipment and a medium for analyzing a failure disaster chain of a gas pipeline, which relate to the technical field of gas pipeline analysis and comprise the following steps: when the natural gas transmission pipeline fails, taking all disaster events of the current natural gas transmission pipeline as nodes in a network, taking induction factors among the disaster events as directed continuous edges in the network, and constructing a disaster chain network according to the nodes and the directed continuous edges; calculating topological structure parameters comprising an input degree, an output degree, a total degree value and a clustering coefficient in a disaster chain network, and determining an evolution mechanism of failure disaster chain risk propagation of the current natural gas transmission pipeline based on the topological structure parameters; calculating the risk degree of a failure disaster chain of the current natural gas transmission pipeline based on the disaster rate, the loss degree and the directed continuous edge weakness degree of the disaster chain network; analyzing the current natural gas pipeline according to an evolution mechanism of the risk propagation of the failure disaster chain of the current natural gas pipeline and the risk degree of the failure disaster chain of the current natural gas pipeline.

title_en: Hierarchical distributed scheduling method and system for multi-microgrid power distribution system under carbon flow tracing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hierarchical distributed scheduling method and system of a multi-microgrid power distribution system under carbon flow tracing, wherein the method comprises the following steps: establishing operation constraint of the multi-micro-grid power distribution system according to the selected system parameters and scheduling parameters of the multi-micro-grid power distribution system; based on a carbon emission flow theory, reasonably and averagely spreading carbon responsibility of a power distribution network source side to a load side, guiding a power distribution network-micro network interaction low-carbon energy consumption behavior, and constructing a power distribution network system carbon transaction constraint and a multi-micro network system carbon transaction constraint under carbon flow tracing; establishing a multi-microgrid power distribution system layered distributed scheduling model under carbon flow tracing by utilizing a target cascading theory; and decoupling the interaction power by a target cascading method and carrying out iterative solution. The invention is based on a layered distributed optimization idea of a target cascade analysis method and a multi-microgrid power distribution system collaborative complementary operation strategy, and adopts a correlation solver to solve a mixed integer linear programming model in an optimization stage to obtain a system operation scheme in a scheduling period.

title_en: Power grid cascading failure early warning method based on risk assessment model
