abstract_en: The invention relates to a power grid cascading failure early warning method based on a risk assessment model, which comprises the steps of dynamically monitoring the load condition of a line in a coverage area by using the risk assessment model, marking the line judged to be abnormal by the risk assessment model as a potential risk line, acquiring a line associated with the potential risk line, determining a load transfer amount according to the current load quantity of the associated line, calculating the difference value between the load transfer amount and the local reserved load of the potential risk line, marking the difference value as the local reserved load, comparing the ratio of the local processing amount to the local reserved load, and sending early warning when the ratio is larger than or equal to a set value. According to the power grid cascading failure early warning method and system based on the risk assessment model, the risk assessment model is combined with the mode that the risk assessment model predicts and the later adjustment means intervenes to correct the result given by the risk assessment model.
assignees: KAIFENG POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Full-polarization programmable antenna unit and design method
abstract_en: The full-polarization programmable antenna unit comprises a digital amplitude-phase programmable matching network module and a horn-type radiation antenna module, wherein the digital amplitude-phase programmable matching network module comprises a T-shaped power divider, a 90-degree directional coupler, an FPGA control module and two 360-degree digital phase shifters, and the amplitude is realized by mutually cascading the power divider, the 360-degree phase shifters and the 90-degree directional coupler, and the FPGA control module is used for realizing programmable regulation. The amplitude and phase modulation of two polarization components of the antenna unit can be realized through the digital amplitude phase programmable matching network module, specifically, the programmable matching network module for feeding is connected with the antenna radiator through the radio frequency coaxial line, so that the full polarization programmable capacity is greatly improved, the polarization loss can be reduced and the polarization interference capacity can be improved through polarization change in a complex and changeable electromagnetic environment, and the method can also be applied to application scenes such as polarization imaging in combination with related algorithms in the aspect of polarization information identification.

title_en: Dynamic evaluation method and device for toughness of supply chain network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic evaluation method for toughness of a supply chain network. The method comprises the steps of defining normal operation, damage and interruption states of nodes, simulating interruption propagation and tracking node state changes through constructing an improved cascade failure model, counting the number of normal operation nodes at each moment to generate a structural performance curve, constructing a maximum flow model with maximum total delivery capacity as a target, solving the total delivery capacity at each moment to generate an operation performance curve, respectively calculating maximum performance degradation, recovery duration and average performance maintenance rate according to the structural performance curve and the operation performance curve, and quantifying the network toughness of a supply chain from three dimensions of absorption capacity, recovery capacity and adaptive capacity. The invention also discloses a supply chain network toughness dynamic evaluation device, electronic equipment, a storage medium and a computer program product. The invention can dynamically evaluate the toughness of the supply chain network when the supply chain network is at risk of interruption, provides stability and reliability basis, and is suitable for evaluating and optimizing the toughness of the supply chain network.

title_en: Expressway construction area risk situation sensing method based on environment sensing
abstract_en: The invention relates to an expressway construction area risk situation awareness method based on environment awareness, which comprises the steps of deploying a multi-source sensing device network along the expressway construction area and at key structure positions to collect data and label, constructing and training an expressway construction area risk situation awareness model, obtaining a trained model through counter propagation and joint optimization of all trainable parameters of the model, deploying the trained model to a construction area edge computing platform, outputting a final prediction result through the trained model according to the data collected in real time, judging whether early warning is carried out or not according to the prediction result, calibrating the risk position and grade, and continuously screening a high confidence sample through a pseudo tag self-enhancement module to carry out fine tuning on the model. According to the invention, the constructed model is trained, so that the construction risk can be predicted more quickly and accurately, workers are guided to carry out emergency treatment in time, and the safety index in the construction process is improved.

title_en: Risk scheduling method for water resource system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water resource system risk scheduling method which comprises the steps of obtaining regional basic data, constructing a supply and demand pressure field, identifying causal relations, generating heterogeneous computing grids and a space-time causal network, dynamically determining a water-required tail cutting threshold value by adopting a cascade buffer pool mechanism based on historical supply and demand sequence data of the heterogeneous computing grids and influence factors identified by the space-time causal network, outputting a regulated water-required sequence, generating a water scene set by adopting an optimal transmission method of tail conformal by utilizing the regulated water-required sequence, simplifying the water scene set into a representative scene subset, constructing a distributed robust optimization model aiming at the representative scene subset, and generating a water resource scheduling scheme and a risk assessment report by fairness constraint projection and causal path analysis. The invention can finely describe the space-time pressure, adaptively regulate and control the extreme requirements, and generate a scheduling scheme which takes robustness and fairness into consideration under the condition of keeping the tail risk characteristics.

title_en: Carbon emission reduction and ecological cooperative gain accounting method for geothermal development full life cycle
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of big data analysis and processing, and particularly relates to a full life cycle carbon emission reduction and ecological synergy gain accounting method for geothermal development. The method comprises the steps of firstly constructing a graph containing life cycle stage unit process nodes, space grids or land block nodes and ecological index nodes, setting process influence edges, space adjacent edges and space observation edges in the graph, secondly constructing a graph neural network model which adopts a graph attention network layer and graph convolution network layer combination on the graph, and thirdly writing operation information of a target geothermal development scheme into attribute fields of the life cycle stage unit process nodes and the space grids or land block nodes to obtain a full life cycle carbon emission reduction and ecological cooperative gain accounting result of geothermal development. The invention can simultaneously consider the staged influence of engineering activities, the spatial propagation characteristics and the dynamic response of an ecological system, so that the carbon emission reduction effect and the ecological synergistic effect are presented in a spatial mode on the full life cycle scale.
assignees: SHANDONG PROVINCIAL LAND SPACE ECOLOGICAL RESTORATION CENTER SHANDONG PROVINCIAL GEOLOGICAL DISASTER;UNIV SHANDONG SCIENCE & TECH;LUNAN GEOLOGICAL ENGINEERING INVESTIGATION INST OF SHANDONG PROVINCE SECOND GEOLOGICAL BRIGADE OF SH

title_en: Fire disaster monitoring system
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To enhance a determination accuracy of a fire disaster by making a multilayer type neural network efficiently study by fire disaster input information or a non-fire disaster image adapted to a monitoring region.SOLUTION: Images of monitoring regions 14-1, 14-2 imaged by monitoring cameras 16-1, 16-2 are inputted to a multilayer type neural network provided in a determination device to determine whether a fire disaster or a non-fire disaster breaks out. When the fire disaster is determined to break out, a fire alarm is caused to be issued from a receiver of fire alarm equipment. The determination device is provided with a recording device, and moving images of the monitoring regions imaged by the monitoring camera are recorded. The determination device is provided with a study control part, and upon receipt of a fire disaster alarm signal from the receiver, if a fire disaster determination operation is performed by the receiver, the recording images at that time are read from the recording device and inputted to the multilayer type neural network as fire disaster images, thereby making a study by error reverse propagation. When a restoration operation is performed by the receiver, the recording images are inputted to the multilayer type neural network as the non-fire disaster images to be studied.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Method for safety evaluation of energy storage system, apparatus and device
abstract_en: A method for safety evaluation of an energy storage system, an apparatus and a device, relating to the technical field of energy storage systems. The method comprises: acquiring first operating data of an energy storage system, the first operating data comprising fault data describing at least one basic fault type; on the basis of the first operating data, determining a prior probability of a basic fault type represented by a leaf node in a Bayesian failure propagation network, a root node in the Bayesian failure propagation network being used for representing a failure mode of the energy storage system, and a directed path from the leaf node to the root node representing a propagation link of the failure mode caused by the basic fault type; on the basis of the prior probability and the directed path from the leaf node to the root node, inferring a posterior probability of a corresponding failure mode of the energy storage system; and on the basis of the posterior probability, obtaining an evaluation result of the energy storage system.
assignees: HUAWEI DIGITAL POWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Determining utility infrastructure and connectivity interruptions
abstract_en: An approach for determining an infrastructure service interruption is disclosed. The approach relies on utilizing UAVs (unmanned aerial vehicle) to map electronic signals (e.g., Wi-Fi, etc.) that emanates from building structures (e.g., residential, commercial, etc.). Electronic signals having a certain frequency or multiple frequencies may be used. Essentially, the approach can detect power/signal loss by comparing differences in Wi-Fi signal maps pre and post event (e.g., severe thunderstorm, etc.). The 24/7 event monitoring is carried out by using UAVs and the UAVs can operate on a regular or event driven schedule vs. continuously operating multiple fixed data collection units.

title_en: A kind of wind power base cascading failure risk perceptions method for early warning
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of wind power base cascading failure risk perceptions method for early warning and system thereof.The present invention obtains electrical network and the real time operation mode data of wind energy turbine set by SCADA and WAMS, obtain the foundation of current electric grid contingent wind power disturbance in conjunction with wind energy turbine set historical data and be reasonably expected that fault set, the Wind turbines dynamic model set up and fan safe protection model, wind energy turbine set dynamic operating conditions after simulating grid fault, carry out the Power Network Transient Stability analysis after wind power base breaks down, and after failure removal, carry out static security analysis, by the serial index being applicable to the cascading failure early warning of large-scale wind electricity base set up, safety and stability situation after current electric grid generation wind power disturbance is calculated assessment, analyze large-scale wind electricity base and the risk of cascading failure occurs, realize the safety on line early warning of power system after wind power disturbance.The present invention is easily achieved, it is possible to reflect the power system safety and stability ruuning situation comprising large-scale wind power base intuitively.

title_en: Endless-walk formula restoration methods based on bandwidth fairness in a kind of WDM optical-fiber networks
abstract_en: The endless-walk formula restoration methods based on bandwidth fairness in a kind of wavelength-division multiplex (WDM) optical-fiber network are claimed in the present invention, belong to Communication Network Technique field.This method is directed to the business recovery problem in disaster loss network, the method restored using endless-walk formula, and providing fairness bandwidth for different brackets business restores.By flexibly dividing the grade of service and adjustment and recovery step-length, the business that is damaged to different brackets carries out interim or step-by-step movement and restores successively, realizes the relative fairness of each grade business recovery；The recovery priority of business is damaged according to bandwidth loss rate dynamic adjustment ad eundem, in a manner that least unit bandwidth cycle is restored, realizes the fairness of ad eundem business recovery；By the recovery operation of multiple endless-walk formula, effectively improve the service fairness of recovery business and reduce the Service disruption ratio of the whole network.

title_en: Vulnerability assessment method for information physical fusion system in cascading failure mode
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vulnerability assessment method of an information physical fusion system in a cascading failure mode, which comprises the following steps: s1, establishing an information layer model and a physical layer model according to a complex network theory; s2, modeling the dependency relationship between the information layer and the physical layer by using a dependency theory according to the information layer model and the physical layer model to obtain a coupling model; s3, modeling the electric CPS cascading failure by using a seepage theory according to the coupling model, and outputting all survival nodes of the coupling model; s4, establishing vulnerability assessment indexes, and assessing the vulnerability of the power CPS according to the vulnerability assessment indexes and survival nodes of the coupling model; the invention solves the problems of complex steps, low effectiveness, low practicability and lack of generality in the prior art, and avoids serious consequences of power failure, thereby causing huge economic loss and social influence.

title_en: Short-term power load prediction method
abstract_en: The invention provides a short-term power load forecasting method, which comprises the steps of establishing a short-term power load forecasting model based on a front-stage and back-stage BP cascade neural network, clustering historical power load data by adopting an improved maximum deviation similarity criterion clustering algorithm, carrying out hierarchical clustering on class centers, obtaining similar load classes of a forecasting day through class cluster combination, and taking load data of a Z class as training data of the back-stage BP neural network, thereby improving the convergence speed and the forecasting precision of the neural network. The short-term power load prediction method provided by the invention has the advantages of high calculation speed and high prediction precision, and can better meet the demand of a power grid on power load prediction.

title_en: Disaster roaming method, device and system
abstract_en: The method, the device and the system for disaster roaming can reduce service interruption of terminal equipment, minimize service interruption and improve user experience. Specifically, the terminal equipment determines a first PLMN according to the stored information of the disaster roaming public land mobile network PLMN; the information of the disaster roaming PLMN comprises identification information of at least one PLMN allowing the terminal equipment to perform disaster roaming, wherein the first PLMN is a PLMN in the at least one PLMN; the terminal equipment sends a registration request message to the first PLMN, wherein the registration request message comprises disaster roaming indication information, and the disaster roaming indication information is used for indicating the terminal equipment to request disaster roaming registration; the terminal device receives a registration acceptance message sent by the first PLMN.

title_en: Wind power prediction method based on DE-BP neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind power prediction method based on a DE-BP neural network, which is implemented according to the following steps: step 1, acquiring and processing wind power related data; step 2, adjusting the weight and the threshold of the BP neural network by using a gradient descent method and back propagation, and establishing the BP neural network; step 3, searching the initial weight value and the optimal value of the threshold value of the BP neural network established in the step 2 by utilizing a DE algorithm to obtain a DE-BP neural network model; and 4, using the DE-BP neural network model for wind power prediction, and performing wind power prediction. The wind power prediction method based on the DE-BP neural network solves the problems that the prediction method in the prior art is easy to fall into a local optimal value and the convergence speed is too slow.

title_en: Cascading failure risk assessment method based on network dependency relationship
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascading failure risk assessment method based on a network dependency relationship, which comprises the following steps: 1, constructing an electric power information physical system, improving conditions of network dependency relationship, 2, constructing a risk transfer function, forming an initial fault set of information nodes, 3, selecting an initial fault, wherein the fault is transmitted between a power grid and an information network in a cross-space mode due to risk transfer, 4, selecting an initial fault line and a subsequent fault line of the power grid according to the risk transfer function, and if corresponding fault on-off information is uploaded to a dispatching center, the dispatching center issues a corresponding control command; if the information uploading is unsuccessful, the dispatching center is not controlled, the protection and safety device traverses the initial fault set according to the system state action 5, the steps 3-4 are repeated until the end condition is met, the accident chain data are recorded, and the risk is calculated. On the basis of network dependence, the invention takes the transmission characteristics of the power grid and the information grid into consideration, thereby researching the cross-space propagation process of the fault and providing theoretical guidance for the prevention and control of the cascading faults of the electric power information physical system.

title_en: Intelligent monitoring method and system for water conservancy facilities based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent monitoring method and system for water conservancy facilities based on the Internet of things, which belong to the technical field of water conservancy projects, and comprise the steps of collecting data through a sensor, generating a physical dependency graph, fusing the physical dependency graph and a short-time dependency graph into a space perception graph, and establishing a space perception model, obtaining an abnormal propagation link and an abnormal score set, extracting high-confidence abnormal links, aggregating the high-confidence abnormal links in the space perception model to obtain a global model, and generating a scheduling decision through the global model. According to the intelligent monitoring method and system for the water conservancy facilities based on the Internet of things, under a multi-facility distributed monitoring scene, the space-structure dependency relationship between multi-dimensional monitoring data in the water conservancy facilities can be fully modeled, the space accurate positioning and propagation path tracing of abnormal events are realized, and the abnormal detection capability in single facilities is remarkably improved.

title_en: Dynamics-based synchronous cross information propagation analysis method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a synchronous cross information propagation analysis method and a system based on dynamics, which comprises the following steps: dividing the state of a network user into three user states of a susceptible state, a forwarding state and an immune state; constructing a cross information synchronous propagation dynamic model of the user changing between different user states along with the propagation of the two pieces of information; collecting two pieces of information of which the release time interval is smaller than a set value, dividing the user states of network users of the two pieces of information, inputting a plurality of user states of the two pieces of divided information into a cross information synchronous propagation dynamic model, and predicting the total number of individuals of different crowds changing along with time. The above method and system consider the interaction between two pieces of information.

title_en: Modeling and threshold algorithm for rumor propagation system under random switching visual angle
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rumor propagation prediction, and discloses a modeling method of a rumor propagation system under a random switching visual angle, which comprises the following steps: classifying the population in the social network rumor model, drawing a relation flow chart of each population, constructing a differential equation expression of the rumor model, searching a rumor-free balance point and a rumor-having balance point of the model according to whether the rumors are popular, and solving a basic regeneration number, thereby further explaining a switching model. The invention firstly provides an assumption that a social network is assumed to exist and is composed of N individuals, the individuals can be regarded as nodes in the network, the relationship between the individuals can be regarded as connecting edges between the network nodes, in the whole network, the switching model is further explained, the contact infection rate is added with a Markov chain by using the nonlinear coupling relationship, and the anti-rumor is added on the basis of the traditional model, thereby conforming to the more practical situation.

title_en: Urban infrastructure group vulnerability analysis method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for analyzing the vulnerability of an urban infrastructure group, wherein the method for analyzing the vulnerability of the urban infrastructure group comprises the following steps: acquiring city infrastructure data; dividing all infrastructures in the city into city infrastructure groups according to the city infrastructure data; constructing a facility group cascade failure model for the city infrastructure group; analyzing the vulnerability of the urban infrastructure group according to the facility group cascade failure model; discovering a vulnerable infrastructure from all of the infrastructures of the urban infrastructure group according to the vulnerability. According to the method, the urban infrastructure group is constructed based on the relevance among the infrastructures, the operation condition of the infrastructures is analyzed in a non-isolated manner, the actual cascade failure model of the infrastructure group is constructed based on the infrastructure load distribution after the external disturbance occurs, and the results of vulnerability analysis and the fragile infrastructure excavation are closer to reality and more effective.
assignees: SHENZHEN URBAN TRANSP PLANNING CENTER CO LTD;SHENZHEN TRANSP RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: BP neural network-based industrial device energy consumption control method
abstract_en: The invention provides an energy consumption control method of an industrial device based on a BP (back propagation) neural network, which comprises the following steps: collecting historical energy consumption information and influence factor information of the industrial device and historical data corresponding to the historical energy consumption information and the influence factor information to form an energy consumption characteristic data set; inputting the energy consumption characteristic data set into a BP neural network model to be trained for training until the trained BP neural network model converges to obtain a trained BP neural network model; inputting the collected real-time energy consumption data of the industrial device into a trained BP neural network model for operation to obtain an energy consumption predicted value of the industrial device; and when the absolute value of the deviation between the predicted energy consumption value and the actual energy consumption value is larger than the set deviation fluctuation value, the industrial device gives an abnormal alarm. The industrial device energy consumption control method based on the BP neural network can be suitable for various industrial devices, is simple in control process and accurate in energy consumption control, and can be widely applied to the field of energy consumption control.

title_en: Single event prediction effect method based on dense connection network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a single event prediction effect method based on a dense connection network, which comprises the following steps of; step 1, modeling by GEANT4: step 2, taking the obtained LET data under different particle conditions as a data set; step 3, randomly dividing a total sample data set into a training set, a cross validation set and a test set, and fixing random seeds to ensure that an experimental result can be reproduced; step 4, constructing a prediction model based on the dense connection network; step 5, inputting the training set into a prediction model to optimize the prediction model; step 6, inputting the cross validation set into a prediction model in the process of step 5, and adjusting the repeated training times of the training set and the learning rate in back propagation in the optimization process by comparing the loss function curve with the loss function curve of the training set; and 7, evaluating the prediction accuracy and generalization capability of the method. The invention can accurately and quickly predict the linear energy transmission data of the microelectronic device, thereby analyzing the influence of the single particle effect on the linear energy transmission data.

title_en: Complex equipment elastic reliability assessment method considering fault and repair factors
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating the elastic reliability of complex equipment by considering fault and repair factors, which comprises the following steps: the prior parameters are calculated, which is aimed at the prior parameters to be used as input parameters of the dynamic bayesian network and the dynamic propagation properties. And step two, establishing a multi-level topological directed graph model, wherein the multi-level topological directed graph model is used as a structure model of the dynamic Bayesian network. And step three, calculating dynamic fault propagation attributes, wherein the purpose of the step is that the dynamic propagation attributes are used as input parameters of a conditional probability table in a dynamic Bayesian network. And step four, applying a conditional probability table. And fifthly, applying evidence information, wherein the aim of the step is that the evidence information is used as an input parameter of an evidence node in the dynamic Bayesian network. And step six, evaluating the elasticity reliability. The method fully considers the influence of a fault propagation mechanism and a repair factor, and can evaluate the elastic reliability of any complex equipment.

title_en: Tunnel crack micro defect detection method based on generation countermeasure network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tunnel crack micro defect detection method based on a generated countermeasure network, which comprises the steps of S1, acquiring a space-time crack data set containing tunnel surface micro crack information, S2, generating a preprocessed space-time crack data set, S3, generating a crack expansion image data set, S4, designing and generating a countermeasure network model comprising a generator and a discriminator, S5, inputting the preprocessed space-time crack data set into the generated countermeasure network model, S6, deploying the trained generated countermeasure network model into a tunnel monitoring system, S7, classifying the cracks into different risk grades according to the form, the size and the expansion trend of the cracks, and S8, and according to the crack detection result and the expansion trend thereof. The invention not only improves the accuracy of tunnel crack detection and the capability of predicting crack propagation, but also remarkably improves the automation level of the system, and can realize efficient and accurate crack detection and monitoring in complex environments.

title_en: Thermal power generating unit coordinated load change rate control method and system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power systems, and discloses a method and a system for controlling the coordinated load change rate of a thermal power unit, wherein the method comprises the steps of regarding the thermal power unit as a network node and establishing a connection relation between the thermal power units; defining attributes of nodes and edges, constructing a network topological structure, analyzing interaction and synergistic effects among thermal power units, constructing a load fluctuation propagation model, predicting the influence of load fluctuation on other units and transmission paths of the load fluctuation, determining an optimized load scheduling strategy by utilizing a cooperative control mechanism of a complex network, and combining the load fluctuation propagation model and an information transmission mechanism to adjust the load change rate of each unit in real time. According to the intelligent power grid dispatching method, load dispatching is optimized through the cooperative control mechanism and the load fluctuation propagation model, dispatching efficiency and stability of a power system are improved, influence of load fluctuation on the system is reduced, response capacity and adjustment flexibility of a unit are improved, and development of the intelligent power grid can be effectively promoted.
assignees: JINING HUAYUAN THERMAL POWER CO LTD;SHANDONG NAXIN ELECTRIC POWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network fault propagation path tracing method
abstract_en: The application provides a power distribution network fault propagation path tracing method. The method comprises the steps of preprocessing polymorphic measurement information in a power distribution network to generate node characteristic data by collecting the polymorphic measurement information and a system operation log, and extracting a time sequence characteristic set by combining the system operation log to provide a high-quality data base for subsequent analysis. By constructing the information difference graph, the information interconnection relation and the change condition between each target assembly before and after the fault can be intuitively reflected, so that the dynamic characteristics of fault propagation are captured. Further, sequencing learning is carried out on the time sequence feature set to generate a sequencing score, and a fault propagation path is determined by combining the information difference graph, so that a complete closed loop from data acquisition to path tracing is realized. The method not only improves the accuracy of fault location, but also remarkably improves the efficiency and reliability of fault tracing through multidimensional data fusion and intelligent analysis, and provides powerful support for the stable operation of the power distribution network.
assignees: ZHONGSHAN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO

title_en: Knowledge graph-based bad weather power grid risk identification method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for identifying risks of a severe weather power grid based on a knowledge graph, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of collecting multisource weather forecast data and power grid topological structure data in a target area, carrying out data cleaning and space-time calibration, fusing the weather data and power grid state data by utilizing a knowledge graph technology, generating a physical risk correlation sub-graph and a linkage risk correlation sub-graph, analyzing the physical damage risk and the fault cascade diffusion risk of power grid facilities by adopting a probability simulation method and a graph theory cascade failure analysis method respectively, determining the comprehensive risk level of a power grid, and generating a power grid risk thermodynamic diagram according to the comprehensive risk level of the power grid. The visual expression of the risk level of the power grid region is realized, and a decision basis is provided for power grid dispatching operation and pre-disaster early warning.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENT RES INST STATE GRID JIANGXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Low-voltage power failure range analysis method and system based on machine learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power supply systems, and particularly discloses a low-voltage power failure range analysis method and system based on machine learning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of collecting equipment operation parameters of a low-voltage power supply area, calculating equipment state abnormality indexes and power failure abnormality indexes, dynamically adjusting and carrying out electric power early warning to generate an adjusting scheme of the low-voltage power supply area, dynamically adjusting four monitoring periods to realize risk classification management and control, inputting the power failure abnormality indexes and multidimensional features into a machine learning model, identifying and mapping a fault propagation path and a power grid topology, defining a power failure geographic scope and quantitatively affecting indexes, automatically generating a command strategy comprising fault positioning, material scheduling and path planning based on emergency level, and obviously improving the risk prevention and control timeliness and the emergency repair resource scheduling accuracy of the low-voltage power distribution network.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Monitoring method and system for industrial chain breakpoint treatment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of industrial chain monitoring and treatment, in particular to a monitoring method and a system for industrial chain breakpoint treatment; the method comprises the steps of acquiring production, logistics, finance, policy and environment dynamic information through multi-source data, generating industrial chain comprehensive characteristics through standardization, multidimensional embedded representation and cross-dimension fusion, introducing historical trend dependence enhancement prospective prediction, constructing a dynamic coupling network, quantifying risk propagation intensity among nodes by using dynamic side weights to realize cross-level breakpoint propagation analysis, calculating risk indexes through fusion of node characteristics and a network structure, screening breakpoint candidate nodes by combining self-adaptive thresholds, predicting multi-step evolution trend by using a nonlinear propagation function, and mapping the multi-step evolution trend into multi-level early warning grades. Generating a treatment strategy according to the risk level, evaluating the effect in real time through a closed-loop optimization mechanism, and dynamically adjusting parameters. The invention realizes the closed-loop management of risk identification, prediction and self-adaptive treatment.
assignees: HIGH QUALITY STANDARDIZATION RES INSTITUTE SHANDONG CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic Bayesian network construction risk prediction method based on sliding window self-adaptive learning and particle filtering
abstract_en: A dynamic Bayesian network construction risk prediction method based on sliding window self-adaptive learning and particle filtering relates to the technical field of engineering construction safety management and intelligent prediction. The method comprises the steps of risk factor state input, dynamic Bayesian network topological structure construction, CPT updating based on sliding windows, risk state recursion reasoning based on particle filtering, risk prediction based on forward Monte Carlo propagation, and risk level assessment. The method can efficiently establish the accurate time sequence mapping relation between the risk state and the multisource observation, realize global state estimation and uncertainty quantification by combining a dynamic Bayesian network with particle filtering, and realize quick response and online updating of distributed drift by matching with sliding window self-adaptive learning, thereby comprehensively improving prediction efficiency and precision and early warning timeliness.
assignees: HARBIN INST TECHNOLOGY;FIRST CO CHINA 8TH ENG BUREAU LTD

title_en: Disaster recovery method, system and equipment in IMS network
abstract_en: There is provided a kind of disaster recovery method in the ims network, control system and equipment.Disaster recovery method in IMS network includes：By user equipment registration to the multiple IMS access devices communicated with equipment of the core network；The state of multiple IMS access devices is safeguarded in equipment of the core network；And when the service disruption of the IMS access devices that user equipment is used, equipment of the core network is based on the state of multiple IMS access devices, other IMS access devices in selection multiple IMS access devices are communicated with user equipment.According to presently filed embodiment, user equipment can be made to use IMS network un-interrupted in the case where the IMS access devices for being used cannot provide service.

title_en: Electric power system efficiency test management system and method for testing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of electric power system efficiency test management system and method for testing, whole system is divided into three layers, and ground floor is NML, by server centered management PXI or IPC/PC104 main control computer, and form ethernet local area network by hub, be cascaded to other local area network (LAN); The second layer is PXI system or the IPC/PC104 system that observing and controlling layer is furnished with embedded controller, serves as the client computer of centralized management system on the one hand, is again the main control computer of site measuring and control equipment on the other hand, serves the effect of gateway; Third layer comprises various monitoring and test equipment units, and the operation being arranged on monitored equipment is on-the-spot, and kind and quantity are determined according to detection requirement.The present invention realizes, to the real-time dynamic monitoring of the long-range energy consumption of electric power system power equipment at different levels, managing power consumption and Energy Efficiency Analysis work, realizing the real-time energy conservation of electric power system and reducing energy consumption.

title_en: Power amplifier frequency domain behavior modeling method based on FFT and BP neural network model
abstract_en: The invention aims to provide a power amplifier frequency domain behavior modeling method based on a Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) and Back Propagation (BP) neural network, which models a power amplifier from the perspective of a frequency domain and effectively solves the problem that the frequency domain precision of a common power amplifier behavior model is not high. The back propagation neural network model utilized by the method has good description capability on nonlinear data, and has the advantages of simple model structure, less required parameters and high convergence rate. The method can well describe the nonlinear characteristic and the memory effect of the power amplifier, especially the frequency domain characteristic of the power amplifier, and has higher model convergence speed and higher precision.

title_en: Electric power market clearing method, system, device and medium containing step hydropower
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a system, a device and a medium for clearing an electric power market comprising step hydropower. The method comprises the steps of obtaining unit operation boundary conditions, power grid operation boundary conditions, daily water level control interval information and quotation data of each unit in a power spot market issued by a power dispatching mechanism, and further obtaining a daily safety constraint unit combination model comprising hydraulic constraint conditions of a step hydroelectric unit; and the operation cost of the units is minimized as an objective function to clear the power market in the future, so as to obtain the clear result of the output of each unit. In the discharging and cleaning model of the electric power spot market, the embodiment of the application considers the upstream-downstream coupling relation of the cascade hydroelectric generating sets, linearizes the cascade hydroelectric generating sets through hydraulic constraint conditions, embeds the safety constraint set combination model to execute discharging and cleaning, is beneficial to the normal operation of the hydroelectric generating sets at all levels, and reduces the resource waste caused by water discarding of the hydropower station. The application can be widely applied to the technical field of electric power.

title_en: Multi-factor-based hydropower station generator deduction oil level prediction method
abstract_en: A hydroelectric power station generator deduction oil level prediction method based on multiple factors comprises the following steps: obtaining original data through a sensor, and then obtaining an original factor data matrix R and an original oil level matrix D; carrying out dimensionless treatment on the original factor data matrix R and the oil level original matrix D; obtaining a standardized factor data matrix X; weighting the standardized factor data matrix X; establishing an oil level prediction model, and training the oil level prediction model by using a three-layer back propagation neural network; inputting training samples to calculate errors; judging whether the oil level prediction model is trained; and if the training is completed, predicting by using the oil level prediction model. The method improves the accuracy and efficiency of deducing the oil level, uses multidimensional factors to establish a temperature prediction model, and avoids the influence on the historical trend analysis of the oil level; therefore, the oil level prediction result is more reasonable and accurate. The operation reliability of the hydropower station generator set can be effectively improved.

title_en: Wide-area tracing method, system, equipment and storage medium for broadband oscillation of power grid
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of power system automation, and discloses a wide-area tracing method, system, equipment and storage medium for broadband oscillation of a power grid, which comprises the steps of obtaining oscillation characteristic quantity information of nodes of each station; the method comprises the steps of obtaining oscillation station nodes in each station node and oscillation current flowing directions of each oscillation station node according to oscillation characteristic quantity information of each station node, obtaining oscillation amplitude of each oscillation station node, obtaining oscillation propagation directions of each oscillation station node according to the oscillation amplitude of each oscillation station node and the oscillation current flowing directions of each oscillation station node, and carrying out oscillation tracing according to the oscillation propagation directions of each oscillation station node to obtain an oscillation source. The method has the advantages that the accurate analysis of the oscillation propagation path and the influence range is realized, the tracing and the accurate positioning of the oscillation source are realized, and further, powerful support is provided for the operation monitoring of the power grid and the targeted inhibition of oscillation, the operation monitoring service is strongly supported and scheduled, and the operation safety of the power grid is ensured.

title_en: Emergency plan making method based on industrial park
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency plan making method based on an industrial park, which is characterized in that data acquisition and preprocessing are realized through a distributed sensing network and edge calculation, a park dynamic model is constructed by utilizing multi-source heterogeneous data fusion and a digital twin technology, a risk propagation path is analyzed by combining a graph neural network, and a preliminary emergency suggestion is generated based on a knowledge graph matching historical case. The invention further adopts a resource scheduling optimization and path planning algorithm to formulate a dynamic response scheme, evaluates the effects of different schemes through a situation evolution prediction model, finally generates an optimal emergency treatment scheme and issues a structural instruction. The method realizes the intelligent formulation of the emergency plan of the industrial park, improves the accuracy of risk identification and the timeliness of emergency response, and provides powerful support for park safety management.

title_en: Reservoir group flood control optimal scheduling method and system based on quadratic programming
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of flood control optimization scheduling, in particular to a reservoir group flood control optimization scheduling method and system based on quadratic programming, wherein the method comprises the following steps of constructing a flood control scheduling topological network according to space distribution of key nodes and hydraulic connection of the space distribution of the key nodes of a system according to hydraulic engineering facilities and hydrologic elements in a flow field to obtain a reservoir group flood control optimization scheduling topological graph; and (3) establishing a reservoir group flood control optimal dispatching quadratic programming model according to the reservoir group flood control optimal dispatching topological graph, and optimally solving the reservoir group flood control optimal dispatching quadratic programming model by using a gradient method and a quasi-Newton method based on a MINOS library of GAMS. According to the invention, the propagation of flood among reservoir groups is coupled in a mathematical equation set, so that complex simulation sequence coding is avoided, modeling is easy, universality is good, and a model is easy to seek an optimal solution, so that the flood control capacity, peak clipping effect and reasonable scheduling of reservoir water storage capacity of the reservoir can be balanced, and the accuracy and efficiency of flood regulation are improved.

title_en: Intelligent content generation system based on open source data analysis
abstract_en: The application discloses an intelligent content generation system based on open source data analysis, which relates to the technical field of monitoring analysis and comprises a data preprocessing module, a map construction and extraction module, an intelligent content generation module and an optimization module, wherein the data preprocessing module is used for carrying out multi-mode content acquisition on a heterogeneous open source data platform to obtain a structural semantic feature matrix, the map construction and extraction module is used for carrying out domain knowledge map construction based on the structural semantic feature matrix to obtain a domain evolution feature vector, the intelligent content generation module is used for inputting the domain evolution feature vector into a multi-mode generation countermeasure network to carry out semantic-visual cross-mode mapping to obtain style enhanced intelligent generated content, the optimization module is used for carrying out propagation effect simulation prediction on the style enhanced intelligent generated content to generate a content propagation influence matrix, carrying out optimization iteration on the intelligent generated content according to the content propagation influence matrix to generate final optimized content and pushing the final optimized content to a target terminal.

title_en: The ecosystem protection facilities of river
title_ko: 하천의 친환경 생태 보호 시설
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an eco-friendly facility for protecting the ecosystem of rivers and, more specifically, to an eco-friendly facility for protecting the ecosystem of rivers, capable of providing habitat in which fish can stably inhabit around the river without disturbing the flow of river water and providing spacious large habitat in case the amount of the river water is rapidly increased caused by flood.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 하천의 친환경 생태 보호 시설에 관한 것으로, 하천수의 흐름을 방해하지 않으면서 하천 변에 어류 등이 안전하게 서식할 수 있는 서식지를 제공하고, 홍수와 같이 하천수의 양이 급격히 증가하는 경우 보다 넓은 은신처를 제공하여 하천에 서식하는 어류 등을 안전하게 보호함을 목적으로 한다. 
본 발명에 의한 하천의 친환경 생태 보호 시설은, 하천 변에 연쇄적으로 연결되도록 설치되는 다수의 생태 블록(10)과; 상기 생태 블록의 하천쪽 면에 형성되며 하천수의 양에 따라 상기 생태 블록의 내부와 통하는 은신처를 제공하는 생태 보호 루프(20)를 포함하고, 상기 생태 블록은, 앵커를 통해 하천 바닥에 정착되는 바닥부(11a)와 상기 바닥부 위에 박스 형태로 형성되는 블록부(11b)로 이루어진 블록 본체(11), 상기 블록 본체의 블록부 내부에 길이방향을 따라 양측이 개방되도록 형성되면서 입구쪽에 제1거름망(12a)이 구비된 서식홀(12), 상기 블록 본체의 블록부의 하천을 향하는 면에 상기 서식홀과 통하도록 형성되며 제2거름망(13a)이 구비된 제1이동홀(13), 상기 블록 본체의 바닥부 내부에 양측이 상기 하천과 상기 서식홀에 연통되도록 형성되는 다수의 제2이동홀(14)을 포함하고, 상기 생태 보호 루프는, 상기 제1이동홀의 좌우 양측에 상하 종방향으로 형성되는 승강레일(24), 상기 승강레일에 승강 가능하게 연결되며 내부에 부력재가 주입되어 상기 부력재를 통해 하천수의 수위에 따라 승강하고 상측의 표면이 물결형태로 형성된 루프체(21), 상기 루프체에 식재되어 상기 생태 블록의 전면을 녹화하는 수초(25), 상기 루프체의 하부에 설치되는 한 쌍이며 각각의 저부는 상기 블록 본체에 회전핀(22a)을 통해 회동 가능하게 연결되며 상부는 상기 루프체의 저면에 형성된 절첩레일(21a,21b)에 슬라이딩 가능하게 연결되어 상기 루프체의 승강에 따라 절첩되어 상기 루프체의 승강시 상기 루프체와 함께 공간을 형성하는 제1,2벽체(22,23)로 구성된다.

title_en: Determining utility infrastructure and connectivity interruptions
abstract_en: An approach for determining an infrastructure service interruption is disclosed. The approach relies on utilizing UAVs (unmanned aerial vehicle) to map electronic signals (e.g., Wi-Fi, etc.) that emanates from building structures (e.g., residential, commercial, etc.). Electronic signals having a certain frequency or multiple frequencies may be used. Essentially, the approach can detect power/signal loss by comparing differences in Wi-Fi signal maps pre and post event (e.g., severe thunderstorm, etc.). The 24/7 event monitoring is carried out by using UAVs and the UAVs can operate on a regular or event driven schedule vs. continuously operating multiple fixed data collection units.

title_en: A kind of disaster tolerance system and a kind of disaster recovery method
abstract_en: This application discloses a kind of disaster tolerance system and a kind of disaster recovery method, which includes: main storage subsystem, the business datum sent for receiving production host；First passes through the business datum that the first asynchronous remote copy link is sent from storage subsystem, for receiving the main storage subsystem；Second passes through the business datum that the second asynchronous remote copy link is sent from storage subsystem from storage subsystem, for receiving described first.The application by main storage system and first between storage system the first asynchronous remote copy link, first realize cascade networking mode from the second asynchronous remote copy link between storage system from storage system and second; and then realize the data protection of more copies, improve the safety of business datum；In addition, can be utilized after breaking down from the Backup Data adapter tube business in storage system, the probability of service disconnection is reduced.
assignees: INSPUR BEIJING ELECTRONIC INF IND CO LTD

title_en: The Unit Combination dispatching method that multistage power grid links in regional power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses the Unit Combination dispatching methods that multistage power grid in a kind of regional power system links, comprising steps of determining multistage power grid active load and power grid unit operating parameter at different levels in regional power system；Establish the security constraint Unit Combination economic load dispatching model for considering that Unit Commitment, power grid active load at different levels are linkage decision content；Analytic approach solving model is cascaded based on target, determines system optimal scheduling result.Microgrid constraint includes microgrid power-balance constraint, the constraint of microgrid tie-line power transmission.The present invention surrounds a certain regional power system, using district system overall operation cost minimization as target, under the premise of meeting power grid layers at different levels and respectively constraining, establish the security constraint Unit Combination model for considering that Unit Commitment, power grid layer initiative ability at different levels are linkage decision content, realize the united analysis and decision to Integrated power system, and the model is solved using the target of Distributed Parallel Computing cascade analytic approach (ATC), realize complication system source net lotus cooperative scheduling.
assignees: STATE GRID ENERGY RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD

title_en: Hurricane path prediction method and system based on recurrent neural network
abstract_en: The invention provides a hurricane path prediction method and a system based on a recurrent neural network, comprising the following steps: carrying out gridding treatment on the delimited hurricane path area; calculating the moving distance and the moving angle of each coordinate point as data enhancement; using a three-layer long-short term memory network as a main cyclic neural network of a prediction model; the main network is a long-short term memory model carrying Dropout layer with the proportionality coefficient of 0.1; the output layer is a full-connection layer activated by a hyperbolic tangent function, a gradient descent algorithm RMSProp based on momentum is used for training the model, and the training target is the square error of the predicted longitude and latitude coordinates; the output layer of the prediction model is composed of a grid ID prediction layer and a coordinate correction part to form a final hurricane coordinate prediction. In the prediction stage, the prediction only depends on the forward propagation of the model based on the recurrent neural network reasoning, and the correlation search of a historical database is not needed, so that the performance of the hurricane path prediction is greatly improved.
assignees: EAST CHINA COMPUTER TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE THE 32ND RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA ELECTRONICS TECH GR;PEOPLES LIBERATION ARMY 61540 TROOPS

title_en: Method for identifying and positioning tiny objects in complex environment by using SISO antenna
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for identifying and positioning tiny objects in a complex environment by using a SISO antenna, which comprises the following steps: s1, establishing a cubic vacuum resonant cavity, and placing a partition plate; s2, two ports S3 are arranged inside the cubic vacuum resonant cavity, and a feed signal is sent through the port I, so that the ports are used for receiving signals; s4, exporting the received signal of the port II, performing time reversal operation, and doubling the time reversed signal; s5, placing a metal block in the cubic vacuum resonance cavity, exciting a port II by using the processed signal, wherein the port I is used for receiving the signal sent by the port II; s6, obtaining a time reversal phase fringe image; s7, obtaining time-frequency images of objects with different shapes and different positions; s8, training a cascade neural network consisting of a classification network and a positioning network; and S9, testing the accuracy of the neural network to evaluate the robustness of the neural network.
assignees: YANGTZE RIVER DELTA RES INSTITUTE UESTC HUZHOU

title_en: Distribution line wind disaster vulnerability assessment method considering cascading failure
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of wind resistance and disaster prevention of electric power infrastructure, and discloses a distribution line wind disaster vulnerability assessment method considering cascading failure. The invention can rapidly and accurately calculate the vertical and horizontal overturning angles of the invalid distribution pole under the action of strong wind and the additional overturning force to the adjacent distribution pole caused by the vertical and horizontal overturning angles, and gets rid of the inefficiency limit of the traditional explicit finite element method in analyzing cascade invalidation. The invention discloses the propagation process of the failure in the whole line in a parameterized form, and accurately judges the direct failure caused by wind load and the indirect failure caused by additional overturning force. Meanwhile, the invention can help engineers to determine the safe operation tension and horizontal span in the construction erection stage, and has strong creativity. The invention has simple implementation, high analysis efficiency and calculation precision, can provide effective guidance for engineering design, construction erection and daily operation and maintenance of the electric power infrastructure, and has wide applicability and high practicability.

title_en: Method, system, electronic equipment and storage medium for evaluating cascade influence of local energy crisis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a local energy crisis cascade influence evaluation method, a system, electronic equipment and a storage medium based on an input-output model, which mainly comprise the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining an energy supply pressure index, obtaining an energy shortage probability, obtaining energy crisis sensitivity, obtaining energy crisis and cascade influence evaluation and determining a key supply link path. The invention provides a monetization index of the energy crisis, analyzes cascade influence from a view angle of a supply chain, namely analyzes the transfer relation and a driving mechanism of the energy crisis in an area department, identifies a supply chain conduction path of the energy crisis, has the advantages of wide application range, quick calculation mode and the like, and can provide a method and data support for improving the toughness of a trade network to the energy crisis.

title_en: Building body flexible regulation potential prediction method
abstract_en: A building body flexible regulation potential prediction method includes the steps of building a building group energy consumption model based on a back propagation neural network, enabling each energy consumption system sub-model to take characteristic data of influence parameters of energy consumption of each energy consumption system as input, enabling the power saving rate of the corresponding energy consumption system to be the maximum first-stage optimization target, outputting energy consumption prediction values of each energy consumption system under different time periods, adopting a distributed entropy improved self-adaptive grid searching particle swarm method, enabling the power saving rate of a building group to be the maximum second-stage optimization target, determining energy consumption prediction minimum values of each energy consumption system under different time periods, utilizing the extreme value of each energy consumption system and the deviation of the power saving rate of the building group to update the energy consumption prediction minimum values, enabling the energy consumption prediction minimum values of each energy consumption system under different time periods to be spliced according to time sequence to serve as building group energy consumption prediction values, enabling the difference between the building group energy consumption actual values and the building group energy consumption prediction values to be the ratio in the building group energy consumption actual values, and enabling accurate prediction to be achieved.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID SHANGHAI COMPREHENSIVE ENERGY SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Comprehensive evaluation method for watershed cascade water-light complementary system
abstract_en: The application provides a comprehensive evaluation method of a watershed cascade water-light complementary system, which relates to the technical field of data processing and comprises the steps of obtaining a watershed cascade hydropower station and a photovoltaic power station of a target watershed, wherein the watershed cascade hydropower station comprises K hydropower stations, performing synchronous power generation monitoring data, obtaining a water-light complementary power generation capacity sequence, determining a system power supply deviation factor, obtaining K hydropower station power generation cost, K hydropower station benefits and photovoltaic power station benefits, and calling a benefit evaluation network layer to analyze the system power supply deviation factor, the K hydropower station power generation cost, the photovoltaic power station power generation cost, the K hydropower station benefits and the photovoltaic power station benefits to determine a target benefit comprehensive evaluation result. The method and the device can solve the technical problem of inaccurate yield evaluation caused by lack of fluctuation analysis of the generated energy in the prior art, and achieve the technical effect of improving the accuracy of the yield evaluation of the water-light complementary system.
assignees: DATANG XIANGCHENG HYDROPOWER DEV CO LTD;DATANG HYDROPOWER SCIENCE & TECH RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent equipment integrated management system for power grid distribution network inspection
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent equipment comprehensive management system for power grid distribution network inspection, which comprises a data preprocessing module, a distributed anomaly detection module, a self-adaptive threshold adjustment module, a fault locating and spreading analysis module and an alarm and visualization module, wherein the data preprocessing module carries out hierarchical clustering on sensors to construct a tree structure, each cluster node is provided with a local anomaly detector, the distributed anomaly detection module calculates anomaly scores of data collected by bottom nodes by using a RASA algorithm, the middle nodes gather bottom leaf node information to carry out local anomaly detection, the top nodes gather middle node information to carry out global anomaly detection, the self-adaptive threshold adjustment module dynamically adjusts an anomaly threshold by using an ATA algorithm, and when an anomaly is detected by the fault locating and spreading analysis module, the GCN-FPA module is activated to analyze a fault source and a possible propagation path, and the system can be used for rapidly locating the fault source and predicting the fault propagation path.
assignees: KUITUN POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID XINJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Photovoltaic active distribution network-containing voltage out-of-limit problem tracing method
abstract_en: The invention provides a voltage out-of-limit problem tracing method for a photovoltaic active distribution network, which comprises the steps of receiving research data and carrying out multi-scale feature analysis to obtain a standardized multi-dimensional feature matrix and a space-time correlation matrix, constructing an initial causal graph based on basic research data and physical constraints of a power grid, constructing a multi-layer causal network by calculating causal strength, extracting dynamic feature sequences and analyzing propagation features to generate a propagation path set and a path weight matrix, carrying out tensor completion and state estimation on the research data to obtain a state estimation matrix and estimation uncertainty, and outputting out-of-limit source positions, out-of-limit risk scores and early warning information based on pattern matching analysis and risk assessment. According to the invention, through the combination of multidimensional feature analysis and multi-layer causal network, accurate positioning and risk early warning of a voltage threshold crossing source are realized, and the tracing accuracy and analysis efficiency are improved.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;Quanzhou Power Supply Company Of State Grid Fujian Electric Power Company;LONGYAN POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Method, system, equipment and medium for predicting growth of tree species in power transmission corridor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, equipment and a medium for predicting tree species growth in a power transmission corridor, which belong to the technical field of tree growth prediction and comprise the steps of obtaining tree species data and environment data in the area of the power transmission corridor, and preprocessing the tree species data and the environment data to obtain a training data set; training the cascade recurrent neural network model based on the training data set to obtain a trained cascade recurrent neural network model, predicting the growth trend of tree species according to the trained cascade recurrent neural network model to obtain a prediction result, carrying out error analysis on the prediction result, optimizing the trained cascade recurrent neural network model according to the error analysis result, carrying out growth trend analysis according to the prediction result to determine the growth trend of tree species, and carrying out early warning on the growth trend of tree species according to the prediction result and combining a preset safety threshold. The invention improves the precision of tree species growth prediction through the cascade structure.

title_en: Urban hydropower network safety monitoring method, device, home host and system
abstract_en: The application relates to a method, a device, a home host and a system for monitoring the safety of an urban water-electricity network, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring hydropower data acquired by a home terminal of the home host, and extracting abnormal characteristic data based on the hydropower data; the method comprises the steps of receiving abnormal characteristic data shared by other home hosts in an intelligent joint defense network, carrying out group intelligent analysis on the received abnormal characteristic data and the abnormal characteristic data extracted by the intelligent joint defense network by utilizing a group intelligent analysis model, identifying a space-time association relation of urban hydro-electric pipe network abnormal propagation, determining whether regional disasters exist in the urban hydro-electric pipe network according to the space-time association relation, and carrying out alarming in an alarming mode matched with the type of the regional disasters according to the type of the regional disasters under the condition that the regional disasters exist in the urban hydro-electric pipe network. Therefore, regional disasters of the urban water supply network can be accurately identified, and regional disaster prevention and control capability is improved.
assignees: GREE ELECTRIC APPLIANCES INC ZHUHAI;ZHUHAI LEAYUN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power grid voltage sag source positioning method and device
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a device for positioning a power grid voltage sag source, and relates to the field of positioning of power grid voltage sag sources, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining voltage and current waveform data of monitoring points during power grid voltage sag; the method comprises the steps of inputting voltage and current waveform data of monitoring points in a grid voltage sag into a trained graph attention network to obtain the position of a grid voltage sag source, wherein the graph attention network comprises an input layer, a cascaded graph attention layer, a pooling layer and an output layer, a multi-head attention mechanism and a voltage sag amplitude are introduced into the graph attention layer, the voltage sag amplitude is determined by the voltage and current waveform data, the graph attention network is trained by adopting an improved loss function and comparison learning, and the improved loss function introduces the grid voltage sag source judgment based on instantaneous disturbance power quantity and disturbance energy into the loss function. The application improves the accuracy of positioning the power grid voltage sag source.

title_en: Power system transient stability evaluation method and device
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of transient stability evaluation of power systems and discloses a method and a device for evaluating the transient stability of a power system, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining initial samples of the power system in different operation scenes, wherein the initial samples comprise steady-state characteristics, fault positions and transient stability judging results; extracting a training set and a verification set from initial samples, screening important features from steady-state features to obtain a candidate feature set, training based on the training set and the verification set to obtain an initial transient stability evaluation neural network, calculating uncertainty indexes of all samples in the training set based on the results of multiple forward propagation of a Dropout layer of the initial transient stability evaluation neural network, classifying the samples according to the uncertainty indexes, constructing a condition generation countermeasure network model, training the condition generation countermeasure network model based on the classified samples to obtain a transient stability evaluation model, and performing transient stability evaluation on a power grid according to the transient stability evaluation model.
assignees: STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV TSINGHUA

title_en: Emergency bell device with sensor detection and output port on/off function of remote control terminal
title_ko: Cctv 원격 제어 단말의 센서 감지 및 출력 포트 온/오프 기능을 갖는 비상벨 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an emergency bell device having sensor detection and output port on/off functions in a CCTV remote control terminal. The emergency bell device comprises: a sensor part; a remote control terminal; and an emergency bell server. According to the present invention, a corresponding sound source can be automatically transmitted for each sensor detection port by using the remote control terminal.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 원격 제어 단말의 센서 감지 및 출력 포트 온/오프 기능을 갖는 비상벨 장치에 관한 것으로서, 보다 구체적으로는 원격 제어 단말의 센서 감지 및 출력 포트 온/오프 기능을 갖는 비상벨 장치로서, 도심의 재난이나 재해를 감지하기 위한 적어도 하나 이상의 센서를 구비하는 센서부; 상기 센서부의 적어도 하나 이상의 센서와 전기적으로 연결 접속되는 센서 감지 포트를 구비하고, 상기 센서부의 센서 감지에 대응하는 해당하는 음원을 출력하는 원격 제어 단말; 및 상기 원격 제어 단말과 네트워크를 통해 연결 접속되며, 상기 원격 제어 단말의 센서 감지 포트를 관리하기 위한 비상벨 서버를 포함하는 것을 그 구성상의 특징으로 한다. 
본 발명에서 제안하고 있는 원격 제어 단말의 센서 감지 및 출력 포트 온/오프 기능을 갖는 비상벨 장치에 따르면, 도심의 재난이나 재해를 감지하기 위한 적어도 하나 이상의 센서를 구비하는 센서부와, 센서부의 적어도 하나 이상의 센서와 전기적으로 연결 접속되는 센서 감지 포트를 구비하고, 센서부의 센서 감지에 대응하는 해당하는 음원을 출력하는 원격 제어 단말과, 원격 제어 단말과 네트워크를 통해 연결 접속되며, 원격 제어 단말의 센서 감지 포트를 관리하기 위한 비상벨 서버를 포함하여 구성함으로써, 비상벨 서버의 원격 제어 하에 원격 제어 단말을 통해 센서 감지 포트별로 해당하는 음원을 자동으로 송출할 수 있도록 할 수 있다. 
또한, 본 발명의 원격 제어 단말의 센서 감지 및 출력 포트 온/오프 기능을 갖는 비상벨 장치에 따르면, 비상벨 서버의 원격 제어 하에 원격 제어 단말을 통해 센서 감지 포트별로 해당하는 음원을 자동으로 송출하되, 센서 감지 포트별로 해당하는 음원이 자동으로 송출될 수 있도록 구성함으로써, 도심의 재난이나 재해에 따른 해당 음원의 송출로 현재의 재난 상황을 신속하게 전파함은 물론, 그에 따른 도심의 재난이나 재해의 모니터링 및 상황 관리의 효율성이 더욱 향상될 수 있도록 할 수 있다.

title_en: Virtual simulation experiment system for softwood cutting propagation of ginkgo biloba
abstract_en: A virtual simulation experiment system for softwood cutting propagation of ginkgo biloba, comprising four procedures: cutting medium preparation, cuttings treatment, cutting process and post-cutting management, and fourteen specific operation steps thereof; furthermore, six modules are provided for experiment preview and self test, for full process experiment, for exploratory experiment, for knowledge learning and expansion, for experiment tips and help, and for experiment examination and evaluation; an experiment scenario is virtually simulated, and an experimental facility is constructed; corresponding parameters of an experiment design are set by means of a virtual experiment environment parameter setting device, and an experiment result is presented on a front end terminal of the system in a visualized form such as a scenario, a graph, and a table. The constructed system is powerful in function, reproduces the whole process and environment of cutting propagation production, and has a high simulation degree and a strong closeness to reality; and said system simulates and restores the teaching effect and environment of a real experiment, shortens the experiment time and improves the learning efficiency, and has wide popularization and utilization prospects in the teaching of cutting propagation experiments in universities such as agriculture and forestry colleges.

title_en: Method for improving monitoring capability of borehole-surface micro-seismic monitoring system
abstract_en: A method for improving a monitoring capability of a borehole-surface micro-seismic monitoring system includes selecting multiple candidate points for installing surface wireless sensors to form a natural-number-coded candidate point set and combining a fixed number of candidate points randomly selected from the candidate point set with an underground installed sensor set to form a borehole-surface micro-seismic monitoring network; carrying out multiple random selections until a certain scale of borehole-surface micro-seismic monitoring network deployment plans are generated; establishing an evaluation model for a monitoring capability of each borehole-surface micro-seismic monitoring network deployment plan according to a propagation relation equation between a micro-seismic energy and a first-arrival peak amplitude of a P-wave, forming an initial population; determining an optimal borehole-surface micro-seismic monitoring network deployment plan through a genetic algorithm; and determining an optimal surface wireless sensor deployment plan that significantly improves the monitoring capability of the borehole-surface micro-seismic monitoring network deployment plan.
assignees: UNIV CHINA MINING;XUZHOU HONGYI TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Method and apparatus of using drive test data for propagation model calibration
abstract_en: A method using drive test data for propagation model calibration includes: step  1,  obtaining original drive test data; step  2,  selecting the data from the drive test data according to predefined conditions as effective drive test data; and step  3,  extracting the effective drive test data to form a data file used for propagation model calibration. An apparatus using drive test data for propagation model calibration includes: a drive test data obtaining module, configured to obtain the drive test data in the regions to be calibrated; an effective drive test data generation module, configured to generate effective drive test data from the drive test data according to predefined conditions; and a data file generation module, configured to extract the effective drive test data to form a data file used for propagation model calibration. The present invention utilizes drive test data of existing networks to largely decrease the CW test work and reduce the network building cost. It is believed that the calibrated model can relatively accurately reflect the propagation characteristics in the field. Furthermore, base stations can be optimally allocated.
assignees: CHINA MOBILE COMM CORP DESIGN;CHINA MOBILE COMM CORP;CHINA MOBILE COMM CORP FUJIAN

title_en: Oil temperature prediction method and device and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses an oil temperature prediction method and device and a computer readable storage medium, and belongs to the field of petroleum transportation.
