The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a training data set, wherein the training data set comprises a plurality of data samples; calling an oil temperature prediction model based on a plurality of data samples to perform oil temperature prediction to obtain a plurality of predicted historical oil temperatures, wherein the oil temperature prediction model is obtained by training a back propagation neural network by adopting a training data set; subtracting the plurality of predicted historical oil temperatures from the historical downstream incoming oil temperatures of the plurality of predicted historical oil temperatures respectively to obtain a residual value sequence; calling an autoregressive moving average model to predict a residual value of the residual value sequence at the next moment; calling an oil temperature prediction model to perform oil temperature prediction based on oil temperature data to be predicted to obtain predicted oil temperature at the next moment, wherein the oil temperature data to be predicted comprises upstream oil temperature, upstream ground temperature, downstream station-entering ground temperature and output; and adding the residual value at the next moment and the predicted oil temperature at the next moment to obtain a predicted value of the inbound oil temperature at the next moment.

title_en: Short-term electric vehicle charging load prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a short-term electric vehicle charging load prediction method and system. When the daily load prediction model is established, the data mining is carried out on the samples in the sample library by using a neighbor propagation method, so that the prediction efficiency of the prediction model can be effectively improved. Meanwhile, the method fully utilizes the characteristic extraction advantages of the convolutional neural network, converts the charging load numerical value in the sample into image data by utilizing an RGB color mapping method, and simultaneously considers the influences of seasons, weather, temperature, holidays and traffic volumes on the charging load, thereby greatly improving the prediction accuracy of the prediction model. On the basis, the weight and the threshold of the convolutional neural network are subjected to multi-objective optimization by using a non-inferior ranking genetic algorithm, and then the convolutional neural network is trained based on the optimal initial weight and the optimal initial threshold, so that the problem of long network training time caused by initialization random giving of neurons in the network can be effectively solved, and the prediction speed of a prediction model is further improved.

title_en: Analysis method and system for transmission path of gas transmission pipe network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for analyzing a transmission path of a gas transmission pipe network, wherein the method comprises the following steps of S1, determining a key node set and an end node set; the method comprises the steps of S2, setting an acquisition strategy corresponding to a propagation path analysis request, S3, determining a target node set based on the acquisition strategy, and S4, determining a target node propagation path based on the target node set, the key node set and the terminal node set. According to the invention, the transmission path is analyzed based on the quantized key degree, the target node is rapidly positioned and forms a pipe network node which takes the target node as the center and is not concerned in the simulation process and presentation, so that the analysis, simulation and presentation efficiency is greatly improved.

title_en: Wind power plant grid-connected performance evaluation system and method thereof
abstract_en: The system comprises a plurality of three-level index semantic feature vectors which are obtained through a trained context encoder comprising an embedded layer, and a cascade connection of the three-level index semantic feature vectors to obtain a second-level index feature vector. After the two-level index feature vectors are respectively arranged into a two-dimensional feature matrix and a one-dimensional feature vector, a two-dimensional two-level index associated feature vector and a multi-scale two-level index associated feature vector are obtained through a trained first convolutional neural network and a trained multi-scale neighborhood feature extraction unit, the two-dimensional two-level index associated feature vector and the multi-scale two-level index associated feature vector are fused to obtain a classification feature vector, and then a classification result used for representing grid-connected performance grade labels of the wind power plant can be obtained through a classifier. Particularly, the application extracts the association features among indexes of different levels by using different receptive fields through the convolutional neural network and the multi-scale domain feature extraction module, thereby improving the accuracy of index evaluation.

title_en: Thermal management method of Ka frequency band microstrip waveguide conversion and power synthesis device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a thermal management method of a Ka frequency band microstrip waveguide conversion and power synthesis device, which relates to the technical field of thermal management, and comprises the steps of carrying out digital modeling to generate a power simulation model; the method comprises the steps of collecting a waveguide synthesis test sample of a target integrated device, inputting the waveguide synthesis test sample into a power simulation model, performing power density test to generate a power density distribution network, performing temperature propagation analysis based on the power density distribution network to generate a temperature distribution network, generating an optimal fluid channel network, and performing thermal management control based on the optimal fluid channel network. The technical problems that the existing Ka frequency band microstrip waveguide conversion and power synthesis device is difficult to accurately simulate the power distribution and heat generation conditions of the microstrip-waveguide conversion and power synthesis device under high-frequency and high-power conditions, and further heat dissipation requirements cannot be met are solved, the stability and service life of the device are poor, and the technical effects of improving the heat dissipation efficiency and stability of the device are achieved.

title_en: Big data management and intelligent evaluation system for air quality of hospital environment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent regulation and energy conservation of air quality of a hospital environment, in particular to a big data management and intelligent evaluation system of air quality of the hospital environment, which comprises a multi-mode data acquisition module, a data processing module, a dynamic transmission modeling module, a dynamic Bayesian network risk modeling module, a prospective risk hedging module and an energy consumption optimizing module, wherein the system calculates a dynamic air transmission coefficient by acquiring environment and people flow data and builds a dynamic Bayesian network model to calculate a cross-region propagation risk probability, and the core is that when the risk probability exceeds a threshold value, the system actively solves a multi-objective optimization problem with minimum energy consumption as a target to generate an optimal HVAC control instruction.

title_en: Assessment method for rainstorm disaster risks of sectional power transmission line pole-tower foundation slopes
abstract_en: The invention relates to an assessment method for rainstorm disaster risks of sectional power transmission line pole-tower foundation slopes, and the method comprises the following steps of acquiring control factors of the rainstorm disaster risks of the pole-tower foundation slopes, and quantizing and normalizing the control factors; establishing a mapping relation between the control factors and a rainstorm landslide accident rate by utilizing an improved BP (Back Propagation) network and adopting disaster statistics and artificial rainfall slope erosion test results as training samples, and acquiring a risk assessment mathematic model; and acquiring the rainstorm landslide risk grade of each slope relative to a whole line by adopting the calculated average rainstorm landslide accident rate value of the whole-line foundation slope as a benchmark value, acquiring a weight vector of each section in terms of percentage for the slope at each risk grade by utilizing an improved layering analysis calculation program, with consideration of different influences of the slope at each risk grade on the rainstorm disaster risks, calculating the weight vector of the slope at each risk grade for the rainstorm disaster by continuously adopting the improved layering analysis calculation program, and finally synthesizing the weight vectors of all layers from top to bottom by utilizing a computer to obtain the risk assessment result of each section.

title_en: A kind of forest rocket detection method based on region division and feature extraction
abstract_en: The forest rocket detection method based on region division and feature extraction that the present invention provides a kind of, belongs to computer image processing technology field, comprising: establish forest rocket sample data set；Choose suitable static nature and training cascade neural network；The first frame of video to be processed is chosen, adaptive region segmentation is carried out；Motion detection is carried out to video to be processed；Prediction classification is carried out to doubtful pyrotechnics region.The method of the present invention calculates simply, reduces operand and a large amount of erroneous detections, has relatively good real-time in the not high equipment of calculating speed, while rate of false alarm is greatly reduced；The method of the present invention has important application value in terms of forest rocket, is of great significance in forest fire protection field of video monitoring.

title_en: Based on laser scanning, BQ and RQDtMethod for solving Q anisotropy of anisotropy
abstract_en: Based on laser scanning, BQ, RQD t An anisotropic Q anisotropy solving method belongs to the Q anisotropy solving field and comprises the following steps: (1) three-dimensional laser scanning of the structural surface is rapidly acquired; (2) polar point diagram of structural planeAnd trend rose mapping; (3) calculating the rock mass based on the BQ index; (4) generating and sectioning a rock three-dimensional fracture network model; (5) RQD t Drawing an anisotropy map; (6) solving method of optimal threshold t based on BQ inversion; (7) RQD t An anisotropy solution method; (8) q anisotropy solving method. The invention combines three-dimensional laser scanning, a neighbor propagation algorithm, a BQ theory, a fracture network model, a generalized RQD theory and inversion calculation to realize RQD t The best threshold value t and the solution of the anisotropy realize the solution of the Q anisotropy, and the method based on laser scanning, BQ and RQD is provided t And solving the Q anisotropy of the anisotropy. The method is clear and suitable for solving the anisotropy of the rock mass Q.

title_en: Distributed energy source cold, heat and power active variable working condition optimization regulation and control method and system based on edge calculation
abstract_en: The invention provides a distributed energy combined cooling heating and power active variable working condition optimization regulation and control method and system based on edge calculation, wherein a control optimization system is divided into two layers, one layer is deployed at the cloud end, and planning management of a large number of distributed energy subsystems is realized; the system comprises a distributed energy source, a network and load key equipment, wherein one layer is arranged on the edge side, data acquisition and direct management of the distributed energy source, the network and the load key equipment are realized, aiming at a distributed energy system which is constantly changed and is technically updated, the acquisition and analysis of energy data are realized through a two-layer system of cloud computing and edge computing, an optimal scheme is calculated, an optimal operation strategy and parameters are designed, update application can be pushed in time through the management of the edge computing, the cascade utilization of the energy can be carried out according to the space-time change of distributed energy according to the requirement of islands, meanwhile, the refrigeration and dehumidification are driven by the waste heat of a recovery diesel engine, the energy utilization efficiency of an energy supply system is greatly improved, and meanwhile, edge cloud cooperative computing is utilized.
assignees: HAINAN GREEN ENERGY AND ENVIRONMENTAL ENGINEERING INSTITUTE OF TECH

title_en: Remote verification method for propagation type charging pile
abstract_en: The invention provides a remote verification method for a propagation type charging pile, which is characterized by collecting charging process data, wherein the charging process data comprises a charging pile interface ID number, an electric vehicle VIN code, an electric vehicle BMS measured voltage, an electric vehicle BMS measured current, an electric vehicle BMS metered electric energy, a charging pile measured voltage, a charging pile measured current and a charging pile metered electric energy, subtracting the charging process data to obtain a measurement error, and completing remote pre-verification of the charging pile; the method has the advantages that the measurement accuracy of the plurality of charging piles with high use frequency is guaranteed, and the standard quantity value is transmitted to a network formed in the whole charging process by means of the charging behavior of the electric automobile, so that remote pre-verification of the charging piles is completed; the workload of verification personnel is greatly reduced, the verification efficiency is improved, and the cost consumed by the verification work is saved. Meanwhile, as an online remote verification system, the system can find problems at the first time, and real-time performance is guaranteed.
assignees: SHENZHEN ACADEMY OF METROLOGY & QUALITY INSPECTION NAT HIGH TECH METROLOGY STATION NAT DIGITAL ELECT;HARBIN INST TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Real-time power system cascading failure risk assessment method and system based on space-time diagram neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real-time power system cascading failure risk assessment method and system based on a space-time diagram neural network. According to the cascading failure risk real-time prediction method and system, the highly nonlinear mapping relation between the time sequence electrical characteristics in the historical failures and the final failure models is extracted through the space-time diagram neural network, and the cascading failure risk is predicted according to the real-time operation data of the power system based on the mapping relation. The method considers the real-time prediction of the cascading failure risk, and has important significance for guaranteeing the safe and stable operation of the power system.

title_en: Method for constructing accident chain search model of power grid cascading failure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for constructing an accident chain search model of power grid cascading failures, and belongs to the field of failure early warning. Aiming at the defects of the existing research, firstly, a cascading failure analysis model based on an accident chain is established, then, the historical statistical failure rate of each power transmission line is considered, the initial failure risk index of the line is calculated, the risk index which simultaneously considers the probability importance of the line failure and the importance of the line structure is calculated, and finally, the multi-attribute index is calculated by adopting a grey correlation algorithm based on the dispersion maximization. The construction method of the power grid cascading failure accident chain search model accords with the general evolution process of the power grid cascading failure, and provides a basis for preventing the occurrence of the blackout accident.
assignees: NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER UNIV BAODING

title_en: Analysis method for possible maximum disaster of cascade hydroelectric junction group
abstract_en: The invention discloses an analysis method for the maximum possible disaster of a cascade hydroelectric hub group, which divides the dam break generation factors of the cascade hydroelectric hub group into an extreme load action unit and a dam break influence unit, divides the influence result of the dam break of the hydroelectric hub group into a disaster-bearing body disaster-suffering loss unit, considers the extreme load combination of 4 disaster-causing factors of extreme flood, giant earthquake, dammed lake and giant landslide, and can simply and scientifically calculate the maximum possible disasters of 3 disaster-bearing body losses of dam affiliated facilities and downstream building damages, personal casualties and ecological interferences thereof caused by cascade hydroelectric hub group continuous collapse by constructing an analysis method for the maximum possible disaster of the cascade hydroelectric hub group based on a Bayes network and utilizing the dam break influence unit in the Bayes network, thereby being beneficial to scientifically and quantitatively analyzing the disaster influence degree of the cascade hydroelectric hub group and helping to determine a reasonable hydroelectric hub risk control decision.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES;UNIV BEIJING TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Virtual earthquake scene playing system based on mobile equipment propagation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a virtual earthquake scene playing system based on mobile equipment propagation, which comprises an earthquake at a playing making layer and an application layer interaction terminal which is in wireless communication with the earthquake playing making layer through a network communication layer, wherein the earthquake playing making layer comprises the following components: the invention relates to the technical field of seismic performance, in particular to a seismic virtual image model importing module, a virtual space coordinate system creating module, a seismic virtual image model processing unit, a machine position real-time tracking module and a seismic virtual image model matching unit. The virtual seismic scene playing system based on mobile equipment propagation can realize image self-adaption processing between virtual video models corresponding to different shooting machine positions to realize continuity switching operation, eliminate time difference of regenerating virtual images to ensure smoothness of image watching of people, and achieve adjustment of self-adaption positions and image scaling areas through the whole virtual image model along with movement of shooting equipment.

title_en: Satellite emergency communication vehicle and emergency communication system
abstract_en: The application provides a satellite emergency communication vehicle and an emergency communication system, wherein the satellite emergency communication vehicle comprises: the system comprises a vehicle-mounted base station and vehicle-mounted satellite communication equipment; the vehicle-mounted base station is used for receiving multimedia data collected by the unmanned aerial vehicle and sent by the wireless communication system base station, and sending the multimedia data to the vehicle-mounted satellite communication equipment; and the vehicle-mounted satellite communication equipment is used for transmitting the received multimedia data to a satellite so that the multimedia data can be transmitted to a ground gateway station through the satellite. Since the satellite emergency communication vehicle can mount a larger-sized satellite communication device, the transmission bandwidth of the base station can be enlarged. At the same time, the multimedia data is transmitted to the ground gateway station through the satellite. Because the communication capacity of satellite is big, consequently can enlarge the frequency of propagation, be difficult to cause the network to block up to satisfy unmanned aerial vehicle and gather the demand of data transmission.

title_en: Apparatus and method for Indoor Fire Test Facility
title_ko: 실내화재 실증시험 설비 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a facility for testing indoor fire in practice, and more specifically, to a facility for testing indoor fire in practice and a method thereof for artificially implementing jet fire and pool fire indoors and enabling research related to fire dynamics, a passive fire protection system, and an active fire protection system due to the introduction of a fire protection portion. To this end, the present invention includes: a structure body; a fire implementation portion configured to implement artificial jet fire and pool fire; and a fire protection portion configured to block heat emission, flame propagation, flame spread, radiant heat, and the like, which occur when the fire implementation portion is operated.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 실내화재 시험설비에 관한 것으로, 특히 실내에서 분사 화재(Jet Fire)와 액면 화재(Pool Fire)를 인위적으로 구현하고, 방화부를 도입하여 화재역학과 수동적 방화설비(Passive Fire Protection System) 및 능동적 방화설비(Active Fire Protection System)에 대한 관련 연구를 할 수 있도록 한 실내화재 실증시험 설비 및 그 방법에 관한 것이다.  
이러한 본 발명은, 구조물 본체와; 인위적인 분사 화재 및 액면 화재를 구현하는 화재 구현부과; 상기 화재 구현부를 동작하는 경우에 발생하는 열방출, 화염 전파 및 복사열 등의 차단을 위한 방화부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: PUSAN NATIONAL UNIV INDUSTRY-UNIV COOPERATION FOUNDATION

title_en: Ceiling-mounted electric vehicle charging system equipped with fire spread delay function
title_ko: 화재 확산 지연 기능을 구비한 천장형 전기차 충전 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 전기차의 주차 공간의 천장에 배치되는 것으로서, 주차된 전기차에 전력을 공급하는 충전 코드, 상기 충전 코드와 연결되는 연장 케이블 및 상기 충전 코드를 제어에 따라 인출 및 수납하는 충전 본체를 포함하는 천장형 전기차 충전부; 상기 충전 본체의 내부에 배치되고, 주차된 전기차와 연결되었을 때 통신을 통해 충전을 위한 전압과 전류를 확인하여 조정하고, 충전된 전력량을 측정하는 전기차 충전 제어부; 상기 충전 본체의 내부에 배치되고, 상기 전기차 충전 제어부와 통신 가능하며 전기차의 화재 발생을 감지하기 위해 구비되는 화재 감지 처리부; 상기 천장형 전기차 충전부의 외부에서 상기 전기차 충전 제어부 및 상기 화재 감지 처리부와 통신하며, 전기차의 배터리 상태정보와 충전 상태를 수집하는 전기차 충전 관제부; 및 상기 천장형 전기차 충전부의 외부에서 상기 화재 감지 처리부와 통신하며, 화재 발생을 수신하고 전파하는 시설 및 건물 화재 수신부를 포함하는 화재 확산 지연 기능을 구비한 천장형 전기차 충전 시스템에 관한 것이다. 이러한 본 발명에 따르면, 천장형 이동식 전기차 충전 시스템의 가지고 있는 설치 위치에 대한 이점을 활용하여 차량 화재 발생시 화재 발생을 빠르게 감지하고, 화재의 확산 속도를 늦추는 장치를 장착하여, 화재 피해를 줄일 수 있다.

title_en: System Evaluation via Multiplex Network Science and Multiscale System Dynamics
abstract_en: A multiplex network science (MNS) model represents infrastructure of an environment and an installation as a plurality of nodes connected by links, the links defining dependencies between the plurality of nodes. A multiscale system dynamics (MSD) model represents the installation as a plurality of nested subsystems and resource flows connecting the nested subsystems. A hybrid model integrating the MNS model and the MSD model is generated, the hybrid model linking the MNS model and MSD model via boundary conditions representing dependencies between the installation and the infrastructure of the environment. The hybrid model simulates an alteration to the infrastructure of the environment and propagation of effects of the alteration through at least one of the boundary conditions to the installation.

title_en: Sewage treatment based on self-organizing cascade neural network is discharged total phosphorus prediction technique
abstract_en: Sewage treatment water outlet total phosphorus prediction technique based on self-organizing cascade neural network had not only belonged to Control Science and Engineering field, but also belonged to Environmental Science and Engineering field.Aiming at the problem that sewage disposal process water outlet total phosphorus in current city is difficult to real-time online measuring, the present invention realizes the online real-time prediction of water outlet total phosphorus.This method devises the subtended network configuration of self-organizing growth form, the contribution rate calculation formula of variable, and the Weight Training method of differentiation improves the precision of prediction of municipal sewage treatment process water outlet total phosphorus by adjusting the structure and connection weight of cascade network of relation in real time.The experimental results showed that the intelligent Forecasting can accurately measure municipal sewage treatment process water outlet total phosphorus concentration in real time.Material to the relevant control link during municipal sewage treatment and in biochemical reaction is adjusted, and improves the effluent quality quality of sewage treatment, and sewage disposal process safety, even running is promoted to provide theory support and technical guarantee.

title_en: Risk assessment method and device for leakage of fuel gas pipeline, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a risk assessment method and device for gas pipeline leakage, equipment and storage medium, wherein the assessment method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining a first disaster event set and a first disaster bearing body set by carrying out data processing on an accident case set; constructing a first propagation network according to causal relationships among a plurality of first disaster events; dynamically adjusting the first propagation network according to the peripheral condition of the target gas pipeline to obtain a second propagation network; determining the probability that the third disaster event causes the event to be evaluated to occur; determining connectivity of the event to be evaluated according to the second propagation network; determining a loss coefficient of the event to be evaluated according to a disaster-bearing body associated with the event to be evaluated; and determining the risk value of the event to be evaluated according to the probability, the connectivity and the loss coefficient. The invention can accurately predict the disaster event possibly caused by the gas pipeline and the propagation risk of the disaster event.

title_en: Fire-fighting safety management system using communication facility of apartment house
title_ko: 공동주택의 통신시설을 이용한 소방 안전관리 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a firefighting safety management system using a communication facility of an apartment house, which allows a fire for each household of an apartment house to be sensed and propagated based on a sensing signal of a home fine dust measurer installed at each household of an apartment house and a communication facility of a corresponding apartment house. According to the present invention, the firefighting safety management system using a communication facility of an apartment house comprises a fine dust measurer, a household intercom, a household indoor air measurement value database server, a firefighting control server, an intercom system, a robot cleaner, and a mobile smart device. According to the present invention, the fire in the corresponding household is sensed based on a sensing signal of a fine dust measurer installed in each household of an apartment house to normally maintain a 24-hour operation status, thereby fundamentally solving the mismanagement of a corresponding sensor due to dependency only on an existing firefighting-dedicated sensor and a non-operation phenomenon caused thereby.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 공동주택의 세대별 설치되는 가정용 미세먼지측정기의 감지 신호 및 해당 공동주택의 통신시설을 기반으로 공동주택의 각 세대별 화재 감지 및 전파가 이루어질 수 있도록 하는 공동주택의 통신시설을 이용한 소방 안전관리 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 본 발명에 따른 공동주택의 통신시설을 이용한 소방 안전관리 시스템은 미세먼지측정기, 세대 인터폰, 세대 실내공기 측정값 데이터베이스 서버, 소방 제어 서버, 인터폰 시스템, 로봇 청소기 및 모바일 스마트 디비이스를 포함하여 구성되며, 이러한 구성에 따라 공동주택에 세대 단위로 설치되어 통상 24시간 작동 상태를 유지하는 미세먼지측정기의 감지 신호를 기반으로 해당 세대의 화재 감지가 이루어짐에 따라, 기존의 소방 전용 센서에만 의존하는데 따른 해당 센서의 관리 부실 및 그에 따른 미작동 현상이 근본적으로 해결될 수 있게 된다.

title_en: Fire Place Data Collection and Spreading Systewm by Using Throw Ball Throwing to Fire Place
title_ko: 화재 공간에 투척되는 투척 볼을 통한 정보 수집 및 전파 시스템
abstract_en: An information collection and transmission system using a throwing ball thrown into a fire space of the present invention, for reasonably determining whether to deploy firefighters and where to deploy firefighters, comprises: a throwing ball which is thrown into a fire site, is equipped with a temperature sensor, humidity sensor, oxygen saturation sensor, camera unit, and the like to determine an internal condition of the fire site before firefighters are deployed to the fire site, and transmits information sensed by a sensor module and video information captured by the camera unit to a fire chief terminal; a smart name tag module which is attached to an oxygen cylinder carried by a firefighter, displays oxygen pressure information or oxygen remaining information of the oxygen cylinder, additionally displays and provides affiliation and name information, is equipped with a motion sensor to display and provide information on the firefighter's collapse, transmits the oxygen pressure information, affiliation and name information, and collapse information to the fire chief terminal, and displays information transmitted from a fire chief through two-way communication with the fire chief terminal; a fire chief terminal which receives and displays the information transmitted from the name tag module and transmits information such as withdrawal order information and firefighter movement information transmitted by the fire chief to the name tag module; and a mesh network which performs a plurality of relay functions to bi-directionally connect the throwing ball, name tag module, and fire chief terminal to a network.
abstract_ko: 본 발명 화재 공간에 투척되는 투척 볼을 통한 정보 수집 및 전파 시스템은 화재 현장에 투척되는 것으로 화재 현장에 소방관이 투입되기 전에 화재 현장의 내부 상태를 파악하기 위하여 온도 센서, 습도 센서, 산소 포화도 센서, 카메라부 등을 구비하고 있으며 센서 모듈이 센싱한 정보들과 카메라부가 촬영한 영상 정보를 소방대장 단말기로 전송하는 투척 볼과, 소방관이 메고있는 산소통에 부착되는 것으로 산소통의 산소 기압 정보 또는 산소 잔여 정보를 표출하고 소속, 이름 정보를 추가적으로 표출 제공할 수 있으며, 모션 센서가 장착될 수 있어서 소방관의 쓰러짐 정보를 표출 제공할 수 있고, 상기 산소 기압정보, 소속, 이름정보, 쓰러짐 정보를 소방대장 단말기로 전송하고 소방대장 단말기로부터 양방향 통신을 통하여 소방대장으로부터 전송되는 정보를 표출할 수 있는 스마트 네임 태크 모듈과, 상기 네임태크 모듈로부터 전송되는 정보를 수신하여 표출하고 소방 대장이 전송하는 철수 명령정보, 소방관 이동 정보와 같은 정보를 네임태그 모듈로 전송하는 소방 대장 단말기와, 투척 볼, 네임태그 모듈 및 소방대장 단말기를 네트워크로 양방향으로 연결하는 다수의 중계 기능을 수행하는 메쉬 네트워크로 구성된 것을 특징으로 하는 것이다

title_en: Earthquake damage prediction and prevention system and method thereof
abstract_en: An earthquake damage prediction and prevention system for determining an impact or damage caused by an earthquake to objects associated with different geographical locations. A central unit with a filter module selects and collects earthquake related data of a plurality of network units. At least one impact ratio table is stored with a first data structure for storing geographical and/or topographical data coordinates of the different geographical locations. The geometric distances of the geographical locations from a hypocenter/epicenter are generated by an intensity calculation module with a coordinates processor. Local intensity values based upon the generated geometric distances and a given earthquake magnitude of a stored parameterization including variable weight parameters are generated by a propagation calculation unit of the intensity calculation module, whereas the generated geometric distances are stored assigned to the corresponding geographical locations by a second data structure of the impact ratio table.

title_en: Simulation method and device for cascading failures of power grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulation method and device for cascading failures of a power grid. The method comprises the steps of carrying out stability analysis on the power grid and determining a key failure component in the power grid; generating a cascading failure sequence of the power grid on the basis of the key failure component; carrying out dynamic simulation for a whole process on the basis of the cascading failure sequence; and determining the state of the power grid after the cascading failures through a simulation result. According to the simulation method and device, the technical problem of high workload of cascading failure simulation of the power grid is solved.
assignees: STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: A kind of public charging pile information supply apparatus
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of public charging pile information supply apparatus, the server in service station where belonging to electronic information technical field, including information processor and multiple public charging piles；Public charging pile information processor, including obtain information module, connect collection information module, send information module.A kind of public charging pile information supply apparatus that the present invention is provided, public charging pile information in certain area can be collected and be propagated by network, citizen use mobile phone or computer, specific position provides corresponding public charging pile information according to where citizen, selection charging nearby is carried out for citizen, improves City Green traffic and configuration is set.
assignees: SHENZHEN RUIRONGCHUANG ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of software module change based on complex network dynamic simulation influences to determine method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of software module changes based on complex network dynamic simulation to influence to determine method, belongs to complex software network field, including：Static scanning is carried out to the source code of target software first, builds software attributes method network；Further according to actual needs identification software module granule size, complex software network model is constructed, the influence after determining software module is happened to change and propagates into Mobile state emulation, obtains each node degree of susceptibility quantized value and change coverage；Finally, the attenuation coefficient by node in each change propagation generation is summed, and as node degree of susceptibility quantized value, relies on the change influence degree visualization result figure that this quantization is worth on software network.The present invention has considered change propagation characteristic and nodal properties carry out dynamic simulation, the attenuation process influenced using change, entire metric analysis process can all be realized on backstage, and establish in the flow of full automation, it is ensured that lower manpower and time cost to greatest extent.

title_en: Stability judgment method for extracted online social network data
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for judging stability of extracted online social network data, which comprises the following steps: s1, E 0 ＝(1,0,0) T Initial state, balance point when no information is transmitted; at the step of S2, the method comprises the steps of, a termination state, a balance point after information has passed through the entire network; s3, in On the premise that the information reaches the equilibrium point of a temporary stable state in the competition propagation process

title_en: Assessing network assets based on downstream events and measurements
abstract_en: A method for rating network assets based on downstream events may include: receiving communications from one or more sensors in the power distribution network, the communications indicating an occurrence of a network event; calculating, for each network asset in an affected area of the network, a probability of the network asset causing the problem indicated by the event; calculating, for each network asset in an affected area of the network, a propagation probability of the network asset causing the problem; calculating a probability of network asset failure for each network asset in an affected area of the network based on the probabilities and the propagation probabilities; comparing the probability of the network asset failing to a threshold; based on the comparison, determining the network asset having the highest probability of failure; and controlling one of more other network assets to alleviate the problem.

title_en: Method for realizing multi-MCU cascade centerless video conference
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for realizing a multi-MCU cascaded centerless video conference, which comprises the steps that firstly, a terminal is connected with a LAN2 network port of a slave MCU, and the slave MCU is connected and cascaded with LAN1 network ports of all main MCUs through a LAN1 network port; then each terminal collects video and audio, and then codes, compresses and transmits the video and audio to the connected slave MCU; each slave MCU decodes the media data of the terminal, then carries out picture synthesis and sound mixing processing, codes and sends the coded data to all the master MCUs; each master MCU decodes the media data of all the slave MCUs, then carries out picture synthesis and sound mixing processing, codes and sends the coded data to all the slave MCUs; each slave MCU decodes the media data sent by all the master MCUs, then carries out picture synthesis and sound mixing processing, codes and sends the coded data to a terminal communicated with the slave MCU; each terminal decodes the media stream data of the slave MCU connected with the terminal and plays the data through video output and audio output equipment. The invention can realize the low-coupling multistage cascade conference, and the conference supports remote disaster recovery and has good recoverability, stability and compatibility.
assignees: SHENZHEN RONGXUN VISION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network safe and economic dispatching method considering multiple systems
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for safely and economically scheduling a power distribution network considering multiple systems, which comprises the following steps of: s1, establishing a park comprehensive energy system model; s2, establishing a dispatching model of the park comprehensive energy system with the aim of minimum comprehensive cost; s3, establishing an optimized dispatching model of the active power distribution network system; and S4, coupling the park comprehensive energy system and the active power distribution network system by using a target cascade method, and solving an optimal scheduling scheme. The invention not only considers the economy of the power distribution network, but also considers the operation risk problem of the power distribution network, constructs a weighted objective function, and adopts a target cascade method combined with a harmony search algorithm to solve, thereby achieving the balance of safety and economy.
assignees: YANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH COMPANY OF JIANGSU PROVINCE ELECTRIC POWER LTD COMPANY OF STATE GRID;STATE GRID JIANGSU PROVINCE ELECTRIC POWER LTD COMPANY

title_en: Analysis method and system for transmission path of gas transmission pipe network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for analyzing a transmission path of a gas transmission pipe network, wherein the method comprises the following steps of: determining a key node set and an end node set; step S2: setting an acquisition strategy corresponding to the propagation path analysis request; step S3: determining a target node set based on the acquisition strategy; step S4: the target node propagation path is determined based on the set of target nodes, the set of key nodes, and the set of end nodes. According to the invention, the transmission path is analyzed based on the quantized key degree, the target node is rapidly positioned and forms a pipe network node which takes the target node as the center and is not concerned in the simulation process and presentation, so that the analysis, simulation and presentation efficiency is greatly improved.
assignees: SHANGHAI CHUANJI PIPE NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Mine energy electric load prediction method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electric power prediction, in particular to a mine energy electric load prediction method and device. The method comprises the steps of removing abnormal values of mine energy electric load data by adopting a clustering algorithm to obtain processed data; based on the processed data, constructing a deep learning model for predicting the mine energy electric load by using a Bi-directional long-short-term memory network Bi-LSTM; training the deep learning model through a back propagation algorithm, judging the training progress of the deep learning model by using a Huber loss function, and obtaining a trained deep learning model after training is completed; and acquiring mine energy electric load data in real time, and inputting the mine energy electric load data into a trained deep learning model to obtain the mine energy electric load prediction. By accurately predicting the mine energy electric load, a relevant decision maker can make scheduling decisions on the mine energy use condition in advance, thereby being beneficial to optimizing the production process, reducing the production cost and improving the efficiency.
assignees: QINGHAI YELLOW RIVER MINING IND CO LTD;STATE NUCLEAR ELECTRIC POWER PLANNING DESIGN & RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Control method, device, equipment and medium for power distribution network and electrochemical energy storage
abstract_en: The invention provides a control method, a device, equipment and a medium for power distribution network and electrochemical energy storage, wherein the control method for the power distribution network and the electrochemical energy storage comprises the following steps: constructing a coupling operation model of the power distribution network and the energy storage system, and determining a propagation path of abnormal electric quantity; the power distribution network and the energy storage system form a coupling system; based on the propagation path of the abnormal electric quantity, determining the fault protection of the energy storage system and the triggering condition of thermal runaway of a lithium battery pack in the energy storage system; determining a safe operation boundary of the energy storage system under the stable condition of the power distribution network according to the triggering condition; and determining a coordination control strategy of the coupling system according to the safe operation boundary of the energy storage system. The invention can realize the coupling coordination control of the power distribution network and the energy storage system, and solves the problem of poor control effect of the power system in the prior art.

title_en: Power transmission network cascading failure risk assessment device and method based on optimization domain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power transmission network cascading failure risk assessment device and method based on an optimization domain, which belong to the technical field of power transmission network failure assessment and comprise a cascading failure optimization domain generation module, a power transmission network cascading failure risk assessment module and a power transmission network cascading failure risk assessment module, wherein the cascading failure optimization domain generation module is used for constructing a cascading failure risk assessment model based on historical data and generating an optimization domain; the system comprises a power transmission network, a disconnection judging module, a cascading failure deduction module and a cascading failure evaluation module, wherein the power transmission network is used for transmitting a single fault to a power transmission network, the offline judging module is used for judging the on-network state of all generators in the power transmission network based on the current running state, the cascading failure deduction module is used for judging the cascading line failure caused by the single fault and updating an optimization domain based on the current topological state, and the cascading failure evaluation module is used for constructing the mapping from a running space to the optimization domain based on all potential renewable energy scenes so as to realize rapid cascading failure evaluation. The power transmission network cascading failure risk assessment device and method based on the optimization domain can effectively assess the influence of a large-scale scene on cascading failures, and can remarkably improve the speed and efficiency of cascading failure assessment.

title_en: Building construction safety risk assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for evaluating the safety risk of building construction, which relate to the technical field of building construction safety management and comprise the steps of identifying a plurality of risk factors influencing the construction safety based on multi-source construction data acquired at a construction site, constructing a multi-layer fuzzy ANP network based on fuzzy dependency among the risk factors, and calculating the fuzzy weight of each risk factor; the method comprises the steps of converting a multi-layer fuzzy ANP network into a Bayesian graph, generating initial conditional probabilities of risk factors by using fuzzy weights, constructing a failure propagation path set of the risk factors in the Bayesian network, calculating propagation probabilities and accumulated risk intensities of the paths by combining preset severity levels of each risk factor, dynamically correcting the conditional probabilities and severity levels in the Bayesian network by combining real-time construction data, updating the ordering results of the failure paths and the risk factors, and outputting a risk assessment result of a current construction stage. And the real-time assessment of the construction safety risk is realized, and the accuracy of the assessment result is improved.
assignees: GUIZHOU CONSTRUCTION ENG GROUP GUANSHANHU CONSTRUCTION CO LTD

title_en: Coal dust explosion risk early warning system and method for underground coal mine area
abstract_en: The invention relates to a coal dust explosion risk early warning system and method for an underground coal mine area, and belongs to the technical field of underground coal mine safety production. The invention solves the problems of insufficient real-time performance, limited monitoring range, high false alarm rate and incapability of dynamically evaluating risks of the traditional coal dust explosion early warning. The technical scheme includes that the real-time data acquisition module acquires dynamic data of an underground sensor through an industrial ring network, the database stores dynamic data and static index data of coal dust, the monitoring point coal dust explosion risk analysis module calculates a risk value by using a back propagation neural network, the regional coal dust explosion risk analysis module synthesizes the monitoring point risk value in a region and corrects the monitoring point risk value by using a spark monitoring condition, and the coal dust explosion risk early warning display module visualizes early warning results. The method has the technical effects of realizing comprehensive dynamic risk assessment of the underground environment, providing regional comprehensive early warning capability, enhancing intelligent analysis accuracy, reducing false alarm rate, improving safety response efficiency, optimizing dust treatment strategies and remarkably improving safety and reliability of coal mine production.
assignees: CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENG GROUP CHONGQING RES INST

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle power distribution network inspection image real-time identification method based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle distribution network inspection image real-time identification method based on artificial intelligence, which relates to the field of image identification and comprises the steps of carrying out space-time calibration on a multi-mode data packet, extracting characteristics of each mode, using a cross-mode attention mechanism to fuse the characteristics, obtaining multi-mode characteristic vectors, constructing an abnormal pattern through distribution network topology data, setting nodes and edges, giving the multi-mode characteristic vectors to the nodes, using a graph convolution neural network to aggregate neighbor equipment characteristics, updating node representation, outputting an abnormal classification result and an abnormal propagation path prediction result of distribution network equipment, receiving the abnormal classification result and the abnormal propagation path prediction result by a bandwidth network center, continuously monitoring and utilizing historical network data and an environmental factor training bandwidth prediction model, and predicting bandwidth change trend.
assignees: YONGCHENG DISTRIBUTION NETWORK CONSTRUCTION BRANCH OF NINGBO POWER TRANS AND DISTRIBUTION CONSTRUCTI

title_en: Power distribution network weak node identification method, equipment and medium based on short circuit parameters
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power systems and automation thereof, and discloses a method, equipment and medium for identifying weak nodes of a power distribution network based on short-circuit parameters. Based on the standardized data, respectively calculating the related index of the short circuit parameter, the voltage stability index and the network topology strength index of the node, determining the weight coefficient of each evaluation index by adopting an objective weighting method, and establishing a weighted evaluation model. And introducing a dynamic response model based on frequency deviation, and evaluating the dynamic response characteristic of the node under the disturbance condition. According to the propagation characteristics of the faults in the network, the influence degree of the faults on adjacent nodes is analyzed, and a comprehensive evaluation model is generated.

title_en: Centralized heating network management monitoring method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention provides a centralized heating network management monitoring method and system based on artificial intelligence, which collect pressure, temperature, flow and pipe wall acoustic vibration time sequence data of each node. The multi-modal fusion feature vector is generated by calculating the hydraulic imbalance, enthalpy difference change rate and extracting the MFCC features of the acoustic vibration signal. Initializing the pipe network topology into a graph structure, and dynamically calculating the association weight among nodes by using a relationship attention mechanism, thereby constructing a time-varying thermodynamic propagation graph. And the space-time characteristics are fused and extracted through a double-branch time convolution module, the space-time characteristics are input into a fully connected network, the fault type and the position are output, and a topological perception weighting loss function optimization model is adopted during training.
assignees: SHANXI SHANAN LANTIAN ENERGY SAVING TECH CO LTD;SHANXI INSTALLATION GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for predicting double-carbon marketization service market scale of power grid company
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for predicting the market scale of a dual-carbon marketization service of a power grid company, wherein the method comprises the following steps of constructing a basic assumption of the dual-carbon marketization service diffusion of the power grid company, wherein the assumption comprises a customer group division assumption, a dual-channel propagation assumption and a price acceptance mechanism assumption, establishing an improved Bass diffusion model based on the assumption, wherein the model comprises a final customer number change speed equation and a final customer number accumulation equation, completing parameter estimation and fitting goodness verification of the improved Bass diffusion model by combining historical data and expert scoring and questionnaire investigation data through a nonlinear least square method, and respectively carrying out market scale prediction on carbon transaction services which are already developed and carbon capture services which are not already developed by the power grid company based on parameter estimation results.
assignees: STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Method and apparatus for propagating public safety multicast and broadcast services among public safety personnel
abstract_en: Public safety user equipment (PS UE) that establishes a first wireless communication channel over a primary network to at least one multimedia multicast or broadcast service management entity and establishes one or more alternative wireless communication channels over one or more alternative networks ( 310 ). The public safety user equipment receives at least one multimedia multicast or broadcast service message over the first wireless communication channel ( 320 ), Then, the PS UE extracts data contained in the multimedia multicast or broadcast service message and storing the data in a local cache ( 330 ). The PS UE receives a cache request from the one or more user equipment over one or more alternative wireless communication channels ( 340 ) and then the PS UE transmits the stored data to the one or more PS user equipment ( 350 ).

title_en: Power grid self-organization critical state quantitative evaluation method based on multi-level variable weight theory
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid self-organization critical state quantitative evaluation method based on a multi-level variable weight theory in the field of power system cascading failure prevention and defense, which comprises the following steps of: determining a key index set influencing the self-organization critical state of the power grid; determining the self-organization criticality of the power grid in each operation state in the sample set; dividing an original physical index set into a physical layer and a factor layer, and calculating the weight of physical layer indexes in each running state in a sample set based on a positive and negative ideal variable weight theory; calculating the expression and the dimensionality of the factor index based on a principal component method, and ensuring that the factor index information is not overlapped; calculating the weight of the factor layer index based on a consistency judgment matrix constructed by the physical layer index weight and the principal component information expression factor; calculating an evaluation value by adopting a rank-sum ratio comprehensive evaluation method and taking the factor layer index as input; the influence mechanism of each factor on the self-organization critical state of the power grid can be comprehensively described, the self-organization critical state of the power grid can be quantitatively evaluated, and the calculation speed is high.

title_en: Method for generating N-2 expected accident set of large-scale alternating current-direct current hybrid power grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for generating an N-2 expected accident set of a large-scale alternating current-direct current hybrid power grid, which comprises the steps of screening out main line samples from the alternating current-direct current hybrid power grid to form a single fault set; clustering the line samples of the single fault set obtained in the step 1 by adopting a neighbor propagation algorithm, and determining a clustering result; calculating the correlation degree of a double fault set formed by any two line samples in each type and a double fault set formed by any two line samples in any two types; and setting a correlation threshold, screening out a double fault set with the correlation reaching or exceeding the correlation threshold, and generating an N-2 expected accident set. The method can generate the N-2 expected accident set of the large-scale alternating current and direct current hybrid power grid in an off-line state, and comprises N-2 accident scenes such as double alternating current faults, direct current faults, alternating current and direct current faults and the like.

title_en: Reservoir water level prediction method based on cyclic neural network and attention mechanism
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of reservoir operation control, and discloses a reservoir water level prediction method based on a recurrent neural network and an attention mechanism, which comprises the following steps: collecting flow and water level data to form a data set, and classifying the data set; converting the water level and flow values of the data set to obtain a standard data set; constructing a cyclic neural network model with an attention mechanism, and defining a target function; selecting data of a standard data set to train the recurrent neural network model; verifying and testing the trained recurrent neural network model; and predicting the water level of the key section by using the trained recurrent neural network model. The calculation precision of the model can be continuously improved along with the accumulation of the reservoir operation data, the dependence on the accuracy of the boundary condition is low, and the problem of low calculation precision of the traditional hydrodynamic method can be effectively solved; in reservoir flood season scheduling, the key section water level can be accurately predicted, and technical support is provided for flood control and prosperity scheduling decisions of large-scale reservoirs or cascade reservoirs.

title_en: Power system state estimation method combining particle filtering and convolutional neural network
abstract_en: The invention provides a power system state estimation method combining particle filtering and a convolutional neural network, which comprises the following steps: an off-line learning part measures fusion data by using a historical RTU/PMU, analyzes probability distribution of system injection power, generates a training sample by using Monte Carlo sampling through a Bayesian estimation-based particle filter algorithm, and trains a convolutional neural network; and the online state estimation part is used for preprocessing the real-time PMU measurement data, establishing a network according to a convolutional neural network structure and a weight value obtained from the training of the offline learning part, and then completing the state estimation of the power system through forward calculation and backward propagation. Compared with the Newton method iterative algorithm of the traditional least square estimation, the method can effectively improve the calculation speed and improve the precision and the robust capability of state estimation.

title_en: Node importance identification method based on complex network dependent seepage model
abstract_en: The invention provides a node importance identification method based on a complex network dependent seepage model, and aims to determine influence of nodes in a network according to seepage characteristics and cascade dynamics process when the network fails. The invention comprises an edge-dependent network modeling module and a real network verification module, wherein the edge-dependent network modeling module comprises the following steps: (1) Constructing a network model based on an edge dependency mechanism, and introducing a weak dependency seepage model to adjust the dependency strength between the connected edges in the network model; (2) Performing failure investigation on nodes in the network model in the step 1, setting the dependency strength among the adjustable parameter control nodes, and performing a new round of failure judgment according to whether new dependency edge failures exist in the network model until the network model is stable, so as to obtain the final value of the maximum connected component of the network model; (3) The importance of the node is evaluated based on the edge-dependent strength threshold and the maximum connected component that lead to network collapse when the node is deleted.

title_en: Network threat protection method and device for power transformer substation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for protecting network threat of an electric power transformer substation, which comprise the steps of analyzing intelligent transformer substation system configuration files in an intelligent transformer substation, extracting assets in the substation and forming an intelligent transformer substation asset list; analyzing the flow of real-time circulation to obtain real-time asset information, and marking abnormal assets by the flow to the asset table of the intelligent substation to obtain an asset list; setting actions generated by assets in the asset table as pass tags, and setting actions generated by assets which are not in the asset table as packet loss tags; and setting an emergency response threshold for the packet loss label, and closing an interface management state if the illegal access flow hit exceeds the threshold, so as to realize network threat protection. The flow of unauthorized asset access is controlled through the table entry, access threat detection is continuously carried out, and the access threat detection is processed according to the interface emergency treatment module, so that the threats of virus propagation, malicious attack and the like obtained by an illegal terminal are avoided in advance.

title_en: Three-dimensional assembly model change propagation influence evaluation method based on feature driving
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional assembly model change propagation influence evaluation method based on characteristic driving, which specifically comprises the following steps: step 1, establishing a characteristic assembly relation network of a three-dimensional assembly model; step 2, selecting the part relation network in the step 1 to evaluate the influence of part change; and 3, selecting the characteristic assembly relation network in the step 1 to evaluate the characteristic change propagation influence. The method comprehensively considers 4 aspects of importance of the part assembly topological structure, characteristic change propagation paths, characteristic change propagation indexes and characteristic change propagation evolution rules, and comprehensively analyzes and evaluates the characteristic change propagation influence of the three-dimensional assembly model; when the geometric topological shape of the three-dimensional part model is changed, the influence of the part and the characteristic granularity layer on the part can be comprehensively evaluated, and a foundation is provided for the change propagation decision and control of the three-dimensional assembly model.

title_en: Electric heating energy network toughness assessment method and system in extreme weather
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for evaluating toughness of an electrothermal energy network in extreme weather, which belong to the field of toughness evaluation, and comprise the following steps: establishing a line fault model of an electric heat energy network in extreme weather; the line fault model comprises an external force fault model and an overload fault model; simulating extreme weather by adopting a Monte Carlo simulation method, and cutting off fault lines caused by the extreme weather based on an external force fault model; balancing islanding, calculating power flow, and cutting off overload lines based on an overload fault model; reconstructing an electrothermal energy network based on a two-stage optimization model, balancing power, and calculating the weight of a cascading failure graph edge; and establishing a cascade fault diagram of the electric-thermal energy network, and calculating element-level toughness indexes and system-level toughness indexes. The method considers the influence of continuous disturbance and cascade faults on the electrothermal energy network, more accurately identifies the weak links of the electrothermal energy network, and improves the toughness of the electrothermal energy network.

title_en: Intelligent integrated service method and system for anti-overflow anti-static controller
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent integrated service method and system for an anti-overflow anti-static controller, which relate to the technical field of risk prediction and comprise the steps of calling a fault time sequence tracking data set of a historical sample controller according to a model ID of a target controller, wherein the target controller is the anti-overflow anti-static controller; performing index fluctuation association analysis, constructing a fault fluctuation association tree, constructing a cross-level risk prediction network, performing polling backtracking of association sensing equipment to obtain an intersection index monitoring time sequence array, outputting scene matching probability distribution, performing risk prediction level verification, outputting an integrated risk prediction result, matching a fault propagation path map, and performing source parameter inhibition regulation. The invention solves the technical problems that the overflow-preventing anti-static controller in the prior art mostly judges whether faults occur by setting a fixed threshold value, lacks flexibility and adaptability, is easy to cause false alarm and leakage alarm, and further influences the running stability and safety of equipment.

title_en: Distributed energy storage virtualization sharing system scheduling method based on target cascading method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed energy storage virtualization sharing system scheduling method based on a target cascading method, which comprises the steps of 1, constructing an operation model comprising a producer community containing distributed energy storage and a producer community renting virtual energy storage, 2, constructing a service life model of a generator set, thereby utilizing an interactive power equivalent calculation strategy of the distributed energy storage-virtual energy storage to construct an operation model of an operator, 3, constructing a three-layer optimization model of the distributed energy storage virtualization sharing system, 4, solving the three-layer optimization model based on the target cascading method, and solving a scheduling scheme of the distributed energy storage virtualization sharing system. According to the invention, by introducing the distributed energy storage-virtual energy storage interactive power equivalent method and combining the distributed target cascade optimization method, the three-layer optimization model of the distributed energy storage virtualization sharing system is solved, and on the basis of ensuring the safe operation boundary of the power network and equipment, the carbon emission of the system is effectively reduced and the utilization rate of the distributed energy storage is improved.

title_en: Cascading failure search comprehensive evaluation method based on probability index and severity index
abstract_en: According to the cascading failure searching comprehensive evaluation method based on the probability index and the severity index, the probability index and the severity index of the failure of the next-stage alternative line are respectively obtained through analyzing the operation state of the power grid after each stage of failure, and the cascading failure comprehensive risk index of the alternative line is obtained through grading and comprehensive.
assignees: CHINA SOUTH POWER GRID ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO;UNIV SOUTH CHINA TECH

title_en: A kind of energy internet construction method for improving efficiency of energy utilization
abstract_en: A kind of energy internet construction method for improving efficiency of energy utilization.It includes building energy Internet architecture Physical Network：Build energy Internet architecture Information Network：Structure energy Internet architecture application platform and etc..The present invention is configured with the energy production installations and lithium bromide chiller etc. such as Wind turbines, photovoltaic plant, cold, heat and electricity triple supply unit and earth source heat pump unit in Physical Network aspect and supplies cold heat equipment, to illuminating, feeding water, the system such as elevator carried out reducing energy consumption, realize the cascade utilization and saving energy and decreasing loss of the energy.In Information Network aspect, rely on production, transmission and consumption status of the intelligent things network technology to the energy to carry out comprehensive monitoring and monitoring, realize the target for reducing manpower, reducing cost, improving efficiency.In application platform aspect, using the complementary characteristic between multipotency source supplying system, on the basis of meeting user with energy demand, the supply of the energy such as hot and cold, electric, gas is coordinated and optimized, promotes the consumption of clean energy resource, improves efficiency of energy utilization.
assignees: STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER;BEIJING LANHAI XINYUAN TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Short-term optimization scheduling model considering step dynamic water flow time lag
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power grids, and discloses a short-term optimization scheduling model considering cascade dynamic water flow time lag, which comprises the following steps: constructing an original model; constructing a multi-section real time lag mixed integer linear programming model; linearizing the two-dimensional nonlinear relation of the water level and the reservoir capacity by using a piecewise linearization method; linearizing a two-dimensional nonlinear relation of tail water level and discharge capacity by using a piecewise linear method; linearizing the three-dimensional nonlinear relation of the power station power characteristic curve by using a three-dimensional linear interpolation method; converting an original model considering the short-term optimization scheduling of the step dynamic water flow time lag into a mixed integer linear programming model; and optimally scheduling the cascade hydropower station group by using a mixed integer linear programming model. The method can be used for describing the water flow delay finely in the short-term optimized dispatching of the cascade hydropower station.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG;CSG POWER GRID TECHNOLOGY RES CT;CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO

title_en: Reducing wireless device service disruption
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to apparatus, systems, and methods for reducing wireless device service disruption. An indication of the disaster condition may be provided to the wireless device. The disaster condition may affect the home public land mobile network of the wireless device. The wireless device can perform cell selection in a manner that is affected by the disaster condition indication. In various possibilities, this may include considering cells associated with forbidden public land mobile networks for cell selection, or excluding unavailable (e.g., due to a disaster condition) cells associated with the wireless device's home public land mobile network.

title_en: Expressway multi-scale traffic situation deduction method under unpredictable traffic event
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for deducing multi-scale traffic situation of a highway under the occurrence of an unpredictable traffic event, which utilizes the state information of vehicles recorded by a highway side unit and a toll station under the occurrence of the unpredictable traffic event to acquire multi-scale traffic parameter data through information coupling; constructing a highway traffic situation propagation model under the occurrence of unpredictable traffic events based on the infectious disease model so as to accurately describe the propagation characteristics of traffic behaviors in the network; based on traffic parameter data, traffic behavior propagation characteristics and expressway traffic node division, the spatial-temporal correlation of the multi-scale traffic parameter data is modeled by using a hypergraph convolutional neural network, so that traffic situation deduction at the expressway node level is realized. The invention can fill the defect of real-time perception of the unexpected traffic event on the expressway, provide accurate traffic situation evolution information for the management department, and assist the management department to quickly formulate reasonable traffic control and emergency rescue measures.
assignees: UNIV XINJIANG;UNIV TONGJI;RES INST HIGHWAY MINI TRANSP

title_en: Cascade tap hydropower station water level prediction and regulation method supporting new energy flexibility
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of complementary coordination scheduling of multiple energy sources of water, wind and light, in particular to a cascade tap hydropower station water level prediction and regulation method supporting the flexibility of new energy sources, aiming at improving the power supply and absorption capacity of a drainage basin tap hydropower station supporting power grid under the uncertain background of the power generation capacity of the runoff power generation and the wind and light new energy sources.

title_en: Automatic establishment and pushing method for load optimization distribution strategy of cascade hydropower station
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic establishment and pushing method for a load optimization distribution strategy of a cascade hydropower station, and belongs to the technical field of information automation of hydraulic and hydroelectric engineering. The method comprises the following steps of S1, establishing a comprehensive database for model call calculation, S2, establishing an intelligent simulation model, adjusting input and constraint conditions according to data of database numbers, selecting proper optimization targets according to different scene demands, S3, outputting a long-term scheduling scheme, a medium-term scheduling scheme and a short-term scheduling scheme by the intelligent simulation model, S4, establishing a unit combination and output distribution model, inputting unit state constraint conditions, outputting an optimization unit combination and output distribution strategy, and carrying out corresponding plan issuing or adjustment by personnel at a power grid mechanism side. The technical problems that the traditional cascade hydropower station load distribution strategy cannot meet the requirement that a user can not automatically formulate and implement the cascade hydropower station load optimization distribution strategy and cannot realize automatic pushing are solved.
assignees: GUANGXI GUIGUAN ELEC POWER CO LTD;DATANG YANTAN HYDROPOWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Power system training management method, system, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electric power system research and discloses an electric power system training management method, an electric power system training management system, an electric power system training management device and a storage medium, wherein the electric power system training management method comprises the steps of obtaining first operation data and first operation data; the method comprises the steps of generating a dynamic three-dimensional simulation training environment according to first operation data, linking the first operation data with the dynamic three-dimensional simulation training environment, constructing a first learning evaluation model, and generating a personalized learning path based on the cooperative action of an analysis mechanism and the first learning evaluation model. The dynamic fault propagation modeling and real-time operation feedback mechanism can truly simulate the running state of a power grid, is matched with a personalized learning recommendation function, can greatly improve the operation skills and emergency response capability of students, and has outstanding practical value and popularization prospect.
assignees: YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD TALENT DEV CENTER

title_en: Power grid mountain fire prediction method based on causal driving and space-time diagram convolution network
abstract_en: The invention provides a power grid mountain fire prediction method based on a causal driving and space-time diagram convolution network, and belongs to the technical field of mountain fire prediction. Designing dynamic and static feature encoders to extract weather time sequence information, geographical space environment and high-dimensional space-time features of multi-source heterogeneous data of power transmission line distribution, constructing a causal graph topology of dynamic evolution by adopting a causal discovery algorithm, identifying real causal driving relations among variables, decoupling causal strength matrixes into positive and negative adjacent matrixes, designing causal constraint graph rolling modules to aggregate and propagate high-order information, and finally realizing precise prediction of mountain fire of a power grid. The causal GCN layer in CSTGCN model extracts the space dependent features by utilizing the adjacency matrix of causal structure constraint, and CSTGCN model embeds causal structure information into a space-time feature learning frame, so that the causal structure information has higher prediction precision and generalization performance.

title_en: Power grid damage consequence evaluation method considering cascading failure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid damage result evaluation method considering cascading failures, and belongs to the technical field of power system dispatching.
