The method comprises the steps of establishing a HEMP E1 environment model, obtaining peak field intensity of a key equipment installation position of a power grid, establishing a key equipment fault probability model based on the peak field intensity, generating an initial fault through Monte Carlo simulation, establishing a cascading fault evolution model integrating direct current flow calculation, power grid regulation measures and communication equipment influence, iteratively simulating a fault process until the power grid is stable, calculating indexes such as load loss ratio, average utilization rate of line capacity and the like, and quantitatively evaluating the damage result of the power grid. The invention breaks through the limit of the existing equipment layer evaluation, realizes the accurate simulation of the cascading failure evolution of the system layer, gives consideration to the evaluation accuracy and the calculation efficiency, and provides important support for formulating the power grid defense strategy in the HEMP E1 environment.
assignees: HUANENG YIMIN COAL & ELECTRICITY CO LTD;UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG

title_en: Network selection method and apparatus
abstract_en: A network selection method and apparatus are provided. The method includes: A terminal device receives a broadcast message from a non-forbidden PLMN and a broadcast message from a forbidden PLMN. The broadcast message of the forbidden PLMN includes a disaster occurrence indication, and the disaster occurrence indication indicates that a disaster occurs on the non-forbidden PLMN. The terminal device requests, based on the disaster occurrence indication, to register with the forbidden PLMN, when the terminal device fails to register with the non-forbidden PLMN. According to the foregoing method, the terminal device can select a network that ensures a normal service, and service interruption of the terminal device caused by the disaster that occurs on the non-forbidden PLMN can be effectively reduced.

title_en: City gas pipeline system pipeline fault propagation impact evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the present invention discloses a kind of city gas pipeline system pipeline fault propagation impact evaluation method and system, and the method includes the network structure topological diagram of city gas pipeline system is established according to city gas pipeline system；Network model is established according to network structure topological diagram；According to network model and preset constraint condition, obtains the corresponding first flow pressure of city gas pipeline system normal condition and distribute information；Pipeline fault is simulated in network model, and according to preset pipeline fault propagation rule and constraint condition, is obtained city gas pipeline system corresponding second flow pressure under pipeline fault state and distributed information；Compare first flow pressure distribution information and second flow pressure distribution information carries out the assessment of pipeline fault propagation effect to city gas pipeline system.The system is for executing the above method.The embodiment of the present invention improves the accuracy of city gas pipeline system pipeline fault propagation impact evaluation.

title_en: Power grid system construction optimization method based on cascade failure simulation
abstract_en: The invention provides a power grid system construction optimization method based on cascade failure simulation, which comprises the steps of firstly designing an initial network model of a power grid system to be constructed, then carrying out cascade failure simulation on the network model containing a failure link, including current redistribution and link state updating, obtaining a network model after cascade failure, and finally judging whether the initial network model meets design requirements according to the network model after cascade failure. The method and the device are applied to the construction process of the real power grid, can be used for detecting the safety of the existing power grid, and can be used for checking whether the designed power grid meets the construction requirement when the real power grid is constructed.

title_en: Power grid service identification model generation method and power grid service identification method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a generation method of a power grid service identification model and a power grid service identification method. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a training sample set formed by power grid business data, inputting types of training samples and model tasks into a teacher network model for recognition to obtain a first recognition result, inputting types of the training samples and model tasks into a student network model to be trained for recognition to obtain a second recognition result, determining a first loss function and a second loss function according to the first recognition result, the second recognition result and label data, calculating a fitting loss function according to the first loss function and the second loss function, and carrying out back propagation on the student network model to be trained based on the fitting loss function to obtain the student network model to be trained for the next iteration until iteration convergence conditions are met to obtain the power grid business recognition model, and solving the problems that the model recognition accuracy is low, the high delay is high, and multi-business data cannot be processed.

title_en: Construction progress dynamic optimization method and system based on BIM and computer vision
abstract_en: The invention discloses a construction progress dynamic optimization method and a construction progress dynamic optimization system based on BIM and computer vision, which particularly relate to the technical field of building construction management and comprise the following steps of automatically registering a BIM model with a construction site image; the method comprises the steps of processing a construction site image by adopting a visual recognition algorithm to generate a visual recognition result, constructing a four-dimensional dynamic BIM model, mapping the visual recognition result to a corresponding component in real time through multi-feature similarity calculation, monitoring progress deviation by utilizing a key path dynamic recognition and deviation propagation matrix, and combining a Bayesian network and Monte Carlo simulation prediction risk. According to the invention, by fusing BIM and computer vision technology, a construction progress optimization system integrating automatic registration, dynamic monitoring, risk prediction and intelligent decision is constructed, the problems of low efficiency, delay in progress monitoring, fuzzy risk prediction and rough resource allocation in traditional manual inspection data acquisition are solved, and accurate monitoring, risk early warning and resource optimization configuration of construction progress are realized.

title_en: Distribution network automation system architecture
abstract_en: A distribution network automation system architecture. The system adopts a layered distributed system architecture and mainly comprises a main station system, a data communication system, a substation system and a remote terminal. The master station system adopts a high-speed reliable dual Ethernet structure, and adopts a dual-computer hot standby mode for a main data server and a communication front-end processor; the substation system adopts a plug-in card type hardware platform supporting hot plug and an embedded real-time operating system and supports multi-stage cascade; the remote terminal system adopts an embedded hardware platform technology and an embedded real-time operating system to support abundant uplink interfaces.

title_en: Command and control cascade failure model method for building up based on m rank adjacency matrix
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of command and control cascade failure model method for building up based on m rank adjacency matrix, is as follows：Step 1：Calculate each node angle value and node betweenness in network；Step 2：The initial load of calculate node；Step 3：Count operation link total number；Step 4：It calculates in sensing node to the shortest path between Strike node by the item number of specified node；Step 5：Calculate operation link betweenness；Step 6：Respectively initial load is calculated according to node degree and operation link betweenness；Step 7：Foundation degree index calculate node importance；Step 8：According to operation link betweenness calculate node importance；Step 9：Calculate the initial load of network；Step 10：Load capacity model is obtained according to initial load.The application establishes nonlinear load capacity model, effectively resists the cascading failure of command and control network, to improve the survivability of network according to the non-linear relation of load and capacity.

title_en: Power grid service risk assessment method, device and equipment based on meteorological disasters
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a power grid service risk assessment method, a device and equipment based on meteorological disasters. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring operation statistical data of a power grid system; acquiring the occurrence probability of the set fault type in each subnet and the service interruption time length caused by the set fault type according to the operation statistical data; constructing an interruption time matrix between the set fault category and the service interruption time, and calculating a service loss vector according to the interruption time matrix and the service importance vector; calculating a first risk value according to the occurrence probability of the set fault category in each subnet and the service loss vector; adjusting the first risk value according to a network scale coefficient to obtain a second risk value; and respectively sequencing the first risk value and the second risk value of each subnet to obtain a risk evaluation result. The accuracy of power grid service risk assessment can be improved, and the assessment result has stronger objectivity and practicability.
assignees: BIG DATA CENTER STATE GRID CORP OF CHINA

title_en: Dual-branch tropical cyclone strength and scale estimation method and system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention designs a method and a system for estimating strength and scale of a double-branch tropical cyclone based on deep learning. The invention relates to the technical field of ocean atmosphere remote sensing image processing. The method and system comprise the following steps: the method comprises the following steps: data preprocessing and data set construction: the method is used for the task of double-branch tropical cyclone strength and scale estimation, data are derived from a HURSAT public data set, infrared and microwave remote sensing images are adopted, and tropical cyclone strength and wind radius are collected. Step two: tropical cyclone strength and scale estimation encoder module: and extracting high-level features on the strength and scale of the tropical cyclone by using a convolutional neural network and an attention mechanism according to the input tropical cyclone remote sensing images of the infrared and microwave channels. Step three: a tropical cyclone strength and scale estimation dual-branch decoder module: the two-branch decoder module is composed of two different branches, one branch is used for estimating the strength of the tropical cyclone, and the other branch is used for estimating the radius of the tropical cyclone. Step four: and combining the two modules in the second step and the third step, and jointly forming an algorithm part of the deep learning-based dual-branch tropical cyclone strength and scale estimation system based on a back propagation principle. And deploying the trained model and system at the cloud end by using the relevant knowledge of software engineering to form a final system.

title_en: Railway risk factor identification and evaluation method and system based on comprehensive importance
abstract_en: The invention provides a railway risk element identification and evaluation method and system based on comprehensive importance, which belong to the technical field of transportation risk element identification and evaluation, wherein a risk element set of a railway system is obtained through accident cause analysis, a network relation among risk elements is obtained according to a risk propagation theory, a multi-granularity network model is established, principal component analysis is carried out through indexes in the model, a first principal component is selected as a functional importance index weight, and the risk importance weight obtained through scoring processing by a cloud model-entropy weight expert is subjected to linear weighting, so that the comprehensive importance weight of the risk element is obtained and is used as an evaluation basis of the importance degree of the railway system level risk element. The invention builds a multi-granularity network model of the railway system level, and realizes the rapid identification and evaluation of key risk elements of the railway system level; the method provides important basis for early protection of the railway system for risks and targeted measures before the railway system is put into operation, and improves the reliability and safety of the railway system operation.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING JIAOTONG;CHINA STATE RAILWAY GROUP CO LTD;RAILWAY SCIENCE AND TECH RESEARCH AND DEVELOPMENT CENTER CHINA ACADEMY OF RAILWAY SCIENCES CORPORATI;CHINA ACADEMY RAILWAY SCIENCES CORP LTD

title_en: Training method and device for space-time perception building equipment operation risk identification model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of risk identification, in particular to a training method and a training device for a space-time perceived building equipment operation risk identification model, comprising the steps of carrying out different behavioral pattern cluster analysis on extracted building equipment state space-time perceived characteristics, and calculating the similarity between a low-frequency behavioral cluster and a high-frequency behavioral cluster to obtain a risk cluster similarity matrix so as to determine a risk space-time comprehensive weight; and constructing a device risk propagation network by traversing nodes in the space-time perception graph neural network, and training a risk identification model according to the space-time perception characteristics of the building device state and the device risk propagation network to obtain a building device operation risk identification model. According to the invention, the time-space sensing characteristics of the state of the building equipment and cluster information obtained by cluster analysis are fused, so that the risk identification model not only can learn the time-space dynamic characteristics of the operation of the equipment more comprehensively, but also can analyze the performance of the characteristics under different behavioral modes, and the identification accuracy of the operation risk of the building equipment is improved.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD SHUANGCHUANG CENTER

title_en: Power distribution network maintenance strategy generation method of heuristic algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network maintenance strategy generation method of a heuristic algorithm, which comprises the steps of evaluating the aging degree of a coating and judging whether the coating needs to be replaced or repaired or not according to multidimensional health state indexes such as the aging degree of the surface of an insulator, a glaze crystal structure, geometric dimension deviation, surface cracks, temperature distribution and the like in a power distribution network, dividing a maintenance area and determining an optimal maintenance path by analyzing the geographic position of a tower where the insulator is located, surrounding vegetation coverage conditions and electromagnetic interference level; in the ground inspection process, three-dimensional point cloud data of the power transmission line are obtained, and whether the insulator is damaged or polluted is judged; measuring the width and length of the surface crack, predicting the crack propagation trend and the residual life, making a maintenance time window and scheduling maintenance resources; after the insulator is replaced or repaired, detecting the temperature distribution of the insulator to judge the installation quality; finally, through multidimensional data analysis, an optimal overhaul decision sequence of the whole life cycle of the insulator is generated.
assignees: MAOMING POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Container port cascade failure risk assessment method based on ship flow distribution
abstract_en: The invention discloses a container port cascade failure risk assessment method based on ship flow dynamic allocation, which comprises the steps of extracting airlines from mass container ship AIS track data and constructing a directional weighted shipping network, generating alternative substitute port sets for an interrupted port based on network topology features and space neighbor effects, determining 3 optimal substitute ports of the interrupted port by integrating multi-source shipping big data of the port, constructing a port cascade failure risk modeling method based on linear Motter-Lai model assumption, constructing 3 port cascade failure risk assessment indexes under a shipping scene, assessing the influence degree of the container shipping network after the port is interrupted, and exploring a dynamic cascade failure risk diffusion process and a dynamic cascade failure risk diffusion mechanism by combining a geographic visualization method. The method enriches the prior knowledge system of dynamic risk assessment of the global container transportation system, and provides important practical significance for container cascade failure risk management and countermeasure research.
assignees: INST GEOGRAPHIC SCIENCES & NATURAL RESOURCES RES CAS

title_en: Photovoltaic power generation power ultra-short-term prediction method and system based on hybrid neural network
abstract_en: The invention provides a photovoltaic power generation power ultra-short-term prediction method and system based on a hybrid neural network, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring and preprocessing historical characteristic data, constructing the input of the neural network, and carrying out original sampling time sequence of the photovoltaic power generation power in the preprocessing characteristic time sequence Performing CEEMDN decomposition to obtain CEEMDAN decomposition sequence, and combining to obtain combined characteristics The method comprises the steps of constructing M+1 GRU-Attention neural network models, processing combined characteristics to obtain a final predicted value IM F  m  of an mth GRU-Attention neural network, and training the M+1 GRU-Attention neural network models through back propagation and gradient descent algorithms to obtain a photovoltaic power generation short-term prediction model so as to predict photovoltaic power generation power. The method solves the technical problems that modeling capability of time dependence is not strong, photovoltaic power generation power prediction precision and calculation efficiency are to be improved, stability and integrity of a decomposition process are difficult to ensure, noise interference is caused by a modal aliasing phenomenon, and adaptability and robustness of a model to photovoltaic power generation fluctuation characteristics are low.
assignees: STATE GRID ANHUI POWER CO LTD CHUZHOU POWER SUPPLY COMPANY;UNIV HEFEI TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Safety management method and system for heat distribution pipe network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of safety management, in particular to a safety management method and system of a heating power pipe network, comprising the following steps: applying heat pulse to key sections of a heating power pipe network, monitoring propagation, collecting temperature, pressure and flow data, analyzing delay, temperature change and pressure fluctuation, determining a propagation path, evaluating transmission efficiency, adjusting heat distribution, monitoring regional temperature in real time, evaluating safety risk, sending an adjustment instruction, updating management and control priority, and generating a pipe network state feedback result after dispatching. According to the invention, by capturing the dynamic change of heat transmission, the heat transmission path and efficiency can be evaluated in real time, the heat distribution of the pipe network is optimized, the real-time analysis of the temperature data of the pipe network area is performed, the risk area is identified, the risk evaluation is performed, the priority control of the key area is ensured, the flexibility and response speed of the pipe network to the change are improved, the possibility of fault occurrence is reduced, and the stability and safety of heat supply are ensured.
assignees: HENAN HONGYE CONSTRUCTION MAN CO LTD

title_en: Reliability evaluation method and system for multi-power-supply radiation type power grid
abstract_en: The invention provides a reliability evaluation method and a system for a multi-power radiation type power grid, which comprise the steps of generating a partition branch current node injection matrix and a partition node current branch injection matrix and outputting an isolation node matrix, enabling the multi-power to be equivalent to common nodes and generating an undirected graph adjacent matrix of the power grid, determining connectivity among power grid nodes under each fault scene to obtain a branch fault node connectivity matrix, updating a load classification matrix, determining a corresponding load classification matrix, determining the power branch fault node connectivity matrix and a standby power branch fault node connectivity matrix by combining corresponding priority strategies, updating parameters of the load classification matrix, calculating a node reliability index and a system reliability index according to the updated load classification matrix, and evaluating the reliability of the power grid. The method considers the cascading failure of the power grid and the influence of the cascading failure on the multiple power supplies, and can accurately and rapidly evaluate the reliability of the radiation type power grid with multiple power supplies.

title_en: Improved super-network rumor propagation model building method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of supernetworks, and provides an improved supernetwork rumor propagation model building method which comprises the following steps of 1, building a SEIAR supernetwork rumor propagation model with opposite states according to a classical SEIR model, 2, building a differential kinetic equation set according to rumor propagation rules, 3, calculating a rumor-free balance point of the model according to the differential kinetic equation set, 4, calculating a basic regeneration number, 5, calculating local and global progressive stability conditions of the balance point by utilizing Routh-Hurwitz criteria and Lyapunov stability theorem, and 6, adopting a control strategy according to rumor propagation conditions. The invention can better describe the behavior of refute a rumour in the social network and reveal the dynamic influence of refute a rumour on the rumor propagation process.

title_en: Electric power network security defense method and device based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twinning-based electric power network security defense method and a digital twinning-based electric power network security defense device, which belong to the technical field of network security, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring electric power data of an electric power network in real time; the method comprises the steps of constructing a digital twin simulation environment of an electric power network according to electric power data, extracting electric power characteristic data in the digital twin simulation environment, carrying out layer-by-layer risk analysis on the electric power characteristic data according to each layer of hyperplane functions of a preset decision tree to determine a risk type and a risk matrix of the electric power network, reconstructing a propagation path of a current attack according to the risk matrix in the digital twin simulation environment, and generating a security defense strategy of the electric power network according to the risk type and the propagation path. Therefore, by implementing the invention, the problem of low detection accuracy of the risk of the power network in the prior art can be solved.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Method for estimating risk of infectious disease spread in facilities
title_ko: 시설물의 감염병 전파 위험도 판단 방법
abstract_en: A method for determining the risk of infectious disease transmission in a facility is provided. The method for determining the risk of infectious disease transmission in a facility according to an embodiment of the present invention may detect whether there are contacts of a confirmed person with an infectious disease, identify facilities where the detected contacts came into contact with the confirmed person, and determine the risk of infectious disease transmission at the identified facilities. As a result, the risk of infectious disease transmission in facilities can be determined based on objective standards, making it possible to take reasonable, systematic, and effective follow-up measures for facilities visited by confirmed infectious disease patients. Ultimately, the present invention can contribute to the prevention and suppression of infectious disease pandemics.
abstract_ko: 시설물의 감염병 전파 위험도 판단 방법이 제공된다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 시설물의 감염병 전파 위험도 판단 방법은, 감염병에 확진된 확진자와 접촉한 접촉자가 있는지 탐지하고, 탐지된 접촉자가 확진자와 접촉한 시설물을 파악하며, 파악된 시설물의 감염병 전파 위험도를 판단한다. 이에 의해, 시설물의 감염병 전파 위험도를 객관적인 기준에 의거하여 판단할 수 있으므로, 감염병 확진자가 방문한 시설물에 대한 합리적이고 체계적이며 효과적인 사후 조치가 가능해져, 궁극적으로 감염병 대유행의 예방과 억제에 기여할 수 있게 된다.

title_en: Cascading failure search comprehensive evaluation method based on probability index and severity index
abstract_en: According to the cascading failure searching comprehensive evaluation method based on the probability index and the severity index, the probability index and the severity index of the failure of the next-stage alternative line are respectively obtained through analyzing the operation state of the power grid after each stage of failure, and the cascading failure comprehensive risk index of the alternative line is obtained through grading and comprehensive.

title_en: Medium-and-long-term hidden random scheduling method for cascade hydropower station of combined wind power photovoltaic power station
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for carrying out medium-term and long-term hidden random scheduling on a cascade hydropower station of a combined wind power photovoltaic power station, and belongs to the technical field of hybrid energy system scheduling. According to the method, lunar runoff uncertainty is considered, and a radial basis function neural network is used for fitting a scheduling model through a hidden random scheduling method. The model reasonably considers wind power photovoltaic uncertainty and impact of a reverse peak regulation phenomenon which can occur to a power grid, considers that short-term wind and light uncertainty is reserved for standby in medium and long-term scheduling, and distributes enough daily electric quantity to deal with pressure of the reverse peak regulation phenomenon to the power grid peak regulation. The model result of the method is greatly different from the result without considering the short-term standby wind power photovoltaic, the method can effectively utilize wind power photovoltaic output and cascade hydropower station optimized scheduling information, and provides a reference basis with strong operability for the cascade hydropower station scientific decision under the condition of large-scale new energy grid connection.

title_en: Virus propagation inhibition method
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a method of inhibiting viral transmission, the method comprising the steps of: constructing a trust value model of an interactive trust value mechanism, and giving trust values for all links; evaluating infection parameters according to the current network infection condition, and calculating a strategy parameter threshold value adopting a corresponding virus transmission inhibition strategy; receiving infection feedback information; and responding to the infection feedback information, and adjusting the current network security level according to the trust value. The method provided by the disclosure can reduce network structure damage on the premise of inhibiting network virus transmission, and can adapt to network security environment change to dynamically adjust the network structure.

title_en: Fault hazard index calculation and vulnerability assessment method for smart power grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fault hazard index calculation and vulnerability assessment method for an intelligent power grid, which comprises the following steps of: constructing a dependent coupling network topology model of the smart power grid in an abstract mode according to the power grid and the information network; acquiring a fault element set according to the node fault of the power grid and the node fault of the information grid, and acquiring a fault hazard index of a node according to the fault element set; obtaining coupling secondary fault propagation of the node according to the interactive propagation of the fault and the bidirectional coupling of the smart grid, and obtaining a coupling secondary fault hazard index of the node according to the coupling secondary fault propagation of the node; and acquiring a node secondary comprehensive fault hazard index according to the node fault hazard index and the node coupling secondary fault hazard index, and acquiring a node vulnerability evaluation index according to the node secondary comprehensive fault hazard index. The method considers the coupling of the smart grid and the interactive propagation of the fault, and the obtained system vulnerability analysis result is more visual and accurate.

title_en: Parallel oil and gas pipeline domino effect risk analysis method based on Bayesian network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a parallel oil and gas pipeline domino effect risk analysis method based on a Bayesian network, which comprises the steps of determining a source pipe, and distributing source pipe nodes and other nodes in the Bayesian network; determining an upgrading vector according to the type of the pipe transmission medium and the failure mode; evaluating the strength of an upgrade vector sent by a target pipeline receiving source pipe; calculating the accident upgrading probability of the target pipeline; evaluating the probability of domino accidents of the target pipeline; judging whether the target pipeline continuously transmits the domino effect or not to obtain a domino accident sequence of the multi-pipe parallel system; and simulating different domino accident scenes and evaluating the failure probability of the multi-pipe parallel system. The method can solve the problems that a domino risk analysis method for parallel oil and gas pipelines does not exist in the prior art, and domino risk inside a multi-pipe parallel oil and gas pipeline system cannot be quantified, and achieves the purposes of establishing a domino effect risk analysis method special for parallel oil and gas pipelines and providing scientific support for risk decisions of oil and gas pipeline builders and operators.

title_en: Method for Risk Management using Web based RMS linked with SSO
title_ko: 통합인증시스템과 연계된 웹 기반 위험관리시스템을 이용한 위험관리방법
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 통합인증시스템과 연계된 웹 기반 위험관리시스템을 이용한 위험관리방법에 관한 것으로, 웹 환경에서 SSO(통합인증)와 위험관리시스템(RMS)연동을 통해 관리자 인증과 접근성이 강화된 을 제공하는데 그 목적이 있다. 
본 발명의 목적은 점검 대상 네트워크 영역의 OS별 취약점, 네트워크 장비 취약점 및 웹 응용프로그램 취약점을 스캐닝하여 해당 로그 파일을 취약점DB에 저장하는 취약점 센서과정; 취약점 센서과정의 프로세스 결과와 SSO 인증 로그를 취합하는 취약점 수집과정; 취약점 수집 결과에서 IP기준으로 관리자가 자산을 등록하는 자산 등록과정; 등록된 자산에 대응하는 관리 대상 네트워크의 IT 자산의 자산가치를 내부 보안 운영 방침을 기준으로 관리자가 정의한 자산가치 연산식을 이용하여 자산가치를 산정하는 자산 분석과정; 위협 빈도와 위협 영향을 파악하여 위협영향 및 위협빈도수를 산출하는 위협 분석과정; 취약점 센서과정에 의해 수집된 데이터에서 취약성 수준을 도출하는 취약성 분석과정; 및 산정한 자산가치와 위협 영향값을 연산하여 자산별 파급 강도인 자산별 위협지수를 산정하고, 위협빈도수와 취약성지수를 통해 자산별 위험도를 산정하는 자산별 위험도 산정과정을 포함하여 이루어진 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Control federation for utility grids
abstract_en: In one embodiment, a federation device receives one or more grid control-based signals over a computer network, applies one or more utility grid control policies to the one or more grid control-based signals, and federates the one or more signals and/or the one or more utility grid control policies into one or more federated control-based signals. The federation device then propagates the one or more federated control-based signals to one or more grid-related devices.

title_en: User notification for service interruption
abstract_en: System and methods for selecting customers to notify of a service interruption or outage are described. A network may receive an interruption notification indicating when a service interruption is to occur. In some examples, the interruption notification may also include a particular set of equipment, such as a base station, that will experience the interruption, such as being taken offline for maintenance or a power outage affecting the base station. A notification module determines which customers will be affected by the service interruption and transmits a notification to the customers, informing the customers of the service interruption.

title_en: Short-term power generation prediction method applied to high-concentration-ratio photovoltaic power generation system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a short-term power generation prediction method applied to a high-concentration ratio photovoltaic power generation system. The method comprises the following steps of collecting historical data of the high-concentration ratio photovoltaic power generation system, and determining input of a BP (back-propagation) neural network for predicting short-term power generation according to a related coefficient analytic method; training the initialized BP neural network according to each input historical datum; obtaining the predicted short-term power generation according to the input historical data and the trained BP neural network. According to the short-term power generation prediction method applied to the high-concentration ratio photovoltaic power generation system, short-time prediction and daily prediction can be carried out, short-time average errors between prediction results and actual results are not greater than 10 percent, and the prediction accuracy is greatly improved.

title_en: Power equipment data information management system
abstract_en: The present invention provides power equipment data information management systems, including the data collection terminal being arranged on power equipment and the management system, the processing system that are connect respectively with the data collection terminal, the data collection terminal includes the device parameter acquisition terminal, the video information acquisition terminal that are set on power equipment；The management system includes control host and the data concentrator, the data exchange unit that are connect with the control host；The processing system is Multilevel method structure, and including mechanical floor, network layer, dispatch layer and transport layer, each layer sets mutually independent information preprocessing unit respectively.The present invention disclosure satisfy that growth requirement of the power equipment to information integration, can make originally mutually can not the device end of data direct connection and data Unified Communication realize that data are independently called and communication function, power system device communication and the cascade of expansible Data Acquisition Design are realized, should be widely promoted and use.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID SHANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: New energy scene generation method and system based on confrontation learning model
abstract_en: The invention relates to a new energy scene generation method and a system based on an antagonistic learning model, wherein the method comprises the following steps: generating a sample set for neural network training against a learning model and a label for each sample; constructing a discrimination network D and a generation network G; inputting the random vector z and the label of the sample into a generation network G to obtain a simulation sample G (z), and simultaneously inputting the simulation sample G (z), the real sample and the label of the sample into a discrimination network D; carrying out back propagation training on the neural networks of the generation network G and the discrimination network D, and carrying out iteration; and after iterative convergence, generating a network G to generate and output an optimized new energy operation scene. The method can solve the problems of single generated output parameter, inaccurate result, large quantity of simplified assumptions and the like of the traditional method, optimizes the new energy output parameter, and provides data basis and guarantee for random optimization operation control of the energy Internet.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Fault diagnosis method and device for electric vehicle charging equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fault diagnosis method, a fault diagnosis device and a storage medium for electric vehicle charging equipment, wherein the fault diagnosis method for the electric vehicle charging equipment comprises the following steps: acquiring state parameter information data of the charging equipment; the state parameter information comprises the fault time, the fault type, the fault position and the equipment state parameter of the equipment; extracting the parameter characteristics of the state parameter information data by adopting sampling windows, convolution kernels and step lengths with different sizes based on a convolution neural network CNN to obtain multi-scale characteristics; and inputting the multi-scale features into a trained error back propagation BP neural network, and outputting the fault reason of the charging equipment by the BP neural network. The method combines the CNN and the BP neural network, acquires the key characteristics of the fault types through the CNN, and performs iterative learning based on error reverse direction propagation on the fault reasons of the equipment and the system parameters of the charging equipment by combining the BP neural network, thereby realizing accurate diagnosis of the fault reasons of the charging equipment.
assignees: GCI SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD;GUANGZHOU JIESAI COMM PLANNING & DESIGN INST CO LTD

title_en: Circuit line risk value determination method, device, computer equipment and medium
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a method, apparatus, computer device and medium for determining risk value of a circuit line, including: performing cascading failure simulation on the power system based on a preset initial random failure to obtain a simulation failure chain, wherein the cascading failure simulation is used for performing simulation processing on system operation of the power system after the initial random failure is triggered; performing fault forward on the simulation fault chain to obtain a fault network set sequence, wherein the fault network set sequence comprises a plurality of fault network sets, each fault network set corresponds to a circuit line, and the circuit lines are used for describing lines generating faults; determining an optimal load shedding of the set of faulty networks based on the operating parameters of the power system; and determining the target risk value of the circuit line corresponding to the fault network set based on the optimal load reduction of the fault network set. Therefore, the evaluation efficiency of the risk value is effectively improved by measuring and counting the influence of cascading failure propagation on the circuit line.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST EAST INNER MONGOLIA ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Stability improving method for symmetrical phase-locked grid-connected variable current system based on virtual damping
abstract_en: The invention discloses a stability improving method of a symmetrical phase-locked grid-connected variable current system based on virtual damping. Aiming at the problem that the stability margin of the grid-connected variable current system induced by the voltage coupling path of the symmetrical phase-locked loop is greatly reduced, the virtual damping loop of the grid-connected point voltage to current loop control instruction is introduced into the dq coordinate system of the controller, the cascade loop coupling inhibition link eliminates the negative influence of the voltage coupling path of the symmetrical phase-locked loop, and a first-order high-pass filter is introduced as a loop damping enhancement unit, so that the stability margin of the symmetrical phase-locked grid-connected variable current system in a middle-low frequency range is greatly enhanced while the symmetry of the dq axis control structure is maintained, and the stable operation capacity and the loop response speed of the symmetrical phase-locked grid-connected variable current system under the weak current network working condition are remarkably improved.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID SHANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Optimal power flow calculation method for power load unbalance
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optimal power flow calculation method for power load unbalance, which comprises the following steps: 1, modeling a power grid to obtain classification results aiming at different nodes; 2, considering the power generation cost and the load regulation cost, and respectively establishing corresponding objective functions aiming at the direct current and alternating current models; 3, respectively constructing respective constraints for direct current power flow and alternating current power flow; and 4, calculating the power flow according to the objective function and the constraint to obtain the optimal voltage amplitude and phase angle of each node and the load quantity required to be reduced by each load. The optimal power flow calculation method for power load unbalance can provide a proper load regulation strategy for the power grid under the condition that the power grid is damaged or in cascade failure, so that the malignant expansion of the power grid failure range is avoided.

title_en: Zero-carbon power system modeling method and system based on closed-loop feedback optimization order reduction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a zero-carbon power system modeling method and system based on closed-loop feedback optimization order reduction, which relate to the field of zero-carbon power system modeling and combustion mechanism optimization, and are used for carrying out mechanism order reduction on a chemical reaction mechanism network of a zero-carbon power system to obtain a key reaction path; the method comprises the steps of adopting an improved dynamic force model to dynamically layout an energy network constructed based on a key reaction path to obtain a dynamic energy network, adopting a closed loop feedback mechanism to optimize the dynamic energy network to obtain a simplified mechanism network, obtaining multidimensional data based on the simplified mechanism network and extracting features to obtain a low-dimensional feature vector, and inputting the low-dimensional feature vector into a comprehensive mapping model to predict to obtain a prediction result of key combustion parameters. The method of the directed relation graph with the error propagation of the plasma is combined with a closed-loop feedback mechanism to reduce the order of a mechanism network, multidimensional data of the mechanism network is reduced in dimension, and the high-precision and quick response prediction of key combustion parameters is realized by utilizing a multi-model fusion strategy.

title_en: River flood rapid forecasting method based on physical information neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a river flood rapid forecasting method based on a physical information neural network, and belongs to the field of river flood forecasting. The method comprises the steps of introducing boundary condition parameters as input variables on the basis of a traditional physical information neural network (Physical InformedNeural Network, PINN), so that PINN learns flood wave propagation rules under different boundary conditions. Furthermore, a physical information neural network flood rapid forecasting framework (Physics InformedNeural Networks for Rapid Flood Forecasting, RFF-PINN) integrating a hydrodynamic method is provided on the basis, a numerical solution based on grid dispersion is reconstructed into a continuous function on a time-space domain through a piecewise polynomial interpolation method, residual loss between network output and a hydrodynamic model simulation value is constructed, network parameters are optimized in cooperation with PDE loss, and the problem that network parameter optimization effect is reduced due to the fact that PDE loss in a complex fluid region is difficult to converge is avoided. The method has the beneficial effects that the water depth change process of each section of the river under any boundary condition can be accurately and rapidly predicted.

title_en: Power distribution network information physical coupling risk propagation deduction method, system, equipment and medium based on hidden Markov model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent power distribution networks and discloses a power distribution network information physical coupling risk propagation deduction method, a system, equipment and a medium based on a hidden Markov model. According to the method, complex information physical coupling risk events are disassembled into independent risk event sets, so that characteristics of each risk event can be analyzed in depth, risk influence can be estimated accurately according to multivariate information such as an originating side, a damage loss type, occurrence probability and influence range, propagation mechanisms of risks at different layers are described clearly, workers can position risk sources quickly, and effective measures are taken to block risk propagation.

title_en: Apparatus and method thereof for video monitoring of subway vehicle
title_ko: 지하철 차량 영상감시 장치 및  그 방법
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 지하철 차량과 지하철 역사 내에 카메라를 통한 영상감시 장치에 있어서, 상기 지하철 차량의 천정에 형성하여 상기 지하철 차량의 내부를 정밀 판독 및 감시할 수 있도록 구성하는 실내용 돔 하우징이 장착된 네트워크 카메라 및상기 지하철 역사 내 플랫폼을 감시할 수 있도록 구성하는 플랫폼 감시카메라와, 상기 네트워크 카메라에 의해 촬영된 영상을 전자유도, 전파장애의 통신 노이즈의 영향을 받지 않고 링 구조로 전송의 끊김이 없는 광케이블을 이용한 광 링 네트워크 스위치와, 상기 광 링 네트워크 스위치를 통해 전송받은 영상을 상기 지하철의 기관실에서 디스플레이하도록 구성하는 산업용 디브이알(Digital video recorder, DVR)과, 상기 산업용 디브이알(Digital video recorder, DVR)에 디스플레이되는 영상정보를 역사상황실에 무선 랜을 경유하여 전송하는 제1영상전송부와, 상기 지하철 역사 내 플랫폼 감시카메라에 촬영된 영상정보를 기관실에 무선 랜을 경유하여 전송하는 제2영상전송부와, 상기 제1영상전송부에서 전송하는 영상정보를 상기 역사상황실에 디스플레이하는 상황모니터를 포함하여 이루어지는 지하철 차량 영상감시 장치를 제공한다. 
       
     네트워크 카메라, 광 링 네트워크 스위치, 산업용 디브이알(Digital video recorder, DVR)

title_en: Disaster prediction system and method using major keyword analysis technology of artificial intelligence
title_ko: 인공지능에 의한 빅데이터의 주요 키워드 분석기술을 활용한 재난예측 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are a disaster prediction system capable of predicting disasters by analyzing disaster keywords in SNS messages shared between people through the Internet instead of using data detected from various detection devices and a method thereof. To this end, the disaster prediction system comprises: a message screening module analyzing message data published on social media through an Internet network to select the message data containing disaster keywords as disaster message data; a keyword extraction module extracting the disaster keywords on the basis of the disaster message data; a keyword classification module selecting a disaster type matched with the disaster keyword and classifying and storing the disaster keyword by disaster type; a risk estimation module estimating disaster risk by evaluating a value of disaster keywords collected by disaster type for a predetermined time; and a disaster prediction response module comparing and analyzing the disaster risk with a threshold value specified for each type of disaster to propagate disaster prediction information through the Internet network when the disaster risk exceeds the threshold. Accordingly, big data can be built by collecting messages containing disaster keywords from SNS messages published through an Internet network, and disasters such as building collapse can be detected in real-time and be predicted by analyzing the big data.
abstract_ko: 각종 탐지장치로부터 감지된 데이터를 활용하는 대신 인터넷을 통해 사람들 사이에 공유되는 SNS 메시지의 재난 키워드를 분석하여 재난을 예측할 수 있는 재난예측 시스템 및 방법이 개시된다.  이를 위하여 인터넷망을 통해 소셜 미디어에서 공개된 메시지 데이터를 분석하여 재난 키워드가 포함된 메시지 데이터를 재난메시지 데이터로 선택하는 메시지 선별모듈과, 상기 재난메시지 데이터를 기반으로 재난 키워드를 추출하는 키워드 추출모듈과, 상기 재난 키워드에 매칭된 재난 유형을 선정하고, 상기 재난 키워드를 재난 유형별로 분류하여 저장하는 키워드 분류모듈과, 미리 지정된 시간동안 재난 유형별로 수집된 재난 키워드의 가치 평가를 통해 재난 위험도를 산정하는 위험도 산정모듈, 및 상기 재난 위험도를 재난 유형별로 미리 지정된 임계값과 비교 분석하여 재난 위험도가 임계값을 초과하면 재난예측정보를 인터넷망을 통해 전파하는 재난예측 대응모듈을 포함하는 인공지능에 의한 빅데이터의 주요키워드 분석기술을 활용한 재난예측 방법을 제공한다.  본 발명에 의하면, 인터넷망을 통해 공개된 SNS 메시지 중 재난 키워드가 포함된 메시지를 수집하여 빅데이터를 구축하고, 이 빅데이터의 분석을 통해 건축물 붕괴 등의 재난을 실시간으로 감지할 수 있을 뿐만 아니라 미리 예측할 수도 있다.
assignees: CATHOLIC UNIV KOREA IND ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION

title_en: Water-wind-solar short-term risk scheduling method considering remaining water resource utilization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water-wind-solar short-term risk scheduling method considering the utilization of remaining water resources, which is characterized in that a water-wind-solar complementary system day-ahead risk scheduling model considering the comprehensive utilization of remaining water resources is constructed by considering the power discarding and load losing risks of the water-wind-solar complementary system and the peak regulation targets of a power grid under the condition of uncertainty of wind and photoelectric output through a response function of the current state of a constructed cascade reservoir and the comprehensive utilization targets of remaining water resources, and the day-ahead power generation scheduling model of the complementary system is constructed by considering the stability requirements of the system output.

title_en: Power network key ring detection method based on simulated annealing algorithm
abstract_en: The invention provides a detection method of a power network key ring based on a simulated annealing algorithm, which comprises the following steps of 1, constructing a power network topology model; step 2, constructing a solution space, step 3, constructing an initial solution set, and step 4, detecting a key ring. The invention adopts a simulated annealing algorithm comprising a neighborhood search strategy to detect the key ring of the power network, can successfully detect the key ring of the power network, effectively improves the detection efficiency, is applicable to a large-scale network, expands the application range of the network, simulates the fault process of a real power network by adopting a cascade failure process, can detect the fragile structure of the power network, and provides effective support for the safety protection of the power network.

title_en: Disaster forecasting and warning system with cascade vhf wireless communication network
title_ko: 다단중계 브이에이치에프 통신기능이 내장된 재난예경보 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A disaster prediction/alerting system including a multistep relay VHF communication function is provided to alarm a high-capacity disaster message in which a control staff appointed by connecting to a local alert system, and to connect an alert station apparatus to a communication network but to use a frame structure of a packet in the original form. CONSTITUTION: A disaster prediction/alerting system capable of including a multistep relay VHF communication function is comprised of the followings: a plurality of local alert systems(1) which include a control station apparatus which communicates with a plurality of local devices, including an alert station apparatus, through a multistep relay VHF communication network, receives a disaster message which corresponds to a patch signal by requesting to a central control server(3) when receiving the patch signal from the central control server, and alarming from the alert station apparatus within a local alert system; a central control server in which a user terminal(2) is connected, designates the local alert system, inputs the disaster message, stores and endows a serial number, transmit the patch signal according to the disaster message, and transmits the message according to a request of the disaster message which corresponds to the patch signal; a first communications network(4) which is built between the central control server and the control station apparatus for the transmission of patch signal, and comprises a CDMA communication network, a ORBCOMM communication network, a TRS communication network, a VHF communication network, and an internet network; and a second communication network(5) which is built between the central control server and the control station apparatus for the request and transmission of the disaster message, and comprises the internet communication network. [Reference numerals] (4) First communications network; (5) Second communication network
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 다단중계 VHF 통신기능이 내장된 재난예경보 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는, 경보국 장치를 포함한 각각의 지국장치를 통제국 장치와 다단중계로 통신하게 구성한 로컬 경보시스템에게 사용자가 지정한 대용량 재해재난 메시지를 경제적인 통신방식으로 전달하여 경보를 발령하게 함은 물론이고 로컬 경보시스템 내에서의 다단중계도 1단 중계망에서 사용하던 패킷의 프레임을 그대로 사용하여 2단 또는 3단 중계망을 구축할 수 있어 통신망 구성 범위의 확장 및 통신품질의 향상이 가능한 다단중계 VHF 통신기능이 내장된 재난예경보 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Power grid system construction optimization method based on cascading failure simulation
abstract_en: The invention provides a power grid system construction optimization method based on cascade failure simulation, which comprises the steps of firstly designing an initial network model of a power grid system to be constructed, then carrying out cascade failure simulation on the network model containing a failure link, wherein the cascade failure simulation comprises the redistribution of current and the update of a link state to obtain a network model after cascade failure, and finally judging whether the initial network model meets the design requirements or not according to the network model after cascade failure; the method considers the time delay characteristic of the power grid in the cascade failure and the automatic recovery function of the power grid in the cascade failure process in reality, realizes the implementation from the current perspective through the network model of the cascade failure while researching and designing, and increases the practical significance. The method and the device are applied to the construction process of the real power grid, can also be used for detecting the safety of the existing power grid, and can be used for checking whether the designed power grid meets the construction requirement or not when the real power grid is constructed.

title_en: Power grid cascading failure risk assessment method and system based on snow ablation algorithm
abstract_en: The power grid cascading failure risk assessment method based on the snow ablation algorithm comprises the following steps: and respectively calculating subjective weight and objective weight of each risk index, wherein the risk index comprises: a unit power angle difference severity index, a weighted power flow entropy index and a load loss severity index; based on subjective weight and objective weight of each risk index, calculating comprehensive weight of each index by adopting a snow ablation algorithm; calculating the risk value of each line in the power grid according to the comprehensive weight of each risk index; and evaluating the risk of the grid cascading failure according to the risk value of each line. The design reduces index redundancy while guaranteeing the accuracy of the evaluation result.
assignees: CENTRAL CHINA BRANCH STATE GRID CORP CHINA;UNIV WUHAN

title_en: Distributed robust recovery method and terminal for electric-gas comprehensive energy system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed robust recovery method and a terminal for an electric-gas comprehensive energy system, wherein a built upper-layer electric system recovery model accounts for pumped storage and wind power uncertainty, the upper-layer electric system recovery model is reconstructed based on the distributed robust model to obtain a reconstructed upper-layer electric system recovery model, a built lower-layer natural gas system recovery model accounts for gas storage and pipe storage, the reconstructed upper-layer electric system recovery model and lower-layer natural gas system recovery model are solved by using an analysis target cascade method to obtain an optimal recovery decision of an electric system, the influence of a natural gas network on a high-capacity electric system recovery process is considered, the concurrent influence of a pumped storage hydropower station and a wind power generation field is considered, the excessively conservative recovery decision is avoided, the balance point of the proposed double-layer optimization problem can be accurately calculated, the privacy of an electric network and a natural gas system is ensured, and the recovery effectiveness and reliability after the system failure are improved.
assignees: SHANXI ENERGY INTERNET RES INSTITUTE;UNIV SHANDONG

title_en: Smart power grid relay protection reliability assessment and promotion control method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for evaluating and improving the reliability of a smart power grid relay protection, and relates to the technical field of smart power grid relay protection. The fault mode, collaborative anomalies, and reliability levels are identified at the device level, interval level, and station level, respectively, using a multi-stage fault diagnosis model, and the fault propagation paths and effects are predicted based on a causal inference network. And finally, constructing a layered cooperative control strategy, and realizing coordination optimization of protection fixed values through multi-objective optimization, distributed game optimization and layered rolling optimization, thereby improving the reliability of the relay protection device, reducing the fault propagation probability and ensuring the safe and stable operation of the power grid.
assignees: MINYUE NETWORK POWER OPERATION CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;EHV BRANCH STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Power grid equipment operation and maintenance data safety management system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses an operation and maintenance data safety management system of power grid equipment based on artificial intelligence, which relates to the technical field of operation and maintenance safety management of power system equipment, and comprises the following steps of S1, constructing a data element mapping model with credibility marks, S2, carrying out cross dimension logic consistency check according to credibility data, S3, constructing a multi-stage evolution track graph according to consistency check data, S4, screening out conflict evolution paths based on a state graph model, S5, carrying out asynchronous disturbance propagation modeling according to a purification path graph, S6, carrying out nested structure encryption processing based on a disturbance propagation model, S7, carrying out data output and system feedback adjustment according to an encryption data structure, and solving the problem that the equipment state modeling in the prior art lacks a dynamic evolution mechanism and lacks the structural expression capability of a path analysis means by arranging a state evolution vector field modeling module and a multi-dimensional path jump graph construction module.
assignees: BEIJING BEE GONGWU TECH CO LTD

title_en: Open-air dyeing tracing and soil nutrient migration analysis method integrating spectrum analysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of in-situ monitoring, in particular to a field dyeing tracing and soil nutrient migration analysis method integrating spectrum analysis, which effectively focuses on a key concentration evolution channel by adopting a statistical analysis and threshold screening strategy of total gradient change of the channel, avoids interference of a redundant path on the whole analysis precision, adopts a graph convolution neural network to topologically propagate and embed an adjacency relation constructed by concentration difference nodes to represent, and adopts a combination judgment mode of concentration change rate, an included angle cosine value and a distance, the graph structure is ensured to have physical continuity when the nutrient migration space evolution characteristics are expressed, similarity measurement and high-frequency numbering clustering treatment between node characteristic vectors are realized, extraction and structural expression of a concentration migration hot spot area are realized, a frequency chart generated by combining time and depth index statistics is effectively reduced, the dynamic evolution trend of a local high risk area in soil is effectively reduced, and the analysis precision and the expression level of complex nutrient migration behaviors are improved.

title_en: Intelligent fault diagnosis method and system for electrical equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fault diagnosis of electrical equipment, in particular to an intelligent fault diagnosis method and system of electrical equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps of uniformly fusing equipment state information, electrical distance weighted connection and phase dynamic coupling relation by constructing a multidimensional tensor model, and extracting an abnormal propagation mode by utilizing high-order singular value decomposition; the method comprises the steps of designing a space-time-frequency coupling interference stripping mechanism, combining structure-guided disturbance deconstruction, multi-scale dictionary learning and sparse low-rank decomposition to accurately separate transmissibility and non-transmissibility interference, reconstructing a fault track based on a generation countermeasure mechanism, coupling a graph structure dynamic encoder, a topology consistency discriminator and a time controllable generator to restore a real propagation path, and finally integrating tensor semantic compression, a three-view graph neural network and fault label back projection interpretation through a multi-source semantic fusion mechanism. The invention realizes the fault diagnosis and tracing of the space-time and structure, and improves the accuracy and the interpretability.
assignees: SHANDONG LUSHANG ARCH DESIGN CO LTD

title_en: Power grid topology toughness enhancement method based on pre-disaster prediction of graph neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a grid topology toughness enhancement method based on pre-disaster prediction of a graph neural network, which comprises the steps of constructing a grid graph structure taking grid equipment as nodes, predicting node damage probability through the graph attention network, defining a high-risk node set, constructing a mixed integer programming model according to the high-risk nodes and propagation paths thereof, solving to generate an optimal grid structure adjustment strategy before disaster, generating a resource scheduling scheme by utilizing a deep reinforcement learning algorithm in combination with the strategy, calculating a grid toughness core index after simulation operation, optimizing the structure adjustment strategy if the index is lower than a preset threshold value, and uploading the optimized strategy and scheduling scheme to a scheduling platform to finish pre-disaster active defense deployment. The invention realizes the cooperative linkage of pre-disaster risk prediction and topology reconstruction and resource deployment, automatically generates a differential pre-disaster defense scheme, converts post-emergency repair into pre-disaster prevention and distribution, and remarkably improves the pre-disaster prevention and control response efficiency.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENT RES INST STATE GRID JIANGXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Fault recovery method, device and program product based on multiple data centers
abstract_en: The application discloses a fault recovery method, a device and a program product based on a plurality of data centers, which relate to the field of big data, and the method comprises the steps of collecting the running states of the data centers and a plurality of disaster recovery data centers through a monitoring tool; the method comprises the steps of synchronizing incremental data in a data center to a plurality of disaster recovery data centers based on a log synchronization mechanism, detecting faults of the data center according to hardware states, network states and storage equipment states to obtain detection results, and executing a fault recovery strategy according to the data center and the disaster recovery data centers after synchronizing the incremental data under the condition that the detection results indicate that the data center has faults. The application solves the problems of long service interruption time caused by long time consumption in the traditional manual switching process to the disaster recovery center when the data center fails in the environment of the multiple data centers in the related technology.
assignees: INDUSTRIAL & COMMERCIAL BANK OF CHINA CO LTD

title_en: Auxiliary decision-making method, system, equipment and storage medium for power distribution network fault maintenance
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electric power automation and discloses a power distribution network fault overhaul auxiliary decision-making method, a system, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining real-time operation data of electric power equipment to be overhauled in a power distribution network, and carrying out data preprocessing and state identification on the real-time operation data to obtain an equipment state; the method comprises the steps of inputting equipment states into a knowledge graph to perform fault reasoning to obtain a plurality of initial fault paths, calculating path confidence of the initial fault paths according to a fault propagation causal chain, extracting reliable fault paths from the initial fault paths according to the path confidence, obtaining fault diagnosis results according to the reliable fault paths, and extracting corresponding recommended treatment measures according to the fault diagnosis results. By introducing an interpretable reasoning path mechanism, the invention can clearly display the logical reasoning process between the fault phenomenon and the processing suggestion, obviously enhance the transparency and the reliability of the decision result and improve the operation safety and the reliability of the power distribution network.
assignees: QIANTANG BRANCH OF ZHEJIANG DAYOU IND CO LTD

title_en: A method of for excavating fragile node and route in electric power networks
abstract_en: A method of for excavating fragile node and route in electric power networks, it is characterized in that, comprehensively consider the topological property and electrical characteristic of electric power networks, the fragile node and route of power grid are excavated, comprising the following steps: establish power network model, establish network key degree index, calculate topological property criticality index and electrical characteristic criticality index, calculate comprehensive criticality index, the high fragile unit of output criticality, the high as fragile unit of the weakness numerical value.It is significant to the emergency prevention and control of cascading failure to excavate fragile unit in electric power networks so that the transmission process of electric power networks energy is quantified for the method for the present invention efficiency with higher, simple and convenient easy realization.

title_en: Combined decentralized coordination optimization method for trans-regional power grid unit containing new energy power generation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a combined, dispersed and coordinated optimization strategy of a trans-regional power grid unit containing new energy power generation, which is based on a target cascade technology, boundary node voltage phase angle values influencing the power of interconnection lines between interconnected power grids are used as coordination variables between regions to avoid the problem of circulation between the regions, an upper layer coordinator is formed for the coordinated optimization of the boundary node voltage phase angle of each region, a lower layer is optimized for the parallel solution of the SCUC problem of each region, the solution is alternately iterated through the upper and lower layer coordinated optimization problems, then the convergence is judged, and if all the regions are converged at any time, the iteration is finished to obtain the optimal solution; therefore, coordinated optimization of the on-off plan and the standby plan of the unit in the region and the transmission power of the connecting line is realized. The strategy provided by the invention can reasonably control and economically schedule the power grid resources, meet the actual requirements of network safety and line flow, realize source-network-load coordination and resource sharing among regions, and effectively improve the economical efficiency and reliability of power grid operation.

title_en: Multimode oscillation on-line monitoring and early warning system based on edge calculation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-modal oscillation online monitoring and early warning system based on edge calculation, which comprises an acquisition layer, an edge node layer and a central layer, wherein the acquisition layer comprises an AD acquisition conversion module and a multi-modal synchronous phasor calculation module; the edge node layer extracts modal information and synchronous phasor data obtained by the acquisition layer, and extracts the characteristics of each modal oscillation by analyzing the multi-modal synchronous phasor data; the center layer analyzes the oscillation source and the propagation path by combining the power network topological structure according to the analysis result of the edge node layer, so that multi-mode oscillation early warning is realized. The system of the invention realizes a new electric power automatic dispatching system architecture, and breaks through the frame that all the original collected data are sent to the dispatching center and are managed and analyzed by the dispatching center system in a unified way. The method realizes the in-situ and real-time basic analysis, reduces the calculation load of a dispatching center, avoids the data problem caused by the transmission problem, and further improves the accuracy and the real-time performance of the analysis.

title_en: Smart power grid load prediction system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power load prediction, in particular to a smart grid load prediction system and a smart grid load prediction method. According to the method, the load change rate is extracted, the load increment and the load flow proportion are calculated, the load dynamic coupling relation is described, the voltage phase angle deviation is calculated by combining the power grid topology, the connectivity of a load prediction area is enhanced, the response capacity of a model to sudden fluctuation is improved based on the forward load propagation delay adjustment parameter, the load slope is analyzed by combining weather data, the temperature and humidity sensitive interval is set, the extreme weather adaptability is enhanced, the input parameter is optimized by utilizing the load coupling correction value, the data distortion is reduced, the long-term prediction stability is improved, the load dynamic adjustment, the weather influence modeling and the input optimization precision are improved, and the accurate support is provided for power grid dispatching.

title_en: Underwater target positioning method and system based on side-scan sonar data
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides an underwater target positioning method and system based on side-scan sonar data, and belongs to the technical field of underwater detection and positioning. The method comprises the steps of reading a side-scan sonar data file in a target format, extracting sonar image data, converting the sonar image data into a general image format, inputting the general image format into a pre-trained convolutional neural network model, identifying an underwater target, outputting relative coordinates of the image, fusing attitude and position data of sonar equipment and a ship, obtaining sonar real-time geodetic coordinates through Kalman filtering, and mapping the relative coordinates into longitude and latitude coordinates by using a side-scan sonar wave beam propagation geometric model in combination with water depth, inclined distance and wave beam angle. The invention improves the accuracy, reliability and real-time performance of underwater target positioning through multi-source data fusion and geometric modeling, and is suitable for the scenes of ocean engineering detection, underwater search and rescue and the like.

title_en: Water-light-storage complementary and direct-current outgoing two-stage random optimization scheduling method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of optimal scheduling of power systems, in particular to a water-light-storage complementary and direct-current outgoing two-stage random optimal scheduling method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of establishing a water-light-storage complementary and direct-current outgoing system model comprising a thermal power unit, a photovoltaic unit, step hydropower, a pumped storage unit, a static reactive compensator and direct-current outgoing; the method comprises the steps of constructing a two-stage random optimization scheduling model by taking operation cost minimization as an objective function and taking node balance constraint, branch flow constraint, thermal power unit constraint, photovoltaic output constraint, pumped storage power station constraint, cascade hydropower constraint, static reactive compensator constraint and tributary operation constraint as constraint conditions, generating a typical scene by taking photovoltaic uncertainty into consideration of a condition generation countermeasure network CGAN, reducing the generated scene through a Euclidean hierarchical clustering method EAHCM, solving the two-stage random optimization scheduling model to obtain an optimization scheduling result, and achieving the aim of economic scheduling.

title_en: Wave matrix-based cascading super-surface electromagnetic transmission modeling and analysis method and cascading super-surface
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascading super-surface electromagnetic transmission modeling and analyzing method based on a wave matrix and a cascading super-surface, belonging to the technical field of high-frequency communication and artificial electromagnetic super-surface, wherein the method takes the wave matrix theory as a core, a cascading structure comprises a medium baffle plate and n thin sheet admittance layers, the total electric field is the sum of the forward and reverse propagation fields, a magnetic field expression is obtained by combining a 90-degree rotation matrix, a four-port network is equivalent, a wave matrix and a scattering and transmission matrix are associated, a total wave matrix is obtained by combining each layer of wave matrix, an isolation medium is introduced for correction, and parameters are solved to complete modeling. The cascading super-surface electromagnetic transmission modeling and analyzing method based on the wave matrix and the cascading super-surface can form a cross-building surface signal enhancement system frame, improve the transmission efficiency of electromagnetic waves penetrating through the glass curtain wall, reduce the deployment maintenance cost, further endow the super-surface with mechanical adaptability, enhance the compatibility with the glass curtain wall and support large-scale deployment of complex scenes.

title_en: The apparatus of muti data between marine object and ocean floor object with network zone
title_ko: 해상가시광네트워크망을 통한 수중객체와 해상객체 간의 멀티데이터 송수신장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a device for transceiving multi-data between an underwater object and a marine object through a marine visible light network. The device comprises: a control server (100) transmitting a multi-data signal toward an LED visible light module for a lighthouse; an LED visible light module (200) for a lighthouse transmitting a multi-data signal toward an LED visible light module for a marine ship and an LED visible light module for a buoy and receiving a response data signal about the transmission to transfer the response data signal to the control server; the LED visible light module (300) for a buoy located on one side of a buoy; and the LED visible light module (400) for a ship located on one side of a ship. Therefore, the device for transceiving multi-data performs near-field communication of a point-to-point (PTP) type by using LEDs under water.
