abstract_ko: 본 발명에서는 종래 등대 및 부표가 단지, 불빛을 통한 항로표지의 역할만 할 뿐, 등대를 기준으로 이웃하는 부표, 선박, 그리고 수중객체(수중시설물, 침몰된 선박) 사이의 네트워크 연결이 어려워, 근해에 해상사고 발생시 재난구조 및 방재조치를 신속하게 처리할 수 없는 문제점과, 세월호와 같은 선박사고시, 침몰된 선박까지 접근한 수중다이버의 위치를 해상의 작업 통제실에서 정확히 파악할 수가 없고, 또 다른 수중사고 발생시 해당 사고에 대한 빠른 인지와 긴급한 구조 인원의 투입에 큰 어려움을 개선하고자, 제어서버(100), 등대용 LED 가시광모듈(200), 부표용 LED 가시광모듈(300), 선박용 LED 가시광모듈(400)로 구성됨으로서, 등대용 LED 가시광모듈을 기준으로 이웃하는 또 다른 부표용 LED 가시광모듈 또는 선박용 LED 가시광모듈과 해상가시광네트워크망을 형성시킬 수 있어, 원격지의 제어서버에서 보내는 멀티데이터신호를 가시광통신을 통해 해상객체와 수중객체로 실시간으로 전송시킬 수 있고, 이로 인해 해상사고 발생시 재난구조 및 방재조치를 신속하게 처리할 수 있으며, 수중객체의 위치와 수중상태를 해상의 작업 통제실에서 1:1 모니터링하면서 명령신호를 양방향데이터를 보낼 수 있고, 해상 및 수중에서 기본 조명과 데이터 통신을 동시에 수용시킬 수 있으며, 해상 및 수중에서 채널 전송 시 인접 주파수 대역 간섭이 기존 육상 환경에서 널리 사용되는 전파 통신 비교하여 상대적으로 적고, 수중에서 LED를 이용하여 빛을 집중시켜 Point-to-Point(PTP)방식의 근거리 통신을 할 수 있는 해상가시광네트워크망을 통한 수중객체와 해상객체 간의 멀티데이터 송수신장치 및 방법을 제공하는데 그 목적이 있다.

title_en: Substation Remote Control System of Transformer Fault Based on Block Chain
title_ko: 변전소 변압기 사고 시 블록체인 기반의 변전소 원격 제어 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a blockchain-based remote substation control system for managing a fault of a transformer. According to the present invention, a remote substation management server matches substation-related basic data for each substation with each substation and each distribution line and each transformer of the substation to distribute, register, and store the matched data in a related system and a worker's smart phone; and perform recovery of an accident according to a standard protocol while transmitting and sharing, with the related system and the worker's smartphone, main facility status information, operation information, and monitoring information generated from a relay operation to correcting and recovering the accident in the event of the accident with respect to an accident in a transformer of the substation. Accordingly, when an accident occurs in a transformer of a substation, the accident is processed with respect to a system rather than a person, so that the accident can be systematically managed, thereby preventing safety and power spillage accidents caused by erroneous operation of field facilities.
abstract_ko: 본 발명 변압기 사고 시 블록체인 기반의 변전소 원격 제어 시스템은 변전소 원격 관리 서버가 변전소 관련 기초 데이터를 변전소별, 변전소의 배전 선로별, 변압기 별로 매칭하여 관련 시스템과 근무자 스마트 폰에 분산 등록 저장하고 변전소에서 변압기 사고를 중심으로 하여 사고 시의 계전기 동작부터 사고를 수습하고 복구하기 까지의 생성되는 주요 설비 상태 정보, 조작 정보, 감시 데이터 정보들을 상호 관련 시스템과 근무자의 스마트 폰을 통하여 전송 공유하면서 기준 절차대로 사고 복구하도록 하는 것으로  변전소 변압기 사고 시 사고 수습을 사람 중심이 아닌 시스템 중심으로 처리하도록 하여 사고를 시스템적으로 수습하도록 함으로써 특히 현장 설비의 오조작으로 인한 안전 사고 및 전원 파급 사고를 방지하도록 하는 것이다.

title_en: Combination forecast modeling method of wind farm power by using gray correlation analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a combination forecast modeling method of wind farm power by using gray correlation analysis, belonging to the technical field of wind power generation modeling. In particular, the invention is related to a weighted combination forecast method of wind power based on a least square support vector machine and an error back propagation neural network. The forecast method comprises that forecasted values of wind speed and wind direction are acquired in advance from meteorological departments while real-time output power is acquired from a wind farm data acquiring system; that the forecasted values of wind speed and wind direction and the real-time output power are inputted into a data processing module for data analyzing extraction and data normalization, and then normalized data is loaded to a database server; processed data in the database server is extracted by a combination forecast algorithm server to carry out model training and power forecast, and the wind farm sends running data to the data processing module in real time to realize rolling forecasting. The method of the invention achieves the goal of combination forecast of wind farm output in a short time. The method not only maximally utilizes advantages of two algorithms but also increases forecast efficiency by saving computing resources and shortening computing time.

title_en: A kind of human skeleton extracting method relied on based on joint
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of human skeleton extracting methods relied on based on joint, comprising the following steps: S1, image data collection is pre-processed and expanded, and is divided into training set and test set；The human skeleton that S2, building joint rely on extracts network；S3, the human skeleton that training set input joint relies on is extracted into network, the human skeleton for obtaining joint dependence extracts the prediction category in network model and joint；S4, the prediction category according to joint extract network model to the human skeleton that joint relies on using back-propagation algorithm and optimize, and the human skeleton for obtaining optimal joint dependence extracts network model；S5, the human skeleton that test set input optimal joint relies on is extracted into network model, obtains the test category in joint；S6, the test category according to joint, extract human skeleton；The present invention solves the problems, such as that optimization of the existing technology is difficult, process is complicated, the relationship modeling effect between joint is poor, accuracy is low and practicability is low.

title_en: Day-ahead optimal scheduling method and system for electric heating load of commercial building
abstract_en: The invention provides a day-ahead optimal scheduling method and system for commercial building electric heating loads, and relates to the technical field of electric power optimal scheduling. The electric heating day-ahead load optimization scheduling method for the commercial building provided by the invention coordinates all devices in the system at the same time, realizes the cascade utilization of energy, improves the utilization efficiency of the energy, reduces the energy utilization cost of the commercial building, promotes the balance of supply and demand of electric power and ensures the safety of an energy system. The invention uses the deep neural network to predict the electricity, heat load and photovoltaic output power of the commercial building, overcomes the uncertainty of two sides of energy supply and demand, and ensures that the obtained optimized dispatching scheme is more accurate and effective.
assignees: XIAN TUJI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Active disturbance rejection control system for static optimization of central air-conditioning refrigeration station
abstract_en: The invention discloses an active disturbance rejection control system for static optimization of a central air-conditioning refrigeration station, wherein an air-conditioning load prediction unit is used for predicting load through a BP (back propagation) neural network; the central air-conditioning refrigeration station model calculation unit is used for executing one of a single model modeling mode and a multi-model fusion modeling mode; the system working point optimization unit is used for calculating the optimal working point of the system by using an optimization algorithm; and the central control refrigeration station control unit is used for tracking control by adopting an active disturbance rejection controller. The invention also discloses an active disturbance rejection control method for the static optimization of the central air-conditioning refrigeration station. The system and the method determine the optimal working point of the system closest to the actual value by accurately establishing a static model and predicting the cold load, and adopt the active disturbance rejection controller to carry out tracking control on the optimal working point of the system, thereby realizing the optimization and energy conservation of the central air-conditioning refrigeration station.

title_en: Intelligent networking method based on automatic fire alarm system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent networking method based on a fire-fighting fire automatic alarm system, which comprises a plurality of controllers which are cascaded in a tree-shaped topological structure and are in communication connection, wherein a controller at a root node is taken as a first node controller for a main fire-fighting control room, and the other sub-nodes are taken as branch node controllers for a secondary fire-fighting control room; each controller is matched with a corresponding networking communication ID number, and the network logic node of each controller is set by the networking communication ID number of the controller and the networking communication ID number of a superior node controller networked with the controller; the message identifier of the networking communication ID number of the head node controller is the smallest among all the controllers, and the message identifier of the networking communication ID number of the branch node controller is increased in order of the hierarchy based on the message identifier of the communication ID number of the head node controller. The invention realizes the aims of centralized management, unified coordination and hierarchical control.
assignees: SHENZHEN FANHAI SANJIANG ELECTRONICS CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for identifying key nodes of cascading failures of power system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power systems, in particular to a method and a system for identifying key nodes of cascading failures of a power system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring historical fault data in the power system, and quantizing the historical fault data to obtain initial fault data and final fault scale data; extracting a highly nonlinear mapping relation from initial fault data to final fault scale; quantifying cascading failure risks of all nodes of the power system under different failure types based on a highly nonlinear mapping relation from initial failure data to final failure scale; and identifying key nodes by using the quantitative indexes according to cascading failure risks of all nodes under different failure types. A highly nonlinear mapping relation between initial faults and final fault scales in historical faults is extracted through the LM optimized BP neural network, the final fault scales are predicted according to the initial faults on the basis of the mapping relation, and a method for identifying key nodes in cascading faults is considered.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECHNICAL RES INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID SHANDONG POWER COMPANY;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Demand side response resource calling method based on grey correlation point ideal point method
abstract_en: A demand side response resource invocation aid decision based on a grey correlation ideal point method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the following steps: and constructing a value index weighting model for the demand side resources by using an objective and subjective combination weighting method, and constructing a value evaluation index system. Step two: model evaluation is carried out based on a grey correlation ideal point method, and on the basis of the original evaluation model, grey correlation analysis is combined with TOPSIS, so that the effectiveness of the evaluation result is improved. Step three: and performing value grade correction on the evaluation result through a variable weight method to form an evaluation result, and forming a calling sequence by adopting a cascade utilization strategy when the power grid needs to mobilize resources on the demand side. Based on the characteristic that the resource types of the power demand side are various, the invention provides a demand side response resource calling auxiliary decision method based on a grey correlation point ideal point method, aiming at the problem that the conventional demand side resource scheduling lacks theoretical basis.
assignees: INNER MONGOLIA EASTERN POWER TRANSACTION CENTER LTD COMPANY;UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Toughness calculation method for electric power information physical system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a toughness calculation method of a power information physical system, which is characterized by comprising the following steps: constructing an initial network architecture of the electric power information physical system; constructing a node multi-state model and a branch state model of an information system and a power system, and generating a fault element set and an effective network of a power information physical system in an initial state; constructing a fault propagation dynamic model in an information system; constructing a node power balance model of fault propagation in the power system; constructing a virus infection dynamic model of fault propagation between an information system and a power system; and (4) iteratively solving to obtain the stable state of the fault propagated in the electric power information physical system, and calculating the toughness index of the electric power information physical system. The method provided by the invention comprehensively analyzes the operation structure difference between the power system and the information system, simulates the propagation mechanism of the fault in the two systems and between the two systems, and overcomes the problems of singleness and adaptability of toughness research of the traditional power information physical system.
assignees: NANJING POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Electricity-gas cooperative recovery method considering information interaction of power grid and natural gas grid
abstract_en: The invention provides an electricity-gas cooperative recovery method considering information interaction of a power grid and a natural gas grid. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a power grid recovery model and a natural gas grid recovery model under a distributed optimization solution framework; and solving the power grid recovery model and the natural gas grid recovery model under the distributed optimization solving framework by an electric-gas cooperative recovery algorithm based on an objective cascade analysis ATC (objective-transfer-model-transfer) method to obtain a power grid recovery strategy and a natural gas grid recovery strategy. The method provided by the invention considers the limited information interaction of the power grid and the natural gas grid, establishes a power grid recovery model and a natural gas grid recovery model under a distributed solving framework, and designs and solves a distributed algorithm of an electric-gas cooperative recovery problem to generate an optimal power grid and natural gas grid cooperative recovery scheme.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV BEIJING JIAOTONG

title_en: Reinforced learning-based power distribution network reconstruction optimization method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network reconstruction optimization method based on reinforcement learning, wherein the training stage of the model provided by the invention adopts forward propagation of a deep mental network to predict Q value, a greedy algorithm is used for selecting actions, when the actions pass through a training environment, a deep reinforcement learning agent obtains rewards (or punishments) according to the performances of the actions, a target Q value is obtained according to reward calculation, a mean square error is adopted as a loss function, errors are propagated reversely to update DNN weight, and finally a trained DRL agent is used for finding out an optimal power distribution network structure. The model based on Q learning is used for improving the reliability of a power distribution network system. DNR can optimize the existing resources through the model provided by the invention, and reconstruct the configuration of the power distribution network through changing the states of the sectionalizing and interconnecting switches, so as to ensure the power supply reliability of the power distribution network.

title_en: Electrical appliance demand response potential prediction method and device based on C-LSTM
abstract_en: A C-LSTM-based electrical appliance demand response potential prediction method and device are provided, wherein historical load data of an electrical appliance are collected as a data set; constructing a C-LSTM network model for improving the long and short memory network, and inputting a data set into the C-LSTM network model for training to obtain a training model; wherein the C-LSTM network model is based on the improvement of the LSTM network model, the neuron structure of the LSTM network model is improved to obtain the C-LSTM network model, and C is the same as that of the neuron structure of the LSTM network model  t‑1  Introduction of forgetting door F  t  Input gate I  t  Output gate Q  t  The method comprises the steps of carrying out a first treatment on the surface of the Carrying out demand prediction of the electric appliance by adopting a training model to obtain demand response potential of the electric appliance, namely obtaining electric appliance load prediction; the C-LSTM network model can better capture the ultra-long-term trend of the electric quantity time sequence through forward calculation and backward propagation along time, so that the prediction model has higher prediction precision.
assignees: QINGDAO POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO;MARKETING SERVICE CENTER OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY METERING CENTER;BEIJING ZHIZHONG ENERGY TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD;SHANDONG LURUAN DIGITAL TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Wind-solar-water network hybrid optimization game scheduling method based on green evidence mechanism
abstract_en: A wind-light-water network hybrid optimization game scheduling method based on a green certificate mechanism comprises the following steps: the wind-light power station and the cascade hydropower station form a wind-light hydration alliance, a green certificate corresponding to the internet surfing power is obtained when the wind-light power station surfing the internet, the green certificate is sold into a green certificate market, and the regional power grid purchases the green certificate from the green certificate market; constructing a multi-objective multi-stage short-term optimization scheduling model of the wind-light water network; and respectively solving a multi-objective multi-stage short-term optimization scheduling model of the constructed wind, light and water network by adopting a Kriging meta-model solving algorithm, an ADMM algorithm and a GA algorithm. The method considers the wind-light-water uncertainty risk cost to reduce the uncertainty execution risk of the scheduling scheme; wind-solar water-combined alliance and regional power grid bilateral transaction based on master-slave game optimization model, and alliance benefit and regional power grid benefit are maximized; the water electricity regulation compensation electricity price is optimized through Nash bargaining, so that the benefits of multiple members are effectively improved compared with those before cooperation, and the step water electricity is stimulated to participate in wind and light absorption while the stability of the alliance is ensured.
assignees: UNIV CHINA THREE GORGES CTGU;CHINA YANGTZE POWER CO LTD

title_en: Natural gas station working state probability value determining method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, equipment and a medium for determining the probability value of the working state of a natural gas station, which relate to the technical field of computers and comprise the following steps: acquiring equipment fault statistical information in a natural gas station so as to determine a control equation in a Markov process based on the equipment fault statistical information; constructing a target neural network model based on the control equation, performing preset training on the target neural network model, and performing preset gradient calibration operation to obtain a trained neural network model; the preset training comprises feedforward propagation and back propagation; and inputting the current equipment information of the current natural gas station into the trained neural network model to obtain a corresponding working state probability value. According to the invention, based on physical information neural network training, the physical fusion neural network is introduced to improve the calculation efficiency, and the gradient correction is introduced to improve the stability of network training and convergence, so that the efficiency, stability and accuracy of working state probability value calculation are improved.

title_en: Primary load re-electricity optimization method and system for distribution line reverse pole under typhoon disaster
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power systems, in particular to a primary load re-electricity optimizing method and a primary load re-electricity optimizing system for a distribution line reverse pole under typhoon disasters, wherein the primary load re-electricity optimizing method comprises the steps of obtaining the cascade reverse pole fault probability of a plurality of special power supply distribution lines of a primary load user under typhoon disasters according to the single line reverse pole fault probability so as to calculate the cascade reverse pole fault load loss power of the primary load user in a typhoon influence area; and constructing a cascade reverse pole fault power restoration optimization model of the primary load user line by taking the maximized primary load user load loss recovery power supply as an optimization target, and solving by using a long-short-term memory artificial neural network and a Markov chain method to obtain the grid loss primary load power restoration optimization power when the cascade reverse pole fault occurs. According to the invention, by combining the long-term memory artificial neural network and the Markov chain method, the high-efficiency and accurate solving of the primary load re-electricity optimization problem in typhoon multi-line reverse pole disasters is realized, and necessary technical support is provided for safe and stable operation of an electric power system.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Shipping network risk and fault interaction propagation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a shipping network risk and fault interactive propagation method. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a target shipping network, and then adopting a node attack mode to the target shipping network to obtain an attacked node; acquiring a fault state node communication state and a corresponding upstream port network node fault state by using a forward fault cascading model; acquiring the probability of risk caused by a fault node by using a risk and fault interaction propagation model, and acquiring a risk state caused by the fault node, evolution of a node fault state caused by the risk node and evolution of a network node communication state; acquiring the evolution degree of the node and the network fault and the evolution of the network node communication state by using a node fault degree conversion model; and obtaining node failure rate and maximum connectivity rate by using the failure evolution degree and the connectivity state among all state nodes to obtain the risk and failure interaction propagation condition of the network. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of fully fitting the real scene of interaction between risks and faults in the shipping network and the like.

title_en: Multi-gradient mountain wireless channel modeling method combining digital elevation model and ray tracing
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-gradient mountain wireless channel modeling method combining a digital elevation model and ray tracing, and belongs to the field of wireless communication. The unmanned aerial vehicle base station is used for assisting communication, and is suitable for rapidly deploying an efficient communication network in natural disasters or emergency events. The real mountain environment with different slopes and the acquired mountain slope can be established through the digital elevation model, and the signal propagation path and the propagation characteristics of the acquired signals can be predicted through a ray tracing method. The modeling method comprises the steps of firstly establishing a real mountain scene, extracting mountain gradient, then obtaining channel model parameters, analyzing channel characteristics, and finally adjusting transmitter parameters according to channel characteristic data to realize multi-gradient mountain wireless channel modeling. The modeling method provided by the invention has the main ideas that the channel model is analyzed through accurate topographic data and channel characteristic data, and the reliability of the wireless communication system is improved through adjusting parameters. Design suggestions are provided for emergency communication and technical innovation.

title_en: BP neural network-based photovoltaic power station power prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photovoltaic power station power prediction method and a system of a BP neural network, which relate to the technical field of operation and maintenance and comprise the steps of collecting weather information and historical light power data related to the power of the photovoltaic power station and classifying the historical light power data; the method comprises the steps of constructing a BP neural network model, training the BP neural network by using an error back propagation algorithm, minimizing a loss function, optimizing and iterating a particle swarm based on the prediction error of the BP neural network by defining an fitness function, and finding out an optimal weight and bias combination. The method disclosed by the invention improves the recognition capability of the model to the power change of the photovoltaic power station under different meteorological conditions, lays a foundation for accurate prediction, improves the prediction accuracy, enables the model to be better adapted to the environment change due to the self-adaptive learning capability of the neural network, improves the prediction robustness, improves the generalization capability of the neural network model, reduces the prediction error and improves the overall performance of the power prediction of the photovoltaic power station.
assignees: HUANENG NANJING JINLING POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Modeling method and device for disaster propagation and risk evolution of power system
abstract_en: The invention provides a modeling method and device for disaster propagation and risk evolution of a power system, and relates to the technical field of power systems. The modeling method of disaster propagation and risk evolution of the power system comprises the steps of determining risk key nodes in a target area according to historical disaster damage data of the target area, wherein the risk key nodes comprise risk disturbance source nodes, equipment fault nodes and terminal loss nodes, determining edges among the risk key nodes according to risk conduction causal relations among the risk key nodes to obtain a disaster chain evolution network, and constructing a disaster deduction model according to the disaster chain evolution network. The invention can deduce the evolution process of various risk paths caused by the risks caused by equipment faults of the power system under extreme weather conditions, and provides basis for timely taking countermeasures when the extreme weather comes.
assignees: UNIV TSINGHUA;ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Climate risk prevention and control method and device based on graph theory and knowledge graph
abstract_en: The application discloses a climate risk prevention and control method and device based on graph theory and knowledge graph. The method comprises the steps of collecting weather data, traffic facility data and geographic topology data from multi-source heterogeneous data, constructing a knowledge graph by utilizing entities extracted from the data and relationships among the entities, enabling the knowledge graph to represent knowledge by using triplets and updating by using a dynamic updating mechanism, constructing a multi-time aerodynamic network based on graph theory technology, enabling the multi-time aerodynamic network to introduce time dimension and describe a dynamic propagation process of weather risks by using a nonlinear dynamics model, describing the dynamic propagation process of the weather risks by using the nonlinear dynamics model in the multi-time aerodynamic network, and identifying key nodes and risk propagation paths and optimizing the multi-time aerodynamic network by analyzing the multi-time aerodynamic network. The method solves the technical problem that the prior art lacks a corresponding optimization strategy due to the fact that key risk nodes and propagation paths are difficult to accurately identify.

title_en: Vehicle safety early warning method and system for expressway network
abstract_en: The application provides a vehicle safety early warning method and system for a highway network, relates to the field of traffic safety control, and solves the technical problem of inaccurate early warning in the prior art. The method comprises the steps of collecting environment data of a highway, dividing the highway into a plurality of areas, calculating an initial risk value of each area according to the environment data, calculating a risk propagation value of each area according to the initial risk value based on a dynamic risk propagation equation, determining a risk grade of each area according to the risk propagation value, and triggering early warning measures of each area according to the risk grade. The method is used for real-time safety management and control of the expressway network in severe weather, and can realize accurate prediction and hierarchical early warning of risks through multidimensional data fusion and dynamic risk propagation modeling, so that the safety and the passing efficiency of the expressway network under complex meteorological conditions are improved.
assignees: ANHUI TECH HANDGO INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Heat supply load ultra-short-term prediction method and system based on depth residual error network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of energy management and discloses a heat supply load ultra-short-term prediction method and a heat supply load ultra-short-term prediction system based on a depth residual error network, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining multidimensional data flow, preprocessing, obtaining data characteristic vectors, then dynamically modeling to obtain a long-period memory network model and generating a corresponding hidden state sequence; the method comprises the steps of calculating the change amplitude of a hidden state sequence, updating a model parameter and recording the hidden state sequence if the change amplitude exceeds a threshold value, extracting attention weight from the hidden state sequence, calculating a predicted deviation value of a model, adjusting the model parameter and carrying out forward propagation on a data characteristic vector if the deviation value exceeds the threshold value, taking the calculated result as an ultra-short-term load predicted value to obtain preliminary predicted output, calculating an association value of the preliminary predicted output and the data characteristic vector, and fine-tuning the parameter if the association value is lower than the threshold value to determine final predicted output. The method can solve the problem that the ultra-short-term accurate prediction of the heating load cannot be realized in the distributed system.
assignees: HUANENG RIZHAO THERMAL CO LTD;XIAN THERMAL POWER RESEARCH INST CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent troubleshooting method and system for distribution and utilization ring network faults
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent power grid industry, in particular to an intelligent troubleshooting method and system for a distribution and utilization ring network. The method generates the ring network situation primitive through multi-source heterogeneous data fusion. And (3) extracting the initial characteristics of the instantaneous faults by inputting the primitives into synchronous compression transformation, and mapping the initial characteristics of the instantaneous faults into fault propagation path characteristics through a graph rolling network considering topological structure constraints. And then, inputting the features into a space-time associated prediction model, integrating defect type discrimination and trend prejudgement features, and generating a fault diagnosis evidence set. And starting an investigation mechanism based on the evidence set to determine an investigation interval, and performing closed loop verification by constructing a fusion judgment matrix based on multi-mode physical sensing information to realize the physical space locking of fault defect points. The invention integrates deep learning diagnosis and multi-mode positioning, and effectively improves the detection precision and positioning efficiency of ring network defects and the recognition capability of transient hidden faults.
assignees: NANJING XUANMIAO ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: fire preventing and repoding hub system for densely population area with solar power suppy
title_ko: 거주밀집형 화재취약지역을 위한 태양광전원을 이용한 화재감지 및 경보 허브시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire prevention and alarm hub system for a densely populated fire-vulnerable area using a solar power source, collecting a signal of risk occurrence from various types of detection devices to propagate the signal when a fire occurs in a densely populated area of dilapidated dwellings such as single houses insufficient in fire detection/alarm facilities. According to the present invention, the system comprises: a solar power conversion unit converting light energy inputted from sunlight into electric energy to charge the electric energy in a battery; a fire detection hub selectively using general commercial power supplied from the outside to determine fire detection information received through wired and wireless networks so as to transmit a fire alarm signal; and a unit fire detection unit installed in each place, including a temperature sensor to measure the temperature of a corresponding area, a fire sensor to detect a fire occurring in the corresponding area, and an overcurrent sensor measuring consumption current to measure whether or not overcurrent equal to or greater than a preset level flows, and communicating with the fire detection hub through wired and wireless networks.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 본 발명은 단독주택과 같이 화재 대비 감지/경보시설이 미진한 노후주택의 밀집형 거주지역에서 화재 발생 시 다양한 형태의 감지장치로부터 위험발생의 신호를 수집 전파하는 허브시스템에 관한 것으로, 태양광으로부터 입사되는 빛 에너지를 전기에너지로 변환시켜 배터리에 충전하는 태양광전력변환부와, 외부에서 공급되는 일반상용전원을 선택적으로 사용하여 유무선으로 전송되는 화재감지정보를 판단하여 화재경보신호를 전송하는 화재감지허브; 각 개별 장소에 구비되어, 해당 구역의 온도를 측정하는 온도센서, 해당구역의 화재발생여부를 감지하는 화재감지센서와, 소모되는 전류를 측정하여 설정된 소정의 크기 이상의 과전류의 흐름여부를 측정하는 과전류 감지센서를 포함하여 구비되고, 상기 화재감지허브와 유무선으로 통신하는 단위화재감지유니트;를 포함하여 구성되는 거주밀집형 화재취약지역을 위한 태양광전원을 이용한 화재감지 및 경보 허브시스템의 구성을 제공한다.
assignees: UNIV DONG A RES FOUND FOR IND ACAD COOP

title_en: A kind of human factor is to power grid cascading failure effect analysis (FEA) method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of human factors to power grid cascading failure effect analysis (FEA) method.The present invention includes the following steps：1. according to power grid current operating conditions needs, the scheduling operation of dispatching of power netwoks person is analyzed, and decompose the cognitive behavior for being included；2. analyzing failure mode included in cognitive behavior；3. solving the probability basic value HEP that human failure occurs 0 ；4. analysis operation Task Circumstance determines the level of behavioral implications factor, failure probability correction factor is obtained；5. solving the human failure probability under specific operation situation；6. using N-1 failures as primary condition, reliability assessment is carried out to system.The present invention improves operation of power networks reliability.

title_en: Foundation pit displacement prediction method based on GA-BP neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a foundation pit displacement prediction method based on a GA-BP neural network. In the construction stage, the prediction simulation of the deformation of the foundation pit structure is one of key technologies of foundation pit construction safety guarantee. The traditional foundation pit construction heavy monitoring and light prediction often take remedial measures after deformation is found, and the optimal time for deformation support repair is often missed. According to the invention, the possible deformation of the foundation pit in the future is predicted and simulated by using the GA-BP neural network method, so that the time point of supporting and repairing is effectively advanced, the difficulty of supporting and repairing is reduced, and finally the foundation pit is protected by safe driving. The invention carries out quantized simulation analysis and research on time domain (only time sequence) characteristics, airspace (only adjacent points) characteristics and time domain airspace combination characteristics in the genetic back propagation neural network, relies on engineering examples for predicting horizontal and vertical displacement deformation of the monitoring points of the Zhoushan foundation pit, and carries out multidimensional comparison with support vector machine regression (SVR) and random forest Regression (RF) methods.

title_en: Cascading failure simulation method for alternating current-direct current series-parallel power grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascading failure simulation method for an alternating current-direct current series-parallel power grid, which comprises the following steps of: s1, determining parameters of a power grid; s2, performing cycle simulation on the power grid, and compared with the previous simulation, increasing the capacity and the load level of the generator according to a certain proportion, and increasing the capacity of the line with the fault in the previous simulation according to a certain proportion; s3, simulating all lines to be disconnected according to a certain probability each time; s4, carrying out power flow optimization on the power grid after disconnection, judging whether a line reaches a heavy load, if the line reaches the heavy load, entering S5, and if not, entering S6; s5, disconnecting the heavy load line according to a certain probability, repeating S4 if a new line is disconnected, and otherwise, entering S6; and S6, judging whether the simulation times reach preset times, if so, ending the simulation, and otherwise, repeating the S2. The cascading failure simulation method provided by the invention can take a direct-current line model and a direct-current protection measure into consideration, and is suitable for cascading failure simulation of an alternating-current and direct-current series-parallel power grid.

title_en: Power grid fragile line classification method and device
abstract_en: The application provides a classification method and a classification device for fragile lines of a power grid, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring accident chains of a power grid to be processed, calculating and obtaining a cascading failure accident chain set of the power grid to be processed according to the accident chains, analyzing the cascading failure accident chain set of the power grid to be processed to obtain a weight index between the lines in the power grid to be processed, and determining the fragile type of the line from a plurality of preset fragile types according to the weight index between the lines. By the aid of the power grid fragile line classification method and device, lines in a power grid to be processed can be accurately classified.

title_en: Multi-attribute important node evaluation and planning method for power grid
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power system automation, and particularly relates to a multi-attribute important node evaluation and planning method for a power grid. The invention comprises the following steps: establishing a complex network topology diagram of a dependent network by collecting data of a target information physical fusion system; establishing a fault propagation model for the dependent network, and calculating the influence of the information node on the physical system and the information system after being attacked; respectively establishing the condition numbers of the information nodes and the physical nodes, and respectively evaluating the vulnerability of the information nodes according to the failure difficulty of the information nodes; according to the topological structure of the complex network, the hub degree of the information node is evaluated by taking the intermediate degree center degree and the degree center degree of the node as hub degree indexes; and reasonably planning the nodes according to influencing factors in the node importance index to improve the risk resistance of the cps. The invention provides a new view for the safety analysis and protection method research of the power grid cps, and provides a basis for planning and defending deployment of power grid nodes.

title_en: Bid electricity quantity boundary determination method for step hydropower station group participating in day-ahead spot market
abstract_en: The invention relates to the fields of electric power markets, hydro-electric scheduling and power grid operation, and discloses a bidding power quantity boundary determination method for a cascade hydropower station group participating in the daily spot market. Along with the continuous perfection of the construction of the electric spot market in China, the participation of hydropower in the spot market is imperative. In the electric power market, the clearing efficiency is related to the safe and stable operation of the power grid. Aiming at the problems that a spot delivery model is complex, the delivery efficiency is low and water and electricity are easy to participate in spot market, water abandon and trade results are difficult to execute and the like caused by complex hydraulic connection of a step upstream water reservoir and a step downstream water reservoir, the invention determines the daily market boundary conditions of the step hydropower station, provides the concept of absolute feasible electric quantity interval of the hydropower station, reveals the evolution rule of the electric quantity boundary of the step hydropower station along with the change of self-generatable water quantity, completely avoids the problem of unmatched upstream and downstream power stations, improves the delivery model solving efficiency, and provides a feasible idea for market operators to manage the participation of water and electricity in spot market.

title_en: Traffic cascading failure emergency regulation strategy generation method, system, terminal and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, a terminal and a medium for generating an emergency regulation strategy of a traffic cascading failure, which relate to the technical field of traffic failure and have the technical scheme that: acquiring a target cascading network diagram formed by fault locating points and fault association points in a target area; at least one fault locating point is selected as a regulating and controlling central point, and the cascade failure relation in the target cascade network diagram is updated by keeping all the fault locating points normally working as targets when the regulating and controlling central point operates, so that an emergency regulating and controlling strategy set is obtained; inputting all emergency regulation strategies in the emergency regulation strategy set into the multi-objective optimization function to obtain the optimal emergency regulation strategy. The invention can effectively reduce the difficulty of recovering the traffic cascade faults, and update the cascade failure relationship, effectively enhance the stability of the whole traffic system under the influence of secondary natural disasters, and provide data support for solving the failure state of the traffic infrastructure caused by the traffic cascade faults under emergency conditions.

title_en: Fire fighting water system fault detection and early warning method and system based on fire fighting Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire control monitoring, in particular to a fire water system fault detection and early warning method and system based on a fire-fighting Internet of things, wherein the method comprises the following steps of 1, periodically collecting pressure data through pressure sensors deployed at an outlet of a fire-fighting water pump, a branch point of a main pipe of a pipe network and the most unfavorable tail end; the method comprises the steps of step 2 of generating theoretical pressure expected values and dynamic tolerance bands of all nodes according to current valve opening, pump states and historical normal working condition data, step 3 of marking abnormal nodes and reversely constructing a fault propagation tree along a topology model when measured pressure deviates from the theoretical pressure expected values by more than the dynamic tolerance bands, and step 4 of triggering grading early warning based on the number of the abnormal nodes, fault propagation paths and accumulated values of the weight factors according to fault types. The system can automatically take measures when faults occur through the equipment linkage function, so that the high-efficiency operation of the fire-fighting water system is ensured, and the efficiency and the safety of fire emergency response are improved.

title_en: Moving repeater
title_ko: 이동용 무선 중계기
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 지하시설물이나 지상시설물에 재난 재해가 발생되거나 긴급한 사고의 발생으로 인한 통신선로의 파손시 독립적으로 운영되어 통신선로의 신속한 확보를 위해 사용되는 이동용 무선 중계기에 관한 것으로; 밧데리가 내부에 설치되는 케이스와, 상기 케이스의 중앙 상측에 구비되며 한쌍의 제1 및 제2중계용 안테나가 구비되는 안테나지지대와, 상기 제1 및 제2중계용 안테나를 통해 수신되는 전파의 감도를 측정하는 전파감도측정센서와, 상기 전파감도측정센서로 부터 전파감도정보가 수신되면 그 전파감도를 정량적으로 표시해주는 디스플레이수단과, 상기 전파감도측정센서의 전파감도정보를 입력받고, 상기 디스플레이수단을 제어하는 제어판넬로 이루어지는 것을 그 기본 구성으로 한다. 
     본 발명에 따르면 지하시설물이나 지상시설물 내에서 재난 재해 또는 사고가 발생되어 통신 통신망이 무력화된 경우 전력선이 필요없이 자체적인 밧데리 전력으로 자체 구동되어 통신망을 신속하게 복구할 수 있게 하는 장점이 있다.
