title_en: Method and detection for peripheral vehicle risk based on image analysis and communication connection between portable communication terminals and building cctv camera
title_ko: 이동통신단말 및 건물 cctv카메라 간의 통신연결 및 영상분석 기반의 주변차량 위험상황 감지 및 방법
abstract_en: According to the present invention, even if a vehicle does not have a separate device or facility, in order to enable emergency communication between vehicles, a situation is shared based on a cellular network between smartphones, emergency situations are transmitted to nearby vehicles. As vehicle owners drive vehicles while holding their smartphones in the vehicle, a situation notification service may be performed through such network communication between smartphones. In particular, by acquiring the CCTV image of the building, the dangerous situation is detected through image analysis, and is transmitted to the smartphone of the nearby vehicle, so as to perform compensation for the emergency situation awareness.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 차량에 별도의 장치나 설비를 구비하지 않더라도, 차량 간 긴급 통신이 가능하도록 하기 위해, 스마트폰 간의 셀룰러 네트워크 기반으로 상황을 공유 함으로써, 주변 차량에 위급상황을 전파하는 기술이다. 차량의 차주들은 스마트폰을 차량내에 소지하고 운전하기 때문에, 스마트폰 간의 이러한 네트워크 통신을 통해 상황 알림 서비스가 수행될 수 있다. 특히, 건축물의 CCTV의 영상을 획득하여, 영상 분석을 통해 위험상황을 감지하여, 주변 차량의 스마트폰에 전송함으로써, 위급상황 인지에 대한 보완을 수행할 수 있다.
assignees: MA IN ENG & ARCHITECTS CO LTD

title_en: Coombined Fire Sensing and Extinguishing System at Home
title_ko: 가정에서의 통합 화재감지 정보 전파 및 화재 소화 시스템
abstract_en: An integrated fire detection dissemination and fire extinguishing system at home of the present invention includes a home server, a fire detection module, a user smart terminal, a camera control module, a plurality of camera units, and a fire extinguishing robot. The present invention is to prioritize dissemination of a fire alarm according to a predetermined criterion so that fire extinguishing and human evacuation can be performed quickly.
abstract_ko: 본 발명 가정의 통합 화재 감지 전파 및 소화 시스템은 가정 구성원의 스마트 단말기 번호 정보, 카메라 고유 정보와 포인트 정보를 등록 저장받고, 화재 발생 시의 기준 온도 정보를 저장하며, 등록 저장된 가정 구성원 스마트 단말기 번호 정보를 기초로 화재 경보 전파의 우선 순위를 설정하며, 화재 감지 모듈로부터 화재 감지 정보를 수신하고, 가정 구성원의 스마트 단말기와 통신하여 각 가정 구성원의 위치 정보를 수신하고 수신된 각 가정 구성원 스마트 단말기의 위치 정보가 홈 서버의 위치 정보와 일치하는지 여부를 판단하며, 일치하는 경우, 일치한 가정 구성원 스마트 단말기를 메모리에 저장하고 메모리에 저장된 홈 서버의 위치와 일치하는 가정 구성원 스마트 단말기 중에서 기 설정하여 저장된 화재 경보 전송 우선 순위에 따라서 화재 경보를 전송하며, 각 카메라부로부터 고유정보, 영상정보 및 다수 포인트의 온도 정보를 수신하고 수신된 다수 포인트의 온도 정보를 기 설정하여 저장된 화재 발생 시의 기준 온도 정보와 비교하여 화재 발생 여부를 판단하고, 화재가 발생한 것으로 판단되면 해당 카메라의 포인트 정보를 화재 소화 로봇으로 전송하는 홈 서버와, 화재를 감지하고 화재 감지 정보를 홈 서버, 화재 소화 로봇 및 카메라 제어 모듈로 전송하는 화재 감지 모듈과, 홈 서버로부터 화재 감지 정보를 수신하고 화재 경보 앱을 활성화하며 부착된 AI 스피커로 화재 경보 정보를 전송하여 음성으로 반복 제공하도록 하는 사용자 스마트 단말기와, 화재 감지 모듈로부터 화재 경보를 수신한 카메라 제어 모듈이 슬립모드에서 워킹 모드로 전환되고 카메라 제어 모듈이 네트워크로 연결된 각 카메라부로 제어 신호를 전송하여 각 카메라를 구동시키는 카메라 제어 모듈과, 카메라 제어 모듈로부터 제어 신호를 수신하여 구동되고 카메라 고유정보, 촬영된 영상정보 및 다수 포인트의 온도 정보를 홈 서버로 전송하는 다수의 카메라부와, 홈 서버로부터 화재가 발생한 장소에 설치되는 카메라의 포인트 정보를 수신하고 기 설정된 경로에 따라서 해당 카메라 포인트로 이동하며, 부착된 적외선 카메라가 촬영한 다수 포인트의 온도 정보를 수신하고 온도가 가장 높은 포인트 방향으로 소화기 노즐이 회전하도록 이동 로봇의 방향을 회전하고 소화기 노즐을 개방하여 소화액을 분사하도록 하는 화재 소화 로봇을 포함하여 구성된 것을 특징으로 하는 것이다.

title_en: Adaptive deep confidence network bearing fault diagnosis method based on Nesterov momentum method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a self-adaptive deep confidence network bearing fault diagnosis method based on a Nesterov momentum method, which comprises the following steps: carrying out sample division on original signals of different health states of the rolling bearing to generate training samples; building a DBN (constrained Boltzmann Machine) by a cascading constrained Boltzmann Machine, adding a Nesterov momentum method and an independent self-adaptive learning rate, inputting a training sample into the DBN, and pre-training the DBN by a batch stochastic gradient descent method and a greedy layer-by-layer unsupervised algorithm; adding a Softmax classifier at the top layer of the pre-trained model, using a supervision algorithm to train the Softmax classifier independently, and carrying out global fine adjustment through a Back Propagation algorithm and a conjugate gradient method to obtain optimal parameters of the model; and inputting unknown state signals to form a test sample set, and then inputting the test sample into the trained DBN model and the Softmax classifier to judge the fault type of the rolling bearing. By adding a Nesterov momentum method and an independent self-adaptive learning rate, the DBN pre-training speed is increased, and the fault classification precision is improved.

title_en: The method and device of risk profile is propagated in a kind of design alteration
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of design alteration and propagates Risk Forecast Method and device.During Variant Design, avalanche type effect is propagated in design alteration can bring design resource the problem of consuming excessively, need to be it is determined that before Variant Design scheme, predictive designs change propagation highest risk path.Product development (product development are built first, PD) network model, this method follows the inherent characteristic of small-world network model from PD networks, considers that redundancy link connects with long-range between design node in PD networks, and design alteration set of node diffusion characteristic；Using small-world network model analytical technology, establish design alteration and propagate greateset risk Quantitative Analysis Model.The fragile link in effective design protection change propagation path, take precautions against design alteration and propagate avalanche type effect.Variant Design efficiency can be improved, saves design cost, so as to provide foundation for Variant Design adaptability Dynamic Programming.

title_en: Enterprise breaks one's promise Risk of Communication inquiry system and method
abstract_en: It breaks one's promise Risk of Communication inquiry system and method the present invention relates to a kind of enterprise, which includes: basic data library module, for inputting and storing the information of Target Enterprise and its affiliated party；Network map construction module, input terminal are connect with the output end of basic data library module, for extracting data from basic data library module, and construct the network map being made of Target Enterprise and its affiliated party；Computation model module, input terminal are connect with the output end of network map construction module, for being based on the network map and Risk Propagation Model of breaking one's promise, estimate the risk profile value of breaking one's promise of each affiliated party of Target Enterprise；Front end interactive module, input terminal are connect with the output end of computation model module, are used for input inquiry condition, and export the risk profile value of breaking one's promise of the affiliated party under the querying condition.This system and method can inquire the risk profile value of breaking one's promise of the affiliated party of any hierarchical relationship.
assignees: CHENGDU BUSINESS BIG DATA TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network risk sensing method and system, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a power distribution network risk perception method, a system, electronic equipment and a storage medium, which belong to the field of data processing, and the method comprises the following steps: acquiring historical monitoring data; establishing improved fault models of various electrical equipment based on historical monitoring data; establishing a model integrating the operation reliability of all electrical equipment; acquiring online monitoring data; and inputting the online monitoring data into all the electrical equipment operation reliability models to obtain the fault probability of each electrical equipment. The system comprises: the system comprises a historical data acquisition module, a fault model creation module, a reliability model creation module, an online data acquisition module and a fault probability calculation module; according to the method and the device, weak links and potential fault equipment under the current operation condition can be found, and accidental shutdown equipment caused by the external environment can be found in the cascading failure propagation process, so that an auxiliary decision can be provided for power grid operators.
assignees: STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;UNIV QINGHUA

title_en: Wide-area energy storage step configuration device and optimization method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wide area energy storage cascade configuration device and an optimization method, which relate to the technical field of energy integration configuration, and in particular relates to a wide area energy storage cascade configuration device and an optimization method, comprising a base, wherein a gas boiler is arranged on one side above the base, a burner is arranged above the gas boiler, a gas pipeline is arranged in the gas boiler, one end of the gas pipeline is connected with a conveying pipeline, and one end of the conveying pipeline is connected with a filter box; the inner wall of gas holder is provided with the heat preservation, gas boiler's outside is provided with the heat collection box, and the inner wall of heat collection box is provided with the heat-conducting plate, the outer wall of heat collection box is provided with the heat preservation skin. The wide-area energy storage cascade configuration device and the optimization method solve the problem that the existing energy system is usually composed of relatively single energy networks, and the coordination among different energy networks is not considered in the networks, so that the energy utilization rate is not high.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE STATE GRID XINJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: LSTM water quality prediction method based on multilayer reverse cell state
abstract_en: The invention provides an LSTM water quality prediction method based on a multi-layer reverse cell state, which is based on big data of the whole sewage treatment process, and does not input all data at one time during model training, but performs data input and verification step by step and step, thereby more effectively capturing the running state of a water plant and fitting the complex biochemical reaction process of the water plant. By introducing back-propagation of the model cell states, the accurate training model captures the operating state of the water plant processing unit. On the basis, the biological treatment layer and the three-stage treatment layer are connected in series through two-layer networks, so that ordered flow of data and deep fusion of information are realized. The biological treatment layer can simulate the biological treatment process in sewage treatment, and the three-stage treatment layer simulates further advanced treatment so as to predict the water quality of the effluent. Through the improvement of the series structure and the reverse propagation path, the invention not only improves the adaptability of the model to the complexity of the sewage treatment process, but also enhances the accuracy of the prediction result.

title_en: Establishment method and application of mountain road network cascading failure model under influence of rainfall landslide
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of complex network cascading failure and urban risk disaster prevention and control, in particular to a method for establishing a mountain road network cascading failure model under the influence of rainfall landslide and application thereof, which can be used for establishing a road network cascading failure model under the influence of rainfall landslide disaster, further can be applied to the network invalidity research of mountain road infrastructure under extreme environment, the disturbance form and cascade failure characteristics of rainfall landslide disasters on a mountain area road network are comprehensively considered, a rainfall-type landslide cascade failure model is constructed based on the nonlinear space-time distribution characteristics and road traffic flow changes of the rainfall landslide disasters through improving a coupling mapping lattice theory and a network seepage theory, the state changes of road network nodes and connecting traffic flows are observed, and then the change of the mountain area road network situation under the influence of the rainfall landslide is judged. The invention has important significance for improving the disaster risk and emergency cooperative security capability of the road traffic infrastructure in the mountain area.

title_en: Meteorological disaster risk grading intelligent assessment and pushing method for town areas
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for intelligently evaluating and pushing weather disaster risk grades for a town area, which relates to the technical field of weather disaster early warning and comprises the steps of extracting and fusing space-time characteristics and geographic element characteristics by utilizing a space-time attention mechanism and a dynamic weight mechanism through acquiring weather monitoring data of a plurality of monitoring points in the town area, and generating weather disaster risk grades through a bidirectional long-short-time memory network; and finally, constructing a distributed storage network through a hierarchical cascade block chain, and encrypting and pushing the early warning information in fragments. The method can realize accurate assessment and efficient early warning of the risk of the meteorological disaster in the town area, and improves the reliability and timeliness of early warning information.

title_en: Cross-domain fault prediction method and system based on graph neural network
abstract_en: The invention provides a cross-domain fault prediction method based on a graph neural network, which comprises the steps of obtaining data of an electric power network and a traffic network, constructing graph structure data containing electric power element nodes and traffic element nodes based on the data, inputting the graph structure data into a pre-trained graph neural network model, obtaining predicted fault states of the electric power element nodes and the traffic element nodes through model processing data, and determining a joint fault scene containing the electric power element nodes and the traffic element nodes in the fault states according to the predicted states. The method solves the problem that the cascade faults between the power network and the traffic network cannot be effectively predicted in the prior art, realizes the accurate prediction of the cross-domain cascade faults, improves the recognition capability of large-area concurrent faults, and provides decision support for active disaster prevention and reduction.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV SHANGHAI JIAOTONG

title_en: Intelligent dividing method for coal mine multi-disaster risk areas based on graph neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent dividing method of a coal mine multi-disaster risk area based on a graph neural network, which comprises the following steps of collecting multi-disaster monitoring data and space structure information to form original monitoring data, constructing a composite graph structure based on the original monitoring data, obtaining directional input through directional association according to the composite graph structure, introducing Hodge-Laplacian directional information transmission mechanism based on the directional input to obtain an edge state updating result, converging the edge state updating result to corresponding connection nodes to output node states, generating enhanced node representation based on the node states in a fusing mode, constructing an anisotropic thermonuclear diffusion graph model to generate a multi-disaster risk propagation graph, carrying out normalization and threshold division according to node scores according to the multi-disaster risk propagation graph, and outputting a coal mine multi-disaster risk area dividing graph layer with continuous boundaries. The invention realizes the intelligent division of the multi-disaster risk areas of the coal mine.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and medium for classifying disaster recovery data of power distribution network in grading mode
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a device, equipment and a medium for classifying disaster-relief data of a power distribution network, belonging to the field of data processing, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting a plurality of pieces of disaster-relief data from the power distribution network and constructing nodes of each piece of disaster-relief data; establishing a plurality of sub-connection sides between two nodes according to the association relation between disaster recovery data corresponding to any two nodes to obtain a knowledge graph, determining the weight of the corresponding sub-connection side according to the association relation, carrying out weighted calculation on the weight of the corresponding sub-connection side between the two nodes through a graph attention mechanism to obtain a first adjacent matrix of the knowledge graph, inputting the first adjacent matrix and embedded representation of each node into a preset graph convolution neural network to carry out feature propagation, and obtaining a classification result corresponding to each label dimension of disaster recovery data corresponding to each node. Therefore, the method and the device can solve the problem of low accuracy of the classification result in the disaster recovery data classification process.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Public safety-oriented Chinese text intelligent recognition and classification method
abstract_en: The invention provides a public security-oriented Chinese text intelligent recognition and classification method, which relates to the technical field of network security text data natural language processing, and aims to support high-concurrency text stream processing by introducing an asynchronous computing framework based on a Graphic Processing Unit (GPU), integrate a plurality of semantic perception models comprising context enhancement, entity recognition and event extraction to cooperatively work, embed a structured knowledge map constructed by taking a public security case library and a judicial case abstract as cores into classification logic, fuse a custom emotion dictionary, combine emotion trigger maps constructed by field hot events, and trigger label cascading and grade response strategies after multi-level judgment is completed. The method and the system can make up for the defect that the general model lacks of field support aiming at text recognition in the professional field, have good interpretability in the decision process, can meet strict compliance requirements, and can be effectively applied to various high-risk real-time decision scenes.
assignees: WUHAN ZHONGZHI DIGITAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Earthquake determination system and method of analyzing earthquake
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an earthquake determination system for early and correct determination of an earthquake, and a method of analyzing the earthquake.  <P>SOLUTION: A plurality of observation terminal devices dispersively installed over random regions and an earthquake analysis processor are connected via a communication network. Upon reception, from the plurality of observation terminal devices, of estimated primary wave detection information transmitted when detection of an earthquake primary wave is estimated from oscillation waveform information output from a seismometer, the earthquake analysis processor obtains, for at least two pairs of observation terminal devices, a distance D and a difference δ in detection times between the observation terminal devices from the detection time and installation position information of the estimated earthquake primary waves included in each pair of the estimated primary wave detection information, and determines that an earthquake occurs when both of two pairs of observation terminal devices satisfy 2D<SB>SL</SB><D and δ<D/S<SB>P</SB>+Δt where D<SB>SL</SB>refers to a transmission limit distance of local oscillation energy, S<SB>P</SB>refers to the minimum propagation speed of the earthquake primary wave, and Δt refers to the maximum detection error between the detection times of a pair of observation terminal devices.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2011,JPO&INPIT

title_en: A protection apparatus for chemical biological and radiological and fire
title_ko: 인명보호용 화생방 방호설비
abstract_en: A protection apparatus having an oxygen concentration controller and a HEPA and carbon filter is provided to regulate oxygen yield and to remove carbon dioxide exhaled by people in an evacuation space, respectively. A protection apparatus comprises: a HEPA filter(12) and a carbon filter(15) for filtering contaminants from the outside; a fan housing(20) provided with an exhaust(21) and an intake fan(22); an oxygen generator operating under the control of an oxygen controller according to an indoor oxygen concentration sensor; a solenoid valve(38) which allows oxygen to inflow, and which actuates an outdoor air motor damper(37) to block outside air and an inner motor damper(39) to supply carbon dioxide among the indoor air to the HEPA filter and the carbon filter such that carbon dioxide-free air is supplied indoors; and a solid oxygen(41) for supplying oxygen into an evacuation space through the rotation of the intake fan operated by a manual handle(26) in the event of oxygen shortage.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 인명보호용 방호장치및 그 방호시설에 관한 것으로, 전시중이나 화재등 천재지변시에 발생될 수 있는 화생방 내지 유해가스등 오염물질에 의한 직접적인 접촉을 막으면서, 대기를 통해 전파되는 오염물질의 각종유해가스나 미생물이 정화되어 인체에 유해되지 않은 상태로 안전대피공간인 방호실 내부로 유입될수 있도록하며 , 대피공간 안에 산소를 발생하는 것과 대피공간안의 이산화탄소를 제거 함으로써 밀폐된 대피공간 안에서 인명을 안전하게 보호하기 위한 방호장치 그 시설에 관한 것이다. 
     이를 위하여 본 발명은, 외부로부터 유입되는 오염물질의 각종유해가스를 헤파필터및 카본필터를 통하여 정화되어 인체에 유해하지 않은 상태의 공기로 내부로 공급된 후, 밀폐된 대피공간 안에서의 산소농도 콘트롤러에 의한 산소 발생기로부터 필요량의 산소를 밀폐된 내부에 공급하는 한편, 사용자로부터 발생되는 이산화탄소를 헤파필터및 카본필터를 통하여 제거 하는 것에 특징이 있다. 
       
     산소발생기, 산소농도 콘트롤러, 이산화탄소, 헤파필터, 카본필터

title_en: Methods and systems for streaming buffer numerical propagation
abstract_en: Systems, methods, and instructions of computer-readable media may include obtaining, at a client machine, a user-selected configuration parameter for an orbit simulation; sending, from the client machine to a remote system, via a network connection, a first set of configuration parameters for the orbit simulation, wherein the first set of configuration parameters comprise the user-selected configuration parameter; receiving, at the client device from the remove device, via the network connection, a stream of orbital data comprising points along an orbit, wherein the points along the orbit are determined by the remote system based on the first set of configuration parameters; and presenting, at a display, a dynamic rendering of the orbit simulation, wherein the orbit simulation is based on the stream of orbital data.

title_en: Surface-layer half water retention type permeable bituminous pavement
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel surface-layer half water retention type permeable bituminous pavement structure and a preparation method thereof. The novel surface-layer half water retention type permeable bituminous pavement structure comprises a permeable bituminous surface layer and a base layer, wherein the bituminous surface layer is divided into an upper surface layer which is 25-30mm thick and a lower surface layer which is 70-90mm thick; the lower surface layer which has half road breadth in the middle of a pavement is filled with a water retention material; the base layer is divided into an upper base layer and a lower base layer; the upper base layer is a bituminous gravel base layer which is 80-120mm thick, and the lower base layer is a cascaded gravel base layer which is 180-220mm thick; the water retention material is prepared by doping 15-20wt% of slaked lime and 60-80wt% of water into a powder body material consisting of 85-95wt% of blast furnace slag powder and 5-15wt% of coal ash. According to the novel surface-layer half water retention type permeable bituminous pavement structure, a quick permeable pavement and the water retention functional material on the lower surface layer are combined together; being an auxiliary of a municipal water drainage facility, the novel surface-layer half water retention type permeable bituminous pavement structure can greatly improve the capacity of an urban road for resisting flood disasters and enhancing the traffic safety, effectively reduce the temperature of the urban road, relieve the high-temperature condensation effect of the bituminous surface layer to a certain extent, delay the bituminous aging speed and prolong the service life of the pavement.

title_en: Combined operation control method for cascade reservoir group flood discharge facilities
abstract_en: The invention discloses a combined operation control method for a cascade reservoir group flood discharge facility, which comprises the following steps: s1: step reservoir group flood scheduling theory research and analysis; s2: the flood discharge facilities use digitalization, and a classification calculation method of a flood discharge facility combination scheme is adopted to simplify the processing; s3: the flood discharge facility combines the dynamic control technology. The invention has the advantages that: the precision of the reservoir discharge curve can be greatly improved; the fine control level of reservoir flood discharge facilities is improved; the problems of low control accuracy, large workload and the like of the flood discharge facilities are solved, and the refinement and the intellectualization of the operation control of the reservoir flood discharge facilities are facilitated.

title_en: Real-time power generation plan optimization method considering linkage adjustment of Shaanxi cascade section quota
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real-time power generation plan optimization method considering the linkage adjustment of the limit of a cascade section in northern Shaanxi, which comprises the following steps: constructing a grid province two-stage real-time power generation plan coordination optimization model under a generalized tie line mode based on various basic data of a real-time power generation plan, and providing a unit initial plan value and a section initial tidal current value for the combined optimization of the real-time power generation plan and the Shaanxi cascade section limit; based on various basic data of a real-time power generation plan, a unit initial plan and a section initial tidal current value, a real-time power generation plan optimization model considering linkage adjustment of the limit of the cascade section of the northern Shaanxi is constructed, an optimization target introduces the minimum air loss of the new energy of the virtual partition of the northern Shaanxi, constraint conditions introduce constraints such as the cascade section of the northern Shaanxi and the acceptance capacity of the partition in the customs, combined optimization of unit output and stable section limit is realized, the consumption potential of the new energy of the partition of the northern Shaanxi in Shaanxi province is fully exploited, the utilization rate of the cascade section of the northern Shaanxi is improved, and the lean level of new energy scheduling of the power grid in the northwest region is improved.

title_en: Data center multifunctional collaborative optimization method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for multi-energy collaborative optimization of a data center, and relates to the technical field of optimization of energy systems of the data center. Firstly, acquiring a data network load based on a network load prediction model; then classifying the data network load and determining the priority of the processing sequence; constructing a multi-energy collaborative optimization model of the data center based on a data center comprehensive energy system comprising a waste heat recovery unit; and finally, solving the multi-energy collaborative optimization model, and optimizing the data center based on the solution result. The invention realizes the collaborative optimization scheduling of data network load and various energy sources in the data center, realizes the cascade utilization of energy, simultaneously recycles the waste heat resources of the data center, reduces the energy consumption of the data center and improves the energy utilization efficiency.

title_en: Risk propagation analysis method for production line design change
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of production lines, and particularly relates to a risk propagation analysis method for design change of a production line. The method comprises the steps of obtaining production line information, establishing a first production line parameter association network according to the production line information, setting initial load and node capacity of each node in the first production line parameter association network, taking production line change data as input of a second production line parameter association network, calculating change risks of the production line by the second production line parameter association network according to the production line change data to obtain a change propagation result, and analyzing robustness of the second production line parameter association network through normal state rates of the nodes in the second production line parameter association network to obtain an analysis result. Compared with the prior art, the method and the device can effectively analyze the dynamic process of the design change propagation, and learn the influence of the dynamic change propagation on each part of the production line, thereby better optimizing the production line.

title_en: Ground satellite signal distributed cooperative processing method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a distributed cooperative processing method and a system for ground satellite signals, which relate to the technical field of communication, wherein the method comprises the steps of extracting a user MAC address hash value, an emergency priority code and a frequency spectrum occupation matrix from a synchronous network to generate a triplet feature vector; the three-tuple feature vector is transmitted through a double-layer Mesh network, two reference target points with fixed geographic coordinates on the ground of a disaster area are selected, three-dimensional coordinates of the two reference target points are obtained, a space reference straight line is constructed, the vertical projection distance from each node to the space reference straight line is calculated according to real-time position data of each node, a node offset parameter is generated, a refraction correction coefficient of a signal propagation path is dynamically generated based on a comparison result of the node offset parameter and a preset threshold value, and when the offset exceeds the threshold value, a piecewise linear interpolation method is adopted to increase correction weight. The invention can realize high-reliability low-delay emergency communication coverage.

title_en: Power transmission line galloping risk early warning and system based on multi-physical-field fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power transmission line galloping risk early warning and system based on multi-physical-field fusion, which comprises the steps of firstly acquiring a multi-physical-field data set of a power transmission line galloping process, and generating a dynamic three-dimensional point cloud sequence through space-time alignment and three-dimensional gesture reconstruction; extracting dancing energy distribution characteristics, frequency spectrum characteristics and space track characteristics from the dancing energy distribution characteristics, fusing the dancing energy distribution characteristics, the frequency spectrum characteristics and the space track characteristics to obtain fused characteristic vectors, inputting the vectors into a physical constraint enhanced two-way long-short-term memory network, predicting a dancing evolution trend, outputting a combined prediction matrix of a dancing amplitude value and a frequency, inputting the matrix into a pre-trained risk propagation reasoning model, calculating a multi-level risk quantification index, generating a risk early warning prompt according to the index, and sending the risk early warning prompt to corresponding risk management equipment to realize the dancing risk early warning of the power transmission line. The method and the device can accurately predict the galloping evolution trend of the power transmission line, thereby accurately pre-warning the galloping risk of the power transmission line.

title_en: Cascade hydropower station accident evolution key node and path identification method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascade hydropower station accident evolution key node and path identification method, which comprises the steps of collecting basic data of a target cascade hydropower station, preprocessing data of the cascade hydropower station accident text, determining association relations among accident factors, classifying, constructing a cascade hydropower station accident evolution network model by adopting a complex network method, constructing an accident propagation probability model by combining network topology characteristics and accident factor point mutual information indexes, calculating the cascade hydropower station accident propagation probability by combining a Bayesian network, operating the cascade hydropower station accident evolution network model, identifying a key path in accident propagation, introducing a node recovery function, and identifying the key node in accident propagation. The key risk nodes and the evolution paths thereof in the emergency process of the cascade hydropower station accidents can be accurately identified, the risk management and control precision of the cascade hydropower station is improved, the risk of cascade accident diffusion is reduced, and the overall safety management and control level is improved.

title_en: Device for supplying DC voltage using power of equivalent signal of traffic signal light
title_ko: 횡단보도 보행자 신호등의 등가 신호 전력을 이용한 직류 전압 치환 공급 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a direct current voltage substituting and supplying device using equivalent signal power of a crosswalk pedestrian signal light. The present invention comprises: a first diode bridge; a second diode bridge; a charging capacitor; a transformer; a switching unit; and a pulse width control unit. In a blackout situation in which a red signal light is not operated, an alternating current voltage is supplied from a green signal light to provide an output voltage. In a blackout situation in which a green signal light is not operated, an alternating current voltage is supplied from a red signal light to provide an output voltage.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 횡단보도 보행자 신호등의 등가 신호 전력을 이용한 직류 전압 치환 공급 장치는, 횡단보도 보행자 신호등의 레드 신호등 제어용 교류 전압과 접지 전압을 전달받아 전파 정류 전압을 제공하는 제 1 다이오드 브리지와; 횡단보도 보행자 신호등의 그린 신호등 제어용 교류 전압과 접지 전압을 전달받아 전파 정류 전압을 제공하는 제 2 다이오드 브리지와; 상기 제 1 다이오드 브리지가 제공하는 전파 정류 전압을 전달받아 충전하고, 상기 제 2 다이오드 브리지가 제공하는 전파 정류 전압을 전달받아 충전하는 충전 커패시터와; 상기 충전 커패시터에 충전되어 있는 제 1 다이오드 브리지의 전파 정류 전압과 제 2 다이오드 브리지의 전파 정류 전압을 전달받아 필요한 출력 전압으로 변압하는 트랜스포머와; 상기 트랜스포머의 입력단을 온오프시키는 스위칭부; 및 상기 스위칭부(FET)에 인가되는 상기 제 1 다이오드 브리지(DIODE BRIDGE1)에서 제공되는 레드 신호등 제어용의 전파 정류 전압 또는 제 2 다이오드 브리지(DIODE BRIDGE2)에서 제공되는 그린 신호등 제어용의 전파 정류 전압에 대한 입력 신호의 듀티비(duty ratio)를 조절하는 펄스폭 제어부를 포함하며, 상기 레드 신호등 제어용 교류 전압과 상기 그린 신호등 제어용 교류 전압을 이용하여 횡단보도 신호등과 연계되어 레드 신호등이 작동하지 않는 정전 시에는 그린 신호등으로부터 교류 전압을 제공받아 출력 전압을 제공하고, 그린 신호등이 작동하지 않는 정전 시에는 레드 신호등으로부터 교류 전압을 제공받아 보행안전을 위한 장치 및 시설물에 출력 전압으로 제공하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: A kind of training method and device of service quality assessment model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of training method of service quality assessment model and devices, wherein this method comprises: according to machine performance data, network characterization data and the quality monitoring data of fixed cycle acquisition service node；Characteristic value is determined based on the machine performance data and the network characterization data；Aimed quality data are determined based on the quality monitoring data；Utilize the characteristic value and the aimed quality data；Service quality assessment model is constructed using the training set.The indexs such as machine performance data, network characterization data and service quality are associated by the present invention by the Feature Engineering function of deep neural network itself, it is trained in conjunction with back-propagation algorithm, and it is fitted non-linear relation therein, the artificial time loss for carrying out Feature Engineering, while the accuracy for assessment of improving service quality can be reduced.

title_en: Method, system and equipment for calculating and predicting daily operation efficiency of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system and equipment for calculating and predicting daily operating efficiency of a power distribution network, which comprise the following steps: calculating the real-time operation efficiency of the power distribution equipment; calculating the daily operation efficiency of the power distribution system based on the real-time operation efficiency of the power distribution equipment; analyzing the influence factors of the daily operation efficiency of the power distribution system; screening main influence factors from the influence factors by utilizing grey correlation analysis; and predicting the daily operating efficiency of the power distribution system by using a back propagation algorithm according to the main influence factors. The method and the device predict the operation efficiency through grey correlation analysis and a Back Propagation (BP) algorithm, thereby considering the influence of the influence factors on the operation efficiency, and select the main influence factors through the grey correlation, thereby dynamically considering the influence of the influence factors on the operation efficiency, solving the defect that the analysis of the operation efficiency and the influence factors in the prior art only stays at a qualitative level, and promoting the reasonable development of the power distribution network.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG;CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO

title_en: Traffic characteristic prediction method and system applicable to long-time prediction based on control information
abstract_en: The invention relates to a traffic characteristic prediction method and a system based on control information and suitable for long-time prediction, wherein the control information is introduced into traffic characteristic prediction to respectively process traffic speed, road network structure and traffic control data; the data are respectively sent to a neural network to obtain space embedding, time embedding and control embedding, and the space embedding, the time embedding and the control embedding are combined to form comprehensive embedding; and finally obtaining the predicted traffic speed value through an encoder based on a space-time attention mechanism module, a data conversion module and a decoder based on the space-time attention mechanism module. The invention improves the effectiveness of the speed prediction of the signal control road network, can better model the dynamic space correlation and the nonlinear time correlation, and simultaneously can avoid the error accumulation to relieve the error propagation effect, thereby improving the long-term traffic flow prediction performance and solving the problem of being suitable for long-term traffic prediction.
assignees: ZHEJIANG YINJIANG INTELLIGENT TRAFFIC ENGINEERING TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Distributed generalized energy storage convergence coordination method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed generalized energy storage convergence coordination method which is suitable for converging scattered generalized energy storage resources in space-time distribution and assisting power grid operation. It includes: 1) acquiring relevant operation parameters of distributed generalized energy storage; 2) evaluating the schedulable potential of the distributed generalized energy storage participating in convergence by utilizing an analytic hierarchy process based on the obtained parameters; 3) designing the schedulable potential of distributed generalized energy storage according to the relative importance degree of the rule layer factors of the analytic hierarchy process, and establishing a aggregator-distributed generalized energy storage shunting step convergence utilization framework; 4) on the basis of a shunting cascade convergence utilization architecture, a convergence cooperative interaction model is established by using a Stackelberg game, so that convergence multiplexing is realized. The distributed generalized energy storage convergence collaborative modeling method can realize the schedulable potential evaluation of the distributed generalized energy storage, the multiplexing scene shunting and individual cascade output sequencing of the distributed generalized energy storage with different characteristics, and the distributed generalized energy storage convergence collaborative modeling, and finally realize the distributed generalized energy storage convergence multiplexing.

title_en: Charging equipment fault rate analysis system and method based on BP neural network
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of power grid informatization, and particularly relates to a charging equipment fault rate analysis system and method based on a BP (back propagation) neural network. The data preprocessing module is used for preprocessing data derived from the Internet of vehicles platform; the index system building module comprehensively constructs indexes influencing the fault rate of the charging equipment from multiple dimensions to form a charging equipment fault rate analysis index system; the model construction module constructs multi-dimensional wide-table data of the charging equipment according to the fault rate analysis index system, and constructs and trains a BP neural network model to predict the fault rate of the charging equipment; and the analysis and decision module analyzes factors influencing the failure rate of the charging equipment in a multi-dimensional manner and provides data support for decision making. The invention can fully utilize the multi-dimensional information of the operation of the charging equipment, comprehensively and effectively predict the failure rate of the charging equipment and provide effective support for improving the equipment investment yield.

title_en: Road side unit optimized layout method considering coexistence of vehicle-vehicle and vehicle-road communication
abstract_en: The invention provides a road side unit optimized layout method considering coexistence of vehicle-to-vehicle and vehicle-to-road communication, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the following steps: discretizing a road network into a road network topological structure G (N, A) of nodes and road sections based on graph theory, wherein G is the road network, N is a node set in the road network, and A is a road section set; step two: based on the road network topological structure, Z is set as a candidate node set in the RSU layout, layout scheme z of road side unit is [ z ═ z 1 ,…,z i ,…z |Z| ]， Step three: constructing an RSU optimized layout model according to positive income brought by information coverage, negative income related to RSU equipment installation cost and a layout scheme z based on a traffic flow-information flow coupling propagation theory; step four: and solving the RSU optimized layout model to obtain an optimal road side unit layout scheme and an optimal line network layout scheme corresponding to the maximum total negative revenue sum related to the positive revenue and the RSU equipment installation cost brought by information coverage. The method can remarkably improve the information flow coverage rate and the comprehensive benefits after layout, and reduce the cost.

title_en: Charging safety state evaluation method and system based on BP neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a charging safety state evaluation method and a charging safety state evaluation system based on a BP (back propagation) neural network, wherein power battery safety data are obtained from historical message data; setting an evaluation index SOS of a safety state, establishing a BP neural network, and predicting the SOS according to the BP neural network; performing SOS calculation according to the real-time message data, and performing charging control according to the calculation result; the scheme of the invention combines the advantage that the neural network can process big data with the advantage of a specialist law, provides the safety state index SOS, predicts the safety state SOS of the electric vehicle in charging by using the BP neural network building model, can effectively make different judgments on the safety condition of the power battery pack according to the battery safety state SOS, and effectively improves the safety monitoring efficiency.
assignees: SHANGHAI JIEMA ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Novel radio frequency identification network planning modeling method based on multistage cascade and supply chain layering
abstract_en: A novel radio frequency identification (Radio Frequency Identification, RFID) network planning (RFID Network Planning, RNP) modeling method based on multistage concatenation and supply chain layering, specifically comprising the following steps: firstly, acquiring a novel RNP communication link equation with multistage cascade characteristics according to connectivity between a tag and a reader, between adjacent readers and between the reader and a terminal; secondly, describing a novel RNP problem based on a supply chain structure, classifying roles of readers and providing three brand-new link modes, and then constructing an RNP optimization target model around positioning accuracy, label coverage and forwarding hop count. The novel RNP modeling method designed by the invention has certain guiding significance for deployment of readers and selection of links in large-scale RNP problems.

title_en: Method, device and medium for analyzing full-chain evolution of blackout event
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device and a medium for analyzing full chain evolution of a blackout event. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a complete chain evolution network model of the blackout event; calculating a plurality of preset typical indexes of a full-chain evolution network model of the blackout event; based on a plurality of preset typical indexes, constructing node importance evaluation indexes and connecting edge importance evaluation indexes of a full-chain evolution network model of the blackout event; constructing path propagation efficiency indexes of each path in the full-chain evolution network model of the blackout event according to the node importance evaluation indexes and the link importance evaluation indexes; and respectively determining key nodes, key links and key paths in the full-chain evolution network model of the blackout event according to the node importance evaluation index value, the link importance evaluation index and the path propagation efficiency index, and determining a coping strategy of the blackout event.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Power system risk assessment method in extreme weather scene based on hybrid simulation
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a power system risk assessment method based on hybrid simulation in an extreme weather scene, and belongs to the field of power system risk assessment. The evaluation method comprises the steps of obtaining power grid data and extreme weather scene data, modeling according to the obtained extreme weather scene data, constructing a fault model of a line in an extreme weather scene to calculate the fault probability of the line, and calculating a risk index of the power system based on Monte Carlo simulation and the fault probability of the corresponding line. The assessment method can integrate various extreme weather factors, characterize initial faults and cascading failure dynamic evolution characteristics so as to support planning and operation decisions of the power grid.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INST OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Face recognition-based power transmission line constructor identity verification method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a face recognition-based power transmission line constructor identity verification method, which relates to the technical field of power engineering safety management and comprises the steps of collecting multispectral face data to generate a spectral three-dimensional feature matrix, extracting micro-blood flow pulsation features, skin texture features and thermal imaging temperature distribution features from the spectral three-dimensional feature matrix, constructing a three-layer cascading anti-fake verification mechanism to carry out comprehensive living judgment, establishing a distributed feature matching network, matching the spectral three-dimensional feature matrix with a pre-stored feature library, collecting constructor geographic position tracks and operation behavior patterns, carrying out multidimensional cross verification with an identity matching result to generate a multi-level safety evaluation index, writing the identity verification process and the multi-level safety evaluation index into a distributed account book to generate a verification credential. The invention effectively solves the problem that the traditional face recognition system is easy to be falsified by the identity by carrying out cross analysis on the identity matching result and the behavior characteristic of constructors.
assignees: GUANGDONG SENXU GENERAL EQUIPMENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Urban public transport network toughness measurement method in extreme stormwater weather
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for measuring toughness of an urban public transportation network in extreme stormwater, which comprises the steps of obtaining urban public transportation network station and line data, stormwater disaster information and passenger flow data, constructing a bus-subway double-layer transportation network, establishing a linear relation between stormwater rainfall intensity and passenger flow change based on the constructed bus-subway double-layer transportation network, calculating disturbance values of stormwater on stations and edges in the network, constructing a bus-subway double-layer transportation network cascade failure model considering passenger flow, representing a dynamic evolution process of the urban public transportation network in extreme stormwater, determining network performance measurement indexes by utilizing the constructed bus-subway double-layer transportation network cascade failure model, and measuring the toughness level of the urban public transportation network in extreme stormwater. The method is favorable for accurately measuring the toughness of the urban public transportation network and improving the coping capacity of the urban public transportation system in extreme stormwater weather.

title_en: Pre-disaster preventive island division method and system for constrained spectrum clustering power transmission system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pre-disaster preventive island division method and system for a constrained spectrum clustering power transmission system, which are used for acquiring power grid data comprising grid frame data, unit parameters, load data and typhoon path parameters, and calculating the maximum wind speed radius of typhoons by adopting a Holland wind field model based on the acquired power grid data And Holland B parameters Then calculating the wind speed of each node of the power grid, and obtaining the maximum wind speed radius of typhoons The method comprises the steps of calculating the fault probability of a power transmission line and a tower by wind speed of each node of a power grid, simulating cascading faults caused by single line faults to generate a high-probability fault scene set, calculating a risk index RI, carrying out fuzzy classification, outputting a risk grade, and executing preventive island division when the risk grade exceeds a set threshold value. Three cascade control of data-driven evaluation, dynamic risk decision-constrained spectral clustering isolation is adopted, so that the technical pain points of pre-disaster defense deficiency and island division rough in extreme weather are overcome, and core support is provided for the elastic power grid.
assignees: UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID SHAANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: High-resistance fault unsupervised identification method and system based on prototype comparison and knowledge distillation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-resistance fault unsupervised identification method and a system based on prototype comparison and knowledge distillation, wherein the method comprises the steps of carrying out standardized pretreatment on a high-resistance fault signal and converting the high-resistance fault signal into a two-dimensional characteristic representation; the method comprises the steps of carrying out depth feature coding on two-dimensional feature representation by using a residual network, extracting high-level semantic features, implementing a contrast learning strategy, enhancing the discrimination of features by means of pulling similar samples and pushing different samples, keeping priori knowledge by using a knowledge distillation technology in a continuous domain adaptation process, designing domain adaptation loss, carrying out weighted combination on classification loss, contrast loss, distillation loss and domain adaptation loss to form a total loss function, gradually adapting to new target domains by adopting a gradient back propagation optimization model parameter, carrying out fault category prediction on test samples, and outputting fault types and confidence. The invention has the advantages of high detection precision, good environmental adaptability, high calculation efficiency and the like.
assignees: STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LIMITED ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RESEARCH INSTITUTE;STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LIMITED;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Deep learning-based intelligent hierarchical prediction method, system, equipment and medium for power grid alarm signals
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent operation and fault diagnosis of electric power systems, and discloses an intelligent hierarchical prediction method, an intelligent hierarchical prediction system, intelligent hierarchical prediction equipment and medium for electric power network alarm signals based on deep learning, wherein the intelligent hierarchical prediction method, the intelligent hierarchical prediction system, the intelligent hierarchical prediction equipment and the medium comprise the steps of constructing a heterogeneous graph network comprising equipment, alarm and defect nodes through a multi-mode feature extraction step; the method comprises the steps of adopting an improved graph attention network fused with power grid topology information to extract space association features, utilizing a transducer encoder with causal mask to extract time sequence association features, deeply fusing space-time features through a cross attention mechanism, outputting a four-level defect prediction result and an uncertainty quantization index based on an evidence theory, and realizing continuous learning of a model through self-adaptive online optimization. The method effectively overcomes the defect of insufficient modeling of the topological association and the time sequence causal relationship of the power grid in the prior art, and remarkably improves the accuracy of alarm classification, the identification capability of cascading failures and the rapid adaptability to new scenes.

title_en: Road water damage disaster rapid identification method and system based on remote sensing image analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid recognition method and a rapid recognition system for highway water damage disasters based on remote sensing image analysis, which belong to the technical field of remote sensing image analysis and disaster detection, wherein the method comprises the steps of extracting a change region of a remote sensing image before and after the disaster through a multi-scale differential twin network change detection module; identifying five types of water damage types, namely roadbed impact damage, pavement collapse, side slope collapse, retaining wall collapse and bridge and culvert damage through a cascade attention water damage semantic segmentation network; calculating a damage degree grade by fusing morphology, spectrum and spatial characteristics through a multidimensional damage degree cooperative evaluation module; the traffic state is judged and the rush repair priority report is generated through the traffic influence self-adaptive quantification module, so that the rapid identification, accurate classification and comprehensive evaluation of the road water damage disasters are realized, and technical support is provided for the post-disaster rush repair and conservation decision.

title_en: Wireless social group communication system
title_ko: 무선 소셜 그룹 통신 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a technology related to a wireless social networking method and a system configuration capable of executing direct communication, relay communication, and group communication, and broadcasting between the terminals which connect peripheral users using the social networking between the users using the network using a wireless method and to a technology for developing the group communication by applying the local broadcasting using the wireless network protocol technology of a content method and a communication fusion technology (application number 10-2012-0091879) to an actual use system and without interference between the users in the compact condition of the users. A terminal can be widely used in store management or industrial site, and for a leisure sport because the terminal can execute the group communication with the Ad-hoc relay with an infrastructure. In addition, the present invention relates to a useful technology capable of constructing a communication network related to disaster and safety using the terminal in a disconnected condition with stop of the all infra structure in a disaster site and capable of enabling a user to execute communication by relaying between the terminals.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 네트워크를 이용한 사용자간의 소셜 네트워킹을 무선 방식을 이용하여 주변의 사용자들을 연결시켜주는 단말기간 직접 통신, 중계, 그룹 통신과 방송이 가능한 무선 소셜 네트워킹 네트워킹 방법 및 시스템 구성에 관한 기술과 사용자가 밀집한 상황에서도 사용자 간의 간섭없이 다양한 서비스를 하나의 프로토콜로 해결할 수 있는 컨테이너 방식의 무선 네트워크 프로토콜 기술을 이용한 근거리 방송과 통신 융합 기법(출원번호 10-2012-0091879)을 실제 사용하는 시스템에 적용하여 그룹 통신용으로 발전시킨 기술에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Terminal mobility management method and device using nas
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a 5G or 6G communication system for supporting higher data transmission rates. The present disclosure may provide a device and method for managing the mobility of a terminal in a wireless communication system. Disclosed is a method for selecting a PLMN or SNPN, in a process of confirming service disruption of a first communication provider communication network and utilizing service of a second communication provider communication network, on the basis of capability information about the ability of a terminal in a wireless communication system to utilize a communication network of a provider that the terminal is not subscribed to in a disaster situation.

title_en: Static engine and neural network for a cognitive reservoir system
abstract_en: Implementations described and claimed herein provide systems and methods for developing a reservoir. In one implementation, observed data points in a volume along a well trajectory and well logs corresponding to observed data points are received at a neural network. Feature vectors are generated using the neural network. The feature vectors are defined based on a distance between each of the observed data points and randomly generated points in the volume. A 3D populated log is generated by propagating well log values of the feature vectors across the volume. Uncertainty is quantified by generating a plurality of realizations including the 3D populated log. Each of the realizations is different and equally probable. core values are generated from the realizations, and a static model of the reservoir is generated by clustering the volume into one or more clusters of rock types based on the core values.

title_en: Power grid line importance degree evaluation method based on meteorological prediction and risk evaluation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid line importance degree evaluation method based on meteorological prediction and risk evaluation. Firstly, determining a fault set of a line in typhoon weather; then, establishing a typhoon effective wind speed model, and establishing a mathematical model for describing the influence of the typhoon effective wind speed on the line fault probability, so as to determine the occurrence probability of each fault in the fault set; then, 3 consequence severity measurement indexes of system load loss proportion, system line load rate and system voltage deviation are provided, and a consequence severity comprehensive index is provided on the basis; and finally, defining the single fault risk, the multiple fault risks and the cascading fault risk of the line by combining the occurrence probability of the accident, and providing a method for representing the comprehensive risk of the line by using a triangular radar map. The method can effectively identify the key line of the regional power grid in real time according to the power grid parameters and the typhoon weather forecast data, so that the practical evaluation method meeting the actual engineering requirements is provided on the evaluation of the power grid key line combined with the weather conditions.

title_en: Uncertain system modeling method based on interval feedback neural network
abstract_en: The invention provides an uncertain system modeling method based on an interval feedback neural network, and relates to the technical field of system modeling in an industrial process. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring actual input and output data pairs of a system; collecting system data pairs under condition UBB; normalizing the input of the actual point value and the output data of the actual interval corresponding to the actual point value; taking the normalized data as training data to perform off-line training on the interval feedback neural network to obtain a trained interval feedback neural network; and testing the trained interval feedback neural network by using the test sample and completing output value prediction. The uncertain system modeling method based on the interval feedback neural network provided by the invention utilizes the nonlinear approximation capability of the interval feedback neural network and adopts the gradient descent algorithm based on error back propagation to carry out network weight learning, thereby avoiding a large amount of input of neurons and the requirement on a system mechanism model, and being widely suitable for the modeling process of a high-order dynamic system with unknown errors and being bounded.

title_en: Hydropower station short-term multi-target power generation plan compilation method and system for power grid peak regulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydropower station short-term multi-target power generation planning method and a system for power grid peak regulation, and the method comprises the following steps of firstly, constructing a cascade hydropower station short-term multi-target power generation planning model; determining an economic operation mode of the power station according to the input conditions; randomly generating a plurality of particles in a feasible space, determining an individual extreme value of each particle based on an objective function value of each particle, and storing the independent particles in an external archive set; updating the position and the speed of each particle, randomly selecting partial particles to carry out polynomial variation, repairing infeasible solutions, and calculating the objective function value of each particle again; updating the individual extreme value of each particle according to the recalculated objective function value of each particle; and updating the external archive set according to the domination relation and the crowding distance of the particles, and outputting the external archive set if a preset termination condition is met, thereby obtaining a global extremum. The invention can effectively reduce the peak load of the system and improve the power supply quality. The power grid can be operated safely, stably and economically.

title_en: Neural network-based multi-parameter life prediction method for three-phase alternating current asynchronous motor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a neural network-based multi-parameter life prediction method for a three-phase alternating current asynchronous motor, which belongs to the field of industrial motor security inspection systems, and realizes the multi-parameter life prediction of the motor by using the state parameter and the protection event parameter recording information of a microcomputer relay protector and combining a deep learning network, wherein the prediction step comprises the following steps: establishing a neural network training set, a half life training subset and a loss training subset, sending the training set into a neural network for training, correcting network parameters by using an error back propagation algorithm, obtaining parameterized description of the network on the service life of the motor, establishing a motor loss test set, inputting the established neural network and predicting; the complex modeling process is avoided, the accuracy of prediction is improved, the potential safety hazard of abnormal shutdown of the factory process is avoided, and the economic loss and the casualty risk caused by safety accidents are reduced.

title_en: Flight operation risk network construction and control method based on unsafe events
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flight operation risk network construction and control method based on unsafe events. The method constructs a flight operation risk network based on civil aviation unsafe event data, and performs logic supplementary connection on the network according to flight operation actual services; and improving a risk propagation and control process based on an SIR virus propagation model, distinguishing risk propagation probabilities among different nodes according to the occurrence frequency of different unsafe events, and simulating the propagation process of the risk in the network. The propagation of risks in the network is controlled by two methods of controlling nodes and network attack, and the probability of risks of unsafe events is reduced by establishing defense for important nodes, so that a reliable and effective flight operation risk control scheme is provided. The flight operation risk network is constructed, so that the relationship among flight risk factors and the relationship between risks and accidents can be known, the risk propagation process is more consistent with the actual flight operation condition, and the reliability of the determined risk control scheme is higher.

title_en: Method for identifying and positioning tiny objects in complex environment by using SISO antenna
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for identifying and positioning tiny objects in a complex environment by using a SISO antenna, which comprises the following steps of S1, establishing a cube vacuum resonant cavity, placing a baffle, S2, arranging two ports S3 in the cube vacuum resonant cavity, feeding and sending signals by the ports S3, at the moment, leading out the signals received by the ports S4, performing time inversion operation, and doubling the time-inverted signals, S5, placing a metal block in the cube vacuum resonant cavity, exciting the ports S5 by using the processed signals, at the moment, enabling the ports to be used for receiving the signals sent by the ports S6, obtaining time-inverted phase line images, S7, obtaining time-frequency images of objects in different shapes and at different positions, S8, training a cascade neural network consisting of a classification network and a positioning network, and S9, testing the accuracy of the neural network to evaluate the robustness of the neural network.

title_en: Pumped storage and cascade hydropower joint scheduling method based on virtual power plant
abstract_en: The invention provides a pumped storage and step hydropower joint scheduling method based on a virtual power plant. Acquiring pumping data of a plurality of distributed pumped storage power stations and storage capacity data of an upper warehouse and a lower warehouse, and confirming unit parameters of a virtual pumped storage unit in a virtual power station; acquiring power generation data and upstream and downstream water level data of each stage of power stations in the step power plant, and confirming unit parameters of a virtual step hydroelectric unit in the virtual power plant; responding to a power grid load instruction, and confirming load scheduling schemes of the virtual pumped storage unit and the virtual step hydroelectric unit based on unit parameters of the virtual pumped storage unit and the virtual step hydroelectric unit; the load scheduling scheme comprises a pumping instruction of the virtual pumped storage unit and a load scheduling instruction of the virtual step hydroelectric unit. The invention solves the technical problems of large management difficulty and poor effect caused by the scheduling management of the river basin step power plant and the pumped storage respectively in the prior art.

title_en: Power data center station network fault diagnosis method based on dependent network model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power data center station network fault diagnosis method based on a dependent network model, which comprises the steps of constructing a cascading failure model of a power data center station dependent network according to log information of terminal equipment accessing the power data center station, calculating initial load and capacity of each side in the network, simulating a random network fault and updating network state, calculating current load of each side in the updated network, deleting the side from the network if the current load is larger than the capacity of the side, repeatedly carrying out state updating, load calculating and deleting until all sides in the power data center station network meet the current load which is smaller than or equal to the capacity of the side or all nodes in the network are isolated nodes, calculating the function value of the current network model, and giving a quantized judging result. The invention is oriented to complex power data center station scenes, captures and acquires the real-time change of the node state through the modeling of the dependent network model, and effectively supports the state sensing and fault analysis of the node state.

title_en: Rainstorm disaster risk evaluation method for foundation slope of transmission line tower
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rainstorm disaster risk evaluation method for a foundation slope of a transmission line tower. The method comprises the following steps of: obtaining disaster causing factors controlling the rainstorm risk of the foundation slope of the transmission line tower according to extensive disaster statistics and artificial rain slope corrosion test statistics; and performing quantification and normalization processing on the disaster causing factors and slope stability, and calculating a weight vector of influence of each disaster causing factor on the disaster causing of rainstorm by adopting an improved hierarchical analysis calculation program; establishing a mapping relationship between the disaster causing factors and a slope stability safety coefficient by adopting an artificial intelligence method and an improved back propagation (BP) network to obtain a mathematical model for evaluating the rainstorm landslide risk of the foundation slope of the transmission power tower; quantifying vulnerability factors, obtaining a weight vector of influence of each vulnerability factor on the disaster causing risk of the rainstorm by adopting an expert analysis method, and establishing a rainstorm risk evaluation mathematical model for the foundation slope of the transmission line tower according to a relationship that the risk is equal to a product of danger and vulnerability; and accurately evaluating the rainstorm risk of the foundation slope of a specified transmission line tower.

title_en: Neural network prediction method for generated output of photovoltaic power station
abstract_en: The invention discloses a neural network prediction method for the generated output of a photovoltaic power station. According to the invention, a neural network model fitting corresponding function relationships can be established by using a BP (back-propagation) neural network with momentum according to temperatures and illuminations in meteorological history data and generated power history data, and the most similar historical situation can be found according to the weather conditions of the latest two hours, then accordingly, the generated power of the photovoltaic power station in a future period can be predicted. An operation of predicting the output power of a photovoltaic power station helps power grid dispatching departments to comprehensively arrange the coordination of conventional power sources and photovoltaic generated power, timely adjust dispatching plans, and reasonably arrange the running modes of power grids.
assignees: JIANGXI JIUJIANG POWER SUPPLY CO LTD

title_en: Power system parallel recovery partitioning method based on label propagation algorithm and game theory
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of parallel recovery of power systems, and particularly discloses a parallel recovery partitioning method for a power system based on a label propagation algorithm and a game theory, which comprises the following steps: edge weight B for initializing power system after power failure ij Node weight C i A weighted adjacency matrix W and a partition discrimination matrix F; initiating cooperative game league C g ＝F 0 ，F 0 An initial partition discrimination matrix which is a partition discrimination matrix F; and updating the labels of the nodes in the initial network based on a label propagation algorithm until the partition discrimination matrix F converges, and outputting a node set of each subsystem of the power system during convergence. The invention comprehensively considers the network topology structure and system of the power gridAccording to the practical characteristics of the system, a partitioning method based on a label propagation algorithm and a cooperative game theory is provided, the partitioning problem of the nodes is decided by calculating a Shapley value according to the relation between the nodes and the subsystems, partitioning constraints are embedded in an iteration process, and a partitioning scheme meeting the requirements of equivalent subsystem scale, compact internal structure, power balance and the like is quickly obtained.

title_en: Vulnerability assessment method for intelligent power grid information physical system based on complex network
abstract_en: The invention provides a vulnerability assessment method of a smart grid information physical system based on a complex network, which comprises the following steps: step 1: acquiring a public power grid data set from an open source website, carrying out data analysis and mining on the data set, and carrying out abstract network modeling on a power system; step 2: based on complex network theory and data set, constructing information layer network model of communication system; step 3: further considering the coupling relation between the physical layer and the information layer, constructing a double-layer network interconnection model with different coupling mechanisms; step 4: based on a multilayer complex network theory, carrying out static analysis on a power grid information physical system, and considering vulnerability measurement indexes under different attack conditions; step 5: and carrying out cascade fault propagation dynamic simulation analysis on the constructed information physical system network model, and evaluating the vulnerability of the system according to the dynamic simulation analysis result.

title_en: Method, system, electronic equipment and medium for predicting residual life of intelligent ammeter
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a system, electronic equipment and a medium for predicting the residual life of an intelligent ammeter, which are suitable for the technical field of intelligent ammeters and can improve the accuracy of predicting the residual life and the fault probability of the intelligent ammeter. The method comprises the following steps: according to the application environment data, the factory verification data and the characteristic values of the correlation coefficient matrix of the real-time monitoring data of the intelligent electric meter, determining the accumulated contribution rate of each related data of the intelligent electric meter and a main parameter sequence affecting the residual life of the intelligent electric meter, inputting the main parameter sequence into a transformation neural network and a counter-propagation neural network, training a model for predicting the residual life of the intelligent electric meter, and obtaining the residual life predicted value of the intelligent electric meter based on the model.
