assignees: State Grid Tianjin Electric Power Company Marketing Service Center;STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Artificial intelligence-based chemical enterprise security risk identification method
abstract_en: The invention provides an artificial intelligence-based chemical enterprise security risk identification method, which comprises the following steps: constructing a flow-oriented Petri network based on the safety risk identification process of the chemical enterprises, wherein the position of the Petri network represents the state of resources, identification sequence or operation, and the transition of the Petri network represents the start or end of the operation; acquiring a cascade effect of safety risk factors of chemical enterprises based on the Petri network; based on the cascading effect, a security risk factor is determined and evaluated. The invention can more accurately acquire the safety risk factors of chemical enterprises.

title_en: Hydropower and thermal power electric quantity distribution method and system considering high-proportion wind-solar access
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water power and thermal power electric quantity distribution method considering high-proportion wind-light access, which comprises the following steps: acquiring historical data and self requirements of energy, matching corresponding influence factors according to the historical data and the self requirements of the energy, and analyzing multi-energy coordination scheduling requirements of an electric power system under the condition that new energy is accessed to obtain the power grid energy output characteristic; according to the power grid energy output characteristics, selecting full new energy consumption as a boundary condition, taking the minimum average thermal power load distance as an objective function, and establishing a hydroelectric and thermal power optimal scheduling model by combining constraint conditions; and solving the hydroelectric and thermal power optimal scheduling model by utilizing an improved successive load shedding algorithm to obtain a time-period-by-time optimal scheduling result, smoothing a thermal power generation process line, optimizing thermal power operation working conditions, improving the generating capacity of cascade hydroelectric power, providing technical support for power system power generation planning, power generation strategy optimization and the like.

title_en: Demand response optimization method and device based on load side resource three-layer cooperative scheduling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a demand response optimization method based on three-layer collaborative scheduling of load side resources, which comprises the steps of respectively establishing basic models of power grid, aggregators and users participating in demand response scheduling, carrying out coupling optimization on the basic models of power grid, aggregators and users by utilizing a target cascading algorithm, establishing a three-layer collaborative scheduling model based on a power grid-aggregator-user architecture, and solving the three-layer collaborative scheduling model to obtain an optimization scheme of the power grid, the aggregators and the users participating in demand response scheduling. The method and the system promote reasonable allocation of main body resources of all parties in demand response, are favorable for promoting the normalization of mass user side resources to participate in interactive regulation, realize cooperative optimization of energy-consumption side adjustable resources, and ensure efficient utilization of power resources and stable operation of a power grid.
assignees: MARKETING SERVICE CENTER OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;JIANGSU FANGTIAN POWER TECH CO

title_en: Power system network attack consequence evaluation method considering switch modularization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system network attack consequence evaluation method considering switch modularization, which relates to the technical field related to power system safety protection and emergency response and comprises the following steps of carrying out modularization modeling on key switch equipment in a power system to determine functional logic and fault propagation paths of the key switch equipment; and solving the optimal attack path and generating a defending configuration scheme by simulating strategy games of an attacker and a defender. The method can more accurately simulate the influence of the network attack on the power system, is beneficial to analyzing the fragile links and key nodes of the network attack, and identifies potential network attack paths and risks, thereby providing scientific basis for the safety protection and emergency response of the power system.

title_en: Landslide hazard risk assessment method, landslide hazard risk assessment equipment, landslide hazard risk assessment medium and landslide hazard risk assessment product
abstract_en: The application discloses a landslide hazard risk assessment method, equipment, medium and product, and relates to the field of geological hazard risk assessment. The method comprises the steps of constructing a disaster pregnancy factor system participating in landslide disaster risk assessment, uniformly sampling a research area according to preset sampling intervals to obtain a uniform point set, respectively collecting information amounts of disaster points and uniform points in the research area to form a positive sample set and a negative sample set, constructing a landslide disaster risk assessment model based on an artificial neural network, training the model by adopting the positive sample set and the negative sample set, outputting landslide disaster occurrence probability of each sample, further calculating prediction precision and prediction density of the model, calculating a weighted cross entropy loss function based on the prediction density, and carrying out error counter-propagation until the training is completed, and carrying out landslide disaster risk assessment on an area to be assessed by utilizing the trained landslide disaster risk assessment model, so that objectivity, rationality and accuracy of the landslide disaster risk assessment can be remarkably improved.
assignees: SICHUAN INST OF LAND AND SPACE ECOLOGICAL RESTORATION AND GEOLOGICAL DISASTER PREVENTION;UNIV CHENGDU INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Multi-mode data fusion-based power operation risk identification method, system, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power grid monitoring, in particular to a power operation risk identification method, a system, equipment and a storage medium based on multi-mode data fusion. Aiming at the problems of multi-mode data fracturing, topology constraint missing and the like in traditional power disturbance analysis, an improved BERT model is constructed, the time-frequency characteristics of electric signals and text semantic information are mapped to a unified vector space through a multi-mode embedding mechanism, a time-dependent relation between the signals and the text is established by adopting a time sequence attention mechanism, risk propagation modeling under the power grid topology constraint is realized by combining a graph attention network, and disturbance classification, risk prediction and trend analysis are cooperatively optimized through a multi-task learning framework. The method effectively solves the technical problems of difficult heterogeneous data fusion and insufficient risk identification precision, realizes accurate identification and intelligent early warning of power operation risks, and improves the safe operation level of the power grid.
assignees: KUNMING POWER SUPPLY BUREAU YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Load prediction method and system based on virtual power plant operation
abstract_en: The invention provides a load prediction method and a system based on virtual power plant operation, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a hybrid prediction model based on an ant colony optimization algorithm dynamic weighting combination LSTM time sequence sub-model, XGBoost gradient lifting sub-model and fuzzy clustering sub-model, positioning a main deviation source through an error propagation network, triggering the reconstruction of the hybrid prediction model according to the real-time operation state of the virtual power plant, calculating the load predictability index of the reconstructed hybrid prediction model, and correcting the load prediction result of the hybrid prediction model according to the load predictability index to obtain a final load prediction value. According to the method, the mixed prediction model is built by dynamically weighting and combining all the sub-models through the ant colony optimization algorithm, the deviation source is positioned through the error propagation network, the sub-model weight is adjusted according to the real-time running state reconstruction model of the power plant, the reliability of the model is estimated by calculating the predictability index of the model so as to correct the result, and the accuracy of the load prediction of the virtual power plant is greatly improved.
assignees: CHENGDU HUAMAO NENGLIAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Urban waterlogging disaster chain modeling and blocking method based on large language model and complex network analysis
abstract_en: A modeling and blocking method for urban waterlogging disaster chains based on large language models and complex network analysis belongs to the field of disaster prevention and reduction. The method comprises the steps of inputting multi-source media texts into data, automatically extracting disaster events and causal relations thereof by using a large language model, analyzing and calculating support, confidence and lifting degrees among the events through association rules, constructing a weighted directed disaster chain network for describing cascading propagation relations of urban waterlogging events, identifying key nodes and fragile propagation paths based on indexes such as centrality, connectivity and network efficiency of complex network theory calculation nodes and edges, designing progressive node and edge removal experiments, evaluating various intervention strategies, and determining an optimal disaster chain blocking scheme. The invention can realize automatic modeling and quantitative analysis from unstructured text data to disaster chain network, rapidly identify key transmission links and system weak points in waterlogging, and remarkably improve the identification precision, analysis efficiency and scientificity of prevention and control decisions of urban waterlogging disaster chains.

title_en: Intelligent micro-grid source network load storage integrated coordination management and control system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent micro-grid source network load storage integrated coordination control system, which relates to the technical field of intelligent micro-grid and comprehensive energy regulation and control and comprises a multi-energy flow data acquisition unit, a multi-energy flow coupling modeling and optimizing unit, a multi-energy flow cascade utilization execution unit, a mode self-adaptive switching unit and a main control unit, wherein the multi-energy flow data acquisition unit is connected with the multi-energy flow data acquisition unit; according to the invention, through the multi-energy flow coupling modeling and optimizing unit, an electric-thermal-gas multi-energy flow coupling model comprising a heat supply network transmission loss calculation sub-model is constructed, a renewable energy source absorption constraint sub-model is additionally arranged, an improved mixed particle swarm algorithm is adopted for dynamic optimization solution, and an optimal scheduling strategy is generated, so that the absorption rate of renewable energy sources is improved, and through a heat energy distribution priority regulation mechanism and the efficiency optimization control of a waste heat recovery module, the electric-thermal cascade utilization and high-efficiency configuration are realized, and the dependence of heat load on electric energy is remarkably reduced.
assignees: XIANYANG XINXING DISTRIBUTED ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: Photovoltaic facility operation and maintenance decision method based on knowledge graph
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photovoltaic facility operation and maintenance decision method based on a knowledge graph, which comprises the steps of S1, constructing the knowledge graph, establishing equipment, fault modes, characteristic parameter nodes and causal association, S2, carrying out state diagnosis based on an improved Markov logic network, utilizing a structure regularization factor decomposition model and a confidence level adjustment mechanism to obtain equipment state probability, a fault propagation chain and influence degree, S3, constructing an operation and maintenance index system, extracting risks, fault influence and performance degradation, combining cost and power generation recovery rate to form an evaluation vector, S4, optimizing the operation and maintenance strategy based on the improved VIKOR method, introducing an index coupling degree matrix and a compromise correction factor, calculating group utility, individual regrets and compromise evaluation values, S5, outputting operation and maintenance decision, generating a priority and alternative scheme, and providing fault chain interpretation and weight correction basis. The invention realizes intelligent diagnosis and operation and maintenance auxiliary decision-making of the photovoltaic facilities, improves operation and maintenance efficiency, reduces fault risk and optimizes power generation income.
assignees: INNER MONGOLIA HUANENG KUBUQI ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: System for providing power supply service for cost saving based on Time of Use (TOU) and method therefor
title_ko: 계시별 요금제를 기초로 비용 절약을 위한 전력 공급 서비스를 제공하기 위한 시스템 및 이를 위한 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for providing a cost-saving power supply service based on a time-of-use rate plan. The system includes: a service server generating a transaction by signing a smart contract including service details to be provided to a user device with a service private key and transmitting the generated transaction to a blockchain network; and node devices forming the blockchain network. Here, a node device that is one of the node devices and has succeeded in mining extracts the smart contract from the transaction, generates a block including the extracted smart contract, and propagates the generated block to the node devices. The node devices verify the block and connect the block to the blockchain when the verification is successful.
abstract_ko: 계시별 요금제(TOU: Time-of-Use)를 기초로 비용 절약을 위한 전력 공급 서비스를 제공하기 위한 시스템이 제공된다. 상기 시스템은 사용자장치에 제공할 서비스 내역을 포함하는 스마트계약서를 서비스 개인키로 서명하여 트랜잭션을 생성하고, 생성된 트랜잭션을 블록체인네트워크로 전송하는 서비스서버와, 상기 블록체인네트워크를 형성하는 복수의 노드장치를 포함한다. 여기서, 상기 복수의 노드장치 중 채굴에 성공한 노드장치는 상기 트랜잭션으로부터 스마트계약서를 추출하여 추출된 스마트계약서를 포함하는 블록을 생성하고, 상기 생성된 블록을 상기 복수의 노드장치로 전파하고, 상기 복수의 노드장치는 상기 블록을 검증하고, 검증에 성공하면 블록체인에 상기 블록을 연결하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Method for estimating shock wave generation points in water pipeline network
title_ko: 상수도 관망 충격파 발생 지점 추정방법
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 상수도 관망 충격파 발생 지점 추정방법에 관한 것이다.  
본 발명에 따른 방법은, (a)복수의 상수도관이 연결되어 있는 상수도 관망을 복수의 블럭으로 구획하고, 블럭 내 상수도관의 위치정보와 블럭 내 상수도관에 설치된 복수의 압력센서의 위치정보를 파악하는 단계; (b)블럭 내 상수도관의 특정 지점에서 충격파를 발생시키고 상수도관을 따라 전파된 충격파가 압력센서들에 수신된 시간 및 압력값을 계측하는 테스트 단계; (c)X축은 충격파를 발생시킨 지점으로부터 각 압력센서까지의 시간, Y축은 압력센서에서 계측된 압력값으로 하는 XY 평면에 계측값을 플로팅하고, 충격파 발생 지점으로부터의 시간에 따른 압력값에 대한 기본감쇠그래프를 형성하는 단계; (d)블럭 내에서 충격파가 발생하여 복수의 압력센서에서 충격파를 순차적으로 수신하면, X축은 복수의 압력센서에서 충격파를 수신한 전파시간, Y축은 압력센서에서 계측된 압력값으로 하는 이벤트감쇠그래프를 형성하는 단계; (e)기본감쇠그래프에서 이벤트감쇠그래프의 형태와 대응되는 대응영역을 결정하는 단계; (f)기본감쇠그래프의 대응영역을 이용하여 충격파 원점까지의 거리를 추정하는 단계; 및 (e)대응영역 내에 포함된 압력센서들로부터  충격파 원점까지의 거리를 이용하여 충격파가 발생한 발생지점을 추정하는 단계;를 구비하는 것에 특징이 있다.

title_en: Enhancements for minimization of service interruption
abstract_en: A user equipment (UE) is configured to identify a disaster condition applies to a first public land mobile network (PLMN), select a second PLMN for disaster roaming services, wherein one or more tracking areas (TAs) of the second PLMN are in a forbidden list stored locally at the UE and wherein the second PLMN and the first PLMN have a roaming agreement for disaster roaming services and register with the second PLMN for disaster roaming services in the one or more TAs of the second PLMN from the forbidden list.

title_en: Mechanical anomaly detection method based on potential feature codes
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mechanical anomaly detection method based on potential feature codes. The invention relates to a mechanical anomaly detection method based on potential feature codes, which comprises the following steps: data preprocessing: preprocessing the vibration signal data, including Fourier transformation and normalization; forward propagation: and inputting the preprocessed signals into a first full convolution network to encode data. The invention has the beneficial effects that: aiming at the problem of abnormal sample loss, the method learns the data distribution of normal signal samples by utilizing the characteristic mining capability of a deep network, and transfers the signals to a potential space for data distribution comparison by coding, decoding and recoding the signals.

title_en: Rural power grid transformation method based on cascade combination scoring
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rural power grid transformation method based on cascade combination scoring, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the following steps of combing the main problems existing in the current situation of the rural power grid, respectively defining corresponding single evaluation indexes, constructing a calculation formula matched with each evaluation index according to the actual operation rule and the internal development change rule of the rural power grid, carrying out grading treatment on the severity of each problem, setting the cascade evaluation standard of each evaluation index, and constructing an evaluation index system capable of fully reflecting the weak link and the severity of the rural power grid; determining equipment with modification requirements according to the index values, taking the equipment as an evaluation object, scoring the evaluation object according to the scoring standard of the evaluation indexes, determining the weight among all the evaluation indexes by adopting a CRITIC method, calculating the comprehensive score of the evaluation object, and finishing the graded combination score of the evaluation object; and performing descending order according to the size of the comprehensive scores, and preferentially modifying the equipment with the front ranking of the scores so as to realize the modification of the rural power grid.

title_en: Intelligent assessment method and system for landslide risk of tunnel peripheral area
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geologic material analysis, in particular to an intelligent assessment method and system for landslide risk in a tunnel peripheral region. According to the method, an initial data set with high information density is constructed through geologic elastic wave data analysis, the quality and efficiency of data screening are improved, the fine observation of stress distribution and earth surface displacement in the data selection process is optimized, the capturing capacity of dynamic change of geologic conditions is enhanced, cracks and cavities in geologic media are accurately analyzed through simulating elastic wave propagation, finer geologic heterogeneity insight is provided, landslide triggering factors are calibrated more accurately by the method, high risk areas can be effectively identified and evaluated, the risk management and early warning accuracy of tunnels and key infrastructure are greatly improved, and potential geologic disaster influence is reduced.

title_en: Intelligent monitoring method and system for energy consumption and carbon emission of data center
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent monitoring method and system for energy consumption and carbon emission of a data center, which are characterized in that energy consumption monitoring data and environmental data in an operating environment of the data center are monitored, a time sequence analysis is adopted to identify an energy consumption mode and generate hierarchical quality configuration, marginal utility evaluation is carried out based on the energy consumption mode to determine an accuracy configuration boundary, a carbon source strength index is generated through influence strength evaluation and is converted into an influence coverage area, a carbon propagation network is constructed by analyzing a change track of the environmental data, a key propagation path is obtained and a monitoring network is reconstructed, an abnormal propagation range of the influence coverage area is evaluated to determine a monitoring expansion area, a self-adaptive monitoring configuration is constructed and an emission reduction potential area is identified, the emission reduction potential area is decomposed into space monitoring nodes and is subjected to utility weight distribution, a matrix operation is carried out through a differentiated monitoring sequence to generate an energy consumption carbon emission analysis matrix, and finally, a monitoring configuration parameter is generated through statistical evaluation, so that intelligent monitoring management of the energy consumption and carbon emission of the data center is realized.

title_en: Contactless temperature measurement system using wireless network
title_ko: 무선통신을 이용한 비접촉 체온 측정 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A contactless body temperature measuring system using wireless communications is provided to reduce a degree of danger by a secondary infection of a temperature measurer. CONSTITUTION: An input part(11) directs the body temperature measurement of a user. A temperature sensor part(12) is comprised of an infrared temperature detection sensor measuring body temperature by the order of the input part. A transmitter(15) transmits data measured in the temperature sensor part to a wireless access point device. A receiver(16) receives information transmitted from a server. An amplifier(14) increases recognition distance through the transmitter and a power amplifier within a wireless module of the receiver. The wireless access point device transmits body temperature data measured by the temperature sensor part to the server.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 각종 발열성 질환자에 대한 조기 대응 및 위급 상황에 대한 정보수집과 각종 상황별 관제를 가능하게 해주는 시스템으로써, 발열성 질환의 2차 감염의 위험도가 높은 곳에 무선AP기를 설치하고 무선AP기를 설치한 USN-zone에서 체온 측정용 RF 단말기를 통하여 체온 측정을 한 후, 측정된 데이터를 무선AP기를 통해서 서버로 전송되는 것으로 구성된다. 좀 더 상세하게는 임의의 영역에 무선AP기를 설치하고 AP의 전파가 닿는 곳인 USN-zone내에 있는 RF 단말기들로부터 전송된 데이터를 무선AP기를 통하여 서버로 전송되는 것으로, 상기 RF 단말기는 적외선 온도 감지 센서를 이용한 체온 측정이 가능하며, 무선AP기를 통하여 전송되는 서버의 정보를 LCD나 스피커를 통해 알려주게 된다. 상기 무선AP기는 온도 측정용 RF 단말기의 데이터, 무선AP기의 위치정보, 무선AP기와 직접 연결되거나 원격지에 설치된 센서에서 보내오는 수질측정센서 데이터, 화재센서 데이터, 습도센서 데이터 등을 서버로 전송 가능한 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Ambient vibration monitoring and processing method for building
title_ko: 건물 상시진동 모니터링 및 측정치 처리 방법
abstract_en: The present invention is to perform simultaneous control on a vibration measurement apparatus of a plurality of unspecific buildings by regularly measuring and recording vibration of a building, transmitting the vibration to an integrated server (40) at a remote place to integrally manage the vibration, and transmitting the vibration through a push service of a wireless network (60) when an abnormal situation like an earthquake or the like occurs. According to the present invention, not only a regular vibration measurement value of the building can be effectively collected and measured, but also measurement facilities installed in the plurality of unspecific buildings can be integrally controlled even when the abnormal situation like the earthquake or the like occurs, thereby collecting time series primitive information transmitted by a vibration sensor (30), and integrally managing the collected information. Therefore, the utilization of the information can be improved.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 건물의 진동을 상시 계측하여 기록함과 동시에, 이를 원격지의 통합서버(40)로 전송하여 통합관리하고, 지진 등 이상 상황 발생시 이를 무선망(60) 푸시 서비스를 통하여 전파함으로써, 불특정 다수 건물의 진동 계측 장치에 대한 동시 제어가 가능하도록 한 것이다. 
본 발명을 통하여, 건물의 상시진동 계측치를 효율적으로 수집 및 관리할 수 있을 뿐 아니라, 지진 등 이상 상황 발생시에도 불특정 다수의 건물에 설치된 계측설비를 일시에 제어하여, 진동센서(30)에서 송출되는 시계열 원시정보를 누락 없이 수집할 수 있으며, 수집된 정보를 통합 관리함으로써, 정보의 활용도를 제고할 수 있다.

title_en: Private network mirroring
abstract_en: Techniques for private network mirroring are described. Users can select one or more existing private networks to be mirrored in the same or different network area. Any network configuration changes made in the selected private network (e.g., “master” private network) can be propagated automatically to the mirror private network. This enables users to utilize resources in another network area for disaster recovery, ensuring that the network configuration of the mirror private network is consistent with the master private network through real-time updates. Additionally, users managing infrastructure that includes multiple private networks can select one master private network and propagate configuration changes to other private networks, reducing management overhead incurred by these multi-private network installations.

title_en: Mechanical fire-fighting arm
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of mechanical fire-fighting arms, including sequentially connected mounting base, linking arm, main working arm and spherical rotatable work hand, the rotatable work of spherical shape is equipped with water mist from spray apparatus and Explosionproof camera on hand, the water mist connects fire-fighting pipeline from spray apparatus, the Explosionproof camera is electrically connected control system by high temperature resistant communication network wired link, and the linking arm and main working arm outer surface are equipped with fire behavior and forecast detection system.The fire-fighting arm of the utility model passes through linking arm, the cascaded coordination of working arm and rotatable work hand so that water mist expands from the rotatable range of spray apparatus, can put out a fire to the comprehensive no dead angle of six degree of freedom.Fire behavior forecast detection system can be monitored environment, and Explosionproof camera can shoot ignition point fire behavior, easy to operation and control immediately.

title_en: Earthquake damage prediction and prevention system and method thereof
abstract_en: A seismic damage prediction and prevention system (1) for determining impacts or damages caused by an earthquake to objects associated with different geographical locations (A, B, C, D) is presented. A central unit having a filter module selects and collects seismic related data for a plurality of network elements. At least one impact ratio table (151) is stored, the impact ratio table (151) having a first data structure for storing geographical and/or topographic data coordinates of different geographical locations (A, B, C, D). The geometric distance of the geographic location (A, B, C, D) from the source/epicenter (2) is generated by an intensity calculation module (104) having a coordinate processor. The propagation calculation unit of the intensity calculation module (104) generates local intensity values based on the generated geometric distances and the given seismic amplitude using a stored parametric setting comprising variable weighting parameters, while the generated geometric distances assigned to the corresponding geographical locations (A, B, C, D) are stored using a second data structure of the impact ratio table (151). Receiving, from a plurality of users, at least one of: a variable weight parameter and/or at least one impact ratio representing different seismic intensity levels of impact or damage caused to the object by the earthquake and/or at least one object parameter defining the seismic exposure structure of the object. The index calculation module (105) generates a shock index for the geographical location (A, B, C, D) by determining in each case a shock ratio of the local intensity at the respective geographical location (A, B, C, D) from the shock ratio table (151) and adding the shock ratios weighted in each case by the weighting factor assigned to the respective geographical location (A, B, C, D).

title_en: Short-term optimized scheduling method and system for cascade reservoir group
abstract_en: The invention discloses a short-term optimized dispatching method and a short-term optimized dispatching system for a cascade reservoir group, which belong to the field of cooperative optimized dispatching of water-fire power stations, and are characterized in that the fitness of each individual in an initial population is obtained, and the positions of an optimal fitness individual, a suboptimal fitness individual and a third optimal fitness individual in the population are updated; then updating the positions of all individuals in the population and generating a temporary population; screening the population by adopting a variation strategy based on the population and the temporary population obtained after updating all individual positions of the population; and the self-adaptive boundary strategy is adopted to effectively prevent the population from falling into local optimum. And updating all individual positions in the population through iteration, and outputting the individual position with the optimal fitness as the optimal scheduling process of the cascade hydropower system after the stop condition is reached. The method has the advantages of high convergence speed, high solving precision, strong optimizing capability, capability of effectively avoiding being trapped in local optimal solution and the like, can well coordinate the water-fire power station cooperative scheduling among the power grids, improves the economic benefit, and has very high practical value.

title_en: Power network vulnerability assessment method based on multiple attack strategies
abstract_en: A method for evaluating the vulnerability of an electric power system based on multiple attack strategies comprises the following steps: 1) and constructing a power grid model. 2) The node importance in the network is evaluated from four aspects of node degree, betweenness, local centrality and node fault loss, and the establishment of an attack strategy is completed according to the network node importance. 3) And establishing an betweenness virtual flow model to simulate the process of cascading fault propagation in the power system. 4) Establishing a vulnerability index based on the betweenness virtual flow model, simulating network attack by adopting various attack strategies, and evaluating the vulnerability of the IEEE300 power system network according to the change of the vulnerability index. Aiming at the vulnerability of the power network under the condition of various attack strategies, the method establishes an betweenness virtual flow model and the various attack strategies to analyze the performance change of the power grid under the cascade failure. The method can identify the importance of the nodes in the power network and provide decision support for maintenance work of power system managers and designers when power system fault prevention is carried out.

title_en: Forest fire detection method based on cascade network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a forest fire detection method based on a cascade network, which is characterized in that a smoke flame detection network comprising a global feature extraction network and a local feature extraction network is designed by an MC-YOLOv5s structure, forest fire local images and suspicious mist local images are detected aiming at forest shooting images, primary forest fire detection is realized, and according to the conditions that the forest fire local images do not exist and the suspicious mist local images exist, the preset meteorological element values of a forest area when the suspicious mist local images are shot are combined, a smoke classification network of an SCN structure design is further applied, classification analysis is carried out aiming at the suspicious mist local images, and secondary forest fire detection is realized by distinguishing smoke or mist, so that forest fire false alarm phenomena are effectively avoided, and forest fire detection precision is improved.

title_en: Pre-disaster scheduling pre-control method and system for considering line load rate under complex weather
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pre-disaster scheduling pre-control method and system for considering line load rate under complex weather, comprising the following steps: acquiring network parameters of a power grid, and acquiring a line affected by a disaster; constructing a disaster prevention pre-control scheduling mathematical model considering the load balance degree of the power grid according to the network parameters of the power grid and the disaster affected line; the optimization target of the model comprises the steps of taking the minimization of the average load rate of a line affected by disaster as an optimization target I, taking the minimization of the average absolute deviation of the load rate of the whole network transmission line as an optimization target II and taking the minimum running cost of the electric power system as an optimization target III; and solving the model to obtain a pre-disaster power dispatching scheme of the generator output and power flow distribution of the power grid. The invention realizes the effects of lower line load affected by disaster and more balanced overall load rate of the power grid, reduces the probability of cascade overload shutdown accidents caused by shutdown of the line affected by disaster, and improves the running reliability of the power grid and the toughness for resisting the influence of the disaster.
assignees: UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;JINHUA POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Structural seismic response prediction method and system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The embodiment of the specification provides a structural seismic response prediction method and a system based on deep learning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: based on the dynamic characteristics of the structure, extracting parameter indexes of all seismic records in a seismic database, and constructing a parameter index set; carrying out nonlinear time-course analysis NLTHA on the parameter index set, and calculating response results of the structure recorded in all earthquake motions to obtain a structure reaction set; carrying out multiple rounds of comparison and selection on the parameter indexes through an artificial neural network, and selecting a parameter index chain set of the optimal combination; and training the BP neural network based on the parameter index chain set and the structure reaction set of the optimal combination, and predicting earthquake responses of other structures through the trained BP neural network. The invention realizes the quick, accurate and wide-application-range earthquake response prediction method through the error back propagation algorithm in the deep learning.

title_en: Multi-heat source cooperative heat supply energy cascade utilization optimization method
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-heat source cooperative heat supply energy cascade utilization optimization method. The multi-heat source energy cascade control method based on the heat load demand gap is established by orderly combining four energy supply forms of a heat supply secondary network, a ground source, a water source and an air source, the multi-energy heat supply control system based on an autonomous controllable hardware architecture is used for realizing multi-stage optimal utilization of heat supply energy, the dependence degree on a single heat source is reduced to the greatest extent, the diversification of heat supply carriers is obviously promoted, and a new clean energy heat supply mode is realized.
assignees: DATANG NORTHEAST ELECTRIC POWER TEST & RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Vulnerability stain detection system based on industrial asset fingerprint identification
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of vulnerability detection, in particular to a vulnerability taint detection system based on industrial asset fingerprint identification. The invention acquires the flow data of each industrial asset device in operation in real time to generate fingerprint information, matches the data acquired in real time with a vulnerability database according to the fingerprint information, identifies the known vulnerability, deduces a possible stain propagation path according to network topology and a stain source by constructing a network topology diagram, identifies the affected device, evaluates the flow change of the affected device, calculates the influence degree of the stain source on the network to identify abnormal activities in the stain propagation process, evaluates the network security risk, and timely adjusts a monitoring strategy and a threshold value according to the evaluation result so as to ensure the accuracy and the reliability of a monitoring system.

title_en: Hydrogen energy system safety assessment method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydrogen energy system safety assessment method based on deep learning, which comprises the following steps of S1, collecting dynamic operation parameters of a hydrogen energy system and preprocessing the parameters to generate an input feature matrix, S2, inputting the feature matrix into a multi-resolution feature sensing module to generate a high-dimensional feature map, S3, inputting the high-dimensional feature map into a dynamic time bending network to generate a parameter association matrix, S4, optimizing feature weight distribution based on a self-adaptive differential evolution algorithm, S5, capturing abnormal distribution through a dynamic map convolution network to generate a dynamic abnormal map, S6, simulating an abnormal propagation path, generating a cascading abnormal analysis result by combining a dynamic tracing mechanism, S7, optimizing the cascading abnormal analysis result through a gray wolf-firefly hybrid optimization algorithm, and S8, adjusting the dynamic operation parameters based on a final cascading risk prediction result to finish the hydrogen energy system safety assessment. The method combines deep learning and a hybrid optimization algorithm and the like, and realizes safety assessment of anomaly detection and risk prediction of the hydrogen energy system.
assignees: SHAANXI ZHONGYUAN SHANGQING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for adjusting annual power generation plan of step hydropower under electric power market environment before month
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of hydroelectric power generation, and discloses a method for adjusting a cascade hydroelectric annual power generation plan before month in an electric power market environment, which comprises the steps of firstly constructing a power generation plan adjustment model, modeling benefits and operation requirements of hydroelectric power generation, inter-provincial power transmission and provincial power consumption, introducing opportunity constraint to describe risks of water level overrun of a hydropower station caused by runoff uncertainty, constructing two indexes of line disturbance rate and contract net adjustment rate to respectively manage influences of contract adjustment on a power transmission side and a power consumption side, modeling points on coupling relations between two types of power transmission modes of a network and a network-to-network and multi-provincial and multi-variety contracts, and then constructing The solving method is used for converting the power generation plan adjustment model into an SAA model and iteratively adjusting the risk level of the SAA model And finally, obtaining a contract adjustment scheme of the step hydropower. The invention can effectively solve the problem of contract adjustment, and the provided solving method can accelerate the obtaining of a feasible solution with high confidence on the basis of ensuring the solving precision.

title_en: Method and system for regulating and controlling stable operation of circuit board of industrial control equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of automatic control and discloses a method and a system for regulating and controlling the stable operation of a circuit board of industrial control equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps of analyzing the characteristics of the circuit board corresponding to the circuit board of the industrial control equipment, analyzing the operation stability factor of the circuit board, and deploying a multisource heterogeneous sensing network of the circuit board; the method comprises the steps of collecting multisource heterogeneous data of a circuit board, analyzing industrial control characteristics of the circuit board, constructing a dynamic stability matrix of the circuit board, determining an environment disturbance propagation path of the circuit board in the dynamic stability matrix, calculating a parameter fluctuation variance of the dynamic stability matrix of the circuit board, generating a stability margin index of the circuit board, determining a dynamic regulation parameter of the circuit board, analyzing a twin stability optimization coefficient of the dynamic regulation parameter, and executing stable operation regulation of the circuit board by utilizing the dynamic regulation parameter when the twin stability optimization coefficient is larger than a preset threshold value. The invention can improve the timeliness and accuracy of circuit board regulation and control.

title_en: Intelligent fault tree generation method and system based on joint simulation and dynamic causal reasoning
abstract_en: An intelligent fault tree generation method and system based on joint simulation and dynamic causal reasoning relate to the technical field of fault trees and solve the problems of low artificial construction efficiency, high hidden failure path omission rate and disjoint model and operation and maintenance data of a complex system fault tree. The method comprises the steps of constructing a system joint simulation model with multiple physical field coupling, capturing propagation paths of faults among functional units in real time to generate a fault propagation map, constructing a minimum cut set based on Monte Carlo simulation AND Bayesian network reasoning, automatically adapting an AND/OR logic gate to generate a fault tree, AND dynamically updating a knowledge map by combining an online learning technology. The invention has good application prospect in the field of health management of high-safety-requirement equipment.

title_en: Same-city distribution intelligent order and path planning method and system based on real-time road condition
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for intelligent distribution and path planning in the same city based on real-time road conditions, which relate to the technical field of path planning and comprise the steps of collecting real-time road condition information to construct time-space road network characteristics, calculating transit time cost, constructing order time-space correlation characteristics based on historical tracks, calculating order time-space overlapping degree, dynamically adjusting a clustering algorithm by using association strength, calculating an initial distribution path for clustered order clusters, and carrying out risk assessment and path optimization by a road congestion propagation model. The invention can improve the distribution efficiency, reduce the delay risk and adapt to complex and changeable urban traffic environments.

title_en: Auxiliary radio communication system based on optical cable
title_ko: 광케이블 기반 무선통신 보조 설비 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an auxiliary wireless communication facility system based on optical cables. The auxiliary wireless communication facility system includes: a wireless communication module which transmits, receives, and relays wireless communication signals including, at least, fire radio signals and disaster broadcast signals while additionally including terrestrial trunked radio (TETRA) signals and public safety LTE (PS-LTE) signals; a master unit (MU) which converts electric signals corresponding to the wireless communication signals to optical signals using multiplexing and wavelength division schemes to output the optical signals as well as converting the optical signals converted by using multiplexing and wavelength division schemes before being transmitted through optical cables to the electric signals to transmit the electric signals to an optical module; multiple remote units (RUs) which is installed in a high-rise building or under the ground with a weak wave propagation rate and transmits and receives the optical signals converted by using multiplexing and wavelength division schemes; and an optical coupler which generates the optical signals converted by using the multiplexing and wavelength division schemes to be output from the MU in a number matching the number of the RUs, transmits the optical signals to the individual RUs through the optical cables, and couples the optical signals converted by using the multiplexing and wavelength division schemes before being transmitted to the individual RUs to transmit the optical signals through the optical cables. Each of the RUs can receive the optical signals converted by using the multiplexing and wavelength division schemes from the optical coupler, converts the optical signals to wireless communication signals, outputs the wireless communication signals to enable the communication with wireless communication devices, and receives the wireless communication signals from the wireless communication devices to convert the wireless communication signals to the electric signals and generate the optical signals converted by using multiplexing and wavelength division schemes. The optical signals can be transmitted to the optical coupler through the optical cables.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 광케이블 기반의 무선통신 보조설비 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 그 무선통신 보조설비 시스템은 적어도 소방무선신호 및 재난방송 신호를 포함하고, TETRA 신호와, PS-LTE 신호가 더 포함될 수 있는 무선통신 신호들을 송수신 및 중계하는 무선통신모듈과, 그 무선통신 신호들에 상응하는 전기신호를 파장분할 다중화된 광신호로 변환하여 출력하고, 광케이블을 통해 수신되는 파장분할 다중화된 광신호를 전기신호로 변환하여 무선통신 모듈로 전달하는 광모듈을 구비하는 마스터장비(MU); 전파의 도달이 원활하지 않는 지하나 고층건물에 설치되며, 파장분할 다중화된 광신호를 송수신하는 복수의 리모트 장비(RUs); 및 마스터 장비로부터 출력되는 파장분할 다중화된 광신호를 복수의 리모트 장비 수 만큼 생성하여 광케이블을 통해 리모트 장비 각각에게 전달하고, 리모트 장비 각각으로부터 수신되는 파장분할 다중화된 광신호를 결합하여 광케이블을 통해 전달하는 광커플러를 포함하고, 리모트 장비 각각은 광커플러로 부터 파장분할 다중화된 신호를 수신하여 무선통신기기들과 통신할 수 있는 무선통신 신호로 변환하여 출력하고, 무선통신 기기들로부터 무선통신 신호를 수신하여 전기신호로 변환하여 파장분할 다중화된 신호로 생성하여 광케이블을 통해 광커플러로 전송한다.

title_en: Mesh-Based Village Broadcasting Device and Method
title_ko: 메시 기반 마을 방송 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: A message-based village broadcasting apparatus is proposed according to an embodiment of the present invention to solve problems of a smart village broadcasting system, including technical accessibility issues, a requirement for an Internet connection, privacy concerns, cost issues, and participation rate issues. The apparatus comprises: a speech recognition unit configured to recognize content spoken through a microphone by a user and convert the recognized speech into text; a message management unit configured to manage editing of the recognized text, schedule management such as setting a transmission time and retransmission, transmission and reception of text messages, reception confirmation and inquiry through a touchscreen, history management of emergency situation dissemination, message transmission/reception requests, expansion of additional functions (for example, situation dissemination when an emergency occurs through video monitoring, warning lamp notification during an emergency situation, etc.), and other functions; a message transmission/reception unit configured to manage transmission and reception of messages and processing of transmission/reception errors according to a request from the message management unit; and a speech synthesis unit configured to synthesize the received text into voice and output the synthesized voice through a speaker. In addition, the apparatus and method can minimize the amount of transmission and reception data by converting broadcast content, which is voice, into text and transmitting the text, and can eliminate dependence on Internet infrastructure by synthesizing the text back into voice at a receiving side for listening.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실 시예에 따른 스마트 마을 방송의 기술접근성 문제, 인터넷 연결 필요, 개인정보 보호 우려, 비용 문제, 참여율 문제를 해결하기 위한 메시 기반 마을 방송 장치가 제안되며, 상기 장치는 전달하려고 하는 내용을 마이크로 통해 말로하면 이를 인식하여 문자로 변환하는 음성 인식; 상기 인식된 문자를 편집하거나, 언제 보낼지, 재전송하는 등의 스케줄 관리, 문자의 전송이나 수신, 터치스크린에 의한 수신확인 및 조회, 응급상환 전파 등에 대한 이력관리, 문자를 전송이나 수신 요청하는 메시지 전송/수신, 추가 기능(예: 영상감시를 통한 응급상황 발생 시 상황전파, 비상 상황시 경광등 알림, ...) 확장 및 기타 등을 관리하는 메시지 관리; 상기 메시지 관리 요청에 의해서 문자의 송수신, 송수신 오류 처리 등의 관리를 하는 메시지 송수신; 상기 수신된 문자를 음성으로 합성해서 스피커로 전달하는 음성 합성 등에 대한 상기 장치 및 방법으로 구성된다. 이외에 방송 내용인 음성을 문자로 변화해서 송수신 데이터의 량을 최소화해서 전송후, 수신측에서 다시 문자를 음성으로 합성하여 청취함으로써 인터넷 인프라의 의존성을 제외할 수 있다.

title_en: Method and apparatus of using drive test data for propagation model calibration
abstract_en: A method using drive test data for propagation model calibration includes: step 1, obtaining original drive test data; step 2, selecting the data from the drive test data according to predefined conditions as effective drive test data; and step 3, extracting the effective drive test data to form a data file used for propagation model calibration. An apparatus using drive test data for propagation model calibration includes: a drive test data obtaining module, configured to obtain the drive test data in the regions to be calibrated; an effective drive test data generation module, configured to generate effective drive test data from the drive test data according to predefined conditions; and a data file generation module, configured to extract the effective drive test data to form a data file used for propagation model calibration. The present invention utilizes drive test data of existing networks to largely decrease the CW test work and reduce the network building cost. It is believed that the calibrated model can relatively accurately reflect the propagation characteristics in the field. Furthermore, base stations can be optimally allocated.

title_en: Earthquake alert method and system using wireless terminals
abstract_en: An earthquake alert system using wireless terminals and a method for providing an earthquake alert are provided. The system includes at least one wireless terminal for detecting vibration greater than a predetermined amount and transmitting vibration information generated based on the vibration, and a mobile communication network for transmitting the vibration information to an emergency management agency, and if it is notified by the emergency management agency that the vibration information is caused by an earthquake, determining a propagation direction of the earthquake and transmitting an earthquake alert message to wireless terminals located in the earthquake propagation direction.

title_en: Depth calculation model for gas path fault diagnosis of aircraft engine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a depth calculation model for gas path fault diagnosis of an aircraft engine, which belongs to the technical field of computers and comprises the following steps: (1) carrying out segmentation pretreatment on the continuous flight performance data; (2) extracting spatial features of the data object blocks by using a convolutional neural network; (3) learning local nonlinear features in the data object blocks using a multi-layered perceptron; (4) extracting long-term dependence features in the data object block by using a recurrent neural network; (5) the deep hybrid model is trained using an end-to-end approach, i.e., a joint error back-propagation algorithm. The characteristics of an aircraft engine model are considered in the implementation of the method, the spatial characteristics, the nonlinear characteristics and the long-term dependence characteristics of the gas circuit performance data generated by the model are fused, the aircraft gas circuit fault diagnosis model is constructed, and a joint error back propagation algorithm is designed for end-to-end training of the deep hybrid model by taking a classification task as a target.

title_en: Multistage scheduling mechanism coordinated step hydropower station real-time scheduling water abandoning reduction method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of hydropower dispatching operation, and particularly relates to a cascade hydropower station real-time dispatching water abandoning reduction method coordinated by a multi-stage dispatching mechanism. The method can carry out real-time plan quick adjustment on the water abandon possibly generated in the day at the cascade centralized control center end by considering the load balance and the stable operation factors of the power grid, improve the receptivity of the total dispatching and the intermediate dispatching to the real-time dispatching scheme, or reduce the adjustment range of the total dispatching and the intermediate dispatching to the centralized control proposal real-time dispatching scheme, and improve the real-time dispatching coordination efficiency of the multistage dispatching mechanism.

title_en: Opportunity constraint considered maximum energy supply capacity evaluation method for electrical coupling system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an evaluation method for the maximum energy supply capacity of an electric coupling system in consideration of opportunity constraint, which comprises the steps of constructing an evaluation model for the maximum energy supply capacity of the electric coupling system in consideration of random wind energy output and opportunity constraint; secondly, converting the wind energy output joint opportunity constraint into an equivalent mixed integer linear constraint group by adopting a Boolean reconstruction method; then, converting the model into a mixed integer second-order cone programming model containing a penalty term by adopting a convex-concave method; and finally, decomposing the model into power grid and gas grid submodels for distributed iterative solution based on a target cascade analysis method. According to the method, the coupling relation of the power grid and the air network is fully considered, the influence of the output randomness of the fan is considered, and a maximum energy supply capacity evaluation model of the electric coupling system is established; the method is based on a target cascade decomposition method, decomposes the integral model into a power grid sub-model and a power grid sub-model for distributed independent solution, and meets the actual engineering requirements better.

title_en: Remote sensing image change detection method combining U-shaped network and self-attention mechanism
abstract_en: The invention provides a remote sensing image change detection method combining a U-shaped network and a self-attention mechanism, which mainly solves the problems of large occupation of a video memory and complex network structure in the prior art, and comprises the following implementation steps of 1) acquiring a training sample set and a test sample set; the method comprises the steps of 2) constructing a U-shaped change detection network model, namely, a multi-scale feature extraction module, a layered self-attention mechanism, a fusion up-sampling module and a classifier which are sequentially cascaded, 3) inputting a training sample set into the U-shaped change detection network model and carrying out iterative training on the training sample set by using a counter-propagation method, and 4) inputting a test sample set into the trained U-shaped change detection network model to obtain a remote sensing image change detection visual map and a numeric result. The invention realizes lightweight change detection, obtains multi-scale fine granularity characteristics, reduces the complexity of a network structure, improves the detection precision, reduces the calculation resources, and can be used for geological disaster detection, urban planning and forest destruction detection.

title_en: Method, system, electronic equipment and storage medium for evaluating cascade influence of local energy crisis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a local energy crisis cascade influence evaluation method, a system, electronic equipment and a storage medium based on an input-output model, which mainly comprise the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining an energy supply pressure index, obtaining an energy shortage probability, obtaining energy crisis sensitivity, obtaining energy crisis and cascade influence evaluation and determining a key supply link path. The invention provides a monetization index of the energy crisis, analyzes cascade influence from a view angle of a supply chain, namely analyzes the transfer relation and a driving mechanism of the energy crisis in an area department, identifies a supply chain conduction path of the energy crisis, has the advantages of wide application range, quick calculation mode and the like, and can provide a method and data support for improving the toughness of a trade network to the energy crisis.

title_en: Vulnerability assessment method based on mixed transmission allocation factors
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vulnerability assessment method based on mixed transmission allocation factors, which belongs to the technical field of interdependent network vulnerability assessment and comprises the steps of constructing a coupling system model comprising an electric power network layer, a hydrogen energy network layer and a logistics network layer, respectively calculating the transmission allocation factors of the electric power network layer, the hydrogen energy network layer and the logistics network layer, establishing an interlayer sensitivity coupling relation through a coupling weight matrix, forming a global mixed transmission allocation factor (MTDF) matrix by adopting a layered sensitivity calculation and cross-layer coupling mapping technology, realizing cross-layer influence quantification of new energy output fluctuation, automatically identifying key fragile nodes and establishing a cascading fault propagation model, and solving the technical problem of assessing the coupling vulnerability of a three-layer network of a green harbor electric power-hydrogen energy-logistics by calculating L2 norm to propose a vulnerability assessment index before and after a fault.

title_en: Power grid cable wiring path optimization method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a power grid cable wiring path optimization method and device, the method comprises the steps of carrying out load analysis on geographic distribution data and electricity consumption data of a power grid system to generate load region types and weight data corresponding to the region types, carrying out fault propagation risk assessment on power grid nodes in the power grid system according to the load region types and the weight data, generating a cable capacity scheme according to a risk assessment result, generating a candidate path set through a multi-objective balance mechanism and an adaptive path growth algorithm according to the load region types, the weight data and the cable capacity scheme, and carrying out toughness evaluation and optimization on the candidate path set under the preset multiple simulation scene conditions to generate the power grid cable wiring scheme. According to the invention, the distribution characteristics of the power grid load, the fault propagation risk and the system toughness are comprehensively considered, a cable wiring scheme which is suitable for a complex load environment and has fault resistance capability can be generated, and the reliability and the stability of a power grid system are obviously improved.

title_en: Earthquake regulating type stand chair
title_ko: 지진통제형 관람석
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an earthquake-controlled seat, which can minimize the casualties as save evacuation induction of a visitor and on-site control are quickly made when detecting an earthquake, while automatically detecting the occurrence of the earthquake, at the same time. According to one embodiment of the present invention, the earthquake-controlled seat comprises: a seat body provided in a public viewing facility and having a plurality of seat chairs cascaded in accordance with a plurality of rows and columns; an earthquake detection sensor installed in the seat body and detecting an intensity of vibration transmitted from the ground; an electronic board installed at one side of the public viewing facility; and an evacuation induction controller receiving a sensor signal of the earthquake detection sensor and displaying earthquake occurrence facts and emergency evacuation route information through the electronic board when detecting the vibration intensity over a set value.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 지진 발생여부가 자동으로 감지됨과 동시에 지진 감지시에 관람객의 안전한 대피유도와 현장 통제가 신속하게 이루어짐에 따라 인명피해가 최소화될 수 있도록 한 지진통제형 관람석에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 지진통제형 관람석은, 대중관람시설에 구비되고 복수의 관람석 의자가 다수의 행과 열에 맞춰 계단식으로 설치되는 관람석본체와, 상기 관람석본체에 설치되고 지면으로부터 전달되는 진동의 강도를 감지하는 지진감지센서와, 상기 대중관람시설의 일측에 설치되는 전광판과, 상기 지진감지센서의 센서신호를 수신하여 설정값 이상의 진동 강도 감지시에 상기 전광판을 통해 지진발생사실과 긴급대피로 정보를 표시하는 대피유도컨트롤러를 포함한다.

title_en: Maintaining computational flow in a data-dependent constraint network
abstract_en: Presented are methods for determining computational flow for a data-dependent constraint network that are especially useful for modeling and trading off alternative configurations in a single computational environment, during design analysis and optimization of an engineering system. These methods leverage a preexisting constraint management system that uses a bipartite graph of variables and constraints to model an engineering system and employ logic formulae based world sets to determine the applicability of the constraints to different system configurations. These methods ensure that a data-dependent constraint network is in a consistent state, and are the essential foundation for other techniques that rely on a consistent constraint network to produce computational plans for propagating values and uncertainties through the constraint network during tradeoff analyses.

title_en: Cascade hydropower station group daily power generation plan making method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascade hydropower station group daily power generation plan making method which comprises the steps that 1. turning-on-off constraint of a power plant power generator unit is not considered, the target that the similarity degree of the power generation load of a hydropower station group and the daily typical load of a power plant is highest is used as one of optimization targets, and a cascade hydropower station group daily power generation plan is obtained through primary optimization; 2. according to the cascade hydropower station group daily power generation plan, a power plant power generator unit turning-on-off state process is prepared; and 3. power plant power generator unit turning-on-off state process constraining conditions are increased, the target that the similarity degree of the power generation load of the hydropower station group and the daily typical load of the power plant is highest is used as an optimization target, and a cascade hydropower station group daily power generation plan is obtained through secondary optimization. Power grid requirements are considered, a hydropower station power generating strategy which accords with practical situations better can be obtained, and the method is suitable for single hydropower station and cascade hydropower station group daily power generation plan making.

title_en: Hydropower station group power generation electric scheduling rule extraction method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of hydropower station energy optimization, and particularly discloses a hydropower station group power generation regulation extraction method, which comprises the steps of establishing a target function with the maximum annual power generation amount of a hydropower station group as a target and a constraint condition thereof, and solving to obtain an optimal solution of output flow of each time period of each reservoir; establishing a generalized regression network by taking the input flow and the reservoir water level corresponding to each time interval of each reservoir as input and the output flow as output; and optimizing a generalized regression network smoothing factor to obtain a scheduling function by adopting a particle swarm method based on the known optimal solution of the input flow, the reservoir water level and the output flow corresponding to each time interval of each reservoir and the training error minimum objective function. According to the invention, deep learning and cascade hydropower station power generation scheduling are combined, the generalized regression network corresponding to the scheduling function is established, the cascade hydropower station power generation scheduling rule based on the community gravity particle swarm and the generalized regression network is extracted, the defect that the basic traditional particle swarm algorithm is easy to fall into local optimization is overcome, and the reliability is high.

title_en: Cascading failure successive cut-off disturbance setting method and system considering new energy grid connection influence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascading failure successive cut-off disturbance setting method and system considering new energy grid-connected influence, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing a boundary condition vector of a power grid severe fault simulation calculation mode based on the severe and harsh requirements of operating conditions; constructing a grid-connected new energy correlation requirement-based initial element set vector of successive cut-off of a power grid; constructing a sequential on-off element triggering condition set vector considering the fault ride-through characteristic of the new energy power supply; designing and designing a cascading failure successive cut-off disturbance setting flow influenced by new energy grid connection based on the boundary condition vector of the grid serious fault simulation calculation mode, the grid successive cut-off initial element set vector and the successive cut-off element triggering condition set vector; and acquiring a cascading failure successive switching disturbance final serious fault set considering the new energy grid connection influence based on the cascading failure successive switching disturbance setting process.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Network public opinion analysis method, device, system, equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a network public opinion analysis method, device, system, equipment and readable storage medium. The method disclosed by the application comprises the following steps: acquiring network information published by different propagation channels in real time; extracting hotspot information in the network information; analyzing the positive and negative trends of the hotspot information by using a Bayesian algorithm; and adding the positive and negative trends to a prediction parameter of the hotspot information, and predicting the public sentiment risk of the hotspot information according to the prediction parameter. The method and the device can predict the public opinion risk brought by the network information in time, so that the risk can be estimated in advance, and early warning is realized.

title_en: Connection maintaining method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a connection keeping method, a connection keeping device and electronic equipment, and belongs to the field of mobile communication. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a disaster relief message of a second network side; and responding to the disaster relief message, and executing a first operation to enable the terminal to maintain network connection. By the embodiment of the application, the terminal can still maintain network connection under the condition that the disaster of the second network is relieved, and service interruption is avoided.

title_en: Routing method applied to indoor fire-fighting communication
abstract_en: The invention discloses a routing method applied to indoor fire-fighting communication, which comprises the following steps: step 1: modeling a wireless signal propagation model under a scene to obtain related parameters; step 2: information interaction of scenes is realized through a neighbor discovery algorithm, and link duration LET is estimated; step 3: improving an intra-area routing algorithm, and constructing an intra-area routing table based on LET; step 4: the route discovery process is improved and inter-area routes are updated based on the LETs. The invention estimates the link duration by combining the indoor propagation model and the node motion state on the basis of the original ZRP, so that the node can predict the link state, thereby maximizing the route survival time. Through simulation verification, the method can reduce the end-to-end time delay, reduce the packet loss rate and improve the network throughput.
assignees: UNIV XIDIAN;SHAANXI XILU ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Evaporation waveguide profile inversion method based on non-cooperative navigation radar signals
abstract_en: The invention relates to an evaporation waveguide profile inversion method based on non-cooperative navigation radar signals, which adopts a monitoring point space diversity method, distributes a plurality of sets of monitoring systems in a key monitoring sea area to form a monitoring network, jointly adopts a method of comparing amplitude direction finding, time delay locking and frequency division multiple access, detects and tracks and monitors the same navigation radar target signal, inverts evaporation waveguide profile distribution in a monitoring area by combining monitoring signal intensity differences of monitoring points at different receiving heights, and inverts evaporation waveguide profile distribution in a monitoring area by taking a short-range link evaporation waveguide inversion result as an initial value and further combining different navigation radar signal monitoring results, wherein links are from near to far, and inverts evaporation waveguide distribution in a large-scale sea area by utilizing assimilation and interpolation algorithms. The marine radar of the ship around the monitoring area is reasonably utilized to passively receive signals in real time, the section of the evaporation waveguide in a large-range sea area is inverted, the environmental characteristics of the propagation of the marine electromagnetic waves are obtained, and the beyond-the-horizon working requirements of the marine electromagnetic system are ensured.

title_en: Load prediction adjusting method and device of combined cycle power generation system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a load prediction adjusting method and device of a combined cycle power generation system, belongs to the technical field of combined cycle power generation, and solves the problems that when the traditional method processes unit data, an LSTM neural network model is poor in self-adaption and cannot avoid gradient dispersion on the unit data; the load prediction model is constructed by combining the group intelligent algorithm and the back propagation neural network, has the advantages of processing time sequence working parameters by the group intelligent algorithm and the back propagation neural network, can accurately output the load curve of the combined cycle power generation system in the next period, and provides a basis for distributed adjustment of the combined cycle power generation system.
assignees: XIAN THERMAL POWER RES INST CO;HUANENG JILIN POWER GENERATION CO LTD JIUTAI ELECTRIC FACTORY;HUANENG GUANGDONG ENERGY DEV CO LTD;HUANENG GROUP TECH INNOVATION CENTER CO LTD

title_en: Three-network collaborative power grid recovery method and system based on complex network theory
abstract_en: The invention provides a three-network collaborative power grid recovery method and system based on a complex network theory, which belong to the technical field of power systems, and effectively solve the problems that the traditional scheme only focuses on fault propagation in a single network, the simulation result and the actual physical condition of the traditional scheme are greatly different, and the traditional power grid recovery strategy mainly only considers a single traditional power generation power station due to the single structure of a current urban power station, so that the disaster recovery capability is poor, the disaster resistance capability is weak and the recovery strategy is not flexible enough.

title_en: Energy time sequence prediction method and device based on frequency domain decoupling and multi-scale fusion
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence and energy time sequence prediction, and provides an energy time sequence prediction method and device based on frequency domain decoupling and multi-scale fusion. The method comprises the steps of 1) carrying out feature embedding and normalization preprocessing on input energy time series data, 2) carrying out frequency domain analysis by adopting fast Fourier transform, carrying out multi-scale division and reconstruction according to the cycle length of a main cycle component so as to extract multi-scale cycle features, 3) constructing a double-branch structure combining a gating unit and a multi-head attention mechanism, respectively modeling long-term trend dependence and short-term dynamic features, 4) distinguishing the relationship between homogeneity and heterogeneity of variables based on pearson correlation coefficients, 5) realizing structured information propagation among multiple variables by utilizing a graph convolution network, and outputting prediction results of a plurality of time steps in the future through a linear projection layer, and 6) deploying the model in a plurality of energy monitoring systems for long-time sequence prediction of energy scenes such as natural gas flow, electric load, solar energy yield and the like. The method can effectively capture the association relation between the multi-scale periodic rule and the complex variable of the energy time sequence data, thereby improving the prediction precision of the energy system and the intelligent level of operation scheduling.

title_en: Enterprise risk early warning method, device, equipment and medium based on big data
abstract_en: The application relates to an enterprise risk early warning method, device, equipment and medium based on big data. The method comprises the steps of respectively extracting time dynamic characteristics and space topological characteristics of nodes through dynamic heterogeneous risk graphs, generating unified space-time embedded representation through cross-modal fusion, adopting nonlinear propagation effects of event logic enhanced dynamic heterogeneous composition attention network modeling risk events, outputting enhanced node representation and global representation, obtaining topology residual scores through deviation of topology residual detection calculation nodes and community mean values, obtaining representation similarity scores through minimum similarity of similarity analysis calculation nodes and known risk prototypes, linearly combining and normalizing the two scores to generate unknown risk scores, calculating the known risk probabilities based on a pre-training model, obtaining comprehensive risk indexes through maximum value operation, achieving comprehensive monitoring and early warning of known and unknown risks of enterprises, and remarkably improving coverage range, accuracy and timeliness of risk identification.

title_en: Portable IoT Sensor Kit for Smart Safety with Wireless Mesh and Artificial Intelligence
title_ko: 무선메쉬와 AI를 이용한 휴대가능한 지능형 화재예측 IoT센서 키트
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a portable intelligent fire prediction IoT sensor kit using wireless mesh and AI. As soon as power is applied, a sensor node composes a sensor network which can immediately transmit device information, measurement values, or the like of a sensor node itself to all the sensor nodes and intelligent connection nodes at low power through all adjacent sensor nodes and a wireless mesh network. When the sensor network is configured, the sensor node transmits measured sensor data through another sensor node or directly transmits to the intelligent connection node at a certain period or the moment when the data occurs in accordance with types. The intelligent connection node receives all the sensor data transmitted by the sensor node, stores the sensor data in a database of the control unit, and transmits the sensor data to a backend system. The control unit generates and modifies an artificial intelligence algorithm for predicting and determining the occurrence of fire through the sensor, location, and node information data in the database. Since fire detection, analysis, and prediction are possible by the sensor data, sensor data errors are removed, corrected, and accurate data is accumulated, so that an optimal prediction algorithm is generated and utilized.
abstract_ko:
국가적으로 큰 문제가 되고 있는 공공 및 민간 다중이용시설 (재래시장, 상가/쇼핑몰, 병원/요양원, 위락시설-극장, 실내놀이시설 등)에서의 화재발생과 유독가스 등의 누출시 발생 할 수 있는 대량 인명손실과 천문학적인 사회적 기회비용의 손해가 빈번히 발생하고 있는데, 이러한 화재 및 가스누출사고 발생시 즉각적으로 감지하고 징후를 판단하여 화재 확산의 예측이 가능하여 관련자 및 관련기관에 자동적으로 경보하고 전파하여 인명의 조기구조나 재산손실을 미연에 방지하기 위한 골든 타임을 확보 할 수 있도록 도와주는 (1) 경제적으로 보급이 가능하고  (2)구성 및 운용이 쉬우며 (3)휴대 또는 이동 하여 일반 초보자도 간편하게 사용 할 수 있는 화재 및 가스누출 등의 재난 방재와 사회안전 편익에 도움을 주는 “무선메쉬와 AI를 이용한 휴대가능한 지능형 화재예측 IoT센서 키트”에 관한 장치의 구성과  인공지능 프로그램에 관한 것이다 
      화재 재난현장에서 사용되는 사물인터넷(IoT) 스마트 센서는 센서데이터의 신뢰성이 매우 중요하기 때문에 센서데이타의 전송 신뢰도를 향상하기 위하여 센서 노드간에 연결성이 강화된 무선메쉬 센서네트워크를 구성하는 것이 안전하다.
