      아래 대표도 에서 보는 바와 같이, 센서노드는 전원이 인가되는 즉시 인접한 모든 센서노드와 무선메쉬네트워크를 통하여 센서노드 자신의 기기정보와 측정값 등을 모든 센서노드 및 지능형 접속노드에 저전력으로 즉각 전달 가능한 센서네트워크을 구성한다. 
      센서네트워크가 구성되면, 센서노드는 측정한 센서데이터를 종류에 따라서 일정주기 또는 데이터 발생 즉시 다른 센서노드를 통하거나 직접 지능형 접속노드에 전송한다. 
      지능형 접속노드는 센서노드가 전달한 모든 센서데이터를 수신하여 제어부의 데이터베이스에 저장하고 백엔드시스템에 전송한다. 제어부는 데이터베이스에서 센서, 위치 및 노드 정보 데이터를 통하여 화재예측 및 발생 판단을 위한 인공지능 알고리즘을 생성 및 수정한다. 
      지능형 접속노드에서 생성되는 인공지능 알고리즘(216) 및 백엔드시스템에서 생성되는 인공지능 알고리즘은 시간별, 센서별, 종류별 측정 데이터를 기준으로 각 센서의 오차 및 화재 발생 여부를 판단한다. 
     만일 인공지능 알고리즘이 화재 발생 상황이 일어났다고 판단한 경우, 지능형 접속노드(200)는 제어부를 통해 자동경보프로그램에 화재경보를 전달하며 자동경보프로그램은 관리자 등 관련자, 소방서 등 관련부처, 필요한 경우 미리 등록해둔 지자체에 화재 발생 사실과 해당 지능형 접속노드의 실제 위치정보를 전파한다. 
     센서데이타에 의해 화재 감지와 분석, 예측이 가능하기 때문에 센서데이터 오류를 제거하여, 보정하고 정확한 데이터를축적하여, 최적의 예측 알고리즘을 생성하여 활용한다. 
    센서데이타의 유형과 패턴에 따라 보다 정확한 분석을 위해 충분한 데이터를 확보하기 위하여 센서노드의 데이터 전송주기와 센서에서 측정되는 센서데이터 수치정보를 증가하여 전송하게하므로서 보다 밀도 있는 시계열 분석이 되도록 하여, 단기간내에 모든 데이터를 수집 분석하여  정확한 시나리오를 예측하고 이에 따른 경보 수준을 판단 한다. 
화재, 가스누출 등의 재난 방재 목적 이외에, 산업현장의 위험작업장, 예를 들면 유해가스 지역의 환경정보 감지 및 알람, 유류저장소, 원전과 같은 방사능 누출 지역, 고로, 사일로 등과 같은 시설파괴시 재해가 예상되는 장소나 기관의 구조물 등에도 간편하게 사용 할 수 있으며, 사회안전을 위한 공공SOC, 예를들면 교량, 도로, SOC구조물 등에서도 사용 할 수 있다.

title_en: Probabilistic model for cyber risk forecasting
abstract_en: A system and method are presented for forecasting the risk of cyber-attacks on targeted networks. The described technology quantifies linear and non-linear damages to network-dependent assets by propagating probabilistic distributions of events in sequence and time in order to forecast damages over specified periods. Damage-forecasts are used to estimate probabilistically time-varying financial losses for cyber-attacks. The described technology incorporates quantities and dependencies for pricing insurance, re-insurance, and self-insurance, assessing cost-benefit tradeoffs for sequenced implementation of security control measures, and detecting attacks in the targeted network.

title_en: Network playback of video programming after customer premises service interruption
abstract_en: An exemplary method includes monitoring a condition relating to power at a customer premises to automatically detect a power outage at the customer premises, the power outage causing an interruption to a video service provided through a network to a video device within the customer premises, sending a notice of the interruption through the network to a node having a video recorder in the network, recording, at the video recorder in the network, a video program that was being accessed by the video device within the customer premises before the interruption, at least from a point in the video program substantially corresponding to a point when the interruption occurred, and transmitting at least a portion of the recorded video program starting from the point substantially corresponding to the identified point when the interruption occurred, from the video recorder through the network to the video device within the customer premises.
assignees: POOLE R ANDREW;FARRIS ROBERT D;VERIZON COMMUNICATIONS INC

title_en: User notification for service interruption
abstract_en: System and methods for selecting customers to notify of a service interruption or outage are described. A network may receive an interruption notification indicating when a service interruption is to occur. In some examples, the interruption notification may also include a particular set of equipment, such as a base station, that will experience the interruption, such as being taken offline for maintenance or a power outage affecting the base station. A notification module determines which customers will be affected by the service interruption and transmits a notification to the customers, informing the customers of the service interruption.

title_en: Support data transmission and the visible ray of location and power line communication method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses visible ray and power line communication method and the device supporting data transmission and location, method includes: be coupled in electric lines of force be transmitted by transmitting signal；Extract and launch signal, according to the first signaling information from launching selection business information signal, merge the positional information of LED with carrying out automatic growth control process and frequency division multiplexing according to the source of location information, obtain merging signal；Merging signal sent into LED and merging signal is converted to current signal, by the luminous intensity of regulation LED, current signal being converted to visible light signal；Receive visible light signal, demodulate corresponding business information according to the second signaling information, and obtain LED location information.The signal of telecommunication of power line transmission is directly gone out by LED emission with line-of-sight propagation, and take into account data transmission and location application, there is network construction cost low, the advantages such as building time is fast, can be used for the fields such as intelligent grid, digital home, public safety monitoring.

title_en: Shield tunneling machine parameter optimization method based on deep neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a shield tunneling machine parameter optimization method based on a deep neural network. The invention utilizes a neural network algorithm to establish a forward model of the shield tunneling machine excavation parameters for predicting complex geological conditions, if an expected output value cannot be obtained in an output layer, the sum of squares of an output error and an expected error is taken as a target function, backward propagation is carried out, partial derivatives of the target function to each neuron weight are calculated layer by layer to form a gradient of the target function to the weight vector, the gradient is used as a basis for modifying the weight, and the learning of the network is completed in the weight modifying process. When real data are used for prediction, the model prediction value is consistent with the change rule of original data, the average error is within 12%, the lightweight and generalization capability of the model structure meet the field construction requirements, an effective scheme is provided for predicting the excavation parameters of the shield tunneling machine, and the method has certain practical value.

title_en: Multi-layer coupling power system risk propagation analysis method based on space-time diagram neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a time-space diagram neural network-based risk propagation analysis method for a multi-layer coupling power system, and belongs to the technical field of power systems. The method comprises the steps of constructing an information-electric power-traffic three-layer heterogeneous coupling network model, collecting physical quantity in the heterogeneous coupling network, constructing graph data based on neighborhood and connectivity, constructing a risk propagation prediction model based on a space-time multi-graph neural network, enabling a space learning network to comprise k parallel graph convolution layers, enabling a time learning network to be realized by combining a long-short-period memory network LSTM and an attention mechanism, obtaining history graph data of normal operation of the heterogeneous coupling network and history graph data with faults, inputting the history graph data into the prediction model for training, enabling the graph structure to be adaptively updated, and predicting a risk propagation path in the three-layer heterogeneous coupling network by using the trained risk propagation prediction model. The invention realizes the risk propagation path in the three-layer heterogeneous complex network structure of information-electric power-traffic and can reflect the real-time space-time relationship.

title_en: Zero-carbon power system modeling method and system based on closed-loop feedback optimization order reduction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a zero-carbon power system modeling method and system based on closed-loop feedback optimization order reduction, which relate to the field of zero-carbon power system modeling and combustion mechanism optimization, and are used for carrying out mechanism order reduction on a chemical reaction mechanism network of a zero-carbon power system to obtain a key reaction path; the method comprises the steps of adopting an improved dynamic force model to dynamically layout an energy network constructed based on a key reaction path to obtain a dynamic energy network, adopting a closed loop feedback mechanism to optimize the dynamic energy network to obtain a simplified mechanism network, obtaining multidimensional data based on the simplified mechanism network and extracting features to obtain a low-dimensional feature vector, and inputting the low-dimensional feature vector into a comprehensive mapping model to predict to obtain a prediction result of key combustion parameters. The method of the directed relation graph with the error propagation of the plasma is combined with a closed-loop feedback mechanism to reduce the order of a mechanism network, multidimensional data of the mechanism network is reduced in dimension, and the high-precision and quick response prediction of key combustion parameters is realized by utilizing a multi-model fusion strategy.

title_en: Heavy-duty card charging health evaluation method based on optimized graph rolling network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a re-card charging health evaluation method based on an optimized graph rolling network, which particularly relates to the technical field of electric operation and maintenance, and aims to realize space-time correlation modeling and intelligent maintenance path planning of the health state of a charging pile by collecting multi-source heterogeneous operation data of the charging pile and dividing a uniform time window, constructing a dynamic multi-graph structure integrating space, electric and behavior coupling relations, extracting local state evolution trend and neighbor influence factors of nodes to generate a joint feature vector, inputting features under the multi-time window into the multi-scale attention-enhanced graph rolling network to obtain joint potential health degree representation, calculating health scores based on the potential representation, identifying high risk nodes, constructing a potential failure propagation path map, combining the centrality index with degradation rate to generate a maintenance priority table, and outputting an optimized inspection path.

title_en: Oneself weather data transmitter and weather data reception indication method of net radio structure and system
title_ko: 그물 무선망 구조의 자체 기상정보 송신기와 기상정보 수신 표시 방법 및 장치
abstract_ko:
최근 정부에서는 세계인류의 녹색선진국을 건설하기 위한 핵심추진10대 과제중 기후변화재해에 대해 적극 대응하기 위한 대책등 기상에 대처할 수 있는 방법과 방안을 강구하고 있다. 실제적으로 실생활에서의 현지역에 실시간으로 기상을 국민이 접할 수 있는 네트워크 시스템이 구축되어 있지는 않다. 생활 활동을 시작하기전에 외부기온을 알고 싶어 하는데 내가 위치한 현재의 기상을 쉽게 바로 인지할 수있다면 에너지 절감을 위한 여러 행동을 할 것이다. 이러한 표시장치는 다소 제한적으로 독립된 방식으로는 있지만 전지역에 이러한 정보를 실시간에 전송해주고 이를 일반적으로 보편화된 장치로 수신을 할 수 있다면 기상변화에 바로 적응/대응 할 수 있을 것이다. 이를 위한 방법을 설계한 그물 무선구조망(Netted structure network)화된 현지기상 정보표시 방법 및 장치에 대한 것으로 자세히 말하면 일정 송신기능을 지닌 현지기상 송수신기(자가 송신 및  수신 저장기능을 내장한 소형 백엽상)에서 송출하는 정보를 일정주파수로 송신하도록 여러 지역에 분포시켜두고 각 송신단은 상호 특정지역에서 보내어지는 것을 상호 저장하여 이를 지속적으로 업데이트시켜 나가고 모든 지역의 기상을 알수 있도록 표시해줄 수 있는 수신기로 전송 받아 주거지역과 같은 공용아파트 같은 곳에서 기상정보를 실시간 표시함으로 현재 위치한 기상정보인 현지 기상의 변화에 적응할 수 있도록 하여 경제적 국가녹색성장에 기반적인 체계 구축이 되는 방법 및 장치가 될 것이다. 기상정보수집을 위한 독립전원 생성과 경제적 효율성과 저탄소의 효율을 위해 현지역의 기상을 수집하는 백엽상에 일정영역에서의 일정 주파수로 송수신기능을 추가한 백엽상을 전국적으로 분포시켜 두고, 각 백엽상 송수신단에서 발신된 정보를 수신할 수 있도록 하면 전국 어느 지역에서도 현지 실시간 기상정보와 계절별 지수를 알 수 있으며 이를 전파하는 다양한 유무선방법으로 실생활을 보다 윤택하게 할 것이다. 
       
     그물무선망, 기상정보, 무선전송, 표시장치, 휴대단말장치

title_en: Single-frequency propagation multi-channel calamity public emergency information system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a single-frequency propagation multi-channel calamity public emergency information system, comprising an information acquisition processing portion, a monitoring center processing portion, a transmitting portion and a terminal receiver; wherein the information acquisition processing portion comprises a monitoring computer, a calamity early warning information acquisition server, a science popularization information acquisition server, a public information acquisition server, and a convenient information acquisition server; the monitoring center processing portion comprises a VPN (Virtual Private Network) router, a monitoring center server, a short message operating platform, a short message monitor, a network switch, and a control computer. The single-frequency propagation multi-channel calamity public emergency information system of the utility model has the advantages of wide coverage, wide suitable objects, quick propagation, various functions, little environment affection, capacity for realizing public information, calamity alarm information, science popularization information and convenient information to the home, capacity for automatically broadcasting text information content in a voice way, etc.
assignees: HUIZHOU SUNTIM ELECTRONIC TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for identifying weak links of power grid in high-proportion new energy region
abstract_en: The method and the system for identifying the weak links of the regional power grid of the high-proportion new energy source judge that the power grid has the cascading failure if the connecting line has direct current when the capacity of the regional power grid is the same in order of magnitude as that of the external power grid and the short circuit ratio is more than 3; if the connecting lines have no direct current, reducing the number of fault connecting lines to perform stability control calculation, and determining weak links of the regional power grid according to a calculation result; when the magnitude of the regional power grid capacity is smaller than that of the external power grid capacity, performing stability control calculation according to the influence of the capacity of the accessed thermal power generating unit on the regional power grid trend direction, wherein the stability control calculation comprises the following steps: when the regional power grid sends power flow to the external power grid, performing stable control calculation of transient power angle stabilization, main transformer or line overload and outlet section bayonet; when the regional power grid flows down the grid, performing stable control calculation of transient power angle stabilization, main transformer or line overload, grid section opening and transient voltage and steady voltage; and determining the regional power grid weak links according to the calculation result. The application improves the efficiency and quality of stability control analysis.
assignees: SUIZHOU POWER SUPPLY COMPANY HUBEI PROVINCE ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY STATE GRID COOP;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;BEIJING SIFANG PROJECT CO LTD

title_en: Regional cold and heat source energy supply network optimization method and system based on dual physical information neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to an automatic regional cold and heat source optimization technology, and provides a regional building cold and heat load prediction and multi-target cold and heat source scheduling optimization method, system and equipment based on a dual physical information neural network, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1, acquiring and preprocessing a historical load data set, and establishing cold and hot load physical information constraint based on a thermodynamic prior mechanism; s2, building and training a building load prediction model based on the data set and the constraint; s3, constructing a regional cold and heat source multi-objective optimization model based on an energy cascade utilization principle; s4, optimizing and configuring the cold and heat sources by adopting a multi-target particle swarm algorithm according to the model load prediction result; s5, analyzing prediction load prediction and optimization results, and establishing multidimensional physical information constraint of the cold and hot loads; s6, building and training a building cold and heat source optimizing model based on the result and the constraint; s7, realizing automatic source network tuning based on predicted load through a control system.

title_en: Electric vehicle charging station planning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric vehicle charging station planning method, which is based on power distribution information physical system data, a data acquisition module, charging station modeling in a normal operation stage and charging station modeling in a fault emergency treatment stage; wherein: the data acquisition module establishes a mutual coupling relationship between an initial communication network and a power grid of the charging station according to parameters of the information physical system of the power distribution station; the charging station modeling in the normal operation stage constructs a novel charging station according to balanced market operation and user requirements when the charging station operates normally; the fault emergency treatment charging station modeling is used for mobilizing the electric automobile and the emergency power generation automobile to supply power to the power grid when the power distribution information physical system fails; in the pre-configuration stage, the network side opens a looped network in the power grid through a remote control switch and a manual switch at the same time, and an operator cuts off the charging electric automobile; meanwhile, the electric automobile and the emergency power generation vehicle are remotely scheduled to supply power to the power grid and the communication network; in the degradation stage, determining whether the communication network can continuously control the power grid remote control switch by judging the power grid node fault and the influence on the communication node and the route thereof after the power grid node fault; in the service recovery stage, if the remote control switch in the power grid can be controlled by the communication side continuously, the remote control switch can act continuously to isolate faults according to the fault propagation condition; meanwhile, the electric automobile and the emergency power generation automobile are scheduled to supply power to the non-fault area; according to the invention, the toughness of the electric vehicle charging station facing to extreme environments is improved by restraining information physical data through the bidirectional energy transmission fusion between the electric vehicle and the power grid of the charging station.

title_en: Hub connection public transportation network cascade failure analysis method based on capacity load model
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for analyzing cascade failure of a junction public transportation network based on a capacity load model aiming at the problem of analyzing cascade failure of a passenger junction public transportation network. The method comprises the steps of (1) extracting site operation intensity, determining site capacity, establishing a capacity load model to redistribute invalid passenger flows, (2) determining site repair time, establishing a model analysis invalid passenger flow recovery propagation mechanism, updating site loads, and (3) extracting network efficiency evaluation indexes, analyzing key parameter influences and providing optimization suggestions. The invention provides a coupling method for constructing a double-layer public transportation network, establishes a full-period simulation model for the passenger flow transfer of the transportation junction public transportation network, provides a theoretical basis for the organization and optimization of the transportation junction network, and effectively improves the overall service level of the transportation junction.

title_en: System for notifying emergency in wireless
title_ko: 학내 비상상황 발생 통보시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A system for notifying an emergency in a school is provided to transmit a voice and an image to a wireless communication network which is connected with a wireless sharing unit, thereby applying the voice and the image to a wireless broadcast and a wireless CCTV in a school. CONSTITUTION: A broadcasting speaker(121~123) receives an emergent signal from an emergent remote controller(111~114), the broadcasting speaker transmits the emergent signal and location information corresponding to the emergent remote controller to an in-school server(140). The in-school server identifies the emergent remote controller by the emergent signal. The in-school server controls execution of a selected emergent situation program. A light(130) is turned on/off by control of the in-school server.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일실시예에 따른 학내 비상상황 발생 통보시스템은, 사용자 입력이 있는 경우, 비상신호를 브로드캐스팅(broadcasting)하는 비상 리모컨; 하나 이상의 구역에 각각 설치되고 해당 구역에서 브로드캐스팅되는 비상신호를 상기 비상 리모컨으로부터 수신하는 경우, 상기 비상신호 및 상기 비상 리모컨에 대응하는 위치정보를 하기 학내 서버로 전송하는 방송용 스피커; 상기 방송용 스피커로부터 상기 비상신호 및 상기 위치정보를 수신하는 경우, 상기 비상신호를 통해 상기 비상 리모컨을 식별하고, 선정된(predetermined) 비상상황 프로그램의 수행을 제어하는 학내 서버; 및 상기 하나 이상의 구역에 각각 설치되고, 상기 학내 서버의 제어에 따라 동작하는 경광등을 포함하되, 상기 비상상황 프로그램은 상기 비상 리모컨을 사용하는 사용자의 비상상황이 상기 방송용 스피커를 통해 전파되도록 하고 상기 경광등이 동작하도록 하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Central monitoring and management system for detecting dangerous substances
title_ko: 위험물 유출 감지 중앙 감시 관리 시스템
abstract_en: The technical idea of the present invention relates to a central monitoring and management system for detecting the leakage of dangerous substances. An objective of the present invention is to provide the central monitoring and management system for detecting the leakage of dangerous substances that can observe dangerous facilities and report an accident on the dangerous facilities where the accident has occurred. The present invention observes the state of a dangerous facility, reports an accident on the dangerous facility where the accident has occurred, when an accident is expected according to a result of observation, and informs people with terminals around the dangerous facility of the accident to evacuate them from the dangerous facility.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 기술적 사상이 되는 위험물 유출 감지 중앙 감시 관리 시스템에 관한 것으로, 본 발명은 위험 시설물을 관찰하고 사고 발생된 위험 시설물에 대해 사고 신고할 수 있는 위험물 유출 감지 중앙 감시 관리 시스템을 제공하는 것을 목적으로 한다. 본 발명은 위험 시설물의 상태를 관찰하고, 관찰 결과 사고 발생이 예상되는 경우 사고 발생된 위험 시설물에 대해 사고 신고하고, 위험 시설물 주변 단말기로 사고 발생을 전파해서 단말기를 소지한 사용자 또는 주위 사용자가 사고 발생을 인지하고 대피하는 효과를 가질 수 있다.

title_en: Power grid node importance degree evaluation method, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a power grid node importance degree evaluation method, computer equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining power grid node information according to the power grid data information; preprocessing the power grid node information to obtain training data; performing clustering analysis processing on the training data to obtain clustering data; obtaining a membership function according to the clustering data; initializing the rule parameters of the membership function to obtain initialized rule parameters; and obtaining a power grid node evaluation value function according to the membership function and the initialized rule parameters, performing cluster analysis processing on the power grid node information, and constructing the membership function to construct a power grid node importance evaluation model, thereby obtaining the power grid node evaluation value function, namely forming a multi-rule power grid node importance evaluation model to realize comprehensive evaluation of the power grid node importance, effectively preventing power grid cascading faults, guaranteeing safe and stable operation of a power grid, and ensuring the economic benefit of a power grid enterprise.

title_en: Intelligent positioning and diagnosing method for optical fiber composite faults of power distribution network based on hybrid sensing
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent positioning and diagnosing method for optical fiber composite faults of a power distribution network based on hybrid sensing, which relates to the technical field of power distribution networks and comprises the steps of acquiring and preprocessing optical fibers and electric sensing data, extracting time-frequency domain characteristics through a multichannel convolutional neural network, and calculating a dynamic weight coefficient by using an attention mechanism to perform feature fusion, constructing a dynamic fault propagation diagram, and performing space-time feature extraction by combining diagram convolution and causal convolution to realize fault positioning and type identification. The invention can fully utilize multi-source heterogeneous data, improves fault positioning accuracy and diagnosis reliability, and is suitable for fault diagnosis of a complex power distribution network.

title_en: Landslide hazard risk assessment method, landslide hazard risk assessment equipment, landslide hazard risk assessment medium and landslide hazard risk assessment product
abstract_en: The application discloses a landslide hazard risk assessment method, equipment, medium and product, and relates to the field of geological hazard risk assessment. The method comprises the steps of constructing a disaster pregnancy factor system participating in landslide disaster risk assessment, uniformly sampling a research area according to preset sampling intervals to obtain a uniform point set, respectively collecting information amounts of disaster points and uniform points in the research area to form a positive sample set and a negative sample set, constructing a landslide disaster risk assessment model based on an artificial neural network, training the model by adopting the positive sample set and the negative sample set, outputting landslide disaster occurrence probability of each sample, further calculating prediction precision and prediction density of the model, calculating a weighted cross entropy loss function based on the prediction density, and carrying out error counter-propagation until the training is completed, and carrying out landslide disaster risk assessment on an area to be assessed by utilizing the trained landslide disaster risk assessment model, so that objectivity, rationality and accuracy of the landslide disaster risk assessment can be remarkably improved.

title_en: Micro-grid group cooperative scheduling method based on master-slave strategy
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power system dispatching, in particular to a micro-grid group collaborative dispatching method based on a master-slave strategy, which comprises an upper-layer uncertainty propagation simulator and a plurality of lower-layer local robust optimizers. The upper simulator collects real-time uncertainty source data and network topology, generates a collaboration Lu Bangyu through simulating an uncertainty propagation path, and sends the collaboration Lu Bangyu to the lower layer as a probability constraint. And the lower-layer optimizer executes local cost minimization optimization under constraint and reports the operation point and the uncertainty index. The upper layer calculates the overall collaborative entropy, and expands the robust domain through a feedback mechanism to maximize the benefit if the overall collaborative entropy is lower than the threshold, and reduces the risk if the overall collaborative entropy is higher than the threshold. And the iterative process adjusts domain boundary parameters by using a gradient algorithm until convergence or a scheduling period is finished, so that the micro-grid group robust cooperative scheduling is realized. The invention dynamically maximizes the cooperative operation benefit and the robust potential of the micro-grid group on the premise of ensuring the global stability of the system.

title_en: Prisoner monitoring device using id information and patent information and the method thereof
title_ko: 아이디 정보와 환자 정보를 이용한 수용자 호출 관리 장치 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus for managing a prisoner call using ID information and patient information and a method thereof. Specifically, a guard who has a proper authority can confirm individual information and patient information of a prisoner through a monitor of a prisoner accommodating room in immediate response to a call signal by an emergency call button in a prisoner accommodating room by taking into consideration a special facility that is a correctional facility, in a room of a person in charge by day or in an all-source situation room at night. Therefore, it is possible to process a subsequent action for the prisoner by using an apparatus which classifies and stores each prisoner information, the patient information, and a guard patrol record in a database of a central server according to the time or place. In the apparatus for managing a prisoner call using ID information and patient information, which includes a prisoner monitor module unit connected to the central server via a network, the prisoner monitor module unit comprises: a monitor managing module which manages the monitor of the prisoner accommodating room; a guard ID managing module which manages individual information of the guard and determines whether the individual information of the guard matches with information of a short-range radio wave identification tag; a prisoner ID managing module in which, in a case where the short-range radio wave identification tag has the proper authority, a prisoner group ID number or a prisoner individual ID number is inputted and which controls the monitor managing module to display information corresponding to a group ID number or an individual ID number; and a patient information managing module which, in a case where the patient information of the prisoner accommodating room is present, controls the monitor managing module to display the patient information.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 아이디 정보와 환자 정보를 이용한 수용자 호출 관리 장치 및 그 방법에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는 교정시설이라는 특수시설을 감안하여 주간에는 담당근무자실 또는 야간에는 보안과 종합상황실에서 수용거실 내에서의 비상 호출 버튼에 의한 호출신호에 즉시 응답하여 정당한 권한을 가진 교도관이 수용자 수용거실의 모니터를 통해 수용자의 개인 정보 또는 환자 정보를 확인할 수 있으며, 각 수용자 정보와 환자 정보와 교도관의 순찰 기록을 중앙서버의 데이터베이스에 시간 또는 장소에 따라 구분하여 저장하는 장치를 이용하여, 수용자에 대한 차후 조치를 원활하게 처리할 수 있도록 활용할 수 있는 아이디 정보와 환자 정보를 이용한 수용자 호출 관리 장치 및 그 방법에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명은 중앙서버와 네트워크 연결되는 수용자 감시 모듈부를 포함하는 아이디 정보와 환자 정보를 이용한 수용자 호출 관리 장치에 있어서, 상기 수용자 감시 모듈부는, 수용자 수용거실의 모니터를 관리하는 모니터 관리 모듈; 교도관의 개인 정보를 관리하여, 근거리 전파 식별 태그의 정보와 일치하는지 판별하는 교도관 ID 관리 모듈; 근거리 전파 식별 태그가 정당한 권한을 가진 경우, 수용자 단체 ID 넘버 또는 수용자 개인 ID 넘버를 입력하면 단체 ID 넘버 또는 개인 ID 넘버에 대응하는 정보를 모니터 관리 모듈을 통해 디스플레이하도록 제어하는 수용자 ID 관리 모듈; 상기 수용자 수용거실의 환자 정보가 존재하는 경우, 환자 정보를 모니터 관리 모듈을 통해 디스플레이하도록 제어하는 환자 정보 관리 모듈;을 포함한다.

title_en: Disaster indoor communication system with wireless communication network and the communication method thereof
title_ko: 무선네트워크부를 구비한 실내 재난 통신 시스템 및 실내 재난 통신 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an indoor disaster communication system equipped with a wireless network part and an indoor disaster communication method, which enable indoor disaster communication to be performed without discontinuation of communication even in a disaster situation, such as sinking or fire of a structure having a complex indoor constitution, such as a ship or a building. The indoor disaster communication system equipped with a wireless network part comprises a wireless network part which includes a plurality of wireless network nodes configured to selectively perform radio wave communication and sound wave communication in order to switch communication to the sound wave communication when flooding occurs during performance of the radio wave communication and which provides local area communication service inside a structure. In case of occurrence of a disaster, such as flooding or fire inside a ship or a large-sized building, communication is prevented from being discontinued inside a structure, a location and situation of a rescuee can be identified by a rescuer via a gesture or emergency message, and stable local communication service can be provided in case of a disaster by configuring the wireless network part by using an infrastructureless ad hoc network, thereby providing an effect of considerably facilitating rescue of human lives in case of occurrence of a disaster.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 선박 또는 건물 등의 복잡한 실내 구조를 가지는 구조물의 침몰, 화재 등의 재난 상황에서도 통신의 단절 없이 실내에서의 재난 통신을 수행할 수 있도록 하는 무선네트워크부를 구비한 실내 재난 통신 시스템 및 실내 재난 통신 방법에 관한 것으로, 
상기 무선네트워크부를 구비한 실내 재잔 통신 시스템은, 무선전파통신을 수행하는 과정 중 침수가 발생한 경우 음파통신으로 통신을 변경하도록 무선전파통신과 음파통신을 선택적으로 수행하는 다수의 무선네트워크노드들을 구비하여 구조물 내에서의 로컬영역 통신서비스를 제공하는 무선네트워크부;를 포함하여 구성되어, 
선박 또는 대형 건물 내에서의 침수, 화재 등의 재난 발생 시, 구조물 실내에서의 통신 단절을 방지하고, 제스처 또는 응급메시지를 통해 요구조자의 위치 및 상황을 구조자가 확인할 수 있도록 하며, 무선네트워크부를 인프라스트럭처를 구비하지 않는(infrastructureless) 애드 혹(ad hoc) 네트워크로 구성하는 것에 의해 재난 시에도 안정적인 국지적 통신서비스를 제공하며, 이에 의해 재난 발생 시의 인명 구조를 현저히 용이하게 하는 효과를 제공한다.

title_en: Anti- bird grape planting greenhouse
abstract_en: Anti- bird grape planting greenhouse, it is related to application field, and in particular to a kind of anti-bird grape planting greenhouse.The bending connector of main arch bar one end connecting cross beam, the connector that one end connects base cross members form greenhouse framework；Bar button is buckled in main arch bar, and cross bar passes through clamping ring to connect main arch bar；Diagonal brace one end connecting cross beam, one end connect base cross members；Greenhouse front end is provided with more straight-bars and column, straight-bar lateral connection or so main arch bar, and column erects connection main arch bar and base cross members, and plastic film and protection network are covered entire greenhouse.After adopting the above technical scheme, the utility model has the beneficial effect that：Protection network can keep birds outside of the door, cut off the Propagation Methods of harmful bird, effectively control the injury that birds bring kind of plant.And protection network has the effects that and with light transmission, appropriate shading, creates the advantage of suitable for crop growth.Protection network can also resist storm and wash away and the natural calamities such as hail invasion.

title_en: Daily electricity consumption prediction method based on artificial neural network
abstract_en: A daily electricity consumption prediction method based on an artificial neural network belongs to the power supply technology field. A topology structure of a neural network model comprises an input layer, a hidden layer and an output layer, and the learning rules of the neural network model are that: a parallel distribution processing model of an error back propagation algorithm is adopted, a steepest descent method is used, and the weight and the threshold value of the network are adjusted continuously by the back propagation, so that the error sum of squares of the network is minimum. By the training sample learning, a prediction model can be established automatically and is hidden inside the artificial neural network, by using the electricity consumption prediction method in a short-term load predication, a time sequence model can be supplemented beneficially. The daily electricity consumption prediction method based on the artificial neural network can be widely used in the load predication and load management field of an electric power system.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: A kind of power system excessive risk cascading failure fault chains searching method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of power system excessive risk cascading failure fault chains searching method.The accident chain model for being currently based on Complex Networks Theory have ignored the exclusive feature of the power networks such as electrical characteristic, operation characteristic and characteristics of tidal flow, the not fully security and stability analysis suitable for power network and control.The present invention is based on accident chain model; consider existing two, the anti-configuring condition in three roads; propose key element protection control action evaluation index; the uncertain factor controlled for quantized key element protection; the action probability of the key element protection control under critical condition is calculated, the successor of cascading failure fault chains is determined；In addition, the control cost according to needed for after protection control action probability and its action, assesses the risk of fault chains, excessive risk cascading failure fault chains are screened, are had a power failure on a large scale offer analysis foundation for prevention cascading failure.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO;NARI TECHNOLOGY DEV CO LTD

title_en: A kind of power distribution network regulation and administration weak link identification method based on cascade weight
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of power distribution network regulation and administration weak link identification methods based on cascade weight, are primarily based on analytic hierarchy structure, calculate power distribution network regulation and administration base values and cascade weight；Then using index connection weight between entropy assessment calculating power distribution network regulation and administration level；The contribution margin of each base values is finally calculated according to the calculated result of step S1 and step S2, and it is sorted from low to high, contribution margin is lower, and weak degree is higher, to realize that weak link recognizes.The present invention can scientifically and accurately identify the weak link in power distribution network regulation and administration business.
assignees: STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Toughness evaluation method of storage tank facility defense system under multi-disaster coupling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a toughness evaluation method of a storage tank facility defense system under multi-disaster coupling, which comprises the following steps of obtaining basic information; the method comprises the steps of analyzing the performance degradation and equipment vulnerability of a safety barrier under natural disasters, and identifying an initial accident scene and accident expansion possibility; constructing a dynamic Bayesian network to obtain node probability values of each device at different time points; evaluating system functions according to possible economic losses of the node tank area systems at different times; and evaluating the toughness of the system according to the system function, and drawing a time-varying curve of the system toughness. Due to the cascade effect of multiple kinds of coupling accidents, the performance of the original defense system may be reduced due to natural disasters, so that the toughness of the system is reduced, and further expansion of the accidents is difficult to resist. By adopting the method, the system toughness evaluation of different stages of accident evolution under multi-disaster coupling can be realized, and theoretical basis and decision support are provided for the multi-disaster coupling accident prevention and control and defense system optimization.

title_en: Vulnerable circuit identification method of wind power-containing power system based on interval electrical DebtRank algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for identifying a fragile line of a wind power-containing power system based on an interval electric DebtRank algorithm. Firstly, a wind speed interval which obeys WeiBull distribution is provided by utilizing a Monte Carlo method; then, calculating a wind power interval corresponding to the wind speed interval and a line interval power flow of the wind power field after the wind power field is connected into the power system; next, defining the DebtRank value of each line; and finally, sequencing the DebtRank values of the lines by using a power mean method, and selecting the lines in the top ten of the sequence as fragile lines. The method can identify the fragile lines in the wind power grid-connected power system, enhance the situation awareness ability of operation and maintenance personnel to protect the fragile lines, effectively prevent cascading failures caused by interruption of the weak links, and provide a certain reference value for avoiding the occurrence of major power failure accidents.

title_en: Adaptive positioning method for target node environment of underwater search and rescue wireless sensor network
abstract_en: The invention relates to an underwater search and rescue wireless sensor network target node environment self-adaptive positioning method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring position information of an anchor node; constructing a path loss model of the anchor node for receiving the target node to be searched and rescuing based on the position information, attenuation loss and absorption effect of the underwater signal propagation; based on the path loss model, constructing a distance-based underwater search and rescue wireless sensing network target node positioning model by adopting a Taylor expansion type; approximating the target node positioning model to a sum expression of two least squares using a least maximization strategy; and solving a target node positioning optimal solution by using an interior point method based on the approximated least square sum expression. Compared with the prior art, the method is highly suitable for the underwater search and rescue environment with high dynamic state and severe communication environment, and has the advantages of improving the positioning calculation precision and the like.

title_en: Typhoon path prediction method, system, terminal and storage medium of multi-mode data and antique model based on sounding equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of typhoon path prediction and discloses a typhoon path prediction method, a system, a terminal and a storage medium based on multi-mode data of a sounding device and a large model of the antique, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring multi-source heterogeneous data acquired by a sounding device related to typhoon prediction, fusing and adaptively enhancing the multi-source heterogeneous data based on the large model of the antique, and generating a high-resolution three-dimensional field; the method comprises the steps of constructing a cascading AI downscaling network, introducing a physical constraint layer, carrying out local refined modeling on a typhoon eye area according to the high-resolution three-dimensional field, outputting a high-resolution three-dimensional gas image field, designing a typhoon-environment field interaction model based on a graph neural network, carrying out typhoon prediction according to the high-resolution three-dimensional gas image field, and outputting typhoon path set prediction and typhoon thermodynamic structure analysis report containing a confidence interval. The method improves the speed and the precision of typhoon path prediction, reduces the prediction time and the prediction error, and saves the calculation resources.
assignees: GUANGDONG LABORATORY OF ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE AND DIGITAL ECONOMIC SHENZHEN

title_en: Multi-mode social network public opinion hidden trouble investigation method and system
abstract_en: The application discloses a multi-modal social network public opinion hidden danger investigation method and system, wherein multi-modal data of a social platform are collected in real time through distributed edge nodes, the multi-modal data comprise text, image and audio data, a plurality of social network communities are divided based on user interaction relations, the user interaction relations comprise but are not limited to topic rings, friend relations, comment interaction and forwarding praise, community propagation dynamics features, community topology features and content features are extracted from the plurality of social network communities one by one based on the multi-modal data, a plurality of suspected hidden danger communities are screened out from the plurality of social network communities based on the community propagation dynamics features, the community topology features and the content features and a preset screening strategy, and a plurality of hidden danger classifications corresponding to the plurality of suspected hidden danger communities are output after hidden danger detection and hidden danger classification are carried out on the plurality of suspected hidden danger communities based on the multi-modal data. The method and the system of the application obviously improve the comprehensiveness and the accuracy of public opinion hidden danger identification.

title_en: Two-stage sea-iron intermodal network toughness optimization method under uncertain cascade failure
abstract_en: The invention relates to a two-stage sea-iron intermodal network toughness optimization method under uncertain cascade failure, which comprises the steps of S1, acquiring a failure junction node, generating a container operation load redistribution scheme based on a sea-iron intermodal network dynamic load distribution stochastic programming model under uncertain cascade failure, wherein the sea-iron intermodal network dynamic load distribution stochastic programming model under uncertain cascade failure takes the total loss expectation of all substitute nodes and the minimum container freight volume which cannot be redistributed as targets, distributing the original container operation requirement of the original failure junction node to the peripheral uninterrupted substitute nodes, and S2, taking the generated container operation load redistribution scheme as the input of a sea-iron intermodal network transportation organization optimization model under the interruption of a key interval, generating a new shift-on operation requirement, and generating a new feasible restorable transportation scheme through the sea-iron intermodal network transportation organization optimization model reconstruction path when the key region interruption occurs to the new shift-on operation requirement. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages of and the like.

title_en: High-altitude canyon strong wind forecasting method based on WSTD-KOA-BPNN technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for forecasting the strong wind of a plateau canyon based on WSTD-KOA-BPNN technology. The method comprises the steps of collecting historical wind speed data, temperature and other meteorological element data of a target area of a plateau canyon by using a distributed wind speed sensor, filling missing data points by using a cubic spline interpolation method, carrying out noise filtering by using a wavelet soft threshold denoising algorithm (WSTD), carrying out normalization processing on the denoised wind speed data by using a Min-Max method, optimizing Back Propagation Neural Network (BPNN) parameters based on a KOA Optimization Algorithm (KOA), constructing a KOA-BPNN prediction model, and carrying out real-time monitoring and prediction result output. According to the invention, through fusion WSTD of noise suppression, KOA global parameter optimization and BPNN nonlinear modeling capability, the capturing precision and generalization performance of complex strong wind characteristics of the plateau canyon are remarkably improved, and reliable technical support is provided for disaster prevention and reduction.
assignees: HUANENG LANCANG RIVER HYDROPOWER CO LTD;HUANENG LANCANG RIVER UPSTREAM HYDROPOWER CO LTD;UNIV CHINA THREE GORGES CTGU

title_en: Power grid black start system and method based on step hydroelectric characteristics
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of recovery control of an electric power system, in particular to a power grid black start system and a method based on cascade hydropower characteristics, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a software and hardware integrated system integrating physical equipment and intelligent control; the system comprises a software and hardware integrated system, a central decision unit, a synchronous phasor measurement unit PMU, a central decision unit, a power grid framework expanding step by step, wherein the software and hardware integrated system is used for carrying out situation awareness, automatically identifying a power outage range of a power grid after a large-area power outage, positioning an available step hydropower station, automatically triggering a black start plan, simultaneously instructing a plurality of upstream hydropower station start units according to preset rules to establish a plurality of independent power islands, each power island is used for transmitting power to a next-stage transformer substation or a power station in parallel after stabilizing own frequency and voltage, carrying out regional collaborative recovery, dynamically distributing loads to be recovered, carrying out synchronous parallel operation by utilizing real-time phase angle difference data provided by the synchronous phasor measurement unit PMU, and carrying out synchronous parallel operation on a plurality of subsystems which are operated stably.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST OF STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Coupling method and device based on node importance of power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coupling method and a coupling device based on the node importance of a power system, wherein the device is used for realizing the method; implementing cascade failure attack on the power network in the model, dynamically adjusting the actual output power of each power supply node under the condition of ensuring that the power utilization node obtains the conventional input power, obtaining the output power of each power supply node under each stable state in dynamic adjustment, respectively calculating the node influence and the node vulnerability, and obtaining a node d by weighted summation of the node influence and the node vulnerability  0  The importance of the nodes is ranked from small to small based on the importance of the nodes to generate a new power network, and the new power network is heterogamy coupled with a communication network to generate a new power system model. The invention obtains the node importance through the calculation of the direct current load flow model to obtain a more accurate simulation result, and then performs the different distribution coupling of the new power network and the communication network, thereby improving the robustness of the power system network under the attack.

title_en: Photovoltaic power station short-term power prediction method based on gated cyclic unit network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a photovoltaic power station short-term power prediction method based on a gated cyclic unit network. The method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the following steps: step S1: selecting meteorological parameters as model input according to weather types of days to be predicted, wherein the dominant meteorological parameters are different in different weather types; step S2: processing 20 days of history data before the day to be predicted, eliminating abnormal values and values of the night, and then performing normalization processing on the historical power and the historical NWP meteorological parameters to serve as a training data set; step S3: learning the training data set by adopting a gate control cycle unit network, and adjusting parameters of the network by using a root-mean-square back propagation algorithm; step S4: and taking the NWP meteorological parameters of the day to be predicted as the input of the model to obtain the predicted power value. The method can obviously improve the accuracy and reliability of the short-term power prediction of the photovoltaic power station.

title_en: Swarm unmanned aerial vehicle fault propagation analysis method based on time sequence network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a swarm unmanned aerial vehicle fault propagation analysis method based on a time sequence network, and relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle fault analysis. The method solves the problem of difficult fault propagation modeling of the swarm unmanned aerial vehicle, can effectively describe the fault condition of the unmanned aerial vehicle, understand the propagation process of the fault in the swarm unmanned aerial vehicle, and provide a theoretical basis for the prevention and solution of the fault of the swarm unmanned aerial vehicle.

title_en: Distributed emergency scheduling method for power distribution network considering coordination of electric buses
abstract_en: The invention relates to a distributed emergency scheduling method of a power distribution network considering the cooperation of electric buses, which comprises the following steps of constructing a self-scheduling sub-model of the power distribution network; constructing an electric bus company self-dispatching sub-model for supporting the operation of the power distribution network by the electric bus company; based on a distribution network self-dispatching sub-model and an electric bus company self-dispatching sub-model, constructing a distribution network-electric bus company-electric bus cooperative emergency dispatching double-layer distributed model by adopting an extended Lagrangian method; and carrying out distributed iterative optimization on the power distribution network-electric bus company-electric bus collaborative emergency dispatching double-layer distributed model by adopting a target cascading method, and solving by utilizing a solver to obtain an optimal emergency dispatching strategy of the power distribution network and the electric bus company. According to the invention, emergency dispatching is performed from a distributed angle, so that the data privacy of a power distribution network and an electric bus company can be effectively protected, and the optimal solving speed of dispatching problems is improved through a double-layer distributed architecture.

title_en: Power grid dynamic knowledge graph link prediction method for quantum walk and quantum thermodynamics
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for predicting dynamic power grid knowledge graph links of quantum wander and quantum thermodynamics, which relates to the technical field of defect diagnosis and dynamic graph representation learning of main equipment of a power system, and comprises the steps of collecting relevant data of dynamic power grid knowledge graphs, including states, connection relations and time stamps of power grid equipment, constructing a data set, and dividing the data set into a training set and a testing set; constructing a power grid dynamic knowledge graph link prediction model based on quantum migration and quantum thermodynamics, wherein the model comprises a quantum migration perception encoder and a temperature perception mixed expert model decoder; training the model by using training set data, and optimizing model parameters by a back propagation algorithm to obtain a trained model; and evaluating the trained model by using the test set. The method can accurately predict possible faults of the power grid equipment in the future and improve the stability and safety of the power grid.

title_en: A kind of miniature earthquake calamity audio life detecting device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of miniature earthquake calamity audio life detecting device, mainly include：Detection device and main control device, detection device between wireless network and main control device by being transmitted；Using special microelectronics processor, it can identify the small vibrations propagated in air or solid, after main control device is placed on safety zone, detection device is controlled to enter rescue region, camera captured in real-time transmits terrain graph, micro- vibration sensor probe and speech transducer probe transfer information to microseismic signals display screen and sound wave display screen, and micro- vibration sensor probe perceives the faint seismic signal that surface layer transmits, and speech transducer probe can carry out voice communication with rescuer；Voice signal is directly passed to detection personnel by main control device；According to signal strength infinite approach rescuer, the then detailed rescue plan of rapid development.

title_en: Charging station power consumption prediction method based on deep clustering model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a charging station power consumption prediction method based on a deep clustering model, which comprises the following steps: enhancing and preprocessing the charging station data; determining a cluster to which the charging station belongs based on the feature mapping of the deep clustering model; charging station power prediction based on nearest neighbor algorithm. The method uses a deep neural network to learn the feature representation and the cluster distribution of the charging station data at the same time, iteratively optimizes a clustering target and reconstructs loss by mapping the data to a hidden feature space, and reduces the possibility of error propagation; the charging station power consumption is further predicted using a nearest neighbor algorithm. Compared with the conventional charging station electricity utilization prediction method, the method can mine the implicit characteristics of the data, reduce the search space and have higher prediction accuracy.
assignees: JIANGSU FRONTIER ELECTRIC TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;UNIV SOUTHEAST

title_en: Multi-time-scale nested wind, light and water multi-energy complementary scheduling method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-time scale nested wind, light and water multi-energy complementary scheduling method, which belongs to the technical field of multi-energy comprehensive utilization and is used for exerting electric quantity compensation benefits of wind, light and water multi-energy complementation on a long term and electric power compensation benefits on a short term; the core of long-term scheduling is that the complementary advantage of multi-energy complementary electric quantity is played by changing the water level control mode of a large reservoir in a drainage basin, and the utilization efficiency of clean energy is improved; on the premise of meeting long-term water level constraint, short-term scheduling utilizes the flexible water and electricity regulation capability to carry out 'primary power compensation' regulation on the natural randomness, the intermittence and the fluctuation of wind and light output, thereby reducing the impact of the wind and light output on the safe and stable operation of a power grid; and the wind and light forecast deviation is regulated by 'secondary power compensation' by scheduling in real time and utilizing the water power, a day-ahead output plan is tracked, the power supply reliability of the system is ensured, and sufficient energy storage is left for the cascade hydropower station system through the control of the last storage capacity so as to ensure the long-term power generation benefit of the system.

title_en: Active power distribution network partitioning method based on graph convolution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an active power distribution network partitioning method based on a graph convolution network, which comprises the following steps: 1. establishing an undirected graph model of the active power distribution network; 2. preprocessing characteristic data of nodes of the active power distribution network to serve as training samples; 3. constructing a graph convolution neural network; 4. updating network parameters of the graph convolution neural network through a gradient descent back propagation algorithm; 5. and realizing network partition of the active power distribution network according to the optimal model. According to the method, the optimal partition result can be obtained without establishing and solving a complex active power distribution network partition mathematical optimization model, so that the time cost is reduced, the operation, control and management instructions of the active power distribution network can take effect in time, and the voltage quality is improved.

title_en: Multidimensional collaborative scheduling method for cascade reservoir group
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-dimensional cooperative scheduling method for a cascade reservoir group, which is characterized by comprising the following steps of: step 1: generalizing the river cascade reservoir groups according to the distribution topography of the river cascade reservoir groups, and constructing a system network node diagram of the watershed hydraulic connection; step 2, constructing a multidimensional collaborative scheduling simulation model target function according to a system network node diagram of watershed hydraulic connection; and 3, solving the objective function of the multi-dimensional cooperative scheduling simulation model according to the real-time data. The invention establishes the multi-dimensional cooperative control principle of the cascade reservoir group and provides an optimization solving method, and breaks through the problem of complex multi-dimensional cooperative control of the cascade reservoir group. The invention adopts the representative series to calculate and optimize the long-series yellow river step reservoir group cooperative scheduling scheme, realizes the matching of the river basin water supply and demand processes and the reasonable reservoir and river channel silt flushing process, improves the system generating capacity and stability, basically ensures the river ecological water quantity and process, and improves the overall benefit of the yellow river step reservoir group system.

title_en: Photovoltaic power prediction method based on neural network and honeypot optimization
abstract_en: The invention relates to a photovoltaic power prediction method based on neural network and honeypot optimization, and provides a photovoltaic power generation prediction model based on a badger algorithm and an enhanced counter-propagation neural network aiming at the defect that random initial weight and bias seriously affect the performance of a BP neural network. The solar irradiance per hour and the ambient temperature of the peltier cell are used as input data for the predictive model, and the historical power generation per hour (power) is used as the expected output. HBAs are introduced in the BP neural network to optimize initial weights and biases. The simulation results of various indexes show that the prediction accuracy of the HBA-BP neural network is improved to a certain extent relative to a BP prediction model.

title_en: Fire source positioning method and system based on artificial neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire source positioning method and a fire source positioning system based on an artificial neural network, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting indoor wall pictures after fire disaster through an image collecting module; the collected pictures are subjected to graying by utilizing an image preprocessing module and converted into gray images, and the gray images are further subjected to binarization to obtain binary images; identifying fire burning trace areas in the binary images by adopting an image identification module to obtain edge coordinates of burning traces; converting the edge coordinates into actual space coordinates through a feature extraction module, and extracting features of the converted coordinates; and inputting the extracted characteristic value into a fire source prediction module, and obtaining a fire position prediction value through forward propagation. The invention uses the artificial neural network to identify the wall surface image after fire disaster and position the fire source, realizes the intelligent fire source position identification in fire disaster investigation, and overcomes the defects of high labor intensity and low working efficiency of the artificial identification method.

title_en: Automatic early warning method for stability of foundation pit based on feedforward and circulating neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic pre-warning method for stability of a foundation pit based on a feedforward and circulating neural network, which comprises the following steps: s1, determining the type of acquired data; s2, installing measuring instruments at corresponding positions of the foundation pit to collect data; s3, preprocessing the data acquired in the step S1; s4, establishing a feedforward neural network; s5, establishing a back propagation mechanism; s6, obtaining the maximum value of each control index of foundation pit deformation according to the feedforward neural network model, taking the maximum value as a threshold value, and defining the safety level of the control index; s7, respectively establishing a single-layer RNN (RNN-network) circulating neural network for each control index in the S6 and training; s8, comparing the result of the change of each control index predicted by the RNN circulating neural network model along with the working condition with the threshold value in S6, and judging the safety level of each control index under the current working condition. The method solves the technical problem that the construction safety risk is high due to the fact that the deformation of the foundation pit cannot be accurately predicted and controlled in the foundation pit excavation process.

title_en: Evolution traceability analysis method and system for complex faults of power distribution network coefficients
abstract_en: The invention discloses an evolution traceability analysis method and system for complex faults of a power distribution network coefficient, comprising the steps of obtaining a first signal of a target power distribution line, and performing first preprocessing on the first signal to obtain a second signal; the method comprises the steps of establishing a first characteristic matrix, obtaining a third signal according to a second signal, inputting the third signal into a pre-trained first judging network, obtaining the fault category of a fault point, and carrying out fault position evolution tracing. The focusing performance of the power grid fault signal at the fault point is remarkably enhanced through time reversal operation, amplitude attenuation, phase change and energy reflection characteristics of signal propagation in a complex power grid are accurately described by combining BLT super matrix modeling, and fault classification and position accuracy under a complex fault scene are improved by combining deep feature learning of a Siam network and energy focusing verification and least square optimization.
assignees: GUIGANG POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GRID COMPANY OF GUANGXI

title_en: Optical power prediction method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention provides an artificial intelligence-based optical power prediction method and system, the method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-data source information of photovoltaic power generation, preprocessing to obtain standardized multi-mode input tensors, determining disturbance criteria at each moment based on the multi-mode input tensors, determining whether current weather has severe change or not to generate corresponding indication signals, constructing a graph structure according to component state data constructed by the multi-mode input tensors, constructing an edge set and calculating edge weights according to the structure/physical/environmental coupling relation among components, conducting disturbance propagation based on an improved graph neural network according to the constructed graph structure, outputting disturbance feature representations of a plurality of components, integrating the disturbance feature representations of the components, and outputting a system-level optical power predicted value at the current moment.
assignees: THE SECOND GEOLOGICAL SURVEY INST OF HEILONGJIANG PROVINCE

title_en: Automatic operation and maintenance intelligent management system of transformer substation based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power equipment, in particular to a digital twin-based substation automation operation and maintenance intelligent management system, which comprises an information acquisition module, a data simulation module and an intelligent operation and maintenance module, wherein the information acquisition module is used for acquiring real-time operation data of equipment, the data simulation module is used for performing substation simulation operation according to the real-time operation data of the equipment, the intelligent operation and maintenance module is used for performing equipment fault prediction according to a simulation operation result and performing intelligent operation and maintenance according to a prediction result, the digital twin-based substation power flow simulation module is constructed based on a digital twin technology, active power, reactive power and branch power flow simulation are realized, simulation precision is optimized through deep reinforcement learning, fault prediction is performed by merging a graph-convolution network, the equipment health score and a fault propagation model are combined, the topological relation is dynamically adjusted, the prediction accuracy is improved, and the priority of maintenance tasks and the resource allocation strategy are intelligently adjusted based on the fault prediction result, so that the priority maintenance of key equipment is ensured, and the operation and maintenance efficiency of the substation is improved.

title_en: Intelligent operation and maintenance management platform fault monitoring method based on big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fault monitoring method of an intelligent operation and maintenance management platform based on big data, which comprises the steps of constructing a text graph structure based on historical operation and maintenance knowledge data, processing a Laplacian matrix of the text graph structure to obtain node characteristic values, extracting first characteristics in the historical operation and maintenance knowledge data according to the node characteristic values, simulating the propagation process of the first characteristics in a semantic space, constructing an operation and maintenance knowledge graph based on the obtained semantic propagation result, extracting characteristics of the operation and maintenance knowledge data, embedding and fusing the extracted second characteristics with the operation and maintenance knowledge graph, constructing and training a teacher network based on the fusion characteristics, constructing a student network for fault detection and positioning, optimizing the student network based on the trained teacher network, and inputting real-time operation and maintenance knowledge data into the optimized student network to obtain a fault detection type and a positioning result. The method of the invention improves the operation and maintenance management level of the power grid information system.
assignees: STATE GRID HUITONG JINCAI BEIJING INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power grid cascading failure risk assessment method for wind power direct current output system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid cascading failure risk assessment method of a wind power direct current delivery system, which comprises the steps of 1, establishing a network model of the wind power direct current delivery system according to characteristics of the wind power system, selecting a cascading failure sequence, 2, establishing cascading failure risk assessment indexes suitable for the wind power direct current delivery system, 3, calculating subjective and objective weights of all the cascading failure risk assessment indexes obtained in the step 1,4, linearly combining the subjective and objective weights obtained in the step 3, 5, optimizing the subjective and objective weights obtained in the step 4 by adopting an improved black-wing iris algorithm, further obtaining a risk assessment comprehensive index, and 6, assessing influence degree of the cascading failure on the wind power direct current delivery system by using the risk assessment comprehensive index processed in the step 5. The method solves the problem that the prior method can not comprehensively grasp and evaluate the characteristics of the cascading failure of the wind power direct current output system.

title_en: Seismic data-based oil and gas reservoir distribution-oriented convolutional neural network learning and predicting method
abstract_en: A seismic data-based oil and gas reservoir distribution-oriented convolutional neural network learning and predicting method. Said method comprises firstly taking original seismic data as a basis, extracting seismic attributes which can represent oil and gas characteristics; then designing a convolutional neural network model, taking several preferred seismic attributes as an input layer of a network, extracting seismic attribute values at a well location, taking the void ratio, permeability and oiliness of the well location as a training sample, performing back propagation by means of a BP neural network, so as to continuously correct parameters such as the convolution kernel, weight W and bias b until the model training is completed; and then testing data of an area having no wells, so as to implement lateral prediction of reservoirs from an area having wells to an area having no wells. Said method directly performs convolutional neural network learning on oil and gas sensitive attribute bodies, being able to implement lateral prediction of seismic information characteristics of unknown seismic reservoirs in the same block and even cross regions.

title_en: Information analysis method, apparatus and device for complex relationship network, and storage medium
abstract_en: An information analysis method, apparatus and device for a complex relationship network, and a storage medium, which are used for enhancing the capability of identifying and controlling risks of a community group. Said method comprises: acquiring a complex relationship network to be analyzed, and dividing a network topology structure of the complex relationship network by means of a preset algorithm, so as to obtain communities and community information corresponding to each community (101); performing linear dimension reduction processing on the community information to obtain community features, and performing word vector conversion processing on the community features to obtain community feature vectors (102); calculating a target similarity between every two community feature vectors, and determining candidate community information according to the target similarity (103); performing risk value marking on the candidate community information to obtain target community information, filling the target community information and the target similarity into a preset adjacency list, and generating a community weighted graph according to the adjacency list, the adjacency list being used for indicating a pointer array corresponding to a data domain of the community weighted graph (104); and acquiring a community to be evaluated in the community weighted graph, a weighted risk value and a risk value of the community to be evaluated, analyzing the weighted risk value by means of a preset label propagation algorithm, so as to update the risk value of the community to be evaluated, and obtaining, by means of the updated risk value, the risk degree of the community to be evaluated and the degree of identification for the risk, the weighted risk value being used for indicating a value obtained by multiplying, by the target similarity, a risk value of a community connected to or adjacent to the community to be evaluated (105).
assignees: ONE CONNECT SMART TECH CO LTD SHENZHEN

title_en: Method and apparatus to reduce service interruption in communication system
abstract_en: A method of a user equipment (UE) is provided. The method includes identifying a disaster condition for a first network, identifying whether the UE is in a registered state and a connected state over a first access based on the identified disaster condition, and performing a disaster roaming based on an identification that the UE is not in the registered state and the connected state over the first access.

title_en: A kind of power distribution network isolated island division methods based on Pulse Coupled Neural Network
abstract_en: The present invention is a kind of power distribution network isolated island division methods for being based on Pulse Coupled Neural Network (PCNN), belongs to the power distribution network isolated island containing distributed generation resource and divides field.There is a problem of that division speed is slow, supply district is small when carrying out isolated island division for the power distribution network currently containing distributed generation resource, present invention introduces time delay Pulse Coupled Neural Network (DPCNN, Delay PCNN) model, it takes full advantage of PCNN and inherits the undamped characteristic with propagated in parallel of the pulse come, using each distributed generation resource as root neuron, it scans for simultaneously, greatly reduces the storage of ephemeral data, supply district is expanded while improving the speed of service.The isolated island that this algorithm partition comes out is for other algorithms, and faster, scheme is more accurate for the speed of division, in engineering closing to reality, with more operability.

title_en: Identification method of weak cascade, key cascade and controllable cascade of cascade reservoir group based on Bayesian risk network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for identifying weak steps, key steps and control steps of a step reservoir group based on a Bayesian risk network, relates to the field of hydraulic and hydroelectric engineering, and solves the problem of how to identify the risks of the step reservoir group in the aspect of risk prevention and control of the step reservoir group.
