Based on the Bayes risk network model of the cascade reservoir group, a recognition method of weak cascade, key cascade and control cascade of the cascade reservoir group is provided, and theory and method support is provided for applying the Bayes risk network model of the cascade reservoir group to cascade reservoir group risk recognition, evaluation and prevention and control. The method is simple and clear, has strong operability, and has important application prospect in risk identification, evaluation, prevention and control of the cascade reservoir group.

title_en: Cascade water-light complementary day-ahead robust peak shaving scheduling method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of multi-energy complementary power generation, in particular to a method, a system, equipment and a medium for gradient water-light complementary day-ahead robust peak regulation and scheduling, which comprise the following steps: establishing an objective function of step water-light complementary day-ahead robust peak regulation scheduling by taking the minimum peak-valley difference of the residual load of the receiving-end power grid as an objective; establishing a day-ahead scheduling constraint condition taking hydraulic coupling into account mainly step hydropower constraint; performing uncertainty set modeling and robust equivalent transformation on the photovoltaic output, and transforming the nonlinear constraint of the step hydropower into linear constraint; constructing a mixed integer linear programming model of cascade hydropower joint optimization scheduling by using an objective function and linear constraint; and solving the planning model to obtain the day-ahead robust scheduling method of the cascade water-light complementary combined power generation system. According to the invention, uncertainty of photovoltaic output can be fully considered, peak regulation effect and photovoltaic digestion of the combined power generation system are considered, and complementary operation of step hydropower and photovoltaic is realized.

title_en: Artificial intelligence intelligent park multisource data monitoring and analyzing method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent park data monitoring and discloses an artificial intelligence multi-source data monitoring and analyzing method for an intelligent park. The method comprises the steps of constructing a park operation state basic model, extracting data dynamic change characteristics by utilizing a space-time data fusion technology when the model is abnormal, identifying a specific region abnormal event mode by combining deep belief network deep analysis, calculating data complexity by using permutation entropy, optimizing and analyzing an abnormal propagation path by combining an A star algorithm, evaluating a diffusion range and an influence path, identifying a comprehensive risk region according to the data, analyzing the regional environment and equipment state characteristics by utilizing a multispectral imaging technology, evaluating the operation abnormality by combining real-time multisource data, and executing accurate intervention on the comprehensive risk region according to the abnormal condition. The method realizes effective integration and analysis of multi-source data of the intelligent park, accurately identifies abnormality and grasps risk, provides scientific means for park management, and ensures stable and efficient operation of the park.

title_en: Ship automatic broadcasting system
title_ko: 선내 자동 방송 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 항해정보와 환경정보와 모션정보와 선내상황정보를 계측하는 센서부(110), 계측값을 모니터링하고 분석하여 경고정보를 생성하는 모니터링서버(120), 이벤트신호에 따라 네트워크 제어 음원소스(137)를 추출하여 TTS 프로그램 모듈(138)을 통해 경고정보를 디지털음성신호로 변환하는 디지털음성변환모듈(139)로 구성되어, 스케쥴방송과 마이크방송과 전화방송에 해당하는 디지털음성신호 및 경고정보에 해당하는 디지털음성신호를 비상구역정보에 포함된 해당 방송구역 또는 콜 스테이션(134)에 의해 선택된 해당 방송구역으로 전송하는, 선내 방송 서버(130), 선내 방송 서버(130)에 연결되어 디지털음성신호를 출력하는 다수의 IP 스피커(140), 증폭된 음성신호를 출력하는 다수의 아날로그 스피커(153)로 구성되는, 선내 네트워크 방송부(150), 및 센서부(110)와 모니터링 서버(120) 사이, 모니터링 서버(120)와 선내 방송 서버(130) 사이, 선내 방송 서버(130)와 IP 스피커(140) 사이, 및 선내 방송 서버(130)와 선내 네트워크 방송부(150) 사이를 유무선 네트워크로 연결하는 TCP/IP 기반의 통신망(160);을 포함하여, IP 스피커(140) 또는 아날로그 스피커(153) 중 어느 하나의 오류시에 대체하여 노이즈없이 비상상황을 전파하도록 하는, 선내 자동 방송 시스템을 개시한다.

title_en: Critical infrastructure blueprint selection for optimized response to state changing conditions
abstract_en: Critical infrastructure (CI) blueprint selection for optimized response to state changing conditions includes defining a hierarchy of interdependent CI elements of a community in a digital twin and receiving characterization data for different nodes of the digital twin. A fingerprint is generated for the hierarchy based upon the characterization and a blueprint which corresponds to the fingerprint retrieved from a data store, the blueprint defining a set of parameters to be applied to different computing elements of different nodes in the hierarchy determined to minimize a cascading effect of a state changing condition in one of the nodes. Finally, the set of parameters of the retrieved blueprint is applied to corresponding computing elements of the digital twin and a state changing condition is simulated in the digital twin in a selected node so as to compute the cascading effect of the state changing condition to other nodes dependent upon the selected node.

title_en: A kind of electric power in information society emerging system reliability estimation method based on stream association analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of electric power in information society emerging system reliability estimation methods based on stream association analysis.Electric power in information society emerging system is mapped as the double-deck coupling network by the present invention.Compared with conventional information electric power emerging system reliability estimation method, the data flow of Information Level in electric power in information society emerging system is mapped as the stream in the double-deck coupling network by the present invention, by being analyzed based on the remaining largest connected accounting flowed under associated failure cascading failure the double-deck coupling network, to assess the reliability of the electric power in information society emerging system, so that assessment result is more in line with reality, there is engineering value.

title_en: Wind power prediction method based on fluctuation sequence classification correction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind power prediction method based on fluctuation sequence classification correction, which comprises the following steps: 1, predicting a wind power reference value in N hours in the future by using a reference model; 2, dividing a power fluctuation process by adopting a characteristic clustering method, and mining the correlation between meteorological forecast errors and model generalization errors under different fluctuation sequences from the output power angle; 3, aiming at a small dynamic sequence with gentle output, adopting a CNN-LSTM time sequence model 1 to deduce the power change in a future time period; aiming at the non-small fluctuation sequence, a CNN-LSTM time sequence model 2 and a back propagation neural network are combined to interactively correct double-layer errors; and 4, combining the reference power correction results again according to the time sequence to obtain the final wind power output. The invention adopts a composite method combining time sequence analysis and feature learning to realize the correction of errors by extracting features from multiple dimensions and fit the actual error distribution rule, thereby ensuring that the model has good accuracy.
assignees: FERTILIZER COMBINING INDUSTRIAL UNIV;ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INSTITUTE OF ZHEJIANG PROVINCE ELECTRIC POWER LIMITED COMPANY OF STATE GR

title_en: Prediction method of lightning ground flash signal based on LSTM (least squares) circulating neural network
abstract_en: The application relates to a prediction method of lightning ground flash signals based on an LSTM circulating neural network. The method comprises the following steps: dividing a training set and a testing set by adopting the processed historical lightning electric field signals, constructing an LSTM model as a lightning electric field signal prediction model to be trained, initializing a weight matrix and a bias matrix of the LSTM model, inputting the training set into the LSTM model, carrying out forward propagation training by adopting a forward propagation algorithm, finishing training of the LSTM model by updating weights and biases by adopting an error back propagation algorithm, obtaining an optimal weight matrix and an optimal bias matrix, inputting the testing set into the LSTM model by adopting the optimal weight matrix and the optimal bias matrix for testing to reach preset precision, and obtaining a lightning electric field signal predicted by the trained lightning electric field signal prediction model in a future preset time period so as to determine whether lightning back shots occur or not and accurately realize lightning ground flash disaster prediction.

title_en: Power consumption behavior anomaly identification method, system, equipment and medium based on local cascade neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, equipment and a medium for identifying abnormal electricity consumption behavior based on a local cascade neural network, which belong to the technical field of intelligent power grid abnormality detection and comprise the steps of collecting multi-mode time sequence data of a plurality of monitoring nodes in a power grid, carrying out data preprocessing, dynamically generating a suspected local area based on a real-time electricity consumption coupling relation, inputting an output node set into a first-stage local neural network, carrying out feature extraction and residual calculation, outputting an information packet, inputting the information packet into a second-stage neural network, carrying out time sequence causal discovery and abnormal conduction path research and judgment, calling a corresponding incremental normal mode dictionary based on the output suspected source node, carrying out comparison and output verification conclusion, and carrying out comprehensive research and judgment through a multi-mode evidence fusion decision engine to generate a final structured abnormal report. The invention realizes high-precision, low-delay and interpretable detection and tracing of power consumption abnormality, and particularly shows remarkable robustness and practicability in a high-noise power grid environment.

title_en: Space-time correlation-based power system short-circuit parameter prediction method, system, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power grid safety evaluation, in particular to a power system short-circuit parameter prediction method, a system, equipment and a storage medium based on space-time correlation. And extracting space-time correlation characteristic vectors comprising time dimension characteristics, space-time coupling characteristics and state characteristics by constructing a multi-dimensional state vector comprising node voltage vectors, branch current vectors, short circuit impedance matrixes, space position information and time characteristic vectors. Wavelet transformation, fourier analysis and graph theory analysis are adopted to identify parameter change rules and propagation effects. And constructing a multi-level prediction model of a statistical prediction layer, a deep learning layer and a fusion layer, and comprehensively describing the dynamic characteristics of the short circuit parameters through space-time feature fusion. The method adopts a staged training strategy, and comprises the steps of establishing a basic model through offline training, updating parameters in real time through online learning and quantifying uncertainty through a probability prediction framework. And establishing a prediction correction mechanism and a reliability evaluation system to form a complete prediction-evaluation-correction closed loop.

title_en: Early warning method and system applied to hydraulic engineering construction risk assessment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a construction risk assessment early warning method and system applied to hydraulic engineering, which belong to the technical field of hydraulic engineering construction safety, and are used for collecting multi-source data of construction areas, constructing a multi-dimensional construction information flow set divided by time, working procedures and working points, constructing a time-space risk causal map based on construction units, expressing time sequence association and risk propagation paths among the construction units, mapping the information flow to a map structure, training a multi-task map neural network model, acquiring risk scores and future risk evolution trends of the construction units, carrying out cluster analysis on risk states, identifying high-risk working point sets, identifying risk linkage chains based on the causal map, and triggering grading early warning signals when the risk scores exceed a dynamic threshold or a closed propagation structure exists.
assignees: JIANGXI PROVINCE WATER CONSERVANCY ACADEMY JIANGXI PROVINCE DAM SAFETY MAN CENTER JIANGXI WATER RESO

title_en: Earthquake monitoring data analysis method and system based on big data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of earthquake monitoring, in particular to an earthquake monitoring data analysis method and system based on big data, comprising the following steps of analyzing the spatial relationship between a station and the earthquake based on the spatial distribution information of an observation station, and judging the change characteristics of the main seismic wave band at each station, and adjusting event distribution and frequency band response by combining the continuity of a propagation path, the depth change of a seismic source and the trend of heat flow density to obtain a frequency band response optimization set. According to the invention, by automatically matching the station sequence with the seismic event propagation path and combining the structural band with the heat flow change trend, synchronous judgment of event characteristics, space partition and trend classification is realized, a data period updating mechanism promotes a monitoring network to adapt to change in real time, frequency band response distribution is automatically adjusted, continuity and sensitivity of trend identification are continuously enhanced, structural richness and risk identification capability of seismic monitoring data are comprehensively improved, and capability of adapting to complex scenes is endowed to seismic observation.

title_en: Cascade hydropower station economic dispatching method considering spare capacity configuration optimization
abstract_en: The invention discloses an economic dispatching method of a cascade hydropower station considering spare capacity configuration optimization, and relates to the field of electric power systems, wherein the method comprises the steps of generating a probability density curve of joint errors based on probability distribution characteristics of new energy output and load, and determining the total requirement of the spare capacity of the system according to confidence level; the method comprises the steps of taking the minimum total cost as an objective function, wherein the total cost comprises the starting and stopping cost, the output cost and the spare capacity cost of the unit, taking thermal power unit constraint, new energy constraint, step hydroelectric unit constraint, line capacity constraint and electric power and electric quantity balance constraint into consideration, and realizing collaborative economic dispatching and spare capacity configuration of the step hydroelectric station and the thermal power unit through production simulation optimization solution. Through the cooperative optimization of economy and reliability, the invention not only reduces the running cost of the system, but also improves the accuracy of spare capacity configuration and the toughness of the power grid, and provides an innovative solution for the safe and efficient scheduling of a high-proportion new energy power system.
assignees: STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CO ELECTRIC POWER RESEARCH INSTITUTE

title_en: Heavy-duty card charging health evaluation method based on optimized graph rolling network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a re-card charging health evaluation method based on an optimized graph rolling network, which particularly relates to the technical field of electric operation and maintenance, and aims to realize space-time correlation modeling and intelligent maintenance path planning of the health state of a charging pile by collecting multi-source heterogeneous operation data of the charging pile and dividing a uniform time window, constructing a dynamic multi-graph structure integrating space, electric and behavior coupling relations, extracting local state evolution trend and neighbor influence factors of nodes to generate a joint feature vector, inputting features under the multi-time window into the multi-scale attention-enhanced graph rolling network to obtain joint potential health degree representation, calculating health scores based on the potential representation, identifying high risk nodes, constructing a potential failure propagation path map, combining the centrality index with degradation rate to generate a maintenance priority table, and outputting an optimized inspection path.

title_en: System for village-oriented disaster response intelligent unmanned information terminal
title_ko: 마을 중심의 재난대응 지능형 무인 정보 단말 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a village-centered disaster response intelligent unmanned information terminal system that enables optimal response within the golden time, such as rapid disaster situation dissemination and distribution of relief supplies, through a village-centered independent disaster response system in a village with low accessibility and insufficient transportation infrastructure, in the event of a disaster. More specifically, the village-centered disaster response intelligent unmanned information terminal system according to the present invention includes a disaster response system server that provides various disaster information, including nuclear power plant accidents and natural disasters, in real time to an unmanned information terminal when a disaster occurs, and an unmanned information terminal that is installed in a public facility including a village hall, a senior center, etc., and receives disaster information from the disaster response system server when a disaster occurs, disseminates the disaster situation, and distributes relief supplies.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 접근성이 낮고 교통 인프라가 부족한 마을에 마을 중심의 독자적인 재난 대응 시스템을 통해 재난 발생 시, 신속한 재난 상황 전파 및 구호 물자 배포 등 골든타임 내 최적의 대응을 가능하게 하는 마을 중심의 재난대응 지능형 무인 정보 단말 시스템에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 본 발명에 따른 마을 중심의 재난대응 지능형 무인 정보 단말 시스템은, 재난 발생 시, 실시간으로 원전 사고 및 자연재난 등을 포함하는 다양한 재난정보를 무인정보 단말기로 제공하는 재난대응 시스템 서버 및 마을회관, 경로당 등을 포함하는 공동시설에 설치되어 재난 발생 시, 상기 재난대응 시스템 서버로부터 재난정보를 수신하여 재난 상황을 전파하고, 구호물자를 배포하기 위한 무인정보 단말기를 포함한다.

title_en: Flashover analysis tool
abstract_en: According to the present invention, there is provided a method to minimize human intervention during decision making process while controlling the electrical power system by identifying the initiating element that cause a tripping of the transmission overhead lines and capable of identifying the potential future protection system failures that can initiate a cascading of tripping or total national blackout. A method of producing flashover analysis signal as a protection system analysis comprising processing a neutral current, three phase current profile, three phase voltage profile, and a plurality of digital signal of a transmission line using an artificial neural network to calculate pickup time, reset time, DEF confirmation time or total fault clearance time. A method of producing flashover analysis signal comprising as a flashover signature analysis to identify the cause of the flashover as a current transformer explosion, tree encroachment, crane, lightning strike or polluted insulator.
assignees: TNB RES SDN BHD;UNIV MALAYSIA TECH

title_en: Method for evaluating vulnerability of power network
abstract_en: The application discloses an assessment method for the vulnerability of a power network, which adopts an improved cascading failure Markov chain model, selects the next exact failure branch in a neighborhood power grid according to the probability of p for cascading failure state transition probability, selects the branch outside the neighborhood according to the probability of 1-p, calculates the load loss rate, the reduction rate of the characteristic parameters of the power transmission network, the total load loss and the characteristic parameters of the power transmission network, and assesses the vulnerability of the power grid. According to the method and the device, a neighborhood cascading reaction and non-neighborhood approximately random cascading failure model of the failure is constructed, and the method and the device are beneficial to the research of a cascading failure propagation mechanism. Meanwhile, when p is equal to 1, the defect that a serious fault boundary cannot be defined exactly based on a probability theory cascading failure method is solved, and a minimum electric energy transmission network characteristic parameter is taken as a next fault branch, so that a clear direction is provided for N-K analysis and early warning of the power network.

title_en: Atmospheric pollution prevention and control electricity consumption data analysis platform based on big data sharing
abstract_en: The invention discloses an atmospheric pollution prevention and control electricity consumption data analysis platform based on big data sharing, which comprises an electricity consumption information acquisition unit, a transmission module and a system master station, wherein the electricity consumption information acquisition unit comprises metering terminal equipment and acquisition and storage equipment which are installed on site, the system master station comprises a server group and a data analysis center, the system master station is connected with the electricity consumption information acquisition unit through the transmission module, and the data analysis center comprises a big data sharing analysis model based on a BP (back propagation) neural network. The invention is based on the electricity utilization information acquisition system, and uses big data sharing analysis and prediction as technical means, thereby realizing remote monitoring of the industrial electricity utilization data of gas-related pollution enterprises and various regions, and providing powerful support for making pollution control measures.

title_en: Aviation network risk propagation identification method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an aviation network risk propagation identification method, which is applied to the field of civil aviation risk assessment and comprises the following steps: determining an airport risk coefficient for the preprocessed airport pair risk time sequence data based on a pre-established airport risk coefficient model; determining a checking order according to the airport risk coefficient, and determining a corresponding residual square sum based on the checking order and the corresponding airport risk time sequence; the residual sum of squares is examined to identify risk propagation relationships between the airport pairs. The method determines the corresponding residual sum of squares based on the inspection order and the corresponding risk time sequence of the airport; and (4) the sum of squares of the residual errors is checked to identify the risk propagation relationship between the airport pairs, so that the judgment of whether risk propagation exists between two airports in the aviation network is realized.

title_en: Cascade reservoir group optimal scheduling method and system considering generated energy and minimum output
abstract_en: The invention provides a cascade reservoir group optimal scheduling method and system which give consideration to generated energy and minimum output, which can enable the generation of the cascade reservoir group to be more coordinated with the power grid demand and promote the cascade reservoir group to fully utilize the water energy. The cascade reservoir group optimization scheduling method taking the generated energy and the minimum output into consideration comprises the following steps: step 1, establishing a cascade reservoir group multi-objective optimization scheduling model with the aim of maximum cascade power generation capacity and minimum power output according to the basic situation of a river basin and comprehensive utilization requirements; step 2, solving a multi-objective model by adopting a DDDP-SA algorithm combined with penalty factors, and obtaining a non-inferior solution set with uniform and wide multi-objective problem distribution by controlling the variation range of the penalty factors and selecting discrete penalty factors in the range; and step 3, determining the optimal solution of the cascade reservoir group optimal scheduling according to the non-inferior solution set.

title_en: Household air conditioner load prediction method based on building load prediction and matching
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of air conditioner load prediction, and discloses a household air conditioner load prediction method based on building load prediction and matching, wherein the method uses TRNSYS to establish a building load calculation model, and combines meteorological parameters and the building model to calculate building load; building an air conditioner load matching function for matching the building load with the household air conditioner load by combining the household air conditioner load; and taking the meteorological parameters as input and the building load as output, establishing a building load back propagation neural network prediction model, and matching the building load calculated by the back propagation neural network load prediction model with the household air conditioner load through an air conditioner load matching function to realize the load prediction of the household air conditioner. The method is suitable for household electricity behavior analysis, is used as the basis of household electricity intelligent management strategies, and has good application prospects.

title_en: Artificial intelligence-based risk early warning method for supply chain of automobile part enterprise
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of automobile parts and discloses an artificial intelligence-based risk early warning method for an automobile part enterprise supply chain, which comprises the steps of collecting and processing supply chain data, constructing a map, evaluating suppliers based on the map to generate an image matrix, based on the image matrix, combining production parameters, carrying out model training, constructing a prediction engine to generate a part quality risk prediction result, carrying out anomaly detection on nodes to form a monitoring network, producing a risk assessment result, based on the map, constructing a supply chain network topology model, carrying out risk propagation path analysis, generating a risk conduction diagram, establishing a risk assessment model, integrating the risk prediction result, the risk assessment result and the risk conduction diagram, carrying out integrated assessment on risks of each link of the supply chain to form a scoring system, and based on the scoring system, generating a dynamic risk early warning threshold, constructing a risk response decision tree, providing an intelligent risk response suggestion, so that the risk treatment efficiency of the enterprise is improved.

title_en: Intelligent weather risk early warning system for mining industry
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mining safety management, in particular to a mining-oriented weather risk intelligent early warning system which comprises the steps of acquiring multi-source heterogeneous data such as mining area weather, geology and the like in real time by constructing a mining area multi-field coupling monitoring network, providing rich and accurate data bases for subsequent risk analysis, dynamically synthesizing mining area sceneries of weather threat factors by combining mining scene metadata and time sequence features through condition antagonism, accurately capturing weather risk features under different mining scenes, and helping a manager to quickly know mining area risk conditions by establishing a geologic body-weather field coupling risk propagation topological graph and generating a regional risk potential energy thermodynamic diagram, identifying medium and high risk areas by spatial clustering analysis, generating scene self-adaptive regulation and control instructions, improving pertinence and effectiveness of emergency response, and being beneficial to quickly controlling risks and reducing losses.

title_en: Robust observer-based power distribution network control input attack detection and state estimation method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of power system automation and information safety, and discloses a power distribution network control input attack detection and state estimation method based on a robust observer, which comprises the steps of constructing a power distribution network linear discrete dynamic model based on a Droop control, and improving the observability of a system by utilizing a multi-step observation structure and differential modeling; based on a disturbance propagation matrix and a zero space projection technology, the attack detection problem is converted into a sparse optimization problem, an Unknown Input Observer (UIO) is designed, the robustness is enhanced by combining a dynamic compensation matrix and feedback gain, and an online feedback mechanism is introduced to realize parameter self-adaptive update. The method can realize real-time identification of control instruction tampering attack and high-precision estimation of system state, and meets high requirements of power distribution network operation on safety, instantaneity and reliability.

title_en: LLMs-KG-based underground station facility flood vulnerability cascade effect analysis method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, and discloses a LLMs-KG-based underground station facility flood vulnerability cascade effect analysis method, which is characterized in that an underground station facility knowledge graph of object-behavior-state three-domain association is constructed by analyzing underground station facility components and association relations from top to bottom, a cellular automaton calculation model of flood evolution-facility component coupling is constructed, interaction between underground station facility components and flood is depicted, formal modeling and explicit semantic expression of the underground station facility association relations are realized through KG on one hand, and on the other hand, intelligent reasoning is carried out on interaction and cascade propagation paths between the underground station facility components under the action of flood disasters by utilizing LLMs, so that the transformation from traditional split type evaluation to system integral vulnerability evaluation is realized. Related achievements can provide important theoretical basis and technical support for establishing flood targeted emergency strategies of underground stations and improving system toughness.

title_en: Elevator network for emergency operation
abstract_en: A kind of emergency operation controller for elevator, the emergency operation controller arrives the corresponding emergency operation controller of other elevators by network connection, and each controller constitutes the node in network.When the controller detects emergency, other controllers for the adjacent node that the controller generates emergency situation detection message and constitutes the controller into the network transmit the emergency situation detection message, and when other controllers detect emergency, other controllers that the controller constitutes the adjacent node of the controller from the network receive emergency situation detection message.The emergency situation detection message includes propagating to count.Described propagate counts other controllers for being configured to be transferred to emergency situation detection message whenever a controller adjacent node after constituting and subtracts one.The emergency situation detection message is continuously transmitted on, until propagation counting reaches zero.

title_en: Swarm unmanned aerial vehicle fault propagation analysis method based on time sequence network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a swarm unmanned aerial vehicle fault propagation analysis method based on a time sequence network, and relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle fault analysis. The method solves the problem of difficult fault propagation modeling of the swarm unmanned aerial vehicle, can effectively describe the fault condition of the unmanned aerial vehicle, understand the propagation process of the fault in the swarm unmanned aerial vehicle, and provide a theoretical basis for the prevention and solution of the fault of the swarm unmanned aerial vehicle.

title_en: Foundation pit deformation safety risk assessment method based on artificial neural network and entropy method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating the safety risk of foundation pit deformation based on an artificial neural network and an entropy method, which belongs to the technical field of engineering monitoring informatization and comprises the following steps: 1. collecting foundation pit construction data and foundation pit deformation monitoring data, and establishing a data set; 2. establishing an artificial neural network based on a back propagation algorithm; 3. training an artificial neural network model; 4. performing foundation pit deformation prediction; 5. calculating the weight of the foundation pit deformation safety risk index; 6. and calculating the comprehensive risk score of the foundation pit deformation safety. The method for determining the risk factor weight based on the entropy method can objectively, accurately and dynamically determine the weight of the foundation pit deformation safety risk factor based on the foundation pit monitoring historical data, eliminates the influence of human factors, and obtains a more objective and convincing conclusion.
assignees: HANGZHOU COMMUNICATIONS INVEST GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Disaster area communication network multilayer information propagation model
abstract_en: The invention provides a disaster area communication network multilayer information propagation model, which comprises the following steps: and designing a disaster area communication network multilayer information propagation model to obtain an information propagation equilibrium state in the model, and proving the influence of parameters such as node density, node communication range and the like on the information propagation equilibrium state. The interference optimization problem based on the disaster area communication network multilayer information propagation model is solved, the network deployment cost is minimized by using a convex optimization technology, the optimal node density and node communication range are obtained, and network interference is effectively avoided. The effectiveness of the proposed model is verified through experiments under different environments, and simulation results show that the disaster area communication network multi-layer information propagation model provided by the invention can describe the information propagation process between disaster area communication network nodes, and meanwhile, parameter optimization is provided for the disaster area communication network by considering the interference of the environments to the network and the cost of deployment and communication of rescue nodes.

title_en: Network propagation simulation method and device for introducing imitator node
abstract_en: A network propagation simulation method and device for introducing a simulator node, wherein the simulator node becomes an active node after a designated node in a neighbor node corresponding to the simulator node becomes the active node, the method comprises the following steps: firstly, constructing a random network diagram; secondly, determining the node type and state in the random network; third, determining respective state updating rules of the imitator node and the common node; fourth, the cascading propagation of network information; after the number of active nodes in the fifth random network is stable, counting the number of active nodes. The application expands the original threshold model, considers the role of the imitator node in the social network, and is convenient for researching how the heterogeneous performance of the node in behavior enables information to be transmitted in the network.

title_en: Dynamic stress field generation method for fault state of annular mechanical structure bolt
abstract_en: A dynamic stress field generation method for a fault state of a bolt with an annular mechanical structure belongs to the technical field of mechanical health monitoring. The method aims to solve the technical problem of mathematical modeling of nonlinear stress wave propagation paths in the annular mechanical structure bolts. The method comprises the steps of initializing parameters of annular mechanical structure bolts to generate a loosening parameter data set, constructing a bidirectional stress field model, executing bidirectional stress calculation on each node bolt in the annular mechanical structure bolts, calculating each level of stress components in a circumferential acceleration direction by a forward stress component, calculating joint attenuation components in a circumferential deceleration direction by a reverse stress component, then calculating total stress of each node bolt in the annular mechanical structure bolts to construct an annular mechanical structure bolt self-adaptive measuring point network, adjusting measuring point positions according to a dynamic phase deviation matching formula, optimizing measuring point layout, superposing simulation noise conforming to N (0, sigma  2 ) normal distribution on each measuring point of the annular mechanical structure bolts, and generating a standard characteristic waveform library.

title_en: Operation and maintenance analysis method, device, equipment and medium of virtual power plant
abstract_en: The application discloses an operation and maintenance analysis method, device, equipment and medium for a virtual power plant, which are used for acquiring structural time sequence data, text data and image data generated in the operation and maintenance process of the virtual power plant, and extracting characteristics of the multi-mode data to obtain multi-mode fusion characteristics. The multimodal fusion feature is then input into the constructed causally enhanced multi-agent fault diagnosis framework for reasoning to determine the root cause of the fault and its propagation path for the virtual power plant. Meanwhile, an equipment health state evaluation model based on meta reinforcement learning is constructed, and the model is combined with the multi-mode fusion characteristics and the dynamic knowledge graph to evaluate the health state of equipment in the virtual power plant and output corresponding maintenance actions. The method and the system can improve the accuracy and the practicability of the operation and maintenance analysis of the virtual power plant, and are beneficial to enhancing the operation reliability, economy and flexibility of the virtual power plant in a complex power grid environment. The application can be widely applied to the technical field of electric power.
assignees: SOUTHERN POWER GRID PEAKING FREQUENCY MODULATION GUANGDONG ENERGY STORAGE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent monitoring and evaluating method and system for power quality of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent monitoring and evaluating method and system for electric energy quality of a power distribution network, which relate to the technical field of electric energy quality management of an electric power system and comprise the steps of constructing a node electrical correlation matrix, and mapping harmonic characteristic vectors to form a harmonic propagation characteristic diagram; performing spatial cluster analysis on the feature map, constructing a boundary convergence algorithm to locate pollution source nodes by using the ratio of the electrical distance to the harmonic impedance, matching the pollution source features with a preset library to identify the type of equipment, and constructing a multi-objective optimization model to generate a treatment scheme. The invention realizes the accurate positioning and identification of the harmonic pollution source and improves the power quality management efficiency.
assignees: STATE GRID JIBEI POWER CO LTD SMART DISTRIB NETWORK CENTER

title_en: Scheduling method and system based on linear alternating current power flow
abstract_en: The invention discloses a scheduling method and a scheduling system based on linear alternating current power flow, which belong to the technical field of electric power, wherein the method comprises the steps of setting a probability threshold value based on a vulnerability curve of real-time disaster data, and screening to form an expected initial fault set; modifying the power grid topology according to fault and overload information, preferentially searching and identifying isolated islands according to breadth, calculating the expected lowest frequency of the isolated islands and executing recovery operation, calculating power flow based on a linear alternating current power flow model, simulating relay protection and self-installation operation, identifying overload branches according to overload severity indexes and circularly processing, and executing an optimal scheduling strategy to eliminate overload. The method solves the problems of low cascading failure simulation accuracy, unstable tide solving and the like under extreme disasters, improves the authenticity of failure simulation and the dispatching reliability, can effectively block cascading failure propagation, reduces load loss and provides support for stable operation of the power system in the disasters.

title_en: Urban rainfall flood impact cascade propagation simulation method, system and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a city rainfall flood impact cascade propagation simulation method, a system and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing an infrastructure network according to city key infrastructure information; the method comprises the steps of constructing an interdependence matrix according to an infrastructure network, determining a dependency weight according to the interdependence matrix, determining an initial impact node in the infrastructure network according to urban meteorological observation data, inputting the infrastructure network, the upstream and downstream relation of the node, the dependency weight and the initial impact node into a cascade propagation simulation model to perform propagation simulation, and obtaining an urban rainfall flood impact cascade propagation simulation result. According to the embodiment of the invention, the infrastructure network, the node upstream-downstream relationship, the dependence weight and the initial impact node are input into the cascade propagation simulation model to perform propagation simulation, so that cascade simulation of the process from local node triggering to range diffusion of urban flood impact can be effectively realized, and the accuracy of urban flood disaster impact propagation simulation is improved.
assignees: INST GEOGRAPHIC SCIENCES & NATURAL RESOURCES RES CAS;UNIV JIANGXI NORMAL

title_en: Collaborative optimization control method and device for power distribution network and micro-grid
abstract_en: The application provides a collaborative optimization control method and a collaborative optimization control device for a power distribution network and a micro-grid, which relate to the technical field of intelligent grids, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining micro-distribution monitoring data flow; the method comprises the steps of carrying out multi-level fault prediction tracing, carrying out multi-level power flow reconstruction scheduling on a micro-cooperation power grid according to a micro-cooperation power grid prediction tracing map based on load time-varying characteristics, constructing a micro-cooperation dispatching space, introducing a reconstruction dispatching risk analysis model to carry out reconstruction dispatching risk filtering, carrying out power supply quality fitting evaluation filtering based on the load time-varying characteristics, and carrying out double-branch guide differential propagation optimizing on the micro-cooperation dispatching space to obtain a micro-cooperation dispatching optimizing result. According to the application, the technical problem of insufficient stability of the micro-grid coordination due to difficulty in effectively coping with faults and load fluctuation of the power distribution network and the micro-grid in the prior art is solved, and the intelligent scheduling and management capacity of the micro-grid coordination is improved, so that the reliability and stability of power supply are improved.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD NANTONG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH;UNIV HEFEI TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Monitoring system for fire of railway car
title_ko: 도시철도의 화재 감지 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A system and a method for monitoring a fire of a railway car are provided to prevent the spread direction of a fire by accurately grasping the spread direction and speed of a fire. CONSTITUTION: A sensor unit(110) is comprised of a plurality of sensors to sense a fire by measuring the density of volatile materials included in the air. A camera unit(120) verifies the fire through an image when the sensor unit senses the fire. A fire determining unit(130) grasps a fire point through the sensor unit and the camera unit and grasps the spread direction and speed of the fire. The sensor unit includes a smoke sensor, an optical sensor, a temperature sensor, a gas sensor, and an air sensor. The air sensor measures the concentration of volatile materials included in the air.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 도시철도의 화재 감지 시스템 및 그 방법에 관한 것으로서, 공기 중 휘발물질의 농도를 측정하여 화재 발생 여부를 감지하도록 복수의 센서들로 구성된 센서부와, 상기 센서부를 통해 화재 발생이 감지되면 영상을 통해 검증하는 카메라부와, 상기 센서부 및 카메라부를 통해 발화점을 파악하고, 화재의 전파 방향 및 전파 속도를 파악하는 화재 판단부로 구성된 것을 특징으로 한다. 
     따라서, 본 발명은 공기질, 유해가스, 풍향, 열감지, 온도 및 연기 감지 등의 센서 데이터와 영상 데이터를 융합하여 초기에 화재 발생 여부를 정확하게 판단할 수 있고, 화재의 전파 방향이나 전파 속도를 파악함으로써 신속한 화재 인식이 가능하고, 이를 기반으로 정확하고 신속한 화재 진압이 가능하고, 시설물 정보를 바탕으로 화재의 전파 방향과 전파 속도를 예측하여 발화점을 피해 승객의 대피 경로를 확보할 수 있으며, 화재 차단 게이트를 효율적으로 개폐할 수 있어 인적 및 물적 피해를 최소화할 수 있다.  
       
     도시철도, 화재 감지 시스템, 카메라부, 센서부, 화재 판단부

title_en: Coupling analysis system for ecological process and hydropower cascade development of mountain watershed water system
abstract_en: The invention provides a coupled analysis system for a mountain watershed water system ecological process and hydropower cascade development, which comprises a processor, an input device, an output device and a memory, wherein the processor is configured to call the program instructions and execute the following method: constructing a complex network model according to the modeling principle of natural attributes of rivers flowing from high terrains to low terrains; setting a river reach between a source and a junction or between the junction and the junction in the drainage system of the drainage basin to be analyzed as a node, and setting the flow direction of the drainage system in the drainage system of the drainage basin to be analyzed as an edge connecting each node; constructing an index system based on a complex network model; and constructing a coupling coordination index by using the index system, and performing coupling analysis on the ecological process of the watershed water system to be analyzed and the hydropower cascade development. The system can utilize a complex network to carry out coupling analysis of the ecological process of the mountain watershed water system and the development of the hydropower cascade, and has high accuracy.

title_en: Asteroid gravitational field reconstruction method based on physical information neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to an asteroid gravitational field reconstruction method based on a physical information neural network, which comprises the following steps of completing sampling of data points and generation of auxiliary points based on an asteroid substance point group model, constructing a gravitational potential function solver, preprocessing data for the data points and the generated auxiliary points, calculating the gravitational potential of each sampling point, calculating a Laplace equation and an gravitational acceleration rotation equation of the auxiliary points and an gravitational acceleration equation of the data points by using a partial differential equation solver for the gravitational potential of the sampling points, constructing a total loss function by combining a mean square error of the equations, carrying out error back propagation for the loss function, optimizing network parameters and each loss weight, evaluating a model prediction result for the optimized model, carrying out key sampling in a key area with larger prediction error, and finally adding the sampling result to an auxiliary point data set for continuous training.

title_en: Hierarchical distributed scheduling method and system for multi-microgrid power distribution system under carbon flow tracing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hierarchical distributed scheduling method and system of a multi-micro-grid power distribution system under carbon flow tracing, wherein the method comprises the steps of establishing operation constraint of the multi-micro-grid power distribution system according to system parameters and scheduling parameters of the selected multi-micro-grid power distribution system; the method comprises the steps of reasonably and averagely spreading carbon responsibility of a power distribution network source side to a load side based on a carbon emission flow theory, guiding a power distribution network-micro network interaction low-carbon energy consumption behavior, constructing a power distribution network system carbon transaction constraint and a multi-micro network system carbon transaction constraint under carbon flow tracing, establishing a multi-micro network power distribution system layered distributed scheduling model under carbon flow tracing by utilizing a target cascading theory, and decoupling interaction power by a target cascading method and carrying out iterative solution. The invention is based on a layered distributed optimization idea of a target cascade analysis method and a multi-microgrid power distribution system collaborative complementary operation strategy, and adopts a correlation solver to solve a mixed integer linear programming model in an optimization stage to obtain a system operation scheme in a scheduling period.

title_en: Quantitative evaluation method and system for fire risk of distribution network equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quantitative evaluation method and a quantitative evaluation system for fire risks of distribution network equipment, wherein the quantitative evaluation method comprises the steps of obtaining distribution network equipment data, constructing a quantitative first risk evaluation model based on the data, carrying out preliminary risk judgment based on the quantitative first risk evaluation model, analyzing fault transfer risks and calculating overall risk state values, constructing a quantitative second risk evaluation model for predicting the change condition of risk parameters, dynamically updating the overall risk state values, and carrying out fire risk early warning by combining the change condition of the risk parameters. According to the method, the transfer risk among the risk factors of the equipment can be dynamically monitored by calculating the starting condition value and the propagation threshold value according to the fuzzy membership degree of the nodes of different risk factors, and the nodes with high risk membership degree are amplified by calculating the risk contribution degree through the nonlinear function, so that the influence on the overall risk is more remarkable, and the influence on key nodes is facilitated to be highlighted when the overall risk of the system is evaluated.

title_en: Method for calculating propagation influence intensity of multi-source adaptability modification of product based on path coupling
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for calculating the propagation influence intensity of multi-source adaptive modification of a product based on path coupling, and belongs to the technical field of engineering modification. According to the method, a product adaptability change propagation network is constructed according to propagation influence relations among product parts, coupling nodes and coupling paths of multi-source adaptability change propagation are identified, the correlation of structural change attribute changes of corresponding parts caused by the coupling nodes when the coupling nodes are influenced by different change source propagation is determined, the direct propagation influence intensity of a front end node of the coupling paths on a rear end node during multi-source change is calculated, and the product multi-source adaptability change propagation influence intensity is calculated according to the correlation of the coupling paths, the direct propagation influence intensity of the coupling nodes and the change complexity of the parts. The invention can effectively identify the coupling nodes and the coupling paths with multisource adaptive modification, can improve the design efficiency of products, reduce modification cost and provide basis for the adaptive modification in the personalized customization process of the products.

title_en: Disaster response system that is based on the machine to machine and method thereof
title_ko: 사물지능통신을 기반으로 하는 재난대응시스템 및 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 유해화학가스 확산, 원유유출, 플랜트폭발, 방사능누출사고 등의 다양한 인재사고의 확산으로 인한 피해범위의 광역화와 누적적 장기화로 인한 불특정 다수의 주민과 생물환경에 심대한 영향을 주는 인적재난에 대해, 빅데이터를 기반으로 사고상황 발생 전부터 지속적으로 체크함으로써, 고확산, 고위험이 수반되는 유해화학물질의 관리를 체계적으로 수립 및 해당 지역 주민들에게 안내하여 사고발생 전부터 해당 지역 주민들에게 신속하게 대응 및 대처할 수 있게 안내하여 야기될 수 있는 위험성을 극소화시킴과 더불어 실제로 재난사고가 발생한 상태에서 지역 소속자들이 그 재난사고가 발생된 지역을 인지하고, 그 재난사고가 전파되는 지역을 회피하면서 안전한 지역까지 최단경로로 이동하게 안내하여 줌으로써, 재난사고 발생후에도 인명피해를 최소화시켜줄 뿐만 아니라 사고발생지역에 위치하는 소속자들이 보유한 단말과 중앙관제시스템 간의 무선인터넷망이 재난사고로 인해 본연의 구실을 수행하지 못하더라도 사고발생지역에 위치하는 소속자들의 위치를 확인하고 이를 통해, 소속자들이 안전하게 탈출할 수 있는 경로를 소속자들에게 제공하여 주는 사물지능통신을 기반으로 하는 재난대응시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 산업시설 주변지역의 상황을 감지하여 기설정된 주기마다 지역별 방재용 주변상황정보를 생성하고, 이를 TCP/IP 인터넷통신모듈(130)을 이용하여 TCP/IP 기반 인터넷망을 통해 전송하는 사물지능 방재센서 관리부재(100)들과; 상기 사물지능 방재센서 관리부재(100)들이 설치된 산업시설 주변지역에 속하는 소속자가 소유한 단말로서, 해당 소속자의 위치를 나타내는 산업시설 주변지역 소속자 위치좌표정보를 무선인터넷 통신모듈(220)을 이용하여 무선인터넷망을 통해 송신하는 산업시설 주변지역 소속자용 단말(200)과; 상기 산업시설 주변지역을 나타내는 지도 상에 상기 사물지능 방재센서 관리부재(100)들의 위치가 표시된 산업시설 주변지역 사물지능 방재센서 위치 안내용 지도정보가 저장된 산업시설 주변지역 사물지능 방재센서 위치 안내용 지도 목록정보 DB(316)를 포함하는 DB부(310); 재난분석엔진(320) 및 안전이동경로 생성엔진(330);을 갖는 것으로, 상기 재난분석엔진(320)을 운영하여, 상기 사물지능 방재센서 관리부재(100)로부터 TCP/IP 기반 인터넷망을 통해 기설정된 주기마다 방재용 주변상황정보들을 전송받고, 그 전송된 방재용 주변황상정보들을 분석하여 사고가 감지된 경우 그 사고가 감지된 방재용 주변상황정보를 전송한 해당 사물지능 방재센서 관리부재(100)를 인지하며, 상기 산업시설 주변지역 소속자용 단말(200)들로부터 무선인터넷망을 통해 산업시설 주변지역 소속자 위치좌표정보들을 전송받고, 상기 안전이동경로 생성엔진(330)을 운영하여, 상기 산업시설 주변지역 사물지능 방재센서 위치 안내용 지도 목록정보 DB(316)에서 산업시설 주변지역 사물지능 방재센서 위치 안내용 지도정보를 추출하여 그 추출된 산업시설 주변지역 사물지능 방재센서 위치 안내용 지도정보 상에 상기 사고가 감지된 방재용 주변상황정보를 전송한 해당 사물지능 방재센서 관리부재(100)를 중심으로 사고위험반경(r1)을 설정하며, 상기 추출된 산업시설 주변지역 사물지능 방재센서 위치 안내용 지도정보 상에 상기 사고가 감지된 방재용 주변상황정보를 전송한 해당 사물지능 방재센서 관리부재(100)로부터 안전한 지역을 나타내는 안전지역(SZ)을 선정한 후 상기 전송된 산업시설 주변지역 소속자 위치좌표정보들을 참조하여 상기 추출된 산업시설 주변지역 사물지능 방재센서 위치 안내용 지도정보 상의 사고위험반경(r1)의 외(外)에 위치하는 소속자들을 인지하며, 그 인지된 해당 소속자들의 위치에서 상기 안전지역(SZ)까지 최단으로 이동하는 경로인 위험전파 회피기반 최단경로(MR)를 검색하여 상기 추출된 산업시설 주변지역 사물지능 방재센서 위치 안내용 지도정보 상에 표시하고 이를, 상기 사고위험반경(r1)의 외(外)에 위치하는 소속자들의 산업시설 주변지역 소속자용 단말(200)로 통보하는 재난대응서버(300);에 있어서, BLE통신모듈(530b,530c)과 RSSI 측정모듈(520b,520c)을 갖는 한 쌍의 위치측정용 슬레이브측 설치지점별 근거리 위치안내단말(500b,500c) 및 BLE통신모듈(530a)과 RSSI 측정모듈(520a)을 갖는 위치측정용 마스터측 설치지점별 근거리 위치안내단말(500a)이 한 조로 이루어져 산업시설 주변지역마다 분포설치되는 설치지점별 근거리 위치안내단말군(500);을 포함하고, 상기 위치측정용 마스터측 설치지점별 근거리 위치안내단말(500a)에는 한 조로 이루어진 한 쌍의 위치측정용 슬레이브측 설치지점별 근거리 위치안내단말(500b,500c) 및 위치측정용 마스터측 설치지점별 근거리 위치안내단말(500a)을 삼점(三點)으로 연결하여 이루어지는 영역을 포함하는 설치지점지역을 나타내는 설치지점별 주변지도정보가 저장된 설치지점별 주변지도 목록정보 DB(511a)를 더 포함하며, 상기 재난대응서버(300)는 상기 방재용 주변상황정보들의 분석된 값이 사고발생 예측상황감지에 해당하는 경우 기설정주기마다 상기 산업시설 주변지역 소속자용 단말(200)로 무선인터넷망이 정상작동된다는 것을 안내하는 무선인터넷망 정상작동안내신호를 전송하며, 상기 산업시설 주변지역 소속자용 단말(200)은 상기 재난대응서버(300)로부터 무선인터넷망을 통해 기설정주기마다 전송되는 무선인터넷망 정상작동안내신호가 전송되지 않는 경우 사용자 식별정보 및 서버단절 안내정보를 포함하는 무선단절 안내신호를 블루투스 통신모듈(230)을 이용하여 근거리통신망을 통해 전송하고, 상기 설치지점별 근거리 위치안내단말군(500)을 이루는 것으로, 산업시설 주변지역마다 분포설치된 한 조를 이루는 한 쌍의 위치측정용 슬레이브측 설치지점별 근거리 위치안내단말(500b,500c) 및 위치측정용 마스터측 설치지점별 근거리 위치안내단말(500a) 중 상기 산업시설 주변지역 소속자용 단말(200)로부터 근거리통신망을 통해 전송되는 무선단절 안내신호가 수신가능한 근거리지역에 위치하는 한 조를 이루는 한 쌍의 위치측정용 슬레이브측 설치지점별 근거리 위치안내단말(500b,500c)의 BLE통신모듈(530b,530c)과 위치측정용 마스터측 설치지점별 근거리 위치안내단말(500a)의 BLE통신모듈(530a)에서 상기 무선단절 안내신호를 각각 수신하며, 상기 무선단절 안내신호를 수신한 상기 한 쌍의 위치측정용 슬레이브측 설치지점별 근거리 위치안내단말(500b,500c)은 RSSI 측정모듈(520b,520c)을 운영하여 그 수신된 무선단절 안내신호의 세기(RSSI)를 측정하고, 그 측정된 값인 한 쌍의 슬레이브측 세기측정정보를 BLE통신모듈(530b,530c)을 이용하여 근거리통신망을 통해 한 조를 이루는 상기 위치측정용 마스터측 설치지점별 근거리 위치안내단말(500a)로 전송하고, 상기 한 쌍의 위치측정용 슬레이브측 설치지점별 근거리 위치안내단말(500b,500c)과 한 조를 이루는 상기 위치측정용 마스터측 설치지점별 근거리 위치안내단말(500a)은 RSSI 측정모듈(520a)을 운영하여 그 수신된 무선단절 안내신호의 세기(RSSI)를 측정하고, 그 측정된 값인 마스터측 세기측정정보와 상기 BLE통신모듈(530a)을 통해 수신되는 한 쌍의 슬레이브측 세기측정정보를 토대로 상기 무선단절 안내신호를 수신한 해당 위치측정용 마스터측 설치지점별 근거리 위치안내단말(500a) 및 한 쌍의 위치측정용 슬레이브측 설치지점별 근거리 위치안내단말(500b,500c)의 삼점(三點)으로 연결되는 설치지점지역에서 상기 무선단절 안내신호를 송신한 상기 산업시설 주변지역 소속자용 단말(200)의 위치를 나타내는 설치지점별 소속자 위치좌표정보를 생성하며, 상기 설치지점별 주변지도 목록정보 DB(511a)에서 상기 설치지점별 소속자 위치좌표정보가 포함되는 설치지점별 주변지도정보를 추출하여 그 추출된 설치지점별 주변지도정보 상에 상기 설치지점별 소속자 위치좌표정보를 참조하여 지근거리용 탈출경로를 표시하여 탈출안내용 설치지점별 주변지도정보로 가공하며, 그 가공된 탈출안내용 설치지점별 주변지도정보에 상기 사용자 식별정보를 취합하고 이를, 블루투스 통신모듈(530a)을 이용하여 근거리통신망을 통해 전송하고, 상기 산업시설 주변지역 소속자용 단말(200)은 상기 위치측정용 마스터측 설치지점별 근거리 위치안내단말(500a)로부터 근거리통신망을 통해 전송되는 탈출안내용 설치지점별 주변지도정보를 블루투스 통신모듈(230)을 통해 수신하고, 그 수신된 탈출안내용 설치지점별 주변지도정보에 취합된 사용자 식별정보를 토대로 사용자 식별을 수행한 후 탈출안내용 설치지점별 주변지도정보를 출력 안내하는 시스템 및 이를 이용한 방법을 제공하는 특징으로 한다.

title_en: It is a kind of based on power flow transfer than thermally-stabilised key transmission channel recognition method
abstract_en: The invention discloses it is a kind of based on power flow transfer than thermally-stabilised key transmission channel recognition method, belong to Power System and its Automation technical field.The present invention carries out Contingency screening by monitoring element load factor after failure judgement and failure prior fault element load rate to forecast failure set；For the power flow transfer ratio of monitoring element after the calculation of fault failure in critical failure set, main power flow transfer element is screened than threshold value according to power flow transfer, the cascade connection and the limitation of total transfer ratio threshold value for further considering element determine main power flow transfer element；The main power flow transfer element of critical failure is constituted into the key transmission passage of candidate together with fault element, the thermally-stabilised power limit based on power flow transfer than estimating passway for transmitting electricity determines key transmission passage by thermally-stabilised power limit nargin in candidate collection.The present invention can meet the requirement for considering that the thermally-stabilised key transmission passage of forecast failure scene Recognition carries out safety on line monitoring under power network current operating situation.
assignees: CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO;NARI TECHNOLOGY DEV CO LTD;NANJING NARI GROUP CORP

title_en: Transmission line of electricity fragility recognition methods based on cascading failure network
abstract_en: The present invention discloses the transmission line of electricity fragility recognition methods based on cascading failure network, comprises the following steps：Step a：Numbering is proceeded by from 1 to the transmission line of electricity in electric power networks, and obtains the data message in the electric power networks；Step b：Transmission line of electricity vulnerability assessment Index Formula (I) is established, establishes system loading loss late formula (II)；Step c：The failure chain of electric power networks is built by formula (I) and formula (II)；Step d：According to the failure chain building cascading failure network topological diagram of electric power networks；Step e：The out-degree and in-degree of every transmission line of electricity are calculated according to cascading failure network topological diagram；Step f：Transmission line of electricity out-degree size in electric power networks, successively record circuit number；Transmission line of electricity in-degree size in electric power networks, successively record circuit number.The present invention can effectively be distinguished by the calculating to the out-degree and in-degree of Weighted Coefficients in cascading failure network to fragility circuit.

title_en: A method of it is predicted for energy consumption
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of method for energy consumption prediction, comprising: step 1, data target standardization: the energy-consuming influence factor of arrangement and total energy consumption experimental data are standardized, and realize nondimensionalization；Step 2 establishes prediction time in advance solving model and solves prediction time in advance: the prediction time in advance based on invention is theoretical and designs solving model, finds out each index to standardized data and predicts time in advance, and forms one group of new experimental data；Step 3, Data Dimensionality Reduction processing: dimensionality reduction is carried out to previous step data based on principal component analysis, eliminates multiple conllinear influence；Step 4, neural network prediction: joined momentum term in the error back propagation of traditional neural algorithm and improve, and by upper step, treated that data band enters the complete network training of neural model, is finally predicted.Using technical solution of the present invention, it can more accurately realize that energy-consuming is predicted.

title_en: Recovery analysis method is coupled after urban infrastructure system calamity
abstract_en: The invention discloses couple recovery analysis method after a kind of urban infrastructure system calamity, it is modeled comprising disaster analysis, Analysis of Structural Damage, loss function estimation, functional rehabilitation predicts four parts, disaster establishes the Load Model within the scope of City-scale with Spatial-Temporal Variability and correlation using Random Field Theory first after occurring, Load Model based on foundation calculates the faulted condition of each monomer of urban architecture group and the sub- component of infrastructure system under random load effect, the cascading as caused by Function Coupling between reutilization system opinion technique study urban architecture group and all kinds of infrastructure, assess the loss function of Building group and infrastructure system, it finally predicts recovery time after each infrastructure system calamity and restores track；The method of the invention realizes the quantitative analysis of loss function and recovery process after urban infrastructure system calamity, are the committed steps of toughness city quantitative evaluation, and the decision model that can promote city toughness for development is provided fundamental basis.
assignees: RENKE ZHEJIANG DATA TECH CO LTD

title_en: Risk identification method and system for label propagation algorithm of client network characteristics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a risk identification method and a system of a label propagation algorithm of client network characteristics, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining historical customer data information and preprocessing the historical customer data information; obtaining an account-level fund transaction table and a client-level fund transaction table according to the preprocessed historical client data information; obtaining a first point file and a first relation file according to the account-level fund transaction table and the client-level fund transaction table; constructing a network model according to the first point file and the first relation file; obtaining network characteristic information of the first client according to the network model; obtaining a risk conduction coefficient of the first client according to the network characteristic information of the first client; analyzing the risk of the first customer according to the risk transmission coefficient of the first customer. The method solves the technical problems that in the prior art, the identification rate of the client with the risk is low in risk identification, and the application method is obviously insufficient and limited.

title_en: Landslide deformation displacement prediction method for improving BP neural network
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention relates to the technical field of neural networks, and discloses a landslide deformation displacement prediction method for an improved BP neural network, which comprises the following steps: collecting landslide training data and constructing a prediction data set; normalizing the prediction data set; establishing a BP neural network model by adopting an ant colony algorithm, and calculating the optimal solution of the BP neural network model; training the BP neural network model by adopting an optimal solution to obtain a landslide prediction model; and correcting the landslide prediction model according to the time error sequence to obtain a prediction result. According to the landslide prediction method and device, based on landslide historical monitoring data, a landslide prediction model is established by improving a BP (back propagation) data network, accurate prediction of landslide disasters is achieved under the condition that multiple influence factors exist and the influence factors show nonlinear changes, monitoring cost and construction cost are reduced through reasonable planning and design, and life and property safety of people is effectively protected.
assignees: JIANGXI NUCLEAR INDUSTRY SURVEYING AND MAPPING INST GROUP CO LTD;JIANGXI MANPU INFORMATION TECH CO LTD;JIANGSU KEBO SPACE INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Hydropower plant power generation control method considering power grid operation stability
abstract_en: The invention relates to a hydropower plant power generation control method considering the operation stability of a power grid, and belongs to the technical field of hydropower. The method includes the steps that based on historical electricity price data, a date with the highest similarity to working conditions on an operation day is identified by considering electricity price influence factors, and electricity price data on the similar day is used as a prediction training set; adopting a Gaussian process regression method to predict a probability interval, and determining a confidence interval and an interval discrete electricity price point of each time interval on the operation day; establishing an upstream hydropower station day-ahead market application and return optimization model; solving by adopting a self-adaptive particle swarm optimization algorithm; further obtaining a day-ahead market declared volume curve of the upstream hydropower station in each time period all day; then generating a downstream power station declared rating curve based on the cascade output coupling relation; and finally, performing power generation control based on the reported electric quantity. The method can prevent the water abandon of the power station, not only can save the waste of water resources, but also can ensure the safety and stability of the operation of the power grid, and is easy to popularize and apply.
assignees: KUNMING ELECTRIC POWER TRANSACTION CENTER CO LTD

title_en: Physical information safety early warning method, device and equipment for liquefied natural gas receiving station
abstract_en: The application provides a physical information safety early warning method, a physical information safety early warning device and physical information safety early warning equipment for a liquefied natural gas receiving station. The method comprises the following steps: respectively identifying nodes on each subsystem of each layer, and determining risk nodes and a connection mechanism of the risk nodes; acquiring a risk network structure according to the risk nodes and the connection mechanism of the risk nodes; respectively acquiring the risk entropy, the risk state and the energy influence value of each risk node by adopting an SIRS model; and respectively acquiring the propagation processes under two preset propagation mechanisms according to the risk entropy, the risk state and the energy influence value of each risk node so as to realize the prediction of the risk path. Compared with the prior art that workers conduct qualitative analysis on the nodes in the station according to personal service levels and work experiences, the method and the system achieve quantitative analysis on risk propagation objectively according to risk entropy, risk states and energy influence values and finish prediction of risk paths.

title_en: Annual planned electric quantity curve decomposition method for cascade hydropower station group
abstract_en: A method for decomposing annual planned electric quantity curves of a cascade hydropower station group comprises the following steps: step one: taking the differentiated load regulation requirements of a plurality of receiving end power grids into consideration, and constructing a peak regulation criterion model of electric quantity curve decomposition; step two: determining a typical load curve of each receiving-end power grid in a peak shaving criterion model; step three: using the large M method, a 0-1 variable b is introduced  sc,d,k,m  Large number M, two continuous variables x  sc,d,k,m  、o  sc,d,k,m  At this time, the mathematical description of the positive and negative deviation can be abstracted into a general rule of the power market performance problem, and then a mixed integer programming model is adopted for solving. The method can obtain reasonable annual month-by-month electric quantity decomposition curves of multiple power grids of the cascade hydropower stationAnd the differential peak shaving requirements of different receiving end power grids can be effectively responded, and the differential load response capability of the cascade hydroelectric system to the receiving end power grids is improved.

title_en: Fire intelligent identification method and device, cloud equipment and computer device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of intelligent fire disaster identification, in particular to an intelligent fire disaster identification method and device, cloud equipment and a computer device, which improve the accuracy of fire disaster identification. The fire intelligent identification method comprises the steps of constructing a multi-level separation convolutional neural network, wherein the multi-level separation convolutional neural network is mainly composed of lightweight multi-view decoupling convolutional modules, the lightweight multi-view decoupling convolutional modules are formed by cascading at least two lightweight multi-view decoupling convolutional sub-modules with different convolutional directions, the output of the former sub-module serves as the input of the latter sub-module, and the input of the lightweight multi-view decoupling convolutional module is connected to the output of the latter sub-module through a residual path to form the final output of the lightweight multi-view decoupling convolutional module; training the multi-level separation convolutional neural network through the training data set, optimizing parameters of the multi-level separation convolutional neural network, and identifying fire disaster through the trained multi-level separation convolutional neural network. The invention is suitable for fire disaster identification.

title_en: Urban rail transit network toughness assessment method considering passenger flow dynamics
abstract_en: The invention discloses an urban rail transit network toughness assessment method considering passenger flow dynamics, and relates to the technical field of urban rail transit network assessment. The urban rail transit network system comprises a modeling of an urban rail transit network by using a complex network theory, calculation of traffic demands among stations in the urban rail transit network to obtain passenger flow demand data, acquisition of passenger flow distribution by adopting a user balancing model according to the passenger flow demand data from an origin to a destination among nodes, establishment of an urban rail transit network cascade failure model considering station overload, establishment of an urban rail transit network recovery model considering passenger flow redistribution and station repairing states, quantification of urban rail transit network recovery capacity through three indexes of nodes, lines and topology, and evaluation of urban rail transit network toughness. The invention constructs the performance evaluation index from three aspects of nodes, lines and topology, and can comprehensively grasp the change of the urban rail transit network operation performance in all aspects.

title_en: Dynamic identification method for risk evolution law of complex water network system
abstract_en: The invention provides a dynamic identification method of a complex water network system risk evolution law, which comprises the steps of collecting basic information and identifying risk factors to obtain a risk factor sample set, dividing hydraulic engineering of a water network research area into three-level mutual feedback layered structures to construct a multi-target real-time risk scheduling model, solving to obtain a risk scheduling scheme set, combining the risk scheduling scheme set and aiming at the layered structures of the complex water network system, establishing a real-time scheduling risk propagation model and a global real-time risk propagation network model of each level, respectively identifying vulnerability nodes and key risk paths of each level based on the global real-time risk propagation network model, and carrying out cross-level node dominance mapping on the vulnerability nodes and the key risk paths of the whole water network system. The method comprehensively considers multiple uncertainties, improves the calculation efficiency and the accuracy of risk positioning, and has important significance for risk regulation and control of the water network system.

title_en: Non-key unit fire risk assessment method integrating human factor analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-key unit fire risk assessment method integrating human factor analysis, which comprises the steps of constructing a fire human factor analysis time sequence analysis model, dividing an assessment subspace and collecting human factor dynamic data; and extracting fire risk parameters such as the use frequency of the electrical equipment and the like, and fusing the fire risk parameters with corresponding human data characteristics to form vectors. The vector element relationships are captured by means of a detrimental multi-headed attention mechanism architecture, generating attention weighted feature vectors. According to the vector, a time sequence analysis model is combined to deduce a human factor change trend, and each subspace risk influence factor is determined. And (3) establishing a risk propagation network, setting weights by considering subspace physical positions and personnel flows, and simulating risk diffusion. And finally, determining the overall fire risk level of the non-key unit by combining the risk diffusion simulation result, the artificial factor model deduction result and the attention weighted feature vector through the comprehensive evaluation model, and providing a scientific basis for fire prevention and control.
assignees: CHENGDE YUNFANG SMART FIRE FIGHTING CO LTD

title_en: Attribution evaluation method for composite extreme climate event of Qinghai-Tibet plateau
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of meteorological monitoring and climate prediction, in particular to a method for attributing and evaluating composite extreme climate events of Tibet plateau; the method comprises the steps of integrating ground observation, remote sensing and analysis data through a multisource data dynamic space-time weight fusion technology to achieve outlier correction and non-uniform interpolation, adopting a multivariate combined extreme index and space-time coupling graph model to identify a composite event and generate a structured label comprising intensity, range, duration and evolution paths, constructing a multiscale causal network analysis driving factor contribution, implementing physical constraint disturbance based on causal weights, recovering high-resolution response through combining a Bayesian agent model with terrain constraint random downsampling, deducing space-time evolution through an event propagation network, and adopting a kernel polynomial mixed uncertainty propagation framework to generate a probabilistic scene set to achieve multilevel risk early warning and dynamic knowledge base optimization. The invention comprehensively improves the attribution precision and the early warning efficiency of the original composite extreme event.
assignees: NAT CLIMATE CENTRE;CHENGDU PLATEAU METEOROLOGICAL INST OF CHINA METEOROLOGICAL ADMINISTRATION
