title_en: Electric vehicle charging demand prediction method based on vehicle-pile-network interactive coupling model
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of electric automobiles and intelligent traffic systems. The electric vehicle charging demand prediction method based on the vehicle-pile-network interactive coupling model is characterized by comprising the following steps of 1, taking a data layer as a system input end, integrating an electric vehicle track data set, actual traffic network data obtained from an OSM open platform, the number of electric vehicles on station of a real-time charging station and distribution network parameter data, 2, constructing a cross-domain collaborative model based on data layer output by a model layer, 3, extracting urban trip OD matrix distribution from the track data, generating a traffic flow space-time thermodynamic diagram, providing macroscopic demand input for path planning, and 4, carrying out multi-layer cascade simulation on the data layer, the model layer and an algorithm layer, establishing a three-layer closed-loop simulation frame, and finally simulating and predicting electric vehicle charging demand load. The method predicts the charging demand in real time.
assignees: YICHANG CHANGJIANG SANXIA ANDIAN TECH CO LTD;YICHANG POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV CHINA THREE GORGES CTGU

title_en: Power grid toughness assessment method and system based on urban lifeline cross-system interconnection
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for evaluating toughness of a power grid based on cross-system interconnection of urban lifelines, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a communication network model of the power grid to be evaluated in a target area; the method comprises the steps of carrying out fault propagation on a power grid to be evaluated under a preset disaster situation through a preset cascading fault mechanism to obtain a fault propagation result, carrying out recovery simulation on the power grid to be evaluated under the preset disaster situation through a preset recovery mechanism to obtain a recovery simulation result, analyzing the fault propagation result and the recovery simulation result based on a predefined structural toughness index to obtain the structural toughness of the power grid to be evaluated, analyzing the fault propagation result and the recovery simulation result based on a predefined functional toughness index to obtain the functional toughness of the power grid to be evaluated, fusing the structural toughness and the functional toughness to obtain comprehensive toughness, and completing the toughness evaluation of the power grid to be evaluated. Compared with the prior art, the method and the device remarkably improve the comprehensiveness and accuracy of the power grid toughness evaluation.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: System for Alarm Broadcasting of Indoor using Broadcasting Means
title_ko: 방송 수단을 이용한 옥내용 경보 방송 시스템
abstract_en: According to the present invention, an indoor alarm broadcasting system using a broadcasting means can spread a disaster situation to the inside of buildings in a disaster area, a major organization, and a densely populated area by using a VHF communication network in an event of the disaster situation, so that an active response can be performed with respect to an alarming situation by delivering the alarming situation to residents in the buildings which exist as the shaded area in a conventional alarming wave. Therefore, the loss of life and property can be reduced or prevented.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 방송 수단을 이용한 옥내용 경보 방송 시스템에 따르면, 재난 상황 발생 시 VHF 통신망을 이용하여 신속하게 재난 지역, 주요 기관 및 인구 밀집 지역의 건물 내부로 재난 상황을 전파할 수 있도록 하여, 기존 방식의 경보 전파에 음영 지역으로 존재하던 건물 내 거주민들에게 경보 상황을 전달함으로써, 경보 상황에 대하여 능동적인 대처를 할 수 있도록 하여 인명 피해와 재산 손실을 줄이거나 방지할 수 있도록 하는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Wind-solar-water complementary power generation plan calculation method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of planning and design of power dispatching systems, in particular to a wind-light-water complementary power generation plan calculation method based on power grid structure and cascade hydropower station hydraulic connection coupling in a hydropower, wind power and photovoltaic power generation mutual compensation operation mode. The method comprises the following steps: establishing a layered structure covering the basin hydropower stations, the wind power and photovoltaic physical power stations and the power supply set according to the power output channels of the wind power, photovoltaic and cascade hydropower stations in the basin; on the basis of the established power station and power supply layered structure, establishing a wind, light and water complementary scheduling model comprehensively considering the hydraulic connection between a power station sending-out channel and the power station in a drainage basin; the model is solved according to a hierarchical coordination method, and the requirements of power grid operation-oriented cascade hydropower station, basin wind power and photovoltaic power supply complementary power generation operation and planning are met.

title_en: Information association propagation and non-association propagation realization method based on threshold model
abstract_en: The invention provides an information association propagation and non-association propagation realization method based on a threshold model, which comprises the steps of (S1) constructing a random network, (S2) distributing an initial threshold value to all nodes in the network, setting the initial state of all nodes in the network as an S state, randomly selecting one node as a first generation information propagation source, (S3) propagating information according to a threshold value model mechanism, carrying out first generation and second generation information propagation from one node, (S4) propagating information according to the threshold value model mechanism, carrying out first-generation and second-generation non-association information propagation from one node, and (S5) calculating the occupation of the number of the non-S state nodes in the network in the total number of the nodes after the propagation is ended as a final cascade range.

title_en: Port petrochemical region transportation risk early warning method and system based on cascading failure
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of risk early warning, provides a port and petrochemical region transportation risk early warning method and a system based on cascade failure, and solves the problems that the existing petrochemical port region road transportation network is easily disconnected after being attacked, so that traffic jam is easy to occur, and the social risk and the personal risk value of a petrochemical port region are increased; the early warning method comprises the following steps: acquiring a port petrochemical region basic road network architecture; extracting key road network nodes of the port petrochemical region in a port petrochemical region basic road network framework, and evaluating the initial potential transportation risk of the key road network nodes; acquiring an initial potential transportation risk result of a key road network node; according to the embodiment of the invention, the importance of important nodes in the geographic network of the petrochemical port area is researched through a multi-attribute decision method to carry out comprehensive sequencing, so that the safety and the efficiency of the network are better guaranteed, the practical significance is provided for the road planning and transportation safety organization of the petrochemical port area, and the road congestion of the petrochemical port area is reduced.

title_en: Centralized heating network management monitoring method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention provides a centralized heating network management monitoring method and system based on artificial intelligence, which collect pressure, temperature, flow and pipe wall acoustic vibration time sequence data of each node. The multi-modal fusion feature vector is generated by calculating the hydraulic imbalance, enthalpy difference change rate and extracting the MFCC features of the acoustic vibration signal. Initializing the pipe network topology into a graph structure, and dynamically calculating the association weight among nodes by using a relationship attention mechanism, thereby constructing a time-varying thermodynamic propagation graph. And the space-time characteristics are fused and extracted through a double-branch time convolution module, the space-time characteristics are input into a fully connected network, the fault type and the position are output, and a topological perception weighting loss function optimization model is adopted during training.

title_en: Smart apartment complex security system that implements crime prediction through video analysis
title_ko: 영상분석을 통한 범죄 예측을 구현한 스마트 공동주택 보안 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed in the present invention is a smart apartment complex security system, including: an optical camera (110) that captures the inside and outside of an apartment complex and generates first image information; an infrared camera (120) installed inside the household to capture thermal images and generate second image information; a home network server (130) that integrates and manages IoT smart home appliances (131) that perform security, intrusion prevention, heating, cooling, ventilation, cooking, illumination control, and safety accident prevention, respectively, by linking therewith, performs real-time control and reservation control, generates first warning information when the front door is attempted to be opened using unregistered biometric information, and receives the first image information and the second image information to analyze the intrusion of an unregistered outsider into the apartment complex and generate second warning information; a resident terminal (140) that receives and monitors operation detection information, first image information, and second image information according to operation from the home network server (130), and spreads an alarm according to the first warning information and second warning information; and a management office server (150) that is connected to the home network server (130) and the resident terminal (140) through a communication network to receive first warning information and second warning information, receive and store the corresponding image information, and transmit an alarm to a public safety center server (160). Therefore, crimes caused by outsider intrusion can be prevented in advance.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 공동주택 내외부를 촬영하여 제1영상정보를 생성하는 광학카메라(110), 세대 내부에 설치되어 열화상을 촬영하여 제2영상정보를 생성하는 적외선카메라(120), 보안과 침입탑지와 난방과 냉방과 환기와 요리와 조도와 안전사고예방을 각각 수행하는 IoT 스마트 가전기기(131)와 연동하여, 통합관리하며, 실시간 제어 및 예약 제어를 수행하고, 미등록 생체정보에 의한 현관도어의 개방시도시에 제1경고정보를 생성하고, 제1영상정보 및 제2영상정보를 전송받아 해당 공동주택의 미등록 외부인의 침입을 분석하여 제2경고정보를 생성하는, 홈 네트워크 서버(130), 홈 네트워크 서버(130)로부터 운용에 따른 작동감지정보와 제1영상정보와 제2영상정보를 전송받아 모니터링하고, 제1경고정보 및 제2경고정보에 따라 알람을 전파하는, 입주민 단말기(140), 및 홈 네트워크 서버(130) 및 입주민 단말기(140)와 통신네트워크로 연결되어 제1경고정보 및 제2경고정보를 전송받아 해당 영상정보를 전송받아 저장하고, 치안센터서버(160)로 알람을 전송하도록 하는 관리실 서버(150)를 포함하여, 외부인 침입에 의한 범죄를 사전에 방지하는, 스마트 공동주택 보안 시스템을 개시한다.

title_en: The generation method in the train system fault propagation path based on failure potential energy field
abstract_en: The present invention provides the generation methods in the train system fault propagation path based on failure potential energy field, comprising: building railway train system complex network model；According to viral transmission model and failure potential energy field theory, probability of spreading model between railway train system component is constructed；According to probability of spreading model between railway train system component and railway train system complex network model, railway train system fault- traverse technique is constructed；It is iterated judgement according to the railway train system fault- traverse technique, obtains train system fault propagation path.The present invention analyzes train system fault propagation process from railway train system network structure and the state itself and inherent mechanism of node, and then obtains all possible propagation path and its probability, facilitates more good carry out maintenance work.

title_en: Fault leakage current separation method and device based on cross self-coding network
abstract_en: The invention provides a fault leakage current separation method and a fault leakage current separation device based on a cross self-coding network, the method is based on the principle of minimum reconstruction error, two independent automatic coding networks are respectively learned on a residual current data set and a fault leakage current data set, a residual current feature coding module and a fault leakage current feature decoding module are intercepted and cascaded to form the cross self-coding network, migration fine tuning training is carried out on the cross self-coding network by adopting paired residual current-fault leakage current data, and finally a mapping model for separating fault leakage current from residual current is obtained, so that fault leakage current separation is realized. The method can effectively separate the fault leakage current from the residual current, thereby improving the cross network training efficiency and enhancing the generalization capability and robustness of the obtained model.
assignees: STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Method for making short-term power generation plan of cascade hydropower station by considering peak shaving depth
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for making a short-term power generation plan of a cascade hydropower station by considering peak shaving depth, which relates to the field of short-term optimized dispatching of cascade hydropower stations in the power industry and comprises the following steps: step 1: determining a short-term power generation plan making idea considering the peak shaving depth; step 2: aiming at the characteristics of different peak regulation amplitudes and different water abandonment amounts in different periods, respectively establishing flood season, dry season and open season models, and determining model constraint conditions by taking peak regulation at different depths and water abandonment amount reduction as targets and combining a cascade energy storage control strategy of a key time node in an actual scheduling process and cascade power station peak capacity meeting power consumption requirements of a power grid, wherein the constraints comprise water balance, reservoir water level constraint, final water level control, peak regulation depth constraint, power generation flow constraint, ex-reservoir flow constraint, power station output constraint and the like, and determining a model solving algorithm; and step 3: and carrying out short-term optimization scheduling solution by using a heuristic algorithm.
assignees: POOL POOL HYDROELECTRIC POWER PLANT OF HUAYUFU NEW ENERGY CO LTD;LIMITED COMPANY OF ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INSTITUTE OF CHINA

title_en: New energy plant network interaction layered optimization scheduling method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a new energy plant network interaction layered optimization scheduling method, which comprises the following steps: (1) Acquiring grid structure data, new energy output historical data and load demand historical data of a power grid; (2) Establishing a probability distribution model of new energy output and a probability distribution model of load demand by adopting mixed Gaussian distribution; (3) Dividing a power distribution network containing a new energy power plant into a plurality of grid power supply units and performing layered definition; (4) Establishing a local scheduling model of each sub-layer power supply unit in the new energy plant network interaction hierarchical optimization; (5) defining interaction variables; (6) And establishing an upper layer coordination control model based on a multilayer target cascading method, thereby forming a new energy plant network interaction layered optimization upper layer coordination control framework. The invention considers the distributed new energy and the load randomness, reduces the data sharing range between the plant networks as much as possible on the basis, and realizes the safe and optimized operation of the whole network.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD YANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Fault propagation analysis method and device for power information physical system
abstract_en: The application is applicable to the technical field of electric power, and provides a fault propagation analysis method and device for an electric power information physical system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: injecting faults caused by target uncertainty factors into the power network, and collecting relevant data of the target uncertainty factors in the power network; according to the related data, analyzing probability statistical characteristics of the target uncertain factors; calculating power flow information of the power network according to the probability statistical characteristics; determining a fault element in the power network according to the tide information, and controlling the fault element to send an abnormal data packet to a dispatching center of the power information physical system at a corresponding node in the information network; adjusting the power network according to the abnormal data packet received by the dispatching center; the propagation characteristics of the fault are analyzed based on the changes in the power network before and after the adjustment. The method can analyze the influence of the uncertain factors on the fault propagation of the power information physical system.
assignees: STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ECONOMIC AND TECHNICAL RES INSTITUTE;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;HEBEI HUIZHI POWER ENG DESIGN CO LTD

title_en: Power grid real-time operation risk identification and power restoration management system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of deep learning, in particular to a power grid real-time operation risk identification and power restoration management system based on deep learning, which comprises a data center: the system is used for collecting multisource information of a power grid and storing data in a classified mode; analysis processing unit: the data fusion correlation analysis is used for preprocessing the received data and carrying out data fusion correlation analysis; risk identification unit: the risk position and the cause are determined according to the analyzed data; and (3) a management and control center: for taking corresponding measures against the impact of the risk event. According to the invention, risk real-time sensing and identification can be carried out, range reasons related to fault information and cascading fault events can be obtained through analysis based on deep learning, intelligent early warning is carried out, the fault information can be displayed on a large screen in real time, and after fault burst, a reasonable and safe power supply restoration path can be quickly selected based on historical fault information.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD ZUNYI POWER SUPPLY BUREAU

title_en: Step reservoir optimal scheduling system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of collaborative optimization scheduling of water and thermal power stations in a short-term power grid, and discloses a cascade reservoir optimization scheduling system, which comprises the following steps: the data acquisition and monitoring are used for establishing a hydrological observation network; the hydrologic forecasting and simulating device is used for forecasting and simulating rainfall, snow melting and inflow conditions in a certain period in the future; the multi-objective optimization scheduling algorithm is used for designing and applying the multi-objective optimization scheduling algorithm suitable for the cascade reservoir; the multi-source data fusion is used for fusing the hydrological observation data with satellite remote sensing data and unmanned plane data multi-source data; the decision support system is used for integrating hydrologic forecasting and simulation results and output information of an optimized dispatching algorithm into one decision support system, optimizing reservoir dispatching, improving forecasting precision and accuracy, and enabling the dispatching system to be better suitable for changing environmental conditions and demands.
assignees: CHINA YANGTZE POWER CO LTD;UNIV HOHAI

title_en: Relay protection method and system for transformer substation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of relay protection, in particular to a relay protection method and a relay protection system for a transformer substation, comprising the following steps: and collecting electromagnetic field data of the substation relay, and drawing an electromagnetic field distribution diagram by integrating node connection data of a substation power grid to generate an electromagnetic field data matrix. According to the invention, through numerical solution of an electromagnetic field data matrix and accurate spatial positioning of nodes, an electromagnetic field distribution diagram can be drawn in detail, an in-depth view of interaction between power grid nodes is provided, not only is the accuracy of fault positioning improved, but also the accuracy of fault analysis and simulation is improved through accurate correction of the node positions, the continuity and safety of transformer substation operation are ensured, timeliness and effectiveness of emergency response are further enhanced through on-site testing and sending of early warning signals, a stronger guarantee is provided for preventing large-scale power interruption and equipment damage, and potential service interruption is reduced.

title_en: Distributed light Fu Fu power prediction-based power distribution network voltage regulation and control method combining group and cooperation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power distribution network voltage regulation and control, and discloses a power distribution network voltage regulation and control method based on distributed light Fu Fu power prediction cluster-cooperation, which integrates photovoltaic historical data, inputs an improved counter-propagation neural network model to output predicted photovoltaic active power, and estimates reactive capacity boundaries of all nodes in real time based on the running state of a grid-following inverter; the method comprises the steps of establishing a two-dimensional module degree function of a net load index and an equivalent electrical distance, dividing a distributed photovoltaic cluster, providing a multi-device differentiated cooperative control strategy aiming at the voltage out-of-limit risk in the cluster, constructing an optimization function aiming at minimum network loss and voltage offset, and carrying out optimization solution function by using an improved multi-tissue particle swarm optimization algorithm to obtain a multi-device adjustment sequence and device action quantity. The invention improves the capacity of renewable energy consumption and reduces the network loss while guaranteeing the voltage stability of the power distribution network, and optimizes the comprehensive regulation cost.

title_en: Method and system for solving seismic wave propagation equation based on physical information neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of earthquake engineering, and provides a method and a system for solving a seismic wave propagation equation based on a physical information neural network, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining a space domain, a time domain, an initial condition and a boundary condition of a one-dimensional seismic wave equation; the method comprises the steps of randomly extracting initial value coordinate points to serve as a training data set constraint network, generating space-time domain configuration points by utilizing Latin hypercube sampling to meet partial differential equation constraint, establishing a physical information neural network model, inputting space-time coordinates, automatically calculating equation residuals by differential, constructing a composite loss function by combining initial value loss and the physical residuals to train, providing a residual-based self-adaptive region sampling strategy, resampling a high residual region according to average residual values of the configuration points during training, fusing new points with initial configuration points, and iteratively optimizing network parameters. According to the method, the sampling density of the high-error area is dynamically enhanced, so that the relative error of L2 of a prediction solution is reduced by one order of magnitude, the network is effectively prevented from being trapped into local optimum, the convergence efficiency is remarkably improved, grid dispersion or priori data support is not needed, and a high-precision grid-free solution scheme is provided for a one-dimensional seismic wave equation.

title_en: Cascade electric energy metering management system and method for redundant double-clothes and intelligent network control
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a redundant double-clothes and intelligent network-controlled step electric energy metering management system and a method thereof, which aim to solve the problems of single function, low reliability of data acquisition and transmission, low operation and maintenance efficiency and the like of the existing step dispatching centralized control center electric energy metering management system; the invention provides an electric energy metering management system integrating 14 application functions of electric quantity data acquisition, storage, statistics, metering service management, semi-automatic side-generation electric quantity processing, data inquiry, operation condition monitoring, change calculation and analysis, report application, system management, system alarm, parameter maintenance, file synchronization, cross-isolation data synchronization, system migration and the like; the system adopts redundant server configuration and intelligent network technology, ensures high availability and stability of the system, improves convenience and high efficiency of system maintenance through a simple and easy maintenance diagnosis tool, reduces operation and maintenance cost, and provides powerful guarantee for safe and efficient operation of power production.

title_en: Infrastructure cascade failure prediction method and system for flood disaster scenario construction
abstract_en: The invention provides an infrastructure cascade failure prediction method and system for constructing flood disaster situations, which comprise the steps of constructing extreme storm flood disaster situations by using a numerical simulation method, constructing independent network topologies of traffic infrastructures, power infrastructures and communication infrastructures, analyzing cascade relations and disaster propagation mechanisms of the power-communication-traffic infrastructures under extreme storm impact, constructing a third-order network model of urban key infrastructure cascade failure, wherein the third-order network model comprises the third-order network topology model, the extreme storm flood model, the disaster propagation model and the cascade failure model, setting infrastructure failure conditions according to the submerged water depth of the urban infrastructure affected by the extreme storm, and performing infrastructure node failure prediction, independent infrastructure network failure prediction and urban key infrastructure cascade failure prediction. The invention can predict the cascade failure of the infrastructure.

title_en: Information fusion operation and maintenance system between zero carbon park industries
abstract_en: The invention discloses an information fusion operation and maintenance system between industries of a zero carbon park, in particular to the technical field of dynamic control of carbon emission, which is used for solving the problem of carbon accounting distortion caused by state deviation of an existing static carbon emission model and a physical system; an initial carbon bank model containing energy efficiency reference parameters is established through a design stage, an operation boundary characteristic spectrum is obtained through multi-working-condition dynamic calibration in a construction stage, thermodynamic tracks are synchronously collected, topological fragile nodes are identified based on Lyapunov exponent stability analysis and optical flow method thermal gradient analysis, a carbon bank cascade conduction effect is quantized by combining an equipment energy topological network, a dynamic carbon bank model correction instruction is generated to update energy efficiency parameters, and finally double-instruction cooperative management and control is executed in an operation and maintenance stage, so that full-period carbon data flow closed loop is realized, and the effect of continuously reducing carbon bank intensity in a park is achieved through multi-source information fusion and conduction chain modeling.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY CONSTR GROUP CO;CHINA RAILWAY CONSTRUCTION GROUP MECH AND ELECTRICAL INSTALLATION CO LTD

title_en: Forward variation network modeling method driven by product change demand
abstract_en: The invention aims to provide a forward modification network modeling method driven by product changing requirements, which comprises the steps of determining the product changing requirements, obtaining changing requirements of an assembly line to be changed according to the product changing requirements, obtaining key parts in an existing assembly line as parameter nodes to form a parameter node library, obtaining association relations between any two nodes in the parameter node library based on a five-dimensional model, initially constructing a parameter node network model reflecting an assembly line structure, optimizing the parameter node network model, constructing a forward modification network, predicting and analyzing a changing propagation path, and processing the changing requirements of the assembly line to be changed by utilizing the forward modification network to conduct assembly line modification path planning, guide and realize quick reconstruction of the existing assembly line. The method shortens the reconstruction period, improves the reconstruction efficiency, reduces unnecessary resource waste and reduces the reconstruction cost.

title_en: Urban rail transit station safety assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a security assessment method and a security assessment system for urban rail transit stations, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing network topology, setting an initial security state value of each node, applying external disturbance to the nodes, calculating a coupling strength coefficient of each node, calculating the security state value of each node, judging whether a failure node is newly added at the current moment, and eliminating the newly added failure node if the failure node is newly added. The urban rail transit station safety evaluation method and system provided by the disclosure dynamically describe the coupling relation between the nodes, so that the safety modeling is more complete, regional safety association analysis is realized, the disturbance influence of the node safety state and the passenger flow on the safety state is combined with the node coupling relation between the regions, the dynamic description of the linkage propagation of the node failure is realized, and the accuracy and the reliability of urban rail transit station safety evaluation are effectively improved.

title_en: Wind driven generator multi-working-condition flow field prediction method and device based on neural network
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical fields of wind power generation, artificial intelligence and hydrodynamics, and discloses a prediction method and a prediction device for a multi-working-condition flow field of a wind power generator based on a neural network. And under the condition of training the wake field prediction model for a new round, carrying out back propagation on the total loss, and optimizing the neural network parameters. In this way, a double branch loss collaborative optimization mechanism is formed. The physical information neural network is combined with the domain countermeasure neural network, and the complementary advantages of the physical information neural network and the domain countermeasure neural network are fully exerted. When the data is limited or the distribution difference is large, the wake field prediction with high precision and physical consistency can be realized.

title_en: Emergency communication command method for long tunnel construction site based on multi-network fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a long tunnel construction site emergency communication command method based on multi-network integration, in particular relates to the technical field of wireless communication network switching, and is used for solving the problems of command service interruption and session state loss caused by cross-network switching in the existing emergency communication system; the method comprises the steps of continuously monitoring and generating session snapshots containing real-time transmission protocol and transmission layer protocol states in the moving process of a terminal, predicting network coverage weak areas by combining the moving state prediction with an electronic map intelligent predicting network, dynamically selecting an optimal target network based on multidimensional network stability quantitative analysis and digital simulation deduction, pre-distributing resources by a command center, issuing a switching instruction, and finally realizing cross-network seamless switching and complete recovery of service session to realize high-continuity transmission guarantee of emergency command service.
assignees: TIANJIN BRANCH CRSC ENG GROUP COMPANY LTD;CRSC ENG GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Collaborative management method and system for construction engineering construction based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of building engineering construction, in particular to a collaborative management method and system for building engineering construction based on the Internet of things. The method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-mode data of a construction site through Internet of things equipment, constructing a construction knowledge graph, selecting a small amount of construction risk-marked data on the multi-mode data as a sample data set to train an initial risk prediction model, generating a cross-mode consistency constraint expansion training set through pseudo tags, dynamically updating the risk prediction model based on a sliding window increment learning method, inputting the construction knowledge graph into a heterogeneous graph neural network to propagate and aggregate characteristics of nodes and edges, identifying a risk causal chain in the construction knowledge graph, virtually intervening based on a causal inference method, calculating intervention probability of risks of subsequent nodes, calculating causal priority of each risk event according to the intervention probability, and retraining the risk prediction model according to feedback of a management platform.
assignees: TANGSHAN CAOFEIDIAN XINCHENG URBAN CONSTRUCTION MAN CO LTD

title_en: Risk propagation probability learning method among nodes in supply chain network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a risk propagation probability learning method among nodes in a supply chain network, which comprises the steps of firstly constructing a scoring function L (W) related to risk propagation probability based on final running state data of a provider and a structure of a risk propagation relationship, then randomly initializing a value of the risk propagation probability W in a given interval, then calculating a derivative of the scoring function L (W) and determining a learning rate, and carrying out repeated iteration update on the risk propagation probability W by using the learning rate of the calculated derivative until the maximum iteration number is reached or convergence conditions are met. The invention can learn to obtain the risk propagation probability between nodes in the supply chain network based on the final operation state data of the suppliers and the structure of the risk propagation relationship.
assignees: TECH TRAINING CENTER OF STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Construction method and system for double-layer robust optimal scheduling strategy of wind, light and water storage
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for constructing a double-layer robust optimal scheduling strategy of wind, solar and water storage, and relates to the technical field of energy management, wherein the method comprises the steps of firstly acquiring multi-source data of a wind power plant, a photovoltaic power station and a cascade hydropower station; the method comprises the steps of carrying out feature extraction and integrated prediction based on multi-source data to generate a wind-solar power prediction result, further combining hydrodynamic coupling modeling analysis to obtain a hydropower station power generation capacity and adjustable water quantity sequence, constructing a multi-layer energy coupling diagram and carrying out spectral domain structure optimization to form a power coupling network representing space-time association and ecological sensitivity of a system, and finally adopting double-layer distributed robust optimization to synchronously optimize economic targets and ecological risk constraints to generate a collaborative scheduling strategy. The invention effectively solves the problem of time sequence matching between wind-light fluctuation and water-electricity time stagnation, improves the renewable energy source digestion capacity and the water resource utilization efficiency, and reduces the ecological operation risk.

title_en: Cascading failure searching method and system based on game theory
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of power grid safety protection, and provides a cascading failure searching method and system based on game theory, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining an initial failure; the method comprises the steps of determining initial faults, adopting an optimal defense strategy based on the determined initial faults, calculating the defense cost of the optimal defense strategy, pruning a search path by taking the line fault probability and the line fault result of lower-level faults as pruning indexes to obtain a next-level fault line set, carrying out one-by-one simulation on each cascading fault of the line in the next-level fault line set, counting the emergency control cost and the fault probability of each cascading fault to judge whether the fault level reaches a threshold value, stopping searching if the fault level reaches the threshold value, otherwise, increasing the fault level by one level, continuing fault defense and searching, determining the control cost and the fault risk value of each cascading fault, and sequencing according to the fault risk value to obtain the cascading fault set. The method can accurately search the AC/DC high-risk cascading faults which are difficult to effectively defend the power grid.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Method and system for evaluating risk of strong wind disaster of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power distribution networks, in particular to a method and a system for evaluating the risk of a strong wind disaster of a power distribution network. The method comprises the steps of constructing a data vector of each node at t time by means of meteorological observation of wind resistance parameters, environmental parameters and t time of each node in a power distribution network topology model, constructing a node vulnerability model based on a wind pressure response-failure probability mapping function, acquiring failure probability of each node at t time, acquiring risk propagation weight between each node at t time and adjacent nodes based on electric adjacent strength, inverse proportion function of the geographic coordinates and meteorological consistency of each node and adjacent nodes, and dividing all nodes into a plurality of risk areas by considering consistency, connectivity, boundary complexity and time stability in the areas, and acquiring node level risk assessment results, area level risk assessment results and whole network level risk assessment results at t time. The method and the system effectively improve the evaluation precision of the risk of the wind disaster of the power distribution network.
assignees: SHIZUISHAN POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID NINGXIA ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID NINGXIA ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Online cascading failure analysis method and device based on large event driving
abstract_en: The invention relates to an online cascading failure analysis method and device based on large event driving, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining predicted power flow data of each element in a power grid; determining the predicted outage probability of each element in the power grid according to the predicted power flow data of each element in the power grid; judging whether the power grid has a major event of cascading failure according to the predicted power flow data and the predicted outage probability of each element in the power grid; if yes, searching a cascading failure path of the power grid according to the current outage probability of each element in the power grid; if not, judging whether the power grid has a major event of cascading failure or not again according to the predicted power flow data and the predicted outage probability of each element in the power grid. And carrying out cascading failure analysis on the power grid based on the large event drive, and carrying out prevention and control measures on the power grid by utilizing the cascading path analysis result, so that the monitoring capability of the outage risk of the power grid equipment is enhanced.

title_en: Load false data injection attack modeling method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a load false data injection attack modeling method, which relates to the technical field of power information physical systems and is used for solving the problems that a large-scale physical power flow is transferred and even a cascading failure reaction of a power system is caused to cause a blackout accident because a dispatcher is misled to perform wrong operation after the existing power system is attacked by the load false data injection; according to the invention, under the fusion background of the power information physical system, the attack behaviors of an intruder are considered from the angle of an information layer by combining with the actual network attack scene, the maximum damage attack path is predicted timely and accurately, and a beneficial hint is provided for power system management personnel on how to more effectively prevent and defend load false injection attack.

title_en: Automobile merchant intelligent risk identification system based on merchant state self-monitoring
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of risk identification, in particular to an automobile merchant intelligent risk identification system based on merchant state self-monitoring, which comprises a market dynamic prediction module, a strategy network analysis module, a risk level assessment module, a resource dynamic allocation module, a fuzzy logic risk assessment module, an anomaly detection early warning module, a time window analysis module and a risk management strategy generation module. According to the invention, the opportunity and risk identification accuracy is improved through an autoregressive moving average algorithm and a linear regression model, the social network analysis method is applied to strategy network analysis, the risk propagation path prediction accuracy is improved, the fault tree analysis method and the fuzzy logic model are applied, the risk management effectiveness is improved, the dynamic allocation of resources is optimized through a linear programming model, the resource allocation efficiency is improved, the statistical method and the moving average method are improved, the abnormal point identification accuracy and the risk early warning timeliness are improved, the multi-criterion decision analysis and Monte Carlo simulation are enhanced, and the risk management strategy formulation and optimization are enhanced.

title_en: Multi-gradient mountain wireless channel modeling method combining digital elevation model and ray tracing
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-gradient mountain wireless channel modeling method combining a digital elevation model and ray tracing, and belongs to the field of wireless communication. The unmanned aerial vehicle base station is used for assisting communication, and is suitable for rapidly deploying an efficient communication network in natural disasters or emergency events. The real mountain environment with different slopes and the acquired mountain slope can be established through the digital elevation model, and the signal propagation path and the propagation characteristics of the acquired signals can be predicted through a ray tracing method. The modeling method comprises the steps of firstly establishing a real mountain scene, extracting mountain gradient, then obtaining channel model parameters, analyzing channel characteristics, and finally adjusting transmitter parameters according to channel characteristic data to realize multi-gradient mountain wireless channel modeling. The modeling method provided by the invention has the main ideas that the channel model is analyzed through accurate topographic data and channel characteristic data, and the reliability of the wireless communication system is improved through adjusting parameters. Design suggestions are provided for emergency communication and technical innovation.

title_en: Intelligent monitoring system for state of relay protection hard pressing plate
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power system monitoring and discloses an intelligent monitoring system for a relay protection hard pressing plate state. The system comprises a state acquisition module, a characteristic analysis module, a joint characterization module, an abnormality prediction module, a decision execution module and a decision execution module, wherein the state acquisition module acquires mechanical displacement, contact resistance and surface infrared thermal imaging data of a hard pressing plate in real time, the characteristic analysis module respectively processes the data to generate a displacement characteristic vector, a resistance characteristic matrix and a thermodynamic characteristic map, the joint characterization module inputs the characteristics into a cascade attention fusion network, outputs multi-source joint state characterization through space alignment and weight distribution, the abnormality prediction module inputs the characteristics into a lightweight time sequence prediction model embedded into contact physical constraint to predict displacement offset, resistance attenuation rate and hot spot diffusion trend of the hard pressing plate in three working cycles, and the decision execution module generates a hard pressing plate maintenance instruction set comprising mechanical lubrication grade, contact polishing frequency and cooling fan rotating speed adjustment according to a prediction result.

title_en: Power material demand plan prediction method based on BP neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power material demand plan prediction method based on a BP neural network, which comprises the following steps: preparing a historical power material demand plan data sample; the output and input of the neural network are determined. Selecting proper hidden layer number, defining the learning rate of each layer of the network, and establishing a BP neural network; initializing a network; calculating the error in the current network, then reversely propagating the error, and adjusting the connection weight and the threshold according to the gradient items of each layer; starting the iterative procedure until the training error has reached a small value; selecting a plurality of groups of different parameters to initialize a plurality of neural networks and searching for relative 'global minimum'; and calculating to obtain network output according to the selected BP neural network. The invention can provide effective guidance suggestions for electric power engineering construction projects. And powerful support is provided for the aspects of planning purchasing plans and project progress control of project teams.
assignees: Jiangsu electric power information technology co ltd;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Urban power grid cascading failure risk assessment method and system
abstract_en: The application discloses a city power grid cascading failure risk assessment method and system, wherein tidal current probability models of wind power generation, photovoltaic power generation and electric vehicle charging stations are respectively built, and compared with the prior art, the consideration factors are more comprehensive. In the process of solving the probability trend, a semi-invariant method is used for converting random variables into semi-invariant, and meanwhile, compared with a Monte Carlo method, the semi-invariant method adopting a Cornish-Fisher series expansion formula has higher calculation speed and is more beneficial to realizing online evaluation; compared with the semi-invariant method of the Gram-Charlie series expansion, the situation that the probability density function has negative values does not occur. The urban power grid cascading failure risk assessment method based on the probability trend has the advantages that the established model is more complete, the considered factors are more comprehensive, the solving method is more efficient and the like. Therefore, the technical problem that the risk of the actual power grid cascading failure can not be quickly and accurately evaluated in the prior art is solved.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ZHUHAI POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Non-intrusive load decomposition method based on cascade width learning and sparrow algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-intrusive load decomposition method based on cascade width learning and a sparrow algorithm. The method uses a lightweight width learning algorithm, solves the technical problems of complex structure, extremely time-consuming training and high requirement on computing resources of a deep learning-based non-intrusive load decomposition network, and can simultaneously obtain the running state and detailed power information of the target equipment. In addition, the invention constructs a cascade width learning load decomposition network by improving the connection mode of the width learning characteristic nodes, and optimizes network parameters by using a sparrow search algorithm, thereby improving the load decomposition precision. Compared with the traditional non-invasive load decomposition method based on deep learning, the method provided by the invention has the advantages that the decomposition precision is ensured, the training time is greatly reduced, the network structure is simple, the method is convenient to be integrated with embedded equipment, and the algorithm support is provided for the popularization of the non-invasive load decomposition.

title_en: Numerical simulation method and system for simulating expansion of fracture in conglomerate
abstract_en: The invention relates to a conglomerate reservoir hydraulic fracture propagation numerical simulation method and system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1, establishing a geological model of a conglomerate oil reservoir according to geological feature parameters of the conglomerate oil reservoir; s2, establishing a geomechanical model of the conglomerate oil deposit according to geomechanical parameter characteristics of the conglomerate oil deposit; s3, analyzing geological characteristic parameters and geomechanical parameters of the conglomerate oil reservoir to obtain a ground stress direction and natural crack distribution parameters; s4, analyzing the conglomerate oil reservoir fracturing technological parameters, and establishing a pumping program; and S5, combining the results obtained in the step S3 and the step S4, and performing hydraulic fracturing complex fracture network expansion simulation calculation to obtain a fracture simulation result. The invention can consider the interaction of complex fracture network expansion and the intersection of the hydraulic fracture tip and the natural fracture, and judge whether the hydraulic fracture is crossing or cutting off; the stress shadows can be calculated by taking into account fracturing fluid flow and proppant migration, applying the boundary element method, and taking into account inter-fracture interference.

title_en: Method for establishing network information propagation model in multi-data propagation environment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of network information propagation models, and discloses a method for establishing a network information propagation model in a multi-data propagation environment, which comprises the following steps: s1, constructing a network information propagation model in a multi-data transmission environment; s2, simplifying a network information propagation model in the multi-data transmission environment to obtain a simplified network information propagation model in the multi-data transmission environment; s3, acquiring the basic regeneration number of a network information propagation model in a simplified multi-data propagation environment; s4, carrying out numerical simulation on a network information propagation model in a multi-data transmission environment, analyzing group types and state conversion relations in the data interaction propagation process, establishing a network information propagation system in the multi-data transmission environment, giving out a dynamic equation, and calculating to obtain a balance point of the model, so that the network information propagation model constructed on the basis of data interaction propagation is more in line with the actual propagation situation.

title_en: Optimized operation and bundling and delivery method for watershed cascade water-light complementary power station
abstract_en: The invention discloses a watershed cascade water-light complementary power station optimizing operation and bundling and delivering method, which is characterized by comprising the following steps: establishing a water-light complementary peak regulation model, establishing a peak regulation objective function and a peak regulation constraint condition of the optimized operation of the water-light complementary power station, and obtaining the water-light complementary peak regulation model with the maximum peak regulation benefit; obtaining the daily power generation load of the cascade hydropower station group through the water-light complementary peak regulation model with the maximum peak regulation benefit; establishing an optimized operation model of the river basin cascade hydropower station; the method has the advantages that the running scheme of each power station is obtained by solving the hydropower station optimizing running model by combining the power station objective function and the power station constraint condition with the daily power generation load of the cascade hydropower station group through a particle swarm algorithm, the defect that the output has fluctuation, randomness and indirection when the photovoltaic power station generates electricity can be effectively overcome, the regulating performance is better, the photovoltaic light rejection rate can be effectively reduced, and the capacity of the power grid for absorbing the photovoltaic electric power is improved.
assignees: SOUTHWEST ELECTRIC POWER DESIGN INST CO LTD CHINA POWER ENG CONSULTING GROUP

title_en: Urban traffic flow dynamic allocation method and system based on arc resistance function
abstract_en: The invention discloses an urban traffic flow dynamic allocation method and system based on an arc impedance function, wherein the method comprises the steps of establishing an urban traffic flow dynamic allocation model based on the arc impedance function: reconstructing a topological model of the urban traffic network based on travel chain origin-destination points and key nodes of traffic users; describing the passing time of different automobiles in different arc segments according to the arc segment flow differentiation, and constructing an arc resistance function model; constructing a dynamic traffic flow propagation model; minimizing the economic trip cost of the vehicle as an objective function; and solving an urban traffic flow dynamic distribution model based on the arc impedance function. According to the invention, the urban traffic network reconstructed by introducing the virtual arcs of the starting point, the charging station and the gas station can effectively describe the traffic network topology structure under the multi-energy supply system; according to the dynamic traffic flow propagation model provided by the arc resistance function, the propagation condition of traffic flow between road sections can be reliably identified, and further, the travel behavior of the traffic flow is guided through the economic travel cost of the vehicle, so that the efficient and economic travel of the vehicle is assisted, the congestion condition of a traffic network is relieved, and the balanced distribution of the dynamic traffic flow of the traffic network is realized.

title_en: BP neural network algorithm and temperature measurement system capable of being used for temperature prediction of electrical equipment of transformer substation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a BP neural network algorithm for predicting the temperature of electrical equipment of a transformer substation, in particular to a multi-input single-output three-layer BP neural network, which comprises an input variable X, an hidden layer node Y, weights W of the variable X and the hidden layer node Y and weights V of the hidden layer node Y and an output Z node, and comprises forward propagation and backward propagation. The invention also discloses a temperature measurement system which can monitor and predict the temperatures of all important areas and equipment of the transformer substation by combining with the BP neural network algorithm.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Fault recovery method and system for cascade faults of power distribution network information physical system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fault recovery method and a system for cascading faults of an information physical system of a power distribution network, which relate to the technical field of power system automation, wherein the method comprises the following steps: and acquiring fault information of the target power distribution network, and establishing an information-physical system recovery model. And inputting element information in the fault information into a model, and determining the recovery time and the first maintenance sequence of each fault element. And determining the first recovery cost of the physical system of the target power distribution network according to the recovery time and the maintenance sequence. And adjusting the first maintenance order to obtain a second maintenance order, and determining a second recovery cost. Comparing the second recovery cost with the first recovery cost, if the second recovery cost is smaller, updating the maintenance sequence and returning to the previous step; otherwise, fault recovery is carried out according to the first maintenance sequence. The invention can comprehensively consider the recovery requirements of the information system and the physical system, and improve the recovery speed of the system and reduce the influence of cascading faults by optimizing the maintenance sequence and the recovery cost.

title_en: River basin flood forecasting method integrating multisource rainfall data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of flood forecasting and computer combination, and discloses a river basin flood forecasting method integrating multisource rainfall data, which comprises the following steps: acquiring historical multi-source rainfall data, historical geographic data and historical disaster data of a river basin area, and preprocessing to construct a training data set; constructing a flood forecast model, training the flood forecast model by adopting a training data set, and generating a trained flood forecast model; acquiring real-time multisource rainfall data and real-time geographic data of a river basin, preprocessing the multisource rainfall data and the real-time geographic data, inputting a flood forecast model, and outputting a flood peak value at a set time point; according to the method, the historical multi-source rainfall data, the historical geographic data and the historical disaster data of the river basin area can be analyzed and learned through the flood forecast model, the influence parameters of the secondary disasters on the hydraulic characteristics of the river network system and the influence parameters of the interference flood propagation process are obtained, and the accuracy rate of flood forecast can be effectively improved.
assignees: SHUIFA DIGITAL TECH CO LTD;SHANDONG HAIHE HUAIHE XIAOQING BASIN WATER RESOURCES MAN SERVICE CENTER

title_en: Method, system, equipment and storage medium for associating electric power safety knowledge
abstract_en: The invention relates to a correlation method, a system, equipment and a storage medium of electric power safety knowledge, which comprise the following steps of obtaining multi-dimensional data of electric power safety knowledge, fusing the multi-dimensional data to obtain electric power safety knowledge fusion data, carrying out map modeling based on the electric power safety knowledge fusion data to obtain an electric power safety knowledge map, obtaining electric power fault information, carrying out fault correlation analysis on the electric power fault information based on the electric power safety knowledge map to obtain an electric power fault propagation path, carrying out causal relation mining on the electric power fault propagation path to obtain electric power fault equipment and an induction mechanism corresponding to the electric power fault equipment, carrying out influence range analysis on the electric power network equipment based on the induction mechanism to obtain an influence power network area range, and formulating a management strategy corresponding to equipment in the influence power network area range, thereby solving the technical problem that comprehensive analysis and prediction cannot be timely and accurately carried out when complex electric power faults are faced.
assignees: DONGGUAN POWER BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Cascade water-wind-solar combined peak regulation method and system for hybrid type pumping power station
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power system optimization operation, and discloses a cascade water-wind-light combined peak regulation method and system of a hybrid pumping power station, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining historical data of a cascade watershed wind-light power station and predicting scheduling data of the cascade watershed wind-light power station; and generating a scheduling instruction of the step river basin wind-solar power station based on the solution of the optimization model. Through the optimization model, the adjustment efficiency of the hybrid pumped storage power station is effectively improved, and the hybrid pumped storage power station can flexibly participate in peak regulation of a power system. Meanwhile, the consumption rate of new energy sources such as wind power, photovoltaic and the like is remarkably improved, and the electricity discarding phenomenon is reduced. By reasonably controlling the operation of the thermal power generating unit, the dependence on thermal power is reduced, so that carbon emission is reduced, and environmental protection and sustainable development are promoted. In addition, the invention reduces the peak-valley difference of load, enhances the stability of the power grid and reduces the economic burden of system operation by smoothing the residual load of the system.

title_en: Digitization method of urban security risk assessment standard
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digitizing method of urban security risk assessment standards, which comprises the steps of identifying risk factors for historical accident time sequence data, carrying out relevance analysis to obtain a relevance function, further constructing an urban network topology structure, determining prior probability of nodes according to similarity of the nodes and pre-disaster data, generating a simulated accident scene, adding disturbance items to simulate burst risks, combining the prior probability of the nodes to obtain a risk propagation path, constructing a risk assessment model, assessing space-time influence ranges of the nodes on the propagation path, and carrying out weighted summation on assessment results of the nodes to obtain an urban security risk assessment result. The method is used for constructing the network topology structure by multi-stage analysis of the historical accident data, so that the risk propagation simulation is more accurate, the urban risk assessment can be accurately quantized, and meanwhile, the method has better interpretability.

title_en: Distributed marine seismic monitoring and data processing system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, in particular to a distributed marine seismic monitoring and data processing system based on the Internet of things, which comprises a marine node seismic sensor network, edge computing equipment, a distributed Internet of things platform, a central data processing server, a multi-wave source numerical simulation module and a visual early warning platform, wherein a data processing algorithm is used for optimizing wave field simulation of marine seismic and submarine landslide, displaying a tsunami wave propagation path, intensity and expected arrival time in real time, and carrying out abnormal wave detection and early warning based on wave field topology change rate.

title_en: Intelligent power transmission line management and control method and system based on power distribution data feedback
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent control method and system for a power transmission line based on power distribution data feedback, which relate to the technical field of power transmission line control and comprise the following steps: by integrating multi-source data, a historical environment-electric coupling characteristic matrix is constructed, a long-short-time memory network is utilized to extract time sequence characteristics, a convolutional neural network is combined to capture a spatial distribution rule, and a dynamic line loss prediction model is established to simulate minimum line loss values in different environment scenes. Detecting abnormal time periods through an isolated forest algorithm, screening key damage factors by combining Pearson correlation analysis and SHAP value analysis, dynamically generating and executing a damage reduction strategy priority event, and optimizing model parameters by utilizing error back propagation and reinforcement learning. And finally, generating a typical environmental scene loss reduction case library based on an optimization model, and simulating strategy effectiveness under extreme conditions through a digital twin technology to form a reusable decision rule set, so that the running efficiency and the power supply reliability of the power transmission line are improved.
assignees: KARAMAY PETROLOR ENERGY SERVICES CO LTD;XINJIANG PETROLOR ENERGY SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Power transmission and distribution line hanging foreign matter detection method and system based on image processing and deep learning
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a system for detecting suspended foreign matters of a power transmission and distribution line based on image processing and deep learning. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a history point cloud set on the surface of a power transmission tower, generating a deformation gradient map through dynamic registration of curvature differences of adjacent point clouds, marking a superthreshold area as a deformation association area, extracting foreign matter outline parameters, mapping node strain signals to the association area through time-frequency decomposition, reserving steady-state components, forming a strain map, calculating displacement offset of the deformation association area, constructing a deformation propagation network, extracting load superthreshold nodes, constructing a stress diffusion network, superposing the network, fusing displacement and load values in the superposition area to generate a risk index, and combining the foreign matter coordinates and the risk index to output early warning. According to the technical scheme provided by the application, the cross-modal dynamic analysis of the deformation propagation and stress diffusion paths is integrated, and the foreign matter attachment and structural abnormality risk early warning efficiency of the power transmission tower is improved.
assignees: STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD EHV POWER TRANS COMPANY

title_en: Modeling method for accurate traffic flow prediction
abstract_en: The invention relates to a modeling method for accurate traffic flow prediction, which comprises the following steps of S1, integrally modeling all intersections and roads into a road network undirected graph, defining an adjacent matrix and a distance matrix, S2, defining the propagation delay of traffic flow of the intersections, combining the propagation delay and the influence of abrupt change of the traffic flow of the adjacent intersections to confirm the comprehensive effect of each intersection at a moment t to obtain the traffic flow representation of the intersection at the moment t, S3, aggregating the characteristics of each intersection through the adjacent matrix and the propagation delay by a space graph convolution layer, capturing the dynamic rule step through a time graph convolution layer, combining the graph convolution layer and the time convolution layer to form a time space graph convolution network, outputting final traffic flow prediction, S4, giving a final traffic flow prediction and a kernel density estimation matrix of GKDE, setting three learnable matrices, and S5, outputting through a feedforward neural network.

title_en: Microblog rumor detection method and system based on static and dynamic knowledge enhancement
abstract_en: The invention discloses a microblog rumors detection method and system based on static and dynamic knowledge enhancement. The method comprises the steps of preprocessing a microblog text, including text cleaning, word segmentation, part-of-speech tagging and named entity recognition, so as to obtain structured text and entity information, and then carrying out knowledge linking and semantic enhancement on the text entity by utilizing a pre-constructed domain static knowledge graph, extracting entity attributes, relations and related facts, and realizing the deep combination of the text and background knowledge. Aiming at the core statement that the knowledge graph is not covered or has disputes, the invention further introduces a dynamic search enhancement mechanism, acquires authoritative external evidence through a search engine and constructs dynamic knowledge representation. And then, a knowledge consistency verification module is adopted to evaluate semantic consistency and logic consistency between the microblog content and static knowledge and dynamic evidence respectively, and the credibility of the microblog content is quantized. Finally, text semantic features, knowledge enhancement features, user behavior features, propagation features and knowledge credibility scores are fused, a multidimensional comprehensive feature vector is constructed, and rumor recognition is completed by using a deep neural network classifier. Compared with the traditional detection technology depending on content or transmission structure, the method can simultaneously utilize structured knowledge and real-time external evidence to realize accurate identification of complex, novel and time-efficient rumors, and provides more reliable and efficient technical support for social media content auditing, public opinion monitoring and public safety management.

title_en: Method and apparatus to reduce service interruption in communication system
abstract_en: A method of a user equipment (UE) is provided. The method includes identifying a disaster condition for a first network, identifying whether the UE is in a registered state and a connected state over a first access based on the identified disaster condition, and performing a disaster roaming based on an identification that the UE is not in the registered state and the connected state over the first access.

title_en: Private network mirroring
abstract_en: Techniques for private network mirroring are described. Users can select one or more existing private networks to be mirrored in the same or different network area. Any network configuration changes made in the selected private network (e.g., "master" private network) can be propagated automatically to the mirror private network. This enables users to utilize resources in another network area for disaster recovery, ensuring that the network configuration of the mirror private network is consistent with the master private network through real-time updates. Additionally, users managing infrastructure that includes multiple private networks can select one master private network and propagate configuration changes to other private networks, reducing management overhead incurred by these multi-private network installations.

title_en: Static engine and neural network for a cognitive reservoir system
abstract_en: Implementations described and claimed herein provide systems and methods for developing a reservoir. In one implementation, observed data points in a volume along a well trajectory and well logs corresponding to observed data points are received at a neural network. Feature vectors are generated using the neural network. The feature vectors are defined based on a distance between each of the observed data points and randomly generated points in the volume. A 3D populated log is generated by propagating well log values of the feature vectors across the volume. Uncertainty is quantified by generating a plurality of realizations including the 3D populated log. Each of the realizations is different and equally probable. core values are generated from the realizations, and a static model of the reservoir is generated by clustering the volume into one or more clusters of rock types based on the core values.

title_en: THz spectrum rapid nondestructive testing method for fresh meat freshness K value
abstract_en: A THz spectrum rapid nondestructive testing method for fresh meat freshness K value comprises the following steps: first) meat collection and processing: uniformly cutting fresh meat into meat slices, and refrigerating; when sampling and cutting, the fat and connective tissue of the meat are avoided; II) measuring the THz spectral data of the meat: a THz attenuated total reflection ATR detection mode is adopted to rapidly detect a sample; when the spectrum is collected, the temperature and the humidity of the environment are kept stable; thirdly), rapidly detecting the freshness K value of the fresh meat by adopting a relation prediction model between the THz spectrum data and the fresh meat K value: the relation model is a principal component regression PCR prediction model or a back propagation neural network regression BPANN prediction model. And substituting the THz spectrum data obtained in the step two) into the relation prediction model, and quickly calculating the K value of the unknown sample. The method for sample pretreatment of the invention, which only needs to cut the sample to form the meat slices to be put into an instrument for measurement, is much simpler and faster than the existing method.

title_en: Damping separation method suitable for sub-synchronous oscillation analysis of photovoltaic transmission system through LCC-HVDC
abstract_en: The invention discloses a damping separation method suitable for sub-synchronous oscillation (sub-synchronous oscillation, SSO) analysis of a line-commutated high-voltage direct current (LCC-HVDC) outgoing system of a photovoltaic power grid. Firstly, according to a closed loop transfer function block diagram of a photovoltaic through an LCC-HVDC (liquid crystal control-high voltage direct current) transmission system (hereinafter referred to as PVSL system), a coupling path of a subsynchronous component during propagation between the photovoltaic and the LCC-HVDC is ascertained, then a damping torque method is applied to analyze an SSO mode of the PVSL system, finally, based on a superposition principle of a linear system, a transfer function block diagram is reconstructed to realize PVSL system damping separation, and the influence of subsynchronous interaction of the photovoltaic and the LCC-HVDC on system damping is quantitatively evaluated.
