The damping separation method overcomes the defect that the PVSL system is regarded as a whole when SSO problems are studied in the conventional analysis method, achieves the purpose of analyzing sub-synchronous interaction among subsystems by analyzing damping of an oscillation coupling path, and provides powerful support for analysis of the sub-synchronous interaction of the PVSL system.

title_en: Method for eliminating rubber interference gasoline identification by using back propagation neural network method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for eliminating rubber interference gasoline identification by using a back propagation neural network method. According to the invention, on the premise of considering the actual fire scene environment as much as possible, the gas chromatograph-mass spectrometer is utilized to detect the rubber and gasoline samples, and meanwhile, the influence of other interference conditions on analysis and classification is considered; compared with the traditional manual identification, the method has the advantages of rapidness, high efficiency, high accuracy and the like, provides a method for eliminating the interference of rubber on gasoline, and provides a scientific reference for fire investigation personnel.

title_en: Earthquake motion parameter prediction method based on artificial intelligence and earthquake motion experience model mixing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a seismic vibration parameter prediction method based on a mixed artificial intelligence and seismic vibration experience model, which aims to solve the problem that the existing method cannot simultaneously reserve the physical meaning of the prediction precision and attenuation relation. The earthquake motion parameter prediction method comprises the following steps: 1. selecting a traditional empirical formula of the earthquake motion attenuation relation, and determining an operation form, an input parameter item, an output parameter item and an unknown coefficient in the traditional empirical formula; 2. establishing a seismic data set; 3. establishing a neural network combined with a traditional empirical formula; 4. the neural network is used for carrying out network training by combining with the earthquake motion data set, the gradient of unknown coefficients is calculated through the back propagation of the neural network, and the loss function is continuously reduced through continuous iterative training, so that the training result of the optimal coefficients is obtained. 5. And predicting earthquake motion parameters. The earthquake motion parameter prediction method comprises an empirical model, and has better robustness. Provides effective basis for structural earthquake-proof design and earthquake risk analysis.

title_en: Single particle prediction effect method based on dense connection network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a single particle prediction effect method based on a dense connection network, which comprises the following steps of 1, GEANT4 modeling, step 2, namely randomly dividing an acquired LET data under different particle conditions into a training set, a cross validation set and a test set, fixing random seeds to ensure that an experimental result can be reproduced, step 4, constructing a prediction model based on the dense connection network, step 5, inputting the training set into the prediction model to optimize the prediction model, step 6, inputting the cross validation set into the prediction model in the step 5, adjusting the repeated training times of the training set and the learning rate in the back propagation in the optimization process by comparing a loss function curve and a training set loss function curve, and step 7, and evaluating the prediction accuracy and generalization capability. The invention can accurately and rapidly predict the linear energy transmission data of the microelectronic device, thereby analyzing the influence of single particle effect on the linear energy transmission data.

title_en: Knowledge-graph-based safety production risk identification method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a safety production risk identification method and a system based on a knowledge graph, which relate to the technical field of safety production risk identification, and the invention adopts a graph neural network to generate embedded representation by acquiring entity nodes and relationship edge data of the knowledge graph and extracting feature vectors, calculating node weights by using an attention mechanism to determine a risk mode, traversing the associated paths to generate a risk propagation sequence, fusing time sequence features to update entity states and determine a dynamic propagation path, extracting key node subgraphs to adjust edge weights to optimize the risk mode, and finally identifying a complete risk propagation chain by iteratively querying and integrating environmental features. The method and the system realize dynamic tracking of equipment, personnel and environmental network risks and cross-dimension cascading risk identification.

title_en: Optimal scheduling method for peak regulation of cascade hydro-photovoltaic complementary power generation system
abstract_en: Disclosed is an optimal scheduling method for peak regulation of a cascade hydro-photovoltaic complementary power generation system. The method includes: establishing an objective function of optimal scheduling for peak regulation of the cascade hydro-photovoltaic complementary power generation system; establishing a photovoltaic power station output constraint condition considering uncertainty; optimizing a mixed integer linear model by performing linear processing on the constraint condition; and obtaining a scheduling solution by solving the mixed integer linear model. According to the present disclosure, a unit commitment of a hydro-power station and an operational solution of a reservoir are considered, so that photovoltaic output can be consumed by fully using a characteristic that the hydro-power unit is easy to regulate, and a demand for peak regulation of a power grid can be satisfied.
assignees: HUANENG LANCANG RIVER HYDROPOWER INC;UNIV HOHAI;POWERCHINA GUIYANG ENGINEERING CORP LTD;HUANENG GROUP R & D CENTER CO LTD;HUANENG GROUP R&D CENTER CO LTD

title_en: Harmonic stability analysis method for high-speed railway vehicle network system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a harmonic stability analysis method for a high-speed railway vehicle network system, which comprises the steps of firstly establishing a mathematical model of a dual-port network of a long-distance high-speed railway traction network; establishing an admittance model under a complex frequency domain of the motor train unit converter based on a harmonic linearization theory; and finally, solving the closed loop stability of the train network system based on the impedance analysis theory of the cascade system, and analyzing the network side parameters of the train network system and the parameter stability of the motor train unit control system according to the generalized Nyquist stability criterion. The invention applies the impedance model based on the harmonic linearization theory, and can also apply the linear control theory even on the premise of a nonlinear car network system, so that the system model is clear and concise; harmonic characteristics of the high-speed railway vehicle network system are obtained based on a harmonic linearization theory, and therefore harmonic stability analysis is conducted on the system.

title_en: Based on laser scanning, RQD and RQDtMethod for solving Q anisotropy of anisotropy
abstract_en: Based on laser scanning, RQD t An anisotropic Q anisotropy solving method belongs to the Q anisotropy solving field and comprises the following steps: (1) three-dimensional laser scanning of the structural surface is rapidly acquired; (2) drawing a structural plane polar diagram and a trend rose diagram; (3) rock mass calculation based on RQD indexes; (4) generating and sectioning a rock three-dimensional fracture network model; (5) RQD t Drawing an anisotropy map; (6) solving method of optimal threshold t based on RQD inversion; (7) RQD t An anisotropy solution method; (8) q anisotropy solving method. The invention combines three-dimensional laser scanning, a neighbor propagation algorithm, an RQD theory, a fracture network model, a generalized RQD theory and inversion calculationThen realize RQD t The best threshold value t and the solution of the anisotropy are realized, the solution of the Q anisotropy is realized, and the method based on laser scanning, RQD and RQD is provided t And solving the Q anisotropy of the anisotropy. The method is clear and suitable for solving the anisotropy of the rock mass Q.

title_en: Method for evaluating cascading failure vulnerability of power system including wind power plant
abstract_en: The invention relates to an evaluation method for cascading failure vulnerability of a power system including a wind power plant, which comprises the following steps of: 1) constructing an optimal power flow model based on a line overload model; 2) under the power grid cascading failure, the line shutdown routing is carried out by combining a thermal stability model and a random model of the power transmission line, and the total trip occupation ratio of the line is obtained; 3) performing cascading failure simulation based on the mixed optimal power flow model and the random model, constructing a power grid vulnerability index considering the wind power uncertainty level and the penetration rate, and evaluating the influence of the power grid vulnerability through the total percentage of line tripping and the total load shedding percentage under the cascading failure. Compared with the prior art, the method effectively solves the problems of uncertainty and permeability of the power grid caused by popularization of renewable energy sources such as wind power generation and the like, quickly and accurately evaluates the vulnerability of the power grid to different uncertainty levels and penetration rates during cascading failures, and is helpful for technicians and decision-makers to more efficiently solve related practical problems.
assignees: SHANGHAI ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY OF STATE GRID;SHANGHAI ELECTRIC POWER UNIV

title_en: Method, device, equipment and medium for quantitatively analyzing propagation characteristics of oscillation in MMC
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of flexible direct current transmission, in particular to a method, a device, equipment and a medium for quantitatively analyzing propagation characteristics of oscillation in MMC, which comprise the following steps: describing multi-harmonic characteristics of MMC bridge arm voltage and current by utilizing Fourier decomposition and Euler formulas; according to the characteristics of multiple harmonics, linearizing the multiple harmonics through Toeplitz steady-state matrixes and vectors, and establishing a main circuit small signal model of the MMC in a frequency domain; according to the application scene of the MMC, a small signal model of the MMC control circuit in the frequency domain is established; and according to the main circuit small signal model and the control circuit small signal model, establishing a relation between MMC bridge arm current disturbance and alternating current-direct current port voltage disturbance through elimination, and establishing a three-dimensional oscillation propagation matrix. According to the invention, the propagation characteristics of oscillation between the alternating current side and the direct current side of the MMC can be accurately quantified. The topology and parameters of the AC/DC side power grid are not limited in the modeling process, namely, the AC/DC power grid connected by the model is a black box, so that the model has good expansibility and applicability.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO RES INST;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: New energy cluster grid-connected planning method and system considering off-grid risk
abstract_en: The invention discloses a new energy cluster grid-connected planning method considering off-grid risk, which is characterized by comprising the following steps: acquiring power planning information in a target area; constructing a new energy cluster access and regional power grid coordination expansion planning model considering off-grid risks; and inputting the power supply planning information into a new energy cluster access and regional power grid coordinated expansion planning model to solve, so as to obtain a grid multi-stage expansion planning scheme suitable for the transmission and the consumption of the new energy cluster. According to the method, the coordination and expansion planning model and related constraint conditions are constructed by considering the large-scale new energy offline risk existing under the condition of the grid-connected line fault of the collecting station, so that the large-scale new energy cascading offline risk under the condition of the grid-connected line fault of a certain collecting station can be handled, and the overall technical economic benefit of the scheme is optimal.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECHNICAL RES INSTITUTE STATE GRID SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Reservoir group flood control optimal scheduling method and system based on quadratic programming
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of flood control optimization scheduling, in particular to a reservoir group flood control optimization scheduling method and system based on quadratic programming, wherein the method comprises the following steps of constructing a flood control scheduling topological network according to space distribution of key nodes and hydraulic connection of the space distribution of the key nodes of a system according to hydraulic engineering facilities and hydrologic elements in a flow field to obtain a reservoir group flood control optimization scheduling topological graph; and (3) establishing a reservoir group flood control optimal dispatching quadratic programming model according to the reservoir group flood control optimal dispatching topological graph, and optimally solving the reservoir group flood control optimal dispatching quadratic programming model by using a gradient method and a quasi-Newton method based on a MINOS library of GAMS. According to the invention, the propagation of flood among reservoir groups is coupled in a mathematical equation set, so that complex simulation sequence coding is avoided, modeling is easy, universality is good, and a model is easy to seek an optimal solution, so that the flood control capacity, peak clipping effect and reasonable scheduling of reservoir water storage capacity of the reservoir can be balanced, and the accuracy and efficiency of flood regulation are improved.

title_en: Photovoltaic power station health assessment and prediction method based on self-attention mechanism and space-time diagram neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photovoltaic power station health assessment and prediction method based on a self-attention mechanism and a space-time diagram neural network. The method comprises the following steps of S1, data acquisition and preprocessing, S2, space-time diagram construction, S3, multi-dimensional attention space-time diagram network (MAST-GNN) model construction and forward propagation, S4, a multi-task output layer and model output, S5, model training and optimization, and S6, model deployment and application. According to the invention, comprehensive health monitoring and early warning are carried out on the photovoltaic power station through a deep learning technology, and two functions of evaluation and prediction are seamlessly integrated, so that comprehensive and integrated intelligent management on the health condition of the photovoltaic power station is realized, and the operation efficiency and safety of the power station are improved.
assignees: MCC HUATIAN NANJING ELECTRICAL ENGINEERING & TECH CO LTD;MCC HUATIAN ENG & TECH CORP;HUATIAN NANJING ENGINEERING & TECHNOLOGY CORP MCC

title_en: village broadcasting system using internet protocol and method for operating the same
title_ko: 인터넷 프로토콜망을 이용한 유무선 마을방송 시스템
abstract_en: An embodiment of the present invention includes: a national security management server for transmitting an announcement including a disaster broadcast; a village unit network for propagating the announcement received from the national security management server to villagers as a network grouped with a village unit which is a preset residential unit; and an infrastructure communication network for connecting the national security management server and the village network by wire or wirelessly. Accordingly, the present invention can efficiently transmit the announcement provided from a national infrastructure.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시 형태는 재난방송을 포함한 안내 방송을 송신하는 국가 안전 관리 서버; 미리 설정된 주거지역 단위인 마을 단위로 그룹핑된 네트워크로서, 상기 국가 안전 관리 서버로부터 수신한 안내 방송을 마을 주민들에게 전파하는 마을 단위 네트워크; 및 상기 국가 안전 관리 서버와 마을 네트워크를 유선 또는 무선으로 연결해주는 기간 통신망;을 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Cascade effect evaluation method and system of local energy scarcity risks based on betweennesss algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascade effect evaluation method and system for evaluating local energy scarcity risks based on a Betweennesss algorithm, which involves the field of energy resource management. The method includes steps of obtaining an energy pressure index of each region and an energy dependence of each sector, and an energy scarcity probability is calculated according to the energy pressure index. The initial energy scarcity risk is then combined with a multi-regional input-output model to construct a virtual energy scarcity risk transmission network. Based on the Betweenness algorithm, the key transmission nodes of the cascade effect of local energy scarcity risk are evaluated and identified in the virtual energy scarcity risk transmission network. The invention has a wide application range and efficient calculation method, and can provide an effective method for improving the resilience of trade networks to cope with the risk of energy scarcity.

title_en: Complex electromechanical system failure chain construction method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for constructing a failure chain of a complex electromechanical system, which belong to the technical field of operation and maintenance of the electromechanical system, and are used for constructing a topological network model of the complex electromechanical system, listing risk points based on a minimum maintainable and computable unit, expressing states of the risk points based on a mathematical characterization method, calculating and measuring correlation coefficients among state parameters of the risk points, constructing a direct influence matrix among the risk points, calculating a global influence matrix among the risk points to obtain quantized dependency degrees among the risk points, and predicting failure sequences of the complex electromechanical system to construct a failure propagation chain of the complex electromechanical system. The invention considers the factor of the integral failure of the complex electromechanical system caused by the failure propagation of the internal components of the complex electromechanical system, provides a method and a basis for the early prediction and the later maintenance of the failure of the complex electromechanical system, further analyzes the interaction mechanism among components and reveals the influence relationship of the local failure on the system failure.

title_en: Digital safety emergency drilling and commanding platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of project management, in particular to a digital security emergency exercise and command platform, which comprises a risk assessment module, an event propagation prediction module, a resource demand and scheduling module, a response time management module, a cost benefit analysis module, a network flow abnormality detection module and a security hole priority ordering module, wherein the invention utilizes the network flow abnormality detection module to introduce a real-time monitoring and response technology, the method has the advantages that the real-time monitoring and quick response to the network security event are realized, the response time of the security event is shortened, the risk and influence of the security event on the organization are reduced, in addition, the response time management module is utilized by means of an automatic emergency response technology, the automatic identification and processing to the common security event can be realized according to the set rules and procedures, the efficiency and the accuracy of the emergency response are improved, and the human error and delay are reduced.

title_en: Construction method and system for double-layer robust optimal scheduling strategy of wind, light and water storage
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for constructing a double-layer robust optimal scheduling strategy of wind, solar and water storage, and relates to the technical field of energy management, wherein the method comprises the steps of firstly acquiring multi-source data of a wind power plant, a photovoltaic power station and a cascade hydropower station; the method comprises the steps of carrying out feature extraction and integrated prediction based on multi-source data to generate a wind-solar power prediction result, further combining hydrodynamic coupling modeling analysis to obtain a hydropower station power generation capacity and adjustable water quantity sequence, constructing a multi-layer energy coupling diagram and carrying out spectral domain structure optimization to form a power coupling network representing space-time association and ecological sensitivity of a system, and finally adopting double-layer distributed robust optimization to synchronously optimize economic targets and ecological risk constraints to generate a collaborative scheduling strategy. The invention effectively solves the problem of time sequence matching between wind-light fluctuation and water-electricity time stagnation, improves the renewable energy source digestion capacity and the water resource utilization efficiency, and reduces the ecological operation risk.

title_en: Partition landslide detection system and method based on cascade deep convolutional neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a partition landslide detection system and method based on a cascade deep convolutional neural network. The method for detecting the landslide in the subareas comprises an image acquisition module for acquiring landslide disaster images, a database module for constructing and storing landslide disaster image samples with different attributes and different areas, a landslide detection model preparation module for preprocessing the images, constructing an image pyramid and determining corresponding area coefficients of each area, and a landslide detection model generation module for generating landslide disaster identification detection models corresponding to different areas, wherein the landslide detection model generation module comprises a visual DLNet detector generation optimization module and a multilayer cascade deep convolution neural network detection model module. The method combines the artificial intelligence technology with landslide disaster identification, and generates detection models aiming at different areas by utilizing the area commonality of landslide disasters; the deep convolution neural network with the cascade characteristic is constructed, so that the landslide disaster can be intelligently interpreted, and the landslide disaster identification accuracy is improved.

title_en: Method and system for indicating escape path of forest fire based on A-Star algorithm
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention relates to a method and a system for indicating escape paths of forest fires based on an A-Star algorithm, which are used for acquiring target images of fire extinguishing areas of fire extinguishers by image acquisition equipment, processing the target images to obtain three data, namely flame area growth rate, flame circularity and flame sharp angle width, in the images, inputting the three data into a BP (back propagation) neural network model to identify whether a fire disaster occurs at a position corresponding to the target images, establishing a rasterized map according to geographical positions and identified target image structures, searching the escape paths of the fire extinguishers on the rasterized map by adopting the A-Star algorithm, wherein the escape paths are used as indications for the fire extinguishers to safely leave a fire scene, so that the safety of the fire extinguishers is ensured, and the problem that the existing system or the method for planning the escape paths of the fire scene is mainly indoor and has no outdoor fire such as forest fires, causing fire extinguishing personnel to be in danger.

title_en: Urban rail transit network cascade failure evaluation method based on redundancy recovery
abstract_en: A redundant recovery-based urban rail transit cascade failure assessment method comprises the following steps: and acquiring the inbound passenger volume and the outbound passenger volume of a certain time period, and modeling the rail transit network by using a space L method. The important nodes in the network are respectively identified from three aspects of node degree, betweenness and node strength. And establishing a passenger flow distribution model to simulate the passenger flow distribution process in the cascade failure process of the rail transit network and establishing a redundancy recovery scheme to simulate the system recovery of the Nanjing rail transit network under the fault condition. And evaluating the vulnerability of the urban rail transit network by simulating attacks under different scenes. The invention considers the vulnerability of the rail transit network under the condition of actual passenger flow, and establishes a node capacity model and a redundancy recovery strategy to analyze the performance of the rail transit network under cascade failure. Therefore, the nodes which have great influence on the network are identified, and theoretical support is provided for maintenance work of urban rail transit managers and later-stage rail transit expansion of designers.

title_en: Method for simulating infection in urban resident office commuting under epidemic normalization
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for simulating infection in urban resident office commuting under epidemic normalization, which comprises the following steps of collecting traffic data: constructing a complex city commuting network by using a network node module and a connecting line setting module; setting infection rules among the environment, community nodes and resident individuals by using a network infection propagation module; inputting the acquired traffic data into the complex city commuting network, and performing simulation prediction on the intelligent office scheme under epidemic normalization; and visualizing a chart of the result of the simulation prediction. The invention provides a method for simulating infection in urban resident office commuting under epidemic disease normality, an urban complex commuting network is constructed based on real flow data, and network node design can better restore the process of resident attendance and further better support the simulation prediction of intelligent office schemes under multiple scenes.

title_en: Combined optimization method of transmission and distribution cooperative safety constraint unit based on target cascading method
abstract_en: The wind power installed capacity optimization method considering dynamic frequency constraint and multiple uncertainties comprises the following steps: step 1: constructing a transmission and distribution cooperative system, wherein: the power transmission network layer comprises a large-scale centralized wind turbine generator set, a traditional thermal power generating unit and a load; the distribution network layer comprises controllable distributed energy power generation, distributed renewable energy power generation, energy storage and load. Step 2: respectively constructing an upper-layer power transmission network unit combination model and a lower-layer power distribution network economic dispatch model; step 3: and (3) converting the nonlinear term in the step 2 model into a mixed integer linear programming problem by adopting an incremental segmentation method and a second order cone technology. Step 4: and taking the exchange power of the connecting lines between the transmission and distribution networks as coupling variables, decoupling an upper-layer transmission and grid unit combination model and a lower-layer distribution network economic dispatch model by adopting a target cascading method, and carrying out parallel optimization solving. The optimization method of the invention not only can ensure the accuracy of solution, but also can ensure the safe and economic operation of the transmission and distribution network.

title_en: Urban road network toughness measurement method under multi-layer traffic network dependence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for measuring the toughness of an urban road network under the dependence of a multilayer traffic network, which comprises the following steps: collecting space vector data of urban roads, subways and public transport networks; mapping different spatial layer data into a multi-layer network model formed by nodes and edges; gradually removing the road network connecting edge and other traffic network lines connected with the road network connecting edge; and drawing a relation curve between the road network structure index and the removal proportion under the connection support of the different traffic layer networks, and comparing the phase change threshold value and disaster-bearing capacity change of the space structure of the road network under the support of the different traffic layer networks. The invention builds the interconnection model and the toughness measurement model of the road network and other multi-layer traffic networks, can reveal complex mechanisms of the mutual support and the destructive propagation of the road network and the traffic network, can identify key threshold values and important areas of the road space structure change under the multi-layer traffic support, and provides a technical tool for accurately measuring the toughness of the urban road network.

title_en: High-efficiency autonomous controllable electromagnetic transient real-time simulation method and simulation platform
abstract_en: A high-efficiency autonomous controllable electromagnetic transient real-time simulation method and a simulation platform relate to the field of electric digital data processing, and the method comprises the following steps: and (3) constructing a space-time diagram neural network model according to the power grid equipment and the connection relation thereof, inputting physical parameters of the power grid equipment into node feature vectors, calculating a fault signal propagation time matrix, dynamically layering power grid nodes according to the fault signal propagation time matrix, dividing a core layer, a near-domain layer, a transition layer and a far-domain layer, calculating a basic step length of the core layer due to the fact that the core layer is close to a fault point, calculating a layer far from the fault point, for example, calculating a large time step length of the far-domain layer, calculating electrical feature parameters of the fault nodes at the core layer to identify a key node set, taking interlayer boundary node parameters in the key node set as adjacent layers to calculate boundary conditions, and outputting transient process data of each power grid node, dynamic change data of a fault influence range and parameter alarm information of the key nodes. By implementing the method, the consumption of computing resources of electromagnetic transient real-time simulation is reduced.
assignees: JINPIN COMPUTER TECH TIANJIN CO LTD

title_en: Line early warning judging method and system based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of power transmission line maintenance and provides a line early warning judging method and system based on multi-source data fusion, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a multi-dimensional knowledge graph and establishing a semantic association network; the method comprises the steps of collecting weather and equipment state data in real time, integrating the data into a knowledge graph space through a mapping function, identifying an abnormal weather-equipment combination mode through fuzzy reasoning, calculating the thickness change rate by combining an icing growth prediction model, calculating the icing thickness and galloping probability, generating a composite early warning grade, dynamically generating a risk thermodynamic diagram on a GIS map, and visually displaying a risk propagation path. The system breaks through the limitation of single parameter criteria of the traditional early warning through semantic fusion, composite risk modeling and spatial decision of multi-source data, realizes intelligent identification and dynamic early warning of meteorological-equipment coupling risks, and remarkably improves the accuracy and operation and maintenance decision efficiency of disaster early warning of the power transmission line.
assignees: HUBEI CENTRAL CHINA TECH DEVELOPMENT OF ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: System log data anomaly detection and management system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power system data processing and network security, in particular to a system log data anomaly detection and management system and method. The system comprises a map building module, an abnormality identification module and a feedback adjustment module. According to the invention, a global knowledge graph is constructed through a graph establishing module, deviation degree is calculated by combining with a historical baseline, direct association anomalies are judged, potential influence degree among nodes is calculated by an anomaly identification module based on a graph neural network propagation mechanism, indirect association anomalies are identified through feature vector cosine similarity, anomaly types are determined by combining with a multidimensional feature matching rule base, response measures are executed, a feedback adjustment module collects execution data through buried points, validity is quantitatively evaluated, feature backtracking and root cause positioning optimization schemes are adopted, iteration is carried out by depending on digital twin simulation and gray landing implementation schemes, accuracy of anomaly detection and dynamic adaptation capability of response measures are improved, and the method is suitable for log management and risk prevention and control of a complex system.
assignees: DALIAN POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD

title_en: Whole-house health environment regulation and control system and method integrating oxygen production and phase change humidification
abstract_en: The invention discloses a full-house healthy environment regulation and control system integrating oxygen production and phase change humidification, which belongs to the technical field of air conditioning systems. The indoor environment treatment unit is of a vertical laminar flow structure, fresh air circulation, deep purification, oxygen generation, phase change humidification and heat exchange modules are sequentially integrated, a main water tank and a hot water return tank are arranged in the outdoor energy center, energy cascade utilization is achieved, and the building heat exchange network is used as a radiation tail end and is cooperated with an indoor unit to form a regulation strategy of 'mainly radiating and secondarily convection'. The invention realizes the active regulation and control of the indoor oxygen concentration for the first time, and achieves remarkable energy-saving and noise-reducing effects while ensuring healthy and comfortable indoor environment through system-level optimization.
assignees: GUANGDONG WEISEN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Rapid prediction method for thermochemical energy storage carrier particle thermo-mechanical coupling process
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid prediction method of a particle thermal-force coupling process, which is characterized by scanning carrier particles based on a micro-focus computed tomography technology to generate a three-dimensional digital model, importing the three-dimensional digital model into a multi-physical-field simulation platform to establish a transient full-order model, generating training data sets and test data sets under different working conditions and corresponding temperature fields and stress fields based on the transient full-order model, decomposing and calculating the training data sets by utilizing an intrinsic orthogonal decomposition POD (point-of-sale) reduced-order model to obtain POD basis functions and spectrum coefficients, establishing a mapping model from an input working condition to an output spectrum coefficient based on a BP (back propagation) neural network, inputting the target working condition into the mapping model to output the POD spectrum coefficient, and reconstructing full-field physical quantity distribution at any moment under the target working condition by linear combination based on a calculation result and the POD spectrum coefficient. The method solves the problems of low calculation efficiency and high resource consumption of the traditional numerical simulation.

title_en: A repeater for integrated public wireless network signals and the control method by using the same
title_ko: 통합공공망용 무선신호 중계장치 및 그 제어방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a wireless signal repeater for an integrated public network and a control method thereof. The wireless signal repeater for an integrated public network transmission of signals related to a disaster or an emergency by installing a repeater in a radio-shadow area such as an underground space and a tunnel where an integrated public network service such as a public safety long term evolution (PS-LTE) and a trunked radio system (TRS) is not supported. Also, malfunction of equipment and damage to the equipment caused by the malfunction can be prevented by having an automatic level control (ALC) function for limiting an output level and a shutdown function to shut down the repeater when the repeater output is above the rated output.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 PS-LTE(Public Safety Long Term Evolution, 재난안전통신망), TRS(Trunked Radio System, 주파수 공용통신) 등의 통합공공망 네트워크 서비스가 지원되지 않는 지하공간, 터널 등의 전파 음영 지역에 중계장치를 설치하여 재난이나 위급상황에 대한 신호의 송출이 가능하도록 하며, 출력 레벨을 제한하기 위한 ALC(Automatic Level Control) 기능, 정격 출력 이상으로 출력될 경우 셧다운(shutdown)하는 기능 등을 중계장치에 구비하여 기기의 오동작 및 이로 인한 기기의 손상을 방지하도록 하는 통합공공망용 무선신호 중계장치 및 그 제어방법에 관한 것이다.

title_en: System methodology for autonomous monetary and commerce generation, regeneration, distribution, and redistribution
abstract_en: A comprehensive Socio-Financial, Socio-Economic, Socio-Commerce, distribution and re-distribution system comprised of various technologies adapted to achieve an (Eco) System Network engineered specifically to generate “Autonomous Money” in addition to varied forms of Finance and Commerce propagation. The generation and propagation are accomplished through a dynamic exchange of money, goods, or services, through a unique methodology, accomplished through a series of fully and/or semi-automated, synchronous, homogenous internet interactions and transactions. The purposeful outcome in one sense is to provide a comprehensive, realistic and reliable residual income type system that is organic and possible-of-attainment by the greater masses of humanity. In another aspect, the system is capable of producing considerable worldwide economic stimulation as well as realistically enabling a Universal Basic Income (UBI) without burdensome taxation. However, because this System possesses a multifaceted approach to Commerce, as well as the generation of wealth, the UBI humanitarian aspect is but one of various applications.

title_en: Citation network academic influence evaluation ranking method based on credibility
abstract_en: A citation network academic influence evaluation ordering method based on credibility belongs to the technical field of academic influence evaluation, combines the characteristics of a citation network, defines a series of rules according to article background information, improves a TrustRank algorithm and an Anti-TrustRank algorithm to select a seed set mechanism, calculates the credibility value and the non-credibility value of a network node in a circulating iteration mode, and finally integrates the results of the credibility value and the non-credibility value to give a score. And acquiring and outputting academic influence sequencing of scientific documents in the citation network according to the final descending sequencing result of the comprehensive reputation value. The invention aims to provide a reasonable and fair evaluation method, which can accurately evaluate the influence of documents so as to evaluate high-quality thesis data in a certain subject. Scientific researchers can also quickly search literature data and grasp the hot direction of the current research, and more time is distributed on the scientific theory research. The research of the invention has important theoretical significance for understanding the structure and propagation characteristics of the citation network and evaluating the influence of the literature.

title_en: Power information physical system data propagation modeling method considering three defense lines of power grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data propagation modeling method of a power information physical system considering three defense lines of a power grid. The technical scheme adopted by the invention is as follows: establishing a data transmission architecture, wherein data transmission is divided into data transmission in an information space, an electric power space and between the electric power space and the information space, and nodes and communication channels exist in the spaces; aiming at a data transmission architecture, a data transmission model based on a transmission matrix is constructed, and model quantization is carried out on data transmission from an information space receiving end to a power space transmitting end; and solving the system data state vector under each time period based on the data propagation matrix and the system initial data state vector. The invention combines the information space and the security defense system of the power system by analyzing the influence of data propagation in the power information physical system, and can guide the development of three defense measures.

title_en: Power equipment fault cross-domain collaborative analysis system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power equipment fault cross-domain collaborative analysis system and a method, which relate to the technical field of power grid dispatching and comprise the steps of acquiring multisource heterogeneous data of preprocessed power equipment, based on the topological relation of the preprocessing data and the historical fault data, a cross-domain knowledge graph is constructed, a fault propagation path is marked, and an embedded representation is carried out by adopting a graph neural network. And designing a space-time multi-branch network, respectively extracting space, time sequence and modal interaction characteristics by using the space-time multi-branch network, and fusing at a characteristic fusion layer to obtain fusion characteristics and branch weights. Combining knowledge graph embedded representation, constructing a collaborative reasoning model by using a Bayesian network, carrying out reasoning decision on the fusion characteristics, finally obtaining a cross-domain collaborative analysis result of the power equipment fault, and realizing fusion and efficient reasoning of multi-source heterogeneous data by combining the knowledge graph and a space-time multi-branch network, thereby improving the accuracy and efficiency of fault diagnosis.

title_en: Urban lifeline facility flood disaster chain simulation method based on big data
abstract_en: The invention provides a big data-based urban lifeline facility flood disaster chain simulation method, which comprises the steps of simulating and verifying an urban flood model based on big data, constructing an urban lifeline facility flood disaster chain based on big data, dynamically simulating a lifeline facility flood disaster chain by coupling a numerical simulation and cascade failure method, and evaluating the influence of extreme storm flood on the evolution of the lifeline facility disaster chain. The method of the invention is based on big data, adopts the technical scheme of numerical simulation, big data and cascade failure, the dynamic simulation of the life line facility disaster chain is creatively realized, the technical method in the field is innovated, and the method has obvious technical progress.

title_en: Emergency situation transmitting system and method based on location of public facility
title_ko: 공공시설물 위치에 기반한 안전재난 정보전파 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention provides a system for transmitting disaster information based on a location of a public facility. The system for transmitting disaster information based on a location of a public facility comprises: a control server to analyze a disaster when the disaster occurs to calculate a range influenced by the disaster, then set a disaster information transmission area based on address information of a smart grid facility including a utility pole, a collection device, a power meter, an AMI modem, and a power communication network or a smart city facility including a streetlight, a security light, and a CCTV pole, and transmit disaster information; a disaster information transfer network which comprises a wide area network including an optical communication network, a mobile communication network, a TRS network, and a dedicated disaster network or a local area network including a wireless LAN, binary CDMA, TVWS, RF communication, power line communication, and a wired LAN, and is a communication connection network for transmitting/receiving the disaster information to/from the control server; a disaster information transmission device which is attached to the smart grid facility or the smart city facility, and receives and transfers the disaster information based on location information of the smart grid facility or the smart city facility; a disaster information notification device to transmit the disaster information to the disaster information transmission device; and a disaster information display device to receive a disaster information transmission command from the disaster information transmission device or the disaster information notification device to display the disaster information transmission command.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 안전재난 발생 시 이를 분석하여 안전재난의 영향력이 미치는 범위를 계산한 후 전신주, 수집장치, 전력량계, AMI 모뎀, 전력 통신네트워크를 포함하는 스마트그리드시설물 또는 가로등, 보안등, CCTV주를 포함하는 스마트시티시설물의 주소 정보를 기반으로 안전재난 정보전파 영역을 설정하고, 안전재난 정보를 전송하는 관제서버; 광통신망, 이동통신망, TRS망, 재난전용망을 포함하는 광역망 또는 무선랜, 바이너리 CDMA, TVWS, RF 통신, 전력선통신, 유선랜을 포함하는 지역망을 포함하며 상기 관제서버와 안전재난 정보를 송수신하는 통신연결망인 안전재난정보전달망; 상기 스마트그리드시설물 또는 스마트시티시설물에 부착되며, 상기 스마트그리드시설물 또는 스마트시티시설물의 위치정보를 기반으로 안전재난 정보를 수신하여 전달하는 안전재난정보전파장치; 상기 안전재난정보전파장치로 안전재난 발생 정보를 전송하는 안전재난정보통지장치; 및 상기 안전재난정보전파장치 또는 안전재난정보통지장치로부터 안전재난 정보 전파명령을 입력받아 표시하는 안전재난정보표시장치를 포함하는 공공시설물 위치에 기반한 안전재난 정보전파 시스템을 제공한다.

title_en: Methods and systems for streaming buffer numerical propagation
abstract_en: Systems, methods, and instructions of computer-readable media may include obtaining, at a client machine, a user-selected configuration parameter for an orbit simulation; sending, from the client machine to a remote system, via a network connection, a first set of configuration parameters for the orbit simulation, wherein the first set of configuration parameters comprise the user-selected configuration parameter; receiving, at the client device from the remove device, via the network connection, a stream of orbital data comprising points along an orbit, wherein the points along the orbit are determined by the remote system based on the first set of configuration parameters; and presenting, at a display, a dynamic rendering of the orbit simulation, wherein the orbit simulation is based on the stream of orbital data.

title_en: Ultrasonic back scattering homodyne K model parameter estimation method based on neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultrasonic backscattering homodyne K model parameter estimation method based on a neural network, which is characterized in that according to parameters mu and K of a known ultrasonic backscattering homodyne K model, Monte Carlo simulation is utilized to generate ultrasonic backscattering signal samples with homodyne K models independently distributed; calculating feature parameters based on the samples; training to obtain a back propagation neural network model by using the characteristic parameters obtained by calculation and the known mu and k; for an ultrasonic backscatter signal sample to be detected, firstly, the characteristic parameters of the ultrasonic backscatter signal sample are calculated, and then the characteristic parameters are input into a back propagation neural network model obtained through training, so that the estimation results of homodyne K model parameters mu and K of the sample to be detected can be obtained. Compared with the prior art, the method has higher estimation precision and higher estimation speed.

title_en: Step hydropower station generating capacity prediction method based on long-term and short-term memory network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a step hydropower station generating capacity prediction method based on a long-short term memory network, which comprises the steps of carrying out stability test on a hydropower station generating capacity time sequence; carrying out correlation test on the generated energy time series; converting the generated energy time series data into supervised learning data; establishing a generating capacity prediction model based on a long-term and short-term memory network; performing integrated empirical mode decomposition on the generated energy data to obtain a training set and a test set; training the generated energy prediction model by using a training set, and performing model hyper-parameter optimization by using an improved discrete differential evolution algorithm to obtain optimal model parameters; and adopting a power generation amount prediction model to predict the power generation amount of the cascade hydropower station. The method can be suitable for predicting the generated energy of large and medium-sized step power stations; the generated energy prediction model based on the LSTM neural network has more advantages on the generation energy prediction of the multi-year regulation power station, and the fitting precision of the model is improved by the super-parameter optimization of the model.

title_en: Power grid multi-attribute important node evaluation and planning method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power system automation, and particularly relates to a method for evaluating and planning multiple-attribute important nodes of a power grid. The invention comprises the following steps: establishing a network-dependent complex network topological graph by carrying out data acquisition on a target information physical fusion system; establishing a fault propagation model for the dependent network, and calculating the influence of the information node on a physical system and an information system after the information node is attacked; respectively establishing the survival condition numbers of the information nodes and the physical nodes, and respectively evaluating the vulnerability of the information nodes according to the failure difficulty of the information nodes; according to the topological structure of the complex network, the pivot degree of the information node is evaluated by taking the betweenness centrality and the degree centrality of the node as pivot degree indexes; and reasonably planning the nodes according to the influence factors in the node importance indexes to improve the risk resistance of the cps. The invention provides a new visual angle for the research of the security analysis and protection method of the power grid cps and provides a basis for the planning and defense deployment of the power grid nodes.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;UNIV NORTHEASTERN

title_en: Power distribution network distributed emergency dispatching method considering cooperation of electric public transport company
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power distribution network distributed emergency dispatching method considering cooperation of an electric bus company, which comprises the following steps of constructing a power distribution network self-dispatching submodel; constructing a self-scheduling sub-model of the electric public transport company for supporting the operation of the power distribution network by the electric public transport company; based on the power distribution network self-scheduling submodel and the electric public transport company self-scheduling submodel, constructing a power distribution network-electric public transport company-electric public transport vehicle cooperative emergency scheduling double-layer distributed model by adopting an augmented Lagrange method; and performing distributed iterative optimization on the power distribution network-electric public transport company-electric public transport vehicle cooperative emergency dispatching double-layer distributed model by adopting a target cascade method, and solving by using a solver to obtain an optimal emergency dispatching strategy of the power distribution network and the electric public transport company. The emergency dispatching method is used for carrying out emergency dispatching from a distributed angle, can effectively protect data privacy of a power distribution network and an electric public transport company, and improves the optimized solving speed of dispatching problems through a double-layer distributed architecture.
assignees: UNIV HUAZHONG SCIENCE TECH;HUANGSHI POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;CENTRAL CHINA BRANCH STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Power distribution network line reinforcement strategy considering flexibility of demand side resources
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network line reinforcement strategy considering the flexibility of demand side resources, which comprises the following steps: acquiring frame information and the ground meteorological data of a certain power distribution network, performing load flow calculation based on node load data and network topology information of the power distribution network, and judging whether a voltage out-of-limit node and an overload branch exist in the network; defining the flexibility requirement of the system by the net load difference value of adjacent time periods of the system; predicting the output of a photovoltaic power station based on a multi-Markov chain Monte Carlo model, and clustering to generate a typical flexibility demand scene based on a neighbor propagation algorithm; aggregating and modeling the adjustable boundary of the multi-energy heterogeneous resources at the demand side based on the virtual battery model; optimizing the gears of the on-load tap changing transformer by taking the minimum voltage deviation degree of the node of the power distribution network as a target; if the node voltage is out of limit or the line is overloaded, then the day-ahead economic dispatching of the power distribution network for considering the resource flexibility of the demand side is carried out; searching a line reinforcement economic scheme by adopting an evolutionary particle swarm algorithm, introducing the maximum annual insufficient electric quantity index to evaluate risks and selecting a reinforcement scheme with the minimum index; and updating network topology information, repeating the steps until all the years in the traversal planning period, and outputting a line reinforcement optimal scheme. By adopting the strategy of the invention, the flexibility of the demand side resources can be effectively utilized to slow down the high-volume investment of the strengthening of the power distribution network lines, and the strategy has positive significance on the economic planning and decision of the strengthening of the power distribution network lines.

title_en: Man-machine terminal picture data interaction method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a man-machine terminal picture data interaction method and a system, which relate to the technical field of data interaction and comprise the following steps: installing a traveling wave sensor, acquiring fault electromagnetic waves, determining a time stamp and traveling wave propagation speed, and determining a fault area through a fault positioning algorithm; acquiring traveling wave signal data of fault electromagnetic waves according to a fault region, simultaneously acquiring power grid topology data, extracting traveling wave characteristics and topology characteristics, determining structural characteristics, identifying the shortest path of nodes in a power grid topology graph, and combining clustering coefficients to perform characteristic fusion to obtain a comprehensive topology vector; the method comprises the steps of encoding a comprehensive topological vector based on a graph neural network, carrying out node feature fusion on traveling wave features and the encoded comprehensive topological vector, generating initial node features, updating the initial node features through the graph neural network by combining a attention mechanism introduced in advance, generating input node features, combining the traveling wave features, carrying out fault location through a random forest module in the graph neural network, and determining a fault position.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD NINGBO POWER SUPPLY CO;NINGBO POWER TRANS AND CONSTRUCTION CO LTD YONGYAO TECHNOLOGY BRANCH

title_en: Photovoltaic equipment generated power prediction method and system
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a method and a system for predicting the generation power of photovoltaic equipment, and relates to the technical field of new energy generation control. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring photovoltaic equipment data, illumination related data and topographic data; constructing a solar radiation intensity model based on a back propagation neural network according to the acquired data, predicting the current solar radiation intensity, and obtaining a preliminary radiation intensity result; determining the sea distance according to the acquired data, carrying out weight distribution on the water vapor salt fog and the attached salt fog based on the sea distance, and calculating the radiation intensity loss rate influenced by the salt fog; correcting the primary radiation intensity result by the loss rate of the radiation intensity influenced by the salt fog, and reconstructing a solar radiation intensity model according to the correction result; predicting the radiation intensity by using the reconstructed solar radiation intensity model to obtain a final radiation intensity result; and predicting the photovoltaic power generation power according to the final radiation intensity result. The influence of salt mist on the photovoltaic power generation power is considered, and the accuracy of photovoltaic power generation power prediction is improved.
assignees: WEISHAN POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Yolov 5-based forest fire detection optimization method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a forest fire detection optimization method based on yolov, which belongs to the field of target detection in the field of image processing, and comprises the following steps: firstly, the invention designs a trunk network combining the cascading pyramid feature extraction and MobileNetv, which is used for improving the detection efficiency of the forest multi-scale targets and further accelerating the training speed of the network. Secondly, the invention designs a convolution structure which inserts the deformable convolution into the bneck blocks in MobileNetv to improve the precision of the whole detection network, effectively improves the detection precision of fire and smoke with various forms under a complex background, and simultaneously ensures that the detection speed can also meet the requirement of real-time detection.

title_en: Ecological scheduling scheme optimization simulation coupling decision-making method based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses an artificial intelligence-based ecological scheduling scheme optimization simulation coupling decision method which comprises the steps of determining ecological scheduling starting time and ecological scheduling key parameters, determining proper intervals of the ecological scheduling key parameters required by fish propagation, constructing a reservoir multi-objective optimization ecological scheduling model for promoting fish natural propagation by applying an optimization algorithm, solving optimization schemes of reservoir ecological scheduling under different scenes, arranging the optimal scheduling schemes to form a scheduling track sequence data set, constructing a reservoir ecological scheduling scheme simulation decision model based on a long-short-term memory network deep learning algorithm, constructing a loss function with a physical mechanism, and taking the scheduling track sequence data set as training data to autonomously learn a reservoir ecological optimal scheduling rule from the data set. The invention can rapidly give out the ecological dispatching outflow scheme which is suitable for various actual working condition scenes, assist the optimization decision of the ecological dispatching scheme and realize the improvement of the ecological dispatching scheme from static state to real-time dynamic state.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Digital twinning-fused power grid fault prediction system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of digital twinning, in particular to a power grid fault prediction system and method integrating digital twinning. According to the invention, a structural state tensor is constructed by fusing multi-source heterogeneous sensing data and executing a space-time alignment algorithm, the Laplace operation is combined with a stress wave propagation model to analyze non-rigid deformation characteristics, a load transfer path map is generated to reveal hidden mechanical association, a finite element grid dynamically corrects Young modulus to form a structural degradation coefficient matrix, and a time sequence difference and a long-short term memory network capturing device degradation trend are combined, the Kelmogorov test quantifies the space-time distribution probability of faults, so that the power grid device is predicted to rise from single threshold early warning to multi-physical field coupling, the space-time resolution and dynamic adaptability of fault prediction are improved, the dependence of manual experience is reduced, and the robustness of a complex working condition system is enhanced.
assignees: SHANDONG TIANZHUO INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Hydraulic engineering full life cycle management system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydraulic engineering full life cycle management system, which comprises a model construction module, a high-order potential energy encoder module, a tensor coupling dynamic propagation module, a potential energy trend predictor module, a risk assessment module, a feedback adjustment module, a decision support module and a model training and optimizing module, wherein the model construction module is used for constructing a tensor potential energy evolution network model, the high-order potential energy encoder module is used for generating potential energy representation of a current life cycle stage, the tensor coupling dynamic propagation module is used for capturing time sequence and space dependency relationship and generating a hidden state tensor, the potential energy trend predictor module is used for generating a potential energy predicted value at the next moment, the risk assessment module is used for triggering risk early warning and generating a risk grade, the feedback adjustment module is used for dynamically adjusting a risk threshold and tensor potential energy evolution network model parameters, the decision support module is used for providing an emergency response and resource optimizing scheme, and the model training and optimizing module is used for optimizing tensor potential energy evolution network model parameters. According to the invention, dynamic monitoring, risk prediction and early warning of hydraulic engineering are realized through the tensor potential energy evolution network model, and the management safety and accuracy are improved.
assignees: ZHICHENG SHUCHUANG XIAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power quality abnormality tracing and purifying strategy generation system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power quality monitoring and treatment, and discloses a power quality anomaly tracing and purifying strategy generation system. The electric energy acquisition module acquires waveform data of key nodes of the group network in real time and sets a monitoring interval, the characteristic analysis module decomposes spectral characteristics to generate pollution characteristic vectors, the anomaly tracing module extracts core index construction tracing rules, the pollution evaluation module identifies propagation paths to calculate pollution indexes, the parameter optimization module derives optimal parameters to generate deviation sequences, and the strategy generation module integrates the sequences to form a purification strategy. The system realizes abnormal accurate tracing and dynamic management, improves the comprehensive analysis and strategy intelligent level, and is suitable for electric energy quality control of the power grid.
assignees: WUXI CHENGCHENG ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Comprehensive evaluation method for weak links of power system related to multidimensional indexes in extreme weather
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive evaluation method for weak links of an electric power system, which relates to multidimensional indexes in extreme weather. Firstly, a multidimensional index system comprising safety and optimized operability is established, wherein the multidimensional index system comprises line outage probability, load loss probability, electric energy deficiency expectation, line overload rate and network loss rate. And secondly, constructing a line fault model and a cascading fault model in extreme storm weather, describing the fault probability change by combining a Gaussian function and Weibull distribution, and simulating line sectional failure by using Poisson distribution. And calculating the system state after the fault through a direct current optimal power flow model, and acquiring a large amount of simulation data by combining a non-sequential Monte Carlo method. Further, subjective and objective weights are calculated by a fuzzy analytic hierarchy process and a CRITIC process respectively, subjective and objective comprehensive evaluation is realized by weighting fusion, and weak links of the system are identified. The method has the advantages of evaluating scientificity and calculating efficiency, and is suitable for real-time risk evaluation and weak link identification of a large-scale power system in extreme weather.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INST OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Anti-theft system for cultural properties
title_ko: 문화재 도난방지용 시스템
abstract_en: An anti-theft system for cultural properties is provided to raise a security level by instantly notifying a manager of a theft or a blackout. Plural shelves are arranged in a drawer(14). Plural antennas(20) are attached to an upper surface of the drawer and enclose a rim of the drawer. A frequency adjuster(30) determines a frequency of an output signal. An RFID(Radio Frequency IDentification) reader(40) is connected to the antenna through the frequency adjuster. A PDA(50) is connected to the RFID reader and notifies a manager of a theft through a mobile communication network or a wired telephone network. An RFID tag is inserted into a book or an old document. An alarm device(70) is installed on an outer wall of the drawer and connected to the PDA(Personal Digital Assistant). A release switch is connected to the PDA and turns off the alarm device. A power supply device(60) supplies power and notifies a blackout to the PDA.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 문화재 도난방지용 시스템에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 서적이나 고문서와 같은 유형문화재의 도난방지를 위하여 알에프아이디 시스템을 적용한 것이다. 본 발명은 복수 개의 선반을 구비한 수납장과; 상기 각 선반의 상면에 부착되어 선반의 테두리를 감싸는 복수 개의 안테나와; 상기 안테나에 연결되어 출력전파의 주파수를 결정하며, 상기 각 선반에 부착되는 주파수 조절기와; 상기 주파수 조절기를 통해 안테나와 연결되는 RFID 리더기와; 상기 RFID 리더기를 제어할 수 있도록 RFID 리더기와 연결되며, 이동통신 전화망 또는 유선전화망에 연결되어 관리자에게 도난사실을 통지할 수 있는 PDA와; 상기 각 선반에 거치되는 서적 또는 고문서에 끼워서 사용되는 시트상의 RFID 태그와; 상기 PDA와 연결되어 도난시 경보를 발생시키도록  상기 수납장 외벽에 설치된 경보발생장치와;경보해제스위치와; 상기 RFID 리더기와 PDA와 경광등에 전원을 공급하기 위한 무정전 전원공급장치로 이루어진 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Method of propagating information on power grid energy flows, device, and machine-readable instruction code
abstract_en: To make information on an energy flow composition available for an electric power system (40), devices (31-36) of a communication system (30) exchange data specifying the energy flow composition. The devices (31-36) are operative to exchange the data by means of a message exchange that generally follows the energy flow paths in a power grid (10) of the electric power system (40).

title_en: Method and system of learning-based problem management for information technology (it) operations
abstract_en: An architecture of an enterprise can be fully on on-premises with multiple computing systems or on cloud or on Hybrid. Enterprise information technology (IT) departments are continually adopting new technologies and changes leads more complex, and increased probability of service disruption, through malfunctions in software, hardware, networks, natural disasters, simple human error. Embodiments of the present disclosure provide a method and system to detect problem associated with the computing system in an enterprise. A plurality of data associated with each resource in the enterprise is received. The plurality of data is considered to iteratively perform (a) derive a parameter associated with a metric data, and an incident data to obtain an analyzed data, (b) detect a problem associated with each resources by processing the plurality of analyzed data based on a propositional logic, and (c) generate a feedback associated with each problem of the resources in a subsequent iteration.

title_en: Riadry risk assessment method based on network risk entropy difference
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rumor risk assessment method based on network risk entropy difference, which comprises the following steps: s1, establishing a rumor propagation model based on an SIR model for a network platform to be evaluated; s2, identifying rumor sources and propagation time by using a rumor source identification method based on the network structure of the rumor propagation model; s3, simulating a rumor forward propagation process in the network structure to obtain the probability that each node in the network is in different states at the current moment; s4, calculating the maximum risk entropy and the minimum risk entropy of the network at the current moment according to the probability that each node is in different states at the current moment; s5, calculating the network risk entropy at the current moment by using the maximum risk entropy and the minimum risk entropy of the network at the current moment; s6, calculating the network risk entropy difference according to the network risk entropy of the network at the current moment and the previous moment, and evaluating the potential risk of the rumor at the current moment on the network platform according to the network risk entropy difference. The invention can quantitatively and accurately evaluate the risk of the rumor on the network in real time.

title_en: Power distribution network regulation and control management weak link identification method based on cascade weight
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power distribution network regulation and control management weak link identification method based on cascade weight, which comprises the steps of firstly, calculating the cascade weight of basic indexes of the power distribution network regulation and control management based on a hierarchical analysis structure; then, calculating the inter-stage index connection weight of the power distribution network regulation and control management layer by adopting an entropy weight method; and finally, calculating the contribution values of the basic indexes according to the calculation results of the step S1 and the step S2, and sequencing the contribution values from low to high, wherein the lower the contribution value is, the higher the weak degree is, and therefore the weak link identification is realized. The method can scientifically and accurately identify weak links in the regulation and control management service of the power distribution network.

title_en: Comprehensive judgment method for breakout prediction of slab caster
abstract_en: A comprehensive judgment method for breakout prediction of a slab caster belongs to the technical field of continuous casting production monitoring methods. The technical scheme is as follows: establishing a cyclic neural network model for each thermocouple on the crystallizer copper plate to judge whether the temperature curve of the thermocouple has the characteristic of adhesive breakout; establishing a logic judgment model according to a propagation rule of a casting blank bonding point on a space to judge whether a thermocouple of a temperature curve with bonding breakout characteristics has bonding breakout space propagation characteristics; all thermocouples with bonding breakout space propagation characteristics are alarm thermocouples, different weights are given to different alarm thermocouples according to the different positions of the alarm thermocouples, and a system gives a final bonding breakout alarm signal when the sum of the weights of the alarm thermocouples is greater than a specified threshold value. The invention utilizes the respective characteristics and advantages of the artificial intelligence model and the logic judgment model, and the miss-report rate and the false-report rate of the comprehensive model algorithm are obviously reduced compared with the single model, and are obviously superior to the traditional model algorithm.

title_en: Mechanism and data hybrid-driven generation type countermeasure network soft measurement modeling method
abstract_en: Mechanism and data mixingThe driven generating type countermeasure network soft measurement modeling method comprises the following steps: sampling the auxiliary variable to obtain data q, sampling the random noise to obtain data z, inputting the q and z into a generator to be identified, which consists of a mechanism model and a data driving error compensation model, to obtain a generated sample Will generate a sample Inputting the real sample x into a discriminator, and back-propagating the obtained loss to obtain the optimal generator parameters; the optimal generator is taken out to serve as a trained soft measurement model, the interpretability of the model is analyzed by using a method for manipulating latent variables, and the prediction performance of the model is analyzed by comparing the model with a single-drive soft measurement model, so that the limitations that dynamic characteristics among data cannot be captured by a static model, modeling errors exist in a mechanism-drive soft measurement model, label-free data are difficult to utilize in data-drive soft measurement and the interpretability is poor are overcome, and compared with the single-drive soft measurement method, the method has the characteristics of accuracy and reliability in prediction.

title_en: Distributed optical fiber sensing mass target data screening method based on image processing
abstract_en: A distributed optical fiber sensing mass target data screening method based on image processing is characterized in that space-time two-dimensional vibration signals are mapped into gray images, a multi-mode fusion technology is utilized, a lightweight convolutional neural network is combined to achieve efficient classification, a dynamic increment learning mechanism and a spatial propagation attenuation correction algorithm are introduced, and the problems of single characteristic representation, model update lag and insufficient positioning accuracy of a traditional method are solved. The method is suitable for the fields of perimeter security protection, pipeline monitoring, geological disaster early warning and the like, and can be used for screening and target recognition of mass vibration data under complex environment interference in real time. The invention breaks through the limitation of traditional time-frequency domain analysis through signal imaging characterization, obviously improves the distinguishing capability of similar events, simultaneously reduces the false alarm rate and the operation and maintenance cost by depending on a dynamic model optimization technology, effectively suppresses the influence of optical fiber attenuation on the positioning precision by combining a space correction algorithm, and provides reliable technical support for intelligent upgrading of a distributed optical fiber sensing system.

title_en: Intelligent algorithm-based high-voltage transmission line safety assessment method
