abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power system safety, and discloses a high-voltage transmission line safety assessment method based on an intelligent algorithm; the method comprises the steps of constructing a database through multi-source data acquisition and fusion processing, analyzing the relevance of meteorological conditions and an icing formation mechanism by using a deep learning model, excavating an evolution rule of the correlation, carrying out multi-scene simulation and sensitivity analysis by combining physical characteristics and topographic information of a power transmission line, and establishing a line icing risk partition assessment system. According to the method, the mechanical strength and the ice coating thickness critical value of a circuit are calculated based on a mechanical model, a grading early warning threshold standard is formulated, a time sequence prediction algorithm and a risk propagation model are constructed to realize intelligent early warning, and an anti-icing resource optimal allocation and self-adaptive generation of a deicing scheme are adopted to form an anti-icing strategy. The invention effectively improves the capacity of the high-voltage transmission line for resisting ice coating disasters and enhances the safe and stable operation level of the power grid.

title_en: Coastal city storm surge disaster toughness assessment method based on graph neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating the toughness of a storm surge disaster in an coastal city based on a graphic neural network, which is used for collecting multi-source heterogeneous data related to the storm surge disaster in the coastal city, and comprises geographic information data, infrastructure data and historical storm surge data, constructing coastal city infrastructure network structure data according to the geographic information data and the infrastructure data, then constructing a graphic neural network model, merging characteristic parameters of the historical storm surge data with the coastal city infrastructure network structure data, inputting the trained graphic neural network model, simulating the progressive influence of the storm surge disaster on coastal city infrastructure nodes, evaluating the state evolution of each node in the coastal city infrastructure network under the influence of the storm surge based on the propagation result of the graphic neural network, and respectively carrying out summarizing analysis on different functional areas based on the obtained toughness evaluation index data of each node to form an integral coastal city toughness evaluation result.

title_en: Low-altitude safety emergency system based on large model application
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of low-altitude safety emergency, and discloses a low-altitude safety emergency system based on large-model application. The system comprises a low-altitude state sensing module, a dynamic state prediction model is constructed based on historical flight data, a low-altitude target track coordinate sequence, radar echo and communication signal characteristics are collected in real time, and theoretical security state values are output. The multi-source data fusion analysis module performs three-dimensional difference analysis on theoretical and actual measurement situation values, and relates to time domain trend deviation, airspace coverage deviation and event sequence matching degree to generate a target level difference feature matrix. The risk propagation path deduction module inputs the matrix into a geographic topology analysis network, and generates a probability thermal distribution map of the abnormal risk propagation path by combining airspace node communication parameters and target positions to locate a risk influence area. The intelligent treatment strategy generation module enables high-frequency monitoring to the high-probability area according to the graph configuration parameters, and applies communication disturbance test to the adjacent targets.

title_en: Cloud data center security management platform
abstract_en: The invention provides a cloud data center security management platform comprising a cloud, a piece of managed equipment, and a security management platform. The cloud and the managed equipment are connected by a wireless communication network, and the cloud and the security management platform are connected by the wireless communication network. The security management platform comprises a Linux operating system module, a backup and recovery module, an intelligent cloud mirror service module, and a fault-tolerant mechanism module. The cloud data center security management platform has the beneficial effect that the platform can realize safe and efficient cloud storage services, alleviate data storm and avoid attacks to servers and service interruption caused by hardware failure, and becomes a novel application mode for helping industries to achieve massive data storage, data security, disaster recovery and backup, realize green computing and promote energy saving and emission reduction.
assignees: TIANJIN XINYUN NETWORK TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: The recognition methods of step power station key risk factor and risk transmission critical path based on Bayes risk network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of recognition methods of step power station key risk factor and risk transmission critical path based on Bayes risk network, it is related to Hydraulic and Hydro-Power Engineering field, step power station risk has the characteristics of common cause failure outstanding problem, using advantage of the Bayesian network in terms of common cause failure problem is handled, solve traditional " three-tree "（Fault tree, event tree, decision tree）Deficiency in terms of hydroelectric project risk analysis.Based on step power station Bayes risk network model, it is proposed that the recognition methods of key risk factor and risk transmission critical path, supported for step power station Bayes risk network method is provided into theoretical and method for risk identification and prevention and control.This method is simple and clear, workable, has important utilization prospect in the risk identification and prevention and control that cascade hydropower engineering and civil engineering similar system engineering application Bayesian network are carried out.

title_en: Aircraft emergency communication apparatus and method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of aircraft emergency communication apparatus and method, when detecting that aircraft is in runaway condition, launch control unit launches information carrying device from aircraft to the position higher than height where aircraft, information carrying device can send the positional information of the aircraft of carrying, the height higher in position is aerial after being launched due to information carrying device, no barrier is broadcasted in high aerial signal, signal can be allowed to propagate farther, good condition is provided to obtain the positional information of aircraft, the wireless signal of high altitude location is better relative to the network signal and gps signal of aircraft position itself, carry-on black box can be overcome because surrounding environment limitation lacks network signal and gps signal leads to not the difficulty that sends the positioning signal of aircraft.

title_en: A kind of anti-power grid wave propagation system based on frequency converter
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of anti-power grid wave propagation system based on frequency converter, and the major loop of frequency converter is controlled by DCS opened point；Power-off delay relay is accessed in the fault-signal circuit of frequency converter, using the power cut off delay break KT of power-off delay relay as in the logic of frequency conversion fault-signal access DCS opened point control frequency converter start-stop；The process conditions (pressure, temperature etc.) of start-stop frequency converter and frequency conversion fault-signal are and door relationship.Situations such as present invention can be according to state and temperature, the pressure of frequency converter, the working condition of intelligent control frequency converter, as long as soon as have a process conditions problematic, halt command, stop jumping equipment can be issued to frequency converter at once.Process conditions are met the requirements during power network fluctuation; and in the safety time of time relay setting, equipment can be restarted when power system restoration is normal immediately, i.e., protects load and frequency converter to the greatest extent; it can resume production as early as possible again, reduce loss and prevent the generation of secondary disaster.

title_en: Power grid planning method considering cascading failure risk
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power grid planning method considering cascading failure risks, which is characterized by comprising the following steps of: step 1: obtaining model parameters in a power grid; step 2: calculating an economic index, a safety index, a abundance index and a flexibility index; and step 3: establishing an evaluation index system based on each index by adopting an analytic hierarchy process; and 4, step 4: and establishing a power grid planning model and solving to obtain an optimal planning scheme. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of improving the utilization rate of new energy, improving the capability of a power grid for coping with cascading failures and the like.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV SOUTHEAST

title_en: Power utilization complaint early warning method based on cascade logistic regression Bayesian algorithm
abstract_en: The invention provides a power consumption complaint early warning method based on a cascade logistic regression Bayesian algorithm, which comprises the following steps: acquiring the power failure time of a power grid and the complaint time of a user, calculating a power failure forgetting index of the user, and screening out the complaint information of the user in an effective complaint range according to the power failure forgetting index; acquiring fault basic information and fault associated information corresponding to the screened user complaint information, extracting basic features based on the fault basic information and the user complaint information, and extracting additional features based on the fault associated information; the power failure forgetting index, the basic features and the additional features are jointly used as final feature sets, and the final feature sets are respectively input into a trained logistic regression model and a naive Bayes model; and cascading results output by the logistic regression model and the naive Bayes model to obtain a power utilization complaint early warning result. The method and the system realize the discrimination of potential complaint users, more accurate early warning of the power consumption complaint risks and can effectively reduce the workload of basic level personnel.
assignees: HANGZHOU CITY LINAN DISTR POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;HANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Civil aircraft cockpit man-machine system risk analysis method based on node elasticity evaluation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a civil aircraft cockpit man-machine system risk analysis method based on node elasticity evaluation, which comprises the following steps: analyzing the operation task of the flight unit in a typical flight phase; analyzing and decomposing the functions of the man-machine system of the cockpit based on a functional resonance analysis method, and screening out main functional units of the man-machine system; analyzing the output characteristics of the functions, taking the internal and external influence factors of the functions into consideration to obtain functional failure links, and constructing a human-computer system risk propagation network model; calculating propagation indexes of all nodes in a risk propagation network of the human-computer system; based on a node elasticity evaluation method, calculating a node elasticity value by a random simulation method, and analyzing key nodes of a man-machine system. The invention can analyze risk events and the damage degree of risks to the system in the complex man-machine system, and has important significance and value for improving the safety, the risk resistance and the recovery capability of the future intelligent aircraft cockpit man-machine system.

title_en: Hybrid type pumping and accumulating day-ahead peak regulation scheduling method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of new energy power generation optimized scheduling, in particular to a hybrid pumping and accumulating day-ahead peak shaving scheduling method, device and equipment and a storage medium, which comprise the following steps: constructing a wind-light-step hybrid pumping and accumulating day-ahead peak regulation scheduling model by taking the minimum residual load peak-valley difference of the receiving end power grid as an objective function; establishing constraint conditions of a scheduling model, wherein the constraint conditions comprise: the conventional cascade hydropower station is additionally provided with hydraulic characteristic constraint, electric characteristic constraint and hydroelectric coupling characteristic constraint after pumping and storage; linearizing the objective function and the constraint condition; and solving the linearized scheduling model to obtain an optimized scheduling result. According to the invention, a day-ahead peak regulation scheduling model is established, and finally, an optimal scheduling result is obtained by solving the model, so that a power generation scheme of the wind-light-step hybrid pumping and accumulating system meeting constraints can be provided, wind power and photovoltaic digestion is promoted, and compared with a water-wind-light complementary power generation system, the effects of better peak clipping and valley filling are realized.

title_en: Flow monitoring-oriented supply chain intelligent tracking system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a supply chain intelligent tracking system oriented to flow monitoring, which relates to the technical field of supply chain intelligent management and is used for solving the problems of flexibility and risk resistance of supply chain breakpoint management; the method comprises the steps of collecting original data from supply chain link points, combining time sequence, classification characteristics and high-dimensional data processing technology, generating effective characteristics, constructing a breakpoint prediction model through a gradient lifting decision tree, identifying and evaluating breakpoint risks, constructing a supply chain network topological structure, recursively calculating propagation paths and influence ranges of the breakpoint risks, determining affected node sets, combining prediction results to formulate adjustment and recovery strategies, optimizing resource allocation and logistics routes, quickly recovering key nodes, ensuring continuity of the supply chain, upgrading early warning mechanisms to dynamically monitor risks, and accordingly improving management flexibility and risk resistance of the supply chain.
assignees: SHENZHEN DINGRUN JIETONG SUPPLY CHAIN CO LTD

title_en: Transmission and distribution network cooperative scheduling method considering wind power uncertainty and frequency modulation constraint
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transmission and distribution network collaborative scheduling method considering wind power uncertainty and frequency modulation constraint, which comprises the steps of constructing frequency modulation safety constraint by combining frequency modulation response capacities of a wind turbine generator, an energy storage system and a thermal power generating unit, acquiring operation data of a transmission network and a distribution network and unit parameters, respectively establishing an upper layer transmission network unit combination model and a lower layer active distribution network scheduling model containing the frequency modulation safety constraint, linearizing nonlinear parts in the models by utilizing a second order cone technology and a large M method, and realizing parallel optimization solution of a transmission and distribution system by adopting a distributed optimization method based on a target cascading algorithm by taking interconnection line interaction power and auxiliary frequency modulation power between the transmission and distribution network as coupling variables. The method ensures the solving accuracy, realizes the efficient linkage of the transmission and distribution network system in the resource scheduling and frequency response, and obviously reduces the frequency modulation pressure caused by large-scale grid connection of wind power to the traditional thermal power generating unit.

title_en: Power grid fault cascading identification method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of power systems, in particular to a power grid fault linkage identification method and a system, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring alarm information and WAMS synchronous measurement data in a power grid; and carrying out relevance analysis on fault events among a plurality of fault events generating alarm information by utilizing the rule base based on the power grid topology model and WAMS synchronous measurement data, wherein the relevance analysis comprises at least one of a time type, a space type and an electrical type, and the rule base records the causal relationship among the fault events.
assignees: BEIJING SIFANG ENG CO LTD;BEIJING SIFANG AUTOMATION CO

title_en: Dangerous chemical transportation path dynamic risk prevention and control system and method based on space-time fusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of intelligent traffic safety, in particular to a system and a method for preventing and controlling dynamic risks of a dangerous chemical transportation path based on space-time fusion, which are used for calculating a multidimensional risk index matrix through a risk index quantization module and realizing accurate assessment of dynamic risks of a road section by combining a space-time environment sensitivity prediction matrix generated by an environment sensitivity analysis module and a risk propagation probability cloud picture of a risk diffusion prediction module; the system establishes a collaborative risk factor assessment model, adjusts a safety threshold according to historical accident data to generate a time-space road network risk scoring matrix, determines an early warning level according to the safety threshold, selects prevention and control measures, optimizes a transportation path, makes an emergency response plan for a high-risk road section and outputs an intelligent decision instruction set.

title_en: Flood risk propagation assessment method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood risk propagation assessment method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of calculating a flood risk value of each sub-river basin in a research area according to an acquired flood risk assessment index variable of the research area; the method comprises the steps of grading flood risk values to obtain flood risk grades of each sub-river basin in a research area, constructing a Markov chain space-time model, determining a flood risk space-time propagation rule according to the Markov chain space-time model, fitting a flood risk propagation function according to the flood risk space-time propagation rule, determining a flood risk transfer blocking effect of the flood control hydraulic engineering according to the flood risk propagation function, flood control hydraulic engineering operation information data and historical flood data, constructing a flood risk space-time propagation network model with space-time dependency relationship, and evaluating the research area according to the flood risk space-time propagation network model to obtain a flood risk propagation evaluation result.

title_en: Method for minimizing service interruption and related equipment
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a method and related equipment for minimizing service interruption, and relates to the technical field of wireless communication. The method comprises the steps that a terminal device sends a registration request message to a first network element, the registration request message carries indication information of supporting MINT by the terminal device, a registration acceptance message sent by the first network element is received, the registration acceptance message is generated according to subscription data of the terminal device sent by a second network element to the first network element, and the subscription data of the terminal device comprises PLMN information used under a disaster condition and PLMN associated access type information used under the disaster condition. The method and the device can fully ensure the continuity of the terminal data service and can develop wide-area emergency communication service.
assignees: CHINA TELECOM CO LTD;CHINA TELECOM CORP LTD TECHNOLOGY INNOVATION CENTER

title_en: Power grid fault mode prediction and plan generation method and system based on self-supervision learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for predicting a power grid fault mode and generating a plan based on self-supervision learning, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting real-time operation data and historical data of a power grid by a power grid monitoring system and other sensors and preprocessing the data; the method comprises the steps of automatically identifying a fault mode of a power grid by utilizing historical data and real-time data of the power grid through a self-supervision learning method, predicting fault types, occurrence time, influence areas and propagation trends, and generating an emergency plan based on the prediction results when the self-supervision learning model is generated for the fault emergency plan to complete the prediction of the fault mode of the power grid. The invention realizes the intellectualization and automation of the fault plan by combining the self-supervision learning and the multi-objective optimization algorithm, and can find the optimal balance among a plurality of optimization objectives by the multi-objective optimization algorithm, thereby ensuring the comprehensiveness and the effectiveness of the fault plan.

title_en: Method and equipment for optimally configuring lightning damage grade driving lightning arrester of 10KV distribution line
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of lightning protection of distribution networks, in particular to an optimization configuration method and equipment for a lightning damage level driving lightning arrester of a 10KV distribution line. The method takes grade evaluation, model matching, layout optimization, grounding reinforcement and simulation verification as a main line, provides a set of engineering method and system capable of landing, can ensure the reliability of power supply and simultaneously consider the economical efficiency, and is suitable for differential and refined protection and large-scale deployment of a power distribution network in a lightning damage high-rise area. The method has the advantages that accurate type selection and arrangement according to the sections are realized, the unit length and multiphase concurrent flashover rate are reduced, the remote overvoltage propagation and counterattack discharge risks are restrained, and the lightning protection precision and the practicability of the power distribution system are improved under engineering constraint and economic requirements.
assignees: XIZANG AGRICULTURE AND ANIMAL HUSBANDRY UNIV

title_en: Water service state on-line monitoring management method and system for intelligent water service
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water service state monitoring and management, in particular to a water service state online monitoring and management method and system for intelligent water service, which form a quantifiable flow direction judging basis by establishing node pressure grading and flow difference, ensure that the flow path and intersection proportion are unified in a calculation level to form a dynamic evolution structure with time-dependent characteristics, enhance the recognition capability of pressure wave propagation and hysteresis response, realize multi-characteristic anomaly synchronous recognition through node pressure anomaly frequency, flow difference rate and long-short-term memory network, reduce random fluctuation false alarm, improve anomaly rejection accuracy and stability, ensure parameter consistency of a constraint coordination system, calculate a matrix of balance indexes and neighborhood influence coefficients and isolate forests to form a quantified stable distribution pattern, realize accurate modeling of a dynamic pipe network, and improve anomaly detection sensitivity, flow direction prediction accuracy and operation stability evaluation reliability.

title_en: Tracking, analyzing, and visualizing application delay
abstract_en: Performance metrics related to the processing and propagation of messages related to select applications are collected during a simulation of a network. Each message associated with an application is tagged, and each simulated packet that contains some or all of a tagged message is correspondingly tagged to facilitate the creation of transmit records and receive records. A post processor is configured to collate transmit and receive records of each tagged message to identify delays associated with each node that processes the message, and each link that propagates the message from node to node within the network. The processed timing information is provided to the user via an interactive user interface that allows the user to view the timing information from an application layer perspective.

title_en: Electric network fault partition method
abstract_en: A kind of electric network fault partition method, the method comprising the steps of: A, sets up the vulnerability inder of circuit in electrical network, forms the vulnerable line set of electrical network；B, when breaking down in electrical network, it is judged that whether fault occurs in vulnerable line set, if then operating procedure C, otherwise terminates；C, with faulty line node or the node of vulnerable line that is attached thereto as starting point, judge the vulnerability inder of connected circuit, if vulnerability inder is less than predetermined threshold, then described circuit is included into border circuit, another node of the most described circuit is included into fault zone, continue to judge the vulnerability inder of connected circuit, until finding border circuit.D, electrical network is divided into fault zone or non-faulting region.By using the electric network fault partition method of the present invention, it is possible to when breaking down, faulty line is isolated in a little region, makes fault to propagate on a large scale, prevent the generation of large-scale blackout.

title_en: Multi-time-scale nested wind-solar-water multi-energy complementary scheduling method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-time scale nested wind, light and water multi-energy complementary scheduling method, which belongs to the technical field of multi-energy comprehensive utilization and aims to exert the electric quantity compensation benefit of wind, light and water multi-energy complementation on a long term and the electric power compensation benefit on a short term; the core of the long-term dispatching is that the water level control mode of the large reservoir in the current domain is changed, the complementary advantage of the multi-energy complementary electric quantity is exerted, and the utilization efficiency of clean energy is improved; on the premise of meeting long-term water level constraint, the short-term dispatching utilizes the flexible regulation capability of water and electricity to carry out primary power compensation regulation on natural randomness, intermittence and fluctuation of wind and light output, thereby reducing the impact of wind and light output on safe and stable operation of a power grid; the wind and light forecast deviation is adjusted in a 'secondary power compensation' mode through real-time scheduling by utilizing water and electricity, a day-ahead output plan is tracked, the power supply reliability of the system is ensured, and the surplus energy of the cascade hydropower station system is fully stored through the end reservoir capacity control, so that the long-term power generation benefit of the system is ensured.

title_en: Power grid cascading failure prediction method based on Q learning network attack
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid cascading failure prediction method based on Q learning network attack, which comprises the following steps: 1 constructing a network attack model, determining the success probability of each attack path of the fault-free tripping attack of the circuit breaker, 2 constructing a cascading fault evolution model based on Q learning, training by using a Q learning algorithm, generating a Q value table to select an optimal network attack scheme, and screening out attack paths with larger risks. According to the invention, on the basis of considering the success probability of the network attack, the Q learning algorithm is utilized to select the network attack path, so that the large-scale calculation similar to the traversal algorithm can be avoided, the calculation time is greatly shortened, the workload and the completeness are well balanced, and theoretical guidance is provided for the power grid cascading failure prevention and control under the network attack scene.

title_en: Key line identification method for AC/DC power grid accident chain
abstract_en: A key line identification method of an AC/DC power grid accident chain comprises the following steps: step 1: acquiring an alternating current/direct current power grid cascading failure accident chain to be processed, identifying a key line, and recording the occurrence probability and load loss of the accident chain; step 2: constructing indexes aiming at the influence of lines in an accident chain on system power flow, voltage, topological structure and load loss; step 3: respectively solving subjective weight w 'and objective weight w' of the constructed indexes; step 4: establishing an objective function of w', w ", searching the most linear combination coefficient, carrying out combination weighting, and measuring the local importance IN  i  of the line L  i  IN the accident chain L  j ; step 5: the key index of each line l  i  in the AC/DC power grid is obtained as follows Step 6: sequencing the criticality indexes of all the lines, and taking a plurality of lines in front of the criticality indexes as the critical lines of the AC/DC power grid; and identifying the key circuit of the cascading failure of the AC/DC power grid through the steps.

title_en: Wind power generation power prediction method and system based on multi-scale double space-time network area
abstract_en: The invention provides a wind power generation power prediction method and a wind power generation power prediction system based on a multi-scale double-space-time network region, which are used for eliminating the influence of high-frequency noise on wind power prediction, decoupling wind power data of different frequencies, adopting a wind power prediction strategy based on wavelet decomposition, respectively predicting future trends of obtained subcomponents after the wavelet decomposition of the historical wind power data, and summing the future trends to obtain final wind power prediction. The present invention proposes a more efficient model to learn the spatio-temporal representation. Two key space-time correlation layers are realized in the invention, including a synchronous space-time layer and an asynchronous space-time layer. Wherein the synchronous time-space layer learns the similarity between the time series of sites, and the asynchronous time-space layer learns the wind propagation between sites. In order to solve the space-time correlation deviation caused by time variation, the invention adopts a multi-scale structure. Robust representation of wind sites is achieved by learning spatiotemporal correlations over multiple scales.

title_en: Power load prediction method and system based on weather prediction model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power load prediction method and a power load prediction system based on a weather prediction model, and relates to the technical field of load prediction, comprising the following steps of acquiring historical power load data and corresponding multidimensional weather data, constructing a weather coupling effect analysis model, and calculating a dynamic coupling weight matrix among weather parameters through an attention mechanism network; the method comprises the steps of carrying out feature fusion on a coupling weight matrix and multidimensional meteorological data through a gating circulation unit to generate space-time coupling feature vectors, establishing an electric load prediction model, extracting short-term fluctuation features and long-term trend features of the electric load from the space-time coupling feature vectors based on a depth residual error network architecture and a parallel convolution channel, updating a dynamic coupling weight matrix based on prediction error back propagation, and realizing self-adaptive adjustment of meteorological parameter coupling relations. According to the invention, the dynamic fusion of the space-time characteristics is realized through the cross gating unit, so that the model can simultaneously utilize the space-time information to predict the power load, and the prediction precision is improved.

title_en: Landslide evolution based dynamic identification method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a dynamic identification method and a device based on landslide evolution, which relate to the technical field of landslide identification and comprise the steps of constructing a space-time similarity matrix based on a direction consistency item and a space adjacent item of monitoring point data, and constructing a matrix to represent total energy by decomposing characteristic values of the space-time similarity matrix; according to space-time similarity matrix analysis, obtaining a main energy concentration index, calculating the standard deviation of the energy concentration as a fluctuation measure in combination with a sliding time window, judging the development stage of the main energy concentration index, the fluctuation measure and a fluctuation constraint condition according to matrix representation total energy to obtain a sliding belt development stage result, training a depth feedforward neural network based on a back propagation algorithm, and inputting slope parameters, rock-soil mass parameters and the sliding belt development stage result into the trained neural network to predict a slope safety coefficient to obtain a sliding slope evolution result. The invention solves the problem of insufficient recognition precision in the slide belt forming stage.

title_en: Cascade reliability index determination method for multi-level inter-city road network
abstract_en: The application provides a cascading reliability index determining method of a multi-level inter-city road network, which comprises the steps of constructing the multi-level inter-city road network of a target area, calculating initial load and capacity of any first node of the first node set, triggering cascading failure of the multi-level inter-city road network by utilizing an attack strategy based on the betweenness centrality to determine initial failure nodes from the first node set, simulating a cascading failure propagation process by utilizing a multi-path load distribution model driven by identifying equal impedance lines by taking the initial failure nodes as a starting point until the propagation process is finished, and determining the number of newly-increased failure nodes, the network efficiency ratio, the global node cascading failure rate and the local node cascading failure rate of each round in the cascading failure propagation process as cascading reliability indexes of the multi-level inter-city road network. The application improves the authenticity and accuracy of the cascade reliability index of the multi-level inter-city road network of the target area.

title_en: Method and device for providing situation propagation platform to strengthen disaster response capabilities
title_ko: 재난 대응역량 강화를 위한 상황전파 플랫폼 제공 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for providing a situation propagation platform to strengthen disaster response capabilities, which supports a site-centered customized disaster response system, and an apparatus thereof. According to the present invention, the method comprises the following steps: establishing a standard operation procedure for collaboration functions for each type of disaster; in response to the occurrence of a disaster situation, receiving a selection for the collaboration function to generate a task management process for managing the standard operation procedure; when the task management process is started, activating the uniquely assigned emergency contact network function and situation propagation function, respectively, tracking a situation propagation target′s access to an emergency contact network in real-time, and monitoring transmission and reception status between the situation propagation targets; and generating and providing a checklist on standard response tasks to the situation propagation targets based on the standard operation procedure in accordance with the flow of situation propagation.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 재난 대응역량 강화를 위한 상황전파 플랫폼 제공 방법 및 장치에 관한 것으로, 상기 방법은 재난 유형 별로 협업기능에 관한 표준운영절차(Standard Operation Procedure)를 구축하는 단계; 재난 상황의 발생에 따라 상기 협업기능에 관한 선택을 수신하여 상기 표준운영절차의 관리를 위한 업무관리 프로세스를 생성하는 단계; 상기 업무관리 프로세스가 개시되면 고유 할당되는 비상연락망 기능 및 상황전파 기능을 각각 활성화하고, 상황전파 대상자들의 상기 비상연락망에 대한 접속상황을 실시간 추적하며 상기 상황전파 대상자들 간의 송·수신 상태를 모니터링 하는 단계; 및 상기 표준운영절차를 기초로 상황전파의 흐름에 따라 상기 상황전파 대상자에게 표준대응업무에 관한 체크리스트를 생성하여 제공하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: AC/DC power grid cascading failure analysis method based on key power transmission section recognition
abstract_en: The invention provides an alternating current-direct current power grid cascading failure analysis method based on key power transmission section recognition, which comprises the following steps of: A. searching all power transmission sections between a direct current transmitting end and a receiving end by adopting a power transmission section traversal algorithm based on graph theory; from the direct current sending end node v S Starting from, forming a set S of nodes 0 ＝{v S Then search for S 0 All cut sets of branches between adjacent points and adopting gradually outward expansion of node set S 0 The traversal search is completed. B. Further identifying a key power transmission section which possibly causes a larger cascading failure risk by utilizing the power flow transfer coefficient and the section maximum overload rate index; C. and (4) giving out cascading failure sets with larger risks in each key power transmission section and key branches to be monitored in a key mode through transient stability calculation. By adopting the method, the key power transmission section and the key branch which are easy to have cascading failure after the direct-current monopole is locked can be effectively determined.
assignees: CHINA SOUTH POWER GRID ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO;CSG POWER GRID TECHNOLOGY RES CT

title_en: Consider the power information physics system Risk of Communication parser that risk status is propagated
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of power information physics system Risk of Communication parsers that consideration risk status is propagated.Establish Risk of Communication framework, system is divided into electric power, power information and information space, and Risk of Communication is divided into information space, the Risk of Communication in electric power space, between electric power and information space, and there are nodes in space；Risk Propagation Model and risk status propogator matrix are constructed, risk status propogator matrix is solved, the system risk state vector after acquiring under risk not homogeneous Risk of Communication, develop each node Risk of Communication process, until reaching stable state, Risk of Communication terminates；Risk hypersensitivity node is found out by analyzing venture influence.The present invention solves the problems, such as impact analysis of the risk in different spaces with the architectural characteristic of the characteristic of spatial and system to Risk of Communication, quantify the propagation path of power information physics system network structure and risk, disclosure risks change procedure, finds out risk hypersensitivity node.

title_en: Real-time tiny face detection method based on preprocessing mechanism
abstract_en: The invention mainly relates to the problem of target detection in the field of artificial intelligence. Aiming at the problem of tiny human faces in a complex environment, a cascading human face detection method is provided, and the method mainly comprises two neural networks and a preprocessing mechanism. Firstly, a first neural network, namely SSD is used for detecting a pedestrian confidence frame, then the region is transmitted into a preprocessing mechanism, the mechanism automatically predicts the region of interest of the face according to the length and the width of the confidence frame, and performs image pyramid processing on the region of interest, and the algorithm enables a second face detection network to detect faces with different sizes as the input size of the second network is fixed. The method provided by the invention can accurately and effectively detect the extremely small faces in a plurality of complex environments, and can be potentially used and integrated in the fields of public safety detection, face recognition and the like.

title_en: Building energy consumption prediction method based on longicorn stigma optimization algorithm and neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building energy consumption prediction method based on a longicorn stigma optimization algorithm and a neural network, which comprises the following four main steps: 1) collecting building energy consumption related data, and performing principal component analysis and normalization pretreatment on the data; 2) determining input and output items and a network structure of a multi-layer feedforward neural network model with an error back propagation learning function; 3) optimizing the connection weight and the threshold of the BP network by using a longicorn algorithm; 4) and carrying out short-term prediction on the building electric power energy consumption by using the BAS-BP prediction model obtained by optimization. The method utilizes the principal component analysis algorithm to carry out principal component analysis on the pre-input variables, and selects the variables meeting the principal component extraction requirement, thereby reducing the input dimension; and optimizing the structure and parameters of the neural network model by using the global optimization capability of the longicorn algorithm. Compared with the existing building energy consumption prediction method, the prediction model provided by the invention has the advantages of simple structure, high prediction precision, short operation time and the like.

title_en: Method, system, equipment and storage medium for planning cascade hydropower
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of automation of electric power systems, and discloses a method, a system, equipment and a storage medium for planning cascade hydropower plans, which comprises the following steps: acquiring step hydropower prediction data of a day to be compiled; inputting the cascade hydropower prediction data of the day to be compiled into a cascade hydropower plan deep learning model obtained by training the length-time memory network model by using the historical cascade hydropower prediction data, so as to obtain the cascade hydropower plan of the day to be compiled. The cascade hydropower plan compiling method does not need to research the internal mechanism of the operation of a power grid, and constructs a cascade hydropower plan deep learning model representing the mapping relation between cascade hydropower prediction data and a cascade hydropower plan based on a deep learning method.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Electric energy quality analysis and identification method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric energy quality analysis and identification method based on deep learning, which comprises the steps of collecting electric energy signals to be detected, randomly dividing the electric energy signals to be detected into a training sample set and a testing sample set, inputting the training sample set into a long-short term memory network (LSTM) model for training to obtain the trained LSTM model, and inputting the testing sample set into the trained LSTM model for testing the electric energy quality disturbance classification condition. According to the method, the long-time memory network is used as a model for electric energy signal classification, the model is trained through a Softmax function and a back propagation algorithm, convergence is rapidly achieved, feature extraction through human intervention is avoided, electric energy quality signal classification is directly achieved, errors are reduced, identification accuracy is improved, and the method is high in practicability.

title_en: Line loss calculation method based on data prediction filling and global dynamic model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a line loss calculation method based on data prediction filling and a global dynamic model, which belongs to the technical field of line loss detection and comprises the following steps: step 1: determining abnormal data, enumerating line loss data types, and inputting main reasons of data abnormality as cluster number; step 2: clustering and grouping, namely performing data grouping on abnormal data by using a neighbor propagation algorithm, and repeatedly iterating to enhance the accuracy; and step 3: missing data prediction filling, adopting a DNN algorithm to respectively train and learn each type of data, and predicting by using the data outside the package; and 4, step 4: and theoretical line loss calculation, namely associating operating equipment in the power grid with line loss, and establishing a global network dynamic model, so that the accuracy of line loss calculation can be enhanced, and the accurate positioning of the abnormal line loss defect can be assisted.
assignees: MARKETING SERVICE CENTER OF LIAONING PROVINCE ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Regional multi-system double-layer distributed optimization scheduling method considering double-layer carbon emission optimization distribution model
abstract_en: The invention provides a regional multi-system double-layer dispersion optimization scheduling method considering a double-layer carbon emission optimization distribution model, which constructs the regional multi-energy system double-layer carbon emission optimization distribution model, wherein an upper-layer multi-energy main system mainly considers a power distribution network, a gas distribution network and a heat distribution network system, real-time carbon emission constraint is formulated based on real-time environment monitoring, historical carbon emission of each multi-energy subsystem in a lower-layer region is decomposed to each multi-energy subsystem in the lower-layer region in real time, and each multi-energy subsystem in the lower-layer region needs to meet the real-time carbon emission constraint while being optimized; and finally, solving a double-layer dispersion optimization scheduling model of the multi-energy system in the region between the upper layer and the lower layer by adopting an improved target cascade analysis method. The method can reduce the total network loss of the upper distribution network system of the regional multi-energy system, reduce the operation cost of each energy subsystem in the lower region, and determine the optimal distribution scheme of the whole carbon emission of the regional multi-energy system.

title_en: Audit data processing method suitable for distribution network engineering
abstract_en: The invention provides an audit data processing method suitable for distribution network engineering, which comprises the following steps: generating first twin distribution network 3D data based on first component information of a first distribution network engineering number at the current moment; acquiring all second component information in current audit data received at the current moment to obtain a second component set, and segmenting the first twin distribution network 3D data based on the second component set to obtain second twin distribution network 3D data; acquiring third twin distribution network 3D data corresponding to the second twin distribution network 3D data in the first twin distribution network 3D data; verifying the current audit data of the 3D data of the second twin distribution network to obtain a first verification result based on the historical audit data and/or the information cascade strategy of the 3D data of the third twin distribution network; and correspondingly storing the current audit data, the first verification result and the 3D data of the second twin distribution network, and updating the 3D data of the first twin distribution network.
assignees: ZHEJIANG PROVINCE ELECTRIC POWER LTD COMPANY OF STATE GRID;JINHUA POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF ZHEJIANG PROVINCE ELECTRIC POWER LTD COMPANY OF STATE GRID

title_en: Medical system risk management and control prior prediction method and system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a medical system risk management and control pre-prediction method and system based on deep learning, relates to the technical field of risk management and control of medical systems, and aims to solve the problems of large data volume and low risk evaluation accuracy rate caused by risk evaluation indexes in the conventional risk prediction based on a neural network. The risk category prediction model comprises an LSTM network, a CNN convolutional network and an attention bidirectional RNN network; during training, a BP feedback propagation algorithm is adopted for gradient feedback, the average absolute error MAE is used for distinguishing risk types, and the root mean square error RMSE is used for carrying out regression learning on the risk evaluation grade. The method predicts the non-occurrence risk by adopting algorithms of different risk categories, and ensures that the risk evaluation accuracy of the neural network is higher by adopting an attention mechanism.
assignees: WEST CHINA HOSPITAL SICHUAN UNIV;CHENGDU AIJIA FEISHITE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Ultra-wideband antenna with substrate integrated waveguide feed structure and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultra-wideband antenna with a substrate integrated waveguide feed structure and a manufacturing method thereof, belonging to the field of antennas, the antenna structure is further cascaded and combined by constructing a hybrid substrate integrated waveguide ring structure, a two-dimensional dual-polarized single-pulse feeding network, a slot substrate integrated waveguide back cavity antenna and other components, so that the ultra-wideband antenna with single-layer feeding of the substrate integrated waveguide is realized. The amplitude and phase distribution of the output port of the antenna accords with the amplitude and phase excitation signals required by the single-layer structure for realizing the dual-polarized ultra-wideband antenna. The antenna provided by the invention has a simple structure, can effectively realize ultra-wideband transmission of radio frequency signals, and has wide practicability and operability.
assignees: SICHUAN AEROSPACE VOCATIONAL COLLEGE SICHUAN AEROSPACE ADVANCED TECHNICAL SCHOOL

title_en: Method for predicting cascading faults of power grid of graph neural network based on physical information guidance
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of power system cascade fault prediction, and relates to a method for predicting a grid cascade fault of a graphic neural network based on physical information guidance, which comprises the steps of obtaining operation data of a cascade fault, inputting the operation data of the cascade fault into a trained grid cascade fault prediction model, and obtaining a prediction result; the grid cascading failure prediction model comprises a co-embedded graph neural network and a structure coding module, wherein the data enhancement is carried out by utilizing the structure coding based on multi-step random walk matrix and node degree representation considering the line attribute of the grid, the capability of capturing topology information is improved, the co-embedded graph neural network is utilized to promote the interaction of grid nodes and grid lines, the accuracy of grid cascading failure prediction is improved, the node-side interaction aggregation function of the co-embedded graph neural network is changed through the power transmission distribution factor of the grid, the description capability of the complex interaction relation of the actual grid is improved, and the accuracy of grid cascading failure prediction is improved.

title_en: Evaluation method and system of novel power distribution communication network under extreme disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses an evaluation method and system of a novel power distribution communication network under extreme disasters, which are characterized in that a double-network coupling model of a novel power distribution system 10kV line, a power grid node failure model under the extreme disasters and a communication node failure model after power grid node energy supply is lost under the extreme disasters are constructed, the correlation characteristics of a power distribution system power grid and the communication network are fully considered, the failure conditions of the power grid node and the communication node are accurately judged, probability distribution of the power grid node flowing through wind speed under the extreme disasters is generated, the wind speed condition is truly simulated, a basis is provided for judging the power grid node failure, and cascading failure simulation is carried out based on the double-network coupling model of the novel power distribution system 10kV line, the power grid node failure model under the extreme disasters, the communication node failure model after power grid node energy supply is lost under the extreme disasters and the probability distribution of the power grid node flowing through wind speed under the extreme disasters, so that the reliability of the communication network is evaluated, and the reliability of the communication network is improved.
assignees: ECONOMIC RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Method and system for recommending optimal operation scheme of cascade pump station group with stable fusion operation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for recommending a cascade pump station group optimization operation scheme with stable fusion operation, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a mathematical model, analyzing the correlation degree between a machine set working condition parameter and a stability parameter by utilizing a maximum information coefficient method, calibrating the working condition parameter according to the correlation degree, respectively constructing a deep neural network model for each stability parameter, taking the working condition parameter calibrated by a pump station machine set as input data and the stability parameter as output data, training to obtain a mapping relation between the machine set working condition parameter and the stability parameter so as to establish a working condition-stability relation model, solving the mathematical model, constructing a scheme library, respectively calculating the pump station machine set stability parameter under each scheme, and obtaining an optimal operation scheme considering economy and stability according to a parameter comparison result. The invention can perform operation stability analysis on the schemes in the step pump station group optimization operation scheme library, and comprehensively select the optimal operation scheme considering economy and stability.

title_en: Low-carbon economic dispatching method and system for multi-region interconnected electric heating combined system considering carbon emission flow and demand response
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-carbon economic dispatching method and system of a multi-region interconnection electric heating combined system considering carbon emission flow and demand response, wherein the method comprises the steps of analyzing tie line trend, decomposing the multi-region interconnection electric heating combined system into a plurality of independent region subsystems, analyzing coordinated coupling relations of the region subsystems, building a low-carbon economic dispatching model of the multi-region interconnection electric heating combined system considering carbon emission flow and demand response based on a target cascade analysis method according to region decomposition results, comprising an upper-level main problem and lower-level sub-problems corresponding to the region subsystems, solving the model after modeling, and calculating carbon emission allocation results of the region subsystems according to optimization results. According to the invention, the thermodynamic system heat supply network pipeline and the carbon emission flow thereof are modeled in a refined mode, on the basis, the heat supply side is led to participate in demand response according to the carbon emission allocation condition while the multi-region independent optimization is carried out, the confidentiality of data of subsystems in each region is facilitated, and the low-carbon economic scheduling of the multi-region interconnection electric heating combined system is realized.

title_en: Trans-regional ammeter anomaly detection method and system based on transfer learning and ammeter
abstract_en: The application discloses a trans-regional ammeter anomaly detection method and system based on transfer learning and an ammeter, belonging to the technical field of ammeter detection, and comprising the steps of constructing a layered characteristic extraction network and inputting ammeter data into the layered characteristic extraction network; the method comprises the steps of carrying out cross-regional feature alignment on feature data extracted from a hierarchical feature extraction network, classifying the abnormality of an ammeter in a target region through a classifier after the cross-regional feature alignment is carried out, carrying out time sequence analysis on the abnormality data through a time sequence abnormality positioning network, and identifying the association among a plurality of abnormal events after the abnormality positioning to construct an abnormality propagation diagram. In the implementation process of the technical scheme, the characteristic data are subjected to cross-regional characteristic alignment through a layered characteristic extraction network, the abnormal condition of the ammeter in the target region is classified and positioned through a classifier, then the association among different abnormal events is identified through an association analysis technology, and the abnormal detection effect of the ammeter is improved.
assignees: JIANGSU HUAPENG ELECTRIC METERS TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-dimensional coupling reversible mapping landslide susceptibility evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multidimensional coupling reversible mapping landslide susceptibility evaluation method, and relates to the technical field of geological disaster prediction. The method has the advantages of being more efficient in characteristic characterization, realizing low-dimensional sparse characterization by using one-hot coding of extremely random leaf nodes, reducing the calculated amount of a deep network, inhibiting overfitting through sparsity, retaining the combined meaning of geological factors corresponding to the leaf nodes, considering efficiency and interpretability, being more robust in network training, solving the gradient attenuation problem by lossless characteristic propagation of reversible residual blocks, improving the generalization capability of small samples by random subspace heavy parameter strategy, enabling the models to be stably trained in a landslide sample scarcity scene, and enabling overfitting gap to be less than or equal to 0.010.

title_en: Dynamic simulation and risk assessment method and system for power system with collaborative source network and charge storage
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of operation and control of power systems, and particularly relates to a power system dynamic simulation and comprehensive risk assessment method and system integrating the cooperative interaction characteristics of source, network, load and storage, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a source network load storage cooperative simulation model based on multiple intelligent agents; the method comprises the steps of setting a simulation scene comprising initial disturbance and uncertainty, running a collaborative simulation model, aiming at a system risk state identified in a simulation result, adopting a path backtracking and contribution analysis algorithm based on a time-varying system interaction directed graph, deconstructing a key propagation path causing the risk state, quantifying the contribution degree of each agent and an interaction event in risk formation, generating a collaborative control strategy package related to a plurality of links of a source, a network, a load and a storage based on the contribution degree deconstructing result with the aim of minimizing the current risk and the future risk propagation uncertainty, and feeding back the collaborative control strategy package as a new control input to the collaborative simulation model for verification and effect evaluation to complete closed loop.
assignees: LUOHE POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Remote monitoring failure reporting alternate system
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To stand in for reporting to a remote monitoring device and identify the presence of an abnormal state of building equipment, when a failure occurs in remote monitoring.  <P>SOLUTION: A remote monitoring failure reporting alternate system 10 includes a backup power supply 16, capable of supplying urgent power in service interruption; an abnormality occurrence reporting device 18 for notifying the remote monitoring device 22 via a public line 20 of, as an abnormal signal, the fact that an urgent button 14 of a car 8 of an elevator has been pushed; and an urgent radio transmitting/receiving device 34 disposed on the roof or the like of a building 4, in order to output an abnormality occurrence signal instead of the abnormality occurrence reporting device 18, when it cannot report the abnormal signal. By using them, the system connects to the remote monitoring device 22 via an urgent radio network 24 and a local administration disaster prevention network 28. This abnormality occurrence signal can be received also by a portable abnormality occurrence signal receiver 42 of a field engineer (FE) 40.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Using computer video camera to detect earthquake
abstract_en: Images from the video camera (24) of a computer are compared (46) over time, e.g., every few milliseconds, to determine from the pixel data if motion of the computer matches template motion associated with an earthquake P-wave. If so, a warning is generated (58), uploaded to a communication network, and propagated over the network to other computers.

title_en: Voltage stability evaluation fault set forming method for multi-direct current feed-in receiving end alternating current system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for forming a voltage stability assessment fault set of a multi-direct current feed-in receiving end alternating current system, which is characterized by comprising the following steps of: acquiring the fluctuation data of a recent multi-direct-current feed-in direct-current receiving end system, the corresponding transmission curve of a direct-current transmission system with the maximum power, the current regional load and the starting mode to form a relation table, carrying out rule reduction on the relation table according to a reduction rule, and determining a typical operation mode in a future period; calculating a voltage stability level coefficient of a receiving end system in a typical operation mode; calculating the voltage stability level coefficient S of the direct current receiving end system under the condition of various line faults and disconnection n (ii) a Sequencing the line faults according to the voltage stability level coefficient of the direct current receiving end system; and combining the power flow transfer condition after the fault, the low voltage point and the electrical distance risk coefficient of the fault point to combine the worst cascading fault set. The method can quickly evaluate the voltage instability risk of the receiving end power grid of the direct current system after the fault by carrying out characteristic analysis on the transient voltage instability accident possibly existing in the existing alternating current-direct current hybrid power grid.

title_en: Software module change influence determination method based on complex network dynamic simulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for determining the change influence of a software module based on complex network dynamic simulation, which belongs to the field of software complex networks and comprises the following steps: firstly, statically scanning a source code of target software to construct a software attribute method network; identifying the granularity of the software module according to actual needs, constructing a software complex network model, and dynamically simulating the influence propagation of the change after the software module is determined to obtain the influence degree quantized value and the change influence range of each node; and finally, summing the attenuation coefficients of the nodes in each change propagation generation to obtain a quantized value of the influenced degree of the nodes, and obtaining a visual result graph of the influence degree of the changes on the software network according to the quantized value. The invention comprehensively considers the change propagation characteristics and the node characteristics to carry out dynamic simulation, utilizes the attenuation process of the change influence, can realize the whole measurement analysis process in the background, is established on a fully automatic process, and ensures that the labor and time cost is reduced to the maximum extent.

title_en: Emergency logistics network risk propagation method and system based on material reliability
abstract_en: An emergency logistics network risk transmission method based on material reliability comprises the steps of firstly, introducing emergency material reliability factors, constructing an emergency logistics network by combining a complex network theory, and analyzing risk transmission by combining an improved infectious disease model; further analyzing an emergency logistics risk propagation mechanism and an evolution rule from the network structure and the evolution rule thereof; and finally, analyzing and discussing the utility and risk propagation influence factors of the model by a simulation technology, and providing an emergency logistics risk management and control strategy according to the result. The invention also comprises a system for implementing the emergency logistics network risk propagation method based on the material reliability. According to the method, the main factors influencing the risk propagation of the emergency logistics are analyzed in combination with the actual situation, and a strategy for controlling the risk propagation of the emergency logistics is given, so that the loss caused by the risk is reduced.

title_en: Risk target identification method, risk target identification device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data analysis, and provides a risk target identification method, a risk target identification device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The risk target identification method comprises the following steps: obtaining abnormal behavior data from preset behavior data, wherein each abnormal behavior data carries a data identifier, and part of the data identifiers carry risk labels; constructing a relationship graph by taking each data mark as a vertex based on the abnormal behavior data; screening relationship subgraphs with risk labels from the relationship graph, and carrying out label propagation on each relationship subgraph based on the risk label of each relationship subgraph; and calculating the risk value of each relation sub-graph after label propagation, and identifying the data identification of the relation sub-graph with the risk value higher than the threshold value as a risk target. According to the invention, the hidden risk relation network can be rapidly and effectively identified from massive preset behavior data through graph calculation and big data analysis, and the wind control interception capability is improved.

title_en: Disaster area communication network multilayer information propagation model
abstract_en: The invention provides a disaster area communication network multilayer information propagation model, which comprises the following steps of designing a disaster area communication network multilayer information propagation model to obtain an equilibrium state of information propagation in the model, and proving the influence of parameters such as node density, node communication range and the like on the equilibrium state of information propagation. The interference optimization problem based on the disaster area communication network multilayer information propagation model is solved, the network deployment cost is minimized by using a convex optimization technology, the optimal node density and node communication range are obtained, and network interference is effectively avoided. The effectiveness of the proposed model is verified through experiments under different environments, and simulation results show that the disaster area communication network multi-layer information propagation model provided by the invention can describe the information propagation process between disaster area communication network nodes, and meanwhile, parameter optimization is provided for the disaster area communication network by considering the interference of the environments to the network and the cost of deployment and communication of rescue nodes.

title_en: Three gorges reservoir dam front drift prediction method based on improved neural network model
abstract_en: The invention relates to a three gorges reservoir dam front float prediction method based on an improved neural network model, which comprises the steps of collecting three gorges reservoir inflow, outflow and dam front float data, dividing training and testing sets, setting a particle swarm algorithm and an improved neural network structure and parameters, training the improved neural network by using the training set, carrying out optimization solution on weights and thresholds of the improved neural network by using the improved particle swarm algorithm in training, calculating prediction errors and judging whether the prediction errors are qualified or not, and using the trained improved neural network for real-time prediction of the three gorges reservoir dam front float. According to the invention, after the training process of the error counter propagation neural network is optimized and improved by utilizing the particle swarm algorithm, the improved error counter propagation neural network is used as a front drift amount prediction model of the three gorges reservoir dam, so that the connection weight of the prediction model is more approximate to an optimal ideal value, and the prediction precision of the drift amount and the adaptability to the uncertainty of the data information of the reservoir dam are improved.

title_en: Mixed cascade multi-terminal direct current transient overvoltage risk suppression strategy determination method
abstract_en: The application discloses a method for determining a mixed cascade multi-terminal direct current transient overvoltage risk suppression strategy, which can determine a transient overvoltage target suppression strategy for reducing energy absorption of an energy dissipation device and improve the safe and stable operation level of a mixed cascade direct current and a transmitting and receiving end alternating current power grid. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring first operation information of an actual hybrid cascade multi-terminal direct current control system and second operation information of a transmitting-receiving-terminal alternating current power grid; constructing a first simulation model and a second simulation model according to the first operation information and the second operation information; carrying out electromechanical-electromagnetic hybrid simulation by adopting a first simulation model and a second simulation model, simulating line faults at different positions of the receiving end alternating current power grid, and screening out fault line sets with risks according to energy absorption values of energy dissipation devices under different fault lines; and carrying out inhibition operation on each fault line in the fault line set by adopting a preset transient overvoltage inhibition strategy, and determining a target inhibition strategy corresponding to each fault line.

title_en: AI-based intelligent regulating method and device for reducing loss of distribution network 10KV line technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses an AI-based intelligent regulating method and device for reducing loss of a distribution network 10KV line technology, comprising the following steps: acquiring real-time data of a 10KV line of the distribution network, and preprocessing; step 2: establishing a robust deep learning model; step 3: training the deep learning model through historical data to improve the accurate prediction capability of the deep learning model on line loss, optimizing model parameters by using a back propagation algorithm, and introducing a data enhancement technology of training data to improve the robustness of the model; step 4: monitoring the real-time data by using an anomaly detection algorithm; step 5: comparing the model prediction result with actual observation data, monitoring the state of the system in real time, and introducing a self-adaptive control strategy to adjust the system; step 6: setting performance indexes, and performing iterative optimization through continuous monitoring data and user feedback. Compared with the traditional method, the method has stronger adaptability and robustness, and can better cope with the complexity and uncertainty of the power system.

title_en: Active power distribution network two-stage planning method and device considering network attack
abstract_en: The invention provides a two-stage planning method and device for an active power distribution network considering network attacks, which comprise the steps of giving corresponding punishment cost coefficients according to node importance degrees, establishing an objective function, carrying out first-order planning on line reinforcement and remote control switch deployment on the objective function according to preset expense budgets, constructing first-order planning decision constraints, carrying out second-order planning on the objective function according to line faults and propagation of the line faults under attack scenes based on the first-order planning decision constraints, obtaining second-order planning decision constraints, solving the objective function according to the first-order planning decision constraints and the second-order planning decision constraints, and obtaining optimal defense strategy and optimal planning strategy vectors corresponding to worst attack scenes, so that the active power distribution network can be regulated and controlled according to the optimal defense strategy and the optimal planning strategy vectors.

title_en: Reservoir dispatching method considering power grid load change
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reservoir dispatching method considering power grid load change, which makes up the defect that a power station lacks consideration to the overall change trend of a power grid and lacks consideration to the benefits of the power station when carrying out peak regulation, provides a concept of the power grid load demand satisfaction rate for representing the consistency strong and weak relation between reservoir output and the power grid load change process, introduces the power grid demand satisfaction punishment factors into a traditional reservoir power generation dispatching model, designs ten groups of conversion functions, calculates the punishment factors in the power generation process of the power grid and the power grid load change process, and builds a cascade reservoir dispatching model considering the power grid load demand satisfaction rate.

title_en: Auto fire streamline, wireless prompt report system and prompt report method thereof
