title_ko: 자동화재 유, 무선 속보시스템 및 그에 따른 속보방법
abstract_en: An automatic fire alarm system and a fire alarm method are provided to enable a user to accurately locate a fire accident by displaying an output from a position sensor on an LED unit. A detector(100) includes plural sensors. An alarm unit(200) is connected to the detector, drives the sensors, and transmits signals using wireless and wireline communication schemes, such as CDMA, PSTN(Public Switched Telephone Network), and Ethernet. A controller(300) controls the alarm unit and includes a CTI(Congestion and Travel-time Information) unit(500), which generates a voice signal informing an abnormal state of the alarm unit. The alarm unit includes a power supply, a communication unit, an audio portion, a controlling unit, and an LED unit. The audio portion is connected to the communication unit and includes a speaker and a microphone. The controlling unit controls the audio portion and the communication unit. The LED unit is connected to the controlling unit and displays operation states of the detector.

title_en: Fire extinguishing construction of underground wiring for building
title_ko: 건축물용 지중배선의 소화구조물
abstract_en: A fire extinguishing structure of underground wiring for building is provided to intercept the contact with air by making a flame retardant material adhered to the outer surface of the underground wiring and using fire-extinguishing liquid. A fire extinguishing structure of underground wiring for building includes upper and lower side fixing tools(10,10a), upper and lower side fixing pipes(20,20a), a metal flame retardant foam, a spring, a wire(50) and left and right side fire-extinguishing liquid spray tools(60,60a). The metal flame retardant foam is adhered to the outer surface of underground wiring by the elasticity of the spring to extinguish fire. The wire recognizes the fire in front of the underground wiring and operates the spring. The left and right side fire-extinguishing liquid spray tools spray fire extinguishing liquid to the underground wiring.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 상하로 양분되는 반원형상의 링체로 내측에 일정두께의 열가소성 플라스틱인 밀착링을 개재시킨 상태에서 지중배선의 전방측 외주연에 볼트와 너트로 고정되는 상하측고정구와; 상기 상하측고정구의 후방측 지중배선에 위치되어 상하로 양분되는 반원형상으로 전후방에서 일정간격을 두고 기립된 전후방반원판이 형성되고, 전후방반원판을 동일직선상으로 관통하는 다수 개의 관통공이 각각 형성되며, 전후방반원판 양측단에는 양측단을 이으면서 외측으로 수평연장되는 좌우측반원관이 형성되어 좌우측반원관 양단에서 볼트와 너트에 의해서 지중배선 외주연에 고정되는 상하측고정관과; 상기 상하측고정관의 전후방반원판 사이에 삽입되어 상기 지중배선 외면과 밀착되어 충전되는 수세미와 같은 금속재난연폼과; 상기 상하측고정관의 전후방반원판 사이에서 상기 금속재난연폼 상측에 위치되어 금속재난연폼을 지중배선 외면으로 일정압력으로 밀착시키는 태엽스프링과; 일단은 상기 상하측고정구의 밀착링 내측에 삽입되어 고정되고, 타측은 상기 상하측고정관의 전방반원판의 관통공을 거쳐 후방반원판의 관통공 후방에 고정결합되는  다수 개의 와이어와; 상기 상하측고정관의 좌우측반원관에 볼트와 너트로 전방선단부가 체결고정되는 관체로 지중배선 방향의 중심부에는 전후방향으로 일정간격 다수 개의 노즐을 갖는 소화통이 형성되고, 소화통 양단에는 각각 피스톤이 소화통 중심부를 향하도록 스프링에 의한 탄성으로 피스톤이 중심부로 이동되게 설치되어 양단은 밀폐마개로 각각 밀폐고정되며, 소화통 중심부 상단에는 내측으로 소화액을 일정압력으로 투입하여 밀폐되는 소화액주입구가 형성되되 소화액을 투입시키기 전에 소화통의 노즐은 지중배선을 좌우측에서 반원형상으로 감싸는 열가소성 플라스틱인 반원형지지대 중심측에서 돌출된 지지바 선단의 고무볼에 의해 밀착되어 노즐이 폐쇄됨으로써 소화통 내부에 투입된 소화액은 일정압력으로 노즐을 통해 분사될 상태를 유지하는 좌우측 소화액분사구를 구비하는 건축물용 지중배선의 소화구조물에 관한 것이다. 
     이러한 본 발명은 누전이나 합선에 의해 건축물에 시설되어 있는 지중배선으로부터 화재가 발생하는 경우에 지중배선의 피복부를 통한 화재의 전파를 난연재에 의한 밀착으로 공기와의 접촉을 차단하는 1차적인 방법으로 소화가 이루어지다가 이에 소화가 완전히 이루어지지 않으면 2차로 지중배선의 좌우측에서 소화액을 자동분사시켜 지중배선의 화재를 확실하게 2단계에 걸쳐서 차단할 수 있어 소화기능이 크게 강화되어 지중배선의 화재 염려를 크게 덜게 되는 효과가 있다. 
       
     상하측고정구, 상하측고정관, 금속재난연폼, 태엽스프링, 와이어, 좌우측 소화액분사구

title_en: Method and device for predicting risk in corporte internal documents using artificial neural networks
title_ko: 인공 신경망을 이용하여 기업 내부 문서의 리스크를 예측하는 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method and a device for predicting a risk in a corporate internal document using an artificial neural network. The device includes: at least one processor; and a memory storing instructions for the at least one processor to execute at least one operation. The at least one operation includes the following steps of: receiving article information from an external server; generating keyword impact information with respect to a risk detection keyword based on the article information; receiving a corporate internal document and enterprise information from an enterprise terminal; inputting the corporate internal document, the enterprise information, and the keyword impact information to an artificial neural network supervised-learned in advance; and determining the risk score of the corporate internal document based on an output value of the artificial neural network. The risk score means a score quantifying a risk that is a negative effect on an enterprise in the case of leakage of the corporate internal document.
abstract_ko: 인공 신경망을 이용하여 기업 내부 문서의 리스크를 예측하는 방법 및 장치가 개시된다. 인공 신경망을 이용하여 기업 내부 문서의 리스크를 예측하는 장치는, 적어도 하나의 프로세서(processor); 및 상기 적어도 하나의 프로세서가 적어도 하나의 동작(operation)을 수행하도록 지시하는 명령어들(instructions)을 저장하는 메모리(memory)를 포함하고, 상기 적어도 하나의 동작은, 외부 서버로부터 기사 정보를 수신하는 단계; 상기 기사 정보에 기초하여 리스크 검출 키워드에 대한 키워드 파급력 정보를 생성하는 단계; 기업 단말로부터 기업 내부 문서 및 기업 정보를 수신하는 단계; 상기 기업 내부 문서와 상기 기업 정보, 및 상기 키워드 파급력 정보를 미리 지도학습(supervised learning)된 인공 신경망에 입력하는 단계; 및 상기 인공 신경망의 출력값에 기반하여 상기 기업 내부 문서의 리스크 점수를 결정하는 단계를 포함하고, 상기 리스크 점수는 상기 기업 내부 문서가 유출되었을 경우 기업에 끼치는 부정적인 영향력인 리스크(risk)를 정량화한 점수를 의미한다.

title_en: Method for identifying fragile lines in power grids based on electrical betweenness
abstract_en: Disclosed is a method for identifying fragile lines in power grid based on electrical betweenness, which comprises the following steps: constructing the power grid into a network diagram, sequentially removing lines in the network diagram, and sorting the electrical betweenness of each line from large to small; constructing a nonlinear model of complex network cascade failure considering overload and weighted edges, and respectively performing two ways of removing lines for sorted electrical betweenness, namely sequentially removing preset proportion lines and sequentially removing all lines until no new lines are removed in the network diagram; obtaining a change of generator-load power before and after each line removal, and evaluating a severity of power grid failure based on the change of generator-load power, thus completing an identification of power grid fragile lines.

title_en: The OSPF quick recovery method
abstract_en: The present invention proposes a kind of OSPF quick recovery method, may further comprise the steps: detection failure; Generate new LSA LSA reflection change in topology, propagate to each router by the mode of inundation; Each router recomputates route according to new topology.The present invention makes ospf protocol to be issued to quick convergence in the accidental situation about breaking down of network stabilization by adjusting the timer in the ospf protocol; Under the situation of unstable networks, can slow down response speed, not free from consuming redundant network resources to fault.

title_en: AdaGrad-based optimization neural network power transmission network project material demand prediction method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for predicting the demand of materials of a power transmission network project based on an AdaGrad (advanced-oriented-data-oriented) optimization neural network, wherein the BP neural network is divided into an input layer, a hidden layer and an output layer, when the error between an output result and an expected result does not meet the requirement, the back propagation is carried out, the network weight and a threshold value are modified layer by layer from the output layer through the error, the forward propagation is carried out by using the modified parameters, and the parameters are circulated to an optimal model parameter through the forward and the back directions, and the method is characterized in that: the method for predicting the demand of the basic building materials of the power transmission network comprises the steps of predicting the demand of the power transmission network power materials and predicting the investment amount of the project of the power transmission network. The invention improves the accuracy of the power grid material report demand plan, predicts the power grid basic building material demand by modeling by utilizing the historical data, reduces the power grid resource waste, reduces the situations of redundant backlog stock of materials caused by material multi-report, delay construction period caused by material less report and the like, and provides reference for the high-quality construction of the power grid.
assignees: JINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Method for reducing and predicting power supply quantity errors of power grid based on CNN-BILSTM algorithm
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for reducing the power supply quantity error of a predicted power grid based on a CNN-BILSTM algorithm, which comprises the following steps: acquiring data, cleaning the data, constructing characteristics, constructing an algorithm, improving a model (optimizing a data set), and verifying the model; according to the invention, based on a convolutional neural network-long and short term memory network (CNN-LSTM) algorithm, a two-way sequence propagation (BILSTM) is adopted for LSTM, so that the convolutional neural network-two-way long and short term memory network (CNN-BILSTM) is formed, the power supply quantity of a power grid is modeled and predicted through the algorithm, the model error is reduced by optimizing a data set under the condition of not damaging an original trained model, multiple training models are avoided, time and labor are saved, and the model error is effectively reduced.
assignees: HUBEI CENTRAL CHINA TECH DEVELOPMENT OF ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for evaluating high-frequency harmonic wave propagation characteristics based on cable modeling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for evaluating high-frequency harmonic propagation characteristics based on cable modeling, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining a PI model structure of the cable based on the structural parameters of the cable; calculating model parameters of the PI model structure; based on the calculated model parameters, the risk of resonance occurring in the propagation of the high frequency harmonics in the cable is evaluated. The cable modeling method suitable for high-frequency harmonic wave propagation characteristic analysis can simulate the response characteristic of the cable under high-frequency harmonic wave input, and is applied to the practical application scene of high-frequency harmonic wave propagation characteristic and resonance risk research of a large power grid.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID XINJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Energy storage system safety assessment method, device and equipment
abstract_en: An energy storage system safety assessment method, device and equipment relate to the technical field of energy storage systems. The method comprises the steps of obtaining first operation data of an energy storage system, wherein the first operation data comprise fault data describing at least one basic fault type, determining prior probability of the basic fault type represented by leaf nodes in a Bayesian failure propagation network according to the first operation data, enabling root nodes in the Bayesian failure propagation network to be used for representing failure modes of the energy storage system, enabling a directed path from the leaf nodes to the root nodes to represent propagation links of the failure modes caused by the basic fault type, reasoning posterior probability of the corresponding failure modes of the energy storage system according to the prior probability and the directed path from the leaf nodes to the root nodes, and obtaining an evaluation result of the energy storage system according to the posterior probability.
assignees: HUAWEI DIGITAL POWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power supply fault diagnosis method and system for low-voltage distribution network based on power outage and restoration logic
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power supply fault diagnosis method of a low-voltage distribution network based on power outage and restoration logic, which belongs to the technical field of power supply fault diagnosis and comprises the steps of converting unstructured power outage complaints of a user into standardized event labels by utilizing a natural language processing technology, synchronously aligning power outage pulses of an ammeter with action records of a branch switch to construct a multidimensional space-time event sequence, establishing a fault propagation logic network through topology division of power supply units, deducing a fault diffusion path according to power outage time sequence differences of adjacent units and failure states of a protection device, and reversely positioning initial fault points. And meanwhile, dynamically correcting the fault association probability among the units to generate a weighted candidate fault chain. The fault propagation tree is modified in reverse through a variety of validation mechanisms. And finally, screening out a fault chain with optimal space-time consistency by calculating the confidence coefficient. The method solves the problems of multi-source information fracturing, time-space association weakening and insufficient verification reliability in fault location of the low-voltage distribution network.

title_en: System reliability assessment method based on time sequence multi-layer complex network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a system reliability evaluation method based on a time sequence multi-layer complex network, which comprises the following steps: step one, space-time division of maintenance records; step two, constructing a single-layer network; step three, multi-layer network coupling; generating a super-adjacency matrix; step five, characteristic centrality solving; step six, extracting reliability indexes; step seven, evaluating the confidence coefficient; aiming at the problems of reliability prediction and warranty management of complex products, the invention creatively provides a time-aware multi-layer network framework, breaks through the limitations of system structure simplification and cascade fault neglect in the traditional reliability analysis, integrates the degradation short-term mutual dependence and cross-layer cascade failure mechanism of the product components by constructing a cross-layer time analysis network, and develops a super-centrality matrix and dynamic node centrality measurement, thereby systematically quantifying the influence of the product components on the system reliability and accurately identifying key nodes.

title_en: Urban crowd emergency evacuation optimization method and system based on multimode traffic network
abstract_en: The invention provides an urban crowd emergency evacuation optimization method and system based on a multi-mode traffic network, which belong to the technical field of emergency evacuation management, take the total evacuation time and evacuation risk minimization in the whole multi-mode network as optimization targets, consider the coupling characteristics of different traffic modes, establish a multi-mode traffic network dynamic collaborative evacuation model, and decide the dynamic requirements born by each traffic mode, and solve the established multi-mode traffic network dynamic collaborative evacuation model to obtain an optimal regulation strategy. According to the invention, three evacuation traffic modes of private cars, emergency buses and urban rail transit transfer emergency buses are considered, a dynamic multi-mode traffic evacuation model based on a system optimal criterion is established, the dynamic congestion propagation of people in large-scale evacuation is considered, and a decomposition algorithm based on Lagrange relaxation is provided for solving, so that an optimal multi-mode evacuation strategy is obtained, the collaborative optimization of multi-mode evacuation is realized, and the efficiency of urban large-scale crowd evacuation is improved.

title_en: Power distribution network risk assessment method containing distributed photovoltaic based on functional resonance analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network risk assessment method containing distributed photovoltaic based on functional resonance analysis, which comprises the following steps of identifying key functional modules of a power distribution network from four aspects of 'figure pipe ring', wherein each functional module is completely defined through a six-element model based on a functional resonance theory, driving typical fault backtracking analysis based on scene level, calculating comprehensive risk indexes of scenes, and constructing a 'node-link-loop-scene' system integrated risk assessment system. The method has the beneficial effects that the risk propagation mechanism of the power distribution network can be divided into a node level, a path level, a loop level and a scene level four-layer system based on the dynamic characteristics of the functional coupling relation, and the accurate analysis of the multi-dimensional risk propagation mechanism of the high-proportion photovoltaic power distribution network is realized by constructing a node-link-loop-scene four-level risk assessment system.

title_en: Optimal dispatching method, system, equipment and medium for cascading failures in extreme weather
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascading failure optimization scheduling method, system, equipment and medium under extreme weather, which belong to the technical field of disaster simulation and comprise the steps of calculating all line failure rates according to extreme weather data and power distribution network frame data, screening all lines to obtain a key line set, establishing an upper optimization model according to a first constraint condition, inputting the key line set into the upper optimization model to obtain an initial scheduling scheme, screening out a key line with the largest cut load in the initial scheduling scheme as a second constraint condition of the upper optimization model, inputting the second constraint condition into the upper optimization model to obtain a middle scheduling scheme, and adjusting the middle scheduling scheme to obtain a final scheduling scheme. The invention solves the problem that the prior art only aims at a single fault or static running state design strategy, realizes the design of a multi-angle and dynamic scheduling scheme, and meets the requirements of loss reduction and pre-prevention and control.

title_en: Intelligent factory equipment monitoring method and system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for monitoring the health state of equipment based on the Internet of things. The method comprises the steps of obtaining data in a multi-source sensor, preprocessing the data to obtain a real-time operation data set of the equipment, and determining a health quantification deviation value and a health state trend through the real-time operation data set. When the health state is abnormal, the starting point coordinates of the abnormal events are recorded, the triggering time stamp of the abnormal events is marked, and the dependency relationship among the devices is analyzed by utilizing graph network modeling. The method and the system further analyze the potential risk probability through the long-short-time memory network, realize real-time monitoring, fault propagation prediction and risk assessment of the health state of the equipment, and improve the operation reliability and maintenance efficiency of the industrial equipment.
assignees: NANTONG SHIDAO INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Supply chain demand prediction and risk early warning method and system based on multi-source data
abstract_en: The application relates to a supply chain demand prediction and risk early warning method and system based on multi-source data, comprising the steps of collecting multi-source heterogeneous data and constructing a feature vector set; the method comprises the steps of establishing a supply chain network topology structure, inputting a feature vector set and the supply chain network topology structure into a risk propagation model to obtain a risk space-time distribution map, inputting the feature vector set and the risk space-time distribution map into a demand prediction model to obtain collaborative prediction result information, generating a node criticality distribution map based on the supply chain network topology structure, comparing the node criticality distribution map, identifying high-risk nodes, obtaining risk level information and generating hierarchical risk early warning information.

title_en: Intelligent sensing, identifying and compiling system for power grid communication overhaul risk
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent sensing, identifying and compiling system for power grid communication overhaul risks, which belongs to the technical field of power grid overhaul analysis and is used for solving the technical problems of poor flexibility and reliability of active implementation of power grid communication overhaul risk identification and compiling in the existing scheme, capturing the associated risks of power grid communication network nodes, links and topology through a space-time convolution and attention mechanism, continuously learning in a digital twin environment by using reinforcement learning intelligent agents, realizing online evolution of overhaul strategies, flexibly selecting high-risk inhibition, high-resource investment or balance strategies according to power grid operation scenes through generated pareto optimal solutions, visualizing an output risk propagation path and a reinforcement learning decision process, automatically converting the pareto optimal solutions into execution strategies through intelligent contracts, effectively improving the resource utilization rate through a real-time feedback and deviation adjustment mechanism, and reducing the deviation of actual values and predicted values of the risk inhibition rates.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD YANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Alarm terminal for facility and alarm interface
title_ko: 건물용 경보단말 경보 인터페이스
abstract_en: Provided are a method using an alarm terminal and an alarm interface for a building and an apparatus thereof. According to one embodiment of the present invention, the method using the alarm terminal and the alarm interface for a building includes: a step in which an alarm terminal control system for a building issues an alarm; a step in which an alarm terminal for a building prepared in a specific multipurpose facility receives alarm data from the alarm terminal control system; and a step in which the alarm terminal for a building outputs the received alarm data through at least one information display system built in the multipurpose facility. Therefore, in case of a disaster, an alarm can be issued in various forms such as a text, a sound, an icon, a picture and the like through various alarm display devices in a multipurpose facility. Thus, unspecified individuals staying in the multipurpose facility can be urged to evacuate the place urgently. Moreover, since an alarm system based on a common alarm protocol which is a domestic and overseas standard is provided for alarm propagation in the multipurpose facility, the present invention can contribute to the establishment of a standard-based multipurpose facility alarm propagation system.
abstract_ko: 건물용 경보단말 및 경보 인터페이스를 이용한 방법 및 장치가 제공된다. 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른, 건물용 경보단말 및 경보 인터페이스 방법은 건물용 경보단말 통제시스템이, 경보를 발령하는 단계; 특정 다중이용시설에 마련된 건물용 경보단말이, 상기 건물용 경보단말 통제시스템으로부터 경보 데이터를 수신하는 단계; 및 상기 건물용 경보단말이, 상기 수신된 경보 데이터가 상기 다중이용시설 내에 구축된 하나 이상의 정보 표출 시스템을 통해 출력되도록 하는 단계;를 포함한다. 이에 의해, 재난 발생 시, 다중이용시설 내의 다양한 경보 표출장치를 이용하여 텍스트, 소리, 아이콘, 그림 등 다양한 형태로 경보를 알릴 수 있어, 다중이용시설 내에 재실 중인 불특정 다수의 사람들의 긴급 대피를 도모할 수 있으며, 다중이용시설 내의 경보 전파를 위해 국내외 표준인 공통경보프로토콜 기반의 경보 시스템을 제공함으로써, 표준기반의 다중이용시설 경보 전파 체계 수립에 기여할 수 있다.
assignees: THE REPUBLIC OF KOREA MINI INTERIOR

title_en: Building Entry and Exit Electric Vehicle Fire Hazard Detection System
title_ko: 건물 진출입 전기차 화재 위험 감지 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 다양한 건물 및 주차시설의 진출입시설에서 활용 가능한 건물 진출입 전기차 화재 위험 감지 시스템에 관한 것이다. 전기차의 화재 위험이 충전시에만 한정된 것이 아니라 충전 및 주행을 반복하는 전주기에 발생하므로 건물 진출입시 화재 위험 여부를 판단하여 화재 발생 초기에 신속하게 대상 차량을 침수, 열차단포등의 조치로 인명과 재산을 대량 참사로부터 건물내 주차전에 보호해야 할 필요가 있다. 본 발명은 기존의 진출입로에 설치된 주차 차단기와 연동 또는 독립적으로 동작하며 다음과 같이 구성된다.건물 진출입 전기차 화재위험 감지 시스템은 진입한 차량을 일반차(내연기관)과 전기차(전기차, 하이브리드 자동차, 수소전기차)로 구분 위한 각종 센서와 카메라 기반의 차량 정보 획득 장치(11a), 열화상 카메라(11b)의 열화상 이미지에서 획득한 열화상 이미지에서 발화를 확인하는 화재 판단 모듈(12b)과 일반차와 전기차를 구분하는 차량 인식 모듈(12a) 및 출입 차단 모듈(13a)과 경광등-사이렌(13b), 위험정보를 생성 및 전파하는 긴급 통신 모듈(14a)을 포함한다.

title_en: Methods and systems for streaming buffer numerical propagation
abstract_en: Systems, methods, and instructions of computer-readable media may include obtaining, at a client machine, a user-selected configuration parameter for an orbit simulation; sending, from the client machine to a remote system, via a network connection, a first set of configuration parameters for the orbit simulation, wherein the first set of configuration parameters comprise the user-selected configuration parameter; receiving, at the client device from the remove device, via the network connection, a stream of orbital data comprising points along an orbit, wherein the points along the orbit are determined by the remote system based on the first set of configuration parameters; and presenting, at a display, a dynamic rendering of the orbit simulation, wherein the orbit simulation is based on the stream of orbital data.
assignees: SLINGSHOT AEROSPACE INC;MARCHAND BELINDA GRACE;LEDERMAN JOSHUA;KOENIG DANIEL;JONDROW MATTHEW

title_en: Key line identification method and device for cascading failure of power system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for identifying a key line of cascading failures of a power system, belonging to the field of cascading failure risk analysis and stability research of the power system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: performing cascading failure direct current power flow simulation on the power system to acquire failure chain data required by identification; decomposing the fault chain data into states at different moments to form a state network; based on a state network, solving a line risk value of a line fault in the state of the cascading faults at different moments by using an SARSA algorithm; and determining the line corresponding to the line risk value exceeding the given threshold value as the critical line of the cascading failure. The method can realize high-risk fault line identification based on cascading fault data, and carry out risk mitigation, prevention and control on cascading faults at different moments so as to guarantee safe and stable operation of the power system.

title_en: Routing method applied to indoor fire-fighting communication
abstract_en: The invention discloses a routing method applied to indoor fire-fighting communication, which comprises the following steps of modeling a wireless signal propagation model under a scene to obtain relevant parameters, 2 realizing information interaction of the scene through a neighbor discovery algorithm, estimating and obtaining a link duration LET, 3 improving the routing algorithm in an area and constructing a routing table in the area based on the LET, and 4 improving a routing discovery process and updating routes among areas based on the LET. The invention estimates the link duration by combining the indoor propagation model and the node motion state on the basis of the original ZRP, so that the node can predict the link state, thereby maximizing the route survival time. Through simulation verification, the method can reduce the end-to-end time delay, reduce the packet loss rate and improve the network throughput.

title_en: Intelligent factory equipment monitoring method and system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for monitoring the health state of equipment based on the Internet of things. The method comprises the steps of obtaining data in a multi-source sensor, preprocessing the data to obtain a real-time operation data set of the equipment, and determining a health quantification deviation value and a health state trend through the real-time operation data set. When the health state is abnormal, the starting point coordinates of the abnormal events are recorded, the triggering time stamp of the abnormal events is marked, and the dependency relationship among the devices is analyzed by utilizing graph network modeling. The method and the system further analyze the potential risk probability through the long-short-time memory network, realize real-time monitoring, fault propagation prediction and risk assessment of the health state of the equipment, and improve the operation reliability and maintenance efficiency of the industrial equipment.

title_en: An Emergency Situation Perception and Notifying Apparatus for Underwater Worker
title_ko: 수중작업자의 위급상황 감지 및 알림장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an emergency situation detecting and notifying apparatus of an underwater worker which can transfer information on an accident position or the like through a wireless communications network by using a GPS as well as an agreed rescue request signal by floating a floating material having a wireless communications apparatus (RF transceiver) on the water when a rescue does not execute within several minutes (four minutes, a most desirable time) after accident occurring.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은, 수중작업자 스스가 위험에 노출된 것으로 판단되거나 감지하면 구조버튼을눌러 구조신호를 보내거나, 수중작업자(해녀 또는 잠수작업자)의 작업 패턴을 분석하여 발생이 의심될 때에 요구조자에게 경고 신호를 출력하여 사고유무를 파악하고 맥파등의 신체 정보를 활용하여 사고발생 후 최단 시간내에 사고 발생을 감지하여 사고로 파악되면 즉시 음향신호, 형광물질 표식 및 경광등, 초음파 통신등으로 사고 발생 사실을 전파하여, 주변 작업자들이 신속히 구조할 수 있도록 하고, 사고 발생 후 수분(가장 바람직하게는 4분)이내 구조가 실시되지 않으면 무선통신장치(RF송수신기)가 내장된 부유물을 수면에 띄워 약정된 구조요청신호와 더불어 GPS를 이용한 사고위치 등의 정보를 무선통신망을 통해 전달할 수 있도록 된 수중작업자의 위급상황 감지 및 알림장치이다. 
본 발명은, 수중 작업 중에 사고를 감지하거나 발생할 경우 인명의 손실을 줄이기 위해사고 발생(시작)부터 구조에 소요되는 시간이 매우 짧다는 것을 충분히 감안하여 사고 발생 인근에서 공동 작업 중인 동료들에게 사고 사실을 신속히 알려(전파)주고 발생지점을 표시하여 요구조자(구조요청자)를 신속히 구조할 수 있도록 하고,  또한 사고초기에 요구조자를 구조하지 못하더라도 사고자의 몸과 연결된 부유물을 수면에 표시하여 실종자를 신속히 발견 및 인양하게 하며, 실종자의 수색 및 그에 따른 시간과 사회적 비용을 줄이고 행정적 손실을 최소화할 수 있다. 
또 발명은, 수중작업자의 특성을 고려하여 구조를 간단히 하여 저가의 비용으로 용이하게 제조 및 보급할 수 있고, 장기간 사용하더라도 고장이 발생하지 않도록 할 수 있는 것이다.

title_en: Public emergency rescue device with video communication
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a public of utensil video communication propagation is with urgent rescue apparatus, it includes a containing box that can supply to accomodate first aid equipment, after the containing box is opened and takes out first aid equipment, can start triggering module, photographic module passes through this user's of photographic analysis characteristic, transmit the message through network module and carry out the analysis to remote server in, this remote server passes through the audio-visual module of internet control, and through audio-visual module to this user broadcast first aid equipment's correct operation demonstration and relevant medical information, furthermore, be equipped with the module of charging on the containing box, can supply the usefulness that the mobile device charges, especially people are when viewing and admiring the display screen broadcast program, usable time charges.

title_en: One kind is based on BP neural network roll alloy contact prediction of fatigue behaviour method
abstract_en: The invention discloses one kind to be based on BP neural network roll alloy contact prediction of fatigue behaviour method, belongs to alloy cast steel roll technical field.The training sample data required for artificial nerve network model are gathered first, and these sample datas mostly come from contact fatigue property result of the test of the alloy cast steel roll under different-alloy composition, Technology for Heating Processing and load；Input and the output parameter of neutral net are determined, builds neural network structure；Neutral net is learnt and trained using improved back-propagation；Choose the sample data beyond training sample to test the neutral net trained, then the contact fatigue property of alloy cast steel roll is predicted.The BP neural network model that the present invention establishes has higher predictive ability, provides new approach to research and develop the alloy cast steel roll material of high contact fatigue property, and have obvious practical value.

title_en: A kind of power grid fragility node automatic identifying method based on neighbour's propagation clustering algorithm
abstract_en: Present invention relates particularly to a kind of power grid fragility node automatic identifying method based on neighbour's propagation clustering algorithm, the present invention combines Power Grid Vulnerability Assessment with AP clustering algorithm, according to node structure vulnerability inder calculation method, assessment result is constantly updated into its Attraction Degree matrix of iteration and degree of membership matrix by AP clustering algorithm, the architectural vulnerability assessment result of nodes all in power grid is automatically separated into the multiclass from " very fragile " to " not fragile ", effectively recognizes the weak link in power grid.The present invention can meet the needs of bulk power grid fragility link or region automatic identification and be not required to manual intervention.

title_en: Comprehensive energy system dispatching management platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive energy system dispatching management platform. The disclosed platform includes: the system comprises a demand configuration module, a data acquisition module, an operation calculation module and a scheduling management module, wherein the demand configuration module is used for a user to select an energy supply side system configuration mode, energy equipment and an optimization target according to demands; the data acquisition module is used for acquiring system operation data time by time within a certain total time length; the scheduling management module is used for receiving the operation data acquired by the data acquisition module and sending the operation data to the model calculation module; meanwhile, the system is used for receiving result data of the operation calculation module and outputting the result data to the corresponding upper-layer energy network and energy equipment to adjust the operation condition; and the operation calculation module is used for calculating the result of the optimization target selected by the demand configuration module on the premise of constraint conditions. The invention can realize the cascade utilization of energy in the comprehensive energy system, improve the energy utilization rate and is suitable for supplying energy to areas such as commercial areas, residential areas, industrial parks, villages and the like.

title_en: Power grid GIS-based electric power emergency disposal safety pre-control intelligent identification method
abstract_en: The invention provides a power grid GIS-based electric power emergency disposal safety pre-control intelligent identification method, and relates to the field of electric power emergency disposal. The invention positions the accident scene and the position of emergency disposal personnel on the power grid GIS. Positioning on a power grid GIS according to longitude and latitude coordinates of an accident scene; according to the method, real-time positions are displayed on a power grid GIS by wearing a follow-up terminal high-precision multi-relocation module by emergency disposal personnel, an early warning identification area is divided and constructed through monitoring and early warning of the emergency disposal site environment, after a site operation electronic fence is automatically generated based on the early warning identification area, a small-scale mountain fire and hazardous chemical substance diffusion and propagation model is established according to meteorological data, topographic data, geomorphic data and the like, the development trend is dynamically predicted, calculation results of dynamic and quantitative diffusion and propagation directions, ranges, speeds and the like are formed, the influence condition of the analysis and judgment on power grid facilities is analyzed, and a basis is provided for scientific and rapid emergency disposal of accident sites. The invention reduces the working pressure of the central platform, improves the disaster and area division accuracy, and can store the data acquired when the disaster occurs.
assignees: EMERGENCY MAN CENTER OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Transmission and distribution network distributed coordination recovery method, system, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed coordination recovery method, a distributed coordination recovery system, distributed coordination recovery equipment and a distributed coordination recovery storage medium for a transmission and distribution network, which relate to the technical field of power systems, and the distributed coordination recovery method comprises the steps of decomposing a global transmission and distribution network recovery model into two types of transmission and distribution network recovery sub-models based on a target cascade analysis method; relaxation treatment is carried out on the consistency constraint of the coupling variable in the form of an augmentation Lagrangian penalty function, and the relaxation treatment is added into a transmission network recovery and distribution network recovery sub-model objective function respectively; describing the ambiguity of renewable energy source predicted power as the ambiguity of constraint conditions, and converting the uncertain constraint conditions containing fuzzy variables in the transmission network recovery and distribution network recovery sub-model objective function into clear equivalent class forms of fuzzy opportunity constraint; and (3) introducing a diagonal quadratic approximation method to approximate the extended Lagrange penalty function, and solving the objective function of the transmission network recovery and distribution network recovery sub-model in full parallel to complete distributed coordination recovery of the transmission network and the distribution network. The invention can improve the solving efficiency.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Complex network-based industrial chain risk propagation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an industrial chain risk propagation method based on a complex network, which comprises the following steps: step one: the system determines the region and industry to be evaluated, and collects regional enterprise basic information data; step two: mounting an enterprise on a corresponding industry chain node, and constructing an industry chain complex network comprising the relationship between the enterprise and the enterprise, the relationship between the enterprise and the industry and the relationship between the industry and the industry; step three: acquiring an original risk value of an enterprise node while determining the original risk value of an industrial chain link point; step four: carrying out association strength calculation of risks among enterprises, enterprises and industries and industry; step five: performing risk propagation analysis; step six: according to the total calculated risk transfer value of each industrial chain, the result of the industrial risk value is evaluated, analyzed and predicted.
assignees: JIANGSU FENGYUN TECH SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Target detection method based on fusion of two modal images
abstract_en: The invention discloses a target detection method based on fusion of two modal images, which comprises the following steps: constructing a related scene based on an AirSim platform to perform analog simulation, and collecting image data sets of different modes; constructing a bimodal image fusion network, and training the fusion network according to a counter-propagation principle; simultaneously extracting features of images of two modes by using a Siamese neural network, and reconstructing the features into a fusion image through deconvolution operation; the quality of the reconstructed fusion image is checked and evaluated through the quantized evaluation index, and the fusion network is modified according to the evaluation result; and directly inputting the fusion characteristics output by the trained fusion network into a single-stage YOLOv7 target detection network, freezing the trained network parameters of the fusion network, and training the target detection network to obtain an optimized fusion and detection network. The method is convenient to realize efficient and accurate bimodal image fusion and detection, and is beneficial to improving the target detection capability of the unmanned aerial vehicle in scenes such as emergency search and rescue.

title_en: Hydraulic engineering risk intelligent regulation and control system based on knowledge graph embedment
abstract_en: The application discloses an intelligent hydraulic engineering risk regulation and control system based on knowledge graph embedment, and belongs to the technical field of hydraulic engineering. The system comprises a multi-level knowledge graph construction module, a graph embedding representation module, a risk identification and evaluation module, a reinforcement learning regulation and control decision module, a dynamic feedback optimization module and a visual interaction module, wherein the multi-level knowledge graph construction module is used for constructing a multi-level knowledge graph to form a dynamically updated knowledge network, the graph embedding representation module is used for encoding entity attributes, relationship features and time sequence evolution characteristics of the entity attributes, the risk identification and evaluation module is used for integrating graph embedding features and expert knowledge rules and analyzing risk features of hydraulic engineering and space propagation modes of the entity features so as to realize accurate identification and quantitative evaluation of risks, the reinforcement learning regulation and control decision module is used for encoding risk states and regulation and control targets into state-action space based on a deep reinforcement learning frame, the dynamic feedback optimization module is used for automatically updating entity states and relationship strength so as to form a closed loop for continuous optimization and knowledge accumulation, and the visual interaction module is used for visually displaying risk situations, regulation and control effects and propagation paths of the hydraulic engineering.
assignees: LUANNAN WATER CONSERVANCY MAT SUPPLY AND MARKETING CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent monitoring method and system for water conservancy facilities based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent monitoring method and system for water conservancy facilities based on the Internet of things, which belong to the technical field of water conservancy projects, and comprise the steps of collecting data through a sensor, generating a physical dependency graph, fusing the physical dependency graph and a short-time dependency graph into a space perception graph, and establishing a space perception model, obtaining an abnormal propagation link and an abnormal score set, extracting high-confidence abnormal links, aggregating the high-confidence abnormal links in the space perception model to obtain a global model, and generating a scheduling decision through the global model. According to the intelligent monitoring method and system for the water conservancy facilities based on the Internet of things, under a multi-facility distributed monitoring scene, the space-structure dependency relationship between multi-dimensional monitoring data in the water conservancy facilities can be fully modeled, the space accurate positioning and propagation path tracing of abnormal events are realized, and the abnormal detection capability in single facilities is remarkably improved.
assignees: GUANGZHOU CHUANGKE ENG QUALITY INSPECTION CO LTD

title_en: Cascading failure early warning method of power transmission system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascading failure early warning method of a power transmission system, which belongs to the technical field of early warning of power systems and comprises the steps of S1, early warning data preparation, S2, early warning failure screening, S3, early warning grade judgment, S4, early warning execution, S, early warning information output and real-time dynamic update, wherein the early warning data preparation comprises multi-source data acquisition and analysis and quantitative characterization of power grid heterogeneous characteristics, the S2, early warning failure screening comprises simulation model construction and failure searching based on an accident chain, the S3, early warning grade judgment comprises risk value quantitative calculation and risk grade division. According to the cascading failure early warning method of the power transmission system, during operation, the heterogeneous phenomenon of a complex power grid with new energy grid connection in the aspects of operation conditions and grid structures is researched, characterization indexes reflecting the operation conditions of the power grid and the heterogeneous degree of the grid structures are constructed, meanwhile, a cascading failure process analysis model which comprehensively considers new energy and load fluctuation and is suitable for the working condition of a given power grid is built, the influence mechanism of the power grid heterogeneity on the cascading failure is researched, and the problem caused by new energy grid connection is well solved.
assignees: KAIFENG POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Robustness assessment method, device and equipment of power grid information physical system
abstract_en: The invention provides a robustness assessment method, a device and equipment of a power grid information physical system, and relates to the technical field of power information, comprising the steps of removing a fault power node and a fault information node from a first topological structure of the power grid information physical system to obtain a plurality of second topological structures; the method comprises the steps of determining fault probability of each power node and/or power line based on data transmission information of each information node in each second topological structure and a power flow calculation result of a power network corresponding to each second topological structure, removing at least one potential fault power network element and potential fault information node based on the fault probability of each power node and/or power line in each second topological structure for each second topological structure to obtain a third topological structure, and carrying out robustness assessment on a power grid information physical system. The invention can take into account the fault propagation process between the power network and the information network and quantify the influence of the information network fault on the power network.
assignees: STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ECONOMIC AND TECHNICAL RESEARCH INST;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;HEBEI HUIZHI POWER ENG DESIGN CO LTD

title_en: A kind of meteorological transmission line forest fire sprawling method for early warning of combination public network
abstract_en: A kind of meteorological transmission line forest fire sprawling method for early warning of combination public network, comprises the following steps：Obtain fiery point coordinates；Based on the fiery point coordinates, the rate of propagation that the fire point spreads direction is calculated；According to the rate of propagation, linear position of the fire point after spreading the time on sprawling direction is calculated, obtains spreading coordinate；According to the sprawling coordinate, the sprawling area that the fire is put is calculated；According to the sprawling time, warning grade definition is carried out to the transmission line of electricity in the sprawling area, and issue early warning.The present invention judges that power network mountain fire the condition of a disaster provides effective information support for power department；The present invention can calculate fire point and arrive transmission line forest fire rate of propagation, and according to mountain fire rate of propagation, passage time judges the warning grade of transmission line of electricity, has higher accuracy and practicality, is played an important role to safeguarding the safety and stability of power network and mitigating casualty loss.

title_en: Electromechanical-electromagnetic hybrid simulation method and system
abstract_en: The application provides an electromechanical-electromagnetic hybrid simulation method and system, comprising the following steps: determining that a bus connected with a power transmission line meeting preset conditions at an electromagnetic transient network side is a hybrid simulation interface position; the electromagnetic wave propagation delay tau on the power transmission line is larger than the electromagnetic transient simulation step delta t; the k side of the power transmission line is connected with an electromechanical transient network, and the j side of the power transmission line is connected with the rest of the electromagnetic transient network; the other networks of the electromagnetic transient network, the power transmission line and the electromechanical transient network are equivalent to the following three parts: the power transmission line j side and the rest of the network part of the electromagnetic transient network, the equivalent circuit part of the power transmission line k side and the electromechanical transient network, and the equivalent circuit of the electromagnetic transient network and the electromechanical transient network part; and respectively solving the three parts to obtain the power grid state of the electromagnetic transient network and the electromechanical transient network. The technical scheme provided by the application can greatly reduce the interface calculation amount and improve the calculation efficiency.

title_en: Intelligent park digital twin system and method based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent park digital twin system and method based on artificial intelligence, which particularly relate to the technical field of digital twin simulation optimization and are used for solving the problems of low simulation distortion and emergency preview reliability caused by insufficient dynamic relevance modeling of entity behaviors in the prior art, constructing a propagation path hierarchical analysis network by collecting entity attribute data and dynamic interaction behavior data in real time, identifying key disturbance nodes based on path length and behavior type division groups and individual behavior data and quantifying propagation path relevance strength of the key disturbance nodes, generating a simulation model adjustment strategy by dynamic change difference and relevance strength, correcting propagation direction and density weight parameters of the key nodes to generate a high-precision simulation result, and forming a virtual-real linkage closed-loop optimization system by reversely updating the behavior weight based on the relevance strength based on a feedback mechanism of non-key node behavior deviation so as to improve the reliability of digital twin simulation in a complex scene.

title_en: A kind of wisdom prison generalized information management system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of wisdom prison generalized information management system, including front end hardware equipment and back-end processing system.Front end hardware equipment includes mainly graphic images acquisition module, it is seen that light image acquisition module, infrared emission detecting module, front end recognition module, handheld terminal, comprehensive management module, A/D conversion modules.Back end processing module includes rear end recognition detection module, multiple cascading networks module, emergency command module, central processing regulation and control module, GIS positioning display modules, voice monitoring and broadcast module, information inquiry module, personal management module.The visible images acquisition module is all connected with the input terminal of front end recognition module with graphic images acquisition module output end；The front end recognition module and infrared emission detecting module are connected with comprehensive management module；Handheld terminal is connected with A/D conversion modules.A/D conversion module back-end processings are connected.This practical advantage is personnel positioning, high-definition video monitoring, recognition of face and image trace.The safety management of the Code in Hazardous Special Locations such as detention house, prison is met, while being also beneficial to resource-sharing and the personnel placement scheduling on the ground such as each detention house, prison.
assignees: XIAN HUADING COMPUTER INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Load prediction method based on improved cuckoo-neural network algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a load prediction method based on an improved cuckoo-neural network algorithm, which comprises the following steps: calculating the maximum influence factor: collecting local meteorological data and historical load power data recorded by a system by using a monitoring system arranged on a load side, and finding out the type of influence factor with the maximum load influence degree by using an average influence value algorithm (MIV); selecting similar days: selecting a similar day according to the maximum influence factor calculated in the step one; the invention has the beneficial effects that: finding the first n environmental factors with the largest influence on the load by adopting an average influence value algorithm (MIV), selecting a similar day by combining the optimal similarity, finally improving the traditional cuckoo algorithm, applying the improved algorithm to a BP (back propagation) neural network, and predicting the load; the improved cuckoo algorithm can avoid the algorithm from falling into a local optimal solution and has stronger global search capability.

title_en: Physical simulation test method and device for mine water inrush and propagation process
abstract_en: A physical simulation test method and device for the mine water inrush and spreading process are disclosed, which are based on the similarity theory to determine the scale relationship between the test model and the prototype; according to the evolution characteristic of the burst water permeability, the position and the flow curve of the burst water are used as inflow conditions of the test to form a preset test working condition; planning test steps under preset test working conditions by combining test purposes; acquiring test water level and flow under a preset test working condition, and acquiring flow state data through video monitoring; constructing a water level curve according to the water level data, constructing a flow curve according to the flow data, and performing flow state indication according to the flow state data; and evaluating the rationality of numerical simulation of the mine water inrush and spreading process by using the obtained test monitoring result. The method overcomes the difficulties in field sudden water penetration and spreading process measurement and in-situ test implementation, and reveals the flow rule of water flow in a complex roadway network; and a scientific theoretical basis is provided for the reliability evaluation of numerical simulation results and the formulation of emergency rescue schemes.

title_en: Peak regulation energy optimization scheduling method for cascade hydropower station group
abstract_en: The invention relates to a peak regulation energy optimization scheduling method for a cascade hydropower station group, which is used for carrying out optimization management on the peak regulation capability of the cascade hydropower station group according to three time scales and making a final scheduling plan on the basis of long-term, short-term and real-time prediction. During long-term prediction, aiming at different time characteristics of a basin where the cascade hydropower stations are located, a long-term scheduling plan is formulated in three periods of a flood season, a dry season and a flat season, and then the scheduling plan of each hydropower station is reasonably distributed according to different installed capacities of hydropower station groups. The invention can make the cascade hydropower station meet the energy dispatching requirement of the large power grid, and fully exert the peak regulation capability; the hydropower stations with different output powers in the hydropower station group can be comprehensively considered for unified energy scheduling, peak regulation of a large power grid is met, and meanwhile, power generation benefits can be guaranteed.
assignees: FUJIAN SHUIKOU POWER GENERATION GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Automatic blending combustion method and system for coal yard, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to an automatic blending combustion method, an automatic blending combustion system, electronic equipment and a storage medium for a coal yard, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing a constraint condition and an objective function for acquiring the optimal mixed burning scheme; solving the objective function by adopting a Lagrange's method, and determining an optimal mixed combustion scheme meeting the constraint condition; in the solving process, the physical property parameters of the mixed coal of the blending combustion scheme are calculated by adopting a trained error inverse propagation neural network model; and controlling a bucket wheel machine of the coal yard to automatically take materials based on the optimal blending combustion scheme. The method realizes the calculation of the physical property parameters based on the trained error inverse propagation neural network model, improves the accuracy of the physical property parameter calculation, and avoids the occurrence of unfavorable combustion conditions caused by the inaccuracy of the physical property parameter calculation.

title_en: Weak measurement scene-oriented large-scale distributed photovoltaic simplified clustering method and device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of distributed photovoltaics, and discloses a scale distributed photovoltaic simplified clustering method and device for weak measurement scenes, wherein the method comprises the following steps: under the condition that large-scale distributed photovoltaic measurement information is incomplete, key points with the closest output characteristics at distributed photovoltaic grid-connected points are extracted based on the Morse theory, a reliable simplified topology containing the large-scale distributed photovoltaic power distribution network is established, effective information of multi-source measurement data of the key points is fully mined on the basis, and the rationality of distributed photovoltaic cluster division is enhanced by adopting affine propagation clustering. The method provided by the invention can effectively remove the redundant topological structure while avoiding excessive extraction of the historical data characteristics, effectively improve the accuracy of the Morse-Smale complex on the description of the output characteristics of each grid-connected point, realize the rapid clustering of high-dimension and multi-type measurement information, and synchronously improve the clustering effect and the calculation performance.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Unknown scene remote sensing image subtitle generation method based on attribute learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote sensing image subtitle generating method of an unknown scene based on attribute learning, which mainly solves the problem that the existing method can only generate words and sentences which appear in the training process and cannot accurately describe the unknown scene. The implementation scheme is as follows: building an attribute extractor, setting a learnable attribute identification vector A, and pre-training on a multi-label classification data set; constructing a decoder based on attribute learning, which is composed of an attribute reasoning module and a subject word generation module; cascading a theme encoder, an attribute extractor and an attribute learning-based decoder to form an unknown scene remote sensing image subtitle generating network based on attribute learning, and performing iterative training on the unknown scene remote sensing image subtitle generating network; and inputting the remote sensing images of the test set into a trained subtitle generating network to generate subtitle descriptions. The invention improves the description accuracy of the remote sensing image under the unknown scene, can adapt to various scenes of the remote sensing image, and can be used for ground object image retrieval, disaster prediction and image understanding.

title_en: BP network-based electric energy meter metering self-adaptive compensation method and equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to an electric energy meter metering self-adaptive compensation method and equipment based on a BP neural network, comprising the following steps: step 1: initializing an adaptive compensation model, and step 2: initializing a BP neural network compensation model, and step 3: optimizing an initial weight threshold of the BP neural network compensation model by adopting an improved artificial fish swarm algorithm; step 4: training the BP neural network compensation model; step 5: updating the weight threshold of the neural network in the error back propagation stage, calculating the number of times of training, judging that all samples are trained when the number of times of training or the error precision is higher than a set value, otherwise, training the next group of samples, and returning to the step 3; step 6: and inputting the output of the ammeter model, the temperature parameter, the moderate parameter, the altitude parameter and the environmental quality parameter into a trained BP neural network compensation model, and outputting an energy value h. The invention has the advantages that: and the influence of multidimensional environmental factors is considered, so that the metering precision of the gateway electric energy meter of the ultra-high voltage transformer substation is further improved.
assignees: GREAT POWER SCIENCE AND TECH STOCK CO LTD STATE GRID INFORMATION & TELECOMMUNICATION CORPORATION;STATE GRID INFORMATION & TELECOMMUNICATION CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for intelligent early identification of large-area potential landslide
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a device for early intelligent identification of a large-area potential landslide, which belong to the technical field of image target identification and geological disaster monitoring, and the method comprises the steps of collecting historical data of a landslide area, obtaining earth surface deformation rate and gradient data, and forming a sample data set; the method comprises the steps of constructing a potential landslide identification model composed of a data input layer, a feature coding network and an identification result output layer, wherein the feature coding network is composed of 9 cascaded feature learning modules, each feature learning module is composed of a network hiding layer and a data normalization layer, training and verifying the potential landslide identification model to obtain a final potential landslide identification model, obtaining actual measurement data of a monitoring area, inputting the actual measurement data into the final potential landslide identification model, and outputting a potential landslide identification result of the monitoring area. The invention realizes the distinction between potential landslide candidate points and non-hidden danger points in a large area range, and provides reliable technical support for landslide disaster prevention and control.

title_en: Multi-source energy linkage heat storage method and system based on gradient heating of large-temperature-difference unit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-source energy linkage heat storage method and a system based on cascade heating of a large-temperature-difference unit, which belong to the technical field of central heating and comprehensive energy utilization, and comprise the steps of obtaining a water inlet temperature parameter and an external environment prediction parameter of a heating pipe network to generate load demand characteristics; the method comprises the steps of establishing a dynamic optimization model according to load demand characteristics and acquired energy price time sequence parameters, calculating operation parameters of a multi-stage heating unit group and scheduling parameters of a double-medium heat storage tank through the dynamic optimization model to generate a multi-source scheduling instruction, executing the multi-source scheduling instruction, controlling a self-adaptive valve group to switch heat source paths and linking the double-medium heat storage tank to charge and discharge heat. The invention adopts the operation mode of establishing a dynamic optimization model to cooperatively control the multi-stage heating unit group and the double-medium heat storage tank, can realize the cascade high-efficiency utilization and intelligent economic dispatch of multi-source energy sources, and remarkably improves the economy and the operation stability of the heating system.
assignees: ZHONGKE HUIRONG HEBEI ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Hydropower station equipment operation and maintenance risk assessment method and system based on big data analysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of hydroelectric power generation equipment state monitoring, in particular to a hydropower station equipment operation and maintenance risk assessment method and system based on big data analysis, comprising the following steps of 1, hydropower station specific data fusion acquisition; the method comprises the steps of step 2 of extracting hydraulic-mechanical coupling characteristics, step 3 of dynamically constructing a fault propagation network, step 4 of generating a dynamic risk field and outputting a decision, wherein the step 4 is to inject coupling factors and wet pollution indexes into network nodes of equipment, generate risk density distribution through three-dimensional spatial interpolation, dynamically adjust risk threshold values in combination with real-time working conditions, and output a priority maintenance node and a maximum maintenance time window under constraint conditions. The hydraulic-mechanical coupling failure mechanism is deeply analyzed, the risk conduction path of the equipment cluster is quantized, and dynamic risk assessment is realized by combining a big data analysis technology, so that the accuracy, the instantaneity and the efficiency of the operation and maintenance of the hydropower station equipment are remarkably improved.
assignees: SICHUAN HUANENG DONGXIGUAN HYDROPOWER CO LTD

title_en: Natural resource asset checking method and system for abnormal event influence analysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, and discloses a natural resource asset checking method and system for abnormal event influence analysis. Firstly, constructing a basic database integrating natural resource background and dynamic monitoring data, sensing abnormal events and extracting structural features through a multi-channel monitoring network, then constructing a disaster stress wave propagation model to generate a value loss field intensity distribution map, dividing a check area according to the map, acquiring data by intelligent scheduling investigation equipment, and finally comparing data to optimize model parameters and generate an investigation report; the system comprises a multi-source data fusion module, an event intelligent perception module, a stress wave deduction analysis module, an intelligent scheduling module, an intelligent checking module, a model optimization module and a report generation module, and the system solves the problems of low and inaccurate traditional evaluation efficiency and realizes efficient and accurate checking of natural resource assets.

title_en: Financial wind control and anomaly detection method and system based on graph neural network
abstract_en: The invention provides a financial wind control and anomaly detection method and system based on a graph neural network, which relate to the field of financial risk control and comprise the following steps: constructing a financial transaction graph network, constructing a feature graph by combining transaction time sequence information, extracting time sequence feature vectors, calculating risk propagation feature vectors, determining node embedding vectors and fusion node vectors, constructing a transaction flow graph, performing community division, and finally determining abnormal transaction communities and early warning through fuzzy clustering.
assignees: STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Multi-cascade model-based complex-working-condition offshore floating type photovoltaic array fault diagnosis method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of photovoltaic power generation systems, in particular to a multi-cascade model-based complex-working-condition offshore floating photovoltaic array fault diagnosis method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a photovoltaic array power generation model considering the influence of offshore waves; the method comprises the steps of carrying out fault analysis and feature quantity extraction on an offshore floating photovoltaic array according to a photovoltaic array power generation model, respectively constructing a primary fault diagnosis model based on a GA-LSTM neural network and a secondary fault diagnosis model based on a 1D-CNN-GRU, constructing a collaborative decision mechanism of the primary fault diagnosis model and the secondary fault diagnosis model, determining a fault diagnosis result based on the primary fault diagnosis model, the secondary fault diagnosis model and the collaborative decision mechanism, and effectively improving the diagnosis robustness and accuracy of the system in an offshore complex environment through task decomposition and collaborative processing, and overcoming the limitation of single model adaptability.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO RES INST

title_en: Building waterproof supervision acceptance system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building waterproof supervision acceptance system and a method, and relates to the technical field of buildings, wherein the method comprises the steps of scanning a waterproof material sample through a micro-channel impedance tomography strategy, extracting pore communication paths and defect distribution characteristics, and constructing a three-dimensional infiltration network model comprising pore sizes, communication paths and defect distribution; based on a material family knowledge graph, mapping the water pressure and crack propagation law of a concrete structure in a historical engineering to a penetration network characteristic space of a current material to generate a composite test parameter set comprising a heavy rain impact waveform, a temperature circulation gradient and a structural deformation rate, synchronously applying dynamic load in a climate simulation test cabin according to the composite test parameter set, positioning a leakage high risk area according to a test result through a space-time correlation algorithm, and generating a decision scheme comprising maintenance priority, carbon footprint evaluation and disaster resistance prediction by combining a material durability database and area extreme climate data.
assignees: GUANGDONG CAIMAO CONSTRUCTION ENG CONSULTANTS CO LTD

title_en: Photovoltaic safety early warning method based on Bayesian dynamic belief propagation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photovoltaic safety early warning method based on Bayesian dynamic belief propagation, and relates to the field of photovoltaic safety early warning. According to the method, a dynamic Bayesian network model of risk evolution along with time is constructed, the BD-BP algorithm is utilized to perform belief propagation reasoning on multi-source heterogeneous data, and the risk weighting convergence is performed by combining with the network topology centrality. Therefore, false alarm caused by environmental noise is effectively restrained, dynamic tracking and accurate positioning of gradual change type risks of the photovoltaic equipment are realized, early warning has the characteristics of high anti-interference capability and accurate key node identification, and crossing from single-point passive alarm to system-level active situation sensing is realized.
assignees: CHINA THREE GORGES CORPORATION SICHUAN ENERGY INVEST CO LTD;CHINA THREE GORGES CORP

title_en: Urban water consumption prediction system and method based on multi-source heterogeneous data coupling modeling
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of smart cities, in particular to a city water consumption prediction system and method based on multi-source heterogeneous data coupling modeling, comprising the following steps that a multi-source data acquisition module acquires multi-dimensional influence factor data from heterogeneous data sources; the data preprocessing and coupling module cleans and normalizes data and generates a structured training data set through space-time alignment and fusion operation, the prediction model building module builds a three-layer BP neural network prediction model based on the data set, the model training and optimizing module divides the data set into a training set and a testing set and carries out iterative training and parameter optimization on the model by utilizing the training set and a back propagation algorithm, the model precision verification module evaluates the prediction performance of the trained model by utilizing the testing set and calculates a plurality of precision evaluation indexes, and the prediction service deployment module packages and deploys the model which is qualified in verification into a callable prediction service so as to realize quick and accurate prediction on new input data.
assignees: LUOYANG URBAN PLANNING & ARCHITECTURE DESIGN RESEARCH INST CO LTD

title_en: System and method for optimizing supply chain of hydrogen distribution network
abstract_en: The present disclosure generally relates to producing, transporting, distributing, and storing hydrogen fuel, more particularly to system and method for optimizing supply chain of hydrogen distribution network. A centralized server triggers production facility to produce gas/liquid Hydrogen. Centralized server stores at storage facility in hydrogen cylinders, produced gas/liquid Hydrogen, in Liquid Organic Hydrogen Carrier (LOHC) molecule, based on hydrogenation of chemicals. Centralized server transmits instructions for transporting hydrogenated LOHC molecule in tanker trucks, from production facility to depots, and dehydrogenates at depots, hydrogenated LOHC molecule to release hydrogen at low pressure. Centralized server compresses, at depots, released hydrogen, and fill compressed hydrogen in high-pressure tube trailers/flat-bed cylinder cascades. Centralized server determines optimal routes for transportation vehicles from depots to retailers/consumption sites, and stores, at retailers/consumption sites, compressed hydrogen in low-pressure tanks/high-pressure buffer cylinders. Centralized server outputs information corresponding to inventory of low-pressure tanks/high-pressure buffer cylinders at retailers/consumption sites.

title_en: Method for short-term generation scheduling of cascade hydropower plants coupling cluster analysis and decision tree
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of hydropower scheduling, and relates to a method for short-term generation scheduling of cascade hydropower plants coupling cluster analysis and decision tree. Linear regression technique is adopted to determine a matching relationship of energy production between upstream and downstream hydropower plants. With the relationship, typical generation curves of each hydropower plant can be clustered from lots of historical data. These typical generation curves and impact factors of generation scheduling such as planned daily electricity, reservoir level, and power grid characteristics, are together trained to obtain decision-making library for generation scheduling of cascaded hydropower plants. Thus, the decision tree method can be used to rapidly determine an operational scheme for generation scheduling of cascaded hydropower plants. Finally, a correction strategy for operation constraints is introduced to ensure feasibility of the operation scheme. The invention can quickly obtain generation schedules of cascade hydropower plants.

title_en: Earthquake damage prediction and prevention system and method thereof
abstract_en: Proposed is an earthquake damage prediction and prevention system (1) for determining an impact or damage caused by an earthquake to objects associated with different geographical locations (A,B,C,D). A central unit with a filter module selects and collects earthquake related data of a plurality of network units. At least one impact ratio table (151) is stored with a first data structure for storing geographical and/or topographical data coordinates of the different geographical locations (A,B,C,D). The geometric distances of the geographical locations (A,B,C,D) from a hypocenter/epicenter (2) are generated by an intensity calculation module (104) with a coordinates processor.
