Local intensity values based upon the generated geometric distances and a given earthquake magnitude by means of a stored parameterization comprising variable weight parameters are generated by means of a propagation calculation unit of the intensity calculation module (104), whereas the generated geometric distances are stored assigned to the corresponding geographical locations (A,B,C,D) by means of a second data structure of the impact ratio table (151). At least one of the variable weight parameters and/or at least one impact ratio for different earthquake intensity levels indicative of the impact or damage caused by an earthquake to the object and/or at least one object parameter defining earthquake exposed structures of the object are received from a plurality of users. By means of an index calculation module (105) the impact index for the geographical locations (A, B, C, D) generated by determining in each case from the impact ratio table (151) the impact ratio for the local intensity at the respective geographical location (A, B, C, D), and adding up the impact ratios weighted in each case by the weighting factor assigned to the respective geographical location (A, B, C, D).

title_en: A kind of Study of Risk Evaluation Analysis for Power System method based on deterministic parsing
abstract_en: A kind of Study of Risk Evaluation Analysis for Power System method based on deterministic parsing, has considered the change of the power flow transfer after system is disturbed and node voltage, proposes more perfect power network fragility comprehensive analysis index.The present invention is comprised the following steps：1) the trend distribution after analysis system topological structure, computing system steady-state operation and disturbance, including the effective power flow and reactive power flow of each branch road, each node voltage and its phase angle difference.2) each evaluation index in the evaluation system, including the pre- risk assessment factor and the network synthesis risk assessment factor are calculated.3) the index grade according to setting carries out risk assessment to power system.Study of Risk Evaluation Analysis for Power System method of the invention, more comprehensively reflect the risk information of system,, Voltage Instability out-of-limit to system trend that may be present and cascading failure make unified metric decision in the face of risk, be conducive to operations staff to make quickly and accurately to judge, take measures guarantee system safe and stable operation in time.

title_en: Urban road network electric vehicle charging station deployment method based on structural hole theory
abstract_en: The urban road network electric vehicle charging station optimized deployment method based on the structural hole theory converts the extracted road map into a road network; selecting candidate station site nodes of the charging stations from the converted road network by adopting a constraint propagation algorithm based on a structural hole theory; establishing a dual-target planning model and converting the dual-target planning model into a single-target planning model; solving the single-target planning model to obtain a final station building node: the station building node is a road in the actual road graph, so that the intersection of the road with the maximum road constraint is solved as a station building site of the charging station by using a structural hole theory, and the specific position of the charging station is determined. The invention considers the influence of the actual road on the station building position, carries out mathematical modeling on the deployment problem of the charging station from the aspects of investment and users, optimizes the deployment problem of the charging station by combining the actual road and other influencing factors, and solves the specific position of the deployment of the charging station.

title_en: Method for simulating continuous burst flood of cascade reservoir group
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for simulating continuous burst flood of a cascade reservoir group, which comprises the steps of extracting river network information, carrying out evolution calculation on flood in a river channel by adopting a holy-Venn equation and a Massa-Kyoto equation, carrying out flood detention and flood traveling outside the river channel along the topographic direction, carrying out flood regulation calculation on a reservoir, taking the whole process of dam break outflow as inflow flood of a downstream river section of a dam, and returning to the step S2. According to the method, the dam break process, the flood routing and the reservoir regulation and storage are comprehensively considered, the Saint-Venn equation and the Mas Kyoto equation are adopted to carry out the routing calculation on the flood in the river channel, and a generalized dam break process line method is adopted, so that the simulation calculation aiming at the continuous dam break of the step reservoir group is realized, the measurement cost is reduced, and the calculation efficiency is improved.

title_en: Modeling, calibrating and simulating method and system for photoresist multistage serial characterization network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a modeling, calibrating and simulating method and system for a photoresist multistage serial characterization network, and belongs to the field of semiconductor lithography. The invention firstly divides the photoresist reaction process into a plurality of key stages, adopts a new modeling thought of a multistage serial system network, builds a multistage serial wiener-Pade form sub-cascade module according to the characteristics of each photoetching process, provides a simulation means based on library matching and model parameter low-order multivariable polynomial equivalent by utilizing a combined calibration strategy based on a constraint type quadratic convex optimization algorithm, emphasizes and utilizes the universality advantage of the wiener-Pade system theory in nonlinear system response characteristic characterization, and realizes accurate and efficient modeling and calibration of the nonlinear response characteristics of the photoresist under different process flows while avoiding overfitting and reducing the complexity and redundancy of the model.

title_en: Public space dynamic risk network assessment method integrating space-time characteristics
abstract_en: The invention provides a public space dynamic risk network assessment method integrating space-time characteristics, which relates to the technical field of network assessment and comprises the steps of obtaining basic data, adopting an octree algorithm to adaptively divide grid units, establishing a connection relation diagram, calculating risk propagation probability by using a graph neural network, calculating a risk propagation path by applying an improved A algorithm, and finally outputting risk level distribution, propagation path risk change and prevention and control deployment suggestions. The method and the system realize the fine quantitative assessment of the public space risk and improve the risk early warning accuracy and the pertinence of prevention and control measures.

title_en: Method and system for identifying generation and influence of sudden natural disaster fault scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for identifying generation and influence of sudden natural disaster fault scenes, belonging to the technical field of disaster risk assessment and toughness modeling of an electric power system; the method comprises the steps of calculating damage probability of each node by combining with the geographical coordinates of the nodes, generating an initial fault set by using a Monte Carlo sampling method, defining a node state vector, performing fault cascade propagation simulation until the node state vector reaches a stable state, respectively identifying an electric power failure area, a communication uncontrolled area and a traffic blocking area, and outputting the initial fault set, the stable state and the three areas together as simulated disaster scene samples to finish identification. The invention solves the problems of difficult multi-network cascade fault propagation and system interruption identification under the influence of complex disasters, supports the automatic generation of samples and the accurate identification of disaster influence areas, provides data support for the follow-up, and can be used for the evaluation of multi-network fusion and resource scheduling.

title_en: Method and system for leak localization in complex pipeline networks using a digital twin
title_ko: 디지털 트윈을 이용한 복합 배관망의 누설 위치 탐지 방법 및 시스템
abstract_ko: 디지털 트윈을 이용한 복합 배관망의 누설 위치 탐지 방법 및 시스템이 개시된다. 디지털 트윈을 이용한 복합 배관망의 누설 위치 탐지 방법은 (a) 유체 이송을 위한 복합 배관망의 복수 지점에 설치된 센서로부터 누설에 의한 압력 및 유량 변동을 실시간 측정한 계측 데이터를 수집하는 단계-상기 계측 데이터는 측정된 계측 정보 및 측정된 시점에 대한 타임스탬프를 포함함; (b) 상기 각 센서의 계측 데이터에 포함된 타임스탬프를 이용하여 기준 센서에 대한 상대 도달 시간으로 정규화하는 단계; (c) 상기 복합 배관망의 기하 정보를 기초로 디지털 트윈 기반 가상 배관망을 시뮬레이션하고, 환경 변수 및 실측 도달 시간을 반영하여 상기 가상 배관망에 대한 전파속도 보정값을 산출하는 단계; (d) 상기 디지털 트윈에서 상기 가상 배관망을 복수의 로컬 구역으로 분할하고, 각 로컬 구역에 대해 서로 다른 로컬 연산 모델을 적용하여 상기 전파 속도 보정값을 이용해 센서별 예측 도달 시간을 산출하는 단계; 및 (e) 상기 센서별 예측 도달 시간과 센서별 상대 도달 시간의 오차를 최소화하는 로컬 누설 후보 위치를 추정하고, 상기 추정된 로컬 누설 후보 위치들 중 오차가 최소인 위치를 최종 누설 위치로 결정하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: System for propagating messages for purposes of demand response
abstract_en: A system having a utility, a communications intermediary and demand response resources. The utility may be connected to the communications intermediary via a network. The demand response resources may be connected to the communications intermediary via another network. A single dispatch destined for the demand response resources may be sent to the communications intermediary. The dispatch may be disaggregated at the communications intermediary into a multitude of dispatches which may be dispersed to their respective destined demand response resources. The demand response resources may send telemetries to the communications intermediary that aggregates the telemetries into a single telemetry. The single telemetry may be sent to the utility.

title_en: Detection method for key propagation path and central node on microblog platform
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the research category of information propagation influence on a social network in a complex network research system, relates to a detection method for a key propagation path and a central node on a microblog platform and solves the detection problem of the central node on microblog advertising communication flow on the microblog platform. According to the detection method, the abstract problem of detection of the central node is tightly combined with the problem of the shortest propagation path in a complex network, and a detection model of the shortest propagation path of the advertising communication flow on the Sina microblog is established, so that the problem of detection of the central node on a microblog advertising propagation path, namely the detection problem of an advertising typhoon eye, is solved.

title_en: Emergency information transmits covering method and device
abstract_en: This application provides emergency information transmission covering method and device, it is related to broadcasting communication technology field, wherein, emergency information transmission covering method includes：First, responding agencies judge whether current network is unimpeded, if the judgment is Yes, emergency information is sent to multistage linking link and is responded by responding agencies, if the judgment is No, emergency information is sent to device link and is responded by responding agencies, multistage linking link and device link are caused by this kind of method while being present in a system, so, responding agencies can be according to environmental condition, suitable link is selected to be transmitted emergency information, it is achieved thereby that the extensive covering of emergency information and fast propagation.

title_en: Aviation network risk assessment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an aviation network risk assessment method. According to the method, on the basis of the risk of a single airport, more serious airspace risk caused by risk cascade is researched, and airspace-oriented risk assessment is carried out, so that the control of the overall operation situation of the airspace is facilitated. On the other hand, potential safety risks such as airport saturation and flight delay are selected as evaluation factors, from the factors causing aviation network risks in the pre-tactic stage, time points of risk evaluation and adjustment measures are advanced, major flight accidents such as collision are prevented from developing, and high-risk operation of tactical levels is reduced. Meanwhile, flight delay and airport saturation are dynamic, so that the safety risk assessment of the aviation network based on delay and congestion is dynamic, and the risk level assessment of each airspace of the whole aviation network is more reliable.
assignees: CIVIL AVIATION MAN INSTITUTE OF CHINA;ZHEJIANG JIANDE GENERAL AVIATION ACAD

title_en: Power distribution network line loss calculation method for optimizing BP neural network by improving sparrow search
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network line loss calculation method for improving sparrow search and optimizing a BP (back propagation) neural network, which comprises the steps of continuously collecting data of a plurality of required historical moments through a power grid advanced measurement system, and preprocessing the data; secondly, inputting the preprocessed data of each historical moment into a BP (back propagation) neural network for prediction to obtain the predicted line loss rate of each historical moment, constructing a BP neural network loss function model by combining the predicted line loss rate with the data, and further performing optimization solution by a sparrow search algorithm which is improved by chaotic initialization and t-distribution variation fusion to obtain an optimized BP neural network; finally, the data collected in real time are input into the optimized BP neural network for prediction to obtain the real-time predicted line loss rate.

title_en: Cement raw meal grinding system power consumption prediction method based on circulating high-speed neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for predicting power consumption of a cement raw material grinding system based on a circulating high-speed neural network, which belongs to the technical field of industrial big data analysis and comprises the following steps: step 1: selecting variable data with the highest correlation with power consumption from an energy management database of a cement enterprise, cleaning abnormal values, then carrying out normalization and standardization processing, and arranging to obtain a complete time sequence; step 2: establishing a power consumption prediction model based on a circulating high-speed neural network, and predicting the power consumption value at the next moment by using variable data and a historical value of the power consumption value; and step 3: performing model training by adopting a supervised learning method, and adjusting and optimizing parameters of a coder decoder in a model by utilizing an error inverse propagation algorithm; and 4, step 4: and (4) realizing the real-time prediction of the power consumption of the cement raw material grinding system by utilizing the model completed in the steps. The prediction method reasonably schedules resources, and further provides possibility for reducing energy consumption and improving cement production efficiency.

title_en: Flood prevention forecasting method and system for power grid facilities
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a system for forecasting flood control of power grid facilities, which relate to the technical field of flood control forecasting of the power grid facilities, and avoid artificial subjective consciousness by carrying out K-means cluster analysis processing, thereby avoiding the problem that the conversion of original data possibly affects the flood control forecasting result of the power grid facilities; the problem of index weighting in the traditional method is avoided, so that the influence of irrational property of the index weighting method on the final evaluation result is avoided; and secondly, a deep learning model is established by using a back propagation algorithm, data are input into the deep learning model for training, parameters of the classifier are automatically learned through the performance of the classifier on a classification task, the reliability is high, the problem of model overfitting is effectively relieved, the continuous learning capacity of the current deep learning model is effectively improved, the flood prevention forecast of power grid facilities is more accurate, and the risk of damage to the power grid facilities caused by disasters is reduced.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INST OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Circumferential weld performance prediction method
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a circumferential weld performance prediction method which can solve the technical problem of insufficient circumferential weld management of a natural gas long-distance pipeline. The circumferential weld performance prediction method comprises the following steps: normalizing the girth weld original data set to obtain an initial data set; obtaining an initial training set according to the initial data set; training the weld joint value transmission model according to the initial training set to obtain a weld joint fusion ratio to be tested; establishing a weld cooling speed model according to the initial data set and the weld cooling speed; obtaining the initial cooling speed of the weld joint to be measured according to the weld joint cooling speed model; and training to obtain a first weld toughness prediction model to be tested based on the counter propagation artificial neural network model according to the fusion ratio of the weld to be tested and the initial cooling speed of the weld to be tested. Through the girth weld performance prediction technology, a basis is provided for newly-built pipeline girth weld performance optimization, the girth weld failure probability is reduced, and a technical support is provided for in-service pipeline girth weld integrity management.
assignees: NAT PETROLEUM PIPELINE NETWORK GROUP CO LTD;WEST EAST TRANSP BRANCH OF NATIONAL PETROLEUM AND NATURAL GAS PIPELINE GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Power grid dynamic modeling method and system for fusion of power grid equipment and service resources
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid dynamic modeling method and a system for fusion of power grid equipment and service resources, belongs to the technical field of power, and solves the problem that the existing method cannot predict and evaluate the running state of a monitoring node, so that effective identification cannot be performed when the monitoring node has potential risks, and the method comprises the following steps: obtaining modeling parameters associated with a target power grid, and carrying out normalization pretreatment on the modeling parameters to obtain standard modeling parameters and obtain a visual three-dimensional model containing dynamic nodes; the risk identification model performs evolution propagation based on a fault evolution rule, identifies potential fault dynamic nodes in the visual three-dimensional model, and in the invention, the risk identification model can perform evolution propagation based on the fault evolution rule, therefore, dynamic nodes with potential faults in the visual three-dimensional model are identified, the efficiency of data processing and analysis is improved, and the power grid equipment and service resources can be fused in practical application, so that more accurate prediction and early warning are provided.
assignees: MARKETING SERVICE CENTER OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Conduction logic and cascading model analysis method in energy and power field
abstract_en: The invention discloses a conduction logic and cascading model analysis method in the field of energy and power, which comprises the following steps of data collection and pretreatment: global energy trade data including energy importation and importation, prices, etc. are collected and preprocessed to construct global energy cascade conductive networks. And (3) establishing an underload cascade fault model considering overload limitation based on the collected data, wherein the model can simulate a cascade fault process in the energy trade network. Setting different scenes, simulating the fluctuation of the upper limit and the lower limit of the node load, and performing simulation analysis by using a model. And analyzing and reporting the results, namely analyzing the influence of the international energy power pattern on the energy safety of China according to the simulation results, generating an analysis report and providing reference for policy makers. The invention can find the influence of the international energy power pattern on the energy power development of China through simulation under different situations.
assignees: UNIV TSINGHUA;STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID ENERGY RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Order information pushing method, equipment and medium based on big data analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses an order information pushing method, equipment and medium based on big data analysis, which relate to the technical field of big data analysis and intelligent decision intersection, and comprise the steps of collecting an order bright data stream and a dark data source for preprocessing, extracting global features and generating a federal feature vector matrix; the method comprises the steps of calculating an order comprehensive risk according to a dynamic side weight matrix, generating an order risk knowledge graph, executing a mixed decision engine on the order risk knowledge graph, generating a decision instruction set, performing hierarchical response on an order based on the decision instruction set, outputting a pushing execution log, collecting a performance monitoring ternary data set in real time according to the pushing execution log, calculating order comprehensive benefit according to the performance monitoring ternary data set, and generating an order information pushing report. According to the method, dynamic decision reasoning based on map topology is realized, the risk propagation path is analyzed by combining the map neural network and the rule engine, the response strategy generation is optimized, and the decision self-adaptability and the real-time response efficiency are enhanced.
assignees: CHENGCHENG ZHISHU TECH SHENZHEN CO LTD

title_en: Fire-fighting electric fire early warning method and system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire early warning, and particularly discloses a fire-fighting electric fire early warning method and a fire-fighting electric fire early warning system based on the Internet of things, wherein the method comprises the steps of configuring an edge computing gateway, and acquiring a current waveform signal and a high-frequency electromagnetic radiation signal of an electric loop based on the edge computing gateway; the method comprises the steps of acquiring a power grid topological structure, constructing a risk value prediction and propagation model based on a graph neural network model, generating a data packet when the coupling relation between the harmonic feature and the electromagnetic radiation feature meets a joint triggering condition, inputting the data packet into the risk value prediction and propagation model, outputting a dynamic risk value and a fault source position based on the risk value prediction and propagation model, and carrying out bimodal acquisition to early find out potential electrical fire hazards, carrying out real-time feature extraction by utilizing an edge computing gateway, reducing data transmission quantity, modeling the power grid topology by using the graph neural network model, accurately predicting a fault propagation path and improving early warning precision.

title_en: Power grid vulnerability assessment method, system, equipment and medium for meteorological disaster data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, equipment and a medium for evaluating grid vulnerability of meteorological disaster data fusion, and relates to the technical field of meteorological disaster defense of power systems. By constructing a dynamic coupling field model of disaster physical mechanism and power grid equipment tolerance characteristics, deep space-time fusion of multi-source heterogeneous data is realized, and the defect that disaster data and power grid vulnerability are disjointed in the traditional technology is solved. Complex physical processes such as mountain fire heat radiation conduction, icing stress propagation, lightning stroke ground potential lifting and the like are quantized into equipment-level risk functions, and risk penetration dynamic deduction is performed by combining real-time power flow distribution and load importance grading of a power grid, so that disaster early warning accuracy is improved.

title_en: Method for determining influence maximization seed set size based on seepage model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for determining the size of an influence maximization seed set based on a seepage model, which comprises the steps of firstly carrying out seepage simulation on a target network to obtain the maximum connected subgraph size after seepage of the target network corresponding to different propagation probabilities; fitting the different propagation probabilities and the maximum connected subgraph size values after the target network seepage simulation corresponding to the different propagation probabilities to obtain a fitting function of the propagation probabilities and the maximum connected subgraph size after the target network seepage simulation corresponding to the propagation probabilities; obtaining a seepage value of the target network through a fitting function; and finally, solving the size of the target network influence maximization seed set through the seepage value. The method can quickly obtain the size of the seed set with the maximized influence of the target network, and has good robustness.

title_en: Comprehensive emergency command and dispatch system based on multifunctional three-proofing mask
abstract_en: A comprehensive emergency command and dispatch system based on a multifunctional three-proofing mask comprises the multifunctional three-proofing mask, a command and dispatch center, a comprehensive emergency command and dispatch platform, a storage system, an interface gateway and a third party emergency platform; the command dispatching center adopts a cascade management architecture of a multi-level center according to the mechanism setting of the user, namely an overall command center and a sub command center; the comprehensive emergency command scheduling platform is deployed in the general command center, one end receives a dangerous signal sent by the multifunctional three-proofing mask through the interface gateway, and the other end performs data butt joint with the third-party emergency platform through the SDK development kit to feed back an emergency plan; the storage system is a storage platform supporting multiple services such as voice, video, short messages, messages and the like based on an IP network; the interface gateway adopts an IP technology and is in butt joint with a main control box in the multifunctional three-proofing mask; the third party emergency platform comprises medical emergency centers, traffic management centers and fire rescue centers which are distributed at all places.

title_en: Same-city distribution intelligent order and path planning method and system based on real-time road condition
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for intelligent distribution and path planning in the same city based on real-time road conditions, which relate to the technical field of path planning and comprise the steps of collecting real-time road condition information to construct time-space road network characteristics, calculating transit time cost, constructing order time-space correlation characteristics based on historical tracks, calculating order time-space overlapping degree, dynamically adjusting a clustering algorithm by using association strength, calculating an initial distribution path for clustered order clusters, and carrying out risk assessment and path optimization by a road congestion propagation model. The invention can improve the distribution efficiency, reduce the delay risk and adapt to complex and changeable urban traffic environments.

title_en: Risk knowledge graph construction and intelligent early warning method based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses an artificial intelligence-based risk knowledge graph construction and intelligent early warning method which comprises the following steps of collecting multisource risk related data and preprocessing the multisource risk related data to generate a composite input data set, constructing an enhanced TabPFN structure and introducing a risk logic rule constraint matrix to generate a risk prediction result set, mapping the risk prediction result set to a knowledge graph entity node and a relationship set to generate a risk knowledge graph structure, introducing Sheaf Neural Networks into the risk knowledge graph structure to generate a consistency parameter set, updating the knowledge graph structure to generate a risk knowledge graph enhanced representation, and executing reasoning by combining the risk prediction result set and the consistency parameter set to output an intelligent early warning result set. According to the invention, the form data modeling and graph consistency propagation are fused, so that the risk prediction accuracy and the early warning reliability are improved.

title_en: Monitoring and management method for detecting dangerous substances
title_ko: 위험물 유출 중앙 관리방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for central management of the leakage of dangerous substances, that can centrally and comprehensively control the detection and countermeasures for the leakage of dangerous substances for a number of scattered dangerous facilities. The present invention comprises: a warning means (10) installed in a hazardous facility to detect whether dangerous substances are leaked and to transmit the detection result to a terminal means (20) and a central control center (30); the terminal means (20) carried by a user working in the hazardous facility, detecting whether dangerous substances are leaked, and automatically transmitting the detection result to other terminal means (20) and the central control center (30); and the central control center (30) for receiving whether dangerous substances are leaked from any one or more of the warning means (10) and the terminal means (20) and issuing countermeasures thereof. In case of leakage of dangerous substances, even after the initial situation propagation and the issuance of countermeasures, it is possible to minimize the damage caused by the leakage of dangerous substances by continuously monitoring the situation and instructing the user to actively respond to changes in the situation.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 산재해 있는 다수의 위험시설물에 대한 위험물 유출감지 및 대응조치를 중앙에서 종합적으로 통제할 수 있는 위험물 유출 중앙 관리방법에 관한 것으로서, 위험시설물에 설치되어 위험물의 유출 여부를 감지하고, 상기 감지결과를 단말수단(20) 및 중앙관제센터(30)에 송신하는 경보수단(10), 상기 위험시설물에 근무하는 사용자가 휴대하며, 위험물의 유출 여부를 감지하고, 그 감지결과를 타 단말수단(20) 및 중앙관제센터(30)에 자동으로 송신하는 단말수단(20) 및 상기 경보수단(10) 및 단말수단(20)의 어느 하나 이상으로부터 위험물 유출 여부를 수신하고 그 대응조치를 발령하는 중앙관제센터(30)를 포함하여 구성되고, 위험물 유출 시 최초의 상황전파 및 대응조치 발령 이후에도 상황추이를 지속적으로 파악하고, 상황변화에 적극 대응토록 지시함으로써 위험물 유출에 따른 피해를 최소화할 수 있는 효과가 기대된다.

title_en: Method and device for repairing missing power load data based on cascade convolution self-encoder
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for repairing missing power load data based on a cascade convolution self-encoder. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring original power load data without loss, establishing a loss mask generation model, simulating and generating a grading sub-mask, and generating simulated incomplete data by combining the original power load data; preprocessing the original power load data, the simulated incomplete data and the graded sub-masks to serve as a training set, establishing a cascade convolution self-encoder network, and training the cascade convolution self-encoder network; and after the incomplete power load data to be repaired and the corresponding grading sub-masks are preprocessed, inputting the data into the trained cascade convolution self-encoder network to obtain the repaired power load data. The method disclosed by the invention can be used for repairing the incomplete power load data, and higher repairing precision is realized.

title_en: Water, fire and wind combined dispatching model building method containing river basin step hydropower
abstract_en: The application discloses a method for establishing a water-fire-wind joint scheduling model of river basin cascade hydropower, which comprises the steps of generating a wind power generation scene frame of a countermeasure network (WGAN) based on an improved condition Wasserstein, establishing an objective function of water-fire-wind joint low-carbon power scheduling, a pre-scheduling stage constraint condition and a rescheduling stage constraint condition, and establishing the water-fire-wind joint scheduling model of the river basin cascade hydropower through the objective function, the pre-scheduling stage constraint condition and the rescheduling stage constraint condition. The river basin cascade hydropower station group coupling scheduling model comprehensively considers various complex operation constraints such as water system coupling, water flow time lag, flow and reservoir capacity limitation of the cascade hydropower station. The effectiveness of the model is verified through simulation of an improved IEEE-24 node system example, and a certain guiding significance is provided for water, fire and wind joint optimization scheduling containing large-scale wind power and step hydropower.
assignees: FUJIAN HUADIAN FURUI ENERGY DEV CO LTD

title_en: PMU (Power management Unit) point distribution method and system considering fault reconstruction and state estimation precision
abstract_en: A PMU (Power management Unit) dotting method and system considering fault reconstruction and state estimation precision utilizes pseudo quantity measurement, SCADA (supervisory control and data acquisition) quantity measurement and PMU and DULR (coordinated measurement and calculation) to calculate state estimation voltage and state estimation error covariance matrix; based on E-optimal design standard, taking the magnitude relation between the characteristic value of the state estimation error covariance matrix and the specified value as the state estimation precision index of the power distribution network; taking the minimum installation cost as an objective function of a PMU (Power management Unit) distribution model, taking the power flow operation constraint and the topology constraint of the power distribution network as basic constraint of the distribution model, and taking the fault propagation constraint and the load loss constraint of the power distribution network as relay protection characteristic constraint of the distribution model; and under the condition that the state estimation precision index of the power distribution network is met, carrying out joint solution on an objective function, basic constraint and relay protection characteristic constraint, and determining PMU joint optimization distribution points by taking the state estimation precision in a normal state and the load loss rates in a plurality of fault scenes as constraint conditions.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD SUZHOU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH

title_en: Big data-based energy management system
abstract_en: The application discloses an energy management system based on big data, which relates to the technical field of energy management, and comprises a data screening module: the method comprises the steps of obtaining network data, screening to obtain screening results, and processing the screening results to obtain target data; and a data analysis module: the method comprises the steps of obtaining the propagation rate of target data based on the target data; history analysis module: the method comprises the steps of extracting historical data in network data to obtain a historical reddening city and a historical reddening industry, and obtaining a reddening mode; load prediction module: the method is used for obtaining electricity load change data of the city according to the reddening mode and the propagation rate; and the energy management module is used for: the power utilization control system is used for obtaining power utilization control requirements according to power utilization load change data, and carrying out energy management layout on urban power energy based on a target area and the power utilization control requirements. The application has the effect of improving the flexibility and the stability of the electric quantity management of the city when the electric load changes.
assignees: ZHONGNENG GUANGHE SUZHOU NEW ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Step hydroelectric dispatching method, system, equipment and storage medium based on TD3 algorithm
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of hydropower station scheduling, in particular to a step hydropower station scheduling method, a system, equipment and a storage medium based on a TD3 algorithm, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing a long-term optimized scheduling model based on basic data and running conditions of the cascade hydropower station; converting the scheduling problem in the long-term optimized scheduling model into a Markov decision process; solving a Markov decision process by utilizing a double-delay-determination strategy gradient algorithm TD3 to obtain a long-term scheduling decision scheme of each power station in the cascade hydropower station; based on the actual cascade hydropower station, a long-term scheduling decision result is output. According to the invention, the continuous action space value under the state can be output according to the state quantity, the problem of network overestimation is reduced, the problem of error accumulation is solved by adopting a delay strategy update and a noise smoothing target strategy, and the power generation benefit of the cascade hydropower station can be effectively improved.
assignees: UNIV HOHAI;YALONG RIVER HYDROPOWER DEV CO LTD

title_en: Near-field DoA estimation method based on CCKAN
abstract_en: A near-field DoA estimation method based on CCKAN includes the steps of simulating received signals of array element channels in an off-line stage, generating simulated signals influenced by near-field effect according to a near-field propagation model to serve as a sample set, extracting characteristic data of the received signals of each array element channel, obtaining covariance characteristics of the received signals by using empirical autocorrelation, further using the covariance characteristics to train CCKAN, and carrying out real-time DoA estimation through CCKAN after training in an on-line stage. According to the invention, complex-valued convolution is introduced into a Kolmogorov-Arnold network (KAN), and the internal relation of signal amplitude and phase is enhanced by simulating complex-valued operation in the convolution, and KAN with better interpretability is introduced as feature extraction, so that excellent DoA resolution can be obtained under far field and near field conditions.

title_en: Water supply plant residual chlorine prediction method based on cascade time sequence neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a residual chlorine prediction method for a water supply plant based on a cascade time sequence neural network, and relates to the technical field of water quality prediction. The invention discloses a water supply plant residual chlorine prediction method based on a cascade time sequence neural network, which comprises the steps of collecting historical data, carrying out data cleaning on the historical data, constructing a water supply plant residual chlorine prediction model of the cascade time sequence neural network, training the model by using preprocessed data until the model converges, comprehensively evaluating the prediction performance of the model by adopting test set data.
assignees: ANHUI SHUNYU WATER AFFAIRS CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent content generation system based on open source data analysis
abstract_en: The application discloses an intelligent content generation system based on open source data analysis, which relates to the technical field of monitoring analysis and comprises a data preprocessing module, a map construction and extraction module, an intelligent content generation module and an optimization module, wherein the data preprocessing module is used for carrying out multi-mode content acquisition on a heterogeneous open source data platform to obtain a structural semantic feature matrix, the map construction and extraction module is used for carrying out domain knowledge map construction based on the structural semantic feature matrix to obtain a domain evolution feature vector, the intelligent content generation module is used for inputting the domain evolution feature vector into a multi-mode generation countermeasure network to carry out semantic-visual cross-mode mapping to obtain style enhanced intelligent generated content, the optimization module is used for carrying out propagation effect simulation prediction on the style enhanced intelligent generated content to generate a content propagation influence matrix, carrying out optimization iteration on the intelligent generated content according to the content propagation influence matrix to generate final optimized content and pushing the final optimized content to a target terminal.
assignees: GUANGDONG INFORMATION TECH SECURITY EVALUATION CENTER

title_en: Power grid knowledge graph generation method and device, terminal equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid knowledge graph generation method, a device, terminal equipment and a storage medium, and belongs to the field of knowledge graphs. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a power grid node entity set, a power grid node relation set and power grid topological structure data, constructing a message transmission mechanism, carrying out path search by taking an abnormal detection point as a starting point according to a current fault propagation node and the message transmission mechanism to generate a fault prediction path set, taking the current fault propagation node as the power grid node entity set during first search, constructing a target path selection function for the fault prediction nodes in the fault prediction path set according to a preset power grid node weight matrix and a characteristic vector of each power grid node, and updating the current fault propagation node by taking a fusion function constructed by a semantic score function and the target path selection function as a target at maximum, and generating a power grid knowledge map when a preset loss function value converges. By implementing the method and the device, the problem of low accuracy of knowledge graph generation in the prior art is solved.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD;GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO

title_en: Vehicle public opinion intelligent analysis method and system based on Internet of vehicles, product and vehicle
abstract_en: The application provides a vehicle public opinion intelligent analysis method, a system, a product and a vehicle based on the Internet of vehicles, and relates to the technical field of vehicle public opinion analysis, wherein the method utilizes a cross-modal attention mechanism to dynamically evaluate and weight emotion contribution degrees of all data sources by comprehensively integrating vehicle-mounted system logs, in-vehicle voice, social media videos and other multi-modal data in the Internet of vehicles, thereby effectively overcoming the one-sided performance of single-modal analysis and improving the accuracy and robustness of public opinion emotion judgment; the method further comprises the steps of deep mining public opinion propagation information by means of a space-time diagram neural network, constructing a propagation path model, generating an event-emotion-propagation force three-dimensional thermodynamic diagram, realizing visual insight and trend prediction of public opinion evolution situation, constructing a local and external cooperative hierarchical emergency response mechanism on the basis, relieving anxiety of users, and effectively restraining poor public opinion diffusion.

title_en: System based on network for detecting a fire
title_ko: 네트워크 기반의 화재 감시 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A system monitoring a fire based on a network is provided to verify the occurrence of a fire in a facility by monitoring the change of the state of first fighting units in the facility. CONSTITUTION: A fire sensor(10) detects the occurrence of a first in a facility. A state monitoring sensor(20) monitors the change of the state of a fire fighting units in the facility. A data transmission unit(30) transmits monitored data. A remote monitoring unit(40) analyzes the monitored data and verifies whether the fire is occurred in the facility.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 화재 감시 시스템에 관한 것이다. 보다 상세하게는 시설물의 화재 발생 여부를 정확하게 판단하여 화재 발생 상황시 신속하게 대처하는 것이 가능한 화재 감시 시스템에 관한 것이다.본 발명은 시설물의 화재 발생 여부를 감지한 후 상기 감지 결과인 제1 감지 데이터를 생성하는 화재 감지부; 상기 시설물에 설치된 소방 설비의 상태 변화를 감지한 후 상기 감지 결과인 제2 감지 데이터를 생성하는 상태 감지부; 상기 시설물 내부에서 상기 제1 감지 데이터와 상기 제2 감지 데이터를 수집하여 전송하는 감지 데이터 전송부; 및 상기 제1 감지 데이터와 상기 제2 감지 데이터를 분석하여 상기 시설물의 화재 발생 여부를 판단하고 상기 시설물의 화재 발생 상황을 전파하는 원격 감시부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 본 발명에 의하면 시설물의 화재 발생 여부 및 시설물에 설치된 소방 설비의 상태 변화를 동시에 감지한 후 감지 결과에 따라 시설물에 대한 화재 발생 여부를 판단하여 시설물의 화재 발생 여부 판단에 대한 정확성이 높아지므로 실제 화재 발생시 신속하게 대처가 가능하여 화재 진압을 위한 초동 대처가 미흡하여 인적 및 물적 피해가 발생하는 것을 최대한 방지할 수 있는 효과를 가진다. 
       
     소방설비, 화재감시, 원격관제, 빌딩관리

title_en: Dynamic Pricing and Automated Charging System and Method for Air Rights Utilization
title_ko: 공중권 이용자의 동적 가격 책정 및 자동 청구 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and a method for dynamically calculating a usage fee by comprehensively analyzing a risk of infringement, a degree of local congestion, a time zone, weather information, a past history, and the like in a process of using an air right of a spatial moving object such as a drone, a uam, and the like, and automatically billing and calculating a fee through a smart contract or an automatic payment api. The calculated rates and billing details are stored in the blockchain-based distributed ledger to prevent forgery and falsification, and can be used as public rights transaction history, legal evidence, and policy analysis data in the future. The present invention has high industrial applicability as a base infrastructure having practical usability and technical ripple effects in various fields such as drone delivery, uam, emergency response of public institutions, content filming, insurance and policytech, and the like, along with establishing an order of using the public ticket.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 드론, UAM 등 공간 이동체의 공중권 이용 과정에서 침해 위험도, 지역 혼잡도, 시간대, 기상 정보, 과거 이력 등을 종합 분석하여 이용 요금을 동적으로 산정하고, 스마트 계약 또는 자동 결제 API를 통해 요금을 자동 청구 및 정산하는 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것이다. 산정된 요금과 청구 내역은 블록체인 기반 분산원장에 저장되어 위변조가 방지되며, 향후 공중권 거래 이력, 법적 증빙, 정책 분석 자료로 활용 가능하다. 본 발명은 공중권 이용 질서 확립과 함께, 드론 배송, 도심항공모빌리티(UAM), 공공기관의 비상 대응, 콘텐츠 촬영, 보험 및 정책 기술(PolicyTech) 등 다양한 분야에서 실질적 활용성과 기술적 파급력을 갖는 기반 인프라로서 산업적 이용 가능성이 매우 높다.

title_en: Unsafe event-based method for constructing and controlling flight operation risk network
abstract_en: An unsafe event-based method for constructing and controlling a flight operation risk network. The method comprises: constructing a flight operation risk network on the basis of civil aviation unsafe event data, and performing logical supplement connection on the network according to an actual flight operation service; and improving a risk propagation and control process on the basis of an SIR virus propagation model, distinguishing risk propagation probabilities between different nodes according to the occurrence frequency of different unsafe events, and simulating a process of propagating a risk in the network. The propagation of the risk in the network is controlled by means of node control and network attack methods, and the probability of an unsafe event occurrence risk is reduced by establishing defense for an important node, such that a reliable and effective flight operation risk control solution is provided. The flight operation risk network is constructed, such that the relationship between flight risk factors and between risk and accident can be understood, a risk propagation process better conforms to an actual flight operation condition, and the determined risk control solution is higher in reliability.

title_en: A kind of mountain fire disaster alarm method of overhead transmission line
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of mountain fire disaster alarm methods of overhead transmission line, including A. to obtain mountain fire using monitoring modular acquisition and information occurs, and it includes combustible characteristic, terrain factor and meteorological factor that information, which occurs, for mountain fire；B. the mountain fire impact factor in mountain fire generation information is obtained, and for the threshold values association between mountain fire and its mountain fire impact factor, passes through Random Forest model opening relationships；C. by carrying out the time-space process modeling of mountain fire sprawling with the cellular automata for simulating complicated natural calamity temporal-spatial evolution process capability, and the cellular transformation rule of cellular automata is determined using Random Forest model；D. the sprawling process that mountain fire is predicted by cellular Automation Model estimates time of the mountain fire apart from overhead transmission line, and the risk for combining external disaster information and power grid bulk properties assessment overhead transmission line to stop transport.Cascading failure in power system caused by the present invention can help more efficiently reply Disaster prediction to act on, to mitigate the economy and personal casualty loss of power grid and electricity unit.

title_en: Machine predictive maintenance method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a machine predictive maintenance method based on deep learning, which comprises the following steps: collecting a vibration signal of the screw rod during operation from the screw rod by using a vibration sensor; collecting signals with a sliding frame in a fixed length; randomly selecting samples to construct a training set and a testing set database, and marking the training set and the testing set as impulse response and non-impulse response; training data sets and test data and learning models for training and testing the sparse automatic encoder layer and the error back propagation neural network layer; determining the dynamic performance of the screw rod along with the time according to the impulse response; using indexes based on the similarity of dynamic performance to indicate and monitor the service life state of the screw rod; the maximum speed, acceleration, and the like are limited depending on the life. The invention firstly predicts the service life, limits the highest rotating speed, the highest load and the like of the screw rod on the basis of the service life, and achieves the purposes of prolonging the service life and improving the utilization rate by limiting the highest rotating speed or the acceleration and the like of the screw rod.

title_en: Method and power distribution network management system for assessing power distribution network assets based on downstream events
abstract_en: A method for assessing a network asset based on a downstream event may include: receiving a communication from one or more sensors in the power distribution network, the communication indicating an occurrence of a network event; calculating, for each network asset in an affected area of the network, a probability of the network asset causing a problem indicated by the event; calculating a propagation probability of the network asset causing the problem for each network asset in the affected area of the network; calculating a probability of network asset failure for each network asset in the affected area of the network based on the probabilities and the propagation probabilities; comparing the probability of the network asset failure to a threshold; determining, based on the comparison, the network asset having the highest probability of failure; and controlling one of the more other network assets to alleviate the problem.

title_en: Modeling simulation method of language competition microscopic simulation model based on partitioned double-layer network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a modeling simulation method of a language competition microscopic simulation model based on a partitioned double-layer network, which improves a modeling method based on an agent social circle network, constructs a social network with a remote weak connection relation, and can describe the reinforcing trend of the weak relation of the social network caused by regional population flow and communication connection under the urbanization background. Besides considering the influence of the language position and the language population proportion, the language evolution mechanism of different crowds introduces a new mechanism of influence of bilingual on the conversion from monolingual to bilingual and influence of language attitude on language selection behavior. An improved agent language horizontal and vertical propagation model is provided, and the propagation model comprehensively considers factors such as language status, language density, language attitude, influence of bilingual on monolingual, remote connection weight and the like.

title_en: Traffic characteristic prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a traffic characteristic prediction method and a system, control information is introduced into traffic characteristic prediction to respectively process traffic speed, road network structure and traffic control data; the data are respectively sent to a neural network to obtain space embedding, time embedding and control embedding, and the space embedding, the time embedding and the control embedding are combined to form comprehensive embedding; and finally obtaining the predicted traffic speed value through an encoder based on a space-time attention mechanism module, a data conversion module and a decoder based on the space-time attention mechanism module. The invention improves the effectiveness of the speed prediction of the signal control road network, can better model the dynamic space correlation and the nonlinear time correlation, and simultaneously can avoid the error accumulation to relieve the error propagation effect, thereby improving the long-term traffic flow prediction performance and solving the problem of being suitable for long-term traffic prediction.

title_en: Air conditioning system load prediction method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses an air conditioning system load prediction method based on deep learning, which comprises the steps of 1, selecting characteristic elements influencing the load of an air conditioning system, 2, collecting original data of the load of the air conditioning system, 3, processing the load data, 4, building a deep learning model based on a neural network, 5, determining a deep learning optimal model, and 6, predicting the load of the air conditioning system. The invention fully utilizes the multi-source characteristic information influencing the energy consumption of the air conditioning system, and determines the deep learning optimal model by selecting different neuron numbers and hidden layer numbers and comparing the prediction results. At the same time, the learning rate of back propagation by introducing a Gaussian function The method can solve the problem of gradient disappearance which is easy to occur in the calculation process, improves the load prediction precision, further can provide energy consumption fluctuation information, adjusts the operation strategy of each device in the refrigeration system in advance, and avoids the energy consumption loss of the air conditioning system caused by the delay of feedback signal transmission.

title_en: Sea island micro-energy network two-stage optimization method considering hydrogen energy cascade utilization
abstract_en: The invention relates to a sea island micro energy network two-stage optimization method considering hydrogen energy cascade utilization, which belongs to the field of comprehensive energy, and comprises the steps of constructing a sea island micro energy network integrating a hydrogen energy cascade utilization device, constructing a day-ahead stage objective function taking the maximum net profit of a day-ahead market as a target based on historical data of wind power, photovoltaic and photo-thermal power stations and energy supply equipment, storage equipment, a gas turbine and hydrogen fuel cell output of the sea island micro energy network, solving the day-ahead stage objective function based on the day-ahead supply and demand balance constraint, unit constraint and demand response constraint to obtain day-ahead market electricity, heat and gas transaction quantity, constructing a real-time stage objective function taking the minimum real-time market deviation adjustment cost of the sea island micro energy network as a target, solving the real-time objective function based on the uncertainty of real-time supply and demand balance constraint, unit constraint, demand response constraint, supply and demand cooperation, and electric, heat and gas transaction quantity of the day-ahead market to obtain an optimal solution of each unit output and a reduction quantity capable of reducing load on a demand side.

title_en: Earthquake phase pickup method based on time-frequency analysis and deep learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to a seismic phase pickup method based on time-frequency analysis and deep learning, which belongs to the field of seismology, and comprises the steps of establishing a deep neural network comprising an empirical mode decomposition module, a residual error contraction module, an LSTM layer, a transducer layer, an up-sampling layer and a convolution layer, adopting a linear rectification function as an activation function, adopting an Adam self-adaptive optimization function to carry out counter propagation, adopting a binary cross entropy loss function as a loss function, and adopting an average absolute error function, an error standard deviation, an accuracy rate, a recall rate and an F1 fraction as evaluation indexes to obtain a deep neural network model. When the frequencies of noise, P wave and S wave are different, the empirical mode decomposition can effectively separate the P wave from the S wave, thereby helping the network to better identify the P wave and the S wave. Even for broadband noise, the noise is decomposed into different eigenmode functions, so that the noise content in the eigenmode functions where the P wave and the S wave are located is reduced. The time-frequency analysis method can effectively improve the noise immunity of the network.

title_en: Digital twinning-fused power grid fault prediction system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of digital twinning, in particular to a power grid fault prediction system and method integrating digital twinning. According to the invention, a structural state tensor is constructed by fusing multi-source heterogeneous sensing data and executing a space-time alignment algorithm, the Laplace operation is combined with a stress wave propagation model to analyze non-rigid deformation characteristics, a load transfer path map is generated to reveal hidden mechanical association, a finite element grid dynamically corrects Young modulus to form a structural degradation coefficient matrix, and a time sequence difference and a long-short term memory network capturing device degradation trend are combined, the Kelmogorov test quantifies the space-time distribution probability of faults, so that the power grid device is predicted to rise from single threshold early warning to multi-physical field coupling, the space-time resolution and dynamic adaptability of fault prediction are improved, the dependence of manual experience is reduced, and the robustness of a complex working condition system is enhanced.

title_en: Method for forecasting and analyzing circuit state transition probability of electric power system under severe weather
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for forecasting and analyzing a circuit state transition probability of an electric power system under severe weather. The method comprises the following steps of A, constructing a regression model using a circuit fault probability as a dependent variable index and a meteorological factor as an independent variable index; B, calculating an FTRF (Flow Transferring Relativity Factor) of every other branch circuit after one branch circuit is disconnected; C, obtaining a cascading trip probability model of each branch circuit; and D, obtaining a circuit state transition probability model under the condition of the severe weather. According to the method disclosed by the invention, the state transition probability estimation of each branch circuit under the condition of the severe weather can be realized, thus information of a high-risk fault branch circuit can be obtained, and safe and reliable running of a power grid under the severe weather can be ensured.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV CHANGSHA SCIENCE

title_en: Cascade hydropower day-ahead scheduling method considering power grid section constraint
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of cascade reservoir group power generation optimization scheduling, and particularly relates to a cascade hydropower station day-ahead scheduling method considering power grid section constraint.
assignees: SOUTHWEST BRANCH OF STATE GRID CORP OF CHINA;UNIV SICHUAN

title_en: Power transmission and distribution coordination planning method considering generalized load random characteristics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power transmission and distribution coordination planning method considering generalized load random characteristics, which decomposes a power transmission and distribution coupling system into a plurality of small systems according to a physical structure and then constructs a power transmission and distribution iterative interactive distributed decision framework. Firstly, fitting a probability density function of generalized load containing distributed new energy according to measured data, randomly sampling generalized load values by using a Monte Carlo sampling method, and sequentially accessing the generalized load values into a power distribution network with new energy for power generation. And (4) independently operating each power transmission system and each power distribution system, and solving boundary power between power transmission and power distribution. The invention provides a method for realizing the information transfer between a power transmission system and a power distribution system by taking the mean value and the standard deviation of boundary power as shared variables and applying a probabilistic target cascade algorithm, and a target function with a Lagrange penalty function is written in a target column with the lowest total operation cost of the system, so that the calculation precision is not reduced, and the operation speed can be greatly improved.
assignees: UNIV HANGZHOU DIANZI;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Traffic cascade fault emergency regulation and control strategy generation method, system, terminal and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a traffic cascade fault emergency regulation and control strategy generation method, a system, a terminal and a medium, which relate to the technical field of traffic faults, and the key points of the technical scheme are as follows: acquiring a target cascade network diagram consisting of fault locating points and fault associated points in a target area; selecting at least one fault positioning point as a regulation and control central point, and updating the cascade failure relation in the target cascade network graph by taking the normal work of all the fault positioning points as a target when the regulation and control central point runs to obtain an emergency regulation and control strategy set; and inputting all the emergency regulation strategies in the emergency regulation strategy set into a multi-objective optimization function to obtain an optimal emergency regulation strategy. The invention can effectively reduce the difficulty of recovering the traffic cascade fault, updates the cascade failure relation, effectively enhances the stability of the whole traffic system under the influence of secondary natural disasters, and provides data support for solving the failure state of traffic infrastructure caused by the traffic cascade fault under the emergency condition.

title_en: Signed social network forward influence maximization method based on polarity reverse reachable set
abstract_en: The invention provides a signed social network forward influence maximization method based on a polarity reverse reachable set. The method specifically comprises the following steps: step 1, constructing a signed social network G according to known information; step 2, calculating the required number theta of the polarity-reversal reachable sets by using a halving guessing method according to the signed social network G and the number k of the seed nodes; step 3, regenerating theta polarity reverse reachable sets, and adding the theta polarity reverse reachable sets into the set R  +  In (a) and (b); step 4, in the set R  +  Selecting k seed groups S  *  The method comprises the steps of carrying out a first treatment on the surface of the Step 5, seed subset S  *  Substituting the influence propagation model for propagation so as to complete the influence maximization process. The method can form enough polarity reversal reachable sets according to the signed social network, and select energy in the polarity reversal reachable setsThe seed node of the forward influence can be maximized, thereby forming the maximum forward influence.

title_en: Power prediction method, system and storage medium of wind power plant
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power prediction method, a system and a storage medium of a wind power plant, wherein the method comprises the following steps: setting a wind field machine position in a wind field to collect wind speed of an area where a wind driven generator is located, and collecting other meteorological data in the wind field; reconstructing airflow distribution in the wind field range according to the acquired data; predicting future airflow distribution of the wind field according to the airflow distribution in the reconstructed wind field range; selecting a machine position, and selecting a predicted wind speed value corresponding to the machine position from predicted future airflow distribution; and converting the predicted wind speed value corresponding to the machine position into a power predicted value. Compared with the prior art, the method can effectively predict the power change of the wind farm for 1-15 minutes, brings huge safety and economic benefit for countries and regions with insufficient power grids and under the scene that the wind farm is directly supplied to the load side, and can effectively position and track the wind flow propagation motion trail without accumulating a large amount of historical data.

title_en: Novel physical information neural network for solving seismic wave equation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of earthquake engineering, in particular to a novel physical information neural network (gs-PINN) for solving a seismic wave equation, which comprises the steps of establishing the novel physical information neural network, dividing configuration points required by network training, determining the form of incident waves, developing network training, namely acquiring a solution of a one-dimensional seismic wave fluctuation equation, wherein the first layer of hidden layer of each sub-network is composed of two sub-networks, the parameters of which are untrainable parameters, the values of which are determined by the propagation direction of the seismic wave, and the rest parameters are trainable parameters, so that the network can automatically meet the one-dimensional seismic wave fluctuation equation, the network is effectively prevented from being trapped into local optimum, the training difficulty is greatly reduced, and a powerful technical support is provided for solving the one-dimensional seismic wave fluctuation equation.

title_en: Intelligent building collaborative optimization operation method considering toughness constraint
abstract_en: The invention provides a cooperative optimization operation method of an intelligent building considering toughness constraint, which relates to the technical field of building comprehensive energy scheduling and comprises the steps of constructing a source network load storage integrated module of an intelligent building comprehensive energy system, integrating distributed energy, an energy storage unit and load data through an energy router, and realizing cascade utilization of electric energy, heat energy and cold energy based on a multi-energy complementation principle; the method comprises the steps of constructing toughness indexes to quantify the capability of an intelligent building comprehensive energy system for coping with emergency, constructing a double-layer optimization scheduling model based on the intelligent building comprehensive energy system and the toughness indexes, and solving the double-layer optimization scheduling model by utilizing an improved gray wolf optimization algorithm to obtain an optimal energy scheduling strategy. The invention can comprehensively consider the system economical efficiency and toughness indexes, ensure the electricity utilization safety of the building, improve the new energy consumption capacity, reduce the total power generation cost of the whole building comprehensive energy system as much as possible, and solve the optimization problem through an improved gray wolf algorithm.
assignees: FUJIAN BRANCH OF CHINA HUADIAN GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent fire control monitoring and early warning system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of intelligent fire protection and discloses an intelligent fire protection monitoring and early warning system based on the Internet of things, which comprises a data acquisition unit, an abnormal fluctuation feature extraction unit and a spatial correlation analysis unit, wherein the data acquisition unit acquires a fire protection environment through an Internet of things sensor network to obtain a fire protection environment data set, the abnormal fluctuation feature extraction unit extracts abnormal fluctuation feature vectors from the fire protection environment data set, the spatial correlation analysis unit analyzes the abnormal fluctuation feature vectors, the comprehensive monitoring of the fire protection environment is realized through the Internet of things sensor network, advanced technologies such as deep reinforcement learning and a graph neural network are combined, fire protection environment data can be analyzed in real time, a fire source potential area can be dynamically evaluated, early warning signals can be sent out in advance, the early-stage quick response of a fire disaster is ensured, the early warning accuracy and timeliness are remarkably improved, a fire source potential area and a fire propagation path can be identified, scientific basis is provided for fire protection resource allocation and fire source positioning, and fuzzy judgment and delayed response of a fire source position in a traditional scheme are avoided.
assignees: GUANGZHOU SHUNAN FIRE ENG EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Network-coupled modeling method for fire spread of lithium-ion battery energy storage system
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a coupling network model lithium-ion battery energy storage system fire spread modeling method, which belongs to the technical field of lithium-ion battery model construction and simulation method. The coupling network model lithium-ion battery energy storage system fire spread modeling method includes: obtaining battery electrochemical parameters, material thermophysical parameters and energy storage system geometric characteristic parameters of a battery energy storage system; establishing a three-dimensional geometric model of air domain inside the energy storage system and performing a grid division; calculating the heat generated inside batteries during thermal runaway; solving the heat transfer and the thermal runaway propagation process between batteries, and calculating the battery temperatures; calculating the gas generation inside batteries during thermal runaway; solving jet dynamics parameters of batteries; and, solving the conservation equations of fluid regions in the battery energy storage system, to predict the fire spread behavior inside an energy storage power station.

title_en: Method of combined simulation of the software and hardware parts of a computer system, and associated system
abstract_en:
This invention relates to a method for simulation of a computer system ( 10 ), for example for an aeronautical simulation application, comprising a hardware infrastructure (HW) and a software portion (SW). 
     The method comprises:
         the modeling (E 100 ) of the said hardware infrastructure (HW) in a plurality of schedulers ( 11 - 14 ) capable of simulating the successive execution of tasks ( 15, 40, 40′ ),   the modeling (E 110 ) of the said software portion (SW) in a plurality of initial tasks ( 15 ) comprising accesses to resources of the said hardware infrastructure (HW),   the simulation (E 130 ) of the initial tasks ( 15 ) comprising the software propagation of simulated accesses through schedulers ( 11 - 14 ) of the said modeled infrastructure (HW),       

     the said propagation being carried out in the form of transactions ( 50 ) between pairs of schedulers ( 11 - 14 ), a transaction ( 50 ) comprising a task ( 40,   40′ ) on each scheduler and an indication of precedence ( 40″ ) linking the two tasks ( 40, 40 ′).

title_en: Method and system for optimizing and predicting short-term wind speed interval based on random sensitivity
abstract_en: The invention discloses a short-term wind speed interval multi-target optimization prediction method and system based on random sensitivity, which comprises the steps of firstly pretraining a neural network by adopting a counter-propagation training mode, then improving the random sensitivity so as to be suitable for a special prediction mode, namely a prediction interval, and then carrying out two important indexes of the prediction interval: the interval coverage accuracy and interval width are used as three objective functions together with the constructed random sensitivity for predicting the interval, a multi-objective genetic optimization algorithm NSGA-III is used for optimizing the pre-trained neural network, wherein the random sensitivity can be used for calculating the anti-interference capability of a model on surrounding samples added with random disturbance; after training, heuristic selection is carried out on the pareto optimal population finally obtained. The method provided by the invention can be used for different network structures and has high expandability; the number of the super parameters is greatly reduced by utilizing multi-objective optimization and specially selecting an optimal solution scheme, and the method has good practical application value.

title_en: Simulation method for simulating power grid cascading failure state under typhoon disaster effect
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulation method for simulating a grid cascading failure state under the action of typhoon disasters, which comprises the steps of firstly establishing a circulating wind field model and a traveling wind field model of typhoons according to typhoons data sets, then establishing a typhoons space-time distribution model, then drawing a grid element vulnerability curve to obtain damage probabilities of grid elements corresponding to different wind speeds, abstracting a working state set of the grid elements into a Markov state, and constructing a state transfer model of a power system to generate a fault grid element set of the power system at different moments under the action of typhoons.

title_en: Novel rapid dynamic thermal simulation method based on discrete event simulation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of heat supply pipe network dynamic simulation, and discloses a novel rapid dynamic thermal simulation method based on discrete event simulation, which is used for simulating a heat supply pipe network by considering heat loss and time lag of water in pipes, accurately and rapidly calculating heat propagation of each pipe, and playing a key role in planning and optimizing a pipe network system. The discrete event simulation is applied to the simulation of the regional heating network for the first time, can effectively and accurately process the changed inlet temperature and flow, and is also applicable to the working condition of zero flow.
