The variable space-time discretization is automatically determined by input data, and the numerical value diffusion of transmission delay and temperature is not considered during calculation, so that the rapid calculation of heat loss and temperature drop can be rapidly calculated. The model is efficient and flexible, achieves unprecedented efficiency on the premise of ensuring precision, and is suitable for various large-scale dendritic and annular pipe networks. The pipeline model can be used for fast dynamic thermal simulation of a variable-time and variable-space step large-scale central heating pipe network.

title_en: Multi-traffic subarea distributed collaborative optimization method and system based on double-layer architecture
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-traffic subarea distributed collaborative optimization method and system based on a double-layer framework, which relate to the technical field of traffic control and automatic control and comprise the steps of constructing a weighted directed graph by utilizing a road network model, dividing the weighted directed graph into a plurality of traffic subareas, constructing an upper-layer multi-subarea collaborative optimization model based on a macroscopic basic graph of each traffic subarea to obtain the optimal accumulated number of vehicles of each traffic subarea under collaborative control, taking the optimal accumulated number of vehicles of each traffic subarea as the constraint of a lower-layer single-subarea optimization control model, optimizing each intersection timing in the traffic subarea to obtain the optimal timing scheme of a controlled road network, solving the optimal accumulated number of each subarea under collaborative control by the upper layer based on the double-layer cascading framework, and carrying out cascading and continuous parameter updating on the conditions of each intersection in the subarea by the subarea boundary control, thereby carrying out multi-subarea collaborative optimization.

title_en: Optimal decentralized coordination control method for micro-grid in new energy power system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of large-scale power grid safety guarantee, in particular to an optimal decentralized coordinated control method of a micro-grid in a new energy power system. According to the invention, the virtual disconnection verification of the key transmission lines is implemented one by acquiring the power grid topology and line tide data in real time, the simulation and analysis of the line fault scene are realized, the full-network cascading risk quantification index is established on the basis, the initial fault line with the greatest threat to the system security is identified by comparing with the security threshold in real time, the vulnerable line risk contribution list is generated, the positioning and early prevention of the high-risk line are realized, and the power adjustment quantity required by the micro-grid group is directly calculated according to the risk contribution list, so that the prospective tide dredging instruction set is formed.

title_en: Water network dynamic risk assessment method and system based on space-time diagram convolution
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water network dynamic risk assessment method and system based on space-time diagram convolution, and relates to the field of intelligent monitoring of water networks. The method comprises the steps of constructing a water network diagram structure, obtaining static and dynamic properties of physical nodes and pipe sections, generating virtual nodes in response to external events, calculating pollution propagation probability and influence weight, generating a dynamic adjacency matrix through self-adaptive diagram learning based on water quality and time sequence water flow data, calculating leakage risk values through space-time separation convolution, and calculating time-varying stability index assessment risks by fusing design efficiency reference values, real-time network efficiency and the like. The system comprises a data acquisition module, an event response module, a graph structure construction module, a risk calculation module and a stability evaluation module. The method solves the problems of static hysteresis and insufficient scene coverage in the traditional evaluation, improves the risk prediction precision and emergency response efficiency, and is suitable for real-time risk monitoring of various water networks.

title_en: Large power grid cascading failure analysis methods based on the accident chain
abstract_en: A kind of large power grid cascading failure analysis methods based on the accident chain; this method is that accident chain theory is applied to the cascading failure analysis; select with accident chain theoretical direction fault; with the fault selectional restriction on supply path; adopt trend alternately to calculate and stability Calculation is analyzed, and take all factors into consideration overload in the cascading failure process, stable, the action situation of protecting performance and aut.eq..When carrying out the cascading failure analysis, the explicit and chain method of implicit expression that adopts element to stop transport is searched the stoppage in transit elements combination that causes regional power outage on each bar supply path, obtain the accident chain form of stopping transport and representing with element; Consider the explicit triggering and the implicit expression triggering selection of cascading failure accident chain link, the search depth of implicit expression trigger event is set at adjacent area, i.e. going up or the next stage section on the section of this circuit place; The trend that consideration accident chain link triggers shifts and causes the variation in remaining network power supply path.The present invention can be used for the fault analysis of electric system large power grid cascading.

title_en: Coupling process based on electric system node importance
abstract_en: The present invention discloses coupling process and device based on electric system node importance, and for the device for realizing this method, this method includes creating cascading failure model based on electric power system model；Cascading failure attack is implemented to the electric power networks in model, it is obtained under conventional input power in guarantee electrical nodes, the real output of each supply node of dynamic regulation, output power of each supply node under each stable state is obtained in dynamic regulation, egress influence power and node fragility are calculated separately, the two weighted sum obtains node d 0 Importance, sorted from small to small based on the importance of node and generate new electric power networks, by new electric power networks and communication network carry out it is different match couple, generate new electric power system model.The present invention is calculated node importance by DC flow model and obtains more accurate simulation result, then new electric power networks are different with coupling with communication network progress, improves robustness of the power system network under attack.

title_en: Time-varying network model construction method and system and rumor propagation time-varying network model construction method
abstract_en: The application relates to a time-varying network model construction method, a time-varying network model construction system and a rumor propagation time-varying network model construction method, which belong to the technical field of time-varying network model research, wherein a two-dimensional grid network with the node number of N and L is set, node spacing and accumulated edge connection times sum are obtained on the basis of the space coordinates of nodes and the edge connection condition of each moment node, the edge connection preference probability of each moment active node is obtained by combining the node spacing and the accumulated edge connection times sum, and the time-varying network model is obtained by performing edge connection on the basis of the edge connection preference probability of each moment active node; by utilizing the time-varying network model construction method, a node information acquisition module, a preference probability acquisition module, an instantaneous network model forming module and a time-varying network model generating module are obtained, so that a time-varying network model construction system is obtained; and a construction method for obtaining a rumor propagation time-varying network model. Compared with the related art, the method has the effect of reducing the limitation of the time-varying network model to a certain extent.

title_en: High-proportion clean energy power grid vulnerability assessment method considering cascading failure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-proportion clean energy power grid vulnerability assessment method considering cascading failures. First, the power grid is abstracted into a topological graph connected by nodes and lines based on the topological structure of the power grid, and the line betweenness of the power grid considering the electrical characteristics is calculated on the basis of the topological graph. And then, analyzing the source load fluctuation characteristics of the power grid, analyzing a corresponding typical daily load curve for load fluctuation based on industrial, commercial and residential load historical data, and establishing a wind-light unit output model for the time sequence fluctuation of wind-light renewable energy sources, and obtaining a typical sunrise force curve of the wind-light unit based on historical wind speed and illumination data in a region. Then, establishing a grid vulnerability evaluation index; and finally, obtaining corresponding grid vulnerability evaluation indexes according to the power grid cascading failure results under different line failure conditions. The invention realizes the evaluation of the vulnerability of the power grid under the known power grid topology and the source load fluctuation historical data, and can provide a theoretical basis for the operation scheduling of the power system.

title_en: Power grid service identification model generation method and power grid service identification method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a generation method of a power grid service identification model and a power grid service identification method. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a training sample set formed by power grid business data, inputting types of training samples and model tasks into a teacher network model for recognition to obtain a first recognition result, inputting types of the training samples and model tasks into a student network model to be trained for recognition to obtain a second recognition result, determining a first loss function and a second loss function according to the first recognition result, the second recognition result and label data, calculating a fitting loss function according to the first loss function and the second loss function, and carrying out back propagation on the student network model to be trained based on the fitting loss function to obtain the student network model to be trained for the next iteration until iteration convergence conditions are met to obtain the power grid business recognition model, and solving the problems that the model recognition accuracy is low, the high delay is high, and multi-business data cannot be processed.
assignees: BEIJING SMARTCHIP MICROELECTRONICS TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power transmission line inspection data asset management method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a transmission line inspection data asset management method and system, which are used for acquiring multi-mode data of a transmission line through various sensors arranged in the transmission line and surrounding environment and sensors carried by a helicopter and an unmanned plane; and generating a fusion data set by processing the multi-mode data based on the space-time correlation model. Analyzing the fusion data set by utilizing a self-adaptive feature extraction algorithm to generate a structured power transmission line data asset comprising environmental features, defect features and hidden danger features, evaluating the possibility of triggering defects by environmental conditions based on the association of the environmental features and the defect features, constructing a graph network model which takes the power transmission line as a node and sensor data as side weights according to the hidden danger features and the environmental conditions, analyzing a defect propagation path and predicting the time and space distribution of hidden dangers, generating a defect risk level early warning based on a prediction result, generating a power transmission line hidden danger distribution map by combining environmental meteorological data, and providing accurate assistance for inspection and maintenance planning.
assignees: STATE GRID POWER SPACE TECH CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Intelligent monitorable lightning protection system based on copper mesh cable combination
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent monitorable lightning protection system based on copper network cable combination, which relates to the technical field of monitoring lightning protection and comprises a distributed sensing network module, a high-speed synchronous acquisition module, a lightning current reconstruction module, a thermal stress prediction module, a visual early warning module and a central control module; the system comprises the following working processes of paving copper net cables, embedding triaxial magnetic fields and temperature sensor arrays into nodes, recording three-dimensional coordinates, triggering lightning stroke events through magnetic field change rate threshold values, synchronously collecting magnetic field and temperature time sequence data by the nodes of the whole net, reconstructing three-dimensional space current density distribution based on a dynamic weight matrix and a field intensity integration algorithm, predicting plastic deformation risks of conductors of all the nodes by combining Joule heat accumulation and a time heating stress equation, marking high-risk current areas and super yield strength stress points, and outputting damage coordinate early warning. According to the invention, through distributed sensing of copper mesh nodes, the propagation path, the intensity distribution and the time-varying characteristics of lightning current in a three-dimensional space are reconstructed in real time.
assignees: ZHONGFU CARBON FIBER CORE CABLE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic control method for water level lower limit of cascade hydropower station for supporting power grid supply protection
abstract_en: The invention provides a dynamic control method for a lower limit of a water level of a cascade hydropower station for supporting power grid supply protection, and belongs to the field of multi-energy power system planning. The method is based on prediction data of the annual runoff represented by the dead water and the new energy output, and the supply-keeping period is set on the premise of meeting hydropower operation parameters and constraints. In order to ensure the water and electricity bearing supply and demand in the period, a 'electricity-based water fixing' algorithm which is used for coupling a fourth-order Dragon-grid-tower method and a success-failure search method is innovatively adopted to solve the required power generation flow. And further, combining the water balance principle, calculating an initial reservoir capacity through reverse iteration, determining an initial water level lower limit by utilizing a piecewise linear interpolation method, and finally correcting according to the operation constraint. And in the simulation period, dynamically updating the lower limit of the water level by adopting a rolling calculation strategy to form a complete dynamic control curve of the lower limit of the water level. The method has the remarkable advantages of simple and convenient solution, convenient parameter adjustment, high calculation efficiency, quick response to the real-time power grid supply protection instruction and the like through the direct reverse recursion physical process.

title_en: Day-ahead power load prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a daily electric load prediction method and system, and belongs to the technical field of electric load prediction. The method comprises the steps of (1) constructing a model, wherein for the load of the d day and the t time to be predicted, the numerical value is influenced by multiple factors, constructing a hybrid neural network and a continuous conditional random field according to the multiple factors, (2) carrying out model solving and parameter training, realizing the hybrid neural network and continuous conditional random field training through forward derivation-error back propagation, and (3) carrying out power load prediction by using the trained hybrid neural network and continuous conditional random field. According to the invention, the time sequence dependency relationship of the load between every two moments in the day is quantized by using the Gaussian kernel function, and multiple dependency relationships are embedded into the probability undirected graph frame of the CCRF to carry out integral modeling and prediction solving, so that the accuracy of load prediction before the day is improved.

title_en: Ship SOFC system safety analysis method, computing device and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ship SOFC system safety analysis method, and belongs to the technical field of risk prevention and control. The method comprises the steps of determining cause factors of a ship SOFC system, constructing a failure accident tree and an event tree model, constructing a Bow-Tie model according to the failure accident tree and the event tree model, quantitatively analyzing the potential cause factors to obtain key factors affecting the SOFC system, combining analyzed ship SOFC system accident cause data and collected ship fuel cell standard specification data to form a data system, constructing a ship SOFC system accident risk prevention knowledge graph, and analyzing the SOFC system safety according to the ship SOFC system accident risk prevention knowledge graph. The method and the system define the key degree, the hierarchical relationship and the action path of each cause factor, construct the cause factors into the accident cause complex network, and deeply disclose the accident cause propagation mechanism by combining the semantic information of the knowledge graph and the analysis capability of the complex network, thereby providing a comprehensive view for understanding the occurrence and the development of the accident.

title_en: Transmission and receiving system for weather information providing
title_ko: 기상 정보 제공을 위한 송,수신 시스템
abstract_en: A transmitting and receiving system for offering the weather information is provided to supply the transmitted weather information to printers at transmission and reception sides, thereby securing the weather information visually. A disaster broadcasting system(1) is constructed by an edit input device(3), a data bank(4), and a storing device(5) such as a hard disc for storing a system program and a management program with a control unit(2) as the center. A transmission side(A) transmits electromagnetic wave through a transmitter(28). A tuner receives the broadcasting through a receiving antenna. The broadcasting signal is outputted through an image driving member and a speaker through a video amplifier and an audio amplifier. A transmission side memory(6) is connected with the control unit of the transmission side and stores the transmitted weather broadcasting related data. A weather data receiving tuner is connected with the receiving antenna. A detector generates the output corresponding to the existence and kinds of the received weather data. A control member is connected with the tuner and the detector. A character output member is connected with a character display board connected with the control member.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 호우, 폭설, 태풍, 홍수, 돌풍 등 각종 방재를 위한 각종 기상 정보를 기상청 소속 기관, 유관 방재 기관, 방송국, 전국 지방자치단체, 회사, 대형 판매점 등 사람이 많이 왕래하는 곳에 설치된 모니터나 텔레비전 등으로 제공하기 위한 기상 정보 제공을 위한 송,수신 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
     본 발명은 소음 공해를 일으키지 않으면서 각종 시설 내에 있는 국민들에게 모든 기상 정보를 제공할 수 있도록 한 것이다. 
     이를 위하여 본 발명은 영상 또는 음성 데이터를 전파로 송출하도록 된 방송 시스템과 송출된 전파를 수신하기 위한 수신 안테나로 수신하기 위한 튜너와, 튜너의 신호 출력을 증폭하고, 이를 복조하여 영상 및 음성 증폭을 실시하며, 동기 신호 출력부에 의하여 화면 표시기로 영상 신호를 출력시키도록 하여서 된 영상 구동부를 구비하여서 된 공지의 방송 송,수신 시스템에 있어서, 송신측의 제어 유니트와 연결되어 송출된 기상 방송 관련 데이터를 저장하기 위한 송신측 메모리와, 수신 안테나에 연결된 기상 데이터 수신 튜너와, 기상 데이터 수신 튜너에 수신된 데이터의 종류를 판정하기 위한 디텍터와, 디텍터의 출력에 의하여 램프 구동부 또는 문자 출력부로 해독된 출력을 제공하기 위한 제어부와, 제어부의 출력으로 복수 종류의 경광등을 선택된 모드로 선별 제어하기 위한 램프 구동부와, 제어부의 출력으로 문자 데이터를 출력시키기 위한 문자 출력부와, 문자 출력부의 출력 데이터를 영상 데이터를 합성하여 동기 신호에 의하여 화면 표시기로 표시하기 위한 전술한  동기신호 출력부로 된 기상 정보 제공을 위한 송,수신 시스템을 제안한다. 
     이에 따라 본 발명은 각종 기관이나 단체 등에 설치된 모니터에 기상과 관련된 각종 정보가 실시간으로 제공됨과 아울러, 현재의 기상 상황에 상응하는 색상의 경광등이 점등 또는 점멸됨으로써, 국민들이 쉽게 기상 상황을 파악할 수 있게 되며, 송신 측에 데이터 송신과 관련된 데이터가 저장됨과 아울러, 수신측에도 메모리에 해당 데이터의 수신과 관련된 데이터가 저장되므로, 상황발생시 추적성을 확보할 수 있게 되어 책임 소재를 명확히 할 수 있게 될 뿐만 아니라, 송, 수신측에 설치된 프린터에 의하여 송신된 기상 정보가 각각 인자됨으로써, 기상 정보를 시각적으로 파악 할 수도 있게 되는 유용한 효과가 있다.

title_en: Static engine and neural network for a cognitive reservoir system
abstract_en: Implementations described and claimed herein provide systems and methods for developing a reservoir. In one implementation, observed data points in a volume along a well trajectory and well logs corresponding to observed data points are received at a neural network. Feature vectors are generated using the neural network. The feature vectors are defined based on a distance between each of the observed data points and randomly generated points in the volume. A 3D populated log is generated by propagating well log values of the feature vectors across the volume. Uncertainty is quantified by generating a plurality of realizations including the 3D populated log. Each of the realizations is different and equally probable. core values are generated from the realizations, and a static model of the reservoir is generated by clustering the volume into one or more clusters of rock types based on the core values.

title_en: Deep reinforcement learning-based economic dispatching method for cogeneration system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an economic dispatching method of a cogeneration system based on deep reinforcement learning, which comprises the following steps that S1, aiming at an operation model of the cogeneration system, a Markov chain model is utilized to describe the operation model, and an objective function and a constraint target in an optimization method are strictly converted respectively and proved; s2, the DPPO algorithm in the improved deep reinforcement learning is used for training the intelligent agent under various running states, and firstly, running data can be randomly generated in a reasonable running range by the running environment before each training round starts; the in-round intelligent agent generates a control strategy according to the current internal neural network parameters and interacts with the operation environment; and after the round is finished, the method takes the maximum in-round accumulated rewards as a target for back propagation, optimizes the network parameters of the intelligent agent, and learns economic dispatching strategies corresponding to different running states of the cogeneration system. The invention greatly improves the convenience of use. And simultaneously has better convergence performance.

title_en: Cascade hydropower station group water level prediction method and device and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascade hydropower station group water level prediction method, a cascade hydropower station group water level prediction device and a computer readable storage medium, and the technical key point of the invention is that a K-means++ clustering algorithm is used for identifying the current hydrologic state of a cascade hydropower station group so as to accurately divide hydrologic periods; based on the method, the sequence prediction method based on the LSTM network is utilized, and the collected hydrologic information and the meteorological information are combined to predict the water level of the cascade hydropower station group. The invention can accurately predict the water level change condition of the subsequent period according to the running condition of the cascade hydropower station and the surrounding hydrologic and meteorological condition changes, thereby providing basis for the dispatching running of the hydropower station and improving the overall economic benefit and risk prevention capability of the cascade hydropower station group.

title_en: Electromagnetic transient fault analysis method, device and equipment based on large model
abstract_en: The application discloses an electromagnetic transient fault analysis method, device and equipment based on a large model, wherein the method comprises the steps of preprocessing real-time operation information obtained from a power grid to obtain time sequence operation information, carrying out fault reasoning analysis according to the time sequence operation information based on a preset fault analysis large model and a thinking chain technology to obtain a fault analysis result, wherein the fault analysis result comprises a fault position, a fault type and a fault root cause, and analyzing the cascading effect of faults according to a space-time feedback reasoning chain in the preset fault analysis large model by combining power grid topological structure information and the fault analysis result to obtain a fault influence analysis result. The method and the device can solve the technical problems that the analysis precision is insufficient, the calculated amount is large, and the influence analysis and evaluation are difficult to carry out aiming at various faults of different types in the prior art.

title_en: Evaluation method and system for power distribution communication network under extreme disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses an evaluation method and system of a power distribution communication network under extreme disasters, which are characterized in that a double-network coupling model of a 10kV line of a power distribution system, a power grid node failure model under the extreme disasters and a communication node failure model after power grid node energy supply is lost under the extreme disasters are constructed, the correlation characteristics of a power distribution system power grid and the communication network are fully considered, the failure conditions of the power grid node and the communication network are accurately judged, probability distribution of the power grid node flowing through wind speed under the extreme disasters is generated, the wind speed condition is truly simulated, a basis is provided for judging the power grid node failure, and cascading failure simulation is carried out based on the double-network coupling model of the 10kV line of the power distribution system, the power grid node failure model under the extreme disasters, the communication node failure model after power grid node energy supply is lost under the extreme disasters and the probability distribution of the power grid node flowing through wind speed under the extreme disasters, so that the reliability of the communication network is evaluated, and the reliability of the communication network is improved.

title_en: Power equipment operation state prediction and anomaly simulation method based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power equipment operation state prediction and abnormal simulation method based on digital twinning, and relates to the technical field of power grid operation. According to the method, the prediction and abnormal simulation of the running state of the power equipment are realized by establishing a digital twin model and real-time data analysis of the power equipment. The method comprises the steps of constructing a digital twin model by analyzing the physical structure, the operation characteristics and the load distribution of the power equipment, performing multidimensional analysis on real-time data by utilizing edge calculation, extracting electrical characteristics and behavior patterns, generating an equipment state data set, constructing an abnormal causal chain model based on the model and the data set, identifying a fault mode caused by uneven load or overload, and evaluating the influence of the abnormal state on the stability and the efficiency of the power system through virtual simulation and fault propagation analysis to obtain an abnormal influence index of the power equipment. The accuracy of power equipment fault prediction is improved, the stability and efficiency of a power system are optimized, and support is provided for intelligent operation and fault early warning.

title_en: Fault evolution analysis method for power transmission and distribution-gas comprehensive energy system under extreme typhoon disaster
abstract_en: The invention provides a fault evolution analysis method of a power transmission and distribution-gas integrated energy system under an extreme typhoon disaster, which is characterized by calculating time-varying fault probability of a power transmission and distribution network element based on a mechanical stress model of typhoon-rain load, generating an initial breaking set through Monte Carlo sampling, identifying a serious overload line caused by power flow transfer and executing protection cutting through affine power flow calculation of power transmission and distribution network coupling, analyzing a power transmission and distribution-gas load shedding strategy by adopting a dynamic affine model, combining a natural gas pipe existence equation and an electric-gas coupling equipment operation constraint, quantifying the influence of power line breaking on pressure fluctuation and pipe existence change of a natural gas system, balancing overload power of a general overload line, processing a bilinear term, adopting rotary second-order cone relaxation to convert non-convex constraint, and quantifying the natural gas system fault propagation risk caused by power transmission and distribution line breaking and power transmission and gas load shedding by combining the coupling operation constraint of an electric drive compressor, a gas turbine and electric-gas conversion equipment.

title_en: Multifunctional cascade multi-network converged communication guarantee system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of communication guarantee, in particular to a multifunctional cascade multi-network fusion communication guarantee system which comprises a central console, a plurality of groups of leakage cable communication lifesaving illumination lines and a plurality of groups of wire coils, wherein one end of the central console is cascaded with the wire coils through the leakage cable communication lifesaving illumination lines, cascade expansion is realized between adjacent wire coils through the leakage cable communication lifesaving illumination lines, the leakage cable communication lifesaving illumination lines are wound on the wire coils, and the leakage cable communication lifesaving illumination lines can be optionally wound and unwound according to actual demands during use. The multifunctional cascade multi-network fusion communication guarantee system solves the problems of communication coverage, multi-service data transmission, guiding illumination, power supply coordination and the like in a closed environment and a complex environment through wired and wireless multi-mode fusion communication, a wide-frequency-band cable leakage transmission technology and an integrated design, improves the fire rescue efficiency and the self safety, guarantees the smooth communication of various devices of firefighters, and achieves no communication.

title_en: Fire Sign Detection System of Power equipment
title_ko: 전력설비의 화재 징후 감지 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire sign detection system of a power facility, which is attached to a fire weakness part to detect a fire sign in advance to prevent a fire through inspection guidance, and is easily installed in a clip form and manufactured in a micro size to save installation costs and make low power driving possible. The fire sign detection system of a power facility comprises: a plurality of arc detection units coupled to a plurality of power cables of a power facility, respectively, and detecting a resistance heat generated according to generation of an arc to transmit an arc detection signal to the outside through wireless communications; a transmission terminal formed in the power facility to receive the arc detection signal detected by each of the arc detection units and transmit the arc detection signal to the outside; a relay receiving the arc detection signal from the transmission terminal, and amplifying the arc detection signal to overcome a wave shadow zone and extend and enlarge a transmission distance; a collector receiving the arc detection signal from the relay to collect arc information data generated from the power facility; and a management server receiving, storing and analyzing data on the arc information of the power facility collected from the collector.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재 취약 부분에 부착하여 화재 징후를 사전에 감지함으로써 점검 유도를 통해 화재를 미연에 방지함과 더불어 클립 형태로 설치가 용이하고 초소형으로 제작하여 설치비를 절감과 함께 저전력 구동이 가능하도록 한 전력설비의 화재 징후 감지 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 전력설비 중 다수의 전원 케이블에 각각 결합되고 아크 발생에 따라 발생하는 저항열을 검출하여 무선 통신을 통해 외부로 전송하는 다수의 아크 검출부와, 상기 전력설비에 구성되어 상기 각 아크 검출부로부터 검출된 아크 검출신호를 전달받아 외부로 전송하는 전송 단말기와, 상기 전송 단말기로부터 아크 검출 신호를 전달받아 증폭하여 전파 음영지역을 극복하고 전송거리를 연장 및 확장하는 중계기와, 상기 중계기로부터 아크 검출 신호를 수신하여 상기 전력 설비에서 발생하는 아크 정보 데이터를 수집하는 수집기와, 상기 수집기로부터 수집된 상기 전력설비의 아크 정보에 대한 데이터를 전달받아 저장하고 분석하는 관리 서버를 포함하여 구성되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Cascade type fire detector base with positioning and communication functions
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cascading fire detector base with positioning and communication functions, which comprises a base shell and a base circuit board, wherein bus terminals are arranged in the base shell, and the circuit board integrates an RJ45 network port, a memory, a switch chip, a network transformer, a network chip, a Bluetooth chip power chip, a radio frequency switch, a double antenna and an LED indicator lamp. The base is connected with the fire-fighting two buses through bus terminals to supply power to the detector and provide an interface, and is connected with an external PoE switch through an RJ45 network port to realize network power supply. The network data is transmitted to the switch chip through the network transformer, and the network chip is connected with the switch chip through the transformer to realize data forwarding. The Bluetooth chip controls the network chip to receive and transmit control and positioning information through TCP/IP. The power chip reduces the high-voltage direct current to 3.3V, supplies power for each module, and isolates interference through the magnetic beads. The Bluetooth chip is connected with the radio frequency switch, switches the dual antennas to receive and transmit data, and the modules work cooperatively to realize the functions of positioning, communication and cascading.

title_en: Power grid cascading fault diagnosis, early warning, assessment system based on monitoring information
abstract_en: The present invention relates to electric power network technique fields, and in particular to a kind of power grid cascading fault diagnosis, early warning, assessment system based on monitoring information.The system includes power grid cascading fault diagnosis subsystem, power grid cascading fault pre-alarming subsystem, power grid cascading assessment of failure subsystem；Diagnosis of the power grid cascading fault diagnosis subsystem for electric network fault is inquired；The power grid cascading fault pre-alarming subsystem is used for the early warning analysis to electric network fault；The power grid cascading assessment of failure subsystem provides assessment report for assessing electric network failure diagnosis, warning information.This system realizes relevant device information and concentrates access, solves the problems, such as the discrete storage of different device-dependent messages, pass through authority data source, the ex-post analysis of monitoring of tools information is prejudged and is handled into advance evaluation, thing transformation, utilize big data analysis technological means, monitoring information analysis intelligent level is increased substantially, provides more efficient and practicability technical support for Centralized Monitoring operation.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;TELLHOW SOFTWARE CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent energy system fusion station based on ubiquitous power Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent power grids, in particular to a smart energy system fusion station based on ubiquitous power Internet of things, which comprises an energy station, an energy storage station, a data center, a charging station and a switching station, wherein the data center comprises a cold channel type machine room, computer equipment, communication equipment, a machine room fire-fighting system and a UPS (uninterrupted power supply), the computer equipment and the communication equipment are both arranged in the cold channel type machine room and are powered by the UPS, the UPS is connected with commercial power, the computer equipment is connected with the communication equipment, the machine room fire-fighting system is arranged in the cold channel type machine room, the fire-fighting state of the computer equipment is monitored, and fire is extinguished when a fire occurs, the energy station comprises a gas generator set and a lithium bromide water chilling unit, the energy storage station comprises a high-voltage cascade energy storage device, and the charging station comprises an intelligent power supply and a plurality of charging piles: all stations are coordinated and matched, so that the construction cost is saved, and the economic benefit is improved.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD JIAXING POWER SUPPLY CO

title_en: Computer-implemented method for providing technical selection parameters of an energy supply system, computer program product for providing such technical selection parameters, and computer system for providing such an energy supply system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a computer-implemented method for providing technical selection parameters for an energy supply system that supplies electrical energy to a facility connected to a public power grid that may experience a service disruption, the computer-implemented method comprising the steps of: inputting a power consumption schedule of the facility (S1); inputting a photovoltaic production capacity limit and an energy storage unit capacity limit (S9); estimating a ratio of self-sufficient or self-consumed or internal rate of return (S11); displaying a plurality of energy supply system configurations on a user interface device (S13); wherein each configuration is associated to a sensitivity parameter allowing to determine an optimized technical sizing parameter of the energizing system with respect to the reliability of the utility grid. The invention also relates to a computer program product intended to be executed on a computer system to implement the computer-implemented method.

title_en: Electric power market clearing method, system, device and medium containing cascade hydropower
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a system, a device and a medium for clearing an electric power market containing cascade hydropower. The method comprises the steps of obtaining unit operation boundary conditions, power grid operation boundary conditions, daily water level control interval information and quotation data of each unit in the electric power spot market, wherein the unit operation boundary conditions, the power grid operation boundary conditions, the daily water level control interval information and the quotation data are issued by an electric power dispatching mechanism, and further obtaining a day-ahead safety constraint unit combination model comprising hydraulic constraint conditions of a cascade hydroelectric generating unit; and clearing the power market in the future by using the operation cost minimization of the units as a target function to obtain the clearing result of the output of each unit. According to the embodiment of the application, in the clearing model of the electric power spot market, the upstream and downstream coupling relation of the cascade hydroelectric generating sets is considered, the cascade hydroelectric generating sets are linearized through hydraulic constraint conditions, the safety constraint unit combination model is embedded to perform clearing, normal operation of all levels of hydroelectric generating sets is facilitated, and resource waste caused by water abandonment of a hydropower station is reduced. The method and the device can be widely applied to the technical field of electric power.

title_en: Method and device for improving power grid benefit and stable operation of power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for improving power grid benefit and stable operation of a power system, wherein the method comprises the steps of inputting parameters to construct a unit combination objective function, cascade hydroelectric power and thermal power and system constraint; establishing a unit combination model of the cascade hydroelectric power and thermal power considering a complex vibration area, and solving the model; and applying the solution to a power system according to the solution result to reduce the output fluctuation and the start-stop times of the thermal power generating unit. The invention establishes the cascade hydroelectric-thermal power system unit combination model considering the characteristics of the complex vibration region, effectively avoids the problems of poor safety of a power system, low operation benefit and the like caused by flexible peak regulation operation of hydroelectric in the vibration region, and has important significance for ensuring the safe, stable and economic operation of a power grid.

title_en: Method for predicting depth and midrange of seismic source based on physical information neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for predicting depth and center distance of a seismic source based on a physical information neural network, which aims to solve the technical problems of low prediction precision of the depth and center distance of the seismic source and poor interpretability of a data driving network. The method for predicting the depth and the midrange of the seismic source comprises the following steps: 1. three-component earthquake motion records are selected from the data set to serve as input parameters, and the corresponding earthquake focus depth and earthquake focus middle distance are used as label parameters; 2. establishing a deep neural network comprising a convolution layer and a residual block, adopting a linear rectification function as an activation function, adopting an Adam self-adaptive optimizer to perform counter propagation, and combining a mean square error function and a seismic wave travel time difference equation as a loss function; 3. training a deep neural network model; 4. and predicting the depth and the midrange of the seismic source. The invention adopts the deep neural network which integrates the physical information, not only can improve the prediction precision, but also can ensure that the deep neural network model has a certain interpretation, and improves the prediction precision.

title_en: Dynamic risk assessment method for photovoltaic-containing power grid by short-term power prediction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photovoltaic power grid dynamic risk assessment method utilizing short-term power prediction, which comprises the following steps: according to the historical power output of the photovoltaic power generation field and the current weather forecast parameters, obtaining a power forecast value of the photovoltaic power generation field in the power grid, and establishing a fault propagation mechanism model for simulating the evolution process of the power failure accident of the system; according to the model, carrying out simulation on power failure accidents, and recording four index data of node voltage deviation, system load rate, load loss rate and inertia loss rate; and screening a plurality of groups from the index data, and calculating weights of four indexes by adopting a comprehensive weighting method combining an objective entropy weighting method and an improved analytic hierarchy process to obtain a risk assessment result. According to the invention, the dynamic power output prediction is carried out on the power system containing the photovoltaic power generation, the index data is obtained by simulation under the power system fault propagation mechanism model, the index weight is calculated, the power grid dynamic risk assessment result is obtained, and the assessment is accurate.
assignees: HENAN JIUYU ENPAI ELECTRIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network cascading failure risk assessment method and system with large-scale distributed energy access
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network cascading failure risk assessment method and system with large-scale distributed energy access, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring circuit fault data, output state data of a photovoltaic unit and load level data of a target power distribution network; establishing a distributed photovoltaic low voltage ride through capability uncertainty model based on circuit fault data, output state data of a photovoltaic unit and load level data of a target power distribution network, and a power distribution network fault scene set containing large-scale distributed energy access; and simulating the uncertainty model of the distributed photovoltaic low voltage ride through capability, outputting the average power shortage amount in each scene, and evaluating the cascading failure risk. The invention considers the uncertainty of the low voltage ride through capability of the distributed generator set in the risk assessment of the cascading faults of the power distribution network containing large-scale distributed energy access, has more accurate assessment results, and can accurately predict the propagation paths of the cascading faults.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Multi-time-scale operation scheduling method for power grid considering pumping storage and step hydropower
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power systems and discloses a power grid multi-time scale operation scheduling method considering pumping storage and cascade hydropower, which comprises the following steps of S1, deducing bidirectional coupling relations of different time scales by considering the characteristics of a pumped storage multi-basin cascade hydropower station; the method comprises the steps of S2, constructing a annual scheduling model, a pericycle scheduling model and a daily scheduling model, S3, establishing a robust optimal scheduling strategy based on a confidence interval, and S4, outputting a scheduling scheme through the robust optimal scheduling strategy of the confidence interval. The invention has the advantages that each index of the long time scale plan and the short time scale plan can be considered, the two-way coupling relation of different time scales is considered, and simultaneously, the peak regulation requirements in the week and the day are ensured, so that the multiple targets of power supply protection, consumption protection and economy are achieved.
assignees: CHANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;SICHUAN ENERGY INTERNET RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF TSINGHUA UNIV

title_en: Graph theory-based electric CPS vulnerability assessment method and system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of power system application, in particular to a graph theory-based power CPS vulnerability assessment method and a graph theory-based power CPS vulnerability assessment system, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing an unauthorized network topology model of a power CPS network, and acquiring nodes of the power CPS network, connecting edges among the nodes and load voltage data of the nodes; the method comprises the steps of obtaining load abnormality of each node of a power CPS network, obtaining voltage recovery responsiveness of each node of the power CPS network, obtaining operation robustness of each node of the power CPS network, obtaining communities and associated communities of each community in the power CPS network, obtaining voltage abrupt change time sequences of each node in the power CPS network, obtaining cascading failure degree of each community in the power CPS network, obtaining cascading criticality of each community in the power CPS network, obtaining vulnerability factors of the power CPS network and evaluating the vulnerability of the power CPS network. The application reduces the risk of damaging the safety of the power system.
assignees: BOYUAN ELECTRICAL TECH XIAN CO LTD

title_en: Cascade power station scheduling parameter access and influence factor prediction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a step power station scheduling parameter access and influence factor prediction method, which relates to the technical field of power station scheduling and comprises the following steps of obtaining operation parameter data of each step power station, including but not limited to flow, output, storage capacity and water level; multidimensional impact factor data is collected relating to power plant scheduling, including meteorological data, geographic data, and hydrographic data. According to the method, the reservoir water level is accurately predicted through multi-source data fusion and deep learning, prediction errors are reduced, scheduling is optimized, and the method is especially suitable for extreme weather. The feedback adjustment mechanism is introduced to reduce water waste and improve the water and electricity utilization efficiency and the flexibility of the power grid. And by combining an intelligent optimization algorithm and deep reinforcement learning, a scheduling scheme is dynamically adjusted, so that the utilization of water and electricity resources is maximized, the safety of a power grid is ensured, overload or insufficient supply of loads is avoided, and the emergency response capability and stability of the power grid are enhanced.
assignees: HUANENG TIBET YARLUNG ZANGBO RIVER HYDROPOWER DEVELOPMENT AND INVEST CO LTD

title_en: Construction and resolving method for optimal scheduling model of cascade hydropower station
abstract_en: The invention discloses a construction and resolving method of an optimal scheduling model of a cascade hydropower station, and relates to the technical field of construction of optimal scheduling models of cascade hydropower stations. According to the invention, by means of the dynamic optimization scheduling method, the cascade hydropower station can optimize water resource allocation according to hydrologic changes, power grid requirements and reservoir adjustment capacity, so that the water energy utilization rate is improved, and water abandoning is reduced. Under the support of power grid load prediction, the output of the hydropower station is adjusted, the peak regulation capacity is enhanced, and the stability of the power system is improved. The successive approximation dynamic programming algorithm is adopted, so that the calculation complexity of multi-reservoir joint optimization is reduced, the scheduling efficiency is improved, the overall scheduling is optimized by combining with the artificial intelligent algorithm, and the economical efficiency and the reliability of the operation of the cascade hydropower station are ensured.
assignees: HUANENG TIBET YARLUNG ZANGBO RIVER HYDROPOWER DEVELOPMENT AND INVEST CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for adjusting energy consumption of machine room based on AI
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for adjusting energy consumption of a machine room based on AI, which relate to the technical field of energy consumption adjustment, and the method collects all energy consumption devices in the machine room, calculates the importance of each energy consumption device on the work of the machine room, and screens out primary devices and secondary devices; training the preprocessed data by deep learning, capturing the change trend of the energy consumption data along with a time sequence, constructing an energy consumption prediction model, training the preprocessed data by using a convolutional neural network, performing feature learning on equipment state data, constructing a fault early warning model, calculating the correlation between equipment faults and energy consumption changes, analyzing the influence degree of the faults on the energy consumption to obtain a fault energy consumption function, constructing a fault propagation map in a machine room, performing real-time monitoring on the energy consumption data in the machine room by combining the energy consumption prediction model and the fault early warning model, and preparing an energy source regulation strategy according to different monitoring results.
assignees: BEIJING YINGFENGTE ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Low-voltage distributed multi-energy complementary coordination green power consumption conversion system and optimization method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-voltage distributed multifunctional complementary coordinated green power consumption conversion system and an optimization method, wherein data acquisition and state monitoring are realized by acquiring output data of a distributed energy unit in real time through a communication module of an intelligent control unit, the power supply reliability is improved to 99.99%, a plug-and-play interface supports flexible access of newly added distributed energy or load, a system architecture is not required to be reconstructed, and the system is suitable for multiple scenes such as villages, industrial parks, micro-grids and the like. The intelligent control unit is compatible with DL698, modbus and other multiprotocol communication, can be used for seamlessly butting the existing power grid dispatching system and accelerating the application of technology to land, and the invention comprehensively improves the digestion capacity, the operation efficiency and the reliability of low-voltage distributed green power and provides key technical support for low-carbon transformation of a novel power system through the innovative integration of multi-energy complementary configuration, multi-form energy storage fusion, intelligent cooperative regulation and control and cascade utilization technology.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECHNICAL RES INSTITUTE STATE GRID SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Intelligent regulation and control method, device, equipment and medium for energy storage-mechanical load energy matching
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent regulation and control method, device, equipment and medium for energy storage-mechanical load energy matching. The regulation and control method comprises the steps of generating a restarting risk coefficient and a no-load time length by analyzing mechanical load starting and stopping state data, constructing a dynamic credibility weight matrix by combining the risk coefficient and the no-load time length, building a weighted directed topology network based on the matrix and energy storage capacity and load requirements, generating an optimal allocation decision matrix by constraint optimization solution, and when sudden restarting of equipment is detected, positioning conflict equipment according to the decision matrix, calculating compensation capacity and freezing time length to form an energy storage regulation and control scheme. The method effectively solves the problem of system breakdown caused by capacity deficiency occupation conflict during cooperative operation of multiple devices, rapidly isolates the conflict during sudden restarting of the devices through a dynamic risk quantification and intelligent buffer mechanism, avoids cascading faults, and remarkably improves the system stability and the energy utilization rate.

title_en: Geothermal pipe network intelligent monitoring method and system based on edge calculation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geothermal pipe network monitoring, in particular to a geothermal pipe network intelligent monitoring method and system based on edge calculation; the method comprises the steps of collecting sound pressure signals, vibration signals and pressure signals in real time, carrying out first-order differential calculation based on the pressure signals to obtain a differential pressure change sequence, inputting the sound pressure signals and the vibration signals into a micro-seismic intelligent recognition model, outputting micro-seismic risk quantization scoring indexes, generating execution regulation and control instructions, recording execution feedback data to form a micro-seismic scoring feedback data set, carrying out time sequence reconstruction on the differential pressure change sequence by using a nerve differential equation model, identifying an abnormal propagation source point and a shortest propagation path, constructing a water hammer propagation response structure, transmitting the micro-seismic scoring feedback data set and the water hammer propagation response structure to a cloud platform, and carrying out real-time monitoring and early warning on the state of a geothermal pipe network. The invention realizes the intelligent monitoring and tracking of the slight earthquake abnormal state and the water hammer effect of the geothermal pipe network.

title_en: Meteorological-driven rural highway risk prediction method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a weather-driven rural highway risk prediction method which comprises the steps of constructing a road-weather double-map structure based on input road network information and weather lattice point information, fusing roads and weather information based on a cross-domain attention propagation mechanism, generating road-weather fusion feature vectors, introducing road physical attribute vectors based on the generated road-weather fusion feature vectors, carrying out feature interaction fusion and nonlinear modulation through fusion physical priori feature modulation to obtain feature vectors modulated through physical constraint, inputting the modulated feature vectors into an edge-center collaborative reasoning frame to carry out risk prediction, carrying out collaborative calculation of edge nodes and center nodes to realize local quick response and global fine optimization, carrying out model parameter update through a prediction-inspection hierarchical feedback mechanism based on the result of the risk prediction, and generating a visualized risk map and management strategy. The method can realize rural highway risk prediction with high precision, high real-time performance and long-term self-adaption capability.
assignees: FUJIAN PROVINCIAL TRANSPORTATION RESEARCH INST CO LTD;UNIV FUJIAN

title_en: Critical risk identification method, system and storage medium based on social network analysis and gravitation model
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of complex system risk management, and relates to a key risk identification method, a system and a storage medium based on social network analysis and an gravitation model. Firstly, constructing a risk factor network model of a complex system, calculating the centrality, the middle centrality, the near centrality and the feature vector centrality of each risk factor by using a social network analysis method, normalizing the indexes, and determining the quality of the risk factor by an exponential function and a maximum and minimum normalization method. Secondly, the strength of action among risk factors is characterized by using Jaccard similarity coefficients, and the risk propagation distance is defined. And finally, calculating the gravitation values among the risk factors based on the quality and the propagation distance among the risk factors, and realizing the identification of the key risks by summarizing the total gravitation of each risk factor. The invention can comprehensively reflect the structural characteristics and the action intensity of risk factors in a complex system and improve the scientificity and accuracy of risk identification.

title_en: Systems and methods relating to effective management of fluid infrastructure
abstract_en: Fluid stream management systems and methods are described. An exemplar fluid stream management system includes a neural network connected to a cascading treatment processor. The neural network calculates an initial distant flow condition attribute value for a distant fluid treatment facility. The cascading treatment processor using hydrological information and the initial distant flow condition attribute value computes a predicted modified contribution value for the distant fluid treatment facility. The cascading treatment processor instructs multiple fluid flow controllers, each of which controls the operation of a flow-directing device such that a sum of the predicted modified total load value and a real time total load value of the distant fluid treatment facility is minimized. The real time total load value of the distant fluid treatment facility is based upon real time measurements obtained from one or more of the distant fluid treatment facility sensors.

title_en: Minimization of service interruption
abstract_en: User equipment (UE) may detect a disaster condition, and the resolution thereof, based on broadcast information, RRC messaging, NAS messaging, the ability to connect to an allowable PLMN, and indications from forbidden PLMNs. In a disaster condition, a UE may perform an enhanced PLMN selection procedure wherein, for example, the UE will not consider PLMNs that are in a disaster situation if the disaster situation applies to a current location of the UE, prioritize forbidden PLMNs for disaster roaming connection. For disaster roaming connection, the UE may be configured by an otherwise forbidden PLMN with information about what services the UE can access and what type of authentication procedure the network is able to perform with UE. Upon detecting that the disaster condition is over, the UE move back to an allowable PLMN.

title_en: System translation look-aside buffer integrated in an interconnect
abstract_en: System TLBs are integrated within an interconnect, use a and share a transport network to connect to a shared walker port. Transactions are able to pass STLB allocation information through a second initiator side interconnect, in a way that interconnects can be cascaded, so as to allow initiators to control a shared STLB within the first interconnect. Within the first interconnect, multiple STLBs share an intermediate-level translation cache that improves performance when there is locality between requests to the two STLBs.

title_en: Recursive graph convolution network system for power grid transient stability evaluation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a recursive graph convolution network system for power grid transient stability assessment. The invention designs a new graph relation matrix of a convolution layer by taking line admittance as a reference to form a special graph convolution network, and adopts a graph convolution algorithm to realize transmission and fusion of power grid node state information based on topological relation; the space extractor comprising the special graph convolution network is cascaded with the time sequence extractor comprising the long and short memory network (LSTM), and a time pooling layer is designed behind the time sequence extractor to aggregate the prediction results of a plurality of time steps, so that a recursive depth graph convolution model suitable for power grid stability assessment is formed, and space layer and time layer characteristic aggregation and characteristic extraction of power grid state quantity data can be sequentially realized, so that a power grid transient stability assessment system established based on the space extractor can adapt to the change of a power grid topological structure, excellent generalization capability is shown, and the assessment result is accurate.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and medium for analyzing failure disaster chain of gas pipeline
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a device, equipment and a medium for analyzing a disaster chain of a gas pipeline failure, which relate to the technical field of gas pipeline analysis and comprise the steps that when a natural gas pipeline failure disaster occurs, all disaster events of the current natural gas pipeline are taken as nodes in a network, induction factors among the disaster events are taken as directed edges in the network, and a disaster chain network is constructed according to the nodes and the directed edges; the method comprises the steps of calculating topological structure parameters comprising an input degree, an output degree, a total degree value and a clustering coefficient in a disaster chain network, determining an evolution mechanism of failure disaster chain risk propagation of the current natural gas pipeline based on the topological structure parameters, calculating the risk degree of the failure disaster chain of the current natural gas pipeline based on the disaster rate, the loss degree and the directed continuous edge weakness degree of the disaster chain network, and analyzing the current natural gas pipeline according to the evolution mechanism of failure disaster chain risk propagation of the current natural gas pipeline and the risk degree of the failure disaster chain of the current natural gas pipeline.

title_en: Emergent universal multimedia device
abstract_en: The utility model is suitable for rescue aid technical field, provides a kind of emergent universal multimedia device.Including：Radio station, industrial personal computer, radio station transmitting-receiving modular converter and power module, the working frequency in radio station and the working frequency of external radio trunk desk are coincide, for sending and receiving RI radio intelligence, radio station connection radio station transmitting-receiving modular converter, radio station transmitting-receiving modular converter connection industrial personal computer, industrial personal computer is equipped with the voice software to communicate with exterior terminal equipment, and power module is respectively radio station, industrial personal computer and radio station transmitting-receiving modular converter power supply.After using the above program, radio signal can be networked by network when disaster occurs, to obtain the preferably real-time circulation of rescue effect and enhancement information, it is and easy to carry, it can be placed in specified region and use, be conducive to the propagation of information, the rescue of the convenient stranded masses, and the device is cheap, convenient for promoting.

title_en: Method and system for optimally dispatching cascade reservoirs on basis of quantum-behaved particle swarm algorithms
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for optimally dispatching cascade reservoirs on the basis of quantum-behaved particle swarm algorithms. The method includes acquiring initialized population according to established objective functions for solving problems for optimally dispatching the cascade reservoirs and utilizing the initialized population as parent-generation particles; constructing small-world networks to obtain adjacent matrixes; updating the parent-generation particles according to the adjacent matrixes and generating child-generation particles; computing the fitness of the child-generation particles according to fitness functions; comparing the fitness of the parent-generation particles to the fitness of the child-generation particles by the aid of competition operators, selecting the child-generation particles with the good fitness and utilizing the selected child-generation particles as parent-generation particles for next iteration; judging whether current iteration numbers are larger than the maximum thresholds or not; carrying out computation if the current iteration numbers are larger than the maximum thresholds and outputting cascade reservoir optimal dispatching computation results. The method and the system have the advantages that the quantum-behaved particle swarm algorithms are improved by small-world network models, so that the population diversity can be kept by improved algorithms, the shortcoming of easiness in trapping in local optimization of basic quantum-behaved particle swarm algorithms can be overcome, and effects of optimally dispatching the cascade reservoirs can be improved.

title_en: A kind of short-term load forecasting method of multi-model fused neural network
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of short-term load forecasting method of multi-model fused neural network, step are as follows: data acquisition and pretreatment obtain data set；It is training set and verifying collection by Segmentation of Data Set；Individually a variety of models of the construction based on back-propagation algorithm, use the input vector sequence training pattern of training set；Use the output of a variety of independent models as input one top layer DNN model of training；By individually trained model and top layer DNN Model Fusion, accurate adjustment is carried out；Trained model is verified with verifying collection, by the precision and error of contrast test collection and verifying collection, adjusts model parameter, by repeatedly training, the model for selecting verifying collection to behave oneself best is as training result；When relatively large deviation occur in predicted value and actual value training set training pattern again is added in latest data by moving model in the actual environment.The present invention reduces the complexity of deployment by the way of independent training, combination tuning, and precision is better than single model, has good practical value.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;UNIV NORTHEASTERN;SHENYANG ELECTRIC POWER SURVEY AND DESIGN INST CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Wind power prediction method based on weighted fuzzy clustering
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind power prediction method based on weighted fuzzy clustering, which comprises the following steps: 1, selecting strongly relevant meteorological features based on a grey correlation theory; dividing a key meteorological feature set into data sample subsets by using a feature weighted fuzzy C-means clustering algorithm, and performing classified modeling by using a back propagation neural network; and 3, calling a model most similar to the characteristics of the current time period to predict the power, and synthesizing a plurality of prediction models by utilizing the membership function to confirm the wind power output of the model in order to perfect the affiliation of the boundary data. According to the method, the matching degree of meteorological features and the sample subset is strengthened from two angles of classification modeling and feature matching, potential relation is mined from the randomly fluctuating wind power signals, and the prediction precision of the wind power model is improved.
assignees: ENERGY RES INSTITUTE ANHUI PROVINCE ENERGY LABORATORY OF COMPREHENSIVE NATIONAL SCIENCE CENTER;FERTILIZER COMBINING INDUSTRIAL UNIV

title_en: Fault information early warning system and method based on power equipment inspection knowledge graph
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power inspection information processing, and particularly relates to a fault information early warning system and method based on an inspection knowledge graph of power equipment. The system extracts relevant corpus of the power equipment from a corpus of the power equipment through a knowledge graph construction module and constructs a patrol knowledge graph of the power equipment; the information transmission module based on the iterative characterization enhanced graph convolution neural network utilizes the constructed power equipment inspection knowledge graph, and combines the iterative characterization enhanced graph convolution neural network to enable fault information of the power equipment to be transmitted among different equipment; and the early warning information identification module carries out fault judgment on the propagated information and carries out early warning. The invention enables the early warning information to be transmitted among different power equipment nodes, and accurate judgment is carried out in fewer power equipment samples.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD EHV BRANCH;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;ELECTRIC POWER SCIENT RES INST STATE GRID JIANGXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Fault analysis simulation method and device for energy system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fault analysis simulation method and device for an energy system, which are used for obtaining an admittance matrix of the power grid system by acquiring data information generated by an electricity-gas integrated energy system in operation and performing steady-state modeling based on standard information of the power grid system and obtaining a time sequence two-port transmission matrix of the natural gas system by performing dynamic modeling based on the standard information of the natural gas system; the method comprises the steps of determining initial fault information of the comprehensive energy system, determining a fault propagation strategy according to the initial fault information, carrying out power flow scheduling simulation on the power grid system and the natural gas system when faults occur according to the fault propagation strategy and the admittance matrix, and obtaining load shedding conditions of all nodes in the power grid system and the natural gas system when the power flow scheduling simulation is carried out, so that personnel can evaluate the comprehensive energy system according to the load shedding conditions.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Active power distribution network two-stage planning method and device considering network attack
abstract_en: The invention provides a two-stage planning method and device for an active power distribution network considering network attacks, which comprise the steps of giving corresponding punishment cost coefficients according to node importance degrees, establishing an objective function, carrying out first-order planning on line reinforcement and remote control switch deployment on the objective function according to preset expense budgets, constructing first-order planning decision constraints, carrying out second-order planning on the objective function according to line faults and propagation of the line faults under attack scenes based on the first-order planning decision constraints, obtaining second-order planning decision constraints, solving the objective function according to the first-order planning decision constraints and the second-order planning decision constraints, and obtaining optimal defense strategy and optimal planning strategy vectors corresponding to worst attack scenes, so that the active power distribution network can be regulated and controlled according to the optimal defense strategy and the optimal planning strategy vectors.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Electric power spot market price prediction method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention provides an artificial intelligence-based electric power spot market price prediction method and system, which relate to the technical field of electric power price prediction and comprise the steps of calculating influence factor weights based on historical transaction data and external associated data by utilizing a deep reinforcement learning optimization fuzzy reasoning system, carrying out wavelet transformation decomposition on the data to obtain a characteristic fluctuation sequence, and carrying out weighted fusion to generate a market characteristic fusion sequence; the method comprises the steps of constructing a bidirectional feedback neural network by using a graph attention network, extracting market transaction characteristics, generating characteristic correction parameters, generating a layered early warning signal by combining a cascading forest algorithm, constructing a dynamic market behavior characteristic map, inputting an optimized characteristic map into a prediction model group comprising a plurality of prediction sub-models, realizing information sharing and complementary learning by a cross-modal characteristic interaction module, generating an initial prediction result, carrying out constraint correction according to an intelligent clearing rule, correcting the correction prediction result, and finally outputting the predicted price of the electric power spot market.
assignees: BEIJING REAL WISDOM POWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: LNG cold energy cascade utilization equipment and high-pressure gas storage tank capacity collaborative configuration optimization method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for optimizing collaborative configuration of LNG cold energy cascade utilization equipment and high-pressure gas storage tank capacity.
