The method comprises the steps of establishing LNG cold energy cascade power generation-refrigeration capacity configuration and operation models, establishing high-pressure gas storage tank capacity configuration and operation models according to optional number parameters of the high-pressure gas storage tank, taking distributed resources in a multi-functional micro-grid system, purchasing electricity with an upper power grid and balance constraint of electric-cold-gas multi-energy flows into consideration, aiming at minimizing total configuration investment cost and operation cost in a planning period, establishing a multi-functional micro-grid energy management optimization model comprising LNG cold energy cascade utilization, constructing fuzzy sets based on Wasserstein distance according to prediction data of new energy output and electric-cold-gas load during planning, converting the models into two-stage distribution robust collaborative configuration optimization models, and solving to obtain the optimal configuration capacity of the LNG cold energy cascade utilization equipment and the high-pressure gas storage tank.

title_en: Intelligent traffic analysis platform and method for multi-source data fusion for smart city
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent traffic analysis platform and method for multi-source data fusion for smart cities, and relates to the technical field of traffic data analysis. The method comprises the following steps of S1, collecting traffic analysis data in real time, preprocessing the data, S2, dividing an urban traffic network into different space units and different time periods, constructing a space-time joint characteristic data set, quantifying the sensitivity of each space unit and time period combination, screening a sensitive area, S3, quantifying the abnormality degree aiming at the space unit and time period combination of the sensitive area, performing time space clustering and positioning, S4, generating a corresponding emergency response strategy, synchronously evaluating the abnormal risk propagation probability among the space units, adjusting the space early warning range and emergency scheduling measures, and performing visual display and parameter optimization. The problem that traffic anomalies in the edge space and abnormal time periods are easy to ignore and high-risk points of the masses are difficult to discover in time due to the fact that the traditional traffic analysis technology is generally focused on the central hot spot area is solved.
assignees: ZHONGXING HAOTIAN BEIJING CONSTRUCTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power grid cascading failure deduction and elastic recovery collaborative decision method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a collaborative decision method and a collaborative decision system for power grid cascading failure deduction and elastic recovery, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a state model of each power grid element in extreme weather, and acquiring the state transition probability of each power grid element in continuous time according to the state model; the method comprises the steps of constructing a system cascading failure evolution model under extreme weather according to state transition probability, calculating line real-time outage probability under a wind power grid-connected scene according to the system cascading failure evolution model, constructing an optimal power flow model according to the line real-time outage probability with minimized load shedding amount as a target, simulating a derating operation response process after grid failure to obtain a load reduction strategy of a system under each failure state, establishing a post-disaster emergency recovery model based on the load reduction strategy and system topology constraint, and determining a fault repair time sequence and a load recovery sequence. The invention can obviously improve the risk perception capability, decision scientificity and recovery efficiency of the power grid in an extreme event.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD NINGBO POWER SUPPLY CO

title_en: Intelligent risk identification method and system for energy adding station
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of industrial Internet of things and edge computing, in particular to an intelligent risk identification method and system for an energy adding station; the method comprises the steps of deploying a sensor network at an energy adding station, synchronously collecting signals, extracting multi-scale time-frequency and physical response characteristics, mapping heterogeneous characteristics to energy flow fingerprints through a mixed projection model, carrying out self-calibration enhancement by utilizing a differential baseline, decoding and mapping the energy flow fingerprints into semantic characteristics, identifying candidate abnormal modes through short-term trend analysis and multi-source cross correlation and calculating local abnormal scores, constructing a physical semantic constraint local causal network based on the candidate abnormal, deducing an abnormal propagation path, quantifying node risk contribution, grading and positioning key risk sources, packaging risk information into a token matching strategy library, executing a transactional action chain according to a grading intervention principle, monitoring effects in real time and supporting rollback upgrading. The invention realizes real-time identification, causal deduction and intelligent dynamic response of the energy adding station risk.
assignees: JIANGSU YUNPENG INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: System for providing observation data for marine environment
title_ko: 해양환경 관측자료 제공시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for providing observation data of the marine environment. The collects data from various institutions, monitors and analyzes the environment on the basis of the data, and provides a forecast and a warning through an information prediction, and more efficient, accurate and specialized marine environmental information. The system comprises: a network group having an environmental information server which senses the marine environmental information on a specific area, according to a predetermined period or in response to a request from a monitoring server, and stores the same; a communication system which is dually built with the internet and the telephone network on the basis of wired (RS485 module) and wireless (DASH7 module) communications; a marine environmental collection system which builds a marine environment database through a data collection unit which receives marine environmental data from the environmental information server of the network group via the communication system; a prediction/analysis system which predicts marine disasters and analyzes the marine environment by using the collected data through the marine environmental collection system; and condition propagation system which propagates the predicted and analyzed marine disaster condition via the communication system.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 다양한 기관주체들로부터의 데이터를 수집하여 이를 토대로 해양환경을 모니터링, 분석하고 정보예측을 통해 예보 및 경보를 보다 효율적이며 정확하고 전문화된 해양환경정보를 제공할 수 있는 해양환경 관측자료 제공시스템으로 기 설정된 주기 또는 모니터링 서버의 요청에 따라 특정 지역에 대한 해양 환경 정보를 센싱하여 저장하는 환경정보 서버를 가지는 네트워크 그룹과, 유선(RS485 모듈)과 무선(DASH7 모듈)을 기반으로 인터넷과 전화통신망으로 이원화하여서 구성된 통신 시스템과, 상기 통신 시스템을 통하여 네트워크 그룹의 해양정보 서버로부터 해양환경 자료를 수신하여 해양정보를 수집하는 데이터 수집부를 통해 해양환경 데이터베이스를 구축하는 해양환경 수집시스템과, 상기 해양환경 수집시스템을 통해 수집된 정보를 이용하여 해양 재난 예측 및 해양환경을 분석하는 예측/분석 시스템 및, 상기 예측 및 분석된 해양 재해 상황을 통신 시스템을 통해 전파하는 상황전파 시스템을 포함하여 제공된다.

title_en: Reduce the propagation of the message flooding in computer network
abstract_en: A kind of computer network (400) comprises the first switch (435) and neighboring switch (440), wherein, owing to transmitting disappearance, described first switch (435) carries out inundation to described computer network (400), and described neighboring switch (440) serves as barrier is transmitted in the extraneous areas of described computer network (400) to prevent described inundation.The method reducing the inundation in computer network (400) comprise when made by first network switch (435) new transmit entry time intentionally inundation is carried out to computer network, thus make to be included in and newly transmit information in entry by adjacent networks switch (440) record, it stops the message received on suitable destination port subsequently.

title_en: Regional multi-system double-layer distributed optimization scheduling method considering double-layer carbon emission optimization distribution model
abstract_en: The invention provides a regional multi-system double-layer decentralized optimization scheduling method considering a double-layer carbon emission optimization distribution model, which constructs the regional multi-energy system double-layer carbon emission optimization distribution model, wherein an upper-layer multi-energy main system mainly considers a power distribution network, a gas distribution network and a heat distribution network system, real-time carbon emission constraints of the upper-layer multi-energy main system are formulated based on real-time environment monitoring, historical carbon emission of each multi-energy subsystem in a lower-layer region is decomposed in real time to each multi-energy subsystem in the lower-layer region, and each multi-energy subsystem in the lower-layer region needs to meet the real-time carbon emission constraints while being optimized; and finally, solving a double-layer dispersion optimization scheduling model of the multi-energy system in the region between the upper layer and the lower layer by adopting an improved target cascade analysis method. The method can reduce the total network loss of the upper distribution network system of the regional multi-energy system, reduce the operation cost of each energy subsystem in the lower region, and determine the optimal distribution scheme of the whole carbon emission of the regional multi-energy system.

title_en: Noise reduction method for constructing secondary channel estimation by using neural network, computer readable storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a noise reduction method for constructing secondary channel estimation by utilizing a neural network, a computer readable storage medium and electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a second neural network model, and taking the second neural network model as secondary channel estimation S' (z) in an adaptive feedforward type active noise reduction architecture based on the architecture. The invention changes S' (z) into the second neural network model to realize the estimation of the secondary channel more accurately, and improves the harmonic wave and intermodulation distortion phenomenon caused by nonlinear links in the propagation path from the B-bit loudspeaker to the C-bit error microphone.

title_en: Hydropower station emergency escape exercise method, system, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a hydropower station emergency escape exercise method, a hydropower station emergency escape exercise system, a storage medium and electronic equipment, and relates to the technical field of emergency exercises, wherein the method comprises the following steps: establishing a cascade hydropower station VR virtual reality server infrastructure supporting multi-person collaboration; establishing a dynamic emergency environment generation model based on the historical emergency accident data; designing emergency escape simulation resources according to a dynamic emergency environment generation model; remotely monitoring escape performance of each user in the escape process, and judging whether the user is in an acceptable range; the escape performance emergency coefficients of different drilling groups are obtained through calculation, and improvement suggestions are provided for an emergency escape drilling command center, a team and a user; the invention solves the problems that the common emergency exercise flow is difficult to truly simulate the actual emergency situation, and the exercise flow is complicated and single in configuration or is limited by time, space and resources, so that a large amount of manpower and material resources are wasted.

title_en: Intelligent electricity-saving scene building method based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of three-dimensional modeling of computer graphics, and particularly relates to an intelligent electric field protection scene building method based on digital twinning. The invention comprehensively collects the running, state and power grid topology data of the equipment. And (3) deeply analyzing the equipment relationship by combining the improved graph neural network with multi-scale and time sequence characteristic modeling. The key is that the electricity-keeping scene is constructed by comprehensively considering the equipment fault probability, fault propagation and load fluctuation based on the digital twin model. And the dynamic simulation simulates the evolution of the power grid, and the influence of the scene on the stability of the power grid is accurately evaluated. The method can dynamically adjust the scene according to the actual working condition, effectively improve the scientificity and effectiveness of the construction of the electricity-protecting scene, ensure the stable operation of the power grid and provide powerful support for electricity-protecting work of the power system.

title_en: Disaster roaming method, device and system
abstract_en: The application provides a method, a device and a system for disaster roaming, which can reduce service interruption of terminal equipment, realize minimum service interruption and improve user experience. Specifically, the terminal equipment determines a first Public Land Mobile Network (PLMN) according to the stored information of the PLMN; the information of the disaster roaming PLMN comprises identification information of at least one PLMN allowing the terminal equipment to carry out disaster roaming, and the first PLMN is a PLMN in the at least one PLMN; the terminal equipment sends a registration request message to the first PLMN, wherein the registration request message comprises disaster roaming indication information, and the disaster roaming indication information is used for indicating the terminal equipment to request disaster roaming registration; and the terminal equipment receives the registration acceptance message sent by the first PLMN.

title_en: Power battery cascade utilization decision method and system based on scene matching
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field related to power battery recycling and discloses a power battery cascade utilization decision method based on scene matching, which comprises the following steps: acquiring cascade utilization standard use parameters of the power battery in various practical application scenes and basic parameters and performance parameters of the power battery; constructing a neural network classification model, and training by using an original data set; and comparing the obtained performance parameters of the power battery with standard use parameters of cascade utilization of the power battery in various practical application scenes based on the trained neural network classification model, and further obtaining a decision result of the cascade utilization of the power battery. The invention also discloses a corresponding system. By the method and the device, big data can be processed more quickly and comprehensively, decision efficiency and accuracy are improved, and the problems of disassembly depth decision of various retired power batteries and decision matching with various practical application scenes can be solved effectively.

title_en: Intelligent inversion method, system and storage medium for tunnel lining disease change characteristics
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent inversion method, a system and a storage medium for tunnel lining disease change characteristics, wherein the intelligent inversion method comprises the following steps: performing geological radar data acquisition on the tunnel lining area to be detected in a plurality of different time periods to obtain B-scan data of the tunnel lining area to be detected in a plurality of time periods; respectively carrying out synthetic aperture focusing algorithm processing on the B-scan data of each time period to correspondingly obtain focused B-scan data, and forming two-dimensional B-scan data pairs corresponding to each time period of the tunnel lining area to be detected; respectively inputting the two-dimensional B-scan data pairs corresponding to each time period into the trained neural network model; the neural network model is formed by cascading a time phase slice inversion module and a phase slice inversion module through a four-dimensional inversion module; and outputting the dielectric constant model corresponding to each time period by the neural network model to obtain the change characteristics of the defects of the tunnel lining area to be detected. The invention realizes the dynamic detection of the diseases in the area to be detected and can greatly improve the working efficiency and inversion stability.
assignees: CHINA COMMUNICATIONS 2ND HIGHWAY SURVEY DESIGN & RES INST

title_en: Power supply area dividing method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power supply area dividing method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: determining a power supply area to be divided and an infection probability matrix of nodes of the power supply area; updating the states of nodes in the power supply area according to the infection probability matrix and the virus transmission model, and dividing the nodes with the same virus information into corresponding power supply areas; acquiring at least one node and node power, dividing the node into power supply areas, and determining at least one benefit value of the power supply areas divided by the node; and determining nodes in at least one power supply area according to the maximum profit value. According to the technical scheme, the power supply area is divided through the virus propagation model and the constructed infection probability matrix, the power supply area divided by the nodes is determined based on the maximum benefit value calculated by the cooperative game theory, dynamic division of the power supply area is realized, and the robustness, rationality and scientificity of the division of the power supply area of the power grid are improved.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;HUIZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Quantitative evaluation method and system for fire risk of distribution network equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quantitative evaluation method and a quantitative evaluation system for fire risks of distribution network equipment, wherein the quantitative evaluation method comprises the steps of obtaining distribution network equipment data, constructing a quantitative first risk evaluation model based on the data, carrying out preliminary risk judgment based on the quantitative first risk evaluation model, analyzing fault transfer risks and calculating overall risk state values, constructing a quantitative second risk evaluation model for predicting the change condition of risk parameters, dynamically updating the overall risk state values, and carrying out fire risk early warning by combining the change condition of the risk parameters. According to the method, the transfer risk among the risk factors of the equipment can be dynamically monitored by calculating the starting condition value and the propagation threshold value according to the fuzzy membership degree of the nodes of different risk factors, and the nodes with high risk membership degree are amplified by calculating the risk contribution degree through the nonlinear function, so that the influence on the overall risk is more remarkable, and the influence on key nodes is facilitated to be highlighted when the overall risk of the system is evaluated.

title_en: Foundation deep three-dimensional vibration testing device and method in dynamic compaction construction process
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of geotechnical engineering test, in particular to a device and a method for testing deep three-dimensional vibration of a foundation in a dynamic compaction construction process, wherein the device comprises a centering positioning pipe which is vertically inserted into the soil body of the foundation; the self-adaptive centering structure is arranged on the electric push rod-vibration sensor composite structure. According to the invention, through the real-time linkage of the multidimensional and adjustable deep sensing network and the construction process, the limitation of planarization and discretization of traditional monitoring is broken through, the dynamic tracking and three-dimensional reconstruction of the vibration wave full-space propagation track are realized, and the core technical support is provided for accurate regulation and control of ramming energy, quantitative evaluation of foundation treatment effect and active prevention and control of engineering disasters, so that the intelligent transformation from experience driving to data driving of dynamic compaction construction is promoted.
assignees: CHINA UNITED NORTHWEST INSTITUTE FOR ENGINEERING DESIGN & RES CO LTD

title_en: New unit equipment risk management and control and spare part demand optimization method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for risk management and control of new unit equipment and optimization of spare part requirements, and relates to the technical field of intelligent operation and maintenance, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting operation condition signals in real time, constructing a digital twin model of each part of the unit equipment, and forming a unified discrete state vector; the method comprises the steps of carrying out feature extraction on an operation condition signal according to a fixed window, combining process attributes to construct a Bayesian network of a layered causal structure, carrying out posterior reasoning on the Bayesian network through belief propagation to obtain the posterior probability of faults of causal nodes, calculating risk scores according to weights and result costs, carrying out life parameter estimation, simulating and predicting the demand by using Monte Carlo, and calculating the optimal spare part ordering quantity by combining inventory constraint. The method can discover potential risks in time, reduce unplanned shutdown, reduce inventory redundancy and capital occupation, and improve the safety, reliability and economy of operation of the new unit.
assignees: HUANENG HAINAN CHANGJIANG NUCLEAR POWER CO LTD

title_en: Data tracing method and device based on whole process management of equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a data tracing method and device based on equipment whole process management, and relates to the technical field of power grids. When a data abnormal event is detected, the unique identifier of the device is extracted, the time sequence data corresponding to the unique identifier of the device, the associated device state and the blood edge association relation are obtained through analysis by combining the blood edge map of the data in the blockchain database, and then source tracing reasoning is carried out through a causal reasoning model, an abnormal source, an abnormal reason and an abnormal propagation path are determined, and a data tracing result is automatically generated. The problem of grid equipment data blood relationship fracture and difficult tracing is solved, and automatic tracing of the grid equipment data is realized.
assignees: DIGITAL TECH BRANCH OF HEBEI ZHONGXING JINENG ELECTRIC POWER DEVELOPMENT CO LTD;INFORMATION & COMMUNICATION BRANCH COMPANY STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Method and system for separating and cleaning runoff of rainwater in water-deficient city
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of urban rainwater management, in particular to a method and a system for cleaning and diverting runoff of rainwater in a water-deficient city. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a distribution diagram of a road section easy to accumulate water and a distribution diagram of a rainwater pipe network, determining a pipeline section at risk of deposition, determining initial interception indexes according to rainfall data, determining starting shear stress according to continuous rainfall-free time, calculating effective shear stress in a pipeline in a diversion stage, calculating pollution propagation speed when the effective shear stress is not smaller than the starting shear stress, calculating predicted time for pollutants to reach a diversion node according to the pollution propagation speed, and introducing rainwater runoffs into a sewage treatment path when the predicted time and the pollution propagation speed meet requirements. According to the invention, the moving process of the lagged pollution peak is dynamically tracked and predicted through the double monitoring points, so that the rainwater recycling utilization rate is improved.

title_en: Integrated management system for industrial gas supply facility
title_ko: 산업용 가스공급 설비 통합 관리 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an integrated management system for an industrial gas supply facility including: an information collection unit including gas detection modules detecting gas leakage, fire detection modules detecting a fire, an earthquake detection module detecting an earthquake, and video recording modules imaging a monitoring target region, installed in the monitoring target region, collecting event information related to the occurrence of gas leakage, a fire, and an earthquake, and transmitting the collected event information through a communication network; a management server unit evaluating the occurrence or non-occurrence of gas leakage, a fire, and an earthquake by receiving the event information transmitted through the communication network from the information collection unit and generating and transmitting notification information including the event information and an event response method in a case where it is evaluated that gas leakage, a fire, or an earthquake has occurred; and an individual terminal unit receiving the notification information generated by the management server unit. According to the present invention, the system is capable of quickly detecting and distinguishing various types of gases leaking out of the monitoring target region and capable of determining whether a fire and an earthquake have occurred. As a result, industrial gas supply facilities can be safely managed. In addition, the event including gas leakage, a fire, and an earthquake can be quickly disseminated through the communication network and damage to people and properties can be minimized.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은, 가스 누출을 감지하는 복수 개의 가스 감지 모듈, 화재를 감지하는 복수 개의 화재 감지 모듈, 지진을 감지하는 지진 감지 모듈, 감시 대상 영역을 촬영하는 복수 개의 영상 촬영 모듈을 포함하고, 감시 대상 영역에 설치되어 가스 누출, 화재 및 지진 발생에 관련한 이벤트 정보를 수집하고, 수집한 이벤트 정보를 통신망을 통해 전송하는 정보 수집부; 통신망을 통해 상기 정보 수집부에서 전송한 이벤트 정보를 수신하여 가스 누출, 화재 및 지진 발생 여부를 평가하고, 가스 누출, 화재 또는 지진이 발생한 것으로 평가한 경우 이벤트 정보 및 이벤트 대응 방법을 포함하는 알림 정보를 생성하여 전송하는 관리 서버부; 및 관리 서버부에서 생성한 알림 정보를 수신받는 개별 단말부;를 포함하는 산업용 가스공급 설비 통합 관리 시스템을 제공한다. 
본 발명에 따른 산업용 가스공급 설비 통합 관리 시스템은 감시 대상 영역에서 누출되는 다양한 종류의 가스를 단시간에 검출 및 판별할 수 있고, 화재 및 지진 발생 여부를 판별할 수 있어 산업용 가스공급 시설을 안전하게 관리할 수 있고, 가스 누출, 화재, 지진을 포함하는 이벤트를 통신망을 통해 신속히 전파하도록 하여 인명 및 재산 피해를 최소화할 수 있다.

title_en: System for providing electric power supply service for cost reduction on basis of time-of-use rate plan, and method therefor
title_ko: 계시별 요금제를 기초로 비용 절약을 위한 전력 공급 서비스를 제공하기 위한 시스템 및 이를 위한 방법
abstract_en: Provided is a system for providing an electric power supply service for cost reduction on the basis of a time-of-use (TOU) rate plan. The system comprises: a service server which generates a transaction by signing, with a service private key, a smart contract comprising the details of a service to be provided to a user device, and which transmits the generated transaction to a blockchain network; and a plurality of node devices for forming the blockchain network. Here, a node device, among the plurality of node devices, that has succeeded at excavation extracts the smart contract from the transaction to generate a block comprising the extracted smart contract, and propagates the generated block to the plurality of node devices, and the plurality of node devices validate the block and, if validation is successful, connect the block to the blockchain.
abstract_ko: 계시별 요금제(TOU: Time-of-Use)를 기초로 비용 절약을 위한 전력 공급 서비스를 제공하기 위한 시스템이 제공된다. 상기 시스템은 사용자장치에 제공할 서비스 내역을 포함하는 스마트계약서를 서비스 개인키로 서명하여 트랜잭션을 생성하고, 생성된 트랜잭션을 블록체인네트워크로 전송하는 서비스서버와, 상기 블록체인네트워크를 형성하는 복수의 노드장치를 포함한다. 여기서, 상기 복수의 노드장치 중 채굴에 성공한 노드장치는 상기 트랜잭션으로부터 스마트계약서를 추출하여 추출된 스마트계약서를 포함하는 블록을 생성하고, 상기 생성된 블록을 상기 복수의 노드장치로 전파하고, 상기 복수의 노드장치는 상기 블록을 검증하고, 검증에 성공하면 블록체인에 상기 블록을 연결하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: The use of aggregation group for regulatory requirement resource response
abstract_en: Demand response manages system, can be used for managing the operation of demand response program related with the consumer of the output from communal facility, autonomous system operator etc., client, participant and user by communal facility, autonomous system operator, go-between etc..Demand response manages system and response events can provide the propagation of demand response signal according to demand and generate.There may be the aggregations of consumer, client, participant, user etc..Before initiating DR events and even before generating DR signal, which can be executed and managed by communal facility, autonomous system operator etc..

title_en: Dynamic emergency evacuation method for urban rail transit line failure
abstract_en: A dynamic emergency evacuation method for urban rail transit line failure relates to the technical field of rail transit control. The problem of the secondary propagation that leads to the fact the passenger flow is detained in the network to single station evacuation ability limited is solved. Establishing an attribute set and an operation state set of each station in a network; analyzing the passenger flow state of the station; using SAS software to predict subway passenger flow in short time, and simulating the passenger flow arrival process; determining an evacuation starting point and an evacuation finishing point; constructing an emergency state rail public transport collaborative evacuation network; constructing a path dynamic selection model in the end point range; determining an optimal evacuation path; determining the required number and the operation time interval of the emergency buses; determining the distribution rule of the passenger flow to be evacuated reaching the evacuation subway station; according to the rail transit train parameters, the train conveying capacity is determined, the subway station passenger flow is combined, the resource allocation is carried out on the train capacity, and a train operation scheme in an emergency state is formulated. The passenger flow evacuation capacity of a single node is increased, and the network evacuation efficiency is improved.

title_en: Multi-stage combined extension planning method and system for power transmission and distribution
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-stage combined extension planning method and a multi-stage combined extension planning system for power transmission and transmission, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of utilizing a fuzzy clustering method to reduce operation data with space-time characteristics to serve as a planning operation scene in a research period, respectively using the total life cycle cost and the cascading failure risk as economic and reliability targets, and using each horizontal year in the research period as a planning stage to establish a multi-target and multi-stage power generation and transmission combined expansion planning model for optimizing. The invention coordinates the economy and the operation reliability of the system in the whole research period, forms a progressive expansion planning mode with the network source structure matched with the load requirement, and can obtain the pareto optimal solution set and the recommended stage expansion planning sequence through optimization.

title_en: Service reliability and bandwidth recovery method based on multiple paths
abstract_en: The invention requests to protect a service reliability and bandwidth recovery method based on multiple paths, belonging to the technical field of communication networks. Aiming at the serious damage and threat of a large-scale disaster event to a backbone optical network, the method adopts a flexible route configuration and bandwidth supplement method to recover the damaged service in the network. In order to deal with the conditions of network resource shortage and network component reliability reduction after disaster, the routes and the number of recovery paths are dynamically adjusted according to the service reliability requirement, the bandwidth is distributed and adaptively upgraded according to the service bandwidth requirement in a balanced manner, and the routes and the bandwidth are further supplemented for the damaged service according to the resource utilization rate maximization principle, so that the performances such as the service interruption rate, the reliability, the bandwidth loss rate and the like are greatly improved.

title_en: Load optimization scheduling method, device, equipment and medium for cascade hydropower station
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, equipment and a medium for optimizing and scheduling load of a cascade hydropower station, wherein the method comprises the following steps: forecasting incoming water of the tap hydropower station and gradually optimizing the power generation process of the tap hydropower station; forecasting the incoming water of the current hydropower station by combining the optimization results of the gradual power generation process of the upper hydropower station, and gradually optimizing the power generation process of the hydropower station according to the respective forecasting results of the incoming water; and uploading the step-by-step power generation process optimization results of all levels of hydropower stations to a power grid dispatching center, extracting the cascade load plan, and carrying out cascade intra-group dynamic distribution on the load of each level of hydropower station by adopting a coefficient discrimination method according to the real-time operation index of each level of hydropower station. The invention completes the generation plan making of the cascade hydropower station by the combination of water forecast and water fixed power optimized dispatching, which is more consistent with the operation practice of the hydropower station; on the premise of meeting the step load plan, the generating water heads of all the steps are maintained in a certain range by a coefficient discrimination method, so that the water energy utilization rate is improved.

title_en: Complex dynamic oil reservoir simulation method based on adaptive physical meaning neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of oil deposit engineering and discloses a complex dynamic oil deposit simulation method based on an adaptive physical meaning neural network, which comprises the following steps of 1, acquiring complex production dynamic oil deposit development data; step 2, establishing an adaptive physical meaning neural network model, initializing model parameters and setting a production regulation schedule, step 3, responding to input initial pressure data of an oil reservoir, adjusting internal boundary conditions according to the production schedule, calculating gradients by forward propagation mapping and reverse propagation, step 4, updating saturation according to the pressure data output by the model, and step 5, iteratively executing the steps 3 and 4, and continuously solving the simulation process of the whole oil reservoir by using the pressure field output by each step and the neural network parameters obtained by training as input of the next step. The invention can be rapidly adapted to the severe change of the oil reservoir under the complex production dynamic state.

title_en: System reliability assessment method based on time sequence multi-layer complex network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a system reliability evaluation method based on a time sequence multi-layer complex network, which comprises the following steps: step one, space-time division of maintenance records; step two, constructing a single-layer network; step three, multi-layer network coupling; generating a super-adjacency matrix; step five, characteristic centrality solving; step six, extracting reliability indexes; step seven, evaluating the confidence coefficient; aiming at the problems of reliability prediction and warranty management of complex products, the invention creatively provides a time-aware multi-layer network framework, breaks through the limitations of system structure simplification and cascade fault neglect in the traditional reliability analysis, integrates the degradation short-term mutual dependence and cross-layer cascade failure mechanism of the product components by constructing a cross-layer time analysis network, and develops a super-centrality matrix and dynamic node centrality measurement, thereby systematically quantifying the influence of the product components on the system reliability and accurately identifying key nodes.

title_en: Coordinated standby-based multi-level scheduling operation solving method for national network province
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of grid collaborative optimization, in particular to a national grid province multi-level scheduling operation solving method based on collaborative reserve, which comprises the following steps of establishing a multi-level scheduling model considering collaborative reserve constraint according to each level objective function participating in cross-province energy scheduling and reserve scheduling; decomposing the multi-level scheduling model into sub-problems of a national scheduling level, a network scheduling level and a provincial scheduling level based on an augmented Lagrangian relaxation method, and carrying out collaborative solution on each sub-problem by utilizing a target cascading method to obtain a global optimal scheduling scheme. The multi-level dispatching operation solving method for the national province can provide references for exploring a multi-level cooperative dispatching mode suitable for the national province by constructing a national-network-province multi-level dispatching model considering a cooperative standby mechanism, and in addition, solves by adopting a target cascading method, not only considers actual and internal mechanisms of a power grid under each level, but also improves the optimal dispatching solving efficiency of a power system under the cooperation of the whole network.

title_en: Regional Ripple Impact Analysis System Based on Interconnection and Dependence of National Core Infrastructure
title_ko: 국가핵심기반시설 상호연계성 및 의존도 기반 지역 파급영향 분석 시스템
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide a regional spillover impact analysis system based on the interconnectivity and dependency of national key infrastructures, which analyzes the impact between facilities in the event of a functional outage or deterioration of individual national key infrastructures through a network-based scientific simulation that takes into account interconnectivity and dependency, by setting up a user scenario, and scientifically analyzes the spillover impact on the local community. The provided regional ripple impact analysis system based on the interconnectivity and dependency of national key infrastructures includes: database (10) comprising a national infrastructure DB (12), a local government DB, a statistics DB by department, a disaster statistics DB, and a local community disaster prevention capacity DB; a disruption risk scenario setting unit (20) that accesses the database (10), constructs a national key infrastructure and sub-facility DB in advance, selects national key infrastructures in each field, and then selects functions within the field; a facility-to-facility impact analysis module (30) that accesses the database (10) and constructs a national key infrastructure interconnectivity and dependency analysis matrix DB; and a community ripple impact analysis simulator (40) that selects variables of community impact due to national key infrastructures by constructing a DB for pre-impact relationship analysis.

title_en: Systems and methods for order-of-magnitude viral cascade prediction in social networks
abstract_en: Systems and methods for predicting order-of-magnitude viral cascades in social networks are disclosed.

title_en: Earthquake early warning terminal equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an earthquake early warning terminal equipment, including seismic data network center and early warning terminal, through communication module interactive connection between seismic data transceiver module and the seismic data network center, seismic data transceiver module's first signal output part is connected with the signal input part of the analytic module of seismic data, and the signal output part of the analytic module of seismic data is connected with seismic data output module's signal input part, and seismic data output module's signal output part is connected with seismic data display module's signal input part. The utility model discloses a seismic data receiving and dispatching module carries out seismic data information's collection, parses seismic data information through seismic data analysis module, adopts multiple approach to show the public to early warning information through seismic data output module and seismic data display module, and the ageing of propagation information is stronger and propagation approach and audience's scope is wider, can to a great extent avoid personnel's injures and deaths.
assignees: TIANJIN TASHI TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: A method of prediction and evaluation mud shale hydrofracturing split net propagation law
abstract_en: The present invention proposes a kind of prediction and evaluation mud shale hydrofracturing splits the method for net propagation law, and net system complex, fracture quantitatively characterizing be difficult, nothing clearly characterizes again in practical FRACTURING DESIGN for splitting of solving the problems, such as that mud shale formed after hydraulic fracturing.The research method of the present invention is that model engineering progress hydraulic pressure system first is split, then extraction mode splits net, then it carries out mode and splits network data, finally carry out the Research on Statistics and Analysis that number splits net, web area is split in concrete analysis, fracture length, width, the parameters such as fractal dimension, it is calculated by parameters such as fractal dimensions, counterincision net is counted and is characterized, obtain the extent of the destruction of shale, symbolize the complexity and expanded configuration for splitting net, it integrates shale extent of the destruction and splits net expanded configuration and can obtain and split net propagation law and hydrofracturing effect is evaluated, wherein rock failure mechanism of rock degree is more serious, it is generated that split net more complicated, shale hydrofracturing effect is better.

title_en: A kind of power grid vulnerable line classification method and device
abstract_en: The application provides a kind of power grid vulnerable line classification method and device, the described method includes: obtaining the fault chains of power grid to be processed, and the cascading failure fault chains set of power grid to be processed is calculated according to each fault chains, it is analyzed by the cascading failure fault chains set to power grid to be processed, obtain the weight index in power grid to be processed between each route, according to the weight index between each route, fragile type belonging to the route is determined from pre-set a variety of fragile types.Using power grid vulnerable line classification method provided by the present application and device, Accurate classification can be carried out to the route in power grid to be processed.
assignees: NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER UNIV BAODING

title_en: Method for predicting charging behavior of electric vehicle user based on BP neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for predicting charging behavior of an electric vehicle user based on a BP neural network, which comprises the following steps: step 1, data preprocessing. Step 2, determining training data, verification data and test data of the neural network; step 3, establishing a neural network architecture; step 4, selecting an activation function delta (z) and a loss function A cost function J (w, b); step 5, calculating a loss function by forward propagation from the input layer to the hidden layer And a cost function J (w, b); step 6, judging whether the calculated loss function meets the pair errorIf the requirement is met, jumping to step 7, if the requirement is not met, correcting the bias matrix b of the weight matrix omega by adopting a gradient descent method, and jumping to step 5 to recalculate by using the newly calculated weight matrix omega; and 7, using the trained weight matrix omega bias matrix b for testing data, and comparing and evaluating the obtained neural network prediction result with a real result. The invention provides a considerable and reliable basis for the charging behavior prediction.

title_en: Method for realizing BELLHOP underwater acoustic channel model based on NS3
abstract_en: The invention provides a BELLHOP underwater acoustic channel model realization method based on NS3, which can accurately calculate parameters required by sound field propagation calculation by using the BELLHOP model, thereby simulating a more real channel environment. The BELLHOP underwater acoustic channel model for UASNs network simulation based on NS3 breaks through the defect of channel propagation loss calculation of the original platform experience model, and provides a technical thought and implementation means for promoting the development of UASNs protocol simulation reliability; the accuracy of the sound field propagation calculation result is improved, and parameters required by sound field propagation calculation are accurately calculated by using the BELLHOP model, so that a more real channel environment can be simulated, the performance of a UASNs link layer and a routing protocol can be accurately evaluated, and a scientific basis is provided for rapidly developing and satisfying the UASNs protocols for military and civil use.

title_en: Baseline load prediction method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a baseline load prediction method, a baseline load prediction device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the baseline load prediction method comprises the following steps: acquiring historical load data and historical date data and predicted date data determined by indexes; determining principal components in the index and corresponding principal component comprehensive scores by adopting an entropy method-based improved principal component analysis method for a matrix formed by historical day data; calculating weather similarity between the predicted day and the historical day according to historical day data and predicted day data corresponding to the indexes divided by the principal component comprehensive score; determining a historical day set similar to the forecast day according to the weather similarity and the time similarity of the forecast day and the historical day; and obtaining the predicted daily load data by adopting a back propagation neural network according to the historical load data, the historical daily set, the meteorological matrix and the predicted daily data. The method and the device solve the problem that the data quality obtained by preprocessing the data before the baseline load prediction is not high in the related technology.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID SMART GRID RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Co-earthquake landslide susceptibility prediction CGboost algorithm
abstract_en: The invention provides a common-earthquake landslide susceptibility prediction CGboost algorithm, equipment and storage equipment, which are used for constructing a common-earthquake landslide influence factor set according to a common-earthquake landslide disaster-inducing environment and disaster-inducing characteristics; cross GAT was proposed based on GAT, simplified attention, and cascade aggregation; integrating CGBoost networks according to cross gat and XGBoost: coupling 2 branches of cross gat and XGBoost integrated learning, and extracting associated characterization of the inside of the slope units, between the slope units and between the prediction index and the susceptibility; inputting the same-earthquake landslide influence factor set into a CGboost network, carrying out self-adaptive weighted fusion on the associated features to obtain rich high-level features with higher discrimination, converting the high-level features into the probability of the vulnerability, carrying out the prediction of the vulnerability of the wide area, and grading the vulnerability of the wide area according to the probability of the vulnerability. The utility model provides a same earthquake landslide susceptibility prediction equipment and storage device for realize same earthquake landslide susceptibility prediction CGboost algorithm. The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows: the method is applied to the newly-generated large earthquake event in future, and the quick emergency landslide susceptibility prediction after earthquake is realized.

title_en: Method and device for monitoring voltage state of regional network point device
abstract_en: A voltage state monitoring method and equipment of regional network point equipment relate to the field of equipment monitoring, and the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of receiving voltage fault event information of regional network points, calculating a fault degree index according to fault voltage data, determining a fault propagation path by using a power grid simulation model if the fault degree is greater than a threshold value, acquiring equipment information of regional network point equipment on the path, calculating an influence index of the voltage fault on the regional network point equipment, generating corresponding fault response measures if the influence index exceeds the threshold value, sending a measure instruction to the regional network point equipment for execution, and simulating the fault propagation path of the voltage fault event, so that the monitoring range is enlarged, the voltage fault diffusion can be effectively prevented, the safe operation of key equipment is protected, the voltage fault is timely and effectively processed, and the reliability and the stability of the power grid operation are improved.
assignees: JIANGSU LINGJIN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: System security analysis method based on complex state network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a system security analysis method based on a complex state network, and belongs to the technical field of system security. The system refers to an aircraft overall system or an aircraft component system, and comprises the steps of constructing a finite state machine network comprising a state transition relation based on each key component of the system and a function influence relation among the key components, forming a state vector representing the overall state of the system at a certain moment based on the state of each key component at the moment, determining evolution rules of all the state vectors based on the finite state machine network, constructing a state evolution network of the system based on the evolution rules, determining a plurality of final vectors of the overall state of the system based on the state evolution network, determining risk levels of all the final vectors, and obtaining a safety analysis result of the system based on the risk levels and propagation paths corresponding to the final vectors. According to the invention, the safety boundary of the system state evolution is determined based on the attractor theory of the dissipation system, and the potential safety risk of the system is obtained through analysis, so that the early warning and avoidance of the risk are realized.

title_en: Intelligent park digital twin system and method based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent park digital twin system and method based on artificial intelligence, which particularly relate to the technical field of digital twin simulation optimization and are used for solving the problems of low simulation distortion and emergency preview reliability caused by insufficient dynamic relevance modeling of entity behaviors in the prior art, constructing a propagation path hierarchical analysis network by collecting entity attribute data and dynamic interaction behavior data in real time, identifying key disturbance nodes based on path length and behavior type division groups and individual behavior data and quantifying propagation path relevance strength of the key disturbance nodes, generating a simulation model adjustment strategy by dynamic change difference and relevance strength, correcting propagation direction and density weight parameters of the key nodes to generate a high-precision simulation result, and forming a virtual-real linkage closed-loop optimization system by reversely updating the behavior weight based on the relevance strength based on a feedback mechanism of non-key node behavior deviation so as to improve the reliability of digital twin simulation in a complex scene.
assignees: JINAN GAOPIN WEIYE INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Distribution network line fault detection data processing method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power system fault diagnosis and discloses a distribution network line fault detection data processing method, a system, equipment and a medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining load data of a target distribution line detection point, and performing first preprocessing on the load data to obtain a fusion feature vector; the method comprises the steps of carrying out second optimization operation on fusion feature vectors to obtain optimized fusion feature vectors, calculating potential feature matrixes according to the optimized fusion feature vectors, mapping the potential feature matrixes to a low-dimensional space to obtain a low-dimensional sample set, presetting an adaptive label propagation algorithm, carrying out fault category judgment on the low-dimensional sample set based on the adaptive label propagation algorithm, and storing judgment results in a relational database. The method effectively solves the problems of inaccurate feature extraction, insufficient new fault expansion capability of a classification model and the like in a high-noise environment, and improves the robustness of fault signal processing.

title_en: Mutation early warning model and mutation control method of E-commerce supply network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mutation early warning model and a mutation control method of an e-commerce supply network, and belongs to the technical field of e-commerce and supply chain management. Aiming at the cascade failure risk of an e-commerce supply network under an emergency public event, the invention constructs a multidimensional network model through a super network theory, characterizes the complex interaction relationship among suppliers, logistics nodes, e-commerce platforms and consumers, and dynamically updates a network structure based on real-time data. And analyzing the critical state of the network by adopting the mutation theory, and combining an intelligent optimization algorithm and a multi-agent simulation technology to realize the real-time early warning of the mutation risk. The control method effectively reduces the mutation influence and optimizes the network stability through the flow steps of dynamic monitoring, short-term optimization adjustment, intervention opportunity prediction, long-term topology reconstruction and effect evaluation. The invention breaks through the static limitation of the traditional model, remarkably improves the early warning accuracy, the response speed and the network toughness, and provides an innovative solution for the E-commerce platform to maintain high-efficiency operation under the emergency.

title_en: Multi-layer network cascade failure-based multi-mode intermodal network toughness assessment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-layer network cascading failure-based multi-mode intermodal network toughness assessment method, and belongs to the technical field of multi-mode intermodal network operation and toughness assessment. The method comprises the steps of constructing a public molten iron weighted undirected multilayer network model by adopting an ML-space method according to the multilayer structure of a multi-modal network and the characteristic of freight transportation circulation, calculating the multi-layer centrality and freight transportation level of nodes to determine node importance degree by fusing network topology and freight transportation attribute double view angles on the basis, constructing a load-capacity cascade failure model comprising initial load, node capacity and differential load distribution strategies by combining sub-network heterogeneity, constructing a full-stage toughness assessment system comprising resistance capacity, absorption capacity and recovery capacity on the basis of a toughness triangle theory, and comparing network toughness under different cascade failure and recovery strategies through MATLAB software numerical simulation to reveal the influence rule of node capacity coefficient on toughness. The invention starts from the actual operation scene of the multi-mode intermodal network, considers the multi-layer characteristics and the cascade failure propagation rule, provides the accurate evaluation method of the toughness of the multi-mode intermodal network under the cascade failure scene, and provides scientific references for planning construction, risk prevention and control and toughness improvement of the multi-mode intermodal network.

title_en: Voltage sag evaluation method and device
abstract_en: The application provides a voltage sag evaluation method and device. The application considers the voltage sag depth of the electric equipment, can improve the accuracy of the voltage sag, can furthest reduce the power interruption risk, and provides guarantee for the reliable and safe operation of the electric equipment. In the process of calculating the voltage sag depth of the electric equipment, the power grid coupling factor, the influence factor of the new energy equipment and/or the energy storage equipment and the comprehensive exposure index of the electric equipment are considered, the propagation and evolution process of the voltage sag in the power grid can be dynamically reflected, the evaluation accuracy and reliability are further improved, and the normal operation of the electric equipment is ensured. According to the application, the grading evaluation of the voltage sag is realized by setting different risk thresholds, different protection strategies can be provided for different power supply areas and different electric equipment, and the emergency response capability of the power supply areas and the electric equipment can be improved.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RESEARCH INST CO LTD

title_en: Composite energy storage topology simulation design optimization method for enhancing safety and stability of power grid
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of energy storage topology regulation, in particular to a composite energy storage topology simulation design optimization method for enhancing the safety and stability of a power grid, which comprises the steps of obtaining a high-frequency component of a history regulation period of a cascade multiport topology; the method comprises the steps of analyzing a peak value stage and regulating and controlling the requirement condition of the whole process on power energy storage, constructing an expected electric energy requirement classification model of each cascading multiport topology, inputting high-frequency components of a requirement frequency modulation period of a target cascading multiport topology into the expected electric energy requirement classification model to obtain the high-frequency requirement gain degree of the target cascading multiport topology, correcting the power of real-time high-frequency components of the target cascading multiport topology according to the high-frequency requirement gain degree, and performing scheduling optimization of the composite energy storage topology by utilizing the corrected real-time high-frequency components and real-time low-frequency components. The invention aims to avoid the situation that static energy storage is easy to judge the actual discharge capacity within the future duration time by mistake and improve the safety and stability of the composite topology.
assignees: ECONOMIC TECHNOLOGY RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV HUAZHONG SCIENCE TECH;XUJI ELECTRIC CO LTD

title_en: Dryer exhaust systems for fiber
title_ko: 섬유용 건조기의 배기장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an exhaust device, capable of preventing fire while discharging moisture and exhaust gas in a fiber dryer (1). The device comprises: an exhaust part (10) connected to the upper part of the dryer (1), and including an exhaust duct (11) discharging exhaust gas and moisture from the inside to the outside; a blocking part (20) including a blocking panel (21) blocking chain diffusion and oxygen supply by fire while controlling emission in the exhaust part (10), and an actuator (25) connected with the blocking panel (21) to open and close; a fire extinguishing part (30) installed in the exhaust duct (11) and the dryer (1), and including a nozzle (35) to spray fire extinguishing substances by receiving a signal of a sensor (31) sensing the fire by ignition; and a control part electrically connected with the blocking part (20) of the exhaust part (10) and the fire extinguishing part (30), and controlling power of the dryer (1) while controlling the fire extinguishing part (30) and the blocking part (20) according to a set sequence. Therefore, the present invention is capable of increasing facility efficiency and making the external appearance beautiful by making exhaust smooth by installing a cylindrical exhaust duct in a zigzag form, and blocking chain diffusion and oxygen supply by fire while controlling the amount of discharge air with precise balance by using the actuator and the blocking panel.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 섬유용 건조기(1) 내의 배기가스 및 수분을 방출하면서 화재를 예방하는 배기하는 장치에 관련되며, 그 구성의 특징으로서 상기 건조기(1)의 상부에 연통되게 장착되고, 내부에 배기가스 및 수분을 외부로 방출하는 배기덕트(11)를 구비하는 배기부(10); 상기 배기부(10)의 내부에 방출량을 조절하면서 화재에 의한 산소 공급과 연쇄확산을 차단하는 차단판(21)을 구비하고, 상기 차단판(21)과 연결되어 개폐시키는 엑추에이터(25)를 구비하는 차단부(20); 상기 건조기(1)와 배기덕트(11)의 내부에 장착되고, 발화에 의한 화재를 감지하는 감지기(31)의 신호를 전달받아 소화물질을 분사하도록 노즐(35)을 구비하는 소화부(30); 및 상기 배기부(10)의 차단부(20), 소화부(30)와 전기적으로 연결되고, 설정된 시퀀스에 따라 차단부(20)와 소화부(30)를 제어하면서 건조기(1)의 전원을 단속하는 제어부;를 포함하여 이루어지는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
이에 따라 본 발명은, 배기덕트를 원형의 통으로 양측을 지그재그 형식으로 장착하여 배기를 원활하게 해주어 설비효율을 높여주고 외관을 미려하게 함은 물론, 차단판과 엑추에이터를 이용해 배출에어의 양을 정밀한 밸런스로 조절하면서 화재에 의한 산소공급과 연쇄확산을 차단하는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Ship accident alarming system in an ocean
title_ko: 해양 사고 통보 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention provides a marine accident reporting system capable of automatically reporting a marine accident of a vessel on a voyage to neighboring vessels, being suitable when an accident occurs in a small vessel around littoral sea, and easily finding neighboring vessels around the vessel on a voyage. According to the present invention, the marine accident reporting system includes: an accident vessel including a communication control part transmitting an accident signal of the vessel through mobile communication or satellite communication; a communication network delivering the accident signal transmitted through the mobile communication or satellite communication; a disaster situation reporting server transmitting an accident spread signal to neighboring vessels if an accident situation is determined by analyzing the accident signal delivered from the communication network; and a vessel position database storing communication method information and position coordinate information of the accident vessel and neighboring vessels.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 항해 중인 선박에 사고가 발생하면 자동으로 주변 선박에 통보할 수 있고, 연근해에서 조업하는 소형 선박의 사고 발생시에 적합하며, 항해 중인 사고 선박의 주변에 위치한 선박을 찾아내기가 용이한 해양 사고 통보 시스템을 제공한다. 
본 발명에 따른 해양 사고 통보 시스템은, 이동통신방식 또는 위성통신방식으로 선박의 사고신호를 전송할 수 있는 통신제어부를 포함하는 사고선박; 상기 이동통신방식 또는 위성통신방식으로 전송되는 사고신호를 전달할 수 있는 통신네트워크; 상기 통신네트워크로부터 전달되는 사고신호를 분석하여 사고 상황으로 결정되면, 주변선박으로 사고 전파 신호를 송출하는 재난 상황 고지 서버; 및 상기 사고선박과 주변선박의 위치좌표정보와, 통신방식정보를 저장하는 선박위치데이터베이스를 포함한다.
assignees: LKWAY CO LTD;CHEJU HALLA COLLEGE INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION

title_ko: 원자력 발전소의 수소폭발 방지를 제공하는 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 원자력 발전소의 비상 보호에 관한 것으로,　특히 화재를 방지하고수냉식 발전소(WWER)로 원자력 발전소(NPP)의 보호 격납실(AO)에서 폭발성 가스의 축적을 방지하여 수소폭발 방지를 제공하는  기술에 관한 것이다. 또한,　제안된 본 발명은 다량의 경량 연료가스의 방출 및 시설의 닫힌 구내에서의 위치 파악과 관련하여 잠재적으로 위험한 비상처리를 유발할 가능성이 있는 다른 시설에 적용할 수 있다. 청구된 본 발명에 의해 달성된 기술적 결과는 다음과 같다. 원자력 발전소의 보호 범위 내에서 기체 매체를 점화할 가능성을 감소시키고,　약한 연소파의 자체 소멸 생성,　원자력 발전소의 보호 격납실에서 가스 환경의 점화시 원자력 발전소의 벽면에 가해지는 동적 하중을 줄여 충격강도를 약화시킨다. 이 기술적 결과는 원자로 발전소의 수소폭발 안전성을 확보하기 위한 방법으로서,　원자로의 보호 격납실의 환기 및 원자로의 보호 격납실 내의 수소 재조합을 촉매산화에 의해 행하는 것으로써 달성된다. 상기 해결책에 따라,　반사기가 보호 격납실에서 가압된 수소　함유 증기　-　가스 제트의 잠재적 우연한 전파경로를 따라 배치되며,　원자로의 격실 사이의 벽의 구멍(개구)는 이들 벽의 면적의　35%　이상의 크기로 형성되고, 수소 함유 증기　-　가스 혼합물의 연소의 초점의 잠재적인 위치의 장소에서 과도한 열이 제거된다.
assignees: ROSENERGOATOM;JOINT STOCK COMPANY SCIENCE AND INNOVATIONS SCIENCE AND INNOVATIONS JSC

title_en: A kind of modeling method of millimeter wave FET
abstract_en: The present invention provides the modeling methods of millimeter wave FET a kind of, comprising steps of millimeter wave FET to be divided into the input electrode in passive structures area and the grid source-drain electrode in output electrode and active structure area；Active structure area is divided into several level-one subelements along grid width direction；Calculate input electrode S parameter, output electrode S parameter and several level-one subelement S parameters of multiport network；Level-one subelement is divided into the second level subelement with grid index mesh equal parts, calculates the intrinsic parameters of second level subelement；The intrinsic parameters of input electrode S parameter, output electrode S parameter, several level-one subelement S parameters and second level subelement based on multiport network, connect to obtain the model of millimeter wave FET in a manner of matrix cascade.By the above-mentioned means, the present invention can simulate the influence of row wave effect when millimeter-wave signal is propagated in FET electrode, model accuracy is higher, can be used for frequency extrapolation, performance of the prediction device in higher frequency.

title_en: Medium-and-long-term load prediction method and device for power market
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a method and a device for predicting medium and long-term loads of an electric power market, wherein the method comprises the following steps: processing missing values and abnormal values of the historical daily load data and the corresponding index data, counting according to a preset time period to obtain load data and index time of the preset time period, and performing normalization processing; setting the number of hidden layer nodes of a feedback neural network model, the weight and the threshold of each connection, inputting the data after normalization processing into the feedback neural network model for calculation to obtain a predicted value, calculating the variance of the predicted value and the real-time power load, obtaining an adjusting formula of the weight and the threshold through a back propagation operation method according to the variance and the power cost, adjusting the weight and the threshold through the adjusting formula to calculate the predicted value, and repeating training until the predicted value and the variance of the actual charge accord with the preset variance or the iteration times to obtain the target feedback neural network model. The problem that the balance between the power cost and the prediction precision is not considered in the conventional power prediction method is solved.

title_en: Active power distribution network partitioning method based on graph convolution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an active power distribution network partitioning method based on a graph rolling network, which comprises the following steps: 1. establishing an active power distribution network undirected graph model; 2. preprocessing characteristic data of the active power distribution network node as a training sample; 3. constructing a graph convolutional neural network; 4. updating network parameters of the graph convolution neural network through a gradient descent back propagation algorithm; 5. and realizing the network partition of the active power distribution network according to the optimal model. According to the method, a complex mathematical optimization model for the partition of the active power distribution network is not required to be established and solved, so that the optimal partition result can be obtained, the time cost is reduced, and therefore the running, control and management instructions of the active power distribution network can be timely validated, and the voltage quality is improved.

title_en: Earthquake acquisition footprint denoising method based on unsupervised model driving type deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses an earthquake acquisition footprint denoising method based on unsupervised model driving type deep learning, which is applied to the field of earthquake data processing, and aims at the problem that the footprint removing effect is poor due to priori knowledge of hand making when an earthquake image has unexpected characteristics beyond the assumption of the earthquake image, wherein a model driving footprint removing network FR is provided for unsupervised acquisition footprint suppression without any valuable signal assumption, and a unidirectional total variation acquisition footprint model is designed by an FR-Net network according to the inherent directivity of noise. The depth convolution self-encoder is strongly regulated by using the UTV model, so that the FR-Net network is ensured to convert DCAE from complete data driving to model driving, and the advantages of the DCAE and the footprint model are inherited. The FR-Net network is optimized by a back propagation algorithm, projecting the complete separation of the footprint noise and the useful signal in an unsupervised manner.

title_en: Power transmission network cascading failure risk assessment device and method based on optimization domain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power transmission network cascading failure risk assessment device and method based on an optimization domain, which belong to the technical field of power transmission network failure assessment and comprise a cascading failure optimization domain generation module, a power transmission network cascading failure risk assessment module and a power transmission network cascading failure risk assessment module, wherein the cascading failure optimization domain generation module is used for constructing a cascading failure risk assessment model based on historical data and generating an optimization domain; the system comprises a power transmission network, a disconnection judging module, a cascading failure deduction module and a cascading failure evaluation module, wherein the power transmission network is used for transmitting a single fault to a power transmission network, the offline judging module is used for judging the on-network state of all generators in the power transmission network based on the current running state, the cascading failure deduction module is used for judging the cascading line failure caused by the single fault and updating an optimization domain based on the current topological state, and the cascading failure evaluation module is used for constructing the mapping from a running space to the optimization domain based on all potential renewable energy scenes so as to realize rapid cascading failure evaluation. The power transmission network cascading failure risk assessment device and method based on the optimization domain can effectively assess the influence of a large-scale scene on cascading failures, and can remarkably improve the speed and efficiency of cascading failure assessment.

title_en: Power grid key line identification method based on topology and operation characteristics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid key line identification method based on topology and operation characteristics, and belongs to the technical field of power grid key line identification. In the aspect of operation characteristics, an improved webpage link algorithm is adopted, the product of the initial load rate and the historical fault rate of each line is taken as an algorithm initial value, and the trend fluctuation caused by disconnection of each line on other lines is counted in sequence to construct a link matrix required by the algorithm. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a propagation matrix and a fragile matrix, obtaining a line key propagation value vector and a key fragile value vector of a power grid by adopting initial values and propagation/fragile matrix calculation, and obtaining a line key value by weighting and summing the key propagation value and the key fragile value of each line. The importance of the line on the local topology of the power grid is considered, the comprehensive degree of nodes at two ends of the line is constructed, a line key value correction coefficient is formed, and then a line comprehensive key value is constructed. And sequencing the comprehensive key values of all the lines, and identifying the line arranged in the front as a key line. The method can obtain the key degree of each line of the power grid and has certain effectiveness.

title_en: Fire Managing Method in Network, Intelligent Fire Extinguisher, and Managing Server Used Therein
title_ko: 지능형 소화 도구를 이용한 네트워크 상의 화재 관리 방법, 이에 사용되는 지능형 소화 도구 및 관리 서버
abstract_en: Disclosed are a fire management method on a network using an intelligent fire extinguisher, and an intelligent fire extinguisher and a management server used therein. The present invention comprises: a sensing unit using usage of the fire extinguisher by a user in a fire situation; and a communications unit transmitting a fire notice message in the case that the sensing unit senses the usage of the fire extinguisher. The present invention can provide fire situation propagation and escape information to people instantly in the case that the fire occurs. In addition, the present invention implements rapid fire situation propagation to a fire station and administrator under the control in the case that the fire occurs, thereby being capable of performing early fire suppression.
abstract_ko: 지능형 소화 도구를 이용한 네트워크 상의 화재 관리 방법, 이에 사용되는 지능형 소화 도구 및 관리 서버가 개시된다. 본 발명은, 화재 상황에서의 사용자에 의한 소화 도구의 사용을 감지하는 감지부, 및 감지부가 소화 도구의 사용을 감지하는 경우에 화재 알림 메시지를 송신하는 통신부를 구비한다. 본 발명에 따르면, 화재가 발생하는 경우 사람들에게 즉각적인 화재 상황 전파 및 대피 경로 정보를 제공할 수 있게 된다. 아울러, 본 발명에 따르면 화재가 발생하는 경우 관할 소방서 및 관리자 등에게 신속한 상황 전파가 이루어짐으로써, 조기 화재 진압이 가능하게 된다.

title_en: Automatic elevator call formation device and method using a pressure sensor tag-type wireless signal transmission module on a Braille sidewalk block for the visually impaired
title_ko: 시각장애인용 점자보도블럭상에서의 압력센서태그형 무선 시그널 송출모듈을 통한 엘리베이터 호출 자동형성장치 및 방법
abstract_en: Provided is an automatic elevator call forming device which generates a tag signal by sensing pressing pressure, activates a wireless antenna, and then transmits a wireless signal for automatically pressing an elevator call button to call an elevator. The automatic elevator call forming device using a pressure sensor tag type wireless signal transmission module on a braille sidewalk block for the visually impaired comprises: a braille sidewalk block pressure sensor tag type wireless signal transmission module (100) which transmits a wireless signal for automatically pressing an elevator call button to call an elevator to a wireless signal reader module; and a wireless signal reader module (200) which transmits a call button automatic pressing signal for automatically pressing an elevator call button to call an elevator. In the present invention, compatibility is excellent by being compatible with an existing braille sidewalk block through a powerless structure of a pressure sensor tag type wireless signal transmission unit consisting of a pressure sensor tag unit and a unidirectional powerless wireless signal transmission unit.
