abstract_ko: 본 발명에서는 종래 장애인이나 몸이 불편한 환자 등이 엘리베이터를 쉽게 호출할 수 있도록 하는 풋 버튼 기술, 엘리베이터 카의 호출장치의 경우에, 시각장애인이 엘리베이터 앞에 왔을 때 결국에는 시각장애인 스스로가 호출버튼을 눌러야 하기 때문에, 호출버튼을 찾지 못해 헤매다가 엘리베이터 문에 손이 끼는 안전사고의 문제점과, 바닥면에 시각장애인 전용 인식장비 설치시, 점자보도블럭과 호환되지 않고, 별도로 설치해야 하므로, 설치비용이 비싸지고, 무엇보다, 전기를 사용하기 때문에 전력소모가 많이 발생되는 문제점을 개선하고자, 점자보도블럭 압력센서태그형 무선 시그널 송출모듈(100), 무선 시그널 리더기모듈(200)로 구성됨으로서, 압력센서태그부, 단방향 무(無)전력 무선 시그널 송출부로 이루어진 압력센서태그형 무선 시그널 송출부의 무(無)전력구조를 통해, 기존 점자보도블록에 호환시킬 수 있어, 호환성이 우수하고, 기존보다 60% 저렴한 가격에 설치할 수 있으며, 무엇보다 전력소비 제로율과 함께, 밀봉효과가 우수하고, 배터리가 필요없어 별도의 유지보수가 필요없으며, 바닥 청소시, 물기 유입에 구애받지 않고, 정상구동시킬 수 있어, 실제 활용도를 기존에 비해 80% 향상시킬 수 있고, 시각장애인이 엘리베이터 앞의 점자보도블럭상에 위치했을때, 눌러지는 압력센싱에 의한 태그신호를 생성시켜, 무선 안테나를 활성화시킨 후, RFID 식별번호와 함께 시각장애인이 점자보도블럭부상에 있으므로, 엘리베이터 호출버튼이 자동으로 눌러지면서 호출되도록 하는 무선 시그널을 무선 시그널 리더기모듈쪽으로 송출시킬 수 있어, 시각장애인의 엘리베이터 앞 안전사고발생율을 기존에 비해 80%이하로 낮출 수 있으며, 점자보도블럭 압력센서태그형 무선 시그널 송출모듈에서, 무선 시그널 리더기모듈을 통해 형성된 RF송출거리인 50cm~100cm에 맞게, RF인식거리를 20cm~30cm로 형성시켜, RF전파(Radion waves) 에너지를 수신받고, 무선 시그널 리더기모듈쪽에 유도기전력을 발생시켜 신호화한 IC칩부의 고유정보를 전송시킬 수 있어, 기존에 비해 하중에 따른 센싱정밀성을 1.5배~3배 향상시켜, 엘리베이터 호출 자동형성 뿐만 아니라, 아파트나 병원의 현관문 자동 개폐시설, 경기장 입장객 압사사고방지용 하중계산 기초데이터, 건축물 붕괴사고 방지데이터에 널리 응용시켜 새로운 압력센서태그시장을 주도해 나갈 수 있는 시각장애인용 점자보도블럭상에서의 압력센서태그형 무선 시그널 송출모듈을 통한 엘리베이터 호출 자동형성장치 및 방법을 제공하는데 그 목적이 있다.

title_en: Ceiling-mounted electric vehicle charging system equipped with fire spread delay function
title_ko: 화재 확산 지연 기능을 구비한 천장형 전기차 충전 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 전기차의 주차 공간의 천장에 배치되는 것으로서, 주차된 전기차에 전력을 공급하는 충전 코드, 상기 충전 코드와 연결되는 연장 케이블 및 상기 충전 코드를 제어에 따라 인출 및 수납하는 충전 본체를 포함하는 천장형 전기차 충전부; 상기 충전 본체의 내부에 배치되고, 주차된 전기차와 연결되었을 때 통신을 통해 충전을 위한 전압과 전류를 확인하여 조정하고, 충전된 전력량을 측정하는 전기차 충전 제어부; 상기 충전 본체의 내부에 배치되고, 상기 전기차 충전 제어부와 통신 가능하며 전기차의 화재 발생을 감지하기 위해 구비되는 화재 감지 처리부; 상기 천장형 전기차 충전부의 외부에서 상기 전기차 충전 제어부 및 상기 화재 감지 처리부와 통신하며, 전기차의 배터리 상태정보와 충전 상태를 수집하는 전기차 충전 관제부; 및 상기 천장형 전기차 충전부의 외부에서 상기 화재 감지 처리부와 통신하며, 화재 발생을 수신하고 전파하는 시설 및 건물 화재 수신부를 포함하는 화재 확산 지연 기능을 구비한 천장형 전기차 충전 시스템에 관한 것이다. 이러한 본 발명에 따르면, 천장형 이동식 전기차 충전 시스템의 가지고 있는 설치 위치에 대한 이점을 활용하여 차량 화재 발생시 화재 발생을 빠르게 감지하고, 화재의 확산 속도를 늦추는 장치를 장착하여, 화재 피해를 줄일 수 있다.

title_en: A kind of AC-DC hybrid power grid cascading failure emulation mode
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of AC-DC hybrid power grid cascading failure emulation mode, comprising: S1, the parameter for determining power grid；S2, circulation emulation is carried out to power grid, relative to preceding primary emulation, improves generator capacity and load level according to a certain percentage, the capacity of the route of failure occurred before increasing according to a certain percentage in primary emulation；S3, all routes are emulated every time disconnect according to certain probability；S4, tide optimization is carried out to the power grid after broken string, judges whether there is route and reaches heavy duty, if there is route to reach heavy duty, enter S5, otherwise, into S6；S5, heavy-haul line is disconnected according to certain probability, S4 is then repeated if there is new line disconnects, otherwise, into S6；S6, judge whether simulation times reach preset times, if reached, terminate emulation, otherwise, repeat S2.Cascading failure emulation mode provided by the invention can take into account DC line model and direct current protecting measure, and the cascading failure suitable for AC-DC hybrid power grid emulates.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENT RES INST STATE GRID JIANGXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV HUAZHONG SCIENCE TECH

title_en: Cable formula seabed earthquake monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cable type submarine earthquake monitoring system, which comprises: a main subsystem and a plurality of secondary expansion subsystems; the main subsystem is formed by connecting two earthquake monitoring shore base stations on the shore with a plurality of primary ocean bottom earthquake monitoring stations in series to form an energy and data gathering connection network of the ocean bottom earthquake monitoring system; the secondary expansion subsystem consists of a primary ocean bottom earthquake monitoring station and a plurality of secondary ocean bottom earthquake monitoring stations which are cascaded layer by layer; the primary ocean bottom earthquake monitoring station is used for acquiring earthquake data and carrying out digital processing on the acquired data, receiving the data transmitted by the secondary ocean bottom earthquake monitoring station connected with the primary ocean bottom earthquake monitoring station, summarizing all the data and transmitting the summarized data to an earthquake monitoring bank base station; the secondary ocean bottom earthquake monitoring station is used for acquiring earthquake data, carrying out digital processing on the acquired data, receiving the data transmitted by the secondary ocean bottom earthquake monitoring station connected with the secondary ocean bottom earthquake monitoring station, and transmitting all the data to the upper-stage ocean bottom earthquake monitoring station through the expansion submarine cable after being aggregated.

title_en: Urban rail transit network cascading failure modeling method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a modeling method for urban rail transit network cascade failure, relating to the technical field of rail transit and control science; it includes: according to two indexes of passenger flow volume proportion coefficient and node efficiency, solving the importance degree through an importance degree contribution matrix method, and setting the initial capacity of the station; building station capacity based on node overload; and establishing a residual load redistribution strategy based on the dynamic edge weight to obtain a rail transit network cascade failure model. According to the construction method of the cascade failure model, by considering passenger flow factors in the urban rail transit network, a residual load redistribution strategy considering dynamic side weights is provided, the propagation condition of cascade failures in the real urban rail transit network is fitted, the propagation of the failures is controlled and prevented, and the influence of cascade failure on the urban rail transit network is reduced.

title_en: Method and device for predicting power of offshore wind turbine generator
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for predicting power of an offshore wind turbine, wherein the method comprises the following steps: performing space-time-power characteristic analysis on the offshore wind turbine generator; acquiring operation data of an offshore wind turbine generator, and extracting a characteristic vector of the acquired data; clustering the acquired operation data; and constructing a model based on the cuckoo optimization algorithm back propagation neural network according to the clustering of the operating data. The method ensures the strong correlation between the variables used in modeling and the predicted power; a cuckoo optimization algorithm is introduced into parameter optimization of the constructed offshore wind power prediction back propagation neural network model, so that the accuracy of a prediction result is effectively improved, and the stable operation of a power grid is promoted.
assignees: BEIJING HUAENAN NEW SHARP CONTROL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Low-voltage distribution network cascading failure early warning method based on risk assessment model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-voltage distribution network cascading failure early warning method based on a risk assessment model, which comprises the following steps: data acquisition and processing: collecting load data, weather data and fault data of a low-voltage distribution network, and performing data preprocessing on the collected data; selecting fault characteristics: performing optimization selection on the fault characteristics of the low-voltage distribution network by adopting an improved G-Relieff algorithm; cascading failure search: performing subsequent fault search according to the line outage model and the key line model to generate an accident chain and evaluate the accident chain; fault early warning: and calculating a risk evaluation coefficient of the element and the line, determining the fault occurrence probability through the risk evaluation coefficient, and finally performing comprehensive risk evaluation on the fault to calculate the risk level. The method is used for predicting and mastering the safe operation state of the low-voltage distribution network, discovering potential danger and judging the fault development trend so as to improve the accuracy of fault early warning and further avoid large-area power failure.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU PROVINCE ELECTRIC POWER LTD COMPANY SALT CITY POWER SUPPLY BRANCH COMPANY;STATE GRID JIANGSU PROVINCE POWER SUPPLY BRANCH COMPANY IN COUNTY COUNTY LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU PROVINCE ELECTRIC POWER LTD COMPANY

title_en: Dynamic coordination pricing optimization method based on dynamic wireless charging of electric automobile
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic coordination pricing optimization method based on dynamic wireless charging of an electric automobile, and relates to the field of optimal scheduling of traffic-power distribution coupling systems. The method comprises the following steps: simulating the propagation process of traffic flow by adopting a cell transmission model based on a path; calculating travel costs according to the dynamic coordination pricing policies; establishing a dynamic user balance model of the traffic network to determine congestion fees and vehicle route selection; establishing an optimal power flow model of the power distribution network to determine power price and power generation capacity; and finally, solving the dynamic network equilibrium state of the coupled traffic-power distribution network model by adopting a self-adaptive step length projection algorithm, and determining dynamic coordination pricing. Experiments prove that the method can improve the network efficiency, effectively relieve traffic network congestion and promote the safe and economic operation of the power distribution network.

title_en: Power communication network topology optimization method based on complex network theory
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power communication network topology optimization method based on a complex network theory; the method comprises the steps of firstly establishing a graph model of an electric power communication network, embedding a power flow parameter in the electric power network and a service flow parameter in the communication network into a weight matrix of the graph model, quantifying the coupling degree between layers according to the similarity of nodes, and constructing a coupling model of the network. And then, providing an elasticity evaluation index of the power communication network, evaluating the elasticity of the power communication network at different moments by using a dynamic form of a kirchhoff coefficient, and tracking the development evolution process of the network in the cascade fault process. And finally, taking the elasticity evaluation index as an objective function, establishing an optimization model by adopting a simulated annealing method, and solving the optimal elasticity topology of the network. The invention is a planning method of network topology, considers the characteristics of electric power and communication network coupling, and can enhance the structural strength of the electric power communication network by adjusting the topological relation of the communication network, thereby improving the resistance of the network in faults.

title_en: Power system multi-dimension index risk assessment method based on fuzzy comprehensive evaluation and LSTM
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power system multi-dimensional index risk assessment method based on fuzzy comprehensive assessment and LSTM, which comprises the following steps: step 1, establishing a power grid cascading failure probability grading model, and solving a power grid cascading failure probability fuzzy evaluation vector; and step 2, grading the severity of the grid cascading failure, determining the comprehensive early warning level of the cascading failure, and further finishing the risk assessment of the multidimensional index of the power system. The invention can effectively identify the weak links of the novel power system and effectively and accurately early warn the cascading faults with low probability and high risk.
assignees: STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Noise-based power grid cascading failure model optimization method, system and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid cascading failure model optimization method, a system and a storage medium based on noise, wherein the method comprises the following steps: establishing an importance model of the power grid node and calculating an initial load strategy; calculating a load capacity strategy according to the initial load strategy; calculating a load redistribution policy according to load transfer and noise; constructing a noise-based power grid cascading failure model; calculating a power grid load capacity critical threshold according to the influence of different variable parameters on the power grid cascading failure model; and optimizing a power grid load capacity critical threshold according to the influence of noise on the power grid cascading failure model. The method solves the problems that node importance values cannot be comprehensively considered and evaluation on external interference factors is lacking in the current power grid cascading failure model.

title_en: Knowledge and data driving-based photovoltaic system fault diagnosis mixing method
abstract_en: The invention aims to classify and identify five different states of normal operation, open-circuit fault, short-circuit fault, aging fault and shadow blocking fault. A fault diagnosis model based on the DBN is established. The dataset was generated based on Matlab/Simulink models of the photovoltaic array under different operating conditions. Training a DBN model, and optimizing the quantity of neurons of each hidden layer by adopting a BA algorithm to achieve the optimal training result. Then inputting the test data set into a BA-DBN model for photovoltaic array fault diagnosis, wherein the accuracy is obviously higher than that of a K nearest neighbor (K-nearest neighbors, KNN), a back propagation neural network (backpropagation neural network, BPNN) and an original DBN algorithm, and the accuracy reaches 98%.
assignees: SHAOXING DAMING ELECTRIC POWER CONSTRUCTION CO LTD

title_en: Bi-TCN-LSTM network model-based transmission line icing galloping prediction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power transmission line icing galloping prediction method based on a Bi-TCN-LSTM network model, which comprises the steps of generating a weather data set according to historical weather forecast data including but not limited to temperature, humidity, precipitation, wind speed, wind direction, air pressure and weather conditions, wherein the weather conditions include sunny days, rainy days and snowy days, matching and labeling historical icing galloping information of the power transmission line with the weather data set to obtain the icing galloping data set, carrying out feature extraction on the icing galloping data set according to a time sequence convolution network model to obtain an icing galloping feature data set, cascading a bidirectional long-short-term memory network model and a time sequence convolution network model to construct a Bi-TCN-LSTM network model, training the Bi-TCN-LSTM network model according to the icing galloping feature data set, inputting target weather forecast data into the trained Bi-TCN-LSTM network model, and predicting the icing galloping information of the power transmission line. According to the invention, the TCN model and the Bi-LSTM model are combined, so that the long-term and short-term dependency relationship in the time sequence data is effectively captured, and the prediction accuracy is improved.
assignees: STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Cascade hybrid pumped storage power station short-term scheduling method based on additional pump station
abstract_en: The invention discloses a short-term dispatching method of a step hybrid pumped storage power station based on an additional pump station, which comprises the steps of adding an energy storage pump station between step serial hydropower stations, and dynamically setting a reservoir capacity constraint by adopting a reservoir capacity dynamic control strategy considering the step hybrid pumped storage power station; the method comprises the steps of constructing a step hybrid pumped storage power station short-term dispatching model based on an additional energy storage pump station with the minimum mean square error of the residual load of a power grid as a target, solving the dispatching model based on an improved gradual optimization algorithm POA, constructing a comprehensive risk-benefit evaluation system, considering multi-dimensional targets of a system dispatching layer and a power station operation layer, and deeply analyzing the influence of the additional energy storage pump station on the power grid risk and benefit. The invention can be used for guiding daily scheduling of the step hybrid pumped storage power station based on the additionally arranged pump station, and can reduce the wind and light discarding phenomenon to the maximum extent while ensuring the safe and stable operation of the power system, thereby improving the absorption capacity of wind and light resources and the power supply reliability of the power system.

title_en: Multi-user energy storage power station charge and discharge control method and system based on electricity price
abstract_en: A multi-user energy storage power station charge-discharge control method and system based on electricity price comprises the steps of setting a monitoring terminal on energy storage equipment, collecting load data of each energy storage equipment, carrying out data preprocessing on the collected load data, constructing a cascade neural network prediction model, training the model by using the preprocessed load data to generate a regional total load demand predicted value of a future period, designing a deep reinforcement learning model DRL by using the regional total load demand predicted value to obtain a preliminary power adjustment amount, designing an objective function considering battery aging cost by using the preliminary power adjustment amount, determining a preliminary value range of coefficients in the objective function of an optimization model according to constraint conditions, considering a multi-objective optimization problem, and obtaining a Pareto optimal solution set based on the preliminary value range to determine a final power distribution scheme. The method can accurately predict the load, optimize the charge and discharge strategy, reduce the electricity consumption and operation cost, balance the service life and economic benefit of the battery and improve the intellectualization and high efficiency level of the energy storage power station.
assignees: CEEC BEIJING ENERGY RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Cascade reservoir optimization regulation and control method based on water nitrogen and phosphorus circulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascade reservoir optimization regulation method based on nitrogen and phosphorus circulation of a water body, which relates to the technical field of water resource management and optimization, and aims to collect multidimensional data of a gradient reservoir, construct a space-time aligned multimodal data set, deduce a physical equation of the nitrogen and phosphorus circulation according to a bio-geochemical process of the nitrogen and phosphorus circulation, design a physical constraint loss term and form a mixed loss function by weighting and combining the physical constraint loss term and data driving loss. According to the invention, by constructing the physical constraint neural network model and embedding the physical equation of the nitrogen-phosphorus cycle into the neural network loss function, not only is the strong fitting capacity of the data driving model utilized, but also the output of the model is ensured to accord with the bio-geochemical rule through the physical constraint, and the key parameters of the physical equation are calibrated through the Bayesian optimization algorithm, so that the prediction precision of the model on the nitrogen-phosphorus migration conversion process is further improved, the dependence on big data is effectively reduced, and a reliable prediction result can still be provided especially under the condition of lower data space-time resolution.
assignees: INST HYDROGEOLOGY & ENV GEOLOGY CAGS;HEBEI NEW CITY URBAN AND RURAL STATISTICS DEV SERVICE CENTER

title_en: Power project data logic abnormality correction method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for correcting logic abnormality of power project data, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a data logic check network based on an association rule mining algorithm so as to express constraint relation among fields; the method comprises the steps of verifying non-zero dependence of a data record through a constraint propagation mechanism, generating a logic abnormal result when a violation of a constraint is detected, triggering automatic correction, namely obtaining a similar normal case from a historical knowledge base to generate a correction scheme, applying the correction scheme to an abnormal field to obtain a corrected record, and performing secondary verification to ensure that correction is effective. The application realizes the rapid and accurate dynamic correction of logic abnormality by constructing the verification network, verifying the dependence, automatically correcting and secondarily verifying, and overcomes the defects of low efficiency and lack of verification of manual correction.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ECONOMIC RESEARCH INST

title_en: Method and system for modeling, calibration, and simulation of multi-stage series photoresist characterization network
abstract_en: Disclosed in the invention are a method and system for modeling, calibration, and simulation of a multi-stage series photoresist characterization network, pertaining to the field of semiconductor lithography. The invention comprises: firstly dividing a photoresist reaction process into several key stages, using a new idea of modeling a multi-stage series system network, constructing multiple stages of series Wiener-Padé form sub-cascading modules according to characteristics of lithography processes, and utilizing a joint calibration strategy based on a constrained quadratic convex optimization algorithm to provide a simulation means based on library matching and low-order multivariate polynomial equivalence of model parameters. The invention emphasizes and leverages universal advantages of the Wiener-Padé system theory in the characterization of non-linear system response characteristics, thereby achieving accurate and efficient modeling and calibration of complex physical, optical, and chemical highly-nonlinear response characteristics of photoresists in different process flows, while avoiding over-fitting and reducing model complexity and redundancy.
assignees: WUHAN YUWEI OPTICAL SOFTWARE CO LTD

title_en: Road section partition routing method of SDN vehicle-mounted network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a road section partition routing method of an SDN vehicle-mounted network, which ensures that a selected vehicle in a previous area can be stably connected with the selected vehicle in the next area before the selected vehicle leaves the area; when the selected vehicle in the last area of the road section leaves the road section, the whole communication link does not need to be recalculated, and only the algorithm needs to be repeated in Set1 to select a propagation vehicle to be added into the existing communication link; the data transmission efficiency is effectively improved, the transmission stability is improved, and the defect of poor disaster tolerance capability is overcome.

title_en: Intelligent auxiliary overhaul flow analysis method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent auxiliary overhaul flow analysis method and system, comprising the following steps: analyzing the influence factors of the overhaul, taking an analysis service communication channel as a main line, completing multiple analyses, and analyzing each link one by one to obtain the influence range in the overhaul; according to the fault influence service analyzed before overhaul, the current running state of the overhaul influence service is analyzed one by combining with the real-time alarm of the current network manager, and whether overhaul starts or ends is determined; based on the completed overhaul project, analyzing the collected alarm information generated by overhaul, comparing the project plan to judge the execution condition of the project, automatically producing an alarm comparison report, obtaining a working operation quality report, and completing the overhaul flow analysis. According to the invention, an overhaul decision maker is assisted to quickly and comprehensively determine the overhaul influence range, and data support is provided for overhaul decision making; the maintenance implementation personnel are assisted to know the real-time situation, and unplanned service interruption is avoided; and carrying out post-analysis on the quality of the overhaul engineering.

title_en: Information-epidemic co-evolution analysis method under dynamic multisource information and behavior response effect
abstract_en: The invention discloses an information-epidemic co-evolution analysis method under the action of dynamic multi-source information and behavior response, which comprises the steps of firstly constructing a multi-layer time sequence network model with partially coupled nodes, then constructing unconscious-conscious-unconscious, susceptible-infected-susceptible models to analyze information-epidemic propagation dynamics processes, describing epidemic states and information state transitions of the nodes, deducing epidemic threshold beta  c , then simulating the dynamic evolution processes of epidemic propagation and information diffusion, and finally counting the proportion of infected nodes and conscious nodes in the network in steady state to finish the information-epidemic co-evolution process. According to the invention, the influence of individual time-varying self-consciousness and behavior response on the cooperative evolution of the information-epidemic disease is considered in the multi-layer time sequence network with the nodes partially coupled, the state transition of the nodes is described through a micro Markov chain method, the critical threshold beta  c  of the epidemic disease is theoretically solved, and guidance is provided for the intervention and control of other sudden epidemic diseases which possibly burst in the future.

title_en: Urgent rescue system using active network communication
title_ko: 능동형 네트워크 통신을 이용한 긴급구조시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An urgent rescue system using an active network communication is provided to implement emergency rescue in case of emergency by protecting a crime in residential street. CONSTITUTION: A rescue button(13) transmits a SOS signal in case of emergency. A go-out/home mode(14) transmits the accurate address and position of a terminal carrying person when an emergency signal is generated. An OK selection button(15) allows a user to select a menu for setting and selection.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 주택가 골목에 설치된 보안등이나 대로변 신호등의 온/오프 제어기를 SOS 수신기능이 추가된 양방향 무선기술로 개량하여 SOS 신호 발신자의 위치정보를 중앙통제센터의 GIS 전자지도상에 표시되도록 하여 주택가 골목길이나 주거지에서의 치안범죄예방과 신속한 응급구조가 가능함과 동시에 원격에서 등기구의 제어와 고장감시도 가능한 기술이다. 본 발명은 또한 평상시에는 위치추적을 하지 않다가 SOS신호 발신시 위치추적이 개시되도록 하여 사생활 침해 논란이 없고, GPS신호 수신과 관계없이 건물 내외부를 구분하여 신호 전송이 가능하며, GPS 위치 또는 보안등이나 신호등 폴(POLE)의 위치를 하이브리드 측위방식으로 표시하여 건물 내외부 어디에서든 높은 정확도로 SOS 신호 발신자의 위치 추적이 가능하다. 또한 본 발명은, 종래에는 치매노인이나 어린이 미아방지를 위해 컴퓨터 GIS 관제프로그램에서 이탈경보구역을 설정한 후 이탈사실을 판단하고 있으나, SOS 단말기만으로도 기준위치점과 안전 존을 설정할 수 있어 치매노인이나 어린이가 안전 존을 벗어날 때 SOS신호의 자동 전송이 가능하다. 본 발명은 또한 수신기가 설치되지 않은 지역에서도 SOS 단말기 두 대가 상호 이동 중 상대방의 위치와 방향 그리고 거리를 표시하여 줌으로써 미아 방지 등에 대단히 효과적이다. 또한 본 발명은 이동통신망을 이용하지 않고 기존 보안등이나 신호등을 기반으로 하는 능동형 RF Cell 네트워크망을 구성하여 전파 장애요인에도 능동적으로 대응할 수 있으며 단말기 사용자의 통신비용이 들지 않아 SOS 단말기 보급이 용이하다. 
       
     단말기, 라우팅, 비상신호, 사생활, 미아,  CCTV.

title_en: Multiple-use reservoir group's method for optimizing scheduling towards crucial water level control under bulk power grid platform
abstract_en: Multiple-use reservoir group's method for optimizing scheduling towards crucial water level control under bulk power grid platform, be using before the beginning of the year, flood, after flood and year end water level control as optimization aim, to abandon water minimum, generated energy is up to optimizing evaluation index, carries out growing the flow-optimized calculating in serial footpath using multiple-objection optimization technology.This method is used as optimized variable and control targe using crucial water level, then to the method assess of key water bit matrix sequence, NSGA II multi-objective calculation methods using crucial water level as optimized variable and based on valuation functions proposed above again, it is finally based on the scheduling rule application process of non-bad crucial water level collection.The present invention is for the purpose of improving water power consumption and reducing abandoned water, it is intended to by optimizing crucial water level control, there is provided simple possible, the easily operated Model for Cascade Hydroelectric Stations method of operation.Consider to predict that water and scheduling experience, application process simple, intuitive, result of calculation effectively reduce while generated energy improves and abandons water simultaneously.

title_en: A kind of bunch wire crosstalk prediction technique based on BP-FDTD algorithm
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of bunch wire crosstalk prediction techniques, relate to the extracting method of bunch wire RLCG parameter matrix and the calculation method of bunch wire crosstalk.Include the following steps: step 1: establishing the physical model of bunch wire, bunch wire is considered as to the parallel multi-conductor transmission lines being cascaded by the straight wire of unlimited " short "；The RLCG parameter matrix of the parallel multi-conductor transmission lines of step 2: on extraction bunch wire in single pitch on different location " short "；Step 3: being learnt using RLCG parameter matrix of back propagation (BP) neural network to extraction and training, is obtained the bunch wire RLCG parameter matrix based on BP neural network and is extracted model；Step 4: extracting model for the bunch wire RLCG parameter matrix based on BP neural network and Implicite Wendroff finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) algorithm combine, and solves the time domain crosstalk of bunch wire single-frequency point；Step 5: by the excitation source frequency in control FDTD algorithm, the frequency domain crosstalk of bunch wire is obtained.
assignees: ZHENJIANG INST FOR INNOVATION AND DEVELOPMENT NNU

title_en: Opportunity constraint considered maximum energy supply capacity evaluation method for electrical coupling system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an evaluation method for the maximum energy supply capacity of an electric coupling system in consideration of opportunity constraint, which comprises the steps of constructing an evaluation model for the maximum energy supply capacity of the electric coupling system in consideration of random wind energy output and opportunity constraint; secondly, converting the wind energy output joint opportunity constraint into an equivalent mixed integer linear constraint group by adopting a Boolean reconstruction method; then, converting the model into a mixed integer second-order cone programming model containing a penalty term by adopting a convex-concave method; and finally, decomposing the model into power grid and gas grid submodels for distributed iterative solution based on a target cascade analysis method. According to the method, the coupling relation of the power grid and the air network is fully considered, the influence of the output randomness of the fan is considered, and a maximum energy supply capacity evaluation model of the electric coupling system is established; the method is based on a target cascade decomposition method, decomposes the integral model into a power grid sub-model and a power grid sub-model for distributed independent solution, and meets the actual engineering requirements better.

title_en: Short-term wind power prediction method and system based on neural network imbalance optimization
abstract_en: The invention provides a short-term wind power prediction method and a short-term wind power prediction system based on neural network imbalance optimization, which relate to the technical field of wind power prediction.A wind speed time sequence, a wind direction time sequence and a wind power time sequence are preprocessed to obtain a characteristic vector, a neural network is constructed, an intermediate characteristic layer is selected, the characteristic vector is used as the input of the neural network, and characteristic tensor similarity processing is carried out on the intermediate characteristic layer, so that the characteristic similarity of samples with similar wind power is improved, wind power samples with small data volume can enhance the fitting effect by depending on the propagation of the samples with similar wind power in the neural network, and the processing capacity of the neural network to unbalanced wind power sequence samples is improved; and carrying out multidirectional imbalance optimization on the training loss of the neural network, and expanding the capability of training optimal fitting parameters of the neural network based on imbalance adjustment, so that the generalization capability of the neural network is enhanced, and the prediction precision of the wind power is improved.

title_en: Risk assessment method and system based on coupling analysis of power grid and power communication network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a risk assessment method and system based on coupling analysis of a power grid and a power communication network, and belongs to the technical field of power communication. Primary line risk identification is carried out on a power grid side through power grid risk evaluation indexes, importance ordering of power lines is carried out, power grid guarantee requirements are obtained and transmitted to a power communication network side, and guarantee measures are formulated on the power communication network side; according to the risk assessment results, the risk points are sequenced at the power communication network side through the communication risk assessment indexes, the reliability sequencing results are obtained, and the communication risk is transmitted to the power network side, so that the power network side is ready to deal with the plan. Fully considering the risk bidirectional transfer process between two networks, performing risk assessment on the operation of the two networks, and avoiding large-scale fault cascading; the problem that the risk transfer flow and the fault range control strategy are not clear is solved.
assignees: INFORMATION COMMUNICATION CO STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Combined simulation method for cascading failure of gas-electric coupling system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a joint simulation method for cascading faults of a gas-electric coupling system, which is based on a joint simulation framework of an event driving mode, establishes a dynamic model of a power grid-natural gas network-coupling element, designs an information interaction interface on the basis of two mature commercial simulation software of the two systems, and realizes the space-time interaction of simulation information of a power system and a natural gas system on different platforms. The method has the advantages of high accuracy, convenient model construction and the like, and can realize the accurate depiction of the evolution process of the electric-gas fault. By applying the simulation method, the fault dynamic evolution process can be more effectively analyzed. In addition, the invention also provides a fault blocking strategy which can effectively block faults caused by extreme disasters from spreading across the energy system.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV BEIJING JIAOTONG

title_en: Lifting platform suitable for special scene
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of civil unmanned aircrafts, in particular to an elevating platform suitable for special scenes. The invention provides a lift-off platform suitable for special scenes, which can better meet the use requirements of urban environments, emergency situations and other special scenes by means of a 'beyond-the-horizon flight control' mode, an air-land dual-purpose design of flight and vehicle rows and combining the functions of an environment self-adaptive mechanism, an action design and the like. The 'beyond-the-horizon flight control' mode relies on a mobile communication network (public network, main network) or a wireless local area network (WLAN ad hoc network, auxiliary network) to realize wireless communication, and relates to two layers of contents: one is "curvilinear communication", i.e., the aircraft and the console can normally communicate in both line-of-sight and non-line-of-sight (NLOS) propagation environments; secondly, the control is carried out by remotely controlling the flying hand to communicate with the airplane through a network (public network or ad hoc network), namely, the control can be realized under two conditions of on-site short distance and long-distance in different places.

title_en: Industrial chain risk assessment method and system based on co-occurrence emotion and graph annotation meaning force
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic industrial chain risk assessment method and a system based on co-occurrence emotion and graph annotation meaning force, wherein the method comprises the steps of generating a co-occurrence relation graph, extracting co-occurrence emotion to obtain co-occurrence emotion scores, and aggregating multi-dimensional characteristics of neighbor nodes through a graph annotation meaning mechanism to obtain multi-dimensional characteristic embedded representation of enterprise nodes; and carrying out binary risk classification on the industrial chain company nodes by utilizing a new risk embedding representation after the neural network model is combined with the co-occurrence emotion score adjustment, so as to realize dynamic evaluation on the industrial chain risks. The invention provides real-time insight on information such as enterprise reputation, market emotion and the like through co-occurrence emotion analysis, and the attention mechanism strengthens recognition of a key risk propagation path, thereby improving sensitivity and accuracy of risk assessment. And learning expression of the industrial chain state-owned enterprise industrial node co-occurrence relationship, efficient calculation of co-occurrence emotion scores, timely capturing of risks and dynamic evaluation of industrial chain node risks are realized.

title_en: Flood disaster propagation simulation method based on bus-subway double-layer traffic network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a flood disaster propagation simulation method based on a bus-subway double-layer traffic network, which comprises the steps of constructing the bus-subway double-layer traffic network according to bus nodes, bus node connection relations, subway nodes, subway node connection relations and bus-subway transfer nodes, introducing disaster disturbance into the bus-subway double-layer traffic network, simulating the influence of the flood disaster on the double-layer traffic network, obtaining a node state update formula and a flood disturbance formula, iteratively calculating the node states at all moments through the node state update formula and the flood disturbance formula, and obtaining a disaster chained propagation path based on dynamic evolution of the node states in time. Compared with the prior art, the invention fills the blank of complex network disaster propagation research, and the proposed dynamic model can comprehensively reveal the dynamic behavior of the bus-subway system in extreme weather.

title_en: Intelligent positioning and diagnosing method for optical fiber composite faults of power distribution network based on hybrid sensing
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent positioning and diagnosing method for optical fiber composite faults of a power distribution network based on hybrid sensing, which relates to the technical field of power distribution networks and comprises the steps of acquiring and preprocessing optical fibers and electric sensing data, extracting time-frequency domain characteristics through a multichannel convolutional neural network, and calculating a dynamic weight coefficient by using an attention mechanism to perform feature fusion, constructing a dynamic fault propagation diagram, and performing space-time feature extraction by combining diagram convolution and causal convolution to realize fault positioning and type identification. The invention can fully utilize multi-source heterogeneous data, improves fault positioning accuracy and diagnosis reliability, and is suitable for fault diagnosis of a complex power distribution network.
assignees: BAOTOU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH COMPANY INNER MONGOLIA POWER GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Typhoon path and strength prediction method based on multi-mode fusion network model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a typhoon path and strength prediction method based on a multi-mode fusion network model, and belongs to the technical field of meteorological monitoring. The method comprises the steps of obtaining position coordinates, central wind speed and central air pressure of typhoons and analysis data of wind fields and potential heights of typhoons in a central area, constructing a multi-mode fusion network model driven by the data and physics together, constructing a loss function of the multi-mode fusion network model, updating parameters of the multi-mode fusion network model through counter propagation to obtain a trained multi-mode fusion network model, inputting data in a test set into the trained multi-mode fusion network model, and outputting typhoons paths and intensities. The method analyzes the space-time characteristics of the dynamic association relation and the potential height field in the wind field, provides effective physical constraint for typhoon path and strength prediction, is used for typhoon path and strength prediction, and can improve the accuracy of typhoon path and strength prediction.

title_en: 1.5-Dimensional transmission line matrix model construction method, system and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a 1.5-dimensional transmission line matrix model construction method, a system and a medium, which comprise the steps of establishing a basic equation for the propagation of a partial discharge signal in a conductor circuit, introducing a radial layered equivalent RL network structure of a conductor on the basis of a traditional one-dimensional transmission line matrix model, establishing a first model, taking a tower structure and an accessory connection part thereof as impedance discontinuous units, modeling by adopting a multi-section cascade TLM sub-model to obtain a second model, obtaining a second model-level link tower impedance model, and solving the first model and the second model by combining in a time domain according to the basic equation to form a solving structure of the 1.5-dimensional transmission line matrix model. The invention simultaneously considers the skin effect and the impedance discontinuity of the transmission line to carry out the matrix modeling of the high-frequency overhead line time domain transmission line, and solves the problem of larger deviation between the simulation result and the actual measurement.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER CORP

title_en: Automatic news text formation method and system based on mobile and web program
title_ko: 모바일과 웹의 연동에 의한 뉴스텍스트 자동생성 방법과 그 장치
abstract_en: Except for values of comments and editions, news, which have been so far written by heads and hands of peoples (reporters) by using information transferred by people as a material, have severe problems such as inaccuracy, slowness, and intentional perversion. Even reporters who handle news say that things written for news values can become news and others do not have values of news. By at least considering that accuracy and rapidness are the lives of accident and disaster reports, the present invention has been devised to direct mechanical news which transfers only facts in a rapid speed. This application of the present invention has been designed to transmit an image at the same time of pressing a shutter by collecting, in real time, data around a site along with position data and visual data needed for news sentences. The data are made to reach a news text automatic generation program mounted to a CMS on a server to be immediately included in a news text. Thus, a picture news can be generated within 5-7 seconds only by a shouter one-touch and a keyword input, and can be transmitted to journalism companies without an edition process. Such a mechanical generation system of news perfectly secures accuracy and rapidness in accident and disaster rapid reports, thereby entirely resolving problems of response time delays caused due to the properties of a report system of an administration organization which have not been resolved for a long time along with unnecessary life and asset damages. Accordingly, the present invention solves problems of all world disaster information reporting problems caused by reporting depending on manpower information network based on AP communications, and is expected to be a leading technology of a global news market which opens a new smart rapid reporting time.
abstract_ko: 이제까지 사람들이 전하는 정보를 재료로 사람(기자)의 머리와 손에 의해 쓰여져 온 뉴스들은 논평적, 편집적 가치를 제외하면 부정확하고, 느리고, 의도적으로 왜곡되어 온 등의 심각한 문제점을 안고 있었다. 심지어 뉴스를 다루는 기자들은 뉴스가치에 대하여 쓰면 뉴스가 되고, 안 쓰면 뉴스가치가 없다라고 말하기까지 한다. 적어도 사건사고, 재난보도에 있어서만큼은 정확성과 신속성이 생명이라는 착안에서 본 발명은 광속으로 팩트만을 전달하는 기계적인 뉴스를 지향하여 창안되었다. 이 어플은 뉴스문장에 필요한 위치 데이터, 시각 데이터, 현장 주변 데이터들을 실시간 수집하여 셔터를 누름과 동시에 영상과 함께 전송하도록 설계되었다. 이 데이터들은 서버 상의 CMS에 장착된 뉴스텍스트 자동생성 프로그램에 도달하여 즉시 뉴스텍스트에 포함됨으로써 셔터 원터치 및 키워드 입력만으로 5~7초 안에 사진뉴스가 만들어지고, 이를 편집과정 없이 각 언론사에 전송한다. 이와 같은 뉴스의 기계적 생산체제는 재난 및 사건사고 속보 보도에서 정확성과 신속성을 완벽하게 수행함으로써 불필요한 인명 및 재산피해와 함께 오랜 기간 고쳐지지 안항 온 행정조직의 보고체계 특성 상 대응시간 지연의 문제를 한꺼번에 해결할 수 있으며, 이는 곧 현재 AP통신을 중심으로 인적 정보 네트워크에 의존하여 전파되고 있는 전 세계 재난정보 전파 보도의 문제점들을 해결하면서 새로운 스마트 속보 보도 시대를 여는 글로벌 뉴스시장의 선도기술이 될 것으로 기대한다.

title_en: A functional Fire Sign Detection System of Power equipment
title_ko: 기능성 전력설비의 화재 징후 감지 시스템
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 전력설비의 화재 징후 감지 시스템에 관한 것으로, 특히 화재 징후를 사전에 감지하여 점검을 유도함과 더불어 설치가 용이하며 전력설비의 종합적인 화재 예측 판단이 가능한 기능성 전력설비의 화재 징후 감지 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명은 전력설비 중 다수의 전원 케이블에 각각 결합되고 아크 발생에 따라 발생하는 저항열을 검출하여 무선 통신을 통해 외부로 전송하는 다수의 아크 검출부와, 상기 전력설비에 구성되어 상기 각 아크 검출부로부터 검출된 아크 검출신호를 전달받아 외부로 전송하는 전송 단말기와, 상기 전송 단말기로부터 아크 검출 신호를 전달받아 증폭하여 전파 음영지역을 극복하고 전송거리를 연장 및 확장하는 중계기와, 상기 중계기로부터 아크 검출 신호를 수신하여 상기 전력 설비에서 발생하는 아크 정보 데이터를 수집하는 수집기와, 상기 수집기로부터 수집된 상기 전력설비의 아크 정보에 대한 데이터를 전달받아 저장하고 분석하는 관리 서버를 포함하여 구성되고, 상기 아크 검출부는 전원을 공급하는 배터리와, 상기 배터리로부터 전원을 공급받아 동작하고 상기 검출된 아크 정보를 무선 통신을 통해 외부로 전달하는 무선 통신부와, 상기 전력 케이블에서 아크 발생에 따른 전력 케이블의 저항열을 감지하여 기계적으로 온 또는 오프되어 상기 배터리와 무선 통신부를 선택적으로 연결하는 바이메탈과, 상기 바이메탈이 동작하여 상기 무선 통신부를 통해 아크 정보를 송부되면 점등하여 발광하는 발광부와, 상기 발광부, 무선 통신부 및 배터리를 수납하는 제 1 수납 케이스와, 상기 제 1 수납 케이스와 체결되고 상기 바이메탈을 수납하는 제 2 수납 케이스와, 상기 제 2 수납 케이스의 측면에 구성되어 상기 전력 케이블에 체결되는 체결부와, 상기 제 1 수납 케이스의 내부 수납 공간에 구성되어 외부에서 조작에 의해 구동되어 송신기와 수신기간의 주기적인 통신 점검을 실행하는 트랙 스위치와, 상기 트랙 스위치의 외부 조작을 위해 상기 제 1 수납 케이스의 표면에 구성되는 트랙 스위치 조작홀을 포함하여 구성되는 기능성 전력설비의 화재 징후 감지 시스템을 제공하고자 한다. 
또한 본 발명의 상기 바이메탈은 일표면에 열전도성 완충부가 부착되어 있는 것을 특징으로 하는 기능성 전력설비의 화재 징후 감지 시스템을 제공한다. 
또한 본 발명의 상기 전송 단말기, 중계기 및 수집기를 포함한 무선 네트워크망은 비상시에도 동작이 가능하도록 2차 전지를 내장하고 있는 것을 특징으로 하는 기능성 전력설비의 화재 징후 감지 시스템을 제공한다. 
또한 본 발명의 상기 아크 감지 수신기는 내부에 온도, 습도, 조도를 감지하는 센서를 내장하고 정기적으로 상기 전송 단말기를 통해 상기 관리 서버로 전달하는 것을 특징으로 하는 기능성 전력설비의 화재 징후 감지 시스템을 제공한다. 
또한 본 발명의 상기 관리 서버는 온도, 습도, 조도와 더불어 화재 징후 감지 신호를 전달받아 분석하여 상황에 따라 해당 전력 설비에 대한 점검 메시지를 표출하는 것을 특징으로 하는 기능성 전력설비의 화재 징후 감지 시스템을 제공한다.

title_en: Method and system for determining optimal energy distribution strategy of traffic network layer
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for determining an optimal energy distribution strategy of a traffic network layer, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining basic parameters of a high-ratio electric automobile traffic power basic coupling complex network graph model; establishing a coupling complex network visual topological graph model; constructing and updating an adjacency matrix of an undirected graph, an adjacency matrix of a directed graph, an adjacency matrix of a three-dimensional graph, a side maximum capacity matrix and a node maximum storage energy value matrix; calculating traditional complex network indexes based on a topological structure; calculating a mixed complex network index based on energy flow characteristics and a topological structure; constructing a power grid attack fault simulator based on the high and low dynamics based on the traditional complex network index and the mixed complex network index; and verifying by adopting the fault simulator according to the traffic network layer energy distribution strategy to obtain the traffic network layer energy optimal distribution strategy. The method can reduce the risks of road congestion, power grid congestion and cascading faults, and enables the charging station to be more reasonable in planning.

title_en: Transient model of transformer winding
abstract_en: The invention provides a transient model of a transformer winding. The model is equivalent to a multi-conductor transmission line, and based on a time domain finite difference method of a conventional multi-conductor transmission line, discrete differential operation at a transmission line port is innovated, so that the model gets rid of the terminal characteristics of an external network, and further, the model can be independently packaged and modularized, and the integration of a transient model of a transformer winding and the external complex transformer substation network is realized. Compared with the original time domain finite difference method, the algorithm of the transient model can reduce the error to 0.025%. The invention lays a foundation for analyzing the propagation characteristics of the high-frequency signals in the transformer substation network and the influence of the topological structure on the online diagnosis of the deformation of the winding.

title_en: Toughness calculation method for electric power information physical system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a toughness calculation method of an electric power information physical system, which is characterized by comprising the following steps of: constructing an initial network architecture of the power information physical system; constructing a node multi-state model and a branch state model of an information system and an electric power system, and generating a fault element set and an effective network of an electric power information physical system in an initial state; constructing a fault propagation dynamics model in an information system; constructing a node power balance model for propagating faults in the power system; constructing a virus infection dynamics model of fault transmission between an information system and a power system; and (3) iteratively solving to obtain the stable state of the fault propagated in the power information physical system, and calculating the toughness index of the power information physical system. According to the invention, through comprehensively analyzing the operation structure difference of the electric power system and the information system, the propagation mechanism of faults in the two systems and between the two systems is simulated, and the problems of singleness and adaptability of toughness research of the traditional electric power information physical system are overcome.

title_en: Power consumption complaint early warning method based on cascading logistic regression Bayesian algorithm
abstract_en: The invention provides a power consumption complaint early warning method based on a cascading logistic regression Bayesian algorithm, which comprises the following steps: acquiring the power failure time of a power grid and the complaint time of a user, calculating a power failure forgetting index of the user, and screening out the complaint information of the user in the effective complaint range according to the power failure forgetting index; acquiring fault basic information and fault associated information corresponding to the screened user complaint information, extracting basic features based on the fault basic information and the user complaint information, and extracting additional features based on the fault associated information; taking the blackout forgetting index, the basic features and the additional features as final feature sets, and respectively inputting the final feature sets into a trained logistic regression model and a naive Bayesian model; and cascading the results output by the logistic regression model and the naive Bayesian model to obtain the result of early warning of electricity consumption complaints. The invention realizes screening of potential complaint users, and more accurate early warning of electricity complaint risks, and can effectively reduce the workload of basic staff.

title_en: Power communication network topology optimization method based on complex network theory
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power communication network topology optimization method based on a complex network theory; the method comprises the steps of firstly establishing a graph model of an electric power communication network, embedding a power flow parameter in the electric power network and a service flow parameter in the communication network into a weight matrix of the graph model, quantifying the coupling degree between layers according to the similarity of nodes, and constructing a coupling model of the network. And then, providing an elasticity evaluation index of the power communication network, evaluating the elasticity of the power communication network at different moments by using a dynamic form of a kirchhoff coefficient, and tracking the development evolution process of the network in the cascade fault process. And finally, taking the elasticity evaluation index as an objective function, establishing an optimization model by adopting a simulated annealing method, and solving the optimal elasticity topology of the network. The invention is a planning method of network topology, considers the characteristics of electric power and communication network coupling, and can enhance the structural strength of the electric power communication network by adjusting the topological relation of the communication network, thereby improving the resistance of the network in faults.

title_en: Civil aircraft cockpit man-machine system risk analysis method based on node elasticity evaluation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a civil aircraft cockpit man-machine system risk analysis method based on node elasticity assessment, which comprises the steps of analyzing operation tasks of a flight unit in a typical flight stage, analyzing and decomposing functions of a cockpit man-machine system based on a function resonance analysis method, screening main functional units of the man-machine system, analyzing output characteristics of the functions, taking intrinsic and extrinsic influence factors of the functions into consideration to obtain functional failure links, constructing a man-machine system risk propagation network model, calculating propagation indexes of all nodes in the man-machine system risk propagation network, calculating node elasticity values based on a node elasticity assessment method, and analyzing key nodes of the man-machine system. The invention can analyze risk events and the damage degree of risks to the system in the complex man-machine system, and has important significance and value for improving the safety, the risk resistance and the recovery capability of the future intelligent aircraft cockpit man-machine system.

title_en: Intelligent power distribution operation and maintenance management system based on 5G transmission
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power distribution operation and maintenance management, and discloses an intelligent power distribution operation and maintenance management system based on 5G transmission. The system comprises a 5G real-time acquisition module, a multidimensional feature fusion module, a dynamic topology generation module, an abnormal propagation analysis module and a strategy optimization feedback module. The system comprises a 5G real-time acquisition module, a multi-dimensional feature fusion module, a dynamic topology generation module, a state fluctuation analysis module, a strategy optimization feedback module and a strategy optimization feedback module, wherein the 5G real-time acquisition module acquires running state data streams such as current and voltage waveforms of power distribution equipment, equipment temperature sequences and environment monitoring indexes through a 5G network, the multi-dimensional feature fusion module separates equipment state features, calculates mutual information quantity and generates equipment state feature tensors, the dynamic topology generation module constructs an association strength matrix according to the feature tensors to generate a hierarchical connection path and a dynamic equipment topology map, the state fluctuation analysis module extracts a state fluctuation sequence, identifies an abnormal transmission path and marks a core transmission node, and the strategy optimization feedback module generates a maintenance strategy priority queue according to the state fluctuation sequence, feeds back an execution result to update the dynamic topology map, so that the intellectualization and the accuracy of power distribution operation and maintenance management are improved.

title_en: Ultra-thin digital flat-panel loudspeaker device of optical network vision linkage broadcast
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of public broadcasting, in particular to an optical network visual linkage broadcasting ultrathin digital flat-panel loudspeaker device which comprises an optical network interface, a frame component, a surface sound source sounding system, a signal processing module, a visual identification component and a cluster cooperative component, wherein the frame component comprises a surrounding frame integrated with the optical network interface, a metal bottom plate, an insulating bottom plate and front and rear surface sound-transmitting metal mesh plates. The ring network cascade function of the network switch module is used for forming a serial broadcast terminal node, the directional guidance is formed by combining the volume differentiation control of the digital power amplifier module, the disaster prevention emergency broadcast evacuation efficiency is effectively improved, the ring network double-link redundancy network architecture is constructed by means of the optical cable, and the all-optical network broadcast system is formed, so that the problem of low connection reliability which is easy to occur when the traditional network cable is connected with a loudspeaker is solved, the technical defects of network interruption, high data transmission error rate and the like of the traditional network cable caused by electromagnetic interference are avoided, and the stable transmission of broadcast signals in a complex environment is ensured.

title_en: A kind of cascade hydropower participate in inside the province with transferring electricity from the west to the east marketing-mix trading strategies optimization method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to Electric Power Network Planning and management and running field, be related to a kind of cascade hydropower participate in inside the province with transferring electricity from the west to the east marketing-mix trading strategies optimization method.The electricity price scene that the present invention is likely to occur based on market inside the province and transferring electricity from the west to the east two single market futures of market, combination obtain polynary market guidance scene；Build the gene-ration revenue maximum model that step participates in market inside the province and transferring electricity from the west to the east market；Solved using nonlinear programming approach, optimization obtains step participation, and the beneficial effects of the invention are as follows prediction power grid future development for the combination trading strategies in market and transferring electricity from the west to the east market inside the province, realize the step generation optimization scheduling under polynary Power Market, it can be provided for the power dispatch system operation and management of the extensive Hydropower Stations in Southwestern China area under new electric power environmental beneficial to support, there is the important meaning of setting an example that takes the lead in.

title_en: A kind of multipotency streaming system optimizing operation method considering region heat supply network transient state heat-transfer character
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of multipotency streaming system optimizing operation methods considering region heat supply network transient state heat-transfer character, including：Step 1) establishes the region heat supply network transient state heat-transfer character model for considering return pipe net topological structure, pipeline section temperature change dynamic process and pipeline section propagation delay time based on graph theory, which includes mainly six aspect contents：Heat source characteristic, thermic load characteristic, node flow balance, node power fusion characteristics, pipeline section heat-transfer character and pipeline section temporarily/steady state heat transfer Performance criteria；Step 2) establishes multipotency streaming system optimal operation model, with the minimum object function of total operating cost in 4 hours futures of system, the operation constraints that should meet in conjunction with system, determine each equipment in multipotency streaming system it is real-time contribute, the real-time supply and return water temperature etc. of each heat source of heat supply network, realize that the United Dispatching of system and optimization are run.The present invention considers the transient state heat-transfer character of region heat supply network, and the optimized operation state of multipotency streaming system is made more to coincide with actual motion state.

title_en: A kind of integrated energy system Risk Identification Method propagated based on multipotency stream faults coupling
abstract_en: Invention describes a kind of integrated energy system Risk Identification Methods propagated based on multipotency stream faults coupling, it is related to comprehensive energy security analysis field, comprising the following steps: 1) establish electric system, therrmodynamic system, the mathematical model of natural gas system, electrical heat Coupling device respectively；2) risk identification System Design: include multipotency Source Type for integrated energy system, propose various dimensions risk identification index system；3) comprehensive energy network tide optimization algorithm is combined to calculate the load margin Optimized model of analysis electrical heat coupled system；4) risk based on load margin loss probability, the key energy hinge mutually converted between crucial branch, node, coupling propagation path and the heterogeneous energy stream for determining energy transport net in integrated energy system.The invention proposes a kind of integrated energy system Risk Identification Methods propagated based on multipotency stream faults coupling, improve safety, the flexibility, reliability of social energy supply.

title_en: Prediction method for cascading failure sequence of power transmission network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a prediction method of a power transmission network cascading failure sequence, which comprises the following steps of firstly, randomly selecting a line of a non-generator outgoing line and a transformer line in a power transmission network as an initial failure line in the cascading failure sequence, wherein the number of failure stages is set to be 1; secondly, counting the number of the overload lines; thirdly, judging a fault line of the next stage, and adding 1 to the number of fault stages; and fourthly, disconnecting all the determined fault lines, judging the running state of the generator, stopping prediction if the power transmission network is disconnected and the generator is in an unsafe running state, outputting the cascading failure sequence, or stopping prediction if the failure series number of the cascading failure sequence reaches the predictable maximum sequence number of 5, and outputting the cascading failure sequence, or else, discharging all the determined fault lines, repeating the steps from the second step until the prediction is stopped, and outputting the cascading failure sequence. The invention relates to a prediction method of a cascading failure sequence of a power transmission network, which can predict all possible cascading failure sequences of the power transmission network in advance.

title_en: Distribution-gas network distributed collaborative planning method and system considering influence of power transmission network
abstract_en: The utility model provides a distribution-gas network distributed collaborative planning method and system considering the influence of a power transmission network, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a typical operation scene of a power distribution-gas network; obtaining an optimal distributed collaborative planning scheme of the power distribution-gas network according to the obtained typical operation scene and a preset power distribution-gas network distributed collaborative planning model; the power distribution-gas network distributed collaborative planning model comprises a power transmission network sub-problem mixed integer quadratic planning model, a power distribution network sub-problem mixed integer quadratic planning model and a gas distribution network sub-problem mixed integer quadratic planning model, and distributed iterative solution is sequentially carried out on the three mixed integer quadratic planning models by using a target cascade analysis algorithm. According to the distributed collaborative planning method, a distributed solving process based on a target cascade analysis algorithm is established by establishing a mixed integer quadratic planning model of a power transmission network, a power distribution network and a gas distribution network, and distributed collaborative planning of a plurality of power distribution-gas networks is realized.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO WEIFANG POWER SUPPLY CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Mobile energy network optimization scheduling method based on fuel cell energy cascade utilization
abstract_en: The invention provides a mobile energy network optimization scheduling method based on fuel cell energy cascade utilization, which comprises the following steps: step 1: a mobile energy network based on the energy cascade utilization of the fuel cell is established, electric propulsion load and household electric load are supplied through a hydrogen fuel cell and a diesel generator, electric load demands are supplemented through an electric storage device, and heat load demands are guaranteed through the hydrogen fuel cell, an electric heat pump and a heat storage device; step 2: establishing a ship navigation model under the condition of ship stall; step 3: establishing a mobile energy network optimization scheduling model based on fuel cell energy cascade utilization, and performing constraint; step 4: and solving the mobile energy network optimization scheduling model, and performing optimization scheduling on the mobile energy network. The invention realizes the optimal scheduling strategy by taking the minimum running cost and the minimum carbon emission cost of the ship mobile energy system as targets on the premise of ensuring the reliable supply of the thermal power and the electric load of the ship energy network and the timely arrival of the ship safety.

title_en: Cable joint insulation state assessment method based on pressure wave detection
abstract_en: The invention relates to a cable joint insulation state evaluation method based on pressure wave detection, which comprises the following steps: step 1: constructing a simulation calculation model of the propagation rule of the pressure wave in the cable joint; step 2: constructing a pressure wave detection system of typical defects of the cable joint; step 3: constructing a cable joint partial discharge fault type identification model; step 4: constructing a model for identifying the partial discharge fault type of the cable joint based on the BP neural network; step 5: evaluating the insulation state of the cable joint based on a data statistics theory; the invention has the advantages of timely finding out the defects of the cable joint, no damage to the cable and high accuracy.
assignees: KAIFENG POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Short-term load prediction method based on multiple similar days and stacked learning
abstract_en: A short-term load prediction method based on a plurality of similar days and stack learning 1) processes time-series power load data with high nonlinearity and non-stationarity by using a sliding window algorithm; 2) The integrated learning method of the stacked neural network is provided, in the pre-training process, a radial basis function, a random vector function link and a back propagation neural network are integrated into a base layer network to provide a robust prediction model, and the base layer network utilizes a deep belief network and an improved generalized learning system to improve the prediction precision; 3) A similarity day prediction method is provided for extracting similar characteristics of the power load data in different time dimensions, so that the robustness and accuracy of the model are further enhanced. The present invention is achieved by using three strategies: the sliding window algorithm, the stacking algorithm and the similar day prediction method effectively extract the space-time characteristics of the historical load data, reduce the calculated amount, effectively improve the model prediction precision and enhance the robustness and accuracy of the prediction model.

title_en: Enhancement for minimizing service disruption
abstract_en: A User Equipment (UE) is configured to identify a disaster condition for application to a first Public Land Mobile Network (PLMN), select a second PLMN for disaster roaming service, wherein one or more Tracking Areas (TAs) of the second PLMN are stored locally in a forbidden list at the UE, and wherein the second PLMN and the first PLMN have roaming agreements for disaster roaming service, and register with the second PLMN disaster roaming service in the one or more TAs of the second PLMN from the forbidden list.

title_en: Multi-precision residual error quantization method in power monitoring and identification scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-precision residual quantization method under a power monitoring and identification scene, which comprises the steps of selecting a data set and preprocessing images in the data set; training an identification network, and applying a multi-precision residual quantization method in a residual structure of a backbone network to obtain backbone network image characteristics; integrating the image features of the backbone network through the pooling layer and the feature arrangement layer, and optimizing the updating rule of the gradient during training the network to obtain a final power monitoring and identifying model; the method is suitable for target detection tasks under power monitoring and identification scenes, has universality for the identification network with a residual structure, introduces a concept of multi-precision quantization in the traditional residual structure, and removes partial calculation redundancy of cyclic convolution; in the back propagation part, the gradient updating rule in training is modified, so that the convergence speed is increased.

title_en: Trade data processing method and system based on blockchain
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of blockchains, in particular to a blockchain-based trade data processing method and a blockchain-based trade data processing system. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring real-time trade data and historical trade data; carrying out standardized processing on the real-time trade data to obtain standard trade data; constructing a trade blockchain network based on standard trade data; carrying out trade product flow direction identification based on a trade blockchain network to obtain circulation link data; generating dynamic demand data based on the circulation link data; performing supply and demand perception modeling on the dynamic demand data to construct a dynamic supply and demand perception model; performing node capacity bottleneck calculation on the trade blockchain network by using a dynamic supply and demand perception model to generate node capacity bottleneck data; generating delivery efficiency data based on the node capacity bottleneck data; risk propagation analysis is performed on the delivery efficiency data to generate risk delivery path data. The method realizes efficient trade data processing.
assignees: SICHUAN RUIHUA HEZONG IND CO LTD

title_en: Urban energy system uncertainty propagation reasoning method based on evidence theory
abstract_en: The invention relates to an uncertainty propagation reasoning method of an urban energy system based on an evidence theory, which is technically characterized by establishing network node topology according to an energy conveying structure, judging connection relation between two nodes, calculating integral uncertainty information of the two nodes if the two nodes are connected in series, respectively calculating uncertainty ranges of the two nodes if the two nodes are connected in parallel, respectively forming two pieces of evidence by utilizing the information of the two nodes, respectively rewriting initial evidence through a weighted mass function, obtaining a synthesis result by adopting a D-S synthesis rule, establishing a class probability likelihood function to carry out information distribution, calculating the uncertainty information based on the information distribution result, and forming integral uncertainty information of the two nodes.

title_en: Multi-component coupling-oriented life prediction method, device and system for chain transmission system
abstract_en: A service life prediction method, device and system for a chain transmission system for multi-component coupling comprise the steps of carrying out topological structure decomposition on multiple components of the chain transmission system, extracting fault relations among all the components of the system by combining historical fault data and expert knowledge, preprocessing the fault data to obtain a structured fault feature matrix, establishing a fault propagation network of the chain transmission system by utilizing a cloud model symbol directed graph, constructing a modularized fault propagation path reasoning model based on functional relations and working condition changes of the components of the system, carrying out dynamic simulation and real-time analysis on fault propagation of the system by compatible path search and qualitative and quantitative conversion of the cloud model, carrying out unified quantification on random uncertainty and cognitive uncertainty, modeling degradation trend of the chain transmission system by adopting a regression model, optimizing model parameters, carrying out residual service life prediction of the chain transmission system by combining a first-time method, and giving confidence of service life prediction by confidence interval analysis.
assignees: ZHEJIANG HENGJIU TRANS TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;UNIV ZHEJIANG TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Three-network fault propagation risk assessment method and system for complex network analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-network fault propagation risk assessment method and system for complex network analysis, which belong to the technical field of toughness assessment and disaster risk management of an electric power system; the method comprises the steps of constructing a node importance evaluation function, carrying out weighted correction, outputting three-network coupling node importance ranking, generating a fault event trigger list, updating a node state matrix until the node state is not changed, outputting a fault influence range and a fault propagation path, calculating three-network overall connectivity loss rate, function recovery time estimation, key node fault sensitivity and coupling dependence vulnerability index, and outputting three-network fault propagation risk estimation indexes. The method can truly reflect the dependency relationship and the influence intensity among the three networks, quantify the contribution degree of the nodes to the system toughness, and realize the multidimensional, quantifiable and interpretable effective evaluation of the fault propagation risk under the complex network.

title_en: Symmetric entropy based key line identification method for two roles of power transmission network
