abstract_en: A key line identification method based on two roles of a power transmission network of symmetric entropy comprises the steps of obtaining relevant data information of the power transmission network; establishing a power evaluation quantification set of two roles of easy transmission and easy infection when the power transmission line is in normal operation; establishing a power evaluation quantification set of two roles of easy transmission and easy infection when the power transmission line runs in a fault; constructing a symmetrical entropy formula for identifying two roles of easy transmission and easy infection of the power transmission network; and identifying key lines with two roles of easy propagation and easy infection of the power transmission network by using the symmetric entropy. According to the method, two roles of easy propagation and easy infection of the key line are distinguished by constructing the symmetric entropy, and by distinguishing the two roles, the roles of the key lines with different roles in the cascading failure process are favorably disclosed, so that the key line identification is more refined.

title_en: Annual planned electric quantity curve decomposition method for cascade hydropower station group
abstract_en: A method for decomposing annual planned electric quantity curves of a cascade hydropower station group comprises the following steps: step one: taking the differentiated load regulation requirements of a plurality of receiving end power grids into consideration, and constructing a peak regulation criterion model of electric quantity curve decomposition; step two: determining a typical load curve of each receiving-end power grid in a peak shaving criterion model; step three: using the large M method, a 0-1 variable b is introduced  sc,d,k,m  Large number M, two continuous variables x  sc,d,k,m  、o  sc,d,k,m  At this time, the mathematical description of the positive and negative deviation can be abstracted into a general rule of the power market performance problem, and then a mixed integer programming model is adopted for solving. The method can obtain a reasonable annual month-by-month electric quantity decomposition curve of the multi-grid of the cascade hydropower station, can effectively respond to the differential peak regulation demands of different receiving end grids, and improves the differential load response capability of the cascade hydropower system to the receiving end grids.

title_en: Intelligent building operation and maintenance management system and method based on BIM platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent building management, in particular to an intelligent building operation and maintenance management system and method based on a BIM platform. The method comprises the steps of constructing a device connection topology network according to acquired target BIM building model data to generate device physical connection topology data, automatically removing logic conflict of the device physical connection topology data to generate device connection topology data, analyzing fault influence links of the device connection topology data to generate fault propagation link data, evaluating fault severity of the fault propagation link data to generate device fault severity data, and performing intelligent operation and maintenance path planning according to the device fault severity data to obtain intelligent device operation and maintenance path data. According to the invention, through the fine division of the operation and maintenance equipment management space and the analysis of the equipment fault propagation link, the intelligent scheduling of fault operation and maintenance tasks is realized, and the operation and maintenance efficiency and the precision of resource allocation are obviously improved.

title_en: Source network load storage collaborative planning method and system considering multi-main-body hybrid game
abstract_en: The invention relates to a source network charge storage collaborative planning method and system considering multi-main body mixed games, wherein the method comprises the following steps of establishing a power distribution network collaborative planning model considering source network charge storage main body master-slave-collaborative mixed games, wherein the power distribution network collaborative planning model is a double-layer model and comprises a power distribution network operator, an upper layer master-slave game sub-model of other main bodies and a lower layer laminated game sub-model between source charge storage side main bodies; and solving the collaborative planning model of the power distribution network by adopting a solving strategy combining a target cascading analysis method and a self-adaptive coefficient alternating direction multiplier method to obtain an optimal planning scheme of a newly-built and distributed power supply and an energy storage device of the circuit. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of realizing efficient configuration and coordinated utilization of the source network charge storage resources, improving planning reliability and the like.

title_en: Unmanned intelligent patrol equipment cooperative scheduling method and system in photovoltaic power generation scene
abstract_en: The invention provides a cooperative scheduling method and a system for unmanned intelligent patrol equipment in a photovoltaic power generation scene, which relate to the technical field of intelligent patrol of photovoltaic power stations and comprise the following steps: task priority classification and time sequence association analysis are carried out based on a dynamic self-adaptive neural network and a sequence predictor, a task dependency graph is constructed, a candidate task allocation scheme is generated based on a deep reinforcement learning framework, the candidate scheme is optimized by combining a collaborative decision system constructed by a multi-objective genetic algorithm and a graph injection force mechanism with the aim of minimizing the completion time, energy consumption and maximizing the coverage rate, the task allocation constraint is updated by utilizing a confidence propagation network, abnormal conditions are judged by a Bayesian inference algorithm, and finally an optimal scheduling scheme is output, so that the inspection efficiency of the photovoltaic power station can be effectively improved, the energy consumption is reduced, and the inspection coverage rate is improved.

title_en: Low-voltage distribution network fluctuation risk research and judgment and intelligent early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a low-voltage distribution network fluctuation risk studying, judging and intelligent early warning method and system, and relates to the technical field of intelligent early warning of electric power systems, wherein the method comprises the steps of performing fusion analysis on power grid operation data and environment data through a space-time convolutional neural network to generate an associated feature matrix of power grid operation state and environment risk; the method comprises the steps of carrying out dynamic modeling on a power grid topological structure by utilizing a physical information dynamic graph attention network, extracting a dynamic risk propagation path, adopting a Bayesian network to calculate fault probability distribution of each node of the power grid in combination with the dynamic risk propagation path, optimizing an early warning strategy through a reinforcement learning algorithm to generate an optimal early warning scheme, and scheduling rush repair resources by utilizing a multi-objective optimization algorithm to generate a rush repair resource scheduling scheme. The method has the beneficial effects of remarkably improving the accuracy of fault early warning and the rush-repair efficiency and providing reliable technical support for the intelligent operation and maintenance of the low-voltage distribution network.

title_en: Enterprise risk assessment method based on multi-agent risk assessment algorithm MA-ERC
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of data evaluation, and discloses an enterprise risk evaluation method based on a multi-agent risk evaluation algorithm MA-ERC, which comprises the following steps of S1, constructing an enterprise multidimensional risk knowledge graph; S2, designing a risk assessment algorithm MA-ERC to assess initial risks of enterprises and quantify propagation risk values among the enterprises, S3, constructing an MNF-GNN model to carry out enterprise risk assessment, S4, constructing an enterprise risk assessment interpretable graph EG, combining a multi-agent architecture based on a large language model with a graph-based risk propagation algorithm to simulate the risk propagation process among the enterprises more accurately and reasonably, wherein the calculated propagation risk values can effectively improve the assessment precision of the risk assessment model, and a new idea is provided for the technical combination of the multi-agent architecture based on the large language model, a knowledge graph, a graph neural network and the like.

title_en: Risk grading method for fusion of tunnel seismic wave data and geological information
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster early warning, in particular to a risk classification method for fusion of tunnel seismic wave data and geological information, which comprises the following steps of S1, collecting amplitude, frequency response and propagation delay information of multi-time-phase seismic waves of a tunnel, identifying abnormal response events, extracting spatial propagation paths of the abnormal response events by combining a tunnel structure, and generating a seismic wave induction response event chain set; S3, calculating trend activating factors by counting the liveness, the derivative direction and the time sequence trend of the structural units in the conduction diagram, and generating a risk level map with predictability and evolution capability. According to the method, the dynamic, accurate and predictive hierarchical assessment of the tunnel structure risk is realized by constructing the seismic response event chain and the structure conduction network, fusing multi-source geological information and introducing trend activating factors.

title_en: Jellyfish capture device
title_ko: 해파리 포획장치
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 해파리를 그물을 이용하여 대량으로 포획할 수 있도록 한 해파리 포획장치(1)를 제공하는 것으로서, 상기 본 발명은 전방으로 개방되게 형성된 전반유입부(21)와 전반유입부(21)의 후방으로 결합되어 후단이 폐쇄되게 구성된 후반저장부(22)로 이루어진 자루그물(2)의 전반유입부(21) 입구에 결합 구성된 금속제 유입틀(3)이 구비되며, 유입틀(3)의 전면 양측이 견인로프(6)로 선박(A)과 연결 구성되면서 유입틀(3)의 상측과 선박(A)에 연결되어 유입틀(3)의 깊이를 조절하는 깊이조절로프(7)가 연결된 전방부표(4)가 구비되며, 후반저장부(22) 후단과 지지로프(8)로 연결 구성된 후방부표(5)가 구비되며, 전반유입부(21)와 후반저장부(22)의 경계부(23)를 둘러싸면서 선박(A)의 양망기(B)에 양단이 연결된 인양로프(9)가 구비된 것을 특징으로 하며, 이러한 본 발명에 의하면 각종 해파리를 대량으로 포획할 수 있으며, 인양 시 경계부(23)가 죄여 해파리의 유실을 방지하면서 산채로 포획하여 식용으로 사용할 시 신선도를 높일 수 있으며, 해파리에 의한 인명사고, 어업손실 및 산업시설의 손실 등을 근원적으로 해결할 수 있으며, 그밖에도 경제적으로 향상된 파급효과를 미치는 등 다수의 효과를 기대할 수 있는 것이다.

title_en: Correlation assessment method of power grid cascading failure accident chains
abstract_en: A correlation assessment method of power grid cascading failure accident chains comprises the steps that (1) a system is initialized to be in a normal operation working condition; (2) initial failures happen to circuits with equal probability, circuit initial failures are circuit three-phase permanent short-circuit failures, relay protecting action failure removing in a set time is carried out, and for direct-current circuit, the initial failures are direct-current circuit single-pole locking failures; (3) based on the previous circuit failure situations, transient stability analysis is carried out on an electric system, if system transient is unstable, the step (7) is carried out; and if system transient is stable, the step (4) is carried out; and other steps are carried out. According to the method, on the basis that the correlation between cascading failures can be considered, system transient stability failures can be subjected to effective searching, searching correlation probability is given, system states and topology are considered, meanwhile, high computing efficiency is achieved, and certain guiding effect is achieved on cascading failure searching and accident chain recognition.
assignees: CT OF POWER GRID PLANNING AND RES YUNNAN POWER GRID CORP

title_en: Method for simulating complicated cascading failures of power grids under extreme meteorological disaster conditions
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for simulating complicated cascading failures of power grids under extreme meteorological disaster conditions. The method comprises the following steps: reading all the failure set lines, calculating and merging the line lengths, and calculating the total line length; selecting failure lines according to the total line length and correspondingly setting line failures; determining the time lengths and intervals of the failures and randomly generating group-occurring successive failures; setting a simulation termination criterion which comprises a splitting criterion, a power angle instability criterion and a network resolving non-convergence criterion; and carrying out time domain simulation on the generated group-occurring successive failures until a termination condition of the simulation termination criterion is satisfied. According to the method, the conventional large power grid breakdown analysis method which takes load flow calculation and line overload as basic means is expanded, and the time domain simulation of detailed models is considered, so that the disturbance factors and performance characteristics in the blackout evolution process can be reflected more comprehensively.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: A kind of method for weighting Seismic net than generation based on ceiling capacity
abstract_en: The invention belongs to complex network technical fields, and in particular to a kind of based on method of the ceiling capacity than generation weighting Seismic net.Technical solution is as follows：A kind of method for being weighted Seismic net than generation based on ceiling capacity, is included the following steps：Step 1：Build network analysis topological property；Step 2：According to magnitude, influence diameter and influence time relationship carries out network modelling；Step 3：Undirected Seismic net and oriented Seismic net are generated by simulation；Step 4：Define based on ceiling capacity than company's side right value method；Step 5：Draw out the distribution probability table of side right value in network；Step 6：Draw the probability distribution graph of side right value in network；Step 7：Draw the probability double-log distribution map of side right value in network.The method provided by the invention for weighting Seismic net than generation based on ceiling capacity, for Study of Seismic propagation path.

title_en: A kind of industrial park power distribution network collaborative planning method considering multiple-energy-source coupled characteristic
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of industrial park power distribution network collaborative planning methods considering multiple-energy-source coupled characteristic, include the following steps：S1. receipts money is investigated in industrial park userbase and Industry Development；S2. industrial park is carried out with energy requirement forecasting；S3. all kinds of energy resources power producing characteristics models are established；S4. according to industrial park energy characteristics, programme object function is built, and establish energy resources constraints；S5. according to comprehensive energy resource Coupling Characteristics, analysis matching is carried out to all kinds of resources；S6. economic and social benefits assessment is carried out to integrated energy planning scheme, obtains comprehensive energy collaboration final scheme.The present invention builds the programme object function based on dual layer resist first, more scientifically and rationally carry out industrial park comprehensive energy collaborative planning on this basis, comprehensive energy collaborative planning scheme can preferably be obtained, the fluctuation sex chromosome mosaicism of regenerative resource is made up, realizes the interaction of the industrial park energy and cascade utilization.
assignees: GRID POWER PLANNING & RES CT GUANGDONG GRID POWER CO LTD

title_en: Real-time power load prediction system based on sparse pruning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real-time power load prediction system based on a sparse pruning method, which adopts connection sensitivity to express the importance of neural network connection and removes connection with smaller relevance to an objective function in the network back propagation process according to the connection importance, so that GRU neural network connection in the prediction system becomes sparse, the sparse GRU neural network only needs to carry out single pruning on the GRU neural network, and the prediction performance is optimized by using a fine tuning mode. Through actual tests, results show that 99.3% of parameters in the GRU prediction system are removed by a single pruning algorithm based on connection sensitivity, the classification accuracy of the system is not lost under the condition of realizing high sparsity, and the problems of parameter redundancy and huge calculation amount of the GRU prediction system in a training stage are solved.

title_en: System and method for controlling operation risk of hydro-junction in real time
abstract_en: The invention provides a system and a method for controlling the operational risk of a hydro-junction in real time, belonging to the technical field of hydropower and water conservancy, wherein the system comprises: the risk monitoring subsystem is used for constructing a risk transmission link, laying a risk monitoring network, and monitoring the change condition of the external environment of the hydropower station and the operation condition of the internal unit in real time through terminal monitoring equipment and manual inspection; the risk analysis subsystem is used for analyzing the risk transmission link, determining a risk occurrence point, formulating and screening an optimal risk truncation scheme according to the risk occurrence point, feeding back the risk truncation condition to the risk analysis subsystem through the risk control subsystem, and synchronously analyzing the propagation position of the risk by using a parallel simulation method; and the risk control subsystem is used for carrying out risk truncation and feeding back the risk truncation condition to the risk analysis subsystem. The invention realizes the multi-dimensional risk perception and control of the hydropower station and improves the risk perception and risk response capability of the hydropower station.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Rumor propagation model building method based on official clarification and platform supervision mechanism
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rumor propagation model building method based on an official clarification and platform supervision mechanism, which is characterized in that four groups of a susceptible person S, a hesitant H, an infected person I and an immune person R are assumed to exist on a social media platform, an official clarification person C and a banker B are added into the rumor propagation model for the first time, a SHIR-CB model is built, and the synergistic effect of the official clarification mechanism and the platform supervision mechanism in rumor treatment is emphasized. In addition, the model considers the influence of the social media platform network structure on rumor propagation, and the validity of the model can be evaluated by utilizing real social media platform rumor data. The designs enable the model to more truly depict and predict the actual effect of an official clarification mechanism and a platform supervision mechanism in the joint inhibition of rumor propagation, thereby remarkably improving the prediction precision of rumor propagation and the practical value of the model.

title_en: Comprehensive energy system transmission and distribution cooperation layering optimization scheduling method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive energy system transmission and distribution collaborative hierarchical optimization scheduling method, belonging to the field of comprehensive energy system transmission and distribution optimization; the comprehensive energy system transmission and distribution collaborative hierarchical optimization scheduling method comprises the following steps: constructing a hot water network equivalent model and a terminal building equivalent model, and fusing to obtain a thermodynamic system equivalent model considering thermal inertia; constructing a natural gas pipeline equivalent gas circuit model, and constructing a natural gas system equivalent model considering the pipe storage characteristic based on the natural gas pipeline equivalent gas circuit model; based on a thermodynamic system equivalent model and a natural gas system equivalent model, constructing a grid-transfer layer system optimization scheduling model and a distribution network layer system optimization scheduling model by taking economic optimization as a target; and decomposing the network layer optimizing problem and the distribution network layer optimizing problem by adopting a target cascading method, and respectively solving a network layer system optimizing and scheduling model and a distribution network layer system optimizing and scheduling model.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHEAST;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for identifying key vehicle nodes of local traffic network for intelligent network-connected vehicle decision planning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for identifying key vehicle nodes of a local traffic network for intelligent network vehicle decision planning, which combines dynamic vehicle network characteristics and complex network theory, considers the direct and indirect propagation of risks and network dynamic characteristics, and provides a method for identifying key vehicle nodes in the local traffic network based on epidemic propagation mechanism. The method has the advantages that the path diversity from the risk of abnormality of the vehicle nodes to the neighbor nodes is directly considered in the propagation, and the potential propagation risk of the vehicle nodes is considered in the indirect propagation on a larger scale, so that the key nodes in the dynamic vehicle network can be more accurately excavated. Helping intelligent automobiles form a more rapid and effective driving strategy.

title_en: Position and capacity optimization method for distributed photovoltaic access power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention provides a position and capacity optimization method of a distributed photovoltaic access power distribution network, which comprises the following steps of S1: defining Beta distribution of solar light intensity, and probability density functions of photovoltaic output power and electric load, and simulating power generation and load fluctuation under actual conditions; step S2: constructing a voltage evaluation model of propagation uncertainty by configuring a local agent and a central coordinator and defining a coordination function; step S3: the uncertainty in model output is quantified by a Sobol method through multi-agent reinforcement learning and optimization parameter updating strategies; step S4: and (3) through dispersing calculation tasks and exchanging information, establishing a model to optimize the address and capacity of the photovoltaic access node, minimizing line loss and considering constraint conditions. The invention provides powerful support for stable operation, efficiency improvement and sustainable development of the power grid through accurately processing and quantifying the uncertainty in the power grid and optimizing the distributed photovoltaic access strategy.
assignees: NANJING ANENGJIE ELECTRIC POWER IND CO LTD

title_en: Hybrid game coordination optimization method for active power distribution network containing multiple micro-grids by considering dynamic power coefficient of grid passing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hybrid game coordination optimization method of an active power distribution network containing multiple micro-grids, which considers dynamic power coefficients of an over-grid, and comprises the following steps: 1, establishing a power distribution network framework structure containing point-to-point power interaction of a plurality of micro-grids aiming at a power interaction system consisting of a power distribution network and the micro-grids; 2, the leader establishes a main distribution network optimization model with minimum total operation energy consumption; 3, the follower establishes a slave multi-micro-grid point-to-point electric energy interaction model with the minimum running energy consumption as a target; and 4, establishing a hybrid game coordination optimization model of the active power distribution network with the multiple micro-grids based on the dynamic power coefficient of the passing network based on the Stackelberg game theory, and solving by combining a dichotomy method with a target cascade analysis method based on diagonal quadratic approximation to obtain a hybrid game coordination optimization scheme of the active power distribution network with the multiple micro-grids. The invention can dynamically update the networking power coefficient so that the networking power coefficient can effectively cover the energy loss generated by network resources.

title_en: Underwater wireless sensor network propagation model construction method based on cellular automaton
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of wireless sensor networks, in particular to a method for constructing an underwater wireless sensor network propagation model based on cellular automata, which comprises the steps of constructing an underwater wireless sensor network model, and acquiring the position of each time node, continuously updating the state and the position of the node by adopting a new cellular space and an updating rule, and constructing an underwater wireless sensor network propagation model based on the cellular automaton based on a new updating mechanism. The application describes the spatial distribution change of the malicious program propagation in the underwater wireless sensor network and the global change trend of the infected nodes, and solves the problem that the malicious program propagation description of the underwater wireless sensor network is lacking in a malicious program propagation model based on a cellular automaton model in the prior art.

title_en: Port equipment cluster multi-energy control method based on quantum deep reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-energy control method for port equipment clusters based on quantum deep reinforcement learning, which comprises the steps of obtaining energy related data and equipment state data of a port, preprocessing the data, converting the preprocessed energy related data and the preprocessed equipment state data into quantum state data according to quantum coding rules, generating probability distribution for selecting energy combinations according to the quantum state data by utilizing a quantum strategy network, selecting optimal energy combinations according to greedy strategies, updating and quantum counter-propagation optimization by utilizing a reward function, a value network, optimizing the optimal energy combinations, and controlling energy equipment of the port according to the optimized optimal energy combinations. Compared with the prior art, the method and the device can comprehensively consider the factors such as cost, energy utilization rate, carbon emission and the like according to the actual operation condition of the port, accurately select the most suitable energy, effectively improve the energy utilization rate and reduce the energy waste.

title_en: Beidou signal high-precision positioning and measuring method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of communication, and particularly relates to a Beidou signal high-precision positioning and measuring method, which comprises the following steps of researching the correlation and analysis algorithm of a Beidou signal structure, a propagation path and receiving processing, and improving the observation precision from the perspective of a data source; according to the Beidou multi-frequency RTK deep coupling technology, calculating a double-difference three-frequency pseudo-range and carrier combination observed value, cooperatively applying a regional network error model, carrying out coordinate calculation and error correction on the basis, and combining an accurate time synchronization and dual monitoring system to obtain high-precision positioning data. According to the invention, through a precise and efficient positioning and attitude determination algorithm, the data processing precision of the Beidou signal is improved, and more accurate data support can be provided for the fields of transportation, public safety, disaster reduction, disaster prevention and the like.
assignees: GUANGXI PRODUCTION RESEARCH INSTITUTE SPACE TIME INFORMATION TECH INSTITUTE CO LTD;UNIV GUILIN ELECTRONIC TECH

title_en: Multi-sensor fusion emergency lamp strip control method and system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a multi-sensor fusion emergency light strip control method and system, wherein after an abnormal event is monitored by receiving environment monitoring data fed back by a plurality of groups of emergency light strips and carrying out abnormal event monitoring, a second emergency light strip which is in cooperative response with a first emergency light strip is dynamically determined based on a partition structure diagram of a building, the type of the abnormal event and abnormal characteristic parameters, so that the control range of the emergency light strip is not limited to a single area any more, and is linked with a building space structure according to a risk propagation rule, a cooperative control network covering a related area is formed, and the influence range of the abnormal event is ensured to be positioned and warned rapidly. Furthermore, the evacuation route and the forbidden region are determined by fusing the second environment monitoring data and the characteristic parameters, and the differential control is performed by combining a preset lamp band control strategy, so that the characteristics of different abnormal events are considered, and the real-time environment parameters are combined, so that the fine control of the emergency lamp band is realized.

title_en: Multi-network cascading failure propagation prediction method based on heterogeneous graph neural network under disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-network chained fault propagation prediction method based on a heterogeneous graph neural network under a disaster, which comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source data of the disaster, electric power, communication and traffic networks, constructing a four-layer heterogeneous graph model, defining multi-type interlayer edges, establishing a mapping relation between disaster physical quantity and physical node health states, predicting initial fault states at disaster impact time, defining multi-scale multi-mechanism propagation rules based on the interlayer edges, simulating chained fault processes, constructing a space-time heterogeneous graph neural network model, stacking a heterogeneous graph neural network module and a gating circulation unit module, adopting a double-head prediction layer to predict node continuous running states and discrete functional states in an autoregressive mode, carrying out post-processing on a state time sequence output by the model, and reconstructing a cross-domain chained fault propagation path through a causal attribution algorithm. The invention can accurately simulate the whole evolution process from disaster occurrence to multi-network cascading failure, and realize multi-scale failure prediction and causal analysis.
assignees: JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO RES INST

title_en: Establishment and operation method of emergency communication system in a massive disaster situation
title_ko: 재난 상황에서의 긴급통신 시스템의 구축 및 운용 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method to establish and operate an emergency communication system in a situation that part or entire communication system malfunctions due to a natural disaster or a massive accident by propagating the disaster situation, rapidly establishing an emergency communication network and operate a system in an emergency communication mode, performing operation to recognize locations of victims and simultaneously providing a group communication function to command and control rescue agents when a communication life-line needs to be established and maintained to rescue the victims with minimum power consumption. Also, a method according to an embodiment of the present invention makes remote control of victims terminal possible in case of emergency by extending the conception of a public warning system (PWS). As such, base stations and terminals operating in an emergency mode can be operated in a minimum power-consumption mode. Also, a method according to an embodiment of the present invention performs a function to recognize locations of the victims by additionally performing functions related to accurate positioning and a function to increase a survival rate of the victims and victims′ terminals.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 자연 재해/재난 또는 대형 사고에 의하여 통신 인프라가 일부 또는 전체가 와해된 상황에서, 신속하게 긴급통신망을 구축하여 재난상황을 전파하고, 긴급통신모드로서 시스템을 동작한다. 피해자들의 위치를 파악하기 위한 동작을 수행하고, 시스템이 최소한의 전력을 소모하며 피해자의 구조를 위한 통신생명선 (communication life-line)을 구축 및 유지하기 위한  필요 시, 재난안전 요원들의 지휘통제를 위한 그룹통신 기능의 동시 제공  시스템의 구축 및 그 운용 방법을 제시한다. 기본적으로 PWS (Public Warning System)의 개념을 확장하여, 긴급 재난상황에서의 피해자 단말을 원격 제어할 수 있도록 한다. 이를 통하여, 긴급모드로 운용되는 기지국 및 단말이 최소 전력 모드로서 운용될 수 있도록 한다. 또한, 단말의 위치에 대한 정밀 측위와 관련된 기능들을 추가적으로 수행하여, 피해자의 위치를 파악하고, 추가적으로 피해자 및 피해자 단말의 생존성을 높이는 기능을 수행한다.

title_en: Method for determining infectious disease transmission risk for facilities
title_ko: 시설물의 감염병 전파 위험도 판단 방법
abstract_en: Provided is a method for determining the infectious disease transmission risk for facilities. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the method for determining the infectious disease transmission risk for facilities involves identifying whether there are any contacts of a confirmed case of an infectious disease, identifying facilities in which the identified contacts have been in contact with the confirmed case, and determining the infectious disease transmission risk for the identified facilities. Accordingly, the infectious transmission risk for the facilities can be determined on the basis of objective criteria, thus making it possible to take reasonable, systematic, and effective follow-up measures for the facilities visited by the confirmed case of the infectious disease and ultimately contribute to the prevention and suppression of a pandemic of the infectious disease.
abstract_ko: 시설물의 감염병 전파 위험도 판단 방법이 제공된다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 시설물의 감염병 전파 위험도 판단 방법은, 감염병에 확진된 확진자와 접촉한 접촉자가 있는지 탐지하고, 탐지된 접촉자가 확진자와 접촉한 시설물을 파악하며, 파악된 시설물의 감염병 전파 위험도를 판단한다. 이에 의해, 시설물의 감염병 전파 위험도를 객관적인 기준에 의거하여 판단할 수 있으므로, 감염병 확진자가 방문한 시설물에 대한 합리적이고 체계적이며 효과적인 사후 조치가 가능해져, 궁극적으로 감염병 대유행의 예방과 억제에 기여할 수 있게 된다.

title_en: Method for generating train system fault propagation path based on fault potential energy field
abstract_en: The invention provides a generation method of a train system fault propagation path based on a fault potential energy field, which comprises the following steps: constructing a complex network model of a rail train system; constructing a propagation probability model among components of a rail train system according to a virus propagation model and a fault potential energy field theory; constructing a rail train system fault propagation model according to the rail train system component propagation probability model and the rail train system complex network model; and carrying out iterative judgment according to the rail train system fault propagation model to obtain a train system fault propagation path. The invention analyzes the fault propagation process of the train system from the network structure of the rail train system, the self state and the internal mechanism of the nodes, further obtains all possible propagation paths and the probability thereof, and is beneficial to carrying out operation and maintenance work with better quality.

title_en: Hydropower cluster division method suitable for hydropower enrichment power grid power dispatching
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydropower cluster division method suitable for power dispatching of a hydropower enrichment power grid. The hydropower station adjustment capacity data acquisition method comprises the steps of carrying out scale division on a hydropower station to obtain hydropower station scale data, carrying out adjustment capacity division on the hydropower station to obtain hydropower station adjustment capacity data, carrying out three-level cluster division on the hydropower station to obtain third-level cluster data of the hydropower station, obtaining a hydraulic topology structure diagram with installed scale attributes and adjustment capacity attributes, obtaining a final hydropower cluster division result, and calculating the power generation capacity of hydropower clusters according to the final hydropower cluster division result. The method is suitable for not only serial cascade hydropower station clusters, but also cross-basin cascade hydropower station clusters developed in parallel, and comprehensively considers the attribute of the power section, the attribute of the dispatching main body, the attribute of the investment main body, the attribute of the regulation, the attribute of the hydraulic connection and the attribute of the installation scale of the hydropower station, and is more suitable for dividing hydropower clusters of the electric power dispatching of the hydropower enrichment power grid.

title_en: Day runoff prediction method based on multi-feature fusion and two-dimensional time convolution network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a daily runoff prediction method based on multi-feature fusion and a two-dimensional time convolution network, which comprises the following steps of carrying out feature mining and feature fusion on hydrologic and meteorological multi-source data of a target river basin, and constructing a multi-source fusion feature matrix as input of a space-time feature extraction stage; and constructing an overall network framework model, determining training parameters of a network, and training and predicting. The method has the advantages that the method adopts a double-layer routing attention mechanism to perform feature fusion on internal mode features and screening features, focuses key information in multi-source features, introduces residual connection to enhance information flow and gradient propagation, relieves gradient disappearance problem in deep networks, extracts key detail features and simultaneously retains original feature information, and regards the fused multi-source feature sequence as two-dimensional features to perform expansion convolution instead of a one-dimensional sequence of a plurality of channels so as to enhance the capability of capturing fine granularity information of the network.

title_en: Three-network collaborative power grid recovery method and system based on complex network theory
abstract_en: The invention provides a three-network collaborative power grid recovery method and system based on a complex network theory, which belong to the technical field of power systems, and effectively solve the problems that the traditional scheme only focuses on fault propagation in a single network, the simulation result and the actual physical condition of the traditional scheme are greatly different, and the traditional power grid recovery strategy mainly only considers a single traditional power generation power station due to the single structure of a current urban power station, so that the disaster recovery capability is poor, the disaster resistance capability is weak and the recovery strategy is not flexible enough.

title_en: Underground radio network integrated repeater system
title_ko: 지하 무선망 종합 중계장치
abstract_en: An integrated repeating system of underground radio networks is provided to solve a problem that a user cannot watch a terrestrial service in an underground environment. An integrated repeating system of underground radio networks comprises an antenna receiver(10), an emergency broadcasting unit(11), an automatic switch(12), a repeater, a transmission monitoring unit(17), a multiple band coupler(18), the second distributer(20), a leakage coaxial cable(24) and a remote manager(33). The antenna receiver(10) receives a wireless signal of a modulated sky wave via a receipt antenna, and converts the wireless signal into an electric signal. The emergency broadcasting unit(11) amplifies, modulates, reamplifies and synthesizes a voice signal recorded by an event signal of a fire detector or a voice signal inputted via a mike. The automatic switch(12) switches a broadcast signal of a sky wave received from the antenna receiver(10) and an emergency broadcast signal inputted from an emergency broadcasting unit. The repeater repeats the broadcast signal received from the automatic switch(12) and includes a fault detector which outputs fault information. The transmission monitoring unit(17) receives a signal from the repeater, and monitors whether the repeater is normally operated. The multiple band coupler(18) couples the signal, inputted from an external communication network, and the signal, inputted from the repeater, via one transmission cable. The second distributer(20) distributes the signal inputted from the multiple band coupler(18). The leakage coaxial cable(24) outputs a signal from the second distributer(20) to a terminating resistor. The remote manager(33) receives the fault information from the fault detector of the repeater, manages a fault state and transmits the fault information via an LAN connector to a remote place.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 지하 무선망 종합 중계장치에 관한 것으로서, 터널이나 광산의 갱도, 지하상가, 지하철 또는 지하주차장 등의 전파차단지역 및 전파음영지역에서 방송신호(AM/FM)와 더불어 지상파 DMB 방송신호를 중계할 수 있도록 할 뿐만 아니라 비상상황 발생시 AM/FM 라디오방송과 구내의 무선스피커를 통해 비상방송을 할 수 있도록 하며 원격지에서 중계장치 및 전송선로의 고장여부를 종합적으로 판단할 수 있는 효과가 있다.  
       
     지하무선, 중계장치, 비상방송, 고장검출, 무선스피커, DMB, AM, FM

title_en: Blind fast network synchronization algorithm for reducing LTE public safety product costs
abstract_en: Systems and methods are provided for providing blind fast network synchronization for reducing LTE public safety products costs, comprising, in one embodiment: determining if location setup is required to mitigate timing offset due to propagation delay from the synchronization source and adjusting downlink timing, and when location setup is required then providing one of manual setup in terms of timing samples, limited power RACH based on SIB2 parameters, and based on observed time difference of arrival and position reference signal; coordinating network listening periods based on graphs and hash function to avoid common silence for two or more neighboring eNodeBs; and providing continuous synchronization using blind carrier estimation.

title_en: Using computer video camera to detect earthquake
abstract_en: Images from the video camera (24) of a computer are compared (46) over time, e.g., every few milliseconds, to determine from the pixel data if motion of the computer matches template motion associated with an earthquake P-wave. If so, a warning is generated (58), uploaded to a communication network, and propagated over the network to other computers.

title_en: Intelligent power grid economic dispatching method based on integrated neural network
abstract_en: An integrated neural network-based intelligent power grid economic dispatching method is used for acquiring power generation parameters of a power grid system, wherein the power generation parameters comprise power generation cost functions of all power generators in the system and upper and lower limits of the load of the power generators; generating a large data set using an existing optimal non-convex optimization algorithm; constructing a deep neural network named as EDNet by using a current data set, and learning data in the data set through a back propagation technology to enable the output of the network to gradually approach an output part in the data set; fine-tuning the output of the EDNet by using a fine-tuning algorithm to obtain an optimal solution which strictly meets the problem constraint; using AdaboosSequentially training M EDNet by using the t.R2 algorithm as a training strategy, and parallelly arranging the M EDNet to form E 2 DNet; and selecting the solution with the minimum power generation cost from the M optimal solutions as the optimal solution of the whole integrated network. To be trained completely E 2 DNet is put into use, and economic dispatching problems of the smart grid are processed on line.

title_en: Method for predicting importance of nodes of power system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a power system node importance prediction method, which is based on the convolution long-short term memory network to predict the importance of the power system node, and comprises a training set construction process, a model training process and an importance prediction process; the method comprises the following steps that a training set is constructed in the training set construction process based on historical power flow data of power system nodes, a prediction model is trained by using the training set in the model training process to obtain a trained prediction model, and the importance prediction of the power system nodes is carried out by using the trained prediction model in the importance prediction process. The method for predicting the importance of the power system nodes can be used for rapidly and accurately predicting the importance of the power system nodes, so that data guidance is provided for preventing cascading failures in advance and avoiding failures.

title_en: Method for realizing power grid alarm data association traceability system based on density clustering and self-organizing network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for realizing a power grid alarm data correlation traceability system based on density clustering and a self-organizing network, which comprises the following steps: segmenting original alarm data of multiple power stations based on multiple dimensions, and performing feature vectorization by using feature keywords of each dimension; extracting target suspicious alarm data from the vectorized alarm data, establishing a correlation index ConValue, and clustering the target alarm data and the alarm data of each power station by using a DBSCAN to obtain a plurality of pieces of correlation data; extracting the associated data and the alarm starting time and the latest occurrence time of the target alarm data, defining the port entry and the port exit of the associated data by taking the time of the target alarm data as an origin, and constructing an attack propagation diagram with two time dimensions; and performing secondary feature segmentation on the associated data of the multiple power stations, and performing secondary feature mining by using a self-organizing network to obtain fine-grained feature description of the associated data. The invention can ensure the safe and stable operation of the power monitoring system.
assignees: INF & TELECOMMUNICATION CO STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Active prevention and control construction method and system for operation risk of urban rail transit system
abstract_en: The invention provides an active prevention and control construction method and system for urban rail transit system operation risks, which belong to the technical field of urban rail transit operation maintenance and comprise the following steps: constructing an active urban rail transit risk prevention and control system; based on the constructed urban rail transit risk active prevention and control system, identifying urban rail transit operation risk points by using a condition judgment method; based on the constructed urban rail transit risk active prevention and control system, key risk points in a risk propagation chain are identified by combining data analysis. The invention provides an active risk prevention and control strategy for preventing accidents from the perspective of networked operation overall situation, and has important theoretical and practical significance for promoting the risk management of rail transit operation safety and guaranteeing safe and efficient operation.

title_en: Method, system and equipment for evaluating vulnerability of power CPS under typhoon disaster
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a method, a system, equipment and a medium for evaluating electric power CPS vulnerability under typhoon disasters, wherein the method is based on typhoon historical record data, obtains typhoon occurrence frequency by adopting stable poisson distribution, adopts a line cutting model to fit typhoon paths, simulates typhoon disaster areas by a simulated circle method, and determines states of communication nodes and power grid observable domains according to power supply and monitoring coupling relations between power grids and communication networks under cascading faults caused by typhoon disasters so as to obtain working states of electric power lines. And (3) considering the processing method of the overload of the power line under different working states of the power line, updating the power flow distribution of the power grid, and calculating the load loss rate of the power CPS to quantify the vulnerability of the system. The method and the device fully consider the coupling relation of power supply and monitoring between the power and the communication network, the cascade fault process of the power CPS under typhoon disasters, the vulnerability assessment of the power CPS after the disaster is accurately simulated, and the safe and reliable operation of the power system is ensured.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD WENZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Risk transfer method for cascade hydropower junction group
abstract_en: The invention discloses a step hydroelectric junction group risk transfer method, which comprises the steps of drawing a step hydroelectric junction group risk network diagram aiming at different step compositions of a step hydroelectric junction group; based on the cascade hydroelectric junction group risk network diagram, constructing a graph neural network model, and establishing a risk transfer calculation method between different risk nodes and edges; acquiring historical water level, flow, gradient and intensity data of each step of a step hydropower junction group in a research area, and converting related data into dimensionless data serving as a graph neural network training data set; and (3) giving scenes of different water levels, flow rates and gradients, and calculating by using a graph neural network model to obtain risk values of all network nodes. The method fully digs the interaction relation of different levels of the cascade hydroelectric junction group and multiple elements in the levels, and solves the problem of insufficient consideration of the traditional risk analysis method on the interaction between factors.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Power grid performance prediction method and system based on depth matrix decomposition technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid performance prediction method and a system based on a depth matrix decomposition technology, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring data in a smart grid sensor, normalizing the data, forming an original data matrix from the normalized data, and generating an indication matrix corresponding to the original data matrix; stacking a plurality of fully-connected neural networks into a deep neural network model, inputting regularized variables into the deep neural network model as potential variables, and simultaneously taking an original data matrix as input and output of a denoising self-encoder to obtain a smart grid data matrix; based on a back propagation optimization algorithm, the optimal weight matrix and bias coefficient of the smart grid data matrix are obtained to obtain a corresponding reconstruction data matrix; according to the method, the nonlinear relation in the measured data is considered for normalization, and the reconstructed data matrix is utilized to recover the lost measured data of the power grid, so that the problem that the nonlinear characteristics in the measured data cannot be extracted is effectively solved.
assignees: STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID INFORMATION & TELECOMMUNICATION BRANCH;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;INFORMATION COMMUNICATION BRANCH STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Water-wind-solar complementary strategy optimization method and system based on large-scale water-wind-solar cluster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water-wind-solar complementary strategy optimization method and system based on a large-scale water-wind-solar cluster, and belongs to the technical field of power system optimization scheduling. The method comprises the steps of dividing a water-wind-solar complementary power system optimization object of a large-scale water-wind-solar cluster through a power grid aggregation model and a power cluster, obtaining the generalized optimization object, establishing constraint conditions of the water-wind-solar complementary power system, including power transmission channel constraint, wind-solar output constraint and hydropower constraint, constructing a water-wind-solar complementary power system complementary strategy optimization model by taking maximization of dead-time energy retention capacity of a cascade water-wind-solar system and maximization of annual energy generation of the water-wind-solar as objective functions and combining the constraint conditions, and solving the water-wind-solar complementary power system complementary strategy optimization model to obtain a water-wind-solar complementary power system complementary strategy. The method improves the accuracy and the calculation efficiency of the optimization modeling of the large-scale system, and realizes the multi-objective optimization of the water-wind-solar complementary power generation based on the large-scale water-wind-solar clusters.
assignees: BEIJING KEDONG ELECTRIC POWER CONTROL SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Water supply quantity prediction method, device and storage medium based on water quantity-water pressure coupling
abstract_en: The invention relates to a water supply quantity prediction method, water supply quantity prediction equipment and a storage medium based on water quantity-water pressure coupling, and belongs to the technical field of water supply quantity prediction and deep learning. By constructing IAMformer network, introducing multi-head sparse attention layer based on EMD distance in encoder and decoder, inputting the historical data of water supply quantity and instantaneous flow and holiday information into encoder to obtain main characteristic Q of water supply quantity prediction, inputting pressure data into decoder to obtain pressure auxiliary characteristic A capable of fusion, inputting both characteristics into main and auxiliary attention layers in decoder to make main and auxiliary attention matrix calculation and fusion to obtain fusion characteristic, outputting predicted water supply quantity by full connection layer, and back-propagation optimizing and updating model parameters according to composite loss function of water supply quantity loss and pressure loss. The invention can reduce the indirect influence of the water pressure prediction error on the water supply quantity prediction, and can reduce the complexity of an algorithm model and improve the robustness of the model.
assignees: SHANDONG FENCER INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Steel manufacturing process energy consumption prediction method and system based on multi-scale channel mixed convolutional neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for predicting energy consumption in a steel manufacturing process based on a multi-scale channel mixed convolutional neural network, which are used for acquiring production data in the steel manufacturing process and preprocessing to obtain a historical data set; the method comprises the steps of constructing a data embedding module, performing size conversion on historical data to obtain embedded features, performing channel mixing on the embedded features to realize channel feature interaction, constructing a multi-scale cavity convolutional neural network with a plurality of convolution kernels with different sizes to obtain multi-scale features, constructing a regression based on a feedforward neural network, inputting the multi-scale features into the regression to perform output prediction, optimizing the multi-scale channel mixed convolutional neural network by utilizing a gradient back propagation algorithm until the maximum iteration number is reached, acquiring real-time data of input variables in a steelmaking production process, inputting the optimized multi-scale channel mixed convolutional neural network to obtain a predicted value of energy consumption, and effectively improving the accuracy and reliability of energy consumption prediction.

title_en: Landslide body monitoring method based on unmanned aerial vehicle laser radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide body monitoring method based on an unmanned aerial vehicle laser radar, which comprises the following steps of S1, constructing a bare earth surface point cloud model of a first time phase, S2, constructing a bare earth surface point cloud model of a second time phase, S3, constructing a standard point cloud data set, S4, constructing a multidimensional time sequence feature vector sequence, S5, introducing an ARIMA and neural network fusion prediction model, outputting a prediction sequence of a final landslide body deformation trend, S6, constructing a disaster chain propagation model, outputting a landslide early warning grade according to a preset grading threshold value, and performing real-time early warning information publishing and response linkage. According to the invention, through fusion of laser radar point cloud registration analysis and ARIMA-neural network prediction modeling, high-precision dynamic monitoring and early warning of small deformation of the landslide body are realized, and the method is suitable for landslide early identification and disaster emergency response scenes in complex terrain environments.
assignees: HUBEI COAL GEOLOGICAL AND GEOPHYSICAL SURVEY TEAM

title_en: Security and protection fire-fighting integrated linkage system and method based on multidimensional sensing
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of intersection of computer technology and intelligent security and fire protection, discloses a security and fire protection integrated linkage method and system based on multidimensional sensing, and aims to solve the problems of isolated security and fire protection system data, single sensing dimension, delayed linkage response and difficulty in studying and judging composite risk events in the prior art. The method comprises the steps of fusing security, fire and three-dimensional space structure data, constructing a unified space-time situation map, identifying abnormal event clusters by utilizing a graph neural network, judging event types by a multi-mode classifier, predicting event evolution trend by combining a risk propagation model, and dynamically generating an integrated collaborative treatment instruction set to drive security and fire equipment to carry out linkage. The system comprises five modules of multidimensional sensing acquisition, data fusion, intelligent research and judgment, strategy generation and linkage execution. The method and the system realize data depth fusion, accurate identification of the compound event, active risk prediction and closed loop cooperative treatment, and remarkably improve the intelligentization and cooperative efficiency of safety response.

title_en: Cooperative scheduling method, device and equipment of power grid unmanned aerial vehicle and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cooperative scheduling method, device and equipment for a power grid unmanned aerial vehicle and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining an initial inspection work order and effective coverage area data of at least one fixed airport, wherein the effective coverage area data are obtained by calculation based on a three-dimensional signal propagation attenuation model, constructing a multi-objective optimization function, primarily distributing the initial inspection work order to the fixed airport meeting the conditions based on the multi-objective optimization function and a preset constraint condition, and determining a target airport for executing the emergency inspection task based on the priority of the emergency inspection task, the initial inspection work order and a collaborative scheduling mechanism simulating market bidding under the condition that the emergency inspection task is received, and scheduling the target airport to execute the emergency inspection task. The technical effects of improving the allocation rationality of the inspection tasks, guaranteeing the efficient execution of emergency tasks and optimizing the utilization of fixed airport resources are achieved.
assignees: JIANGSU FANGTIAN POWER TECH CO;UNIV NANJING AERONAUTICS & ASTRONAUTICS;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Power plant equipment fault detection system based on AI image recognition algorithm
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power plant equipment detection, and discloses a power plant equipment fault detection system based on an AI image recognition algorithm. The system comprises six core modules, namely, equipment image acquisition, fault feature analysis, fault propagation modeling, fault region judgment, fault level classification and fault structure output. The power plant equipment fault detection and management system comprises an equipment image acquisition module, a fault feature analysis module, a fault structure output module and a power plant equipment fault precision detection and efficient management module, wherein the equipment image acquisition module acquires real-time monitoring image data of power plant equipment, equipment feature points are extracted through region segmentation, a feature point topological relation is established by combining equipment types, an equipment feature topological diagram is generated, the fault feature analysis module carries out multidimensional feature extraction based on the topological diagram, a feature point similarity matrix is calculated to construct a fault feature association network, the follow-up module sequentially establishes a fault propagation model, screens a fault core region set, generates a fault grade label group, and finally generates a fault classification map by the fault structure output module.

title_en: Terminal mobility management method and device using nas
title_ko: Nas를 활용한 단말 이동성 관리 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a 5G or 6G communication system for supporting higher data transmission rates. The present disclosure may provide a device and method for managing the mobility of a terminal in a wireless communication system. Disclosed is a method for selecting a PLMN or SNPN, in a process of confirming service interruption of a first communication provider communication network and utilizing service of a second communication provider communication network, on the basis of capability information about the capability of a terminal in a wireless communication system to utilize a communication network of a provider that the terminal is not subscribed to in a disaster situation.
abstract_ko: 본 개시는 보다 높은 데이터 전송률을 지원하기 위한 5G 또는 6G 통신 시스템에 관련된 것이다. 본 개시는 무선 통신 시스템에서 단말의 이동성을 관리하기 위한 장치 및 방법을 제공할 수 있다. 본 발명은 무선 통신 시스템에서 단말이 재난 상황에서 가입되지 않은 사업자의 통신망을 활용하는 능력에 대한 캐퍼빌리티(capability) 정보를 기초로, 제1 통신 사업자 통신망의 서비스 중단을 확인하고 제2 통신 사업자 통신망의 서비스를 활용하는 과정에 있어, PLMN 또는 SNPN을 선택하는 방법을 개시한다.

title_en: Method and apparatus for propagating public safety multicast and broadcast services among public safety personnel
abstract_en: Public safety user equipment (PS UE) that establishes a first wireless communication channel over a primary network to at least one multimedia multicast or broadcast service management entity and establishes one or more alternative wireless communication channels over one or more alternative networks (310). The public safety user equipment receives at least one multimedia multicast or broadcast service message over the first wireless communication channel (320), Then, the PS UE extracts data contained in the multimedia multicast or broadcast service message and storing the data in a local cache (330). The PS UE receives a cache request from the one or more user equipment over one or more alternative wireless communication channels (340) and then the PS UE transmits the stored data to the one or more PS user equipment (350).

title_en: Method and system of learning-based problem management for information technology (it) operations
abstract_en: An architecture of an enterprise can be fully on on-premises with multiple computing systems or on cloud or on Hybrid. Enterprise information technology (IT) departments are continually adopting new technologies and changes leads more complex, and increased probability of service disruption, through malfunctions in software, hardware, networks, natural disasters, simple human error. Embodiments of the present disclosure provide a method and system to detect problem associated with the computing system in an enterprise. A plurality of data associated with each resource in the enterprise is received. The plurality of data is considered to iteratively perform (a) derive a parameter associated with a metric data, and an incident data to obtain an analyzed data, (b) detect a problem associated with each resources by processing the plurality of analyzed data based on a propositional logic, and (c) generate a feedback associated with each problem of the resources in a subsequent iteration.

title_en: A kind of Hydropower Stations Real time optimal dispatch method under Complex Constraints restriction
abstract_en: The present invention relates to Electric Power Network Planning and management and running field, disclose the Hydropower Stations Real time optimal dispatch method under the restriction of a kind of Complex Constraints, it will include in real-time scheduling by generation schedule a few days ago, maximum as optimization aim using the total accumulation of energy of Hydro Power Systems with Cascaded Reservoirs, meet the requirement of the fail safe of Real-Time Scheduling, ageing, practicality, economy.Its technical scheme is: by by power station a few days ago generation schedule and inter-plant load deviation optimize the superimposed mode of allocation result, roll generate real-time generation schedule, hide unit vibration district in real time.Abandoning the power station of water for existing, devising and a kind ofly practically abandoning water adjustable strategies, utilizing step hydropower station to regulate advantage, adopt to let out in advance and rise storehouse, avoid unnecessary generation of abandoning water, improve water utilization rate.The invention has the beneficial effects as follows the future development of prediction electrical network, for Hydropower Stations Real time optimal dispatch system Construction provides solid theoretical foundation.

title_en: A kind of Distributed Power Flow controller site selecting method based on accident chain model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of Distributed Power Flow controller site selecting method based on accident chain model, method is：It is not restrained with trend first or power-angle oscillation diverging is the end condition of fault chains, scan the whole network cascading failure fault chains.The multidimensional index system for characterizing each fault chains influence degree is resettled, including variation index, frequency shift (FS) index, trend equilibrium degree index and burden with power loss late index, quantitative assessment is carried out using influence of the Grey Comprehensive Evaluation method to each fault chains.Finally, the prediction index of comprehensive evaluation index and each link of fault chains is influenced with reference to fault chains, defines and calculates circuit importance index, Distributed Power Flow controller is completed according to index ranking results and recommends addressing.Grey Comprehensive Evaluation is introduced into the impact analysis of fault chains by the present invention, meets the few feature of power grid accident chain sample size, can provide reference for the preconsolidation stress addressing of Distributed Power Flow controller.

title_en: Fire response characteristic and physicochemical property damage experiment platform for high-voltage transmission line
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-voltage transmission line fire response characteristic and physicochemical property damage experiment platform, which comprises a fire source occurrence and steel core aluminum stranded wire coupling action module A, a mass loss and thermal field data acquisition module B1, a smoke dust characteristic and component analysis module B2, a steel core aluminum stranded wire surface state and mechanical and electrical property characterization module B3, a line melt acquisition and analysis module B4 and a computer; the modules B1-4 are respectively connected with the module A, and each item of collected data is stored in a computer. The advantages are that: systematically discussing the evolution characteristics of mechanical properties, electrical properties and component phase states of the steel-cored aluminum stranded wire before and after the fire under the coupling action of the mountain fire nonlinear coupling propagation process and the power transmission line; the method has the advantages of accurately grasping the fire damage characteristics and mechanisms of the power transmission line, revealing key influencing factors and behavior sequences of mountain fire for inducing the tripping of the high-voltage power transmission line, and having important engineering significance for disaster action modes, characteristics, mechanisms and prevention of mountain fire on the high-voltage power transmission line in intelligent power grid high-voltage power transmission.

title_en: Hybrid cascade reservoir combined flood control optimal scheduling method considering branch flood storage civil application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a combined cascade reservoir combined flood control optimal scheduling method considering branch and flood storage civil-oriented application, which comprises the following steps: s1, obtaining flood diversion flow, flood diversion time and flooding area/flood diversion volume samples when the civil-oriented potential flood diversion is used; s2, training an artificial neural network model based on the sample, and constructing a civil flood diversion flow-inundation area/flood diversion volume space-time prediction knowledge base; s3, establishing a flood control optimization scheduling model which is applied by a branch flood storage consumer-oriented machine in consideration; and S4, based on the space-time prediction knowledge base, calculating and analyzing a hybrid reservoir group and flood control optimal scheduling model which is applied by considering the branch flood storage and the hybrid reservoir group and the civil-oriented vehicle to obtain an optimal scheduling scheme. The invention constructs a flood diversion flow-flooding area/flood diversion amount space-time prediction knowledge base by training an artificial neural network, and uses the knowledge base as a boundary condition of a combined flood control optimization scheduling model of the series-parallel cascade reservoir, thereby extracting flood diversion information in real time and realizing real-time scheduling.

title_en: Distribution-gas network distributed collaborative planning method and system considering influence of power transmission network
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a power distribution-air network distributed collaborative planning method and system considering the influence of a power transmission network, comprising the following steps: acquiring a typical operation scene of a power distribution-gas network; obtaining an optimal distributed collaborative planning scheme of the power distribution-air network according to the obtained typical operation scene and a preset distributed collaborative planning model of the power distribution-air network; the power distribution-gas network distributed collaborative planning model comprises a power transmission network sub-problem mixed integer quadratic programming model, a power distribution network sub-problem mixed integer quadratic programming model and a gas distribution network sub-problem mixed integer quadratic programming model, and the three mixed integer quadratic programming models are sequentially subjected to distributed iterative solution by utilizing a target cascade analysis algorithm. The distributed solution flow based on the target cascade analysis algorithm is constructed by establishing a mixed integer quadratic programming model of the transmission network, the distribution network and the distribution network, so that distributed collaborative planning of a plurality of distribution-gas networks is realized.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and medium for identifying weak links of power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, equipment and a medium for identifying weak links of an electric power system, wherein the method comprises the steps of establishing a basic operation model of the electric power system to obtain a planning scheme that a power grid meets all loads when lines are in a normal operation state; the accident bearing capacity of the planning scheme is checked by establishing a power system fault selection model, an operation model of the power system for coping with faults is established, the load loss is obtained, simulation analysis is carried out in a standard system, and a weak link identification result of the power system is output. Firstly, a basic operation model of the power system is established, a fault selection model of the power system is established on the basis, then an operation model of the power system for coping with faults is established, and finally, system joint evolution calculation is carried out, so that the effectiveness and the practicability of the modeling method are verified. And the weak links in the power system are effectively identified by establishing a system planning model of cascading faults based on the ideas of robust optimization and fault simulation, so that the calculation efficiency is improved compared with the existing model.

title_en: Mobile energy network optimization scheduling method based on fuel cell energy cascade utilization
abstract_en: The application provides a mobile energy network optimization scheduling method based on fuel cell energy cascade utilization, which comprises the following steps: step 1: a mobile energy network based on the energy cascade utilization of the fuel cell is established, electric propulsion load and household electric load are supplied through a hydrogen fuel cell and a diesel generator, electric load demands are supplemented through an electric storage device, and heat load demands are guaranteed through the hydrogen fuel cell, an electric heat pump and a heat storage device; step 2: establishing a ship navigation model under the condition of ship stall; step 3: establishing a mobile energy network optimization scheduling model based on fuel cell energy cascade utilization, and performing constraint; step 4: and solving the mobile energy network optimization scheduling model, and performing optimization scheduling on the mobile energy network. The application realizes the optimal scheduling strategy by taking the minimum running cost and the minimum carbon emission cost of the ship mobile energy system as targets on the premise of ensuring the reliable supply of the thermal power and the electric load of the ship energy network and the timely arrival of the ship safety.

title_en: Typhoon disaster prediction method for optimizing back propagation neural network based on genetic algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a typhoon disaster prediction method based on genetic algorithm optimization back propagation neural network, which comprises the steps of obtaining meteorological data of typhoon disasters to obtain a training set and a testing set; constructing a deep learning network, and extracting features to obtain first features; constructing an initial decision tree model through the first characteristics, and optimizing the initial decision tree model by adopting a genetic algorithm and a post pruning technology; establishing an initial model of typhoon disaster estimation based on the BP neural network model and the decision tree model; and inputting the training set into the typhoon disaster prediction model to obtain typhoon disaster prediction results. According to the invention, the typhoon disaster prediction model is established based on the classification decision tree mode, so that the influence of typhoon disasters on the environment can be predicted more accurately, and the disaster prevention and reduction work is guided scientifically.

title_en: Island detection method based on wavelet packet logarithmic energy entropy and genetic algorithm optimization
