abstract_en: The invention discloses an island detection method based on wavelet packet logarithmic energy entropy and genetic algorithm optimization. The island detection method based on wavelet packet logarithmic energy entropy and genetic algorithm optimization introduces the genetic algorithm to optimize a BP (back-propagation) neural network and introduces logarithmic energy entropy as the input signals for optimizing the BP neural network by the genetic algorithm. The method specifically comprises, firstly, collecting common coupling point voltage signals to perform appropriate wavelet decomposition to obtain wavelet packet coefficients in 8 frequency bands under three-dimensional scales; secondly, performing reconstruction and normalization to obtain logarithmic energy entropy; lastly, performing mode recognition on islanding phenomena and non-islanding phenomena through the BP neural network optimized by the genetic algorithm. The island detection method based on wavelet packet logarithmic energy entropy and genetic algorithm optimization overcomes the defect of non-detection zones existing during load matching of a traditional passive island detection method by optimizing the weight and the threshold of the BP neural network through the genetic algorithm, the BP neural network can obtain comprehensive search capability and avoid maloperation during sudden load change and grid voltage harmonic disturbance, and meanwhile, when the output power of an inverter is matched with or not matched with load, islands can still be detected rapidly and accurately.

title_en: City gas pipeline system pipeline fault propagation impact evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the present invention discloses a kind of city gas pipeline system pipeline fault propagation impact evaluation method and system, and methods described includes setting up the network structure topological diagram of city gas pipeline system according to city gas pipeline system；Network model is set up according to network structure topological diagram；According to network model and default constraints, the corresponding first flow pressure distribution information of city gas pipeline system normal condition is obtained；Pipeline fault is simulated in network model, and according to default pipeline fault propagation rule and constraints, obtains city gas pipeline system corresponding second flow pressure distribution information under pipeline fault state；Compare first flow pressure distribution information and second flow pressure distribution information carries out pipeline fault propagation effect assessment to city gas pipeline system.The system is used to perform the above method.The embodiment of the present invention improves the accuracy of city gas pipeline system pipeline fault propagation impact evaluation.

title_en: Distributed reactive power optimization method and device for load prediction of power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses  distributed reactive power optimization method and device for load prediction of an electric power system, wherein the method comprises the steps of dividing electric load information, meteorological information and holiday information of a predicted place into a test set of  input neurons, establishing an initial LSTM network, bringing a training set into the initial LSTM network for forward calculation and backward propagation training, inputting neuron information required by prediction of days through the trained LSTM network to perform load prediction on  time points, analyzing reactive power compensation characteristics of a distributed power supply, collecting target parameters of the distributed power supply to establish a reactive power model of the distributed power supply, establishing a reactive power optimization model of the power grid with the minimum network loss as a target function, and performing distributed optimization control calculation according to the reactive power average utilization rate and an instantaneous communication topology matrix to achieve distributed optimization.
assignees: UNIV CHINA AGRICULTURAL;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID JIBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;NORTH CN ELEC POWER RES INST

title_en: Cascade power station hydraulic relationship coupling method based on deep learning theory
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascade power station hydraulic relation coupling method based on a deep learning theory, which relates to the technical field of hydroelectric operation and comprises the following steps: s1, selecting input factors based on the conditional mutual information theory in the mutual information; s2, constructing a first model, and performing data processing on the input factors through the first model to obtain a deep learning network model of upstream ex-warehouse traffic and downstream in-warehouse traffic; s3, determining the hydraulic coupling relation of the upstream and downstream cascade power stations according to the deep learning network model of the upstream ex-warehouse flow and the downstream in-warehouse flow, and determining the warehouse flow of the downstream power station based on the hydraulic coupling relation of the upstream and downstream cascade power stations; the design realizes the coupling calculation of the hydraulic power relation of the upstream and downstream cascade power stations in the electric power spot market, and can provide important technical support for the operation of the electric power spot market mainly based on water and electricity.
assignees: STATE GRID SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV SICHUAN;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER CORP

title_en: Power information network defense system and method based on honey net
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of network security, and particularly relates to a power information network defense system and method based on a honey net. The invention establishes a malicious software propagation model of a double-layer coupling network containing a honey net in the coupling network, and establishes a power information network defense system based on the honey net according to the model; constructing a non-uniformly distributed double-layer coupling network according to an actual network structure; the construction of the unevenly distributed double-layer coupling network is a malware propagation model of the double-layer coupling network containing the industrial control honeypot, and comprises the following steps: power information networks and honey nets. When the network structure is constructed, the heterogeneous network structure is considered to be more consistent with a real power information network, the honeynet technology is utilized, malicious software which is widely spread in the power information network can be pertinently and effectively resisted, the prediction result of the model can be visually displayed by utilizing the visualization technology, and meanwhile, the research result is also beneficial to improving the deployment efficiency of honeypots.
assignees: LIAONING PROVINCE ELECTRIC POWER LTD COMPANY OF STATE GRID;UNIV NORTHEAST;INFORMATION COMMUNICATION BRANCH COMPANY OF LIAONING PROVINCE ELECTRIC POWER LTD COMPANY OF STATE GR

title_en: Noise reduction method for constructing secondary channel estimation by using neural network, computer readable storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a noise reduction method for constructing secondary channel estimation by using a neural network, a computer readable storage medium and electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: a second neural network model is constructed based on an adaptive feed-forward active noise reduction architecture, with the second neural network model being used as a secondary channel estimate S' (z) in the architecture. The invention changes S' (z) into the second neural network model to realize the estimation of the secondary channel more accurately, and improves the harmonic wave and intermodulation distortion phenomenon caused by nonlinear links in the propagation path from the B-bit loudspeaker to the C-bit error microphone.

title_en: Chemical field event prediction method and system based on logic atlas
abstract_en: A chemical field event prediction method and system based on logic atlas comprises the following steps: (1) Defining event trigger words and event elements, and extracting events from accident reasons in a chemical accident investigation report; (2) constructing a map of the chemical field logic; (3) Performing initial embedding on the chemical event, inputting the initial embedding into BiLSTM networks, and obtaining the representation of an event sequence; (4) According to logic atlases, stacking a plurality of embedded propagation layers by using a graph neural network to represent the high-order vector of the event node; (5) And calculating the vector similarity of each candidate follow-up event and the event context, and selecting the candidate event with the maximum similarity as a prediction result. The invention provides an event prediction model based on logic maps for the problem of low current event prediction accuracy; for the problem of lack of events and insufficient pre-warning in the chemical field, the method is applied to the chemical field, and a chemical field event prediction system based on logic maps is realized.

title_en: Robust observer-based power distribution network control input attack detection and state estimation method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of power system automation and information safety, and discloses a power distribution network control input attack detection and state estimation method based on a robust observer, which comprises the steps of constructing a power distribution network linear discrete dynamic model based on a Droop control, and improving the observability of a system by utilizing a multi-step observation structure and differential modeling; based on a disturbance propagation matrix and a zero space projection technology, the attack detection problem is converted into a sparse optimization problem, an Unknown Input Observer (UIO) is designed, the robustness is enhanced by combining a dynamic compensation matrix and feedback gain, and an online feedback mechanism is introduced to realize parameter self-adaptive update. The method can realize real-time identification of control instruction tampering attack and high-precision estimation of system state, and meets high requirements of power distribution network operation on safety, instantaneity and reliability.

title_en: Coordinated standby-based multi-level scheduling operation solving method for national network province
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of grid collaborative optimization, in particular to a national grid province multi-level scheduling operation solving method based on collaborative reserve, which comprises the following steps of establishing a multi-level scheduling model considering collaborative reserve constraint according to each level objective function participating in cross-province energy scheduling and reserve scheduling; decomposing the multi-level scheduling model into sub-problems of a national scheduling level, a network scheduling level and a provincial scheduling level based on an augmented Lagrangian relaxation method, and carrying out collaborative solution on each sub-problem by utilizing a target cascading method to obtain a global optimal scheduling scheme. The multi-level dispatching operation solving method for the national province can provide references for exploring a multi-level cooperative dispatching mode suitable for the national province by constructing a national-network-province multi-level dispatching model considering a cooperative standby mechanism, and in addition, solves by adopting a target cascading method, not only considers actual and internal mechanisms of a power grid under each level, but also improves the optimal dispatching solving efficiency of a power system under the cooperation of the whole network.
assignees: SICHUAN ENERGY INTERNET RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF TSINGHUA UNIV

title_en: Comprehensive quantitative evaluation method and system for fault probability of power distribution equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a comprehensive quantitative evaluation method and a comprehensive quantitative evaluation system for fault probability of power distribution equipment, which relate to the technical field of power distribution equipment, and realize intelligent management of fault prediction and maintenance strategy of the power distribution equipment by integrating a physical information neural network, abnormal score analysis, a space-time diagram neural network, maintenance decision calculation and the like, improve the accuracy and reliability of the fault prediction, reduce false alarm rate through probability output and support uncertainty quantization; the system has the advantages of enhancing the sensitivity of anomaly detection, facilitating early warning and priority sequencing, improving the response speed of the system to an anomaly state, comprehensively modeling space and time dependence, optimizing risk assessment and resource allocation, reducing cascade fault risks, generating a data-driven maintenance strategy, improving maintenance efficiency and quality, reducing cost and downtime, generating dynamic risk portraits through attribution analysis, supporting real-time monitoring and decision making, and enhancing the transparency of the system.

title_en: Radio wave propagation simulation model creation method, creation system, creation device, and creation program
abstract_en: To solve a problem in the conventional technology in which it is difficult to automatically set a medium constant of an object such as a structure and to automatically create a radio wave propagation simulation model.SOLUTION: A radio wave propagation simulation model creation method includes: a first step of acquiring a large amount of texture image data from a network and accumulating first learned data for determining a medium corresponding to each piece of texture image data by deep learning; a second step of creating a 3D shape model of a communication area; a third step of extracting an object in two-dimensional image data corresponding to the 3D shape model and determining the medium corresponding to a surface image of the object by deep learning on the basis of the first learned data; a fourth step of referring to a database storing a medium constant for each medium and estimating a medium constant of the medium corresponding to the determined object; and a fifth step of setting the estimated medium constant to each object in the 3D shape model and creating a radio wave propagation simulation model in the communication area.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Portable Collective Intelligent Routing Robots System for FireFighters and Network Formation Method Thereof
title_ko: 소방 방재용 투척형 군집지능 라우팅 로봇 시스템 및 그 네트워크 형성 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a throwing type collective intelligence routing robot system for extinguishing fire and a method for forming a network thereof. According to the present invention, the throwing type collective intelligence routing robot system expects a distance between robots and a propagation environment to provide an activity range capable of communicating to a firefighter using communication information between the collective intelligence routing robots in the environment where an infrastructure is collapsed. Moreover, the present invention automatically rearranges the thrown robot in accordance with a change in the propagation environment to form a stable communications network to monitor the status information of the firefighter.
abstract_ko: 발명은 소방 방재용 투척형 군집지능 라우팅 로봇 시스템 및 그 네트워크 형성 방법에 관한 것으로서, 본 발명에 따른 소방 방재용 투척형 군집지능 라우팅 로봇 시스템은 인프라가 무너진 환경에서 군집 지능 로봇 간의 통신 정보를 이용하여 로봇 간의 거리와 전파환경을 예측하여 소방관에게 통신 가능한 활동범위를 제공하고, 전파환경 변화에 따라 투척된 로봇의 자동 재배치로 안정적인 통신망을 구축하여 소방관의 상태 정보를 모니터링하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Power-distribution-network self-healing method and system taking photovoltaic output into consideration
abstract_en: Provided in the present invention are a power-distribution-network self-healing method and system taking photovoltaic output into consideration. The method comprises: acquiring historical operation data of a photovoltaic power station and irradiance observation data from a meteorological station; on the basis of the historical operation data of the photovoltaic power station and the irradiance observation data from the meteorological station, predicting the generated power of the photovoltaic power station by using a convolutional long-short-term memory recurrent neural network model that takes sparrow search into consideration; on the basis of the generated power of the photovoltaic power station, a segment-switch state of a power distribution network and a network topology of the power distribution network, constructing an objective function and a constraint condition for a power-distribution-network self-healing model, and obtaining the power-distribution-network self-healing model; solving the power-distribution-network self-healing model by using a propagation search algorithm, so as to obtain an optimal recovery strategy; and executing the optimal recovery strategy by means of segmented switches and node loads. The present invention can realize self-healing of a power distribution network while ensuring the minimum power generation cost of a distributed power source, the minimum network loss and the minimum node voltage deviation.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD;POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CENTER OF GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Method for generating weighted seismic network based on maximum energy ratio
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of complex networks, and particularly relates to a method for generating a weighted seismic network based on a maximum energy ratio. The technical scheme is as follows: a method for generating a weighted seismic network based on a maximum energy ratio, comprising the steps of: the method comprises the following steps: constructing a network analysis topological characteristic; step two: performing network modeling according to the relation between the earthquake magnitude, the influence diameter and the influence time; step three: generating a non-directional seismic network and a directional seismic network through simulation; step four: defining a method of connecting edge weight based on maximum energy ratio; step five: drawing a distribution probability table of the edge weight values in the network; step six: drawing a probability distribution map of the edge weight in the network; step seven: and drawing a probability double-logarithm distribution graph of the edge weight in the network. The method for generating the weighted seismic network based on the maximum energy ratio is used for researching seismic propagation paths.

title_en: Method for simulating continuous wave lidar sensor
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for simulating sensor data of a Continuous Wave (CW) light detection and ranging lidar sensor, comprising the steps of: generating a light ray set including at least one light ray based on the CW signal 51, each light ray in the light ray set having an emission start time (T _ 0) and an emission duration (T); for each ray of the set of rays, propagating the ray in a simulated scene including at least one object; calculating for each ray in the ray set a signal contribution 71 of the propagating ray at the detection position in the simulated scene; generating an output signal 73 based on mixing the CW signal 51 with the calculated signal contribution of the concentrated light; and at least one of storing and outputting the output signal. The present invention provides analog data corresponding to a full waveform signal of a CW lidar sensor. The provided sensor data also enables additional information to be determined, such as object shape and object class, and object orientation. In addition, the sensor data also includes artifacts present in the real lidar data that originate from physical characteristics of the lidar sensor and the environment and are not present in the point cloud type data, such as multiple reflections of the lidar beam. Thus, sensor development can also be improved by taking this artifact into account. The present invention accurately simulates how a real CW lidar sensor works and thus accurately reproduces the output of a real CW lidar sensor. The provided high-quality data is complete and accurate for the real world, and has high value for developing a signal processing algorithm, training a neural network, performing virtual verification and the like.

title_en: BP neural network-based heating unit peak regulation upper limit evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heat supply unit peak regulation upper limit evaluation method and system based on a BP neural network. And then, establishing a neural network evaluation model, and reducing the error of calculating the peak shaving upper limit to the maximum extent by means of the self-learning and error back propagation characteristics of the BP neural network model, so that the more objective and accurate peak shaving upper limit can be obtained. The whole evaluation process can not influence normal heat supply and power supply, and the workload and the consumed time are relatively small.

title_en: Fault propagation analysis method and system based on causal hierarchical topology network model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electromechanical equipment fault analysis, and discloses a fault propagation analysis method and system based on a causal hierarchical topology network model, so as to more accurately determine an actual fault hierarchical propagation path of a source fault node under a specific fault mode. The method comprises the steps of connecting longitudinal nodes through directed edges according to the propagation relation of signals among the longitudinal nodes when the electromechanical device actually works to form a topology network, establishing a fault propagation model based on a causal layered topology network by the directed edges including transverse causal edges and longitudinal causal edges, calculating whether the fault mode of each potential directed edge can propagate to a fruit fault node one by one according to the fault disturbance of a bottom element aiming at a specific fault mode, and obtaining a fault actual layered propagation path based on the fault propagation model of the causal layered topology network.

title_en: City infrastructure group network elasticity analysis method, electronic device and storage medium
abstract_en: A city infrastructure group network elasticity analysis method, electronic equipment and a storage medium belong to the field of city infrastructure group analysis. The method aims to solve the problem of analysis of urban cascade failure influence. The method comprises the steps of constructing a cascading failure model of an urban infrastructure group network; adopting the theory and the model of the classical elastic triangle from the two aspects of time and space to carry out elastic analysis on the infrastructures in the urban infrastructure group; elasticity analysis for city infrastructure groups: and (3) introducing a fault mode in which multipoint failures occur simultaneously to calculate network elastic parameters of the urban infrastructure group, introducing spatial position information at the same time, analyzing the elastic parameter conditions of the infrastructure group in a central area and an edge area, and finally performing tree analysis on the cascading failure model process. The invention establishes an elasticity analysis system of the urban infrastructure group network, and provides effective support for researching and improving the elasticity of the urban infrastructure.

title_en: Power transmission line partial discharge detection method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a transmission line partial discharge detection method which comprises the following steps of S1, obtaining an original transmission line electric signal, dividing the original transmission line electric signal into training samples and test samples, S2, inputting the training samples into a multi-scale one-dimensional convolutional neural network in batches, setting a threshold value, a multi-scale one-dimensional convolutional neural network structure and the convolution kernel size of the multi-scale one-dimensional convolutional neural network structure, performing forward propagation layer by layer to obtain the characteristics of the training samples, calculating to obtain errors expected to be output and actual to be output, S3, performing backward propagation on the errors from the output to the input, performing fine tuning on network parameters layer by layer, S4, repeating the steps S2 and S3 until all the training samples are completed, calculating the accuracy of a network on the test samples, if the accuracy is larger than the set threshold value, obtaining an ideal network, otherwise, returning to the step S2, and outputting the accuracy of the ideal network on the test samples. The invention solves the problem of partial discharge diagnosis of the power transmission line and achieves better effect under the arrangement of different frequency data and different convolution kernels.

title_en: Interpolation-free hybrid line simulation model with accurate zero sequence impedance and construction method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power system simulation, and discloses an interpolation-free hybrid line simulation model with accurate zero sequence impedance and a construction method thereof, wherein the model comprises a decoupling module, a parallel compensation module and a series synthesis module; the decoupling module is used for enabling electromagnetic propagation delay time to be equal to simulation step length of a simulation program and realizing interpolation-free calculation decoupling at two ends of a line, the parallel compensation module is used for compensating additional parallel susceptance introduced and inter-phase capacitance introduced into an original physical model of the line, and the series synthesis module is used for synthesizing residual series impedance of the line so that total series positive-sequence impedance and zero-sequence impedance of an equivalent model are matched with a preset target value under fundamental wave frequency. The invention can provide calculation decoupling without interpolation for the short line and accurately simulate the full-sequence network parameters including zero sequence components, thereby being capable of well meeting the requirements of high-fidelity parallel simulation of the modern power distribution network.

title_en: Monitoring method and system for industrial chain breakpoint treatment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of industrial chain monitoring and treatment, in particular to a monitoring method and a system for industrial chain breakpoint treatment; the method comprises the steps of acquiring production, logistics, finance, policy and environment dynamic information through multi-source data, generating industrial chain comprehensive characteristics through standardization, multidimensional embedded representation and cross-dimension fusion, introducing historical trend dependence enhancement prospective prediction, constructing a dynamic coupling network, quantifying risk propagation intensity among nodes by using dynamic side weights to realize cross-level breakpoint propagation analysis, calculating risk indexes through fusion of node characteristics and a network structure, screening breakpoint candidate nodes by combining self-adaptive thresholds, predicting multi-step evolution trend by using a nonlinear propagation function, and mapping the multi-step evolution trend into multi-level early warning grades. Generating a treatment strategy according to the risk level, evaluating the effect in real time through a closed-loop optimization mechanism, and dynamically adjusting parameters. The invention realizes the closed-loop management of risk identification, prediction and self-adaptive treatment.

title_en: System for integrated management of reservoir
title_ko: 저수지 통합 관리 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an integrated management system for a reservoir and, more specifically, to an integrated management system for a reservoir which rapidly publicizes an emergency situation via online or a mobile communication network and enables the establishment of a plan about the emergency situation by identifying and determining a risk factor in advance as information related to change in water level, the water discharge amount, and collapse is monitored in real time. The integrated management system according to the present invention comprises: a water level measurement unit for measuring the water level of the reservoir; an overflow measurement unit for measuring the amount of water overflowing to a spillway of a reservoir bank; a reservoir management unit for collecting and transmitting information measured by the water level measurement unit and the overflow measurement unit; a manager server which receives information transmitted from the reservoir management unit and processes the received information to check a state of the reservoir and transmit thereof; a manager device which receives information related to the state of the reservoir transmitted by the manager server; and a warning broadcasting unit which broadcasts in accordance with a signal received from the manager server.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 저수지 통합 관리 시스템에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 저수지의 수위변화, 방류량, 붕괴관련 정보를 실시간으로 모니터링하여 위험요소를 사전에 판별 및 판단할 수 있도록 함으로써 위급상황에 대하여는 온라인이나 이동통신망을 통하여 신속하게 전파하고 그에 대한 대책수립이 가능하도록 한 저수지 통합 관리 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따른 저수지 통합 관리 시스템은, 저수지 수위를 측정하기 위한 수위 측정기와, 저수지 둑의 여수로로 넘치는 물의 양을 측정하기 위한 여수량 측정기와, 상기 수위 측정기 및 여수량 측정기에 의해 측정된 정보를 수집하여 송신하기 위한 저수지 관리기와, 상기 저수지 관리기로부터 송신된 정보를 수신하여 해당 정보를 처리하여 저수지 상태를 파악하고 이를 송신하는 관리자 서버와, 상기 관리자 서버에 의해 송신된 저수지 상태와 관련된 정보를 수신하는 관리자 단말기와, 상기 관리자 서버로부터 수신된 신호에 따라 이를 방송하는 경고 방송기를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: A multifunctional lantern worn on the chest
title_ko: 가슴에 착용하는 다기능 랜턴
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a multi-functional lantern (100) worn on the chest which comprises: a control unit (100a) provided on a lantern body (120) and selectively controlling an operation of the multi-functional lantern; an on/off switch (102) selectively turning the power of the multi-functional lantern on and off; a microphone and speaker (103) with a walkie-talkie function allowing various uses of calling and recording; a battery (106) supplying the power to the multi-functional lantern; a radio (110) receiving radio waves sent from a broadcasting station and allowing a user to hear the same as voices; an alarm (111) emitting an alarm sound to the user and people in case of a dangerous situation to evacuate therefrom; an LED lamp (112) emitting light to illuminate the front so that the user can watch the front; and a shoulder strap (150) worn over the user's shoulder and waist to secure the lantern body (120) close to the chest. The multi-functional lantern worn on the chest is secured tightly to the user's body so that the user can use both hands freely when using the lantern, and is especially designed to be conveniently used in dark bridge interiors, tunnels, etc. during safety diagnosis of facilities. Accordingly, the quality and reliability of multi-functional lantern products worn on the chest are greatly improved so that the various needs of consumers can be satisfied and a good image can be created.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 가슴에 착용하는 다기능 랜턴에 관한 것이다. 본 발명은 이를 위해 가슴에 착용하는 다기능 랜턴(100)에 관한 것으로, 랜턴몸체(120)에 구비되며, 다기능 랜턴의 동작을 선택적으로 제어하는 제어부(100a); 다기능 랜턴의 전원을 선택적으로 온,오프시키는 온,오프스위치(102); 통화와 녹음을 다양하게 사용할 수 있도록 한 무전기 기능의 마이크 및 스피커(103); 다기능 랜턴에 전원을 공급하는 배터리(106); 방송국에서 보낸 전파를 수신하여 음성으로 들을 수 있도록 한 라디오(110); 위험상황시 본인 및 주변사람들에게 경보음을 발산시켜 대피시킬 수 있도록 한 경보기(111); 전방을 주시할 수 있도록 빛을 발산시켜 앞을 비추는 LED램프(112); 및 사용자의 어깨와 허리에 걸쳐지도록 하여 랜턴몸체(120)를 가슴쪽 위치에 밀착시키도록 한 멜빵(150);이 포함된다. 상기와 같이 구성된 본 발명은 렌턴 사용시 사용자의 양손을 모두 자유롭게 사용할 수 있도록 하기 위해 랜턴을 사용자의 몸에 밀착 고정시킨 것이고, 특히 시설물의 안전진단 조사시 어두운 교량 내부, 터널 등에 적용하여 편리하게 사용할 수 있도록 한 것이고, 이로 인해 가슴에 착용하는 다기능 랜턴 제품의 품질과 신뢰성을 대폭 향상시키므로 사용자인 소비자들의 다양한 욕구(니즈)를 충족시켜 좋은 이미지를 심어줄 수 있도록 한 것이다.

title_en: On-line intelligent identification method of provincial level power grid cascading failures
abstract_en: Provided is an on-line intelligent identification method of provincial level power grid cascading failures. A graph theory principle is used for dividing a system line into branches and links. Aiming at a tree-shaped structure of a system, a synergetic multi-group genetic algorithm is used, optimal solution ecological niche radiuses are solved in a self-adapting mode, and therefore a batch of dangerous tree-shaped structures of different modes can be found. Branches which are over a limitation in trend are selected in the dangerous tree-shaped structures and used as target lines, and a line, strongly corresponding to each target line, in the links is found. The lines and target lines form a key section. According to the method, the dangerous tree-shaped structures are only found in a system tree-shaped structure, then the key sections are searched only in the dangerous tree-shaped structure, problem solving space is greatly reduced, line failure reasons are not limited, and non-common-reason multiple failures which can cause the cascading failures can be found.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;UNIV CHINA THREE GORGES CTGU

title_en: A kind of intelligent building firefighting monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of intelligent building firefighting monitoring system, comprise fire station, Surveillance center and multiple Data Detection for fire hazard aerosol fog detection and transmission terminal, described Data Detection and transmission terminal are connected with Surveillance center, and described Surveillance center is connected with fire station；Described Data Detection and transmission terminal comprise fire cigarette propagated sensation sensor, signal modulation module, signal demodulation module, data processing module, sound and light alarm module, controller module, radiofrequency launcher and power module, present invention employs high performance microprocessor SPCE061A is the networking fire protection warning monitoring system that core achieves a kind of intelligent building, through reality test, this system has stronger network communications capability, high real-time, the feature of communication fast and reliable, has the highest practical value.
assignees: WUXI ZHUOXIN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Trend convergence adjusting method based on deep reinforcement learning and cascade graph neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for adjusting the convergence of a power flow based on deep reinforcement learning and a cascade graph neural network. The reinforcement learning can learn an adjustable action strategy through the reward of the environment for the action by continuously interacting the action (the trend adjustment action) and the environment (the current trend parameter), and construct a nonlinear mapping relation between different actions and the final value of the action in the current environment by utilizing deep learning. The method takes the power flow convergence probability obtained by the cascade diagram neural network as one of design references of the reward function, finally obtains the power flow convergence adjustment strategy, and has important significance for guaranteeing safe and stable operation of the power system.

title_en: Wind-solar capacity double-layer optimization configuration method for cascade water-wind-solar multi-energy complementary power generation system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind-solar capacity double-layer optimization configuration method of a cascade water-wind-solar multi-energy complementary power generation system, and belongs to the technical field of new energy power generation. The method solves the problem that the capacity of the wind-solar power station is unreasonable in the prior art, builds a multi-energy complementary power generation system, and builds a multi-energy complementary power generation system output model; acquiring constraint conditions of a multi-energy complementary power generation system; establishing a double-layer optimization model, and establishing an outer-layer capacity optimization configuration model by taking the maximum light capacity regulation and the maximum total water-wind-light output of the multi-energy complementary power generation system as objective functions; establishing an inner-layer operation optimization configuration model by taking the highest output and the highest power grid load tracking degree and the highest economical efficiency of the multi-energy complementary power generation system in the daily combined power generation process as objective functions; the multi-energy complementary system comprises three energy forms of water power, wind power and photovoltaic, fully considers the natural complementary characteristics of wind and light resources and the peak regulation capability of water power, and realizes the selection of the optimal capacity of the wind and light new energy power station.
assignees: SOUTHWEST BRANCH OF STATE GRID CORP OF CHINA

title_en: Robust optimization scheduling method, device, equipment and medium for gradient water-light complementary distribution
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of optimal scheduling of a multi-energy complementary power generation system, in particular to a robust optimal scheduling method, device, equipment and medium for cascade water-light complementary distribution, which comprises the following steps: taking peak-valley difference of a receiving end power grid, minimum hydropower intra-day adjustment power and minimum light rejection into consideration, and establishing an objective function of a step water-light complementation two-stage distribution robust model before and in the day; establishing two-stage constraint conditions of a day-ahead stage and a day-in stage; based on a data driving method, establishing a confidence set considering 1-norm and ++norm constraint uncertainty probability distribution; based on piecewise linearization and McCormick relaxation, converting the distributed robust model into a mixed integer linear programming model; and solving the mixed integer linear programming model by adopting a column and constraint generation algorithm to obtain the gradient water-light complementary distribution robust optimization scheduling method. According to the invention, the peak shaving capacity of complementary operation can be improved, and the operation risk caused by uncertainty of photovoltaic output prediction can be reduced.

title_en: Public opinion information propagation prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a public opinion information propagation prediction method and system. The method comprises the following steps: step 1: dividing crowd nodes in a social network into unknown state nodes, support state nodes, opposite state nodes and neutral state nodes according to the attitudes of the crowd nodes to public opinion information; step 2: setting probability factors for converting an unknown state node into other three state nodes at unit time and probability factors for converting a neutral state node into a supporting state node or an opposite state node respectively; step 3: based on the proportion of each state node at the current moment and each probability factor, constructing a first differential equation for obtaining the proportion change of each state node according to an average field theory algorithm; step 4: and according to the first differential equation, a numerical simulation method or an analog simulation method is adopted to display the change process of the number of the state nodes.

title_en: Characterization of interactions between compounds and polymers using attitude ensembles
abstract_en: Systems and methods for characterizing interactions between compounds and polymers include obtaining multiple sets of atomic coordinates. Each set of atomic coordinates includes the compound bound to the polymer in a corresponding pose of a plurality of poses. Each respective set of atomic coordinates or its encoding is input into the neural network in turn to obtain a corresponding initial embedding as output, thereby obtaining a plurality of initial embeddings. Each initial embedding corresponds to one of the sets of atomic coordinates. The attention mechanism is applied to the plurality of initial embeddings in a cascade to obtain an attention embedding. A pooling function is applied to the attention embedment to derive a pooling embedment. The pooling insert is input into a model to obtain an interaction score for the interaction between the compound and the polymer.

title_en: AI-based intelligent regulating method and device for reducing loss of distribution network 10KV line technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses an AI-based intelligent regulating method and device for reducing loss of a distribution network 10KV line technology, comprising the following steps: acquiring real-time data of a 10KV line of the distribution network, and preprocessing; step 2: establishing a robust deep learning model; step 3: training the deep learning model through historical data to improve the accurate prediction capability of the deep learning model on line loss, optimizing model parameters by using a back propagation algorithm, and introducing a data enhancement technology of training data to improve the robustness of the model; step 4: monitoring the real-time data by using an anomaly detection algorithm; step 5: comparing the model prediction result with actual observation data, monitoring the state of the system in real time, and introducing a self-adaptive control strategy to adjust the system; step 6: setting performance indexes, and performing iterative optimization through continuous monitoring data and user feedback. Compared with the traditional method, the method has stronger adaptability and robustness, and can better cope with the complexity and uncertainty of the power system.
assignees: SHANDONG BEITIANJI ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Railway engineering safety risk cause and conduction mechanism analysis method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a railway engineering safety risk cause and a conduction mechanism analysis method thereof, which comprises the steps of obtaining railway engineering safety accident cases, and further comprising the following steps: analyzing railway work safety accident cases, and mining risk causes; according to the risk cause, processing the accident case and forming a railway work safety risk cause data table; substituting the railway engineering safety risk cause data table into a multi-objective particle swarm optimization algorithm, screening out railway engineering safety risk key causes, and forming a railway engineering safety risk key cause data matrix; substituting the data matrix of the railway safety risk key causes into a Bayesian network, performing structure learning and parameter learning, and analyzing the occurrence probability, posterior probability and conduction mechanism of the risk key causes. According to the invention, index screening meets the requirements of practical application, the Bayesian network structure is optimized, and the propagation diagnosis and probability of the risk key indexes are analyzed to obtain a causal logic chain for generating accident results.

title_en: Electric power physical information system cascading failure assessment method considering information transmission failure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascading failure assessment method of an electric power physical information system considering information transmission failure, which comprises the steps of 1, building an electric power physical information system model, 2, selecting a continuous attack node set, 3, judging that an information node or an electric power line fails according to a dependency relationship and a topological relationship, 4, judging that a power grid is separated and balanced with power, 5, judging that the electric power line is seriously overloaded and disconnecting the seriously overloaded line, 6, judging that the transmission of the seriously overloaded information is successful, 7, judging that the line is generally overloaded, 8, judging that the transmission of the generally overloaded information is successful, 9, making a control strategy by a dispatching center and issuing, 10, judging that the general overload of the line is eliminated and the disconnection of the overload line is not eliminated, 11, calculating a cascading failure assessment index, 12 and traversing the continuous attack node set. The invention can more accurately predict information transmission failure and simulate the cascading failure process under continuous node attack, thereby providing theoretical guidance for the cascading failure prevention and control of the power physical information system.

title_en: Lifesaving guidance illumination line management system based on multi-network converged communication search and rescue
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of life-saving illumination lines, in particular to a life-saving guiding illumination line management system based on multi-network fusion communication search and rescue, which comprises a processing planning module, a matching risk detection module, an interface stability monitoring module and a management terminal; the invention integrates the communication means of private network and public network by adopting a multimode fusion communication mode combining wired and wireless, realizes short-range and long-range command scheduling and supports multi-hop cascade relay forwarding, acquires all the component devices of the life-saving guide illumination line to be installed by the processing planning module, analyzes the availability of all the component devices, and judges the matching risk of all the component devices by the matching risk detection module when the component devices corresponding to low availability signals do not exist, thereby being beneficial to ensuring the use safety and stability of the installed life-saving guide illumination line, reducing the use management difficulty of the life-saving guide illumination line and having high intelligent degree.

title_en: Method, system, equipment and medium for generating fault first-aid repair scheme of low-voltage distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, equipment and a medium for generating a fault first-aid repair scheme of a low-voltage distribution network, which are used for generating a high-precision preliminary fault signal by collecting current, voltage and power data of a power grid in real time and adopting an isolated forest algorithm to perform anomaly detection; the method comprises the steps of combining a convolutional neural network to intelligently classify fault types and candidate fault points, constructing a power distribution network model based on historical topological data, dynamically analyzing fault propagation paths by utilizing a minimum spanning tree algorithm, accurately extracting fault influence ranges and key nodes, optimizing a rush-repair resource allocation scheme through a genetic algorithm, balancing time and cost, planning an optimal rush-repair path by fusing an A-algorithm and real-time GIS data, improving path efficiency, finally constructing a multi-objective optimization model, comprehensively planning rush-repair time, resource cost and power failure loss, outputting a global optimal scheme, realizing full-flow intellectualization, and improving fault positioning precision, resource allocation rationality and path planning efficiency.

title_en: Geological disaster knowledge graph construction method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of knowledge graph construction, in particular to a geological disaster knowledge graph construction method and system based on artificial intelligence; the method comprises the steps of extracting a geological semantic triplet set by using a semantic physical collaborative type preprocessing method to construct a three-layer semantic ontology graph, generating a space section structure chain and a time sequence state chain by using a double-chain type space-time graph construction method to construct a double-chain coupling graph structure, carrying out node state propagation calculation by using a disturbance perception graph neural network mechanism to obtain a risk state prediction result of a landslide structure unit layer under each time node, generating a landslide risk propagation path chain by using a reverse causal path chain reconstruction method, and migrating propagation parameters and response rules in a historical landslide graph structure into the double-chain coupling graph structure to construct a double-chain coupling space-time geological disaster knowledge graph. According to the invention, landslide state prediction and causal path reasoning are realized through the double-chain diagram structure and the disturbance perception diagram neural network.

title_en: Mathematical description method of cascade reservoir group joint scheduling system based on complex network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mathematical description method of a cascade reservoir group joint scheduling system based on a complex network, which comprises the following steps of step 1, determining network types, step 2, defining nodes of the cascade reservoir group complex network, step 3, defining edges of the cascade reservoir group complex network, step 4, defining an adjacency matrix A of the cascade reservoir group complex network, step 5, defining node attributes of the cascade reservoir group complex network and constraint sets thereof, step 6, defining natural running water as input variables of the reservoir group system, step 7, describing hydraulic coupling relations among the cascade reservoirs, step 8, describing a state transfer equation among the cascade reservoirs, and the method can more comprehensively capture the interrelationships among reservoirs, intuitively embody the network properties among the reservoirs in the cascade reservoir group joint scheduling system, provide more analysis angles for reservoir optimal scheduling and provide a mathematical description method of the system for reservoir group complex network analysis.

title_en: Data processing method and system based on multi-layer architecture
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent power grid real-time monitoring, in particular to a data processing method and a system based on a multi-layer architecture, wherein the method comprises the following steps of 1, generating a dynamic priority queue, and generating a dynamic priority sequencing queue based on real-time feature analysis of multi-source sensing data of power equipment, wherein high priority data enter a processing channel preferentially; step 2, modeling cross-layer anomaly association, namely establishing a multi-layer anomaly propagation model through the physical connection relation of the equipment and the historical operation mode by utilizing the priority queue data output in the step 1, and step 3, carrying out resource self-adaptive scheduling, dynamically adjusting a task allocation strategy of a data processing node according to the anomaly propagation model established in the step 2, and ensuring the supply of processing resources of a key anomaly path. The method can obviously improve the accuracy and response speed of the abnormality processing of the power equipment, and finally realizes the efficient maintenance and management of the power equipment.
assignees: BEIJING NORTH STAR TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Lightning strike fire spreading simulation method and system
abstract_en: The application discloses a lightning strike fire spreading simulation method and a system, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source space-time characteristic data corresponding to lightning strike fire; the method comprises the steps of carrying out feature extraction and fusion on corresponding multi-source space-time feature data through a pre-constructed space-time feature fusion network, outputting prediction parameters used for representing fire state conversion, constructing a multi-state cellular automaton comprising smoldering states and open flame states, positioning lightning strike ignition points, initializing states of cells corresponding to the lightning strike ignition points to be smoldering states, giving initial heat energy to the cells corresponding to the lightning strike ignition points, carrying out phase change discrimination on the cells in the smoldering states based on the prediction parameters and dynamic time sequence features, carrying out vector correction based on a neighborhood propagation rule based on a phase change discrimination result, carrying out lightning strike fire propagation simulation, and outputting a simulation result. By utilizing the scheme of the application, the accuracy and the scientificity of lightning fire simulation are obviously improved through deep coupling of deep learning feature extraction and physical mechanism modeling.

title_en: Methods, apparatus, and systems using closed access group (cag) support in minimization of service interruptions (mint)
abstract_en: Methods, apparatus, and systems are disclosed. In one embodiment, a method, implemented by a Wireless Transmit/Receive Unit (WTRU) may use a first Public Land Mobile Network (PLMN) not affected by a disaster condition and a second PLMN affected by a disaster condition. The method may include: receiving from a CAG cell of the first PLMN, broadcast information indicating: (1) that the CAG cell supports disaster inbound roaming (DIR) of WTRUs associated with the second PLMN and (2) that the CAG Cell accepts CAG-supporting disaster inbound roamers; selecting the CAG cell of the first PLMN based on the broadcasted information; and sending a Registration Request message including information indicating a DIR indication and an identifier of the second PLMN. The method may further include receiving new CAG information associated with the first PLMN; and initiating a cell (re)selection procedure using the new CAG information associated with the first PLMN.

title_en: Optimized scheduling method, device, equipment and medium for cascade water wind-solar complementary system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of optimal scheduling of power systems, in particular to an optimal scheduling method, device, equipment and medium of a cascade water wind-light complementary system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: establishing constraint conditions of step water wind-solar complementary system scheduling, wherein the constraint conditions comprise: electric power characteristic constraint, hydraulic characteristic constraint and water-electricity coupling characteristic constraint of the cascade hydropower station, and water-wind-light coupling characteristic constraint and output characteristic constraint of the cascade water-wind-light complementary system; according to constraint conditions, taking the maximum sum of the medium-long-term scheduling effect and the short-term scheduling effect of the cascade water-wind-solar system as an objective function, and constructing a cascade water-wind-solar complementary system scheduling model; and solving the scheduling model by using a linearization method to obtain an optimized scheduling result. According to the invention, a step hydroelectric-wind power-photovoltaic complementary system power generation scheme meeting the constraint can be provided, the overall utility of the system is improved, the waste wind and the waste light are reduced, the resource integration of a new energy power generation system is realized, and the safe and stable operation of a power grid is ensured.

title_en: Method, system and device for evaluating influence of extreme weather on power generation power of power grid
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power grid security risk assessment, in particular to a method, a system and a device for evaluating the influence of extreme weather on power generated by a power grid, which are used for firstly acquiring weather cloud images and microclimate data corresponding to the extreme weather; the method comprises the steps of inputting a meteorological cloud image into a VIT prediction model to conduct prediction to obtain a first sub-decision, inputting microclimate data into a transducer prediction model to conduct prediction to obtain a second sub-decision, and finally inputting the first sub-decision and the second sub-decision into a multi-mode fusion decision machine to conduct cascade fusion to obtain probability of influencing power generation power of a power grid. The method combines the prediction results of the two modes of the weather cloud image and the microclimate data to carry out decision fusion, integrates the different dimensional information collected when the extreme weather occurs, and accurately predicts the influence of the extreme weather on the power generation power of the new energy power grid.

title_en: System for integrated management of reservoir
title_ko: 저수지 통합 관리 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a reservoir integrated management system and, more particularly, to a reservoir integrated management system to discriminate and determine a risk element in advance by monitoring the water level change, discharge flow, and collapse related information of a reservoir in real time, to rapidly inform an emergency situation through on-line or a mobile communication network, and to establish measures. The reservoir integrated management system according to the present invention comprises: a water level measuring unit to measure a water level; an overflow quantity measuring unit to measure water amounts which are flowing over a spillway of a bank of the reservoir; a reservoir managing unit to collect information measured by the water level measuring unit and the overflow quantity measuring unit and to transmit the information; a manager server to receive the information from the reservoir managing unit, to process the information, and to identify and transmit a reservoir state; a manager terminal to receive information related to the reservoir state transmitted from the manager server; and a warning broadcasting unit to broadcast the information by a signal received from the manager server.
abstract_ko:

title_en: Using computer video camera to detect earthquake
abstract_en: Images from the video camera of a computer are compared over time, e.g., every few milliseconds, to determine from the pixel data if motion of the computer matches template motion associated with an earthquake P-wave. If so, a warning is generated, uploaded to a communication network, and propagated over the network to other computers.

title_en: Method for capacity credit assessment of photovoltaic power generation system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for capacity credit assessment of a photovoltaic power generation system. The method comprises: putting forward four factors that affect the capacity credit of a photovoltaic power generation system, i.e., the photovoltaic permeability, the data sampling time interval, the photovoltaic-load output fluctuation and the time sequence correlation between photovoltaic output and load fluctuation; calculating the reliability of the power system by using sequential Monte Carlo simulation and solving the capacity credit by the Secant Method; establishing a three-layer error back propagation neural network between the four factors and the capacity credit; training the neural network by using input and output data sets which are obtained under different irradiation modes; and obtaining the capacity credit of the photovoltaic power generation system under the given condition by using the generalization ability of the neural network which is already trained. The method for capacity credit assessment of a photovoltaic power generation system can be used for planning and design of photovoltaic composite generation and transmission systems, requires no sequential Monte Carlo simulation individually for each specific photovoltaic power generation system, and solves the problem of poor universality of the prior art.

title_en: Load prediction method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a load prediction method and a device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: receiving first initial load predicted values currently output by at least two single prediction models; inputting each first initial load predicted value into a pre-trained Back Propagation Neural Network (BPNN) model; and determining a target load predicted value based on the BPNN model. In the embodiment of the invention, when the load prediction is carried out, the first initial load predicted value is determined based on the single prediction model, then each first initial load predicted value is input into the pre-trained BPNN model, and the target load predicted value is determined based on the BPNN model and combined with each first initial load predicted value, so that the problem that the single model is prone to falling into local optimization under the conditions of poor convergence, large fluctuation and influence of emergencies on data sets is avoided, and the determined target load predicted value is more accurate.
assignees: YANGZHONG INTELLIGENT ELECTRICAL RESEARCH CENTER OF NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER UNIV

title_en: Incremental power distribution network source-network-storage coordination planning strategy considering carbon emission cost
abstract_en: The invention discloses an incremental power distribution network source-network-storage coordination planning strategy considering carbon emission cost, which comprises the following steps: acquiring basic information required by planning of an incremental distribution network in a certain place; constructing a power distribution network optimization planning model by taking the comprehensive income maximization of a power grid company as a target; constructing a multi-benefit main body cost-benefit model considering carbon emission cost, and constructing an incremental distribution network source-load-storage coordination planning model based on the multi-benefit main body cost-benefit model; constructing a power distribution network-incremental power distribution network coordination planning model, and decomposing and solving an optimization target by adopting an objective cascade Analysis (ATC); and describing the interaction relation of the multi-interest subjects in a cooperative game mode, and dividing the profits of the subjects based on a Shapley value method. By adopting the strategy of the invention, the planning scheme can better adapt to the aim of 'double carbon', and the method has positive significance for coordinating the relationship between national investment and social capital investment in power grid construction and exploring a comprehensive income dividing mode suitable for multi-benefit subjects.

title_en: Port comprehensive energy system and bulk cargo wharf distribution cooperative scheduling method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a port comprehensive energy system and bulk cargo wharf distribution collaborative scheduling method, which promotes the economic and efficient operation and the green low-carbon development of ports, and comprises the following steps: constructing a multi-energy production and marketing integrated model; establishing a port comprehensive energy system under double-layer excitation, a bulk cargo wharf logistics system and an operator collaborative framework of an infrastructure; based on the lowest cost target, establishing a port comprehensive energy system multi-energy cooperation dispatching and output optimizing model, a bulk cargo wharf logistics system equipment joint dispatching and energy consumption optimizing model considering bidirectional logistics, and a bulk cargo wharf infrastructure dispatching and energy consumption optimizing model considering energy consumption comfort; constructing a bulk cargo wharf bidirectional logistics pipeline scheduling flow optimization model based on a synchronous parallel machine operation principle; establishing a distributed collaborative scheduling model of different operators by adopting a target cascading analysis method; and solving the model to obtain a port comprehensive energy system and bulk cargo wharf collaborative scheduling scheme.

title_en: Method and device for determining overhaul cost data of transformer substation
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a device for determining overhaul cost data of a transformer substation, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining cost influence data, wherein the cost influence data is influence data which has influence on the cost data and has influence degree of m bits at the front, the cost data is overhaul cost of primary equipment of the transformer substation, and the cost influence data comprises at least one of engineering parameters of the transformer substation, equipment parameters of the transformer substation and process parameters of the transformer substation; calculating the cost influence data by adopting a preset model to obtain a plurality of calculation results, wherein the preset model comprises a target depth confidence network, a target back propagation neural network and a target gray prediction model; and carrying out fusion processing on the multiple calculation results to obtain target cost data, wherein the fusion processing at least comprises quantile regression average processing. The method solves the problem of insufficient reliability in the process of determining the cost data in the prior art.
assignees: ZHANJIANG POWER SUPPLY BUREAU OF GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for extracting relationship of entities involved in electric carbon market transaction based on cascade pointer network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for extracting entity relation in electric carbon market transaction based on a cascade pointer network, comprising the following steps of constructing an electric carbon market transaction field word segmentation dictionary, constructing PowerSpanBERT models, training PowerSpanBERT models by introducing improved gradient accumulation-projection gradient descent countermeasure training strategies, identifying and extracting candidate head entity sets, introducing a multi-head attention mechanism to calculate a word embedding vector output by a PowerSpanBERT model, decoding the candidate head entity set feature vector and the word embedding vector by CPN to obtain candidate tail entity sets, predicting relation types between the candidate head entity sets and head-tail entity pairs in the candidate tail entity sets, outputting the head-tail entity pairs and the corresponding relation types, and generating entity relation triplets according to irrigation results. The invention provides a more accurate and efficient entity relation extraction solution for electric carbon market transaction.
assignees: UNIV TIANJIN;STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Mixed pumped storage scheduling method for reducing water consumption rate of step hydroelectric operation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hybrid pumped storage scheduling method for reducing the running water consumption rate of cascade hydropower, which comprises the steps of establishing a cascade hydropower and light storage complementary power generation scheduling model, establishing a minimum objective function for the total water consumption of a cascade hydropower station based on the cascade hydropower scheduling model, determining constraint conditions of the objective function according to the cascade hydropower scheduling model, establishing a solving model based on an Actor-Critic algorithm, inputting time sequence data in historical data sets as environment state parameters into a deep reinforcement learning algorithm model, solving an optimal day-ahead scheduling strategy through an iterative training network model, and calculating the water consumption rate by using the obtained optimal scheduling strategy result to evaluate the result. By introducing an Actor-Critic algorithm in deep reinforcement learning, an optimization decision strategy under a complex environment is realized, the economic operation efficiency and the power generation benefit of the system are effectively improved, and the water consumption rate of cascade hydropower is remarkably reduced.

title_en: Urban rainfall flood process forecasting method based on data assimilation and multi-mode coupling
abstract_en: The invention relates to a city rainfall flood process forecasting method based on data assimilation and multi-mode coupling, which comprises the following steps of ⑴ collecting historical meteorological data, hydrological data, topographic data, soil texture data, vegetation data and city infrastructure data in an area, inputting all the data into a visual analysis and decision platform based on a GIS technology after quality control and format standardization, ⑵ establishing parameter transfer rules among WRF, SHUD and a two-dimensional hydrodynamic model, ⑶ operating the WRF, obtaining area high-resolution rainfall forecast data, carrying out EnKF dynamic update and inputting the data into the platform, ⑷ driving SHUD, obtaining area surface runoff and groundwater forecast data, carrying out EnKF dynamic update and inputting the data into the platform, ⑸ driving the two-dimensional hydrodynamic model, obtaining flood propagation paths and space-time release data of a inundation area and inputting the data into the platform, and ⑹ utilizing a threshold automatic identification technology to form risk level assessment and inputting the risk level assessment into the platform. The invention has high practicability and can realize accurate forecasting.
assignees: NORTHWEST INSTITUTE ECO ENVIRONMENT & RESOURCES CAS

title_en: Low-voltage distribution network fluctuation risk research and judgment and intelligent early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a low-voltage distribution network fluctuation risk studying, judging and intelligent early warning method and system, and relates to the technical field of intelligent early warning of electric power systems, wherein the method comprises the steps of performing fusion analysis on power grid operation data and environment data through a space-time convolutional neural network to generate an associated feature matrix of power grid operation state and environment risk; the method comprises the steps of carrying out dynamic modeling on a power grid topological structure by utilizing a physical information dynamic graph attention network, extracting a dynamic risk propagation path, adopting a Bayesian network to calculate fault probability distribution of each node of the power grid in combination with the dynamic risk propagation path, optimizing an early warning strategy through a reinforcement learning algorithm to generate an optimal early warning scheme, and scheduling rush repair resources by utilizing a multi-objective optimization algorithm to generate a rush repair resource scheduling scheme. The method has the beneficial effects of remarkably improving the accuracy of fault early warning and the rush-repair efficiency and providing reliable technical support for the intelligent operation and maintenance of the low-voltage distribution network.

title_en: Water supply scheduling variable frequency regulation strategy optimization method based on pressure equalization
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water supply reconstruction, and discloses a water supply scheduling variable frequency regulation strategy optimization method based on pressure equalization, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining topographic elevation data and pipe network topology data of a construction area, preprocessing the data, generating topographic gradient feature vectors, calculating gravitational potential energy distribution by using a topographic flow field coupling analysis algorithm, generating a topographic influence coefficient matrix, analyzing pipe network segmentation conditions caused by construction based on a graph cutting algorithm, calculating topology change features of affected sub-networks, and integrating the topographic influence coefficient matrix and the topology change features. According to the invention, the quantitative relation between gravitational potential energy distribution and pressure propagation is established through the terrain flow field coupling analysis algorithm, so that the influence of terrain factors on pressure can be accurately quantified, the pressure compensation requirements of different elevation positions are obtained to be differentiated by introducing the terrain influence coefficient matrix, and the defect that the traditional method simplifies the terrain influence into a single parameter is overcome.
assignees: ZHAOQING HIGH TECH ZONE YUEHAI WATER CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent verification method for multidimensional scene perception
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent verification method for multi-dimensional scene perception, which comprises the steps of obtaining service data, edge computing environment information and network state information of a power supply station, constructing a multi-dimensional scene feature vector, constructing a meta-confidence coefficient model based on the multi-dimensional scene feature vector by adopting a feature progressive strategy, generating initial confidence coefficient, decision advice and decision context information of an edge computing result based on the meta-confidence coefficient model, receiving cloud verification results, constructing a timing memory module and an error propagation diagram by combining the decision context information, generating a verification feedback optimization instruction and predictive feedback buffer data, updating the meta-confidence coefficient model based on the verification feedback optimization instruction and the predictive feedback buffer data, and executing a final decision by combining the initial confidence coefficient and the decision advice to generate a service execution report. The invention solves the problems of cold start and asynchronous verification inefficiency through a characteristic progressive structure and a predictive feedback buffer mechanism.
assignees: Jiangsu electric power information technology co ltd

title_en: Commercial district passenger flow prediction method based on graph neural network
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and mainly relates to a business district passenger flow prediction method based on a graph neural network, which aims to solve the problems that the prior art cannot dynamically describe the propagation of passenger flow in a complex junction, lacks multi-source real-time data deep fusion, is difficult to adapt to real-time control in model structure solidification, and lacks closed-loop decision support from prediction to intervention; the invention integrates four real-time data of passenger flow, traffic, commercial activities and external environment by constructing a dynamic adjustable business district physical network, and fuses multi-source characteristics for network nodes; further, combining a graph neural network with time sequence modeling, and dynamically learning passenger flow rules among nodes; finally, conducting diversion scheme simulation and comparison based on a prediction result to form a decision closed loop of 'perception-prediction-simulation-intervention'; the method has the dynamic adaptation and real-time response capability, and realizes the transition from passive early warning to active dispatching optimization.
assignees: DENGHUO XINGQIU BEIJING INTERNATIONAL DIGITAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent knowledge base management system
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent knowledge base management system, which relates to the technical field of knowledge maps and comprises a knowledge map construction module, a scene perception module, a knowledge retrieval module, a risk assessment module, a dynamic shielding module and a recommendation output module, wherein the knowledge map construction module is used for constructing a layered knowledge map, the scene perception module is used for collecting scene characteristics of the current running state of a power grid in real time and fusing the scene characteristics to obtain scene embedded vectors, the knowledge retrieval module is used for executing directional propagation in the layered knowledge map according to user inquiry to obtain candidate knowledge nodes, the risk assessment module is used for calculating total risks of the candidate knowledge nodes based on the topological attribute vectors and the scene embedded vectors, the dynamic shielding module is used for shielding candidate knowledge nodes with inverse fact risk differences exceeding a risk threshold to obtain unshielded candidate knowledge nodes, and the recommendation output module is used for sequencing and outputting the unshielded candidate knowledge nodes according to the total risks from low to high. The invention can realize knowledge retrieval and recommendation which not only accords with the operation rule of the power grid, but also can avoid scene-dependent high-risk operation.
assignees: STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER IND CO LTD

title_en: System and method for optimizing supply chain of hydrogen distribution network
abstract_en: The present disclosure generally relates to producing, transporting, distributing, and storing hydrogen fuel, more particularly to system and method for optimizing supply chain of hydrogen distribution network. A centralized server triggers production facility to produce gas/liquid Hydrogen. Centralized server stores at storage facility in hydrogen cylinders, produced gas/liquid Hydrogen, in Liquid Organic Hydrogen Carrier (LOHC) molecule, based on hydrogenation of chemicals.
