Centralized server transmits instructions for transporting hydrogenated LOHC molecule in tanker trucks, from production facility to depots, and dehydrogenates at depots, hydrogenated LOHC molecule to release hydrogen at low pressure. Centralized server compresses, at depots, released hydrogen, and fill compressed hydrogen in high-pressure tube trailers/flat-bed cylinder cascades. Centralized server determines optimal routes for transportation vehicles from depots to retailers/consumption sites, and stores, at retailers/consumption sites, compressed hydrogen in low-pressure tanks/high-pressure buffer cylinders. Centralized server outputs information corresponding to inventory of low-pressure tanks/high-pressure buffer cylinders at retailers/consumption sites.

title_en: Methods and systems for streaming buffer numerical propagation
abstract_en: Systems, methods, and instructions of computer-readable media may include obtaining, at a client machine, a user-selected configuration parameter for an orbit simulation; sending, from the client machine to a remote system, via a network connection, a first set of configuration parameters for the orbit simulation, wherein the first set of configuration parameters comprise the user-selected configuration parameter; receiving, at the client device from the remove device, via the network connection, a stream of orbital data comprising points along an orbit, wherein the points along the orbit are determined by the remote system based on the first set of configuration parameters; and presenting, at a display, a dynamic rendering of the orbit simulation, wherein the orbit simulation is based on the stream of orbital data.
assignees: SLINGSHOT AEROSPACE INC;MARCHAND BELINDA GRACE;LEDERMAN JOSHUA;KOENIG DANIEL;JONDROW MATTHEW

title_en: Risk degree calculation method considering key nodes for power grid close tripping
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for calculating the risk of a power grid approaching cascading trip considering key nodes, which comprises the following steps of firstly, aiming at a cascading trip scene of a power grid, providing a mapping relation between branch current of the power grid after an initial fault occurs and node electrical control quantity and disturbance quantity by using a direct current flow method; step two, forming a new vector; and step three, defining a penalty function according to the mathematical model given by the formula (5), and selecting a particle swarm optimization algorithm to solve. The method has the main advantages that on the basis of strict analysis, only key nodes influencing the intertripping in the power grid are considered, so that the danger degree of the current state of the power grid to the occurrence of the intertripping event is calculated, the calculation time can be greatly reduced, and the analysis efficiency is improved.

title_en: Audit data processing method suitable for distribution network engineering
abstract_en: The invention provides an audit data processing method suitable for distribution network engineering, which comprises the following steps: generating first twin distribution network 3D data based on first component information of a first distribution network project at the current moment; acquiring all second component information in current audit data received at the current moment to obtain a second component set, and segmenting the first twin distribution network 3D data based on the second component set to obtain second twin distribution network 3D data; acquiring third twin distribution network 3D data corresponding to the second twin distribution network 3D data in the first twin distribution network 3D data; verifying the current audit data of the 3D data of the second twin distribution network to obtain a first verification result based on the historical audit data and/or the information cascade strategy of the 3D data of the third twin distribution network; and correspondingly storing the current audit data, the first verification result and the 3D data of the second twin distribution network, and updating the 3D data of the first twin distribution network.

title_en: Variable-working-condition multi-stage fatigue crack propagation prediction method for deep sea pressure-resistant cabin
abstract_en: The invention relates to a variable-working-condition multi-stage deep sea pressure-resistant cabin fatigue crack propagation prediction method, which relates to the technical field of deep sea pressure-resistant cabin fatigue detection, and comprises the steps of establishing a complete machine finite element model of a deep sea pressure-resistant cabin, carrying out fine modeling on weak link analysis, establishing a stress intensity factor-Gaussian process proxy model, carrying out deep sea pressure-resistant cabin fatigue crack prediction based on a dynamic Bayesian best-worth network model, carrying out sensitivity analysis on uncertainty parameters in the dynamic Bayesian network model based on a fatigue life prediction model of a small time scale, and reducing the influence of the uncertainty parameters in the crack propagation process based on a mixed self-adaptive resampling intelligent particle filtering parameter reasoning algorithm.

title_en: Public safety-oriented Chinese text intelligent recognition and classification method
abstract_en: The invention provides a public security-oriented Chinese text intelligent recognition and classification method, which relates to the technical field of network security text data natural language processing, and aims to support high-concurrency text stream processing by introducing an asynchronous computing framework based on a Graphic Processing Unit (GPU), integrate a plurality of semantic perception models comprising context enhancement, entity recognition and event extraction to cooperatively work, embed a structured knowledge map constructed by taking a public security case library and a judicial case abstract as cores into classification logic, fuse a custom emotion dictionary, combine emotion trigger maps constructed by field hot events, and trigger label cascading and grade response strategies after multi-level judgment is completed. The method and the system can make up for the defect that the general model lacks of field support aiming at text recognition in the professional field, have good interpretability in the decision process, can meet strict compliance requirements, and can be effectively applied to various high-risk real-time decision scenes.

title_en: Master-slave ownership-based AGCF device disaster-tolerant backup method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a master-slave ownership-based AGCF device disaster-tolerant backup method and relates to the next-generation network (NGN) communication technology. According to the technical scheme of the invention, based on a master-slave ownership mechanism, the fixed network user of a conventional non-IMS domain can be accessed to an IMS network by two AGCF devices, wherein the two AGCF devices are responsible for mutual backup and load sharing. In this way, the system disaster-tolerant performance is effectively enhanced. Meanwhile, the service interruption duration due to the failure of AGCF devices is greatly shortened.
assignees: HEBEI FAREAST COMMUNICATION SYSTEM ENG CO LTD

title_en: A kind of citation network academic evaluation sort method based on credit worthiness
abstract_en: A kind of citation network academic evaluation sort method based on credit worthiness belongs to academic assessment technique field, with reference to the feature of citation network, the present invention defines series of rules according to article background information, improve TrustRank algorithms and Anti TrustRank algorithm picks subset mechanism, the credit value and non-credit value of loop iteration calculating network node, finally integrate both results and provide scoring.According to the descending sort result of final comprehensive credit value, obtain and export the academic sequence of scientific literature in citation network.The present invention is intended to provide a kind of rational, just evaluation method, can be evaluated the influence power of document, so as to choose the paper information of high quality in a certain subject exactly.Scientific research personnel also can rapidly search documents and materials and hold the popular direction of current research, by the distribution of more times in scientific theory research.The research of the present invention has important theory significance for the structure and propagation characteristic of understanding citation network and the evaluation of document influence power.

title_en: Electric-gas region comprehensive energy system elasticity evaluation method based on heterogeneous dependency network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an elasticity evaluation method of an electricity-gas region comprehensive energy system based on a heterogeneous dependency network, which comprises the steps of 1) constructing an elasticity index system of the electricity-gas region comprehensive energy system from two dimensions including fragility and restoring force facing the elasticity of extreme events, wherein the elasticity index system comprises 5 indexes for quantifying the elasticity of the electricity-gas region comprehensive energy system and each elasticity index is defined in a complex form; 2) establishing a heterogeneous dependency network model of the electric-gas region comprehensive energy system, converting the heterogeneous dependency network model into a double-layer digraph, and calculating values of 5 indexes; 3) and determining the weights of the 5 indexes by using a geometric mean G1-entropy weight method, and calculating to obtain a comprehensive elasticity value of the system to realize the elasticity evaluation of the comprehensive energy system in the electricity-gas region. The method considers the dependency and heterogeneity of the power grid and the natural gas grid, facilitates fault propagation analysis, considers the subjective and objective weights of the indexes, and can scientifically and effectively quantify and evaluate the elasticity of the electric-gas regional comprehensive energy system.

title_en: Capacitive blocking device configuration optimization method based on genetic algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for optimizing the configuration of a capacitive blocking device based on a genetic algorithm, which comprises the following steps: based on the genetic algorithm optimizing process and improvement, an objective function is established by taking the minimum treatment cost as a target under the condition that the direct current magnetic bias suppression effect is met, the installation problem of the capacitance blocking device is equivalent to a discrete function optimization problem, and the optimization configuration scheme of the capacitance blocking device is obtained through calculation. The invention considers the propagation path of the subway stray current in the urban district power grid and specifies the possible occurrence probability event, realizes the optimized suppression of the transformer direct current magnetic bias caused by the subway stray current, and saves the treatment cost of enterprises.

title_en: Power grid line fault identification method and system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deep learning-based power grid line fault identification method, which comprises the following steps: training a target detection model according to pre-collected power grid transmission line image data; acquiring image data of a current power transmission line by using an unmanned aerial vehicle; inputting the acquired image data into the target detection model, and identifying target equipment of the power transmission line in the image; and inputting the identified target equipment image into a trained fault identification model, determining the type of the identified target equipment and judging whether the target equipment has faults or not. The invention adopts the cascade network to decompose the small sample fault detection problem into two parts of target detection and small sample learning, firstly utilizes the detection network to position all target components, and then carries out accurate fault identification on the positioned target components, thereby realizing the automatic interpretation of the power grid inspection image and realizing the accurate identification of the transmission line fault.
assignees: JINING RENCHENG POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;JINING POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Method for minimizing negative information influence under basic social grid treatment
abstract_en: The invention designs a method for minimizing negative information influence under basic social grid treatment, belonging to the technical field of rumor inhibition; the multi-label state variable linear threshold propagation model is designed, the information propagation process is simulated, the information propagation process when multiple types of nodes coexist can be simulated, and the multi-label state variable linear threshold propagation model has good expansibility and compatibility; in addition, the competition strategy and the blocking strategy are combined together to form a strategy set, and the execution cost of different strategies in the strategy set is different; selecting a seed subset and determining a rumor inhibition scheme according to the current propagation condition, the given budget and the strategy execution cost factors; and a multi-turn multi-label algorithm is provided to explore the performance problem of the rumor inhibition method under the limit of cost; the method can be applied to a large-scale network, and the optimal rumor inhibition strategy is adaptively selected under various cost budget conditions, so that the aim of finally believing the minimum rumor number is fulfilled.

title_en: Intelligent park energy management method and system based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent park energy management method and system based on a digital twin technology, wherein the method comprises the following steps: data acquisition, data preprocessing, principal component analysis, random forest prediction model construction, back propagation neural network prediction model construction, combined model prediction analysis and digital twin model construction. The invention relates to the technical field of digital twin, in particular to an intelligent park energy management method and system based on a digital twin technology.
assignees: UNIV SHENZHEN TECHNOLOGY;SHENZHOULONG SPACE TECH SHENZHEN CO LTD

title_en: System for be used for electric power mobile office and intranet and extranet linkage
abstract_en: A system for electric mobile office and internal and external network linkage belongs to the field of mobile office. On the basis of the national network SG186 system, a data layer, a technical support layer, a business service layer, a control distribution layer, a presentation layer and an application layer are arranged; splitting business logic into a plurality of service components, and distributing data on a plurality of nodes by adopting software based on a cloud computing architecture; by means of mobile terminal performance signboard analysis, the 'power grid' result is fused, and the mobile internet technology is adopted to release statistical data products in an online and visual mode, so that statistical propagation force, influence and convenience are improved; the mobile terminal is used for realizing on-line dynamic tracking management of key performance indexes, and the dynamic perception of line loss management and on-line collaborative management capability are enhanced to promote the conversion of a new mode of mobile on-line operation and on-line service.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Cascading failure risk assessment method and system for large-scale wind power access power grid
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power grid risk assessment, in particular to a cascading failure risk assessment method and system for a large-scale wind power access power grid, wherein the assessment method comprises the steps of establishing a power transmission line disconnection probability model; establishing a load loss model according to the load loss of the node; constructing a fault model of the wind turbine; performing cascading failure simulation analysis based on the established model; according to the invention, the accurate assessment of the power transmission line disconnection probability is realized by establishing the power transmission line disconnection probability model; modeling the disconnection probability of the power transmission line by adopting a piecewise linear model effectively simulates the disconnection risk of the power transmission line under different load states, and provides powerful guarantee for the safe operation of the power grid; by carrying out cascading failure simulation analysis, whether the power flow of the power transmission line is out of limit or not is used as a termination condition of failure evolution, and the cascading failure risk after wind power is connected into a power grid can be comprehensively estimated.

title_en: Intelligent monitoring system for state of relay protection hard pressing plate
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power system monitoring and discloses an intelligent monitoring system for a relay protection hard pressing plate state. The system comprises a state acquisition module, a characteristic analysis module, a joint characterization module, an abnormality prediction module, a decision execution module and a decision execution module, wherein the state acquisition module acquires mechanical displacement, contact resistance and surface infrared thermal imaging data of a hard pressing plate in real time, the characteristic analysis module respectively processes the data to generate a displacement characteristic vector, a resistance characteristic matrix and a thermodynamic characteristic map, the joint characterization module inputs the characteristics into a cascade attention fusion network, outputs multi-source joint state characterization through space alignment and weight distribution, the abnormality prediction module inputs the characteristics into a lightweight time sequence prediction model embedded into contact physical constraint to predict displacement offset, resistance attenuation rate and hot spot diffusion trend of the hard pressing plate in three working cycles, and the decision execution module generates a hard pressing plate maintenance instruction set comprising mechanical lubrication grade, contact polishing frequency and cooling fan rotating speed adjustment according to a prediction result.
assignees: DATANG FUZHOU NO 2 POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Abnormality monitoring and processing method based on power operation and maintenance
abstract_en: The invention provides an anomaly monitoring and processing method based on power operation and maintenance, which comprises the steps of collecting running state data, environment influence data and history information of equipment, constructing a simplified digital twin model to output health state scores, dynamically adjusting anomaly identification sensitivity by combining the history degradation degree of the equipment, carrying out cooperative evaluation of running and environment stress change to judge whether to trigger early warning, calculating a transmission activating factor by combining the current anomaly score, a cooperative offset factor and a history inducibility index of the equipment to obtain a deduction result based on a power grid topological structure after the anomaly is judged, fusing the transmission activating factor, a system influence score and a real-time load state to generate a risk regulation index according to the result, and automatically executing graded emergency response operation according to the risk regulation index. The method realizes the early recognition of the abnormality, the quantification of the propagation risk and the closed-loop regulation and control, and improves the intelligent level of the operation and maintenance of the power grid.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Interlayer heat dissipation equalization and signal interference suppression system for multilayer circuit board
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multilayer circuit board interlayer heat dissipation balancing and signal interference suppression system, which relates to the technical field of multilayer circuit boards, and comprises a parameter acquisition module, a coupling analysis module, an electric field suppression module and a heat dissipation scheduling module; the invention collects multi-dimensional field parameters between layers through a sensor array arranged in each interlayer gap of a multilayer circuit board, analyzes the coupling association degree, coupling interference propagation path and influence rule among a thermal field, an electric field and a magnetic field, dynamically adjusts the potential distribution of each grounding point of the grounding network by butting the grounding network of the multilayer circuit board, blocks the propagation path from the source of electric field coupling interference, and avoids signal distortion caused by field coupling; dividing the interlayer region of the multilayer circuit board into a plurality of independent radiating unit regions, identifying the thermal field intensity and the magnetic field disturbance degree of each region based on thermal field distribution and magnetic field disturbance rule data, and realizing hierarchical radiating resource distribution by calculating radiating resource distribution coefficients and dividing radiating grades.

title_en: Power network mom|nitering system and method thereof
title_ko: 전력 망 모니터링 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: A power network monitoring system includes a master device which is installed at least one or more substations among a plurality of substations and a plurality of slave devices which are installed in the remaining substations except the substation in which the master device is installed. The master device analyzes data transmitted from each slave device, generates a command for operating the corresponding slave device based on an analysis result, and transmits the command to the corresponding slave. Accordingly, the present invention can previously prevent a cascading phenomenon due to a power outage and a fault accident.
abstract_ko: 전력 망 모니터링 시스템은, 다수의 변전소 중 적어도 하나 이상의 변전소에 설치된 마스터 장치와, 마스터 장치가 설치된 변전소를 제외한 나머지 변전소에 설치된 다수의 슬레이브 장치를 포함한다. 마스터 장치는 슬레이브 장치 각각으로부터 전송된 데이터를 분석하고 그 분석 결과를 바탕으로 해당 슬레이브 장치의 조치를 위한 명령을 생성하여 해당 슬레이브 장치로 전송한다.

title_en: Automatic conversion method and system for D5000-matpower grid multi-disaster coupling cascading failure model
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic conversion method of a D5000-matpower grid multi-disaster coupling cascading failure model, which comprises the following steps: acquiring first data from a D5000 system; acquiring second data from the relay protection setting calculation system; converting the transformer model of the first data into a power transmission line model; taking the capacity of the transformer in the first data as the limit carrying capacity of the power transmission line in the power transmission line model, and updating the capacity into the first data; judging whether the component name in the second data is matched with the component name in the first data; selecting parameters required for describing the matpower primary model and the matpower secondary model from the first data as member variables, and respectively establishing the primary model and the secondary model; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a power grid element fault set and the probability of each fault in the set under the multi-disaster coupling condition, determining parameters required by describing each fault in the power grid element fault set as member variables, and obtaining a power grid multi-disaster coupling cascading fault model. The invention improves the efficiency and the accuracy of the model generation.

title_en: Civil aircraft operation risk assessment method oriented to multiple failure modes
abstract_en: The invention discloses a civil aircraft running risk assessment method for multiple failure modes, which belongs to the technical field of aircraft safety and comprises the steps of establishing a failure model based on mixed Weibull distribution and carrying out model parameter estimation based on an EM algorithm optimized by PSO aiming at the characteristic that a civil aircraft structural member has multiple loss failure, executing a Monte Carlo simulation algorithm, simulating the number DA of defective aircraft with multiple loss failure in a fleet according to the failure model, constructing a Bayesian network to carry out failure propagation analysis on initial cause events which cause unsafe results, and calculating unsafe result occurrence probability CP under the condition of the initial cause events.

title_en: Modeling method for cascading faults of power information physical system under distributed denial of service attack
abstract_en: The invention provides a cascading failure model of an electric power information physical system under distributed denial of service attack, which simulates a dynamic evolution process of the cascading failure of an electric power network under the condition that overload information of an electric power network line and scheduling information issued by a control center are lost by constructing the cascading failure model. The invention provides an optimal load shedding control method in the dynamic process of cascading failure, wherein distributed denial of service attack is applied to a communication channel of an electric power information physical system, and the attack causes the loss of power grid state information in an uplink communication channel and scheduling information in a downlink communication channel, so that the power grid cascading failure evolution process under the distributed denial of service attack is simulated, and the load loss rate and node loss rate of the residual power grid after the cascading failure is counted, thereby analyzing the influence of the network attack on the power grid.

title_en: E-commerce supply chain anti-outage decision system based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of logistics supply and discloses an e-commerce supply chain anti-outage decision system based on multi-source data fusion, which comprises a heterogeneous graph network construction and risk prediction module, wherein the heterogeneous graph network construction and risk prediction module is used for constructing a heterogeneous graph network representing the relationship of the e-commerce supply chain based on multi-source data and predicting an outage risk propagation path by utilizing a time sequence sensitive graph annotation force network; the invention builds an abnormal composition network and realizes a time sequence sensitive graph annotation force network, so that the system can accurately capture cascading effect and risk propagation paths in a complex supply network, improve the prediction accuracy of the fault cargo risk propagation path and greatly reduce false alarm and missing alarm.

title_en: Active emergency exit device
title_ko: 액티브 비상구 장치
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 액티브 비상구 장치에 관한 것으로, 특정 장소에서 소정의 간격으로 배치되어 비상구의 위치를 표시하고 비상 탈출 방향을 안내하는 비상구 장치에 있어서, 상기 특정 장소에서의 재난 발생을 검출하는 재난 발생 검출부, 상기 재난 발생을 네트워크를 통해 다른 비상구 장치로 전파하는 재난 발생 알림부 및 적어도 하나의 사용자 단말에게 상기 재난 발생에 관한 알림을 제공하고 사용자의 비상 탈출을 위해 상기 알림에 대한 피드백을 기초로 동적으로 생성되는 대피경로를 제공하는 비상 탈출 처리부를 포함한다.

title_en: Method for predicting radio disturbance of electric transmission line by using improved BP (back propagation) neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for predicting radio disturbance of an electric transmission line by using an improved BP (back propagation) neural network. The method comprises the following steps of acquiring and preprocessing data parameters; establishing a BP neural network predicting model of the data parameters; performing optimal training on the BP neural network by using a genetic algorithm and a simulated annealing algorithm; and predicting radio disturbance of the electric transmission line by using the network. The method is high in prediction precision, high in convergence and high in stability; the problem that the BP neural network is caught in a local minimum point is solved; and the method has a great guiding significance on prediction of radio disturbance of the electric transmission line and research on reduction of radio disturbance.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Trans-provincial power transmission cascade hydropower station group peak-shaving dispatching two-phase search method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of hydropower dispatching operation, and discloses a trans-provincial power transmission cascade hydropower station group peak-shaving dispatching two-phase search method. The characteristics of load complementation between receiving-end power grids can be fully utilized and different peak power demands of multiple receiving-end power grids can be taken into consideration to realize reasonable allocation of quality resources between the multiple power grids. The technical scheme is as follows: the trans-provincial power transmission cascade hydropower station group peak-shaving goal is realized in two phases according to the characteristics of the trans-provincial power transmission peak-shaving issue; in the optimization calculation process, load curves with great difference of a plurality of provincial power grids are reconstructed into an overall load by adoption of a load reconstruction strategy, and the hydropower station power output process is determined on the basis by adoption of a variable-scale optimization method; and then the allocation process of output power of the station between the receiving-end power grids is optimized by adoption of an exterior point search method, an initial solution is generated through successive load shedding, and the peak power sizes of the receiving-end power grids are corrected in an iterative mode by taking load level as heuristic information to meet the peak-shaving demands of the multiple power grids. Peak-shaving demands of multiple provincial power grids can be taken into consideration, and a peak-shaving result better than actual dispatching can be obtained. The method is feasible.

title_en: Urban track traffic risk chain group construction method based on multitiered network
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of urban track traffic risk chain group construction method based on multitiered network.This method includes：It determines urban track traffic risk point and risk accidents type, all risk points is constituted into risk point set, all risk accidents types are constituted into risk accidents collection；According to the connection relation between multitiered network theoretical definition risk point, the contextual definition in each layer network between each risk point is interior connection, and the connection relation between different layer network risk points is defined as outer connection；It determines that the logical relation between risk point, the logical relation include propagation relationship and correlativity, is connected to each risk point for having propagation relationship；By the last one risk point in the propagation relationship of connection and risk accidents type matching, risk chain group is formed.The present invention can global control risk accidents generating process, corresponding control measure can be taken on this basis, accident of reducing risks.

title_en: The risk analysis method and system of the concurrent cascading failure of power grid mountain fire disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of risk analysis method and systems of concurrent cascading failure of power grid mountain fire disaster, and the method comprising the steps of: according to mountain fire Monitoring and forecasting system in real-time as a result, calculating the mountain fire tripping probability of impacted transmission line of electricity and transmission line of electricity；According to the mountain fire of all impacted transmission lines of electricity tripping probability, building primary fault combination；Calculate the certainty cascading failure line set under primary fault combination；According to transmission line of electricity and its operation characteristic of protection element, on the basis of certainty cascading failure line set, the probability cascading failure line set of failure combination is generated；It is combined for each failure, calculates the power grid risk index under failure combination condition；According to power grid risk index, the degree of risk of every transmission line of electricity is calculated.The present invention can quickly obtain the concurrent cascading failure combination of power grid under mountain fire disaster, so that the degree of risk of every transmission line of electricity be calculated.
assignees: State grid hunan electric power co ltd;STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD DISASTER PREVENTION & MITIGATION CT;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: A kind of dual-active disaster recovery and backup systems with read and write abruption function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of dual-active disaster recovery and backup systems with read and write abruption function, including successively cascade network layer, application layer, data Layer, accumulation layer；The network layer provides the user channel for accessing operation system；The application layer passes through unified graphic interface all software and hardware resources states, the warning information Dynamic Display in unified interface in system；The data Layer includes two movable data centers, is used to carry out organization of unity management to business datum；The accumulation layer is for providing storage, synchronous, copy function.The system constructs the disaster recovery and backup systems of dual-active layer by layer using redundancy standby resources in strange land and primary data center in network layer, application layer, data Layer and accumulation layer, while utilizing read and write abruption cluster, realizes master/slave data center read and write abruption, mitigates primary data center load.
assignees: NARI TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CO;INFORMATION COMMUNICATION COMPANY OF STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Rural power grid transformation method based on cascade combination scoring
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rural power grid transformation method based on cascade combination scoring, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the following steps of combing the main problems existing in the current situation of the rural power grid, respectively defining corresponding single evaluation indexes, constructing a calculation formula matched with each evaluation index according to the actual operation rule and the internal development change rule of the rural power grid, carrying out grading treatment on the severity of each problem, setting the cascade evaluation standard of each evaluation index, and constructing an evaluation index system capable of fully reflecting the weak link and the severity of the rural power grid; determining equipment with modification requirements according to the index values, taking the equipment as an evaluation object, scoring the evaluation object according to the scoring standard of the evaluation indexes, determining the weight among all the evaluation indexes by adopting a CRITIC method, calculating the comprehensive score of the evaluation object, and finishing the graded combination score of the evaluation object; and performing descending order according to the size of the comprehensive scores, and preferentially modifying the equipment with the front ranking of the scores so as to realize the modification of the rural power grid.

title_en: Cascading failure risk assessment method based on network dependency relationship
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascading failure risk assessment method based on a network dependency relationship, which comprises the following steps: 1, constructing an electric power information physical system, improving conditions of network dependency relationship, 2, constructing a risk transfer function, forming an initial fault set of information nodes, 3, selecting an initial fault, wherein the fault is spread in a cross space between a power grid and an information network due to risk transfer, 4, selecting an initial fault line and a subsequent fault line of the power grid according to the risk transfer function, and if corresponding fault on-off information is uploaded to a dispatching center, the dispatching center issues a corresponding control command; if the information is not uploaded successfully, the dispatching center is not controlled, the protection and stabilization device traverses the initial fault set according to the system state action 5, the steps 3-4 are repeated until the end condition is met, the accident chain data are recorded, and the risk is calculated. According to the invention, on the basis of network dependence, the consideration on the transmission characteristics of the power grid and the information grid is added, so that the cross-space propagation process of the fault is researched, and theoretical guidance is provided for the prevention and control of the cascading faults of the power information physical system.

title_en: Power grid cascading failure prediction method based on Q learning network attack
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid cascading failure prediction method based on Q learning network attack, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of 1, constructing a network attack model, determining success probability of each attack path of the circuit breaker fault-free tripping attack, 2, constructing a cascading failure evolution model based on Q learning, training by using a Q learning algorithm, generating a Q value table to select an optimal network attack scheme, and screening out the attack paths generating higher risks. According to the method, on the basis of considering the success probability of the network attack, the Q learning algorithm is used for selecting the network attack path, so that the large-range calculation similar to the traversal algorithm can be avoided, the calculation time is greatly shortened, the workload and the completeness are well balanced, and theoretical guidance is provided for the prevention and control of the cascading failure of the power grid in a network attack scene.

title_en: Diesel generating set carbon emission quantitative calculation method based on BP neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quantitative calculation method for carbon emission of a diesel generator set based on a BP (back propagation) neural network, which aims to quantitatively calculate the carbon emission generated by different diesel generators burning different quality oil for power generation based on the BP neural network, and combines an online acquisition technology to realize quantitative dynamic calculation of the carbon emission of the diesel generator set and improve the calculation efficiency and accuracy; the invention provides a quantitative calculation method for carbon emission of a diesel generating set based on a BP neural network, which overcomes the technical problems that the carbon emission of the diesel generating set is difficult to calculate effectively, particularly the on-line dynamic calculation; the method has the advantages of simple flow, reasonable calculation model structure, BP neural network training calculation superposition, comprehensive calculation data quantity, clear intermediate structure meaning in the calculation process, strong practicability, contribution to use and popularization of carbon emission control calculation of the diesel generating set, contribution to mastering carbon emission rules of different types of diesel generating sets and support of carbon emission reduction of the diesel generating set.
assignees: LIYANG RESEARCH INSTITUTE SOUTHEAST UNIV;NANJING DONGBO SMART ENERGY RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Icing rate prediction method based on improved particle swarm back propagation neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to an icing rate prediction method based on an improved particle swarm back propagation neural network, which relates to the field of researches on ice disaster prevention strategies of power transmission lines, and comprises the steps of establishing an icing growth mechanism model of the power transmission lines in a low-temperature rain and snow freezing environment; the method comprises the steps of changing environmental parameters through numerical simulation, performing multi-factor analysis by using an icing growth mechanism model to obtain icing working condition data of multiple scenes, multiple moments, multiple weather, multiple terrains and the like, using 4 environmental characteristic values of liquid water content, environmental temperature, water drop diameter and wind speed in air as input values of a network, using the icing rate of a power transmission line as output quantity of the network, constructing a BPNN prediction model, and optimizing the weight and threshold of the BPNN by using IPSO (internet protocol security) to realize accurate prediction of the icing rate of the power transmission line. The method is simple and feasible, the algorithm optimizing speed is high, the model predicting accuracy is high, and a reference is provided for the icing predicting and early warning work of the power transmission line.
assignees: UNIV NORTHEAST FORESTRY;ECONOMIC RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;SHENYANG INST ENGINEERING;UNIV SOUTHEAST

title_en: New energy offline risk assessment method and device for direct-current layered access system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a new energy off-grid risk assessment method and device of a direct-current layered access system, belonging to the technical field of power system control, wherein the method comprises the steps of enabling all alternating-current systems, loads and new energy units in a receiving-end power grid to be equivalent to voltage sources with impedance; substituting the power signal and the equivalent voltage source parameter into a receiving end power grid voltage expression of the direct current layered access system to calculate a first transient low voltage of a receiving end converter bus, so as to calculate a first evaluation index of the new energy off-grid risk and determine whether the system has new energy low on-off grid. According to the invention, based on the power coupling relation of alternating current-direct current-new energy sources in the receiving end power grid, the transient voltage of the receiving end converter bus is calculated under the condition of direct current blocking so as to obtain the evaluation index of the new energy source off-grid risk, meanwhile, the possible new energy source off-grid risk of the system after the occurrence of the direct current blocking is evaluated based on the causal relation among the cascading failures, and the strong impact of the direct current blocking on the alternating current-direct current-new energy source system is disclosed.
assignees: STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV HUAZHONG SCIENCE TECH

title_en: Smart grid fault prediction method, system and equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system and equipment for predicting faults of a smart power grid, and relates to the technical field of power grid fault prediction. Performing operation fault analysis to generate a fault feature vector group, performing migration learning to generate a fault probability distribution matrix, performing fault risk analysis according to the fault probability distribution matrix, dividing a plurality of risk classes, and performing propagation path simulation of a target intelligent power grid on the plurality of fault early warning signals to generate a fault prediction report. The intelligent power grid fault prediction method and the intelligent power grid fault prediction device solve the technical problems of low prediction precision and poor timeliness caused by the fact that intelligent power grid fault prediction lag and fault propagation path simulation inaccuracy in the prior art, achieve accurate prediction and risk early warning of intelligent power grid faults, and improve the timeliness and accuracy of fault prediction.
assignees: STATE POWER TECH ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Method and apparatus for analyzing radio wave environment in a wireless communication system
title_ko: 무선 통신 시스템에서 시뮬레이터의 전파환경 분석 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for analyzing a radio wave environment of a simulator in a wireless communication system. The method comprises: a step of allowing a simulator to receive geographic information and location information in which a transmitter and a receiver can be located within the geographic information; a step of generating radio waves for at least one direction of a sphere having a consistent radius from the transmitter of the simulator located in a random location according to the location information; a step of grouping the radio waves into at least one group based on the moving path of the generated radio waves; a step of setting each group as a calculation unit (warp/wavefront) for a graphics processing unit (GPU); and a step of analyzing the radio wave environment by using the GPU in which the calculation unit is set. Therefore, the method can allow a simulator to analyze the radio wave environment by improving performance of 5G wireless communication network simulation using a GPU.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 무선통신 시스템에서 시뮬레이터의 전파환경 분석 방법에 대한 것으로서, 본 발명의 방법은 시뮬레이터가 지형 정보, 및 상기 지형 정보 내에서 송신기와 수신기가 위치할 수 있는 위치 정보를 수신하는 단계, 상기 위치 정보에 따른 임의의 위치에 배치된 시뮬레이터의 송신기로부터 반지름이 일정한 구의 적어도 하나의 방향에 대한 전파들을 생성하는 단계, 상기 생성된 전파들의 이동 경로에 기반하여 적어도 하나의 그룹으로 그룹화 하는 단계, 상기 각 그룹을 GPU(Graphics Processing Unit)에 대한 연산 유닛(Warp/Wavefront)으로 설정하는 단계 및 상기 연산 유닛이 설정된 상기 GPU를 이용하여 전파환경을 분석하는 단계를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: SAMSUNG ELECTRONICS CO LTD;UNIV YONSEI IACF

title_en: Portable IoT Sensor Kit for Smart Safety with Wireless Mesh and Artificial Intelligence
title_ko: 무선메쉬와 AI를 이용한 휴대가능한 지능형 화재예측 IoT센서 키트
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a configuration of a device and an artificial intelligence program related to a portable intelligent IoT sensor kit for fire prediction using wireless mesh and AI. Since the reliability of sensor data is very important for an IoT smart sensor used in a fire disaster site, it is safe to construct a wireless mesh sensor network with enhanced connectivity between sensor nodes to increase the reliability of sensor data transmission.
abstract_ko:
국가적으로 큰 문제가 되고 있는 공공 및 민간 다중이용시설 (재래시장, 상가/쇼핑몰, 병원/요양원, 위락시설-극장, 실내놀이시설 등)에서의 화재발생과 유독가스 등의 누출시 발생 할 수 있는 대량 인명손실과 천문학적인 사회적 기회비용의 손해가 빈번히 발생하고 있는데, 이러한 화재 및 가스누출사고 발생시 즉각적인 감지하고 징후를 판단하여 화재 확산의 예측이 가능하여 관련자 및 관련기관에 자동적으로 경보하고 전파하여 인명의 조기구조나 재산손실을 미연에 방지하기 위한 골든 타임을 확보 할 수 있도록 도와주는 (1) 경제적으로 보급이 가능하고  (2)구성 및 운용이 쉬우며 (3)휴대 또는 이동 하여 일반 초보자도 간편하게 사용 할 수 있는 화재 및 가스누출 등의 재난 방재와 사회안전 편익에 도움을 주는 “무선메쉬와 AI를 이용한 휴대가능한 지능형 화재예측 IoT센서 키트”에 관한 장치의 구성과  인공지능 프로그램에 관한 것이다 
      화재 재난현장에서 사용되는 사물인터넷(IoT) 스마트 센서는 센서데이터의 신뢰성이 매우 중요하기 때문에 센서데이타의 전송 신뢰도를 향상하기 위하여 센서 노드간에 연결성이 강화된 무선메쉬 센서네트워크를 구성하는 것이 안전하다. 
      아래 대표도 에서 보는 바와 같이, 센서노드는 전원이 인가되는 즉시 인접한 모든 센서노드와 무선메쉬네트워크를 통하여 센서노드 자신의 기기정보와 측정값 등을 모든 센서노드 및 지능형 접속노드에 저전력으로 즉각 전달 가능한 센서네트워크을 구성한다. 
      센서네트워크가 구성되면, 센서노드는 측정한 센서데이터를 종류에 따라서 일정주기 또는 데이터 발생 즉시 다른 센서노드를 통하거나 직접 지능형 접속노드에 전송한다. 
      지능형 접속노드는 센서노드가 전달한 모든 센서데이터를 수신하여 제어부의 데이터베이스에 저장하고 백엔드시스템에 전송한다. 제어부는 데이터베이스에서 센서, 위치 및 노드 정보 데이터를 통하여 화재예측 및 발생 판단을 위한 인공지능 알고리즘을 생성 및 수정한다. 
      지능형 접속노드에서 생성되는 인공지능 알고리즘(216) 및 백엔드시스템에서 생성되는 인공지능 알고리즘은 시간별, 센서별, 종류별 측정 데이터를 기준으로 각 센서의 오차 및 화재 발생 여부를 판단한다. 
     만일 인공지능 알고리즘이 화재 발생 상황이 일어났다고 판단한 경우, 지능형 접속노드(200)는 제어부를 통해 자동경보프로그램에 화재경보를 전달하며 자동경보프로그램은 관리자 등 관련자, 소방서 등 관련부처, 필요한 경우 미리 등록해둔 지자체에 화재 발생 사실과 해당 지능형 접속노드의 실제 위치정보를 전파한다. 
     센서데이타에 의해 화재 감지와 분석, 예측이 가능하기 때문에 센서데이터 오류를 제거하여, 보정하고 정확한 데이터를축적하여, 최적의 예측 알고리즘을 생성하여 활용한다. 
    센서데이타의 유형과 패턴에 따라 보다 정확한 분석을 위해 충분한 데이터를 확보하기 위하여 여 센서노드의 데이터 전송주기와 센서에서 측정되는 센서데이터 수치정보를 증가하여 전송하게하므로서 보다 밀도 있는 시계열 분석이 되도록 하여, 단기간내에 모든 데이터를 수집 분석하여  정확한 시나리오를 예측하고 이에 따른 경보 수준을 판단 한다. 
화재, 가스누출 등의 재난 방재 목적 이외에, 산업현장의 위험작업장, 예를 들면 유해가스 지역의 환경정보 감지 및 알람, 유류저장소, 원전과 같은 방사능 누출 지역, 고로, 사일로 등과 같은 시설파괴시 재해가 예상되는 장소나 기관의 구조물 등에도 간편하게 사용 할 수 있으며, 사회안전을 위한 공공SCO, 예를들면 교량, 도로, SOC구조물 등에서도 사용 할 수 있다.

title_en: Thermal stability key power transmission channel identification method based on power flow transfer ratio
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for identifying a thermal stability key power transmission channel based on a power flow transfer ratio, and belongs to the technical field of power systems and automation thereof. The method carries out fault screening on the expected fault set by judging the load rate of the monitoring element after the fault and the load rate of the fault element before the fault; calculating the power flow transfer ratio of the monitoring element after the fault in the key fault set, screening main power flow transfer elements according to the power flow transfer ratio threshold value, and further considering the cascade relation of the elements and the limitation of the total transfer ratio threshold value to determine the main power flow transfer elements; and combining the main power flow transfer element with the critical fault and the fault element to form a candidate critical power transmission channel, estimating the thermal stability limit power of the power transmission channel based on the power flow transfer ratio, and determining the critical power transmission channel in the candidate set through the thermal stability limit power margin. The invention can meet the requirement of recognizing the thermal stability key transmission channel for online safety monitoring by considering the expected fault scene under the current operation condition of the power grid.

title_en: Aviation network delay propagation model based on SIS and establishment method
abstract_en: The invention provides an aviation network delay propagation model based on SIS, which is characterized in that an airport network is established by taking airports as nodes and taking flight flows among the airports as edges; constructing historical values, and counting the states of the research targets in the same environment; obtaining normal node proportion SI (t), delay node proportion IS (t), delay source node proportion IA (t) and delay propagation probability PS  i,t  Delay dissipation probability PI  i,t  Delay spontaneous probability PA  i,t  Delay statistical probability Nc  i,t  Delay factor Therefore, an aviation network delay propagation model is constructed, the propagation condition of delay in the whole network is taken as a research object, the influence among airport delays and the characteristics of the airport network are analyzed from a more macroscopic view, and reference is provided for solving the airport delay problem.

title_en: Comprehensive energy system dispatching management platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive energy system dispatching management platform. The disclosed platform includes: the system comprises a demand configuration module, a data acquisition module, an operation calculation module and a scheduling management module, wherein the demand configuration module is used for a user to select an energy supply side system configuration mode, energy equipment and an optimization target according to demands; the data acquisition module is used for acquiring system operation data time by time within a certain total time length; the scheduling management module is used for receiving the operation data acquired by the data acquisition module and sending the operation data to the model calculation module; meanwhile, the system is used for receiving result data of the operation calculation module and outputting the result data to the corresponding upper-layer energy network and energy equipment to adjust the operation condition; and the operation calculation module is used for calculating the result of the optimization target selected by the demand configuration module on the premise of constraint conditions. The invention can realize the cascade utilization of energy in the comprehensive energy system, improve the energy utilization rate and is suitable for supplying energy to areas such as commercial areas, residential areas, industrial parks, villages and the like.

title_en: Commercial district passenger flow prediction method based on graph neural network
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and mainly relates to a business district passenger flow prediction method based on a graph neural network, which aims to solve the problems that the prior art cannot dynamically describe the propagation of passenger flow in a complex junction, lacks multi-source real-time data deep fusion, is difficult to adapt to real-time control in model structure solidification, and lacks closed-loop decision support from prediction to intervention; the invention integrates four real-time data of passenger flow, traffic, commercial activities and external environment by constructing a dynamic adjustable business district physical network, and fuses multi-source characteristics for network nodes; further, combining a graph neural network with time sequence modeling, and dynamically learning passenger flow rules among nodes; finally, conducting diversion scheme simulation and comparison based on a prediction result to form a decision closed loop of 'perception-prediction-simulation-intervention'; the method has the dynamic adaptation and real-time response capability, and realizes the transition from passive early warning to active dispatching optimization.

title_en: Method and device for using drive test data for propagation model revision
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for applying drive test data to the propagation model tuning, which comprises: step 1, obtaining the original drive test data; step 2, selecting the data satisfying the preset conditions, as valid drive test data, from the original drive test data; step 3, extracting the valid drive test data to form a data file for the propagation model tuning. The invention also provides a device for applying drive test data to the propagation model tuning, which comprises a drive test data acquisition module adapted to obtain the drive test data from a region to be tuned; a valid drive test data generation module adapted to generate valid drive test data from the drive test data based on the preset conditions; and a data file generation module adapted to extract the valid drive test data to generate a data file for the propagation model tuning. Based on the test data of the existing network, the invention can greatly reduce the test operation of CW, save the cost of network construction, and ensure that the tuned model can accurately show the local propagation characteristics, thereby optimizing the configuration of base station.

title_en: Multilayer forest fire prevention center
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multilayer forest fire prevention center. The multilayer forest fire prevention center comprises an alarm, multiple bottom-layer monitoring centers, a remote monitoring system, a top-layer monitoring center and multiple intermediate-layer monitoring centers, wherein the top-layer monitoring center is provided with a top-layer alarm server, a cascade server and a top-layer network switch cabinet which are successively interconnected; the intermediate-layer monitoring centers comprise intermediate-layer alarm servers and intermediate-layer network switches; the intermediate-layer alarm servers are connected with the intermediate-layer network switches; the intermediate-layer network switches are interconnected with the top-layer network switch cabinet; the bottom-layer monitoring centers comprise video control servers, bottom-layer alarm servers and bottom-layer network switches; the remote monitoring system is connected with the bottom-layer network switches through a network; the bottom-layer network switches, the video control servers and the bottom-layer alarm servers are successively interconnected; the alarm is connected with the bottom-layer alarm servers; and the bottom-layer network switches are in redundancy connection with the intermediate-layer network switches. The multilayer forest fire prevention center has the advantages of scientific decision-making, high response capability and high operation efficiency.
assignees: CHENGDU JINGLIN ELECTRONIC TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Method for analyzing reliability of transformer based on service year and load level
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a method for analyzing reliability of a transformer based on service year and load level, comprising the following steps: (1) determining load levels of transformers; (2) determining load values of the transformers in an original state; (3) obtaining hot-spot temperatures of the transformers; (4) obtaining insulation lives of the transformers according to the hot-spot temperatures of the transformers; (5) obtaining a failure probability cumulative distribution function of the transformers; (6) obtaining an average failure rate index of the transformers in the original state and an average failure rate index of the transformers in a failure state; (7) obtaining a cascading failure starting probability index Pic and a cascading failure weak link indicatrix Pvc, and identifying the transformers in a critical state in a system by sorting of the Pic and the Pvc. The method provided by the present invention improves accuracy of analysis for the reliability of the transformers in the case of cascading failure by combining influences of self structures, functions, service years of the transformers and a coupling relation between the transformers in a regional power grid on equipment reliability.
assignees: CENTRAL CHINA GRID CO LTD;UNIV HUAZHONG SCIENCE TECH

title_en: Subway passenger flow regulation and control plan compilation method based on demand evolution and flow propagation
abstract_en: The invention provides a subway passenger flow regulation and control plan compiling method based on demand evolution and flow propagation, which comprises the following steps of: fusing multi-source automatic fare collection data, and extracting distribution characteristics of current commuting travel demands; according to the utility perception principle of the commuter on the passenger flow regulation and control measures, constructing a commuter departure time adjustment and trip mode transfer behavior NL model, embedding the NL model into a random user balanced distribution model, and predicting demand evolution characteristics under the passenger flow regulation and control measures; constructing a flow propagation model covering the whole travel link, and calculating the net transport energy utilization rate and the passenger delay balance degree under passenger flow regulation and control measures by using the flow propagation model and the demand evolution characteristics; and constructing a subway line network passenger flow regulation plan double-layer planning model, and outputting an optimal passenger flow regulation plan with balanced transportation energy utilization and delay balance. According to the invention, the influence mechanism of the passenger flow regulation and control measures on the individual behaviors of the commuters is revealed through big data, so that the accurate control of the controlled group scale and the regulation and control effect is realized.

title_en: Disaster condition indication for serving PLMN
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a new mechanism involving a network node (100) and a client device (300) for indicating that a serving PLMN (610) is in a disaster situation. The network node informs the client device that the serving PLMN of the client device is in a disaster situation through control signaling (510). Thus, the client device may take appropriate measures to avoid service disruption, e.g., by initiating a PLMN selection procedure to register at a visited PLMN (620) that is not in a catastrophic condition. Examples of control signaling that may be used in this context are SIB, NAS, RRC messages or paging messages. Furthermore, the invention relates to a corresponding method and computer program.

title_en: Modeling, calibrating and simulating method and system for photoresist multistage serial characterization network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a modeling, calibrating and simulating method and system for a photoresist multistage serial characterization network, and belongs to the field of semiconductor lithography. The method comprises the steps of dividing a photoresist reaction process into a plurality of key stages, adopting a new modeling idea of a multi-stage series system network, constructing a multi-stage series wiener-Padd form sub-cascade module according to the characteristics of each photoetching process, providing a simulation means based on library matching and model parameter low-order multivariable polynomial equivalence by using a joint calibration strategy based on a constraint quadratic convex optimization algorithm, emphasizing and utilizing the universality advantage of the wiener-Padd system theory in nonlinear system response characteristic characterization, avoiding overfitting, reducing model complexity and redundancy, and realizing accurate and efficient modeling and calibration of the nonlinear response characteristics of complicated physics, optics and chemical heights of the photoresist under different process flows.
assignees: WUHAN YUWEI OPTICAL SOFTWARE CO LTD

title_en: Risk propagation pattern graph-based contact network part association characteristic analysis method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a contact net part association characteristic analysis method based on a risk propagation pattern diagram, which specifically comprises the following steps: acquiring historical fault associated data of contact net parts; defining a simultaneous fault incidence relation and a time sequence fault incidence relation; constructing a risk coefficient model of the fault association relationship; constructing a virtual path, acquiring a virtual path set between two parts, and acquiring a shortest virtual path set according to a reduction rule; mapping the set of shortest virtual paths into a risk association graph; defining the risk coefficient weight of each virtual path in the risk correlation diagram; constructing a risk propagation pattern diagram taking any fault part as a starting point, and evaluating risk levels of each fault association relation; the invention can evaluate the risk degree of the known fault association relationship and the risk degree of the potential fault association relationship, can reveal the association characteristics among the contact net parts under different time scales and provides decision basis for preventing occurrence of cascading faults.

title_en: Urban flood cascade composite disaster event network construction and evaluation method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for constructing and evaluating an urban flood cascade composite disaster event network, comprising the steps of acquiring a plurality of initial urban flood disaster text data, preprocessing the initial urban flood disaster text data, and determining a plurality of target urban flood disaster text data; carrying out causal relation extraction on flood disaster text data of each target city to generate a plurality of dominant event text data and a plurality of obvious hidden event text data; analyzing the text data of each dominant event and the text data of each explicit and implicit event, and carrying out event fusion to determine a plurality of target event text data; constructing a target city flood cascade composite disaster event network according to the text data of each target event; evaluating the target urban flood cascade composite disaster event network to generate urban flood disaster evaluation data; the method solves the technical problem that the conventional urban flood network construction and risk assessment technology is difficult to comprehensively and effectively assess the risk brought by urban flood disasters.

title_en: Chained risk propagation quantification method for water resource system, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a chained risk propagation quantification method of a water resource system, electronic equipment and a storage medium. Firstly, identifying causal relation of the related elements; then, collecting causal relations among the partition associated elements to form a subunit network, integrating each subunit network through hydraulic links among the areas to form a watershed water resource system risk multilink network, calculating the degree and the betweenness centrality of each node, and defining a risk propagation mechanism: a starting stage: calculating importance level, safety bearing threshold, risk sensitivity and initial load of the nodes according to node characteristics calculated by the risk multilink network; propagation phase: calculating probability of risk propagation by using node network characteristics, and calculating propagation load; the regression phase: defining a fading coefficient to reduce node load; the slave nodes, links and networks analyze the change condition of risks in the propagation process. And finally, providing a risk prevention and control strategy through node characteristics in the network. The invention can perfect the risk analysis technology of the water resource system under complex conditions.

title_en: Power load prediction method and system based on weather prediction model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power load prediction method and a power load prediction system based on a weather prediction model, and relates to the technical field of load prediction, comprising the following steps of acquiring historical power load data and corresponding multidimensional weather data, constructing a weather coupling effect analysis model, and calculating a dynamic coupling weight matrix among weather parameters through an attention mechanism network; the method comprises the steps of carrying out feature fusion on a coupling weight matrix and multidimensional meteorological data through a gating circulation unit to generate space-time coupling feature vectors, establishing an electric load prediction model, extracting short-term fluctuation features and long-term trend features of the electric load from the space-time coupling feature vectors based on a depth residual error network architecture and a parallel convolution channel, updating a dynamic coupling weight matrix based on prediction error back propagation, and realizing self-adaptive adjustment of meteorological parameter coupling relations. According to the invention, the dynamic fusion of the space-time characteristics is realized through the cross gating unit, so that the model can simultaneously utilize the space-time information to predict the power load, and the prediction precision is improved.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Gas pipe network defect hidden danger assessment method, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gas pipe network defect hidden danger risk assessment method, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of hidden danger risk assessment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: step 1, gas pipe network early warning information acquisition, step 2, gas pipe network threat analysis, step 3, gas pipe network gas interruption processing and step 4, gas pipe network post-disaster test processing, the invention analyzes the influence of earthquake waves on a gas pipe by considering not only the damage of environmental data on the gas pipe but also the propagation direction of the earthquake waves and the installation direction of the gas pipe during an earthquake, the method and the device screen the gas-cutting off gas pipelines of each section of the urban gas pipe network, so that the judgment accuracy is improved, the possibility of gas leakage is reduced, the gas ventilation test is performed in advance before the gas supply is carried out again, and the problem of whether the gas-cutting off gas pipelines of each section of the urban gas pipe network leak gas is judged, so that the safety of the gas pipelines is improved.

title_en: Reverse variation network modeling method driven by assembly line performance change requirement
abstract_en: The invention aims to provide an assembly line performance change demand driven reverse deformation network modeling method which comprises the steps of constructing a five-dimensional association model matched with an assembly line to be changed, establishing mapping and constraint relations among dimension elements, identifying key assembly links and change transfer mechanisms, constructing a dynamic feedback model among assembly process parameters, production line configuration parameters and assembly line performance, obtaining topology indexes of any node in a network corresponding to the five-dimensional association model, quantifying propagation risks from an initial node to a potential influence range, establishing an optimization function, solving the optimization function, outputting a set of optimal solution sets, and enabling any solution in the optimal solution sets to represent an optimal change strategy among risks, time and cost. The present disclosure can improve production efficiency, reduce operating costs, and enhance market competitiveness.

title_en: Risk early warning method and system based on power service sensitive event
abstract_en: The invention discloses a risk early warning method and system based on an electric power service sensitive event, which belong to the technical field of deep learning and comprise the steps of obtaining customer service voice texts, work order data and weather early warning information, constructing a heterogeneous space-time diagram comprising power distribution equipment and electric power users, inputting the heterogeneous space-time diagram into a graph neural network model to obtain event propagation path probability distribution and potential source nodes, generating an early warning work order based on the event propagation path probability distribution and a preset sensitive word stock, generating a supervision work order according to the early warning work order triggering supervision flow, configuring elink message sending rules, sending elink messages to appointed responsible personnel, feeding back supervision processing results and updating model parameters. The invention realizes the spanning type upgrade from passive disposal to active prevention and control, from experience judgment to data intelligence and from single-point analysis to system management, and has obvious technical advancement, management practicability and engineering popularization value.

title_en: Micro-grid group cooperative scheduling method based on master-slave strategy
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power system dispatching, in particular to a micro-grid group collaborative dispatching method based on a master-slave strategy, which comprises an upper-layer uncertainty propagation simulator and a plurality of lower-layer local robust optimizers. The upper simulator collects real-time uncertainty source data and network topology, generates a collaboration Lu Bangyu through simulating an uncertainty propagation path, and sends the collaboration Lu Bangyu to the lower layer as a probability constraint. And the lower-layer optimizer executes local cost minimization optimization under constraint and reports the operation point and the uncertainty index. The upper layer calculates the overall collaborative entropy, and expands the robust domain through a feedback mechanism to maximize the benefit if the overall collaborative entropy is lower than the threshold, and reduces the risk if the overall collaborative entropy is higher than the threshold. And the iterative process adjusts domain boundary parameters by using a gradient algorithm until convergence or a scheduling period is finished, so that the micro-grid group robust cooperative scheduling is realized. The invention dynamically maximizes the cooperative operation benefit and the robust potential of the micro-grid group on the premise of ensuring the global stability of the system.
assignees: DAZHOU POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Transport path optimization method and device considering port cascade failure risk
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transportation path optimization method and device considering port cascade failure risk, and belongs to the technical field of port logistics and transportation network optimization. Aiming at the problems of insufficient consideration of systematic risk of a port and easy initiation of chain reaction due to single-point failure in the conventional transportation path planning, the invention provides a comprehensive evaluation and optimization mechanism, which characterizes a port transportation network by constructing a weighted directed graph model, integrates port bearing capacity, historical failure probability and multidimensional external risk factors, and realizes quantitative measurement and calculation of port cascade failure risk. On the basis, a multi-objective optimization function is designed, the minimum product of time and cost is taken as an optimization target, meanwhile, the minimum probability of failure risk of the whole path is restrained, and the optimal transportation path is solved by utilizing algorithms such as gradient descent and the like. By dynamically adjusting traffic distribution, high risk nodes are effectively avoided, and network robustness and transportation reliability are improved. The method can be widely applied to the scenes of international maritime transportation, container scheduling and the like, obviously reduces the transportation cost and the interruption risk, and enhances the capability of coping with emergency events.
assignees: INST GEOGRAPHIC SCIENCES & NATURAL RESOURCES RES CAS

title_en: Power grid safety emergency early warning method and system based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid safety emergency early warning method and system based on multi-source data fusion, which relate to the technical field of power grid public opinion monitoring, the invention screens out each public opinion transmission node of each power construction area by setting the netizen inclusion degree and the public opinion influence level of each power construction area, monitors and evaluates the transmission influence condition of each public opinion transmission node to obtain the public opinion monitoring result of each power construction area, and executing a corresponding public opinion safety emergency early warning scheme, accurately locking key nodes, avoiding the resource waste of generalized monitoring, improving the monitoring efficiency, and tracking the emotion change track of the netizens generating interactive behaviors in public opinion propagation according to the public opinion guiding effect, so as to judge the actual condition of public opinion guiding, effectively identify potential public opinion risks, and make a response strategy with strong pertinence and high efficiency when public opinion occurs, thereby effectively maintaining enterprise images.
assignees: LIAONING POWER ENERGY DEV GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Grid-connected scheduling management method, device, equipment and medium constructed by combining knowledge graph
abstract_en: The application relates to a grid-connected scheduling management method, device, equipment and medium constructed by combining a knowledge graph. The method comprises the steps of constructing a comprehensive data set by integrating multi-source data such as new energy output, power grid topology, load, weather and historical fault records, forming a dynamic knowledge graph by utilizing entity identification and relation extraction technology, constructing a probability causal graph model by extracting causal paths and adding probability parameters, quantifying uncertainty propagation strength by combining a time sequence graph neural network, calculating risk index conditional probability by adopting probability causal reasoning based on the propagation model, simulating a fault propagation sequence by cascading failure theory to realize multi-level risk assessment, generating a self-adaptive scheduling strategy by relying on a multi-objective optimization model and deep reinforcement learning, realizing complete technical closed loop from data fusion, causal reasoning to intelligent decision, and achieving the technical effects of describing the new energy uncertainty propagation path, assessing the power grid risk situation by looking ahead, and dynamically generating an optimal grid-connected scheduling scheme.
assignees: TONGLIAO POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID EAST INNER MONGOLIA ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;STATE GRID NARI NANJING CONTROL SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent trade compliance early warning system based on cross-border supply chain state risk assessment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent trade compliance early warning system based on cross-border supply chain state risk assessment, which comprises a multi-source data acquisition module, a data semantic analysis and standardization module, a supply chain graph modeling module, a multi-dimensional risk index construction module, a graph neural network situation modeling module, a time sequence abnormality detection module and a compliance early warning and strategy linkage module.
