According to the invention, by fusing multi-national customs policies, real-time logistics states and multi-source heterogeneous data of geopolitical events, a cross-border supply chain topological graph is constructed, and dynamic propagation modeling and prospective recognition of compliance risks are realized based on a graph neural network and time sequence anomaly detection, so that multi-national policy differences and superposition effects thereof can be uniformly described, early warning can be carried out on policy mutation and sanction diffusion non-stationary risks, and the real-time performance, accuracy and overall prevention and control capability of cross-border trade compliance management are remarkably improved.
assignees: HONGQIAO HIGH TECH GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Out of order vehicle precise location tracing system, location tracing server, location tracing terminal and program recording medium
title_ko: 고장 발생 차량 정밀 위치추적 시스템과 위치추적 서버 및위치추적 단말과 이를 위한 기록매체
abstract_en: A system for tracking location information of a disabled car is provided to send the location information and status information of the car to an emergency server in a designated repair shop by receiving RCM data(or ECM data) from a tracking location information terminal attached on the car. A location tracking terminal, attached on a car, includes a location tracking frequency transmitting module transmitting a homing signal, receiving FCM(Forward Channel Message) for TDOA(Time Difference Of Arrival) base radio determination, transmits ground wave LBS base RCM(Reverse Channel Message). A base station transmits the FCM to the location tracking terminal and receives the RCM or ECM from the location tracking terminal. A server evaluates location information of the location tracking terminal after receiving the RCM data(or ECM data) from the base stations, at list three, through a communication network, confirms that the received the RCM data(or ECM data) includes disorder mode information of the car, and transmits the evaluated location information and the disorder mode information of the car to an emergency server.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 고장 발생 차량 정밀 위치추적 시스템과 위치추적 서버 및 위치추적 단말과 이를 위한 기록매체에 관한 것으로서, 본 발명에 따른 고장 발생 차량 정밀 위치추적 시스템은, 소정의 위치추적 대상 차량에 탑재되며, TDOA(Time Difference Of Arrival) 기반 무선측위를 위한 FCM(Forward Channel Message)을 수신하고, 상기 차량에 이상 발생시, 소정의 차량이상 발생 모드 정보와 차량이상 발생 정보를 적어도 하나 이상 포함하는 지상파 엘비에스 기반 RCM(Reverse Channel Message)을 송출하거나, 또는 지상파 엘비에스 기반 ECM(Emergency Channel Message)을 송출하고, 근거리에 위치한 소정의 위치추적 전파 수신장치로 적어도 하나 이상의 호밍신호를 송출하는 위치추적 전파 송출모듈을 구비한 위치추적 단말과, 상기 위치추적 단말로 소정의 FCM을 송출하고, 상기 위치추적 단말로부터 소정의 RCM 또는 ECM을 수신하는 기지국 및 소정의 통신망을 통해 상기 적어도 3개 이상의 기지국으로부터 상기 RCM 데이터(또는 ECM 데이터)를 수신하여 상기 위치추적 단말의 위치정보를 산출하고, 상기 수신된 상기 RCM 데이터(또는 ECM 데이터)에 상기 차량이상 발생 모드 정보가 포함되어 있는지 확인하고, 상기 차량이상 발생 확인시, 상기 산출된 위치정보와 차량이상 발생 차량 정보를 소정의 정비소(또는 카센터)에 구비된 긴급구조 서버로 전송하는 서버를 포함하여 구성된다.

title_en: Method for predicting water demand using group method of data handling algorithm
title_ko: 지엠디에이치 알고리즘을 이용한 물수요 예측방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A method for predicting a water demand using a GMDH(Group Method of Data Handling) algorithm is provided to calculate optimum prediction demand amount through the GMDH algorithm, thereby accomplishing precision goal of output prediction. CONSTITUTION: A water operating system drives an intelligent model of water demand prediction. Demand prediction software is connected through a LAN network such as host computer of the water system and database and other related systems. The demand prediction software established a demand prediction GDMH model through a back-propagation learning algorithm according to an operation data of the water operating system and a data of forecast DB. A predicted demand is determined to current demand and forecast state through model-based prediction control algorithm from the intelligent model.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 통상의 물 수요 예측 방법에 있어서, 수운영 시스템에서 수요변동, 기상여건, 계절별 요인 등에 의하여 통상적인 변동사항을 반영하여 취수장, 정수장 및 가압장을 합리적으로 연계 운영함으로서 안정된 공급량을 확보하기 위해 지엠디에이치 알고리즘을 활용한 물 수요예측의 지능형 모델을 구축하는 단계, 지능형 모델을 토대로 지엠디에이치 모델기반 예측제어 기법을 활용하여 예측대상의 물수요를 산출하는 수요예측 소프트웨어를 상위 컴퓨터에 구성하는 단계, 수운영 시스템의 호스트 컴퓨터, 기상정보를 가지고 있는 데이터베이스 등과 LAN 네트워크를 통해 연결하는 단계, 수요예측 소프트웨어는 시스템으로부터 수집된 운영 데이터, 기상 DB의 데이터를 토대로 역전파 학습 알고리즘을 이용하여 수요예측 지엠디에이치 모델을 구축하는 단계 및 지능형 모델로부터 지엠디에이치 모델기반 예측제어 알고리즘을 이용하여 현재의 수요 및 기상 상태에서의 예측 수요량을 결정하는 단계로 이루어진 것을 특징으로 하는 지엠디에이치 알고리즘을 이용한 물수요 예측방법을 제공한다. 
       
     물수요 예측방법, 수운영 시스템, 지엠디에이치 알고리즘

title_en: System, method and program for building and managing a network of underground communal areas in preparation for disaster situations
title_ko: 재난상황을 대비한 지하공동구의 네트워크 구축 및 관리 시스템, 방법 및 프로그램
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a network construction and management system for an underground common duct in preparation for a disaster situation, and provides an effect of providing a network construction and management system capable of determining an optimized wi-fi connection device separation distance, installation location, and channel in the underground common duct based on a pre-irradiation result of a radio wave environment of the underground common duct.
abstract_ko: 본 개시는 재난상황을 대비한 지하공동구의 네트워크 구축 및 관리 시스템에 관한 것으로, 지하공동구의 전파환경 사전조사 결과를 기반으로, 해당 지하공동구에 최적화된 와이파이 연결장치 이격 거리, 설치 위치, 채널을 결정할 수 있는 네트워크 구축 및 관리 시스템을 제공하는 효과를 제공한다.
assignees: CYBERTELBRIDGE CO LTD;ELECTRONICS & TELECOMMUNICATIONS RES INST

title_en: Fault detection early warning method and system for new energy charging pile
abstract_en: The application provides a fault detection and early warning method and a system for a new energy charging pile, which relate to the technical field of fault testing, and the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a charging pile distribution network of a target management area; determining a fault cascade network; a supervision training fault detection module; determining preliminary detection data; if the preliminary detection data is abnormal, performing fault decision and tracing analysis to determine a fault detection result; and transmitting the fault detection result to a charging pile management system for fault visual early warning and operation and maintenance management. The application can solve the technical problem of inaccurate fault detection result caused by the mutual influence and the expansion of the fault range in the prior art, and constructs a fault cascade network by carrying out the multi-element association analysis and the visual compatible analysis of the faults, and combines the charging pile distribution network and the fault cascade network to carry out fault detection early warning, thereby achieving the technical effects of improving the accuracy and the comprehensiveness of fault detection.

title_en: Power distribution information physical risk assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a risk assessment method and a risk assessment system for distribution information physics, which relate to the technical field of distribution information physics system researches and comprise a comprehensive assessment method for defining information system risks and physical system risks, wherein potential threats of information flow interruption or tampering to safe operation of a distribution network are assessed, an evolution mechanism of cross-space cascading failures is revealed, validity under different attack scenes is verified through example simulation, and risk assessment of distribution information physics is completed. The method and the system can effectively quantify the cross-space propagation influence of the faults of the information system on the physical system, accurately evaluate the comprehensive risk level of the information system, the physical system and the information physical system, remarkably improve the accuracy and efficiency of risk evaluation, not only can identify high-risk nodes, but also can quantify the propagation mechanism of the cascading faults, and provide reliable support for the safe operation and planning design of the distribution information physical system, thereby improving the reliability and toughness of the distribution network.

title_en: Geological disaster risk intelligent pre-judging method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent pre-judging method for geological disaster risk based on deep learning, which relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and early warning, and can automatically perform high-precision alignment and feature extraction on monitoring data with different time-space resolutions such as optical remote sensing, radar measurement, laser point clouds and the like and different physical meanings through a depth feature extraction and attention weighted fusion mechanism to generate unified and information-rich characterization, thereby laying a solid data base for follow-up accurate prediction and overcoming the limitation of data splitting application in the traditional method; by constructing a space-time diagram taking the slope unit as a node and utilizing a concentration mechanism diagram convolution network introducing hydrologic directivity, the model can accurately describe the space propagation process of slope substances moving, accumulating and blocking a river channel along with a converging path under the rainfall condition, and meanwhile, the time sequence module effectively learns the influence of the past hydrologic state on the future evolution trend.

title_en: Comprehensive quantitative evaluation method and system for fault probability of power distribution equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a comprehensive quantitative evaluation method and a comprehensive quantitative evaluation system for fault probability of power distribution equipment, which relate to the technical field of power distribution equipment, and realize intelligent management of fault prediction and maintenance strategy of the power distribution equipment by integrating a physical information neural network, abnormal score analysis, a space-time diagram neural network, maintenance decision calculation and the like, improve the accuracy and reliability of the fault prediction, reduce false alarm rate through probability output and support uncertainty quantization; the system has the advantages of enhancing the sensitivity of anomaly detection, facilitating early warning and priority sequencing, improving the response speed of the system to an anomaly state, comprehensively modeling space and time dependence, optimizing risk assessment and resource allocation, reducing cascade fault risks, generating a data-driven maintenance strategy, improving maintenance efficiency and quality, reducing cost and downtime, generating dynamic risk portraits through attribution analysis, supporting real-time monitoring and decision making, and enhancing the transparency of the system.

title_en: Artificial intelligence based smart fire detection device and non-fire alarm analysis system comprising the same
title_ko: 인공지능 기반의 스마트 화재감지장치, 이를 포함하는 비화재보 분석 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an artificial intelligence-based smart fire detection device and a non-fire alarm analysis system including the same. The artificial intelligence-based smart fire detection device comprises: a plurality of child detection devices which detect the occurrence of a fire by a heat detection method and smoke detection method, when a fire is detected in at least one detection device, transmit a fire detection signal through a first wireless communication network, when a fire occurrence determination signal is received, propagate the fire occurrence determination signal to the remaining detection devices through the first wireless communication network, and output a voice alarm and a flash alarm according to the fire occurrence determination signal; and a mother detection device which, when the fire detection signal is received, determines whether the signal is a non-fire alarm using a deep learning model based on standard non-fire alarm information, and transmits, when it is determined that a fire has occurred, the fire occurrence determination signal to the plurality of child detection devices through the first wireless communication network. By using the deep learning model, a non-fire alarm according to environmental factors can be effectively determined, and in case of a fire, human casualties can be minimized by performing a prompt interlocking alarm to an entire place where the fire detection devices are installed.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 인공지능 기반의 스마트 화재감지장치 및 이를 포함하는 비화재보 분석 시스템에 관한 것으로, 열감지방식 및 연기감지방식으로 화재발생여부를 감지하고, 적어도 하나의 감지디바이스에서 화재발생이 감지될 경우 화재감지신호를 제 1 무선통신망을 통해 전송하며, 화재발생판단신호가 수신될 경우 나머지 감지디바이스에 상기 화재발생판단신호를 상기 제 1 무선통신망을 통해 전파하며, 상기 화재발생판단신호에 따라 음성경보 및 섬광경보를 출력하는 복수의 차일드(child)감지디바이스; 및 상기 화재감지신호가 수신될 경우 비화재보여부를 판단하되, 기준비화재보정보를 기반으로 딥러닝모델을 이용하여 판단하고, 화재가 발생한 것으로 판단될 경우 상기 화재발생판단신호를 상기 복수의 차일드감지디바이스에 상기 제 1 무선통신망을 통해 전송하는 머더(mother)감지디바이스;를 포함함으로써, 딥러닝모델을 이용하여 환경요인에 따른 비화재보여부를 효과적으로 판별할 수 있고, 화재 발생 시 화재감지장치가 설치된 장소 전체에 신속한 연동경보를 수행하여 인명피해를 최소화할 수 있다.

title_en: Power system weaknesses identification method based on cascading failure
abstract_en: The invention provides a power system weaknesses identification method based on a cascading failure. A cascading failure model is introduced into the state analysis of risk assessment. The influence of the cascading failure developed by an originating failure on a power grid is taken into account. The dynamic and cascading development law of a blackout incident is met. With the help of a cascading failure process, a weakness affecting the blackout incident is analyzed and identified. A key element in the blackout incident can be really screened out. An acquired weakness result is comprehensive, accurate and useful. According to the invention, the mature theory of risk assessment based on a Monte Carlo simulation method is effectively inherited; complex relationship derivation is not needed; failure enumerating is not needed; and especially for a large system, the advantages of the method provided by the invention are apparent.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;ECONOMIC TECHNOLOGY RES INST STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG

title_en: Cascade hydropower station peak regulating method based on random continuous optimization strategy
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascade hydropower station peak regulating method based on a random continuous optimization strategy. The cascade hydropower station peak regulating method comprises the following steps: (1) generating an initial solution, selecting water levels in front of a dam from hydropower stations from upstream to downstream as discrete state quantities; taking a minimum power grid residual load mean square error as a target to carry out single reservoir peak regulating optimization calculation; (2) randomly and continuously carrying out optimized search step by step; and (3) updating iteration judgment: if reaching the tail of a time period, finishing a regulating process when a stopping condition of a successive optimization algorithm is reached, and outputting a final result, if the stopping condition of the successive optimization algorithm is not reached, setting a time period number to be a starting time period and turning into the step (2) to carry out the next time of iteration optimization, and if not reaching the tail of the time period, adding one to the time period number and turning into the step (2) to carry out two-phase regulation of the next time period. With the adoption of a constraint handling method provided by the invention, complicated cascade hydropower station coupling operation constraint of the cascade hydropower stations can be completely decoupled, and a constraint handling process of the algorithm is simplified; and a decision-making variable dimension is reduced, a reasonable optimization space is found and the method is suitable for solving a peak regulating problem of a large-scale cascade hydropower station group.

title_en: A kind of cophase supply system load flow controller dynamic reliability appraisal procedure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of cophase supply system load flow controller dynamic reliability appraisal procedure, the influence fluctuated by meter and actual traction load randomness and impact to power component junction temperature, power component junction temperature is calculated using power attenuation and ther mal network model, add up model with reference to the physical model based on failure mechanism and linear fatigue damage, flow controller power model crash rate is calculated, PFC reliability is analyzed using the dynamic reliability appraisal procedure of meter and part failure rate change.The present invention is analyzed the redundancy of power model, optimizes flow controller cascade module number, the engineering design and operation maintenance for cophase supply system provide necessary foundation.

title_en: A kind of fire-fighting link intelligence control system and its method of work for window opener
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of fire-fighting link intelligence control system and its method of work for window opener, including Main Control Tank, multiple isolators, multiple power supply boxs, multiple windowing machine controllers, CAN signal line I, CAN signal line II and power cord looped network, Main Control Tank is connected by CAN signal line I with multiple isolators, multiple isolators are connected by CAN signal line I with multiple windowing machine controllers, the multiple power supply box is powered by power cord looped network for multiple isolators and multiple windowing controllers, mutually cascaded by CAN signal line II between the multiple windowing machine controller.Opening, opening angle and the running state information of each window opener can be monitored in real time, unlatching and closing can be synchronized to any one or more window openers at the same time, used easy to fire-fighting link, so as to can open the window in time when fire occurs, be conducive to ventilation smoke exhaust.

title_en: One-key control method and platform for cascade power station group
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power station group control, and discloses a one-key control method for a cascade power station group, which comprises the following steps: obtaining historical order-adjusting data, and inputting the historical order-adjusting data into an order-adjusting model to form an order-adjusting library; matching and associating the typical ticket with the order library to obtain an order ID corresponding to the order of the typical ticket in the order library; associating the specific operation items in the typical ticket with the order ID to establish a ticket rule expert library; the invention uses artificial intelligence technology to realize intelligent ticket forming, network ordering and the like, updates the traditional scheduling business working mode into a new information regulation and control management mode taking artificial intelligence as a core, and does not need to adopt the traditional scheduling business working modes of manually compiling operation tickets, ordering by telephone and the like.
assignees: GUONENG DADU RIVER BASIN HYDROPOWER DEV CO LTD

title_en: Short-term wind power prediction method based on SSA (simple sequence analysis) optimization BP (back propagation) neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a short-term wind power prediction method based on an SSA (simple sequence analysis) optimized BP (back propagation) neural network, which comprises the following steps: acquiring real-time data of a wind power plant, preprocessing the data, loading the data into an SSA (simple sequence analysis) optimization BP (back propagation) neural network model, and acquiring a short-term wind power prediction result; calculating the fitness of each sparrow through a sparrow search algorithm in the training process of the SSA optimization BP neural network model, updating the positions of the finder, the joiner and the detector until the optimal position and the optimal fitness value are obtained, and then respectively assigning values to the BP neural network model to be used as a parameter weight and a threshold value, so that the optimal SSA optimization BP neural network model is obtained. Compared with the prior art, the method improves the network training speed and the wind power prediction precision by optimizing the weight and the threshold of the BP neural network algorithm through SSA.

title_en: Power system scheduling method based on cascading failure prevention
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system scheduling method based on cascading failure prevention, which comprises the following steps: (1) according to the topology of the power system, the parameters and the constraints of the related lines, a cascading failure model of the power system is established through direct current load flow calculation; (2) calculating line parameters representing the correlation of cascading failures in the power system according to the cascading failure accident chain data, and establishing corresponding power system operation constraints; (3) according to the power grid line and load data, ensuring the power quality and the power safety, and establishing a scheduling method model which meets all load consumption with the lowest power generation cost or fuel consumption; (4) and obtaining a safe operation optimization strategy of the power system by taking the lowest power generation cost and load shedding cost of the generator as optimization targets. The method can optimize the operation of the power system by taking the cascading failure prevention as a target, and improves the toughness and the safety of the power system while considering the economy of the power system.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECHNICAL RES INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID JIANGSU POWER CO LTD

title_en: Wind power grid-connected system cascading failure risk assessment method considering frequency modulation characteristics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascading failure risk assessment method of a wind power grid-connected system considering frequency modulation characteristics, and relates to the field of grid operation and maintenance. The failure risk of the wind power grid-connected system is not comprehensively considered. The method comprises the following steps: adding the generator and the load frequency modulation characteristic equation to a power flow equation to obtain a power flow equation considering frequency modulation characteristics; linearizing the tide equation which takes into account the frequency modulation characteristic to obtain a node voltage linear tide equation and a line tide equation which take into account the frequency modulation characteristic of the system; establishing a Gaussian mixture model of the output power of the fan to obtain a probability distribution function of the output power of the fan; based on the obtained probability distribution function, the severity degree of node voltage out-of-limit, line overload and system frequency out-of-limit of the system are calculated respectively; judging whether the severity of the overload of the line exceeds a set value; the risk of the system during the entire cascading failure is assessed. The technical scheme accords with the actual situation, and effectively evaluates the risks of voltage out-of-limit, line overload and frequency instability of wind power access.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ZHOUSHAN POWER SUPPLY COMPANY

title_en: Power system risk assessment method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system risk assessment method, a system, equipment and a medium, and relates to the technical field of power systems. And constructing a network attack model corresponding to the power system by acquiring architecture data of the power system and adopting the architecture data. And carrying out cascading failure analysis on the network attack model based on a preset network attack type to generate system load loss. And calculating the product of the system load loss and the corresponding attack probability to generate a system risk value. And performing resource allocation based on the safety resources corresponding to the power system, the system risk value and the system load loss, and generating a risk assessment result corresponding to the power system. Considering the cascade effect caused by network attack, the cascade effect can lead to the spread of faults to be quicker and wider, and the risk assessment result is inaccurate when the cascade effect is ignored. The risk of different types can be quantitatively evaluated, the severity of the risk can be better known, and corresponding defensive measures are adopted.

title_en: Power system cascading failure emergency blocking control method and device based on risk assessment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of safe operation and control of power systems, and provides a power system cascading failure emergency blocking control method and device based on risk assessment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: designing each action strategy, objective function and constraint condition of emergency blocking control; setting a cascading failure simulation round, simulating cascading failures, and counting average load loss and average unit loss; based on each action strategy of the optimal emergency blocking control of the Monte Carlo tree searching method, model training is carried out based on an improved depth deterministic strategy gradient algorithm, and a cascading failure emergency blocking control model is established; predicting and obtaining the load shedding action quantity of the emergency power shedding machine in various states to form an emergency blocking control scheme of the power grid to be predicted; the invention gives consideration to the safe operation and economy of the system, effectively blocks the cascade fault process and ensures the safe stability of the operation of the new energy grid-connected system.
assignees: UNIV WUHAN;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Agricultural product quality anomaly propagation path prediction system and method based on graph neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for predicting an agricultural product quality abnormal propagation path based on a graphic neural network, wherein S1 is used for collecting a quality data set in an agricultural product supply chain, S2 is used for forming a characteristic vector used for being input by the graphic neural network, S3 is used for constructing an agricultural product supply chain quality abnormal propagation path prediction model based on the graphic neural network, S4 is used for inputting a preprocessed historical quality data set into the abnormal propagation path prediction model, S5 is used for monitoring the quality state of each node in real time, S6 is used for dynamically updating the weight of edges in the graph based on an edge weight self-adaptive adjustment mechanism, S7 is used for calculating the optimal propagation path of quality abnormality again by the abnormal propagation path prediction model and generating a prediction path, S8 is used for identifying potential risk nodes according to the recalculated abnormal propagation path, and S9 is used for updating the abnormal propagation path prediction model through real-time data. The method and the system realize accurate prediction and real-time adjustment of the quality anomaly propagation path in the agricultural product supply chain network.

title_en: Fault diagnosis method and system for energy storage system under multi-level converter topological structure
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of energy storage systems, and provides a fault diagnosis method and system for an energy storage system under a multilevel converter topological structure. The method comprises the steps of identifying a cascade series-parallel topology of a target converter, traversing the cascade series-parallel topology, setting diagnosis point cloud distribution, constructing a swinging function, executing network construction control risk map mining in a multi-working mode based on the diagnosis point cloud distribution and the swinging function, constructing a fault diagnosis module, interacting topology electric signals, carrying out point cloud data diagnosis decision in the target working mode by combining the fault diagnosis module, determining a fault diagnosis list, displaying and early warning the fault diagnosis list by a terminal, and triggering an emergency plan, so that the technical problems that when the complexity of a topological structure of the multi-level converter is increased, fault diagnosis cannot be rapidly positioned, fault tolerance is insufficient, and the operation stability of an energy storage system is reduced are solved.
assignees: SUINING POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;XUZHOU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH CO STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Reservoir dispatching method considering power grid load change
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reservoir dispatching method considering power grid load change, which makes up the defect that a power station lacks consideration to the overall change trend of a power grid and lacks consideration to the benefits of the power station when carrying out peak regulation, provides a concept of the power grid load demand satisfaction rate for representing the consistency strong and weak relation between reservoir output and the power grid load change process, introduces the power grid demand satisfaction punishment factors into a traditional reservoir power generation dispatching model, designs ten groups of conversion functions, calculates the punishment factors in the power generation process of the power grid and the power grid load change process, and builds a cascade reservoir dispatching model considering the power grid load demand satisfaction rate.

title_en: Energy storage optimization scheduling system based on physical guide model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electric power regulation, and particularly discloses an energy storage optimization scheduling system based on a physical guide model, which is used for solving the problems of frequency, power angle, voltage linkage instability and energy storage response hysteresis caused by new energy grid connection, and comprises a data acquisition layer, a physical guide model layer, an extreme disturbance response analysis layer, a data driving decision layer and an execution control layer; according to the invention, through multi-layer modularized closed-loop self-adaptive feedback and physical data coupling modeling, an energy storage charging and discharging strategy is corrected in real time, and control parameters are dynamically optimized, so that the frequency, voltage and power angle compound change of a second cascade dynamic response power grid can be realized under the multi-source disturbance of wind power or photovoltaic extreme fluctuation and equipment sudden fault, the stable operation of the power grid is realized, the economic benefit is maximized, and the service life of energy storage equipment is prolonged.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Multi-node cooperative electric vehicle charging station insurance policy optimization method and system
abstract_en: The application provides a multi-node cooperative electric vehicle charging station insurance policy optimization method and system, belonging to the technical field of electric vehicle charging station insurance policy optimization, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring heterogeneous data from a charging station local sensor, a power grid API and a user terminal application in real time, processing the heterogeneous data and generating a standardized data set; based on standardized data, generating a premium adjustment parameter and a load shunt strategy parameter by utilizing a pre-constructed multi-node reinforcement learning model, wherein each charging station is used as an independent intelligent body to realize global strategy synchronization through a federal learning mechanism, dynamically calculating premium by combining a real-time risk assessment model, generating a premium adjustment parameter and generating a final premium by utilizing the premium dynamically calculated by the multi-node reinforcement learning model, predicting a fault propagation path through a space-time diagram neural network, and iteratively updating the premium adjustment parameter and the load shunt strategy parameter under cascade risk constraint by adopting a multi-objective optimization algorithm.
assignees: SHANDONG UNIV OF FINANCE AND ECONOMICS

title_en: Multi-user anti-interference decision method based on sparse strategy propagation
abstract_en: The application discloses a multi-user anti-interference decision method based on sparse strategy propagation, which comprises the steps of 1, determining the number of sub-slots of a user according to interference detection history, 2, determining the information transmission rate of sub-slots according to a spreading factor, 3, determining system throughput and an optimization target according to a signal-to-noise ratio of a receiving end, 4, determining a state space, an action space, a state transition probability matrix and rewards in a decision process, 5, obtaining lower-layer main network parameters according to experience samples and a loss function, 6, obtaining upper-layer main network parameters according to experience samples and a loss function, and 7, obtaining an optimal anti-interference strategy according to iterative training. The application reduces the decision complexity and avoids dimension disasters.

title_en: Extreme rainfall flood risk propagation path identification method based on hydrologic connectivity
abstract_en: The invention discloses an extreme rainfall flood risk propagation path identification method based on hydrologic connectivity, which comprises the steps of constructing a hydrologic topological network, calculating the yield and hydrologic potential energy of each grid unit, constructing a connectivity weight matrix according to potential energy difference and Manning roughness coefficient, generating a dynamic connectivity adjacency matrix through a ponding depth trigger threshold, constructing a risk propagation probability transfer matrix, and identifying a risk propagation main path and key conduction nodes. The method can dynamically characterize hydrologic connectivity change under extreme rainfall conditions, effectively identify flood risk propagation paths and key nodes, and provide technical support for urban flood disaster risk early warning and emergency management.

title_en: Barrel type medical waste intelligent allocation system and method based on risk propagation dynamics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a barrel type medical waste intelligent allocation system and method based on risk propagation dynamics, and belongs to the technical field of automatic control. According to the system, the state and the environmental parameters of the waste bin are collected in real time through the intelligent sensor network, the dynamic risk evolution of the waste bin is calculated by the risk propagation dynamics engine based on the differential equation model, the risk distribution map of the three-dimensional space of the hospital is constructed by the risk field calculation engine, the potential risk burst is monitored and early warned in advance by the risk phase change detector, the optimal scheduling sequence is generated by combining the risk distribution and the resource constraint by the risk neutralization scheduler, and the related transportation units are driven to execute, so that the dynamic and intelligent management and control of the whole flow of medical waste are realized.
assignees: ESSENIOT SMART TECH DEVELOPMENT SUZHOU CO LTD

title_en: Water conservancy rain radar coverage area simulation method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for simulating a coverage area of a water conservancy rain radar, and aims to solve the problem of coverage blind areas caused by relief of topography and equipment performance. According to the method, radar parameters, topographic data and atmospheric parameters are input, three-dimensional topography is converted into a distance-height two-dimensional section, electromagnetic wave distribution is solved by utilizing a parabolic equation, two-dimensional path loss is calculated by combining a propagation factor formula, three-dimensional path loss data is accumulated, and a coverage area simulation result is output by combining a radar detection capacity threshold value. Taking radar networking of 3 parts of a river basin as an example, simulation shows that the coverage area is increased from 11580.7km2 to 17848.9km2, and the dead zone ratio is reduced from 24.77% to 21.43%. The invention can provide technical support for optimizing the monitoring layout of three-line defense in a river basin and selecting rain-measuring radar equipment.
assignees: CHANGJIANG RIVER SCIENTIFIC RESEARCH INST OF CHANGJIANG WATER RESOURCES COMMISSION

title_en: Enhanced V-pass apparatus for emergence calling
title_ko: 비상호출 기능 등이 강화된 브이패스 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a technique utilized for reporting a position of a ship, especially to a V-pass apparatus technology of emergency call function which can transmit a distress signal stably even in a sinking situation of the ship and report position data that existed in a shadow area. A purpose of the present invention is to improve the emergency call function of a fishing boat by complementarily interlocking a special role of the V-pass and a multifunctional role of a smartphone. Thus, a transmitting and receiving terminal only for transmission and reception having a location reporting communications and emergency communications means is interlocked with a display terminal for providing users convenience are interlocked, wherein the transmitting and receiving terminal and the display terminal are interlocked by a single V-pass apparatus integrated with Bluetooth, and are automatically detached at a time of sinking, and an SOS signal is transmitted simultaneously with the smart phone in an emergency call. Therefore, the present invention is able to obtain a variety of effects, such as switching to a good network in a boundary area of a communication channel, and transmitting an emergency call signal stably.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 선박의 위치보고 등에 활용되는 기술로서, 특히 선박의 침몰 상황에서도 안정되게 조난신호 발신이 가능하고 전파음영지역에 존재했던 위치데이터도 추가보고 가능한 비상호출 기능의 브이패스 장치 기술이다. 
본 발명은 브이패스의 전문 역할과 스마트폰의 다기능 역할을 상호 보완적으로 연동하여 어선의 비상호출 기능을 개량하고자 하는 목적으로, 위치보고통신과 비상통신 수단이 구비된 송수신 전용의 송수신터미널 및 사용자 조작편의성을 제공하는 디스플레이단말을 연동하되, 상기 송수신터미널과 디스플레이단말은 블루투스로 연동되어 통합된 하나의 브이패스 장치를 구성하고 침몰 시에 자동 탈거되고, 비상호출에서 스마트폰과 동시에 SOS신호가 송출되는 등의 구성을 특징으로 한다.  
본 발명에 의하면 특히 통신권의 경계지역에서 양호한 네트워크로 전환되어 비상호출 신호가 안정되게 전송되는 등 다양한 효과를 얻을 수 있다.

title_en: Disaster condition indication of serving plmn
abstract_en: The invention relates to a novel mechanism involving a network node (100) and a client device (300) for indicating that a serving PLMN (610) is in a disaster condition. The network node informs the client device through control signalling (510) that the serving PLMN for the client device is in disaster condition. Thereby, the client device may take suitable measures so as to avoid service interruption, e.g. by registration at a visiting PLMN (620) not in disaster condition by initiating a PLMN selection procedure. Examples of control signalling that may be used in this context is SIB, NAS, RRC messages or paging messages. Furthermore, the invention also relates to corresponding methods and a computer program.

title_en: Power system state estimation method and the system of model is estimated based on set theory
abstract_en: The present invention proposes a kind of power system state estimation method estimating model based on set theory.Wherein, method comprises the following steps: based on set theory, network topology and parameter according to power system generate Power system state estimation model；Generating the first constraint set by the uncertainty of measurement information of state estimation model and measurement equipment, wherein, the first constraint set includes measuring Operations of Interva Constraint and state Operations of Interva Constraint；According to power system physical constraint, the first constraint set being extended obtaining the second constraint set, wherein, the data volume of the second constraint set is more than the data volume of the first constraint set；And the second constraint set is carried out Operations of Interva Constraint propagate obtain POWER SYSTEM STATE estimation interval, and measure estimation interval.By employing set theory, method according to embodiments of the present invention, estimates that model, constraint set extend and Operations of Interva Constraint is propagated and obtained the state interval of power system and measure estimation interval, improves the property be sure of of data, decrease amount of calculation.

title_en: The classification method and device of electric business client
abstract_en: The invention discloses the classification methods and device of a kind of electric business client.The items list of commodity is bought as the cum rights network on side using client by vertex, the client this method comprises: establishing according to order data, wherein the items list includes the title and price of commodity；Cum rights label propagation algorithm is executed to the cum rights network, obtains multiple customer groups, and label is defined to each customer group；Each client vertex in the multiple customer group is traversed, according to the label on all neighbours vertex on each client vertex and the multi-tag classification results of each client of weight calculation.The present invention can generate multiple labels to same client, so that more comprehensively and accurately to the description of client, achieving the effect that carry out Accurate classification to client, maintaining efficient in runing time, can apply on more massive data set.

title_en: Power grid cascading failure modeling simulation method based on colored stochastic Petri network
abstract_en: The invention provides a power grid cascading failure modeling simulation method based on a colored random Petri network, which comprises the following steps of: step 1, determining corresponding actions of a related relay protection device when each element fails according to a power grid system wiring diagram; step 2, classifying each level of relay protection devices of the elements according to the properties of the colored Petri network, and establishing a local CPN model for removing faults; step 3, integrating the local CPN models of all the elements with the fault removed into a CPN model of a fault removal route of the whole system; and 4, considering the possible fault condition of the relay protection device, and establishing an SCPN model of the whole system by using a random Petri network.

title_en: Influence blocking maximization algorithm based on overlapping interest community detection
abstract_en: The invention provides an influence blocking maximization algorithm based on overlapping interest community detection. The method comprises a competition propagation model considering multiple factors and an algorithm based on the model and overlapping interest community detection, and is used for modeling a multi-information competition propagation process and selecting active information seed nodes in a social network. The modeling of the competition propagation process and the blocking of influence maximization are hot spots of social network analysis, the traditional model is expanded based on IC and LT, the actual propagation process is difficult to accurately describe, the traditional community-based algorithm divides communities based on a topological structure, and user interest preference is ignored. The method comprehensively considers the interest preference of the users, the information interaction time delay and the trust degree between the users, can better model the competition propagation process, expands the traditional community concept to the interest communities, improves the community detection accuracy, and guides the selection of the active information seed nodes through overlapping the interest community structure so as to achieve the expected negative information influence blocking effect in a short time.

title_en: Intelligent power transmission line management and control method and system based on power distribution data feedback
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent control method and system for a power transmission line based on power distribution data feedback, which relate to the technical field of power transmission line control and comprise the following steps: by integrating multi-source data, a historical environment-electric coupling characteristic matrix is constructed, a long-short-time memory network is utilized to extract time sequence characteristics, a convolutional neural network is combined to capture a spatial distribution rule, and a dynamic line loss prediction model is established to simulate minimum line loss values in different environment scenes. Detecting abnormal time periods through an isolated forest algorithm, screening key damage factors by combining Pearson correlation analysis and SHAP value analysis, dynamically generating and executing a damage reduction strategy priority event, and optimizing model parameters by utilizing error back propagation and reinforcement learning. And finally, generating a typical environmental scene loss reduction case library based on an optimization model, and simulating strategy effectiveness under extreme conditions through a digital twin technology to form a reusable decision rule set, so that the running efficiency and the power supply reliability of the power transmission line are improved.

title_en: System for village-oriented disaster response intelligent unmanned information terminal
title_ko: 마을 중심의 재난대응 지능형 무인 정보 단말 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 접근성이 낮고 교통 인프라가 부족한 마을에 마을 중심의 독자적인 재난 대응 시스템을 통해 재난 발생 시, 신속한 재난 상황 전파 및 구호 물자 배포 등 골든타임 내 최적의 대응을 가능하게 하는 마을 중심의 재난대응 지능형 무인 정보 단말 시스템에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 본 발명에 따른 마을 중심의 재난대응 지능형 무인 정보 단말 시스템은, 재난 발생 시, 실시간으로 원전 사고 및 자연재난 등을 포함하는 다양한 재난정보를 무인정보 단말기로 제공하는 재난대응 시스템 서버 및 마을회관, 경로당 등을 포함하는 공동시설에 설치되어 재난 발생 시, 상기 재난대응 시스템 서버로부터 재난정보를 수신하여 재난 상황을 전파하고, 구호물자를 배포하기 위한 무인정보 단말기를 포함한다.

title_en: Cascading failure risk recognition method for power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascading failure risk recognition method for a power system, and the method gives comprehensive consideration to the internal operation condition of a power grid and the external natural disaster early warning information, carries out the overall planning of internal and external factors of the power grid, and reflects the actual working condition of the power grid more truly. A mathematic method employed in the system is the theory of credibility measurement, depicts the internal and external complex nondeterminacy of the power grid, calculates the cascading failure risk measure through combining a comprehensive severity index, and enables a risk recognition sequence to much closer to the reality. Therefore, the system achieves the early warning of the cascading failure risks more precisely.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: A kind of power grid icing waves Risk Forecast Method, system and storage medium
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the meteorological disaster technical fields of electric system, it discloses a kind of power grid icing and waves Risk Forecast Method, system and storage medium, to mitigate the disaster of waving that grid power transmission circuit is subjected to, improve grid power transmission circuit reply icing and wave the ability of disaster and safely and steadily run level；The present invention initializes the parameter value of limited Boltzmann machine algorithm according to training sample data collection, then repetition learning and undated parameter value, until limited Boltzmann machine algorithm meets the convergence of training sample data collection, and pass through the precision of prediction E for verifying the limited Boltzmann machine algorithm of sample data set verification avg If precision of prediction E avg It is not presetting within precision, is then continuing undated parameter, until meeting precision of prediction；It further establishes the power grid icing based on back-propagation algorithm and waves prediction model, the parameter for finally waving prediction model to power grid icing according to back-propagation algorithm is adjusted, and is obtained icing and waved prediction model.
assignees: State grid hunan electric power co ltd;STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO DISASTER PREVENTION & REDUCTION CT;HUNAN XIANGDIAN TEST RESEARCH TECH CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Atmospheric storage tank area domino accident dynamic prediction method, system and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of storage tank accident detection, and discloses a method, a system and a device for dynamically predicting domino accidents in a normal-pressure storage tank area, wherein the key points of the technical scheme are that basic data of a tank area to be evaluated are collected; determining an initial storage tank according to the basic data; determining an initial accident mode according to the basic data of the initial storage tank; determining an accident evolution mode according to the initial accident mode; calculating physical effects for each accident evolution mode; judging whether the physical effect exceeds a threshold value, and if so, determining an accident mode of an adjacent storage tank; constructing a static Bayesian network according to the accident mode of the adjacent storage tank; constructing a dynamic Bayesian network according to the static Bayesian network and fire-fighting factors; and calculating dynamic probability according to the dynamic Bayesian network, and determining the most possible extended accident chain and key storage tanks.
assignees: NANJING UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY;NANJING NJTECH SAFETY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Hybrid rolling short-term load prediction method based on GAN network and semi-supervised regression
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mixed rolling short-term load prediction method based on a GAN network and semi-supervised regression, wherein a GAN generation confrontation network consists of a generation layer G and a discrimination layer D, the generation layer of GAN can generate a virtual data sample similar to a real value, the discrimination layer receives two inputs of the generated virtual sample and the real sample, a cluster of error discrimination results based on cross entropy is generated by carrying out data processing on two groups of data with different real values, the error is fed back to the generation layer and the discrimination layer through a back propagation algorithm, a GAN model is corrected by changing mathematical parameters in the GAN model in an iteration mode, and load data are predicted through a trained GAN model. The invention solves the problem of insufficient fitting of the traditional GAN network, solves the problem of possible insufficient historical data by using a rolling self-adaptive method, can realize one-step prediction and multi-step prediction, and obtains good prediction effect.
assignees: JIAXING GUODIANTONG NEW ENERGY TECH CO LTD;BEIJING GUODIANTONG NETWORK TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;STATE GRID INFORMATION & TELECOMMUNICATION CO LTD;UNIV SHANDONG

title_en: Distributed event-driven elastic control method for micro-grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed event-driven elastic control method for a microgrid, which comprises the following steps: step 1, primary droop control of a micro-grid; step 2, determining whether bad data injection attack occurs in the interactive voltage and frequency state process of the distributed power generation unit; step 3, updating a local trust value based on the consistency cooperation index; step 4, obtaining a comprehensive trust value based on a trust propagation mechanism, and updating communication connection edge weights among the distributed power generation units based on the comprehensive trust value; and 5, establishing an event-driven distributed elastic control protocol based on the dynamic communication connection edge rights, and realizing the frequency and voltage recovery of the micro-grid under the network attack condition. The invention reduces the communication burden, simultaneously detects and isolates the bad data injection attack in time, ensures that the node recovered from the attack can be added into the micro-grid again, and improves the operation elasticity of the micro-grid, thereby improving the safety of the power system.

title_en: Roadway gas concentration prediction method based on model and big data double driving
abstract_en: A roadway gas concentration prediction method based on model and big data double driving belongs to the technical field of mine disaster intelligent prevention and control, and solves the technical problems of accuracy and instantaneity of gas concentration prediction in a roadway, and the method comprises the following steps: the coal mine tunnel environmental parameters, the gas concentration historical characteristic data set and the physical equation characteristic data set are combined into a data set, and training is carried out through a convolutional neural network RNN to obtain a predicted value; and further, through model evaluation and optimization, gas diffusion criterion constraint is added in a loss function of a standard RNN, and a standard back propagation algorithm and an Adam optimizer are adopted to train a learning model until a loss function result is minimized, so that accurate prediction of the roadway gas concentration is finally realized. The method can realize accurate and rapid prediction of the roadway gas concentration, provide reliable data support for coal mine safety decision, and effectively ensure safe and efficient mining of the coal mine.

title_en: Substation monitoring alarm information studying and judging method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for studying and judging power transformation monitoring alarm information. The method comprises the steps of obtaining history monitoring alarm information without labels; inputting unlabeled historical monitoring alarm information into an initial model for pre-training to obtain a pre-training model; marking the unlabeled historical monitoring alarm information by utilizing expert system eventing rules, and checking marked data against a scheduling log to obtain the labeled historical monitoring alarm information; inputting the history monitoring alarm information with the tag into a pre-training model, fine-tuning the pre-training model, and updating model parameters of the pre-training model through back propagation to obtain a trained network model; and acquiring monitoring alarm data during the monitoring operation of the power transformation centralized control station, inputting the monitoring alarm data into a trained network model, and acquiring a power transformation monitoring alarm event studying and judging result. The scheme of the invention can realize the autonomous research and judgment of the transformer monitoring alarm event, and improve the accuracy and fault tolerance of the event research and judgment strategy.
assignees: STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INST;HUNAN XIANGDIAN TEST RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;State grid hunan electric power co ltd;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Method and device for discriminating single-phase disconnection faults of power distribution network, terminal equipment and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, terminal equipment and a computer readable storage medium for discriminating single-phase disconnection faults of a power distribution network, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a power distribution network topological structure diagram to be evaluated, and determining a first node characteristic and a first adjacency matrix of each node in the diagram; the first node characteristics comprise three-phase circuit effective values on a distribution network line, the first node characteristics and the first adjacent matrix of each node are input into a trained single-phase disconnection fault positioning model, so that the model carries out forward propagation for a plurality of times according to the first node characteristics and the first adjacent matrix of each node, in the forward propagation process of each time, the model aggregates node characteristics of adjacent nodes of each node according to the connection relation of the nodes in the first adjacent matrix, and the class label of each node is output according to the aggregated node characteristics of each node in forward propagation. By implementing the method and the device, the retraining time and resource cost can be reduced, and the mobility of the model can be improved.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Grape disease identification and early warning method based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses a grape disease identification and early warning method based on the Internet of things, which relates to the technical field of plant disease identification, and comprises the steps of arranging image acquisition equipment and environment sensing nodes in a grape garden to obtain leaf surface images and corresponding temperature, humidity, illumination and soil moisture parameters, inputting the images into a neural network integrating cavity convolution and residual attention mechanisms to achieve extraction of disease spot areas and disease spot variation characteristics and generate a preliminary identification result, constructing a multi-factor evolution sample set by combining the identification result and the environment state of a time node, constructing a space-time correlation map model based on the graph neural network to estimate disease propagation risk paths and diffusion probability, and carrying out early warning judgment at a gateway end through a multi-factor gate control judgment algorithm.
assignees: NINGXIA AGRICULTURAL PRODUCTS QUALITY STANDARDS AND TESTING TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE NINGXIA AGRICULT

title_en: Power failure event digital management method and system for important users
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for digitally managing a blackout event, which comprises the following steps of S1, obtaining basic user data, constructing a power user knowledge graph, S2, training a user importance scoring model, applying a clustering algorithm to carry out user automatic grading, constructing a user digital twin model, S3, constructing a device data acquisition network, S4, identifying potential faults based on a time sequence prediction model according to device data acquired by the device data acquisition network, S5, constructing a blackout propagation model based on a graph neural network, predicting a fault propagation path according to the potential faults identified by the time sequence prediction model, combining the user digital twin model, realizing real-time state digital twin of a power grid, visually displaying the health state of the power grid, and S6, customizing and generating risk early warning for different levels of important users according to the predicted fault propagation path. The invention not only improves the intelligent level of power failure management, but also obviously improves the power supply reliability of important users.
assignees: MARKETING SERVICE CENTER OF STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic emergency resource scheduling method, system and medium based on multidimensional data analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic emergency resource scheduling method based on multidimensional data analysis, which belongs to the technical field of emergency management and resource scheduling and comprises the following steps of S1, multidimensional data acquisition and fusion, S2, disaster chain network construction, construction of a disaster chain evolution network model based on data of the step S1, calculation of node degree, medium centrality and weakness, identification of key risk nodes and evolution paths, S3, dynamic risk assessment, quantification of current risk level and prediction of future risk situation, S4, emergency resource optimization scheduling decision, priority blocking of a high risk chain propagation path according to a risk assessment result of the step S3, and scheduling implementation feedback regulation. According to the invention, through effectively fusing multidimensional dynamic information such as real-time weather, infrastructure states, social disaster-bearing bodies and the like, dynamic simulation and risk assessment of a disaster chain evolution rule are actively carried out, disaster spread is effectively controlled, and overall loss is reduced.
assignees: URBAN SAFETY AND ENVIRONMENT SCIENCE INST BEIJING INST OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Latency-capacity-and energy-aware vnf placement in edge computing environments
abstract_en: One example method includes creating an ILP model that includes a delay model, an energy model, and a QoS model, and modeling, using the integer linear programming model, a VNF placement problem as an ILP problem, and the modeling includes: using the delay model to identify propagation, transmission, processing, and queuing, delays implied by enabling an instance of the VNF at an edge node to accept a user VNF call; using the energy model to identify energy consumption implied by enabling an instance of the VNF at an edge node to accept a user VNF call; and using the QoS model to identify end-to-end delay, bandwidth consumption, and jitter, implied by enabling an instance of the VNF at an edge node to accept a user virtual network function call. The problem modeled by the ILP model may be resolved by a heuristic method.

title_en: Prevention through design environmental material intelligence center
abstract_en: The present disclosure presents systems and methods for building infrastructure and infection prevention data analysis. One such method comprises building contents of an electronic repository of performance metrics related to material pathogen propagation or reduction; assigning, via machine learning, a performance score or grade to a certain infrastructure building material based on the performance metrics associated with the building material; and predicting and outputting, via the machine learning, a risk associated with a building based on its infrastructure building materials, wherein the infrastructure building materials comprises the certain infrastructure building material.

title_en: Method and apparatus for controlling selection of plmn candidates for disaster roaming
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a 5G or 6G communication system for supporting a higher data transmission rate. Embodiments herein disclose a device and methods for managing and selecting Public Land Mobile Networks (PLMNs) for disaster roaming during Minimization of Service Interruption (MINT) situations. A UE is configured for selecting one of the “list of PLMN(s) to be used in disaster condition” configured by a HPLMN/EPLMN, and “list of PLMN(s) to be used in disaster condition” configured by a VPLMN, in a disaster situation based on a UE configuration. The method discloses selection of at least one Forbidden PLMN (FPLMN) by the CE in a disaster situation, when a primary PLMN list configured by a HPLMN/EPLMN is different from at least one secondary PLMN list configured by at least one VPLMN.

title_en: A method of extracting power system frequency dynamic space-time distribution character information
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of methods for extracting power system frequency dynamic space-time distribution character information, the mains frequency dynamic data that electrical power system wide-area measuring system measures is decomposed first with complex empirical orthogonal functions method, extract the standing wave ingredient and traveling wave ingredient in frequency dynamic change procedure, and the speed that frequency dynamic is propagated in power grid is calculated, obtain the relevant information of characterization power system frequency dynamic space-time distribution character.This method is applied to actual electric network by the present invention, the dynamic variation characteristic of mains frequency after analysis disturbance, the traveling-wave component and standing wave in mains frequency dynamic process can be efficiently extracted, it is analyzed in real time by the metric data to electrical power system wide-area measuring system, the propagation characteristic in power grid can be disturbed with on-line analysis, effective decision information is provided for dispatcher, there is good practical value and application prospect.

title_en: Construction method of risk chain group of rail transit system based on infectious disease model
abstract_en: The invention provides a construction method of a rail transit system risk chain group based on an infectious disease model, which comprises the following steps: determining risk points in the rail transit system, and connecting through edges according to the action relationship of the risk points to form a risk network; then calculating the initial risk point migration measure of the risk points and the coupling measure between the risk points, and further calculating the heterogeneous risk propagation comprehensive probability according to the initial average infection rate of the risk points; on the basis of a traditional infectious disease model, a risk point state migration measure, a risk point coupling measure and a heterogeneous risk propagation probability are combined to construct a rail transit system risk propagation evolution dynamic model, and a risk chain group of a rail transit system is constructed by using an asynchronous updating method according to the rail transit system risk propagation evolution dynamic model. The risk chain group obtained by the method can reflect the propagation and evolution rules of risks in the rail transit system, and can provide theoretical support for rail transit operation management.

title_en: Large-scale distributed photovoltaic simplified clustering method and device for weak measurement scene
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of distributed photovoltaics, and discloses a large-scale distributed photovoltaic simplified clustering method and device for weak measurement scenes, wherein the method comprises the following steps: under the situation that the large-scale distributed photovoltaic measurement information is incomplete, key points with the closest force characteristics of the distributed photovoltaic grid-connected points are extracted based on the Morse theory, a reliable simplified topology containing the large-scale distributed photovoltaic distribution network is established, the effective information of the key node multi-source measurement data is fully mined on the basis, and affine propagation clustering is adopted to enhance the rationality of distributed photovoltaic cluster division. The method provided by the invention can effectively eliminate redundant topological structures while avoiding excessive extraction of historical data characteristics, effectively improve the accuracy of Morse-Smale complex form on the description of the output characteristics of each grid-connected point, realize rapid clustering of high-dimension and multi-type measurement information, and synchronously improve the clustering effect and the computing performance.

title_en: Transmission and distribution collaborative low-carbon economic dispatching method and system based on target cascading method
abstract_en: The invention provides a transmission and distribution cooperation low-carbon economic dispatching method based on a target cascading method, which comprises the steps of establishing a transmission and distribution layered dispatching framework, analyzing interactive power characteristics under typical load output, setting decoupling variables of a transmission and distribution network by combining a physical coupling relation, constructing related criteria of transmission and distribution cooperation consistency based on the target cascading method, and constructing a transmission and distribution cooperation low-carbon optimization model based on the target cascading method by combining constraint conditions such as voltage constraint, tide constraint and the like according to the transmission and distribution layered dispatching framework and considering an electric carbon coupling calculation method. According to the invention, the transmission and distribution collaborative low-carbon economic dispatching method based on the target cascade method is applied to the transmission and distribution collaborative dispatching, so that the influence of the dynamic carbon emission factor on the purchase and sale power of the transmission network and the distribution network is considered, and compared with the traditional transmission and distribution collaborative dispatching, the transmission network layer can be guided to purchase clean electric energy, and the carbon emission of a traditional unit is reduced.

title_en: Enterprise digital operation real-time data analysis method based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses an enterprise digital operation real-time data analysis method based on multi-source data fusion, which relates to the technical field of data processing and solves the technical problems that firstly, an enterprise comprehensive benefit index is difficult to analyze and predict, secondly, a knowledge graph is difficult to embed into a vector space to construct a dynamic graph neural network, then, an equipment abnormal offset, a supply chain abnormal offset and customer activity are difficult to analyze, a risk matrix is constructed, a comprehensive benefit index descending propagation path is identified, service link resources are difficult to dynamically allocate according to an analysis result of the risk matrix, and finally, the data analysis result is difficult to visually display. According to the invention, by collecting and preprocessing enterprise multisource data, a three-dimensional vector space and a dynamic graph neural network are constructed, enterprise benefits and risks are predicted by combining multiple technical analysis, resources of a business link are dynamically allocated, and a data analysis result is visually displayed.

title_en: LNG cold energy cascade utilization equipment and high-pressure gas storage tank capacity collaborative configuration optimization method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for optimizing collaborative configuration of LNG cold energy cascade utilization equipment and high-pressure gas storage tank capacity. The method comprises the steps of establishing LNG cold energy cascade power generation-refrigeration capacity configuration and operation models, establishing high-pressure gas storage tank capacity configuration and operation models according to optional number parameters of the high-pressure gas storage tank, taking distributed resources in a multi-functional micro-grid system, purchasing electricity with an upper power grid and balance constraint of electric-cold-gas multi-energy flows into consideration, aiming at minimizing total configuration investment cost and operation cost in a planning period, establishing a multi-functional micro-grid energy management optimization model comprising LNG cold energy cascade utilization, constructing fuzzy sets based on Wasserstein distance according to prediction data of new energy output and electric-cold-gas load during planning, converting the models into two-stage distribution robust collaborative configuration optimization models, and solving to obtain the optimal configuration capacity of the LNG cold energy cascade utilization equipment and the high-pressure gas storage tank.

title_en: Latency-capacity-and energy-aware VNF placement in edge computing environments
abstract_en: One example method includes creating an ILP model that includes a delay model, an energy model, and a QoS model, and modeling, using the integer linear programming model, a VNF placement problem as an ILP problem, and the modeling includes: using the delay model to identify propagation, transmission, processing, and queuing, delays implied by enabling an instance of the VNF at an edge node to accept a user VNF call; using the energy model to identify energy consumption implied by enabling an instance of the VNF at an edge node to accept a user VNF call; and using the QoS model to identify end-to-end delay, bandwidth consumption, and jitter, implied by enabling an instance of the VNF at an edge node to accept a user virtual network function call. The problem modeled by the ILP model may be resolved by a heuristic method.

title_en: Deep reinforcement learning-based power system sequence recovery method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for sequentially restoring an electric power system based on deep reinforcement learning. Based on the power network after cascade failure, the recovery capability of the power network system to the cascade failure in the system recovery process is evaluated through a bus recovery sequence obtained after deep reinforcement learning, the reinforcement learning is combined with the power network, the recovery problem of the power network is considered from the aspect of defenders, the realization range of the power network is expanded through the combination with the neural network, and the optimal recovery strategy of the large-scale power grid can be found.

title_en: Earthquake phase pickup method based on time-frequency analysis and deep learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to a seismic phase pickup method based on time-frequency analysis and deep learning, which belongs to the field of seismology, and comprises the steps of establishing a deep neural network comprising an empirical mode decomposition module, a residual error contraction module, an LSTM layer, a transducer layer, an up-sampling layer and a convolution layer, adopting a linear rectification function as an activation function, adopting an Adam self-adaptive optimization function to carry out counter propagation, adopting a binary cross entropy loss function as a loss function, and adopting an average absolute error function, an error standard deviation, an accuracy rate, a recall rate and an F1 fraction as evaluation indexes to obtain a deep neural network model. When the frequencies of noise, P wave and S wave are different, the empirical mode decomposition can effectively separate the P wave from the S wave, thereby helping the network to better identify the P wave and the S wave. Even for broadband noise, the noise is decomposed into different eigenmode functions, so that the noise content in the eigenmode functions where the P wave and the S wave are located is reduced. The time-frequency analysis method can effectively improve the noise immunity of the network.

title_en: Residential user short-term electricity consumption prediction method and system based on cluster classification and back propagation neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical fields of power system load prediction, artificial intelligent neural network, data mining and machine learning, in particular to a residential user short-term electricity consumption prediction method and system based on cluster classification and back propagation neural network. The method comprises the steps of acquiring residential user electricity consumption data every 15 minutes by using a metering automation system, carrying out data statistics, classifying residential user electricity consumption behaviors by using a fuzzy c clustering algorithm, reflecting the user electricity consumption behaviors by using historical electricity consumption data of users, selecting factors affecting the user electricity consumption as input of a back propagation neural network, determining weights according to the influence degree, and carrying out short-term electricity consumption prediction by taking the weighted influence factors and the historical electricity consumption data as learning samples of a classified BP neural network. By the aid of the refined prediction method, operation efficiency and reliability of the power system can be effectively improved, energy consumption is reduced, and intelligent energy management is achieved.

title_en: Flood disaster cascade event evolution prediction method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of flood disaster prediction and discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for predicting the evolution of a flood disaster cascade event. According to the method, entity nodes and relationship types in a river basin are built into knowledge graphs updated along with time, the evolution of a flood disaster cascade event is reflected in real time by utilizing a node attribute dynamic update and a relationship edge weight dynamic adjustment mechanism, meanwhile, time features are embedded into the knowledge graph nodes and relationship edges, the time dependence represented by the nodes is enhanced, finally, a relationship evolution graph convolution neural network is adopted to infer the knowledge graphs, information of neighbor nodes is aggregated through the graph convolution neural network by utilizing each relationship edge, and respective propagation intensity is adjusted based on the relationship types, so that the result output by the graph convolution network is focused on the structural relationship among the nodes, the edge weight is adjusted according to the change of the node attribute, and the development venation of the flood disaster is accurately simulated.
assignees: CHINA THREE GORGES CORP;CHINA YANGTZE POWER CO LTD;CHINA INST OF WATER RESOURCES AND HYDROPOWER RESEARCH
