title_en: Groundwater safety assessment method under extreme climate event
abstract_en: The invention relates to an underground water safety assessment method under extreme weather events, which comprises the steps of collecting multi-source heterogeneous data such as weather, geology, hydrology and remote sensing, constructing a unified underground water safety knowledge graph through standardized cleaning, semantic alignment and missing complementation, monitoring the extreme weather events in real time, updating node relation weights and sparsifying transmission paths based on knowledge graph dynamic evolution and time sequence attention mechanisms, carrying out risk propagation path reasoning on the dynamic knowledge graph by combining an improved graph neural network, identifying key pollution nodes, outputting structured risk grades and coping suggestions, and realizing high adaptability and reasoning accuracy of emergency response by a system based on evolution feedback continuous optimization graph and model parameters. The method improves the intelligence, the real-time performance and the accuracy of the groundwater risk assessment. The method solves the problems that the underground water pollution propagation path is difficult to dynamically identify and the decision adaptability is insufficient under the extreme climate event.
assignees: SCIENT INSTITUTE OF PEARL RIVER WATER RESOURCES PROTECTION

title_en: Multi-mode dynamic cooperation-based voltage out-of-limit prediction method
abstract_en: The invention is applicable to the technical field of voltage out-of-limit prediction, and provides a voltage out-of-limit prediction method based on multi-modal dynamic coordination, which comprises the steps of collecting multi-modal data of a target area, inputting the preprocessed data into a pre-trained multi-modal collaborative evaluation network to extract multi-modal characteristics, and outputting a comprehensive voltage out-of-limit risk index after fusing the characteristics; and according to the magnitude of the comprehensive voltage threshold crossing risk index, invoking a time sequence extrapolation model, a multi-mode fusion prediction model and a space-time propagation simulation model to conduct voltage threshold crossing prediction, obtaining the voltage threshold crossing probability of each node relative to the dynamic voltage threshold crossing probability in the future preset time based on the output of the invoked prediction model, and determining a key target node and an estimated influence range. According to the method, the prediction models with different complexity are intelligently called according to different risk levels, and the dynamic voltage safety domain boundary is introduced, so that the prediction robustness in a high dynamic scene is effectively improved.

title_en: Double-layer international railway freight network toughness assessment method based on cascade failure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascade failure-based dual-layer international railway freight network toughness assessment method, which belongs to the technical field of road traffic network assessment and comprises the steps of constructing a topology model of a basic circuit network and a transportation service network, constructing a network assessment system and an importance assessment system of each node in the network, constructing a cascade failure-based network vulnerability assessment model, combining each network and assessment model, simulating a cascade failure condition through a simulation experiment, and evaluating the network by combining the assessment system, wherein the model adopts a node state model for improving CML and a cargo redistribution strategy. The invention takes the characteristics of international railway freight into consideration, constructs a double-layer coupling network of a basic line network and a transportation service network, establishes a multidimensional toughness evaluation index system and a cargo allocation mechanism, and can simulate the cascade failure condition in the international railway freight network.

title_en: Collective intelligence routing robot and path control system including the same
title_ko: 군집지능 라우팅 로봇 장치와 이를 포함하는 이동경로 제어 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A collective intelligence routing robot and a transfer path control system including the same are provided to widely apply to observe, reconnoiter, extinguish by providing various collective intelligence robot services. CONSTITUTION: A collective intelligence routing robot comprises a wireless communications network to transmit communication between the collective intelligence routing robots transferring under atypical environment inside a cluster in which a plurality of collective intelligence robots comprises. The collective intelligence routing robot selects the position to maintain communication state between the collective intelligence robots for connecting based on network resource information management of the collective intelligence robots. [Reference numerals] (203) Message layer; (211) Topology manager; (212) Position manager; (213) Traffic manager; (214) Resource manager; (215) Network configuration manager; (A,B,C,D) Cluster; (AA) Service; (BB) Communication multimedia; (CC) Remote control/monitoring; (DD) Maintenance; (EE) Duty execution; (FF) Error prediction; (GG) Middleware; (HH) Network; (II) Robot; (JJ,KK) Wireless
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 군집지능 라우팅 로봇 장치와 이를 포함하는 이동경로 제어 시스템에 관한 것으로, 군집지능 로봇들의 클러스터 기반 동적 애드 혹 메시 네트워크 구성 관리 및 전파 강도, 전파 유효 거리, 전파 간섭, 물리적/논리적 네트워크 토폴로지 및 네트워크 링크 상태 등과 같은 네트워크 리소스 정보 관리를 기반으로 하며, 연결 설정을 하고자 하는 군집지능 로봇들과의 최적의 통신 상태를 유지할 수 있도록 군집지능 라우팅 로봇의 위치를 제어함으로써, 전파의 유효 범위를 벗어난 터널, 하수관, 지하 시설과 같은 음영 지역에 위치한 군집지능 로봇들에게도 실시간 연결성을 제공할 수 있다. 따라서, 음영 지역에서도 임무를 수행할 수 있는 다양한 다중 클러스터형 군집지능 로봇 서비스를 제공할 수 있도록 함으로써 사회 안전, 감시 정찰, 소방 방재 분야에 널리 적용할 수 있는 이점이 있다.

title_en: A Evacuation Rooms Of Buildings Safe From Disasters Such As Fire, Earthquake, And Robbery
title_ko: 화재, 지진 시와 강도 침입 등의 재난으로부터 안전한 건축물의 대피 룸
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a room for enabling evacuees to safely escape from disasters such as fire, earthquake, and robbery and, more specifically, to an evacuation room, which has personal equipment for fire evacuation installed therein to have a location signal generation device and an oxygen supply device, has incombustible materials installed on the front of an inner side thereof, and has oxygen bottles, bottled waters, a pressure measuring device for the oxygen bottles, and a charging device for a battery installed therein. If a fire occurs, it is important for evacuees to survive safely. Thus, the Fire Services Act of Korea stipulates that public facilities that can accommodate people and buildings having a size or more enable an emergency escape, and the installation of space for the devices is mandatory. The present invention can provide the evacuation room, which can store the personal equipment required when a fire suddenly occurs in high-rise buildings, apartments, public buildings, hotels, motels, and complex shopping malls in which fires have occurred, can continuously maintain performance, and can enable evacuees to wait for rescue from the outside in a safe place if quick escape is impossible. The evacuation room can enable evacuees to generate the locations by using radio waves, wait for safety personnel while receiving oxygen, preserve life from invasion of robbers, and wait for rescue from the outside, in a special situation in which the evacuees cannot move from a fire site.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 지진이나 화재, 강도의 침입 등의 재난으로부터 안전하게 대피하기 위한 룸에 관한 것이며, 보다 상세하게는, 위치신호 발생장치와 산소 공급 장치가 설치된 화재 대피용 개인용구가 설치되고, 내측의 전면이 불연재가 설치되며, 산소통과 생수; 상기 산소통의 압력측정 장치와 배터리의 충전장치 등이 설치된 대피 룸에 관한 것이다. 
이처럼 화재 발생 시 대피 자는 안전하게 생존하는 것이 중요하기 때문에 우리나라의 소방법 상에 사람을 수용할 수 있는 공공시설은 물론, 일정 크기 이상의 건물에는 비상 탈출을 할 수 있고, 그 장치의 공간 설치가 의무화 되어 있다. 
화재가 발생한 고층건물, 아파트, 공공건물과 호텔, 모텔, 복잡한 상가 등에서 갑작스런 화재발생시 필요한 개인용구를 보관하고, 성능을 지속적으로 유지하며, 신속한 탈출이 불가능할 경우, 안전한 곳에서 외부로 구조를 기다릴 안전한 대피 룸을 제공하며, 화재현장에서 이동할 수 없는 특수 상황에서 자신의 위치를 전파로 발생시키며, 산소를 공급받으면서 안전요원들을 기다리는 한편, 강도의 침입으로부터 생명을 보존하며, 외부로부터 구조를 기다릴 수 있는 안전 룸을 제공하는 데 있다.

title_en: System and method for providing customized disaster information
title_ko: 맞춤형 재난정보 제공시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and a method for providing customized disaster information and, more specifically, to a system and a method, which generate and publicize region-customized disaster information and medium-customized disaster information when a disaster occurs, so as to minimize unnecessary disaster information reception and quickly publicize a disaster situation. A system for providing customized disaster information, according to an embodiment of the present invention, comprises: an information collection unit for collecting disaster information and weather information when a disaster occurs in a specific facility or region; a control unit for performing real-time monitoring by referring to position information included in the disaster information of the information collection unit, and performing a notification approval procedure; an analysis unit which analyzes the disaster information and the weather information collected by the information collection unit so as to deduce a disaster situation and the range of expected damage, and which checks facilities and warning systems within the range of expected damage; a disaster information generation unit for generating multimedia disaster information content according to the facilities and the warning systems within the range of expected damage on the basis of the information analyzed by the analysis unit; and a notification unit for notifying the facilities and the warning systems, within the range of expected damage, of the multimedia disaster information content generated by the disaster information generation unit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 맞춤형 재난정보 제공시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 재난 발생시 지역맞춤형과 매체맞춤형의 재난정보를 생성 전파하여 불필요한 재난정보 수신을 최소화하고 신속하게 재난상황을 전파하는 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 맞춤형 재난정보 제공시스템은, 특정 시설물이나 지역에 재난이 발생한 경우 재난정보와 기상정보를 수집하는 정보수집부와, 상기 정보수집부의 재난정보에 포함된 위치정보를 참고로 실시간 모니터링하고 통보에 대한 승인절차를 수행하는 관제부와, 상기 정보수집부에서 수집한 재난정보와 기상정보를 분석하여 재난상황 및 피해예상 범위를 도출하고, 그 피해예상 범위 내 시설물과 경보시스템을 확인하는 분석부와, 상기 분석부에서 분석한 정보를 기반으로 피해예상 범위 내 시설물과 경보시스템에 따라 멀티미디어 재난정보 콘텐츠를 생성하는 재난정보생성부, 및 상기 재난정보생성부에서 생성된 멀티미디어 재난정보 콘텐츠를 피해예상 범위 내 시설물과 경보시스템에 통보하는 통보부를 포함하여 구성된다.

title_en: Fracture network fluid flow simulation with enhanced fluid-solid interaction force determination
abstract_en: An illustrative hydraulic fracturing flow simulation method includes: identifying a network of fractures within a formation rock matrix; modeling each fracture in the network as fluid flow path having discrete points at which a fluid pressure is determined; representing the rock matrix with discrete nodes at which a fluid-solid interaction force is determined, each said discrete node being associated with multiple discrete points along a fluid flow path; deriving the fluid-solid interaction force for each node from the fluid pressure at the associated discrete points; estimating an extent of fracture propagation based in part on the fluid-solid interaction forces; and displaying a visual representation of the fracture propagation extent. The deriving includes: obtaining an analytic integral of the fluid pressure as modified by a weighting function for each interval between adjacent ones of the associated discrete points; evaluating the analytic integrals for each interval to obtain contributions; and summing the contributions.

title_en: Simulation-based corridor design for connected autonomous vehicles
abstract_en: A method for generating an infrastructure management plan is described. The method may include determining, via a Regional Traffic Simulation (RTS) model, an opportunity area for connected and automated vehicle (CAV) integrated traffic flow. Generating a regional key performance indicator associated with the opportunity area and modeling a regional KPI associated with local traffic in the opportunity area using a Local Traffic Simulation (LTS) model. The method may further include determining a local KPI associated with the opportunity area, generating a tentative traffic solution associated with the opportunity area, connecting the LTS model to the RTS model using an outer feedback loop, and determining a ripple effect of the tentative traffic solution via the RTS model. The method concludes with generating the infrastructure management plan comprising the change to the LTS model responsive to confirming an improvement to the regional KPI and the local KPI.

title_en: Network selection method and apparatus
abstract_en: Embodiments of a network selection method and a related apparatus are provided. In the method, an apparatus receives a broadcast message from a non-forbidden public land mobile network (PLMN) and a broadcast message from a forbidden PLMN. The broadcast message of the forbidden PLMN includes a disaster occurrence indication, and the disaster occurrence indication indicates that a disaster has occurred on the non-forbidden PLMN. The apparatus requests, based on the disaster occurrence indication, to register with the forbidden PLMN, when the apparatus fails to register with the non-forbidden PLMN. According to the foregoing method, the apparatus can select a network that ensures a normal service, and a service interruption to the apparatus caused by the disaster that occurs on the non-forbidden PLMN can be effectively reduced.

title_en: Mechanical fault diagnosis method using parallel deep neural network hierarchical feature extraction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mechanical fault diagnosis method based on parallel deep neural network hierarchical feature extraction, which comprises the following steps: taking a rotating machinery fault data set as a sample set to obtain initial parameters of a deep neural network model; inputting all samples in the sample set into a deep neural network model to obtain an output result; comparing the output result with the sample label, and calculating a total classification error; calculating the error of each layer by using the classification error through an error back propagation algorithm, and updating the parameters of the network; recalculating the output result of each sample by using the deep neural network model after the network parameters are updated; and (5) performing iteration until the classification error reaches a preset value or the iteration frequency reaches an upper limit, and outputting network parameters and a classification result. The invention directly takes the collected mechanical signal as input, avoids a large amount of preprocessing operation, and improves the classification precision and the calculation efficiency by the layered feature extraction of the parallel deep neural network.

title_en: Semi-physical antenna simulation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a semi-physical antenna simulation method and system, belonging to the technical field of microwaves. Extracting S parameters of a double port of a matching circuit by using a vector network analyzer, importing S parameter data into three-dimensional electromagnetic simulation software, and then cascading the S parameter data with an antenna model; and then simulating the semi-physical antenna model by three-dimensional electromagnetic simulation software, and obtaining the final antenna performance result by means of the simulation software. The invention takes the influence of resistance loss, parasitic capacitance and inductance in the circuit on the antenna into consideration, avoids the interference of ground and surrounding environment on the antenna measurement in actual measurement, and more accurately and conveniently obtains the far field performance of the antenna.

title_en: Coordinated multi-region power transmission maintenance method, device, computer equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of power grid overhaul, in particular to a coordinated multi-region power transmission overhaul method, a coordinated multi-region power transmission overhaul device, computer equipment and a medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring the net load peak-valley time periods of each region, and constructing a key time period set; acquiring the output cost relation and the electric quantity standby relation of each area in the key time period set; constructing an upper maintenance plan model according to the output cost relation, the electric quantity standby relation, the tie line power and the upper constraint of each area; constructing an area maintenance plan model according to the output cost relation of each area, the power of the connecting line and the area constraint; and (3) carrying out iterative computation on the two models by adopting a target cascading algorithm based on the tie line power to obtain the power transmission maintenance plan of each region. By implementing the invention, the current cascade algorithm is adopted, and different optimization modes of two-stage scheduling are considered through two-stage coordination. Meanwhile, the calculation scale under the complex constraint of regional standby, related network safety and the like is reduced, and the calculation efficiency can meet the actual requirements of multi-region power grid dispatching.

title_en: Power quality abnormality tracing and purifying strategy generation system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power quality monitoring and treatment, and discloses a power quality anomaly tracing and purifying strategy generation system. The electric energy acquisition module acquires waveform data of key nodes of the group network in real time and sets a monitoring interval, the characteristic analysis module decomposes spectral characteristics to generate pollution characteristic vectors, the anomaly tracing module extracts core index construction tracing rules, the pollution evaluation module identifies propagation paths to calculate pollution indexes, the parameter optimization module derives optimal parameters to generate deviation sequences, and the strategy generation module integrates the sequences to form a purification strategy. The system realizes abnormal accurate tracing and dynamic management, improves the comprehensive analysis and strategy intelligent level, and is suitable for electric energy quality control of the power grid.

title_en: Improved integer programming method-based optimum PMU (Power Management Unit) placement method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an improved integer programming method-based optimum PMU (Power Management Unit) placement method. A PMU is adopted to serve as the fingerprint features of a failure trend, and thus, the mathematical model for observable OPP (Optimum PMU Placement) problems of an electric network is a formula (shown as a drawing), wherein f(X)=AX=Y, Y1 and Y2 are subsets of Y, Y1 represents a corresponding vector set of nodes irrelevant to 0 injection nodes, Y2 represents a corresponding vector set of nodes relevant to the 0 injection nodes, X= [x1, x2 to xn] and represents a placement vector of the PMU of a node, xi is a binary variable, the value of the xi is equal to 1 when a node i is placed with the PMU and is equal to 0 when the node i is not placed with the PMU; A is a node-relevant matrix, and all diagonal entries of the A are 1; supposed that m nodes are irrelevant to the 0 injection nodes, a formula (shown as a drawing) is a m*1 matrix; and Tmj represents a relational matrix of the 0 injection nodes and relevant nodes of the 0 injection nodes, and Bmj represents a corresponding vector set. With the adoption of the technical scheme, the method has the advantages that: the decision-making level fusion based on switching value failure diagnosis and electrical quantity failure diagnosis is effectively achieved, the real-time performance is high, the essence of cascading failures can be grasped, meanwhile, the defects in the traditional failure diagnosis are made up to some extent, and the investment can be effectively saved at the same time that the diagnostic accuracy is ensured.

title_en: Bulk power grid strategic corridor dynamic identificaton method based on circuit vulnerability inder
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of bulk power grid strategic corridor dynamic identificaton method based on circuit vulnerability inder, including obtain power network line information and establish the reliability model of circuit；Calculate the vulnerability inder of circuit；Dynamic Identification is carried out to the strategic corridor of bulk power grid.The present invention can calculate under diverse geographic location, different weather situation by using meter and the circuit operational reliability model of meteorological geographic factor and Line Flow and different loads level descends the line fault probability of dynamic change；For trigger the less circuit of system cascading failure probability, according to set forth herein weighting vulnerability inder quickly calculated and sorted；And compared to the vulnerability inder based on load factor entropy, the vulnerability inder based on load factor variance is sensitiveer and directly perceived, and physical significance is also very clear and definite.
assignees: STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;ECONOMIC TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: A kind of operation of power networks failure disposition data visualization analysis method of Process-Oriented
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of operation of power networks failure disposition data visualization analysis method of Process-Oriented, firstly, establishing operation of power networks failure Analysis of The Disposal assessment indicator system；Secondly, configuring corresponding weight and scoring element in the database to evaluation index；Then, the event of failure for needing to analyze is chosen, assay is started, analysis evaluation module is independently calculated, goes out corresponding calculated value according to the scoring element factor calculation of configuration, further calculate out overall assessment result further according to the weight of configuration；Finally, assay result is formed visualization assessment report.The causality of the hierarchical relationship and failure disposal process between evaluation goal can be fully demonstrated using the present invention, trace the specific origin cause of formation of operation risk, track the implementation progress of failure disposition, the effect assessment for drawing failure disposition meets the business habit and functional requirement of operation risk evaluation index and the cascade inquiry of failure disposal process data flowization.
assignees: NARI TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;STATE GRID NINGXIA ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID NARI NANJING CONTROL SYSTEM CO LTD;NARI GROUP CORP

title_en: The automatic switching method and system of disaster-ridden kind of the power grid of D5000-matpower coupling cascading failure model
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of automatic switching method of disaster-ridden kind of the power grid coupling cascading failure model of D5000-matpower, comprising: the first data are obtained from D5000 system；The second data are obtained from Relay Protection Setting Calculation System；The transformer model of first data is converted into model of power transmission system；The capacity for taking the transformer in the first data is updated as the limit current-carrying capacity of the transmission line of electricity in model of power transmission system into the first data；Judge whether the element title in the second data matches with element title in the first data；From the first data, parameter needed for choosing description model of matpower and secondary model establishes a model and secondary model as member variable respectively；The probability for obtaining each failure in the electric network element fault set and set under disaster-ridden kind of coupling condition, determines that parameter needed for describing each failure in electric network element fault set as member variable, obtains disaster-ridden kind of coupling cascading failure model of power grid.The accuracy that the present invention improves the efficiency of model generation and model generates.
assignees: State grid hunan electric power co ltd;STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD DISASTER PREVENTION & MITIGATION CT;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Electric power information physical system cascading failure prediction method based on risk element theory
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for predicting cascading failure of a power information physical system based on a risk element theory, which comprises the following steps: 1. correcting the power grid community partition result by a Prim algorithm; 2. constructing a power information physical system; 3. constructing a risk transfer function of the fault, and calculating the initial fault probability of the line and the initial failure probability of the information node to form an initial fault set of an accident chain; 4. selecting a fault stage, and when corresponding fault on-off information is uploaded to a dispatching center, the dispatching center issues a corresponding control command; 5. sequentially selecting a fault line and a failure node in the next fault stage according to a subsequent risk transfer function; 6. and traversing the initial fault set, repeating the steps 4-5 until the end condition is met, recording accident chain data and outputting the accident chain data. The method can dynamically describe the development process of the interactive propagation of the faults in the power grid and the information grid in the power information physical system, thereby providing theoretical guidance for the prevention and control of the cascading faults of the power information physical system.

title_en: Reservoir group scheduling decision behavior mining method and reservoir scheduling automatic control device
abstract_en: The invention provides a reservoir group scheduling decision behavior mining method and an automatic reservoir scheduling control device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: step 1, determining a research situation, collecting basic data of a reservoir group system, historical scheduling data and meteorological data of reservoir area sites, and determining influence factors and decision variables of reservoir group scheduling behaviors; step 2, determining a deep learning algorithm for excavating reservoir group scheduling decision behaviors; step 3, checking the accuracy of the reservoir group scheduling data; step 4, constructing a reservoir group scheduling decision behavior mining model coupling the reservoir basic principle and the deep learning model; and 5, calibrating the hyper-parameters of the model based on the training set sample, reversely propagating and updating the network parameters of the model based on the model loss function, determining the optimal hyper-parameters of the model according to the simulation precision of the model in the test set, and finally establishing the mapping relation between the influence factors of the reservoir group scheduling behaviors and the decision variables to realize the mining of the reservoir group scheduling decision behaviors.

title_en: Method for realizing networking communication of low-power-consumption wireless equipment for fire fighting
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for realizing networking communication of low-power-consumption wireless equipment for fire fighting, which comprises a mode of communication between the wireless equipment and a host and a mode of independent work of the wireless equipment, and realizes remote communication of the wireless equipment through wireless networking under the condition that a repeater is not required to be installed. In the mode of communication between the wireless equipment and the host, the wireless equipment is arranged according to the coding address sequence in a link mode, each wireless equipment is used as a transfer station, information is transmitted to the next stage according to the direction of raising or lowering the coding address, a first wake-up command is sent when the information is transmitted, the first wake-up command is used for activating the whole link, all the wireless equipment is in a wake-up mode, then the information is sent again, the sleep mode is entered after the information is sent, and the information is a control command sent by the host or fire alarm and fault information reported by the wireless equipment. Under the mode that the wireless equipment works independently, a plurality of wireless equipment are arranged according to the coding address sequence in a link mode or an array mode to form array type or cascade type alarm in the area.
assignees: CRUMP TIANJIAN FIRE FIGHTING EQUIPMENT LTD COMPANY

title_en: Fault diagnosis method for high-power magnetic plasma electric propulsion system
abstract_en: The invention provides a fault diagnosis method of a high-power magnetic plasma electric propulsion system, which belongs to the field of fault diagnosis and specifically comprises the following steps: firstly, establishing a high-power magnetic plasma propeller simulation model, and obtaining data in a fault-free state after operation; then setting a fault factor and adding the fault factor to a high-power magnetic plasma propeller simulation model to form a fault simulation simulator, and acquiring data of a fault state; building a cascade feedforward neural network, and performing supervised learning training by using fault-free data and fault data; finally, fault data serving as test signal state quantity are input into the trained neural network by using a fault simulation simulator, output results of the neural network are counted and compared with real fault states, and accuracy is counted; the invention has the characteristics of high diagnosis accuracy and strong adaptability.

title_en: Evaporation waveguide beyond-view-range emergency communication modeling method and system based on ray tracing
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of wireless communication networks, and provides an evaporative waveguide beyond-view-range emergency communication modeling and system based on ray tracing. The method comprises the steps of calculating the vertical distribution of the atmospheric thermodynamic temperature, the atmospheric pressure and the water vapor pressure, and inverting the evaporation waveguide parameters to obtain the distribution of the refractive index in the vertical direction; tracking ray tracks according to the distribution of the refractive index in the vertical direction; comparing the height of each ray at the horizontal distance of the receiving antenna with the height of the receiving antenna to obtain possible intrinsic rays meeting preset conditions; determining whether possible intrinsic rays are intrinsic rays, screening the intrinsic rays to find a plurality of intrinsic rays with different paths as departure angles Center ray of tube, computed rayThe maximum height difference of all rays in the tube at the horizontal distance of the receiving antenna is obtained to obtain the vertical cross section width of the tube, so that the propagation factor and the path loss of each intrinsic ray are calculated.
assignees: INFORMATION COMMUNICATION CO STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV SHANDONG;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Risk assessment method and device for gas pipeline leakage, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a risk assessment method, a risk assessment device, equipment and a storage medium for gas pipeline leakage, wherein the assessment method comprises the following steps: obtaining a first disaster event set and a first disaster bearing body set by processing data of the accident case set; constructing a first transmission network according to the causal relationship among a plurality of first disaster events; dynamically adjusting the first propagation network according to the peripheral condition of the target gas pipeline to obtain a second propagation network; determining the probability of the third disaster event causing the event to be evaluated; determining the connectivity of the event to be evaluated according to the second propagation network; determining a loss coefficient of the event to be evaluated according to the disaster-bearing body associated with the event to be evaluated; and determining the risk value of the event to be evaluated according to the probability, the connectivity and the loss coefficient. The method and the system can accurately predict the disaster events possibly caused by the gas pipeline and the propagation risk of the disaster events.
assignees: SHENZHEN URBAN PUBLIC SECURITY TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Engine system safety analysis method and system and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an engine system safety analysis method, an engine system safety analysis system and electronic equipment, and relates to the technical field of system safety analysis. The invention constructs the finite state machine network model to describe the transfer characteristic of the functional state of the engine system and the propagation rule of the system failure more clearly and accurately. Three main security analysis factors can be accurately determined based on a system state transition network, so that potential risks of the initial state of the system can be identified as early as possible by determining the security risks in the actual application process; by excavating a critical path of system failure propagation, risk prevention and control are facilitated in advance, and large-scale diffusion of system failure is prevented; the fault tree is generated, so that the reasons and rules of the occurrence of the risk event can be diagnosed in a targeted way towards the system safety requirement, and the problems that the subjective factors are strong or the influence caused by poor interaction among the states of the components is difficult to capture in the existing safety analysis method can be solved, and the safety boundary of the engine system is accurately determined.

title_en: Automobile merchant intelligent risk identification system based on merchant state self-monitoring
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of risk identification, in particular to an automobile merchant intelligent risk identification system based on merchant state self-monitoring, which comprises a market dynamic prediction module, a strategy network analysis module, a risk level assessment module, a resource dynamic allocation module, a fuzzy logic risk assessment module, an anomaly detection early warning module, a time window analysis module and a risk management strategy generation module. According to the invention, the opportunity and risk identification accuracy is improved through an autoregressive moving average algorithm and a linear regression model, the social network analysis method is applied to strategy network analysis, the risk propagation path prediction accuracy is improved, the fault tree analysis method and the fuzzy logic model are applied, the risk management effectiveness is improved, the dynamic allocation of resources is optimized through a linear programming model, the resource allocation efficiency is improved, the statistical method and the moving average method are improved, the abnormal point identification accuracy and the risk early warning timeliness are improved, the multi-criterion decision analysis and Monte Carlo simulation are enhanced, and the risk management strategy formulation and optimization are enhanced.
assignees: BEIJING JIZHI CAR NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Heat supply network operation efficiency evaluation method based on data prediction
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of heat supply network operation efficiency evaluation, and discloses a heat supply network operation efficiency evaluation method based on data prediction. The method comprises the steps of constructing a structure transformation result matrix, constructing a graph modeling structure, extracting disturbance characteristics, constructing a graph propagation modulation mechanism, generating a structure disturbance response representation, identifying a structure behavior type, completing node flow prediction by combining a basic predictor, comparing and analyzing a prediction result with actual operation data, judging the degree of fit between the node operation state and a target heat supply requirement, and outputting an operation efficiency evaluation result of a heat supply network. According to the method, through introducing a disturbance-driven graph propagation mechanism and a multi-mode structure identification strategy, modeling capacity and prediction accuracy of nonlinear structure response in a complex heating system are effectively improved, and support is provided for real-time evaluation and efficiency management of the system running state.
assignees: JINING JIAXIANG PUBLIC HEAT SUPPLY CO LTD

title_en: Real-time power grid topology analysis method based on graph neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a real-time power grid topology analysis method based on a graph neural network, which comprises the steps of firstly, carrying out electric topology analysis by constructing an optimized power system physical connection model and combining a Label Propagation Algorithm (LPA) at a substation level, accurately identifying a calculation region, and simultaneously, optimizing the calculation region division by utilizing the Graph Neural Network (GNN), enhancing the topology adaptability, reducing the false division and improving the robustness of the equipment state change. In addition, the method further improves the instantaneity, the accuracy and the intelligent level of the power grid topology analysis by predicting the influence of the state change of the circuit breaker and the disconnecting switch on the power grid topology and training the GNN model and the Reinforcement Learning (RL) optimization region division strategy through historical data. Finally, bus-branch connection is optimized through depth-first search (DFS), topology integrity is ensured, and efficiency of electric island analysis, power supply area division and fault recovery is remarkably improved. The method effectively improves the instantaneity, the accuracy and the intelligent level of the power grid topology analysis.
assignees: NANJING POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Gangue storage bin intelligent early warning management system based on coal preparation processing
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of intelligent management of ore storage, and discloses an intelligent early warning management system of a gangue storage bin based on coal preparation processing, which comprises a distributed phase change sensing network module, a storage module and a control module, wherein the distributed phase change sensing network module is connected with the storage module; the system comprises a distributed phase change sensing network module, a phase change memory tensor construction module, a memory tensor maintenance module, a multi-time-scale frequency division coupling prediction module, a memory guidance activation control module, a memory learning network reconstruction module and a multi-scale early warning decision module, wherein the distributed phase change sensing network module is connected with the phase change memory tensor construction module, the memory tensor maintenance module is connected with the phase change memory tensor construction module, the multi-time-scale frequency division coupling prediction module is connected with the distributed phase change sensing network module, and the memory guidance activation control module is connected with the multi-time-scale frequency division coupling prediction module. Through integral operation and multi-time scale memory kernel function, the technical effects of structural solidification and deep learning of the time-space evolution information of the historical multi-physical phase change field are achieved, so that the early warning management system can identify key precursor features and propagation paths from historical events, and the knowledge base of early warning decisions is improved.
assignees: INNER MONGOLIA GUANGHUI COAL PREPARATION CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent power distribution equipment state on-line monitoring and evaluating method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent power distribution equipment state on-line monitoring and evaluating method and system, which relate to the technical field of intelligent power grids and comprise the steps of obtaining fault characteristic data of target equipment, carrying out semantic mapping based on a power distribution equipment knowledge graph, and acquiring a candidate source device set through the topological connection relationship, calculating a time sequence consistency score and a tracing confidence coefficient, determining a fault source device, extracting a fault propagation link and a transmission mechanism, and generating an analysis result. The invention realizes the rapid positioning and tracing of the faults of the power distribution equipment, improves the fault processing efficiency and reduces the power failure loss.
assignees: STATE GRID JIBEI POWER CO LTD SMART DISTRIB NETWORK CENTER

title_en: Multi-disaster-oriented environment-coupled power grid vulnerability assessment method, system and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-disaster-oriented environment coupling type power grid vulnerability assessment method and system, which relate to the technical field of fault assessment, wherein the power transmission line is decomposed into electric tower nodes and virtual nodes, so that the calculation complexity of linear damage is reduced, the second-level time sequence simulation of a power grid is supported, and a multi-disaster unified coupling mechanism is constructed, namely a geographic matrix, an environment matrix and a meteorological matrix are constructed, various disaster damage models are driven, and the joint quantification of a 'disaster chain' physical process is realized; and finally, taking the topological power supply availability and the cascade failure fault condition as damage measurement indexes, and respectively carrying out grid vulnerability assessment under the earthquake disaster scene and the storm disaster scene, thereby solving the problem of underestimation of faults caused by neglecting power redistribution in the traditional model.
assignees: PLA INFORMATION SUPPORT FORCE ENGINEERING UNIV

title_en: Earthquake distribution system
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an earthquake distribution system with which real-time earthquake information regarding a number of earthquakes occurred in Japan can be received at any time by a mobile phone, PDA or personal computer to individually confirm the focus of an earthquake in a map of surrounding regions.  <P>SOLUTION: An earthquake information transmission center receives earthquake information from earthquake observation network in each region to continuously transmit to an information distribution center basic earthquake data obtained by calculating the focus of an earthquake, magnitude, depth, and the time of occurrence. The information distribution center performs operation and analysis of a predicted intensity, propagation zones having more than a predetermined intensity, and principal motion propagation time etc. from the received basic earthquake data, and stores the results in database. In addition, the information distribution center adds and stores map data including the geographic name of the focus of an earthquake corresponding to the focus of an earthquake. On the other hand, a terminal device which is a distribution target receives via communication circuit network predetermined earthquake data as well as the map data by accessing the information distribution center.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Numerical simulation method and system for simulating expansion of fracture in conglomerate
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for simulating hydraulic fracture propagation numerical simulation of a conglomerate reservoir, wherein the method comprises the steps of S1, establishing a geological model of the conglomerate reservoir according to geological characteristic parameters of the conglomerate reservoir, S2, establishing a geomechanical model of the conglomerate reservoir according to geological mechanical parameter characteristics of the conglomerate reservoir, S3, analyzing the geological characteristic parameters and geomechanical parameters of the conglomerate reservoir to obtain a ground stress direction and natural fracture distribution parameters, S4, analyzing fracture technological parameters of the conglomerate reservoir, establishing a pumping program, S5, and carrying out hydraulic fracture complex fracture network propagation simulation calculation by combining the results obtained in the step S3 and the step S4 to obtain a fracture simulation result. The method can consider complex fracture network expansion and interaction when the hydraulic fracture tip is intersected with the natural fracture to judge whether the hydraulic fracture is crossing or cutting off, can consider fracturing fluid flow and propping agent migration, calculates stress shadows by applying a boundary element method, and considers inter-fracture interference.

title_en: Flexible power supply system and method based on photovoltaic energy storage
abstract_en: The application discloses a flexible power supply system and a method based on photovoltaic energy storage, which are characterized in that a time sequence analysis is carried out on historical power generation capacity and historical weather data of a photovoltaic power station by adopting an artificial intelligence technology based on deep learning, a time sequence dynamic change mode of the historical power generation capacity and the historical weather data in a global time domain is respectively captured by a local time sequence feature extraction and feature time sequence propagation aggregation mechanism, and a nonlinear association relation between the power generation capacity and weather conditions is excavated by carrying out multi-scale interactive response analysis on the historical power generation capacity and the historical weather data, so that decoding prediction of the photovoltaic power generation capacity is carried out. Therefore, the prediction accuracy can be effectively improved, complex and changeable weather conditions can be better adapted, and the requirements of the modern intelligent power grid on accurate prediction and efficient management are met.

title_en: Building body flexible regulation potential prediction method
abstract_en: A building body flexible regulation potential prediction method includes the steps of building a building group energy consumption model based on a back propagation neural network, enabling each energy consumption system sub-model to take characteristic data of influence parameters of energy consumption of each energy consumption system as input, enabling the power saving rate of the corresponding energy consumption system to be the maximum first-stage optimization target, outputting energy consumption prediction values of each energy consumption system under different time periods, adopting a distributed entropy improved self-adaptive grid searching particle swarm method, enabling the power saving rate of a building group to be the maximum second-stage optimization target, determining energy consumption prediction minimum values of each energy consumption system under different time periods, utilizing the extreme value of each energy consumption system and the deviation of the power saving rate of the building group to update the energy consumption prediction minimum values, enabling the energy consumption prediction minimum values of each energy consumption system under different time periods to be spliced according to time sequence to serve as building group energy consumption prediction values, enabling the difference between the building group energy consumption actual values and the building group energy consumption prediction values to be the ratio in the building group energy consumption actual values, and enabling accurate prediction to be achieved.

title_en: Asynchronous remote data copying method and device
abstract_en: An asynchronous remote data copying method is executed separately in a production center and a disaster tolerance center; an application in a local production center host system sends out a plurality of write requests successively; following writing can be continued just after data are written into a production center storage system; the production center and the disaster tolerance center perform multiple data copying successively, namely, lag of multiple writing operations between two systems is allowed. The invention further provides a device of executing the method. The scheme provided is suitable for small network link bandwidth and high network propagation delay.

title_en: Power distribution network fault risk early warning method and system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power grid fault early warning, and discloses a power distribution network fault risk early warning method and system based on deep learning, so that the accuracy of fault early warning is improved. The method comprises the following steps: screening initial characteristic information related to the power distribution network fault and preprocessing the initial characteristic information; calculating the weight of each initial feature and removing the initial features lower than a weight threshold value to obtain target feature information; the power grid data and the meteorological data are mapped in an associated mode based on the target characteristic information, a data set is constructed, and a corresponding label is generated; taking the target characteristic information as the input of the deep neural network, and training and verifying the deep neural network according to the corresponding label; and the LSTM network which predicts meteorological factors based on historical data is used for obtaining the meteorological factors in the target characteristic information, the LSTM network and the deep neural network are cascaded to obtain a fault early warning model based on the deep neural network, and then early warning is carried out according to the fault early warning model based on the deep neural network to obtain an early warning conclusion.
assignees: State grid hunan electric power co ltd;STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INST;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Time series load prediction method based on convolutional neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a time series load prediction method based on a convolutional neural network, which comprises the following steps: preprocessing the related data; establishing a time series load prediction model according to the preprocessed data, and carrying out forward propagation training on the time series load prediction model to obtain a forward propagation prediction result; calculating a mean square error according to the forward propagation prediction result and the actual value, carrying out BP (back propagation) backward propagation calculation on the mean square error, and correcting model parameters; fitting and training the corrected model parameters and training data until the training result of the time series load prediction model is converged, and predicting the power load by using the trained time series load prediction model; the method can effectively avoid the under-fitting condition of the model, and meanwhile, the time sequence load prediction model is built based on the convolutional neural network, so that the parameter training is reduced, the gradient descent trap is avoided, and the prediction precision is effectively improved.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID LTD RESPONSIBILITY COMPANY

title_en: Power grid key branch identification method and system based on overload cascading failure
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of power grid safety analysis, and provides a method and a system for identifying a critical branch of a power grid based on overload cascading failures, wherein the method comprises the steps of establishing improved direct current flow considering voltage and reactive power, and rapidly estimating the voltage and reactive power of the system on the premise of ensuring the convergence of regional flow; considering the action of an automatic control device of the system and rough corrective control measures of the system, and establishing an overload cascading failure evolution model; performing large-scale cascading failure simulation on the system based on an overload cascading failure evolution model to obtain an accident chain, a load loss rate and a branch loss rate corresponding to each cascading failure, and calculating importance indexes of each branch according to the probability of each branch appearing in the accident chain and the loss caused to the system, so as to screen out key branches; the method provides importance evaluation indexes of current-carrying branches of the power grid, and calculates the importance indexes of the current-carrying branches through large-scale cascading failure simulation to effectively identify key branches of the power grid.

title_en: Method for evaluating electromagnetic ring network unlocking safety between partitions of regional power grid
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for evaluating the ring opening safety of an electromagnetic ring network among partitions of a regional power grid, which comprises the following steps: s1, analyzing the necessity of ring opening of the electromagnetic ring network among partitions according to a main grid structure and by combining the running condition of a power grid; s2, analyzing safety risks existing in the transmission line of the electromagnetic ring network itself and the local power network in the near zone after the electromagnetic ring network is disassembled; s3, analyzing safety and stability risks possibly caused by different fault modes of extra-high voltage direct current in the subarea after the electromagnetic ring network is disassembled; s4, analyzing the influence of the electromagnetic ring network decyclization on the oscillation mode and damping among the regional power grid partition clusters; s5, judging the feasibility of the electromagnetic ring network ring opening. The invention evaluates the possible safety and stability risks of the system after the electromagnetic looped network decoiling network structure is weakened to a certain extent in all-round aspects such as cascading failure, decoiling effect on the feeding capacity of the direct current group, influence on the oscillating mode of the inter-partition cluster and the like which are possibly caused by different fault modes of the extra-high voltage direct current.
assignees: CENTRAL CHINA BRANCH STATE GRID CORP CHINA;CENTRAL SOUTHERN CHINA ELECTRIC POWER DESIGN INST CO LTD OF CHINA POWER ENG CONSULTING GROUP

title_en: Short-term wind speed prediction method, system and storage medium for refined wind field
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of weather state prediction, and relates to a short-term wind speed prediction method, a short-term wind speed prediction system and a storage medium for a refined wind field. The invention improves the existing prediction recurrent neural network PredRNN, adds a residual structure, so that the relation between data can be better mined by adopting the prediction recurrent neural network based on residual improvement to establish the first wind speed prediction model of the wind field, the problem that the model is easy to have gradient disappearance at the bottom layer along with the deepening of the network layer number in the back propagation process is solved, and the prediction accuracy of the wind speed prediction model is greatly improved. According to the invention, the first wind speed prediction model is fused with the existing weather prediction mode WRF to obtain a second wind speed prediction model, and the accuracy of the weather prediction mode WRF in the middle and rear section wind speed prediction of the refined wind field and the accuracy of the LSTM series model in the front section wind speed prediction of the refined wind field are combined; the wind speed prediction of the refined wind field in the whole period is quite accurate.
assignees: NANJING POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO RES INST

title_en: Intelligent building operation and maintenance management system and method based on BIM platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent building management, in particular to an intelligent building operation and maintenance management system and method based on a BIM platform. The method comprises the steps of constructing a device connection topology network according to acquired target BIM building model data to generate device physical connection topology data, automatically removing logic conflict of the device physical connection topology data to generate device connection topology data, analyzing fault influence links of the device connection topology data to generate fault propagation link data, evaluating fault severity of the fault propagation link data to generate device fault severity data, and performing intelligent operation and maintenance path planning according to the device fault severity data to obtain intelligent device operation and maintenance path data. According to the invention, through the fine division of the operation and maintenance equipment management space and the analysis of the equipment fault propagation link, the intelligent scheduling of fault operation and maintenance tasks is realized, and the operation and maintenance efficiency and the precision of resource allocation are obviously improved.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY NO 10 ENG GROUP CO LTD;CHINA RAILWAY TENTH GROUP OF THE FIFTH ENG CO LTD

title_en: Nuclear power key index prediction device based on optimal deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nuclear power key index prediction device based on optimal deep learning, which comprises a sodium iodide spectrometer database, a data acquisition and preprocessing module, a one-dimensional CNN-LSTM cascading model module, a multi-target self-adaptive particle swarm optimization algorithm module and a nuclear power key index prediction and online correction module. The method realizes online prediction and parameter optimal online optimization, can robustly and swiftly predict the nuclear power key indexes in the running process of the nuclear power facility, does not need to manually design prediction features or rules, overcomes the defects that the conventional nuclear power key index prediction device is low in precision and easy to be influenced by human factors, and the prediction model is easy to mismatch, so that the prediction effect is poor and even the system is crashed, and improves the prediction efficiency and accuracy of the long-term online running of the nuclear power key index prediction in the radiation environment.

title_en: Broadband electromagnetic radiation interference characteristic modeling method for shielded cable network
abstract_en: A broadband electromagnetic radiation interference characteristic modeling method of a shielded cable network comprises the following steps of 1) obtaining a scattering parameter matrix of a shielded connector and a transmission parameter matrix of a bent shielded cable, 2) constructing an equivalent N-port model of the shielded connector by using the scattering parameter matrix, deducing the transmission parameter matrix of the shielded connector, 3) establishing a multi-conductor transmission line equation for distributing reactive interference current on the shielded cable by using the transfer impedance of the shielded cable, 4) cascading all the transmission parameter matrices of the bent shielded cable and the shielded cable to obtain the transmission parameter matrix of the whole shielded cable network, 5) solving the multi-conductor transmission line equation by combining boundary constraint conditions to obtain common-mode interference current of a shielding layer of the shielded cable, and calculating electric field radiation of the shielded cable network by using a dipole array theory. The invention is suitable for single-core and multi-core wire harness shielding linear uniform and non-uniform shielding cables and shielding cable networks, and has good universality.

title_en: Network public opinion intelligent classification and emergency decision system based on multi-mode fusion and dynamic evolution
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent classification and emergency decision system of network public opinion based on multi-mode fusion and dynamic evolution, belonging to the field of network public opinion monitoring, big data analysis and artificial intelligence. The system comprises a multi-source data acquisition and preprocessing module, a multi-dimensional classification engine module, a logic atlas construction and anomaly detection module, a stakeholder dynamic risk assessment module, an intelligent decision and emergency response module, a benefit correlator dynamic risk assessment module, a benefit decision and emergency response module and a classification response module, wherein the multi-source data acquisition and preprocessing module is used for crawling multi-mode data, constructing a propagation path atlas after preprocessing, identifying key propagation nodes, the multi-dimensional classification engine module is used for carrying out conflict intensity quantification on public opinion events, dynamically updating a rule thesaurus and keeping the adaptability of a conflict intensity quantification model, the logic atlas construction and anomaly detection module is used for constructing a public opinion propagation path and public opinion event commonality logic chain mode, monitoring the public opinion propagation speed and giving an alarm, the benefit correlator dynamic risk assessment module is used for carrying out fine classification on a network public opinion participation main body, providing basis for differentiation propagation intervention, simulating public opinion evolution and carrying out risk simulation, and the intelligent decision and emergency response module is used for executing emergency measures of different levels based on risk indexes according to a classification response strategy.

title_en: Enterprise financial analysis and risk early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an enterprise financial analysis and risk early warning method and system, which relate to the technical field of enterprise financial analysis and early warning, and comprise the steps of obtaining multisource structured financial data of a target enterprise, carrying out cleaning, normalization and time alignment processing on the financial data to form a financial time sequence data sequence, extracting a group of core financial indexes based on the financial time sequence data sequence, identifying time sequence relationships and influence hysteresis periods among the indexes through a Granges causal test and a dynamic time regulation method, constructing a financial index dynamic coupling network, carrying out risk propagation path deduction by utilizing the financial index dynamic coupling network, generating a risk conduction map, determining a key risk driving index based on influence strength of each node in the map, collecting external unstructured information related to the target enterprise, identifying important event types occurring in the enterprise, combining event properties and occurrence time, and calculating impact strength of each event on the enterprise and influence weight of each event on time attenuation.
assignees: NANJING DONGJU INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent energy full-flow management and control platform integrating AI decision
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent energy full-flow management and control platform integrating an AI decision, which comprises an energy data acquisition module, an AI decision center module and a multi-energy coordination module, wherein the energy data acquisition module is used for acquiring energy full-flow data through Internet of things equipment and integrating meteorological data, market data and user behavior data at the same time, the AI decision center module is used for training a neural network model through historical energy full-flow data, dynamically predicting energy load fluctuation, new energy output and market price trend in a future time period, constructing a multi-agent game framework, training a strategy network through a near-end strategy optimization algorithm, generating a dynamic scheduling strategy of source network charge storage, establishing an energy virtual model, simulating the actual running state of energy in real time, verifying the feasibility of the dynamic scheduling strategy of the source network charge storage and early warning potential risks in advance, and the multi-energy coordination module is used for carrying out multi-energy cascade collaborative utilization through a cooling-heating power system, simulating scheduling scheme execution effect in a virtual environment, discovering potential risks in advance and avoiding economic losses in actual running.

title_en: Automatic registration algorithm for low-voltage distribution network carrier terminal
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an automatic registration algorithm for a low-voltage distribution network carrier terminal. It uses each district concentrator as a centre, relies on a domain carrier node which has finished registration, and falls into neighbourhood node registration and non-neighbourhood node registration and neighbourhood and non-neighbourhood node supplementary registration, etc. to complete the registration process of the electric meters of the overall electric grid in a multi-stage wave manner, measures the proximity of the electric-grid registration nodes by virtue of signal quality parameters carried by power-line narrow-band carrier signals during cross-district propagation, and collects, calculates and compares these parameters through a home-domain confirmation algorithm, thereby accurately determining the home district of a carrier node. In addition, a high-efficiency conflict avoidance and multi-priority carrier packet transceiving control algorithm based on a physical-layer CSMA technology is adopted to process the priorities of conflict and discharging messages so that all types of communication nodes in a district simultaneously compete to use one and the same communication medium. The present invention can be used for electric-meter registration of a plurality of types of electric-grid meter-reading networks, and is in particular suitable for electric-meter registration of an electric-power carrier remote meter-reading network in a relatively complicated communication environment.

title_en: Pt/pt-z camera command, control & visualization system and method utilizing artificial intelligence
abstract_en: A system and method for wildfire detection, monitoring, and consequence modeling integrate digital cameras with artificial intelligence to identify, track, and predict fire behavior. The system processes camera imagery, satellite data, environmental inputs, aircraft telemetry, and contextual information to detect ignition points, triangulate fire locations, and model projected fire spread. A fire propagation engine generates maps, graphs, and consequence estimates, including burned area, affected infrastructure, population exposure, and financial loss. Alerts are triggered based on detection and modeled impact, with filters to suppress false positives, merge repeated detections, and escalate based on user-defined risk thresholds. The system includes tools for managing prescribed fires, tracking smoke-only detections, and customizing alert logic by geography, asset proximity, or scenario. External datasets may be ingested via API or file upload to support consequence scoring and operational prioritization. Users may run simulations, analyze historical conditions, and export results for planning, response coordination, or regulatory reporting.

title_en: Distributed power distribution network electricity price adjustment method based on convolution network and collaborative filtering
abstract_en: The invention provides a distributed power distribution network electricity price adjustment method based on convolution network and collaborative filtering, which comprises the following steps of 1, extracting characteristics according to power distribution network data; 2, constructing a scoring matrix, 3, decomposing singular values, 4, calculating the similarity degree, 5, confirming users to be recommended, and 6, selecting recommended users according to the sequence of the users. According to the method, the output prediction of the distribution network with the distributed power supply is realized by adopting a convolutional neural network method, the data characteristic extraction is realized, the period with abundant output of the distribution network with the distributed power supply is predicted, and the electricity price is adjusted by utilizing the prediction result. The collaborative filtering method based on the singular value decomposition and the model is also used for pushing electricity price preferential information to users, the application range of the singular value decomposition method is wide, the method is suitable for large-scale data, the collaborative filtering performance can be improved, and sorting can be more accurately screened. And determining a final recommended user according to the similarity sequence between the user and the target user, and reducing unnecessary information propagation cost.

title_en: Photovoltaic power prediction method based on neural network and honeypot optimization
abstract_en: The invention relates to a photovoltaic power prediction method based on neural network and honeypot optimization, and provides a photovoltaic power generation prediction model based on a badger algorithm and an enhanced counter-propagation neural network aiming at the defect that random initial weight and bias seriously affect the performance of a BP neural network. The solar irradiance per hour and the ambient temperature of the peltier cell are used as input data for the predictive model, and the historical power generation per hour (power) is used as the expected output. HBAs are introduced in the BP neural network to optimize initial weights and biases. The simulation results of various indexes show that the prediction accuracy of the HBA-BP neural network is improved to a certain extent relative to a BP prediction model.

title_en: Agricultural full-industry chain tracing method and system based on big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for tracing an agricultural full-industry chain based on big data, which relate to the technical field of agricultural tracing and comprise the steps of constructing a static knowledge graph in a graph database based on a full-chain data set, setting and initializing nodes, edges and initial weights, predicting environmental changes through an LSTM model, dynamically adjusting the nodes and the edge weights through reinforcement learning, generating a dynamically updated knowledge graph, constructing a multi-factor risk conduction matrix according to the dynamically updated knowledge graph, defining an initial risk propagation path, integrating the full-chain data set through a Bayesian network model, calculating the conditional probability of the initial risk propagation path, generating an optimized risk propagation path, and predicting the risk probability through the optimized risk propagation path by using a random forest model.

title_en: Intelligent high-voltage parallel capacitor device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an intelligent high-voltage parallel capacitor device. The intelligent high-voltage parallel capacitor device comprises a plurality of intelligent capacitance device cabinets and a central intelligent console. Each intelligent capacitance device cabinet comprises a cabinet body, a front end intelligent processing unit and a sensor. A plurality of intelligent capacitance control cabinets are connected in a cascade mode and are connected with the central intelligent console through the network. The intelligent high-voltage parallel capacitor device is characterized in that: the front end intelligent processing unit comprises a communication unit, a data processing unit, a signal acquisition unit and a power supply management unit; The power supply management unit is respectively connected with the data processing unit, a signal acquisition unit and a communication unit; the signal acquisition unit is respectively connected with the sensor and the data processing unit, carries out data reception processing of the signal received by the sensor and sends the processed signal to the data processing unit; the communication unit is connected with the data processing unit, and sends the data processed by the data processing unit to the central intelligent console. The intelligent high-voltage parallel capacitor device can give an early warning of a sub-healthy capacitor in advance, avoids sudden failures and disasters, does not need artificial intervention and automatic all-day on-line monitoring, and reduces power failure time of traditional manual maintenance greatly.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO;ELECTRIC POWER ECONOMIC TECHNOLOGY RES INST JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;ZHONGWANG ELECTRIC CO LTD

title_en: Wind power prediction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind power prediction method. The method comprises the following steps: collecting sample data and processing; establishing a BP (Back Propagation) neural network model by using the processed sample data, and training the BP neural network model to obtain a final weight, a threshold value and a relative error sequence of a prediction value relative to a sample value; solving an initial prediction value of output power according to the weight and the threshold value after the training is completed; calculating a calculation relative error state corresponding to the initial prediction value of the output power by using a markov chain error correction model; combining the initial prediction value of the output power with the corresponding calculation relative error state to calculate corrected power. According to the method, the accuracy of wind power prediction is further improved, and an accurate wind power prediction value is provided for daily power generation scheduling and secure economic dispatch of a wind power generation power grid.

title_en: A kind of by optimizing the method that the on off state of link promotes network system robustness
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of by optimizing the method that the on off state of network link improves network system robustness, cascading failure phenomenon is designed suitable network protective strategy from the angle of complex network by the method.Initially set up electrology characteristic and model that network topological information combines；Then the propagation of the Preservation tactics suppression cascading failure cutting off respective link is utilized; thus reduce the infringement that electrical network is brought by cascading failure; and consider that the number cutting off link can not be too big in practical operation, power network Link State control problem is converted into multi-objective optimization question；Finally utilize non-dominated ranking binary system differential evolution algorithm to solve this multi-objective optimization question, control the on off state of each link of electrical network according to optimum link scheme.The present invention, by considering the electrology characteristic of electrical network, takes to excise the network protective strategy properly connecting limit, just can improve the robustness of electrical network, thus effectively reduce the harm that electrical network is brought by cascading failure in the case of even limit quantity is few in excision.
assignees: JIAXING GUODIANTONG NEW ENERGY TECH CO LTD;UNIV ZHEJIANG SCIENCE & TECH;BEIJING GUODIANTONG NETWORK TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: A kind of dynamic emergency evacuation method of city rail traffic route failure
abstract_en: A kind of dynamic emergency evacuation method of city rail traffic route failure, is related to a kind of rail traffic control technology field.Solve the problem of the limited secondary propagation for causing to be detained passenger flow in network of single dispersing station ability.Establish each station property set and station operating status collection in network；Station passenger flow state analysis；Short-term prediction is carried out to metro passenger flow using SAS software, passenger flow arrival process is emulated；Determine evacuation starting point and evacuation terminal；Construct emergency rating rail public transport collaboration evacuation network；Build the path dynamic select model in ending range；Determine best evacuation path；Determine emergency bus requirement and runing time interval；Determine that passenger flow to be evacuated reaches the regularity of distribution of evacuation subway station；According to rail transit train parameter, train conveying capacity being determined, being flowed in conjunction with subway standee, resource distribution is carried out to train transport power, formulates emergency rating Train operating scheme.Increase the passenger flow evacuation capacity of single node, improves network evacuation efficiency.

title_en: A kind of service reliability and bandwidth recovery method based on multi-path
