abstract_en: A kind of service reliability and bandwidth recovery method based on multi-path is claimed in the present invention, belongs to Communication Network Technique field.This method is seriously damaged and is threatened caused by backbone optical network for mass disaster event, is augmented method using flexible routing configuration and bandwidth, is restored to the impaired business in network.The case where in order to cope with Internet resources after calamity in short supply, networking component reliability decrease, according to the routing and quantity of service reliability demand dynamic adjustment and recovery access, according to service bandwidth demand equilibrium assignment and adaptive upgrade bandwidth, it is further impaired business supplement routing and bandwidth according to resource utilization maximization principle, to obtain biggish promotion in aspect of performance such as Service disruption ratio, reliability, bandwidth loss rates.

title_en: Method and system for simulating cascading failure of thermoelectric coupling system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a method and a system for simulating cascading failures of a thermoelectric coupling system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring natural disaster meteorological data and system load data at the time t; calculating the fault probability of the line based on the natural disaster meteorological data, and updating the performance state of the thermoelectric equipment; randomly disconnecting the line based on the fault probability of the line, updating the topological structure of the thermoelectric coupling system network, and determining the current operation mode; performing thermoelectric coupling load flow calculation based on the current operation mode; analyzing the calculation result of the thermoelectric coupling load flow, and counting out the line with out-of-limit power; if no power out-of-limit line exists, counting the total line disconnection condition within the time t, and determining the load loss in the thermoelectric coupling system based on the system load data; and randomly disconnecting the line with the power exceeding the limit with a preset probability, updating the network topology of the system, determining the current operation mode, and then returning to the thermocouple load flow calculation and circulating until the line without the power exceeding the limit.

title_en: Power grid operation risk situation sensing method for disaster weather
abstract_en: The invention provides a power grid operation risk situation perception method facing to disaster weather. The method is based on a Bayesian network with time-varying wind speed, and a power grid time-varying risk propagation model considering the trend transfer caused by wind speed and disconnection faults is established; solving the running state parameters of the power grid by adopting a Monte Carlo simulation method of Latin hypercube sampling and combining an optimal direct current flow model; and constructing a power grid operation risk situation perception index system, and realizing presentation and prediction of line risk situation, load level situation and power grid toughness situation. An effective real-time perception method is provided for the power grid operation risk situation facing to the disaster weather.

title_en: Cascading failure evolution mode identification method and system considering influence of prevention and control measures
abstract_en: The invention provides a cascading failure evolution mode identification method and a system considering the influence of prevention and control measures, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining the running state information of a power grid and obtaining the prevention and control measures after failures; screening out high-probability cascading failures caused by the current failures by considering the prevention and control measures, and calculating the risk value of the high-probability cascading failures to obtain a high-risk cascading failure set; and taking the high-risk cascading failure set as a sequence, mining a pattern based on prefix projection, and identifying a key evolution pattern in the sequence. Aiming at the measures of output adjustment, direct current modulation and load shedding of the generator, a planning model is established, and the model can quickly provide an optimal power grid prevention and control strategy; calculating cascading failure risks, sequencing, and finally screening to obtain a high-risk cascading failure set; and the key evolution mode of high-risk cascading failure concentration is identified, and weak links of power grid prevention and control can be effectively identified. The invention considers the influence of the prevention and control measures on the cascading failure and can obviously reduce the risk value.
assignees: JINAN POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Multi-power-grid gradient daily peak regulation scheduling model considering high-voltage direct-current channel constraint
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of hydropower dispatching operation, and discloses a multi-power-grid stair-level daily peak regulation dispatching model considering high-voltage direct-current channel constraint. Firstly, a multi-grid daily peak regulation model of a cross-basin cascade hydropower station through high-voltage direct current is established, wherein simple high-voltage direct current constraint is considered; secondly, aiming at sharing the same direct current channel by multiple power stations, a shared high-voltage direct current channel constraint is provided, and the constraint is reconstructed, so that the constraint can be efficiently integrated into the existing mathematical model; finally, a linearization method aiming at the shared high-voltage direct-current channel constraint is provided, part of hydraulic force constraint is linearized, and an MILP model is constructed by introducing methods such as large M constraint and SOS2 so as to improve the solving efficiency of the model. The invention is beneficial to coupling grid-connected constraint, ensures the safety and stability of a high-voltage direct current circuit, and simultaneously can fully utilize the flexibility of water and electricity to ensure that multiple power grids can achieve satisfactory peak regulation effect at the same time.

title_en: Method for calculating input impedance of defective cable
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for calculating input impedance of a defective cable, which belongs to the technical field of cable defect detection, and comprises the following steps: constructing a simulation cable corresponding to the defective cable; determining basic electrical parameters of the simulation cable and each set frequency point on a preset frequency band signal to be fed into the simulation cable; dividing the defective cable into a healthy unit section and a defective unit section according to basic electrical parameters, cascading each unit section to form a composite network so as to multiply the chain parameter matrixes to obtain the chain parameter matrixes of the whole simulation cable, and calculating the input impedance of the defective cable under each set frequency point by utilizing the downlink parameter matrixes of each set frequency point; the chain parameter matrix of each unit section can be calculated in parallel to further obtain the chain parameter matrix of the whole simulation cable and the corresponding input impedance, so that the technical problem that the calculation efficiency is low due to the fact that the impedance of each unit needs to be iterated one by one in the calculation of the input impedance of the existing defective cable is solved.

title_en: Day-ahead load prediction method and system based on MIC theory and monotonic value decomposition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a daily preload prediction method and a system based on MIC theory and monotonic value decomposition, which relate to the technical field of cascade hydropower scheduling and comprise the steps of acquiring a multisource data set of a target regional power grid and supplementing the multisource data set; analyzing the characteristic parameters of the data after the deficiency, and screening the characteristic parameters to construct a data set; constructing a load prediction model, and training the load prediction model by adopting the data set; and defining a loss function of the load prediction model, and carrying out load prediction by adopting the load prediction model to obtain a load prediction result. According to the invention, the original time sequence is decomposed into three components of trend, period and random, different complementation strategies are respectively adopted for the missing values, the accuracy of data complementation is improved, and methods such as moving average, same-period average and the like are introduced, so that local trend and periodic characteristics can be better captured, and estimation is closer to the actual situation.

title_en: Hydropower station reportable electric quantity upper and lower limit determining method and system based on cascade reservoir dispatching model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydropower station reportable electric quantity upper and lower limit determining method and system based on a cascade reservoir dispatching model, comprising the following steps of linearizing an electric quantity expression through a mathematical programming algorithm to obtain a linearized electric quantity expression; the method comprises the steps of carrying an expression of the linearized generated energy into a minimum potential generated energy model and a maximum potential generated energy model, obtaining the maximum potential difference between the upper limit and the lower limit of the generated energy of the hydropower station by solving a linear optimization problem, inputting other constraint conditions of long-term dispatching in the hydropower station and the maximum potential difference between the upper limit and the lower limit of the generated energy of the hydropower station as parameters into an actual dispatching generated energy boundary optimization model of the hydropower station, solving an actual dispatching generated energy boundary optimization model of the hydropower station, and outputting the upper limit and the lower limit of the generated energy of the hydropower station in the first month in a dispatching period. The invention provides a basis for reporting the upper and lower limits of the electric quantity when the power grid sets the hydropower station to participate in the electric power market.

title_en: Petroleum storage tank field system dynamic risk propagation behavior evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of security risk evaluation, and discloses a method and a system for evaluating dynamic risk propagation behaviors of a petroleum storage tank farm system, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a single-layer IRML risk model, converting the single-layer IRML risk model into a GDS network model, sequencing risk factors according to a key set and a vulnerability set of target nodes, determining risk nodes of the petroleum storage tank farm system, constructing a multi-layer risk network of the tank farm system, carrying out static attribute analysis on the multi-layer risk network, and carrying out dynamic attribute analysis on the multi-layer risk network through the security key nodes or the edge characterization risk factors to determine a risk propagation rule. The single-layer IRML risk model constructed by the invention can more comprehensively identify risks, and the risk factors can be ranked according to the key set and the vulnerability set, so that the risk factors at the system level can be more visual by the visualization of the GDS network model.
assignees: CHINA NAT PETROLEUM CORP;CNPC ENGINEERING MATERIALS R & D CO LIMITED

title_en: Water diversion serial cascade power station scheduling method based on real-time cooperative fault response model
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of optimal scheduling of hydropower stations and discloses a scheduling method of a diversion serial cascade power station based on a real-time collaborative fault response model, which aims to solve the problem that the stability of a power grid is affected in the existing scheduling scheme, and mainly comprises the steps of constructing an objective function and constraint conditions of planned load and actual output of the diversion serial cascade power station, and constructing a mixed quadratic programming model according to the objective function and the constraint conditions to obtain the real-time collaborative fault response model of the diversion serial cascade power station; and solving a real-time collaborative fault response model by utilizing a solver based on the boundary conditions to obtain the planned output of each generator set, and carrying out real-time scheduling on the diversion serial cascade power station according to the planned output of each generator set. The application improves the dispatching accuracy of the diversion cascade power station and the stability of the power grid.

title_en: Power grid cable wiring path optimization method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a power grid cable wiring path optimization method and device, the method comprises the steps of carrying out load analysis on geographic distribution data and electricity consumption data of a power grid system to generate load region types and weight data corresponding to the region types, carrying out fault propagation risk assessment on power grid nodes in the power grid system according to the load region types and the weight data, generating a cable capacity scheme according to a risk assessment result, generating a candidate path set through a multi-objective balance mechanism and an adaptive path growth algorithm according to the load region types, the weight data and the cable capacity scheme, and carrying out toughness evaluation and optimization on the candidate path set under the preset multiple simulation scene conditions to generate the power grid cable wiring scheme. According to the invention, the distribution characteristics of the power grid load, the fault propagation risk and the system toughness are comprehensively considered, a cable wiring scheme which is suitable for a complex load environment and has fault resistance capability can be generated, and the reliability and the stability of a power grid system are obviously improved.
assignees: ZHENGZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID HANAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Probabilistic network planning method for new energy clusters and novel power distribution network
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of planning prediction models, in particular to a probabilistic network planning method for a new energy cluster and a novel power distribution network, comprising the following steps of setting planning period granularity and adjusting time granularity; and carrying out synchronous optimization solution of multi-dimensional time periods based on planning period granularity division on the source load balance model based on a group search algorithm, and predicting a new energy maximum output curve and an output strategy of the corresponding power grid partition. The method is added with time constraint, is more suitable for actual production conditions, has higher practicability of algorithm output, performs optimization solving of decision variables in each planning period granularity through synchronization of multiple time dimensions, is favorable for exploring and solving multiple time periods in a short time, and strengthens front-back association of the time dimensions, so that the output capacity of the time constraint is strengthened, and the counter-propagation capacity of the group search algorithm is increased.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CORPORATION DONGYING HEKOU DISTR POWER SUPPLY COMPANY

title_en: Coal-fired unit depth peak shaving system of collaborative economy
abstract_en: The invention discloses a depth peak regulation system of a coal-fired unit with synergistic economy, which comprises a data real-time acquisition module, a combustion unit screening and sequencing module, a historical peak regulation data analysis module, a power grid demand detection matching module, a refinement management module and an effect verification module. The invention belongs to the technical field of peak shaving of coal-fired power generation units, and particularly provides a deep peak shaving system of a coal-fired power generation unit, which solves the problem of poor economy under a low-load working condition through boiler combustion optimization, waste heat cascade utilization, energy storage system coordination and intelligent control and realizes the synergistic economy of dual promotion of peak shaving capacity and economic benefit.
assignees: HUADIAN LAIZHOU POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Lightning arrester performance degradation index construction method based on improved neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lightning arrester performance degradation index construction method based on an improved neural network. The method is used for collecting the environmental temperature, the humidity, the accumulated impact times and the running time as inputs, taking resistive current and capacitive current as outputs, constructing a neural network model, introducing an attention mechanism, combining a counter-propagation algorithm and an improved cosine annealing learning rate to optimize and update model parameters, constructing performance degradation indexes, visually displaying the state of the lightning arrester through the change of electric parameters, judging whether the lightning arrester can normally run, supervise running or stop replacing, effectively improving the processing capability of the model on complex data, providing reliable basis for timely and accurately judging the performance degradation condition of the lightning arrester for an electric power system, and having important significance and popularization value for guaranteeing the safe and stable running of the electric power system.

title_en: Business-impact-oriented network security asset risk pricing and management method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of network security asset risk pricing and management, in particular to a service-impact-oriented network security asset risk pricing and management method and system, a service-resource portraits library is constructed by integrating historical service data, infrastructure resource data and external environment data, a potential interruption event prediction model is trained based on random forests or long-short term memory network LSTM, constructing a multi-objective cost optimization function comprising resource preset cost, service interruption loss cost and resource idle penalty cost, solving an optimal resource preset strategy by adopting a non-dominant sorting genetic algorithm NSGA-II or a particle swarm optimization algorithm, and performing feedback data updating model and function to form closed-loop optimization. The method and the system realize accurate prediction of risk, dynamic balance of cost and continuous adaptation of strategies, effectively ensure service continuity, reduce the overall operation cost of enterprises, and promote pertinence and effectiveness of network security asset risk pricing and management.
assignees: FUZHOU HENGAO INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Audit risk early warning method, device, equipment and storage medium based on dynamic AI model
abstract_en: The invention discloses an audit risk early warning method, device, equipment and storage medium based on a dynamic AI model, and relates to the technical field of digital audit, comprising the steps of acquiring historical audit data and real-time business data, and carrying out dynamic risk identification on the historical audit data and the real-time business data based on an industry vertical large model to obtain an initial risk score; the method comprises the steps of inputting an initial risk score into a self-adaptive threshold model to obtain a dynamic risk threshold, carrying out risk judgment on real-time business data based on the dynamic risk threshold to generate a risk early warning signal, inputting the risk early warning signal into a knowledge graph module to carry out association analysis to obtain a risk propagation network, generating a risk early warning report based on the risk propagation network and uploading the risk early warning report to a group audit digital comprehensive platform to obtain audit risk early warning result data, and realizing dynamic risk identification on history and real-time data at the same time, wherein the risk score is automatically updated along with business changes.
assignees: HUADIAN SHAANXI ENERGY CO LTD;CHINA HUADIAN CORPORATION LTD

title_en: Method and apparatus for controlling selection of plmn candidates for disaster roaming
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a 5G or 6G communication system for supporting a higher data transmission rate. Embodiments herein disclose a device and methods for managing and selecting Public Land Mobile Networks (PLMNs) for disaster roaming during Minimization of Service Interruption (MINT) situations. A UE is configured for selecting one of the "list of PLMN(s) to be used in disaster condition" configured by a HPLMN/EPLMN, and "list of PLMN(s) to be used in disaster condition" configured by a VPLMN, in a disaster situation based on a UE configuration. The method discloses selection of at least one Forbidden PLMN (FPLMN) by the UE in a disaster situation, when a primary PLMN list configured by a HPLMN/EPLMN is different from at least one secondary PLMN list configured by at least one VPLMN.

title_en: Prevention through design environmental material intelligence center
abstract_en: The present disclosure presents systems and methods for building infrastructure and infection prevention data analysis. One such method comprises building contents of an electronic repository of performance metrics related to material pathogen propagation or reduction; assigning, via machine learning, a performance score or grade to a certain infrastructure building material based on the performance metrics associated with the building material; and predicting and outputting, via the machine learning, a risk associated with a building based on its infrastructure building materials, wherein the infrastructure building materials comprises the certain infrastructure building material.

title_en: A kind of flow nodes backing method for intelligent grid scheduling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of flow nodes backing method for intelligent grid scheduling, comprise the following steps：Node rollback processing relevant information and the relevant position stored to database are set；Flow promoter selects the circulation handling process set in database, and submits data；Inquired about in database and obtain current node information and the node rollback processing authority of present node, it is determined whether need to retract；If need not or can not retract, into next node, repeat the above steps；If necessary to retract, then by current node state, node rollback flow is performed.For the present invention by realizing that operation node retracts in dispatching of power netwoks flow, dynamic, which specifies node retracted position and cascades deletion, has completed node, can meet the flow rollback demand in actual electric network business well.

title_en: Combined optimization scheduling method for combined cooling, heating and power supply microgrid and active power distribution network considering IDR (Integrated data Rate)
abstract_en: The invention discloses a combined optimization scheduling method for a cooling, heating and power combined microgrid and an active power distribution network, which takes IDR (Integrated Demand response) into account. Firstly, modeling the combined cooling heating and power microgrid equipment; then respectively establishing an active power distribution network optimization scheduling model and a combined cooling heating and power microgrid scheduling model considering IDR; the randomness of new energy and the cooling, heating and power loads in the combined cooling, heating and power micro-grid is processed by using opportunity constraint planning; and finally, an IATC (Improved adaptive Target tracking, improved Target Cascading method) is used for solving the combined optimization scheduling model of the combined cooling, heating and power supply microgrid and the active power distribution network considering the IDR. The method provided by the invention can effectively improve the energy utilization rate, reduce the system operation cost and obtain the optimal economic dispatching result of the active power distribution network and the combined cooling heating and power micro-grid on the basis of protecting the privacy of the respective areas.

title_en: Method and system for extracting relationship of entities involved in electric carbon market transaction based on cascade pointer network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for extracting entity relation in electric carbon market transaction based on a cascade pointer network, comprising the following steps of constructing an electric carbon market transaction field word segmentation dictionary, constructing PowerSpanBERT models, training PowerSpanBERT models by introducing improved gradient accumulation-projection gradient descent countermeasure training strategies, identifying and extracting candidate head entity sets, introducing a multi-head attention mechanism to calculate a word embedding vector output by a PowerSpanBERT model, decoding the candidate head entity set feature vector and the word embedding vector by CPN to obtain candidate tail entity sets, predicting relation types between the candidate head entity sets and head-tail entity pairs in the candidate tail entity sets, outputting the head-tail entity pairs and the corresponding relation types, and generating entity relation triplets according to irrigation results. The invention provides a more accurate and efficient entity relation extraction solution for electric carbon market transaction.

title_en: Power grid operation situation analysis system combined with knowledge graph
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid operation situation analysis system combining a knowledge graph, which relates to the technical field of intelligent power grids and comprises a power grid data acquisition module, a power grid characteristic extraction module, a monitoring information event analysis module, a power grid graph construction module and a power grid event intelligent research and judgment module, wherein the power grid data acquisition module acquires power grid data, the power grid characteristic extraction module extracts characteristics, the monitoring information event analysis module outputs an overhaul label, a fault label, a related equipment list and a fault list, the power grid graph construction module generates a power grid knowledge graph, a fault propagation path and a threshold value are output, and the power grid event intelligent research and judgment module pushes abnormal data and fault information. According to the invention, automatic cleaning, intelligent fault research and judgment and cross-station propagation path analysis of mass monitoring signals are realized through natural language processing and machine learning technologies, so that manual intervention is reduced, fault identification accuracy is improved, grading alarms are pushed in real time, and power grid situation sensing and emergency disposal efficiency is remarkably improved.

title_en: Knowledge graph-based bad weather power grid risk identification method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for identifying risks of a severe weather power grid based on a knowledge graph, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of collecting multisource weather forecast data and power grid topological structure data in a target area, carrying out data cleaning and space-time calibration, fusing the weather data and power grid state data by utilizing a knowledge graph technology, generating a physical risk correlation sub-graph and a linkage risk correlation sub-graph, analyzing the physical damage risk and the fault cascade diffusion risk of power grid facilities by adopting a probability simulation method and a graph theory cascade failure analysis method respectively, determining the comprehensive risk level of a power grid, and generating a power grid risk thermodynamic diagram according to the comprehensive risk level of the power grid. The visual expression of the risk level of the power grid region is realized, and a decision basis is provided for power grid dispatching operation and pre-disaster early warning.

title_en: Geological disaster networking monitoring and early warning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster networking monitoring and early warning method, which relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and early warning, and comprises the following steps of S1, collecting original data of multiple types of monitoring equipment in a monitoring area, extracting a high-amplitude mutation area and a frequency drift factor according to time and frequency distribution of the original data, constructing a high-frequency disturbance sensing matrix, and generating a disturbance characteristic index map for representing spatial distribution of unnatural disturbance sources. According to the invention, the high-frequency disturbance perception matrix and the disturbance index map are constructed, so that the active recognition and modeling of the unnatural disturbance are realized, disturbance propagation analysis and residual difference are combined to strengthen precursor signal characteristics, the risk level is accurately judged through trend recognition and causal analysis, finally, the early warning model parameters are dynamically optimized by means of response regulation factors, a closed-loop mechanism of disturbance recognition, signal purification, trend extraction, risk judgment and strategy adjustment is formed, and the early warning stability, accuracy and practicability of the system in a high-disturbance environment are remarkably improved.

title_en: Reducing wireless device service interruptions
abstract_en: Apparatuses, systems, and methods for reducing wireless device service interruptions. An indication of a disaster condition may be provided to a wireless device. The disaster condition may affect a home public land mobile network of the wireless device. The wireless device may perform cell selection in a manner influenced by the indication of the disaster condition. This may include considering cells associated with a forbidden public land mobile network for the cell selection, or excluding cells associated with the home public land mobile network of the wireless device that are unavailable, for example due to the disaster condition, among various possibilities.

title_en: Endowment apartment public administration epidemic prevention facility
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an endowment apartment public administration epidemic prevention facility. Including hanger plate and bactericidal lamp, the structure of hanger plate is the rectangular channel, opens the through -hole of installation bactericidal lamp all around, the inslot fixed surface of hanger plate has fluorescent lamp, smoke alarm and combustible gas alarm, does the surface of hanger plate is opened have 2  10cm's rectangle shallow slot, shallow slot fixed surface has switch and domestic earthquake warning ware. The utility model discloses to the insect pest epidemic prevention in the indoor place in the asylum for the aged, design a real -time sterile epidemic prevention facility, this facility adopts indoor hoist and mount lamp plate, is fixed with ultraviolet lamp side by side in the position that the lamp plate leaned on the wall all around, carries out the clearance to insect pests such as mosquitoes through ultraviolet lamp, avoids the propagation of disease, installs smoke alarm and combustible gas alarm and domestic earthquake warning ware moreover and protect indoor hazardous gas and natural disasters jointly on this facility.

title_en: Risk perception and early warning method and system for cascading failures of wind power base
abstract_en: The invention relates to a risk perception and early warning method and a system for cascading failures of a wind power base. The method provided by the invention comprises the steps of acquiring real-time operation mode data of a power grid and a wind power plant through SCADA (supervisory control and data acquisition) and a WAMS (wide area measurement system), acquiring possible wind power disturbance of the current power grid by combining with historical data of the wind power plant so as to establish a reasonable failure set, establishing a wind power generating unit dynamic model and a fan safety protection model, simulating dynamic operating conditions of the wind power plant after the power grid breaks down, carrying out power grid transient stabilization analysis after the wind power base breaks down and carrying out static safety analysis after a failure is removed, carrying out calculation and evaluation on the safety stabilization condition of the current power grid after occurrence of the wind power disturbance through a series of indexes which are applicable to early warning for the cascading failures of large wind power bases, analyzing the risk of the occurrence of cascading failures of the large wind power base, and realizing online safety early warning for an electric power system after the wind disturbance. The method and the system provided by the invention are easy to implement, and can visually reflect safe and stable operation conditions of the electric power system including the large wind power base.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CORP;WIND POWER TECHNOLOGY CT OF GANSU ELECTRONIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Complete distributed charging scheduling management method based on mobile public transportation buses
abstract_en: The invention provides a complete distributed charging scheduling management method based on mobile public transportation buses. Charging stations and electric automobiles carry out information interaction through intermediate agents, the intermediate agents are public transportation buses, each charging station, as an information issuer, periodically issues its own charging service supply condition to the intermediate agents, the public transportation buses driving on lines realize issuing/subscribing aiming at information propagation through vehicle-to-vehicle communication, and the electric automobiles needing charging service obtain state information of all the charging stations in a network through accessing public transportation buses they accidentally meet so as to execute a decision about where they should go for charging. The method is characterized in that: 1, the intermediate agents are mobile, charging management information is obtained through reliance on the mobile lines of the intermediate agents, and thus the flexibility is high; 2, only a quite small number of mobile intermediate agents are needed so that the network configuration cost is quite low; and 3, a distributed charging management mode is employed, and thus the privacy susceptibility is quite low.

title_en: A kind of electromechanical electromagnetism hybrid simulation method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a kind of electromechanical electromagnetism hybrid simulation method and system, including：It is determined that being hybrid simulation interface position in the bus that electro-magnetic transient network side is connected with the power transmission line for meeting pre-conditioned；Electromagnetic Wave Propagation postpones τ more than electromagnetic transient simulation step delta t on the power transmission line；The k sides connection electromechanical transient network of the power transmission line, the j sides of the power transmission line connect remaining network of electro-magnetic transient network；It is following three parts by remaining network of the electro-magnetic transient network, the power transmission line and electromechanical transient Equivalent Network：The equivalent circuit part of remaining network portion, power transmission line k side and electromechanical transient network of the power transmission line j sides with electro-magnetic transient network and the equivalent circuit of electro-magnetic transient network and electromechanical transient network portion；The electric network state for obtaining electro-magnetic transient network and electromechanical transient network is solved respectively to above-mentioned three part.The technical scheme that the present invention is provided can greatly reduce interface amount of calculation, improve computational efficiency.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID HEILONGJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Multi-energy complementary micro-grid distributed optimization dispatching method containing multiagent
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of multi-energy complementary micro-grid distributed optimization dispatching method containing multiagent based on ADMM in power system micro-capacitance sensor technical field.Framework based on ADMM, operator and user form optimal interaction, until reaching the equilibrium of supply and demand.During Optimized Iterative, it is only necessary to exchange and expect delivery, heating load and actual power amount, heating load, operator and user can complete Optimized Operation, greatly protect operator and the privacy of user.The efficient cascaded utilization of energy of cogeneration of heat and power, in conjunction with heat reservoir, the demand response and renewable energy power generation of user side, has the advantages that energy-saving and emission-reduction, alleviates power network pressure；Set indoor comfortable temperature, it is contemplated that users'comfort, cost has considered economy and the subjective desire of user.The present invention provides the optimization method that a kind of cost is lower, feasibility is higher for the economical operation of multi-energy complementary micro-grid.

title_en: Power amplifier frequency domain behavior modeling method based on FFT and BP neural network
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide a kind of power amplifier frequency domain behavior modeling methods for being based on Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) and backpropagation (BP) neural network, power amplifier is modeled from the angle of frequency domain, efficiently against the not high problem of common power amplifier behavior model frequency domain precision.The back propagation artificial neural network model that this method utilizes has good descriptive power for nonlinear data, and model structure is simple, and required number of parameters is few, fast convergence rate.This method can describe the nonlinear characteristic and memory effect of power amplifier, especially its frequency domain characteristic well, have faster model convergence rate and higher precision.

title_en: RQD based on laser scanning, BQ and optimal thresholdtAnisotropy solving method
abstract_en: RQD based on laser scanning, BQ and optimal threshold t Anisotropy solving method, belonging to RQD t The field of anisotropy resolution, comprising the steps of: (1) three-dimensional laser scanning of the structural surface is rapidly acquired; (2) Drawing a structural plane polar diagram and a trend rose diagram; (3) calculating the rock mass based on the BQ index; (4) generating and sectioning a rock three-dimensional fracture network model; (5) RQD t Drawing an anisotropy map; (6) solving method of optimal threshold t based on BQ inversion; (7) RQD t And (3) an anisotropy solving method. The invention combines three-dimensional laser scanning, a neighbor propagation algorithm, a BQ theory, a fracture network model, a generalized RQD theory and inversion calculation to realize RQD t And solving the optimum threshold t and the anisotropy, and provides an RQD based on laser scanning, BQ and the optimum threshold t And (3) an anisotropy solving method. The method is clear and suitable for rock RQD t The anisotropy of (2) is solved.

title_en: Network security situation sensing method based on electric power CPS
abstract_en: The invention discloses a network security situation perception method based on an electric power CPS, which comprises the following steps: s1: preprocessing alarm data; s2: fusing alarm data, namely fusing multi-source alarm information by using an alarm information fusion method based on credibility; s3: power CPS security risk assessment based on a threat propagation tree. According to the network security situation sensing method based on the electric power CPS, correlation analysis can be performed by utilizing the time-space characteristics in the preprocessing of the security alarm log data, redundant data are further merged, and the processing efficiency is improved; the effectiveness is high, the safety threatening action often leaves traces in logs of different devices, and the traces are often correlated in time and space and are often the same or similar in time and space, and the false data and  threat can be effectively distinguished by the property.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: TCMS network fault propagation analysis method based on SIR model
abstract_en: The invention relates to a TCMS network fault propagation analysis method based on an SIR model, which comprises the following steps: carrying out architecture analysis on the TCMS system, and establishing a TCMS fault propagation structure network based on an architecture establishing method; carrying out propagation mechanism hypothesis on the TCMS fault propagation structure network, and determining an SIR fault propagation model suitable for TCMS fault propagation characteristic analysis; solving and analyzing an SIR fault propagation model through SIR evolution equation application; carrying out simulation test on the TCMS software system by using a Netlogo programmable simulation platform to obtain a fault propagation simulation numerical analysis diagram under different simulation parameters; and carrying out fault propagation prediction analysis according to each fault propagation simulation numerical analysis graph to obtain a TCMS network fault propagation conclusion. The invention can reduce the fault propagation probability of the TCMS network, reduce the occurrence of fault propagation and improve the reliability of the TCMS system.
assignees: CRRC CHANGCHUN RAILWAY VEHICLES CO LTD

title_en: Key line identification method for AC/DC power grid accident chain
abstract_en: A method for identifying a key line of an AC/DC power grid accident chain comprises the following steps: step 1: acquiring an AC/DC power grid cascading failure accident chain to be processed, identifying a key line, and recording the occurrence probability and load loss of the accident chain; step 2: constructing indexes aiming at the influence of the lines in the accident chain on the system tidal current, voltage, topological structure and load loss; and 3, step 3: respectively solving subjective weight w 'and objective weight w' of the constructed indexes; and 4, step 4: establishing an objective function of w 'and w', seeking the most linear combination coefficient, performing combination weighting and measuring the lineRoad l i In the accident chain L j Of local importance IN i (ii) a And 5: obtaining each line l in AC/DC power grid i The criticality index of (A) is And 6: sorting the criticality indexes of all lines, and taking a plurality of lines before the criticality indexes as the critical lines of the AC/DC power grid; the key line of the cascading failure of the alternating current and direct current power grid is identified through the steps.

title_en: Node division and time step selection method, device and equipment for pipe network transient flow
abstract_en: The invention discloses a node division and time step selection method, device and equipment of pipe network transient flow, and relates to the technical field of energy power engineering simulation, wherein the method comprises the steps of carrying out node division on a pipe network and calculating to obtain the pressure fluctuation amplitude of each node of a pipeline; setting a pressure fluctuation amplitude threshold to divide a pipe network into a sensitive area and a non-sensitive area, and determining short pipes in the sensitive area based on pressure wave propagation time; acquiring a pipeline with the shortest pressure wave propagation time except for a short pipe in the sensitive area as the shortest pipeline, determining a time step, and dividing pipeline nodes in the sensitive area; dividing the pipeline nodes of the non-sensitive area based on the determined time step, adopting an elastic model for the pipelines except the shortest pipeline in the sensitive area, adopting a short pipeline model for the time delay effect for the pipeline in the non-sensitive area, and performing transient flow calculation. According to the method and the device, the number of pipe network segments is greatly reduced and the calculation efficiency is greatly improved on the premise that accuracy and the accuracy of a physical process are guaranteed.
assignees: NO 719 RES INSTITUTE CHINA STATE SHIPBUILDING CO LTD

title_en: Short-term power load prediction method based on PSR-DBN (Power System support-direct-base network) combined model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power grid load power prediction, in particular to a PSR-DBN (power system-direct-current neutral network) combined model-based short-term power load prediction method, which comprises the following steps: preprocessing the power load data; processing the time series data by adopting a phase space reconstruction technology, and reconstructing a phase space by determining delay time and embedding dimension; after the phase space is reconstructed, performing feature extraction and prediction by using a deep confidence network; performing layer-by-layer pre-training and fine tuning on the deep confidence network, wherein the layer-by-layer pre-training utilizes the weight and bias of the layer-by-layer training network of an unsupervised learning algorithm, and the overall fine tuning is based on the layer-by-layer pre-training, and performs fine tuning on the deep confidence network by using forward propagation and reverse propagation combined with the supervised learning algorithm; model evaluation and optimization. The invention provides rich data samples, enhances the understanding and capturing capability of the model to complex nonlinear relations, and shows remarkable high accuracy in the power load prediction task by combining the two methods.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Multi-layer coupling power system risk propagation analysis method based on space-time diagram neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a time-space diagram neural network-based risk propagation analysis method for a multi-layer coupling power system, and belongs to the technical field of power systems. The method comprises the steps of constructing an information-electric power-traffic three-layer heterogeneous coupling network model, collecting physical quantity in the heterogeneous coupling network, constructing graph data based on neighborhood and connectivity, constructing a risk propagation prediction model based on a space-time multi-graph neural network, enabling a space learning network to comprise k parallel graph convolution layers, enabling a time learning network to be realized by combining a long-short-period memory network LSTM and an attention mechanism, obtaining history graph data of normal operation of the heterogeneous coupling network and history graph data with faults, inputting the history graph data into the prediction model for training, enabling the graph structure to be adaptively updated, and predicting a risk propagation path in the three-layer heterogeneous coupling network by using the trained risk propagation prediction model. The invention realizes the risk propagation path in the three-layer heterogeneous complex network structure of information-electric power-traffic and can reflect the real-time space-time relationship.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING TECHNOLOGY & BUSINESS;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER CORP

title_en: Deep learning-based charging pile load prediction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deep learning-based charging pile load prediction method which comprises the following steps of S1, constructing a regional grid and initializing a cell basic attribute vector, S2, collecting historical load data and external influence factors, unifying the historical load data and the external influence factors into input tensors, S3, generating a time continuous evolution state by a nerve ordinary differential equation modeling module, S4, constructing a current moment state vector, S5, executing one-time space state propagation by a microcell automaton module, S6, carrying out multiple rounds of space propagation iteration, outputting an enhanced state representation, S7, outputting future multi-moment predicted values by a load prediction module, S8, calculating errors, executing end-to-end training optimization model parameters, and S9, outputting a final optimization model as a load prediction method. The invention obviously improves the response capability of the model to sudden disturbance and the stability of multi-region collaborative prediction, and can be widely applied to various application scenes such as intelligent energy management, electric traffic scheduling, intelligent optimization of urban public infrastructure and the like.
assignees: DONGFANG ZHONGTONG ENERGY SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Environment risk reasoning method and system based on environment-friendly intelligent management and control platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses an environment risk reasoning method and system based on an environment-friendly intelligent management and control platform, comprising the following steps: and (3) searching historical environment risk examples based on the production attributes of the target industrial park, and extracting the characteristic analysis evolution process to generate a risk evolution characteristic set. And deep mining the cascade relation in the feature set, constructing a risk evolution feature domain and a risk cascade feature domain, and fusing the risk evolution feature domain and the risk cascade feature domain into an environmental risk knowledge graph. And establishing an inference model by utilizing the atlas, and deducing an environmental risk situation through real-time sensor data. And when the risk is identified, calling a preset strategy to perform Monte Carlo intervention simulation and optimize a regulation scheme. And constructing a regulation response network according to equipment layout, and identifying a weak area through efficiency characteristic analysis to generate a network optimization suggestion so as to realize closed-loop optimization of a management and control system. Thereby promoting the environment treatment to be converted from passive response to active prediction and from single-point control to system control, and improving the overall efficiency and the intelligent level of regional environment risk control.
assignees: DACHENG DEXIN TECH SHANXI CO LTD

title_en: Fmea-based ac power system asset management target equipment selection method considering failure probability and failure impact, and recording medium storing program for executing the same, and computer program stored in recording medium for executing the same
title_ko: 고장확률, 고장영향을 고려한 fmea 기반 ac 전력계통 자산관리 대상 설비 선정 방법, 이를 구현하기 위한 프로그램이 저장된 기록매체 및 이를 구현하기 위해 매체에 저장된 컴퓨터프로그램
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for selecting an FMEA-based AC power system asset management target facility in consideration of failure probability and failure impact. More specifically, the present invention provides a method for selecting an FMEA-based ac power system asset management target facility in consideration of failure probability and failure impact, which is a method for selecting an asset management target facility of an AC power system by expanding a failure mode and effect analysis (FMEA) technique to a power system and analyzing a failure effect for each failure mode of a system configuration facility, and quantifying and considering a failure probability of failure (POF) of the system configuration facility and a secondary damage (consequence of failure (CoF)) that is spread due to a failure as an amount.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 고장확률, 고장영향을 고려한 FMEA 기반 AC 전력계통 자산관리 대상 설비 선정 방법에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 FMEA(Failure Mode and Effect Analysis)기법을 전력계통으로 확장, 계통 구성설비의 고장모드별 고장 영향을 분석하여 AC 전력계통의 자산관리 대상설비를 선정하는 방법으로 계통 구성설비의 고장확률(PoF, Probability of Failure)과 고장으로 인해 파급되는 2차 피해(CoF, Consequence of Failure)를 금액으로 정량화하여 고려한 고장확률, 고장영향을 고려한 FMEA 기반 AC 전력계통 자산관리 대상 설비 선정 방법을 제공한다.
assignees: UNIV NAT MOKPO IND ACAD COOP GROUP

title_en: Using computer video camera to detect earthquake
abstract_en: Images from the video camera of a computer are compared over time, e.g., every few milliseconds, to determine from the pixel data if motion of the computer matches template motion associated with an earthquake P-wave. If so, a warning is generated, uploaded to a communication network, and propagated over the network to other computers.

title_en: HSS (home subscriber server) data disaster tolerant algorithm based on artificial intelligence and neural network
abstract_en: An HSS (home subscriber server) data disaster tolerant algorithm based on an artificial intelligence and neural network includes: firstly, newly adding four zone fields for an HSS database, wherein the zone fields include a user registration status change frequency, a PPR transmission frequency, a RTR transmission frequency and predicted user types after BP (back propagation) neural network study; when optional one of the user registration status change frequency, the PPR transmission frequency or the RTR transmission frequency exceeds a preset neuron threshold value, adding a user into a specific list by a HSS database to trigger backup algorithm, wherein the backup algorithm refers to an artificial intelligence and neural network algorithm. The HSS data disaster tolerant algorithm based on the artificial intelligence and neural network has the advantages that zones frequent in service handling can be designed individually by means of analysis and discovery of some HSS data variations, for example: server performances of the zones are improved and data of the zones are backed up to two or more than two adjacent zones so that risks are avoided.

title_en: Elasticity evaluation method for electricity-gas region comprehensive energy system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an elasticity evaluation method of an electricity-gas region comprehensive energy system based on a heterogeneous dependency network, which comprises the steps of 1) constructing an elasticity index system of the electricity-gas region comprehensive energy system from two dimensions including fragility and restoring force facing the elasticity of extreme events, wherein the elasticity index system comprises 5 indexes for quantifying the elasticity of the electricity-gas region comprehensive energy system and each elasticity index is defined in a complex form; 2) establishing a heterogeneous dependency network model of the electric-gas region comprehensive energy system, converting the heterogeneous dependency network model into a double-layer digraph, and calculating values of 5 indexes; 3) and determining the weights of the 5 indexes by using a geometric mean G1-entropy weight resisting method, and calculating to obtain a comprehensive elasticity value of the system to realize the elasticity evaluation of the comprehensive energy system in the electricity-gas region. The method considers the dependency and heterogeneity of the power grid and the natural gas grid, facilitates fault propagation analysis, considers the subjective and objective weights of the indexes, and can scientifically and effectively quantify and evaluate the elasticity of the electric-gas regional comprehensive energy system.

title_en: Electric power information physical system robustness analysis method based on reachable matrix
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power information physical system robustness analysis method based on a reachable matrix, which comprises the following steps: inputting an adjacency matrix Ep of the power network, an adjacency matrix Ec of the information network, and a dependency matrix Epc between the power network and the information network; determining an attack node in the power network, wherein the attack node is a starting point of fault propagation, deleting fault nodes which appear in an adjacent matrix Ep and an adjacent matrix Ec after the fault propagation based on a dependent matrix Epc, and outputting the adjacent matrix Ep, the adjacent matrix Ec and the dependent matrix Epc; updating the dependency matrix Epc, and forming an attacked widened adjacent matrix based on the adjacent matrix Ep, the adjacent matrix Ec and the updated dependency matrix Epc; and calculating the system robustness index after the attack based on the extended adjacency matrix. The modeling complexity of the mutual coupling network can be reduced, the structural characteristic change and the dynamics rule of network connection in the system are clearly and intuitively displayed, the complexity of an attack graph is reduced, and the understanding and analysis of safety personnel are facilitated.

title_en: Electric-betting-based power grid fragile line identification method
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for identifying a fragile circuit of a power grid based on novel electric betters, which comprises the steps of constructing the power grid into a network diagram, sequentially removing circuits in the network diagram, and sequencing the novel electric betters of each circuit from large to small; constructing a complex network cascading failure nonlinear model considering overload and weighted edges, and respectively performing two line removing modes on the ordered novel electrical betweenness, namely sequentially removing preset proportion lines and sequentially removing all lines until no new lines are removed from the network diagram; and acquiring the change of the generator-load power before and after each line removal, and evaluating the severity of the power grid fault based on the change of the generator-load power to finish the identification of the fragile line of the power grid. The invention obviously reduces the calculation cost and can better consider the accuracy and the efficiency.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and storage medium for predicting output current of synchronous generator
abstract_en: The application relates to a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for predicting output current of a synchronous generator. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring working state data of a current time point of a synchronous generator, wherein the working state data comprise d-axis voltage, q-axis voltage, excitation voltage and mechanical power input into the synchronous generator; inputting the working state data into a preset hybrid driving model, wherein the preset hybrid driving model comprises a cascade synchronous generator physical model and a neural network model; processing the working state data through the physical model of the synchronous generator to obtain initial predicted d-axis current and initial predicted q-axis current; and correcting the initial predicted d-axis current and the initial predicted q-axis current through the neural network model to obtain the predicted d-axis current and the predicted q-axis current of the synchronous generator. By adopting the method, the prediction accuracy can be improved, and the generalization capability of the model under different scenes can be improved.

title_en: Power system network attack consequence evaluation method considering switch modularization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system network attack consequence evaluation method considering switch modularization, which relates to the technical field related to power system safety protection and emergency response and comprises the following steps of carrying out modularization modeling on key switch equipment in a power system to determine functional logic and fault propagation paths of the key switch equipment; and solving the optimal attack path and generating a defending configuration scheme by simulating strategy games of an attacker and a defender. The method can more accurately simulate the influence of the network attack on the power system, is beneficial to analyzing the fragile links and key nodes of the network attack, and identifies potential network attack paths and risks, thereby providing scientific basis for the safety protection and emergency response of the power system.

title_en: Water-wind-light complementary scheduling scheme optimization method, system and equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a water-wind-solar complementary scheduling scheme optimization method, a system and equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps of defining a multi-dimensional index system for the economy and safety of a reaction scheduling scheme; the method comprises the steps of simulating a disturbance propagation process and influence degree based on a logic association network, calculating the size of each index of a scheduling scheme, inputting a disturbance scene to be simulated into the logic association network, simulating the propagation effect of disturbance in the logic association network based on the topology structure of the logic association network, selecting key indexes, determining the system disturbance risk of the disturbance scene based on the size and change degree of each key index after disturbance propagation, selecting the disturbance scene, calculating the system disturbance risk of each disturbance scene, calculating the comprehensive risk index of each scheduling scheme, sequencing the scheduling schemes and selecting an optimal scheduling scheme. The logic association network provided by the application can reflect the association between indexes, evaluate the linkage influence of disturbance on a plurality of indexes, and minimize the risk caused by disturbance.

title_en: Transport path optimization method and device considering port cascade failure risk
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transportation path optimization method and device considering port cascade failure risk, and belongs to the technical field of port logistics and transportation network optimization. Aiming at the problems of insufficient consideration of systematic risk of a port and easy initiation of chain reaction due to single-point failure in the conventional transportation path planning, the invention provides a comprehensive evaluation and optimization mechanism, which characterizes a port transportation network by constructing a weighted directed graph model, integrates port bearing capacity, historical failure probability and multidimensional external risk factors, and realizes quantitative measurement and calculation of port cascade failure risk. On the basis, a multi-objective optimization function is designed, the minimum product of time and cost is taken as an optimization target, meanwhile, the minimum probability of failure risk of the whole path is restrained, and the optimal transportation path is solved by utilizing algorithms such as gradient descent and the like. By dynamically adjusting traffic distribution, high risk nodes are effectively avoided, and network robustness and transportation reliability are improved. The method can be widely applied to the scenes of international maritime transportation, container scheduling and the like, obviously reduces the transportation cost and the interruption risk, and enhances the capability of coping with emergency events.

title_en: Underground radio network integrated repeater system by digital
title_ko: 디지털 지하 무선망 종합 중계장치
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 디지털 지하 무선망 종합 중계장치에 관한 것으로서, 전파차단지역 및 전파음영지역에 AM/FM 방송 및 지상파 DMB 방송의 공중파 방송신호를 디지털신호로 변환하여 채널별 분리 증폭방식으로 각 채널을 구분하여 중계함으로써 중계되는 전파의 질을 향상시킬 뿐만 아니라 외부 무선통신 주파수를 중계하고 비상상황 발생시 AM/FM 방송 및 지상파 DMB 방송을 통해 비상방송을 할 수 있도록 하며 원격지에서 중계장치를 종합적으로 제어 및 감시할 수 있다.

title_en: Method, equipment and system utilizing broadband intelligent network to call service disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, equipment and a system utilizing a broadband intelligent network to call a service disaster. The method comprises the following steps: when the link is switched, an SIP (Session Initiation Protocol) proxy server distributes the call services to SCPs (Service Control Point) of the broadband intelligent network according to a preset distribution strategy; and the SCPs notify the cells required to be in communication with the SCPs in the broadband intelligent network to be in communication with the SCPs. According to the method, the equipment and the system provided by the invention, when the broadband intelligent network is used for SCP service disaster switching, the related cells can be correspondingly switched, as a result, the service interruption caused by untimely synchronous switching is avoided.

title_en: Heat supply unit peak regulation upper limit evaluation method and system based on BP neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heat supply unit peak regulation upper limit evaluation method and system based on a BP neural network, wherein variable working condition calculation based on heat consumption rate is introduced, historical working condition data of main steam flow close to the maximum are obtained, and according to the data, an electric load value is obtained if the main steam flow reaches the maximum under the heat supply working condition based on thermodynamic calculation of the heat consumption rate and is used as a calculated peak regulation upper limit under the working condition. And then establishing a neural network evaluation model, and reducing the error of calculating the peak regulation upper limit to the maximum extent by means of the self-learning property and the error back propagation property of the BP neural network model, so that the more objective and accurate peak regulation upper limit can be obtained. The whole evaluation process does not influence normal heat supply and power supply, and the workload and the consumed time are relatively less.
assignees: HUNAN DATANG XIANYI TECH CO LTD;GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Bidding electric quantity boundary determination method for step hydropower station group participating in spot market before day
abstract_en: The invention relates to the fields of electric power markets, hydropower dispatching and power grid operation, and discloses a bidding electric quantity boundary determining method for a cascade hydropower station group participating in a spot market in the day ahead. With the continuous improvement of the construction of the electric power spot market in China, the participation of water and electricity in the spot market is imperative. In the power market, the clearing efficiency is related to the safe and stable operation of the power grid. The invention aims at the problems that the complex hydraulic connection of a cascade upstream and downstream water reservoir leads to the complex spot shipment model and the low shipment efficiency, and the water abandonment and the difficult execution of the trading result are easy to cause in the spot shipment market of hydropower participation, and the like, carries out the determination of the daily marketization boundary condition of the cascade hydropower station, provides the concept of the absolute feasible electric quantity interval of the hydropower station, reveals the evolution rule of the electric quantity boundary of the cascade hydropower station along with the change of the self-generated water quantity, completely avoids the problem of mismatching of the upstream and downstream hydropower stations, improves the solution efficiency of the shipment model, and provides a practical and feasible thought for a market operator to manage the hydropower participation spot shipment market.
assignees: CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO;UNIV DALIAN TECH

title_en: Problem data processing method and system for distribution network engineering management
abstract_en: The invention provides a problem data processing method and system for distribution network engineering management, which specifically comprise the following steps: determining a problem information transmission path corresponding to the first power monitoring information in the digital twin distribution network model, and taking each node in the problem information transmission path as a target screening node; acquiring all other distribution network equipment connected with the target screening node in the problem information transmission path to generate a twin node topological graph, taking all other distribution network equipment as auxiliary screening nodes, classifying the auxiliary screening nodes corresponding to the target screening nodes according to the twin node topological graph, and acquiring a verification screening set corresponding to each target screening node; sequentially traversing each target screening node in the node screening sequence, and screening according to a verification screening set corresponding to each target screening node to obtain the problem data; and processing the problem data based on an information cascade strategy and a preset twin strategy database to obtain corresponding processing data.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;JINHUA POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: FNP-BPNN fusion drive-based power system frequency lowest point prediction method
abstract_en: The invention provides a power system frequency lowest point prediction method based on FNP-BPNN fusion driving, and belongs to the field of power system frequency stability analysis and control. As a physical driving link, a Frequency Nadir Prediction (FNP) model may solve an analytic solution of Frequency nadirs and obtain an initial prediction result at high speed. As a data driving link, a Back Propagation Neural Network (BPNN) can correct errors of initial prediction results on line and improve prediction accuracy. The serial mode is used for fusing the two, and the final prediction result can be efficiently and accurately obtained. Compared with the existing fusion driving method, the FNP model can retain more key influence factors, and the dependence of the BPNN on sample data and characteristic dimensions is reduced to the great extent, so that the method can provide more reliable indexes and bases for stable frequency analysis and control of the power system.
assignees: YINGKOU ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;UNIV DALIAN TECH

title_en: Non-invasive load identification method and system based on Gram angle field and feature fusion
abstract_en: Non-invasive load identification method and system based on a gladhand angle field and feature fusion, the method comprising: step 1, converting one-dimensional active power data into two-dimensional image data by adopting a Graham angle field visualization technology; step 2, respectively inputting the two-dimensional image data and the one-dimensional active power data into a trained convolutional neural network and a trained counter-propagating neural network to extract features, and fusing the extracted image features and power features; and step 3, inputting the fusion characteristics into a trained classification network to identify the load category, thereby completing non-invasive load identification. The identification accuracy on the low-frequency sampling data can be effectively improved, and the high efficiency and accuracy under the low-frequency acquisition scene are met.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD SUZHOU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH

title_en: Attack and defense game model based on malicious attack damage analysis of power grid and application method of attack and defense game model
abstract_en: The invention discloses an attack and defense game model based on power grid malicious attack damage analysis and a use method thereof, wherein an attacker destructive power model is established according to the maximum attack equivalent of power grid unit damage association propagation and attacker investment; establishing a defender power system hit scheduling model by considering the associated hit state of the power grid unit; according to the optimization targets of the attacker and the defender, an objective function of the attack and defense game problem is proposed; the mixed integer nonlinear two-person zero and game problem in the original problem is successfully converted into a mixed integer linear optimization problem by applying KKT conditions and linear transformation, and finally, an attacker optimal attack path and an defender optimal scheduling scheme under the malicious attack scene of the power grid are solved by a conventional solver. The model and the method can help the power grid defense dispatcher to formulate more effective defense measures, optimize the resistance strategy and the recovery capacity of the power system, and provide scientific basis for emergency response and recovery planning of the system.

title_en: Underground cavern group rock drilling efficiency prediction method and equipment based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underground cavern group rock drilling efficiency prediction method based on deep learning, which comprises the following steps of 1, collecting relevant data of underground cavern group drilling efficiency and influence factors thereof, taking the collected data as original data, 2, preprocessing the collected original data, compiling a sample data set, 3, building a drilling efficiency prediction model based on a back propagation neural network, training the drilling efficiency prediction model by adopting the sample data set, 4, optimizing super parameters of a hidden layer structure in the drilling efficiency prediction model by adopting a BFO algorithm, 5, monitoring the underground cavern group drilling efficiency and the influence factors thereof in the construction process, preprocessing the monitored data, and predicting the drilling efficiency in the construction process by adopting the optimized drilling efficiency prediction model. According to the invention, the bacterial foraging optimization algorithm is selected to optimize the model hyper-parameters, so that the model training effect is improved.

title_en: Marine seismic signal processing method based on distributed optical fiber vibration sensing
abstract_en: The invention provides a marine seismic signal processing method based on distributed optical fiber vibration sensing, and belongs to the technical field of seismic signal processing. The method comprises the steps of collecting ocean seismic signals through a distributed optical fiber vibration sensor, carrying out data preprocessing on the collected seismic signals to construct a seismic waveform chart data set, carrying out feature extraction on the preprocessed seismic signals through a U-KAN network according to preprocessed data to obtain feature data, identifying and classifying the feature data to obtain P waves and S waves, calculating time difference between the P waves and the S waves according to the identified P waves and the identified S waves, and estimating seismic source distance and seismic magnitude according to the time difference and seismic wave propagation speed. The invention improves the degree of automation of seismic signal processing, accurately determines the arrival time of seismic waves, improves the response speed and accuracy of marine seismic monitoring, and provides scientific basis for marine seismic disaster prevention and reduction.

title_en: Power equipment fault cross-domain collaborative analysis system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power equipment fault cross-domain collaborative analysis system and a method, which relate to the technical field of power grid dispatching and comprise the steps of acquiring multisource heterogeneous data of preprocessed power equipment, based on the topological relation of the preprocessing data and the historical fault data, a cross-domain knowledge graph is constructed, a fault propagation path is marked, and an embedded representation is carried out by adopting a graph neural network. And designing a space-time multi-branch network, respectively extracting space, time sequence and modal interaction characteristics by using the space-time multi-branch network, and fusing at a characteristic fusion layer to obtain fusion characteristics and branch weights. Combining knowledge graph embedded representation, constructing a collaborative reasoning model by using a Bayesian network, carrying out reasoning decision on the fusion characteristics, finally obtaining a cross-domain collaborative analysis result of the power equipment fault, and realizing fusion and efficient reasoning of multi-source heterogeneous data by combining the knowledge graph and a space-time multi-branch network, thereby improving the accuracy and efficiency of fault diagnosis.
assignees: SHAANXI ZHONGHUAN ELECTRIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Host machine fault disaster recovery method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
