abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a host machine fault disaster recovery method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium, wherein the method comprises determining whether each host machine contains a fault risk according to the condition of receiving network communication information sent by each host machine; if the host computer with the fault risk exists, stopping receiving the network communication information sent by the host computer with the fault risk, and isolating the storage resource of the host computer with the fault risk; selecting a host from hosts without fault risks, and rebuilding virtual machines running on the hosts with fault risks on the selected hosts. According to the method and the device, the potential faults of the host can be found as soon as possible, and the problems of software and hardware of the host with the fault risk can be detected conveniently and subsequently through isolating and reserving the site, and the virtual machines on the host with the fault risk are rebuilt on other healthy hosts, so that the service interruption time of the host is reduced.

title_en: Wind power large-base energy efficiency collaborative power prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind power large-base energy efficiency collaborative power prediction method and system, which are used for solving the problems that a traditional prediction model does not account for the state of a wind turbine, insufficient regional weather coupling and weak cooperativity of multiple stations, constructing a power main band through a self-adaptive bandwidth kernel function, removing abnormal data to generate a reference health data set, aggregating a wind turbine health index based on a power deviation rate, combining a long-period memory neural network to dynamically correct power output, fusing multiple source data, reconstructing a regional wind field through a limit gradient lifting model, embedding a topographic wake characteristic weight into a loss function to optimize and predict, identifying a dominant station through a force complementary coefficient matrix, establishing a propagation chain to realize wide-area association modeling, remarkably improving the state sensing capability of the wind turbine, strengthening regional weather coupling modeling precision, realizing the collaborative prediction of the multiple stations, reflecting the whole available power generation capability of the large-base, effectively improving the power prediction precision, and providing reliable support for power grid dispatching and power markets.
assignees: NANJING GUODIAN NANZI VALMET AUTOMATION CO LTD

title_en: Flood network flood bank flooding simulation and disaster damage assessment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood network flood bank flooding simulation and disaster damage assessment method, and belongs to the technical field of flood control and disaster reduction. The method comprises the steps of carrying out hydrodynamic analysis based on hydrologic geographic data to determine a potential overtop area, simulating the evolution of a bursting mouth based on accumulated scouring energy criteria aiming at the potential overtop area to generate a bursting mouth flow process, simulating flood evolution according to the bursting mouth flow process to generate a spatial disaster intensity field, and evaluating direct and indirect economic losses by combining the disaster intensity field and social economic data to generate a comprehensive disaster loss result. The invention introduces physical criteria based on accumulated scouring energy, adopts comprehensive strength indexes, three-dimensional vulnerability curved surfaces and applies graph neural networks to simulate cascade failure, and solves the problems of missing of a breach triggering mechanism, single disaster intensity measurement and static disaster damage assessment.
assignees: TAIHU BASIN MANAGEMENT BUREAU WATER RESOURCES DEVELOPMENT RES CENTER

title_en: System Of Notifying And Requesting Emergency Rescue And Method Thereof
title_ko: 긴급구조 전파요청 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention provides a system for spreading an emergency rescue request which includes: a transmitting device transmitting characteristic information of a user and an emergency rescue request in the event of an emergency situation; a user terminal receiving the emergency rescue request from the transmitting device through a near field communication network, and transmitting the emergency rescue request and the characteristic information to a registered terminal and a registered institution through a mobile communication network; and a neighboring terminal receiving the emergency rescue request and the characteristic information from the transmitting device through the near field communication network. Therefore, the present invention is capable of maximizing the efficiency of initial response.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 긴급상황 발생 시 긴급구조요청 및 사용자의 특성정보를 전송하는 발신장치와; 근거리무선통신망을 통하여 상기 발신장치로부터 상기 긴급구조요청을 전송 받고, 이동통신망을 통하여 상기 긴급구조요청 및 상기 특성정보를 등록단말 및 등록기관으로 전송하는 사용자단말과; 근거리무선통신망을 통하여 상기 발신장치로부터 상기 긴급구조요청 및 상기 특성정보를 전송 받는 주변단말을 포함하는 긴급구조 전파요청 시스템을 제공한다.
assignees: PARK JUN KYU;UTILLIGHTING CO LTD;CHANG SEI YUL

title_en: Probabilistic Model For Cyber Risk Forecasting
abstract_en: A system and method are presented for forecasting the risk of cyber-attacks on targeted networks. The described technology quantifies linear and non-linear damages to network-dependent assets by propagating probabilistic distributions of events in sequence and time in order to forecast damages over specified periods. Damage-forecasts are used to estimate probabilistically time-varying financial losses for cyber-attacks. The described technology incorporates quantities and dependencies for pricing insurance, re-insurance, and self-insurance, assessing cost-benefit tradeoffs for sequenced implementation of security control measures, and detecting attacks in the targeted network.

title_en: Production network linkage effect research method based on propagation dynamics in disturbance environment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of chain effect analysis of production workshops, in particular to a method for researching chain effect of a production network in a disturbance environment based on propagation dynamics, which takes a manufacturing node in a production system as a node, takes a process relation between production activities as a continuous edge, determines parameters in a propagation model according to an established production network, adopts a 5W2H analysis method in combination with a process route theory to evaluate and judge disturbance intensity according to delay time and economic loss, classifies disturbance influence degree into four types of slight disturbance, moderate disturbance, severe disturbance and serious disturbance, selects different nodes in the network as propagation source nodes for activation, and deeply researches the interrelation between a production network topological structure and disturbance propagation dynamics characteristics so as to reveal a unique chain propagation rule of an operation workshop in the disturbance environment. The invention provides effective reference and basis for the stable operation control of the production workshop.

title_en: Mid-term peak regulation scheduling method for cascade reservoir group coupled with water flow time lag
abstract_en: The invention provides a cascade reservoir medium-term peak regulation scheduling method coupled with water flow delay aiming at frequent fluctuation of power grid daytime load and complex hydraulic connection of a cascade reservoir group. Firstly, constructing a multi-target model of power grid medium-term dispatching according to the target of optimal power grid peak regulation and maximum cascade power generation amount; then, a middle-stage segmental water flow delay description method and a parameter determination method are provided based on a water quantity balance principle, and a calculation method of scheduling period and delay period cascade comprehensive benefits under the influence of water flow delay is determined according to the middle-stage segmental water flow delay description method and the parameter determination method; and finally, fitting complex nonlinear constraints in the model by using a polynomial. The calculation result of taking the 11-seat cascade hydropower station in the laneway river as a research object shows that the calculation result of the method is more consistent with the actual operation condition by introducing the water flow time-lag factor, so that the scheduling plan deviation influenced by the hysteresis is effectively reduced, the water and electricity utilization benefit is improved, and the method has a good medium-term peak regulation effect.

title_en: Tube burst positioning method based on transient flow
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for realizing the positioning of pipe explosion, in order to realize the accurate positioning of a complex pipe network, a high-frequency SCADA system is applied to monitor a pressure abnormal signal in the pipe network, the whole change (system abnormity) and the transient change (transient flow abnormity) of the pressure are analyzed after the pressure abnormal signal is filtered, and the pipe explosion event is identified; simulating transient flow excited by pipe explosion according to the momentum theorem and the actual operation numerical value of opening the ball valve, and simulating the monitoring point transient flow according to the propagation characteristic of the transient flow on the basis; judging pipe sections of the pipe burst through numerical simulation of monitoring point signals of pipe burst of each pipe section; the pipe bursting positioning is realized by judging the monitoring point signals of pipe section pipe bursting through numerical simulation; compared with the actual pipe burst position and the positioning position of the negative pressure wave method, the method proves that the positioning precision is higher, and the method can effectively solve the problem of precise positioning of the complex pipe network.

title_en: Intelligent water regime detection early warning system based on singlechip
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water regime detection and early warning, and discloses an intelligent water regime detection and early warning system based on a single chip microcomputer, which comprises the following components: the water level meter comprises a water level meter signal acquisition module, a data comparison module, a singlechip, a data recording module, a wireless matching module and a wireless data transmission module; the water level meter signal acquisition module is used for acquiring data signals sent by the water level meter; through the design of wireless matching module and wireless data transmission module, can be when the water level in large-scale lake rises and surpass the early warning value automatic connection to the wireless network equipment around the lake coast and to its water condition early warning signal that sends to pedestrian around the coast and resident around the lake can be carried out the early warning suggestion in the first time that the water condition appears early warning to pedestrian around the coast, thereby can make people in time prevent the water condition disaster that will appear, avoided the water condition early warning information to propagate not in time to lead to the condition emergence of serious harm to appear.

title_en: Intelligent maintenance method and system for rail transit based on adaptive control
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent maintenance method and system for rail transit based on adaptive control, which comprises a camera detection unit, an ultrasonic flaw detection unit, an impact detection unit and a prediction model unit, wherein in the prediction model unit, a first kalman filtering estimation value is calculated in the back propagation process of an RNN (radio network) model; the second Kalman filtering estimation value is calculated in the back propagation process of the LSTM network model; meanwhile, self-adaptive updating is carried out on the weight of the fusion layer through a second Kalman filtering estimation value to obtain an updated fusion estimation risk factor.

title_en: Analysis method for possible maximum disaster of cascade hydropower junction group
abstract_en: The invention discloses an analysis method of a possible maximum disaster of a cascade hydroelectric junction group, which divides the generation factors of the cascade hydroelectric junction group dam break into an extreme load action unit and a dam break influence unit, divides the influence result of the hydroelectric junction dam break into a disaster-bearing body disaster-bearing loss unit, considers the extreme load combination of 4 disaster-causing factors of extreme floods, giant earthquakes, barrier lakes and giant landslide, and utilizes the dam break influence unit to transmit continuous-break influence in the Bayesian network by constructing the analysis method of the possible maximum disaster of the cascade hydroelectric junction group based on the Bayesian network, so that the maximum possible disaster of 3 disaster-bearing bodies of the cascade hydroelectric junction group, such as dam affiliated facilities, downstream building damages, casualties and ecological interference caused by the cascade hydroelectric junction group continuous-break, can be calculated simply and scientifically, thereby being beneficial to quantitatively analyzing the disaster influence degree of the cascade hydroelectric junction group and helping to determine a reasonable hydroelectric junction risk control decision.

title_en: Optimal scheduling method, device, equipment and medium for cascade water-light complementary power generation system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of new energy of electric power systems, in particular to an optimized dispatching method, device, equipment and medium of a cascade water-light complementary power generation system, which comprises the following steps: based on the data analysis of the historical electricity price, constructing a spot price prediction model; acquiring typical photovoltaic output scenes representing different weather conditions by adopting a density peak clustering algorithm; the method is characterized by taking the maximum electricity price gain of a water-light complementary power generation system and the minimum peak-valley difference of a receiving end power grid Yu Fuhe as double targets, and simultaneously taking the complex constraint of cascade hydropower and the limit of the transmission capacity of the outgoing power into consideration; constructing a multi-objective optimization scheduling model of the cascade water-light complementary power generation system considering the peak regulation requirement of the power grid and the economic benefit of the system; and solving the multi-objective optimization model based on NSGA-NPSO non-dominant layered niche particle swarm algorithm to obtain the optimal scheduling method of the cascade water-light complementary power generation system, so that the scheduling result is more matched with the actual situation, and the economy and safety of the system are improved.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle distributed scheduling method and system applied to communication interruption region
abstract_en: The invention provides an unmanned aerial vehicle distribution scheduling method and system applied to a communication interruption area, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining unmanned aerial vehicle information used for the communication interruption area, and carrying out aerial networking on all unmanned aerial vehicles according to the unmanned aerial vehicle information; after networking is successful, defining coordinate sets of all unmanned aerial vehicles participating in networking, constructing a logarithmic path loss model according to the coordinate sets, obtaining signal propagation intensity of any position point of a communication interruption area according to the path loss model, constructing a signal coverage rate objective function according to the signal propagation intensity, constructing a network average link quality objective function and a node energy consumption balance objective function to obtain a comprehensive objective function, maximizing the comprehensive objective function as a target, and solving by adopting an improved particle swarm optimization algorithm to obtain the deployment position of all unmanned aerial vehicles in the communication interruption area. The invention can obviously improve the deployment efficiency and reliability of the disaster area communication system.

title_en: System for evaluating performance of disaster response system using boundary value by using expert evaluation
title_ko: 전문가 평가를 이용하여 재난대응시스템의 성능을 평가하는 시스템
abstract_ko: 일 실시예는 과거재난데이터, 기관이 수집 또는 처리한 기관재난데이터 및 환경시설에서 측정된 환경시설재난데이터를 포함하는 재난데이터를 수집하는 데이터수집부와, 상기 과거재난데이터, 상기 기관재난데이터 및 상기 환경시설재난데이터로부터 재난유형에 따른 재난상황전파방안 및 재난대응방안을 생성하고, 상기 재난유형, 상기 재난상황전파방안 및 상기 재난대응방안을 매칭시킴으로써 상기 재난상황전파방안 및 상기 재난대응방안을 매뉴얼화하여 재난매뉴얼을 생성하고, 상기 재난유형을 입력받으면 상기 재난유형에 대응하는 의사결정을 수행하며, 상기 의사결정에 포함된 상기 재난매뉴얼에 따라 상기 재난상황전파방안 및 상기 재난대응방안을 출력하는 시스템제어부를 포함하는 재난대응시스템; 및 상기 재난유형을 포함하는 입력값을 재난대응시스템에 입력시키는 입력제어부, 상기 재난상황전파방안 및 상기 재난대응방안을 포함하는 출력값을 상기 재난대응시스템으로부터 수신하는 출력제어부, 상기 입력값이 재난 대응 시나리오에 적용되어 생성된 시나리오결과를 수신하는 평가입력부, 상기 출력값에 포함된 재난상황전파방안 및 재난대응방안과 상기 시나리오결과에 포함된 재난상황전파방안 및 재난대응방안을 비교하여 의사결정의 정확도를 평가하는 평가판단부를 포함하는 성능평가장치를 포함하는 재난대응시스템의 성능을 평가하는 시스템을 제공할 수 있다.

title_en: Back propagation (BP) neural network landslide forecasting method based on optimized input layer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a back propagation (BP) neural network landslide forecasting method based on an optimized input layer. The BP neural network landslide forecasting method includes steps: (1) related parameters of landslide of the input layer are collected; (2) BP neural network training is performed; (3) whether requirements are met is judged, the known expected value is t, errors are calculated according to an error formula of an output node, sample training is completed if the requirements are met, otherwise Vij theta i is firstly adjusted and then Wij theta j is adjusted according to the error reducing principle, and the corrected value is used for training until the requirements are met; and (4) after sample training is completed, the initialized forecasting sample value is input, and the forecasting value can be obtained. The BP neural network is adopted so that the BP neural network landslide forecasting method is simple to operate, strong in learning ability and good in adaptability.
assignees: NANXIN BIG IMAGE TECHNOLOGY ENGINEERING SUZHOU CO LTD

title_en: Metallurgical gas integrated dynamic balance scheduling system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a metallurgical gas integrated dynamic balance scheduling system and method, and belongs to the technical field of multiple gases balance scheduling control. Based on real-time state data and production plan data, and on the basis of a combined model of a K-Nearest Neighbor(KNN) algorithm model, a back-propagation neural network algorithm model, a RBF neural network learning algorithm model, prediction is conducted on gas production/consumption value, gas tank place value, and pipe network fluctuating value in a future time period, and corresponding prediction values are obtained, and in accordance with a gas balance scheduling expert database, dynamic balance scheduling on the gas is completed in combination with the aforementioned prediction values. The system and the method of the invention are advantaged in that on the basis of the completion of the gas balance scheduling, functions of online adding algorithm model are expanded, and functions of online correcting balance scheduling expert database is expanded, and in cases that stable and safe operation of a gas system, real-time correction of system defects are achieved, so that gas can be more reasonably utilized and usage efficiency of gas is provided.
assignees: BEIJING SHOUGANG AUTOMATION INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Urban road network's electric automobile charging station dispositions method based on structural holes theory
abstract_en: Urban road network's electric automobile charging station Optimization deployment method based on structural holes theory, is converted into road network for the mileage chart of extraction；Using the constraint propagation algorithm based on structural holes theory, the candidate stations site node of charging station is chosen from the road network after conversion；Bi-objective Programming model is established, and is converted into objective programming model；Objective programming model is solved, obtain final node of building a station: node of building a station is a road in real road figure, so using structural holes theory, solves with the intersection of the road constraint maximum road and to build a station site as charging station, so that it is determined that charging station specific location.The present invention considers influence of the real road to position of building a station, to the deployment issue of charging station, mathematical modeling has been carried out from investment angle and user perspective, real road and other influences factor has been combined, charging station deployment issue is optimized, the specific location of charging station deployment has been solved.

title_en: Power distribution low-voltage distribution area load prediction method and device based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for predicting load of a power distribution low-voltage distribution area based on deep learning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting measurement data of a power distribution low-voltage transformer area; iteratively updating the weight of the neural network based on a back propagation algorithm through an Adam optimization algorithm according to the measured data of the distribution low-voltage transformer area, generating an input value of a prediction model, and training the prediction model; and after the prediction model meets the preset conditions, acquiring the current distribution low-voltage distribution area measurement data, and inputting the current distribution low-voltage distribution area measurement data into the trained prediction model to obtain a distribution low-voltage distribution area load prediction result. The method is based on an LSTM model, and a brand-new load prediction model is built by combining the information expression characteristics of a Wide module and a Deep module, so that the load prediction precision of a low-voltage distribution station area is improved.
assignees: SHENYANG POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;UNIV TSINGHUA;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Method for eliminating rubber interference gasoline identification by utilizing back propagation neural network method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for eliminating rubber interference gasoline identification by using a back propagation neural network method. On the premise of considering the actual fire scene environment as much as possible, the invention utilizes the gas chromatography-mass spectrometer to detect the rubber and gasoline samples, and simultaneously considers the influence of other interference conditions on analysis and classification; compared with the traditional manual identification, the method has the advantages of rapidness, high efficiency, high accuracy and the like, provides a method for eliminating the interference of rubber to gasoline, and provides a scientific reference basis for fire investigators.

title_en: IES-CPS system information-physical combination expected fault generation method, device, storage medium and computing equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an IES-CPS system information-physical combination expected fault generation method, a device, a storage medium and a computing device, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing an IES-CPS information expected fault set and a physical expected fault set; setting physical expected faults and determining an information fault propagation mode by combining the current system operation mode; searching an information transmission path according to the determined information fault propagation mode, an operation control strategy under the current fault and a network layered coupling model; an information expected failure is set in the information transmission path, and the information expected failure and the set physical expected failure constitute an information-physical combination expected failure. The invention comprehensively considers the multi-network layered coupling relation of the neutron energy system in the IES-CPS system, generates the information-physical combination expected fault, analyzes the safety of the IES-CPS when the combination fault occurs, and can obtain the severity of the fault through the safety analysis result, thereby screening out the key nodes or the serious faults.
assignees: NARI TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ECONOMIC RES INST;STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Dynamic cooperative economic dispatching method for multi-microgrid access new energy power distribution system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power systems, and particularly relates to a dynamic cooperative economic dispatching method for accessing a multi-microgrid into a new energy power distribution system, which comprises the steps of obtaining the load of the new energy power distribution network system, the maximum output of each unit of the power distribution network and the microgrid and the power generation cost; establishing a DED model of the distribution network, and calculating the optimal production cost of the distribution network meeting the load requirement; establishing a microgrid DED model, and calculating a power transmission scheduling mode meeting the lowest total operation cost; and establishing a dynamic cooperative economic dispatching model containing a multi-microgrid access new energy power distribution system, and carrying out optimization management on the overall energy. The invention considers the randomness of distributed energy power generation and the difference between benefit bodies of a distribution network and a microgrid, establishes an active power distribution system DED model under the condition of multi-microgrid access based on an analysis target cascade theory, can provide effective technical support for safe, stable and economical operation of the active power distribution system, and is beneficial to the optimal management of power grid operators on the overall energy of the whole active power distribution system.
assignees: CHINESE POWER CONSTRUCTION GROUP QINGHAI PROVINCE ELECTRIC POWER DESIGN INSTITUTE LTD COMPANY

title_en: Energy internet load prediction method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides an energy internet load prediction method, an energy internet load prediction device and electronic equipment, and relates to the technical field of power equipment detection, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining a first load matrix based on historical data of energy internet load; determining whether the information entropy of a second load matrix is smaller than a preset first information entropy threshold, if yes, determining that a prediction model adopts a backward propagation network, otherwise, determining that the prediction model adopts an echo state network, acquiring a plurality of training samples from the second load matrix, training the prediction model by using the plurality of training samples, acquiring input data from the second load matrix, and processing the input data by using the trained prediction model to obtain a predicted value of the energy internet load at a target time position. The method and the system improve the accuracy and the robustness of the prediction of the energy internet load.

title_en: Power system load prediction method based on deep belief network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power system load prediction, in particular to a power system load prediction method based on a deep belief network, which comprises the steps of obtaining training samples and test samples, constructing a DBN complex neural network formed by RBMs, using two classifier models, predicting and analyzing the advantages and disadvantages of the two classifications by using a classification recognition deep belief network algorithm, determining a final classification strategy of an input factor and an output factor, training the RBMs in a layer-by-layer iteration mode, and constructing a power load prediction model by using classification data to obtain a predicted value of the power system load. According to the power system load prediction method based on the deep belief network, a limited Boltzmann machine and a supervised back propagation algorithm are applied, a deep power load prediction model is built, and input high-dimensional load data are subjected to dimension reduction processing, so that the network can fully capture the characteristics of the data, the characteristic extraction capacity of the prediction model is improved, and the accuracy and the stability of load prediction are improved.

title_en: Method, system, device and storage medium for planning using unmanned aerial vehicle network
abstract_en: The application provides a planning method, a system, equipment and a storage medium for using an Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV), wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting control points and environment data by using the UAV, inputting the environment data into a neural network model to generate coordinates of each tower between a starting point and an ending point, verifying the mechanical characteristics of the towers through calculation and adjusting model parameters through reverse gradient propagation in the training process of the neural network model, carrying out point lofting in batches based on the tower coordinates, identifying point lofting errors by using a visual model, carrying out retesting on the coordinates of the corner towers based on the control point coordinates, carrying out line lofting after correcting the point lofting errors to obtain a power grid planning result, and establishing twin model storage data corresponding to the power grid planning result. The application designs a power grid planning method by using an unmanned aerial vehicle as a whole, and the method comprises the comprehensive functions of controlling point acquisition, determining the position of a tower by a newly built line, point lofting and line lofting, and comprehensively replaces manual design.

title_en: Emergency plan making method based on industrial park
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency plan making method based on an industrial park, which is characterized in that data acquisition and preprocessing are realized through a distributed sensing network and edge calculation, a park dynamic model is constructed by utilizing multi-source heterogeneous data fusion and a digital twin technology, a risk propagation path is analyzed by combining a graph neural network, and a preliminary emergency suggestion is generated based on a knowledge graph matching historical case. The invention further adopts a resource scheduling optimization and path planning algorithm to formulate a dynamic response scheme, evaluates the effects of different schemes through a situation evolution prediction model, finally generates an optimal emergency treatment scheme and issues a structural instruction. The method realizes the intelligent formulation of the emergency plan of the industrial park, improves the accuracy of risk identification and the timeliness of emergency response, and provides powerful support for park safety management.
assignees: SHAANXI KING INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power plant equipment intelligent coordination control method and system based on multi-source heterogeneous data
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent coordination control method and system for power plant equipment based on multi-source heterogeneous data, which belong to the technical field of intelligent manufacturing and industrial automation, and comprise the steps of deploying a multi-mode sensor network in the power plant equipment, collecting the multi-source heterogeneous data in real time, and preprocessing the real-time data through an edge computing node; the method comprises the steps of carrying out collaborative modeling on preprocessing data by adopting a mixed analysis framework, predicting equipment state trend, identifying a fault propagation path, positioning a root cause and optimizing a maintenance decision scheme, evaluating equipment failure probability by a fault diagnosis result, triggering a hierarchical early warning mechanism and updating an optimization rule base by combining a dynamic knowledge base, constructing a three-dimensional model by utilizing a digital twin technology for virtual simulation and remote control, and carrying out maintenance guidance by an augmented reality auxiliary technology. The invention realizes high-efficiency real-time monitoring and fault prediction, combines a fault tree model and a digital twin technology, obviously reduces fault diagnosis time and operation and maintenance cost, and improves equipment operation safety and reliability.
assignees: HUANENG POWER INT INC YINGKOU POWER PLANT

title_en: Task risk early warning method and system based on project management data
abstract_en: The invention provides a task risk early warning method and system based on project management data, which relate to the technical field of project management early warning, and the method and system provided by the invention have the advantages that task risk index weights are automatically adjusted to adapt to process states and external environment changes of different stages of projects, so that the accuracy and flexibility of risk assessment are obviously improved, the method and system have good dynamic adaptability, the tasks of each stage of the projects are assessed in a grading manner by means of quantitative comprehensive risk values, priorities are clearly managed, a project team is assisted to focus on key risks, task cooperation relations are visually presented by constructing a task cooperation network, a central node and a fragile link are accurately identified, a risk propagation path is effectively mastered, and real-time monitoring and grading early warning are realized by combining dynamic risk early warning rules, so that the risks can be timely found and dealt with.

title_en: Ocean drilling safety situation diagnosis and early warning method based on entropy weight Bayesian network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of marine drilling safety, and discloses a marine drilling safety situation diagnosis and early warning method based on an entropy weight Bayesian network. The method is characterized in that accurate risk assessment is realized through dynamic coupling of an entropy weight method and a Bayesian network. The method comprises the steps of extracting evaluation indexes from a marine drilling accident library and drilling related specification files, outputting a data set through a standardized processing module, generating a dynamic index weight vector through a practical entropy weight method, constructing a Bayesian network topology by combining a Bow-tie model, coupling the weight vector to a non-root node condition probability table through an entropy weight driving type aggregation function, and finally outputting top-level node risk level probability distribution. Meanwhile, an index database containing early warning measures is established, the prior probability of the root node is combined with the historical data and the default probability, the dynamic expansion of the evaluation index is supported, the risk propagation path is visualized through the three-dimensional drilling situation interface, multi-stage early warning is triggered, and the accuracy and timeliness of ocean drilling safety early warning are improved.

title_en: Control center dispatch service system using life crisis emergency bell
title_ko: 생명위기비상벨을 이용한 관제센터 출동 서비스 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a control center dispatch service system using a life crisis emergency bell that receives a rescue request signal from a caller terminal for detecting the ringing of the emergency bell, comprising: a database part for storing information on a caller or a recipient corresponding to the caller, information on a rescue request signal of the caller, CCTV information in a predetermined area and emergency dispatcher information; and a server for receiving a rescue request signal from the caller terminal and performing controls so that information including an emergency text, the location of the caller, and the on-site voice recording information of the caller can be transmitted to a predetermined number of recipient terminals corresponding to the caller. According to an embodiment of the present invention, when a woman, an elderly person, a child, and a female single-person household member are in an emergency or fire situation, an emergency bell (200) manually or automatically generates an inaudible frequency signal, and a terminal receives the same to transmit the same to a control center through a mobile communication network, and at the same time, disseminate the same to a plurality of pre-designated people, thereby preventing an emergency situation or rescuing the person.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 비상벨의 울림을 감지하는 발신자 단말기로부터 구조요청신호를 수신하는 생명위기비상벨을 이용한 관제센터 출동 서비스 시스템에 관한 것으로, 발신자 또는 발신자에 대응하는 수신자 정보, 발신자의 구조요청신호 정보, 소정 지역의 CCTV 정보, 긴급출동자 정보를 저장하는 데이터베이스부;  상기 발신자 단말기로부터 구조요청신호를 수신하고, 발신자에 대응하는 소정수의 수신자 단말기로 위급문자, 발신자의 위치 및 발신지의 현장음성 녹음정보를 포함한 정보를 송신하도록 제어하는 서버를 포함한다.  본 발명의 실시예에서는, 여성, 노인, 어린이, 여성1인가구 등의 구성원이 위급, 응급, 화재 상황에 처했을 때, 비상벨(200)이 수동 또는 자동으로 비가청주파수 신호를 발생하고, 단말기가 이를 수신하여 이동통신망을 통하여 관제 센터로 송신함과 동시에 미리 지정된 다수의 사람들에게 전파되도록 하여 위급 상황을 예방 또는 구조할 수 있다.

title_en: Impact propagation in it systems
abstract_en: A method of evaluating impact of a change on nodes of a network, including collecting information of changes to configuration items of the network with a change management module that is executed on a computer of the network and forming a list of changes, receiving a dependency graph that defines dependencies between nodes of the network, receiving an impact model that includes an impact value that provides an indication of a risk value for different types of changes to nodes of the dependencies, executing an impact score generation module configured to receive the dependency graph, the impact model and the list of changes to determine a risk value responsive to a specific change to a node of the network and an impact of the change on other nodes of the network, repairing or predicting problems in the network based on the determined risk value for each change.

title_en: BP neural network-based interval water demand prediction method
abstract_en: The application discloses a genetic algorithm optimization back propagation neural network interval water demand prediction method based on grey correlation analysis. The method comprises the steps of firstly, processing original data by using a gray correlation analysis method, and finding out main factors of campus water; then, a BP neural network is selected as a prediction algorithm, and the BP neural network is optimized by adopting a genetic algorithm, so that the BP neural network with the optimal state is obtained for prediction; and then searching the optimal upper and lower boundaries of the prediction interval through the residual errors of the predicted value and the actual value of the output point, so that the fluctuation range of the water consumption in the future period can be accurately predicted. Compared with the traditional BP prediction method, the water demand prediction method is more effective and has higher accuracy.

title_en: Three-dimensional model quantitative retrieval method and system for multi-mode underwater image
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional model quantitative retrieval method and a system for multi-mode underwater images, which comprise the steps of collecting the underwater images, inputting a graph attention network model, outputting a three-dimensional model retrieval result, wherein the graph attention network model comprises a two-dimensional image dataset and a three-dimensional model library for constructing the underwater images, an image feature extraction network and a model feature extraction network are established to obtain feature vectors of the two-dimensional images and the three-dimensional models, the feature vectors are mapped into the same high-dimensional space to establish an adjacent matrix and establish a graph structure, the self-attention mechanism and the graph attention network are utilized to obtain feature vectors after graph embedding, model parameters are updated through back propagation of a loss function, the underwater images to be detected obtain the three-dimensional model retrieval result through the trained graph attention network, and the three-dimensional model retrieval can be realized for the underwater optical images or sonar images and the occlusion graph for effective features of the existing parts of the underwater images, so that the three-dimensional model quantitative retrieval is beneficial to the application in the submarine environment detection and underwater search and rescue fields.

title_en: Flood risk propagation assessment method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood risk propagation assessment method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of calculating a flood risk value of each sub-river basin in a research area according to an acquired flood risk assessment index variable of the research area; the method comprises the steps of grading flood risk values to obtain flood risk grades of each sub-river basin in a research area, constructing a Markov chain space-time model, determining a flood risk space-time propagation rule according to the Markov chain space-time model, fitting a flood risk propagation function according to the flood risk space-time propagation rule, determining a flood risk transfer blocking effect of the flood control hydraulic engineering according to the flood risk propagation function, flood control hydraulic engineering operation information data and historical flood data, constructing a flood risk space-time propagation network model with space-time dependency relationship, and evaluating the research area according to the flood risk space-time propagation network model to obtain a flood risk propagation evaluation result.

title_en: Petroleum and petrochemical fire control interlocking control equipment based on SIS
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of petrochemical fire control, in particular to an interlocking control device for petrochemical fire control based on SIS, which comprises a sensing fusion unit for acquiring optical fibers, radars, acoustics, event cameras and dual-band images, and generating a characteristic tensor and an attitude matrix through multi-scale synchronization and gating sparse fusion. The prediction and risk assessment unit utilizes the graph neural network space-time model and generates countermeasure correction output disaster prediction data, a propagation potential energy matrix and risk entropy. The interlocking control unit builds a binary optimization model by taking the minimum action number and the residual potential energy as targets, obtains a minimum action set by means of quantum annealing and minimum and maximum game, and writes the minimum action set into the memristive programmable logic array to generate an interlocking instruction stream. The execution and feedback unit controls the two-phase flow injection device, the robot team and the heat shielding device to finish treatment, and the feedback event flow is used for model increment learning and action deviation correction. The invention realizes millisecond cascade lock triggering, redundant action drop and obviously reduces the fire spreading radius.

title_en: Risk scheduling method for water resource system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water resource system risk scheduling method which comprises the steps of obtaining regional basic data, constructing a supply and demand pressure field, identifying causal relations, generating heterogeneous computing grids and a space-time causal network, dynamically determining a water-required tail cutting threshold value by adopting a cascade buffer pool mechanism based on historical supply and demand sequence data of the heterogeneous computing grids and influence factors identified by the space-time causal network, outputting a regulated water-required sequence, generating a water scene set by adopting an optimal transmission method of tail conformal by utilizing the regulated water-required sequence, simplifying the water scene set into a representative scene subset, constructing a distributed robust optimization model aiming at the representative scene subset, and generating a water resource scheduling scheme and a risk assessment report by fairness constraint projection and causal path analysis. The invention can finely describe the space-time pressure, adaptively regulate and control the extreme requirements, and generate a scheduling scheme which takes robustness and fairness into consideration under the condition of keeping the tail risk characteristics.

title_en: Fire detection method using iot time synchronization delay
title_ko: 아이오티 시간동기 지연을 이용한 화재 감지 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for detecting a fire in an IoT wireless networking space by utilizing a propagation delay phenomenon of a radio signal. The present invention determines whether a flame is occurred by detecting a delay time in a process of periodically performing IoT time synchronous processing and comparing the delay time with a reference value. Through the present invention, the detection of flame can be performed early in a general IoT-based wireless network environment without expensive optical detection and related signal processing devices, and wireless network configuration information accompanying fire alarm through flame detection, as well as it is possible to minimize encroachment on computing resources of communication devices.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 전파(電波) 신호의 전파(傳波) 지연 현상을 활용하여 아이오티(IoT) 무선망 조성 공간내 화재를 감지하는 방법에 관한 것으로서, 주기적으로 수행되는 아이오티 시간동기 처리의 수행 과정에서 지연시간을 검출하고, 이를 기준치와 비교함으로써 화염 발생 여부를 파악하는 것이다. 
본 발명을 통하여, 고가의 광학 감지 및 연관 신호 처리 장치 없이도, 일반적인 아이오티 기반 무선망 환경에서 화염의 감지를 조기에 수행할 수 있을 뿐 아니라, 화염 감지를 통한 화재 경보에 수반되는 무선망 구성 정보통신기기의 전산자원 잠식을 극소화할 수 있다.

title_en: A kind of multistep abnormal point detecting method based on neighbour's propagation clustering algorithm
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of multistep abnormal point detecting method based on neighbour's propagation clustering algorithm, by excavating normal application to get normal data stream mode, then Malware is detected using multistep abnormal point detecting method, it is final to realize that the purpose that initial stage accomplishes effective early warning be occurred in Android malware by not depending on known malware model.The present invention can effectively solve the problems, such as " dimension disaster " faced when outlier detection, to avoid interference of the noise data of redundancy feature or excessive extraneous features to abnormal point survey technology；Traditional abnormal point survey technology based on cluster or based on distance is overcome to depend on initial value selection unduly simultaneously, the real data assembly obtained by Virusshare and Google Play, which is puted the palms together before one, rolls over cross-validation method verifying effectiveness of the invention, to sum up, the present invention has broad application prospects in network safety filed.

title_en: Integrated moving average autoregression-back propagation neural network prediction method
abstract_en: The invention relates to an integrated moving average autoregressive-back propagation neural network prediction method, which provides a two-step modeling principle, refines the interior of a prediction model into a basic model and a correction model, selects an ARIMA model to carry out initial prediction on data, carries out secondary correction on errors by a BP model, and weakens error fluctuation through secondary modeling to achieve the aim of accurate prediction. The method realizes accurate fitting of various data, can flexibly process the data prediction problem with short-term fluctuation characteristics, expands the application range of the prediction field, greatly improves the prediction accuracy compared with the traditional prediction method, and provides a method for providing reference for decision makers in the energy field.

title_en: Space RQD based on laser scanning and RQD inversion optimal threshold ttSolving method
abstract_en: Space RQD based on laser scanning and RQD inversion optimal threshold t t Solving method, belonging to RQD t The field of anisotropy resolution, comprising the steps of: (1) three-dimensional laser scanning of the structural surface is rapidly acquired; (2) drawing a structural plane polar diagram and a trend rose diagram; (3) rock mass calculation based on RQD indexes; (4) generating and sectioning a rock three-dimensional fracture network model; (5) RQD t Drawing an anisotropy map; (6) solving method of optimal threshold t based on RQD inversion; (7) space RQD t And (5) solving the method. The invention combines three-dimensional laser scanning, a neighbor propagation algorithm, an RQD theory, a fracture network model, a generalized RQD theory and a conic curve equation to realize RQD t Solution of the optimal threshold t and RQD under the optimal threshold t t Elliptic curve and anisotropic ellipsoidAnd (5) volume rendering. The method is clear, and the obtained optimal threshold value t, elliptic curve and anisotropic ellipsoid can reflect the RQD of the real rock mass t Anisotropic characteristics, suitable for rock RQD t The spatial anisotropy of (a) is solved.

title_en: Remote sensing image small target detection method based on context and cascade structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote sensing image small target detection method based on context and a cascade structure, and belongs to the technical field of image processing. The method comprises the following steps: 1) acquiring a training sample and a test sample; 2) constructing a remote sensing image small target detection network model; 3) training a remote sensing image small target detection network model; 4) and acquiring a detection result of the remote sensing image small target. According to the invention, the context module frame is introduced, so that the target area is used for context sensing capability, the problem of difficult small target positioning is effectively solved, the quality of the prediction boundary frame is improved through the cascade structure, higher detection precision is realized, and the method can be used in the fields of resource exploration, natural disaster early warning, city planning, unmanned aerial vehicle target identification and the like.
assignees: 54TH RES INST CHINA ELECTRONICS TECH GROUP CORP;UNIV XIDIAN

title_en: Nuclear power plant network security threat early warning and disposal system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a nuclear power plant network security threat early warning and disposal system, which comprises a nuclear power plant network security situation perception system, a nuclear power plant local network security threat early warning and disposal response work order system and a nuclear power plant network security threat early warning cascade work order disposal system, wherein the nuclear power plant local network security threat early warning and disposal response work order system comprises a first work order and a second work order; the nuclear power plant network security threat early warning and handling system realizes the circulation of the nuclear power plant local network security threat early warning and handling worksheets through the nuclear power plant network security situation perception system, and forms a nuclear power plant network security threat early warning and handling worksheet processing method knowledge base. The nuclear power plant network security threat early warning and disposal system realizes the standardized flow of the early warning and disposal of the nuclear power plant network security threat and forms a method knowledge base of the early warning and disposal of the nuclear power plant network security threat; and (3) efficiently and standardly optimizing the safe operation management work of the nuclear power plant network.
assignees: CHONGKARYOTIC WUHAN NUCLEAR POWER OPERATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-target scheduling MILP (minimum Driving Linear prediction) method for cascade hydropower station with peak regulation and navigation functions
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of hydropower dispatching and power grid operation, and discloses an MILP (micro-electro-hydraulic Loop) method for multi-target dispatching of a cascade hydropower station with peak regulation and navigation functions. The contradiction between the peak regulation of a power grid and the navigation requirement of a river channel is a prominent problem in the cascade scheduling of hydropower shipping, and the complexity of the problem is aggravated by the jacking effect of interval return water. The method establishes an MILP model of the short-term multi-objective optimization scheduling of the cascade hydropower station group considering backwater influence, takes the minimum of the average distance of the residual load and the average distance of the downstream tail water level as a target in the model, uses a right hexahedron rasterization technology and an SOS2 constraint method to realize constraint linearization after nonlinear constraint is subjected to function aggregation, and finally uses an NBI method to solve to obtain a Pareto solution set of the multi-objective problem. The method can fully take the influence of backwater jacking into account, gives consideration to peak regulation and navigation requirements, efficiently solves the multi-target scheduling problem and obtains a more ideal result, and is a practical and effective method.
assignees: CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO;UNIV DALIAN TECH

title_en: Power grid fragile line identification method based on novel electrical betweenness
abstract_en: The invention provides a power grid fragile line identification method based on novel electric medium numbers, which comprises the steps of constructing a power grid into a network diagram, sequentially removing lines in the network diagram, and sequencing the novel electric medium numbers of each line from large to small; constructing a complex network cascade failure nonlinear model considering overload and weighted edges, and respectively performing two line removing modes on the sequenced novel electrical betweenness, namely sequentially removing a line with a preset proportion and sequentially removing all lines until no new line is removed from the network diagram; and acquiring the change of the generator-load power before and after removing the line each time, evaluating the severity of the power grid fault based on the change of the generator-load power, and completing the identification of the fragile line of the power grid. The invention obviously reduces the calculation cost and can better consider both the accuracy and the efficiency.

title_en: Enterprise risk prediction method and device, electronic equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses an enterprise risk prediction method, an enterprise risk prediction device, electronic equipment and a medium, wherein the enterprise risk prediction method comprises the following steps: according to the acquired enterprise operation activity data, extracting main event information required by a preset enterprise for risk prediction and information of related enterprises; based on the subject event information and the information of the related enterprises, constructing a subject event sequence and generating an event network diagram; the main event sequence comprises an event chain of a preset enterprise and preset candidate events; inputting an event initial code generated by the main event sequence and an event propagation matrix generated by the event network diagram into a pre-constructed and trained risk prediction model to obtain a risk prediction result of the preset enterprise; the risk prediction model comprises a graph neural network GNN and a long-short-term memory network LSTM, and is obtained by training with the minimum edge loss function margin as a target through historical data of enterprise business activity events. The method and the device effectively improve the accuracy of enterprise risk prediction.

title_en: Reservoir water level disturbance interval assessment and control method under cascade hydropower response flexibility demand mode
abstract_en: The invention provides a reservoir water level disturbance interval assessment and control method under a step hydropower response flexibility demand mode, which belongs to the field of novel power system dispatching, and comprises the following steps: collecting initial calculation conditions, and calculating new energy prediction deviation in the future 1 day; the power grid predicts deviation according to new energy, combines flexibility supply capability to issue flexibility requirements to the cascade hydroelectric power in real time, and adopts a linear distribution mode to carry out dynamic distribution; constructing a minimum objective function of peak-valley difference of the residual net load of the power grid and giving constraint conditions; taking the power station output, the power generation flow and the storage capacity in the planned implementation stage as random variables, and meeting the operation constraint; controlling the fluctuation range of the water level at the end of the scheduling period; performing equivalent reconstruction on constraint items containing random variables to obtain a linear programming model without the random variables; and carrying out model solving by using an optimization solver. The invention can effectively cope with the uncertainty of the flexibility requirement of the high-proportion new energy power system and grasp the running state of the flexibility requirement provided by hydropower.

title_en: Power information physical system key node identification method based on cascading failure characteristics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a key node identification method of an electric power information physical system based on cascading failure characteristics, which comprises the following steps: 1. constructing an electric power information physical system comprising a power grid and an information network, 2, calculating a node transfer characteristic matrix of a link matrix, a voltage sensitivity matrix S  e  of a random matrix, a voltage safety margin index L of a dynamic damping factor, 3, calculating PageRank values R  P  of power grid nodes, 4, calculating an information network key index of each information node, 5, calculating a coupling key index vector K of a coupling node, and recording a key node identification result. The invention can screen out key nodes which possibly cause serious cascading failures, thereby providing preventive protection for power system disasters.

title_en: Intelligent visualization method and system for electric power emergency management
abstract_en: The application relates to an intelligent visualization method and system for power emergency management, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting real-time operation data of a power grid through multi-source data collection equipment, preprocessing the real-time operation data, identifying abnormal events in the power grid, marking time of the abnormal events to obtain preprocessed data, analyzing the preprocessed data through a fault prediction model based on deep learning to generate a prediction result of a fault position, calculating an influence range of fault propagation through power flow analysis based on the fault prediction result, determining an affected area, performing space mapping on the fault position and the affected area to generate a visual power grid fault diagram, displaying power supply conditions of the affected area, generating an emergency response plan based on the fault position and the affected area, and pushing the emergency response plan to a relevant power dispatching and operation maintenance terminal. The application has the effect of improving the accuracy of fault identification.
assignees: SHANDONG DENENG IOT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Basin risk assessment method and system based on geographic space and Bayesian network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of natural disaster risk assessment and discloses a river basin risk assessment method and system based on a geographic space and a Bayesian network, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a digital elevation model diagram of a target river basin, multi-disaster investigation record and simulation research results, and extracting key points; establishing a disaster chain path according to the key points to complete Bayesian network modeling, carrying out node probability modeling and initializing parameters, establishing a disaster chain probability propagation mechanism to describe the sequential transmission process of disasters among nodes, establishing a high-dimensional joint distribution model to carry out forward reasoning propagation of a plurality of Bayesian networks, carrying out uncertainty compression of a disaster reasoning chain, carrying out probability propagation and reasoning, and calculating disaster probability of population loss and economic loss. By utilizing the scheme of the invention, the overall synergy of disaster chain reasoning and the delicacy of risk expression under a complex system can be improved, and the risk assessment capability of the model under the complex chain disaster system is improved.
assignees: CHINA RENEWABLE ENERGY ENGINEERING INST;CHINA RENEWABLE ENERGY ENGINEERING INST CO LTD;CHINA WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER ENG CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent mine pressure monitoring and early warning system based on AI algorithm and dynamic analysis method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ore pressure early warning, and discloses an ore pressure intelligent monitoring early warning system based on an AI algorithm and a dynamic analysis method thereof, wherein the ore pressure intelligent monitoring early warning system based on the AI algorithm comprises a distance sensitive spectrum information extraction module for obtaining distance sensitive spectrum information; the system comprises a radial sequence determining module, a radial graph generating module, a node level risk amount calculating module, an alarm triggering state determining module and a space positioning module, wherein the radial sequence determining module determines a radial sequence, the radial graph generating module generates a radial graph, the node level risk amount calculating module generates a node level risk amount, the alarm triggering state determining module determines an alarm triggering state, and the space positioning module identifies the maximum value position of a continuous risk field as a space positioning result. According to the invention, the distance sensitive spectrum information is extracted and is integrated with the medium dispersion characteristic, the association rule of the signal and the propagation distance is captured, the ordered radial graph is constructed by combining the energy centroid and the radial sequence, and the internal connection of the spatial distribution and the spectrum characteristics among the nodes is excavated through the neural network, so that the false alarm and missing report condition of the alarm is reduced, and the safety production guarantee capability is improved.
assignees: HUAIBEI MINING IND CO LTD;SICHUAN AEROSPACE ELECTRO & HYDRAULIC CONTROL CO LTD

title_en: Broadcasting system suitable for emergency broadcasting
title_ko: 재난방송이 적합한 방송시스템
abstract_en: In the present invention, data is easily restored with a less noise effect by using a coded orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (COFDM) to simultaneously transmit data in several frequencies, and a wide audible band increases a broadcasting effect while a single frequency network is established to maximize transmission rate of broadcasting, thereby increasing disaster broadcasting effect to minimize damage from disasters. In particular, the present invention is as follows: stably transmitting desirable data to a digital broadcasting station by being formed to be able to transmit data to the digital broadcasting station by means of at least one social network service (SNS); the digital broadcasting station transmitting the data to a portable terminal in the COFDM method, such that a radio wave efficiency of data can be maximized. In addition, according to the present invention, since the digital broadcasting station and the portable terminal can transmit and receive to/from each other in a signal frequency network (SFN) method, which is a single frequency method, the establishing of a network is easy and the data transmission can be effectively in a nationwide or in a local area through a single network.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 직교 부호화 주파수 분할 다중방식(COFDM)을 이용하여 여러 개로 나눈 주파수로 데이터를 동시에 전송하여 잡음 영향이 적으면서도 데이터를 쉽게 복원할 수 있고, 가청 지역이 넓어 방송 효과를 높이면서도 단일 주파수 망을 구축하여 방송의 전송률을 극대화할 수 있으므로 재난 방송 효과를 높여 재난피해를 최소화할 수 있게 한 것이다. 특히, 본 발명은 적어도 하나의 사회적 네트워크 서비스(SNS)로 데이터를 디지털 방송국에 전송할 수 있게 구성하므로 원하는 데이터를 디지털 방송국에 안정적으로 전송할 수 있고, 다시 이 데이터를 디지털 방송국에서 COFDM 방식으로 휴대용 단말로 전송하므로 데이터 전파 효율을 극대화할 수 있게 한다. 또한, 본 발명은 디지털 방송국과 휴대용 단말을 단일 주파수 방식인 SFN(Signal Frequency Network) 방식으로 송수신할 수 있게 하여 망 구축이 쉬우면서도 단일망으로 전국적 또는 국지적으로 필요한 지역에 데이터 송신을 효과적으로 할 수 있게 한다.

title_en: Emergency information transmits covering method and device
abstract_en: This application provides emergency information transmission covering method and devices, it is related to broadcasting communication technology field, wherein, it includes: first that the emergency information, which transmits covering method, responding agencies judge whether current network is unimpeded, if the judgment is Yes, emergency information is sent to multistage linking link and responded by responding agencies, if the judgment is No, emergency information is sent to device link and responded by responding agencies, by this kind of method multistage linking link and device link are existed simultaneously in a system, in this way, responding agencies can be according to environmental condition, suitable link is selected to send emergency information, to realize extensive covering and the fast propagation of emergency information.

title_en: Power grid multi-disaster coupling cascading failure analysis method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for analyzing multi-disaster coupling cascading failures of a power grid, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a primary parameter and a secondary parameter of a power grid, and establishing a dynamic power grid system model; acquiring external environment data, inputting the external environment data into a dynamic power grid system model, judging whether an external power grid fault event exists or not, and acquiring a sequence of power grid element faults caused by the external environment in an initial power grid operation mode; establishing a power grid hybrid differential algebraic equation; simulating a dynamic power grid system model according to initial conditions of power grid cascading failure simulation analysis and the established power grid hybrid differential algebraic equation; in simulation, according to the admittance matrix Y bus Judging whether the power grid is disconnected, and if the power grid is not disconnected, continuing to operate; judging whether the simulation is finished; forming a power grid successive fault accident chain; and (4) outputting simulation data and comprehensively evaluating the operation risk of the power grid. The invention can consider the influence of the multi-disaster coupling cascading failure of the relay protection action characteristic on the power grid element.

title_en: Fire spread modeling method for coupling network model lithium ion battery energy storage system
abstract_en: The invention provides a fire spread modeling method of a coupled network model lithium ion battery energy storage system, which belongs to the technical field of lithium ion battery model construction and simulation methods, and comprises the steps of obtaining battery electrochemical parameters, material thermophysical parameters and geometric characteristic parameters of the battery energy storage system; establishing a three-dimensional geometric model of an air domain in the energy storage system and dividing grids; calculating heat generation inside the battery during thermal runaway; solving the heat transfer and thermal runaway propagation processes among the batteries, and calculating the temperature of the batteries; calculating gas production inside the battery during thermal runaway; solving jet flow kinetic parameters of the battery; solving a conservation equation of a fluid region of the battery energy storage system, and predicting fire spreading behaviors inside the energy storage power station; according to the method, the thermal runaway propagation behavior of the lithium ion battery at the energy storage system level can be calculated, and meanwhile, the fire evolution condition inside the energy storage system after an accident occurs can be simulated.

title_en: Multi-mode social network public opinion hidden trouble investigation method and system
abstract_en: The application discloses a multi-modal social network public opinion hidden danger investigation method and system, wherein multi-modal data of a social platform are collected in real time through distributed edge nodes, the multi-modal data comprise text, image and audio data, a plurality of social network communities are divided based on user interaction relations, the user interaction relations comprise but are not limited to topic rings, friend relations, comment interaction and forwarding praise, community propagation dynamics features, community topology features and content features are extracted from the plurality of social network communities one by one based on the multi-modal data, a plurality of suspected hidden danger communities are screened out from the plurality of social network communities based on the community propagation dynamics features, the community topology features and the content features and a preset screening strategy, and a plurality of hidden danger classifications corresponding to the plurality of suspected hidden danger communities are output after hidden danger detection and hidden danger classification are carried out on the plurality of suspected hidden danger communities based on the multi-modal data. The method and the system of the application obviously improve the comprehensiveness and the accuracy of public opinion hidden danger identification.

title_en: Apparatus, system and method for managing asset of water treatment plant
title_ko: 정수처리장의 자산관리장치, 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: According to the present invention, in order to manage properties of a water treatment plant, the present invention is capable of more accurately managing cycles and items for maintenance by water treatment device based on actual malfunction and driving records of each water treatment device, collected from a management device (SCADA) of a water treatment plant system, by being connected with the management device, and sensing and handling an abnormal change in device. Moreover, the present invention is capable of enabling well-timed maintenance by providing information about the cycles for maintenance to a worker terminal, and enabling more systematic budget management than the estimation of priorities about repair or replacement by calculating an importance degree considering an effect of repair or replacement, caused by the malfunction of a device, on the management of the water treatment plant system as a weighted value. The present invention includes: a communication part transceiving data with a management device or worker terminal through a communication network; and a property management device managing maintenance information about a reference maintenance cycle.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따르면, 정수처리장의 자산관리에 있어서, 정수처리장 시스템의 운영장치(SCADA)와 연계하여 운영장치로부터 수집되는 정수처리 관련장치별 실제 운전 이력과 고장 이력을 기반으로 자산관리장치에서 정수처리 관련장치별 정비 항목과 정비 주기를 보다 정확히 관리하고, 장치별 비정상적인 변화를 감지하여 대처할 수 있도록 한다. 또한, 장치별 정비 주기에 대한 정보를 작업자 단말로 제공하여 시기적절한 정비가 이루어지도록 하고, 장치의 고장으로 인한 수리 또는 교체 시 장치별 정수처리장 시스템 운영에 미치는 파급력을 가중치로 고려하여 중요도를 산출함으로써 수리 또는 교체의 우선순위를 추산할 때 보다 체계적인 예산 운영이 가능하도록 한다.
assignees: GS ENGINEERING & CONSTR CORP;WATERWORKS HEADQUARTERS DAEGU METROPOLITAN CITY

title_en: Maritime distress rescue system
title_ko: 해상 조난 구조 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed is a maritime distress rescue system. While enabling closed communication between a gateway of a ship and distress signal transmitters of passengers in the ship, a rescue request signal of the distress signal transmitter can be received by a gateway of another ship in the event of a distress accident, such that a rescue operation for a rescuer is conducted quickly and accurately. Also, when the distress accident occurs, a mesh network is formed between the distress signal transmitters such that the rescue request signals transmitted from the distress signal transmitters are propagated without omissions and crosstalk. According to an embodiment, a maritime distress rescue system comprises: a plurality of distress signal transmitters determining a distress situation, transmitting a distress signal when the distress situation occurs, and consisting of a plurality of groups; a plurality of gateways each communicating with the plurality of distress signal transmitters belonging to the same group, and receiving the distress signal; and a master device controlling a signal receiving authority of the other group of each gateway by communicating with the plurality of gateways.
abstract_ko: 선박의 게이트웨이와 선박 내 탑승자들의 조난용 신호 송출기 간의 폐쇄적인 통신을 가능하게 하면서, 조난 사고 발생시에는 조난용 신호 송출기의 구조 요청 신호를 다른 선박의 게이트웨이에서도 수신할 수 있도록 하여, 조난자의 구조 활동이 신속하고 정확하게 이루어지도록 하고, 또한 조난 사고 발생시, 조난용 신호 송출기들 간에 메쉬 네트워크를 구성하여 조난용 신호 송출기들에서 전송된 구조 요청 신호가 누락 없이 그리고 혼선 없이 전파될 수 있도록 하는 해상 조난 구조 시스템이 개시된다. 일 실시예에 따른 해상 조난 구조 시스템은, 조난 상황을 판단하고 조난 상황 발생시 조난 신호를 전송하며 복수의 그룹으로 이루어진 복수의 조난용 신호 송출기; 각각 동일한 그룹에 속하는 상기 복수의 조난용 신호 송출기와 통신하며 상기 조난 신호를 수신하는 복수의 게이트웨이; 및 상기 복수의 게이트웨이와 통신하여 각 게이트웨이의 타 그룹의 신호 수신 권한을 제어하는 마스터 장치를 포함한다.

title_en: Smart pole linkage system that can provide intelligent city information
title_ko: 지능형 도시정보 제공이 가능한 스마트 폴 연계 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smart pole linkage system capable of providing intelligent city information. An integrated control center receives various types of city information via a communication network from a local government information providing server. The city information includes municipal public relations, public advertisements, event promotion, local government promotion, emergency disaster situation information, traffic information, tourist information, living information, weather information, and location information related to a city. The city information is output and provided in real time through a kiosk. As a result, a user can check desired city information in real time. The present invention includes a local government information providing server (100), an integrated control center (200), a management server (300), and a kiosk (400) as main components so that crimes can be prevented by real-time monitoring of the zone where the kiosk is provided and the integrated control center quickly disseminates the occurrence of an emergency disaster situation through the kiosk in a case where the emergency disaster situation has occurred in the zone.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지능형 도시정보 제공이 가능한 스마트 폴 연계 시스템에 관련되며, 보다 상세하게는 통합관제센터로 지자체 정보제공 서버로부터 통신망을 통하여 해당 도시와 관련된 시정홍보, 공익광고, 행사홍보, 지자체 홍보, 긴급 재난상황 정보, 교통정보, 관광정보, 생활정보, 날씨정보, 위치정보를 포함하는 각종 도시정보를 수신하고, 상기 도시정보를 키오스크를 통해 실시간으로 출력하여 제공함으로써, 사용자가 원하는 도시정보를 실시간으로 확인할 수 있으며, 해당 지역의 긴급 재난상황이 발생할 경우 통합관제센터에서 이를 신속하게 키오스크를 통해 전파하고, 키오스크가 구비된 지역을 실시간 모니터링하여 범죄예방을 도모하기 위해 지자체 정보제공 서버(100), 통합관제센터(200), 관리서버(300) 및 키오스크(400)을 주요구성으로 이루어진다.

title_en: Method of combined simulation of the software and hardware parts of a computer system, and associated system
abstract_en:
This invention relates to a method for simulation of a computer system ( 10 ), for example for an aeronautical simulation application, comprising a hardware infrastructure (HW) and a software portion (SW). 
     The method comprises:
         the modeling (E 100 ) of the said hardware infrastructure (HW) in a plurality of schedulers ( 11 - 14 ) capable of simulating the successive execution of tasks ( 15, 40, 40′ ),   the modeling (E 110 ) of the said software portion (SW) in a plurality of initial tasks ( 15 ) comprising accesses to resources of the said hardware infrastructure (HW),   the simulation (E 130 ) of the initial tasks ( 15 ) comprising the software propagation of simulated accesses through schedulers ( 11 - 14 ) of the said modeled infrastructure (HW),   the said propagation being carried out in the form of transactions ( 50 ) between pairs of schedulers ( 11 - 14 ), a transaction ( 50 ) comprising a task ( 40,   40′ ) on each scheduler and an indication of precedence ( 40″ ) linking the two tasks ( 40, 40 ′).

title_en: Intelligence house integrated management system
