abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligence house integrated management system, including security protection watch -dog, network communication interface, central processing unit and applied controlgear, central processing unit one side electric connection network communication interface, central processing unit opposite side electric connection security protection watch -dog, central processing unit bottom electric connection uses controlgear, security protection watch -dog one side electric connection burglary -resisting window controller and the cigarette propagated sensation sensilla of setting in burglary -resisting window controller bottom, cigarette propagated sensation sensilla bottom is equipped with air detection device and sets up the theftproof door controller in air detection device bottom. The utility model discloses a central processing unit controls with applied controlgear the security protection watch -dog, and the security protection watch -dog is used for receiving the signal that jointing equipment transmitted to central processing unit is given in the timely feedback, and the emergency warning ware is sent out police dispatch and is reported signal, and the controlgear who connects through network communication interface can handle the signal of central processing unit transmission.

title_en: Electricity stealing behavior detection method based on BP neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power stealing behavior detection method based on a BP (back propagation) neural network. The model firstly preprocesses the electricity utilization data of a user and determines an electricity stealing evaluation index; then, a Principal Component Analysis (PCA) method is adopted to realize the feature extraction of sample data, so that the efficiency of the model is improved, and the load of a detection system is reduced; and then, the BP neural network is used for finishing the diagnosis of the electricity stealing behavior of the user, so that the judgment of normal users and electricity stealing users is realized. The practical applicability and the universality of the invention are verified by carrying out example analysis on the power utilization data of large enterprise users provided by a certain power grid company.
assignees: HUANENG POWER INT INC;XIAN THERMAL POWER RES INST CO

title_en: City infrastructure group network elasticity analysis method, electronic device and storage medium
abstract_en: A city infrastructure group network elasticity analysis method, electronic equipment and a storage medium belong to the field of city infrastructure group analysis. The method aims to solve the problem of analysis of urban cascade failure influence. The method comprises the steps of constructing a cascading failure model of an urban infrastructure group network; adopting the theory and the model of the classical elastic triangle from the two aspects of time and space to carry out elastic analysis on the infrastructures in the urban infrastructure group; elasticity analysis for city infrastructure groups: and (3) introducing a fault mode in which multipoint failures occur simultaneously to calculate network elastic parameters of the urban infrastructure group, introducing spatial position information at the same time, analyzing the elastic parameter conditions of the infrastructure group in a central area and an edge area, and finally performing tree analysis on the cascading failure model process. The invention establishes an elasticity analysis system of the urban infrastructure group network, and provides effective support for researching and improving the elasticity of urban infrastructures.
assignees: SHENZHEN URBAN TRANSP PLANNING CENTER CO LTD;SHENZHEN TRANSP RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Comprehensive energy system scheduling method based on improved multi-target dung beetle optimization algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive energy system scheduling method based on an improved multi-target dung beetle optimizing algorithm, which comprises the steps of firstly constructing a comprehensive energy system model, excavating low-carbon resources from two sides of a source load and analyzing low-carbon characteristics, secondly, establishing a demand response model on an energy utilization side, finally, solving the comprehensive energy system optimizing scheduling model by adopting the improved multi-target dung beetle optimizing algorithm, respectively introducing a rapid non-dominant sorting and crowding degree calculation, introducing a self-adaptive weight coefficient into a dung beetle rolling ball position updating formula, introducing a spiral bubble network optimizing mode into a dung beetle propagation and dung beetle foraging formula, and introducing a Levy flight strategy into the dung beetle foraging position updating formula to improve the convergence accuracy and searching speed of the multi-target dung beetle optimizing algorithm. The invention obviously improves the consumption of new energy output, reduces the emission of CO  2 , reduces the operation cost of the comprehensive energy system and improves the energy utilization benefit of the user side.

title_en: Inlet end impedance calculation method of saturated reactor broadband equivalent circuit model
abstract_en: The invention discloses an input impedance calculation method of a saturated reactor broadband equivalent circuit model, and relates to the technical field of impedance analysis of power systems. The method comprises the steps of enabling a broadband equivalent circuit model of a saturation reactor in a converter valve to be equivalent to a passive two-port network connected with a load, conducting decoupling equivalent operation on inductance containing mutual inductance in the passive two-port network, taking each element except the load in the broadband equivalent circuit model of the saturation reactor after decoupling as one two-port, determining a transmission parameter matrix of each two-port, obtaining the transmission parameter matrix of the passive two-port network according to a two-port cascading principle and the transmission parameter matrix of each two-port, and determining the input impedance of the broadband equivalent circuit model of the saturation reactor according to the relation between the transmission parameter matrix of the passive two-port network and input voltage, input current, output voltage and output current. The method can improve the calculation efficiency of the impedance of the input end of the wideband equivalent circuit model of the saturation reactor.
assignees: CSG EHV POWER TRANS CO;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG

title_en: Temperature regulation and control system applied to water-cooled air conditioner of machine room
abstract_en: The invention discloses a temperature regulation and control system applied to a water-cooled air conditioner of a machine room, and relates to the technical field of temperature regulation and control. The system comprises a coupling analysis module, a cooperative control module, a dynamic regulation and control module and a correction module. The heat flow propagation model is constructed by collecting temperature distribution and power consumption data of the cabinet in real time and utilizing the graph neural network, and the refrigerant flow velocity and the tail end air outlet temperature set value are output. And (3) combining efficiency curves of the water pump, the fan and the compressor, optimizing total energy consumption, equipment service life and refrigeration stability of the system by using a non-dominant sequencing genetic algorithm, and generating a control instruction. And verifying thermodynamic constraint conditions and generating a refrigerant distribution priority matrix according to the layout and regulation and control instructions of the machine room, and ensuring the coordination response of the equipment. And comparing actual data with simulation data through the digital twin platform, and reversely correcting the edge weight of the heat flow propagation model to optimize the system performance. The system can realize accurate regulation and control of the machine room environment, improve the energy efficiency and the service life of equipment, and ensure the refrigeration stability.

title_en: Urban lifeline facility flood disaster chain simulation method based on big data
abstract_en: The invention provides a big data-based urban lifeline facility flood disaster chain simulation method, which comprises the steps of simulating and verifying an urban flood model based on big data, constructing an urban lifeline facility flood disaster chain based on big data, dynamically simulating a lifeline facility flood disaster chain by coupling a numerical simulation and cascade failure method, and evaluating the influence of extreme storm flood on the evolution of the lifeline facility disaster chain. The method of the invention is based on big data, adopts the technical scheme of numerical simulation, big data and cascade failure, creatively realizes the dynamic simulation of the life line facility disaster chain, innovates the technical method in the field and has obvious technical progress.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Big data mining method, system, equipment and medium for analysis and prediction of electric power service hot spot event
abstract_en: The invention discloses a big data mining method, a system, equipment and a medium for analysis and prediction of electric power service hot events, which belong to the technical field of electric power customer service and comprise the steps of obtaining customer service data of a plurality of electric power service interaction systems, constructing an electric power service risk comprehensive data set containing customer appeal and service behaviors, carrying out joint analysis of voiceprint features and text semantics on customer interaction contents to generate customer emotion scores of each service event, constructing a dynamic heterogeneous map, analyzing propagation paths of risk events in space-time dimensions by using a graph neural network model to generate risk diffusion prediction results of each service event, calculating comprehensive risk indexes of each service event, generating early warning work orders of corresponding levels when the comprehensive risk indexes exceed preset multi-level thresholds, and triggering message notification to scheduling personnel of corresponding levels according to risk areas and event types indicated by the comprehensive risk indexes. The invention realizes the automation of risk early warning.

title_en: Safety inspection method, device, equipment, storage medium and program product for intelligent power plant
abstract_en: The application discloses a safety inspection method, a device, equipment, a storage medium and a program product of an intelligent power plant, and relates to the technical field of power plant inspection. The intelligent power plant fault detection method comprises the steps of dynamically updating a fault propagation network based on a device health state tensor, predicting a fault propagation path according to the updated fault propagation network, carrying out self-optimization of a routing inspection path based on risk nodes in the fault propagation path to obtain an optimized routing inspection path, carrying out safety routing inspection based on the routing inspection path, and determining potential faults of the intelligent power plant based on routing inspection results of the safety routing inspection. The multi-mode data in the intelligent power plant are obtained and fused to obtain the device health state tensor, so that the limitation of the traditional single-mode analysis is avoided.
assignees: JIALING RIVER TINGZIKOU WATER RESOURCES AND HYDROPOWER DEV CO LTD

title_en: Efficient wind farm system reliability assessment method and system based on graph neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a wind power plant system reliability high-efficiency evaluation method and system based on a graph neural network, wherein the method comprises the steps of modeling uncertainty and spatial correlation of wind speed through Weibull distribution and a t-Copula function, and capturing time correlation by combining a vector autoregressive model so as to generate a wind speed sequence with space-time correlation; sampling the wind power plant output state and the element fault scene by adopting a non-sequential Monte Carlo method, constructing a minimum output reduction mixed integer linear programming model considering spare cable switching, introducing a graph neural network based on double graph topology, establishing a mapping relation between the fault scene and the output reduction through cooperative training of a full-set edge supervision graph and a closed edge propagation graph, realizing EWOL rapid regression and edge classification of a branch switch state, and balancing the precision of graph stage and edge task through a weighted joint loss function. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of efficiently estimating the average loss power of the sample and the like.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV CHONGQING POSTS & TELECOM

title_en: Apparatus for inspecting electric power conduit in underground using mobile device
title_ko: 모바일 기기를 이용한 지중 전력구 점검장치 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus and method for inspecting an electric power conduit in underground by using a mobile device. The apparatus receives degradation damage in a two-dimensional model and realizes and expresses the degradation damage in a three-dimensional model based on correlation between mutual spatial coordinates by independently utilizing the mobile device without support of an external computer system based on a GPS and wired/wireless communication networks when inspecting and diagnosing the electric power conduit in underground at the electric power conduit in underground which is a radio wave shadow area. Therefore, it is possible to improve economic efficiency by reducing time and labor for an additional work for the three-dimensional model realization, and it is also possible to realize and confirm a three-dimensional degradation damage model in real time at the electric power conduit site in underground. Consequently, it is possible to improve the reliability of diagnosis information and a visual inspection check by previously preventing artificial mistakes and errors that can occur in a conversion process of performing three-dimensional regeneration or re-input based on maintenance information and two-dimensional graphic information.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 모바일 기기를 이용한 지중 전력구 점검장치 및 그 방법에 관한 것으로서, 전파 음영지역인 지중 전력구에서 지중 전력구의 점검과 진단시 GPS와 유무선 통신네트워크 등에 기반한 외부 전산시스템의 지원없이도 독립적으로 모바일 기기를 활용하여 열화손상을 2차원 모델로 입력받아 상호 공간좌표의 연계성에 근거하여 3차원 모델로 구현하여 표출할 수 있도록 함으로써 3차원 모델 구현을 위한 추가적인 작업을 위한 시간과 인력을 줄여 경제성을 향상시킬 수 있으며, 지중 전력구 현장에서 실시간으로 3차원 열화손상 모델을 구현하고 확인할 수 있어 2차원적 그래픽정보와 유지관리정보를 바탕으로 3차원적으로 재생성하거나 재입력하는 변환과정에서 발생될 수 있는 인위적인 실수와 오류를 사전에 방지할 수 있어 외관조사의 점검 및 진단 정보의 신뢰성을 높일 수 있다.

title_en: Disaster condition indication of serving plmn
abstract_en: The invention relates to a novel mechanism involving a network node (100) and a client device (300) for indicating that a serving PLMN (610) is in a disaster condition. The network node informs the client device through control signalling (510) that the serving PLMN for the client device is in disaster condition. Thereby, the client device may take suitable measures so as to avoid service interruption, e.g. by registration at a visiting PLMN (620) not in disaster condition by initiating a PLMN selection procedure. Examples of control signalling that may be used in this context is SIB, NAS, RRC messages or paging messages. Furthermore, the invention also relates to corresponding methods and a computer program.

title_en: Medical system risk management and control pre-prediction method and system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a medical system risk management and control pre-prediction method and system based on deep learning, relates to the technical field of risk management and control of medical systems, and is used for solving the problems of low risk assessment accuracy caused by huge data volume and risk assessment indexes in the existing risk prediction based on a neural network. The risk category prediction model comprises an LSTM network, a CNN convolution network and an attention bidirectional RNN network; during training, a BP feedback propagation algorithm is adopted to carry out gradient feedback, average absolute error MAE is used for distinguishing risk types, and root mean square error RMSE is used for carrying out regression learning on risk assessment grades. The invention predicts the risk which does not occur by adopting algorithms of different risk categories, and adopts an attention mechanism to ensure that the risk assessment accuracy of the neural network is higher.

title_en: Short-term wind speed calculation method based on hazardous chemical accident diffusion model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a short-term wind speed calculation method based on a hazardous chemical accident diffusion model. The short-term wind speed calculation method comprises the following steps of by combining an ABC (artificial bee colony) algorithm and a BP (back propagation) nerve network, optimizing the weight and threshold value of the BP nerve network by the ABC algorithm, accurately predicting the wind speed, and quickly and efficiently performing accurate evaluation on the influence degree and influence range of hazardous chemical leakage accidents in a chemical industrial park. Compared with a PSO-BP (particle swarm optimization-back propagation) nerve network and a GA-BP (genetic algorithm-back propagation) nerve network, the short-term wind speed calculation method has the advantages that the predicting accuracy is obviously improved, the high-efficiency predicting is realized, and the economic cost is reduced; the predicting accuracy on short-term wind speed is improved, and the error rate is only 1.82%; the site accidents can be effectively treated, the emergency rescue and high-efficiency population evacuation can be quickly performed, and the personal casualty and economic loss in the accidents are decreased.
assignees: SHANGHAI ZHONGWEITIANAN PUBLIC SAFETY TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of method and system of the failure major issue of power grid cascading for identification
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of method and system of power grid cascading failure major issue for identification, belong to power system security technical field.The method of the present invention includes: that 1.1 utilization power grid real-time status tracking techniques obtain operation of power networks state；1.2 screen anticipation event set according to pre-set level；The risk elements that 1.3 selection forecast failures are concentrated, it is risk element is out of service and verify；1.4 carry out Load flow calculation for the whole network, obtain calculated result, risk element is cut off if calculated result does not restrain, and excision risk element fault is classified as major issue to be assessed；1.5 when determining power grid is there is no overload or already off 3 overloads route, and the consequence index of acquisition anticipation event is overloaded and do not disconnected 3 overload routes when determining that power grid exists, overload element disconnection is classified as junior's event, into 1.4；Major issue is determined according to major issue evaluation index.The present invention enables the major issue of power grid cascading failure to be identified in advance, for recognition result and takes corresponding prevention and control measure.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: A kind of step power station load variations real-time adaptive method considering daily electricity deviation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to Optimized Scheduling of Hydroelectric Power fields, are related to a kind of step power station load variations real-time adaptive method for considering daily electricity deviation.Since the network load used in power grid generation schedule formulation a few days ago predicts that there are deviations, it is in actual operation realization balancing the load, the variation according to network load is needed, the generation schedule in part power station is adjusted in real time, and step power station is usually as this kind of balancing the load power station.The present invention, which is used, determines step hydropower station power output increase and decrease sequence relative to the abandoning water reduced rate of step electric quantity change, the daily electricity deviation ratio more than limitation, the step accumulation of energy increase rate relative to step electric quantity change three criterion with priority, and the distribution of day part step load increase and decrease amount is successively carried out according to sequence.This method can take into account step waterpower utilization rate and power grid needs, be more easily the receiving of cascade operation department, practicability is stronger.
assignees: UNIV DALIAN TECH;GUIZHOU QIANYUAN POWER CO LTD

title_en: Adaptive scheduling method and system for reservoir group
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reservoir group adaptive scheduling method and system, and belongs to the field of water resource utilization. The initial population is generated in the search space, the fitness value of each individual in the population is evaluated, the individual optimal position and the global optimal position in the population are updated, the global exploration strategy in the coevolution algorithm is adopted to conduct global exploration so as to improve the population convergence speed, and the local development strategy in the coevolution algorithm is adopted to conduct local search so as to improve the individual precision. And updating the positions of the individuals in the population through iterative evolution, and outputting the individuals corresponding to the global optimal solution as a final solution after a search stopping condition is reached. The embodiment proves that the method has good convergence speed and search precision, can coordinate the relationship between exploration and development, effectively solves the problem of cascade reservoir group scheduling, and obviously improves the economic benefit of the whole power grid.

title_en: Design method of broadband miniaturized VICTS antenna feed network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a design method of a broadband miniaturized VICTS antenna feed network, which comprises the steps of determining the level of a power distribution network according to the transverse size of the feed network, and determining the number of T-shaped nodes according to the level of the power distribution network and the longitudinal size of the feed network; analyzing a field mode propagated in the waveguide, calculating the initial frequency and the termination frequency of a main mode, establishing a miniaturized T-shaped junction model, and establishing a relation between structural parameters of the T-shaped junction and a reflection coefficient; a broadband technology is adopted to design a broadband and miniaturized T-shaped junction, and a full-wave analysis method is applied to extract the relation between the broadband T-shaped junction and a reflection coefficient. Adjusting the amplitude and the phase of the T-shaped junction to meet the in-phase excitation output of specific power distribution; and designing a port conversion module and a transition matching and polarization adjusting module, and checking the relevant indexes of the excitation source to achieve the set indexes. The invention realizes the effective compression of the longitudinal dimension of the feed network, realizes the accurate control of the amplitude while outputting in phase within the required frequency band range, thereby ensuring the gain and standing wave characteristics of the antenna.

title_en: Demand response potential evaluation method based on deep forest
abstract_en: The invention discloses a demand response potential evaluation method based on deep forest, which comprises the following steps: collecting historical electricity utilization data and flexible load data of a user for preprocessing to obtain analysis data of user demand response potential, and dividing the analysis data into training data and verification data; sampling the training data to obtain sampled data; generating and training a neural network by taking the sampled data as input according to a BP back propagation algorithm, and establishing a plurality of neural network identification models according to the requirements of data scale and precision; and the neural networks are connected in parallel to form a deep forest model; verifying the deep forest model; inputting the demand response potential analysis data of the target user into the demand response potential prediction of the trained deep forest model, and finishing the demand response potential evaluation of the target user; the technical problems that the method in the prior art consumes a large amount of time, manpower and material resources, and is poor in effect, small in information amount, low in user acceptance degree and the like are solved.

title_en: High-speed railway contact net operation state evaluation method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-speed railway contact network running state evaluation method based on deep learning, wherein a contact network state monitoring detection system comprises two groups of cameras and auxiliary lighting equipment, the cameras and the auxiliary lighting equipment are arranged on the roof of a detection vehicle, the two groups of high-resolution cameras respectively shoot images of a contact network from two opposite directions, a cascade deep convolution neural network realizes multi-resolution analysis of the contact network, parameters and training difficulty of a positioning network are reduced, boundary frame coordinates obtained by the positioning network are mapped to corresponding coordinates of an original high-resolution image, a binary decision diagram is introduced into system reliability analysis, a contact network fault tree model is built, and a fault tree model of a system to be analyzed is converted into the binary decision diagram, so that the fault tree model is rapidly converted into an uncrossified form.
assignees: JIANGSU XINLYUNENG SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Group cascade photovoltaic fire-fighting safety rapid shutoff device and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a group cascade photovoltaic fire safety rapid turn-off device; the device comprises a control module, wherein the control module is electrically connected with a closed-loop control module, the closed-loop control module is electrically connected with a processing module, the processing module is electrically connected with a receiver module, and the receiver module is electrically connected with a detection module; the closed-loop control module and the control module are electrically connected with a driving module together, and the driving module is electrically connected with an emitter module which is electrically connected with the assembly photovoltaic network; the control module is electrically connected with a communication module, and the communication module is connected with mobile equipment in a communication way; according to the invention, the receiver module is used for receiving and transmitting the data information of the component photovoltaic network detected by the detection module, the closed-loop control module is used for calculating, controlling and adjusting, the transmitter module is used for switching off, controlling and adjusting the component photovoltaic network, and the communication module is used for communicating with the mobile equipment, so that the remote operation, control and adjustment are convenient.
assignees: CHANGZHOU SUOTONG INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Earthquake prediction method and system based on optical fiber micro-vibration monitoring
abstract_en: The invention discloses an earthquake prediction method and system based on optical fiber micro-vibration monitoring, comprising the following steps of S1, adopting a dynamic self-adaptive acquisition frequency adjustment mechanism to acquire micro-vibration signals, acquiring data at the frequency of 1kHz in a distributed optical fiber sensing network, simultaneously acquiring the fluctuation condition of the data, setting a fluctuation threshold, and when the fluctuation condition of the micro-vibration signals continuously exceeds the fluctuation threshold in m continuous time windows, acquiring the frequency to be increased to 10kHz to acquire the data and count all micro-vibration signal data, S2, constructing a cross-correlation coefficient matrix of the micro-vibration signal data among different acquisition frequencies through all the micro-vibration signal data, acquiring direction information and propagation velocity information among different monitoring points based on corresponding values in the cross-correlation coefficient matrix to form spatial characteristic parameters, comprehensively capturing the spatial propagation characteristics of the signals, and effectively solving the one-sided problem of the traditional method.
assignees: BORUI TAIKE TECH NINGBO CO LTD

title_en: Power failure area prediction method, power failure sensitive user identification method and system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of intelligent power grids. The invention provides a power failure area prediction method, a power failure sensitive user identification method and a power failure sensitive user identification system, which are used for extracting characteristics of nodes in a device node set according to historical power data to obtain initial node characteristics, determining initial edge weights according to physical or logical relations, updating the initial node characteristics and the initial edge weights according to nodes with changed states to obtain updated node characteristics and updated edge weights, determining node power failure probability according to the updated node characteristics, determining edge fault propagation probability according to the updated node characteristics and the updated edge weights, determining all fault nodes according to the node power failure probability and the edge fault propagation probability, and identifying power failure sensitive users by taking areas where all the fault nodes are as power failure area prediction results.

title_en: Apparatus for uhd disaster broadcasting
title_ko: Uhd 재난 방송 수신 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an UHD disaster broadcast receiving device capable of quickly propagating a disaster situation by using an UHD broadcast signal, and an UHD disaster broadcast system including the same. The UHD disaster broadcast receiving device includes: an UHD broadcast receiving part receiving an ultrahigh definition (UHD) broadcast signal from a broadcast network, and confirming whether disaster broadcast data exists from the UHD broadcast signal; a control part generating subtitle image data and a voice signal based on the disaster broadcast data from the UHD broadcast receiving part; an image display part displaying disaster-related subtitles based on the subtitle image data from the control part; and a sound output part outputting a disaster-related sound based on the voice signal from the control part.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 UHD 방송 신호를 이용하여 재난 상황을 신속히 전파할 수 있는 UHD 재난 방송 수신 장치 및 이를 포함하는 UHD 재난 방송 시스템에 관한 것으로, 방송망으로부터의 UHD 방송(Ultra High Definition) 신호를 수신하고, 상기 UHD 방송 신호로부터 재난 방송 데이터의 존재 유무를 확인하는 UHD 방송 수신부; 상기 UHD 방송 수신부로부터의 재난 방송 데이터를 근거로 자막 영상 데이터 및 음성 신호를 생성하는 제어부; 상기 제어부로부터의 자막 영상 데이터를 근거로 재난 관련 자막을 표시하는 영상 표시부; 및 상기 제어부로부터의 음성 신호를 근거로 재난 관련 음향을 출력하는 음향 출력부를 포함한다.

title_en: Customized Disaster Information Provision System and Method
title_ko: 맞춤형 재난정보 제공시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a customized disaster information providing system and a method thereof and, more specifically, to a system and a method which generate and disseminate area-customized and medium-customized disaster information when a disaster occurs to minimize unnecessary disaster information reception and quickly disseminate disaster information. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the customized disaster information providing system comprises: an information collection unit collecting weather information and disaster information if a disaster occurs in a specific facility or an area; a control unit monitoring location information included in the disaster information of the information collection unit for reference in real time, and performing an approval procedure for notification; an analysis unit analyzing the disaster information and the weather information collected by the information collection unit to derive a disaster situation and a damage prediction range, and checking facilities and warning systems within the damage prediction range; a disaster information generation unit generating multimedia disaster information content in accordance with the facilities and the warning systems within the damage prediction range based on information analyzed by the analysis unit; and a notification unit notifying the facilities and the warning systems within the damage prediction range of the multimedia disaster information content generated by the disaster information generation unit.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 맞춤형 재난정보 제공시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 재난 발생시 지역맞춤형과 매체맞춤형의 재난정보를 생성 전파하여 불필요한 재난정보 수신을 최소화하고 신속하게 재난상황을 전파하는 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것이다. 
 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 맞춤형 재난정보 제공시스템은, 특정 시설물이나 지역에 재난이 발생한 경우 재난정보와 기상정보를 수집하는 정보수집부와, 상기 정보수집부의 재난정보에 포함된 위치정보를 참고로 실시간 모니터링하고 통보에 대한 승인절차를 수행하는 관제부와, 상기 정보수집부에서 수집한 재난정보와 기상정보를 분석하여 재난상황 및 피해예상 범위를 도출하고, 그 피해예상 범위 내 시설물과 경보시스템을 확인하는 분석부와, 상기 분석부에서 분석한 정보를 기반으로 피해예상 범위 내 시설물과 경보시스템에 따라 멀티미디어 재난정보 콘텐츠를 생성하는 재난정보생성부, 및 상기 재난정보생성부에서 생성된 멀티미디어 재난정보 콘텐츠를 피해예상 범위 내 시설물과 경보시스템에 통보하는 통보부를 포함하여 구성된다.

title_en: The Ministry spread direction by electronic display board and The anti-crime CCTV system including the civil defense's improved disaster forecast-alarm broadcasting and The way to broadcast using an anti-crime CCTV and The integral unit and The civil defense/disaster forecast-alarm smart bell and The Military Demarcation Line prallel monitoring IR perspective filter backlight camera CCTV blackbox and The block type controller of DMG quantum code electronic protective wall
title_ko: 방범용 감시카메라 내부망을 이용한 행정안전부 전광판 활용 민방위경보 전파지침 표출 민방위 재난예경보 동보방송 방법 및 행정안전부 전광판을 활용한 민방위경보 전파지침 표출 전광판과 민방위 재난예경보 동보방송 성능개선 비상벨 일체형 함체를 포함하는 방범용 cctv 시스템 및 비상벨 일체형 함체 및 민방위 재난예경보 스마트 비상벨 및 군사분계선 평행감시 ir 투시필터 역광카메라 cctv 블랙박스 및 블랙박스형 비상벨 및 dmg 양자암호 전자방호벽 블록형 제어기 및 양자방호벽 시스템
abstract_en: In an integrated emergency bell enclosure, camera sets consisting of a high-focal distance camera and a low-focal distance camera are installed to and monitor 90 degrees in all directions on all four sides on top of the enclosure, such that a total of eight emergency bell cameras are installed with a fixed camera function for 360-degree surveillance without blind spots. The integrated emergency bell enclosure consists of a switch hub, a power supply, a broadcasting device, a video storage memory, and an Eve SERVER, wherein the Eve SERVER and a Bob SERVER communicate through an unlicensed frequency wireless communication device, videos from crime prevention surveillance cameras are transmitted to an integrated crime prevention center through the switch hub for real-time monitoring, and videos from emergency bell cameras are stored in the video storage memory. In a wireless integrated enclosure, four wireless cameras with a low focus distance are installed to monitor each 90 degrees in all directions on top of the enclosure, and the Eve SERVER and Bob SERVER communicate through the unlicensed frequency wireless communication device. When an emergency bell button is inserted in a front surface of the integrated wireless enclosure and the emergency bell button is activated, the Eve SERVER connects to a network with the Bob SERVER through an unlicensed frequency wireless private network and then establishes a two-way call with an Alice SERVER inside the integrated crime prevention center. Accordingly, performance is improved for surveillance without blind spots and distortion and effective dissemination of civil defense warnings.
abstract_ko:
비상벨 일체형 함체는 외함 상단에 고초점거리 카메라 및 저초점거리 카메라 2대 1조로 구성되어 90도 전방위를 감시하는 카메라 세트를 4면에 설치하여 사각방지용 360도 감시 고정카메라 기능의 총 8대의 비상벨 카메라가 설치된다. 
비상벨 일체형 함체는 스위치허브, 전원부, 방송장치, 영상저장 메모리, Eve SERVER를 포함하여 구성되어, Eve SERVER와 Bob SERVER는 비면허주파수 무선통신장치를 통하여 통신하고, 방범용 감시카메라의 촬영영상은 스위치허브를 통해 통합방범센터로 전송하여 실시간 감시하고, 비상벨 카메라의 촬영영상은 영상저장 메모리에 저장된다. 
무선 일체형 함체는 외함 상단에 각 90도 전방위를 감시하는 저초점거리 카메라 4대의 무선 카메라가 설치되고, Eve SERVER와 Bob SERVER는 비면허주파수 무선통신장치를 통하여 통신한다. 
무선 일체형 함체 전면에 비상벨 버튼이 삽입되어, 비상벨 버튼 작동시 Eve SERVER는 비면허주파수 무선자가망을 통해 Bob SERVER와 네트워크망 연결 후 통합방범센터 내부 Alice SERVER와 양방향 통화로 개통한다.

title_en: System and method for optimizing supply chain of hydrogen distribution network
abstract_en: The present disclosure generally relates to producing, transporting, distributing, and storing hydrogen fuel, more particularly to system and method for optimizing supply chain of hydrogen distribution network. A centralized server triggers production facility to produce gas/liquid Hydrogen. Centralized server stores at storage facility in hydrogen cylinders, produced gas/liquid Hydrogen, in Liquid Organic Hydrogen Carrier (LOHC) molecule, based on hydrogenation of chemicals. Centralized server transmits instructions for transporting hydrogenated LOHC molecule in tanker trucks, from production facility to depots, and dehydrogenates at depots, hydrogenated LOHC molecule to release hydrogen at low pressure. Centralized server compresses, at depots, released hydrogen, and fill compressed hydrogen in high-pressure tube trailers/flat-bed cylinder cascades. Centralized server determines optimal routes for transportation vehicles from depots to retailers/consumption sites, and stores, at retailers/consumption sites, compressed hydrogen in low-pressure tanks/high-pressure buffer cylinders. Centralized server outputs information corresponding to inventory of low-pressure tanks/high-pressure buffer cylinders at retailers/consumption sites.

title_en: Recommendation engine for a cognitive reservoir system
abstract_en: Implementations described and claimed herein provide systems and methods for developing a reservoir. In one implementation, a reservoir model is received. The reservoir model includes a static model and a dynamic model. The static model includes one or more clusters of a three-dimensional volume of the reservoir and an uncertainty quantification generated using a neural network. The dynamic model includes pressure values and fluid saturation values propagated across the three-dimensional volume through a nodal connectivity of neighboring clusters. A set of input features is generated from the static model and the dynamic model. The set of input features is related to a drilling attractiveness of a target region of the reservoir using a set of rules executed by a fuzzy inference engine. A quantification of the drilling attractiveness is generated. A recommendation for drilling in the reservoir is output based on the quantification of the drilling attractiveness.

title_en: Power distribution network fault risk early warning method and system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power grid fault early warning, and discloses a power distribution network fault risk early warning method and system based on deep learning so as to improve the accuracy of fault early warning. The method comprises the following steps: screening initial characteristic information related to power distribution network faults and preprocessing; calculating the weight of each initial feature and removing the initial features lower than the weight threshold to obtain target feature information; based on the target characteristic information, carrying out association mapping on the power grid data and the meteorological data, constructing a data set and generating a corresponding label; taking the target characteristic information as the input of the deep neural network, and training and verifying the deep neural network according to the corresponding label; and obtaining meteorological factors in target characteristic information by using an LSTM network for predicting the meteorological factors based on historical data, cascading the LSTM network with a deep neural network to obtain a fault early warning model based on the deep neural network, and then carrying out early warning according to the fault early warning model based on the deep neural network to obtain an early warning conclusion.

title_en: Reducing wireless device service interruption
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to apparatus, systems, and methods for reducing wireless device service disruption. An indication of the disaster condition may be provided to the wireless device. The disaster condition may affect the home public land mobile network of the wireless device. The wireless device is able to perform cell selection in a manner affected by the disaster status indication. Among the various possibilities, this may include considering cells associated with disabling the public land mobile network for cell selection, or excluding cells associated with the home public land mobile network of the wireless device that are unavailable (e.g., due to a disaster condition).

title_en: Water supply system scheduling agent decision method
abstract_en: A water supply system dispatching agent decision method comprises the steps of 1) collecting actual measurement monitoring data of water delivery engineering, including water level, flow and gate opening and closing conditions. The sample data is divided into a training set, a test set and a prediction set. 2) And constructing a BP neural network model, which consists of an input layer, an implicit layer and an output layer. 3) The training set sample data is input into a BP neural network model, and the training process comprises an information propagation process and an error propagation process. 4) And 3) outputting the control decision step 3) to obtain an ideal BP neural network model, wherein the output result of the output layer is in the interval [0,1], and the output result is subjected to inverse normalization processing to obtain the opening value of the gate, and the control decision of the gate is output. The invention can reflect the mutual connection and the mutual influence among the elements of the water delivery system, can predict the valve opening value through the elements such as the water level, the target flow and the like, has reliable result, can provide reference for actual dispatching management, ensures that the water dispatching decision is more intelligent and accurate, and is convenient for the operation management of actual engineering.

title_en: Deep learning-based urban village risk assessment and risk factor positioning method
abstract_en: The invention provides a deep learning-based urban village risk assessment and risk factor positioning method, which comprises the steps of searching various risk accidents by using a crowd sensing technology, clustering each type of risk accidents, taking the risk accidents exceeding a threshold value as risk hot spots, and acquiring risk hot spot scene data according to urban village risk hot spots, wherein the risk hot spot scene data comprises urban village scene data and scene data; extracting urban village level scene characteristics from urban village level scene data, and extracting scene level scene characteristics from scene level scene data; inputting the scene characteristics of the village level in the city and the scene level in the city into a constructed trained residual network model, evaluating the risk of the village in the city, and adopting a layer-by-layer correlation propagation algorithm to locate risk factors; the heterogeneous data fusion is realized, the advantages of high efficiency and low consumption are achieved, and meanwhile, higher accuracy is achieved.

title_en: Step liquid collecting method in-situ exploitation process of ionic rare earth ore
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascade liquid collecting method in an in-situ mining process of an ionic rare earth mine, which is used for carrying out cascade division and liquid collecting facility arrangement according to geological conditions such as area, topography, formation shape and the like of a region of liquid injection mining aiming at the ionic rare earth mine with steep hillside or larger ore body, wherein a plurality of layers of liquid immersion guide holes, liquid immersion collecting grooves and rain water draining grooves are arranged from top to bottom to realize cascade collection of liquid immersion and natural rainfall drainage, an impermeable curtain is constructed along a mountain foot to prevent overflow and leakage of the liquid immersion, and a liquid immersion collecting well with a plurality of layers of liquid immersion guide holes is arranged in a liquid accumulation region inside the impermeable curtain to recover the liquid immersion and control the water level of a liquid accumulation region. The method can effectively control the phenomena of mountain collapse, landslide or debris flow which are easy to occur in the liquid injection process of the mountain high-slope steep mine, can realize the cascade exploitation and immersion liquid effective collection of the mine with larger ore body quantity, reduces the loss of the immersion liquid, and is beneficial to constructing a new ecological green exploitation mode for sustainable development of the mine.

title_en: Method for trading medium-and-long-term electric power markets of hydropower enrichment power grid with compatible excitation
abstract_en: The invention provides a medium-long-term electric power market trading method for a hydropower enrichment power grid with compatible excitation, which is characterized by adopting the maximum individual power generation benefit and the minimum power purchase cost at the power grid side as targets, firstly carrying out optimal scheduling on a hydropower system with the maximum minimum output of the hydropower system as targets to obtain guaranteed electric quantity, then splitting the guaranteed electric quantity into basic electric quantity, inner-provincial electric quantity and east-west electric quantity to participate in corresponding market trading respectively, adopting a reinforcement learning algorithm to carry out loop iteration solution, and finally selecting different water supply frequencies and analyzing the power supply stability under different forms and different guaranteed electric quantities. The method has guiding significance for the problems of default, insufficient water resource utilization and the like caused by unreasonable competition of the cascade power stations, uncertain natural water supply and mismatching of the winning power quantity, and provides effective advice and direction for medium-long term transaction modes of the hydropower enrichment power grid.

title_en: Digital twinning-based modeling method for underground pipe network of power grid engineering area
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of digital twinning, and in particular relates to a modeling method of an underground pipe network in a power grid engineering area based on digital twinning, which comprises the steps of initializing a digital twinning model of the underground pipe network, carrying out gridding on the digital twinning model, and calibrating static parameters; the method comprises the steps of carrying out state propagation on particles representing states of grid nodes based on a state transfer equation of a plurality of coupled physical fields to obtain predicted particles, evaluating engineering risk degrees of all the grid nodes, determining the engineering risk degrees based on construction risk coefficients, state uncertainty and safety margin, reallocating the particles according to the engineering risk degrees, fusing heterogeneous sensor data, calculating the weight of the predicted particles, calculating a state optimal estimated value of the grid nodes according to the normalized weight of the predicted particles, and updating the digital twin model. The method and the device realize non-uniform distribution of computing resources to the key areas, and improve model estimation precision and real-time performance of risk early warning.

title_en: System for evaluating performance of disaster response system by adjusting input data
title_ko: 입력데이터 조정을 통해 재난대응시스템의 성능을 평가하는 시스템
abstract_en: One embodiment may provide a system comprising: a disaster response system including a data collection unit that collects disaster data including past disaster data, institutional disaster data collected or processed by the institution, and environmental facility disaster data measured at environmental facilities, and a system control unit for generating a disaster situation propagation plan and disaster response plan according to the type of disaster from the past disaster data, the institutional disaster data, and the environmental facility disaster data, matching the disaster type, the disaster situation propagation plan, and the disaster response plan to manualized the disaster situation propagation plan and the disaster response plan to generate a disaster manual, performing a decision-making corresponding to the disaster type when the disaster type is input, and outputting the disaster situation propagation plan and the disaster response plan according to the disaster manual included in the decision-making; and a performance evaluation device including an input control unit for inputting an input value including the disaster type to the disaster response system, an output control unit for receiving an output value including the disaster situation propagation plan and the disaster response plan from the disaster response system, and an evaluation unit for evaluating the accuracy of the decision-making on the basis of the error of the output value. The input value is generated from input data composed of a plurality of classes defined by different boundary values according to the disaster type, and the performance of the disaster response system corresponding to a value belonging to one of the classes is evaluated. It is possible to evaluate the accuracy of decision-making or the accuracy of disaster costing.
abstract_ko: 일 실시예는 과거재난데이터, 기관이 수집 또는 처리한 기관재난데이터 및 환경시설에서 측정된 환경시설재난데이터를 포함하는 재난데이터를 수집하는 데이터수집부와, 상기 과거재난데이터, 상기 기관재난데이터 및 상기 환경시설재난데이터로부터 재난유형에 따른 재난상황전파방안 및 재난대응방안을 생성하고, 상기 재난유형, 상기 재난상황전파방안 및 상기 재난대응방안을 매칭시킴으로써 상기 재난상황전파방안 및 상기 재난대응방안을 매뉴얼화하여 재난매뉴얼을 생성하고, 상기 재난유형을 입력받으면 상기 재난유형에 대응하는 의사결정을 수행하며, 상기 의사결정에 포함된 상기 재난매뉴얼에 따라 상기 재난상황전파방안 및 상기 재난대응방안을 출력하는 시스템제어부를 포함하는 재난대응시스템; 및 상기 재난유형을 포함하는 입력값을 재난대응시스템에 입력시키는 입력제어부, 상기 재난상황전파방안 및 상기 재난대응방안을 포함하는 출력값을 상기 재난대응시스템으로부터 수신하는 출력제어부, 상기 출력값의 오류에 기반하여 상기 의사결정의 정확도를 평가하는 평가판단부를 포함하는 성능평가장치를 포함하고, 상기 입력값은, 상기 재난유형에 따라 상이한 경계값으로 규정되는 복수의 클래스로 구성되는 입력데이터로부터 생성되되, 상기 복수의 클래스 중 하나의 클래스에 속하는 값에 해당하는 재난대응시스템의 성능을 평가하는 시스템을 제공할 수 있다.

title_en: Video providing system for the location of the fire site of the building and the firefighting equipment
title_ko: 건물의 화재장소와 소방기기의 위치에 대한 영상제공시스템
abstract_en: The present invention provides a video providing system for the location of the fire site of a building and firefighting equipment. The video providing system for the location of the fire site of a building and firefighting equipment according to an embodiment of the present invention is includes a user device, a firefighting facility, an alarm, a CCTV, and a service control server. Because a member who first discovered fire can share the fact of the fire with the rest of the member, damage to life and property can be minimized.
abstract_ko: 건물의 화재장소와 소방기기의 위치에 대한 영상제공시스템이 제공된다. 건물의 화재장소와 소방기기의 위치에 대한 영상제공시스템은, 사용자 디바이스, 소방시설, 경보기, CCTV 및 서비스 관제서버를 포함하는 건물의 화재장소와 소방기기의 위치에 대한 영상제공시스템에 있어서, 사용자 디바이스는, 화재발생을 발견하고 전파하는 화재전파용 제1 사용자 디바이스와, 제1 사용자 디바이스로부터 화재발생을 수신하고 공유하는 제2 사용자 디바이스를 포함하고, 소방시설은 소화기 및 위치 알림 거치대를 포함하고, 위치 알림 거치대는, 소화기가 거치되는 본체 및 본체에 내장된 알림부를 포함하며, 알림부는  소화기의 거치유무를 판단하는 제1 알림부 및 화재발생시 빛을 출력하는 광원부와 소리를 출력하는 음향출력부를 포함하는 제2 알림부를 포함하고, 경보기는, 바디부와, 상기 바디부의 하면에 배치된 스피커부와, 스피커부를 둘러싸는 커버부를 포함하고, 바디부는 서로 이격된 제1 모듈부 및 제2 모듈부를 포함하고, 제1 모듈부 및 제2 모듈부는 바디부의 외면에 내장되며, 제1 모듈부 및 제2 모듈부 각각은, 제1 방향으로 순차적으로 배치된 제1 센서부, 제1 발광부, 제2 센서부 및 제2 발광부를 포함하고, 제1 센서부 및 제2 센서부 각각은 연기 센서, 열 센서, 습도 센서 중 적어도 하나를 포함하고, 커버부는 제1 부분 및 제2 부분을 포함하고, 제1 부분 및 제2 부분은 제1 방향으로 교번하여 다수 배치되며, 제1 부분은 테드라데칸으로 이루어지되, 제2 부분은 금속재질로 이루어지고, CCTV는, CCTV를 고정시키는 고정부, 고정부와 연결되는 연장부, 연장부와 연결되며 외부 하우징부, 외부 하우징부에 수납되며 촬영부와 보조 촬영부를 포함하는 내부 하우징부를 포함하고, 고정부는, 제1 고정부 공기통로 및 제2 고정부 공기통로를 다수 포함하고, 제1 고정부 공기통로 내부에는 실리콘 충전되며, 제2 고정부 공기통로 내부에는 테드라데칸이 충전되되, 제1 고정부 공기통로 및 제2 고정부 공기통로는 서로 교번하여 배치되고, 제1 고정부 공기통로 및 제2 고정부 공기통로 각각은 원 기둥 형상으로 이루어지며, 제1 고정부 공기통로 및 제2 고정부 공기통로 각각의 지름은 0.05cm 내지 0.4cm이고, 연장부는 고정부와 외부 하우징부를 연결하되, 길이가 가변되고, 외부 하우징부는 금속재질로 이루어지되, 내부에 제1 외부 하우징부 공기통로 및 제2 외부 하우징부 공기통로를 다수 포함하고, 제1 외부 하우징부 공기통로 내부에는 실리콘 충전되며, 제2 외부 하우징부 공기통로 내부에는 테드라데칸이 충전되되, 제1 외부 하우징부 공기통로 및 제2 외부 하우징부 공기통로 각각은 원 기둥 형상으로 이루어지며, 제1 외부 하우징부 공기통로 및 제2 외부 하우징부 공기통로 각각의 지름은 0.1cm 내지 0,8cm이고, 외부 하우징부의 하면에는 제1 센서 모듈 및 제2 센서 모듈이 배치되고, 제1 센서 모듈은 열 감지 센서를 포함하고, 제2 센서 모듈은 사람의 음성 주파수를 인식하는 음성인식센서 및 GPS신호를 분석하여 위치 정보를 획득하는 GPS 센서를 포함하며, 제1 센서 모듈 및 제2 센서 모듈 각각은 외면에는 열전도 차단막이 배치되되, 열전도 차단막은 글라스파이버 75 중량%, 페놀수지 17중량%, 탄산칼슘은 8중량%를 포함하여 이루어지며, 열전도 차단막의 두께는 0.1cm 내지 0.3cm이고, 열전도 차단막은 다수의 홀을 포함하며, 다수의 홀의 직경은 0.01cm 내지 0.03cm이며, 서비스 관제서버는, 제1 사용자 디바이스 및 제2 사용자 디바이스, 소방시설, 경보기 및 CCTV와 무선통신 방식으로 연동하며, 각 지역별 건물의 도면 맵을 저장 관리하는 맵 정보 저장 관리부를 포함한다.

title_en: Smart IoT Fire Alarm System
title_ko: 스마트 IoT 화재 경보 시스템
abstract_ko:
스마트 IoT 화재 경보 시스템이 개시된다.  본 발명의 실시예에 따른 스마트 IoT 화재 경보 시스템은, 소방시설법상 장착되어야 할 구역 및 화재로부터 취약한 경계구역에 다수 장착된 화재감지센서로부터 화재발생정보를 실시간으로 수신하고, 수신된 화재발생정보를 서버에 전달하는 IoT모듈이 내장된 스마트 IoT 화재수신기; 및 상기 스마트 IoT 화재수신기로부터 전달된 데이터를 바탕으로 소방서에 화재관련 신고를 수행하고, 건물 관계인에게 실시간으로 화재수신기 작동 정보를 전송하는 서버;를 포함하는 것을 구성의 요지로 한다. 
본 발명에 따르면, 소방안전관리자들의 휴대폰으로 화재 발생 위치 및 대처 방법을 포함하는 화재 경보 메세지를 자동 발송하여 보다 구체적인 화재발생 관련정보를 소방안전관리자들에게 전파함으로써 호재발생에 대응하여 효과적인 대처를 가능하게 하는 스마트 IoT 화재 경보 시스템을 제공할 수 있다.

title_en: Static engine and neural network for a cognitive reservoir system
abstract_en: Implementations described and claimed herein provide systems and methods for developing a reservoir. In one implementation, observed data points in a volume along a well trajectory and well logs corresponding to observed data points are received at a neural network. Feature vectors are generated using the neural network. The feature vectors are defined based on a distance between each of the observed data points and randomly generated points in the volume. A 3D populated log is generated by propagating well log values of the feature vectors across the volume. Uncertainty is quantified by generating a plurality of realizations including the 3D populated log. Each of the realizations is different and equally probable. core values are generated from the realizations, and a static model of the reservoir is generated by clustering the volume into one or more clusters of rock types based on the core values.

title_en: Tetra and GSM (Global System for Mobile Communication) common base station platform based on software radio
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Tetra and GSM (Global System for Mobile Communication) common base station platform based on software radio. The Tetra and GSM common base station platform comprises a digital processing platform and a radiofrequency processing platform, wherein the digital processing platform comprises an MCU (Microprogrammed Control Unit), a DSP (Digital Signal Processor), an FPGA (Field Programmable Gate Array) and a clock module; the clock module is connected with the FPGA; a PLL (Phase Locked Loop), a CIC (Cascade Integrator Comb) filter and a digital receiving filter are arranged inside the FPGA; the FPGA is used for processing a clock signal through the PLL and transmitting the processed clock signal to the MCU and the DSP which are connected with the FPGA; the radiofrequency processing platform comprises a transmitting module, a receiving module, a PLL module, a combination module and a digital-to-analog/analog-to-digital conversion module; and the digital processing platform is connected with the radiofrequency processing platform through the digital-to-analog/analog-to-digital conversion module to realize information transmission. The two modes of Tetra and GSM are realized on the same hardware platform, the design period is shortened greatly, and the design cost is reduced; private network and public network communication services are provided by loading different applications according to scene requirements, and the Tetra and GSM common base station platform is suitable for mobile emergency communication.

title_en: Oil temperature prediction method and device and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses an oil temperature prediction method and device and a computer readable storage medium, and belongs to the field of petroleum transportation. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a training data set, wherein the training data set comprises a plurality of data samples; calling an oil temperature prediction model based on a plurality of data samples to perform oil temperature prediction to obtain a plurality of predicted historical oil temperatures, wherein the oil temperature prediction model is obtained by training a back propagation neural network by adopting a training data set; subtracting the plurality of predicted historical oil temperatures from the historical downstream incoming oil temperatures of the plurality of predicted historical oil temperatures respectively to obtain a residual value sequence; calling an autoregressive moving average model to predict a residual value of the residual value sequence at the next moment; calling an oil temperature prediction model to perform oil temperature prediction based on oil temperature data to be predicted to obtain predicted oil temperature at the next moment, wherein the oil temperature data to be predicted comprises upstream oil temperature, upstream ground temperature, downstream station-entering ground temperature and output; and adding the residual value at the next moment and the predicted oil temperature at the next moment to obtain a predicted value of the inbound oil temperature at the next moment.

title_en: Power distribution network information system risk assessment method and system based on graph convolution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a risk assessment method and a risk assessment system for a power distribution network information system based on a graph convolution network, and relates to the technical field of power distribution network information physical systems, wherein the risk assessment method comprises the steps of combining time dynamic characteristics in an LSTM capturing fault propagation process to accurately assess the risk level of node voltage out-of-limit; and under the non-fault condition, the electrical characteristics of the system are learned, the evaluation precision is improved, and the risk evaluation of the information system of the power distribution network is completed. According to the invention, by introducing a combined model based on the graph rolling network GCN and the long-short-term memory network LSTM, the space-time characteristics in the information physical system of the power distribution network can be effectively captured, the risk level of node voltage out-of-limit is accurately estimated, and the accuracy and instantaneity of risk estimation are remarkably improved.

title_en: Potential landslide identification method and system based on surface deformation cause analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a potential landslide identification method and system based on ground surface deformation cause analysis, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining radar data and preprocessing to obtain ground surface deformation phase data, constructing and training IDANet-1 networks, predicting to obtain ground surface deformation abnormal areas, respectively processing terrain DEM data, multi-time-phase MODIS data and optical image data to obtain ground surface subsidence type, glacier snow melting type and mine subsidence type ground surface deformation areas, performing difference set operation on the ground surface subsidence type ground surface deformation areas after collecting operation to obtain a landslide type ground surface deformation target, training IDANet-2 networks by using a landslide type ground surface deformation identification data set, and inputting wide area comprehensive remote sensing data into a IDANet-2 network model for reasoning to obtain wide area potential landslide hidden danger distribution information. According to the technical scheme, multi-layer cascade connection of multi-source multi-mode remote sensing data is realized, the ground deformation information is accurately identified, and the identification efficiency of potential landslide hidden danger in a large area is effectively improved.
assignees: AERO GEOPHYSICAL SURVEY AND REMOTE SENSING CENTER FOR NATURAL RESOURCES OF CHINA

title_en: Electric power facility toughness evaluation system based on multi-source seismic data
abstract_en: The invention provides an electric power facility toughness assessment system based on multi-source seismic data, which relates to the technical field of data processing and is used for acquiring a seismic data set, screening the seismic data set, removing seismic data irrelevant to a target facility in a seismic center position, obtaining the seismic screening data set, extracting inflection points of vibration amplitude change, dividing the seismic screening data set into a plurality of data segments according to the inflection points, splicing according to time sequences, obtaining continuous vibration data, establishing a vibration transmission path according to the spatial position and the connection relation of each component in the target facility and the propagation direction and the action time of the spliced vibration data, calculating vibration response values of each component in the target facility, determining the component numbers and the vibration response values, and calculating toughness indexes of the target facility to obtain a toughness assessment result of the target facility. The invention can evaluate the toughness index of the electric power facilities in the multi-source seismic data.
assignees: POWER EMERGENCY CENTER OF STATE GRID SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER CORP;Sichuan Seismic Station;XIAMEN DIJIA TECH CO LTD

title_en: Shock wave overpressure field reconstruction method based on physical information
abstract_en: The invention discloses a shock wave overpressure field reconstruction method based on physical information, which relates to the technical field of gun firing and comprises the following steps of establishing a multi-scene overpressure experience formula library comprising Henrych formula, M.A. Sadovsky formula and national defense design specification, embedding physical priori knowledge into a neural network for training through a weighted loss function, forming an attention module with channel-space cooperative reinforcement capability by fusing one-dimensional efficient channel attention, extruding an excitation network and reducing dimension CBAM, dividing a forward shock wave field and a post-muzzle wavefront subtask according to shock wave propagation characteristics, realizing regional prediction through dynamic feature routing, optimizing network parameters by adopting a low data quantity training strategy, and outputting overpressure peak field distribution. According to the invention, by constructing a physical data fusion constraint mechanism and an EC-SEAM mixed attention mechanism, the network physical interpretation and the near field mutation feature extraction capability are improved, and the dependence on the annotation data is obviously reduced.

title_en: Intelligent allocation and early warning method for international trade measure workflow
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent allocation and early warning method of international trade measure workflow, which relates to the technical field of resource scheduling and distribution, and aims to realize penetration and forward prospective early warning from macroscopic environment to microscopic core asset risk by calculating vector differences of policy texts in semantic vector space and introducing information source authority as a regulating factor to accurately quantify talent policy tightness, and simultaneously, adopting a principal component analysis method to carry out weighted fusion on basic emotion components of public opinion, logarithmic propagation influence factors and topic risk weights so as to objectively calculate social public opinion rejection degree and focus on public opinion really having systematic threat, and finally, carrying out probability coupling on the accurately quantified external environment risk and core talent loss impact index inside an enterprise by utilizing a dynamic Bayesian network, thereby converting the fuzzy trade risk into manageable and accurate internal safety problem to people and obviously improving the accuracy and efficiency of decision.

title_en: Emerging load power supply potential improving method based on dynamic prediction
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power system dispatching, in particular to a dynamic prediction-based emerging load power supply potential improving method, which comprises the steps of obtaining emerging load power consumption, meteorological environment and power grid schedulable resource data of a target area through an Internet of things sensing terminal, predicting a load curve through a double-channel modeling by using a deep space-time network, establishing a model to quantify resource regulation potential, according to load fluctuation and resource evaluation results, a scheduling priority list and a capacity allocation strategy are generated by means of a matching rule base, actual scheduling effects are fed back to a prediction model, and a closed-loop optimization link is formed through error back propagation correction parameters.
assignees: SHANDONG GUOYAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Depth learning-based turbid water body holographic turbulent flow field three-dimensional reconstruction method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a depth learning-based three-dimensional reconstruction method and a depth learning-based three-dimensional reconstruction system for a holographic turbulent flow field of a turbid water body, which relate to the technical field of underwater optical imaging, and the method comprises the steps of adopting a holographic light path to irradiate the turbid water body and driving a camera to capture a transient holographic interference image sequence; denoising by adopting a noise suppression model, outputting an optimized hologram, positioning particles by using a cascade convolution neural network to generate an initial plane coordinate set, calculating the axial depth of the particles to obtain a transient space coordinate set, executing space-time diagram association and generating a three-dimensional particle field dynamic sequence, and executing flow field inversion to generate a three-dimensional transient turbulence velocity field. The method solves the technical problems that the traditional three-dimensional reconstruction method based on the image is difficult to overcome the noise intensity of the holographic image and the distortion of the particle signal in the turbid water scene, and achieves the effects of effectively resisting the interference caused by the scattering of the turbid water, comprehensively and accurately acquiring key data required by the three-dimensional reconstruction of the turbulent flow field, thereby accurately realizing the technical effect of the three-dimensional reconstruction of the turbulent flow field of the turbid water.
assignees: TIANJIN RESEARCH INST WATER TRANSP ENGINEERING MOT

title_en: Big data management and intelligent evaluation system for air quality of hospital environment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent regulation and energy conservation of air quality of a hospital environment, in particular to a big data management and intelligent evaluation system of air quality of the hospital environment, which comprises a multi-mode data acquisition module, a data processing module, a dynamic transmission modeling module, a dynamic Bayesian network risk modeling module, a prospective risk hedging module and an energy consumption optimizing module, wherein the system calculates a dynamic air transmission coefficient by acquiring environment and people flow data and builds a dynamic Bayesian network model to calculate a cross-region propagation risk probability, and the core is that when the risk probability exceeds a threshold value, the system actively solves a multi-objective optimization problem with minimum energy consumption as a target to generate an optimal HVAC control instruction.
assignees: XIAN SITENG ENVIRONMENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Methods and systems for restoring power based on forecasted loads
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a system for restoring power that identifies back-feeding pathways that reduce the risk of cascading power failure and the need for additional network reconfigurations as a result of restoring power in a power distribution network.SOLUTION: A method for restoring power on the basis of forecasted loads is described. The method includes identifying at least one zone within a power distribution network, and predicting a first energy demand of the at least one zone. The method also includes identifying at least one alternate source of power for the at least one zone, identifying at least one switch within the power distribution network capable of supplying power from the at least one alternate source to the at least one zone, and generating a restoration plan for restoring power to the at least one zone.

title_en: On-Device AI Mediation and Edge Computing-Based Adaptive Precision Positioning Disaster Communication System and Method
title_ko: 온디바이스 ai 중재 및 엣지 컴퓨팅 기반의 적응형 정밀 측위 재난 통신 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 온디바이스 AI 중재와 5G MEC 기반 3계층 아키텍처를 통해 재난 신고와 전파의 정확성·신속성·생존성을 극대화하는 시스템 및 방법이다. 사용자 단말은 적응형 칼만 필터(AKF)로 멀티모달 센서를 융합하여 GPS 음영 지역에서도 정밀 위치를 확보하고, AI 모듈이 허위·중복 신고를 원천 차단한다. 엣지 서버는 ST-DBSCAN 알고리즘을 통해 실시간 재난 클러스터를 형성하며, 중앙 관제 서버는 이동통신사 망 및 민간 플랫폼과 연동된 하이브리드 전파를 수행하고 실시간 도달률 모니터링(ACK)을 통해 미수신자에게 보완 전파를 수행한다. 아울러 통신 인프라 붕괴 시에는 D2D 메쉬 네트워크로 통신을 복원하고, PoA 블록체인을 통해 전 과정의 데이터 무결성을 보장한다.

title_en: Neural network inverse control method for SCR denitration system of coal-fired unit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a neural network inverse control method for a coal-fired unit SCR denitration system, which comprises establishment of a mechanism model of the SCR denitration system, training of an inverse model and application of a feedforward controller based on the inverse model; the establishment of the SCR denitration system mechanism model comprises the following steps: based on Langmuir-Hinshellwood mechanism and Eley-Rideal mechanism, a model of the SCR denitration system is established; the optimal parameters of a mechanism model are obtained by analyzing field real data and optimizing by using particle swarm or genetic algorithm, and the model can basically represent a real system; training of the inverse model includes: based on the constructed accurate mechanism model of the SCR denitration system, giving a group of random numbers to an input end, setting simulation time as long as possible, and generating random output of the model; training an inverse model by utilizing the generated random data and utilizing an NARX neural network; the application of the feedforward controller based on the inverse model comprises the following steps: and the generated inverse model is combined with the original cascade PID control system of the coal-fired unit to form the SCR denitration inverse control system.

title_en: Distributed generalized energy storage convergence cooperative method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed generalized energy storage convergence coordination method which is suitable for converging scattered generalized energy storage resources in space-time distribution and assisting power grid operation. It comprises the following steps: 1) Acquiring relevant operation parameters of distributed generalized energy storage; 2) Based on the acquired parameters, evaluating the schedulable potential of the distributed generalized energy storage participation convergence by using an analytic hierarchy process; 3) Designing and distributing the schedulable potential of generalized energy storage according to the relative importance degree of criterion layer factors of an analytic hierarchy process, and establishing a shunting cascade convergence utilization framework of an aggregator-distributed generalized energy storage; 4) Based on the split-flow cascade convergence utilization architecture, a convergence cooperative interaction model is established by using a Stackelberg game, so that convergence multiplexing is realized. The invention can realize the schedulable potential evaluation of the distributed generalized energy storage, the multiplexing scene diversion and individual cascade output sequencing of the distributed generalized energy storage with different characteristics, and the cooperative modeling of the distributed generalized energy storage convergence, and finally realize the multiplexing of the distributed generalized energy storage convergence.

title_en: Rumor propagation system modeling and threshold algorithm under random switching view angle
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rumor propagation prediction, and discloses a rumor propagation system modeling method under a random switching view angle, which comprises the following steps: classifying the people in the social network rumor model, drawing a relation flow chart of each group, constructing a differential equation expression of the rumor model, searching a non-rumor balance point and a rumor balance point of the model according to whether rumors are popular, and solving a basic regeneration number, and further describing the switching model. The invention firstly proposes the assumption that a social network is formed by N individuals, the individuals can be regarded as nodes in the network, the relation among the individuals can be regarded as the connecting edges among the nodes of the network, the further explanation of a switching model is realized in the whole network, a non-linear coupling relation is used, a Markov chain is added to the contact infection rate, and an anti-rumor person is added on the basis of a traditional model, so that the method accords with more practical conditions.

title_en: Scheduling method, device, equipment and medium of water-wind-storage complementary power generation system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power grid dispatching and discloses a dispatching method, a device, equipment and a medium of a water-wind-storage complementary power generation system, wherein the method is used for constructing a target optimization model by taking the minimum system operation cost and the maximum system stable operation index as targets; constructing constraint based on power balance constraint, generator set output constraint, reactive power constraint, regional load constraint, node voltage constraint and cascade hydropower station constraint of the generator set; solving the target optimization model to obtain an optimal solution conforming to constraint conditions; forming a scheduling scheme based on the optimal solution to complete power scheduling according to the scheduling scheme; therefore, a group of optimal solutions which can ensure the stable operation of the system and enable the operation cost of the system to be the lowest are obtained, and further, a scheduling scheme can be formed according to the optimal solutions to finish the scheduling work of the power.

title_en: Reservoir water level disturbance interval assessment and control method under cascade hydropower response flexibility demand mode
abstract_en: The invention provides a reservoir water level disturbance interval assessment and control method under a step hydropower response flexibility demand mode, which belongs to the field of novel power system dispatching, and comprises the following steps: collecting initial calculation conditions, and calculating new energy prediction deviation in the future 1 day; the power grid predicts deviation according to new energy, combines flexibility supply capability to issue flexibility requirements to the cascade hydroelectric power in real time, and adopts a linear distribution mode to carry out dynamic distribution; constructing a minimum objective function of peak-valley difference of the residual net load of the power grid and giving constraint conditions; taking the power station output, the power generation flow and the storage capacity in the planned implementation stage as random variables, and meeting the operation constraint; controlling the fluctuation range of the water level at the end of the scheduling period; performing equivalent reconstruction on constraint items containing random variables to obtain a linear programming model without the random variables; and carrying out model solving by using an optimization solver. The invention can effectively cope with the uncertainty of the flexibility requirement of the high-proportion new energy power system and grasp the running state of the flexibility requirement provided by hydropower.

title_en: Mine ecological risk prediction method and system based on artificial intelligence
