abstract_en: The invention provides a mine ecological risk prediction method and system based on artificial intelligence, which are characterized in that multisource ecological monitoring data are collected through a distributed sensor network deployed in a mine area, a space-time alignment treatment is carried out to generate a space-time correlation feature set, a pre-trained ecological risk prediction model is called to predict features to generate a risk conduction mode set comprising a risk propagation path, a starting node, a propagation direction and strength, an ecological risk evolution network is constructed based on the risk conduction mode set, the topological structure and time sequence dependency relationship of risk nodes are displayed, a risk early warning instruction set comprising a risk classification result and an ecological restoration strategy is generated according to the ecological risk evolution network and is sent to an ecological management platform, so that mine ecological risks can be comprehensively and accurately predicted, effective risk early warning and ecological restoration strategies are provided, and mine ecological safety is guaranteed.

title_en: Electric power-traffic coupling charging network toughness assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for evaluating toughness of an electric power-traffic coupling charging network, and belongs to the technical field of electric power system analysis. According to the method, an electric power-traffic coupling charging network is built, a Bezier curve is combined to simulate a typhoon path and a Holland wind field model to calculate wind speed, dynamic traffic flow distribution, alternating current optimal power flow and cascading fault models are built, a Monte Carlo simulation is utilized to generate a fault data set, a dynamic Bayesian network is utilized to train a fault prediction model, a dynamic probability map is output after the actually measured wind speed is input, and dynamic toughness indexes are calculated to evaluate the toughness of the electric power-traffic coupling charging network. According to the method, the problem of fault propagation and insufficient dynamic evaluation among the systems is considered, and the toughness evaluation precision of the power-traffic coupling charging network under typhoon disasters is improved.

title_en: Power grid topology toughness enhancement method based on pre-disaster prediction of graph neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a grid topology toughness enhancement method based on pre-disaster prediction of a graph neural network, which comprises the steps of constructing a grid graph structure taking grid equipment as nodes, predicting node damage probability through the graph attention network, defining a high-risk node set, constructing a mixed integer programming model according to the high-risk nodes and propagation paths thereof, solving to generate an optimal grid structure adjustment strategy before disaster, generating a resource scheduling scheme by utilizing a deep reinforcement learning algorithm in combination with the strategy, calculating a grid toughness core index after simulation operation, optimizing the structure adjustment strategy if the index is lower than a preset threshold value, and uploading the optimized strategy and scheduling scheme to a scheduling platform to finish pre-disaster active defense deployment. The invention realizes the cooperative linkage of pre-disaster risk prediction and topology reconstruction and resource deployment, automatically generates a differential pre-disaster defense scheme, converts post-emergency repair into pre-disaster prevention and distribution, and remarkably improves the pre-disaster prevention and control response efficiency.

title_en: High-toughness coordinated operation method for power grid under multi-source disturbance scene
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power grid state analysis, in particular to a power grid high-toughness coordinated operation method under a multi-source disturbance scene. The method uses oscillation frequency as a node to construct an inter-frequency influence graph structure, and uses a poorly-converged mapping algorithm to analyze driving influence relation between oscillation components in the graph structure. And taking the two nodes meeting the verification condition as analysis objects, and utilizing the peak significance to represent energy transfer between frequencies so as to adjust the edge weight of the graph structure and obtain the verification oscillation image graph. A dominant impact path is obtained. By analyzing the propagation power on the main path and the variation characteristics of the propagation power, the power grid oscillation state can be determined by combining the other basic power grid characteristics. According to the invention, the power grid state can be identified before the oscillation event occurs by analyzing the propagation power change characteristics of the oscillation frequency on the dominant influence path, so that monitoring hysteresis is avoided, and the real-time performance and decision efficiency of the coordinated operation decision of the power grid are improved.

title_en: Marine personnel search and rescue signal lamp convenient to height-adjusting
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to search for and rescue the device field, especially, marine personnel search for and rescue with signal lamp of being convenient for height-adjusting, the position to the signal lamp on the equipment of existing search for and rescue is not convenient for adjust, can not enlarge signal propagation range, searches for and rescues the not good problem of effect, proposes following scheme now, and it includes the control box, the top fixed mounting of control box has two fixed plates, and the fixed slot has all been seted up to one side that two fixed plates are close to each other, and slidable mounting has same connecting plate in two fixed slots, the top fixed mounting of connecting plate has the movable plate, and the top of movable plate is seted up flutedly, and the rotation seat is installed to the recess internal rotation, rotates the top fixed mounting of seat and has the. The utility model discloses rational in infrastructure, convenient operation, the position of the signal lamp on this search and rescue equipment is convenient for adjust, can enlarge signal propagation range, and the search and rescue effect is good.

title_en: A kind of power network line importance appraisal procedure based on weather prognosis and risk assessment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of power network line importance appraisal procedure based on weather prognosis and risk assessment.First determine the fault set of circuit under typhoon weather；Typhoon effective wind speed model is then set up, and constructs mathematical modeling of the description typhoon effective wind speed to line fault impact probability, and then determines the probability of happening of each failure in fault set；Then, it is proposed that system loses 3 load proportion, system line load factor and systematic offset voltage sequence severity measurement indexs, proposes sequence severity overall target on this basis；Finally, the probability of happening with reference to accident defines the single failure risk, multiple failure risk and cascading failure risk of circuit, and provides the method that circuit integrated risk is characterized using triangle radar map.The present invention can in real time, effectively identify the critical circuits of regional power grid according to electrical network parameter and typhoon weather forecast data so that being assessed in the power network critical circuits for combining meteorological condition has the practical appraisal procedure for meeting Practical Project demand.
assignees: HUIZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD;UNIV ZHEJIANG

title_en: Grid nodes different degree appraisal procedure, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of grid nodes different degree appraisal procedure, computer equipment and storage medium, this method comprises: obtaining grid nodes information according to electric network data information；Grid nodes information is pre-processed, training data is obtained；Clustering processing is carried out to training data, obtains cluster data；According to cluster data, subordinating degree function is obtained；The parameter of regularity of subordinating degree function is initialized, the parameter of regularity after being initialized；According to the parameter of regularity after subordinating degree function and the initialization, obtain grid nodes evaluation value function, by carrying out clustering processing to grid nodes information, and construct subordinating degree function, to construct grid nodes different degree assessment models, to obtain grid nodes evaluation value function, form the grid nodes different degree evaluation model of more rules, to realize the comprehensive assessment of grid nodes different degree, effectively prevention power grid cascading failure, it ensures power network safety operation, guarantees the economic benefit of power grid enterprises.

title_en: Comprehensive judgment method for breakout prediction of slab caster
abstract_en: A comprehensive judgment method for breakout prediction of a slab caster belongs to the technical field of continuous casting production monitoring methods. The technical scheme is as follows: establishing a cyclic neural network model for each thermocouple on the crystallizer copper plate to judge whether the temperature curve of the thermocouple has the characteristic of adhesive breakout; establishing a logic judgment model according to a propagation rule of a casting blank bonding point on a space to judge whether a thermocouple of a temperature curve with bonding breakout characteristics has bonding breakout space propagation characteristics; all thermocouples with bonding breakout space propagation characteristics are alarm thermocouples, different weights are given to different alarm thermocouples according to the different positions of the alarm thermocouples, and a system gives a final bonding breakout alarm signal when the sum of the weights of the alarm thermocouples is greater than a specified threshold value. The invention utilizes the respective characteristics and advantages of the artificial intelligence model and the logic judgment model, and the miss-report rate and the false-report rate of the comprehensive model algorithm are obviously reduced compared with the single model, and are obviously superior to the traditional model algorithm.

title_en: Neural network-based multi-parameter life prediction method for three-phase alternating current asynchronous motor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a neural network-based multi-parameter life prediction method for a three-phase alternating current asynchronous motor, which belongs to the field of industrial motor security inspection systems, and realizes the multi-parameter life prediction of the motor by using the state parameter and the protection event parameter recording information of a microcomputer relay protector and combining a deep learning network, wherein the prediction step comprises the following steps: establishing a neural network training set, a half life training subset and a loss training subset, sending the training set into a neural network for training, correcting network parameters by using an error back propagation algorithm, obtaining parameterized description of the network on the service life of the motor, establishing a motor loss test set, inputting the established neural network and predicting; the complex modeling process is avoided, the accuracy of prediction is improved, the potential safety hazard of abnormal shutdown of the factory process is avoided, and the economic loss and the casualty risk caused by safety accidents are reduced.
assignees: UNIV CHINA PETROLEUM EAST CHINA;SHENZHEN ANDELE ELECTRIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network edge side load prediction method based on k-nearest neighbor mutual information characteristic simplification
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network edge side load prediction method based on k-nearest neighbor mutual information characteristic simplification, which is characterized in that a load prediction training and verification data set is established by completing a missing value and performing preprocessing modes such as single hot coding on weather date types, and then a daily total load prediction cyclic neural network is trained in forward and backward propagation; after the total daily load is predicted, estimating mutual information between the multidimensional input vector and the output vector, performing feature selection to simplify operation and save edge calculation energy consumption, and training a time-share load prediction network by taking weather and date data and total daily load and time-share load data with simplified features as new data samples; and finally, inputting the relevant information of the predicted days into the trained time-sharing load prediction network to obtain the total daily load of a certain day and the time-sharing load prediction value in the area. The method is simplified integrally, the efficiency of partial edge calculation tasks in the region is improved to a certain extent, and the edge calculation architecture of the power distribution Internet of things is perfected.
assignees: STATE GRID SHAANXI ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE

title_en: Electric DebtRank algorithm-based electric power system fragile line identification method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric power system fragile line identification method based on an electric DebtRank algorithm. Firstly, establishing a dual topology model of the power system, wherein lines in the power system correspond to nodes in the dual topology model, and the connection relationship among the lines corresponds to edges of the dual topology model; then, the three states of the normal state, the heavy load state and the fault state of the line are included in the identification process of the fragile line, and an electric DebtRank algorithm considering the line load flow and the network topological structure is provided for identifying the fragile line of the power system; finally, through power system cascading failure simulation comparative analysis, the weak line identified by the electrical DebtRank algorithm is proved to have larger influence on the power system compared with the existing method. The method can identify the fragile lines in the power system, strengthen and protect the fragile lines, can effectively prevent cascading failures caused by the weak links, and can provide a certain reference value for avoiding blackout accidents.

title_en: Multi-index power grid node vulnerability assessment method fusing structure hole characteristics
abstract_en: A multi-index power grid node vulnerability assessment method fusing structural hole characteristics is characterized in that node degree and clustering coefficient indexes are selected by considering topological characteristics; selecting low-power risk factors, node voltage out-of-limit risks and node electrical betweenness indexes by considering electrical performance; selecting a loss load index in consideration of the cascading failure result; and selecting PageRank, LeaderRank and HITs indexes based on the sorting of the feature vectors, and comprehensively sorting the power grid nodes by 9 evaluation indexes from the four aspects. Constructing a power grid key node sorting algorithm considering the structural hole characteristics based on ListNet sorting learning, firstly randomly generating initial weight coefficient values of all node indexes, and obtaining initial scores of all nodes by using a scoring function h (x); and then substituting the index weight coefficient into a linear neural network model, updating the index weight coefficient by a gradient descent method, controlling circulation by using iteration times until the obtained index weight coefficient value reaches a stable state, outputting the weight coefficient value at the moment, and finally obtaining the scores of all nodes of the power grid according to a scoring function h (x) and sequencing.

title_en: City infrastructure group elasticity analysis method, electronic device, and storage medium
abstract_en: An urban infrastructure group elasticity analysis method, electronic equipment and a storage medium belong to the technical field of evaluation analysis. In order to solve the technical problems that the existing urban infrastructure analysis method is too simple, is separated from the actual condition analysis and the like, the method for constructing the cascade failure model of the urban infrastructure group network comprises the steps of counting the operation data of the urban infrastructure, and then converting the operation data of the urban infrastructure into the operation function value of the urban infrastructure; establishing a city infrastructure group as an analysis basic unit based on the operation function value of the city infrastructure, and performing primary division on the city infrastructure group; performing secondary division on the primarily divided urban infrastructure group by adopting a DBSCAN algorithm to obtain a final urban infrastructure group; establishing a cascade failure model of the urban infrastructure group; and performing elasticity analysis on infrastructures in the urban infrastructure group and the urban infrastructure group. The elasticity analysis of the invention is more comprehensive, and the elasticity capability measurement of the actual system is more reasonable.
assignees: SHENZHEN URBAN TRANSP PLANNING CENTER CO LTD;SHENZHEN TRANSP RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Distribution network scheduling method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a power distribution network scheduling method, a power distribution network scheduling device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The specific implementation scheme is as follows: calculating the data propagation duration from a first terminal to a second terminal based on the sending time of a positioning instruction sent by the first terminal, the positioning duration from the receiving of the positioning instruction to the returning of positioning information to the first terminal by the second terminal, and the receiving time of the positioning information received by the first terminal; wherein the positioning information includes a coordinate position of the second terminal; determining a distance between the first terminal and the second terminal based on a product of the data propagation duration and the light propagation speed; and determining the height of the first terminal relative to the ground based on the coordinate position of the first terminal, the coordinate position of the second terminal and the distance between the first terminal and the second terminal. By adopting the technical scheme disclosed by the invention, the height of the high-altitude staff relative to the ground can be accurately positioned.
assignees: YUEQING ELECTRIC POWER IND CO LTD;WENZHOU TUSHENG HOLDING GROUP CO LTD;YUEQING POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Fire extinguishing bomb throwing strategy simulation method and system based on neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire extinguishing bomb throwing strategy simulation method and system based on a neural network, comprising the following steps: s1: collecting historical fire scene parameters and fire extinguishing bomb throwing strategy parameters as an original data set, and carrying out normalization or single-heat coding treatment on each parameter in the data set to obtain a preprocessed data set; s2: oversampling the preprocessed data set by using a data enhancement algorithm to obtain an enhanced data set; s3: training the self-coding network based on the enhanced data set, and obtaining the encoded data set by using the self-coding network after training; s4: constructing a fire extinguishing bomb throwing strategy generating network based on the coded data set and calculating a forward propagation process; s5: and constructing a loss function, training a fire extinguishing bomb throwing strategy generation network, and simulating the fire extinguishing bomb throwing strategy by using the trained fire extinguishing bomb throwing strategy generation network. The invention can provide a comprehensive, efficient and intelligent fire extinguishing bomb throwing strategy simulation solution.
assignees: HUNAN GUANGHUA DEFENSE TECH GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Controllable scene generation method based on countermeasure network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a controllable scene generation method based on an countermeasure network, which solves the defects of the prior art and comprises the following steps of 1, collecting new energy power generation historical time sequence data as a training set, constructing a latent space input on a construction manifold to optimize historical data, wherein the latent space input comprises a control vector c and a random noise vector z with characteristic indexes with interpretable physical meanings, 2, generating the countermeasure network through iterative training, sequentially training a generator G, a discriminator D and an auxiliary network Q through a counter propagation optimization algorithm in each iterative round until reaching convergence criteria, and 3, adjusting the control vector c along one or more interpretable characteristics in the process of generating the countermeasure network to realize controllable scene generation.
assignees: ZHEJIANG BADA ELECT INSTR CO LTD

title_en: Generalized topology recapture method for totally blind power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention provides a generalized topology restoration method for a full-blind power distribution network. And sequentially injecting natural transient disturbance generated by system operation by utilizing the edge nodes, sequentially collecting transient disturbance response waveforms of all receiving points, extracting distortion points of the transient disturbance response waveforms of all receiving points based on wavelet analysis, calculating disturbance propagation length according to the distortion points, calculating the length of a common cable, and extracting a trunk branch matrix. The sampling rate is further improved, the non-branch variable cross section nodes are extracted, and the network topology is reconstructed. And (3) identifying the branch section by extracting the edge cable section according to network topology and cable variable section rule analysis. Tests on a real 10kV network confirm the feasibility of the method on generalized topology recapture. The method provides a possible solution for solving the new challenges of topology re-picking of the full-blind distribution network.

title_en: Multi-micro-network cooperative scheduling method based on master-slave cooperative game and target cascading analysis
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of power system dispatching, and relates to a multi-micro-grid cooperative dispatching method based on master-slave cooperative game and target cascading analysis, which utilizes the cooperative dispatching problem of power resources and carbon emission of a multi-micro-grid system to construct a double-layer master-slave cooperative game framework, wherein an upper-layer power grid operator coordinates the power dispatching and operation strategy of a micro-grid alliance based on tide analysis, voltage regulation and carbon emission control; the method comprises the steps of realizing power transaction and resource sharing of each micro-grid of a lower micro-grid alliance through cooperative game, dynamically adjusting the power of a connecting wire by introducing an Andersen acceleration method based on a target cascade analysis algorithm, combining the processing constraint of an augmented Lagrange penalty function, optimizing the decoupling iterative process of the upper layer and the lower layer, accelerating convergence, effectively solving the problem of low efficiency of multi-main-body cooperative optimization, ensuring stable system power and reasonable distribution of electric energy resources, and providing technical support for the operation of a multi-micro-grid system.

title_en: Filling station equipment monitoring system and method based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of monitoring of gas station equipment, in particular to a gas station equipment monitoring system and method based on the Internet of things; the method comprises the steps of collecting multidimensional operation parameters of equipment and node dynamics of business flow in real time, constructing a bidirectional coupling graph model of equipment and business, extracting high-order characteristics of physical association and business logic interaction between the equipment by utilizing a graph convolution network, predicting equipment fault risks by adopting a dynamic health scoring mechanism, backtracking a risk propagation chain by combining an attention mechanism, mapping multidimensional data into interpretable fault diagnosis information by an abnormal semantic generation network, introducing a double-layer reinforcement learning game mechanism, coordinating equipment maintenance and risk suppression strategies in an inner layer, and integrating business efficiency and safety targets in an outer layer to generate optimization actions such as resource scheduling, oil allocation and the like to form a perception-diagnosis-decision closed loop. The invention realizes full-time sensing of the equipment state, active fault early warning and cross-domain collaborative optimization, and remarkably improves the operation and maintenance efficiency and safety of the gas station.
assignees: JIANGSU YUNPENG INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for tracing metering error of carbon emission flow of electric power system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electric carbon emission, in particular to a method and a system for tracing a metering error of a carbon emission flow of an electric power system, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a carbon emission factor calculation model of each node based on a topological relation of the electric power system, and determining an upstream-downstream dependency relation between the nodes; according to the error source of the distributed metering system, the relative uncertainty of the metering equipment error at the source side and the data transmission error between the nodes is quantized, the relative uncertainty of the carbon emission factors of each node from the source side to the user side is calculated step by step according to the error transmission rule, a global error propagation path is generated, the total relative uncertainty of the carbon emission amount at the user side is calculated, disturbance analysis is carried out on power grid power data through a probability statistical simulation method, and abnormal nodes are identified. The method aims at realizing error tracing of the carbon emission metering flow and avoiding reduction of accuracy of the carbon emission metering caused by node errors in the power system.
assignees: BEIJING SMARTCHIP MICROELECTRONICS TECH CO LTD;BEIJING ZHIXIN SEMICONDUCTOR TECH CO LTD;SICHUAN ENERGY INTERNET RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF TSINGHUA UNIV

title_en: Ladder dam group risk chain type transfer effect diagnosis method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascade dam group risk chain transfer effect diagnosis method, which comprises the steps of counting the distribution characteristics of upstream and downstream dam reservoir water levels and downstream dam material parameter failure risk influence factors, training a depth neural network for adjacent cascade dam-break flood evolution, randomly sampling the upstream and downstream dam reservoir water levels, calculating a breach flow process line, solving the highest dam front water level of a downstream dam affected by the upstream dam-break flood, selecting failure modes according to the downstream dam type characteristics, constructing a structural limit state function under constant load, solving the downstream dam failure risk rate before and after the upstream dam-break flood is affected, performing repeated sampling calculation, obtaining risk transfer coefficients under a plurality of upstream and downstream reservoir water level combinations, solving a mean value, and obtaining a final risk transfer coefficient. The method breaks through the limitation of the traditional 'only top failure' criterion, and has stronger universality and higher accuracy.

title_en: Power grid basic data stain propagation path marking and identifying method and related equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a method for marking and identifying a stain propagation path of power grid basic data, namely related equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining the power grid basic data and determining a power grid knowledge graph according to the dependency relationship between the power grid basic data; the method comprises the steps of carrying out initial stain marking on key nodes in a power grid knowledge graph to generate initial stains, utilizing a graph neural network to represent the nodes of the power grid knowledge graph, merging edges in the power grid knowledge graph into the graph neural network to determine embedded vectors of the nodes in the power grid knowledge graph, dividing the embedded vectors into a training set and a verification set, training a stain path reasoning model through the training set, responding to the detection of the initial stains, determining a second knowledge graph corresponding to the initial stains, inputting the trained stain path reasoning model, and determining all stains and stain transmission paths.
assignees: BEIJING CHINA POWER INF TECH;STATE GRID ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD;STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Multi-dimensional evaluation method for vulnerability of combat system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vulnerability multidimensional assessment method of a combat system, and belongs to the technical field of complex system safety assessment. The method decomposes a combat system into a physical layer, a logic layer and a cross-layer coupling layer for multidimensional modeling, wherein the physical layer calculates topology indexes such as degree centrality and medium number centrality based on a complex network theory, the logic layer searches a killing chain and quantifies indexes such as the number of chains and average path length based on a killing chain theory through an Ullmann algorithm, and the cross-layer coupling layer analyzes element failure cascade effect and capability recovery degree. And integrating the multidimensional evaluation results through the intersection and union operation to form a vulnerability interval based on the average path length of the killing chain. The invention solves the problems of single-dimension evaluation in the prior art and lack of cross-layer coupling analysis, realizes multi-dimension quantitative evaluation of vulnerability of the combat system, and provides scientific basis for system destruction-resistant optimization and key node protection.

title_en: Visualization of grain and duct parts of natural wood veneer in darkness by light emission
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a surface material for wall surface material, handrail, floor board or the like, which can emit strong light for a long period for prevention of collision against a wall surface, a handrail or the like in a facility of people in a panic state who are left in sudden darkness within the facility due to a sudden service interruption caused by disaster, accident or the like, ensuring of balance sense thereof, ensuring of the visibility of an escape route, recognition of an escape direction, or the like.  <P>SOLUTION: The duct part light-emitting fireproof natural wood decorative board is obtained by applying a white pigment onto a woody substrate 1 or inorganic substrate followed by drying, applying a vinyl acetate adhesive or SBR adhesive thereto followed by semi-drying, sticking a natural wood veneer 5 to the surface followed by compressing at 110°C for about 2 minutes by hot pressing, then neutralizing the surface of the natural wood veneer by applying oxalic acid to the surface and removing scum followed by drying, grinding the surface in the downgrain direction to a minimum by a wide belt sander, filling a luminous pigment in a duct part thereof, immediately spraying a coating material 6 which transmits light emitted by the luminous pigment to cover the surface, and smoothing the surface by the wide belt sander. According to this, the surface material can be viewed in darkness.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Jellyfish capture device
title_ko: 해파리 포획장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a jellyfish capturing device (1) with which jellyfish can be captured in quantity by means of a net. The present invention includes: a metallic inflow frame (3) configured to be coupled with an inlet of a front inflow portion (21) of a sack net (2) having the front inflow portion (21) open forward and a back storage portion (22) coupled with the back of a front inflow portion and having a back end configured to be closed; a front buoy (4) connected to a depth adjustment rope (7) adjusting the depth of the inflow frame (3) by being connected to an upper side of the inflow frame (3) and a ship (A) with both front sides of the inflow frame (3) being connected to the ship (A) by a traction rope (6); a back buoy (5) connected to a back end of the back storage portion (22) by a supporting rope (8); and a salvage rope (9) having both ends connected to a net hauler (B) of the ship (A) and surrounding a boundary portion (23) between the front inflow portion (21) and the back storage portion (22). According to the present invention, various species of jellyfish can be captured in quantity, and the boundary portion (23) is squeezed during salvage so that the jellyfish can be captured alive, jellyfish losses can be prevented, and the jellyfish can be provided with freshness as food. In addition, the present invention can forestall accidents, fishing losses, and industrial facility damage attributable to jellyfish, have positive economic effects, and have many other positive effects.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 해파리를 그물을 이용하여 대량으로 포획할 수 있도록 한 해파리 포획장치(1)를 제공하는 것으로서, 상기 본 발명은 전방으로 개방되게 형성된 전반유입부(21)와 전반유입구의 후방으로 결합되어 후단이 폐쇄되게 구성된 후반저장부(22)로 이루어진 자루그물(2)의 전반유입부(21) 입구에 결합 구성된 금속제 유입틀(3)이 구비되며, 유입틀(3)의 전면 양측이 견인로프(6)로 선박(A)과 연결 구성되면서 유입틀(3)의 상측과 선박(A)에 연결되어 유입틀(3)의 깊이를 조절하는 깊이조절로프(7)가 연결된 전방부표(4)가 구비되며, 후반저장부(22) 후단과 지지로프(8)로 연결 구성된 후방부표(5)가 구비되며, 전반유입부(21)와 후반저장부(22)의 경계부(23)를 둘러싸면서 선박(A)의 양망기(B)에 양단이 연결된 인양로프(9)가 구비된 것을 특징으로 하며, 이러한 본 발명에 의하면 각종 해파리를 대량으로 포획할 수 있으며, 인양 시 경계부(23)가 죄여 해파리의 유실을 방지하면서 산채로 포획하여 식용으로 사용할 시 신선도를 높일 수 있으며, 해파리에 의한 인명사고, 어업손실 및 산업시설의 손실 등을 근원적으로 해결할 수 있으며, 그밖에도 경제적으로 향상된 파급효과를 미치는 등 다수의 효과를 기대할 수 있는 것이다.

title_en: Fire alarm system using Internet of thing
title_ko: 사물 인터넷을 이용한 화재경보시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire alarm system using IoT, which comprises: a fire detection unit detecting the fire by a thermal image detection method, and outputting a fire detection signal having a specific voltage level when detecting the fire; an information transmission unit propagating the fire detection signal by using a wireless communication network or a wired communication network of a wide band and a local band; and a portable terminal receiving the fire detection signal from the information transmission unit to display a fire occurrence situation in real time.
abstract_ko: 사물 인터넷을 이용한 화재경보시스템은, 열화상 감지방식으로 화재를 검출하며, 화재 감지시 특정 전압레벨을 갖는 화재감지신호를 출력하는 화재 감지부와, 광대역 및 로컬 대역의 무선 통신망 또는 유선 통신망을 이용하여 상기 화재감지신호를 전파하는 정보 전달부와, 상기 정보 전달부로부터 상기 화재감지신호를 전달받아 화재발생상황을 실시간으로 표시하는 휴대용 단말기를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: KUMOH NAT INST TECHNOLOGY IND ACAD COOP FOUND;SEO JAE WOO;CHA MIN SEOK

title_en: Petrochemical pipeline flange sealing surface bolt fixed-moment fastening method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for fastening a flange sealing surface of a petrochemical pipeline by bolts with fixed moment, which comprises the following steps of collecting the properties of the pipeline, the size of the flange and the number of bolts used, and determining the risk level and the fastening mode based on a BP (back propagation) neural network; determining an input layer neuron vector of the three-layer BP neural network; mapping the input layer vector to a hidden layer, wherein the number of neurons of the hidden layer is m; and step four, obtaining the neuron vector of the output layer. By collecting the pipeline property and the flange size and using the number of bolts, determining the risk level and the fastening mode based on the BP neural network, and after determining the fastening mode through the neural network, accurately controlling the bolt fixed torque according to the parameters of the flange and the gasket, the sealing quality is ensured, and the construction safety and efficiency are also improved.

title_en: Power grid GIS-based electric power emergency disposal safety pre-control intelligent identification method
abstract_en: The invention provides a power grid GIS-based electric power emergency disposal safety pre-control intelligent identification method, and relates to the field of electric power emergency disposal. The invention positions the accident scene and the position of emergency disposal personnel on the power grid GIS. Positioning on a power grid GIS according to longitude and latitude coordinates of an accident scene; according to the method, real-time positions are displayed on a power grid GIS by wearing a follow-up terminal high-precision multi-relocation module by emergency disposal personnel, an early warning identification area is divided and constructed through monitoring and early warning of the emergency disposal site environment, after a site operation electronic fence is automatically generated based on the early warning identification area, a small-scale mountain fire and hazardous chemical substance diffusion and propagation model is established according to meteorological data, topographic data, geomorphic data and the like, the development trend is dynamically predicted, calculation results of dynamic and quantitative diffusion and propagation directions, ranges, speeds and the like are formed, the influence condition of the analysis and judgment on power grid facilities is analyzed, and a basis is provided for scientific and rapid emergency disposal of accident sites. The invention reduces the working pressure of the central platform, improves the disaster and area division accuracy, and can store the data acquired when the disaster occurs.

title_en: Inverse ungrounded rumour propagation model based on hypergraph
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of inverse ungrounded rumour propagation, in particular to an inverse ungrounded rumour propagation model based on hypergraph, which comprises the following steps of constructing an OSN (open system network) inverse rumor high-order system propagation model based on hypergraph, analyzing the principle and composition of an hypergraph OSN high-order network, constructing a heterogeneous differential equation set of the hypergraph OSN inverse rumor high-order system propagation model and verifying the positive and the finite nature of a model solution, calculating the basic regeneration number of the model or judging whether a rumor is automatically dead, and carrying out numerical simulation verification on the model. The inverse ungrounded rumour propagation model based on hypergraph carries out microscopic analysis on the rumor propagation of the OSN from the angles of hypergraph and complex network theory, establishes a high-order information propagation model of the OSN, focuses on the multi-layer network based on hypergraph modeling and the heterogeneity of the model, emphasizes the combination of network structures, and focuses on the characteristics of multi-layer, multi-level and multi-dimensional networks of the online social network.

title_en: Meteorological disaster risk grading intelligent assessment and pushing method for town areas
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for intelligently evaluating and pushing weather disaster risk grades for a town area, which relates to the technical field of weather disaster early warning and comprises the steps of extracting and fusing space-time characteristics and geographic element characteristics by utilizing a space-time attention mechanism and a dynamic weight mechanism through acquiring weather monitoring data of a plurality of monitoring points in the town area, and generating weather disaster risk grades through a bidirectional long-short-time memory network; and finally, constructing a distributed storage network through a hierarchical cascade block chain, and encrypting and pushing the early warning information in fragments. The method can realize accurate assessment and efficient early warning of the risk of the meteorological disaster in the town area, and improves the reliability and timeliness of early warning information.

title_en: Multi-function monitoring and tracking system for crime and fire
title_ko: 다기능 범죄·화재감시 추적 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a multi-function monitoring and tracking system for crime and fire. The multi-function monitoring and tracking system includes: a visible light camera module rotating 360 degrees, and with an optic angle lens attached thereto; a camera including the visible light camera module with the optic angle attached thereto and an infrared light camera module; a support unit installed in an upper area of the camera; an anemometer or weather information obtainment module obtaining a wind speed of an area where the camera is installed; an illuminance sensor measuring illuminance of the area where the camera is installed; multiple microphones installed in the camera; and a monitoring and tracking module having a combustion product detection module and an image comparison module, thereby reliably monitoring and tracking a forest fire and a body.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 다기능 범죄·화재감시 추적 시스템에 대한 것으로서, 특히, 산불을 감시하고 추적하는 기능과 인체를 감시하고 추적하는 기능을 모듈화하여 기능의 업그레이드와 유지 및 보수가 용이한 다기능 범죄·화재감시 추적 시스템을 제공할 수 있다. 본 발명은 360도로 회전하며 틸트되는 카메라를 구비하여 전방향에 대해서 화재와 범죄를 감시할 수 있으며, 감시 추적 모듈을 모듈화하여 기능의 업그레이드와 유지 및 보수가 용이하다. 또한, 본 발명은 차분 영상으로 연기와 불꽃 등을 감지하여 화재의 발생을 정확하게 판단할 수 있다. 또한, 본 발명은 조도 센서를 구비하고 조도 센서에서 획득된 조도를 임계값으로 고정 이진화를 수행하여 영상에서 하늘 영역을 특정하고, 하늘 영역에서 구름 영역을 삭제한 후 연기를 감지하여 연기를 더욱 정확하게 감지할 수 있다. 또한, 본 발명은 풍속계 또는 기상 정보에서 풍속 정보를 획득하고 이를 기반으로 차분 영상 사이의 프레임 간격을 유동적으로 설정하여 바람의 세기에 관계없이 연기 등을 감지하여 화재의 발생을 정확하게 판단할 수 있다. 또한, 본 발명은 화재 발생 위치와 예상되는 진행 경로를 예측하고 이를 지도에 표시하여 제공함으로써 화재 진화를 효과적으로 수행할 수 있다. 또한, 본 발명은 화재 발생 조건에 따라 코드를 부여하고 상황을 전파하여 관리자가 화재 발생 상황을 쉽게 판단할 수 있다. 또한, 본 발명은 범죄 감시 및 추적 시 영상에서 인체를 감지하고 해당 인체를 추적한 후 인체가 범죄를 행할 것으로 예측되면 탐조등이 인체를 추적하도록 광을 조사하여 범죄 예방 효과를 증가시킬 수 있다. 또한, 인체가 범죄를 행할 것으로 예측되는 행동을 중지하지 않을 경우, 탐조등의 광량을 증가시고 경고 방송을 하여 범죄 예방 효과를 더욱 증가시킬 수 있다. 더욱이, 본 발명은 근접한 감시 추적 모듈을 네트워크로 연계하여 탐지된 인체를 근접한 감시 추적 모듈끼리 연계하여 추적하고, 범죄를 행할 것으로 예측되면 탐조등을 비추되, 근접한 감시 추적 모듈간에 탐조등을 연계하여 비춤으로써 탐조등으로 범죄 가능성이 있는 인체를 추적하여 범죄 예방 효과를 극대화할 수 있다. 또한, 본 발명은 영상에서 인체 탐지 시 차분 영상을 이용하되, 인체의 각 부위별로 특징을 고려하여 별도로 경계를 설정함으로써, 인체의 범죄 행동 여부를 쉽게 판별할 수 있으며, 인체의 일부분만 탐지되거나 직립 보행중이 아니더라도 쉽게 인체를 판별하고 범죄 행뎡 여부를 판별할 수 있으며 추적할 수 있다.

title_en: Substation Remote Control Method of Fault Based on Block Chain
title_ko: 사고 시 블록체인 기반의 변전소 원격 제어 방법
abstract_en: According to a block chain-based remote substation control method of the present invention, the substation remote control server matches the substation-related basic data for each substation, each distribution line of the substation, and each transformer to distribution register and store the data in interrelated systems and workers' smart phones, and transmits and shares major facility status information, operation information, and monitoring data information generated from a relay operation upon accident to correcting and recovering the accident, through the interrelated systems and the workers' smart phones, while focusing on ground faults, short circuit accidents and transformer accidents, which are the main causes of accidents in substations, so as to enable the workers to recover the accident according to standard procedures. Thus, in the event of a substation accident or distribution line accident, the accident is dealt based on a system-centered manner rather than human-centered manner, in particular, so as to prevent accidents and power spillage accidents caused by erroneous operation of on-site facilities.
abstract_ko: 본 발명 블록체인 기반의 변전소 원격 제어 방법은 변전소 원격 관리 서버가 변전소 관련 기초 데이터를 변전소별, 변전소의 배전 선로별, 변압기 별로 매칭하여 관련 시스템과 근무자 스마트 폰에 분산 등록 저장하고 변전소에서 사고의 주 원인이되는 지락, 단락 사고와 변압기 사고를 중심으로 하여 사고 시의 계전기 동작부터 사고를 수습하고 복구하기 까지의 생성되는 주요 설비 상태 정보, 조작 정보, 감시 데이터 정보들을 상호 관련 시스템과 근무자의 스마트 폰을 통하여 전송 공유하면서 기준 절차대로 사고 복구하도록 하는 것으로  변전소 사고 또는 배전 선로 사고 시 사고 수습을 사람 중심이 아닌 시스템 중심으로 처리하도록 하여 사고를 시스템적으로 수습하도록 함으로써 특히 현장 설비의 오조작으로 인한 안전 사고 및 전원 파급 사고를 방지하도록 하는 것이다.

title_en: Photovoltaic system generating efficiency comprehensive evaluation method based on BP (back propagation) neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photovoltaic system generating efficiency comprehensive evaluation method based on a BP (back propagation) neural network. Weight assignment on various evaluation indexes is carried out by the BP neural network, influences of human factors on weight can be gradually eliminated in a training process, the weight is corrected, a photovoltaic power generating system is classified, the whole efficiency of the photovoltaic power generating system is evaluated, the running efficiency level of the photovoltaic system and the running efficiency level of key equipment of the photovoltaic system can be judged effectively, key factors which affect the efficiency level of the photovoltaic system and the efficiency level of the key equipment of the photovoltaic system are uncovered, a generating efficiency improvement strategy is discovered, and the generating efficiency of the photovoltaic system and the generating efficiency of the key equipment of the photovoltaic system are improved. By the method, reliable and accurate multi-item efficiency analysis and comprehensive evaluation analysis results are provided for an optional photovoltaic power station, a theoretical basis is provided for an operation and maintenance strategy of the photovoltaic power station, data are provided for design optimization of the photovoltaic power station, the generating efficiency of the photovoltaic power station is improved, the generating capacity is improved, the economic benefit is increased, and the application value is high.
assignees: XUJI GROUP CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Consider the risk assessment of interconnected network cascading failure and the alarm method of communication fragile degree
abstract_en: The invention provides a kind of interconnected network cascading failure risk assessment for considering communication fragile degree and alarm method, for the forward delay interval of communication link, propagation delay, queue delay, link utilization, unified experience is constructed respectively to be most worth, do normalized, go pulverised processing, equal weight to be added, obtain the fragile degree of the different time section similarly hereinafter communication link of standard；Using performance fragile degree of the communication node based on the node number of degrees, the topological fragile degree based on business route matrix, business criticality, the fragile degree of communication node is constructed.Consider communication fragile degree, establish the stoppage in transit probabilistic model of interconnected network branch roads at different levels；Mistake load, voltage pulsation degree, average communication link utilization, the unobservable rate of communication are defined as to the consequence index in cascading failure path, assessment is ranked up to cascading failure path, and provide a variety of alarms.The present invention assesses electrical hazards and communication fragility combines, and makes interconnected network wide area observing and controlling system trouble analysis and control more comprehensively reasonable.

title_en: Method and device for predicting water level of cascade hydropower station group and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for predicting the water level of a cascade hydropower station group and a computer readable storage medium, and has the technical key points that the current hydrological state of the cascade hydropower station group is identified by using a K-means + + clustering algorithm so as to accurately divide a hydrological period; on the basis, the sequence prediction method based on the LSTM network is utilized, and the collected hydrological information and meteorological information are combined to predict the water level of the cascade hydropower station group. The method can accurately predict the water level change condition of the subsequent time period according to the operation condition of the cascade hydropower station and the changes of the surrounding hydrological and meteorological conditions, thereby providing a basis for the dispatching operation of the hydropower station and improving the overall economic benefit and risk prevention capability of the cascade hydropower station group.

title_en: Method and system for building DC micro-grid simulation model
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a system for constructing a DC micro-grid simulation model, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a network topology structure of a direct-current micro-grid corresponding to a power station; determining first modularized distribution information of the direct current micro-grid according to the network topology structure; determining a first switch distribution characteristic of the direct current micro-grid according to the first module distribution information; determining second modularized distribution information of the direct-current micro-grid according to the first switch distribution characteristics; and constructing a model based on the second modularized distribution information to obtain a DC micro-grid simulation model corresponding to the power station. According to the technical scheme, modularization of the direct-current micro-grid simulation model, parameter adjustment and high simulation model precision are achieved, various micro-grid topologies can be directly built according to requirements, and the technical effects of repeated elimination and propagation of simulation building, rapid selection and building are achieved.
assignees: STATE POWER INVESTMENT CORPORATION SCIENCE & TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Data processing method and device considering cascading failure transient response of power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data processing method and a data processing device considering the cascading failure transient response of a power system, which are used for acquiring the operation data and the operation mode of the power system to be tested and constructing a first mixed differential algebraic equation of the power system to be tested; acquiring fault data, and simulating a first mixed differential algebraic equation based on the fault data to obtain grid structure parameters corresponding to the first mixed differential algebraic equation; judging whether the parameters of the grid structure change or not; if yes, recalculating a network structure matrix of the current power system to be tested, constructing a second mixed differential algebraic equation based on the network structure matrix, simulating the second mixed differential algebraic equation based on fault data to obtain network structure parameters corresponding to the second mixed differential algebraic equation, and judging whether the network structure parameters change or not again; if not, recording simulation data generated by a corresponding mixed differential algebraic equation without changing the grid structure parameters, so that a user performs operation and maintenance deployment on the power system to be tested.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Power information physical system safety assessment method considering wind power and cascading failure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power information physical system safety evaluation method considering wind power and cascading failure, which comprises the following steps: constructing a mathematical model of the power information physical system; launching a network attack on the power information physical system; after the cascading failure occurs, designing a wind power randomness model based on a Markov-Monte Carlo method; active and reactive power injection of each node in the power system is obtained according to the wind power of each cascading failure simulation moment, and the voltage of each node and the power flow of the power transmission line in the power system are calculated by using an improved linearization alternating current power flow calculation method; updating the running temperature of the power transmission line according to the power flow of the power transmission line at each simulation moment, and calculating the probability of disconnection of the power transmission line; by means of entropy theory, cascading failure safety evaluation indexes which simultaneously consider output and load fluctuation of the wind turbine generator are provided, the influence of power transmission line disconnection on subsequent evolution of cascading failures can be analyzed, and dynamic safety of the system in the cascading failure process is evaluated.

title_en: Water, wind and solar energy storage multi-target scheduling method based on improved mixed particle swarm gray wolf optimization algorithm
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power system optimization scheduling, and particularly relates to a multi-target day-ahead peak regulation scheduling method of a step water-wind-solar-energy storage complementary power generation system. The method comprises the specific steps of establishing a mathematical model of a water-wind-solar complementary system, constructing a multi-objective optimization framework considering power generation benefits and peak regulation effects, constructing a prediction network by using a self-adaptive multi-time scale Improved LSTNet to conduct daily prediction on water inflow of a cascade river basin section, power generation of a photovoltaic power station and power generation of a wind power station to serve as input data of the model, solving the modeled model by adopting an improved multi-objective mixed particle swarm gray wolf optimization algorithm (IMOPSO-GWO), coordinating global exploration and local development capability through a convergence factor self-adaptive adjustment mechanism, introducing a dynamic mutation operator to enhance Pareto front search efficiency, and finally obtaining a daily scheduling scheme of the complementary system. The invention has remarkable effects in reducing the residual load fluctuation of the power grid and improving the power generation income by optimizing the output of the step hydroelectric generating set and the energy storage.

title_en: Photovoltaic power generation prediction method of multi-algorithm hybrid model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of photovoltaic power generation, in particular to a photovoltaic power generation prediction method of a multi-algorithm hybrid model, which comprises the following steps of S1, preprocessing historical data, dividing the historical photovoltaic data into three data sets of sunny days, cloudy days and overcast and rainy days by adopting a BIRCH algorithm, screening key influence factors through pearson correlation coefficients, S2, EEMD decomposition and reconstruction, carrying out ensemble empirical mode decomposition on the preprocessed photovoltaic data, reconstructing data according to energy distribution and contribution rate of IMF components, S3, constructing a hybrid prediction model, processing non-stationary IMF components by utilizing BiLSTM neural networks, processing stationary IMF components by adopting a Holt-windows model, and outputting a final photovoltaic power prediction value by means of back propagation weighted fusion prediction results. The method combines the advantages of deep learning and statistical model, performs fine pretreatment and decomposition reconstruction on the data, and effectively improves the precision and stability of photovoltaic power prediction.
assignees: HUAFENG TECH NANJING CO LTD;YANG HAIJIN;CHEN CHAO;ZHANG SHUAISHUAI

title_en: Public space dynamic risk network assessment method integrating space-time characteristics
abstract_en: The invention provides a public space dynamic risk network assessment method integrating space-time characteristics, which relates to the technical field of network assessment and comprises the steps of obtaining basic data, adopting an octree algorithm to adaptively divide grid units, establishing a connection relation diagram, calculating risk propagation probability by using a graph neural network, calculating a risk propagation path by applying an improved A algorithm, and finally outputting risk level distribution, propagation path risk change and prevention and control deployment suggestions. The method and the system realize the fine quantitative assessment of the public space risk and improve the risk early warning accuracy and the pertinence of prevention and control measures.
assignees: HANGZHOU ZHUIXING VIDEO TECH CO LTD

title_en: Market bidding method and system for adjusting capacity of cloud-edge cooperative charging station
abstract_en: The invention relates to a market bidding method and a system for adjusting capacity of a cloud-edge cooperative charging station, and belongs to the technical field of interaction between a charging station and a power grid. The method comprises the steps of establishing an optimization model for adjusting capacity and participating in market bidding on the basis of a view angle of an edge electric vehicle charging station, establishing an electric power system market clearing model based on a view angle of a cloud electric power system to reduce economic cost for acquiring various services, forming cloud-edge collaborative optimization problems by the charging station model and the electric power system model, respectively introducing Lagrange penalty items into the cloud-edge distributed optimization model and the edge distributed optimization model, and carrying out distributed solving on the cloud-edge collaborative optimization problems by utilizing a target cascading method to obtain a vehicle network interaction strategy optimal for each of the charging station and the electric power system. The invention effectively reduces the economic cost of the power system for obtaining energy, regulating capacity and other services, and takes into account the benefits of both the charging station and the power system, thereby promoting the further development of vehicle network interaction.
assignees: CHENGDE POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID JIBEI ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY LTD

title_en: Data processing method and system of water regime monitoring real-time management platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water regime monitoring, in particular to a data processing method and a data processing system of a water regime monitoring real-time management platform. The method comprises the steps of obtaining pipe network multipoint pressure monitoring data, counting pressure change fluctuation characteristic data of each monitoring point according to the pipe network multipoint pressure monitoring data, determining a pipe network operation state based on the pipe network multipoint pressure monitoring data and the pressure change fluctuation characteristic data, detecting pressure anomaly deviation trend data of each monitoring point according to the pipe network operation state, determining a disturbance propagation path in the pipe network according to the pressure anomaly deviation trend data, determining pipe network pressure distribution unbalance characteristics according to the pressure anomaly deviation trend data and the disturbance propagation path in the pipe network, and determining the damage condition of the structural integrity of the pipe network based on the pipe network pressure distribution unbalance characteristics. According to the method, the position of the abnormal source is reversely calculated by analyzing the time difference and the propagation rule of the abnormality detected by each monitoring point.
assignees: ZHUJIANG HYDROLOGY WATER RESOURCE EXPLOR CENTER

title_en: Power system vulnerability assessment method and system considering extreme weather influence
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power system evaluation, and discloses a method and a system for evaluating vulnerability of a power system in consideration of extreme weather influence, wherein a line time-varying fault probability under the dynamic weather influence is determined by constructing a line fault probability model of the power system under the extreme weather, and an countermeasure network model and a Monte Carlo simulation generation typical scene are generated through time sequence relativity matching with gradient penalty; the method comprises the steps of taking a generated typical scene as input, simulating cascade fault evolution through an alternating current cascade fault model, and outputting a cascade fault evolution path, and further realizing multi-level vulnerability quantification of the power system by combining severity analysis, structural vulnerability assessment and causal-probability prejudgment through a spectrogram theory and a Bayesian network based on a fault evolution result, solving the problems of insufficient single-level assessment and neglecting causal association in the prior art, and improving the risk assessment precision and disaster prevention capability of the power system under extreme weather.
assignees: STATE GRID ECONOMIC AND TECHNOLOGICAL RESEARCH INST CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG;EAST CHINA BRANCH OF STATE GRID CORP OF CHINA;STATE GRID JIBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LIMITED;STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Power supply and distribution equipment state monitoring method for large-scale power grid safety guarantee
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power supply and distribution equipment state monitoring method for large-scale power grid safety guarantee, which relates to the technical field of electrical engineering, and comprises the steps of constructing a multi-dimensional power grid equipment layer comprising power supply, power transmission and distribution layers according to a power grid power supply and distribution equipment group; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a perception data set according to hierarchical monitoring of an Internet of things module, carrying out dynamic fault perception modeling according to a fault disturbance evolution mechanism, establishing a first fault perception graph network, then establishing a fourth fault perception graph network through abnormal disturbance correction of a perception scene, topology association propagation optimization and environment interference evolution compensation, and executing power grid security guarantee management based on the graph network. The invention solves the technical problems that the traditional monitoring means are difficult to adapt to the layered structure, the dynamic evolution characteristic of faults and the association of complex environments of large-scale power grid power supply and distribution equipment, and achieves the technical effects of accurately sensing, comprehensively covering and dynamically adapting faults of the power supply and distribution equipment and effectively improving the safety guarantee capability of the large-scale power grid.
assignees: NANJING HUIPAI SMART LOGISTICS SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Contact rates in malware simulation for responsive measure deployment
abstract_en: A computer-implemented method of simulating the propagation of malware in a network is provided. The method comprises accessing a model of the network, where the model comprises a plurality of computer nodes and where each computer node of the plurality of computer nodes is connected to at least one edge of a plurality of edges. Each edge of the plurality of edges connects a pair of computer nodes of the plurality of computer nodes. The method further comprises initiating an outbreak of the malware in the model at a predetermined source computer node of the plurality of computer nodes, and propagating the malware through the model of the network from the source computer node. The propagation is determined based on a rate of transmission, where the rate of transmission is based upon a contact rate for each edge of the plurality of edges, and the contact rate for each edge of the plurality of edges is based upon the network traffic passing between the computer nodes connected by that edge over a predetermined time period.

title_en: A kind of cascading failure recognition sequence system and method
abstract_en: A kind of cascading failure recognition sequence system, including：Trend fault detection analysis module, weather conditions fault detection analysis module, circuit resultant fault probabilistic module, the trend fault detection analysis module are used to analyze the Line Flow probability of malfunction calculated under the influence of Line Flow；The weather conditions fault detection analysis module is used to analyze the weather conditions failure rate calculated under inside even from weather；The circuit resultant fault probabilistic module calculates circuit resultant fault probability for integrating the Line Flow probability of malfunction and the weather conditions failure rate.The cascading failure recognition sequence system of the present invention, considers internal time-varying operating status and outside environmental elements, it is proposed that a scheme for searching out failure path in power grid.

title_en: Power grid cascading failure diagnosis, early warning and evaluation system based on monitoring information
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power grids, in particular to a power grid cascading failure diagnosis, early warning and evaluation system based on monitoring information. The system comprises a power grid cascading failure diagnosis subsystem, a power grid cascading failure early warning subsystem and a power grid cascading failure evaluation subsystem; the power grid cascading failure diagnosis subsystem is used for diagnosing and inquiring power grid failures; the power grid cascading failure early warning subsystem is used for early warning analysis of power grid failures; and the power grid cascading failure evaluation subsystem is used for evaluating power grid failure diagnosis and early warning information and issuing an evaluation report. The system realizes the centralized access of the related equipment information, solves the problem of discrete storage of the related information of different equipment, converts the post analysis of the equipment monitoring information to the prior assessment, the pre-judgment in the event and the processing through standardizing the data source end, utilizes the technical means of big data analysis, greatly improves the intelligent level of the monitoring information analysis, and provides more effective and practical technical support for the centralized monitoring operation.

title_en: Power distribution room equipment state online intelligent monitoring system and method based on embedded GPU platform and deep learning
abstract_en: The monitoring equipment uploads image data of the state of the power distribution room equipment to the embedded GPU platform in a video stream mode in real time, an equipment state recognition model which is deployed in the platform and constructed based on a deep learning technology analyzes and monitors the uploaded data, and a detection result and a monitoring picture are displayed on a Web interface. The invention realizes the online intelligent monitoring of the state of the equipment in the power distribution room, finds the equipment which is not normally operated in time by identifying the on-off image of the equipment indicator lamp and gives an alarm. The invention uses the improved Cascade R-CNN deep learning algorithm, reduces the external influence, has more stable operation and greatly improves the identification precision: the method can accurately identify the target in the monitoring range, and provides powerful technical support for guaranteeing the safety of power grid constructors.

title_en: Power transmission network risk assessment optimization method based on transient energy unbalance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power transmission network risk assessment optimization method based on transient energy imbalance, which comprises the following steps: step SS1: establishing a transient energy function of the alternating current-direct current series-parallel power system based on an energy transfer relation of the alternating current-direct current series-parallel power system; step SS2: and carrying out risk assessment optimization on the transient energy function of the alternating current-direct current series-parallel power system in the step SS1 based on the historical operation data of the power grid on the basis of a BNG model. Aiming at the problem of neglecting the fault prediction and the safety influence caused by cascading faults in the current network risk assessment model, in order to accurately assess the target network risk, a transient energy function of an alternating-direct current hybrid power system is established based on the energy transfer relation of the alternating-direct current hybrid power system, a transient energy efficiency variable is introduced based on historical operation data of a power grid, and the variable is integrated into the calculation of probability to obtain the prior risk probability of each node in the network, so that the network risk is statically assessed.

title_en: Fault processing method for distribution information physical system under DOS attack
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of power information physical systems, and particularly relates to a fault processing method of a power distribution information physical system under DOS attack. The application comprises the following steps: step 1, establishing an information attack possibility model; step 2, establishing a transmission delay model caused by DOS attack; and 3, constructing a power distribution network according to the step 1 and the step 2, analyzing the evolution mechanism of the power distribution information physical system under DOS attack, and providing a fault processing method of the power distribution information physical system under DOS attack. Aiming at the new network security risk and more complex and severe cascading failures and blackout accidents possibly suffered by the system caused by the combination of the electric power information network and the electric power gateway, the application researches the modeling technology of the electric power information physical system, analyzes the propagation mechanism and path of the network attack risk, invalidates DOS attack by controlling decision execution analysis, remarkably improves the security of the electric power network, and further effectively reduces and avoids the occurrence of electric power accidents.

title_en: Hybrid type pumping and accumulating day-ahead peak regulation scheduling method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of new energy power generation optimized scheduling, in particular to a hybrid pumping and accumulating day-ahead peak shaving scheduling method, device and equipment and a storage medium, which comprise the following steps: constructing a wind-light-step hybrid pumping and accumulating day-ahead peak regulation scheduling model by taking the minimum residual load peak-valley difference of the receiving end power grid as an objective function; establishing constraint conditions of a scheduling model, wherein the constraint conditions comprise: the conventional cascade hydropower station is additionally provided with hydraulic characteristic constraint, electric characteristic constraint and hydroelectric coupling characteristic constraint after pumping and storage; linearizing the objective function and the constraint condition; and solving the linearized scheduling model to obtain an optimized scheduling result. According to the invention, a day-ahead peak regulation scheduling model is established, and finally, an optimal scheduling result is obtained by solving the model, so that a power generation scheme of the wind-light-step hybrid pumping and accumulating system meeting constraints can be provided, wind power and photovoltaic digestion is promoted, and compared with a water-wind-light complementary power generation system, the effects of better peak clipping and valley filling are realized.

title_en: System and Method for Managing Road Structure and Resident Welfare Facilities using Real-Time Location-Based
title_ko: 실시간 위치기반을 이용한 도로 시설물 및 주민 복지 시설 관리 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention is configured to manage road facilities and resident welfare facilities with a real-time location-based system. Accordingly, the installation engineer and the manager share location information in real time, thereby improving management efficiency. In addition, the response to complaints will be quickened and damage to facilities will be prevented based on weather and disaster information. A real-time location-based road facility and resident welfare facility management system includes a road facility management server, a situation room management terminal, and an installation technician terminal. By using the GPS base location information, it transmits a message the establishment location and action information and the management server receives a message request and result information. Moreover, the installation need location is detected based on the weather information. The number of complaints and number of execution are counted and establishment is selected over the standards. This is offered to the situation room terminal. It transfers map to the installation technician terminal and the communications unit receives a message the completion information.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 도로 시설물의 안정적이고 효율적으로 관리할 수 있는 실시간 위치기반을 이용한 도로 시설물 및 주민 복지 시설 관리 시스템 및 그 방법을 제공하기 위한 것으로서, 상기와 같은 목적을 달성하기 위한 본 발명에 따른 실시간 위치기반을 이용한 도로 시설물 및 주민 복지 시설 관리 시스템의 특징은, 도로 시설물 관리서버, 상황실 관리 단말기 및 설치기사 단말기 간의 통신을 통해, 도로 시설물 및 주민 복지 시설물(이하, "도로 시설물"이라 칭함)의 관리를 제공하는 시스템에서, 상기 도로 시설물 관리서버는, GPS모듈로부터 수집한 민원인 단말기 및 설치기사 단말기의 현재 위치정보를 기반으로 설치/보수/조치가 필요한 도로 시설물의 위치정보 및 도로 시설물의 설치/보수/조치 정보를 설치기사 단말기 및 상황실 관리 단말기로 송신하고, 설치기사 단말기, 상황실 관리 단말기 중 적어도 하나 이상으로부터 설치/보수/조치가 필요한 요청정보, 설치/보수/조치에 대한 결과 정보, 도로 시설물에 관리에 상응하는 관리정보를 수신하는 통신부와, GPS 위성의 전파신호를 수신하거나, 저장부에 미리 저장되어 있는 도로 시설물의 위치정보 및 고유정보를 검출하여, 특정 도로 시설물의 위치좌표를 계산하여 위치정보를 검출하는 시설물 위치 검출부와, 상기 시설물 위치 검출부에서 도로 시설물의 위치가 마킹된 지도 맵을 표시하고, 상기 통신부를 통해 상황실 관리 단말기 및 설치기사 단말기 중 적어도 하나로부터 전달되는 정보를 모니터링 할 수 있도록 표시하는 표시부를 포함한다.

title_en: Fault tree map generation
abstract_en: A method for Fault Tree Map generation employs to transformation of Fault Trees of production installation, specific installation, technical system (Hardware and integrated Hardware/Software) to new Fault Tree diagram (Fault Tree Map), which permits drastically compact the Fault Tree depiction and facilitates performing of the Fault Tree qualitative analysis, including evaluation of combination of latent failures and evident failures, repeated events and critical events position influence, and failure propagation potentiality, besides facility of localization of each Fault Tree logical Gate and relevant failures in the fault tree printed report. Generation takes place using special symbols, which permit to reflect the Fault Tree logic, present all Fault Tree failures with graphically identification of the failure type, and show the failure repetition and also the failure critically (importance) to Fault Tree Top Event probability. The method presents exceptional advantages to analysis of large-scale, extended Fault Trees, allowing vastly decrease the time of analysis and elevate the analysis quality and Fault Tree perception, including for specialists, who are not the Fault Tree authors.

title_en: Selecting and disaster tolerant method and selecting and disaster tolerant system for accessing supporting node and access control device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a selecting and disaster tolerant method and a selecting and disaster tolerant system for accessing a supporting node and an access control device. The access control device is connected with a plurality of access gateway devices simultaneously, and corresponding relation of terminal identification and access gateway devices is configured on the access control device. During a terminal access process, the access control device accesses a terminal to the access gateway devices corresponding to the terminal identification according to the corresponding relation of the configured terminal identification and the access gateway devices. The selecting and disaster tolerant method and the selecting and disaster tolerant system for accessing the supporting node and the access control device can be applied to an identification locator separation network, the access control device is connected with a plurality of average sample numbers (ASNs), the plurality of ASNs form a service area. When a certain SAN in the service area is failed and escapes service, other available ASNs or spare ASNs can provide service fast, and service interruption time is reduced.

title_en: Intelligent visual emergency broadcase system
