abstract_en: A kind of intelligent visual emergency broadcase system, including host, loudspeaker and emergency APP and small routine；Host includes input mould group, power supply mould group, alarming controller, power amplifier and memory.The advantages of the present invention over the prior art are that: under the mess of the natural calamity power-off suspension of burst, it keeps operating normally using the battery in the photo-voltaic power supply or host of emergency, receive warning information by multiple input modes, warning information is propagated in the form of high-frequency signal loudspeaker, it is sent on the electronic equipment for being preinstalled with emergency APP and small routine in distance range, even if powering off, communication network is unsmooth, without under the states such as net, emergency APP and small routine also can receive graph text information, the people is allowed to understand disaster scenarios it in time, avoid fear；Loudspeaker propagates warning information by acoustic information in the form of intermediate frequency high-decibel in a voice form simultaneously, directly transmitting information.

title_en: Method for identifying abnormal data of power system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for identifying abnormal data of an electric power system, which comprises the steps of taking normal data of the electric power system as a training sample, and training a neural network; inputting data to be detected into the trained neural network to obtain a residual sequence; clustering residual training based on an affine propagation clustering algorithm; and judging abnormal data according to the characteristics of each category and the intra-category distance. The invention utilizes the chaotic particle swarm algorithm to train the neural network, and simultaneously adopts the affine propagation clustering algorithm to realize data clustering, thereby obviously reducing the calculated amount, simultaneously not depending on sampling distribution, and effectively improving the accuracy of identifying abnormal data of the power system.
assignees: INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION BRANCH STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;SHENYANG INST AUTOMATION CAS

title_en: Intelligent training method, evaluation method and system for weak evaluation of power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a training method, an evaluation method and a system for a power system weakness evaluation intelligent agent, and belongs to the field of power system weakness evaluation. The method is based on a deep reinforcement learning algorithm and a power system cascading failure model, an agent based on a deep Q network decides an attack line which most easily causes the power system to crash, a power flow transfer process after the attacked line exits from running is simulated based on the power system cascading failure model, and the power transmission line with the most serious power flow out-of-limit is automatically cut. And continuously utilizing the intelligent agent to decide the attack line until the outage line or the loss load reaches a certain threshold value, judging that the power system is crashed, and outputting an attack sequence decided by the intelligent agent. In the process, experience samples required by reinforcement learning are stored and the updating agent is trained. According to the method, the intelligent agent obtained by deep reinforcement learning algorithm training can be used for effectively deciding the attack sequence which most easily causes the breakdown of the power system under the current tide working condition, so that the weakness degree of the power system is evaluated.
assignees: UNIV HUAZHONG SCIENCE TECH;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Oil reservoir fracturing fracture network expansion path calculation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for calculating a fracture propagation path, which comprises the steps of acquiring geological parameters of various reservoirs required to be used in the fracture propagation process, and determining the circumferential stress distribution formed by the tip of a fracture and the critical fracture stress of each geological unit body around the tip of the fracture according to the geological parameters of the various reservoirs and the distribution rule of natural fractures; for a geological unit body with a formed secondary fracture, when the circumferential stress around the fracture tip is greater than the critical fracture stress, the fracture morphology is output. The method also calculates the crack initiation stress intensity according to the circumferential stress and the crack initiation critical stress; determining the crack propagation probability of each geological unit body around the secondary crack tip according to the crack initiation stress intensity and the fractal probability index; and determining the crack propagation direction by combining all the crack propagation probabilities. According to the method, the problem that the description of a deterministic fracture propagation simulation method is unclear due to unclear reservoir parameters is solved through the fractal probability index.

title_en: Taxpayer risk evaluation method based on graph neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a taxpayer risk evaluation method based on a graph neural network, which comprises the following steps: 1) constructing a data set of a graph risk propagation model; 2) constructing a graph network based on the basic information of each taxpayer in the data set, wherein the graph network is used as a taxpayer attribute information network; establishing a taxpayer bill flow relation information network by taking value-added tax special invoice information as a basis; 3) combining the taxpayer attribute information network and the taxpayer ticket flow relation information network to obtain a final graph network; then acquiring an adjacency matrix of the final graph network; 4) feature vectors of each taxpayer in the data set; 5) taking the adjacency matrix as a network parameter of the graph risk propagation network, and training the graph risk propagation network by using the characteristic vectors of the taxpayers in the data set; 6) and for a group of taxpayers to be evaluated, acquiring the characteristic vector of each taxpayer in the group of taxpayers, and inputting the characteristic vector into the trained graph risk propagation network for prediction to obtain the risk grade of each taxpayer and whether a group situation exists.
assignees: CHINESE SOFTWARE AND TECH SERVICE STOCK LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Disaster weather power grid cascading failure prediction method based on holographic geographic information model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster weather power grid cascading failure prediction method based on a holographic geographic information model, which comprises the following steps of: (1) inputting a data source; (2) establishing a power grid semantic position scene model; (3) Obtaining a holographic power grid semantic position scene model by utilizing a holographic technology; (4) Predicting the risk of the power grid line equipment under the extreme disaster weather by using a holographic power grid semantic position scene model according to weather forecast information, and performing risk evaluation; (5) And analyzing the correlation characteristics among different equipment of the power grid, and predicting the chain accidents possibly caused among the equipment under the extreme disaster weather. According to the method, a power grid semantic position scene model is constructed through natural language matching and natural language-image matching, holographic geographic information is applied to prediction of power grid cascading failures in disaster weather, random change of extreme weather and operation mechanism of power grid equipment elements are considered, and power grid cascading failures can be accurately and quickly predicted.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG;ZHEDA ELECTRIC POWER TECH HANGZHOU CO LTD

title_en: Supply chain network risk propagation assessment method based on Markov process
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of epidemic prevention, and particularly relates to a supply chain network risk propagation assessment method based on a Markov process, which comprises the following steps: step 1, constructing a complex supply chain network model; mapping enterprises in a complex supply chain network into nodes of the network, setting the number of initial nodes as n, and dividing each node into 4 layers which represent a supply layer, a manufacturing layer, a distribution layer and a retail layer in the supply chain network; step 2, constructing a supply chain network failure propagation model based on a Markov process: establishing a multi-period dynamic failure degree evolution network based on a Markov process based on a complex supply chain model; and 3, constructing a failure evaluation model of the network node of the supply chain and carrying out a simulation experiment. The failure degree of each node is quantified, and a dynamic multi-period supply chain network failure degree evaluation model is established, so that the protection and prevention of the nodes with high failure degree are enhanced, and effective parameters can be provided for the supply chain network optimization process.

title_en: Double-layer collaborative optimization method for fixed and movable charging facilities of expressway
abstract_en: The invention discloses a double-layer collaborative optimization method for fixed and mobile charging facilities of an expressway, which comprises the following steps: constructing an optimization model framework, the optimization model framework comprising: an upper layer collaborative site selection optimization model and a lower layer collaborative capacity optimization model; the upper layer collaborative site selection optimization model optimizes the position of a charging station and determines the position and time of the charging requirement for deploying TMC; the lower layer collaborative capacity optimization model optimizes the capacities of TMC and FC of the candidate sites and improves the utilization rate of FC; and (3) carrying out equivalent linear processing on the nonlinear problem by adopting a large M method, converting the nonlinear problem into a mixed integer linear programming model, and realizing the data exchange process between the upper layer and the lower layer by adopting target cascade analysis. The invention improves the utilization rate of the charging facility on the highway, enhances the flexibility of the charging facility, can effectively acquire the time-space distribution of the charging requirements of TMC and FC, completes the cooperative optimization of the charging facility, and provides a new choice for charging station operators and electric vehicle users.

title_en: Electric power system toughness assessment method and system considering incremental power distribution network support
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for evaluating toughness of a power system considering incremental power distribution network support, which relate to the technical field of power systems and comprise the following steps: receiving an IEEE standard node data set, and performing Gaussian sampling near a standard node load of the IEEE standard node data set to generate a node load sample set; receiving power grid related data, inputting the power grid related data into a pre-established cascading failure simulation model added with time sampling to obtain cut load quantity, load recovery quantity and accident chain data, and calculating to obtain toughness indexes by using the cut load quantity, the load recovery quantity and the accident chain data; inputting the obtained node load sample set and the toughness index into a pre-established BP neural network model to obtain a power system toughness evaluation result.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD LIANYUNGANG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH;UNIV SOUTHEAST;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Wind-powered electricity generation intelligent monitoring and early warning system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent wind power monitoring and early warning system, which comprises: the intelligent sensing terminal, the big data analysis and processing module, the power prediction module, the data correction module, the intelligent monitoring module, the network-related scheduling module, the intelligent storage module, the safety protection module, the intelligent equipment maintenance module, the fault statistics analysis module and the fault prediction module are used for realizing the functions of real-time weather information acquisition, ultra-short-term prediction of wind power, real-time monitoring and fault early warning of wind power equipment and the like of the wind power equipment. The power prediction module adopts a BP neural network model based on L-M optimization, and can improve the accuracy of wind power output prediction under various meteorological conditions through the processes of data preprocessing, network initialization, training sample selection, forward and backward propagation, improvement of L-M algorithm optimization, training optimization, wind power prediction and the like, and the accurate control of wind power output is realized by combining variable confidence interval correction.
assignees: HUANENG LUOYUAN POWER GENERATION CO LTD;XIAN THERMAL POWER RES INST CO

title_en: Optimal scheduling method, device, equipment and medium for cascade water-light complementary power generation system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of new energy of electric power systems, in particular to an optimized dispatching method, device, equipment and medium of a cascade water-light complementary power generation system, which comprises the following steps: based on the data analysis of the historical electricity price, constructing a spot price prediction model; acquiring typical photovoltaic output scenes representing different weather conditions by adopting a density peak clustering algorithm; the method is characterized by taking the maximum electricity price gain of a water-light complementary power generation system and the minimum peak-valley difference of a receiving end power grid Yu Fuhe as double targets, and simultaneously taking the complex constraint of cascade hydropower and the limit of the transmission capacity of the outgoing power into consideration; constructing a multi-objective optimization scheduling model of the cascade water-light complementary power generation system considering the peak regulation requirement of the power grid and the economic benefit of the system; and solving the multi-objective optimization model based on NSGA-NPSO non-dominant layered niche particle swarm algorithm to obtain the optimal scheduling method of the cascade water-light complementary power generation system, so that the scheduling result is more matched with the actual situation, and the economy and safety of the system are improved.
assignees: UNIV HOHAI;YALONG RIVER HYDROPOWER DEV CO LTD

title_en: Electric comprehensive energy system fault analysis method based on infectious disease model
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of fault analysis of an electric comprehensive energy system, and particularly relates to a fault analysis method of the electric comprehensive energy system based on an infectious disease model, which comprises the following steps: and (3) model establishment: establishing an air network fault propagation model based on an SIS model and a power network fault propagation model based on an SIR model; a propagation threshold calculation step: calculating the propagation threshold value of the fault in the power grid and the air network according to the complex network theory, the air network fault propagation model based on the SIS model and the power grid fault propagation model based on the SIR model; calculating a network propagation intensity coefficient: and according to a power grid fault propagation model of the fault on the power grid and the air grid, and according to network node parameters and a topological structure, calculating to obtain a network propagation intensity coefficient of the fault on the comprehensive energy system. The method can consider different node characteristics of the gas network and the power network and the propagation characteristics of faults of the gas network and the power network to analyze the faults of the electric comprehensive energy system.

title_en: Electric power visual knowledge distillation method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides an electric power visual knowledge distillation method and system, the method comprises the steps of collecting electric power visual image data, establishing an electric power visual data set, inputting the electric power visual data set into a first model for training to obtain a teacher model, constructing a second model, combining a detection frame of the teacher model with a backbone network of the second model to construct a student model, inputting the electric power visual data set into the teacher model and the student model to obtain an output result, calculating the difference degree between the output results of the teacher model and the student model by using a composite loss function, updating parameters of the student model according to the difference degree by using a back propagation algorithm and an Adam optimizer, and enabling the difference degree to be smaller than a set value through a plurality of rounds of iteration to output the student model. On the premise of greatly reducing the resource consumption, the student model has higher calculation speed, recognition accuracy close to that of a teacher model and smaller model size, and the electric power visual knowledge distillation system is suitable for various resource-limited environments.
assignees: NANJING NARI INFORMATION COMM TECH CO LTD

title_en: House security level prediction method and system based on Bayesian network
abstract_en: A house security level prediction method and system based on a Bayesian network relate to the technical field of house security assessment. The method comprises the steps of obtaining structural feature parameters, environment influence factors and historical state information of a target house, carrying out three-level quantification processing on the structural feature parameters to obtain a structural evaluation matrix, constructing a dynamic attenuation function based on the environment influence factors to calculate dynamic attenuation weights, generating historical state indexes based on the historical state information through a multidimensional feature fusion technology, calculating structural redundancy as hidden variables based on the structural evaluation matrix, the dynamic attenuation weights and the historical state indexes, constructing a three-layer Bayesian network, carrying out probability propagation calculation through a Bayesian network inference engine, and determining the house security level of the target house according to probability distribution of an output layer. By implementing the technical scheme provided by the application, the actual security level of the house can be accurately estimated and predicted.
assignees: SICHUAN WATER CONSERVANCY VOCATIONAL COLLEGE;CHENGDU JINMAO TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power grid cascading failure probability risk assessment method considering transformer mixed failure
abstract_en: The application discloses a power grid cascading failure probability risk assessment method considering a transformer mixed failure, which comprises the steps of S1, system data acquisition, S2, life end failure modeling, S3, weather related random failure modeling, S4, current related overload protection power failure model building, S5, transformer mixed failure probability model building, S6, double-cycle non-sequence Monte Carlo simulation and S7, reliability index calculation. The power grid cascading failure probability risk assessment method considering the transformer mixed failure integrates life-end failure, weather-related random failure and current-related overload protection outage into a joint outage probability, iteratively updates unavailability of the rest equipment in NMC under new current/new temperature, explicitly simulates cascading propagation, quantitatively outputs EENS, PLC, PCFE indexes, and provides a determinable basis for planning and asset management.
assignees: SUZHOU ELECTRICAL APPLIANCE SCIENCE RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: New energy black start partition optimization method considering irregular risks
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of stable control of power systems, and provides a new energy black start partition optimization method considering irregular risks, which comprises the steps of simulating the irregular risks possibly encountered by a power system by adopting Monte Carlo sampling; the method comprises the steps of extracting wind power output characteristics under an unconventional risk by adopting variable-fraction modal decomposition, carrying out output prediction by combining a long-period memory neural network, dividing a recovery partition of a power system based on an LPA algorithm, improving the LPA algorithm by considering a balance principle of the size of the partition, so that the partition area is more balanced and the label vibration effect is reduced. According to the method, a black start partition optimization model which is generated by combining new energy output uncertainty modeling with a non-conventional risk scene is designed, and the partition scheme is cooperatively solved by adopting an improved label propagation algorithm.

title_en: Distribution network investment strategy optimization method based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The application discloses an artificial intelligence-based power distribution network investment strategy optimization method which comprises the steps of constructing a multi-region coupling network model for quantifying the power flow influence intensity among regions according to the electric topology and the power flow data of a target power distribution network, establishing an investment benefit propagation prediction model for quantifying the benefit generated by investment allocation vectors of power supply regions on the whole network based on the multi-region coupling network model, outputting a steady-state benefit change flow distribution tensor in a preset planning period, and obtaining the current optimal investment strategy for N power supply regions according to a preset investment optimization model aiming at maximizing global cooperative net benefit in the planning period based on the steady-state benefit change flow distribution tensor. Therefore, the accuracy of optimizing the investment strategy of the power distribution network is realized.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECHNOLOGICAL RESEARCH INST STATE GRID HEILONGJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID HEILONGJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LIMITED;GUODIAN HUAYAN BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Method, system and equipment for calculating and predicting daily operation efficiency of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system and equipment for calculating and predicting daily operation efficiency of a power distribution network, comprising the following steps: calculating the real-time operation efficiency of the power distribution equipment; calculating daily operation efficiency of the power distribution system based on real-time operation efficiency of the power distribution equipment; analyzing the influence factors of the daily operation efficiency of the power distribution system; screening out main influence factors from influence factors by utilizing gray correlation analysis; and predicting the daily operation efficiency of the power distribution system by using a back propagation algorithm according to the main influencing factors. According to the invention, the operation efficiency is predicted by the gray correlation analysis and the Back Propagation (BP) algorithm, so that the influence of influence factors on the operation efficiency is considered, and the main influence factors are selected by the gray correlation, so that the influence of the influence factors on the operation efficiency is dynamically considered, the defect that the analysis of the operation efficiency and the influence factors in the prior art only stays at a qualitative level is overcome, and the reasonable development of the power distribution network is promoted.

title_en: Disaster weather-oriented power grid operation risk situation awareness method
abstract_en: The invention provides a disaster weather-oriented power grid operation risk situation awareness method. Based on a Bayesian network of time-varying wind speed, the method establishes a power grid time-varying risk propagation model considering the wind speed and the power flow transfer caused by the disconnection fault; solving the running state parameters of the power grid by adopting a Latin hypercube sampling Monte Carlo simulation method and combining an optimal direct current power flow model; and constructing a power grid operation risk situation awareness index system, and realizing the presentation and prediction of a line risk situation, a load level situation and a power grid toughness situation. An effective real-time sensing method is provided for the situation of the running risk of the power grid facing the disaster weather.

title_en: Short-term wind power prediction method based on improved depth forest
abstract_en: The invention relates to a short-term wind power prediction method based on an improved depth forest, which comprises the following steps: splicing time sequence data in the numerical weather forecast data to form multi-dimensional time sequence data, adding wind power labels to the multi-dimensional time sequence data to form a data set, and dividing the data set into a training set and a testing set; inputting the training set into an improved depth forest, performing network training, and forming a time sequence identity mapping of numerical weather forecast data and wind power forecast data; the improved depth forest is formed by combining a multi-granularity scanning layer and stacking layers and connecting cascade forests; and inputting the test set into a trained network, and outputting short-term wind power prediction data. According to the invention, by carrying out self-adaptive feature extraction which is beneficial to wind power prediction on the multidimensional input data through stacking layers and the multi-granularity scanning layers, wind power information under the condition of complex weather can be effectively extracted, the effectiveness of the extraction of the prediction features is improved, and the prediction accuracy is high.

title_en: Wind-solar-load multi-stage scene tree generation method based on source-load uncertainty feature extraction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a source load uncertainty feature extraction-based wind-light load multi-stage scene tree generation method which comprises the steps of extracting wind-light load scene features based on a constructed stacked sparse self-encoder model to obtain a wind-light load scene feature set, clustering the wind-light load scene feature set based on a density peak value improved neighbor propagation algorithm to obtain a wind-light load typical day curve serving as a root node of a scene tree, generating the wind-light load scene tree year by year based on different load growth modes according to the root node of the scene tree, and reducing the scene tree by a Sinkhorn-distance scene tree reduction method to reduce the scale of the scene tree. The wind-solar-load multi-stage scene tree generated by the method can reflect the time sequence information of the new energy output and the load, represents the randomness and the fluctuation of the new energy output and the load, can reflect the uncertainty of the long-term growth of the new energy output and the load, and has important significance for planning and building a power grid.

title_en: Cascade tap hydropower station water level prediction and regulation method supporting new energy flexibility
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of complementary coordination scheduling of multiple energy sources of water, wind and light, in particular to a water level prediction and regulation method of a cascade tap hydropower station supporting the flexibility of new energy sources, which aims at improving the power supply and absorption capacity of a supporting power grid of a drainage basin tap hydropower station under the uncertain background of the power generation capacity of runoff power generation and wind and light new energy sources, and is technically characterized in that a calculation mathematical model of the upper and lower boundaries of the long-term running of the water level of a hydropower station warehouse is established according to the typical scene of predicted runoff and wind and light output, and calculating the upper boundary and the lower boundary of the control water level according to the upper boundary calculation mathematical model and the lower boundary calculation mathematical model, wherein the upper boundary calculation mathematical model and the lower boundary calculation mathematical model are limited by an objective function and constraint conditions, and the effect is that the seasonal power supply protection and new energy consumption regulation requirements of the power grid and the short-term peak regulation requirements are integrally brought into the long-term control process of the water level of the tap hydropower station, and the medium-term optimization allocation of the cascade hydropower quantity, energy storage and regulation capacity is realized.

title_en: Mine emergency communication system
abstract_en: The invention provides a mine emergency communication system which comprises network management equipment, a downlink laser communication access device, a cascade laser communication device, an uplink laser communication access device and the like, wherein the network management equipment is used for establishing a communication network, and the downlink laser communication access device is communicated with the uplink laser communication access device in a laser wireless mode under the relay support of the cascade laser communication device, so that a laser wireless backbone communication link is established, and communication service is provided for underground wireless terminal equipment. The system has the advantages of high bandwidth of a wired communication system and easy deployment of a wireless multi-hop network communication system, solves the problems of low bandwidth, short distance and the like of the conventional wireless multi-hop network emergency communication system, can be widely applied to coal mines and non-coal mines, and has important application value in the aspects of improving the technical level of mine emergency communication, improving the mine disaster rescue efficiency, reducing casualties and property loss and the like.

title_en: Groundwater safety assessment method under extreme climate event
abstract_en: The invention relates to an underground water safety assessment method under extreme weather events, which comprises the steps of collecting multi-source heterogeneous data such as weather, geology, hydrology and remote sensing, constructing a unified underground water safety knowledge graph through standardized cleaning, semantic alignment and missing complementation, monitoring the extreme weather events in real time, updating node relation weights and sparsifying transmission paths based on knowledge graph dynamic evolution and time sequence attention mechanisms, carrying out risk propagation path reasoning on the dynamic knowledge graph by combining an improved graph neural network, identifying key pollution nodes, outputting structured risk grades and coping suggestions, and realizing high adaptability and reasoning accuracy of emergency response by a system based on evolution feedback continuous optimization graph and model parameters. The method improves the intelligence, the real-time performance and the accuracy of the groundwater risk assessment. The method solves the problems that the underground water pollution propagation path is difficult to dynamically identify and the decision adaptability is insufficient under the extreme climate event.

title_en: Fire-fighting management system for apartment house
title_ko: 공동주택의 전기와 통신시설을 이용한 소방관리 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire-fighting management system using electricity and a communications facility of an apartment house. It is possible to prevent occurrence of a fire in advance by monitoring electricity usage situations of households in an apartment house such as a studio, an efficiency apartment, or the like in real time and by immediately propagating worries about occurrence of a fire to an electric facility manager of a corresponding apartment house and a household member of a corresponding household when there is a household causing worries about occurrence of a fire. The fire-fighting management system using electric and a communications facility of an apartment house according to the present invention comprises: a fire risk detection unit which includes a control module, a fire detection facility, a detection sensor module, a disaster prevention device, a wired/wireless communications network, and a computer, and is installed on a distribution board of an apartment house; a fire risk analysis unit which is installed to be linked to the fire risk detection unit on or around the distribution board; and a first communications module and a second communications module.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 아파트, 오피스텔 등의 공동주택에서 세대들의 전기 사용 상황이 실시간 감시되고 이를 통해 화재 발생이 우려되는 세대 존재 시 그 사실이 해당 공동주택의 전기시설 관리자 및 해당 세대의 세대원에게 즉시 전파되어 화재 발생이 사전에 차단될 수 있도록 하는 공동주택의 전기와 통신시설을 이용한 소방관리 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 본 발명에 따른 공동주택의 전기와 통신시설을 이용한 소방관리 시스템은 제어 모듈, 화재탐지설비, 감지 센서 모듈, 방재장치, 유무선 통신망 및 컴퓨터를 포함하는 동시에 공동주택의 분전반에 설치되는 화재위험 감지부 및 상기 분전반 내지 그 주변에 상기 화재위험 감지부와 연계되도록 설치되는 화재위험 분석부, 제1 통신모듈 및 제2 통신모듈을 더 포함하여 구성된다.

title_en: Power data fingerprint evaluation method based on Bayesian network
abstract_en: The invention provides a power data fingerprint evaluation method based on a Bayesian network, which comprises the following three parts: establishing a power data fingerprint evaluation index system, and establishing a Bayesian network evaluation model and Bayesian network reasoning. Analyzing a specific flow of the power data fingerprint, screening evaluation indexes from all indexes by using an entropy weight method, and constructing a power data fingerprint evaluation index system; the dependency relationship of each index node is distinguished, a Bayesian network structure is given, and the reasonable Bayesian network structure is beneficial to accurate inference evaluation; the security of the power data is high, and in order to solve the problem that only small sample data exist, according to the characteristics of the power data, the Beta distribution is equivalently approximate to the normal distribution, and then the maximum posterior probability method of Bayesian estimation is used for calculating the estimated value of the parameter, so that the Bayesian network parameter learning is completed; and the accurate reasoning of the Bayesian network is carried out by utilizing the clique tree propagation algorithm, so that the reasoning time is saved, and the reasoning accuracy is improved.

title_en: Cascade hydropower station participation combined power market optimization scheduling method considering dynamic water flow time lag
abstract_en: The optimized scheduling method for the cascade hydropower station participation combined power market considering the dynamic water flow time lag aims at maximizing the medium and long term contract participation of hydropower enterprises and the power generation profit of the spot combined power market at present, comprehensively considers the dynamic water flow time lag between an upstream power station and a downstream power station, the power station operation constraint, the unit operation constraint and the power constraint, and improves the refinement level of the optimized scheduling of the cascade hydropower station. Aiming at nonlinear constraints in the model, such as a target function, a unit vibration region, dynamic water flow delay between cascade power stations and a unit running state, a series of linearization processing methods are provided, an original nonlinear mixed integer programming model is converted into a standard mixed integer linear programming model, and then a LINGO solver is used for solving the model. The invention maximizes the profit of power generation enterprises participating in the combined power market by using the compensation and regulation function between upstream and downstream reservoirs, improves the short-term optimization and scheduling precision of the cascade power station, and ensures the safe and efficient operation of the power station and the power grid.
assignees: UNIV ZHENGZHOU;YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Hydropower station emergency ecological environment risk prediction early warning method
abstract_en: The invention provides a hydropower station ecological environment risk prediction early warning method which comprises the following steps: establishing and generalizing a pollution risk propagation path based on hydropower station ecological environment risk source identification; determining a contamination propagation path based on the solute transport diffusion model; screening a pollution propagation path by adopting a multi-source data fusion method based on a Bayesian network, and obtaining the pollution propagation path needing ecological risk assessment; acquiring environmental monitoring department data, and preliminarily determining pollution elements of environmental pollution risk evaluation; according to the function of the hydropower station and the sensitive target of the ecological environment; carrying out probability judgment on multi-source data; and fusing the data of the solute migration and diffusion model and the data of the Bayesian network to evaluate the risk of the water ecological environment. Data from various sources are difficult to couple through a mechanism model, and finally an improved Bayesian network model is established, so that comprehensive assessment of ecological environment risks of the hydropower station is realized.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Short-term power load prediction improved layering model containing temperature sensitive load
abstract_en: A short-term power load prediction improved layering model containing temperature sensitive load is a short-term load prediction model and is applied to the field of load prediction containing temperature sensitive load. Step 1: and establishing a transverse layering model. Step 2: and training a transverse layering model. Step 3: and obtaining a predicted load result. The method can solve the problem that errors occur due to the fact that a first layer of neural network cannot refer to comparison non-temperature factors when temperature sensitive components are stripped in a longitudinal layered model, and is high in calculation speed; the constructed transverse layered neural network load prediction model is characterized in that a first layer of neural network considers the nonlinear influence of temperature on the load, a second layer of neural network considers the influence of other factors which do not influence the load by temperature, two layers of neural networks are complexed into a whole through an addition layer, temperature related and temperature independent components are continuously distributed to corresponding neural networks through a back propagation algorithm in the model training process, so that more accurate stripping of temperature sensitive components and non-temperature sensitive components in the load is realized, and short-term power load prediction of the temperature sensitive load in summer is completed. The method is simple and flexible in thought, and can greatly improve the prediction accuracy of the model.

title_en: Key personnel risk prediction method based on time sequence knowledge graph
abstract_en: The invention relates to a key personnel risk prediction method based on a time sequence knowledge graph, which comprises the following steps: acquiring risk data, and carrying out entity identification and relation extraction to form a time sequence knowledge graph quadruple format; dividing four tuples according to the time stamp, generating a map snapshot in corresponding time, converting a risk prediction task into predicting the correct probability of a tail entity under the condition that a head entity and a relationship are known; and calculating the classification loss according to the calculated prediction classification value, and carrying out parameter updating of the model by back propagation until the prediction classification loss tends to be stable. The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows: according to the invention, through calculation of the neural network and back propagation of errors, a loss function is minimized, and the probability of correct prediction of the entity at the next moment is improved, so that the prediction of risk probability of key personnel at the future time stamp is realized. The whole model combines the time sequence evolution characteristic and the history correlation characteristic of the atlas, and obtains better prediction accuracy.

title_en: Power network anomaly detection method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power network anomaly detection method and a system, which relate to the technical field of intelligent power grid monitoring and measurement and comprise the steps of constructing a neuron-like power network graph model, nodizing equipment and introducing a multi-factor anomaly score function, and dynamically activating anomaly nodes by combining an improved Winner-Take-All mechanism; the method comprises the steps of dynamically optimizing connection weights through a topology-aware composite gradient descent method, constructing a multi-layer neural network structure to achieve cross-layer forward propagation and feedback adjustment, establishing an abnormal path model by combining propagation phase differences and information entropy, identifying abnormal paths by using a propagation score function and a weighted shortest path algorithm, and performing fault tracing. The power network anomaly detection method provided by the invention constructs a neuron-like graph model and introduces a multi-factor anomaly activation mechanism, so that comprehensive perception of the power grid node state under the multi-dimensional time characteristic can be realized, and the sensitivity of anomaly identification and the multi-point simultaneous activation capability are effectively improved.

title_en: Non-natural earthquake phase identification method based on image processing
abstract_en: The invention discloses an image processing-based non-natural earthquake phase identification method, which relates to the technical field of image processing and comprises the following steps of capturing continuous signals with the amplitude changing along with time in the earthquake wave propagation process in real time based on sensors distributed on an earthquake monitoring station network, forming an original amplitude sequence, converting the collected continuous signals into three-channel images, and automatically adjusting the brightness of the images according to the dynamic range of earthquake wave data. According to the invention, a three-channel construction strategy is used for constructing a seismic wave multidimensional analysis system, the first channel clearly shows the time domain difference of natural seismic progressive fluctuation and non-natural seismic pulse mutation, the second channel accurately captures microsecond mutation which is easily ignored in traditional time domain analysis, the third channel clearly distinguishes natural seismic low-frequency energy concentration and non-natural seismic medium-frequency characteristic spectral lines, and the self-adaptive brightness adjustment technology aims at the multi-source seismic signal intensity difference, improves non-natural and natural seismic edge distinction and firmly builds a recognition root.

title_en: Collaborative optimization scheduling method and device for heterogeneous resources, electronic equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a collaborative optimization scheduling method, device, electronic equipment and medium for heterogeneous resources, which are used for solving the problems of insufficient regulation and control capability and incomplete scheduling of mass distributed heterogeneous resources at present. The method comprises the steps of applying a cloud-side-end collaborative regulation and control system constructed based on an active power distribution network, a virtual power plant cluster and a multi-element equipment cluster to each virtual power plant of the virtual power plant cluster, obtaining controllable loads and energy equipment data sets transmitted by the multi-element equipment cluster, constructing a controllable load characteristic model based on the controllable loads, constructing a carbon transaction cost model according to the energy equipment data sets, constructing a first optimization regulation and control model of the virtual power plant based on the controllable load characteristic model and the carbon transaction cost model, constructing a second optimization regulation and control model of the active power distribution network with the aim of minimizing the network loss cost of the power distribution network, and carrying out double-layer cascading optimization solving according to each first optimization regulation and control model and each second optimization regulation and control model to obtain an optimization scheduling result.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG;HARBIN INST TECHNOLOGY;CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO

title_en: Risk element identification and multi-factor association modeling method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a risk element identification and multi-factor association modeling method and system, and belongs to the field of risk analysis of flow industry. The modeling method comprises the steps of collecting an original text data set, preprocessing the original text data set to obtain a standardized corpus, carrying out risk semantic recognition on the standardized corpus by using a large language model, extracting semantic elements, carrying out semantic normalization processing on the extracted semantic elements, constructing a risk element coding system, establishing a relation network among the risk elements, storing semantic nodes and associated edges into a graph database to generate a risk event multidimensional associated model, carrying out risk analysis in the graph database, and analyzing the propagation path and key control relation of a risk event by using a visual interface. The invention improves the identification precision of the risk factors, effectively captures the potential risk factors in different data sources, improves the generalization capability of the model under diversified data sources, and ensures the timeliness and flexibility of the risk management system.

title_en: Integration control system using overlay multicasting and unicasting
title_ko: 오버레이 멀티캐스팅과 유니캐스팅을 기반으로 한 통합 보안관제 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed is an integrated security control system capable of rapidly propagating and broadcasting a situation to each scene. The integrated security control system comprises: a plurality of monitoring cameras; a display device; an integrated control server consisting of an event detection module for providing the display device with event images, an input means for receiving control information, and a control module for transmitting the control information to the outside through a communication network in overlay multicasting and unicasting schemes; an agent server for transmitting the received control information to a child node selected by the integrated control server among the designated child nodes; and a base terminal for outputting the control information, which is provided from the agent server, in a sound. The system of the present invention can help members of a corresponding region in performing an initial response by checking the occurrence of events such as disasters, fires, traffic accidents, and crime accidents through the images selectively displayed on the display device in a comprehensive situation room and providing a customized control broadcast to each region in which the event has occurred.
abstract_ko: 각 현장에 신속한 상황전파 및 방송이 가능한 통합 보안관제 시스템이 개시된다.  이를 위하여 복수의 감시 카메라와, 디스플레이 장치와, 이벤트가 발생된 영상을 상기 디스플레이 장치로 제공하는 이벤트 감지모듈과 관제정보를 입력받는 입력수단과 상기 관제정보를 오버레이 멀티캐스팅 및 유니캐스팅 방식으로 통신 네트워크를 통해 외부로 전송하는 제어모듈로 구성된 통합관제서버와, 상기 관제정보를 수신받아 지정된 자식 노드 중 통합관제서버에 의해 선택된 자식 노드에 전송하는 에이전트 서버, 및 상기 에이전트 서버로부터 제공된 관제정보를 음향으로 출력하는 거점 단말기를 포함하는 통합 보안관제 시스템을 제공한다.  본 발명에 따르면, 재난재해, 화재, 교통사고, 방범사고 등의 이벤트 발생을 종합상황실에서 디스플레이 장치에 선택적으로 표시되는 영상을 통해 확인하고, 이벤트가 발생된 지역별로 맞춤형 관제방송을 제공함으로써, 해당 지역의 구성원으로 하여금 신속한 초기 대응을 수행할 수 있도록 도와준다.

title_en: Method for constructing supply chain network risk cascade model
abstract_en: A method for constructing a risk cascade model of a supply chain network comprises the following steps: s1, constructing a supply chain network G with enterprises as nodes N and trade relations among the enterprises as edges E; s2, calculating an initial risk value of each node by adopting a function of the degree and the betweenness; s3, calculating the maximum tolerance risk value of each node according to the proportional relation between the node capacity and the initial risk; s4, calculating the current risk value of each node at the current moment; s5, comparing the current risk value and the maximum tolerance risk value of each node, and determining a failure state; and S6, if the current risk value of a certain node exceeds the maximum tolerance value, judging that the node fails, and performing load redistribution according to the capacity of the surrounding adjacent nodes. The invention has clear logic, mature scheme and clear operation process and has good use and popularization foundation.

title_en: Complex network-based fraud group recognition and risk propagation prediction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fraud group identification and risk propagation prediction method based on a complex network, which comprises the following steps: acquiring individual attributes; determining an attribute value unique code of the subject attribute and the non-subject attribute; filtering data; establishing a data structure for storage and calculation; establishing a connected graph, abstracting the main body attribute values and the non-main body attribute values into nodes, abstracting the attribution relationship of the main body attribute values and the non-main body attribute values into edges connecting the nodes, wherein the nodes and the edges form the connected graph; obtaining a model diagram according to the connected diagram; calculating model parameters according to the data structure; and carrying out fraud group identification and fraud risk propagation prediction according to the model parameters. The method calculates the model parameters according to the knowledge of the graph theory and carries out hierarchy on the model graph according to the known cheating users, thereby achieving the aim of accurately identifying cheating groups and forecasting cheating risk propagation.

title_en: Multi-stage power grid linkage unit combination scheduling method in regional power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a unit combination scheduling method for multi-stage power grid linkage in a regional power system, which comprises the following steps: determining the main quantities of multiple levels of power grids in a regional power system and the operation parameters of power grid units at all levels; establishing a safety constraint unit combined economic dispatching model taking the start and stop of a unit and the main quantity of each level of power grid as a linkage decision quantity; and solving the model based on a target cascade analysis method, and determining the optimal scheduling result of the system. The microgrid constraint comprises a microgrid power balance constraint and a microgrid interconnection line transmission power constraint. The method provided by the invention surrounds a certain regional power system, aims at minimizing the overall operation cost of the regional system, establishes a safety constraint unit combination model taking the start and stop of a unit and the main momentum of each level of power grid layer as linkage decision quantity on the premise of meeting the respective constraint of each level of power grid layer, realizes the unified analysis and decision of the full power system, solves the model by adopting a distributed parallel computing object cascade Analysis (ATC), and realizes the source-grid-load cooperative scheduling of the complex system.

title_en: Typhoon time sequence knowledge graph construction method and terminal
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a terminal for constructing a typhoon time sequence knowledge graph, which are characterized in that a trained cascade neural network model is used for carrying out joint extraction of entities and relations on typhoon text data to be constructed, time sequence triples corresponding to the typhoon text data to be constructed are obtained, and the typhoon time sequence knowledge graph is constructed according to the time sequence triples.

title_en: Quick evaluation method for earthquake damage performance of high-speed railway bridge based on machine learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of bridge earthquake damage performance evaluation, and particularly discloses a quick evaluation method for the earthquake damage performance of a high-speed railway bridge based on machine learning, which comprises the steps of collecting multisource data of a bridge structure of the high-speed railway, a historical earthquake database and a BI M model of the bridge structure in real time through a heterogeneous data collection system; the method comprises the steps of constructing a multi-mode feature space containing time-frequency domain features, space features and partial features of probability features, constructing a hierarchical machine learning framework based on a dynamic Bayesian network damage propagation model, a mixed model of a multi-scale convolutional neural network and a long-short-time memory network and an uncertainty quantification and dynamic updating mechanism, establishing a vibration loss performance evaluation model based on the hierarchical machine learning framework, evaluating the vibration loss performance of the multi-mode feature space by adopting the vibration loss performance evaluation model to generate damage probability distribution, effectively mining potential vibration loss-related information behind data, and more accurately simulating and predicting the vibration loss condition of a bridge in an earthquake.

title_en: Nuclear safety simulation verification method, equipment and medium based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nuclear safety simulation verification method, equipment and medium based on digital twinning, which relate to the technical field of nuclear engineering and digital twinning and comprise the steps of training a physical information neural network based on a digital twinning initial model by combining a nuclide transport equation and a thermal hydraulic equation, outputting a nuclear safety multi-field simulation result, establishing a space-time diagram structure based on the nuclear safety multi-field simulation result, extracting dynamic evolution characteristics by utilizing a space-time diagram convolution network, outputting a nuclear accident propagation path and a risk distribution diagram, and performing credibility evaluation on a virtual-real alignment nuclear safety digital twinning model to generate a nuclear safety simulation verification result.

title_en: Disaster connectivity analysis system, server, and method
title_ko: 재난 연계성 분석 시스템, 서버, 및 방법
abstract_ko: 재난 연계성 분석 시스템 및 방법은 인공지능 기술을 이용하여 복합재난에 대한 선제적 재난관리를 위해 동시다발적 또는 연쇄적 재난과 사고 피해 발생의 구체적 과정을 분석한다. 또한, 실시예를 통해 분석결과에 대한 이해도를 높이기 위해, 재난의 연계성 분석 결과를 재난, 사고 유형별로 구분하여 시나리오 및 지도 형태로 정보를 제공한다. 또한, 실시예를 통해 재난의 네트워크화를 복합재난 분석의 가장 중점적 요소로 두고, 재난, 사고 유형과 취약요소의 관계성을 근간으로 재난 간의 연계성을 분석한다.

title_en: Foldable temporary fire-fighting water tank
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a foldable temporary fire-fighting water tank, which comprises a fire-fighting water tank main body, wherein the fire-fighting water tank main body comprises a horizontally arranged bottom plate and a fixed frame positioned above the bottom plate, and waterproof cloth is hermetically and circularly connected between the fixed frame and the side of the bottom plate; the two opposite sides of the bottom plate and the fixed frame are connected through a support piece, the support piece comprises a pair of symmetrical connecting plates, the pair of connecting plates are respectively and rotatably connected with the sides of the bottom plate and the fixed frame, and a clamping mechanism capable of vertically fixing the pair of connecting plates is rotatably connected between the pair of connecting plates; the clamping mechanism comprises an installation shell and a clamping ring which are respectively fixed at one end of a pair of connecting plates, the end of the connecting plate is close to one end of the clamping ring, a limiting insertion plate penetrates through the installation shell, and the limiting insertion plate penetrates through the bottom wall of the installation shell and is connected with the clamping ring in an inserting mode. This interim fire water tank of folded cascade, it is rational in infrastructure, be convenient for fold and support fixedly, the practicality is strong, easily promotes.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY CONSTR ENG GROUP;CHINA RAILWAY CONSTRUCTION ENG GROUP NORTHERN ENG CO LTD

title_en: Ship-cabin chain fire-disaster alarming priority assessment method
abstract_en: The invention provides a ship-cabin chain fire-disaster alarming priority assessment method which comprises the following steps: acquiring the fire situation information obtained by the combustible gas detectors and the detectors for sensing the temperature and the smoke of all the ship cabins adjacent to the ship cabin with fire disaster; reading the fire-disaster danger level information of the ship cabin with fire disaster; pre-processing the fire situation information obtained by the detectors and the fire-disaster danger level information of the ship cabin in a normalizing way; and sending the processed data to a three-layer feedforward error back propagation neural network for processing to obtain the chain fire-disaster alarming priority assessment results of each ship cabin, namely the primary alarming probability, the intermediate alarming probability and the advanced alarming probability. The comprehensive, early, accurate and reliable automatic alarming of the ship fire-disaster alarming system is realized, the purpose of reducing the wrong and neglected alarming rate is achieved, and the probability that the ship cabins can be subjected to chain fire-disaster to lead to the heavy loss of the ship is reduced.

title_en: Method and device for obtaining information of fire hazard site in building
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a device for obtaining information of a fire hazard site in a building, and belongs to the technical field of fire hazard industry monitoring. The method and the device have the technical scheme that the device comprises a remote monitoring upper machine (1), a monitoring host machine (2), a plurality of monitoring extension machines (3) and a plurality of individual machines (4), wherein the monitoring host machine is connected with the monitoring extension machines through an in-situ wireless network, of the monitoring expansion machines are connected with the individual machines through the in-situ wireless network, the remote monitoring host machine and the monitoring host machine are connected through a wireless or wired network, the monitoring expansion machines transmit all monitored information of all individual machines and monitoring extension machines to the monitoring host machine in a cascade connection mode, the monitoring host machine transmits the information to the monitoring host machine through a remote network, and the obtaining of information of the fire hazard site in the building can be realized. The method and the device provided by the invention have the positive effects that the personnel distribution and the fire condition of the fire hazard situation site can be known in real time, the first information is provided for the danger elimination and rescue organization, and the personnel casualties and the property loss are reduced.

title_en: The method of trunk road vehicle running track reconstruct based on multisource data fusion
abstract_en: The method for the trunk road vehicle running track reconstruct based on multisource data fusion that the invention discloses a kind of.Wherein, this method be intended to comprehensively, accurately reproduce the spatial and temporal distributions and development law of arterial highway traffic behavior, thus improve traffic state data estimation and precision of prediction, promotion signal control benefit.The present invention is based on the Theory of Variational Principles of three-dimensional impact wave, preceding to arc and backward arc slope using the estimation of fixed point detector data first, establish initial arterial highway time-space network figure；Propagation curve profile is lined up secondly by fusion floating car data and the estimation of signal timing dial data；Finally floating wheel paths, be lined up three dimensions in boundary and signal timing dial constraint under, based on shortest path algorithm reconstruct vehicle entire run track.The present invention solves vehicle running track under current congestion status and is difficult to accurately estimate and there is technical issues that currently based on sample path data research more demanding.

title_en: BP neural network-based risk evaluation method for high consequence area of oil and gas pipeline
abstract_en: The invention relates to a BP neural network-based risk evaluation method for a high-consequence area of an oil and gas pipeline. Different from conventional error linear input and output, the evaluation system adopts a three-layer topological structure to perform an error back propagation algorithm, adds a hidden layer between an input layer and an output layer, and performs active learning optimization by alternating three layers of layers. The evaluation accuracy of the invention can be continuously optimized along with the training times, and the invention can carry out associative restoration on the missing input information and has more accuracy and cautiousness.

title_en: Urban building earthquake damage prediction method and system based on neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a city building earthquake damage prediction method and system based on a neural network; the invention relates to the technical field of building parameters; the reading YOLOv algorithm framework includes forward propagation, loss calculation, and back propagation of the input data x using Darknet53 as the backbone network. Wherein the input data x corresponds to any one of the samples in the data set D, YOLOv uses Darknet53 as a backbone network (backbone) for feature extraction. For a set of building images I of a given area, input x at step S2, predictions are made using a trained YOLOv model M. The invention can more accurately identify and classify the building and accurately predict the earthquake damage degree by adopting an advanced YOLOv algorithm and a powerful Darknet-53 deep convolutional neural network structure. The high-precision prediction capability is beneficial to decision makers to make more accurate decisions and optimize resource allocation, so that the emergency rescue efficiency is improved.
assignees: GUANGZHOU VOCATIONAL AND TECHNICAL UNIV OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Method, device and equipment for detecting electricity stealing user based on mixed element heuristic optimization
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electric power detection, and discloses an electric larceny user detection method, device and equipment based on mixed element heuristic optimization, which are characterized in that an original electric power consumption data set is obtained by acquiring the original electric power consumption data set of a user, the original electric power consumption data set is preprocessed, the preprocessed original electric power consumption data set is subjected to characteristic extraction by a mixed element heuristic optimization algorithm to generate the electric power consumption data set, and performing iterative training on the Cascade area convolutional neural network Cascade R-CNN model by using the electric power consumption data set after feature extraction to generate a Cascade R-CNN classification detector model, and finally inputting the original electric power consumption data of the user to be detected into the Cascade R-CNN classification detector model to judge whether the user is an electricity stealing user or not, and performing anomaly marking. The accuracy of electricity stealing detection is effectively improved, and the false alarm rate is reduced.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Intelligent control method and system for new energy transmission and distribution collaborative consumption
abstract_en: The invention discloses a new energy transmission and distribution collaborative consumption intelligent control method and a system, which relate to the technical field of new energy, and comprise the steps of collecting real-time monitoring data of each node in an electric power system and preprocessing; and constructing a complex network model of the power grid according to the adjacency matrix, calculating the power weight of each power transmission line, and storing all data into a relational database and managing. According to the method, the nodes and the edges of the power system are accurately modeled, the adjacency matrix is constructed, the topological structure of the power grid and the power flow of the power transmission line are comprehensively reflected, the load and the running state of the power grid are accurately estimated, errors in the traditional method are avoided, the propagation process of faults in the power grid is simulated in real time by calculating the degrees, the clustering coefficients and the expansion series of the nodes and combining the propagation dynamics model, the speed and the range of the fault propagation are predicted, multi-stage early warning is further realized, the accuracy of evaluating the vulnerability of the power grid is improved, and the stability and the emergency response capability of the power grid are enhanced.

title_en: Artificial intelligence-based risk early warning method for supply chain of automobile part enterprise
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of automobile parts and discloses an artificial intelligence-based risk early warning method for an automobile part enterprise supply chain, which comprises the steps of collecting and processing supply chain data, constructing a map, evaluating suppliers based on the map to generate an image matrix, based on the image matrix, combining production parameters, carrying out model training, constructing a prediction engine to generate a part quality risk prediction result, carrying out anomaly detection on nodes to form a monitoring network, producing a risk assessment result, based on the map, constructing a supply chain network topology model, carrying out risk propagation path analysis, generating a risk conduction diagram, establishing a risk assessment model, integrating the risk prediction result, the risk assessment result and the risk conduction diagram, carrying out integrated assessment on risks of each link of the supply chain to form a scoring system, and based on the scoring system, generating a dynamic risk early warning threshold, constructing a risk response decision tree, providing an intelligent risk response suggestion, so that the risk treatment efficiency of the enterprise is improved.

title_en: LLMs-KG-based underground station facility flood vulnerability cascade effect analysis method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, and discloses a LLMs-KG-based underground station facility flood vulnerability cascade effect analysis method, which is characterized in that an underground station facility knowledge graph of object-behavior-state three-domain association is constructed by analyzing underground station facility components and association relations from top to bottom, a cellular automaton calculation model of flood evolution-facility component coupling is constructed, interaction between underground station facility components and flood is depicted, formal modeling and explicit semantic expression of the underground station facility association relations are realized through KG on one hand, and on the other hand, intelligent reasoning is carried out on interaction and cascade propagation paths between the underground station facility components under the action of flood disasters by utilizing LLMs, so that the transformation from traditional split type evaluation to system integral vulnerability evaluation is realized. Related achievements can provide important theoretical basis and technical support for establishing flood targeted emergency strategies of underground stations and improving system toughness.

title_en: Narrow-band ad hoc network multi-hop link optimization deployment method integrating three-dimensional propagation modeling
abstract_en: A narrow-band ad hoc network multi-hop link optimization deployment method integrating three-dimensional propagation modeling comprises the steps of constructing a three-dimensional space visual view of a deployment area, constructing a direction topological graph based on deployed narrow-band ad hoc network base station equipment, carrying out propagation path type division and propagation path loss estimation on each node in the direction topological graph based on the three-dimensional space visual view, acquiring estimated path loss from each node to a target point, judging whether an effective overlapping area exists between each node in the direction topological graph, acquiring points to be deployed based on the estimated path loss if the effective overlapping area exists, determining the range of the points to be deployed, narrow-band ad hoc network constraint and fitness function if the effective overlapping area does not exist, outputting an optimal multi-hop link deployment scheme, carrying out deployment based on the optimal multi-hop link deployment scheme, carrying out link deployment dynamic adjustment according to monitoring results, obviously improving the estimated propagation loss accuracy, and adapting diversified scene requirements.
assignees: SHANGHAI ICOM COMMUNICATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Industrial waste heat cascade utilization regulation and control method based on multi-source flow cooperation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of industrial waste heat utilization and intelligent regulation, in particular to an industrial waste heat cascade utilization regulation method based on multi-source flow cooperation, which comprises the steps of constructing a digital twin body to comprehensively deconstruct and simulate an industrial waste heat pipe network, accurately grasping the whole process of waste heat generation, transmission and consumption, prompting the system to distribute high-grade waste heat to high-demand users preferentially through a gradient stable rewarding function, reasonably utilizing medium-low temperature waste heat, avoiding waste of the waste heat, the cascade utilization of waste heat is realized, the overall utilization efficiency is remarkably improved, the punishment index of pipe network stability is fully considered in the decision-making process of the DRL algorithm, the excessive pressure fluctuation of the pipe network is avoided due to the regulation and control strategy, the DRL algorithm outputs the optimal regulation and control strategy covering multiple working conditions through trial and error learning in a digital twin environment, and meanwhile, the adaptability and stability of the algorithm under different scenes are ensured through covering the generalization capability of the applicable index evaluation strategy.
assignees: XINJIANG DERUN THERMAL POWER CO LTD;XINJIANG DERUN ECONOMIC CONSTRUCTION DEV CO LTD

title_en: Risk scenario identification method and system for power grid cascading failure, device, and medium
abstract_en: A risk scenario identification method and system for a power grid cascading failure, a device, and a medium. The method comprises: acquiring power grid historical operation data (S101); performing cascading failure simulation on the power grid historical operation data, so as to obtain an active power flow entropy (S102); visualizing the power grid historical operation data and the active power flow entropy, so as to obtain a multi-row heat map (S103); dividing the multi-row heat map into a training set and a test set (S104); training a neural network by using the training set, so as to obtain a power grid cascading failure risk scenario identification model (S105); and testing the power grid cascading failure risk scenario identification model by using the test set, so as to obtain a risk scenario identification result (S106).
assignees: STATE GRID SHANXI ELECTRIC POWER RES INSTITUTE

title_en: Networking method and communication system of emergency communication network for mining area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a networking method and a communication system of an emergency communication network for a mining area, which enable each downstream node to select a superior node with the shortest path and the strongest received signal for communication, and gradually reduce the transmitting power of each downstream node to the lowest level capable of being communicated, thereby being capable of flexibly and quickly establishing a low-power-consumption communication network; the problem of mutual interference between terminal access and network cascade channels is effectively solved by adopting a multi-radio frequency communication mode, so that the network communication rate and the uninterrupted transmission capability of comprehensive data services are improved. Therefore, the implementation of the embodiment of the invention provides a high-quality scheme for the construction, maintenance and use of the emergency communication network for the low-power-consumption mining area, and provides powerful communication guarantee for emergency rescue in mining area accidents.

title_en: Automatic avoidance method for high-water-head irregular multiple restricted areas of main flow cascade hydropower station group
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of hydropower dispatching operation, in particular to an automatic avoidance method for a high-water-head irregular multi-restricted area of a main flow cascade hydropower station group. The technical scheme is as follows: on the basis of mathematical definition of unit limited area constraints, an automatic analysis technology subdivision is carried out on an irregular limited area by using a Hertel-Mehlhorn convex subdivision algorithm, and then a convex optimization theory and an extraction planning theory are adopted to carry out modeling on a subdivided result. The method can automatically avoid irregular multiple restricted areas, and achieves the effect of automatic modeling and solving. The method has important significance for responding to the new situation that the hydropower output changes frequently under the marketization condition in the future in response to the differentiated and automatic scheduling application of the power grid.

title_en: Cascading failure evolution path online identification method considering alternating current and direct current influences
abstract_en: The invention discloses an online identification method of a cascading failure evolution path considering the influence of alternating current and direct current, which aims at a manually set cascading failure initial failure set or a cascading failure initial failure set formed by equipment failure probability, utilizes transient time domain simulation to simulate direct current commutation failure caused by initial alternating current failure under the influence of alternating current and direct current interaction, safety control action caused by direct current continuous commutation failure locking, new energy cascading network disconnection and two-three line-defense action of a power grid, determines lower-stage evolution failure according to equipment overload and voltage out-of-limit and dynamically searches a safety control current value control strategy, and simulates equipment successive disconnection through multi-evolution branch static safety analysis, so that the complex cascading failure evolution path under the influence of alternating current and direct current interaction is accurately identified, and the problem of accurate prejudgment of the cascading failure evolution path of an ultra-high voltage power grid under the online mode is solved. The method can provide a support means for the scheduling personnel to comprehensively master the cascading failure evolution path and the accident risk, and has good application value.

title_en: Power consumption prediction method and prediction system for cement raw material grinding system
