abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for predicting the power consumption of a cement raw material grinding system, which provide a basis for reducing the power consumption of the cement raw material grinding system by predicting the power consumption in real time, take a long-short term memory network as a basic model, adopt an encoding and decoding structure and establish a power consumption prediction model comprising an encoder and a decoder; inputting system variables into an encoder, mining the nonlinear relation among the variables, converting system variable data into feature codes containing the nonlinear relation among the variables, inputting the feature codes and historical power consumption data into a decoder together, mining the relevance between the system variables and the historical power consumption, and obtaining a predicted value at the next moment; meanwhile, model parameters are corrected by adopting a back propagation algorithm, the convergence precision is improved, and then the trained model is used for predicting the power consumption in real time. The invention can be used for accurately predicting the power consumption of the cement raw material grinding system.

title_en: Electric power system vulnerable line assessment method and system considering network attack risk
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for evaluating a vulnerable line of a power system, which consider the risk of network attack, fully consider the influence mechanism of the network attack on the vulnerability of the line and the cascading process of the line fault, and provide the method for evaluating the vulnerable line of the power system, which considers the risk of the network attack. The method has the advantages that the potential maximum power flow of the line under the network attack is calculated, the line fault maskable index and the minimum cut load quantity are utilized for comprehensive risk assessment, the screening and risk sequencing of high-risk lines are realized, and the defect that the network attack threat and the physical consequences of the network attack are not considered in the current assessment method is overcome.

title_en: New energy factory network interaction layering optimization scheduling method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a new energy factory network interaction layering optimization scheduling method, which comprises the following steps: (1) Acquiring grid structure data, new energy output historical data and load demand historical data of a power grid; (2) Establishing a probability distribution model of new energy output and a probability distribution model of load demand by adopting mixed Gaussian distribution; (3) Dividing a power distribution network containing a new energy power plant into a plurality of grid power supply units and defining the grid power supply units in a layering manner; (4) Establishing a local scheduling model of each sub-layer power supply unit in the interaction layered optimization of the new energy factory network; (5) defining an interaction variable; (6) And establishing an upper-layer coordination control model based on a multi-layer target cascading method, so as to form a new energy plant network interaction layered optimization upper-layer coordination control framework. The invention considers the randomness of distributed new energy and load, and reduces the data sharing range between the factory networks as much as possible on the basis, thereby realizing the safe and optimal operation of the whole network.

title_en: Natural language processing method suitable for power dispatching
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power dispatching, and discloses a natural language processing method suitable for power dispatching, which comprises the following steps: collecting data of a power generation unit to generate a feature vector of the power generation unit; constructing a knowledge graph based on the circuit layout, inputting a first neural network, outputting grid-connected point voltage at the next time point, generating a loss value, back-propagating an updated parameter feature vector, and then re-inputting the updated parameter feature vector into a fourth hidden layer; the invention generates the reactive power scheduling parameter for each power generation unit by a deep learning method, and can utilize the reactive power generated by the power generation unit to adjust the power balance of the power generation system.

title_en: Disaster response method that is based on the machine to machine
title_ko: 사물지능통신을 기반으로 하는 재난대응방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster response method based on machine-to-machine communication. The disaster response method based on machine-to-machine communication according to an embodiment of the present invention includes the steps of: collecting surrounding situation information (S100); analyzing and checking the collected surrounding situation information (S110); setting an accident risk radius (r1) around a corresponding machine intelligent disaster prevention sensor unit (100) to transmit the surrounding situation information sensing an accident (S120); generating a risk propagation avoidance-based minimum route (MR) (S130); displaying the risk propagation avoidance-based minimum route (MR) and transmitting the risk propagation avoidance-based minimum route (MR) to terminals (200) (S140); and controlling electronic valves of a harmful dangerous gas pipe (P) to be blocked (S150). Therefore, the present invention can minimize damage due to the explosion and leakage of a dangerous gas.
