title_en: A kind of power system taiwan area load forecasting method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of power system taiwan area load forecasting method, including：Change the APSO algorithm optimization back-propagating BP neural network connection weight and threshold value of inertia weight by dynamic, until the weights and threshold value meet fitness requirement；Based on the weights and threshold value after optimization, training is optimized to BP neural network parameter, obtains the optimum combination of parameter；Taiwan area load prediction is carried out based on the best parameter group.The embodiment of the present invention has faster convergence rate and Geng Gao convergence precision, and it instead of initial optimizing by improvement particle cluster algorithm, effectively raises BP neural network speed of searching optimization and precision, and then improves the accuracy of power system taiwan area load prediction.
assignees: BAODING POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: A kind of construction method of refrigeration unit multi-sensor data prediction model
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of construction methods of refrigeration unit multi-sensor data prediction model, comprising the following steps: data attention mechanism is added in the input terminal of encoder；Refrigeration unit control parameter corresponding to decoder a certain moment timing information to be predicted and environment temperature are combined into vector form, collectively as the input of decoder together with the output cascade of time attention mechanism；Data attention mechanism and time attention mechanism are added in coder-decoder network, the refrigeration unit multi-sensor data prediction model for relying on thresholding recurrent neural network is established.The present invention has rational design, realizes the accurate dynamic prediction function to refrigeration unit multi-sensor data information, can accurately and rapidly position to refrigeration unit multisensor failure, avoid energy waste, improve the service life of equipment.

title_en: Abnormal user behavior identification method based on bidirectional long-short term memory network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an abnormal user behavior identification method based on a bidirectional long-short term memory network. The invention provides a method for establishing an abnormal user behavior recognition model based on a bidirectional long-short term memory network and a BP neural network by combining electric power data. And acquiring user behavior data from a database, cleaning and filling the data, extracting the characteristics of the data through a bidirectional long-short term memory module, and then connecting a BP (back propagation) neural network for classification so as to judge whether the data is abnormal or not. The results show that: compared with a support vector machine, a BP network, a long-short term memory network and a bidirectional long-short term memory network, the bidirectional long-short term memory network can be used for more accurately judging the abnormal user behaviors. It has also been shown that it is effective to extend the data by the Smote algorithm to prevent the over-fitting phenomenon.

title_en: Cascade reservoir group optimal scheduling method and system giving consideration to generated energy and minimum output
abstract_en: The invention provides a cascade reservoir group optimal scheduling method and system giving consideration to generated energy and minimum output, which can enable the power generation of the cascade reservoir group to be more coordinated with the power grid demand and push the cascade reservoir group to fully utilize water energy resources. The optimal scheduling method of the cascade reservoir group considering both the generated energy and the minimum output comprises the following steps: step 1, establishing a cascade reservoir group multi-target optimization scheduling model with maximum cascade power generation capacity and minimum output capacity as targets according to the basic situation of a drainage basin and the comprehensive utilization requirement; step 2, solving the multi-target model by adopting a DDDP-SA algorithm combined with penalty factors, and acquiring a non-inferior solution set with uniformly distributed and wide multi-target problems by controlling the variation range of the penalty factors and selecting discrete penalty factors in the range; and 3, determining the optimal solution of the optimal scheduling of the cascade reservoir group according to the non-inferior solution set.

title_en: Preventive microgrid generation method considering uncertainty of transmission line fault probability
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preventive microgrid generation method considering uncertainty of transmission line fault probability. And further converting the established distributed robust optimization model into an equivalent robust optimization model, and then performing iterative solution on the equivalent robust optimization model by adopting a C & CG algorithm. According to the technical scheme, uncertainty of line fault probability in the power distribution network is considered, a preventive micro-grid generation model of uncertainty of the fault probability of the power transmission line is constructed, and by generating a preventive island micro-grid, power failure loss caused by cascading faults is effectively reduced, and the power supply level of the power distribution network under extreme conditions and the coping capability of the power distribution network under disaster events are improved.

title_en: Multi-energy collaborative power supply self-adaptive online optimization method
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-energy collaborative power supply self-adaptive online optimization method, which not only considers the operation cost, but also comprehensively considers the pollution cost and the energy loss by establishing a multi-energy collaborative power supply optimization objective function and constraint conditions, optimizes the utilization of resources, reduces the investment and the operation cost, and consumes clean energy such as wind power, photovoltaic and the like to the maximum extent; the method comprises the steps of establishing a wind power prediction model and a photovoltaic power generation power prediction model, predicting wind power by a prediction method based on a BP-GA model or a support vector machine, and predicting photovoltaic power generation power by a K-Cascaded-attention network, so that the accuracy of wind power and photovoltaic power generation power prediction is improved; and carrying out dynamic planning and scheduling on multiple energy sources to obtain a multi-energy source cooperative power supply scheme, and improving the utilization rate of the energy sources.
assignees: STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Method, system, device and storage medium for evaluating offshore wind power system line
abstract_en: The application relates to a method, a system, a device and a storage medium for evaluating a line of an offshore wind power system, aiming at the problem of uncertainty of offshore wind power output in typhoon weather, a typhoon scene is constructed based on historical typhoon data, uncertainty of wind power output is described by adopting interval number theory, and an interval tide model considering wind power access is established; aiming at the problem of system line fault propagation in typhoon scenes, a time-varying risk propagation model of the power system is established based on a dynamic Bayesian network according to uncertainty of wind power output and power flow transfer caused by line faults; and (3) considering the real-time comprehensive vulnerability assessment indexes of the line fault and the system risk propagation definition line in the typhoon scene, classifying the vulnerable line under the influence of typhoon by adopting a clustering algorithm, and realizing accurate assessment of the vulnerable line of the offshore wind power system in the typhoon scene. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of reflecting space-time related risks of the power system, accurately evaluating the fragile line under the influence of typhoons and the like.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV SHANGHAI ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Fire-resistant silicone rubber composition and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fireproof silicone rubber composition and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of silicone rubber. The technical proposal is as follows: the composition comprises the following components in parts by mass: methyl vinyl silicone rubber: 40-60 parts of hydroxyl silicone oil: 5-15 parts of hydrogen-containing silicone oil: 3-8 parts of a refractory filler: 20-40 parts of vulcanizing agent: 1 to 3 parts of coupling agent, 0.1 to 1.5 parts of processing aid and 0.1 to 2.0 parts of processing aid. The silicon rubber composition disclosed by the invention has the beneficial effects that the proper combination and proportion of the refractory filler can obviously improve the refractory flame retardant property of the material, can effectively inhibit flame propagation in a high-temperature environment, prevent the material from burning, and ensure the safe operation of power grid equipment under extreme conditions such as fire disaster and the like.
assignees: WEIHAI POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Power distribution network and multi-micro-grid collaborative optimization operation method considering hybrid soft switch multi-mode adjustment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network and multi-micro-grid collaborative optimization operation method considering hybrid soft switch multi-mode adjustment, which relates to the technical field of power system optimization, and comprises the following steps: based on a parallel structure of the interconnection switch and the intelligent soft switch in the hybrid soft switch, a hybrid soft switch power model is established, and the working mode of the hybrid soft switch is adaptively switched according to different operation scenes of the power distribution network and the micro-grid; the method comprises the steps of taking the minimum running cost of a power distribution network and each micro-grid as an optimization target, establishing a power distribution network and multi-micro-grid collaborative optimization running model considering hybrid soft switch multi-mode adjustment, establishing a dynamic target cascading algorithm based on a target cascading algorithm by introducing convergence speed quantization indexes, solving the power distribution network and multi-micro-grid collaborative optimization running model through the dynamic target cascading algorithm, and verifying the optimization effect of the hybrid soft switch. The invention can cooperatively optimize the power distribution network and the multiple micro-grids, and effectively reduce the running cost.

title_en: Energy storage cluster online frequency modulation method considering degradation cost and SOC balance
abstract_en: The invention discloses an energy storage cluster on-line frequency modulation method considering degradation cost and State of Charge (SOC) balance, which comprises the steps of grouping energy storage power stations by adopting a neighbor propagation algorithm by taking structural indexes into consideration, obtaining an objective function of an on-line frequency modulation model by comprehensively considering consistency of the frequency modulation cost and the SOC, obtaining the difference of Lyapunov drift functions at adjacent moments according to dynamic constraint conditions of virtual queue backlog variables, establishing the on-line frequency modulation model of the energy storage clusters, analyzing to obtain optimal Charge and discharge power of the energy storage clusters at all moments, and establishing an energy storage cluster frequency modulation distribution model based on a capacity sensing water injection algorithm to obtain the Charge and discharge power of each energy storage power station in the Charge and discharge states. The invention can respond to the power grid frequency modulation signal in real time on the premise of not depending on the future frequency modulation signal, and can achieve balance between energy storage SOC balance and degradation cost reduction.

title_en: Distributed energy storage virtualization sharing system scheduling method based on target cascading method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed energy storage virtualization sharing system scheduling method based on a target cascading method, which comprises the steps of 1, constructing an operation model comprising a producer community containing distributed energy storage and a producer community renting virtual energy storage, 2, constructing a service life model of a generator set, thereby utilizing an interactive power equivalent calculation strategy of the distributed energy storage-virtual energy storage to construct an operation model of an operator, 3, constructing a three-layer optimization model of the distributed energy storage virtualization sharing system, 4, solving the three-layer optimization model based on the target cascading method, and solving a scheduling scheme of the distributed energy storage virtualization sharing system. According to the invention, by introducing the distributed energy storage-virtual energy storage interactive power equivalent method and combining the distributed target cascade optimization method, the three-layer optimization model of the distributed energy storage virtualization sharing system is solved, and on the basis of ensuring the safe operation boundary of the power network and equipment, the carbon emission of the system is effectively reduced and the utilization rate of the distributed energy storage is improved.

title_en: Artificial intelligence intelligent park multisource data monitoring and analyzing method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent park data monitoring and discloses an artificial intelligence multi-source data monitoring and analyzing method for an intelligent park. The method comprises the steps of constructing a park operation state basic model, extracting data dynamic change characteristics by utilizing a space-time data fusion technology when the model is abnormal, identifying a specific region abnormal event mode by combining deep belief network deep analysis, calculating data complexity by using permutation entropy, optimizing and analyzing an abnormal propagation path by combining an A star algorithm, evaluating a diffusion range and an influence path, identifying a comprehensive risk region according to the data, analyzing the regional environment and equipment state characteristics by utilizing a multispectral imaging technology, evaluating the operation abnormality by combining real-time multisource data, and executing accurate intervention on the comprehensive risk region according to the abnormal condition. The method realizes effective integration and analysis of multi-source data of the intelligent park, accurately identifies abnormality and grasps risk, provides scientific means for park management, and ensures stable and efficient operation of the park.
assignees: SHENZHEN YUNGU XINGCHEN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Daily electricity generation plan making method of cascade hydraulic power plant group
abstract_en: A daily electricity generation plan making method of a cascade hydraulic power plant group is disclosed, the method comprising the steps: step 1, regardless of the constraints for opening and closing the generator set of the power plant, taking the degree of similarity between the power load of a hydraulic power plant group and the typical daily load of power plants being closest as one of the optimization goals, and performing a first optimization to obtain a daily electricity generation plan of the cascade hydraulic power plant group; step 2, according to the daily electricity generation plan of the cascade hydraulic power plant group, planning an opening and closing state for the generator set of the power plant; and step 3, increasing the constraints for opening and closing the generator set of the power plant, taking the degree of similarity between the power load of the hydropower station group and the typical daily load of power plants being closest as the optimization goal, performing a second optimization to obtain the daily electricity generation plan of the cascade hydraulic power plant group. The invention takes into account the demand of a power grid, can obtain hydropower generating strategies better conforming to the actual situations, and is suitable to make daily electricity generation plans for a single hydraulic power plant and the cascade hydraulic power plant group.

title_en: Probabilistic model for cyber risk forecasting
abstract_en: A system and method are presented for forecasting the risk of cyber-attacks on targeted networks. The described technology quantifies linear and non-linear damages to network-dependent assets by propagating probabilistic distributions of events in sequence and time in order to forecast damages over specified periods. Damage-forecasts are used to estimate probabilistically time-varying financial losses for cyber-attacks. The described technology incorporates quantities and dependencies for pricing insurance, re-insurance, and self-insurance, assessing cost-benefit tradeoffs for sequenced implementation of security control measures, and detecting attacks in the targeted network.

title_en: Cascade reservoir optimal scheduling method and system based on quantum particle swarm optimization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascade reservoir optimal scheduling method and system based on a quantum particle swarm algorithm, which comprises the following steps: acquiring an initialized population according to an established objective function of the cascade reservoir optimal scheduling problem, and taking the initialized population as parent particles; constructing a small world network to obtain an adjacent matrix; updating the parent particle according to the adjacency matrix to generate a child particle; calculating the fitness of the offspring particles according to the fitness function; adopting a competition operator to compare the fitness of the parent particle with the fitness of the child particle, and selecting the parent particle with good fitness as the next iteration; judging whether the current iteration times are larger than a maximum threshold value or not; if so, calculating and outputting a calculation result of the optimal scheduling of the cascade reservoir; therefore, the quantum particle swarm algorithm is improved through the small-world network model, so that the improved algorithm not only keeps the population diversity, but also overcomes the defect that the basic quantum particle swarm algorithm is easy to fall into local optimum, and the effect of cascade reservoir optimal scheduling is improved.

title_en: Method and system for determining power grid power failure key line based on cascading failure model
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for determining a power failure key line of a power grid based on a cascading failure model, which comprises the steps of obtaining a power grid model to be calculated and corresponding relevant model information thereof, and obtaining a topological structure of the power grid according to the power grid model and the corresponding relevant model information thereof; and determining the total number of days of cascading failure simulation mode simulation formed by the topological structure of the power grid, simulating by taking each day as a unit, obtaining the line number of the disconnected line output by each day of simulation after the total number of days of simulation is finished, further counting the number of the line numbers of the disconnected line output by each day of simulation, and outputting the disconnected line with the maximum number of the line numbers as the power grid power failure key line. By implementing the method and the device, the key line which has important influence on the cascading failure of the power system can be identified, and data support is provided for line capacity expansion.

title_en: Electric power information physical system modeling method based on alternating current power flow model
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for modeling a power information physical system based on an alternating current power flow model, which is characterized by comprising the following steps of: the method comprises the steps of power network modeling, information network modeling and interaction flow of the power network and the information network, and the modeling of the power information physical system is realized by considering the load flow characteristic of the power network and the monitoring and control function of the information network. Compared with a modeling method based on a complex network theory, the method provided by the invention can better reflect the dynamic characteristics of the power grid, and the optimal economic dispatching algorithm adopted by the information grid not only meets the supply and demand balance of the power system, but also considers the economic operation of the system, can quantitatively reflect the influence of various parameter changes of the power information physical system on the system, and can be widely applied to the fields of safety analysis, cascading failure propagation process, vulnerability assessment and the like of the power information physical system. Has the advantages of scientific and reasonable method, strong applicability, good effect and the like.

title_en: Short-term wind power prediction method and system based on neural network imbalance optimization
abstract_en: The invention provides a short-term wind power prediction method and a short-term wind power prediction system based on neural network imbalance optimization, which relate to the technical field of wind power prediction.A wind speed time sequence, a wind direction time sequence and a wind power time sequence are preprocessed to obtain a characteristic vector, a neural network is constructed, an intermediate characteristic layer is selected, the characteristic vector is used as the input of the neural network, and characteristic tensor similarity processing is carried out on the intermediate characteristic layer, so that the characteristic similarity of samples with similar wind power is improved, wind power samples with small data volume can enhance the fitting effect by depending on the propagation of the samples with similar wind power in the neural network, and the processing capacity of the neural network to unbalanced wind power sequence samples is improved; and carrying out multidirectional imbalance optimization on the training loss of the neural network, and expanding the capability of training optimal fitting parameters of the neural network based on imbalance adjustment, so that the generalization capability of the neural network is enhanced, and the prediction precision of the wind power is improved.

title_en: Method and system for tracing metering error of carbon emission flow of electric power system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electric carbon emission, in particular to a method and a system for tracing a metering error of a carbon emission flow of an electric power system, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a carbon emission factor calculation model of each node based on a topological relation of the electric power system, and determining an upstream-downstream dependency relation between the nodes; according to the error source of the distributed metering system, the relative uncertainty of the metering equipment error at the source side and the data transmission error between the nodes is quantized, the relative uncertainty of the carbon emission factors of each node from the source side to the user side is calculated step by step according to the error transmission rule, a global error propagation path is generated, the total relative uncertainty of the carbon emission amount at the user side is calculated, disturbance analysis is carried out on power grid power data through a probability statistical simulation method, and abnormal nodes are identified. The method aims at realizing error tracing of the carbon emission metering flow and avoiding reduction of accuracy of the carbon emission metering caused by node errors in the power system.

title_en: Urban data fusion event early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of smart city safety and emergency management, and provides a city data fusion event early warning method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a physical environment time sequence data set, a city facility asset data set and an API call behavior log data set; the method comprises the steps of establishing a dynamic digital twin map based on the data set, positioning initial risk trigger nodes based on the dynamic digital twin map and a physical environment time sequence data set, performing graph traversal search to establish a potential risk propagation path set based on a sliding time window abnormality detection mechanism, quantitatively evaluating and generating an early warning event set by adopting a chained probability model, calling a natural language generation function based on a high risk event, matching an optimal emergency plan from an emergency plan knowledge base, and analyzing the optimal emergency plan to generate a scheduling instruction in combination with a natural language early warning message visualization early warning scene. The invention constructs an event early warning and response mechanism oriented to the urban system, and is suitable for intelligent urban early warning emergency management.

title_en: Typhoon path simulation method for coupling machine learning with multi-source marine environment factors
abstract_en: The invention discloses a typhoon path simulation method of machine learning coupling multi-source marine environmental factors, belongs to the field of typhoon disaster simulation, and constructs a typhoon full-path machine learning prediction model integrating marine environmental factors. Firstly, key sea parameters such as sea surface temperature, vertical wind shear of the atmosphere, relative humidity, absolute vorticity, vertical speed, induced airflow and the like, typhoon path and strength time sequence data are integrated, a significant factor influencing typhoon path and strength is selected by combining a P value threshold method, and then, based on a logistic regression model, a counter propagation neural network, a circulating neural network and a support vector machine learning model, a super parameter optimization scheme is combined, so that a full path four-stage optimal prediction model of typhoon in a generation stage, a movement stage, a strength evolution stage and an attenuation stage is respectively constructed. Compared with the traditional statistical model, the machine learning model provided by the invention can better capture the complex interaction mechanism between typhoons and environmental fields.

title_en: A kind of Transmission Network Reliability appraisal procedure based on cascading failure accident chaining search
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of Transmission Network Reliability appraisal procedure based on power grid cascading failure accident chaining search, the method includes cascading failure fault chains search step and carries out reliability assessment step according to the cascading failure result for obtaining.The actual electric network factor such as system stability restraint condition and bus-bar fault, transformer fault is considered in cascading failure accident chaining search；Using new improved cascading failure loss expectation in reliability assessment, existing reliability index is improved, and based on 599 command of State Council and the actual reliability index proposed based on accident gradation of electrical network, there is to engineering practice certain directive function.

title_en: The construction method of supply chain network risk cascade model
abstract_en: A kind of construction method of supply chain network risk cascade model, includes the following steps：S1, building are using enterprise as node N, using the trade relations between enterprise as the supply chain network G of side E；S2, the initial risk values that each node is calculated using the function of degree and betweenness；S3, the relationship directly proportional to initial risks according to node capacity, calculate the maximum patience risk value of each node；S4, the present risk value for calculating current time each node；S5, each node present risk value of comparison and maximum patience risk value, determine failure state；If S6, certain node present risk value are more than maximum tolerance value, determine that the node fails, the capacity according to surrounding adjacent node carries out load reassignment.Clear logic of the present invention, scheme are mature, and operating process is apparent, have and good use and promote basis.

title_en: Port petrochemical region transportation risk early warning method and system based on cascading failure
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of risk early warning, provides a port and petrochemical region transportation risk early warning method and a system based on cascade failure, and solves the problems that the existing petrochemical port road transportation network is easy to be disconnected after being attacked, so that traffic jam is easy to occur, and the social risk and the personal risk value of a petrochemical port area are increased; the early warning method comprises the following steps: acquiring a port petrochemical region basic road network architecture; extracting key road network nodes of the port petrochemical region in a port petrochemical region basic road network architecture, and evaluating the initial potential transportation risk of the key road network nodes; acquiring an initial potential transportation risk result of a key road network node; according to the embodiment of the invention, the importance of important nodes in the geographic network of the petrochemical port area is researched by a multi-attribute decision method to carry out comprehensive sequencing, so that the safety and the efficiency of the network are better guaranteed, the practical significance is provided for the road planning and transportation safety organization of the petrochemical port area, and the road congestion of the petrochemical port area is reduced.

title_en: Method, system, equipment and medium for daily optimal scheduling of multi-level power system
abstract_en: The invention provides a daily optimization scheduling method, a daily optimization scheduling system, daily optimization scheduling equipment and daily optimization scheduling media for a multi-level power system, which relate to the technical field of power scheduling and specifically comprise the following steps: acquiring operation data of a power transmission network, a power distribution network and a micro-grid in a multi-level power system; according to the acquired operation data, constructing a daily optimization scheduling model of the multi-level power system; decoupling and solving an intra-day optimal scheduling model by adopting a self-adaptive target cascading algorithm to obtain an optimal intra-day scheduling scheme of micro-coordination of transmission and distribution, and finishing intra-day optimal scheduling of a multi-level power system; the self-adaptive target cascading algorithm introduces a self-adaptive punishment pair multiplier updating mechanism into the target cascading algorithm, and accelerates updating of a punishment function pair multiplier according to the analysis error among the layers; the invention takes the coordination of transmission and distribution into account, realizes decoupling and parallel optimization of transmission, distribution and microgrid through an improved ATC algorithm, improves the energy utilization efficiency and improves the comprehensive benefit of system operation.
assignees: UNIV SHANDONG;STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO WEIFANG POWER SUPPLY CO

title_en: Method and device for inverting continuous vertical structure of ocean solitary wave by satellite remote sensing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a satellite remote sensing inversion method and device for a continuous vertical structure of an ocean solitary wave, and belongs to the technical field of synthetic aperture radars. The method comprises the steps of collecting ocean real stratification data, extracting ocean stratification parameters, carrying out numerical simulation and radar simulation experiments, setting a numerical simulation initial density field based on the ocean stratification parameters, constructing an internal solitary wave vertical structure-remote sensing characteristic parameter and ocean environment parameter pair sample data set, training a counter-propagation neural network by using the sample data set to obtain a trained internal solitary wave vertical structure inversion model, obtaining the remote sensing characteristic parameter of an internal solitary wave of a target and the ocean environment parameter of a corresponding position, namely the ocean stratification parameters and ocean surface wind field data, and inputting the trained internal solitary wave vertical structure inversion model to obtain the internal solitary wave vertical structure of the target. The inner solitary wave density line offset obtained by the method has extremely high consistency with the on-site measurement result.
assignees: HAINAN KONGTIAN INFORMATION RES INSTITUTE;AEROSPACE INFORMATION RESEARCH INSTITUTE CHINESE ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title_en: Underground space protection evaluation system and method based on BIM and multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The underground space protection evaluation system based on BIM and multisource data fusion comprises a data input layer, an evaluation engine layer and a result output layer, wherein the data input layer, the evaluation engine layer and the result output layer are sequentially used for data transmission and processing, the data input layer is configured to construct a three-dimensional BIM model, an association rule base based on an attack mode and a damage path of a terrorist attack parameter base and a real-time environment data stream based on multisource sensor data fusion, the three-dimensional BIM model integrates geological survey data, topographic survey, structural parameters and civil air defense engineering data through a space topology modeling technology, the evaluation engine layer is configured to receive the three-dimensional BIM model, the association rule base and the real-time environment data stream of the data input layer, a key damage propagation simulation result and a vulnerability analysis result are generated through explosion dynamic response simulation and space topology network analysis, and the result output layer is configured to generate a three-dimensional space classification map, a dynamic design adjustment suggestion and a model self-examination report based on the damage propagation simulation result and the vulnerability analysis result of the evaluation engine layer.
assignees: CN RAILWAY SIYUAN SURVEY & DES;CHINA RAILWAY CONSTRUCTION CORP LTD

title_en: High-toughness coordinated operation method for power grid under multi-source disturbance scene
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power grid state analysis, in particular to a power grid high-toughness coordinated operation method under a multi-source disturbance scene. The method uses oscillation frequency as a node to construct an inter-frequency influence graph structure, and uses a poorly-converged mapping algorithm to analyze driving influence relation between oscillation components in the graph structure. And taking the two nodes meeting the verification condition as analysis objects, and utilizing the peak significance to represent energy transfer between frequencies so as to adjust the edge weight of the graph structure and obtain the verification oscillation image graph. A dominant impact path is obtained. By analyzing the propagation power on the main path and the variation characteristics of the propagation power, the power grid oscillation state can be determined by combining the other basic power grid characteristics. According to the invention, the power grid state can be identified before the oscillation event occurs by analyzing the propagation power change characteristics of the oscillation frequency on the dominant influence path, so that monitoring hysteresis is avoided, and the real-time performance and decision efficiency of the coordinated operation decision of the power grid are improved.
assignees: UNIV NORTHEAST ELECTRIC POWER;ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE STATE GRID HEILONGJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Multidimensional information fusion evaluation method for intelligent product quality security risk
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-dimensional information fusion evaluation method of intelligent product quality safety risk, which comprises the steps of calculating raw material production data aggregation degree and deviation degree, carrying out anomaly identification to obtain an anomaly result, calculating a potential hardware risk coefficient, calculating a first influence degree, correcting the potential hardware risk coefficient to obtain a hardware risk coefficient, carrying out data quality evaluation and cross enhancement to obtain a software integration risk coefficient according to user feedback matching anomaly result and feature enhancement to obtain risk characteristics, constructing a risk correlation propagation network and an intelligent product quality safety risk evaluation model, and inputting multi-dimensional information of an intelligent product to be evaluated into the intelligent product quality safety risk evaluation model to obtain an intelligent product quality safety risk evaluation result. The method not only can promote the comprehensiveness, the dynamics and the accuracy of the risk evaluation of the intelligent product, but also has important significance for improving the reliability of the intelligent product and the industry risk management and control level.

title_en: Water pump controller parameter self-adaptive adjustment control method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent control of water pumps and discloses a water pump controller parameter self-adaptive adjustment control method and a system, wherein the water pump controller parameter self-adaptive adjustment control method comprises the steps of acquiring weather early warning data, pressure pulsation signals of all pump stations and pipe network topology data, and generating a time-space synchronous disaster monitoring data set through a data fusion algorithm; the method comprises the steps of inputting a disaster monitoring data set into a deep space-time diagram neural network, outputting a pipe network damage probability distribution diagram, generating a pulsation propagation prediction model comprising propagation delay and attenuation coefficients based on a fluid dynamics equation and the pipe network damage probability distribution diagram, calculating a PID controller parameter cooperative regulation scheme of each pump station by minimizing an objective function comprising pressure deviation, flow fluctuation and parameter regulation quantity, and acquiring system response data in real time to realize self-adaptive optimization of a control strategy. The invention realizes the stable operation of the water supply system under the disaster condition.

title_en: Product quality inspection management system and method
abstract_en: The application discloses a product quality inspection management system and method, and belongs to the field of product quality inspection and control. The system comprises a network topology construction module, an anomaly detection module, an influence degree calculation module, an evaluation index module, an early warning monitoring module and a differentiation dynamic monitoring and treatment mechanism, wherein the network topology construction module dynamically constructs a network topology structure based on multi-source inspection data to realize space-time correlation analysis of quality states, the anomaly detection module identifies anomaly nodes and risk sources through an anomaly detection algorithm, the influence degree calculation module responds to anomaly identifications output by the anomaly detection module, the diffusion range and the intensity of anomaly correlations in the whole quality analysis system are quantized based on a propagation model, the evaluation index module constructs a multi-dimensional quality evaluation index system and calculates relative weights of indexes by adopting a hierarchical analysis method, the early warning monitoring module monitors network topology change and influence degree calculation results in real time, identifies anomaly correlations of different severity degrees by combining a hierarchical early warning threshold value, and the differentiation dynamic monitoring and treatment mechanism is started.
assignees: TIANJIN WANFU FINANCIAL CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Lithium iron phosphate battery system for high-voltage direct-hanging type mining emergency energy storage power supply and operation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lithium iron phosphate battery system for a high-voltage direct-hanging type mining emergency energy storage power supply and an operation method. The battery system is an energy storage unit formed by a plurality of high-voltage battery clusters and chain link power modules, and three-phase star connection is formed by cascading the chain link power modules, so that the battery system can be directly connected into a high-voltage alternating current power grid without a step-up transformer. The battery core adopts a lithium iron phosphate system, the battery module, the battery pack and the battery cluster adopt a multi-level grouping structure, and a liquid cooling system, a ventilation system, a perfluorinated hexanone and water spraying fire-fighting system and a three-level architecture BMS are configured, so that SOC/SOH monitoring, fault diagnosis and hierarchical protection are realized. The invention is suitable for mining emergency high-voltage direct-hanging energy storage equipment.
assignees: WANBEI COAL ELECTRICITY GROUP CO LTD;HEFEI INST PHYSICAL SCI CAS;ANHUI HENGYUAN COAL & ELECTRIC CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for providing situation propagation platform for strengthening disaster response capabilities
title_ko: 재난 대응역량 강화를 위한 상황전파 플랫폼 제공 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method and a device for providing a situation propagation platform for strengthening disaster response capabilities, and the method comprises the steps of: establishing a standard operation procedure relating to a collaboration function for each disaster type; receiving a selection relating to the collaboration function in response to an occurrence of a disaster situation, so as to generate a task management process for managing the standard operation procedure; when the task management process is initiated, activating each of a uniquely assigned emergency contact network function and a situation propagation function, tracking access situations for emergency contact networks of situation propagation targets in real time, and monitoring transmission/reception states between the situation propagation targets; and generating a check list relating to a standard response task so as to provide the check list to the situation propagation targets according to the flow of situation propagation on the basis of the standard operation procedure.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 재난 대응역량 강화를 위한 상황전파 플랫폼 제공 방법 및 장치에 관한 것으로, 상기 방법은 재난 유형 별로 협업기능에 관한 표준운영절차(Standard Operation Procedure)를 구축하는 단계; 재난 상황의 발생에 따라 상기 협업기능에 관한 선택을 수신하여 상기 표준운영절차의 관리를 위한 업무관리 프로세스를 생성하는 단계; 상기 업무관리 프로세스가 개시되면 고유 할당되는 비상연락망 기능 및 상황전파 기능을 각각 활성화하고, 상황전파 대상자들의 상기 비상연락망에 대한 접속상황을 실시간 추적하며 상기 상황전파 대상자들 간의 송·수신 상태를 모니터링 하는 단계; 및 상기 표준운영절차를 기초로 상황전파의 흐름에 따라 상기 상황전파 대상자에게 표준대응업무에 관한 체크리스트를 생성하여 제공하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Trans-provincial power transmission cascade hydropower station group peak-shaving dispatching two-phase search method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of hydropower dispatching operation, and discloses a trans-provincial power transmission cascade hydropower station group peak-shaving dispatching two-phase search method. The characteristics of load complementation between receiving-end power grids can be fully utilized and different peak power demands of multiple receiving-end power grids can be taken into consideration to realize reasonable allocation of quality resources between the multiple power grids. The technical scheme is as follows: the trans-provincial power transmission cascade hydropower station group peak-shaving goal is realized in two phases according to the characteristics of the trans-provincial power transmission peak-shaving issue; in the optimization calculation process, load curves with great difference of a plurality of provincial power grids are reconstructed into an overall load by adoption of a load reconstruction strategy, and the hydropower station power output process is determined on the basis by adoption of a variable-scale optimization method; and then the allocation process of output power of the station between the receiving-end power grids is optimized by adoption of an exterior point search method, an initial solution is generated through successive load shedding, and the peak power sizes of the receiving-end power grids are corrected in an iterative mode by taking load level as heuristic information to meet the peak-shaving demands of the multiple power grids. Peak-shaving demands of multiple provincial power grids can be taken into consideration, and a peak-shaving result better than actual dispatching can be obtained. The method is feasible.

title_en: Method for monitoring capability of lifting well-ground integrated micro-seismic monitoring system
abstract_en: A method for improving the monitoring capability of a well-ground integrated micro-seismic monitoring system comprises the steps of firstly, selecting a plurality of candidate points which can be provided with wireless sensors on the ground to form a candidate point set of natural number codes, and randomly selecting a fixed number of candidate points from the candidate point set to form a well-ground integrated micro-seismic monitoring table network with the sensors which are installed underground; after multiple random selections, a well-ground integrated microseismic monitoring station mesh arrangement scheme with a certain scale is generated; and then, for each scheme individual, constructing a monitoring capability evaluation model by adopting a propagation relation of the microseismic energy and the P wave first arrival peak amplitude to form an initial population, solving by adopting a genetic evolution algorithm to obtain an optimal individual, and determining an optimal ground wireless sensor layout scheme for remarkably improving the well-to-ground integrated microseismic monitoring capability. The method provides effective guidance for on-site adjustment and optimization of the installation position of the ground wireless sensor, and ensures that the well-ground integrated microseismic monitoring system can observe the microseisms with various energy levels generated in the mine excavation production process.

title_en: Fault emergency scheduling method and system for cascade hydropower station equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a fault emergency dispatching method and system for cascade hydropower station equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring historical operation data and real-time operation data of each level hydropower station in the cascade hydropower station; determining important power flow sections of hydropower stations of all levels in a power grid topology; analyzing and monitoring equipment faults based on important tide sections and combining real-time operation data with power grid topology; calculating the power generation loss of the faulty hydropower station according to the fault analysis result of the equipment fault analysis monitoring; combining the real-time operation data and the power loss and adopting a genetic algorithm to generate an initial emergency scheduling scheme of the cascade hydropower station; predicting maintenance recovery time for recovering all the faulty hydropower stations to a normal running state; and combining the real-time operation data, the power loss and the maintenance recovery time, and adopting a second generation genetic algorithm to generate an optimal emergency scheduling scheme of the cascade hydropower station. The invention has the effect of safely and rapidly carrying out real-time emergency dispatch.

title_en: Disaster-ridden kind of coupling grid cascading failure analysis method of power grid and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of disaster-ridden kind of coupling grid cascading failure analysis method of power grid and systems, comprising: obtains power grid primary parameter and electric grid secondary parameter, establishes dynamic power grid system model；External environment data are obtained, dynamic power grid system model is inputted, are judged to obtain if there is external electrical network event of failure under initial grid operation mode since external environment causes the sequence of electric network element failure；Establish power grid mixing differential algebraic equations；Dynamic power grid system model is emulated according to the primary condition of power grid cascading fault simulation analysis and the power grid mixing differential algebraic equations of foundation；When emulation, according to admittance matrix Y bus Judge power grid whether off-the-line, if power grid not off-the-line, continues operation；Judge whether to terminate emulation；Form electric network consecutive failure accident chain；Output emulation data, overall merit power networks risk.The present invention can consider influence of the disaster-ridden kind of coupling cascading failure of relay protection acting characteristic to electric network element.
assignees: State grid hunan electric power co ltd;STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD DISASTER PREVENTION & MITIGATION CT;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Non-stationary multivariable causal relationship analysis method for gas turbine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-stationary multivariable causal relationship analysis method for a gas turbine. The method is used for extracting the data fluctuation trend through the rank vector and converting the data fluctuation trend into a limited symbol sequence set aiming at the large-range non-stable operation working condition continuously appearing in the operation process of the gas turbine, and quantitatively evaluating the direction and the strength of information transmission between variables by using the multivariate symbol transfer entropy. Meanwhile, a statistical hypothesis testing process is designed, and the significance of the causal relationship of the actual variables is judged by randomly recombining the variable time sequence information as a reference group, so that the redundant false causal relationship among the variables is simplified. And finally establishing a multivariable causal connection network. The method not only can reveal the variable causal relationship of a large-range non-stationary process, but also has robustness to noise interference in a severe industrial environment, establishes a system bottom layer interaction mechanism model in a data driving mode, and provides a high-efficiency and reliable new thought for state evaluation and fault propagation path analysis of a gas turbine system.

title_en: Topic-guided remote sensing image subtitle generation method based on Transformer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for generating a subtitle of a remote sensing image of a Transformer based on theme guidance, which mainly solves the problems that the description generated in the prior art is single and the semantic information in the image cannot be accurately represented. The implementation scheme is as follows: constructing a theme encoder consisting of a Transformer and a theme vector, and pre-training on the classification data set; building a semantic decoder which is formed by cascading a random mask layer, an embedded layer, a Transformer decoder and a soft-max layer; connecting a theme encoder with a semantic decoder to obtain a remote sensing image subtitle generation network; setting training parameters, and iteratively training a remote sensing image subtitle generation network by using a standard RSICD data set; and generating a caption description by using the trained remote sensing image caption generation network. The invention improves the diversity and the accuracy of the generation description, and can be used for ground feature image retrieval, disaster prediction and image understanding.

title_en: Water-wind-light long-term complementary scheduling rule extraction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for extracting a water-wind-light long-term complementary scheduling rule, which comprises the following steps: step1, adopting a clean energy consumption maximum model to carry out water-wind-light long-term complementary optimization scheduling; step2, on the basis of optimizing a scheduling result, analyzing and screening influence factors which have large influence on decision variables month by adopting gray correlation degrees; step 3, establishing a BP artificial neural network model to extract a scheduling rule; step 4, finally, performing simulated scheduling by using historical data to verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the scheduling rule; the GRA can effectively express the association relation among the data samples, and the neural network model constructed by using the simplified impact factors screened by the GRA can greatly shorten the training time and effectively improve the prediction performance of the model; the BP neural network is verified to have good performance in the extraction of the cascade hydropower station dispatching rule, the method has the characteristics of accurate and stable prediction and the like, the prediction result can be referred to actual dispatching, and the method has certain popularization and use values.

title_en: Space-time operation situation deduction method for urban lifeline complex system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of simulation deduction, and discloses a space-time operation situation deduction method of a complex system of an urban lifeline. The method comprises the steps of S100, constructing a multi-layer network model of the urban lifeline complex system corresponding to an actual space position under the same space coordinate reference frame, S102, constructing a space grid model or a field model aiming at each external factor under the same space coordinate reference frame, S104, evaluating and obtaining the damage degree generated under the coupling influence of multiple external factors according to the multi-layer network model and the space grid model or the field model of the urban lifeline complex system, S106, analyzing the cascade fault propagation dynamics of the urban lifeline complex system according to the correlation relationship between the damage degree generated under the coupling influence of the multiple external factors and the nodes in the urban lifeline complex system, evaluating and obtaining the damage degree under the influence of the multiple external factors and the correlation relationship, S108, judging whether to finish deduction, if so, finishing deduction, and returning to S102.
assignees: CASIC INTELLIGENT TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Abnormal electricity utilization detection method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an abnormal electricity utilization detection method and system, comprising the steps of obtaining first electricity data of a target electricity user, and carrying out first preprocessing on the first electricity data to obtain second electricity utilization data; according to the second electricity consumption data, the first time sequence coupling characteristic is obtained by combining the first characteristic extraction model, the second pretreatment is carried out on the first time sequence coupling characteristic to obtain third electricity consumption data, and the third electricity consumption data is input into the first electricity detection model to carry out abnormal electricity consumption detection. The power consumption data is utilized to divide the load subsequence, so that the input characteristics are more representative, and the adaptability of the model to complex power consumption modes is improved. The dimension reduction of the user behavior characteristics is performed through the characteristic selection framework, redundant information is reduced, the running efficiency of the model is improved, and the calculation cost is reduced. The application of the cascade forest network enables the detection process to be more stable, and can process more nonlinear relations, so that the false alarm rate and the false alarm rate are reduced.

title_en: Intelligent scheduling method for cascade reservoir
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent cascade reservoir dispatching method, and belongs to the technical field of intelligent cascade reservoir dispatching. The method comprises the steps of S1, establishing a comprehensive database, periodically grabbing scheduling data of each weather station, a hydrological center, a power plant and a power grid to prepare models for calling operation, S2, establishing an intelligent simulation model, carrying out medium-long-term runoff rolling forecasting and flood forecasting on a tap reservoir with the performance of being regulated in a season and serving as a forecasting object according to the data of the number of the databases, carrying out medium-long-term runoff rolling forecasting and flood forecasting on all the power plants, S3, selecting scheduling objects and calculating time spans according to actual conditions by operators, adjusting input and constraint conditions, selecting proper optimization targets according to different scene requirements, and S4, outputting a scheduling scheme according to input information by the intelligent simulation model, and supporting manual intervention. The method solves the technical problems of low decision efficiency and insufficient precision due to the fact that the conventional step reservoir dispatching depends on manual experience judgment.
assignees: GUANGXI GUIGUAN ELEC POWER CO LTD;DATANG YANTAN HYDROPOWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Photovoltaic power parallel prediction method
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of photovoltaic power prediction, in particular to a photovoltaic power parallel prediction method, which comprises the steps of obtaining a photovoltaic power generation power sequence according to a preset time interval, carrying out data decomposition on the photovoltaic power generation power sequence based on an REMD-OVMD model to obtain a plurality of intrinsic mode functions IMF, carrying out feature extraction on each subsequence in channel dimension and time dimension by utilizing a FreMLP-based time sequence prediction model FreTS by taking the plurality of IMFs as subsequences, carrying out photovoltaic power prediction by utilizing a Dlinear-Tranformer parallel structure prediction model which is constructed in advance based on the fused features of each subsequence, taking the sum of photovoltaic power prediction values corresponding to each subsequence as a photovoltaic power prediction result, carrying out learning and prediction on an error sequence of the photovoltaic power prediction result by utilizing a TCN model, optimizing network parameters by reverse propagation, and finally modifying the photovoltaic power prediction sequence. The application adopts the parallel prediction method, and can simultaneously operate a plurality of sub-models, thereby reducing the calculation time and improving the real-time performance.

title_en: Water-light-storage complementary and direct-current outgoing two-stage random optimization scheduling method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of optimal scheduling of power systems, in particular to a water-light-storage complementary and direct-current outgoing two-stage random optimal scheduling method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of establishing a water-light-storage complementary and direct-current outgoing system model comprising a thermal power unit, a photovoltaic unit, step hydropower, a pumped storage unit, a static reactive compensator and direct-current outgoing; the method comprises the steps of constructing a two-stage random optimization scheduling model by taking operation cost minimization as an objective function and taking node balance constraint, branch flow constraint, thermal power unit constraint, photovoltaic output constraint, pumped storage power station constraint, cascade hydropower constraint, static reactive compensator constraint and tributary operation constraint as constraint conditions, generating a typical scene by taking photovoltaic uncertainty into consideration of a condition generation countermeasure network CGAN, reducing the generated scene through a Euclidean hierarchical clustering method EAHCM, solving the two-stage random optimization scheduling model to obtain an optimization scheduling result, and achieving the aim of economic scheduling.
assignees: UNIV HOHAI;YALONG RIVER HYDROPOWER DEV CO LTD

title_en: Oil transportation safety supervision method and device based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses an artificial intelligence-based petroleum transportation safety supervision method and device, and relates to the technical field of petroleum transportation, comprising the following steps of S1, quantification of transportation chain safety factors and construction of intrinsic risk indexes; S2, obtaining a dynamic dangerous field index, S3, constructing a safety control priority index, S4, constructing a risk coupling propagation model, S5, quantifying response intensity, outputting a multi-strategy response coefficient, S6, automatically deriving a final intervention instruction, and constructing a safety supervision device based on the steps. The system can identify the intrinsic risk, the transient risk and the cross-node linkage risk in the transportation chain in real time, automatically screen the proper regulation and control strategy according to the risk propagation intensity, and finally generate the intervention instruction capable of being directly executed. The method realizes the upgrading of the safety supervision from 'point-level monitoring' to 'networked, predictive and active safety control', and greatly improves the overall safety level and the operation reliability of the petroleum transportation system.

title_en: Flood monitoring device and method
title_ko: 홍수 모니터링 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, a flood monitoring device comprises: a power supply unit supplying power generated by a solar panel as operation power of each unit; a vertical support installed at a first length on the ground; a horizontal support installed at a second length on the vertical support; a camera installed to photograph a water level indicator on the horizontal support and photographing a water level display plate image; a water level sensor installed in a vertical direction on the horizontal support and measuring a water level of flowing water in a non-contact manner; and a water level monitoring device installed on the vertical support, receiving outputs of the camera and the water level sensor, and wirelessly spreading the water level indicator image and the output of the water level sensor to a communication network.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 홍수 모니터링 장치는, 태양광 패널에 의해 발전되는 전원을 각부의 동작전원으로 공급하는 전원부; 지상에서 제1길이로 설치되는 수직 지지대; 수직 지지대에서 제2 길이로 설치되는 수평 지지대; 수평 지지대에서 수위표시자를 촬영할 수 있도록 설치되며, 수위표시판 이미지를 촬영하는 카메라; 수평 지지대에서 수직 방향으로 설치되며, 흐르는 물의 수위를 비접촉식 방식으로 측정하는 수위감지센서; 수직 지지대에 설치되며, 카메라 및 수위감지센서의 출력을 수신하며, 수위표시자 이미지 및 수위감지센서의 출력을 통신망에 무선전파하는 수위감시장치를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: UNIV KYUNGIL INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOP;WINITECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and apparatus of using drive test data for propagation model calibration
abstract_en: A method using drive test data for propagation model calibration includes: step 1, obtaining original drive test data; step 2, selecting the data from the drive test data according to predefined conditions as effective drive test data; and step 3, extracting the effective drive test data to form a data file used for propagation model calibration. An apparatus using drive test data for propagation model calibration includes: a drive test data obtaining module, configured to obtain the drive test data in the regions to be calibrated; an effective drive test data generation module, configured to generate effective drive test data from the drive test data according to predefined conditions; and a data file generation module, configured to extract the effective drive test data to form a data file used for propagation model calibration. The present invention utilizes drive test data of existing networks to largely decrease the CW test work and reduce the network building cost. It is believed that the calibrated model can relatively accurately reflect the propagation characteristics in the field. Furthermore, base stations can be optimally allocated.
assignees: CHINA MOBILE COMM CORP;CHINA MOBILE COMM CORP

title_en: Systems and methods for order-of-magnitude viral cascade prediction in social networks
abstract_en: Systems and methods for predicting order-of-magnitude viral cascades in social networks are disclosed.

title_en: Anomaly factor estimating device, learning device, precise diagnostic system, and anomaly factor estimating method
abstract_en: There are included a sensor data acquiring unit to acquire a plurality of pieces of time-series sensor data collected by a plurality of sensors provided in a plurality of facility components an anomaly detecting unit to detect a plurality of anomaly detection sensors in which an anomaly has occurred on the basis of a plurality of the pieces of sensor data, an anomaly detection order estimating unit to estimate an anomaly detection order in which occurrence of the anomaly is detected, an anomaly propagation path tracking unit to estimate an anomaly propagation order in which the anomaly has propagated on the basis of anomaly detection sensor information and an estimated structure indicating a dependence relationship between the facility components, and an anomaly factor estimating unit to estimate a factor of the anomaly on the basis of the anomaly detection order and the anomaly propagation order.

title_en: Emergency signal priority and social vehicle dynamic path induction collaborative optimization method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency signal priority and social vehicle dynamic path induction collaborative optimization method, which is based on a complex network theory to construct a road network toughness capability index; and deleting the nodes with lower toughness. On the basis, an emergency rescue path double-layer planning model is constructed, and the upper-layer target is to maximize the reduction amount of emergency signals preferentially corresponding to the delay of emergency rescue vehicles, so that the travel delay of the emergency rescue vehicles is minimum; the underlying goal is to optimize traffic flow distribution such that travel time of social vehicles is minimized. And after the emergency vehicle passes through one intersection, updating the sub-network, the emergency rescue path, the emergency signal priority strategy and the social vehicle guidance scheme according to the traffic state of the current road network until the emergency vehicle reaches the accident site. The invention considers the negative influence of the emergency rescue task on the road network toughness capability, constructs a double-layer planning model to realize game balance between the emergency rescue efficiency and the social vehicle passing efficiency, and effectively avoids the occurrence of road network cascade failure and even secondary traffic accidents.

title_en: Cascade hydropower span power supply capacity pricing method and system for responding peak regulation demand of receiving end power grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pricing method and a pricing system for cascade hydropower span power supply capacity in response to peak regulation demands of a receiving end power grid, and belongs to the field of hydroelectric generation. The method comprises the steps of dividing the electricity price peak-to-valley period of a receiving end, drawing up a feasible time-sharing electricity price scheme set, then establishing a cascade hydroelectric multi-province power generation model, finally inputting the time-sharing electricity price scheme into the cascade hydroelectric multi-province power generation model, calculating an output force curve of the cascade hydroelectric for 24 hours, calculating two evaluation indexes of electricity purchasing cost and peak regulation effect of the receiving end power grid, optimizing the time-sharing electricity price scheme through a non-dominant sorting algorithm, setting index weight, defining a preference function, and selecting a scheme with the smallest preference function value as an optimal time-sharing pricing scheme. Under the condition of meeting the maximum generating income, the invention effectively promotes the response of the peak shaving requirement of the power grid of the receiving end, realizes the balance of the self-generated power and the electric quantity of the sending end and the receiving end at the level of hours, has controllable purchasing cost of the power grid of the receiving end, and realizes win-win of the power plant and the power grid of the receiving end.

title_en: Multi-mode traffic network robustness calculation method under typhoon disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-mode traffic network robustness calculation method under typhoon disasters, which comprises the steps of constructing an inter-city public traffic network comprising a plurality of traffic modes, generating an air pressure attenuation model and a typhoon continuous influence model by combining space-time dynamic characteristics of the typhoon disasters, calculating failure probability distribution and state of the inter-city public traffic network under the typhoon disasters based on a system vulnerability curve and a Monte Carlo simulation method, establishing a traffic network cascade failure model according to the failure probability distribution and state of the inter-city public traffic network under the typhoon disasters, simulating the structure and function loss process of traffic network sites and lines under the disaster conditions, designing a traffic network robustness index calculation system, and quantifying the performance change of the inter-city public traffic network from two aspects of topological structures and service functions. The invention can accurately quantify the influence of typhoon disasters on a traffic system.

title_en: Power consumption management peak avoidance method based on multi-objective planning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power system management and discloses a power management peak avoidance method based on multi-objective planning, which comprises the steps of constructing a power system heterogeneous graph network structure, defining an uncertainty characterization model on the graph structure, constructing an uncertainty propagation dynamics model, realizing an uncertainty propagation algorithm perceived by the graph structure, constructing a robust optimization framework perceived by the graph structure, realizing a multi-level risk partition management strategy and finding out an uncertainty complementation effect.

title_en: Day-ahead power load prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a daily electric load prediction method and system, and belongs to the technical field of electric load prediction. The method comprises the steps of (1) constructing a model, wherein for the load of the d day and the t time to be predicted, the numerical value is influenced by multiple factors, constructing a hybrid neural network and a continuous conditional random field according to the multiple factors, (2) carrying out model solving and parameter training, realizing the hybrid neural network and continuous conditional random field training through forward derivation-error back propagation, and (3) carrying out power load prediction by using the trained hybrid neural network and continuous conditional random field. According to the invention, the time sequence dependency relationship of the load between every two moments in the day is quantized by using the Gaussian kernel function, and multiple dependency relationships are embedded into the probability undirected graph frame of the CCRF to carry out integral modeling and prediction solving, so that the accuracy of load prediction before the day is improved.

title_en: Complex wireless communication system
title_ko: 재난 구조용 ＧＰＳ주파수가 130 ｄＢｍ 펄스 폭에 형성된5 ㎓ 밀리미터파 주파수대역을 이용한 초 광대역주파수확장변조 복합무선통신시스템
abstract_en: A UWB(Ultra Wide Band) frequency expanding and modulating complex wireless communication system is provided to implement a frequency expansion system in accordance with IEEE 802.11a and HIPERLAN2 physical layer standards in connection with an SDR(Software Defined Radio) network, a UWB wireless communication system, a BWLL(Broadband Wireless Local Loop), and a BMWS(Broadband Multimedia Wireless Service) network through a 5-GHz millimeter-wave frequency band where a GPS frequency for disaster relief is formed at a pulse width of 130 dBm. A UWB frequency expanding and modulating complex wireless communication system comprises a body part(20), a head part(10), and an LBS(Location Based Service) server. The body part comprises a front plate(21) and a rear plate(22). The front plate(21) transmits and receives frequencies through the wavelength of an output port using the radio propagation caused from a UWB frequency expanding and modulating wavelength. The rear plate(22) contacts with an HDX frequency expanding and modulating RFID(Radio Frequency IDentification) tag. The head part(10), to which an Iris is attached, supports the frequency propagation amplification transmission of a microstrip patch antenna. The LBS server, attached to the center of the front plate(21) or the head part(10), has a 119 frequency transmitting function and a multilingual voice information service transfer function.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 송수신하는 전면판과 HDX 주파수확장변조의 태그(RFID)와 접촉하는 배면판을 포함하는 몸통부; 몸통부 머리에 아이리스를 부착시켜 마이크로스트립 패치 안테나의 주파수 전파증폭전송을 지지하는 머리부; 몸통부 전면판의 중앙부분 또는 머리부에 부착되어 긴급구조신호의 송출기능을 가지고 이를 다국어 음성정보 서비스 전환이 가능한 위치기반서비스(LBS); 를 포함하는 것으로서 몸통부와 머리부에 전파전파 확장변조 및 주파수 전파증폭을 형성시키는 재난구조용 GPS주파수가 130 dBm 펄스 폭에 형성된 5 GHz 밀리미터파 주파수대역을 이용한 초 광대역 주파수확장변조 복합무선통신시스템에 관한 것으로서 재난구조용 GPS단말기에서 송신된 출력 130 dBm 펄스 폭의 파장으로부터 야기된 전파전파와 초장기선 전파간섭계 간의 결합방식을 이용하여 주파수가 확장변조되어 5GHz 이상의 초 광대역 주파수대역을 형성시킬 수 있다.
