title_en: Apparatus for inspecting electric power conduit in underground using mobile device
title_ko: 모바일 기기를 이용한 지중 전력구 점검장치 및 그 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 모바일 기기를 이용한 지중 전력구 점검장치 및 그 방법에 관한 것으로서, 전파 음영지역인 지중 전력구에서 지중 전력구의 점검과 진단시 GPS와 유무선 통신네트워크 등에 기반한 외부 전산시스템의 지원없이도 독립적으로 모바일 기기를 활용하여 열화손상을 2차원 모델로 입력받아 상호 공간좌표의 연계성에 근거하여 3차원 모델로 구현하여 표출할 수 있도록 함으로써 3차원 모델 구현을 위한 추가적인 작업을 위한 시간과 인력을 줄여 경제성을 향상시킬 수 있으며, 지중 전력구 현장에서 실시간으로 3차원 열화손상 모델을 구현하고 확인할 수 있어 2차원적 그래픽정보와 유지관리정보를 바탕으로 3차원적으로 재생성하거나 재입력하는 변환과정에서 발생될 수 있는 인위적인 실수와 오류를 사전에 방지할 수 있어 외관조사의 점검 및 진단 정보의 신뢰성을 높일 수 있다.

title_en: Central monitoring and management system for detecting dangerous substances
title_ko: 위험물 유출 감지 중앙 감시 관리 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 기술적 사상이 되는 위험물 유출 감지 중앙 감시 관리 시스템에 관한 것으로, 본 발명은 위험 시설물을 관찰하고 사고 발생된 위험 시설물에 대해 사고 신고할 수 있는 위험물 유출 감지 중앙 감시 관리 시스템을 제공하는 것을 목적으로 한다. 본 발명은 위험 시설물의 상태를 관찰하고, 관찰 결과 사고 발생이 예상되는 경우 사고 발생된 위험 시설물에 대해 사고 신고하고, 위험 시설물 주변 단말기로 사고 발생을 전파해서 단말기를 소지한 사용자 또는 주위 사용자가 사고 발생을 인지하고 대피하는 효과를 가질 수 있다.

title_en: A kind of full-automatic strike-machine test system of superpower laser
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of full-automatic strike-machine test systems of superpower laser, including power meter A, power meter B, absorb bucket A, absorb bucket B, light splitting piece A, light splitting piece B, laser, laser output port, cut off circuit, water cooling unit, distribution box, monitor, humidity sensor, photodetector, cigarette propagated sensation sensor and network module, computer is connect with power meter A, absorption bucket A is respectively equipped with behind light splitting piece A and light splitting piece B and absorbs bucket B, photodetector is connect by cutting off circuit with laser, laser is equipped with laser output, laser is connect with water cooling unit, monitor respectively with humidity sensor, cigarette propagated sensation sensor is connected with network module, distribution box respectively with monitor, laser is connected with bucket A is absorbed.When the utility model solves high-power laser test, laser power meter can monitor the additional disaster that water, electricity etc. may cause easily by the risk of high power damage, so as to fulfill full automatic test system.
assignees: TIANJIN DONGFANG RUILEI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Business service disaster recovery method, device, system, management server and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a kind of business service disaster recovery methods, device, system, management server and electronic equipment, method includes: that management server receives the bind-request message based on network channel address negotiation protocol that client is sent, according to the address information of the client of bind-request message carrying and the server info for the multiple service servers being obtained ahead of time, from multiple service servers, it is assigned as client and the standby traffic server of specified services service is provided, the protocol message based on network channel address negotiation protocol is sent to client, the address information of protocol message carrying about standby service server, so that client parses the address information of standby traffic server from protocol message, and when detecting specified services exception, according to the address information of standby traffic server, handover access standby traffic service Device improves service experience to realize to reduce occurring the case where specified services service disruption or Caton.
assignees: BEIJING QIYI CENTURY SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Semi-physical antenna simulation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a semi-physical antenna simulation method and system, belonging to the technical field of microwaves. Extracting the S parameter of the double port of the matching circuit by using a vector network analyzer, importing the S parameter data into three-dimensional electromagnetic simulation software, and then cascading the S parameter data with an antenna model; and then simulating the semi-physical antenna model by three-dimensional electromagnetic simulation software, and obtaining the final result of the antenna performance by means of the simulation software. The invention takes the influence of resistance loss, parasitic capacitance and inductance in the circuit on the antenna into consideration, avoids the interference of ground and surrounding environment on the antenna measurement in actual measurement, and more accurately and conveniently obtains the far field performance of the antenna.
assignees: CN ELECT TECH NO 38 RES INST

title_en: Method for generating hydrogen-storing metal-organic framework of hydrogen-fueled automobile
abstract_en: The method relates to a metal-organic framework (MOF) algorithm for generating hydrogen for hydrogen-fueled vehicles. The MOF structure is considered to consist of metal clusters, organic linkers and topological networks. The algorithm mainly comprises Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) and is divided into 4 stages: selection, expansion, simulation, and backtracking. Firstly, obtaining a path capable of generating a complete SMILES character string through an MCTS selection and extension stage, then, predicting the next character of the current SMILES character string by using an improved GRU as a strategy network in a simulation stage according to the SMILES character string in the selected path to obtain a complete SMILES character string, namely an organic connection base of the MOF, then, constructing the MOF by using a metal cluster, a topological network and the organic connection base in Zeo + +, and then simulating the hydrogen adsorption quantity of the constructed MOF by using RASPA, wherein the value of the adsorption quantity is used as a reward value of the path selected when the MCTS generates the organic connection base. Finally, in the backtracking stage of MCTS, the reward value is propagated backwards and the information of the nodes in the path is updated. When the maximum value of the hydrogen adsorption amount of MOFs remained unchanged for 7 hours, it was considered that MOFs having the best hydrogen adsorption performance were obtained at this input.
assignees: THE BEIJING PREVENTION AND TREAT HOSPITAL OF OCCUPATIONAL DISEASE FOR CHEMICAL INDUSTRY

title_en: Tube burst positioning method based on transient flow
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for realizing the positioning of pipe explosion, in order to realize the accurate positioning of a complex pipe network, a high-frequency SCADA system is applied to monitor a pressure abnormal signal in the pipe network, the whole change (system abnormity) and the transient change (transient flow abnormity) of the pressure are analyzed after the pressure abnormal signal is filtered, and the pipe explosion event is identified; simulating transient flow excited by pipe explosion according to the momentum theorem and the actual operation numerical value of opening the ball valve, and simulating the monitoring point transient flow according to the propagation characteristic of the transient flow on the basis; judging pipe sections of the pipe burst through numerical simulation of monitoring point signals of pipe burst of each pipe section; the pipe bursting positioning is realized by judging the monitoring point signals of pipe section pipe bursting through numerical simulation; compared with the actual pipe burst position and the positioning position of the negative pressure wave method, the method proves that the positioning precision is higher, and the method can effectively solve the problem of precise positioning of the complex pipe network.

title_en: Multi-beam feed network design method based on 180-degree directional coupler
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-beam feed network design method based on a 180-degree directional coupler, which comprises the following steps: s1: according to the requirements of application scenes, executing a feed network structure design scheme to obtain a feed network cascade structure; s2: executing a device optimization design scheme according to the feed network cascade structure to obtain an optimization result; s3: determining the power distribution ratio of the 180-degree directional coupler according to the optimization result; s4: obtaining the specific structure of the 180-degree directional coupler according to the power distribution ratio; s5: and cascading a plurality of 180-degree directional couplers to obtain a final comprehensive multi-beam feed network. The method for designing the multi-beam feed network based on the 180-degree directional coupler can solve the technical problem that the existing multi-beam feed network cannot simultaneously consider the number of network ports and the beam forming requirement.

title_en: Data-driven risk analysis method and device fusing physical knowledge
abstract_en: The invention provides a data-driven risk analysis method and device fusing physical knowledge, which comprises the steps of acquiring and processing accident data, judging risk association relations in advance through the physical knowledge, determining mandatory relations among node variables, selecting a Bayesian search algorithm, a greedy algorithm and a PC algorithm for structure learning, constructing a data-driven model, developing parameter learning by combining an expectation maximization algorithm, quantizing probability distribution among the node variables, selecting a cause association relation model with better learning performance from k-fold cross validation results, and determining risk priority by considering the dependence and sensitivity of different risks on the whole network through a risk propagation effect. The method provided by the embodiment combines physical knowledge, considers insufficient and unbalanced blowout accident data, selects different structure learning algorithms, combines parameter learning to establish a blowout accident cause evolution model, analyzes the blowout accident risk association relation and the importance degree, and is beneficial to accident risk prevention and control.

title_en: Distributed energy-containing power distribution network and multi-microgrid day-ahead random scheduling method based on generation countermeasure network
abstract_en: A daily random scheduling method for a distribution network containing distributed energy sources and a multi-microgrid based on a generated countermeasure network belongs to the field of electric scheduling. The method comprises the steps of establishing a multi-micro-grid and power distribution network day-ahead joint random optimization scheduling framework; analyzing the photovoltaic output scene in the micro-grid based on a data driving method to obtain a typical processing scene; based on a data driving generation countermeasure network method, learning wind power photovoltaic processing characteristics and generating a renewable energy source output scene; and (3) performing scene reduction by using a K-media method, and performing typical feature extraction to obtain a typical scene. Aiming at the difficult problem of coordinated scheduling of the access of the multiple micro-networks to the power distribution network, a random optimization model between the power distribution network and the multiple micro-networks in the future is established, the overall optimal solution of the model is obtained by utilizing a target cascading analysis method, and finally, a scheduling scheme with higher economical efficiency and new energy consumption rate is obtained, so that the coordinated operation of the multiple micro-networks and friendly interaction between the multiple micro-networks and the power distribution network are realized. The method is suitable for the field of coordinated operation management between the micro-grid system and the power distribution network.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV WUHAN

title_en: Coordinated multi-region power transmission maintenance method, device, computer equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of power grid overhaul, in particular to a coordinated multi-region power transmission overhaul method, a coordinated multi-region power transmission overhaul device, computer equipment and a medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring the net load peak-valley time periods of each region, and constructing a key time period set; acquiring the output cost relation and the electric quantity standby relation of each area in the key time period set; constructing an upper maintenance plan model according to the output cost relation, the electric quantity standby relation, the tie line power and the upper constraint of each area; constructing an area maintenance plan model according to the output cost relation of each area, the power of the connecting line and the area constraint; and (3) carrying out iterative computation on the two models by adopting a target cascading algorithm based on the tie line power to obtain the power transmission maintenance plan of each region. By implementing the invention, the current cascade algorithm is adopted, and different optimization modes of two-stage scheduling are considered through two-stage coordination. Meanwhile, the calculation scale under the complex constraint of regional standby, related network safety and the like is reduced, and the calculation efficiency can meet the actual requirements of multi-region power grid dispatching.

title_en: Probability prediction method of non-equidistant monotonic compound quantile regression based on iMICN
abstract_en: The invention provides a probability prediction method of non-equidistant monotone compound quantile regression based on iMICN, which comprises the following steps: 1) Feature screening and data preprocessing are carried out on the data set by using a Pearson analysis engine; 2) Dividing the data set into a training set, a testing set and a verification set according to the ratio of 8:1:1; 3) Training by using an iMICN model to obtain a high-precision median value, and predicting the condition quantile by using non-equidistant monotonic compound quantile regression; 4) Through an Adam algorithm, back propagation training model parameters are carried out according to a marbles loss function, and training effects of the model parameters are judged according to loss values of a verification set; 5) And applying the trained network to a test set to obtain a final probability prediction result, and evaluating the probability prediction result through an evaluation index. The iMICN deep learning model greatly improves the prediction precision, reduces the width of a prediction interval under the condition of not reducing the coverage probability, and combines non-equidistant monotone compound quantile regression to show excellent performance in short-term load probability prediction.

title_en: Construction safety risk monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of safety monitoring and intelligent early warning, discloses a construction safety risk monitoring method and a construction safety risk monitoring system, and aims to solve the problems of isolation, static state and hysteresis of a traditional construction safety monitoring means. The method comprises the steps of deploying a multi-mode sensing network to collect environment, personnel, equipment and structure data, constructing a risk factor time sequence matrix through space-time alignment and feature normalization, constructing a dynamic association map by combining a risk conduction rule base and a historical case, predicting risk propagation potential energy of each node by utilizing a graph neural network, triggering early warning according to a multi-level threshold value, outputting a conduction path and blocking advice, and linking field equipment to execute a hierarchical inhibition action. The system comprises six modules of sensing deployment, data fusion, map construction, potential energy prediction, early warning decision making and execution linkage. According to the application, through space-time modeling and intelligent deduction, active identification and second-level intervention of a risk link are realized, construction safety is promoted to be converted from passive response to active prevention, and accident probability and loss scale are reduced.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY FIRST GROUP RAILWAY CONSTRUCTION CO LTD;CHINA RAILWAY FIRST GROUP CO

title_en: Nuclear safety simulation verification method, equipment and medium based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nuclear safety simulation verification method, equipment and medium based on digital twinning, which relate to the technical field of nuclear engineering and digital twinning and comprise the steps of training a physical information neural network based on a digital twinning initial model by combining a nuclide transport equation and a thermal hydraulic equation, outputting a nuclear safety multi-field simulation result, establishing a space-time diagram structure based on the nuclear safety multi-field simulation result, extracting dynamic evolution characteristics by utilizing a space-time diagram convolution network, outputting a nuclear accident propagation path and a risk distribution diagram, and performing credibility evaluation on a virtual-real alignment nuclear safety digital twinning model to generate a nuclear safety simulation verification result.
assignees: ANHUI ZHONGAN ZHIKE DIGITAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Photovoltaic cluster power prediction method based on progressive spatial feature clustering and improved graph attention network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photovoltaic cluster power prediction method based on progressive spatial feature clustering and an improved graph attention network, which relates to the field of photovoltaics and comprises the following steps of constructing a distributed photovoltaic cluster data set, carrying out primary cluster division by taking physical characteristics of a photovoltaic component as a feature input affinity propagation AP algorithm, carrying out secondary cluster division by taking a solar altitude sequence as a feature input AP algorithm, and finally dividing the photovoltaic cluster into a plurality of sub-clusters; and for each light Fu Ziji group, after the historical power and the historical meteorological time sequence data are combined, inputting the historical power and the historical meteorological time sequence data into a GAT-Encoder-Decoder deep learning model for training, reasoning and outputting a daily power prediction result of each power station in the sub-cluster, and accumulating the prediction results of all the power stations to obtain a power prediction result of the whole photovoltaic cluster. According to the invention, clustering calculation is carried out through the step-by-step spatial features so as to obtain the sub-group division result which can reflect the spatial feature states of the photovoltaic power stations, and the relevance of the output of the photovoltaic power stations in the sub-group is improved.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Heating system abnormality detection and repair system and method based on data analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heating system abnormality detection and repair system and a method based on data analysis, which relate to the technical field of heating system data analysis, and the invention collects multi-source data of a heating system user unit and aggregates system state vectors of all user units to form a system state vector set; the method comprises the steps of analyzing consistency coefficients of theoretical relations and actual readings among internal parameters of user units, analyzing external linkage difference degrees among adjacent user units in a heating network topology, analyzing and fusing abnormal indexes by integrating the consistency coefficients and the external linkage difference degrees, repairing accumulated heat based on repaired instantaneous parameter values, analyzing and repairing each accumulated heat repairing value, constructing a propagation directed graph, analyzing root cause suspected indexes of all nodes in the propagation directed graph, constructing a key root cause node candidate set based on a root cause suspected node sequence, and sending the key root cause node candidate set to an administrator, thereby improving accuracy of a final repairing result and improving diagnosis efficiency.

title_en: Management server, control method and control program in power exchange network system
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To construct a power exchange network system which enables an individual to easily buy and sell power, and is useful even during service interruption caused by disaster or accident.SOLUTION: A management server for managing a power exchange system which has a shop or the like expanding in the whole country or a region as an axis comprises power exchange management means which stores power to power storage means prepared in the shop or the like through a power line or through an electric vehicle from a user's dwelling house, and manages the shop or the like and the user who purchases power to the user's dwelling house through the power line or through the electric vehicle from the power storage means. Here, the management server prepares power points given or consumed by power exchange, and can apply the power point to purchase of power in the shop or the like or value payment of merchandise or the like by using the power point. Moreover, the management server comprises processing means at the time of the service interruption which changes the service interruption region or the shop or the like adjacent to the service interruption region into a mode at the time of the service interruption, according to acquisition of service interruption information including the range of the service interruption region, when the service interruption occurs in a specific region, and executes special processing at the time of the service interruption.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Pressurized water nuclear reactor for nuclear disposal
title_ko: 핵폐기물처리용 가압수형 원자로설비
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a pressurized water nuclear reactor for nuclear waste disposal, and more particularly, to a pressurized water nuclear reactor for nuclear waste disposal of an ocean nuclear and hydroelectric power plant including a dual structure block tank collector of a dual structure egg type for the nuclear waste disposal or a dual structure block tank collector comprising nuclear waste disposal execution for continuously operating a nuclear power plant in the nuclear and hydroelectric water nuclear power plant. The present invention includes the dual structure block tank collector, a dual structure block tank which comprises a pressurized water nuclear reactor facility by including an inner block tank and an outer block tank, and a floating dock of the ocean nuclear and hydroelectric power plant. Therefore, the present invention can improve the safety of the nuclear power plant.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 핵폐기물처리용 가압수형 원자로설비에 관한 것인데,더욱 상세하게는,원자력수력발전소에 핵폐기물처리를 위한 이중구조 계란형태의 이중구조블록탱크집진기 또는 이중 관 구조캡슐형태 다수개의 원자로설비에 구비되는 핵폐기물처리 차폐장치의 각개 부위를 연결하는 이중구조저장탱크와,핵연료폭발방지 제어용품의 냉각수와 황토혼합물 운송체인 어도터널 설치 및 강 하구와 해양에 침몰방지체류선에 건설기계를 구비해 소형,중형,대형의 해양원자력수력발전소의 부양식독을 강 하구와 해양에 투입하여 원전가동용 핵폐기물처리의 이중구조바지선인 부양식독 운반선들로 이중구조블록탱크 집진기 연결구조물의 운반을 마련하고,지속적인 원전가동을 위한 핵폐기물처리조절 수행을 구성하는 이중구조블록탱크집진기를 구비한 해양원자력수력발전소의 핵폐기물처리용 가압수형 원자로설비에 관한 것으로 
핵폐기물처리용 가압수형 원자로설비는 상기와 같은 상기한 문제점을 해결하기 위해 창안한 것으로,종래의 원자력발전소 원자로설비의 분배투입장치에 있어서, 
상기 종래의 원자력발전소의 원자로설비의 분배투입장치에는, 
보통 물을 사용하는 비등수형 원자로와 가압수형 원자로의 구조로 구성되어 있고,발전용 원자로는 주로 경수로가 많이 사용되고 있는데 비등수형 원자로에 가압수형 원자로를 갖춘 원자력발전소와 기체냉각로에 다목적 고온가스로와 신형전환로에 고속증식로 원자로설비를 갖춘 원자력발전소들이 육지와 도서 지역으로 연결되어 다수개의 원자력발전소의 원전가동 중에 자연 발생적인 태풍,지진, 해일, 산불, 황사와 화산 폭발 전후 시의 화산재 발생 등으로 인해 종래의 자연재해로부터 원자로설비들이 폭발하여 원전가동이 정지되는 사태를 종종 나타내고 있다. 
이와 같이 종래의 원자력 발전소의 원자로 설비의 분배투입장치에 있어서는,종래의 원전가동 중에,예컨대 도 105에 도시하는 바와 같이 자연재해 발생 전 후 시로부터 종래의 각개의 원자로 설비들은 서로 밀집되어 근접하는 경우로 연쇄적인 핵연료 폭발로 인해 핵발전소의 안전성에 지대한 영향을 미치는 경우가 있다. 
본 발명은 핵폐기물처리용 가압수형 원자로설비에 관한 것인데,더욱 상세하게는,원자력수력발전소에 핵폐기물처리를 위한 이중구조 계란형태의 이중구조블록탱크집진기 또는 이중 관 구조캡슐형태 다수개의 원자로설비에 구비되는 핵폐기물처리 차폐장치의 각개 부위를 연결하는 이중구조저장탱크와,핵연료폭발방지 제어용품의 냉각수와 황토혼합물 운송체인 어도터널 설치 및 강 하구와 해양에 침몰방지체류선에 건설기계를 구비해 소형,중형,대형의 해양원자력수력발전소의 부양식독을 강 하구와 해양에 투입하여 원전가동용 핵폐기물처리의 이중구조바지선인 부양식독 운반선들로 이중구조블록탱크집진기 연결구조물의 운반을 마련하고,지속적인 원전가동을 위한 핵폐기물처리조절을 구성하는 이중구조블록탱크집진기를 구비한 해양원자력수력발전소의 핵폐기물처리용 가압수형 원자로설비에 관한 것으로, 
이러한 본 발명이 해결하고자 하는 기술적 과제는,핵폐기물처리용 가압수형 원자로설비를 구성하는 이중구조블록탱크집진기를 구비한 해양원자력수력발전소 설비에는, 
지구촌 원자력수력발전소에 핵폐기물처리를 위한 이중구조 계란형태의 이중구조블록탱크집진기 또는 이중 관 구조캡슐형태 수개의 원자로설비에 구비되는 이중구조저장탱크와,차폐장치와 동일한 핵폐기물처리의 각개 부위를 연결하는 핵연료폭발방지 제어용품의 냉각수를 믹서기계로 혼합한 황토혼합물 운송체인 어도터널 설치 및 강 하구와 해양에 침몰방지체류선에 건설기계들을 구비해 소형,중형,대형의 해양원자력수력발전소의 이중구조 바지선인 부양식독을 이동 투입하는 원전가동용 핵폐기물처리의 이중구조 바지선에 이중구조블록탱크집진기 운반선들로 마련하고, 
상기 이중구조블록탱크집진기 연결구조물에 구성하는 수개의 펌프와 이중구조 배관과 밸브와 발전기들로 연결되어 핵연료 방사능누출을 제어하는 핵폐기물처리에는, 
지구촌의 산정상에서부터 강 하구와 해양에 이르기까지 원자력수력발전소와 해양원자력수력발전소를 연결하는 핵폐기물처리조절을 이중구조블록탱크 집진기들로 구비해 수개의 펌프와 이중구조 배관과 밸브와 발전기들로 연결하는 핵연료 방사능누출을 제어하는 핵폐기물처리 핵폐기물처리용 가압수형 원자로설비를 구성하며, 
원전가동 대체 발전전력 생산을 위한 풍력발전기와 화력발전기에 수력발전기를 침몰방지체류선에 건설기계들을 구비해 강 하구와 해양 등지에 해양원자력수력발전소를 연결 이동을 마련하고, 
원자력수력발전설비부에서는 핵폐기물처리를 위한 핵연료폭발방지 제어용품의 냉각수를 믹서기계로 혼합한 황토혼합물 운송체인 어도터널을 구비해 원자력발전 핵폐기물처리부를 구성하는 조절축과 구분하는 분배축들로 구비해 이중구조블록탱크집진기를 구비한 핵폐기물처리용 가압수형 원자로설비를 마련하며, 
원자력발전 원전가동 중단 전후 시 대체 발전전력 생산을 위한 풍력발전기와 화력발전기에 수력발전기로 전력생산을 구성하는 전력생산제조부와,이중구조바지선으로 건설기계를 이동 투입하는 건설기계의 교통운송부와,선박과 우주로켓을 구비해 핵폐기물을 분배하여 배출을 구성하는 핵폐기물동력전달부와,온도감지센서를 구비해 원전가동 설비안전을 위한 통제관리생산전장부와,전자제어조절장치를 구비해 전자제어조절을 위한 전자제어조절장치 건설기계조절부와,지주탱크의 수직수평 조절을 위한 전자제어조절장치와 결합을 구성하는 나사조절부와,냉각수를 믹서기계로 혼합한 황토혼합물을 구비해 재해를 차단하는 재해차단예방조절부와,냉각수 공급을 위한 유압굴착기를 구비해 심층수 용량 공급조절을 위한 지하수와 해양심층수 용량 공급조절부와,공유지 및 공유수면 매립처리조절부와,핵폐기물처리를 위한 인공위성과 우주로켓을 구비해 우주발전   및 핵 방사능 오염방지의 인공위성조절 부와,전자센서밸브를 구비해 이중구조 바지선 선체의 높낮이 조절을 위한 전자센서밸브 나사조절부를 구성하는 이중구조블록탱크집진기를 구비한 해양원자력수력발전소의 핵폐기물처리용 가압수형 원자로설비에 관한 것으로 
이러한 본 발명이 해결하고자 하는 기술적 과제는,핵폐기물처리용 해양원자력수력발전소의 원자로설비를 구성하는 이중구조블록탱크집진기를 구비한 해양원자력수력발전소의 핵폐기물처리용 가압수형 원자로설비에는, 
거센 풍랑 파도로부터 해양원자력수력발전소의 원자로설비의 원전가동 보장을 위한 해양원자력수력발전소는 해수면(S L L) 상단 40M 위치의 부양식독 선체갑판데크 상단부(S D U)로 설치하고,해양원자력수력발전소의 안전도를 위하여 0.5k m 간격 거리로 1개소에는 지주 블록탱크 교각들로 구비해 부양식독 선체 갑판데크에 구성하는 이중구조블록탱크집진기를 구비한 해양원자력수력발전소의 핵폐기물처리용 가압수형 원자로설비를 구성하며, 
해양원자력수력발전소 설비를 구성하는 부양식독 선체 갑판데크를 구비해 해수면(S L L) 상단부 핵폐기물처리장치 이중구조블록탱크 관 교량 해양터널교통장치와 연결위치 중간에는 고정식 부양식독 선체갑판데크 상단부(S D U)로 위치하는 해양원자력수력발전소와 항해선박의 비상대피소 구획을 위한 지주탱크 상단의 이중구조 바지선선체 선체갑판 상단부(S D U)에 위치하는 가이드 레일을 갑판데크 좌측과 우측으로 설치하고 5000톤 용량의 크레인(861)들을 갑판데크 가이드레일 위에 위치를 마련해 항해선박을 끌어올리는 항해선박의 비상대피소를 구성하고,무공해 전력공급을 위한 해양에서 원자력발전장치의 생산전력과 조류의 속도를 구비한 수력발전장치들로 구성하고,송전선 연결을 구비해 원자력수력발전설비부의 전력생산 제조부로부터 동력을 공급받아 산업현장으로 동력을 전달하는 동력전달부를 구비해 지구촌의 각 지역으로 전력생산 공급을 마련하고, 
상기 핵폐기물처리용 해양원자력수력발전소의 원자로설비 본체 내부로 구성하는 송전선 연결을 구비해 전력 공급라인이 핵폐기물처리장치 이중구조블록탱크 관 교량 해양터널교통장치와 연결되는 송전선 연결을 구비한 지역으로 전력공급을 재개하면서 핵폐기물처리용 가압수형 원자로설비 본체 내부로 구성하는 해상철구조물에는 핵 폭탄에서부터 재래식 전쟁물자 일체를 유엔안전보장 회원국 합의 일체로 핵 폭탄의 폐기처분을 마련하고,육지에서는 어떠한 명분으로도 핵 물질을 상호 각국은 보유할 수 없도록 마련한 규정을 구성하며, 
핵폐기물처리용 가압수형 원자로설비를 구성하는 해양원자력발전소 주변에 위치하는 핵보유국 다수의 국가는 전쟁과 테러방지를 위한 핵폐기물처리용 가압수형 원자로설비 본체 내부로 구성하는 핵폐기물처리 연결구조물 이중구조블록탱크 관 교량 해양터널교통장치에는, 
인공위성발사대와 우주로켓발사대 위치로 핵폐기물처리장치를 마련하는 인공위성과 우주로켓을 핵폐기물의 탑재를 구비해 핵폐기물처리를 마련하고,기상예보 관측용 기상예보관측소의 일기예보를 발표해서 자연 발생적인 태풍,지진,해일,산불,황사와 화산 폭발 전후 시의 화산재 발생의 피해를 기상예보 관측용 기상예보방재장치로 자연재해를 사전에 방지하며, 
홍수가뭄을 사전예방을 구성하는 해양터널교통장치에는, 
상기 해양터널교통장치를 구성하는 해저선로 분사노즐 연결구와 해저선로 분사노즐에 해저선로배선이 마련되며 핵폐기물처리 이중구조블록탱크 해양터널교통장치를 구비해 생산전력에너지를 핵폐기물처리장치에 선 제공을 마련하고, 
이중구조블록탱크집진기를 구비한 해양원자력수력발전소의 핵폐기물처리용 가압수형 원자로설비를 구성하는 해양원자력수력발전소에는, 
우주과학 발전장비를 구비해 심해저 광물자원과 천연가스 에너지자원을 탐지하고 그 후 석유에너지 굴착장비를 투입해 심해저 광물자원과 천연가스 에너지자원 생산을 마련하며,풍력발전기와 수력발전기의 생산전력을 변전소의 변압기와 송전선을 구비해 지구촌에 공급을 이루도록 구성하고,핵폐기물처리용 이중구조블록탱크 관 교량 해양터널교통장치의 연결구조물들로 구비해 해양원자력수력발전소를 마련하고,해양선박을 대체하는 교통장치설비의 안전운항을 위한 밧데리를 구비해 전력에너지를 선 제공을 마련하고, 
상기 전력에너지를 선 제공을 구성하는 원자로설비 가동중지와 원자로설비 폭발 전 후 시를 대비하여 기존의 원자로 제4벽 격납용기 둘레면에 이중구조블록탱크집진기를 구비해 원자로설비 가동 중지를 없애고 지속적인 원자로설비의 폭발방지를 이루도록 제4벽 격납용기 둘레면에 이중구조블록탱크집진기를 구성하는 이중구조블록탱크집진기를 구비한 해양원자력수력발전소의 핵폐기물처리용 가압수형 원자로설비에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Active emergency exit device
title_ko: 액티브 비상구 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an active emergency exit device, which is the active emergency exit device disposed at a predetermined interval in a specific place to indicate the location of an emergency exit and guide the emergency exit direction. The emergency exit device includes: a disaster occurrence detection unit for detecting the occurrence of a disaster in the specific place; a disaster occurrence notification unit for propagating the occurrence of the disaster to other emergency exit devices through the network; and an emergency escape processing unit providing a notification regarding the occurrence of the disaster to at least one user terminal and providing an evacuation route which is dynamically generated based on feedback on the notification for a user to emergency escape.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 액티브 비상구 장치에 관한 것으로, 특정 장소에서 소정의 간격으로 배치되어 비상구의 위치를 표시하고 비상 탈출 방향을 안내하는 비상구 장치에 있어서, 상기 특정 장소에서의 재난 발생을 검출하는 재난 발생 검출부, 상기 재난 발생을 네트워크를 통해 다른 비상구 장치로 전파하는 재난 발생 알림부 및 적어도 하나의 사용자 단말에게 상기 재난 발생에 관한 알림을 제공하고 사용자의 비상 탈출을 위해 상기 알림에 대한 피드백을 기초로 동적으로 생성되는 대피경로를 제공하는 비상 탈출 처리부를 포함한다.

title_en: Short-term practical scheduling method for super-large-scale hydroelectric station group
abstract_en: A short-term practical scheduling method for a super-large-scale hydroelectric station group, belonging to the field of hydroelectric scheduling and operation. In the method, all hydroelectric stations are divided into three types according to scheduling features such as system levels, spatial attributes, task requirements and particularity of plans, a peak adjustment response based surplus water correction strategy and a valley-hour load balance and cutdown strategy are proposed, realizing the check analysis and contribution adjustment for power stations under a fixed scheduling mode. For small and medium-sized basin cascaded hydroelectric stations, taking a total contribution process as a control condition, and for the goal of minimum water consumption, load distribution between cascaded hydroelectric stations is optimized; and for large-scale basin cascaded hydroelectric stations, a peak adjustment scheduling model is constructed, and an equal load rate scheduling method for balancing power stations is proposed, so as to realize system peak adjustment response and full-time load balance. The method can quickly give a rational hydroelectric scheduling result, satisfying the timeliness and practicability requirements of actual operation of a power grid and providing a new technological approach for efficiently solving super-large-scale hydroelectric system scheduling.

title_en: Method and apparatus for propagating public safety multicast and broadcast services among public safety personnel
abstract_en: Public safety user equipment (PS UE) that establishes a first wireless communication channel over a primary network to at least one multimedia multicast or broadcast service management entity and establishes one or more alternative wireless communication channels over one or more alternative networks ( 310 ). The public safety user equipment receives at least one multimedia multicast or broadcast service message over the first wireless communication channel ( 320 ). Then, the PS UE extracts data contained in the multimedia multicast or broadcast service message and storing the data in a local cache ( 330 ). The PS UE receives a cache request from the one or more user equipment over one or more alternative wireless communication channels ( 340 ) and then the PS UE transmits the stored data to the one or more PS user equipment ( 350 ).

title_en: Blind Fast Network Synchronization Algorithm for Reducing LTE Public Safety Product Costs
abstract_en: Systems and methods are provided for providing blind fast network synchronization for reducing LTE public safety products costs, comprising, in one embodiment: determining if location setup is required to mitigate timing offset due to propagation delay from the synchronization source and adjusting downlink timing, and when location setup is required then providing one of manual setup in terms of timing samples, limited power RACH based on SIB2 parameters, and based on observed time difference of arrival and position reference signal; coordinating network listening periods based on graphs and hash function to avoid common silence for two or more neighboring eNodeBs; and providing continuous synchronization using blind carrier estimation.

title_en: Systems and methods relating to effective management of fluid infrastructure
abstract_en: Fluid stream management systems and methods are described. An exemplar fluid stream management system includes a neural network connected to a cascading treatment processor. The neural network calculates an initial distant flow condition attribute value for a distant fluid treatment facility. The cascading treatment processor using hydrological information and the initial distant flow condition attribute value computes a predicted modified contribution value for the distant fluid treatment facility. The cascading treatment processor instructs multiple fluid flow controllers, each of which controls the operation of a flow-directing device such that a sum of the predicted modified total load value and a real time total load value of the distant fluid treatment facility is minimized. The real time total load value of the distant fluid treatment facility is based upon real time measurements obtained from one or more of the distant fluid treatment facility sensors.

title_en: High-risk cascading failure accident chain searching method for power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-risk cascading failure accident chain searching method for an electric power system. At present, the accident chain model based on the complex network theory ignores the unique characteristics of the power grid such as the electrical characteristic, the operating characteristic and the tidal current characteristic, and is not completely suitable for the safety and stability analysis and control of the power grid. Based on an accident chain model, considering the existing two-prevention and three-prevention configuration conditions, the invention provides a key element protection control action evaluation index for quantifying the uncertainty factor of key element protection control, calculating the action probability of the key element protection control under the critical condition, and determining the subsequent events of a cascading failure accident chain; in addition, according to the protection control action probability and the control cost required after the action, the risk of the accident chain is evaluated, the high-risk cascading failure accident chain is screened, and an analysis basis is provided for preventing cascading failure blackout.

title_en: Power distribution network line risk assessment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network line risk assessment method, which comprises the steps of calculating scores of screening factors by adopting a principal component method according to historical fault data of a power distribution network line fault unit through stepwise regression screening indexes, converting score values and bringing the score values into an EMLR algorithm for machine learning to obtain a risk value calculation model of the power distribution network line fault unit, then popularizing the risk value calculation model by using a BP (back propagation) neural network, and finally importing test data into the neural network calculation model to realize prediction and assessment of the risk values of the line units; through integrating and analyzing the existing power distribution network line data, the digitization and the visualization of the risk degree of the power distribution network line are realized, and the purposes of differential operation and maintenance of risk line units, targeted engineering transformation and safe production are achieved. Through the prediction of the risk, the target investigation of high-risk projects can be facilitated, the occurrence probability of power failure accidents is effectively reduced, and the power supply reliability of the power distribution network is improved.

title_en: Meteorological disaster-based power grid business risk assessment method, device and equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a method, a device and equipment for evaluating power grid business risk based on meteorological disasters. Comprising the following steps: acquiring operation statistical data of a power grid system; acquiring the occurrence probability of a set fault class in each subnet and the service interruption time length caused by the set fault class according to the operation statistical data; constructing an interrupt duration matrix between the set fault type and the service interrupt duration, and calculating a service loss vector according to the interrupt duration matrix and the service importance vector; calculating a first risk value according to the occurrence probability of the fault category set in each subnet and the service loss vector; the first risk value is adjusted according to the network scale coefficient, and a second risk value is obtained; and respectively sequencing the first risk value and the second risk value of each subnet to obtain a risk assessment result. The accuracy of the power grid business risk assessment can be improved, so that the assessment result has stronger objectivity and practicability.

title_en: Network attack damage degree quantification method for power system
abstract_en: The invention provides a network attack destruction degree quantification method facing an electric power system, which is characterized in that a network attack destruction degree quantification model is constructed based on an attack propagation probability representation method of a community structure; representing a dynamic evolution process of the network attack by the propagation of the network attack, constructing a power system penetration dependence attack graph, and determining an attack path set; designing a damage degree quantization model based on an attack path, determining an attack strategy set by constructing a network attack graph of the power system, respectively designing objective functions of an information layer and a physical layer, and constructing the damage degree quantization model by taking an attack strategy as conditional constraint; and finding an optimal strategy from the attack strategy set, and improving the artificial immune algorithm to realize model solution by utilizing a cross recombination operator to enhance the cooperation efficiency among antibodies. The method and the device realize the accurate representation of the network attack propagation probability in different conditions and at multiple angles, realize the numerical representation of the potential consequences of the network attack, and are favorable for accurately mastering the safety state of the power system.

title_en: Method and apparatus for propagating public safety multicast and broadcast services among public safety personnel
abstract_en: Public safety user equipment (PS UE) that establishes a first wireless communication channel over a primary network to at least one multimedia multicast or broadcast service management entity and establishes one or more alternative wireless communication channels over one or more alternative networks ( 310 ). Then, the PS UE extracts data contained in the multimedia multicast or broadcast service message and storing the data in a local cache ( 330 ).
