title_en: Based on the improved BP neural network life of storage battery prediction algorithm of genetic algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses BP neural network is optimized based on the improved BP neural network life of storage battery prediction algorithm of genetic algorithm, including with genetic algorithm；Existing life of storage battery forecast reason is used for reference, establishes index system；Using corresponding achievement data as training sample, the BP neural network after training；The life of storage battery is predicted with the BP neural network after training.The present invention combines genetic algorithm and BP neural network, genetic algorithm is a kind of global search optimized algorithm based on biomechanism, utilize the initial weight and threshold values of genetic algorithm optimization BP neural network, recycle error back propagation method to find its optimal solution, avoid the situation for being absorbed in Local Extremum.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY INFORMATION & TELECOMMUNICATION BRANCH;NANJING NARI INFORMATION COMM TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of Cascade Reservoirs release floodwatering facility combined operating control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of Cascade Reservoirs release floodwatering facility combined operating control methods, include the following steps：S1：Cascade Reservoirs Dispatching Flood theoretical research analysis；S2：Release floodwatering facility simplifies processing using the classified accounts of release floodwatering facility assembled scheme with digitlization；S3：Release floodwatering facility combines dynamic control technology.The advantage of the invention is that：Reservoir aerial drainage curve precision can be substantially improved；It is horizontal to promote reservoir spillway facility Precise control；Overcome the problems such as the low, heavy workload of release floodwatering facility control accuracy, is advantageously implemented the fining and intelligence of the control of reservoir spillway facility operation.

title_en: Tri-Training-Lasso-BP network-based static voltage stability margin prediction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Tri-Training-Lasso-BP network-based static voltage stability margin prediction method. The method applies technologies such as neural network, semi-supervised Training, ensemble learning and the like to the prediction of the static voltage stability margin of the power system, and provides an online prediction method based on a Tri-Training-Lasso-BP network, which consists of a three-body Training method (Tri-Training), a least absolute value shrinkage selection (Lasso) method and a BP (back propagation) neural network. The method can reduce the requirements on the quantity and quality of the data of the training set, give full play to the advantages of mass data acquired in the daily operation process of the power system, improve the generalization capability and prediction precision of the network, reduce manual intervention, and solve the problems that the traditional method is difficult to realize online real-time prediction of the voltage stability margin, needs a large number of training samples and is easy to generate overfitting.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: DI-SCIR-based double-layer coupling social network public opinion propagation model construction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a DI-SCIR (DI-social communication protocol-assisted link) based double-layer coupling social network public opinion propagation model construction method, which comprises the steps of firstly, based on a traditional SCIR model, considering dynamic time variation and direct immunization of the number of network users, and combining with real network public opinion propagation conditions to formulate public opinion propagation rules; secondly, an interlayer strong coupling connection method based on the LBRank is provided; and finally, according to public opinion propagation rules, state transition probability is provided, a differential equation of a public opinion propagation model is established, a final propagation model is generated, and the public opinion propagation process in the double-layer coupled social network can be effectively and accurately reflected.

title_en: Transformer substation grounding grid rapid modeling method suitable for CDEGS
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid modeling method of a transformer substation grounding grid suitable for CDEGS, which specifically comprises the following steps: according to conductor parameters and embedding depth in a design standard of a transformer substation grounding grid, transformer substation dimensions, grounding grid grounding resistance and soil resistivity obtained through actual measurement, calculating the initial size of an equivalent grounding grid by using a grounding resistance calculation formula, establishing the equivalent grounding grid in CDEGS software, calculating the grounding resistance of the equivalent grounding grid by using the software, changing the size of the equivalent grounding grid to enable the grounding resistance of the equivalent grounding grid to be continuously close to an actual value, and further obtaining a conductor structure of the equivalent grounding grid according with the actual grounding resistance. The invention lays a foundation for analyzing the electrical characteristics and the operating condition of the grounding grid under the influence of stray current, is beneficial to analyzing the characteristics and properties of the distribution rule, the propagation characteristics and the like of the stray current in a power grid system, and provides a basis for the prevention and treatment of the direct current magnetic biasing of the transformer and the structural corrosion of the urban power grid.

title_en: Multi-stage information physical cooperative recovery method for distribution network information physical composite fault
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-stage information physical cooperative recovery method for a distribution network information physical composite fault, which is realized in the following four stages: in the fault positioning stage, the fault coordinate data information of the composite network is positioned under the influence of extreme weather disasters on a power grid and a communication network; in the fault propagation stage, fault areas are propagated and divided in the power grid and the communication network according to faults; a fault isolation stage, which comprises the steps of recovering a communication network based on a Floyd algorithm in a fault area and operating a Remote Control Switch (RCS) to block a propagation path of a fault in the power network; in the non-failure area recovery stage, the communication network controls the remote control switch RCS to realize non-failure but no power supply area load recovery; the invention adopts CPS cooperative recovery strategy of information physical bilateral influence and fault processing multi-stage time sequence influence to minimize load loss and repair time to rapidly recover CPS fault.

title_en: Risk community identification method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application provides a risk community identification method, a device, equipment and a medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a risk number, wherein the risk number comprises a known fraud number and a number associated with the known fraud number; taking the risk numbers as entities, and constructing a relationship network map according to the association relationship among the risk numbers and the relationship weight among the risk numbers, wherein the relationship network map comprises the entities carrying the labels, the association relationship among the entities and the relationship weight among the entities; traversing each entity in the relation network map by adopting a label propagation algorithm so as to update the labels of the entities; and judging the cell in which the risk number corresponding to the entity carrying the fraud label is located in the updated relation network map as a risk community. The application constructs and updates the relation network map to determine the cell of the entity corresponding to the fraud label, thereby realizing the positioning and identification of the fraud label and improving the identification range and the identification accuracy of the fraud number.

title_en: Comprehensive power quality assessment method, system, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power systems, in particular to a comprehensive power quality assessment method, a system, computer equipment and a storage medium, wherein the comprehensive power quality assessment method comprises the following steps: based on the historical data of the power grid, the power factor of the power grid is simulated by combining time fluctuation, the power factor fluctuation driven by load change, power grid faults and power supply instability factors is analyzed, and a power factor fluctuation statistical model is generated. According to the invention, through analyzing historical data and time fluctuation of the power grid, the evaluation accuracy of the power factor and harmonic behavior of the power grid is improved, the electric energy quality of the power grid under various operation conditions is calculated and analyzed, the extremum and fluctuation range of the power factor are identified and predicted, the influence of the harmonic on the power grid quality is evaluated through simulating the generation, propagation and attenuation processes of the harmonic in the power grid in real time, and scientific data support is provided for evaluating the electric energy quality by combining with the stability of the power factor analysis, so that accurate fault prediction and quality control are performed.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST OF STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Flexible power grid regulation and control method and system based on wind, light and small hydropower
abstract_en: The application discloses a flexible regulation and control method and a flexible regulation and control system for a power grid based on wind, light and small hydropower, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing a head loss prediction model according to historical operation data of each hydropower station in the cascade small hydropower stations; constructing a target hydropower prediction model by using the photovoltaic power generation prediction model and the wind power generation prediction model; each hydropower station in the cascade hydropower stations is used as a bus topology node, a water flow line between each hydropower station is used as a data transmission line in a bus, and a bus topology diagram is constructed by the bus topology node and the data transmission line; and constructing an optimization objective function according to the head loss prediction model, the target hydropower station prediction model and the bus topological graph based on the minimum energy consumption and the minimum path overlapping rate, and outputting a hydropower station scheduling strategy. The application has the beneficial effects that: the dependence of hydroelectric power generation on a single path is reduced while the energy consumption is reduced, and the redundancy and stability of a power grid are improved.
assignees: JINHUA POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;SICHUAN ENERGY INTERNET RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF TSINGHUA UNIV

title_en: Flood disaster risk assessment method for infrastructure failure cascade
abstract_en: The invention relates to a flood disaster risk assessment method for infrastructure failure cascade, which comprises the following steps of constructing a traffic transportation network topology model of a research area, obtaining basic attributes of infrastructures in the research area, constructing a directed graph, constructing an infrastructure system model based on the directed graph and combining dependency relations among the basic attributes of the infrastructures, simulating flood conditions in the research area in real time, judging failure road sections based on flood simulation results and the traffic transportation network topology model, assessing infrastructure cascade failure conditions based on the failure road sections, the flood simulation results and the infrastructure system model to obtain failure conditions of all infrastructures, and assessing service states of the infrastructures during flood based on the failure conditions of all infrastructures to serve as risk assessment results. Compared with the prior art, the flood risk assessment method has the advantages of being more accurate and deep in flood risk assessment and the like.
assignees: SHANGHAI INST TECH;UNIV SOUTHERN SCI & TECH

title_en: Earthquake isolation and shock absorption system based on tree space layout form
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of earthquake prevention and disaster reduction, and provides an earthquake isolation and shock absorption system based on a tree space layout form. The system comprises a density gradient tree layout area, a periodic lattice tree array area, a target protection area and a buffer transition zone. The density gradient layout area is positioned at the front end of the system, the density of trees is gradually increased along the propagation direction of the earthquake waves and is used for realizing impedance smooth transition and guiding wave energy to enter the array area, the trees in the periodic array area are distributed at equal intervals to form a quasi-periodic elastic structure which is used for generating Bragg scattering band gap effect and reflecting and dissipating the earthquake waves in a specific frequency section, the target protection area is used for laying buildings or infrastructures to be protected, and the buffer transition area is arranged between the tail end of the array and the target area and is used for absorbing residual wave energy and reducing echo amplification effect. The application constructs a green, low-cost and sustainable natural shock isolation system, and has good earthquake wave control effect and engineering adaptability.

title_en: Power transmission line galloping risk early warning and system based on multi-physical-field fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power transmission line galloping risk early warning and system based on multi-physical-field fusion, which comprises the steps of firstly acquiring a multi-physical-field data set of a power transmission line galloping process, and generating a dynamic three-dimensional point cloud sequence through space-time alignment and three-dimensional gesture reconstruction; extracting dancing energy distribution characteristics, frequency spectrum characteristics and space track characteristics from the dancing energy distribution characteristics, fusing the dancing energy distribution characteristics, the frequency spectrum characteristics and the space track characteristics to obtain fused characteristic vectors, inputting the vectors into a physical constraint enhanced two-way long-short-term memory network, predicting a dancing evolution trend, outputting a combined prediction matrix of a dancing amplitude value and a frequency, inputting the matrix into a pre-trained risk propagation reasoning model, calculating a multi-level risk quantification index, generating a risk early warning prompt according to the index, and sending the risk early warning prompt to corresponding risk management equipment to realize the dancing risk early warning of the power transmission line. The method and the device can accurately predict the galloping evolution trend of the power transmission line, thereby accurately pre-warning the galloping risk of the power transmission line.
assignees: NANJING QIZHI ELECTRIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-scale photovoltaic power prediction method and system integrating numerical weather forecast and physical information neural network
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-scale photovoltaic power prediction method and a system integrating numerical weather prediction and physical information neural network, which relate to the technical field of photovoltaic power prediction, and the invention realizes rolling prediction of future meteorological parameters and horizontal radiation intensity through numerical weather prediction, combines quantile mapping and cascade correction of a time sequence mode attention neural network, and effectively improves the authenticity and stability of meteorological data; and then, through the combined modeling of the physical information neural network and the time sequence characteristic network, the weather and radiation data subjected to multi-level correction and conversion are deeply fused with the physical rule of the photovoltaic system, so that the high-precision prediction of the photovoltaic power is realized. The whole prediction flow has the automatic abnormal rejection and missing compensation capabilities, not only enhances the prediction robustness under complex weather conditions and extreme environments, but also optimizes the time sequence response and physical consistency of the photovoltaic power, thereby greatly improving the engineering applicability and the intelligent level of the system.

title_en: Vehicle network model modeling method and system under working condition of cutting magnetic force lines by pantograph
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vehicle net model modeling method and system under the working condition of cutting magnetic lines by a pantograph, and relates to the technical field of modeling, comprising the following steps of constructing a lumped tau-shaped circuit of a traction net in unit length based on self-impedance and earth admittance of a contact line, self-impedance and earth admittance of a steel rail and mutual impedance between the contact line and the steel rail; and cascading the lumped tau-shaped circuit with a unit length, taking dynamic electromotive force generated during train operation as an equivalent voltage source, connecting one end of the equivalent voltage source with a contact line which is in sliding connection with a pantograph in the chain lumped tau-shaped network model, connecting the other end of the equivalent voltage source with the roof end of the train model, and connecting the bottom end of the train model with a steel rail to obtain the train network model under the working condition that the pantograph cuts magnetic lines. The invention provides a modeling method of a train network model for cutting magnetic lines of force by a pantograph of a high-speed train, which can simulate and obtain the influence of the magnetic lines of force of the pantograph cutting on each line of a train and a traction power supply system under different running speeds of the train.
assignees: UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG;BEIJING INST ASTRONAUTICAL SYS ENG

title_en: Geological disaster risk intelligent pre-judging method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent pre-judging method for geological disaster risk based on deep learning, which relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and early warning, and can automatically perform high-precision alignment and feature extraction on monitoring data with different time-space resolutions such as optical remote sensing, radar measurement, laser point clouds and the like and different physical meanings through a depth feature extraction and attention weighted fusion mechanism to generate unified and information-rich characterization, thereby laying a solid data base for follow-up accurate prediction and overcoming the limitation of data splitting application in the traditional method; by constructing a space-time diagram taking the slope unit as a node and utilizing a concentration mechanism diagram convolution network introducing hydrologic directivity, the model can accurately describe the space propagation process of slope substances moving, accumulating and blocking a river channel along with a converging path under the rainfall condition, and meanwhile, the time sequence module effectively learns the influence of the past hydrologic state on the future evolution trend.
assignees: JIANGXI NATURAL RESOURCES DEV CENTER;JIANGXI MINERAL RESOURCES SUPPORT SERVICE CENTER

title_en: Disease and pest control management system and method for tree breeding
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disease and pest control management system and method for tree breeding, and relates to the technical field of tree breeding and seedling raising, wherein the method is characterized by collecting environment data and soil rhizosphere data by collecting multi-mode images of leaves and trunks of pinus massoniana young forests and video of leaf gnawing and clustered diffusion of pinus massoniana; the method comprises the steps of constructing a disease and pest identification model by utilizing a convolutional neural network, carrying out definite diagnosis on pine wood nematode diseases, masson pine caterpillars and monochamus alternatus, quantifying the occurrence area and the pest port density of each subarea, calculating the control demand index of the pine wood nematode diseases, comparing the control demand index with a threshold value, triggering corresponding control strategies, calculating the diffusion coefficient of the masson pine caterpillars, comparing the diffusion coefficient with a risk threshold value, formulating a control scheme, calculating the propagation coefficient of the monochamus alternatus, judging the propagation risk and giving the control strategies, and realizing the intelligent identification of the disease and pest, the quantification of the risk and the closed-loop control of the control strategies, thereby being beneficial to the control and scientific control and improving the disease and pest control efficiency and the forest stand health level of the masson pine young forest.
assignees: SICHUAN FORESTRY AND GRASSLAND INVESTIG AND PLANNING INSTITUTE SICHUAN FORESTRY AND GRASSLAND ECOLOG

title_en: Novel source load-oriented power distribution network sensitive data flow anomaly detection method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel source load-oriented power distribution network sensitive data flow anomaly detection method and system, which comprise the steps of defining a three-dimensional space of power distribution network data, fusing associated features by utilizing an associated fusion matrix, generating a fused feature vector, constructing three cross verification functions, mutually verifying different dimensions of time sequence, physics and topology by utilizing the three cross verification functions to obtain a verification error result, dynamically adjusting a weight coefficient in a comprehensive consistency measurement according to the historical verification error result, calculating the comprehensive consistency measurement according to the weight coefficient, judging that anomalies exist when the comprehensive consistency measurement exceeds a threshold value, creating a propagation model of anomaly data among different dimensions, and reversely solving the anomaly source by sparse optimization according to the observed deviations by utilizing the propagation model. The method can be used for rapidly locking the key abnormal nodes, and improves the operation and maintenance efficiency.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO RESEARCH INSTITUTE;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Cascade water wind-solar storage integrated scheduling method, system, equipment and medium for multi-energy complementary system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of control, and discloses a step water, wind and solar energy storage integrated scheduling method, a system, equipment and a medium for a multi-energy complementary system. The method comprises the steps of constructing a water-wind-solar-storage multifunctional complementary integrated model based on a river basin cascade hydropower station, transforming a conventional cascade hydropower station into a hybrid pumped storage power station, introducing water balance, pumping mutual exclusion and power constraint specific to hybrid pumped storage, performing upper-layer optimization with the aim of minimizing net load peak-valley difference of a power grid to generate a smooth initial net load curve, performing lower-layer optimization with the aim of minimizing comprehensive operation cost of a system based on the upper-layer optimization, comprehensively considering thermal power cost, new energy operation and maintenance cost, waste wind and waste light cost, ladder carbon transaction cost and energy storage cost, and finally verifying the effectiveness of the model through simulation experiments. The invention improves the system adjustment flexibility, new energy consumption capability and economic operation efficiency, and realizes the high-efficiency and low-carbon collaborative scheduling of the multi-energy complementary system.

title_en: Ground-floon-pen a two stoneyed bundle a road enection gang
title_ko: 1층과 2층 뭉치도로 건립도
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A construction drawing of a bundle road is provided to efficiently use a limited space by constructing a second story and to enable a driver to rapidly arrive at a destination by selectively operating lanes. CONSTITUTION: A construction drawing of a bundle road is composed as follows. Northbound columns, center columns, southbound columns are connected in a zigzag shape. A self-powered electrical generator is built. Emergency warning lights are arranged. Hot wire frames are buried in the ground in order to prevent a road from being cracked.
abstract_ko:
본 발명품은 1층 도로와 2층도로 한뭉치 도로 건립도로서대한민국의 땅은 한정되어 있는 실정에서 지역적으로 도로를 확장하고 새로운 도로를 건설 공사를 해야하는 오늘날에 1차산업 2차산업 3차산업의 균형된 발전을 이룩함과 동시에 도로를 확장하고 새로운 도로를 건설해야하는 우리의 과제가 주어집니다. 
     본 발명품은 교통안전 확보와 도로운행 혼잡을 미연에 방지하여 사망사고를 줄이는데 뜻을두었습니다. 
     본 설계도는 아름다운 자연을 살리면서 1차산업의 터전인 논·밭의 형질변경을 줄이고 교통의 발전을 도모할수 있는 2층도로 건립도가 절실히 요구되는 현실이 되고 있습니다. 확장해야 하는 도로에 많은 논·밭을 도로에 편입시키지 말고 2층도로 공사로 교통 문제점을 해결해야 할것이며 1층도로 신설공사 지역에는 100년앞을 내다보는 도로교통 발전의 일환으로 2층도로 건설공사를 후대에 할 수 있도록 터전을 마련하면서 1층도로공사를 시행 하도록 합시다. 
     ① 2층도로 바닥 기초기둥 도형이란? 
     도로 양쪽 가장자리에 사방 3m 폭 가로×세로로 터파기하여 철근을 깔고 사방 가로×세로 폭 1.5m로기둥을 세움과 도로중앙 가로 3m 세로양쪽3M 터파기와 철근을 깔고 기초 콘크리트 타설 중앙가로 1.5m 가로막대 기둥과 세로양쪽 1.5m×1.5m가로막대 기둥자리를 세울 양쪽 각각 3m폭 터파기를 해야합니다. 양쪽 3m중 중앙 1.5m×1.5m 세로 고정 막대 기둥을 세우게 됩니다.(상행선) 
     반대편 하행선 차도에는 상행선 기둥 자리와 기둥자리 중간 지점에 기둥자리 터파기를 함과 도로 중앙 기둥자리로 상행선 중간 기둥자리와 기둥자리 중간 지점에 기둥자리 터파기를 해야 합니다. 기둥자리에는 강관 또는 파일항타후 철근을 깔고 콘크리트 타설과 기둥을 세움과 가로세로 막대 고정후 상판을 깔고 도로 바닥 포장을 합니다. 
     터널을 통과하는 2층도로 에서는 터널 옆으로 새로운 터널을 뚫고서 2층 도로를 건설함과 1층도로위 2층 지점에 교차도로가 있을때 1km후방에서 서서히 다리 길이를 높게하여 2층 교차지점에서는 3층 높이로 도로가 통과할 수 있도록 한 후 차츰차츰 낮게 한후 1km지점에서는 2층 높이로 정상적으로 2층도로 건설 공사를 할 수 있도록 할 것. 강 육교 2층도로 공사로서 육교위 2층도로 공사를 할때는 육교도로 양쪽 끝부분에 기초다리 공사를 튼튼히 함과 육교중앙 도로를 기둥 폭 만큼 구멍을 브레이카로 뚫어서 기둥세움 2층 높이로 공사하는 공법과 기존도로 옆으로 새로운 육교도로 건설 공사 후 육교 끝부분 500m부근에서 2층도로 진입 정상적인 2층도로 공사를 시행공법이 있습니다. 2층도로 가장자리에서 손님이 탑승장소는 전부 엘리베이터로 오르내리게 함과 2층도로 건립은 조립식으로 공사하는 건설 공법입니다. 
     1.2층 전반에 공급되는 전기는 모두 자가발전소에서 발전 생산되는 전기를 공급하게 됩니다. 
     도로 상행선 가장자리에 3층.3색.거리표시 경고등을 250m에서∼500m까지 뒤의 차량에게 사고를사전에 알려주는 역할을 하게 됩니다. 하행선 가장자리도 똑같 이 상행선과 동일하게 설치하며 버튼 설치는 100m 거리 단위로 0m지점에 설치되어 있으며 안전장치인 휴즈박스 고장 경고등을 필히 설치함 연쇄충돌 사고를 예방하여 사망사고를 줄이는데 뜻이 있습니다. 3층 경고등 밑 부분은 파이프형 표면에 나사산 가공 2층 지붕에 구멍식 너트가공과 2층 경고등 밑부분에 파이프 식으로 표면에 나사산 가공 1층 천장에 구멍형속 너트 가공함. 도로 지하철이나 지하상가를 먼저 공사후 추운지방을 우선으로 눈이 많이오는 지방을 우선으로 도로굴곡. 경사가 많은 지방 도로를 우선으로 하여도로폭 3.5m중 열선틀 철근으로 제작 크기는 가로×세로 3m크기로 철근으로 제작후지정된 곳에 동파이프를 조립 파이프속에 넣고 캡에 고정함. 발열이 강한 니크롬선과같은 열선을 조립하여 도로3m폭으로 1차.2차.3차.4차선 도로까지 열선틀을 매설하게됩니다. 4차선까지 같은 배선으로 연결함과 배선으로 퓨즈박스도 설치해야 합니다. 고장시 3m폭으로 4차선까지 모두 터파기하여 철거후 다시 새것으로 교체매설함. 이렇게 계속 연결해 나가면서 매설하면 됩니다. 열선틀 공사를 함으로서 겨울철 동절기 결빙으로 인하여 미끄럼 연쇄충돌 눈폭설 교통대란 차량전복등의 사고를 예방 사망사고를 줄이는데 뜻을 두었습니다. 니크롬선 최고의 열기온도가 높고 낮음에 주석합금 동파이프 굵기와 두께와 주석합금을 결정함. 
     인도지하 양쪽벽 부품 조립도란? 
     도로인도 또는 가장자리에 3m∼3.5m폭과 깊이 3m∼5m깊이로 터파기하여 철근 콘크리트 타설옹벽 제작과 뚜껑 철근콘크리트 두께 30cm이상되게 제작하여 뚜껑은 6m∼10m길이 크기로 제작 크레인이나 기중기로 들어서 뚜껑을 덮게 됩니다. 지하벽  양쪽에 받침대 고정고리 각종 부품을 조립함. 지하바닥은 소형차량 레일을 깔것과 천장.조명등 CCTV를 설치하여 고장 유무를 관리소 모니터로 확인 하세요. 
     도로 차도에는 두번다시 터파기를 하지 못하며 공사시설 관리비는 공동으로 분담하고 공동으로 관리를 합니다. 공사후 내부조립 시에는 뚜껑을 개봉후 조립함. 지하차도 부품조립 공사는 도로차도 지하에 무질서하게 겹쳐지게 위험물등을 매설한 곳이라 부품 교체할 때 인건비도 많이들고 위험성도 크고 도로차도에 많은시설안전품도 매설하지 못하므로 새로신설되는 도로는 필히 도로안전 부품을 모두설치 매설후에 준공검사를 받게 합니다. 2층 도로 준공을 필한 고속도로에서는 1층도로 1차선은 고속버스 전용도로 2차선은 대형화물 전용도로 3차선은 중형화물차 전용도로 4차선은 긴급차량과 지역으로 출구도로 2층 고속도로에서는 1차선은 120km빠르기 승용차량선 2차선은 100km빠르기 승용차선 3차선은 80km빠르기 승용차선 경·소형 화물차량 4차선은60km빠르기 승용차겸 소형 화물차선 앞지르기 차량이나 차선 위반으로 진행방해 행위차량 지정된 차선외 차선진입 차량은 범칙금을 부과받게 됩니다. 
     종전에 1층도로 건설공사를 시행했던 원청이 2층도로 건설 공사를 함으로 1층과 2층 차량운행 숫자가 차이가 많이나게 됨으로 1층고속도로 건설공사를 시행한 원청업체가 2층고속도로 구간을 건설하게 되며 부득이한 사정으로 공사를 원청이 못할 때 공개입찰할것과 새로 신설고속도로 1층과 2층 공사는 공개입찰제입니다. 
     많은업체가 공사에 참여 짧은 구간공사로써 빠른 시일에 준공으로 안전사고를 예방합니다.

title_en: Bulk power grid critical circuits recognition methods based on FP-growth algorithm
abstract_en: The present invention proposes a kind of bulk power grid critical circuits recognition methods based on FP-growth algorithm, it is characterized by comprising the active incidence relation matrix of route is obtained using DC power flow algorithm, line disconnection probabilistic model is established based on operation of power networks state, Line Flow constraint condition and the active incidence relation matrix of route；Monte Carlo simulation is carried out to cascading failure based on line disconnection probabilistic model, generates cascading failure collection；Based on FP-growth algorithm, frequent-item is carried out to cascading failure collection, determines critical circuits.Route effective power flow generation minority routes jumpy can be identified and are controlled within failure short time early stage using technical solution of the present invention, be of great significance to the safe and stable operation for inhibiting cascading failure guarantee electric system.

title_en: Transmission quantitative analysis method and system for assembly characteristic deviation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transmission quantitative analysis method and a system for assembly characteristic deviation, which firstly measure the assembly characteristic deviation of different assembly units of an airplane with different numbers of frames to obtain the assembly characteristic deviation of each assembly unit; secondly, determining a transfer entropy according to the assembly characteristic deviation of the two assembly units; then constructing an assembly characteristic deviation transmission network model according to the assembly characteristic deviation of each assembly unit; and finally, carrying out quantitative analysis on assembly characteristic deviation transmission according to the transmission entropy and the assembly characteristic deviation transmission network model, determining topological relation among assembly deviation variables and indexes for measuring causality by using the transmission entropy, disclosing an assembly deviation propagation mechanism and a coupling rule of the complex structure product in a small-batch development mode, and realizing the assembly tolerance optimization of the complex structure product in a small-batch production mode.

title_en: Wind power prediction method based on fluctuation sequence classification correction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind power prediction method based on fluctuation sequence classification correction, which comprises the steps of 1 predicting a wind power reference value within N hours in the future by using a reference model, 2 dividing a power fluctuation process by adopting a characteristic clustering method, mining correlations between weather forecast errors and model generalization errors under different fluctuation sequences from an output power angle, 3 deducing power changes in the future time period by adopting a CNN-LSTM time sequence model 1 aiming at small fluctuation sequences with gentle output, combining the CNN-LSTM time sequence model 2 and a counter propagation neural network interaction correction double-layer error aiming at non-small fluctuation sequences, and 4 combining the reference power correction result again according to time sequence as final wind power output. The invention adopts a composite method combining time sequence analysis and feature learning, realizes that features are extracted from multiple dimensions to correct errors, and conforms to the actual error distribution rule, thereby ensuring that the model has good accuracy.

title_en: Problem data processing method and system for distribution network engineering management
abstract_en: The invention provides a problem data processing method and system for distribution network engineering management, which specifically comprise the following steps: determining a problem information transmission path corresponding to the first power monitoring information in the digital twin distribution network model, and taking each node in the problem information transmission path as a target screening node; acquiring all other distribution network equipment connected with the target screening node in the problem information transmission path to generate a twin node topological graph, taking all other distribution network equipment as auxiliary screening nodes, classifying the auxiliary screening nodes corresponding to the target screening nodes according to the twin node topological graph, and acquiring a verification screening set corresponding to each target screening node; sequentially traversing each target screening node in the node screening sequence, and screening according to a verification screening set corresponding to each target screening node to obtain the problem data; and processing the problem data based on an information cascade strategy and a preset twin strategy database to obtain corresponding processing data.

title_en: Reservoir group multi-energy complementary scheduling method and system for coping with uncertainty of new energy
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reservoir group multi-energy complementary scheduling method and system for coping with uncertainty of new energy. The method comprises the steps of firstly collecting a long-sequence scene set of historical output and predicted output of new energy, generating a future actual output expected scene based on analysis of new energy output errors according to the long-sequence scene set, secondly constructing a scheduling model which is integrated with decision variables, objective functions, constraint conditions and the like of a coupling cascade hydropower station and the new energy output scene, then solving by adopting a high-performance self-adaptive population evolution algorithm according to hydropower station water regime information and the new energy output scene, quickly obtaining a multi-energy complementary scheduling scheme meeting operation requirements, and finally continuously updating a new energy historical prediction and actual output database to form a long-term and rolling multi-energy complementary scheduling scheme decision system. The method can comprehensively consider the uncertainty factor of the new energy, improve the reliability of the multi-energy complementary scheduling scheme of the cascade reservoir group, reduce the running risk of the power grid and has remarkable comprehensive benefit.

title_en: Forest fire risk prediction method based on graph convolution neural network
abstract_en: The invention provides a forest fire risk prediction method based on a graph convolution neural network. By establishing a characteristic representation method and a graph construction technology suitable for geospatial data and combining a graph convolutional neural network (GCN) which is a deep learning technology focusing on a graph structure, comprehensively considering the influence of weather, topography and vegetation space-time data characteristics of adjacent areas of a prediction target area on fire occurrence and propagation, a novel method which is different from a method for predicting forest fire risk by considering only the space-time data characteristics of the prediction target area is formed, so that a forest fire occurrence rule is better understood, and a technical approach is provided for realizing more accurate forest fire risk assessment.

title_en: Method, system, electronic equipment and medium for predicting residual life of intelligent ammeter
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a system, electronic equipment and a medium for predicting the residual life of an intelligent ammeter, which are suitable for the technical field of intelligent ammeters and can improve the accuracy of predicting the residual life and the fault probability of the intelligent ammeter. The method comprises the following steps: according to the application environment data, the factory verification data and the characteristic values of the correlation coefficient matrix of the real-time monitoring data of the intelligent electric meter, determining the accumulated contribution rate of each related data of the intelligent electric meter and a main parameter sequence affecting the residual life of the intelligent electric meter, inputting the main parameter sequence into a transformation neural network and a counter-propagation neural network, training a model for predicting the residual life of the intelligent electric meter, and obtaining the residual life predicted value of the intelligent electric meter based on the model.

title_ko: 빗물 차 집 필터
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 빗물 저장시설에서 빗물을 차 집 할 때 사용하는 방법으로서 더욱 상세하게는 빗물을 차 집 할 때 비가 적게 오거나 초기 빗물 속에는 이물질이 많아 이 초기 빗물을 버리고 이물질이 빗물과 같이 씻겨 내려가고 빗물의 양이 많아지면 수위센서가 감지하여 초기빗물차단문을 열어 빗물유입관으로 들어오는 빗물을 1차 거름망에서 이물질을 제거하고 차 집을 한 후 속 거름망에서 한번 더 거른 다음 이물질을 침전 실에서 최종 침전을 하고 저장탱크로 보내어 빗물을 저장할 때 사용하는 빗물 차 집 필터의 방법으로서 
빗물을 저장하여 사용하면 홍수를 예방하고 상수원을 공급할 때 사용하는 에너지를 절약하여 경제적인 파급효과는 물론 환경보전에서도 획기적인 파급효과가 있는 줄 알면서도 시설비가 많이 소요되고 유지관리가 어려워 지금까지 시설을 외면하여 왔다. 
그러나 세계적으로 홍수가 자주 발생하고 또한 우리나라는 유엔에서 정하는 물부족국가 이여서 최근에는 정부차원으로 빗물을 저장하여 사용하는데 많은 지원이 있어 많은 지방자치단체에서 빗물저장을 의무화하는 조례를 만드는 준비를 하고 있는 것으로 조사되었다. 
빗물저장시설에서는 가장 시급한 것이 빗물저장탱크로 이물질이 유입되는 것이다  이물질이 유입되면 아무리 좋은 시설을 하여도 그 시설은 무용지물이 되어 버리고 또한 유지관리 면에서도 많은 비용이 소요되어 빗물저장으로 인한 경제적인 효과가 없어 시설을 하였다 하더라도 경제적인 효과가 없으면 가동을 하지 않을 것이다.  
이에 본 발명의 빗물 차 집 필터를 개발하여 빗물 차 집 시에 이물질을 제거하고 빗물을 저장하면 유지관리 면에서는 물론 환경보전에서도 획기적인 파급효과가 있을 것이다.

title_en: Seismic vibration isolation system for building, and method for constructing this same
title_ko: 건축물 기둥용 면진 시설물 및 이의 시공 방법
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 건축물 기둥용 면진 시설물 및 이의 시공 방법에 관한 것으로, 지진 시 지반과 기둥의 원활한 분리 거동을 통해 지반의 거동이 기둥으로 전파되는 것을 막아 기둥의 흔들림과 건축물의 붕괴를 막아주는 것을 목적으로 한다. 
본 발명에 의한 건축물 기둥용 면진 시설물은, 지반에 안착되며 지중에 정착된 앵커를 통해 고정되어 지반과 함께 거동하는 거동판(11)과; 상기 거동판의 위에 설치되어 상기 거동판과 함께 거동하는 다수의 볼 트랜스퍼(12)와; 상기 기둥의 하단부에 고정되어 상기 볼 트랜스퍼 위에 올려지며 상기 거동판과 상기 볼 트랜스퍼의 거동이 기둥에 전파되는 것을 차단하는 거동흡수판(13)과; 상하 양단부가 상기 거동흡수판과 상기 거동판에 각각 연결하는 링크(14)를 포함한다. 본 발명은 지반에 상부를 향해 개방 형성되며 덮개를 통해 밀폐되는 기둥 설치홈(20)을 포함하며, 상기 기둥은 저부가 상기 기둥 설치홈 안에 삽입 설치된다.

title_en: Apparatus for disseminating an emergency situation based on network separation and method therefor
title_ko: 망 분리 기반의 비상 상황을 전파하기 위한 장치 및 이를 위한 방법
abstract_ko: 비상 상황을 전파하기 위한 장치는 감시영상장치로부터 현장 영상을 수신하면, 학습된 가중치로 연결되는 복수의 계층을 포함하는 검출망을 통해 상기 현장 영상에 대해 복수의 계층 간 가중치가 적용되는 복수의 연산을 수행하여 현장 영상의 상황이 정상 상황인지 혹은 비상 상황인지 여부를 확률로 나타내는 출력값을 산출하고, 상기 확률이 현장 영상의 상황이 비상 상황임을 나타내면, 해당 현장 영상을 비상상황영상으로 검출하는 검출부를 포함한다.

title_en: Power distribution management system
title_ko: 전력 분배 관리시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a power distribution management system and, more specifically, to a power distribution management system capable of managing meter reading data for each household online by measuring distribution power through an auxiliary meter arranged according to the number of households living in a specific building. To this end, the power distribution management system comprises: a main meter arranged to measure the total supply power; at least one auxiliary meter continuously distributed and connected from the main meter and arranged to measure the distribution power distributed from the total supply power; and a relay device deriving meter reading data for each household based on the total supply power and the distribution power, encrypting the meter reading data for each household using a public key, and wirelessly relaying the encrypted meter reading data for each household through a network, wherein the relay device is arranged in any one meter, in which a radio interference signal corresponds to a minimum value, among the at least one auxiliary meter.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 전력 분배 관리시스템에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는, 특정 건물에 입주한 세대수에 따라 배치된 보조계량기를 통해 분배 전력을 계측하여 세대별 검침데이터를 온라인으로 관리할 수 있는 전력 분배 관리시스템에 관한 것이다. 이를 위해, 전력 분배 관리시스템은 전체 공급 전력을 계측하도록 배치된 메인계량기, 상기 메인계량기로부터 연속적으로 분배 연결되고, 상기 전체 공급 전력으로부터 분배되는 분배 전력을 계측하도록 배치된 적어도 하나의 보조계량기 및 상기 전체 공급 전력과 상기 분배 전력에 기초하여 세대별 검침데이터를 도출하고, 상기 세대별 검침데이터를 공개키를 통해 암호화하여 네트워크를 통해 무선으로 중계하는 중계장치를 포함하고, 상기 중계장치는 상기 적어도 하나의 보조계량기 중 전파간섭신호가 최소값에 해당하는 어느 하나의 계량기 내부에 배치된다.

title_en: Intelligent disaster recovery for database connection failures
abstract_en: Embodiments of the invention provide techniques for disaster recovery in the event of a database connection failure. In one embodiment, a network address for a secondary server may be stored in multiple data objects of a client computer. In the event of a failed connection to a primary server, the network address of the secondary server may be retrieved from one of the data objects stored in the client computer. When an updated network address for the secondary server is received, it may be propagated to the data objects of the client computer.

title_en: A kind of power network weakness zone on-line identification method
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a kind of power network weakness zone on-line identification method, for solving, existing power network weakness zone discrimination method is no and Real-Time Power System Operation States are associated, it is often on electric network composition or weakness zone of the power network under certain malfunction that it, which picks out the power network weakness zone come, is not the technical problem of the weakness zone under current electric grid running statu.A kind of power network weakness zone on-line identification method of the embodiment of the present invention includes：Operation of power networks state is obtained from current EMS system, and cascading failure emulation is carried out by OPA models of having a power failure on a large scale, and receives preset fault set；The load loss of current failure is counted, each node accident of current failure or event class is judged, and counts current failure dead electricity nodes, excision circuit number, current failure disaster degree, risk factor is calculated；By each node accident or event class of current failure, current failure disaster degree, risk factor, the accident or event harm value of each node of current failure are calculated.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CENTER OF GPGC

title_en: Risk propagation information evaluation method, risk propagation information evaluation system, storage medium and computer equipment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of enterprise information query, and discloses a risk propagation information evaluation method, a system, a storage medium and computer equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining information of a storage target enterprise and related parties thereof, and constructing a multi-level and multi-classification related party database; extracting data from the database of the related party according to the database of the related party, and constructing a multi-level relational network based on the target enterprise; each entity on the relationship network inspects the basic credit worthiness condition and gives a quantized score; and applying a propagation model based on a complex network, giving a driving risk propagation event, analyzing a risk propagation process, and realizing the risk intensity quantification of the target enterprise and the associated party thereof. According to the method, a relationship network of a social association network is established, and a large amount of transaction industry backgrounds are combined, so that when risk change occurs to a certain enterprise on the relationship network, a risk propagation model is applied to quantify a risk propagation process and risk strength, and risk evaluation of a main body to be listed is achieved.

title_en: Urban rail transit epidemic propagation risk quantitative evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for quantitatively evaluating urban rail transit epidemic propagation risks, which comprise the following steps: taking each urban rail transit station as a center, acquiring cell distribution data of peripheral traffic hubs, hospitals and confirmed or suspected cases; calculating station-level epidemic propagation risks of all stations according to the passenger flow congestion degree of urban rail transit stations, distribution data of peripheral traffic hubs, hospitals and districts with confirmed or suspected cases and corresponding input risk values; calculating the line level epidemic propagation risk passing through each station according to the station level epidemic propagation risk of each station; and calculating the overall network epidemic propagation risk of the rail transit line according to the station level epidemic propagation risk of each station. The invention comprehensively considers factors such as land property and passenger flow scale around the site, establishes a dynamic quantitative evaluation method for the propagation risk of the point-line-network multi-level integrated urban rail transit system, and provides quantitative basis for the refined and normalized epidemic situation prevention and control.
assignees: JINAN RAIL TRANSIT GROUP CO LTD;BEIJIAO INTELLIGENCE SHANDONG INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Cascade hydropower station long-term optimization scheduling model considering incoming water nonuniformity
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of hydropower dispatching operation, in particular to a cascade hydropower station long-term optimization dispatching model for considering water inflow nonuniformity. The invention aims at the hydropower stations with weak regulating capacity and low water heads in the cascade hydropower stations and the characteristic that the generating capacity of the low water head hydropower station is limited by the warehousing flow, fits the relationship between the warehousing flow and the generating output of each hydropower station and each month, and optimizes the load distribution among the cascade hydropower stations by taking the cascade generating capacity as the maximum target. Compared with the conventional method for carrying out long-term scheduling on the cascade hydropower station only by means of output coefficient calculation, the method can quickly give out a reasonable hydropower scheduling result and meet the requirements of timeliness and practicability of actual operation of the power grid.
assignees: GUANGXI GUIGUAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD HONGSHUIHE JIKONG CENTER;UNIV DALIAN TECH

title_en: Method, device, equipment and storage medium for predicting output current of synchronous generator
abstract_en: The application relates to a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for predicting output current of a synchronous generator. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring working state data of a current time point of a synchronous generator, wherein the working state data comprises d-axis voltage, q-axis voltage, excitation voltage and mechanical power input into the synchronous generator; inputting the working state data into a preset hybrid driving model, wherein the preset hybrid driving model comprises a cascade synchronous generator physical model and a neural network model; processing the working state data through the physical model of the synchronous generator to obtain initial predicted d-axis current and initial predicted q-axis current; and correcting the initial predicted d-axis current and the initial predicted q-axis current through the neural network model to obtain the predicted d-axis current and the predicted q-axis current of the synchronous generator. By adopting the method, the prediction accuracy can be improved, and the generalization capability of the model under different scenes can be improved.
assignees: CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID DIGITAL GRID RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Carbon emission prediction method and system based on improved long-term and short-term memory network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of energy consumption prediction, in particular to a carbon emission prediction method and system based on an improved long-short-term memory network, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring training data of a node, wherein the training data comprises a historical load sequence and a corresponding carbon emission factor; taking the super-parameters of the LSTM network as the variables of Bayesian optimization, training the super-parameters of the LSTM network according to the training data, and updating the super-parameters of the LSTM network by combining loss function evaluation and back propagation; determining sampling points of the next iteration based on Gaussian process regression, and iteratively training super parameters of the LSTM network to obtain a trained LSTM network; acquiring a real-time load sequence, and predicting carbon emission factors corresponding to the real-time load sequence on line by utilizing a trained LSTM network; the invention can rapidly predict the carbon emission factor.
assignees: FOSHAN RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF NORTHEASTERN UNIV

title_en: Automatic voltage control method for AC/DC hybrid power grid containing high-proportion new energy
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic voltage control method of an alternating current-direct current hybrid power grid containing high-proportion new energy, which is used for determining a calculation model of the dynamic reactive power reserve evaluation of the alternating current-direct current hybrid power grid according to the operation constraint condition of the dynamic reactive power reserve evaluation of the alternating current-direct current hybrid power grid; the method comprises the steps of taking the minimum dynamic reactive power reserve of an alternating current-direct current hybrid power grid as a target, and establishing a corresponding optimization model based on a calculation model of the dynamic reactive power reserve evaluation of the alternating current-direct current hybrid power grid; and then solving an optimization model of the AC-DC hybrid power grid dynamic reactive power reserve estimation according to whether the operation constraint conditions of the AC-DC hybrid power grid dynamic reactive power reserve estimation are linear or not by adopting different strategies, so as to obtain an optimization result of the AC-DC hybrid power grid dynamic reactive power reserve estimation. The method can rapidly determine the boundary of the dynamic reactive power reserve of the alternating current-direct current hybrid power grid on the premise of ensuring the calculation precision of the dynamic reactive power reserve, and provides conditions for real-time online application, thereby helping to avoid cascading failures and voltage breakdown.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV CHONGQING

title_en: Vulnerability assessment of power information physical system based on improved structural entropy
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power systems, in particular to vulnerability assessment of a power information physical system based on improved structural entropy, which comprises the following steps: s1, constructing a power network and information network coupling network model; s2, monitoring and optimizing scheduling of power grid tide conditions; s3, analyzing vulnerability of the electric power information physical system by using improved structure entropy judgment; s4, establishing a cascading failure model to analyze vulnerability of the power information physical system. According to the invention, the coupling relation between the power network and the information network in the power information physical system is modeled, and the dynamic process of cascading faults can be reflected by combining the system power flow characteristics in the cascading fault model, so that the actual situation can be better simulated; the method can overcome the limitation of the entropy index of the single-layer network structure, can identify the influence of important nodes on the vulnerability of the system, and lays a foundation for the reasonable distribution of subsequent defense resources.

title_en: Interphone relay management method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of wireless communication, in particular to a method and a device for managing interphone relay, which comprise the following steps: based on the environment monitoring equipment, the topography and the environment data of the relay station are collected, the attenuation degree of the interphone signal under various environments and transmission distances is analyzed and calculated, and a signal attenuation analysis result is obtained. According to the invention, the influence of various environmental factors and transmission distance data on signal attenuation is analyzed, the signal gain and frequency are adjusted in real time, the signal compensation parameters are calculated, the signal transmitting power and the signal propagation path are adjusted, the signal transmission quality and the communication stability are improved, accurate and rapid signal transmission is realized in a complex and wide coverage area, the overall quality and the coverage area of the signal are enhanced, the communication access priority is adjusted by analyzing the equipment characteristics and the communication behaviors, the emergency communication requirement is responded quickly, the efficiency and the response speed of a communication system are improved, and the adaptability and the reliability of a radio communication network are enhanced.
assignees: QUANZHOU HENGLUDA ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for supporting brain-like simulation model learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for supporting learning of a brain-like simulation model, wherein the method comprises the steps of managing all parameters in the brain-like simulation model, classifying the parameters into fixed parameters, variable parameters, non-micro parameters and learnable parameters according to calculation characteristics, designing an approximate function operator library for the non-micro parameters, integrating the library into the system, designing an application rule of an approximate function, enabling the original calculation function of the non-micro parameters to be adopted in the forward calculation process of the model, calling the approximate function of the non-micro parameters to conduct differential derivation calculation in the backward propagation gradient solving stage, designing an approximate function call interface of the brain-like simulation model, replacing a non-differential calculation part in the model, and constructing a learnable brain-like simulation model network to conduct task learning training. According to the invention, through refined parameter management and combination of approximate function simulation gradient calculation, efficient learning and training of the brain-like simulation model are realized, and the method is successfully applied to complex classification tasks.
assignees: CHINA NANHU ACAD OF ELECTRONICS AND INFORMATION

title_en: Line load processing method, device, server and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a method and a device for processing load of a line, a server and a storage medium. Relates to the technical field of power distribution networks. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a load prediction request, and obtaining load data to be predicted according to the load prediction request, wherein the load data comprises weather condition data and date type data at least at one moment. And carrying out load prediction processing on the load data according to a preset back propagation neural network model to obtain a load prediction result of at least one moment, wherein the preset back propagation neural network model is trained according to weather condition data and date type data of a plurality of historical moments, and the load prediction result comprises load data of a preset line. And according to the load prediction result, carrying out adjustment processing on the load data of the line. The method is used for achieving the effect of reducing the occurrence of fault events caused by excessive line load.
assignees: HUIZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD;GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO

title_en: Digital twinning-based gastrointestinal peristalsis space-time simulation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a gastrointestinal tract peristaltic space-time simulation method based on digital twinning, which is characterized by abstracting a nerve muscle activation process of a gastrointestinal tract into a physiological excitation field, constructing a variable topological strain network of a gastrointestinal wall to form a functional contraction path, introducing a control equation set to enable the excitation field to embody fluctuation evolution in time and embody tension distribution in space to cause geometric deformation in structure, analyzing the behavior difference between a twinning body and a real gastrointestinal system by utilizing an error field, transmitting error feedback to excitation field parameters to realize closed-loop adjustment, fusing historical state data and current feedback, modeling peristaltic trend by adopting a time sequence diagram network, mapping a continuous peristaltic process into a space-time activity density map from fitting reality to predicting future behavior ability evolution, extracting activity mutation, peristaltic stagnation and reverse propagation characteristics of a key region by utilizing topological convolution, outputting semantic class indexes which are easy to understand, constructing a predictable peristaltic behavior model, and improving clinical visibility and auxiliary diagnostic value.

title_en: System for evaluating performance of disaster response system using boundary value by using expert evaluation
title_ko: 전문가 평가를 이용하여 재난대응시스템의 성능을 평가하는 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for evaluating the performance of a disaster response system. The system of the present invention includes a disaster response system and a performance evaluation device. The disaster response system includes: a data collection unit collecting disaster data including past disaster data, institutional disaster data collected or processed by an institution, and environmental facility disaster data measured at an environmental facility; and a system control unit generating a disaster situation propagation plan and a disaster response plan by disaster type from the past disaster data, the institutional disaster data, and the environmental facility disaster data, generating a disaster manual by matching the disaster type, the disaster situation propagation plan, and the disaster response plan and manualizing the disaster situation propagation plan and the disaster response plan, performing decision making corresponding to the disaster type when the disaster type is input, and outputting the disaster situation propagation plan and the disaster response plan in accordance with the disaster manual included in the decision making. The performance evaluation device includes: an input control unit inputting an input value including the disaster type to the disaster response system; an output control unit receiving an output value including disaster situation propagation plan and the disaster response plan from the disaster response system; an evaluation input unit receiving a scenario result generated by applying the input value to a disaster response scenario; and an evaluation determination unit evaluating the accuracy of the decision making by comparison between disaster situation propagation plan and the disaster response plan included in the output value and the disaster situation propagation plan and the disaster response plan included in the scenario result.

title_en: Minimization of service interruptions of core network failure
abstract_en: Techniques are disclosed for the minimization of service interruptions for core network failure. One example includes a method in which a disaster control function (DCF) receives, from an access and mobility function (AMF), an address of a base station managed by the AMF. The DCF detects an interruption of services provided by the AMF. The DCF transmits, to the base station and using the address, a message indicting the interruption of services provided by the AMF.

title_en: Optimal scheduling method for peak regulation of cascade hydro-photovoltaic complementary power generation system
abstract_en: Disclosed is an optimal scheduling method for peak regulation of a cascade hydro-photovoltaic complementary power generation system. The method includes: establishing an objective function of optimal scheduling for peak regulation of the cascade hydro-photovoltaic complementary power generation system; establishing a photovoltaic power station output constraint condition considering uncertainty; optimizing a mixed integer linear model by performing linear processing on the constraint condition; and obtaining a scheduling solution by solving the mixed integer linear model. According to the present disclosure, a unit commitment of a hydro-power station and an operational solution of a reservoir are considered, so that photovoltaic output can be consumed by fully using a characteristic that the hydro-power unit is easy to regulate, and a demand for peak regulation of a power grid can be satisfied.
assignees: HUANENG LANCANG RIVER HYDROPOWER INC;UNIV HOHAI;POWERCHINA GUIYANG ENGINEERING CORP LTD;HUANENG GROUP R&D CENTER CO LTD

title_en: City gas pipeline system failure propagation effect appraisal procedure and system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the present invention discloses a kind of city gas pipeline system failure propagation effect appraisal procedure and system, which comprises the network structure topological diagram of city gas pipeline system is established according to city gas pipeline system；Network model is established according to network structure topological diagram, network model includes the connection matrix of informational table of nodes, side information table and node；According to network model and constraint condition, the first flow pressure for obtaining city gas pipeline system normal condition distributes information；The simulating system failure in network model, and according to fault propagation rule and constraint condition, obtain the second flow pressure distribution information under city gas pipeline system is nonserviceabled；Compare first flow pressure distribution information and second flow pressure distribution information carries out fault propagation impact evaluation to city gas pipeline system.The system is for executing the above method.The embodiment of the present invention improves the accuracy of city gas pipeline system failure propagation effect assessment.

title_en: New energy scene generation method and system based on confrontation learning model
abstract_en: The invention relates to a new energy scene generation method and a system based on an antagonistic learning model, wherein the method comprises the following steps: generating a sample set for neural network training against a learning model and a label for each sample; constructing a discrimination network D and a generation network G; inputting the random vector z and the label of the sample into a generation network G to obtain a simulation sample G (z), and simultaneously inputting the simulation sample G (z), the real sample and the label of the sample into a discrimination network D; carrying out back propagation training on the neural networks of the generation network G and the discrimination network D, and carrying out iteration; and after iterative convergence, generating a network G to generate and output an optimized new energy operation scene. The method can solve the problems of single generated output parameter, inaccurate result, large quantity of simplified assumptions and the like of the traditional method, optimizes the new energy output parameter, and provides data basis and guarantee for random optimization operation control of the energy Internet.

title_en: Malignant data injection attack defense method based on multi-stage dynamic game
abstract_en: The invention provides a malignant data injection attack defense method based on multi-stage dynamic gaming, and relates to the technical field of power information physical systems. The method comprises the steps of firstly regarding a game process as a double game participated by both the attack and the defense, and regarding one action of both the attack and the defense as one stage of the attack and the defense game process; calculating node centrality to represent importance of different nodes of the power grid, taking the node centrality as a weight vector, and calculating the optimal load reduction amount of the power grid as benefits of both attack and defense parties; then calculating seepage propagation probability of malignant data propagated among grid nodes, and establishing a multi-stage attack and defense game model; finally, based on an improved Q learning algorithm, introducing different learning rates in each game stage, redefining a maximum profit calculation formula of both attack and defense parties, solving Nash equilibrium solutions in each game stage, judging whether the total stage gamma of attack and defense game prediction is reached, and if so, obtaining an optimal defense strategy; otherwise, proceeding next attack and defense game.

title_en: Method for producing a metal-organic framework for hydrogen storage in a hydrogen-fuelled vehicle
abstract_en: The present method relates to a metal-organic framework (MOF) algorithm for generating hydrogen for hydrogen fuelled automobiles. MOF structures are considered to consist of metal clusters, organic linkers and topological networks. The algorithm mainly comprises Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS), and is divided into 4 stages of selection, expansion, simulation and backtracking. Firstly, a path capable of generating a complete SMILES character string is obtained through a MCTS selection and expansion stage, then, according to the SMILES character string in the selected path, the next character of the current SMILES character string is predicted by using an improved GRU as a strategy network in a simulation stage to obtain a complete SMILES character string, namely an organic connecting group of MOF, then, MOF is constructed in Zeo++ by using a metal cluster, a topology network and the organic connecting group, and then, the hydrogen adsorption quantity of the constructed MOF is simulated by utilizing RASPA, wherein the adsorption quantity value is used as a rewarding value of the path selected by MCTS when the organic connecting group is generated. Finally, in the backtracking stage of the MCTS, the prize value is propagated backward and the information of the nodes in the path is updated. When the maximum hydrogen adsorption amount of the MOF remained unchanged for 7 hours, it was considered that the MOF having the best hydrogen adsorption performance was already obtained at this input.

title_en: Radio frequency identification network planning modeling method based on multistage cascade and supply chain layering
abstract_en: A novel radio frequency identification (Radio Frequency Identification, RFID) network planning (RFID Network Planning, RNP) modeling method based on multistage cascade and supply chain layering concretely comprises the following steps of firstly, obtaining a novel RNP communication link equation with multistage cascade characteristics according to connectivity between labels and readers, between adjacent readers and between readers and terminals, secondly, describing a novel RNP problem based on a supply chain structure, classifying roles of the readers, providing three brand-new link linking modes, and then constructing an RNP optimization target model around positioning precision, label coverage and forwarding hops. The novel RNP modeling method designed by the invention has certain guiding significance for deployment of readers and selection of links in large-scale RNP problems.
