title_en: Process node returning method used for intelligent power grid dispatching
abstract_en: The invention discloses a process node returning method used for intelligent power grid dispatching. The method comprises the following steps of setting and storing node returning treatment related information to a corresponding place in a database; enabling a process initiator to select a set circulation treatment process in the database and submit data; querying and obtaining information and node returning treatment authority of a current node from the database and determining whether returning is needed or not; and entering a next node if the returning is not needed or is impossible and repeating the aforementioned steps, or executing a node returning process according to the state of the current node if the returning is needed. According to the invention, by virtue of realizing the operation node returning in the power grid dispatching process, dynamically assigning the node returning place, and deleting completed nodes in a cascading manner, the process returning requirement in actual power grid services can be satisfied in a very good manner.
assignees: BEIJING KEDONG ELECTRIC POWER CONTROL SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Real-time cascade hydropower stations dispatching optimizing method under complex restrictions
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of power system planning and dispatching operation, and discloses a real-time cascade hydropower stations dispatching optimizing method under complex restrictions. According to the method, a real-time dispatching algorithm is introduced into day-ahead power generation plans, the maximum total storage energy of a cascade hydropower system serves as the optimizing target, and the requirements of real-time dispatching for safety, timeliness, practicability and economy are met. According to the technical scheme of the method, a mode that the hydropower station day-ahead power generation plans and plant-to-plant load deviation optimizing and distribution results are overlaid, real-time power generation plans are generated in a rolling mode, and unit vibration regions are avoided in real time. For a hydropower station with the abandoned water problem, a practical abandoned-water adjustment strategy is designed, the advantages of cascade hydropower station adjustment are adopted, reservoir predrainage is adopted, unnecessary abandoned water is avoided, and the utilization rate of water resources is improved. The method has the advantages that the future development of the power grid is predicted, and a solid theory foundation is provided for construction of real-time dispatching optimizing systems of cascade hydropower stations.

title_en: A kind of day Methods of electric load forecasting and prediction meanss
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of day Methods of electric load forecasting and prediction meanss, belong to power-system short-term load forecasting field, and method includes: for any t-th of moment in day to be predicted, to historical load data sampling in S days to obtain S the first load sequences；First load sequence is normalized, and obtains the target load sequence of every day in S days from normalization result；Effective influence factor sequence of every day and day to be predicted in S days are obtained respectively and are normalized；It is input with effective influence factor sequence after target load sequence and normalization, power load forecasting module of trained day predicts the load value at t-th of moment in day to be predicted for utilization；Day, power load forecasting module included cascade composite network and the second RBF neural, and composite network is made of side by side ELMAN neural network, BP neural network and the first RBF neural.The present invention can be improved the precision of prediction and data utilization efficiency to electric system daily load.
assignees: UNIV HUAZHONG SCIENCE TECH;STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Wind power project investment estimation method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a wind power project investment estimation method and a device, comprising the following steps: acquiring engineering characteristic factor data related to kilowatt investment of wind power unit; and inputting the engineering characteristic factor data related to the kilowatt investment of the wind power unit into a pre-trained error back propagation neural network model, and determining the estimated kilowatt investment of the wind power unit. The technical scheme provided by the invention improves the capability and accuracy of model optimization, further improves the precision and generalization capability of investment estimation, realizes the rapid and reasonable estimation of wind power project investment, provides scientific and objective basis for investment decision and project establishment, and has important social significance.

title_en: Urban rainstorm disaster risk assessment method and system based on GA (genetic algorithm) optimization BP (back propagation) neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a GA (genetic algorithm) optimization BP (back propagation) neural network-based urban rainstorm disaster risk assessment method and system, relates to the technical field of urban rainstorm disaster risk assessment, and aims to solve the problems that an evaluation mechanism is not visual enough, the reliability of an evaluation result is not enough, and real-time dynamic risk assessment is lacked in the currently adopted assessment method. The key point of the technical scheme is that a rainstorm disaster risk assessment system comprising disaster-causing factor danger, pregnant disaster environment sensitivity, vulnerability of disaster-bearing bodies and disaster prevention and resistance capability is established; generating a risk grade label based on the k-means clustering historical disaster damage data; constructing a GA (genetic algorithm) optimized neural network rainstorm disaster risk evaluation model according to the rainstorm disaster risk evaluation system and the risk grade label; and inputting the real-time rainfall into the rainstorm disaster risk assessment model to obtain a risk grade label in a specific time period. The invention achieves the effect of improving the comprehensiveness and accuracy of evaluation.

title_en: Wind power plant grid-connected performance evaluation system and method
abstract_en: The method comprises the steps of obtaining a plurality of three-level index semantic feature vectors by using a trained context encoder with an embedded layer according to obtained three-level index data, and cascading the three-level index semantic feature vectors to obtain a second-level index feature vector. After the secondary index feature vectors are respectively arranged into a two-dimensional feature matrix and a one-dimensional feature vector, a two-dimensional secondary index association feature vector and a multi-dimensional secondary index association feature vector are obtained through a trained first convolution neural network and a trained multi-scale neighborhood feature extraction unit and are fused to obtain a classification feature vector, and then a classification result used for representing a grid-connected performance grade label of the wind power plant can be obtained through a classifier. Particularly, the correlation characteristics among the indexes of different levels are extracted by using different receptive fields through a convolutional neural network and a multi-scale domain characteristic extraction module, so that the accuracy of index evaluation is improved.
assignees: HUANENG RENEWABLES CORP LTD;BEIJING HUANENG XINRUI CONTROL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power system toughness evaluation modeling method considering cascading overload fault occurrence under typhoon disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system toughness assessment modeling method considering cascading overload faults under typhoon disasters, and relates to the field of power system analysis. The method establishes two fault models of physical faults and overload faults caused by an extreme typhoon scene, and analyzes the internal relation between the space-time change of the fault probability of the power transmission line and the overload outage probability and the operation limit thereof; the method has the advantages that a two-dimensional time sequence fault model under typhoon continuous disturbance is built, the whole fault evolution process takes the fault occurrence time as a unique retrieval standard, and the precision of fault path retrieval is improved; and a power transmission system toughness evaluation model is established, the whole toughness of the system is quantized and a weak toughness line of the clamping system is identified, the capability of a power grid operator for accurately sensing the typhoon disaster coping of the power system is facilitated, and a targeted toughness improvement strategy is formulated. The research result of the invention can provide thought for the future typhoon disaster to effectively carry out toughness expansion and upgrading on the power transmission system and the establishment of operation control strategies.

title_en: DC multi-grid peak shaving model for cascade hydropower station group
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of hydropower dispatching operation, in particular to a DC multi-grid peak shaving model of a cascade hydropower station group, which is a multi-grid cascade short-term peak shaving dispatching model taking DC operation constraint and hydropower and DC coupling operation constraint into consideration. The model aims at the minimum maximum value of residual loads of multiple power grids, and considers the operation constraint of a complex high-voltage direct-current transmission line and the operation coupling constraint between the direct-current line and a hydropower station. In the model solving stage, the model is converted into a mixed integer programming model through objective function linearization, hydropower operation constraint linearization and direct current operation constraint linearization. The result of the research of a giant hydropower station group in southwest areas of China is taken as an example, and shows that the model can utilize the flexibility of sharing hydropower by a high-voltage direct-current transmission line, realize multi-grid peak regulation, ensure that the direct-current transmission line runs in a safe interval, and has better practicability.

title_en: Landslide image segmentation method based on multi-layer feature information fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide image segmentation method based on multi-layer characteristic information fusion, which specifically comprises the following steps: acquiring a landslide image data set, preprocessing the landslide image data set, and dividing the landslide image data set into a training set and a verification set; the landslide image semantic segmentation network model based on multi-layer characteristic information fusion is constructed, and the landslide image semantic segmentation network model comprises an encoder and a decoder, wherein the encoder comprises a main network, a cascading strip-shaped space pyramid pooling module and a high-efficiency channel attention module, and the decoder comprises a multi-layer characteristic information fusion structure; respectively training and verifying the network model by using the training set and the verification set, calculating a loss function, carrying out back propagation, and updating network model parameters to obtain a trained landslide image semantic segmentation network model; inputting the landslide image to be segmented into a trained landslide image semantic segmentation network model to obtain a segmentation result of the landslide image to be segmented. According to the invention, the detection capability of the landslide region is improved by enhancing the edge information of the landslide image.

title_en: Multi-objective cascade hydropower station optimal scheduling method and system based on multi-step return A3C reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-objective cascade hydropower station optimal scheduling method and system based on multi-step return A3C reinforcement learning, which are characterized in that a multi-objective reward function with adjustable dynamic weight is built by taking water level deviation minimization, power generation benefit maximization, flood control safety and ecological protection as collaborative optimization targets, future multi-step accumulated rewards are adopted as return for improving the A3C reinforcement learning, a long-term optimal scheduling strategy is generated through joint estimation of the future multi-step rewards and state values, water balance, water turbine output limit and ecological flow requirements are embedded into a reinforcement learning strategy network, the scheduling scheme is ensured to meet physical feasibility and safety constraint, and the weight coefficient of the reward function is dynamically adjusted according to real-time power requirements and ecological priority, so that a scheduling instruction of self-adaptive multi-objective balance is output.
assignees: FUJIAN HUADIAN FURUI ENERGY DEV CO LTD;UNIV FUZHOU

title_en: Fault evolution analysis method for power transmission and distribution-gas comprehensive energy system under extreme typhoon disaster
abstract_en: The invention provides a fault evolution analysis method of a power transmission and distribution-gas integrated energy system under an extreme typhoon disaster, which is characterized by calculating time-varying fault probability of a power transmission and distribution network element based on a mechanical stress model of typhoon-rain load, generating an initial breaking set through Monte Carlo sampling, identifying a serious overload line caused by power flow transfer and executing protection cutting through affine power flow calculation of power transmission and distribution network coupling, analyzing a power transmission and distribution-gas load shedding strategy by adopting a dynamic affine model, combining a natural gas pipe existence equation and an electric-gas coupling equipment operation constraint, quantifying the influence of power line breaking on pressure fluctuation and pipe existence change of a natural gas system, balancing overload power of a general overload line, processing a bilinear term, adopting rotary second-order cone relaxation to convert non-convex constraint, and quantifying the natural gas system fault propagation risk caused by power transmission and distribution line breaking and power transmission and gas load shedding by combining the coupling operation constraint of an electric drive compressor, a gas turbine and electric-gas conversion equipment.

title_en: Forest grass fire scene situation sensing system based on multisource remote sensing data and artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a forest fire scene situation awareness system based on multi-source remote sensing data and artificial intelligence, which is characterized by comprising a data acquisition module, a space-time analysis module, a decision optimization module and a decision-making module, wherein the data acquisition module acquires multi-source satellite original data streams, acquires forest fire scene data with unified space-time reference through automatic calibration and geometric correction preprocessing operation, the space-time analysis module automatically extracts fire scene element entities through an optimized space-time sensing element learning extractor based on the forest fire scene data to construct an entity space-time position mapping table, the decision-making module defines graph nodes of a graph neural network based on the entity space-time position mapping table, acquires potential association score among the nodes, constructs an edge set of the graph neural network according to the potential association score, updates final representation analysis space-time propagation relation of all the nodes, and acquires a forest fire scene space-time knowledge map, and the decision-making module simulates fire scene evolution paths under different intervention strategies through an antagonistic reasoning mechanism based on the flame scene space-time knowledge map to realize forest fire scene situation awareness.
assignees: INNER MONGOLIA BANGFEI TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Private network mirroring
abstract_en: Techniques for private network mirroring are described. Users can select one or more existing private networks to be mirrored in the same or different network area. Any network configuration changes made in the selected private network (e.g., "master" private network) can be propagated automatically to the mirror private network. This enables users to utilize resources in another network area for disaster recovery, ensuring that the network configuration of the mirror private network is consistent with the master private network through real-time updates. Additionally, users managing infrastructure that includes multiple private networks can select one master private network and propagate configuration changes to other private networks, reducing management overhead incurred by these multi-private network installations.

title_en: Lightning stroke risk assessment method and device based on cascade simulation
abstract_en: The application provides a lightning stroke risk assessment method and device based on cascade simulation. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a three-dimensional electric field model and a two-dimensional circuit model of the target area; inputting the three-dimensional electric field model into electromagnetic field simulation software to obtain electromagnetic field distribution in the three-dimensional electric field model under the preset lightning stroke energy; converting the electromagnetic field distribution into a transient pulse waveform; inputting the two-dimensional circuit model into circuit simulation software, and taking the transient pulse waveform as an energy source to acquire circuit response information; and carrying out lightning stroke risk assessment on the target area through the circuit response information. The lightning stroke risk assessment method and device based on the cascade simulation can analyze lightning strokes from multiple angles and improve the power supply reliability of the power distribution network.

title_en: Power grid disturbance evaluation method based on SIS model
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of network topology dynamics, relates to the field of intersection with electric power information safety, in particular to a power grid disturbance evaluation method based on an SIS model, which is based on the idea of a 'bin model', establishes an extension model of a power grid disturbance crisis event by referring to the SIS model, and realizes power grid static stability evaluation by means of dynamics analysis; the method comprises the following steps: step 1: nodes of the power grid topological structure, node weights and branch weights are calculated and data are processed; step 2: forming a high-dimensional random matrix and processing analysis standard data; step 3: calculating M-P rate or circular rate, and randomly matrix eigenvalue and average spectrum radius; step 4: calculating the infection rate and the cure rate, and solving a differential equation of the SIS model; and finally analyzing the disturbance propagation dynamics characteristics of the power grid.

title_en: Power grid vulnerability assessment method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a power grid vulnerability assessment method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring data of a heterogeneous power network; acquiring a first attack cost corresponding to a transformer substation and a second attack cost corresponding to a transmission line; acquiring an alternative combined attack strategy set according to a preset initial attack cost threshold, a first attack cost and a second attack cost; carrying out simulation attack and cascade failure judgment on an attack target of the combined attack strategy to obtain an attack gain function and a task completion degree of the combined attack strategy corresponding to each attack target; and judging the attack income function and the task completion degree according to a preset task threshold value to obtain a vulnerability evaluation result. The method and the device perform simulation attack and benefit evaluation on the alternative combined attack strategy set under the limited cost, calculate the target cost budget of the power grid under different attack purposes, plan the actual power grid according to the evaluation result, and improve the robustness and accuracy of the power network evaluation result.

title_en: Multi digital door
title_ko: 다기능 디지털 도어
abstract_en: A multi-functional digital door is provided to reinforce security by performing multi-stage locking and releasing operations with successively operating a multi-lock unit according to a pre-set order. A multi-functional digital door(100) is composed of a power unit(110) supplying power to the door; an input unit(120) mechanically and electromagnetically receiving predetermined inputs from a user, and converting the input into data and transmitting the converted data; a multi-lock unit(130) comprising plural locking parts and locking and unlocking the door in a multi-locking method; a communication unit(140) executing a connection function between the door and the network; a memory unit(150) storing data related to a control operation as software, a message related to a fire and crime prevention, and an image and voice data input from the input unit; an audio unit generating the warning sound according to the message; and a control unit(180) connected with the power unit, the input unit, the multi-lock unit, the communication unit, the memory unit, and the audio unit to control the digital door.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은, 네트워크 환경을 이용하여 보안성 및 편리성을 강화시킬 수 있고, 화재 등의 비상시에 안정성을 강화시킬 수 있으며, 도어의 심미성 및 기능성을 강화시킬 수 있는 디지털 도어에 관한 것이다. 
     이를 위해, 본 발명은, 디지털 도어에 있어서, 상기 도어에 전원을 공급하는 전원부와, 사용자로부터 기계적, 전자기적으로 소정의 입력을 받아 이를 데이터로 변환하여 송신하는 입력부와, 복수 개의 잠금부로 구성된 다중 잠금 방식으로 도어의 잠금 및 해지 기능을 수행하는 다중락부와, 상기 도어와 네크워크망 간의 접속 기능을 수행하는 통신부와, 제어에 관련된 데이터가 소프트웨어화되어 실행가능한 형태로 저장되어 있고, 화재 및 방범에 관련된 메시지, 상기 입력부로부터 입력받은 영상 및 음성 데이터를 저장하는 메모리부와, 상기 메시지에 따른 경보음을 생성하는 오디오부와, 상기 전원부, 입력부, 디지털 다중락부, 통신부, 메모리부, 및 오디오부와 연결되어 상기 디지털 도어를 제어하는 제어부를 포함하는 것을 디지털 도어를 제공한다.

title_en: Photovoltaic power generation prediction research system based on Matlab
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photovoltaic power generation prediction research system based on Matlab, and belongs to the field of photovoltaic power generation prediction. The system comprises a data importing and exporting unit, a BP (Back Propagation) neural network training and prediction unit and a comprehensive assessment unit of training effects, wherein the data importing and exporting unit can import meteorological environment data and synchronous corresponding photovoltaic power generation power data, and can export a photovoltaic power generation power prediction value; the BP neural network training and prediction unit has flexible BP neural network parameter setting, training and prediction functions; and the comprehensive assessment unit of the training effects can comprehensively reflect the training effect of the BP neural network in real time and provides a reference for determining a prediction model. The photovoltaic power generation prediction research system is one set of integral prediction research system and is realized in the GUI (Graphical User Interface) environment of the Matlab, which is different from a situation that the Matlabe is provided with a toolbox nntool. By use of the research system, the establishment, the prediction and the interaction with a Windows system of the BP neural network training and prediction model can be more efficient and convenient, and a practical reference value is provided for the research and application of the power generation prediction.
assignees: GUANGZHOU YANGXIN TECH RES CO LTD

title_en: Electric power system transient stability self-adaptive evaluation method based on transfer learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transient stability self-adaptive evaluation method of a power system based on transfer learning, which takes time series data of 27 geometric characteristics of a generator power angle track cluster after fault removal as original input characteristics; constructing a transient stability prediction model based on a convolutional neural network, wherein the transient stability prediction model consists of input features, a convolutional layer 1, a pooling layer 1, a convolutional layer 2, a pooling layer 2, a full-link layer, a classification layer and an output result; and improving a loss function of a back propagation algorithm; finally, parameters of a network structure, two convolution layers, two pooling layers and a full-connection layer of a pre-training model obtained in an operation mode and topological structure system are migrated to a new model by using a migration learning strategy, only the parameters of the classification layer are initialized randomly, and the classification layer is trained by using a training sample set in a new scene in the new operation mode and the topological structure, so that the new model can quickly track the change of the operation mode and the topological structure of the power system, and higher prediction accuracy is kept.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING JIAOTONG;ELECTRIC POWER RES INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Power network vulnerability assessment method based on multiple attack strategies
abstract_en: A power system vulnerability assessment method based on multiple attack strategies comprises the following steps: 1) and constructing a power grid model. 2) The node importance in the network is evaluated from four aspects of node degree, betweenness, local centrality and node fault loss, and the establishment of an attack strategy is completed according to the network node importance. 3) And establishing an betweenness virtual flow model to simulate the process of cascading fault propagation in the power system. 4) Establishing a vulnerability index based on the betweenness virtual flow model, simulating network attack by adopting various attack strategies, and evaluating the vulnerability of the IEEE300 power system network according to the change of the vulnerability index. Aiming at the vulnerability of the power network under the condition of various attack strategies, the method establishes an betweenness virtual flow model and the various attack strategies to analyze the performance change of the power grid under the cascade failure. The method can identify the importance of the nodes in the power network and provide decision support for maintenance work of power system managers and designers when power system fault prevention is carried out.

title_en: Power system elasticity evaluation method considering cascading failure evolution under typhoon disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system elasticity evaluation method considering cascading failure evolution under typhoon disasters, and relates to the field of power system analysis. The method comprises the steps of generating a fault scene through a power transmission line fault model under a typhoon disaster; utilizing a cascading failure evolution model based on short and long time scales to simulate cascading failures and an evolution process thereof of a power system caused by transient stability and thermal stability problems; and (4) evaluating the elasticity index value of the power system according to the system performance condition by combining a power system recovery model and adopting a sequential Monte Carlo simulation method. Compared with the electric power system elastic evaluation method without considering cascading failure evolution, the method can effectively simulate the initial failure condition and cascading failure evolution process caused by typhoon disasters, is more comprehensive and objective in describing the failure scene and closer to the actual failure development condition of the electric power system under the typhoon disasters, so that the elastic evaluation result is more accurate, and is beneficial to accurately evaluating the ability of the electric power system to cope with the typhoon disasters by power grid operators and formulating a targeted recovery strategy.

title_en: Weather factor-based power transmission network cell group organization type P system fault diagnosis method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for diagnosing faults of a power transmission network cell group organization type P system considering weather factors, which relates to the field of power transmission networks, and is based on the power grid partition modeling of a power loss area, when multiple faults and cascading faults occur, all suspicious fault elements do not need to be traversed, the complexity of fault diagnosis cannot be increased along with the increase of the suspicious fault elements, the complexity of the diagnosis method is effectively reduced, and the method has stronger applicability to the treatment of the multiple faults and the cascading faults; the network topology in the cppTPS fault diagnosis model is coupled with the protection device, so that when the network topology structure changes, the model can be adaptively adjusted along with the network topology change, correct reasoning after the network topology change can be realized without changing reasoning rules, and the cppTPS fault diagnosis model is good in universality and convenient; according to the method, the distortion possibility of the alarm signal is increased in the transmission process under the disaster weather condition, the weather factor is considered in the fault diagnosis process, and the accuracy of the diagnosis method is improved.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and storage medium for identifying fragile line of power transmission network under ice disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for identifying a fragile line of a power transmission network under ice disasters, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining the ice coating thickness of each line in the power transmission network under ice disasters; determining the fault probability of each line according to the thickness of each ice coating; on the basis of the fault probability of each line, adopting Monte Carlo simulation to obtain a plurality of line cascading fault accident chains, and constructing a cascading fault incidence matrix according to the line cascading fault accident chains; wherein each element in the cascading failure incidence matrix is: the associated weight of the fault line corresponding to the element and another fault line; determining the node weight degree of each line according to the cascading failure incidence matrix; and taking the first M lines with the maximum node weight degrees as fragile lines. By implementing the method, the fragile line in the power transmission network under ice disasters can be effectively identified.

title_en: Drainage basin cascade power station combined vibration-avoiding method
abstract_en: The invention provides a combined vibration avoiding method for a basin cascade power station. Acquiring water regime data of each stage of current power station every set time interval, and acquiring a health coefficient of each stage of power station according to the water regime data; when the health coefficient of any stage of power station is smaller than the corresponding set threshold value, carrying out load distribution according to the total output of the current power stations at all stages and the unit data of the power stations at all stages; when a joint regulation instruction for power grid dispatching is received, judging whether the joint regulation instruction is legal or not; and when the joint adjusting instruction is legal, jointly adjusting the unit output of each stage of power station according to the joint scheduling instruction. The problem of exist among the prior art the inconvenient not good technique that leads to unit operating condition of single power station load regulation is solved.
assignees: HUBEI QINGJIANG HYDROELECTRIC DEV CO LTD

title_en: Urban key infrastructure toughness assessment method under typhoon disaster and related device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of natural disaster risk and infrastructure toughness assessment, and discloses a method and a related device for assessing urban key infrastructure toughness under typhoon disasters, which are used for acquiring typhoon disaster data, analyzing main risk factors, acquiring a risk factor set and a cascade disaster set, analyzing risk factors in the risk factor set contained in the typhoon disasters to be analyzed, acquiring the coupling types and frequencies of the risk factors, acquiring the coupling degrees of different risk factors by using an N-K model and the frequencies of the coupling types of the risk factors, further determining the risk factors which are most easily coupled with other risk factors, decoupling each cascade disaster in the cascade disaster set by using an interpretation structure model, obtaining an evolution path of the cascade disaster, further obtaining key nodes, determining the failure probability of the key nodes in a selected area by using the interpretation structure model, and evaluating the failure probability by using a sequencing centroid method. The invention can realize the early warning of the failure of the key infrastructure.

title_en: Urban infrastructure risk assessment method oriented to storm disaster chain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a storm disaster chain-oriented urban infrastructure risk assessment method which specifically comprises the following steps of S1, uniformly coding urban infrastructure elements, S2, constructing a correlation network among urban infrastructure nodes, S3, constructing an urban storm disaster chain network, S4, simulating a secondary disaster risk caused by a storm disaster, S5, simulating an infrastructure risk caused by a storm disaster chain, S6, assessing cascade fault conduction of the infrastructure node risk, S7, and realizing real-time risk display based on uniform identification codes. According to the urban infrastructure risk assessment method for the storm disaster chain, support is provided for dynamic emergency decision making of multi-disaster linkage by considering the infrastructure node risk caused by the storm and the secondary disasters, so that the precise infrastructure node risk pre-judgment of timing and fixed points is realized, and the establishment of specific emergency decision making and the targeted resident disaster risk prevention are facilitated.

title_en: Multi-energy complementary system market trading profit distribution method based on Aumann-Shapley method
abstract_en: A multi-energy complementary system market trading profit distribution method based on Aumann-Shapley value method comprises the steps of building benefit models of a cascade hydropower station, a wind power station, a photovoltaic power station and electric hydrogen production equipment under independent operation conditions, building a water-wind-light-hydrogen combined system benefit maximization model by combining the characteristics of time-sharing electricity prices of all energy sources in the electric power market and production and trade capacities in different time periods, decomposing the water-wind-light-hydrogen combined system benefit maximization model into profit maximization sub-problems and cost minimization sub-problems based on an alternate direction multiplier distributed optimization algorithm, building an augmentation Lagrange function model for solving optimal trade capacities, building a Aumann-Shapley value benefit distribution model based on the water-wind-light-hydrogen combined system benefit, and realizing reasonable profit distribution through marginal contribution quantification. The method promotes market participation enthusiasm of the multi-energy complementary system, promotes efficient collaborative operation of the energy network, and enhances economic feasibility and sustainability of the comprehensive energy system.

title_en: Risk intelligent identification and analysis method based on multi-mode heterogeneous data fusion
abstract_en: The invention provides a risk intelligent identification and analysis method based on multi-modal heterogeneous data fusion, which relates to the technical field of risk management and comprises the steps of generating semantic vectors by collecting multi-source data and constructing symbol-nerve double-space processing, extracting features through orthogonal matrix decomposition and a bidirectional long-short-term memory network, utilizing a self-adaptive weight mechanism to fuse multi-modal information, constructing a risk propagation topology network by utilizing a map embedding algorithm, realizing accurate identification and early warning of risks, and effectively improving risk prevention and control capability and prediction accuracy.
assignees: HANGZHOU ZHUIXING VIDEO TECH CO LTD

title_en: Tunnel crossing strong outburst coal seam group construction risk evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating construction risks of tunnel crossing strong outburst coal seam groups, which comprises the steps of incorporating 15 risk factors of geology, construction technology and operators into a comprehensive evaluation framework, acquiring global comprehensive weights of the 15 risk factors by adopting a fuzzy analytic hierarchy process, inputting the weights into a back propagation neural network as parameters, realizing dynamic prediction of risks, and constructing an intelligent risk evaluation model capable of being updated in real time. The method effectively solves the problem of subjectivity and index dependency in expert judgment, and the method utilizes strong nonlinear mapping and learning capacity to realize dynamic simulation and prediction of complex system risks. The method remarkably improves the tunnel construction risk identification precision and early warning capability under the complex geological environment, and can be widely applied to high-risk underground engineering safety management.

title_en: Contact rates in malware simulation for responsive measure deployment
abstract_en: A computer-implemented method of simulating the propagation of malware in a network is provided. The method comprises accessing a model of the network, where the model comprises a plurality of computer nodes and where each computer node of the plurality of computer nodes is connected to at least one edge of a plurality of edges. Each edge of the plurality of edges connects a pair of computer nodes of the plurality of computer nodes. The method further comprises initiating an outbreak of the malware in the model at a predetermined source computer node of the plurality of computer nodes, and propagating the malware through the model of the network from the source computer node. The propagation is determined based on a rate of transmission, where the rate of transmission is based upon a contact rate for each edge of the plurality of edges, and the contact rate for each edge of the plurality of edges is based upon the network traffic passing between the computer nodes connected by that edge over a predetermined time period.

title_en: Textile fabric defect detection model and training method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a textile fabric defect detection model and a training method and application thereof, wherein the training method comprises the steps of collecting sample textile fabric defect images, establishing a data set, and establishing the textile fabric defect detection model based on YOLOv 2; using dimension clustering before training the model, and performing direct coordinate prediction, loss value calculation and back propagation during model training to obtain a current network weight parameter; and updating the network weight parameters of the textile cloth defect detection model by using the current network weight parameters, and then performing multiple times of network weight calculation and updating by using the training set to obtain the optimal network weight parameters, thereby obtaining the trained textile cloth defect detection model. And then collecting textile cloth images in real time, and detecting by using the trained textile cloth defect detection model to obtain defect detection results of the textile cloth images. The defect detection model for textile fabric defects has the advantages of high defect accuracy, strong real-time property and universality.

title_en: Material S parameter measuring method based on de-embedding error
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for measuring S parameter of material, which comprises establishing signal flow chart of measuring process, and determining state equation of embedding error; according to a signal flow chart of a measurement process, five state models of a port network in the material S parameter measurement system are constructed by changing a test sample; establishing a fixture S parameter state equation of the five state models, and determining fixture S parameters; and substituting the S parameter of the clamp into a state equation of the embedding error, and calculating to obtain the real S parameter of the material to be measured. Compared with the three states of the traditional TRL principle-based embedded error port network model, the invention provides five state models. Then, a state equation is established according to the five state models. In the analysis of the dual-port cascade network, the correlation equation of the S parameter is directly listed, the traditional S parameter and T parameter conversion method is not adopted, and the data processing is simpler and more visual.

title_en: Power distribution low-voltage transformer area load prediction method and device based on deep learning
abstract_en: The application discloses a power distribution low-voltage transformer area load prediction method and device based on deep learning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting measurement data of a distribution low-voltage transformer area; according to the distribution low-voltage area measurement data, iteratively updating the neural network weight based on a back propagation algorithm by an Adam optimization algorithm, generating an input value of a prediction model, and training the prediction model; and after the prediction model meets the preset conditions, collecting the measurement data of the current distribution low-voltage transformer area, and inputting the measurement data of the current distribution low-voltage transformer area into the trained prediction model to obtain a load prediction result of the distribution low-voltage transformer area. Based on the LSTM model and combining the information expression characteristics of the Wide module and the Deep module, the method builds a brand-new load prediction model, thereby improving the load prediction precision of the low-voltage distribution transformer area.

title_en: Power system elasticity assessment method considering cascading failure evolution under typhoon disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric power system elasticity assessment method considering cascading failure evolution under typhoon disasters, and relates to the field of electric power system analysis. Generating a fault scene through a power transmission line fault model under typhoon disasters; simulating cascading failures caused by transient stability and thermal stability problems of a power system by using a cascading failure evolution model based on a short time scale and a long time scale; and combining with a power system recovery model, adopting a sequential Monte Carlo simulation method, and evaluating the elasticity index value of the power system according to the system performance condition. Compared with the power system elasticity assessment method without considering cascading failure evolution, the method can effectively simulate the initial failure condition and the cascading failure evolution process caused by typhoon disasters, is more comprehensive and objective in description of failure scenes, and is more close to the actual failure development condition of the power system under typhoon disasters, so that the elasticity assessment result is more accurate, the power grid operators can accurately assess the capability of the power system to cope with typhoon disasters, and a specific recovery strategy is formulated.

title_en: Substation grounding grid rapid modeling method suitable for CDEGS
abstract_en: The invention discloses a substation grounding grid rapid modeling method suitable for CDEGS, which specifically comprises the following steps: according to conductor parameters and buried depth in a transformer substation grounding grid design standard, the transformer substation size, grounding grid grounding resistance and soil resistivity which are obtained through actual measurement are calculated by utilizing a grounding resistance calculation formula, an equivalent grounding grid is established in CDEGS software, the grounding resistance of the equivalent grounding grid is calculated by utilizing the software, the grid size of the equivalent grounding grid is changed to enable the grounding resistance of the equivalent grounding grid to be continuously approximate to an actual value, and then the conductor structure of the equivalent grounding grid which accords with the actual grounding resistance is obtained. The invention lays a foundation for analyzing the electrical characteristics and the running conditions of the grounding grid under the influence of the stray current, is favorable for analyzing the characteristics and properties such as the distribution rule, the propagation characteristics and the like of the stray current in the power grid system, and provides a basis for preventing and treating the DC magnetic bias of the transformer and the corrosion of the urban power grid structure.

title_en: Power system cascading failure analysis method, device, equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a method, a device, equipment and a readable storage medium for analyzing cascading failure of a power system, which are used for analyzing the power physical system of a power information physical system and the architecture information of the power information system, and constructing a model of the power information physical system to analyze cascading failure conditions of the power information physical system due to network attacks. According to the application, abstract modeling can be carried out on each network node information of the electric power information physical system, the mutual coupling characteristic of the electric power information network and the electric power physical network is considered, the propagation characteristic of cascading faults between the electric power information network and the electric power physical network can macroscopically simulate the cascading fault characteristic, and higher operation efficiency is ensured, so that the simulation of the electric power information physical system and the research and analysis of the cascading faults of the electric power network are more efficient and accurate.

title_en: Line active stop and network reconstruction method for preventing typhoon weather cascading failure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a line active pulling and stopping and network reconstruction method for preventing typhoon weather cascading failure, which comprises the steps of main distribution network model splicing, expected failure set analysis, power grid risk assessment, pulling and stopping, reconstruction scheme construction, selection and the like, wherein the risk analysis of multi-voltage-level combination is carried out on lines passing by a typhoon path, possible cascading failure is analyzed, some lines are actively pulled and stopped, and network reconstruction is carried out, so that power supply of residents and important loads can be ensured to the greatest extent after the line failure occurs under the typhoon condition. The method provided by the invention can effectively prevent the occurrence of large-area power failure of the power grid, has strong operability and has more remarkable popularization.

title_en: Flood network flood bank flooding simulation and disaster damage assessment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood network flood bank flooding simulation and disaster damage assessment method, and belongs to the technical field of flood control and disaster reduction. The method comprises the steps of carrying out hydrodynamic analysis based on hydrologic geographic data to determine a potential overtop area, simulating the evolution of a bursting mouth based on accumulated scouring energy criteria aiming at the potential overtop area to generate a bursting mouth flow process, simulating flood evolution according to the bursting mouth flow process to generate a spatial disaster intensity field, and evaluating direct and indirect economic losses by combining the disaster intensity field and social economic data to generate a comprehensive disaster loss result. The invention introduces physical criteria based on accumulated scouring energy, adopts comprehensive strength indexes, three-dimensional vulnerability curved surfaces and applies graph neural networks to simulate cascade failure, and solves the problems of missing of a breach triggering mechanism, single disaster intensity measurement and static disaster damage assessment.

title_en: Load prediction method and system based on virtual power plant operation
abstract_en: The invention provides a load prediction method and a system based on virtual power plant operation, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a hybrid prediction model based on an ant colony optimization algorithm dynamic weighting combination LSTM time sequence sub-model, XGBoost gradient lifting sub-model and fuzzy clustering sub-model, positioning a main deviation source through an error propagation network, triggering the reconstruction of the hybrid prediction model according to the real-time operation state of the virtual power plant, calculating the load predictability index of the reconstructed hybrid prediction model, and correcting the load prediction result of the hybrid prediction model according to the load predictability index to obtain a final load prediction value. According to the method, the mixed prediction model is built by dynamically weighting and combining all the sub-models through the ant colony optimization algorithm, the deviation source is positioned through the error propagation network, the sub-model weight is adjusted according to the real-time running state reconstruction model of the power plant, the reliability of the model is estimated by calculating the predictability index of the model so as to correct the result, and the accuracy of the load prediction of the virtual power plant is greatly improved.

title_en: Pig farm flow yield early warning method and system integrating space-time diagram network and knowledge enhancement
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pig farm flow yield early warning method and system with a fused time-space diagram network and knowledge enhancement, which comprises the steps of connecting a blue ear disease risk knowledge map of each pig farm at each historical moment according to the affiliated organization and geographic position, extracting an inter-field relationship topological diagram reflecting pig farm-organization-city relationship, generating intra-field embedding of event subgraph fusion time weights in each pig farm by utilizing a diagram attention network, learning the inter-field relationship topological diagram and the intra-field embedding by utilizing the diagram attention network again, generating inter-field embedding with space propagation risk, acquiring time sequence trend by inputting a long-short term memory network after splicing the inter-field embedding and the historical abortion rate of each pig farm, respectively predicting abnormal abortion rate risk probability and specific abortion rate value of three time windows in the future, and judging and early warning. According to the method, risk events in and among pig farms are comprehensively considered, so that the dependence relationship of the flow rate at each moment is captured, and the accuracy of pig farm blue ear disease risk early warning is improved.

title_en: Intelligent knowledge base management system
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent knowledge base management system, which relates to the technical field of knowledge maps and comprises a knowledge map construction module, a scene perception module, a knowledge retrieval module, a risk assessment module, a dynamic shielding module and a recommendation output module, wherein the knowledge map construction module is used for constructing a layered knowledge map, the scene perception module is used for collecting scene characteristics of the current running state of a power grid in real time and fusing the scene characteristics to obtain scene embedded vectors, the knowledge retrieval module is used for executing directional propagation in the layered knowledge map according to user inquiry to obtain candidate knowledge nodes, the risk assessment module is used for calculating total risks of the candidate knowledge nodes based on the topological attribute vectors and the scene embedded vectors, the dynamic shielding module is used for shielding candidate knowledge nodes with inverse fact risk differences exceeding a risk threshold to obtain unshielded candidate knowledge nodes, and the recommendation output module is used for sequencing and outputting the unshielded candidate knowledge nodes according to the total risks from low to high. The invention can realize knowledge retrieval and recommendation which not only accords with the operation rule of the power grid, but also can avoid scene-dependent high-risk operation.

title_ko: 원자력 발전소의 수소폭발 방지를 제공하는 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 원자력 발전소의 비상 보호에 관한 것으로,　특히 화재를 방지하고수냉식 발전소(WWER)로 원자력 발전소(NPP)의 보호 격납실(AO)에서 폭발성 가스의 축적을 방지하여 수소폭발 방지를 제공하는  기술에 관한 것이다. 또한,　제안된 본 발명은 다량의 경량 연료가스의 방출 및 시설의 닫힌 구내에서의 위치 파악과 관련하여 잠재적으로 위험한 비상처리를 유발할 가능성이 있는 다른 시설에 적용할 수 있다. 청구된 본 발명에 의해 달성된 기술적 결과는 다음과 같다. 원자력 발전소의 보호 범위 내에서 기체 매체를 점화할 가능성을 감소시키고,　약한 연소파의 자체 소멸 생성,　원자력 발전소의 보호 격납실에서 가스 환경의 점화시 원자력 발전소의 벽면에 가해지는 동적 하중을 줄여 충격강도를 약화시킨다. 이 기술적 결과는 원자로 발전소의 수소폭발 안전성을 확보하기 위한 방법으로서,　원자로의 보호 격납실의 환기 및 원자로의 보호 격납실 내의 수소 재조합을 촉매산화에 의해 행하는 것으로써 달성된다. 상기 해결책에 따라,　반사기가 보호 격납실에서 가압된 수소　함유 증기　-　가스 제트의 잠재적 우연한 전파경로를 따라 배치되며,　원자로의 격실 사이의 벽의 구멍(개구)은 이들 벽의 면적의　35%　이상의 크기로 형성되고, 수소 함유 증기　-　가스 제트의 연소의 초점의 잠재적인 위치의 장소에서 과도한 열이 제거된다.

title_en: The critical circuits recognition methods of two class role of power transmission network based on symmetric entropy
abstract_en: A kind of critical circuits recognition methods of the two class role of power transmission network based on symmetric entropy, step is to obtain the related data information of power transmission network；Transmission line of electricity is established easily to propagate in normal operation and the power assessments of two class role of easy infection quantization set；Transmission line of electricity is established easily to propagate in failure operation and the power assessments of two class role of easy infection quantization set；Structure identification power transmission network is easily propagated and the symmetric entropy formula of two class role of easy infection；The critical circuits with two class role of easy infection are easily propagated using symmetric entropy identification power transmission network.The present invention has distinguished easy propagation and the two class role of easy infection of critical circuits, by distinguishing this two classes role, effect of the critical circuits for being conducive to disclose different role during cascading failure so that critical circuits identification is more refined by building symmetric entropy.

title_en: Power grid cascading fault modeling emulation mode based on colored stochastic Petri net
abstract_en: The power grid cascading fault modeling emulation mode based on colored stochastic Petri net that the present invention provides a kind of, comprising the following steps: step 1, according to network system wiring diagram, determine the corresponding actions of relevant protective relaying device when each element failure；Step 2, according to the property of Colored Petri Net, classify to the protective relaying devices at different levels of element, establish the Local C PN model of excision failure；Step 3, by the Local C PN model integration of each element excision failure at the CPN model of the failure removal route of whole system；Step 4, consider the case where protective relaying device there may be failure, using stochastic Petri net, establish the SCPN model of whole system.

title_en: Rail Transit System risk chain group construction method based on Epidemic Model
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of Rail Transit System risk chain group construction method based on Epidemic Model, comprising: determine the risk point in Rail Transit System, risk network is connected and composed by side according to risk point interactively；Then the coupling measure between risk point is estimated in calculation risk point initial risks point migration, and then calculates the isomery Risk of Communication combined chance according to the initial average rate of risk point；On the basis of traditional Epidemic Model, estimate in conjunction with risk point state transition, risk point coupling measure and isomery Risk of Communication probability, construct Rail Transit System Risk of Communication Evolution Dynamics model, according to Rail Transit System Risk of Communication Evolution Dynamics model, the risk chain group of Rail Transit System is constructed using the method for asynchronous refresh.The risk chain group that this method obtains can reflect out the rule propagated and developed in the in-orbit pipeline transportation system of risk, can provide theory support for rail transportation operation management.

title_en: Power grid disturbance evaluation method based on SIS model
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of network topology dynamics, relates to the crossing field of electric power information safety, and particularly relates to a power grid disturbance evaluation method based on an SIS model, wherein a spreading model of a power grid disturbance crisis event is established by referring to the SIS model based on the concept of a cabin model, and the static stability evaluation of a power grid is realized by means of dynamic analysis; the method comprises the following steps: step 1: calculating node weights and branch weights of nodes of the power grid topological structure and processing data; step 2: forming a high-dimensional random matrix and processing and analyzing standard data; and step 3: calculating the M-P rate or the ring rate, the characteristic value of the random matrix and the average spectrum radius; and 4, step 4: calculating the infection rate and the cure rate, and solving an SIS model differential equation; and finally, analyzing the dynamic characteristics of the disturbance propagation of the power grid.
assignees: STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Oil gas major infrastructure multi-disaster accident coupling three-dimensional simulation system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-disaster accident coupling three-dimensional simulation system for major oil and gas infrastructure, which comprises an accident three-dimensional simulation module, an accident chain evolution prediction module, a model unit and a database module. The accident three-dimensional simulation module and the accident chain evolution prediction module are respectively connected with the model unit and the database module through signals; and the accident three-dimensional simulation module is in signal connection with the accident chain evolution prediction module. On the basis of the existing Natech accident analysis method, a Natech accident multi-disaster coupling link of a major infrastructure for oil and gas storage and transportation is considered, and all potential accident links are identified; in daily management, the probability and the accident consequence of accidents of each unit under the coupling of multiple kinds of disasters are analyzed, and a basis is provided for the reasonable arrangement of safety protection facilities and emergency evacuation drilling; in the emergency rescue stage after the accident occurs, the most probable propagation path and evolution time of the accident under the coupling of multiple kinds of disasters are analyzed, and decision support is provided for the development of emergency rescue actions.

title_en: Emergency communication perception equipment system efficiency evaluation method based on neural network
abstract_en: The invention provides an emergency communication perception equipment system efficiency evaluation method based on a neural network, and belongs to the technical field of efficiency evaluation. In order to reflect the actual combat effectiveness of the emergency communication perception equipment system more reliably, an emergency communication perception equipment system effectiveness evaluation method based on a neural network is provided. The method selects the efficiency evaluation index with larger entropy value after calculating the entropy value of each efficiency evaluation index, thereby screening the efficiency evaluation index and further reducing the dimension of the efficiency evaluation index by combining a principal component analysis method. And finally, setting weight parameters by adopting a back propagation algorithm, and constructing a BP neural network efficiency evaluation model. The method has the advantages of high judgment accuracy, high timeliness and small calculated amount, and can effectively avoid blindness, subjectivity and prejudice when weight parameters are set manually.

title_en: Improved SIR information transmission model and method for multi-source regional distribution
abstract_en: The invention discloses an improved SIR information transmission model and method for multisource regional distribution, which mainly carry out simulation analysis on information transmission through the following steps, firstly, an information transmission model is selected; secondly, constructing an information propagation model; then, improving the model according to an information transmission mode; secondly, carrying out simulation analysis on the improved model; and finally, outputting a simulation result of the SIR information transmission model. The invention can carry out model simulation of the transmission information from the time and space angles by carrying out model simulation on different information types, different transmission media and different audience characteristics. Meanwhile, the invention sets cross-region transmission based on social network model link, and the simulated information can be transmitted from any position at any time, thereby conforming to the information deployment mode and transmission effect in the information network era. The invention can effectively analyze the information transmission effects of different subjects.

title_en: Method for monitoring capability of lifting well-ground integrated micro-seismic monitoring system
abstract_en: A method for improving the monitoring capability of a well-ground integrated micro-seismic monitoring system comprises the steps of firstly, selecting a plurality of candidate points which can be provided with wireless sensors on the ground to form a candidate point set of natural number codes, and randomly selecting a fixed number of candidate points from the candidate point set to form a well-ground integrated micro-seismic monitoring table network with the sensors which are installed underground; after multiple random selections, a well-ground integrated microseismic monitoring station mesh arrangement scheme with a certain scale is generated; and then, for each scheme individual, constructing a monitoring capability evaluation model by adopting a propagation relation of the microseismic energy and the P wave first arrival peak amplitude to form an initial population, solving by adopting a genetic evolution algorithm to obtain an optimal individual, and determining an optimal ground wireless sensor layout scheme for remarkably improving the well-to-ground integrated microseismic monitoring capability. The method provides effective guidance for on-site adjustment and optimization of the installation position of the ground wireless sensor, and ensures that the well-ground integrated microseismic monitoring system can observe the microseisms with various energy levels generated in the mine excavation production process.
assignees: UNIV CHINA MINING & TECHNOLOGY;XUZHOU HONGYI SCIENCE AND TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Earthquake geological disaster and property population loss risk prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for predicting risk of earthquake geological disasters and property population loss, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining recurrence periods of different sections and different cascade combinations under the limitation of sliding rate and magnitude-frequency relation; calculating earthquake-earthquake motion data under the action of a potential earthquake risk section or a potential cascade rupture combination set earthquake; calculating the earthquake landslide probability prediction result; refining the building macro-classification exposure model to a town street scale exposure model, and determining a seismic disaster loss model according to the seismic-seismic motion data; and determining an earthquake casualty population prediction model based on a deep learning network, and predicting casualty populations according to the earthquake-earthquake motion data and the earthquake casualty population prediction model. The invention gets through the whole process from the activity fault quantitative data to the earthquake disaster risk prediction result, and solves the problem that the conventional activity fault research is difficult to use to the actual disaster risk prediction.
assignees: THE NATIONAL NATURAL DISASTER PREVENTION AND CONTROL RES INSTITUTE OF EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT DEPARTMEN;INST ENG MECH CHINA EARTHQUAKE ADMINISTRATION

title_en: Micro-grid group optimal scheduling method, device, terminal and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a micro-grid group optimal scheduling method, a device, a terminal and a medium, wherein the method quantifies uncertainty of new energy and load in a micro-grid group by adopting opportunistic constraint planning, sets a confidence level, converts rotation reserve constraint into a probability constraint form, converts the opportunistic constraint planning into a source load output deterministic model by adopting a deterministic equivalent conversion method, establishes an active power distribution network economic scheduling model containing a multi-main micro-grid group, and establishes a two-level hierarchical optimal scheduling model by adopting a target cascade analysis method so as to realize independent optimization after decoupling of the two-level hierarchical optimal scheduling model. Therefore, the embodiment of the invention can effectively protect privacy of multiple benefit bodies, meet benefit requirements, fully utilize the autonomous running capability of the sub-micro-grid, simplify the dispatching calculation burden of the micro-grid group energy management system and quantify the uncertainty of new energy and load in the micro-grid group.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Urban comprehensive pipe rack operation environment temperature determining method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for determining the operation environment temperature of an urban comprehensive pipe rack, which relate to the technical field of electric digital data processing and comprise the steps of acquiring first information, second information, pipe rack heat source, structure data and third information; the method comprises the steps of inputting historical data in first information into a preset neural network for training to obtain a prediction model, inputting real-time data in the first information into the prediction model to obtain predicted soil surface temperature, establishing a pipe gallery operation model according to the predicted soil surface temperature, second information and pipe gallery heat source and structure data, performing heat exchange calculation on the pipe gallery operation model to obtain predicted pipe gallery operation environment temperature, and comparing the predicted pipe gallery operation environment temperature with third information to obtain a pipe gallery operation state. According to the invention, the soil surface temperature in a future pipe gallery construction area is predicted by using a back propagation algorithm, and the predicted soil surface temperature, the pipe gallery heat source and the structural data are simulated, so that the safe operation state of the pipe gallery can be effectively estimated, and the normal operation of the pipe gallery is ensured.

title_en: Power distribution network planning method and device containing large-scale hierarchical aggregation adjustable resources
abstract_en: The application provides a power distribution network planning method and device containing large-scale hierarchical aggregation adjustable resources, and relates to the technical field of power distribution network planning. The method comprises the steps of constructing a grid-connected multi-micro-grid system planning model, solving the grid-connected multi-micro-grid system planning model by adopting a target cascading method to obtain an optimal power distribution network planning scheme of the power distribution network, wherein the upper planning model is constructed based on construction data, operation data, energy flow data and carbon tax data of the power distribution network, and the lower planning model is constructed based on construction data, operation data, corresponding compensation data on a demand side, carbon tax data and energy transaction data of micro-grids of the lower layer of the power distribution network. The application can improve the energy utilization rate and the economical efficiency of the system under the planning of the power distribution network.
assignees: STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ECONOMIC AND TECHNICAL RES INSTITUTE;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Reverse design method for concave super structure for obtaining specific mechanical property
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reverse design method for obtaining a concave super structure with specific mechanical properties, which comprises the steps of constructing concave lattice structures with different configurations, obtaining stress-strain curves and Poisson ratio values of each lattice structure, dividing all samples of the lattice structures into a training set and a testing set, taking the stress values and the Poisson ratio values as input parameters and θ, t and loading directions as output parameters, training and verifying a reverse propagation neural network model to obtain a mapping relation between the mechanical properties of the concave super structure and configuration parameters thereof, inputting a mechanical property curve of host bone tissues, and matching the configuration parameters of the concave super structure based on the mapping relation. By adopting the method, the machine learning algorithm and the reverse design are combined, and the multi-element nonlinear mapping relation between the mechanical property of the lattice structure and the configuration parameter of the lattice structure is established, so that the implant structure with specific mechanical property is rapidly obtained, and the personalized design aiming at different patients is realized.

title_en: Soft magnetic material single-chip broadband dynamic hysteresis modeling method based on Cauer network
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of electromagnetic characteristic analysis of magnetic elements, and discloses a soft magnetic material single-chip broadband dynamic hysteresis modeling method based on a Cauer network, wherein the magnetic field distribution of the soft magnetic material single-chip is deduced, the magnetic flux is obtained through integration, the magnetic permeability is further obtained, the Taylor of the magnetic flux is unfolded, and the effective impedance and impedance network of the soft magnetic material single-chip are deduced; generating a cascade magnetic circuit Cauer network, calculating the magnetic field intensity corresponding to the single-chip macroscopic vortex of the soft magnetic material under the high-frequency skin effect, extracting the parameters of a continuous reverse Play hysteresis model by using a genetic algorithm method, calculating hysteresis loss by using the continuous reverse Play hysteresis model, calculating eddy current loss by using the Cauer network, and calculating abnormal loss according to Bertotti equation. The invention provides a new model suitable for soft magnetic material broadband dynamic hysteresis simulation, and solves the industrial problem of soft magnetic material broadband hysteresis characteristic prediction.

title_en: Chemical industry park safety management system and method based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The application provides a chemical industry park safety management system and method based on the Internet of things, which are used for generating a dynamic monitoring data set by collecting multi-source monitoring data in a chemical industry park, applying space-time causal constraint to multi-hop connection paths in a device topological graph of the chemical industry park to generate path confidence distribution, constructing entity characteristic embedding of each device in the chemical industry park, determining a time-varying causal association matrix through all entity characteristic embedding and the path confidence distribution, dividing risk device groups with different risk levels, constructing risk propagation tensors of a device risk partition topological network in the chemical industry park through each risk device group, generating dynamic risk vectors through the time-varying causal association matrix and the risk propagation tensors, and early warning safety risks in the chemical industry park based on the dynamic risk vectors. By adopting the scheme of the application, the space-time registration of the multisource monitoring data of the sensing node of the Internet of things can be realized, and the time-varying causal relationship among the devices can be mined to realize dynamic security risk early warning.

title_en: Alternating current/direct current power grid cascading failure evolution and fragile path identification system and method containing new energy
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for identifying cascading failure evolution and a vulnerable path of an alternating current/direct current power grid containing new energy, and relates to the field of safety analysis of power systems. The system comprises a power system modeling module, an element fault modeling module, a vulnerability assessment index module, a cascading failure simulation module and a vulnerable path identification module. By constructing a power system and element fault model containing new energy and alternating current-direct current series-parallel connection, based on entropy weight method fusion structure, tide and voltage multidimensional vulnerability indexes, random scenes are generated through Monte Carlo sampling, fault chains are generated through simulation cascade fault evolution, key vulnerable paths and alternating current-direct current strong coupling risk lines are accurately identified, and the influence of uncertainty factors such as new energy output fluctuation is quantized. The method overcomes the limitation of traditional analysis, can truly simulate fault evolution, improves the identification accuracy of the fragile path, and provides a quantization basis for power grid planning and operation control.
assignees: NORTH CHINA BRANCH OF STATE GRID CORP OF CHINA;HARBIN INST OF TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Identification method for complex power grid self-organization critical state
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for identifying a self-organization critical state of a complex power grid in the technical field of power system cascading failure prevention. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring actual load loss of a power grid in a random fault; calculating the cumulative probability of the random fault of the power grid according to the actual load loss of the random fault of the power grid and the set load loss amount; performing regression analysis on the set load loss and the accumulated probability so as to determine whether the power grid is in a self-organization critical state; and when the power grid is in the self-organization critical state, calculating the expected load loss value of the power grid and determining the relative probability of the power grid having load loss faults. The method can accurately judge whether the current power grid is in a self-organization critical state or not and the probability of the current power grid in cascading failure, calculate the load loss after the cascading failure occurs, and simultaneously estimate the relative probability of large-scale load loss power failure accidents.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;INST OF ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CORP;UNIV NORTH CHINA ELEC POWER

title_en: Gas dynamical disaster affects pilot system and method to mine ventilation network
