abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of gas dynamical disaster affects pilot system and method to mine ventilation network, belongs to coal mine gas Disaster Study field. System is made up of inflator module, dynamic action module, simulation pipe network module and metering module, and wherein inflator module comprises gas gas cylinder, air bottle, pressure-reducing valve, magnetic valve, flowmeter, vavuum pump, air compressor machine and valve; Dynamic action module comprises explosive container, Pressure gauge, igniting probe, igniter, diaphragm and blower fan; Simulation pipe network module comprises simulation pipeline, connecting pipe, ring flange, bolt and nut, thin slice and rubber band; Metering module comprises pressure sensor, data collecting instrument and computer. Major advantage is by grasping the propagation characteristic of gas pressure in pipe network, finding the impact of gas dynamical disaster on mine ventilation network, for rescuing and provide support after gas dynamical disaster control and accident.

title_en: Transformer oil density prediction model modeling method and device
abstract_en: The application discloses a modeling method and a device of a transformer oil density prediction model, which optimize a first transformer oil density regression prediction model established by a back propagation neural network based on temperature compensation and a genetic algorithm, establish a nonlinear mapping relation between transformer oil multi-frequency ultrasonic parameters and oil density by adopting the genetic algorithm, and reduces the error influence brought by the mapping relation by temperature compensation, realizes the regression prediction of the transformer oil density, has the characteristics of high efficiency, high speed and strong self-adaptive learning capability, the transformer oil density can be directly monitored through the regression prediction model, the size of the transformer oil density can be obtained in real time, the prediction result is accurate and reliable, the problems that the existing transformer oil density testing method is time-consuming and labor-consuming are solved, and the real oil density of the transformer can not be monitored in real time and accurately reflected.

title_en: Risk propagation analysis algorithm for electric power information physical system considering risk state propagation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a risk propagation analysis algorithm of a power information physical system considering risk state propagation. Establishing a risk propagation framework, wherein the system is divided into electric power, electric power information and information spaces, risk propagation is divided into risk propagation in the information spaces, the electric power spaces and the information spaces, and nodes exist in the spaces; constructing a risk propagation model and a risk state propagation matrix, solving the risk state propagation matrix, solving system risk state vectors after risk propagation of different times under risks, evolving the risk propagation process of each node until a stable state is reached, and finishing the risk propagation; and finding out the risk high-sensitivity nodes by analyzing the risk influence. The method solves the problem of analyzing the influence of the characteristics of risk propagation in different spaces and the structural characteristics of the system on risk propagation, quantifies the network structure of the electric power information physical system and the propagation path of the risk, reveals the risk change process, and finds out the nodes with high risk sensitivity.

title_en: Training method and device for service quality assessment model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a training method and a device of a service quality assessment model, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring machine performance data, network characteristic data and quality monitoring data of a service node according to a fixed period; determining a feature value based on the machine performance data and the network feature data; determining target quality data based on the quality monitoring data; using the feature values and the target quality data; and constructing a service quality evaluation model by using the training set. The invention relates indexes such as machine performance data, network characteristic data and the like with the service quality through the characteristic engineering function of the deep neural network, combines a back propagation algorithm for training, and fits the nonlinear relation, thereby reducing the time consumption of artificial characteristic engineering and improving the accuracy of service quality evaluation.

title_en: Identification method for dressing specification of distribution network field operators
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for identifying dressing specifications of on-site operators of distribution network, which comprises the following steps of: intercepting a distribution network field operation video as an image book set, and dividing the image book set into a verification set and a training set according to a proportion; formation of training data set: training a target detection and image instance segmentation model by using a Mask-RCNN algorithm, and verifying the trained model by using a verification set to obtain a detection, identification and segmentation model; the method comprises the steps of intercepting images from original images by using personnel position coordinates, workwear categories and workwear pixel segmentation graphs obtained by Mask-RCNN reasoning to form a training data set for image recognition; constructing a classification model: based on a MobileNet-v2 algorithm, constructing an image recognition model, and recognizing whether the worker wears the working clothes normally or not; identification of dressing specifications: the method is characterized in that a target detection model, an image instance segmentation model and an image recognition model which are constructed by adopting Mask-RCNN and MobileNet-v2 algorithms are cascaded, so that whether the worker wears the working clothes normally or not is detected, recognized and segmented.

title_en: Urban comprehensive pipe rack operation environment temperature determining method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for determining the operation environment temperature of an urban comprehensive pipe rack, which relate to the technical field of electric digital data processing and comprise the steps of acquiring first information, second information, pipe rack heat source, structure data and third information; the method comprises the steps of inputting historical data in first information into a preset neural network for training to obtain a prediction model, inputting real-time data in the first information into the prediction model to obtain predicted soil surface temperature, establishing a pipe gallery operation model according to the predicted soil surface temperature, second information and pipe gallery heat source and structure data, performing heat exchange calculation on the pipe gallery operation model to obtain predicted pipe gallery operation environment temperature, and comparing the predicted pipe gallery operation environment temperature with third information to obtain a pipe gallery operation state. According to the invention, the soil surface temperature in a future pipe gallery construction area is predicted by using a back propagation algorithm, and the predicted soil surface temperature, the pipe gallery heat source and the structural data are simulated, so that the safe operation state of the pipe gallery can be effectively estimated, and the normal operation of the pipe gallery is ensured.

title_en: Power failure area prediction method, power failure sensitive user identification method and system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of intelligent power grids. The invention provides a power failure area prediction method, a power failure sensitive user identification method and a power failure sensitive user identification system, which are used for extracting characteristics of nodes in a device node set according to historical power data to obtain initial node characteristics, determining initial edge weights according to physical or logical relations, updating the initial node characteristics and the initial edge weights according to nodes with changed states to obtain updated node characteristics and updated edge weights, determining node power failure probability according to the updated node characteristics, determining edge fault propagation probability according to the updated node characteristics and the updated edge weights, determining all fault nodes according to the node power failure probability and the edge fault propagation probability, and identifying power failure sensitive users by taking areas where all the fault nodes are as power failure area prediction results.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle power distribution network inspection image real-time identification method based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle distribution network inspection image real-time identification method based on artificial intelligence, which relates to the field of image identification and comprises the steps of carrying out space-time calibration on a multi-mode data packet, extracting characteristics of each mode, using a cross-mode attention mechanism to fuse the characteristics, obtaining multi-mode characteristic vectors, constructing an abnormal pattern through distribution network topology data, setting nodes and edges, giving the multi-mode characteristic vectors to the nodes, using a graph convolution neural network to aggregate neighbor equipment characteristics, updating node representation, outputting an abnormal classification result and an abnormal propagation path prediction result of distribution network equipment, receiving the abnormal classification result and the abnormal propagation path prediction result by a bandwidth network center, continuously monitoring and utilizing historical network data and an environmental factor training bandwidth prediction model, and predicting bandwidth change trend.

title_en: Method for forecasting load capacity limit of electric power system online
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for forecasting the load capacity limit of an electric power system online. The method is composed of a sample screening method based on the power grid state similarity, the Lasso method and an error back propagation type neural network. According to the sample screening method based on the power grid state similarity, on the basis of a sample load capacity limit value and a quantitative index of the power grid state similarity, training samples are selected. According to the Lasso method, regression analysis is conduced on the training samples, and the system state quantity, capable of best explaining the load capacity limit, among all state quantities is determined. The error back propagation type neural network is used for conducting off-line fitting on the load capacity limit through the simplified training samples and conducting online forecasting. According to the method for forecasting the load capacity limit of the electric power system online, on the premise that the forecasting precision is guaranteed, the off-line training efficiency of the error back propagation type neural network can be remarkably improved.

title_en: The compact reservoir physical parameter intelligent Forecasting of data-driven
abstract_en: Present disclose provides a kind of compact reservoir physical parameter intelligent Forecastings of data-driven, construct learning sample collection using 3-D seismics Wave data and well-log information, pre-process to learning sample collection；The machine learning network model that building convolution is mixed with inner product operator, uses convolution operation to pretreated 3-D seismics Wave data, inner product operation is used to additional space position, along network propagated forward；The training that machine learning network model is carried out using learning sample collection, until the network model for obtaining meeting error requirements；Centered on sampled point, multiple data are acquired in a plurality of directions as sampled data, using sampled data as the input variable for the machine learning network model trained, compact reservoir physical parameter is predicted in realization.Disclosure substitution relies on the inversion method of empirical model, realizes the compact reservoir physical parameter intelligent predicting of data-driven, solves the problems, such as small-sample learning between well logging-earthquake.

title_en: Recursive graph convolution network system for power grid transient stability evaluation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a recursive graph convolution network system for power grid transient stability evaluation. The invention designs a new graph relation matrix of the convolution layer by taking the line admittance as a reference to form a special graph convolution network, and adopts a graph convolution algorithm to realize the transmission and fusion of the state information of the power grid nodes based on the topological relation; the method comprises the steps of cascading a space extractor comprising a special graph convolution network with a time sequence extractor comprising a long and short memory network (LSTM), designing a prediction result of a plurality of time steps aggregated by a time pooling layer after the time sequence extractor, forming a recursive deep graph convolution model suitable for power grid stability evaluation, and sequentially realizing the aggregation of space layer and time layer characteristics and the extraction of the characteristics of power grid state quantity data, so that a power grid transient stability evaluation system established based on the recursive deep graph convolution model can adapt to the change of a power grid topological structure, shows excellent generalization capability and is accurate in evaluation result.

title_en: BP neural network-based track circuit fault intelligent diagnosis method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fault diagnosis of track circuits, and discloses an intelligent fault diagnosis method of a track circuit based on a BP (back propagation) neural network, which comprises the following steps of firstly, monitoring variables of a track circuit section in real time; dividing a training sample and a test sample; step three, the normalization processing of a training sample data set and a test sample data set; step four, training the BP neural network net 1; and step five, diagnosing the track circuit fault by using the BP neural network net 1. The invention tests 29 kinds of fault data in the track circuit through the BP neural network, and the test accuracy is higher; when a fault occurs, the position of the fault can be quickly positioned, the accuracy can reach 99.9%, and the fault type can be specifically judged, wherein the accuracy is 97.13% -99.4%; the method can provide guidance for field maintenance personnel, reduce maintenance time and improve the reliability of a signal system.
assignees: ZHENGZHOU YOUXIN ALGORITHM INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Network disaster recovery method, disaster recovery core network equipment and communication system
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a network disaster recovery method, disaster recovery core network equipment and a communication system. The network disaster recovery method comprises the following steps: periodically synchronizing a user terminal context and a session management context with a first device in a service core network, wherein the disaster recovery core network and the service core network share a Radio Access Network (RAN); if the service core network is perceived to be invalid, session updating is carried out with the second equipment still in the working state in the service core network; and creating a data path between the disaster recovery core network equipment and the RAN equipment so that the user terminal can interact with a control plane of the disaster recovery core network through the RAN equipment and interact with a user plane of the service core network through the RAN equipment. The method and the device can effectively reduce service interruption time and improve resource utilization rate of core network equipment.

title_en: Main transformer operation state identification method based on ant colony optimization BP neural network
abstract_en: A main transformer operation state identification method based on ant colony algorithm optimization BP neural network belongs to the technical field of power grid operation and maintenance. The invention adopts BP neural network optimized based on ant colony algorithm to identify the fault of the main transformer. Training the initial weight v due to classical BP neural network  ij  ,w  jk  And the choice of threshold b will directly affect the neural networkThe convergence speed of the network. If the initial weights and thresholds are not appropriate, the network is prone to falling into a locally optimal solution, and cannot find a globally optimal solution. This may result in poor performance or inability to converge of the network. The initial values of the weights and thresholds also affect the propagation of gradients in the network. According to the invention, the ant colony optimization algorithm is adopted to optimize the initial weight and the threshold value of the BP neural network, and a group of optimal weight and threshold value combination is found, so that the BP neural network model achieves a better convergence effect, and the accurate identification of the main transformer fault can be realized.
assignees: ANSHAN POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Cascade reservoir dispatching method based on dynamic planning combined gradual optimization algorithm
abstract_en: The invention relates to a cascade reservoir dispatching method based on a dynamic programming joint gradual optimization algorithm, which fully considers the characteristics of close cascade hydraulic connection and complex relation in the cascade power station dispatching process, establishes an objective function based on different dispatching situations such as water dispatching process, total dispatching amount and the like, considers demands such as drainage basin self water dispatching, cross drainage basin dispatching, power station utilization and the like, considers cascade hydropower station group water supply and power generation joint optimization dispatching restriction to determine constraint conditions, adopts the dynamic programming joint gradual optimization algorithm to solve and select an optimal dispatching scheme, can more scientifically, accurately and efficiently dispatch a drainage basin cascade power station, provide higher-quality and stable power supply for a power grid, improve the power generation income of a hydropower development company and support the actual production operation of a cascade hydropower station.
assignees: UNIV JIANGSU;CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES;CHANGAN UNIV

title_en: Power plant steam extraction energy storage and power generation optimization method and system based on molten salt heat storage
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for optimizing steam extraction energy storage and power generation of a power plant based on molten salt heat storage, and relates to the technical field of power, and the method comprises the steps of adopting an intelligent regulating valve group to accurately control steam extraction quantity and steam extraction pressure, introducing extracted steam into a multistage serial steam-molten salt heat exchanger group, adopting a multi-path parallel molten salt conveying system to convey high-temperature molten salt to a cascade molten salt-water heat exchanger group when the load of a power grid is higher than a preset dynamic threshold value, adopting a structure combining countercurrent heat exchange and spiral heat exchange pipes in the molten salt-water heat exchanger group to improve heat exchange efficiency and generate superheated steam, conveying the generated high-temperature high-pressure steam to an improved steam turbine with variable air inlet area, dynamically regulating the air inlet area according to the load requirement of the power grid, optimizing the efficiency of the steam turbine, and realizing bidirectional interaction of a power generation end and a power utilization end by utilizing an intelligent power grid technology and a requirement side response strategy to dynamically balance the power supply and demand.
assignees: GUONENG HEBEI LONGSHAN POWER GENERATION CO LTD;HEPU ENERGY ENVIRONMENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Traffic transportation operation monitoring early warning and decision analysis method based on vehicle-road cooperation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a traffic operation monitoring, early warning and decision analysis method based on vehicle-road cooperation, and relates to the technical field of intelligent traffic. The invention realizes real-time acquisition of dynamic traffic elements through multidimensional sensing networks and V2X communication of vehicle ends, road sides and environments, ensures unified space-time basis of multisource data, builds a 'road-vehicle-environment-event' semantic network, combines hierarchical feature extraction, realizes multidimensional identification of abnormal events such as accidents, congestion, bad weather and the like, improves identification accuracy, predicts an abnormal event propagation path, has global road network situation prediction capability, generates differential early warning based on comprehensive risk indexes, triggers multistage response such as traffic signal adjustment, path planning and the like, greatly shortens response time, optimizes emergency response efficiency, establishes a real-time feedback mechanism of decision execution effect, continuously optimizes system performance along with data accumulation, and avoids the defect that a large data platform lacks intelligent decision closed loop.

title_en: Underwater target positioning method and system based on side-scan sonar data
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides an underwater target positioning method and system based on side-scan sonar data, and belongs to the technical field of underwater detection and positioning. The method comprises the steps of reading a side-scan sonar data file in a target format, extracting sonar image data, converting the sonar image data into a general image format, inputting the general image format into a pre-trained convolutional neural network model, identifying an underwater target, outputting relative coordinates of the image, fusing attitude and position data of sonar equipment and a ship, obtaining sonar real-time geodetic coordinates through Kalman filtering, and mapping the relative coordinates into longitude and latitude coordinates by using a side-scan sonar wave beam propagation geometric model in combination with water depth, inclined distance and wave beam angle. The invention improves the accuracy, reliability and real-time performance of underwater target positioning through multi-source data fusion and geometric modeling, and is suitable for the scenes of ocean engineering detection, underwater search and rescue and the like.
assignees: XIAMEN WEIZHUO SMART OCEAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Laboratory risk control method based on graph neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a laboratory risk control method based on a graph neural network, which comprises the following steps of S1, constructing a dynamically updated interaction event graph based on interaction event sequences of laboratory equipment, personnel and environments, S2, dynamically updating a state space of each node according to an event precursor relation to generate a synchronous node state sequence, S3, generating an early warning feature set of a node state change trend by adopting graph convolution operation, S4, constructing a risk correlation matrix among nodes according to the early warning feature set to generate an updated risk propagation path, S5, evaluating the probability of transition from a node state to an abnormal state to generate a state risk predicted value, S6, inputting a wolf' S group optimization algorithm, and optimizing parameter combinations to obtain a laboratory risk predicted result. The invention improves the real-time performance and accuracy of laboratory risk prediction.

title_en: Fire fighting water system fault detection and early warning method and system based on fire fighting Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire control monitoring, in particular to a fire water system fault detection and early warning method and system based on a fire-fighting Internet of things, wherein the method comprises the following steps of 1, periodically collecting pressure data through pressure sensors deployed at an outlet of a fire-fighting water pump, a branch point of a main pipe of a pipe network and the most unfavorable tail end; the method comprises the steps of step 2 of generating theoretical pressure expected values and dynamic tolerance bands of all nodes according to current valve opening, pump states and historical normal working condition data, step 3 of marking abnormal nodes and reversely constructing a fault propagation tree along a topology model when measured pressure deviates from the theoretical pressure expected values by more than the dynamic tolerance bands, and step 4 of triggering grading early warning based on the number of the abnormal nodes, fault propagation paths and accumulated values of the weight factors according to fault types. The system can automatically take measures when faults occur through the equipment linkage function, so that the high-efficiency operation of the fire-fighting water system is ensured, and the efficiency and the safety of fire emergency response are improved.
assignees: WEIFANG PINGAN FIRE PROT ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Laser process parameter generation method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of laser repair, in particular to a laser process parameter generation method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, wherein single pulse energy data are acquired according to preset measurement position data, the single pulse energy data are analyzed according to a preset Gaussian distribution method and a preset polynomial fitting method to obtain an ablation energy sequence, the maximum effective ablation depth is generated according to a preset laser scanning area and the ablation energy sequence, the ablation energy sequence and the maximum effective ablation depth are analyzed based on preset ablation depth constraint, a preset material network model and a preset laser propagation rule to obtain laser process parameters, fitting spot energy data are acquired accurately to generate effective ablation depth, the laser process parameters are optimized in a simulation mode, the ablation depth is controllable, the repair yield and efficiency of an OLED panel are improved, a multi-defect scene is adapted, and the laser repair process is promoted to be standardized and intelligently upgraded.

title_en: Holding Reinforcement with Elastic Material
title_ko: 탄성소재를 구비한 지주 보강재
abstract_en: A general dual floor having a poor earthquake response ability requires the securement of an earthquake response ability through dual floor support seismic reinforcement. In accordance with the present invention, a dual floor support is reinforced through a support combination reinforcement material, a diagonal reinforcement material and a horizontal reinforcement material, wherein not every support in a corresponding room is reinforced, and, instead, a support in an area excluding an equipment area is selectively reinforced. In the equipment area, there is difficulty for a person to work because most dual floor supports in the area are no more than 40cm in height. There is difficulty not only for a newly constructed dual floor but also for an existing dual floor in most cases. In accordance with the present invention, a reinforcement material is developed to basically reinforce the flange of a dual floor room to be reinforced, and, when seismic reinforcement is determined as lacking through seismic analysis, achieve sufficient seismic performance by additionally reinforcing a support column (row) in which there is no equipment. Moreover, the reinforcement material is developed to be installable on an existing dual floor without the need for the dismantlement of a support. In accordance with another characteristic of the present invention, a material with a high frictional force is applied to the reinforcement material such that the support and the reinforcement material can properly come in tight contact, which can lead to an improvement in seismic performance. As the reinforcement material has passed a test of the National Radio Research Agency 2020-1 test method (6.8 on the Richter scale) in an authorized test institution, the performance thereof is proved.
abstract_ko:
일반적인 이중마루는 지진에 대한 대응 능력이 약하여 이중마루 지주 내진보강을 통하여 지진에 대한 대응능력을 확보하여야 한다. 본 발명에서는 지주결합보강재와 대각보강재, 수평보강재를 활용하여 이중마루지주를 보강하되 해당실 전체 지주를 보강하는 것이 아닌 장비영역을 제외한 영역의 지주를 선택적으로 보강한다. 장비가 있는 영역은 이중마루 지주의 높이가 40cm 이하인 경우가 많아 사람이 작업하기가 사실상 어렵다. 신설 이중마루인 경우도 어렵지만 기 시설된 이중마루의 경우에는 사실상 지주를 보강하는 것은 대부분 어렵다. 
본 발명에서는 보강대상 이중마루실의 테두리를 기본적으로 보강하고 내진해석을 통하여 내진보강이 부족할 경우에는 장비가 없는 지주열(행)을 추가적으로 보강하여도 충분한 내진 성능을 가지도록 하는 보강재를 개발하였다. 또한, 기 설치된 이중마루에 설치하기 위해서 지주를 해체하지 않고 설치가 가능하도록 개발되었다. 본 발명의 또다른 특징은 지주와 보강재가 밀착이 잘될 수 있도록 마찰력이 강한 소재를 보강재에 적용하여 내진 성능을 향상시켰다는 것이다. 본 보강재를 사용하여 공인시험기관에서 ‘국립전파연구원 2020-1 시험방법(리히터규모 6.8수준)’의 시험을 완료하여 성능을 입증하였다.

title_en: Interference SAR sample generation model and image target detection model construction method
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of image detection and discloses a method for constructing an interference SAR sample generation model and an image target detection model, wherein the method for constructing the sample generation model comprises the steps of obtaining an interference-free SAR image and an interference SAR image of a research object, and synthesizing the interference-free SAR image and the interference SAR image to obtain a content image; and training the content image and the style image respectively into a style migration network to generate an interference SAR sample, calculating training loss, updating network parameters through counter propagation to improve the fidelity of generating the interference SAR sample, and training for multiple times until the training loss converges to obtain an interference SAR sample generation model. The style migration network comprises a reversible residual error module, a channel refinement module and a conversion module. By the method, the problem of lack of the current SAR data sample can be solved, and more realistic interference SAR samples can be rapidly generated.

title_en: Multi-source monitoring data analysis method and system based on earthquake active source
abstract_en: The invention provides a multisource monitoring data analysis method and system based on an earthquake active source, which relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and by introducing a pre-trained earthquake wave reinforcement analysis network, the seismic wave strengthening analysis network is composed of a plurality of cascaded model functional layers, and each layer is embedded with a multi-stage knowledge migration unit, so that deep learning and efficient analysis of seismic wave data are realized. The multi-stage knowledge transfer learning mechanism not only can effectively extract key features in time period waveform data, but also gradually enhances understanding and identifying capabilities of seismic wave sequences through layer-by-layer knowledge transfer and node fusion. The method not only improves the accuracy and the robustness of seismic wave data analysis, but also remarkably enhances the sensitivity and the prediction precision of seismic monitoring. By generating the reinforced waveform data and the reinforced learning seismic wave sequence, more reliable and data support is provided for earthquake early warning, seismology research and earthquake disaster assessment.

title_en: Village broadcasting system and method that can disseminate disaster and environmental information through self-communication networks
title_ko: 자가통신망을 통해 재난 및 환경 정보의 전파가 가능한 마을·특정지역 방송 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a village and specific area broadcasting system and method capable of disseminating disaster and environmental information through a private communication network. The village and specific area broadcasting system comprises: a user terminal (15); a security officer terminal (25); a central server (30); an administrator terminal (31); a transmitter (35); a relay unit (40); an environmental sensor (45); and a controller (50). Therefore, disaster broadcasts, environmental broadcasts, news, and administrative broadcasts can be automatically disseminated.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 의한 자가통신망을 통해 재난 및 환경 정보의 전파가 가능한 마을·특정지역 방송 시스템(10)은 특정 지역에 속하는 다수의 가구에 마을방송을 전파하기 위한 것으로, 상기 자가통신망을 통해 재난 및 환경 정보의 전파가 가능한 마을·특정지역 방송 시스템(10)은 상기 특정 지역에 속하는 다수의 가구에 각각 다수 설치되는 사용자단말기(15), 상기 특정 지역을 순찰하는 보안관에게 제공되는 보안관단말기(25), 관리자가 상기 다수의 사용자단말기(15)를 상시 모니터링하기 위한 중앙서버(30), 상기 관리자에게 제공되어, 상기 관리자가 특정 메시지를 입력 처리하기 위한 관리자단말기(31), 재난, 환경, 동보 및 행정데이터를 상기 중앙서버(30), 관리자단말기(31), 사전에 설정된 제1 전파거리 이내의 다수의 사용자단말기(15) 및 중계부(40)로 전송하는 송출기(35), 상기 송출기(35)와 이격되게 구비되어, 상기 송출기(35)로부터 전송받은 데이터를 상기 송출기(35)를 중심으로 상기 제1 전파거리 이내에 속하지 않은 다수의 사용자단말기(15) 및 상기 보안관단말기(25)로 각각 전송하는 중계부(40), 상기 송출기(35)의 일측에 구비되어, 상기 특정 지역의 소음의 크기 및 미세먼지의 농도와 같은 환경데이터를 측정하는 환경센서(45) 및 상기 송출기(35)의 타측에 구비되어, 상기 송출기(35)의 데이터 송출 및 상기 특정 지역에 속한 다수의 사용자단말기(15)의 장애 여부를 점검하는 컨트롤러(50)를 포함하고, 상기 송출기(35)는 기상청으로부터 상기 특정 지역의 지진, 호우, 가뭄, 산불 발생 여부와 같은 재난데이터를 전송받는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Fracture network fluid flow simulation with enhanced fluid-solid interaction force determination
abstract_en: An illustrative hydraulic fracturing flow simulation method includes: identifying a network of fractures within a formation rock matrix; modeling each fracture in the network as fluid flow path having discrete points at which a fluid pressure is determined; representing the rock matrix with discrete nodes at which a fluid-solid interaction force is determined, each said discrete node being associated with multiple discrete points along a fluid flow path; deriving the fluid-solid interaction force for each node from the fluid pressure at the associated discrete points; estimating an extent of fracture propagation based in part on the fluid-solid interaction forces; and displaying a visual representation of the fracture propagation extent. The deriving includes: obtaining an analytic integral of the fluid pressure as modified by a weighting function for each interval between adjacent ones of the associated discrete points; evaluating the analytic integrals for each interval to obtain contributions; and summing the contributions.

title_en: Electric power system risk assessment method based on deterministic analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric power system risk assessment method based on the deterministic analysis. The tide current shifting and node voltage changing caused after a system is disturbed are comprehensively taken into consideration, and a more thorough power grid vulnerability comprehensive analysis index is put forward. The method comprises the following steps that firstly, a system topological structure is analyzed, the tide current distribution of the system after stable running and disturbing is calculated and comprises active tide current and reactive tide current of branch circuits, node voltages and a phase angle difference of the node voltages; secondly, assessment indexes in an assessment system are calculated and comprise a pre-risk assessment factor and a network comprehensive risk assessment factor; thirdly, risk assessment is carried out on an electric power system according to the set index levels. According to the electric power system risk assessment method, the system risk information is more comprehensively reflected, a unified index risk decision is made for tide current threshold-crossing, voltage instability and cascading failure possibly existing in the system, and operators can make rapid and accurate judgment and take measures to guarantee safe and stable running of the system in time.

title_en: Information analysis method, device, equipment and storage medium of complex relation network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of big data, and discloses an information analysis method, device, equipment and storage medium of a complex relationship network, which are used for enhancing the identification and control capacity of community group risks. The information analysis method of the complex relationship network comprises the following steps: dividing a network topological structure of a complex relation network to be analyzed to obtain communities and community information; carrying out linear dimensionality reduction on the community information to obtain community characteristics, and obtaining community characteristic vectors according to the community characteristics; calculating the target similarity between every two community feature vectors, and determining candidate community information according to the target similarity; obtaining target community information, and generating a community weighted graph according to the target community information; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a community to be evaluated, a weighted risk value and a risk value of the community to be evaluated in a community weighted graph, analyzing the weighted risk value through a preset label propagation algorithm to update the risk value of the community to be evaluated, and obtaining the risk degree of the community to be evaluated and the identification degree of the risk through the updated risk value.

title_en: Self-adaptive feedforward active noise reduction method based on neural network filter, computer readable storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a self-adaptive feedforward active noise reduction method based on a neural network filter, a computer readable storage medium and electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of constructing a first neural network model, and using the constructed first neural network model as a feedforward filter in an adaptive feedforward type active noise reduction framework based on the framework. According to the invention, the feedforward filter in the adaptive feedforward active noise reduction architecture is changed into the first neural network model, the nonlinear filter characteristic of the neural network is utilized to realize better control of noise, and the harmonic wave and intermodulation distortion phenomenon caused by nonlinear links in the propagation path from the A-bit noise source to the B-bit loudspeaker are improved.

title_en: Cascade water-light complementary day-ahead robust peak shaving scheduling method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of multi-energy complementary power generation, in particular to a method, a system, equipment and a medium for gradient water-light complementary day-ahead robust peak regulation and scheduling, which comprise the following steps: establishing an objective function of step water-light complementary day-ahead robust peak regulation scheduling by taking the minimum peak-valley difference of the residual load of the receiving-end power grid as an objective; establishing a day-ahead scheduling constraint condition taking hydraulic coupling into account mainly step hydropower constraint; performing uncertainty set modeling and robust equivalent transformation on the photovoltaic output, and transforming the nonlinear constraint of the step hydropower into linear constraint; constructing a mixed integer linear programming model of cascade hydropower joint optimization scheduling by using an objective function and linear constraint; and solving the planning model to obtain the day-ahead robust scheduling method of the cascade water-light complementary combined power generation system. According to the invention, uncertainty of photovoltaic output can be fully considered, peak regulation effect and photovoltaic digestion of the combined power generation system are considered, and complementary operation of step hydropower and photovoltaic is realized.

title_en: Natural language processing method suitable for power dispatching
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power dispatching, and discloses a natural language processing method suitable for power dispatching, which comprises the following steps: collecting data of a power generation unit to generate a feature vector of the power generation unit; constructing a knowledge graph based on the circuit layout, inputting a first neural network, outputting grid-connected point voltage at the next time point, generating a loss value, back-propagating an updated parameter feature vector, and then re-inputting the updated parameter feature vector into a fourth hidden layer; the invention generates the reactive power scheduling parameter for each power generation unit by a deep learning method, and can utilize the reactive power generated by the power generation unit to adjust the power balance of the power generation system.
assignees: STATE GRID INFORMATION & TELECOMMUNICATION CO LTD;Fujian yirong information technology co ltd

title_en: Infrastructure pipe network failure cascade analysis method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascade analysis method for failure of an infrastructure pipe network, which comprises the following steps: constructing a network topology structure diagram of the target area by adopting geographic information system software according to the general survey data of the pipe network of the target area; determining a supply node and a load node of a network according to a network topology structure diagram; according to the supply node and the load node, analyzing and acquiring the reliability of network communication; and obtaining an important supply pipeline and a weak supply node according to the network communication reliability. By the method, important supply pipe sections and weak supply nodes of various infrastructure networks can be identified, and guidance for disaster prevention planning is facilitated.

title_en: Step small hydropower station group optimization scheduling method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascade small hydropower station group optimal scheduling method, which comprises the steps of firstly determining a scheduling objective function according to scheduling requirements of a cascade small hydropower station group; determining a scheduling constraint condition; inputting basic data of a hydropower station, initializing a water level of the hydropower station for one year, calculating the power generation amount and guaranteeing the output size to perform non-dominant sorting through water level change of one year; and then improving the badger algorithm, performing mutation operation on data in an initialization stage by utilizing the improved badger algorithm, calculating the generated energy and guaranteeing the output size, performing non-dominant sorting to select an optimal solution, adding the optimal solution into an archive set, iterating, and finally outputting a global optimal solution in the iterating process to obtain an optimal solution set. The invention has good local refinement capability along with the continuous self-adaptive adjustment of iteration, overcomes the defects of early maturity convergence, local optimal solution instead of global optimal solution and the like of the scheduling solution of the previous cascade small hydropower station group, and greatly improves the economic benefit and cascade small hydropower peak regulation capability of the cascade small hydropower station important by a power grid.
assignees: ZHUZHOU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Method for detecting integrity of full-link simulation signals of backboard and sub-board combined backboard
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of signal integrity detection, in particular to a method for detecting the full-link simulation signal integrity of a backboard and a sub-board base plate, which comprises the steps of connecting all circuit boards well to obtain a connecting circuit board, adopting a network analyzer to evaluate the electrical performance of the connecting circuit board, carrying out topology analysis on the connecting circuit board to confirm the worst condition of the connecting circuit board, carrying out high-speed channel modeling on the connecting circuit board, and carrying out cascade eye simulation.
assignees: NO 34 RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA ELECTRONICS TECH GROUP CORPORATION CETC

title_en: Elasticity evaluation method for AC/DC series-parallel power information physical system under cooperative attack
abstract_en: The invention discloses an elasticity evaluation method of an alternating current-direct current hybrid power information physical system under a collaborative attack, which is used for constructing a multidimensional heterogeneous model of the alternating current-direct current hybrid power information physical system according to an actual information network framework and completing matrixing modeling of the alternating current-direct current hybrid power information physical system based on a method of an incidence matrix. And then, based on a matrixing modeling method, information physical cooperative attack is constructed, so that diversified cooperative attack can be carried out on the multidimensional heterogeneous model, and cascade fault diffusion is caused. Finally, a new elastic index, namely a cascading failure recovery index CFRI, is provided, wherein the index considers the factors such as the node number, branch number and load quantity of the system during the cascade failure diffusion so as to evaluate the disconnection capability and recovery capability of the AC/DC series-parallel power information physical system in the face of the cascade failure. The method can effectively complete the elasticity evaluation of the AC/DC series-parallel power information physical system under the cooperative attack, and reduce the influence of an attacker on the power grid to the greatest extent.

title_en: Output optimization method, system, equipment and medium under complementary scheduling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, equipment and a medium for optimizing output under complementary scheduling, wherein the method acquires data of cascade hydropower, wind farms and optical electric farms, constructs a graph neural network based on geographic position data, configures weights of edges according to historical power generation data, nodes of the graph neural network represent fans, photovoltaic arrays and hydropower stations at different geographic positions, performs weather prediction according to current short-term weather data based on the constructed graph neural network, constructs an evaluation model based on double-layer Monte Carlo-condition risk, outputs probability density functions of output prediction according to the evaluation model, and performs output optimization. According to the invention, a graph neural network is established to capture the propagation condition of weather elements possibly existing in a non-uniform observation network, comprehensive evaluation of water, wind and light is realized by constructing an evaluation model, and a reference direction for short-term complementary output optimization is given by a probability density function, so that the scheduling effect of complementary optimization is improved.

title_en: Urban source network charge storage risk pre-judging method, scheduling method and system in extreme weather
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a scheduling method and a system for predicting urban source network charge storage risk in extreme weather, wherein the risk predicting method comprises the steps of acquiring real-time information of urban infrastructure states in extreme weather based on disaster-tolerant sensors deployed on urban infrastructure; based on the acquired weather data and real-time information, coupling extreme weather with vulnerability of urban source network charge storage by using a pre-constructed space-time coupling risk conduction model to obtain risk conduction prediction data of the extreme weather on the urban source network charge storage and source network charge storage node alarm information, wherein the space-time coupling risk conduction model is constructed based on a space-time diagram convolution network. The space-time coupling risk conduction model can give consideration to composite conduction pre-judgment of multi-disaster coupling, linkage cascade and tail risk, realizes quantitative prediction on the linkage process of extreme weather-equipment failure-load reduction-energy storage exhaustion, and remarkably improves the risk pre-judgment precision. The disaster tolerance sensor provided ensures the reliability of data transmission.
assignees: STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER ENGINEERING RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Data security compliance risk assessment system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of digital security assessment and discloses a data security compliance risk assessment system which comprises the steps of automatically retrieving data related to a target industry based on a preset network model, extracting structural risk factors and aging identifications of the data, judging whether index differences exist or not, carrying out semantic alignment and difference comparison on output knowledge segments and local risk indexes, judging whether a credible score of a risk adjustment suggestion exceeds a set threshold value, judging whether an update result identifies a high risk item according to the generated update suggestion, constructing an attack path corresponding to the high risk item based on a multidimensional logic deduction algorithm in a virtualized security event simulation environment, simulating a multi-scene risk propagation process, calculating a comprehensive risk index and outputting a deduction result, and recording the risk propagation path based on the deduction result to form a verified risk knowledge segment and feeding the verified risk knowledge segment back to a security compliance assessment database. The invention has the advantage of improving the accuracy of the evaluation result.

title_en: The Ministry spread direction by electronic display board and The anti-crime CCTV system including the civil defense's improved disaster forecast-alarm broadcasting and The way to broadcast using an anti-crime CCTV and The integral unit and The civil defense/disaster forecast-alarm smart bell and The Military Demarcation Line prallel monitoring IR perspective filter backlight camera CCTV blackbox and The block type controller of DMG quantum code electronic protective wall
title_ko: 방범용 감시카메라 내부망을 이용한 행정안전부 전광판 활용 민방위경보 전파지침 표출 민방위 재난예경보 동보방송 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for displaying civil defense warning dissemination guidelines and broadcasting civil defense disaster reports and warnings by using electronic displays and the internal networks of monitoring cameras for crime prevention in the Ministry of Public Administration and Security. An emergency bell-integrated enclosure has camera sets installed on four sides thereof to monitor all directions within 90 degrees, provided on top of the enclosure, each including a pair of a great-focal-distance camera and a small-focal-distance camera. A total of eight emergency bell cameras having a 360-degree monitoring fixed camera function to prevent dead zones are installed. The emergency bell-integrated enclosure includes a switch hub, a power supply, a broadcasting device, an image storage memory, and an Eve SERVER. The Eve SERVER and a Bob SERVER communicate with each other through an unlicensed frequency wireless communication device. Images captured by monitoring cameras for crime prevention are transmitted to an integrated crime prevention center through the switch hub and monitored in real time. Images captured by the emergency bell cameras are stored in the image storage memory. A wireless integrated enclosure has four wireless small-focal-distance cameras installed on top of the enclosure to monitor all directions within 90 degrees. The Eve SERVER and the Bob SERVER communicate with each other through the unlicensed frequency wireless communication device. An emergency bell button is inserted into the front of the wireless integrated enclosure. When the emergency bell button operates, the Eve SERVER connects to the Bob SERVER through an unlicensed frequency wireless private network and establishes a two-way call with an Alice SERVER provided in the integrated crime prevention center. Therefore, the method can achieve the effect of improvements in performance with enhanced security.
abstract_ko:
비상벨 일체형 함체는 외함 상단에 고초점거리 카메라 및 저초점거리 카메라 2대 1조로 구성되어 90도 전방위를 감시하는 카메라 세트를 4면에 설치하여 사각방지용 360도 감시 고정카메라 기능의 총 8대의 비상벨 카메라가 설치된다. 
비상벨 일체형 함체는 스위치허브, 전원부, 방송장치, 영상저장 메모리, Eve SERVER를 포함하여 구성되어, Eve SERVER와 Bob SERVER는 비면허주파수 무선통신장치를 통하여 통신하고, 방범용 감시카메라의 촬영영상은 스위치허브를 통해 통합방범센터로 전송하여 실시간 감시하고, 비상벨 카메라의 촬영영상은 영상저장 메모리에 저장된다. 
무선 일체형 함체는 외함 상단에 각 90도 전방위를 감시하는 저초점거리 카메라 4대의 무선 카메라가 설치되고, Eve SERVER와 Bob SERVER는 비면허주파수 무선통신장치를 통하여 통신한다. 
무선 일체형 함체 전면에 비상벨 버튼이 삽입되어, 비상벨 버튼 작동시 Eve SERVER는 비면허주파수 무선자가망을 통해 Bob SERVER와 네트워크망 연결 후 통합방범센터 내부 Alice SERVER와 양방향 통화로 개통한다.

title_en: Abnormality factor estimation device, learning device, precise diagnostic system, and abnormality factor estimation method
abstract_en: The present invention involves: a sensor data acquisition unit (10) that acquires a plurality of sets of time-series sensor data collected by a plurality of sensors (300) provided in a plurality of facility components constituting a target facility; an abnormality detection unit (30) that detects a plurality of abnormality-detecting sensors that are experiencing abnormality on the basis of the plurality of sets of sensor data; an abnormality detection order estimation unit (40) that estimates the abnormality detection order in which the plurality of abnormality-detecting sensors have been detected as experiencing abnormality; an abnormality propagation path tracing unit (50) that estimates the abnormality propagation order in which an abnormality has propagated on the basis of abnormality-detecting sensor information regarding the plurality of abnormality-detecting sensors and an estimated structure that shows dependencies between the facility components; and an abnormality factor estimation unit (60) that estimates factors for the abnormality on the basis of the abnormality detection order and the abnormality propagation order.

title_en: Load prediction method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a load prediction method and a load prediction device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: receiving a first initial load predicted value currently output by at least two single prediction models; inputting each first initial load predicted value into a pre-trained Back Propagation Neural Network (BPNN) model; and determining a target load predicted value based on the BPNN model. In the embodiment of the invention, when the load prediction is carried out, the first initial load predicted value is firstly determined based on the single predicted model, then each first initial load predicted value is input into the pre-trained BPNN model, and the target load predicted value is determined by combining each first initial load predicted value based on the BPNN model, so that the problem that the single model is prone to being trapped into local optimization under the conditions of poor convergence, large fluctuation and influence of emergency on data sets is avoided, and the determined target load predicted value is more accurate.

title_en: Electric DebtRank algorithm-based electric power system fragile line identification method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric power system fragile line identification method based on an electric DebtRank algorithm. Firstly, establishing a dual topology model of the power system, wherein lines in the power system correspond to nodes in the dual topology model, and the connection relationship among the lines corresponds to edges of the dual topology model; then, the three states of the normal state, the heavy load state and the fault state of the line are included in the identification process of the fragile line, and an electric DebtRank algorithm considering the line load flow and the network topological structure is provided for identifying the fragile line of the power system; finally, through power system cascading failure simulation comparative analysis, the weak line identified by the electrical DebtRank algorithm is proved to have larger influence on the power system compared with the existing method. The method can identify the fragile lines in the power system, strengthen and protect the fragile lines, can effectively prevent cascading failures caused by the weak links, and can provide a certain reference value for avoiding blackout accidents.

title_en: Power flow convergence adjustment method based on deep reinforcement learning and cascade graph neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power flow convergence adjusting method based on deep reinforcement learning and a cascade graph neural network. Reinforcement learning can be realized by constantly performing interaction of actions (tide adjustment actions) and environments (current tide parameters), learning adjustable action strategies through rewards of the environments on the actions, and constructing nonlinear mapping relations between different actions and final values of the actions in the current environments by deep learning. The method takes the power flow convergence probability obtained by the cascade graph neural network as one of design references of the rewarding function, finally obtains a power flow convergence adjustment strategy, and has important significance for guaranteeing safe and stable operation of the power system.

title_en: Short-term power generation plan manufacturing method of cascade hydropower station considering peak regulation depth
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for manufacturing a short-term power generation plan of a cascade hydropower station by considering peak regulation depth, which relates to the field of short-term optimized dispatching of the cascade hydropower station in the power industry, and comprises the following steps: step 1: determining a short-term power generation plan making thought considering peak regulation depth; step 2: aiming at the characteristics of different peak regulation amplitudes and different water abandoning amounts in different periods, respectively establishing flood season models, dead season models and flat water season models, taking peak regulation at different depths and water abandoning amount reduction as targets, determining model constraint conditions by combining a step energy storage control strategy of key time nodes in an actual dispatching process and step power station peak capacity meeting power consumption requirements of a power grid, wherein the constraints comprise constraints such as water balance, reservoir water level constraint, final water level control, peak regulation depth constraint, power generation flow constraint, reservoir outlet flow constraint, power station output constraint and the like, and determining a model solving algorithm; step 3: and short-term optimization scheduling solving is carried out by using a heuristic algorithm.

title_en: Wavefront sensor construction method based on coding and decoding combined optimization
abstract_en: The application provides a wave front sensor construction method based on coding and decoding combined optimization, which comprises the following steps: carrying out mathematical modeling on the propagation process of the optical wave to obtain a coding module, and constructing a network architecture comprising the coding module and the decoding module; based on a depth learning technology, carrying out joint training on the structure of the coding layer and a wavefront reconstruction algorithm to obtain optimized coding structure and reconstruction parameters; preparing an optimized coding layer by using a novel material, and replacing original protective glass on the surface of the wavefront sensor with the prepared coding layer; and carrying out physical calibration on the structure of the integrated coding layer, fine-tuning the network architecture based on the current application task, and adjusting a reconstruction algorithm of the wavefront sensor according to the fine-tuned reconstruction parameters. The method can construct a miniaturized and lightweight wave-front sensor to reconstruct wave-front with high quality and high efficiency by carrying out joint optimization on the coding layer structure and the wave-front reconstruction algorithm.

title_en: Intelligent fault diagnosis method and system for electrical equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fault diagnosis of electrical equipment, in particular to an intelligent fault diagnosis method and system of electrical equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps of uniformly fusing equipment state information, electrical distance weighted connection and phase dynamic coupling relation by constructing a multidimensional tensor model, and extracting an abnormal propagation mode by utilizing high-order singular value decomposition; the method comprises the steps of designing a space-time-frequency coupling interference stripping mechanism, combining structure-guided disturbance deconstruction, multi-scale dictionary learning and sparse low-rank decomposition to accurately separate transmissibility and non-transmissibility interference, reconstructing a fault track based on a generation countermeasure mechanism, coupling a graph structure dynamic encoder, a topology consistency discriminator and a time controllable generator to restore a real propagation path, and finally integrating tensor semantic compression, a three-view graph neural network and fault label back projection interpretation through a multi-source semantic fusion mechanism. The invention realizes the fault diagnosis and tracing of the space-time and structure, and improves the accuracy and the interpretability.

title_en: Broadband oscillation suppression method, system and medium for offshore wind power soft direct grid-connected system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of stable control of power systems, in particular to a broadband oscillation suppression method, a system and a medium of an offshore wind power soft direct grid-connected system, which comprise the steps of sequentially injecting positive and negative sequence perturbation sine harmonic signals at grid-connected points of a wind turbine generator, constructing a multi-input multi-output impedance matrix, and reducing the multi-input multi-output impedance matrix into single-input single-output equivalent positive sequence impedance; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a stability margin of an offshore wind power soft direct grid-connected system based on equivalent positive sequence impedance quantification, reconstructing a fan network side converter into a matrix control structure by cascading a weighting coefficient matrix between an inner loop control loop and an outer loop control loop of the fan network side converter when the stability margin is lower than a preset margin threshold value, iteratively optimizing the matrix control structure based on impedance sensitivity, and synchronously carrying out impedance remodeling on a low-pass filter connected in series with a voltage and current feedback channel to complete broadband oscillation risk inhibition. According to the invention, broadband oscillation suppression of the offshore wind power soft-direct grid-connected system is realized through impedance modeling and matrix control strategies.

title_en: Monitoring system for fire of railway car
title_ko: 도시철도의 화재 감지 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 도시철도의 화재 감지 시스템 및 그 방법에 관한 것으로서, 공기 중 휘발물질의 농도를 측정하여 화재 발생 여부를 감지하도록 복수의 센서들로 구성된 센서부와, 상기 센서부를 통해 화재 발생이 감지되면 영상을 통해 검증하는 카메라부와, 상기 센서부 및 카메라부를 통해 발화점을 파악하고, 화재의 전파 방향 및 전파 속도를 파악하는 화재 판단부로 구성된 것을 특징으로 한다.
