title_en: Big data-based electrical load prediction system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a big data-based electrical load prediction system. According to the system, a prediction is carried out on the electric load capacity of one place in the future by an error back-propagation neural network method; the error back-propagation neural network method comprises an input layer, a hidden layer and an output layer; a mathematic model of the error back-propagation neural network method can be established through a function relationship among the input layer, the hidden layer and the output layer; input layer information corresponds to historical data of the electric load capacity; output layer information corresponds to predicted data of the electric load capacity; and the hidden layer corresponds to the function relationship between the predicted data and the historical data. According to the big data-based electrical load prediction system, the prediction is carried out the electric load capacity in the future by the error back-propagation neural network method; and the mathematic model of the error back-propagation neural network method is established, so that the prediction result is relatively accurate; the error can be accurately calculated; and a great convenience is brought to life.

title_en: Power distribution network line risk assessment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network line risk assessment method, which comprises the steps of calculating scores of screening factors by adopting a principal component method according to historical fault data of a power distribution network line fault unit through stepwise regression screening indexes, converting score values and bringing the score values into an EMLR algorithm for machine learning to obtain a risk value calculation model of the power distribution network line fault unit, then popularizing the risk value calculation model by utilizing a BP (Back propagation) neural network, and finally importing test data into the neural network calculation model to realize prediction and assessment of the risk values of the line units; through integrating and analyzing the existing power distribution network line data, the digitization and the visualization of the risk degree of the power distribution network line are realized, and the purposes of differential operation and maintenance of risk line units, targeted engineering transformation and safe production are achieved. Through the prediction of the risk, the target investigation of high-risk projects can be facilitated, the occurrence probability of power failure accidents is effectively reduced, and the power supply reliability of the power distribution network is improved.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;Tongliang Power Supply Branch Of State Grid Chongqing Electric Power Company

title_en: Vehicle network system harmonic time-frequency analysis method based on synchronous compression wavelet transform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vehicle network system harmonic time-frequency analysis method based on synchronous compression wavelet transformation, which comprises the steps of observing network side current and voltage signals by setting different switching frequencies and traction network equivalent parameters under the cascade operation of an equivalent traction network and a CRH5 type vehicle rectifier under the condition of considering time delay generated by a digital control circuit, and analyzing the signals by utilizing the synchronous compression wavelet transformation; the analysis result of the method has good time-frequency resolution, and the amplitude and the frequency of harmonic amplification can be effectively identified when the system has harmonic instability; the invention is convenient to implement and has higher adaptability.

title_en: Power grid telemetering jump data screening method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for screening telemetering jump data of a power grid, which comprises the following steps: acquiring power grid telemetering acquired data, and identifying the telemetering type of the power grid telemetering acquired data; if the power grid telemetering acquired data are in the data interval range corresponding to the telemetering type, the power grid telemetering acquired data are determined to be effective telemetering data; otherwise, determining the data as hopping data to be screened; the calculation of the data interval range comprises the following steps: acquiring a data set of historical telemetering data of a power grid; according to the data set of the historical telemetering data of the power grid, clustering analysis is carried out by adopting a neighbor propagation algorithm to obtain clustering relevance data of different telemetering types; and calculating the mean value and the standard deviation of the relevance data of different telemetry types to obtain the data interval ranges corresponding to the different telemetry types. The data interval range is obtained from the historical power grid telemetering data, and whether the subsequent power grid telemetering acquired data is jump data or not is analyzed and screened based on the characteristics of the data, so that the method has strong universality and expansibility.

title_en: Traffic system elasticity assessment method based on multilayer complex network theory
abstract_en: The invention provides a traffic system elasticity assessment method based on a multilayer complex network theory, which is characterized by comprising the following steps of: the method comprises the following steps: step 1, acquiring related data of a traffic system, abstracting the related data into a complex network model aiming at a single research object, and analyzing the topological characteristics of the network; step 2: improving the recovery process of the traditional dynamic propagation model simulation traffic network after being interfered, and exploring the dynamic propagation mechanism of faults; step 3: analyzing the fault propagation process, and exploring the relation between the system recovery probability and the elastic performance thereof and the network structure aiming at a single traffic network based on an improved model; step 4: combining interdependent complex traffic system data, constructing a mutually coupled multi-stage complex traffic network based on the multi-layer network theory by considering the directionality of links, and exploring the structural characteristics of the network; step 5: and (3) expanding a propagation model, analyzing the propagation process of faults between layers in the layer, evaluating the elasticity of the multi-layer traffic system, and determining the quantitative relation between the network characteristic index and the system elasticity performance.

title_en: Bridge deck pavement crack propagation sensitivity analysis method, device and storage medium based on GA-BP neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a bridge deck pavement crack propagation sensitivity analysis method, a device and a storage medium based on a GA-BP neural network, wherein the method comprises the following steps: step S1: acquiring a plurality of groups of test data, wherein the test data comprise values of all sensitivity parameters and corresponding values of the maximum crack volume; step S2: training a fracture volume prediction model based on the acquired test data, wherein the fracture volume prediction model is a GA-BP neural network; step S3: selecting a sensitivity parameter; step S4: controlling the selected sensitivity parameters to change in a corresponding preconfigured range, keeping other sensitivity parameters unchanged, obtaining a plurality of target prediction data sets, and inputting each obtained target prediction data set into a trained fracture volume prediction model to obtain a prediction value of the maximum fracture volume corresponding to each target prediction data set; step S5: judging whether traversing of all the sensitive parameters is completed, if yes, executing a step S6, otherwise, selecting one sensitive parameter which is not traversed and returning to the step S4; step S6: and obtaining the local contribution degree and the global sensitivity of each sensitivity parameter based on all target prediction data sets and the prediction value of the corresponding maximum crack volume. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of high speed, high accuracy and the like.

title_en: Method and device for rapidly calculating traffic noise map, electronic equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid calculation method, a rapid calculation device, electronic equipment and a rapid calculation medium for a traffic noise map, wherein the rapid calculation method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of forming a noise source file through multi-source data, converting a building contour shape file into a building binary image, then obtaining an initial noise map grid matrix through a road network and the building contour shape file in a receiving point sound pressure level prediction stage, establishing an initial noise propagation matrix for each road section according to atmospheric attenuation, angle attenuation and road section limited correction coefficients, calculating building density noise attenuation through a Bresenham algorithm, calculating front building noise shielding attenuation according to the building contour shape file, and finally carrying out mapping and acoustic energy superposition on the noise propagation matrices of all road sections according to the initial noise map grid matrix in a result aggregation stage to obtain a road traffic noise map with a complete research area, wherein the method can be widely applied to the technical field of data processing.
assignees: UNIV SUN YAT SEN;SHENZHEN ECOLOGICAL ENV INTELLIGENT PIPE CONTROL CENTER

title_en: Power distribution network fault self-healing method and system considering photovoltaic output
abstract_en: The invention provides a power distribution network fault self-healing method and system considering photovoltaic output, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring historical operation data of a photovoltaic power station and observation data of illumination intensity of a meteorological station; based on historical operation data of the photovoltaic power station and illumination intensity observation data of the meteorological station, predicting the power generation of the photovoltaic power station by using a convolution long-short-term memory recurrent neural network model considering sparrow search; according to the power generation power of the photovoltaic power station, the sectional switch state of the power distribution network and the network topology of the power distribution network, constructing an objective function and constraint conditions of a power distribution network fault self-healing model, and obtaining the power distribution network fault self-healing model; solving a power distribution network fault self-healing model by using a propagation search algorithm to obtain an optimal recovery strategy; executing the optimal recovery strategy through a sectionalizing switch and a node load; the invention can realize the self-healing of the power distribution network faults on the premise of ensuring the minimum cost of the distributed power supply, the minimum network loss and the minimum node voltage deviation.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Method for evaluating fluctuation defending capacity of cascade hydropower station on new energy source end of power grid
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of multi-energy power system dispatching, and relates to a method for evaluating fluctuation defending capacity of a cascade hydropower station on a new energy source end of a power grid. The technical proposal is as follows: firstly, constructing a reference model with the maximum final energy storage of the cascade hydroelectric dispatching as an objective function, taking the final energy storage of the cascade hydroelectric dispatching solved by the model as a final energy storage control reference value, and then constructing an disturbance optimizing evaluation model with the maximum requirement for regulating the extreme electric quantity for optimizing the defending capability of the target cascade hydroelectric station to the fluctuation of the new energy source end. The framework can be used for analyzing and quantifying the defending capability of the step hydropower on the fluctuation of the new energy source end, and the result can provide guidance for power and electric quantity balance scheduling and planning in extreme weather. The invention makes quantitative evaluation on the defending capability of the cascade hydropower station to the fluctuation of the new energy source end for the first time.

title_en: Field road and field cascade simulation method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of antennas, and relates to a field path and field cascade simulation method. The method comprises field simulation, path simulation, cascade simulation and iteration; setting the electrical performance parameters of the antenna according to the performance parameters and the structural parameters of the antenna through field simulation; outputting SnP parameters of the matching circuit through path simulation; constructing a cascade simulation model comprising a plurality of ports through cascade simulation; importing SnP parameters into a cascading simulation model; connecting an antenna element port with an antenna through a matching circuit; adding an excitation signal to an input port of the output matching circuit; and (5) simulating and solving the electrical performance parameters of the antenna. The invention combines electromagnetic field antenna simulation and circuit simulation, completes the evaluation of the overall matching performance and radiation performance of the antenna after the matching network is introduced, realizes the predictability of design, and can obtain the optimal antenna after the comprehensive vibrator and the matching circuit through multiple iterations.
assignees: CHENGDU ZHONGYA TONGMAO TECH CO LTD

title_en: Data analysis method and system for multi-energy complementary power distribution system based on deep learning
abstract_en: According to the deep learning-based multi-energy complementary power distribution system data analysis method, firstly, preprocessing and feature extraction are carried out on multi-source heterogeneous sensor data, and key indexes reflecting the health state of equipment are obtained. And then obtaining the globally consistent equipment state representation through a space-time data fusion technology. And then constructing a multi-fault mode knowledge base, and identifying fault types by adopting a multi-label classification algorithm of deep learning. And finally, establishing a mapping relation between the equipment topological structure and the fault propagation path by using an attention mechanism and a graph rolling network, and deducing the specific position of equipment breakage through fault tracing and influence analysis. The invention also adopts methods such as data enhancement, transfer learning and the like to improve the robustness and generalization capability of the model, and realizes real-time and reliable fault positioning through edge calculation. The method can accurately locate equipment faults in the multi-energy complementary power distribution system, and improves the reliability and safety of the system.
assignees: SHAANXI HUATIAN JUNENG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Post-disaster power distribution network optimization reconstruction method based on distributed power supply participation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a post-disaster power distribution network optimization reconstruction method based on distributed power supply participation, which relates to the technical field of power distribution network optimization reconstruction and comprises the following steps of inputting a frequency state discrete vector set into a disturbance cross recognition model, calculating a frequency disturbance propagation factor and a response difference gradient between any two distributed power supplies based on a disturbance sensitivity algorithm of covariance deviation judgment, and recognizing a frequency disturbance source and a frequency inconsistency problem according to a determined local frequency state; constructing an adaptation capability assessment tensor, fusing a frequency disturbance propagation factor, a response difference gradient and a frequency state discrete vector set, executing fuzzy clustering and weight self-adaptive fusion mapping operation, generating a frequency adaptation index, and judging grid-connected adaptation capability of an island region. The method solves the technical problem that the frequency control isomerism of the post-disaster island region is difficult to identify the grid-connected suitability, and realizes the safety and coordination judgment of the multi-source isomerism distributed power supply access.

title_en: Power supply and demand prediction method suitable for complex market environment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power supply and demand prediction, and discloses a power supply and demand prediction method suitable for a complex market environment. The method comprises the steps of collecting multidimensional real-time data of an electric power market, covering a user side load fluctuation sequence and a market price fluctuation signal, constructing an electric power supply and demand dynamic prediction model based on the data, outputting a theoretical supply demand prediction value, comparing the theoretical prediction value with actual metering electric power data, carrying out multidimensional difference analysis of load sequence deviation response delay to generate a market-level difference coefficient matrix, inputting the matrix into an area energy network analysis model, combining power grid node transmission capacity and economic main body distribution information to generate a supply and demand abnormal propagation path probability distribution map, positioning a potential market imbalance area, starting high frequency data monitoring on the high probability imbalance area according to a probability distribution map self-adaptive configuration prediction regulation strategy, applying policy disturbance test on an associated market main body, and supporting stable operation of the electric power market.
assignees: HANGZHOU QIZHI ENERGY TECH CO LTD;ZHEJIANG QIZHI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Urban flood disaster chain propagation simulation method based on disaster-bearing body function destruction mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses an urban flood disaster chain propagation simulation method based on a disaster bearing body function destruction mechanism, relates to the field of hydraulic engineering and disaster prevention and reduction, and solves the problems of insufficient mechanism description, imperfect relevance analysis and the like of the conventional method. The method comprises the steps of inputting flood inundation scenes, combining a disaster-bearing body direct function destruction mechanism and an indirect function destruction mechanism, determining a core disaster-bearing body destruction threshold and probability distribution, identifying a direct destruction unit, establishing a life line facility function association network, calculating the total function failure probability of the disaster-bearing body, identifying an indirect destruction unit, updating the function states of the disaster-bearing body scene by scene, constructing a space propagation model, forming different scene disaster chain networks, and finally outputting key information. The invention can accurately simulate the disaster chain propagation, improves the scientificity of risk assessment and emergency response, and provides reference for disaster prevention and reduction decisions.

title_en: Demand side resource hierarchical classification method based on interaction behavior driving factors
abstract_en: The application provides a demand side resource hierarchical classification method based on interaction behavior driving factors, which comprises the steps of obtaining a current clustering label set of a current demand side resource set by adopting a clustering total model constructed based on a convolutional neural network, a self-encoder and a Gaussian mixture model, obtaining a current behavior feature set and a current interaction influence index set of the current demand side resource set by adopting a dynamic factor analysis model constructed based on a graph neural network, obtaining a hierarchical classification result of the current demand side resource set according to the current clustering label, the current behavior feature set and the current interaction influence index set by adopting a hierarchical classification model, and constructing the hierarchical classification model based on a historical demand side resource set, the clustering total model, the dynamic factor analysis model, a self-adaptive deep cascade forest and multi-task reinforcement learning. The method has the advantages of high data processing efficiency and precision, prediction accuracy, deep improvement of decision support and strong adaptability in complex environments, and improves the intellectualization and accuracy of resource scheduling.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RESEARCH INST CO LTD;MARKETING SERVICE CENTER OF STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Model-energized supply chain risk early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a model-energized supply chain risk early warning method and system, which comprise the following steps of detecting whether an abnormal ordering block exists in acquired supply chain data, if so, carrying out supply chain path restoration according to the abnormal ordering block to obtain a risk link diagram, inputting the risk link diagram into a preset time sequence diagram neural network model to carry out risk conduction analysis to obtain risk probability distribution and a prediction influence range, generating a risk early warning report based on the risk probability distribution and the prediction influence range, and pushing the risk early warning report to a relevant decision maker to support risk prevention and control and emergency response, thereby solving the technical problem that the conventional method cannot judge a path of abnormal order propagation in time, and the risk early warning is often delayed from a process of actual risk occurrence.

title_en: In order to small, medium size enterprise, Visible prognostics system for the machinery out of order and quality failure on the advanced factory automatic based on the embeded I.O.T technology
title_ko: 중소.중견기업에 최적화된 내장된 i.o.t기술을 응용한 첨단제품 제조 자동화 라인의 설비고장과 품질불량의 가시적 예지 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a visible prognostic system of an equipment failure and a poor quality of a high-tech product manufacturing automation line utilizing an embedded I.O.T technology optimized for small or mid-sized firms. The visible prognostic system comprises: an automation production line (10); a trouble and human error processing means (20); a plurality of shop servers (30); a quality analysis center (40); a virtual personal network (50); a company server (60); and a central control tower (70). The present invention initially recognizes problems and prevents an unplanned outage to completely exclude unexpected problems in a high-tech product manufacturing automation line; identifies what is managed/why it is managed/how it is managed while a plan stops to make valid supposition possible and prevents determination based on impulsive intuition in future decision-making; increases a planned period for conveniences and makes cooperation and correction activities possible to handle an emergency situation when errors (failure and faulty) suddenly occur; makes writing of an automated integration report possible to greatly reduce waste of time taken for reporting a result as well as self-management or cooperation with a related engineer in case of faulty; and maintains prognosis, shares unexpected problems, allows related people or organizations to voluntarily participate, and develops an internal limited I.O.T technology (development of Appls) such that handling processes of occurring problems are recorded to make post evaluation possible.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 내장된(Embeded) I.O.T기술을 응용한 첨단제품 제조 자동화 라인의 설비고장과 품질불량 가시적 예지 시스템에 관한 것으로, 자동화 생산라인(10)과; 트러블 및 휴먼에러 처리수단(20)과; 다수의 샵서버(30)와; 품질 분석센터(40)와; 가상 퍼스널 네트워크(50)와; 회사서버(60) 및; 중앙 콘트롤타워(70)로 구성되어 첨단제품 제조 자동화 라인에서 예상 밖의 발생하는 문제들을 철저히 배제하기 위하여 초기에 문제를 인식하고 계획되지 않은 중단(outage)을 방지하고, 근거 있는 추측이 가능하도록 계획 중단 동안 무엇을/왜/어떻게 관리하는지를 파악하고 미래 의사결정에 있어서 충동적인 직감에 기반 하지 않도록 하고, 편리성의 추구를 위하여 계획적인 주기(planning horizon)가 늘어나도록 하며 돌발 장애(고장과 불량)의 발생시 긴급 조치하도록 협업하여 수정 활동을 할 수 있으며, 불량의 경우는 자체 관리 또는 관련 엔지니어(Engineer)와 협업하도록 할 뿐만 아니라 결과보고 상황을 전파하는 낭비되는 시간의 대폭축소가 가능한 자동화된 융합보고서(integration)를 작성할 수 있을 뿐만 아니라 예지 보전과 돌발 문제의 상황이 공유되고 관련된 사람 또는 조직이 자발적으로 참여가 가능하고 발생한 문제해결 과정의 기록이 남도록 하여 사후평가가 가능하도록 내부의 제한된 I..O.T기술(Appls의 개발)을 전개할 수 있는 각별한 장점도 있는 유용한 발명이다.
