title_en: Pipe connecting device, and pipe construction method using same
title_ko: 배관 연결장치 및 이를 이용한 배관 시공방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a pipe connecting device embedded in and provided to a through-hole part, which penetrates a wall or a slab forming a part between the floors of a building, so as to connect and fix a penetration pipe passing through the through-hole part, and provides a pipe connecting device comprising: a sleeve body provided at the through-hole part, which is formed in a pipe shape, having a through-hole into which the penetration pipe is inserted, and having a foaming agent accommodation space formed to be expanded from one end portion thereof such that one side of the accommodation space is open; a foaming refractory filler accommodated in the foaming agent accommodation space; and a flange part coupled to the sleeve body so as to close the foaming agent accommodation space, wherein the sleeve body, the foaming refractory filler and the flange part are formed to be packaged. Therefore, the spreading of fire can be effectively blocked if a fire breaks out, both workability at a worksite and facility stability can be improved, and the standardization and modularization of products are enabled.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 건물의 층간을 형성하는 슬래브 또는 벽체를 관통하는 관통구에 매립 설치되어, 상기 관통구를 관통하는 관통배관을 연결고정하기 위한 배관 연결장치로서, 상기 관통구에 설치되며, 관 형상으로 상기 관통배관이 내측으로 끼워지는 관통홀이 형성되고, 일측이 개방되도록 상기 일측 단부로부터 확장 형성되는 발포제 수용공간이 형성된 슬리브몸체, 상기 발포제 수용공간에 수용되는 발포내화충진제 및 상기 발포제 수용공간을 패쇄하도록 상기 슬리브몸체에 결합하는 플랜지부를 포함하고, 상기 슬리브몸체와 상기 발포내화충진제와 상기 플랜지부가 패키지화되어 형성되는 배관 연결장치를 제공한다. 따라서 화재 시 화염전파를 효과적으로 차단할 수 있으며, 현장에서의 작업성 향상은 물론 시설 안정성을 향상시킬 수 있고, 제품의 규격화 및 모듈화가 가능하도록 하는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Minimization of service interruption
abstract_en: User equipment (UE) may detect a disaster condition, and the resolution thereof, based on broadcast information, RRC messaging, NAS messaging, the ability to connect to an allowable PLMN, and indications from forbidden PLMNs. In a disaster condition, a UE may perform an enhanced PLMN selection procedure wherein, for example, the UE will not consider PLMNs that are in a disaster situation if the disaster situation applies to a current location of the UE, prioritize forbidden PLMNs for disaster roaming connection. For disaster roaming connection, the UE may be configured by an otherwise forbidden PLMN with information about what services the UE can access and what type of authentication procedure the network is able to perform with UE. Upon detecting that the disaster condition is over, the UE move back to an allowable PLMN.

title_en: Load prediction adjusting method and device of combined cycle power generation system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a load prediction adjusting method and device of a combined cycle power generation system, belongs to the technical field of combined cycle power generation, and solves the problems that when the traditional method processes unit data, an LSTM neural network model is poor in self-adaption and cannot avoid gradient dispersion on the unit data; the load prediction model is constructed by combining the group intelligent algorithm and the back propagation neural network, has the advantages of processing time sequence working parameters by the group intelligent algorithm and the back propagation neural network, can accurately output the load curve of the combined cycle power generation system in the next period, and provides a basis for distributed adjustment of the combined cycle power generation system.

title_en: Wheat gluten production quality assessment method based on machine learning
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of quality evaluation, and particularly relates to a wheat gluten production quality evaluation method based on machine learning. Firstly, flour and water are mixed according to a proportion to prepare dough, visual images of wet gluten and cleaning liquid are collected when the dough is cleaned, and core attention areas are extracted through image pretreatment, enhancement, morphological operation and differential screening. Based on this region, the wet gluten color index and starch granule dispersion are calculated, and the optimum value is obtained by changing the ratio of flour and water with the minimum value of the two as an objective function. An improved cascade neural network model is constructed, an input layer fuses optimal indexes, dispersion and production process parameters, a cascade structure processes prediction quality through a BP neural network and a convolution neural network, and the neural network parameters are determined by an improved firefly algorithm. The method solves the problems of low efficiency, poor consistency and the like of the traditional manual evaluation, realizes objective and accurate evaluation, and meets the requirement of industrial production on quality control.

title_en: Central monitoring system for detecting dangerous substances
title_ko: 위험물 유출 중앙 감지시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a central system for dangerous substance outflow detection. According to the present invention, a plurality of dangerous substance outflow warning means installed at dangerous facilities nationwide and terminal means of workers at the dangerous facilities are connected to one central control center using a communication network. Dangerous substance outflow information from the warning means and the terminal means is gathered to determine the presence or absence of dangerous substance outflow. Then, an automatic shutoff facility can be put into operation or a worker can take a countermeasure such as accident notification and evacuation and on-site dispatch for confirmation, accident response, and restoration. According to the present invention, a decrease in costs for constructing the facility can be achieved, a problem attributable to sensor malfunction can be solved, and an accident can be responded early and quick restoration can be performed by the dispatched facility worker even if the automatic shut-off facility does not work due to a malfunction. Those other than the worker can quickly evacuate the dangerous facility and damage to the accident can be minimized.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 전국 각지에 산재한 위험 시설물에 설치된 복수의 위험물 유출 경보수단 및 상기 위험 시설물에 근무하는 근무자들이 휴대하는 단말수단을 통신망으로 하나의 중앙관제센터에 연결하고, 상기 경보수단 및 단말수단으로부터 통보되는 위험물 유출정보를 종합하여 위험물 유출 여부를 판정하며, 그에 따라 자동 차단설비의 작동을 지시하거나 근무자에게 확인, 사고 수습 및 복구를 위한 현장 출동, 사고 전파 및 대피 등의 대응조치를 취하도록 구성된 위험물 유출 중앙 감지시스템을 제공함으로써, 첫째 설비 구축비용이 감소하고, 둘째 센서의 오작동에 따른 문제가 해소되며, 셋째 자동 차단설비가 고장으로 작동하지 않더라도 해당 시설 근무자가 신속히 출동하여 조기에 사고를 수습하고 긴급히 복구하며, 기타 인원들은 위험 시설물로부터 신속히 대피할 수 있도록 함으로써 사고 피해를 최소화할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Drones and abnormal noise detection alarm systems for monitoring military guard areas and critical dangerous facilities, and their methods
title_ko: 군사 경계 경비지역 및 중요 위험시설 감시용 드론 및 이상소음 탐지 경보 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 군사 경계 경비지역 및 중요 위험시설 감시용 드론 및 이상소음 탐지 경보 시스템 및 그 방법에 관한 것으로, 온디바이스 AI 소음 센서를 사용하여, 드론 및 이상소음의 음향 특징을 추출하여 드론 및 이상소음을 정확하게 탐지하고 자동으로 경보하며 상황실로 드론 및 이상소음의 탐지정보를 실시간 전송함으로써, 드론의 침입에 의한 위협을 조기에 차단 및 격멸할 수 있다. 본 발명에 의한 군사 경계 경비지역 및 중요 위험시설 감시용 드론 및 이상소음 탐지 경보 시스템은, 군사 경계 경비지역 및 중요 위험시설물에 설치된 고정형 음향탐지경보장치(110)의 온디바이스 AI 소음 센서(200)를 통해, 드론 및 이상 소음원에 대한 주파수 스펙트럼과 시간 및 증폭도를 검출하여 드론 및 이상 소음원을 탐지하고 자동으로 경보하는 군사 경계 경비지역 및 중요 위험시설 감시용 드론 및 이상소음 탐지 경보 시스템에 있어서, 상기 고정형 음향탐지경보장치(110)는, 상기 군사 경계 경비지역 및 중요 위험시설물에 설치되며, 전방에 호른 원형구조로 개구된 안쪽에 음원감지 마이크(112)가 배치되고 상부에 상황전파용 무선송출 안테나(113)가 배치되며 하부에 배치된 전원공급 잭(116)에 전원공급 플러그(117)가 연결된 방수 및 방폭 케이스(111); 상기 방수 및 방폭 케이스(111)의 내부에 배치되며, 상기 음원감지 마이크(112)를 통해 드론 및 이상 소음원이 입력되면 AI가 동작하여 ANN 알고리즘의 머신 러닝을 통해 드론 및 이상 소음원에 대한 소음 상태를 스캔 및 데이터 필터링하고 소음원의 원시 데이터를 식별하며, 소음원의 진폭과 주파수 변화 여부를 나타내는 의미 있고 정보성이 있는 한 개 이상의 레이블을 추가하여 컨텍스트를 제공하는 데이터 레이블링을 수행하며, 상기 드론 및 이상 소음원에 대한 정상 상태의 기준 소음데이터와 변화된 소음데이터를 머신 러닝을 통해 연산하여 소음원에 대한 정상과 비정상적인 조건을 구분하고 정상과 비정상 결과를 도출하여 드론 및 이상 소음원을 탐지하며, 상기 드론 및 이상 소음원의 탐지 데이터를 무선랜, 블루투스, USB 중 어느 하나를 통해서 에지 게이트웨이 디바이스로 전송하는 온디바이스 AI 소음 센서(200); 상기 방수 및 방폭 케이스(111)의 후방에 고정된 각도조절 링크(114); 상기 각도조절 링크(114)를 상하 소정의 각도로 회전 가능하게 결합하여 고정하는 링크 고정부(115); 및 상기 링크 고정부(115)를 전방의 고정판(118a)에 체결하여 고정하는 고정용 브라켓(118);을 포함한다.

title_en: A kind of service system based on Multifunction self aid integrated machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of service systems based on Multifunction self aid integrated machine, are related to self-help service interated machine field；It includes management backstage, server and service unit；Service unit, management backstage and server are attached by Ethernet or wireless network；Service unit includes body, horizontal retaining frame, pedestal and vertical retaining frame, and horizontal retaining frame is fixedly connected with vertical retaining frame, and body is located at below horizontal retaining frame, and body is set on the base；Body includes host, display playing device, voice intercom device, warning device, fire-fighting emergent device, environment monitoring device and business service device, warning device includes camera and NB IoT units, camera is mounted in horizontal retaining frame, and environment monitoring device is installed on horizontal retaining frame and vertical retaining frame junction；It solves the problems, such as that existing self-help service interated machine function is single, achieved the effect that information remote publication, information propagating, environmental monitoring, Self-Service and improves security processing speed.

title_en: Power supply and distribution online maintenance simulation communication system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a power supply and distribution online maintenance simulation communication system, including high-pressure electric energy meter, high-pressure relay, low pressure electric energy meter, first switch, second switch, industrial network line, install the first computer that supplies the power distribution to overhaul simulation system and install the second computer that supplies the power distribution monitoring system, first computer and second computer are through peer-to-peer network connection first switch, several high-pressure electric energy meters are connected through industrial network line row by row, the one end of every row of high-pressure electric energy meter is connected with high-pressure relay, several rows of high-pressure electric energy meters are connected first switch through star type structure; the plurality of low-voltage electric energy meters are connected in a row through the industrial network cable, the plurality of low-voltage electric energy meters are connected with the second switch through the star-shaped structure, and the second switch is connected with the first switch through the industrial network cable in a cascading mode. The utility model discloses a communication network of mixed type provides the hardware environment that operating personnel on-line simulation overhauld the study, improves learning efficiency.

title_en: Modeling simulation method of language competition microscopic simulation model based on partitioned double-layer network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a modeling simulation method of a language competition microscopic simulation model based on a partitioned double-layer network, which improves a modeling method based on an agent social circle network, constructs a social network with a remote weak connection relation, and can describe the reinforcing trend of the weak relation of the social network caused by regional population flow and communication connection under the urbanization background. Besides considering the influence of the language position and the language population proportion, the language evolution mechanism of different crowds introduces a new mechanism of influence of bilingual on the conversion from monolingual to bilingual and influence of language attitude on language selection behavior. An improved agent language horizontal and vertical propagation model is provided, and the propagation model comprehensively considers factors such as language status, language density, language attitude, influence of bilingual on monolingual, remote connection weight and the like.

title_en: Rapid prediction method for gas explosion shock wave propagation state for emergency rescue
abstract_en: The invention provides a rapid prediction method for a gas explosion shock wave propagation state for emergency rescue. The method comprises the steps of obtaining big data of propagation states of disaster-causing factors such as gas explosion shock waves and flame propagation near a typical explosion source, a typical straight roadway and a typical roadway intersection by utilizing numerical simulation or an explosion experiment, taking factors influencing the gas explosion shock waves and flame propagation as input nodes of an artificial neural network, taking disaster-causing factors such as pressure, temperature and toxic and harmful gases as output nodes, establishing a rapid prediction model of the gas explosion shock wave propagation state, effectively solving the problems of large time consumption and the like in the processes of numerical simulation modeling, calculation, data analysis and processing and the like, and controlling the prediction of the full wind network propagation state of the explosion shock waves and flame to be completed within 60 seconds under the condition of assuming the known explosion source position and the explosion-participating gas content, thereby greatly meeting the requirements of emergency rescue.

title_en: Method and device for constructing dependent network robustness measurement indexes
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a device for constructing a dependent network robustness measurement index, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring the network efficiency of each layer network under the initial state of the dependent network model; carrying out cascade failure attack, obtaining the maximum connected subgraph proportion of each layer of the attacked model and the network efficiency of the maximum connected subgraph, and obtaining the relative efficiency of the initial state of the model and the attacked maximum connected subgraph; obtaining the relative efficiency ratio of the maximum connected subgraph of the model, namely the relative efficiency ratio of the maximum connected subgraph under the initial state after being attacked; the index is used for measuring the robustness of the dependent network, and when the maximum connected subgraph is larger in relative efficiency ratio, the robustness of the dependent network is better. According to the method, a new dependent network robustness measurement index is provided on the basis of the maximum connected subgraph proportion and the network efficiency, and the change condition of the network node in the cascade failure process of the dependent network and the comparison effect of the dependent network before and after being attacked can be reflected.

title_en: Water luminous output joint prediction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water-light output joint prediction method, and belongs to the technical field of water-light joint power generation. The method of the invention comprises the following steps: s10, collecting photovoltaic power station data; s20, predicting the output of the photovoltaic power station; s30, acquiring data of the cascade hydropower station; s40, optimizing output of the cascade hydropower station; and S50, constructing a water luminous output combined model. According to the water-light output combined prediction method, the output of the solar photovoltaic power station is predicted by predicting the target, then the particle swarm optimization algorithm is adopted, the output of each target cascade hydropower station is optimized correspondingly, and the finally constructed water-light output combined model has guiding value on the power generation plan of the cascade hydropower station and photovoltaic power station combined system, so that the impact of photovoltaic grid connection on a power grid can be effectively reduced, the photovoltaic consumption is promoted, and the light abandoning rate is reduced.
assignees: NANJING YUHUA INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Tool residual service life prediction method based on space-time feature extraction
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for predicting the residual service life of a cutter based on space-time feature extraction, which comprises an end-to-end framework comprising a signal segmentation module, an information extraction module and an information aggregation module, wherein a cutter service life degradation process is modeled by utilizing multipath monitoring signals acquired from a cutter cutting process; constructing an augmentation feature matrix containing space-time related information, performing self-extraction of time domain space domain depth features by using a bidirectional depth convolution architecture, and realizing the relation mapping from space-time features to residual life by using a multi-layer perceptron; dynamically updating the network parameter values to obtain an optimal solution for making the error trend to zero by using a back propagation algorithm around a smooth average absolute error between the real life value and the predicted life value; the gradient descent process is optimized based on the adaptive moment estimation, and an initialization weight is determined according to the input dimension so as to improve the adaptability of the model. Experiments are carried out by using the cutter data, so that the method has good comprehensive performance, and the full life cycle degradation process of the cutter can be well predicted.

title_en: Wind power generation power prediction method and system based on multi-scale double space-time network area
abstract_en: The invention provides a wind power generation power prediction method and a wind power generation power prediction system based on a multi-scale double-space-time network region, which are used for eliminating the influence of high-frequency noise on wind power prediction, decoupling wind power data of different frequencies, adopting a wind power prediction strategy based on wavelet decomposition, respectively predicting future trends of obtained subcomponents after the wavelet decomposition of the historical wind power data, and summing the future trends to obtain final wind power prediction. The present invention proposes a more efficient model to learn the spatio-temporal representation. Two key space-time correlation layers are realized in the invention, including a synchronous space-time layer and an asynchronous space-time layer. Wherein the synchronous time-space layer learns the similarity between the time series of sites, and the asynchronous time-space layer learns the wind propagation between sites. In order to solve the space-time correlation deviation caused by time variation, the invention adopts a multi-scale structure. Robust representation of wind sites is achieved by learning spatiotemporal correlations over multiple scales.

title_en: Information propagation prediction method, system and medium
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of network information processing, and discloses an information propagation prediction method, an information propagation prediction system and a medium. The prediction method comprises the steps of constructing entity attributes and state variables according to topic propagation data in a social network, respectively constructing corresponding differential propagation dynamics equations and cellular automata based on the entity attributes and the state variables, analyzing stability and parameter sensitivity of a propagation state vector field according to the propagation dynamics equations, and analyzing propagation network structures and entity differences through cellular automata simulation. The invention solves the challenges in the traditional information propagation dynamics simulation, namely, realizes the stability analysis of the propagation state of the macroscopic population and the differential analysis of the propagation capacity of the microscopic entity while ensuring the grasping of the propagation trend of the macroscopic level and the effective mapping of the individual propagation behavior characteristics of the microscopic level, and provides a reliable tool for accurately analyzing the evolution trend of the information propagation.
assignees: SHENZHEN WANGLIAN ANRUI NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Three-dimensional earthquake simulation method based on residual Fourier neural operator
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional earthquake simulation method based on a residual Fourier neural operator. A data-driven deep learning seismic wavefield simulation technique embedded in physics is presented. The method embeds a fourier wave propagation operator structure into a convolutional neural network structure, alternately performing wave propagation simulation in a spatial domain and a wave number domain. Because the network structure conforming to the wave field propagation mode is adopted, and the wave field propagation mechanism implicit in the data can be automatically satisfied, the method greatly improves the efficiency of the deep learning earthquake simulation method, reduces the requirement of the deep learning earthquake simulation method on the training data quantity and the training time, and can strengthen the generalization performance of the deep learning model. Compared with the classical finite difference numerical solution, the method has higher operation efficiency, occupies less storage space, is not constrained by the size of the space grid and the time step, and is more suitable for the seismic wave simulation requirement of large-range high-frequency complex medium.
assignees: SINOPEC OILFIELD SERVICE CORP;SINOPEC PETROLEUM ENGINEERING GEOPHYSICS CO LTD;NORTH CHINA BRANCH OF SINOPEC PETROLEUM ENG GEOPHYSICS CO LTD

title_en: Method and related device for identifying key elements of supply chain system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a related device for identifying key elements of a supply chain system, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining logistics data among enterprises, determining cooperation and competition relation among the enterprises according to the logistics data among the enterprises, establishing a supply chain network according to the cooperation and competition relation among the enterprises, obtaining a risk propagation process of the supply chain network by combining external and internal disturbance factors based on the flow relation of products among the enterprises to obtain a risk propagation chain of the enterprises, and determining key nodes and key edges in the supply chain network according to the risk propagation chain of the enterprises.

title_en: Micro coordination wide area balance regulation and control method and system under multi-micro grid access scene
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of power distribution system simulation, in particular to a method and a system for regulating and controlling micro-coordination wide area balance in a multi-micro-grid access scene, wherein the method comprises the steps of carrying out cluster division on a plurality of micro-grids based on the electric coupling degree and net power between the micro-grids; the method comprises the steps of carrying out clustering on resources of a region where a micro-grid is located by adopting a pre-built multi-energy coupling source load prediction model, carrying out load prediction on the clustered clusters based on the clustered resources to obtain clusters, resources and groups formed by corresponding loads, solving a pre-built platform region or micro-grid layer optimization model, a feeder line level optimization model and a region layer optimization model by adopting a target cascading method based on the groups to realize scheduling optimization of the power distribution network and the micro-grid, and optimizing power exchange cost, power generation cost and environmental cost between the micro-grid and the power distribution network by constructing a multi-layer optimization model.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Safety inspection method for intelligent power plant
abstract_en: The application discloses a safety inspection method of an intelligent power plant, which comprises the steps of collecting historical operation fault information, classifying the collected historical operation fault information, constructing a network structure of a power generation system by determining nodes and edges according to equipment of the power plant, calculating node degree and edge weight according to the determined nodes and edges, simulating fault propagation according to the node degree and edge weight in the network structure, calculating propagation speed and influence range, adjusting fault association parameters according to the network structure, collecting fault time nodes, generating a fault association interval, determining influence association parameters based on the fault association interval, constructing a multi-level data model, and inputting monitoring data into the multi-level data model to obtain a safety early warning result. By embodying the thermal power generation system as a network structure and adjusting fault-related parameters, nonlinear propagation paths of faults in the system can be captured by the parameters, and interactions and dependency among components in the system can be more comprehensively considered.
assignees: DATANG WUDING NEW ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: Simulation test system and method for secondary disaster induced by coal mine gas dynamic disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulation test system and a simulation test method for secondary disasters induced by coal mine gas dynamic disasters. The system consists of a disaster inoculation induction module and a secondary disaster propagation evolution module, and can integrally simulate a series of complete chained processes of secondary disasters such as explosion, shock waves, wind current disturbance and the like, wherein the complete chained processes can be used for simulating deep coal beds to induce coal and gas outburst due to mining disturbance under the environments of in-situ stress, temperature and gas pressure, and further igniting gas-dust mixed clouds formed by the outburst. The invention can simulate the ventilation condition of the roadway and can be additionally provided with a water spraying/explosion suppression system for checking and evaluating the efficiency of the active disaster suppression technology. The invention can realize the accurate regulation and control of the outstanding source parameters, roadway environment and ignition conditions, and acquire multi-physical-field evolution data through the high-precision sensing network, thereby providing a key test platform and scientific basis for revealing the inherent mechanism of deep composite dynamic disasters, evaluating disaster risks, and checking and optimizing disaster prevention and reduction technologies.

title_en: Digital twinning-based power distribution system operation risk assessment and response method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for evaluating and responding to the running risk of a power distribution system based on digital twin, and relates to the technical field of power grids. And determining a risk index on the digital twin body according to a layering strategy, predicting trend of time sequence data of the risk index, and giving index weight according to the trend prediction, so as to construct a risk index system. Analyzing risk propagation paths in a virtual environment, simulating occurrence probabilities of different risk scenes by combining historical fault data, mapping each index into a risk level, and formulating a corresponding response scheme based on the historical data and a tolerance threshold. And optimizing digital twin parameters by using operation and maintenance feedback information, forming a risk assessment system based on the updated twin, and carrying out high-efficiency assessment and response on the system operation risk.
assignees: HANGZHOU KAIDA ELECTRIC POWER CONSTRUCTION CO LTD;HANGZHOU CITY YUHANG DISTRICT POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Cloud-protogenesis-architecture-based power distribution network collaborative design system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a collaborative design system and method of a power distribution network based on a cloud native architecture, wherein the collaborative design system comprises a user terminal and a cloud server cluster, wherein the user terminal and the cloud server cluster are used for establishing data transmission through a WebSocket and carrying out real-time interaction of an incremental data packet and a calculation result, the user terminal is used for providing an interaction interface for a user, carrying out light rendering on a power distribution network drawing and capturing operation of the user on the power distribution network drawing, and the cloud server cluster is used for centralizing business logic, electric calculation and collaborative control of the power distribution network drawing. The invention provides a collaborative design system and a collaborative design method for a power distribution network based on a cloud primary architecture, which can greatly reduce network bandwidth occupation and ensure operation smoothness in a weak network environment. The electric topology cascade conflict is solved, and the data security of multi-user cooperation is ensured. The design-calculation real-time closed loop is realized, and the engineering design efficiency is remarkably improved. And realizing cross-platform lightweight access.
assignees: CHANGZHOU CHANGGONG ELECTRIC POWER DESIGN INST CO LTD

title_en: Rainwate catch filter
title_ko: 빗물 차 집 필터
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A rainwater collecting filter is provided to remove and store foreign materials included in rainwater when the quantity of the rainwater is increased, and to prevent environmental contamination by clearly and conveniently managing and maintaining the filter. CONSTITUTION: A rainwater collecting filter comprises the following: a rainwater inflow pipe(23) receiving rainwater; a initial rainwater cut off bank(21) blocking inflow of the rainwater when the rainwater is flowed through the initial rainwater cut off bank; a first filtering net(18) filtering foreign materials included in the rainwater when a water level reaches the constant level; a second filtering net separating the foreign materials; a ceramic layer(25) rectifying the rainwater; and a storage tank storing the refined water.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 빗물 저장시설에서 빗물을 차 집 할 때 사용하는 방법으로서 더욱 상세하게는 빗물을 차 집 할 때 비가 적게 오거나 초기 빗물 속에는 이물질이 많아 이 초기 빗물을 버리고 이물질이 빗물과 같이 씻겨 내려가고 빗물의 양이 많아지면 수위센서가 감지하여 초기빗물차단문을 열어 빗물유입관으로 들어오는 빗물을 1차 거름망에서 이물질을 제거하고 차 집을 한 후 속 거름망에서 한번 더 거른 다음 이물질을 침전 실에서 최종 침전을 하고 저장탱크로 보내어 빗물을 저장할 때 사용하는 빗물 차 집 필터의 방법으로서 
빗물을 저장하여 사용하면 홍수를 예방하고 상수원을 공급할 때 사용하는 에너지를 절약하여 경제적인 파급효과는 물론 환경보전에서도 획기적인 파급효과가 있는 줄 알면서도 시설비가 많이 소요되고 유지관리가 어려워 지금까지 시설을 외면하여 왔다. 
그러나 세계적으로 홍수가 자주 발생하고 또한 우리나라는 유엔에서 정하는 물부족국가 이여서 최근에는 정부차원으로 빗물을 저장하여 사용하는데 많은 지원이 있어 많은 지방자치단체에서 빗물저장을 의무화하는 조례를 만드는 준비를 하고 있는 것으로 조사되었다. 
빗물저장시설에서는 가장 시급한 것이 빗물저장탱크로 이물질이 유입되는 것이다  이물질이 유입되면 아무리 좋은 시설을 하여도 그 시설은 무용지물이 되어 버리고 또한 유지관리 면에서도 많은 비용이 소요되어 빗물저장으로 인한 경제적인 효과가 없어 시설을 하였다 하더라도 경제적인 효과가 없으면 가동을 하지 않을 것이다.  
이에 본 발명의 빗물 차 집 필터를 개발하여 빗물 차 집 시에 이물질을 제거하고 빗물을 저장하면 유지관리 면에서는 물론 환경보전에서도 획기적인 파급효과가 있을 것이다.

title_en: Information power fusion system reliability assessment method based on flow correlation analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses an information electric power fusion system reliability evaluation method based on flow correlation analysis. The invention maps the information power integration system into a double-layer coupling network. Compared with the traditional reliability evaluation method of the information electric power fusion system, the reliability evaluation method of the information electric power fusion system maps the data stream of the information layer in the information electric power fusion system into the stream in the double-layer coupling network, and evaluates the reliability of the information electric power fusion system by analyzing the remaining maximum connected piece occupation ratio of the double-layer coupling network under the fault cascade failure based on stream association, so that the evaluation result is more practical and has engineering value.

title_en: Power system parallel recovery partitioning method based on label propagation algorithm and game theory
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of parallel recovery of power systems, and particularly discloses a parallel recovery partitioning method of a power system based on a tag propagation algorithm and a game theory, which comprises the following steps: initializing edge weight B of power system after power failure  ij  Node weight C  i  A weighted adjacency matrix W and a partition discrimination matrix F; initializing a collaborative gaming coalition C  g  ＝F  0  ，F  0  An initial partition discrimination matrix which is a partition discrimination matrix F; updating labels of nodes in the initial network based on a label propagation algorithm until the partition discrimination matrix F converges, and outputting a node set of each subsystem of the power system when the partition discrimination matrix F converges. The invention comprehensively considers the network topology structure of the power grid and the actual characteristics of the system, provides a partitioning method based on a label propagation algorithm and a cooperative game theory, decides the node partitioning problem by calculating a shape value according to the relation between the nodes and the subsystems, embeds partition constraint in the iteration process, and rapidly obtains a partitioning scheme meeting the requirements of equivalent subsystem scale, compact internal structure, power balance and the like.

title_en: Multi-stage information physical cooperative recovery method for distribution network information physical composite fault
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-stage information physical cooperative recovery method of a distribution network information physical composite fault, which is realized in the following four stages: in the fault positioning stage, the fault coordinate data information of the composite network is positioned under the influence of extreme weather disasters on the power grid and the communication network; in the fault propagation stage, fault areas are divided according to propagation of faults in the power grid and the communication network; the fault isolation stage comprises the steps of recovering a communication network based on a Floyd algorithm in a fault area and operating a remote control switch RCS to block a propagation path of a fault in the power network; in the non-fault area recovery stage, the communication network controls the remote control switch RCS to realize non-fault but non-power supply area load recovery; the CPS collaborative recovery strategy of information physical bilateral influence and fault handling multi-stage time sequence influence is adopted, so that the CPS fault is quickly recovered by minimizing load loss and repairing time.

title_en: Dynamic prediction method for secondary domino accident of fire disaster in pressure storage tank area
abstract_en: The application discloses a dynamic prediction method of a fire disaster secondary domino accident in a pressure storage tank area, which relates to the field of data processing systems specially used for prediction purposes, considers the influence of the fire accident of the pressure storage tank on the accident spread among adjacent storage tanks and the influence of coupling factors on the accident spread, evaluates the accident chain probability by combining a Bayesian network method, provides a determination method of the most probable accident chain and the most probable accident storage tank of the fire disaster secondary domino accident in the pressure storage tank area under the influence of time and space coupling, carries out effective risk evaluation on the pressure storage tank area, effectively controls and reduces the occurrence of the fire disaster secondary domino accident in the pressure storage tank area, has extremely important theoretical significance and application value for the prevention and control of the fire disaster domino effect in the pressure storage tank area, and provides guidance for the pressure tank area layout and the fire emergency treatment of chemical enterprises.

title_en: A fire monitoring system of wooden building
title_ko: 목조건물 화재감시시스템
abstract_en: A fire monitoring system of wooden building is provided to prevent a fire due to electric leakage or a short circuit not using a wire or electric equipment. A fire Monitoring System of a wooden building includes a fire detector(100), a transmission unit(200), and a controller. The fire detector includes a first detector(110) having a plurality of FBG sensors which are installed at the wooden building to detect temperature change and tension change of the wooden building, includes a second detector having a plurality of suction ports which are installed to detect gas at the wooden building and includes a third detector having a plurality of smoke sensors which is installed at the wooden building to detect smoke and gas. The transmission unit transmits detected information to local area non-electrically, and the controller judge from the analysis of input information.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 목조건물 화재감시시스템에 관한 것으로서, 목조건물 내에 설치되어 화재로 인한 온도변화, 가스발생 및 연기 발생 정보를 검출하도록 된 화재정보검출수단; 상기 화재정보검출수단의 검출정보를 비전기적 방법을 이용해 근거리 전송하는 검출정보 전송수단; 및 상기 검출정보 전송수단을 통해 입력된 정보를 분석하여 화재상황인지를 판단하는 제어부;를 포함한다. 
     상기 본 발명은 목조 건축물의 원형을 훼손하지 않고도 설치가 가능한 이점이 있고, 건축물 내에 전선과 같은 전기시설을 하지 않기 때문에 전기누전이나 합선으로 인한 화재를 근원적으로 예방할 수 있고, 화재발생유무를 판단하기 위한 검출정보로서 온도변화, 가스발생, 연기발생 유무정보를 동시에 판단함으로써, 실제 화재상황인지를 정확하게 판별할 수 있으며, 화재상황을 신속 정확하게 판단할 수 있고, 화재발생 상황임을 주변에 실시간 전파하여 초기화재진압이 이루어지도록 하는 효과를 갖는다. 
     
     목조건물, 화재감시시스템, 온도변화, 가스, 연기

title_en: High-efficient sensor node apparatus of on-the-spot in protocol for processing multi-stages
title_ko: 고효율 다위처리 프로토콜을 위한 현장센서노드장치
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A field sensor node device for high efficiency multistage process protocol is provided to minimize damage due to various disasters by rapidly generating an alarm and coping with the damage when an abnormal sign is generated and monitoring field information according to collected set conditions. CONSTITUTION: A sensing module(110) senses a preset physical state of a device to grasp the condition of the field. A communication module(120) interactively communicates with other terminal node on a wireless sensor network. A storage module(130) stores a sensed quantity of each module and data generated in communication, operation, and control processes. A central control module(140) operates the physical quantity sensed from the sensing module according to high efficiency multistage process protocol and controls the interactive communication with other terminal nodes on the wireless sensor network.
abstract_ko:
본 발명 고효율 다위처리 프로토콜을 위한 현장센서노드장치는, 특정 프로토콜에 따라 데이터를 무선으로 통신하는 할 수 있고, 필요한 위치에 간단하게 설치하고 휴대하여 필요에 따라 바로 회수하는 등 간편하게 사용할 수 있도록 구성함으로써, 실제 현장의 작업 여건이나 상황 혹은 환경을 감지하여 현장의 안전상태를 안전하게 관리 감독하는 데 사용할 수 있는, 현장의 센서노드장치이다. 
     본 발명은, 작업현장의 소정위치에 설치된 상태에서 상기 작업현장의 여건 파악을 위해 상기 장치에 기설정된 물리량의 상태를 감지하는 센싱모듈과; 고효율 다위처리 프로토콜체계에 따른 통신 중 활성구간 내의 소정 주기내에서 무선센서네트워크 상 다른 단말노드간의 양방향통신을 수행하는 통신모듈과; 상기 각 구성 모듈들을 통한 감지량 및 통신의 수행과 연산 및 제어과정에서 발생하는 데이터들을 저장하는 저장모듈과; 상기 센싱모듈로부터 감지된 물리량을 프로그래밍되어 설정된 상기 고효율 다위처리 프로토콜의 체계에 따라 연산 및 변환시키며, 상기 각각의 모듈들로부터의 데이터를 입력받아 상기 고효율 다위처리 프로토콜체계에 따라 상기 무선센서네트워크 상 다른 단말노드간의 양방향통신을 수행하도록 제어하고, 중앙의 관리장치로부터의 제어에 따라 처리하는 중앙제어모듈을 포함하여 구성되며; 상기 각각의 구성 모듈들은 데이터를 고효율로 통신하기 위한 고효율 다위처리 프로토콜의 체계에 따른다. 
     따라서 본 발명은 작업 및 산업의 현장에서 주변의 온도, 연기, 과전류 등의 센싱를 통해 용접 등 전기 및 불꽃에 따른 현장의 초기 화재 감지하고, 이상 징후의 발생시 초기대처와 신속한 전파를 통하여, 화재 등의 각종 재난 상황의 대처를 통해 피해 규모를 최소화시키는 효과를 제공한다. 
       
     센서, 네트워크, 노드, 프로토콜, 현장, 화재, 재난
assignees: UBITELECOM CO LTD;NAT UNIV KANGNUNG WONJU

title_en: an antifire structure for a duct and electric pipe space with an excellent air permeability and fire resistance
title_ko: 통기성 및 차화성이 우수한 덕트 및 전기시설물 스페이스용 차화 구조물
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 평소에는 덕트 스페이스 내 공기의 흐름이 원활하게 유지되고 화재 시에는 덕트 및 전기시설물 스페이스를 통한 화재의 전파를 차단할 수 있는 통기성 및 차화성이 우수한 덕트 및 전기시설물 스페이스용 차화 구조물에 관한 것이다. 본 발명은 덕트 및 전기시설물 스페이스의 내주면에 설치되어 고정된 앵커 멤버, 덕트 및 전기시설물 스페이스의 내부 공간을 가로질러 덕트 및 전기시설물 스페이스의 내부 공간을 복수 개의 영역으로 나누고 양단이 앵커 멤버에 연결되어 고정되는 제1 멤버, 일단이 제1 멤버에 연결되어 고정되고 타단이 앵커 멤버 또는 다른 제1 멤버에 연결되어 고정되어 복수 개의 덕트 및 전기시설물을 개별적으로 구획하는 제2 멤버, 복수 개로서 앵커 멤버 제1 멤버 및 제2 멤버 중 어느 하나 이상에 연결되어 고정되고 개별적으로 구획된 덕트 및 전기시설물의 외주면에 접하여 에워싸는 제3 멤버 및 덕트 및 전기시설물 스페이스의 길이 방향으로 관통되어 형성된 통기구를 가지는 시트 형태로서 앵커 멤버 제1 멤버 제2 멤버 및 제3 멤버 중 2 이상의 사이에 형성된 영역을 커버하도록 장착되는 차화 멤버를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Sewage treatment effluent total phosphorus prediction method based on self-organization cascade neural network
abstract_en: A sewage treatment effluent total phosphorus prediction method based on a self-organization cascade neural network belongs to the field of controls science and engineering and also belongs to the field of environmental science and engineering. In order to solve the problem that the real-time on-line measurement of the effluent total phosphorus cannot be achieved in the current city sewage treatment process, the invention achieves on-line real-time prediction of the effluent total phosphorus. The method designs the self-organization growth-type cascade network structure, a variable contribution rate calculation formula and a differentiation weight training method, and improves the effluent total phosphorus prediction precision in the city sewage treatment process by timely adjusting the structure and the connection weight of the cascade-correlation network. The experiment result shows that the intelligent prediction method can timely and accurately measure the effluent total phosphorus concentration in the city sewage treatment process. The invention adjusts correlated control links in the city sewage treatment process and materials in biochemical reactions, thereby improving the effluent quality of sewage treatment and providing theoretical support and technical support for improvement of safe and stable operation of the sewage treatment process.

title_en: A kind of flexible measurement method for the reaction of high density polyethylene (HDPE) polymerization cascade
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of flexible measurement methods for the reaction of high density polyethylene (HDPE) polymerization cascade, data prediction is carried out using data correlation techniques and data mining technology, rule is found among creation data and analysis data, Intelligent software measure model and high density polyethylene (HDPE) unit consumption of product model are established using FL neural networks, use regularization method majorized function Connection Neural Network structure, the modeling accuracy for improving FL neural networks, ultimately forms high density polyethylene (HDPE) reaction process intelligent soft-measurement method.Technical solution provided by the invention has the characteristics that the response time is fast, modeling accuracy is high, provides help for the safety progress of guarantee high density polyethylene (HDPE) production, raising polymeric articles quality, saving production cost.FL neural networks provided by the invention based on regularization optimize weight by setting regularization parameter, to reduce network error, improve modeling accuracy and calculating speed.

title_en: Building material supply chain financial risk assessment algorithm based on complex network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building material supply chain financial risk assessment algorithm based on a complex network, which is characterized by comprising building material supply chain financial network generation, building material supply chain financial network robustness analysis and building material supply chain financial default risk propagation calculation. According to the invention, through research and analysis on the characteristics of the building material supply chain, a building material supply chain weighted network evolution model based on a growth mechanism, local selection, connection preference and reconnection quit is provided, and on the basis, a building material supply chain financial weighted network is generated according to a mapping rule, robustness analysis is carried out on the building material supply chain financial weighted network obtained by different mapping parameters, an attack strategy is provided for simulating damage which can be possibly suffered in reality, different robustness is presented on building material supply chain finance, the robustness is influenced by the difference of network structures, and a corresponding countermeasure is made to prevent the generation and propagation of the financial default risk of the building material supply chain.

title_en: Power grid adaptability evaluation analysis method considering access of step power station
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid adaptability evaluation analysis method considering access of a cascade power station, which comprises six steps of determining an evaluation index set and a comment set; obtaining an index matrix and standardizing the matrix; calculating the entropy weight of the index matrix, determining a subjective weight set, and determining a comprehensive weight set of the index matrix according to the entropy weight and the subjective weight set; constructing a fuzzy evaluation matrix; determining the membership degree of a comment set corresponding to an access scheme; and evaluating the access scheme by utilizing the comment with the highest membership degree in the comment set. The invention establishes a power grid evaluation system from adaptability indexes of a power supply and a power grid respectively, and comprehensively evaluates a planning scheme of rolling development of the cascade power station and accessing the power grid by adopting an evaluation method based on a fuzzy entropy weight method on the basis, thereby embodying the characteristics of realizing safe, economic and reliable operation of the power grid and the degree of consumption of the cascade power station.
assignees: SOUTHWEST BRANCH OF STATE GRID CORP OF CHINA;UNIV SICHUAN

title_en: Power distribution network dynamic parameter identification method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for identifying dynamic parameters of a power distribution network. The method comprises the following steps: carrying out data preprocessing on the collected power distribution network operation data and the collected external environment data to generate a power distribution network dynamic parameter identification sample; discretizing a dynamic parameter identification sample of the power distribution network to obtain a discretization sample; based on a pre-established probability map model, obtaining parameters of the probability map model according to the discretization sample; the probability map model is a two-time slice probability map model; and acquiring dynamic parameters of the power distribution network based on a confidence coefficient propagation algorithm according to the observation variables and the probability map model after the parameters are acquired. The method can deduce the dynamic parameters of the power distribution network by using the probability map model under the condition of partial measurement data or external environment data loss, and is beneficial to improving the parameter identification precision under the condition of sudden change of partial power distribution region operation modes or sudden change of external environments.
assignees: SHAOXING POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;SHAOXING JIANYUAN ELECTRIC POWER GROUP CO LTD;NANJING NARI RELAYS ENG TECH;UNIV SOUTHEAST

title_en: Risk platform identification and risk propagation prediction method in bulk commodity trading market
abstract_en: The invention discloses a risk platform identification and risk propagation prediction method in a bulk commodity transaction market. The method is suitable for monitoring and serving of a large commodity electronic commerce transaction market, a transaction network is established by analyzing historical transaction data, abnormal transaction modes are screened according to the topological characteristics of the abnormal transaction modes, and the affiliated risk platform is determined. And establishing a maximum association network according to the commodity overlapping association between the platforms, and predicting the risk propagation path and range by taking the risk source platform as a starting point, so that the risk platform is identified, the platforms possibly influenced by risk propagation are predicted, and the risk propagation path and range are excavated. The invention carries out risk platform identification and risk propagation prediction, and can be used for reference of risk prevention of a transaction platform and reference of institutional health of a supervision department.

title_en: Oil and gas station system corrosion risk identification method based on graph theory topological structure
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of pipeline maintenance, and particularly discloses a corrosion risk identification method of an oil and gas station system based on graph theory topological structure, which is used for collecting data, determining corrosion risk nodes and connection mechanisms in the oil and gas station system from three angles of physical equipment, personnel management operation and natural environment of the oil and gas station system, establishing an oil and gas station system corrosion risk network, collecting oil and gas station system data, the risk network structure attribute analysis is carried out based on the constructed corrosion risk network of the oil gas station system to obtain the corrosion risk identification result of the oil gas station system, the risk factors and the visualizations of the oil gas station system can be identified on the system level, and the importance ordering of the risk factors can be quantitatively carried out to qualitatively describe the importance of the risk nodes in the station and increase the community structure of risk propagation, so that support is provided for decision makers and technicians to risk management and control.
assignees: CHINA NAT PETROLEUM CORP;CNPC ENGINEERING MAT R & D COMPANY LIMITED

title_en: Deep learning-based attack behavior analysis engine construction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deep learning-based attack behavior analysis engine construction method and system, and belongs to the technical field of network security of power systems. Firstly, a multi-layer feature extraction module for service semantic decoupling is constructed, deep grammar tree analysis is carried out on an electric power industrial control protocol, and semantic level mapping from network messages to service operation intents is realized by combining a pre-constructed electric power service knowledge graph, so that a three-dimensional feature tensor is generated. Secondly, a dynamic countermeasure training mechanism is designed, a countermeasure network synthesis high-simulation countermeasure sample is generated by adopting Wasserstein which obeys the constraint of power business logic, and the robustness of a detection model is continuously optimized. And finally, establishing a topological-aware graph neural network attack detection model, converting the device connection relation of physical scenes such as a transformer substation into a graph structure, and analyzing an attack propagation chain crossing nodes by utilizing a graph convolutional network. The invention obviously improves the detection precision and response speed of complex attacks such as advanced persistent threats and the like.

title_en: Crack identification method and system for airport pavement, electronic equipment and medium
abstract_en: A crack identification method, system, electronic equipment and medium for airport pavement relate to the technical field of data processing. The method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-time phase image data and flight operation data of an airport pavement, extracting the multi-time phase image data to obtain crack evolution characteristics of a plurality of areas, calculating load response characteristics of each area, determining load transmission paths and transmission strength between adjacent areas as side weights by taking the crack evolution characteristics as node attributes, generating a damage network structure, determining crack evolution rates of a plurality of damage nodes and evolution coefficients of corresponding areas through the damage network structure, constructing a load-evolution association matrix, screening each damage node, determining target damage nodes, determining propagation paths and influence ranges of the target damage nodes, determining crack propagation trends in a target period, and generating corresponding maintenance reports. By implementing the technical scheme provided by the application, the accuracy of identifying the crack of the airport pavement can be improved.
assignees: BEIJING JINGANG FIELD ROAD ENG CONSTRUCTION CO LTD

title_en: Wireless network construction method using air conditioning duct in ship
title_ko: 선박 내 공조 덕트를 이용한 무선망 구축 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A wireless network construction method using a duct system of a ship is provided to offer optimal feeding methods by using the duct system of the ship. CONSTITUTION: Each antenna of AP(access points) or WiBro RAS(radio access stations) is used to replace an antenna for a duct system. The antenna for the duct system is fed into the duct system. An area is widely constructed to all compartments in the ship. The AP or the WiBro RAS connect to a controller using a PLC(power line communication) modem or an LAN(local area network) cable. A wireless network for mobile communication is constructed in the ship. [Reference numerals] (AA, CC) Phase variable feeder; (BB, DD) Variable impedance matching apparatus; (EE) Phase deviation apparatus; (FF) AP and RF repeater
abstract_ko: 선박은 몸체 전체가 강철로 되어 있으며, 갑판의 위와 아래의 모든 구역이 침수를 막기 위하여 여러 개의 격실 구조로 구성되어 있어서 전파를 완벽하게 차단하는 구조이므로 무선 통신이 불가능하여 작업자들 간의 의사소통이 매우 어렵다. 이를 해결하기 위하여 선박 내의 어떤 위치든 사람이 작업하는 공간에는 연결되어 있는 공조 덕트에 안테나를 넣고 RF 중계기로 덕트망을 연결하는 무선망 구축 방법, 그리고 덕트에 피딩하는 안테나의 구조 및 이중 편파를 가능케하는 덕트와 안테나의 결합구조를 특허로 제안코자 한다.

title_en: Method for risk management using web based rms linked with sso
title_ko: 통합인증시스템과 연계된 웹 기반 위험관리시스템을 이용한 위험관리방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A method for managing risk by using a web-based risk management system linked with an integrated authentication system is provided to supply reliability for the safety of inner assets by calculating levels of risk caused by various types of weak points on important assets of a company/an institution and supplying the information to a manager. CONSTITUTION: An RMS(Risk Management System) collects a process result of a weak point sensor process(100) and SSO(Single Sign On) authentication logs. A manager registers assets(120). The system analyzes a property value(130). The system calculates a threat influence value(140). The system derives a weakness level from the collected data(150). The system calculates a risk level of each asset(160). [Reference numerals] (100) Weak point sensor; (110) Collecting weak points; (120) Registering assets; (130) Analyzing assets(asset value computation); (140) Analyzing risk(risk influence, risk frequency); (150) Analyzing weakness(weakness level); (160) Computing risk by asset; (170) Risk management(manager corrective measure); (201) Manager terminal; (202) SSO storage unit; (203a) Weak point DB; (203b) Risk DB; (203c) Asset DB; (A1) SSO server; (A3) Password module; (A5) Operating system; (A6) Hardware; (BB) Authentication token; (EE) RMS management process; (FF) Step; (GG) Analyzing current state; (HH) Computing spread strength by asset(computing risk index by asset); (II) Computing the frequency of generation by weakness level(computing weak point)
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 통합인증시스템과 연계된 웹 기반 위험관리시스템을 이용한 위험관리방법에 관한 것으로, 웹 환경에서 SSO(통합인증)와 위험관리시스템(RMS)연동을 통해 관리자 인증과 접근성이 강화된 을 제공하는데 그 목적이 있다. 
본 발명의 목적은 점검 대상 네트워크 영역의 OS별 취약점, 네트워크 장비 취약점 및 웹 응용프로그램 취약점을 스캐닝하여 해당 로그 파일을 취약점DB에 저장하는 취약점 센서과정; 취약점 센서과정의 프로세스 결과와 SSO 인증 로그를 취합하는 취약점 수집과정; 취약점 수집 결과에서 IP기준으로 관리자가 자산을 등록하는 자산 등록과정; 등록된 자산에 대응하는 관리 대상 네트워크의 IT 자산의 자산가치를 내부 보안 운영 방침을 기준으로 관리자가 정의한 자산가치 연산식을 이용하여 자산가치를 산정하는 자산 분석과정; 위협 빈도와 위협 영향을 파악하여 위협영향 및 위협빈도수를 산출하는 위협 분석과정; 취약점 센서과정에 의해 수집된 데이터에서 취약성 수준을 도출하는 취약성 분석과정; 및 산정한 자산가치와 위협 영향값을 연산하여 자산별 파급 강도인 자산별 위협지수를 산정하고, 위협빈도수와 취약성지수를 통해 자산별 위험도를 산정하는 자산별 위험도 산정과정을 포함하여 이루어진 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: System for handling the state of emergency by using mobile phone
title_ko: 스마트폰을 이용한 비상 상황 대처용 경보 및 표시장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smartphone-based alarm and display device for emergency response. According to the present invention, button operation is performed in the event of an emergency related to a woman exposed to a crime from a third party. Then, voice content preset using a user′s smartphone is output and psychological self-control is induced on the third party′s part. As a result, the emergency can be avoided. In addition, it is possible to call for help by audio/video emergency recording and automatic transmission to an emergency contact network. As a result, the danger can be avoided and safety can be ensured. In addition, button operation is performed and an automatic emergency call to a rescue and relief agency such as a fire station and a police station is made in the event of an emergency on the part of a disabled person, a patient, a senior citizen, an ordinary person, and so on, examples of which include heart attack, cerebral hemorrhage, fall, house robbery, taxi robbery, female robbery, and kidnapping. The occurrence of the emergency is disseminated by means of voice output using a smartphone, audio/video recording, alarm, display through a display screen, and so on. As a result, an additional accident is prevented and safety is ensured by help from the outside. According to the present invention, user residential environment improvement can be achieved through visitor conversation and confirmation and doorplate and interior decoration, in-vehicle information such as boarding and unboarding can be disseminated by in-vehicle installation, promotion is possible, safe vehicle driving environment improvement can be achieved for a user through vehicle interior decoration, and profit creation is possible through promotion.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 스마트폰을 이용한 비상 상황 대처용 경보 및 표시장치에 관한 것으로서, 좀더 상세하게는 제3자로 부터 범죄 위험이 있는 여성에게 긴급 상황 발생시 버튼 조작으로 사용자의 스마트폰을 이용해 미리 설정한 음성 내용을 출력하면서 제3자의 심리적 자제력을 유도하므로 비상 상황을 회피하게 함은 물론 비상 상황을 음성 및 영상으로 녹화하고 이를 비상 연락망으로 자동 전송하는 방식에 의해 도움을 요청하면서 위험에서 벗어나 안전을 도모할 수 있도록 하고, 또한, 장애인, 환자, 노인과 같이 거동이 불편한 사람들이나 일반인들에게 심장마비, 뇌출혈, 넘어짐 사고 등으로 발생되는 응급 상황, 주택에 침입한 강도, 택시강도, 부녀자 강도 및 납치사건 등 긴급 상황 발생시 버튼조작으로 119, 112 등의 구조 및 구호기관에 자동 긴급 호출되고, 스마트폰을 이용한 음성출력, 음성 및 영상 녹화, 경보 또는 디스플레이 화면을 통한 표시 작동 등에 의해 비상상황 발생을 전파해 추가 사고를 방지하고 외부의 도움을 받아 안전을 도모하도록 하고, 문패, 인테리어 장식, 방문객 대화 및 확인을 통한 사용자의 주거환경 개선, 차량에 설치되어 승하차 등의 차량내 현황 전파, 홍보, 차량 인테리어를 통한 사용자의 차량 안전운전환경 개선, 홍보기능을 통한 수익이 창출되는데 그 특징이 있다.
assignees: SONG CHEONG HEE;LEE HAE JEONG;JANG YU GYEONG;LEE YUN JI

title_en: System and method for dynamic deployable wireless services
abstract_en: A system and method for intelligently and dynamically deploying a plurality of mobile robotic machines capable of carrying out a complex series of actions automatically to propagate wireless network connectivity comprising, at least, a mechanical framework, sensors, actuators, communications capability, an energy source, a propulsion means, a control mechanism, and a payload. The payload may comprise electronic or mechanical communication equipment to propagate services such as wireless networking services, in for example, a first responder or emergency environment, or electronic and mechanical jamming services in a military or anti-terrorism environment.

title_en: Minimization of service interruption
abstract_en: User equipment (UE) may detect a disaster condition, and the resolution thereof, based on broadcast information, RRC messaging, NAS messaging, the ability to connect to an allowable PLMN, and indications from forbidden PLMNs. In a disaster condition, a UE may perform an enhanced PLMN selection procedure wherein, for example, the UE will not consider PLMNs that are in a disaster situation if the disaster situation applies to a current location of the UE, prioritize forbidden PLMNs for disaster roaming connection. For disaster roaming connection, the UE may be configured by an otherwise forbidden PLMN with information about what services the UE can access and what type of authentication procedure the network is able to perform with UE. Upon detecting that the disaster condition is over, the UE move back to an allowable PLMN.

title_en: Method and system for measuring network information propagation influence and influence maximization method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for measuring network information propagation influence, which comprises the following steps: according to historical propagation data of message propagation in the social network, constructing an activation pair of a node and a propagation source; taking a user in a social network as a node, taking a node with the participation time of 0 in the propagation data of the given message as a propagation source of the given message, aggregating the influence of the propagation source on the node through an aggregation function, and then obtaining the probability of the node being activated under the propagation source through an influence margin decreasing function; and (3) taking historical propagation data as training data and taking the maximum log-likelihood of probability as a target, and performing parameter learning on all activated pairs by using random gradient descent to obtain influence among nodes so as to obtain influence measurement of the propagation source set. The influence maximization method based on data driving provided by the invention is directly based on the influence measurement obtained by learning of the invention, and the marginal effect of the node is estimated, so that the node set selection of influence maximization is efficiently carried out.

title_en: Water resource risk assessment method for multiple risk sources of cascade reservoir group
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water resource risk assessment method for multiple risk sources of a cascade reservoir group, which comprises the following steps: identifying structural characteristics of a cascade reservoir group system of a water diversion project; identifying risk sources corresponding to each unit reservoir of the water diversion project respectively; constructing a nested Bayesian network risk assessment model of the cascade reservoir group of the water diversion project according to the structural characteristics and the risk sources, and obtaining the risk level of the water resource of the water diversion project through model analysis; performing sensitivity analysis through a nested Bayesian network risk assessment model, finding out key factors of risks, and formulating corrective measures; and (3) utilizing model analysis to further analyze the overall risk level of the step reservoir group of the water diversion project after the improvement, stopping the analysis if the overall risk level reaches an acceptable risk level, and searching new risk key factors if the overall risk level does not reach an expected risk level until the overall risk level is acceptable.

title_en: Cascade hydropower and photovoltaic short-term complementary scheduling method and system taking unit as scheduling unit
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a step hydropower and photovoltaic short-term complementary scheduling method and system taking a unit as a scheduling unit, and relates to the technical field of clean energy. The method comprises the steps of constructing a model of maximum short-term optimized dispatching of the power consumption of the cascade water-light complementary system based on predicted output data of the photovoltaic power station by taking one day as a dispatching period, and carrying out model conversion and solving. In this way, the unit is taken as the minimum scheduling unit, the power station constraint, the unit constraint and the power grid constraint faced by the complementary system are finely considered, a maximum short-term optimal scheduling model for the power consumption of the cascade water-light complementary system is constructed, and the overall power consumption level and scheduling plan executable of the complementary system are improved through the hydraulic and electric redistribution of the cascade water and electricity.

title_en: Mobile communication system of elevator using cctv cable
title_ko: Ｃｃｔｖ 케이블을 이용한 엘리베이터 내부의 이동통신송수신 시스템
abstract_en: A mobile communication transceiving system inside an elevator is provided to install an RF(Radio Frequency) transceiver by using a CCTV cable equipped within an elevator of a building, thereby improving a mobile communication service as obtaining an emergency communication unit of the elevator. An RF relay system(100) includes a donor in-building optical distributor(120) which transmits a mobile communication RF signal through an optical cable(30) in a building equipped with an elevator. An underground service system(200) consists of a remote in-building distributor(210) for receiving the RF signal, a baseband converter(240) for converting the RF signal into a baseband signal, and an impedance matcher(250) for reducing matching loss of the baseband signal when the RF signal is transmitted by a CCTV cable(60a). An elevator internal system(300) consists of a distributor(310) for distributing the baseband signal, an RF converter(320) for converting(restoring) the distributed baseband signal into(to) the RF signal, and an elevator antenna(330) for transceiving a mobile communication signal inside the elevator.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 건물의 엘리베이터 내부에서 이동통신의  품질 개선을 위한 송수신시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: A kind of SIS-CA Risk of Communication analysis methods based on cellular automata
abstract_en: A kind of SIS CA Risk of Communication analysis methods based on cellular automata, carry out SIS Risk of Communication analyses on the basis of based on CA cellular automatas, and method includes：Parameter setting is carried out to cellular automata and is initialized；The real-time SIS Risk of Communication of cellular state progress in cellular automata is analyzed and updates cellular state；The real-time SIS Risk of Communication of accident progress of cellular in cellular automata is analyzed and updates cellular state；It is analyzed according to the above-mentioned real-time SIS Risk of Communication to cellular in cellular automata, obtains the condition conversion formula of the cellular.The present invention is interfered individual need certain time to carry out self adjustment in the world that can more really reflect reality by introducing the adjustment time of cellular itself in SIS propagation models by risk；It is not difficult to determining parameter in model, makes analog result objective；On the basis of SIS, cellular automata is introduced, is capable of the dynamic behavior of more preferable simulation live network risk propagation.

title_en: Intelligent power grid operation information issuing system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent distribution system of power grid operation information, relating to the technical field of intelligent service systems; the method aims to solve the problems of publishing accuracy, dynamics and interactivity; the system specifically comprises a power failure plan input subsystem, a distribution network fault repair receiving subsystem, a distribution network automatic repair subsystem, a server, information release equipment, a switch and a release terminal. The invention integrates the power failure information generation, reporting, maintenance distribution and power failure information release processes of planned power failure and accidental power failure, effectively provides the efficiency and accuracy of a power grid for dealing with power failure events, improves the data accuracy, expands the information exchange channel and range, improves the influence and the propagation speed, ensures that the power failure information is informed in place, randomly splices and plays videos and broadcasts according to the needs of users, carries out non-contact experience, browsing, inquiry and release information and free editing by recognizing the gesture operation of the users to realize timely interaction with the users, and finally realizes intellectualization, digitalization and interactive linkage.

title_en: Edge coupling-based dependent network seepage analysis method and analysis system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of complex network seepage phase change behavior analysis, and discloses a dependent network seepage analysis method and an analysis system based on edge coupling, wherein the dependent network seepage analysis method based on edge coupling comprises the following steps: constructing an edge-edge dependent network model; establishing a theoretical analysis frame of the edge-edge dependent network model by adopting a self-balancing probability theory; and analyzing the seepage phase change behavior and the seepage threshold of other edge dependent network models under the condition of facing random failure based on the constructed theoretical analysis framework. The method adopts a self-balancing probability theory to establish a theoretical analysis frame of the model, can directly write out a state equation after the system is stable without tracking the cascade failure process, and has the advantages of intuition and conciseness. The method analyzes the phase change behavior and the seepage threshold value of the model under the condition of random failure based on the theoretical framework, and has a reusing meaning for understanding the robustness of the edge coupling network in the real world.

title_en: Method for predicting reliability of offshore wind turbine generator system facing manufacturing process
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for predicting the reliability of an offshore wind turbine generator system facing a manufacturing process, which establishes a membership function between a manufacturing process capability index and a fault mode occurrence probability on the basis of analyzing the manufacturing process capability index of key parts of each subsystem of the offshore wind turbine generator system; by analyzing the fault propagation influence among the subsystems, parts and fault modes of the offshore wind turbine generator system, a reliability prediction network model of the offshore wind turbine generator system is constructed, the sensitivity index of the reliability minimum cut set of each fault mode to the reliability of the offshore wind turbine generator system is analyzed, and the influence degree of the actual manufacturing process to the reliability of the offshore wind turbine generator system is further quantized; on the basis, primary and secondary fault modes of each subsystem are identified, and the inherent reliability of the offshore wind turbine generator is predicted by taking the reliability and the correlation of the primary and secondary fault modes of each subsystem as input under the condition of considering the current manufacturing process by adopting an improved second-order narrow limit theory.
assignees: HUANENG YANCHENG DAFENG NEW ENERGY POWER GENERATION CO LTD;XIAN THERMAL POWER RES INST CO;JIANGSU CLEANING ENERGY BRANCH OF HUANENG POWER INTL INC

title_en: Method for calculating fault tolerance performance of interdependent circuit network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for calculating the fault tolerance performance of an interdependent circuit network, which belongs to the field of fault tolerance, robustness and reliability of the interdependent circuit network. Most dependent networks are not vulnerable in the real world. Therefore, in order to find a more accurate model to explain the mechanism of the actual cascading failure, the relationship between the fault-tolerant distribution and the interdependency network robustness is deeply determined, so that the problem of calculating the fault-tolerant performance of the interdependency circuit network is solved. Through the fault-tolerant performance of the joint circuit calculated by the method, the circuit structure or the node capability in the circuit is changed in real time, the fault-tolerant capability of the joint circuit is maximized, and the robustness and the stability of the joint circuit are improved.

title_en: Method for establishing rail transit network cascading failure model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for establishing a cascading failure model of a rail transit network, and belongs to the technical field of calculation, calculation or counting. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring data and constructing a rail transit network model; removing the fault node and generating a new rail transit network model; simulating node states taking into consideration demand change and time delay effects; and calculating the cascade failure influence index. The cascade failure model established by the invention can simultaneously consider the demand change and the time delay effect under the cascade failure state of the rail transit network, and reveal the cascade failure mechanism in the real world.

title_en: Method for identifying damage of steel structural beam after fire disaster
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of steel structure engineering, in particular to a method for identifying damage of a steel structure beam after fire disaster, which is based on self-vibration frequency measurement and a back propagation neural network technology and has the advantages of simple operation and less required detection equipment; the method comprises the steps of carrying out preliminary appearance damage identification on a steel structure through a CCD camera in combination with detection software, collecting a self-vibration main peak frequency signal of the steel structure beam after fire with uncertain appearance damage, obtaining a first characteristic value, inputting the first characteristic value into an input layer of a back propagation neural network, outputting a second characteristic value by an output layer, comparing the second characteristic value with a mathematical model M1 of the nondestructive steel structure beam, obtaining an output value X, comparing the second characteristic value with a damaged mathematical model M3, obtaining an output value Y, comparing the X with the Y, obtaining Z, judging whether the steel structure is qualified after the fire, and further determining and detecting the steel structure after the fire which is judged to be uncertain.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY NO 9 GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Cascade reservoir joint scheduling method
abstract_en: The invention provides a cascade reservoir joint scheduling method, wherein the cascade reservoirs are annual regulating reservoirs or multi-annual regulating reservoirs, each reservoir is provided with a hydropower station, the distribution load borne by the hydropower station of the cascade reservoirs under an electric network is reasonably distributed, regulated and decomposed by combining the real-time reservoir water level of each hydropower station, and the regulating capacity of each reservoir is excavated on the basis of the distribution of each station meeting the distribution load, so that the optimal matching of the reservoirs and the distribution load is realized.
assignees: HENAN WATER CONSERVANCY NO 2 ENG BUREAU GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Doubly-fed wind farm transient equivalent modeling method and system suitable for cascading failure
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of equivalent calculation, in particular to a transient equivalent modeling method and a transient equivalent modeling system for a doubly-fed wind power plant suitable for cascading failure, which are used for clustering units in groups by using a hierarchical condensation clustering algorithm according to the reactive power supporting capability of doubly-fed wind power units in the cascading failure period to ensure that the units in the same group have similar cascading failure characteristics and the characteristics of the units among different groups have differences, establish an equivalent calculation principle, the method comprises the steps of ensuring the accuracy and rationality of equivalent calculation by a set input wind speed equivalent principle, a generator parameter equivalent principle and a collector network line impedance equivalent principle, performing model construction, extracting reactive current response and stator and rotor current axis components as grouping indexes, performing equivalent calculation to obtain equivalent set parameters and collector network equivalent impedance parameters, performing simulation verification on a wind power plant detailed model, and comparing the simulation verification with the detailed model to verify the accuracy of the equivalent model.

title_en: Construction method and system of power grid safety production index system
abstract_en: The invention provides a construction method and a construction system of a power grid safety production index system, and relates to the technical field of power grid safety monitoring, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining safety production condition data of power grid operation and obtaining an index demand result according to the safety production condition data; the method comprises the steps of selecting an initial index according to an index demand result and a power industry safety production target, selecting a plurality of secondary indexes of five primary indexes of the initial index, screening key indexes from the plurality of secondary indexes of each primary index through an expert belief propagation-decision laboratory analysis method, and carrying out weighted fusion on all the screened key indexes to obtain a power grid safety production index system.
