The invention can comprehensively and accurately reflect the safe production condition of the power grid by constructing the index system covering various aspects of human factors, equipment, environment and the like, and provides comprehensive information support.
assignees: GUILIN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Air conditioner resource allocation method and system based on cold accumulation prediction algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses an air conditioner resource allocation method and system based on a cold accumulation prediction algorithm, and relates to the field of air conditioner cold accumulation, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting historical load operation data of an air conditioner, analyzing the historical load operation data by adopting a gray correlation analysis algorithm, and constructing a cold load prediction model by combining the cold accumulation prediction algorithm; the method comprises the steps of training a cold load prediction model by using a back propagation neural network algorithm, inputting load operation data collected in real time into the trained cold load prediction model, outputting a cold load prediction result, combining the cold load prediction result and electricity price information, formulating an air conditioner resource allocation strategy, and optimizing the allocation strategy by using a model prediction control algorithm. According to the invention, through the integration of the load prediction technology and the real-time electricity price information, the cooling load demand of the whole day can be accurately predicted, the energy waste is reduced, the energy utilization efficiency is improved, the dynamic electricity price market can be responded, and the economic maximization is realized.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU COMPREHENSIVE ENERGY SERVICE CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;MAN TRAINING CENTER OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Fault dynamic simulation method and device for hydrogen-electricity mixing combined system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fault dynamic simulation method and device of a hydrogen-electricity mixing and combining system, belonging to the technical field of comprehensive energy system simulation, the fault dynamic simulation method utilizes a discretized dynamic power flow model of the hydrogen-mixed natural gas system, a discretized frequency response model of the power system and an electric-gas coupling link model to carry out alternate solution to accurately and low-complexity determine the changes of pressure, flow and gas components in the hydrogen-mixed natural gas system and the frequency response of the power system so as to characterize the fault cross-system propagation caused by the coupling of a gas network and a power network after hydrogen loading. The method can quantitatively represent the running state of the combined system and define the fault propagation mechanism when the mixed hydrogen natural gas pipeline breaks down, is used for guiding the running of the mixed hydrogen-electric combined system of distributed hydrogen-doped/centralized hydrogen-doped, and can improve the safety and reliability of the system.
assignees: UNIV HUAZHONG SCIENCE TECH;STATE GRID JILIN ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO

title_en: Multi-dimensional risk quantitative analysis method, system, equipment and storage medium for CPS (control system) of power distribution Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-dimensional risk quantitative analysis method, a system, equipment and a storage medium for CPS (control system) of a power distribution Internet of things, and relates to the field of information side and physical side fusion, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining key factors influencing CPS risk by relying on physical equipment and information system data of the power distribution Internet of things, constructing a multi-level and multi-dimensional risk evaluation index system, analyzing the association coupling effect and risk conduction rule of system components, and establishing a fault propagation model; the method and the system can accurately evaluate CPS risk of the power distribution Internet of things, assist operation and maintenance personnel to prevent and control in advance, reduce power failure risk, optimize power grid planning and improve operation efficiency and economic benefit.

title_en: Local disaster prevention warehouse
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a local disaster prevention warehouse for protecting human life, which can be easily installed at a nearby point, with which rescue/care activity for neighbors can be performed not only in the daytime but even during service interruption at night without waiting for official rescue/care activity, and which allows electric power to be supplied to information equipment and information to be obtained.SOLUTION: A local disaster prevention warehouse comprises: a solar panel 4 receiving sunlight to generate electric power; and a warehouse body 2, on which the solar panel 4 is installed at a predetermined angle, in which batteries 6 for accumulating the electric power from the solar panel 4 is housed, and which has an openable and closable door 3, is compact, and is suitable for transport. Rescue/care equipment, living supplies, a broadcasting facility, and radio communication equipment are stored in the warehouse body 2. Moreover, a fan for ventilation 11 using the batteries 6 as an electric power source, an external broadcast speaker 16, a television monitor 17, and automatic lighting and extinguishing LED lamps 13 are provided in the door 3.

title_en: Apparatus and method for providing personal location information-based disaster response information
title_ko: 개인 위치정보기반 재난 상황 대응정보 제공 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a device for providing disaster situation response information based on personal location information, which includes: a disaster information delivery server which disseminates disaster occurrence and situation information through a text message service of a mobile communication network; and a user terminal which automatically guides the emergency disaster text received from the disaster information delivery server and provides disaster response information corresponding to the received emergency text message to the user.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 개인 위치정보기반 재난 상황 대응정보 제공 장치에 관한 것으로, 재난 발생 및 상황 정보를 이동통신망의 문자메시지 서비스를 통해 관련 정보를 전파하는 재난정보전달 서버; 및 재난정보전달 서버로부터 수신된 긴급재난문자를 자동으로 안내하고, 수신된 긴급재난문자에 대응되는 재난대응 정보를 사용자에게 제공하는 사용자 단말을 포함한다.

title_en: Method and apparatus for predicting output current of synchronous generator, device, and storage medium
abstract_en: A method and apparatus for predicting the output current of a synchronous generator, a device, and a storage medium. The method comprises: acquiring working status data of a synchronous generator at a current moment, wherein the working status data comprises a d-axis voltage, a q-axis voltage, an excitation voltage, and a mechanical power which is input into the synchronous generator; inputting the working status data into a preset hybrid drive model, wherein the preset hybrid drive model comprises a synchronous generator physical model and a neural network model that are cascaded; processing the working status data by means of the synchronous generator physical model to obtain an initially predicted d-axis current and an initially predicted q-axis current; and correcting the initially predicted d-axis current and the initially predicted q-axis current by means of the neural network model to obtain a predicted d-axis current and a predicted q-axis current of the synchronous generator. The use of this method can improve the prediction accuracy, and improve the generalization abilities of models in different scenarios.
assignees: DIGITAL GRID RES INSTITUTE CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID

title_en: Recommendation engine for a cognitive reservoir system
abstract_en: Implementations described and claimed herein provide systems and methods for developing a reservoir. In one implementation, a reservoir model is received. The reservoir model includes a static model and a dynamic model. The static model includes one or more clusters of a three-dimensional volume of the reservoir and an uncertainty quantification generated using a neural network. The dynamic model includes pressure values and fluid saturation values propagated across the three-dimensional volume through a nodal connectivity of neighboring clusters. A set of input features is generated from the static model and the dynamic model. The set of input features is related to a drilling attractiveness of a target region of the reservoir using a set of rules executed by a fuzzy inference engine. A quantification of the drilling attractiveness is generated. A recommendation for drilling in the reservoir is output based on the quantification of the drilling attractiveness.

title_en: City gas pipeline system valve fault propagation impact evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the present invention discloses a kind of city gas pipeline system valve fault propagation impact evaluation method and system, and the method includes the network structure topological diagram of city gas pipeline system is established according to city gas pipeline system；Network model is established according to network structure topological diagram；According to network model and preset constraint condition, obtains the corresponding first flow pressure of city gas pipeline system normal condition and distribute information；Failsafe valve is simulated in network model, and according to preset failsafe valve propagation rule and constraint condition, is obtained city gas pipeline system corresponding second flow pressure under failsafe valve state and distributed information；Compare first flow pressure distribution information and second flow pressure distribution information carries out the assessment of failsafe valve propagation effect to city gas pipeline system.The system is for executing the above method.The embodiment of the present invention improves the accuracy of city gas pipeline system valve fault propagation impact evaluation.

title_en: Upstream and downstream water level prediction method for cascade power station
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for predicting upstream and downstream water levels of a cascade power station, which comprises the following steps: step 1, selecting an input variable and an output variable; step 2, carrying out standardization processing on the data to eliminate the influence of dimensions; step 3, determining input vector dimension, LSTM layer number, output vector dimension and time step; step 4, forward propagation process and error backward propagation process of LSTM; the forward propagation process is sequentially input into the LSTM network according to time steps to obtain corresponding output values; the sum of the squares of the errors of the output value and the true value is taken as a loss function, and the parameters are updated by carrying out reverse propagation of the errors along the time; and 5, performing multi-time continuous prediction by using the trained model. The LSTM is applied to the water level prediction of the cascade power station, so that the hysteresis influence information of an upstream power station on a downstream power station can be captured, the prediction precision is improved, and more reliable theoretical support is provided for scientific scheduling decision.

title_en: Method for predicting reliability of offshore wind turbine generator system facing manufacturing process
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for predicting the reliability of an offshore wind turbine generator system facing a manufacturing process, which establishes a membership function between a manufacturing process capability index and a fault mode occurrence probability on the basis of analyzing the manufacturing process capability index of key parts of each subsystem of the offshore wind turbine generator system; by analyzing the fault propagation influence among the subsystems, parts and fault modes of the offshore wind turbine generator system, a reliability prediction network model of the offshore wind turbine generator system is constructed, the sensitivity index of the reliability minimum cut set of each fault mode to the reliability of the offshore wind turbine generator system is analyzed, and the influence degree of the actual manufacturing process to the reliability of the offshore wind turbine generator system is further quantized; on the basis, primary and secondary fault modes of each subsystem are identified, and the inherent reliability of the offshore wind turbine generator is predicted by taking the reliability and the correlation of the primary and secondary fault modes of each subsystem as input under the condition of considering the current manufacturing process by adopting an improved second-order narrow limit theory.

title_en: Method and medium for acquiring water flow propagation time in dead water period and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water conservancy and discloses a method, a medium and electronic equipment for acquiring the propagation time of water flow in a dead water period, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring initial data of a research area; the initial data comprises river basin topography data, river network water system boundary data, inflow position data and inflow data, and the initial data is input into a medium-low water level radial flow evolution model to perform simulation calculation so as to obtain the water flow propagation time in the dead water period. The method accurately describes the hydrologic power process in the dead water period of the research area, predicts available water resources of all river sections in the river basin, provides quantitative basis for water distribution, is beneficial to optimization of the dead water period scheduling schemes of water conservancy projects such as reservoirs, sluice gates and the like in the river basin, predicts the effect of the water replenishing scheduling scheme, and aims at solving the key problems in the management of the river basin in the dead water period.

title_en: System for wireless networking using duct
title_ko: 덕트를 이용한 무선 통신망 시스템
abstract_ko:
본 발명에 따르면, 건물 최상단 중앙덕트의 환기팬 내측 또는 외측에 설치되어 무선 통신을 수행하는 메인중계수단; 및 중앙덕트로부터 건물의 지상 또는 지하의 각 층으로 분배되는 분배덕트를 전파경로로 하여 메인중계수단과 무선 통신을 수행하고, 건물의 특정 층에 위치한 하나 이상의 단말기와 무선 통신을 수행하며, 건물의 각 층에 적어도 하나 이상 설치되는 보조중계수단을 포함하는 덕트를 이용한 무선 통신망 시스템이 제공된다. 개시된 덕트를 이용한 무선 통신망 시스템에 따르면, 와이맥스 방식의 무선통신이 적용됨과 동시에 건물 내에 설치된 덕트를 무선 전파경로로 이용함에 따라 전송거리의 한계와 전파장애가 극복될 수 있음은 물론이며, 외부의 단말기와 무선통신을 수행하는 보조중계수단을 내열 설계된 공간상에 수용함에 따라 각종 사고로 인한 장비 손상문제가 감소되고 무선 통신의 상시적인 연결 유지가 가능한 이점이 있어 사고 발생시 인명 및 재산 피해를 절감시킬 수 있다. 
       
     덕트, 메인중계수단, 보조중계수단, 건물, 단말기

title_en: Method for estimating risk of infectious disease spread in facilities
title_ko: 시설물의 감염병 전파 위험도 판단 방법
abstract_ko: 시설물의 감염병 전파 위험도 판단 방법이 제공된다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 시설물의 감염병 전파 위험도 판단 방법은, 감염병에 확진된 확진자와 접촉한 접촉자가 있는지 탐지하고, 탐지된 접촉자가 확진자와 접촉한 시설물을 파악하며, 파악된 시설물의 감염병 전파 위험도를 판단한다. 이에 의해, 시설물의 감염병 전파 위험도를 객관적인 기준에 의거하여 판단할 수 있으므로, 감염병 확진자가 방문한 시설물에 대한 합리적이고 체계적이며 효과적인 사후 조치가 가능해져, 궁극적으로 감염병 대유행의 예방과 억제에 기여할 수 있게 된다.

title_en: Method and system for realizing disaster recovery and switching
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for realizing disaster recovery and switching, wherein the method comprises the following steps: judging whether synchronous switching conditions are met or not according to service quality test result of a data access link between the front end or the back end after the disaster recovery and the switching and the back end or the front end without the disaster recovery and the switching of a network device for the network device performing the disaster recovery and the switching at one of the front end and the back end; and performing synchronous switching on the back end or the front end without the disaster recovery and the switching of the network device according to synchronous switching rules when the judgment result is that the synchronous switching conditions are met. With the help of the invention, not only the unnecessary switching between the FE (front end) and the BE (back end) can be avoided, but also the service performance of the system can be ensured through automatic synchronous switching between the FE and the BE, and the service interruption time caused by manual switching can be further avoided.

title_en: Power grid risk pre-control method based on big data
abstract_en: The invention provides a power grid risk pre-control method based on big data. The method comprises steps of 1, scrolling check of multiclass scheduling plan modes; 2, component outage model construction based on reliable data, real-time external factor data and equipment status data; 3, fault filtering based on topology analysis, failure influence domain and probability to automatically generate a real-time fault set; 4, static safety analysis based on multiple algorithms and consideration of cascading failures; and 5, load loss calculation method based on sensitivity. According to the invention, the component outage probability modeling is achieved based on real-time external environmental information, the fault set is automatically generated based on topology analysis and failure influence domain, the static safety analysis based on consideration of cascading failures is achieved, potential risks of a power grid are quantified into load shedding amount, risk indexes are calculated, and a powerful tool for analyzing current power grid risks is provided to dispatchers.
assignees: HANGZHOU WR POWER TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for determining environment protection information transmission effect of grid
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and system for determining an environment protection information transmission effect of a grid. The method comprises: an evaluation index system of an environment protection information transmission effect of a grid is established; a hierarchical structure graph of a transmission effect is constructed; a value of an importance degree of an influence on an environment protection information propagation effect of the grid by each first-order index is determined; on the basis of the values, a determination matrix A is established; a maximum feature value and a maximum feature vector of the matrix A are calculated and consistency checking is carried out on the determination matrix A; when the determination matrix passes the consistency checking, a grid environment protection information transmission effect evaluation formula is established based on the maximum feature value of the determination matrix and the corresponding feature vector, wherein the formula is as follows: an information transmission effect=omega01*(attention rate)+omega02*(interest rate)+omega03*(query rate)+omega04*(action rate)+omega05*(haring rate)+omega06*(query-sharing rate); and on the basis of the evaluation rate, index assignment is carried out for an environment protection propagation activity plan of the power grid and a quantitative evaluation result of the information transmission effect is determined.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;UNIV TSINGHUA

title_en: Multi-infeed DC receiving end AC system Voltage Stability Evaluation fault set forming method
abstract_en: The invention discloses multi-infeed DC receiving end AC system Voltage Stability Evaluation fault set forming method, it is characterised in that including：Gather the delivery profile of fluctuation data and corresponding power the maximum DC transmission system of recent multi-infeed DC direct current receiving-end system and when time domain load and start-up mode, form relation table, Rules Reduction is carried out to the relation table according to reduction rules, it is determined that following one section of typical operation modes in period；The Voltage Stability Level coefficient of receiving-end system under calculating typical operation modes；Calculate the direct current receiving-end system Voltage Stability Level coefficient S under various line fault disconnections n ；Line fault is ranked up according to direct current receiving-end system Voltage Stability Level coefficient；Power flow transfer situation, low voltage point and trouble point electrical distance risk factor, are combined into worst cascading failure collection after combination failure.The present invention carries out signature analysis by existing AC-DC hybrid power grid transient voltage unstability accident that may be present, can carry out rapid evaluation to straight-flow system receiving end line voltage unstability risk after failure.
assignees: STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV HOHAI

title_en: Power grid unit combination and technical improvement plan combined optimization method
abstract_en: A power grid unit combination and technical improvement plan combined optimization method comprises the steps of firstly, respectively constructing unit combination and technical improvement plan combined optimization submodels of a power transmission network and a power distribution network by taking the minimum sum of unit combination cost and technical improvement cost as a target, and then solving the constructed power transmission network optimization submodels and power distribution network optimization submodels by adopting an improved target cascade analysis algorithm on the basis of topology, load, units, new energy, technical improvement projects and electricity price parameters of the power transmission network and the power distribution network to obtain unit combination and technical improvement plan optimization results of the power transmission network and the power distribution network. The method not only effectively considers the load power supply requirement and the technical improvement construction requirement of the system, but also improves the convergence, and shows strong adaptability in a high-proportion new energy power system.
assignees: ECONOMIC TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Underground water model uncertainty control method based on Stacked GPR
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underground water model uncertainty control method based on a Stacked GPR (general purpose processor), which is characterized in that a complex underground water model is converted into a modularized hierarchical GPR submodel combination, data of multiple sources of each submodel are fused, the underground water model structure uncertainty analysis of each submodel is independently carried out based on the GPR, and the propagation process of uncertainty in a GPR network is described. The method can analyze the structural uncertainty of a complex underground water model, and overcomes the defect that the traditional GPR method is limited to the structural uncertainty analysis of a single simple model; the propagation process of model uncertainty is effectively described, the defect that the uncertainty propagation among submodels is not generally considered when the uncertainty of the model structure is analyzed by a traditional GPR method is overcome, and the uncertainty of a model prediction result is reduced; the data from various sources are fused, the defect that the traditional GPR method cannot fully utilize other types of observation data to analyze the structural uncertainty of the model is overcome, and the accuracy of model prediction is improved.

title_en: Artificial intelligent resource allocation method for intelligent power grid
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of smart power grids, in particular to a smart power grid artificial intelligence resource allocation method. The method comprises the following steps: collecting the data of the light energy power generation area equipment in charge of the intelligent power grid system, preprocessing the data, generating vectors by using different data and generating a photovoltaic system data set by using a normalization standardized formula; performing photovoltaic energy consumption calculation on the photovoltaic system data set by using a machine learning algorithm, so as to generate a photovoltaic energy consumption data set; collecting historical electricity consumption, and performing power demand analysis and calculation on the historical electricity consumption by utilizing a data prediction model combining a momentum method and a back propagation network, so as to generate a power demand value; and carrying out load balancing analysis according to the power demand value and the photovoltaic energy consumption data set, thereby generating a dynamic resource allocation adjustment scheme. The invention can improve the efficiency of resource allocation of the intelligent power grid in the new energy field.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER;ELECTRIC POWER RES INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID NINGXIA ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID NINGXIA ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: TimesNet-Crossformer-LSTM-based short-term power load prediction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a short-term power load prediction method based on TimesNet-Crossformer-LSTM, which comprises the steps of 1) screening features of an imported data set, normalizing selected features, 2) dividing a training set, a verification set and a test set, inputting the training set and the verification set into a model for training, 3) extracting information from an input time sequence by the model, extracting a relation between a period and a period in the time sequence, 4) adjusting parameters of a neural network by adopting an Adam algorithm, training the network by utilizing back propagation, evaluating training effects of model parameters by observing loss values on the verification set, 5) selecting tanshark as an activation function of the model according to an ablation experiment result, 6) inputting the test set into the trained model, obtaining a point prediction result, and evaluating the model prediction effect by four evaluation indexes. Compared with the prior art, the method has higher precision in the short-term power load prediction task.

title_en: Multi-energy complementary-oriented source network charge storage integrated planning platform and resource optimization configuration method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a source network and lotus storage integrated planning platform oriented to multi-energy complementation and a resource optimization configuration method, belonging to the technical field of source network and lotus storage planning, and comprising a data layer, a model layer, an optimization layer and an application layer; according to the invention, the platform realizes multi-energy flow synergy, so that energy is utilized in a cascade way, comprehensive energy efficiency is improved to more than 80%, cross-energy complementation is adopted, electrolysis water is used for gas production during wind and light power generation peak time, fuel cells are used for generating electricity during low-peak time, the contradiction between new energy consumption and peak regulation is solved, the platform can perform dynamic resource adaptation, a space-time elastic resource pool is established, the elastic allocation and utilization of resources can be realized, the waste of resources and energy is avoided, the problems of system fluctuation, multi-energy flow coupling complexity and investment economy challenges under high-proportion new energy access are effectively solved through multi-energy complementation collaborative modeling, dynamic optimization of source network charge storage and full life cycle cost control, and the practical application effect of the whole platform is good.
assignees: BEIJING ZHONGNENG GUANGLIAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Interpolation-free hybrid line simulation model with accurate zero sequence impedance and construction method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power system simulation, and discloses an interpolation-free hybrid line simulation model with accurate zero sequence impedance and a construction method thereof, wherein the model comprises a decoupling module, a parallel compensation module and a series synthesis module; the decoupling module is used for enabling electromagnetic propagation delay time to be equal to simulation step length of a simulation program and realizing interpolation-free calculation decoupling at two ends of a line, the parallel compensation module is used for compensating additional parallel susceptance introduced and inter-phase capacitance introduced into an original physical model of the line, and the series synthesis module is used for synthesizing residual series impedance of the line so that total series positive-sequence impedance and zero-sequence impedance of an equivalent model are matched with a preset target value under fundamental wave frequency. The invention can provide calculation decoupling without interpolation for the short line and accurately simulate the full-sequence network parameters including zero sequence components, thereby being capable of well meeting the requirements of high-fidelity parallel simulation of the modern power distribution network.
assignees: JIANGSU KUNYOU ENERGY TECH CO LTD;NANJING KUNHONG SHUZHI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Device for predicting state of charge based deep learning, system for managing microgrid system having the same and methods thereof
title_ko: 딥러닝 기반의 soc 예측 장치, 이를 포함하는 마이크로그리드 시스템의 운영 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: A deep learning-based soc prediction device for operating a microgrid system includes: a solar power generation prediction value calculation unit that calculates a solar power generation prediction value at time t by applying a backpropagation algorithm to a pre-built first artificial neural network model; a power demand load prediction value calculation unit that calculates a power demand load prediction value at time t by applying a backpropagation algorithm to a pre-built second artificial neural network model; and an soc estimation unit that estimates the soc of the energy storage device at time t using the soc at time t-1, the total capacity of the energy storage device, the solar power generation prediction value at time t, and the power demand load prediction value at time t. The present invention optimizes the charging/discharging schedule of the solar-ESS microgrid by deep learning-based SOC prediction. The system improves the power operation efficiency and stability. Moreover, the surplus power loss and operating cost are reduced. It contributes to the carbon neutrality.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 본 발명의 실시예는 딥러닝 기반의 SOC 예측 장치, 이를 포함하는 마이크로그리드 시스템의 운영 시스템 및 그 방법에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 태양광 발전원과 에너지 저장 장치가 결합된 하이브리드 에너지 시스템의 운영 시 중요한 변수인 SoC(State of Charge)를 예측하기 위해 태양광 발전량과 전력수요부하를 특정 딥러닝 모델과 역전파 알고리즘(Back propagation algorithm)을 활용하여 추정하고 이를 기반으로 SoC를 예측하는 장치, 이를 포함하는 시스템과 그 방법에 관한 것이다. 
일례로, 스마트 미터 인터페이스를 통해 태양광 발전 장치로부터 태양광 발전량에 영향을 주는 제1 데이터 및 에너지 저장 장치로부터 전력수요부하 전력량에 영향을 주는 제2 데이터를 각각 주기적으로 수집하는 데이터 수집 장치; 미리 구축된 제1 인공신경망 모델에 상기 제1 데이터 및 역전파 알고리즘을 적용하여 t시점에서의 태양광 발전량 예측치를 산출하는 태양광 발전량 예측치 산출부; 미리 구축된 제2 인공신경망 모델에 상기 제2 데이터 및 역전파 알고리즘을 적용하여 t시점에서의 전력수요부하 예측치를 산출하는 전력수요부하 예측치 산출부; 및 t-1시점에서의 SOC 값, 에너지 저장 장치의 총 용량, 상기 t시점에서의 태양광 발전량 예측치 및 상기 t시점에서의 전력수요부하 예측치를 이용하여 에너지 저장 장치의 t시점에서의 SOC 값을 추정하는 SOC 추정부를 포함하는 SOC 예측 장치; 및 상기 SOC 예측 장치를 통해 추정된 SOC 값을 이용하여 전력 분배 최적화를 위한 상기 에너지 저장 장치의 충방전 제어 동작을 수행하는 전력 제어 장치를 포함하는 마이크로그리드 시스템의 운영 시스템을 개시한다.

title_en: Contagion Risk Detection, Analysis and Protection
abstract_en: A method, system, and computer-usable medium for protecting against contagion-based risk events are disclosed for monitoring behavior of users to construct a contagion network relationship map of connection and influence relationships between different users and then analyzing a received stream of events from the users to identify a critical event performed by a first user having a first risk score so that one or more propagated risk scores can be generated from the first risk score for at least a first connected user based on connection and influence relationships between the first user and the first connected user that are extracted from the contagion network relationship so that an adaptive response may be automatically generated to protect and control against actions by at least the first connected user based on the one or more propagated risk scores.

title_en: Method and device for supporting minimization of service disruption in wireless communication system
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a device and an operating method of a terminal in a wireless communication system. The operating method of the terminal may include receiving, from a first access and mobility management function (AMF) corresponding to a first public land mobile network (PLMN), a first registration accept message including information related to a disaster PLMN (DPLMN), selecting a second PLMN based on the first registration accept message, transmitting, to a second AMF corresponding to the second PLMN, a registration request message in which a disaster-related indication is configured, and receiving, from the second AMF, a second registration accept message, based on the registration request message.

title_en: Time-based approaches in malware simulation for responsive measure deployment
abstract_en: A computer-implemented method of simulating the propagation of malware in a network is provided. The method comprises accessing a model of the network, where the model comprising a plurality of computer nodes and where each computer node of the plurality of computer nodes is connected to at least one edge of a plurality of edges. Each edge of the plurality of edges connects a pair of computer nodes of the plurality of computer nodes. The method further comprises initiating an outbreak of the malware in the model at a predetermined source computer node of the plurality of computer nodes, and propagating the malware through the model of the network from the source computer node over a plurality of step-times. The propagation is determined based on a rate of transmission per step-time for each edge, and each step-time of the plurality of step-times corresponds to a temporal point that is universal across the network, such that at each step-time the malware propagation through the network occurs simultaneously for each edge of the plurality of edges according to the rate of transmission per step-time for each edge.

title_en: Modeling and optimizing method of solvent deasphalting device based on data driving
abstract_en: The invention discloses a modeling and optimizing method of a solvent deasphalting device based on data driving. The modeling method of the solvent deasphalting device based on data driving comprises the following steps: (1) Preprocessing field data, including production operation data, feedstock and product property analysis data for a solvent deasphalting unit; (2) Screening characteristic variables according to process principles and processes; (3) Performing dimension reduction on the characteristic variable by adopting a Principal Component Analysis (PCA); modeling the dimensionality reduced data set by adopting a Back Propagation (BP) neural network, and respectively establishing a yield model of deasphalted oil (DAO) and a desulfurization and carbon residue removal model. The optimization method comprises the step of optimizing the operating conditions of the solvent deasphalting device by using the constructed data-driven-based solvent deasphalting device model.

title_en: Smart apartment complex security system that implements crime prevention through phased access control
title_ko: 단계적 출입통제를 통한 범죄 예방을 구현한 스마트 공동주택 보안 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed in the present invention is a smart apartment complex security system, including: an optical camera (110) that captures the inside and outside of an apartment complex and generates first image information; an infrared camera (120) installed inside the household to capture thermal images and generate second image information; a home network server (130) that integrates and manages IoT smart home appliances (131) that perform security, intrusion prevention, heating, cooling, ventilation, cooking, illumination control, and safety accident prevention, respectively, by linking therewith, performs real-time control and reservation control, generates first warning information when the front door is attempted to be opened using unregistered biometric information, and receives the first image information and the second image information to analyze the intrusion of an unregistered outsider into the apartment complex and generate second warning information; a resident terminal (140) that receives and monitors operation detection information, first image information, and second image information according to operation from the home network server (130), and spreads an alarm according to the first warning information and second warning information; and a management office server (150) that is connected to the home network server (130) and the resident terminal (140) through a communication network to receive first warning information and second warning information, receive and store the corresponding image information, and transmit an alarm to a public safety center server (160). Therefore, crimes caused by outsider intrusion can be prevented in advance.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 공동주택 내외부를 촬영하여 제1영상정보를 생성하는 광학카메라(110), 세대 내부에 설치되어 열화상을 촬영하여 제2영상정보를 생성하는 적외선카메라(120), 보안과 침입탑지와 난방과 냉방과 환기와 요리와 조도와 안전사고예방을 각각 수행하는 IoT 스마트 가전기기(131)와 연동하여, 통합관리하며, 실시간 제어 및 예약 제어를 수행하고, 미등록 생체정보에 의한 현관도어의 개방시도시에 제1경고정보를 생성하고, 제1영상정보 및 제2영상정보를 전송받아 해당 공동주택의 미등록 외부인의 침입을 분석하여 제2경고정보를 생성하는, 홈 네트워크 서버(130), 홈 네트워크 서버(130)로부터 운용에 따른 작동감지정보와 제1영상정보와 제2영상정보를 전송받아 모니터링하고, 제1경고정보 및 제2경고정보에 따라 알람을 전파하는, 입주민 단말기(140), 및 홈 네트워크 서버(130) 및 입주민 단말기(140)와 통신네트워크로 연결되어 제1경고정보 및 제2경고정보를 전송받아 해당 영상정보를 전송받아 저장하고, 치안센터서버(160)로 알람을 전송하도록 하는 관리실 서버(150)를 포함하여, 외부인 침입에 의한 범죄를 사전에 방지하는, 스마트 공동주택 보안 시스템을 개시한다.

title_en: Time-based initial-stage power grid cascading failure analog simulation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a time-based initial-stage power grid cascading failure analog simulation method. The method comprises the following steps: representing influences on a circuit, caused by a heat effect of circuit overload, by utilizing a formula; analyzing parameters of the circuit respectively; when modeling power grid failures, considering influences of cascading failures instead of single failures on a system; providing a power grid failure overload serious degree index; considering influences on a system, caused by changes of a load curve along time; and recalculating the trend of a network, and forming a load index by utilizing a calculating result and judging whether the circuit has the mth failures or not due to passage of time, so as to realize load overload monitoring in a power grid failure process. According to the time-based initial-stage power grid cascading failure analog simulation method, a power grid structure is optimized for power grid planning designers and helps are provided for improving the power grid disaster-resisting capability; and a power grid failure initial-stage evolution can be more comprehensively, more accurately and more detailedly described, and reference is provided for the power grid planning designers and researchers.
assignees: YANTAI POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Analysis method and device, storage medium, the computer equipment of gossip propagation risk
abstract_en: This application discloses a kind of analysis method of gossip propagation risk and device, storage medium, computer equipments, this method comprises: obtaining the social data of social network-i i-platform user；According to social data, the effective distance between user is calculated；Using the effective distance between user, the length of the most short active path between user is obtained；According to the length of the most short active path between user, the propagation risk of user is analyzed.The application quantifies the propagation effective distance between user using the user social contact data of social platform, so that it is determined that the shortest length of the active path between user, propagate the quantitative analysis of risk, compared with prior art, the application is based on user social contact data, the propagation risk of quantitative analysis user is more advantageous to and subsequent is managed and control in the message propagation of social platform to user according to propagating risk.
assignees: PING AN TECH SHENZHEN CO LTD

title_en: Material S parameter measuring method based on de-embedding error
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for measuring S parameter of material, which comprises establishing signal flow chart of measuring process, and determining state equation of embedding error; according to a signal flow chart of a measurement process, five state models of a port network in the material S parameter measurement system are constructed by changing a test sample; establishing a fixture S parameter state equation of the five state models, and determining fixture S parameters; and substituting the S parameter of the clamp into a state equation of the embedding error, and calculating to obtain the real S parameter of the material to be measured. Compared with the three states of the traditional TRL principle-based embedded error port network model, the invention provides five state models. Then, a state equation is established according to the five state models. In the analysis of the dual-port cascade network, the correlation equation of the S parameter is directly listed, the traditional S parameter and T parameter conversion method is not adopted, and the data processing is simpler and more visual.

title_en: Economic dispatching method considering safety constraints of N-1 and N-2 of power grid
abstract_en: The application discloses an economic dispatching method considering the safety constraints of a power grid N-1 and a power grid N-2, heavy load lines which are easy to have cascading failures are screened out by carrying out power grid N-1 power flow analysis on an economic dispatching model P0 which does not consider the safety constraints, N-2 fault pairs are formed by the heavy load lines and corresponding branches which are analyzed by the N-1 one by one to generate a new N-2 fault set, then power flow verification is carried out on the fault set based on branch breaking distribution factors to obtain harmful fault scenes, the harmful fault scenes are added to P0 to obtain a new economic dispatching model P1, P1 is updated through continuous verification and re-verification steps until the number of the harmful N-1 and N-2 fault scenes is zero to obtain a final dispatching model P2, a dispatching scheme meeting the criteria of the line N-1 and the N-2 is obtained by solving P2, the further propagation and development of the initial fault of the power grid N-1 are effectively avoided, and the problem that the power grid cascading failure power failure is caused by the fact that the secondary fault is easy to occur on a heavy-load line after the N-1 fault is not considered in the existing economic dispatching method considering the safety constraint of the power grid N-1 is solved.

title_en: Risk propagation detection method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a risk propagation detection method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of information security. The risk propagation detection method calculates propagation risk values of other nodes except for the preset nodes in the node network by constructing the node network of the data to be predicted, and then: and determining whether the other nodes are nodes with abnormal risk propagation according to the propagation risk values of the other nodes. And constructing a node network by using fields in the data to be predicted, calculating propagation risk values of other nodes by using propagation risk values of preset nodes in the node network for reference, and detecting nodes with abnormal risk propagation according to the propagation risk values of the other nodes. The detection method for data risk propagation is optimized, so that the detection is more stable and the detection result is more reliable.

title_en: Power price adjusting method for distributed power distribution network based on convolutional network and collaborative filtering
abstract_en: The invention provides a distributed power distribution network electricity price adjusting method based on a convolutional network and collaborative filtering, which comprises the following steps: 1. extracting characteristics according to the data of the power distribution network; 2. constructing a scoring matrix; 3. singular value decomposition; 4. calculating the similarity degree; 5. confirming a user to be recommended; 6. and selecting the recommended users according to the sorting. The method adopts a convolutional neural network method to realize the output prediction of the power distribution network with the distributed power supply, realizes data characteristic extraction, predicts the time period with abundant output of the power distribution network with the distributed power supply, and utilizes the prediction result to adjust the electricity price. The electricity price discount information is pushed to the user by a singular value decomposition and model-based collaborative filtering method, the singular value decomposition method is wide in application range and suitable for large-scale data; the collaborative filtering method based on the model can improve the collaborative filtering performance and more accurately screen and sort. And determining a final recommended user according to the similarity ranking between the user and the target user, and reducing unnecessary information propagation cost.

title_en: Method, device and medium for measuring survivability of living material supply network considering cascade failure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device and a medium for measuring the survivability of a living material supply network considering cascade failure, wherein the method comprises the following steps: basic data of a target area are obtained, preprocessing is carried out, and grid division is carried out on the target area; the basic data comprise mobile phone signaling data, POI data, urban road data and administrative data; based on the administrative data after preprocessing, a supply-demand network is constructed according to the mobile phone signaling data and the POI data, and the service quantity of each supply point in the supply-demand network is calculated; constructing a supply network according to the service quantity of each supply point and the preprocessed urban road data; based on community toughness sorting, main supply points corresponding to low-toughness communities are found in a supply-demand network, and an attack strategy is formulated; based on the cascade failure model, the destructiveness of the service efficiency of the supply network under the attack strategy is measured. The method provides references for the urban living material supply and guarantee system and urban management under sudden heavy disasters.

title_en: Slope monitoring module and monitoring system thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a slope monitoring module and a monitoring system thereof, and belongs to the field of slope early warning. In the monitoring system, a plurality of groups of information transmission units are arranged along the extending direction of the slope top of the slope; the information acquisition units are arranged at the sides of the information transmission units and can be used for carrying out signal transmission with the information acquisition units; the information acquisition unit is provided with a plurality of groups of monitoring modules, the monitoring modules are connected with each other, the monitoring modules are arranged along the slope bottom to the slope top of the slope, the monitoring modules are used for monitoring deformation information from the slope bottom to the slope top, the monitoring modules are arranged on the information acquisition unit through the plurality of groups of monitoring modules, so that the monitoring modules cover to form a monitoring surface, once the slope is displaced, the accessible monitoring data are fed back into the information acquisition unit, the data are transmitted to the information acquisition unit for information sharing through the Beidou system, and disaster early warning information is transmitted to the receiving terminal through the mobile network in time for disaster information propagation.

title_en: Geological disaster monitoring and early warning system and method based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention relates to a digital twin-based geological disaster monitoring and early warning system and method, which comprises a data acquisition module, a model building module, an early warning module and a warning module, wherein the data acquisition module is used for acquiring data, a dynamic-static self-adaptive fusion algorithm is utilized for preprocessing the data, the model building module is used for building a deep learning model by using a deep learning algorithm and using a counter propagation algorithm for model training, the model weight and the deviation are continuously adjusted through iterative optimization, the quality of an output result is continuously improved, the output of a convolutional layer of a convolutional neural network is transmitted into the deep learning model for feature extraction again to finish testing, the digital twin-based model is obtained, the early warning module is used for inputting real-time monitoring data into the digital twin-based model to obtain a prediction result, and when the prediction result reaches an early warning grade, early warning information is generated, an early warning signal is triggered and is sent to relevant personnel for confirmation and release. According to the invention, the dynamic-static self-adaptive fusion algorithm and the deep learning classification algorithm are fused, so that the accuracy and the efficiency of analysis and processing of various geological disaster data can be further improved.

title_en: Cascading failure risk assessment method considering aging of power transmission line in typhoon weather
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of safety protection of power systems, and discloses a cascading failure risk assessment method considering power transmission line aging in typhoon weather, wherein a typhoon wind speed simulation model is established according to weather bureau forecast information, and a tower wind load is calculated by combining power grid geographic information; and (3) establishing a transmission tower fault probability calculation model considering ageing and a cascading fault probability calculation model of line ageing, and obtaining a risk value of power grid regulation by combining the cascading fault probability in consideration of comprehensive cost. And calculating the comprehensive risk of causing the cascading failure under the typhoon disaster by combining the risk value regulated by the power grid based on the risk value of the collapse of the tower, forecasting typhoons at each moment as a stage, and accumulating the risk values of all stages until the typhoons are finished to obtain the risk value of the final state of the system. According to the method, the tower aging and the transmission line aging influence are considered, and the tower collapse risk and the power grid regulation risk are considered, so that the risk assessment of typhoons on the power grid is more practical.

title_en: Fault diagnosis method, device, apparatus, storage medium, and program product
abstract_en: The present application relates to a fault diagnosis method, apparatus, device, storage medium, and program product. Relates to the technical field of power systems. The method comprises the steps of processing acquired electrical quantity data, equipment parameters, environment data and unstructured data of a power distribution area in real time to obtain processed data, dynamically updating a pre-constructed knowledge graph based on the processed data, carrying out aggregation processing on node feature vectors in a latest knowledge graph based on a pre-constructed graph neural network model, determining fault probability corresponding to nodes according to the node feature vectors obtained through aggregation, and determining a fault propagation path and/or positioning faults based on topological relations in the knowledge graph under the condition that the fault probability is larger than a set threshold value. By adopting the method, the database can be updated in time along with the change of the fault scene, so that the fault report missing rate is reduced.

title_en: A method to simulate continuous wave lidar sensors
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for simulating sensor data of a continuous wave, CW, Light Detection and Ranging, lidar, sensor, comprising the steps: generating a ray set comprising at least one ray, based on a CW signal 51, each ray in the ray set having an emission starting time (t_0) and an emission duration (T); propagating, for each ray in the ray set, the ray through a simulated scene comprising at least one object; computing, for each ray in the ray set, a signal contribution 71 of the propagated ray at a detection location in the simulated scene; generating an output signal 73, based on mixing the CW signal 51 with the computed signal contributions of the rays in the ray set; and at least one of storing and outputting the output signal. The invention provides simulation data corresponding to full-waveform signals of CW lidar sensors. The provided sensor data also allows to determine additional information, such as object shapes and object classes, and object orientation. Moreover, the sensor data also comprises artifacts which are present in real lidar data, which originate from physical properties of the lidar sensor and the environment and are absent in point-clouds- type data, such as multiple reflections of the lidar beam. Therefore, sensor development can be improved by also taking said artifacts into account. The invention accurately simulates how a real CW lidar sensor works and therefore accurately recreates the output of a real CW lidar sensor. The provided high-quality data, which is both complete and accurate to the real world, can also be of high value for developing signal processing algorithms, training neural networks, virtual validation, and the like.
assignees: SIEMENS IND SOFTWARE AND SERVICES B V

title_en: Distributed reactive power optimization method and device for load prediction of power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed reactive power optimization method and device for power system load prediction, wherein the method comprises the following steps: dividing power load information, meteorological information and holiday information of a prediction place into a test set of a plurality of input neurons and an output sample; establishing an initial LSTM network, and bringing a training set into the initial LSTM network for forward calculation and backward propagation training; inputting neuron information required to be used in a prediction day through a trained LSTM network so as to predict the load of each time point; analyzing reactive compensation characteristics of the distributed power supply, and collecting target parameters of the distributed power supply to establish a reactive model of the distributed power supply; establishing a power grid reactive power optimization model taking the minimum network loss as a target function; and performing distributed optimization control calculation according to the reactive average utilization rate and the instantaneous communication topology matrix to realize distributed reactive optimization. The method can obtain rapid and accurate load prediction.

title_en: Power communication network maintenance exercise method and system based on fault simulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power communication network maintenance exercise method and device based on fault simulation, which are used for acquiring maintenance task information, acquiring corresponding equipment and optical cable resources based on maintenance content in the maintenance task information, and performing maintenance preview simulation; according to the association relation between the overhaul task information and the equipment and the optical cable, corresponding faults are simulated and set, and the diffusion and the propagation of the faults are presented on the network topology and the running state; and analyzing the fault influence according to the fault alarm to realize maintenance exercise. According to the invention, the power communication network overhaul previewing based on fault simulation is finally realized, the pertinence and the effectiveness of overhaul previewing analysis are improved, and the efficiency of relevant operation and maintenance personnel in the power communication network overhaul work is improved.

title_en: Competitive impact propagation maximization method considering community consensus and related equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a competitive influence propagation maximization method considering community consensus and related equipment, which can realize a better influence propagation effect for a social network. The method comprises the following steps: activating K initial nodes selected from the social network to obtain a forward node set; if the target group meets the group activation condition, activating the target group through positive influence or competitive influence; if the target nodes which are not activated and are not in the activated group exist in the social network and the target nodes meet the node activation condition, activating the target nodes through forward influence or competitive influence; adding nodes activated by the forward impact to the forward node set and nodes activated by the competing impact to the competing node set; and activating the unactivated nodes in the social network based on the forward node set and the competitive node set after the nodes are added until a termination condition is reached, so as to obtain a forward final set.

title_en: Method for identifying cascade fault accident chain of wind power-containing alternating current/direct current series-parallel power grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for identifying a cascading failure accident chain of an alternating-current and direct-current mixed power grid with wind power, which comprehensively considers basic indexes for measuring the importance degree of a line from four aspects of wind power output level, stable state of alternating current and direct current interaction, trend running condition and network global topological structure angle, obtains subjective and objective weights as basic weights by calculating wind power access proportion short-circuit ratio indexes, multi-feed short-circuit ratio indexes, weighted trend entropy indexes and line transmission medium number indexes through a relevance coefficient and entropy weight method, and linearly combines the two basic weights to obtain comprehensive weights; solving by using a gray wolf algorithm to obtain a combination coefficient, obtaining the comprehensive weight of each index, sorting according to the magnitude of the comprehensive index value, and identifying the key transmission line as a next-stage accident chain of the cascading failure; and determining a cascading accident chain according to the criterion of ending the cascading failure prediction. The method is beneficial to prediction of the chain accident chain and has an effective guiding effect on engineering practice.

title_en: Traffic transportation operation monitoring early warning and decision analysis method based on vehicle-road cooperation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a traffic operation monitoring, early warning and decision analysis method based on vehicle-road cooperation, and relates to the technical field of intelligent traffic. The invention realizes real-time acquisition of dynamic traffic elements through multidimensional sensing networks and V2X communication of vehicle ends, road sides and environments, ensures unified space-time basis of multisource data, builds a 'road-vehicle-environment-event' semantic network, combines hierarchical feature extraction, realizes multidimensional identification of abnormal events such as accidents, congestion, bad weather and the like, improves identification accuracy, predicts an abnormal event propagation path, has global road network situation prediction capability, generates differential early warning based on comprehensive risk indexes, triggers multistage response such as traffic signal adjustment, path planning and the like, greatly shortens response time, optimizes emergency response efficiency, establishes a real-time feedback mechanism of decision execution effect, continuously optimizes system performance along with data accumulation, and avoids the defect that a large data platform lacks intelligent decision closed loop.

title_en: Cascade hydropower station group long-term generating scheduling method based on bidding strategies
abstract_en: The invention provides a cascade hydropower station group long-term generating scheduling method based on bidding strategies. The cascade hydropower station group long-term generating scheduling method is characterized by solving the cascade hydropower station group scheduling problem in the market environment in three steps, step 1, for Price-Taker-based power generation enterprises, direct deduction from the demand is carried out according to the historical transaction proportion, for Price-Maker-based power generation enterprises, the power generation capacity is estimated by means of a largest power generation capacity model; step 2, the market electricity price and electric quantity relation and the hydropower operation cost and generating capacity relation are described by linear functions; and step 3, the maximum cascade total generating benefit is taken as the control target, the solution is carried out by means of a gradual optimization algorithm and discrete differential dynamic program mixed optimization algorithm to obtain the water level and output processes of the cascade hydropower stations. The invention realizes the combination of the bidding strategy in the market environment and the cascade hydropower station group dispatching process, and has important significance to the participation of the cascade hydropower station group of the other power grids of our country in the electric power market.
assignees: HUANENG LANCANG RIVER HYDROPOWER CO LTD;UNIV DALIAN TECH

title_en: A kind of grid disturbance Forecasting Methodology and device
abstract_en: A kind of grid disturbance Forecasting Methodology and device are the embodiment of the invention provides, by the Monitoring Data for obtaining power network interior joint；According to Monitoring Data, whether decision node disturbs；When one or more nodes are disturbed in node, using the state of disturbance value at node current time as LSTM RTRBM deep learning models input；By LSTM RTRBM deep learning models, the state of disturbance value of one or more the time step interior nodes after current time is predicted；The state of disturbance value of the multiple time step interior nodes after according to current time, predict the situation that disturbance is propagated with one or more time steps among the nodes, computing is carried out without the various actual physics parameters in power network, disturbance can just be predicted by complete data-driven using LSTM RTRBM deep learnings models and spatially and temporally go up two propagation conditions of dimension, improve the efficiency and accuracy of propagation of disturbance prediction.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST OF STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV BEIJING POSTS & TELECOMM;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: A kind of rumour methods of risk assessment based on network risks entropy difference
abstract_en: The invention discloses the rumour methods of risk assessment based on network risks entropy difference, including：S1, the gossip propagation model based on SIR models is established to the network platform to be assessed；S2, the network structure based on gossip propagation model identify rumour source and propagation time using rumour source discrimination；S3, the forward-propagating process for simulating rumour in the network architecture, to obtain the probability that each node in current time network is in different conditions；S4, the probability that different conditions are according to current time each node calculate current time network greateset risk entropy and minimum risk entropy；S5, greateset risk entropy and minimum risk entropy using current time network, calculate the network risks entropy at current time；S6, according to the network risks entropy of network current time and previous moment calculate network risks entropy it is poor, and according to network risks entropy difference assess current time rumour potential risk caused by the network platform.The present invention can quantitatively, accurately in real time assessment rumour risk caused by network.

title_en: Network threat protection method and device for power substation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for protecting network threats of an electric power transformer substation, which comprises the steps of analyzing a system configuration file of an intelligent transformer substation in the intelligent transformer substation, extracting assets in the intelligent transformer substation, and forming an asset table of the intelligent transformer substation; analyzing the real-time flow, acquiring real-time asset information, and marking abnormal assets on the intelligent substation asset list to obtain an asset list; setting the action generated by the assets in the asset table as a pass tag, and setting the action generated by the assets which are not in the asset table as a packet loss tag; and setting an emergency response threshold value for the packet loss label, and if the illegal access flow hit exceeds the threshold value, closing the interface management state to realize network threat protection. The flow accessed by unauthorized assets is controlled through the table entries, access threat detection is continuously carried out, and processing is carried out according to the interface emergency disposal module, so that threats such as virus propagation, malicious attack and the like from illegal terminals are avoided in advance.

title_en: Multi-source distributed power grid space-time information management method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multisource distributed power grid space-time information management method, which relates to the technical field of intelligent operation and maintenance of power systems and comprises the steps of converting power grid basic data into a power grid topological graph data structure; designing a general graph calculation function library as a basic calculation unit for constructing a power special graph calculation engine; collecting all-link multi-source heterogeneous power data, preprocessing, fusing and mapping the all-link multi-source heterogeneous power data into a unified power knowledge graph, and establishing indexes for space-time dimension data; based on a general graph calculation function library, performing graph analysis operation on graph data constructed in the power knowledge graph so as to support multidimensional graph data analysis; in the power knowledge graph, a graph calculation function library correlation algorithm is utilized, and the propagation path and causal link of the power grid fault event are tracked by combining the established space-time data index. The invention builds a unified power knowledge graph, fuses multi-source heterogeneous power data, and provides a knowledge, structuring and intelligent data base for power grid analysis decision-making.

title_en: Fan off-grid cascading failure risk assessment method and system based on neural network
abstract_en: A fan off-grid cascading failure risk assessment method based on a neural network comprises the following steps: constructing a simulation model of an alternating current power grid containing fans; acquiring stator side current simulation data and rotor side current simulation data of each fan under different states of an alternating current power grid through a simulation model, and acquiring training data according to the stator side current simulation data and the rotor side current simulation data of each fan; constructing a prediction model based on a BP neural network, and optimizing super parameters of the prediction model based on a DCS algorithm; predicting the stator side current of each fan in a future period of time through a prediction model; and calculating the off-grid risk index of each fan according to the prediction result, and evaluating the cascading failure risk of the alternating current power grid according to the off-grid risk index of each fan. The design can effectively evaluate the risk of disconnection and cascading failure of the fan in the alternating current power network containing the fan.
assignees: CENTRAL CHINA BRANCH STATE GRID CORP CHINA;UNIV WUHAN

title_en: Real-time monitoring and optimizing method and system for virtual power plant platform source network charge storage equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a real-time monitoring and optimizing method and system for virtual power plant platform source network charge storage equipment, which relate to the technical field of intelligent optimization scheduling of virtual power plants and comprise the steps of collecting equipment operation data, carrying out noise reduction and feature compression to obtain feature data, identifying equipment fault types based on the feature data, decoupling and reconstructing the feature data in time and space dimensions to obtain an equipment association matrix, constructing an equipment topological graph based on the equipment association matrix and trusted fault types, carrying out bidirectional tracking on the equipment topological graph according to fault diffusion probability to generate a fault propagation path, carrying out hierarchical sequencing on equipment on the fault propagation path, outputting a fault influence prediction result and an equipment priority list, and carrying out collaborative scheduling optimization on equipment in the virtual power plant by adopting a hierarchical reinforcement learning algorithm to realize collaborative scheduling optimization of the virtual power plant equipment.
assignees: JINGNENG YUANJING LINGJIN ZHIHUI BEIJING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Long tunnel remote automatic monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a long-and-large tunnel remote automatic monitoring method which comprises the following steps of S1, arranging sensors in and around a tunnel, S2, transmitting data acquired by the sensors, a camera and sound acquisition equipment to a remote monitoring center in real time through a remote data transmission system, S3, carrying out preprocessing on the data after the data are received by the remote monitoring center, constructing an intelligent data processing and analyzing model based on a neural network according to the preprocessed data, training and optimizing the network by utilizing a continuous counter-propagation algorithm and a random reinitialization technology, and evaluating the stability and safety of the tunnel by utilizing the intelligent data processing and analyzing model, S4, carrying out early warning and alarming, wherein when the monitored data exceed a preset threshold value, an automatic monitoring platform automatically triggers an early warning mechanism, and S5, carrying out emergency response and processing, and immediately starting an emergency pre-plan once the hidden danger or problem exists in the tunnel.
assignees: SICHUAN ZHIRUN SHUZHI TECH CO LTD;UNIV SOUTHWEST JIAOTONG;SICHUAN HIGHWAY PLANNING SURVEY DESIGN AND RES INSTITUTE LTD

title_en: Wheat pest remote monitoring and early warning method, device, equipment and medium based on intelligent agriculture
abstract_en: The application relates to a wheat pest remote monitoring and early warning method, device, equipment and medium based on intelligent agriculture. The method comprises the steps of generating a disease occurrence probability distribution map through collecting multisource environment data of a wheat field, combining real-time meteorological data, outputting a predictive disease space-time risk probability field through a disease propagation dynamics model, calculating information value evaluation scores of each node, generating an elastic scheduling strategy based on the information value evaluation scores, collecting new rounds of multisource environment data to optimize model parameters and replay a disease propagation dynamics model after the elastic scheduling strategy is executed, generating an updated disease space-time risk probability field, and generating early warning information of wheat diseases and insect pests by combining a preset early warning threshold value. By adopting the method, the intelligent interaction between the virtual model and the physical perception network can be realized, the problems of missed detection of the high-risk area and resource waste of the low-risk area in the traditional static sampling mode are effectively solved, and the accuracy and the high efficiency of monitoring the wheat diseases and insect pests are improved.

title_en: Recommendation engine for a cognitive reservoir system
abstract_en: Implementations described and claimed herein provide systems and methods for developing a reservoir. In one implementation, a reservoir model is received. The reservoir model includes a static model and a dynamic model. The static model includes one or more clusters of a three-dimensional volume of the reservoir and an uncertainty quantification generated using a neural network. The dynamic model includes pressure values and fluid saturation values propagated across the three-dimensional volume through a nodal connectivity of neighboring clusters. A set of input features is generated from the static model and the dynamic model. The set of input features is related to a drilling attractiveness of a target region of the reservoir using a set of rules executed by a fuzzy inference engine. A quantification of the drilling attractiveness is generated. A recommendation for drilling in the reservoir is output based on the quantification of the drilling attractiveness.

title_en: Distributed optimal scheduling method for multi-energy complementary micro-grid with multiple main bodies
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed optimal scheduling method for a multi-energy complementary micro-grid with multiple subjects based on an ADMM (adaptive differential mm) in the technical field of micro-grids of power systems. The ADMM-based framework allows the operator and the user to form an optimal interaction until equilibrium is reached. In the optimization iteration process, the operator and the user can complete the optimization scheduling only by exchanging the expected power supply amount and the heat supply amount with the actual power supply amount and the heat supply amount, so that the privacy of the operator and the user is greatly protected. The efficient energy cascade utilization of the cogeneration is combined with the heat storage system, the demand response of a user side and the power generation of renewable energy sources, so that the system has the advantages of saving energy, reducing emission, relieving the pressure of a power grid and the like; the indoor comfortable temperature is set, the comfort level of a user is considered, and the economical efficiency and the subjective intention of the user are comprehensively considered in cost. The invention provides an optimization method with lower cost and higher feasibility for the economic operation of the multi-energy complementary microgrid.

title_en: Interconnected power grid cascading failure risk assessment and alarm method considering communication vulnerability
abstract_en: The invention provides an interconnected power grid cascading failure risk assessment and alarm method considering communication fragility, aiming at the sending delay, the propagation delay, the queue delay and the link utilization rate of a communication link, respectively constructing a unified experience maximum value, and performing normalization processing, zero-removing processing and equal weight addition to obtain the fragility of the communication link with the same standard under different discontinuities; and constructing the vulnerability of the communication node by utilizing the performance vulnerability of the communication node based on the node degree, the topology vulnerability based on the service routing matrix and the service criticality. Considering communication fragility, establishing an outage probability model of each level of branch of the interconnected power grid; and defining the load loss amount, the voltage fluctuation degree, the average communication link utilization rate and the communication unobservable rate as the consequence indexes of the cascading failure path, carrying out sequencing evaluation on the cascading failure path, and giving out various alarms. According to the invention, the power risk assessment and the communication vulnerability are combined, so that the fault analysis and control of the interconnected power grid wide area measurement and control system are more comprehensive and reasonable.

title_en: Multi-dimensional grid service package gridding configuration and positioning synchronization method
