abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-dimensional grid service package gridding configuration and positioning synchronization method, which relates to the technical field of data processing, and comprises the steps of obtaining a plurality of grid service packages, collecting on-site multi-mode information, carrying out dynamic parameter configuration after determining an operation and maintenance scene, and establishing a plurality of gridding configuration spaces; the method comprises the steps of constructing a configuration evaluation module based on multidimensional evaluation factors, introducing propagation constraint functions, optimizing and optimizing a configuration space by combining the evaluation module, carrying out accurate parameter configuration on a power grid service package based on an optimizing result, and realizing positioning synchronization. The method solves the technical problems of lack of flexibility, insufficient equipment cooperation and slow response of the traditional power grid service package configuration method in the prior art when facing complex operation and maintenance scenes, and achieves the technical effects of improving the operation and maintenance efficiency, resource utilization and emergency response capability of the power grid through power grid service package configuration optimization based on multidimensional evaluation factors.

title_en: System and method for managing national disaster safety based on a blockchain
title_ko: 블록체인을 기반으로 한 국가 재난 관리 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and a method for national disaster management based on a block chain. The system for national disaster management includes a block chain network includes a plurality of nodes whose identities are verified, and context information for nodes participating in the block chain network is recorded in blocks of a block chain. Also, a node to provide disaster-related information generates a transaction including encoded data and an access tree, digitally signs the generated transaction by using a private key of the node, and then generates a block including the signed transaction to disseminate the block to the block chain network. The data are disaster-related data. The access tree is generated by using context information of nodes having an access right to a block including a corresponding transaction, and preferably has access right information for encoded data included in the corresponding transaction.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 블록체인을 기반으로 한 국가 재난 관리 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것이다. 상기 국가 재난 관리 시스템은, 신원이 증명된 다수 개의 노드들을 포함하여 구성된 블록체인 네트워크를 구비하고, 상기 블록체인 네트워크에 참여하는 노드들에 대한 컨텍스트 정보는 블록체인의 블록에 기록된 것을 특징으로 한다. 또한, 본 발명에 따라 재난 관련 정보를 제공하고자 하는 노드는 재난 번호, 암호화된 데이터 및 액세스 트리를 포함한 트랜잭션을 생성하고, 상기 생성된 트랜잭션을 자신의 개인키를 이용하여 디지털 서명한 후, 상기 서명된 트랜잭션을 포함하는 블록을 생성하여 블록체인 네트워크로 전파하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 상기 데이터는 재난 관련 데이터이며, 상기 액세스 트리는 해당 트랜잭션을 포함하는 블록에 대한 접근 권한을 갖는 노드들의 컨텍스트 정보들을 이용하여 생성된 것으로서, 해당 트랜잭션에 포함된 암호화된 데이터에 대한 접근 권한 정보를 갖는 것이 바람직하다.

title_en: Electric energy substitution extension system and method based on image recognition
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of, and the electric energy based on image recognition substitutes extension system and method, belongs to information popularization technical field.The deficiencies such as the present invention solves traditional publicity mode higher cost, real-time is poor, propagation efficiency is low, realize electric energy alternate resources interact, the building of the extension system of opening and shares.The present invention includes that electric energy substitution promotes Web platform, communication network transmission module and mobile terminal line module, pass through internet+plateform system application, combine equipment nameplate picture recognition, the information storage of planar bar code technology and NFC mark and information transmit advantage, construct collection equipment nameplate photo, the Common item device label of pattern in 2 D code and NFC label one, for the Rapid Popularization Method and kit for of electric energy substitute technology, effectively reduce promotion costs, avoid the wasting of resources and deficiency of the publicity of traditionally on paper plane, greatly improve propagation efficiency, it is capable of the real-time of effective guarantee promotional project information content simultaneously.

title_en: Lightning Strike Risk Evaluation method and device based on cascade emulation
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of Lightning Strike Risk Evaluation method and device based on cascade emulation.This method comprises: the three-dimensional electric field model and two-dimensional circuit model of building target area；It in the three-dimensional electric field mode input electromagnetic field simulation software, will obtain under predetermined lightning stroke energy, the magnetic distribution in three-dimensional electric field model；Transient pulse waveform is converted by the magnetic distribution；By in the two-dimensional circuit mode input circuit simulating software, using the transient pulse waveform as energy source, circuit response message is obtained；And Lightning Strike Risk Evaluation is carried out to the target area by the circuit response message.This disclosure relates to based on cascade emulation Lightning Strike Risk Evaluation method and device, can from multiple angles for lightning stroke analyze, improve distribution network reliability.
assignees: NINGBO HENGCHEN POWER CONSTRUCTION CO LTD;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG NINGBO CITY FENGHUA DISTR POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD NINGBO POWER SUPPLY CO

title_en: Ceiling earthquake damage identification method based on convolutional neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ceiling earthquake damage identification method based on a convolutional neural network, belongs to the field of computer vision, and aims to solve the problem that the efficiency of field earthquake damage degree investigation of professionals is low. The identification method comprises the following steps: firstly, normalizing the ceiling seismic damage picture; secondly, rotating and mirroring the target sample; loading a pre-trained AlexNet model, modifying the last full-connection layer of the model, and performing back propagation by adopting a cross entropy loss function and an Adam self-adaptive optimization function to obtain a primary training AlexNet model; fourthly, continuing to train the model, and adjusting the learning rate, the blocksize and the like of the neural network; and fifthly, evaluating the test sample by using the trained AlexNet model. The invention can accurately and quickly evaluate the use function of the earthquake-caused building in time only by using a certain hardware module and combining with the trained model, and the model has high accuracy.

title_en: RQD based on three-dimensional laser scanning and RQD inversiontOptimal threshold t solving method
abstract_en: RQD based on three-dimensional laser scanning and RQD inversion t The optimal threshold t solving method belongs to RQD t The optimal threshold value t solving field comprises the following steps: (1) three-dimensional laser scanning of the structural surface is rapidly acquired; (2) drawing a structural plane polar diagram and a trend rose diagram; (3) rock mass calculation based on RQD indexes; (4) generating and sectioning a rock three-dimensional fracture network model; (5) RQD t Drawing an anisotropy map; (6) and solving the optimal threshold t based on RQD inversion. The invention combines three-dimensional laser scanning, a neighbor propagation algorithm, an RQD theory, a fracture network model, a generalized RQD theory and inversion calculation to realize RQD t The optimal threshold value t is solved, and the method is put forwardRQD based on three-dimensional laser scanning and RQD inversion t And solving the optimal threshold t. The method is clear, the obtained threshold t can reflect the real rock mass quality and is suitable for the rock mass RQD t The optimal threshold value t of (a) is solved.

title_en: Power grid cascading failure element failure probability evaluation method and system under fire disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for evaluating the failure probability of a power grid cascading failure element under fire disaster, which take power flow transfer, state defects of components of the cascading failure element at the current stage and the rejection of the cascading failure element at the previous stage caused by the high-resistance state of a fire point into account, calculate the failure probability of the cascading failure element, and are more accurate compared with the traditional method.
assignees: NARI TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;State grid hunan electric power co ltd;STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;NARI GROUP CORP

title_en: Pumped storage and cascade hydropower joint scheduling method based on virtual power plant
abstract_en: The invention provides a pumped storage and step hydropower joint scheduling method based on a virtual power plant. Acquiring pumping data of a plurality of distributed pumped storage power stations and storage capacity data of an upper warehouse and a lower warehouse, and confirming unit parameters of a virtual pumped storage unit in a virtual power station; acquiring power generation data and upstream and downstream water level data of each stage of power stations in the step power plant, and confirming unit parameters of a virtual step hydroelectric unit in the virtual power plant; responding to a power grid load instruction, and confirming load scheduling schemes of the virtual pumped storage unit and the virtual step hydroelectric unit based on unit parameters of the virtual pumped storage unit and the virtual step hydroelectric unit; the load scheduling scheme comprises a pumping instruction of the virtual pumped storage unit and a load scheduling instruction of the virtual step hydroelectric unit. The invention solves the technical problems of large management difficulty and poor effect caused by the scheduling management of the river basin step power plant and the pumped storage respectively in the prior art.
assignees: HUBEI QINGJIANG HYDROELECTRIC DEV CO LTD

title_en: Quantitative evaluation method, device, terminal and medium for overhead transmission line channel safety
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quantitative evaluation method, a quantitative evaluation device, a terminal and a medium for the safety of an overhead transmission line channel, wherein the method comprises the following steps of establishing a three-layer physical system model of the overhead transmission line channel; the method comprises the steps of carrying out system failure analysis based on a three-layer secondary physical system model of an overhead transmission line channel, establishing an overall failure model of the overhead transmission line channel, establishing an overhead transmission line channel safety evaluation model based on the overall failure analysis model of the overhead transmission line channel, and carrying out quantitative evaluation on the safety of the overhead transmission line channel to be evaluated by utilizing the overhead transmission line channel safety evaluation model. The invention considers the influence of failure damage of different elements and cascade failure of a plurality of lines in the overhead transmission channel on the safe and stable operation of the whole channel, and can accurately evaluate the safety degree of the overhead transmission channel, thereby providing more reliable scientific basis and technical support for the safe operation and maintenance management of the power grid.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;UNIV CHONGQING;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Substation monitoring method and system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention provides a transformer substation monitoring method and system based on the Internet of things, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining an original electromagnetic disturbance signal of a transformer substation, constructing an electromagnetic disturbance feature matrix, adopting a self-adaptive attention mechanism to combine asymmetric abnormal detection loss to detect the abnormality of the electromagnetic disturbance signal, inputting a time sequence input vector into a fault classification model to identify fault types, outputting fault type labels and severity, calculating fault propagation paths of the fault type labels and severity to obtain fault propagation paths, simulating fault evolution through a digital twin model, predicting fault development trend, secondary fault influence range and future state vectors, and finally generating maintenance priority, a time window and a resource scheduling scheme. The invention breaks through the limitation of the traditional monitoring technology, improves the intelligent level of the transformer substation, reduces the maintenance cost and improves the safety and reliability of the operation of the power grid.

title_en: Risk knowledge graph construction and intelligent early warning method based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses an artificial intelligence-based risk knowledge graph construction and intelligent early warning method which comprises the following steps of collecting multisource risk related data and preprocessing the multisource risk related data to generate a composite input data set, constructing an enhanced TabPFN structure and introducing a risk logic rule constraint matrix to generate a risk prediction result set, mapping the risk prediction result set to a knowledge graph entity node and a relationship set to generate a risk knowledge graph structure, introducing Sheaf Neural Networks into the risk knowledge graph structure to generate a consistency parameter set, updating the knowledge graph structure to generate a risk knowledge graph enhanced representation, and executing reasoning by combining the risk prediction result set and the consistency parameter set to output an intelligent early warning result set. According to the invention, the form data modeling and graph consistency propagation are fused, so that the risk prediction accuracy and the early warning reliability are improved.
assignees: HANSHU ENGINE ZHEJIANG SAFETY TECH SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Coal mine fluidization exploitation dynamic disaster prevention and control method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for preventing and controlling dynamic disasters in coal mine fluidization exploitation, and relates to the technical field of disaster prevention and control. The method comprises the steps of establishing a risk map based on multi-field information of a mining area, setting a focus intensity upper limit, a path attenuation target and an energy absorption displacement target, performing in-situ transformation under control index constraint to form a distributed microcrack network, calculating a residual dynamic carrier spectrum to weaken the focus, constructing an artificial barrier and an energy absorption band with abrupt wave impedance change according to the residual dynamic carrier spectrum to realize propagation energy cutting, configuring a flexible energy absorption protection system according to the residual dynamic carrier spectrum and a propagation attenuation coefficient, monitoring microseismic, stress and displacement data in real time, and realizing parameter self-adaptive correction through threshold triggered linkage treatment. The method constructs a source-diameter-field integrated active prevention and control system, realizes dynamic regulation and closed-loop management of the fluidized mining process, and obviously improves the intrinsic safety and the intelligent level of deep mining.

title_en: Networking method and device based on cloud platform, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of networking based on a cloud platform, and discloses a networking method, a networking device, electronic equipment and a storage medium based on the cloud platform, wherein the networking method comprises the following steps: the cloud authorization and the automatic networking between the terminals realize the minute-level automatic disaster recovery under the physical link fault, change the situation of long-time service interruption caused by relying on manual maintenance, and realize the automatic networking. The application has the beneficial effects that the safe resource sharing across the user equipment is innovatively realized under the centralized management and control of operators, the inherent defects of the traditional ad hoc network scheme in the aspects of authentication, charging and safety are overcome by utilizing the dynamic security token and the encryption tunnel technology, meanwhile, the compliance and the controllability of the operators' network are ensured, the whole process is completely transparent to the users, no manual configuration is needed, and the seamless switching service experience is provided while the efficient operation and maintenance are realized.
assignees: SHENZHEN TONGKANG CHUANGZHI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Automatic heat dissipation system of high-low voltage distribution room based on neural fuzzy control
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power distribution room heat dissipation, in particular to a high-low voltage power distribution room automatic heat dissipation system based on nerve fuzzy control, which comprises a model construction module, a power distribution room data processing module and a power distribution room data processing module, wherein the model construction module is used for acquiring power distribution room data to construct a simulation model, and the power distribution room data comprise equipment load parameters and environment parameters; the system comprises a simulation module, a correlation prediction module, a heat dissipation control module and a heat dissipation control module, wherein the simulation module is used for acquiring environmental parameters of corresponding monitoring points in a power distribution room and equipment load parameters in real time to determine target pheromones, and correlating a plurality of target pheromones based on a single monitoring point with corresponding propagation space to obtain a correlation network.
assignees: JINING LUXING ELECTRIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Soft rock tunnel large deformation prediction method based on particle swarm optimization neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of tunnel engineering disaster prediction, and discloses a soft rock tunnel large deformation prediction method based on a particle swarm optimization neural network, which comprises the steps of selecting geological construction characteristic parameters such as surrounding rock water content, construction method and the like as input factors, and establishing qualitative index and quantitative numerical mapping; the method comprises the steps of constructing an engineering sample data set based on orthogonal test design and numerical simulation, carrying out normalization processing, carrying out global iterative optimization on initial connection weight and bias of an error back propagation neural network by utilizing a particle swarm optimization algorithm, obtaining an optimal initial value by taking a network error as an fitness value, finally inputting data training to generate a mature model, outputting a predicted deformation value and carrying out engineering early warning by combining a double verification mechanism. The method solves the problems of slow convergence and easy sinking into local optimum caused by random initialization of parameters of the traditional neural network, and effectively improves the prediction precision of the large deformation of the soft rock tunnel and the reliability of engineering early warning.
assignees: CHINA CONSTR 8TH ENG DIVISION;CHINA CONSTR CIVIL ENG CO LTD

title_en: Multi-dimensional visualization method, system, equipment and medium for electric carbon flow
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric carbon flow multidimensional visualization method, an electric carbon flow multidimensional visualization system, electric carbon flow multidimensional visualization equipment and an electric carbon flow multidimensional visualization medium, and relates to the technical field of energy information visualization. And calculating the flow direction difference between the node injection power and the node delivery power, and generating a path offset migration characteristic quantity. And comparing the phasor direction sequences of the adjacent nodes to obtain path replacement aggregate mapping data. And calculating the difference of the adjacent powers of the nodes, generating gradient turning density information, evaluating the abnormal response characteristics of the nodes in the carbon propagation diagram, and identifying and judging the abnormal behavior type. The invention realizes the real-time response and dynamic optimization of the electric carbon distribution along with the load fluctuation. The dynamic propagation path and space aggregation relation of the carbon flow in the power grid is presented through path migration correction and structural rearrangement, the gradient turning density extraction technology is utilized to carry out multi-scale structural analysis on power time sequence change, and finally the type of abnormal behavior is identified and judged.

title_en: A method to simulate continuous wave lidar sensors
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for simulating sensor data of a continuous wave, CW, Light Detection and Ranging, lidar, sensor, comprising the steps: generating a ray set comprising at least one ray, based on a CW signal 51, each ray in the ray set having an emission starting time (t_0) and an emission duration (T); propagating, for each ray in the ray set, the ray through a simulated scene comprising at least one object; computing, for each ray in the ray set, a signal contribution 71 of the propagated ray at a detection location in the simulated scene; generating an output signal 73, based on mixing the CW signal 51 with the computed signal contributions of the rays in the ray set; and at least one of storing and outputting the output signal. The invention provides simulation data corresponding to full-waveform signals of CW lidar sensors. The provided sensor data also allows to determine additional information, such as object shapes and object classes, and object orientation. Moreover, the sensor data also comprises artifacts which are present in real lidar data, which originate from physical properties of the lidar sensor and the environment and are absent in point-clouds- type data, such as multiple reflections of the lidar beam. Therefore, sensor development can be improved by also taking said artifacts into account. The invention accurately simulates how a real CW lidar sensor works and therefore accurately recreates the output of a real CW lidar sensor. The provided high-quality data, which is both complete and accurate to the real world, can also be of high value for developing signal processing algorithms, training neural networks, virtual validation, and the like.
assignees: SIEMENS IND SOFTWARE NETHERLANDS B V

title_en: Earthquake determination system and seismic analysis method
abstract_en: Provided are an earthquake determination system and a seismic analysis method which determine the occurrence of earthquakes at early stages and in an accurate manner. A plurality of observation terminal devices and seismic analysis processing devices installed in random areas in a dispersed manner are connected together by a communications network. When detection of seismic P waves is estimated from seismic waveform information outputted by seismographs, then information regarding estimated detection of seismic P waves is transmitted by a plurality of observation terminal devices. The consequent operation performed by seismic analysis processing devices is as follows: When the aforementioned information regarding estimated detection of seismic P waves is received from the aforementioned plurality of observation terminal devices, then with respect to at least two pairs of observation terminal devices, each pair being a combination, the following quantities are obtained from the information regarding detection times of estimated seismic P waves and from the installation information, both pieces of information being included in that information regarding estimated detection of seismic P waves which is transmitted from each pair of observation terminal devices: the distance between observation terminal devices, D; and the detection time difference therebetween, d. The consequent operation performed by each pair of observation terminal devices of the two pairs, each pair being a combination, is as follows: When the following relational expressions are satisfied, it is determined that an earthquake occurred: 2DSL P + ?t, where DSL is the local vibrational energy transfer limit distance, SP is the minimum propagation velocity of seismic P waves, and ?t is the maximum detection error between detection times measured by a pair of observation terminal devices.

title_en: Critical infrastructure protection blueprints generation and utilization in an interdependent critical infrastructure architecture
abstract_en: Critical infrastructure (CI) protection blueprint generation in an interdependent CI architecture includes constructing a digital twin of a heterogeneous collection of CI elements associated with respectively different services provided to a common community. Thereafter, hypothetical sensor data is specified in the digital twin for a target CI element in the hierarchy. In response, sensor data is read for other CI elements dependent upon the target CI element so as to identify impacted CI elements. For each impacted CI element, additional sensor data is read for further CI elements in the hierarchy dependent upon the impacted CI elements and the process repeats until no additional impacted CI elements are identified. A listing of all impacted CI elements is written to a blueprint for the hierarchy in association with the hypothetical sensor data in order to define a cascading effect of the hypothetical sensor data upon the hierarchy within the digital twin.

title_en: A kind of power network key branch road recognition methods based on coupling branch road betweenness
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of power network key branch road recognition methods based on coupling branch road betweenness, comprises the following steps：Establish side right connection matrix, Branch Power Flow weight matrix, node branch road interconnection vector and node reactance matrix；Disconnected branches L ij If grid disconnection, by branch road L ij It is included in the first crucial branch road subset；If the non-off-the-line of power network, by branch road L ij It is included in alternative collection；Coupling branch road betweenness is calculated, and branch road is ranked up, 0.5 branch road is more than for coupling branch road betweenness, is included in the second crucial branch road subset；Obtain power network key branch road collection.The present invention asks for shortest path using Floyd algorithms, and has asked for transmission direction, better than conventional method；It is comprehensive assessment index to couple branch road betweenness, has both considered the absolute size of active power, it is also contemplated that the relative value of power margin, and front and back stages failure is combined, acquired results more conform to power network actual conditions；Coupling branch road betweenness can fully reflect the critical impact of branch road in cascading failure landslide evolution process.

title_en: Analysis method and system for forest fire cascading failure risk of power transmission line of power grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for analyzing the risk of mountain fire cascading failures of a power transmission line of a power grid, wherein the method comprises the following steps: establishing a virtual topology of a power transmission line of a power grid according to a power transmission line database and a map database of the power grid; determining a power flow limit value of each power transmission line according to the heat capacity limit of each power transmission line, and establishing a corresponding relation between power flow and load on each power transmission line; the mountain fire tripping probability of each power transmission line is calculated, and after the corresponding power transmission line is tripped, the power transmission line tripping probability is calculated: when the power flow of the tripped power transmission line is transferred to other power transmission lines, and the power flow of the other power transmission lines does not exceed the power flow limit value, the load to be cut off is required; and combining the mountain fire tripping probability of each power transmission line and the total load shedding amount of the power grid to serve as a risk evaluation index of the mountain fire cascading failure of the power transmission line of the power grid. The invention can predict the risk of each power transmission line on the power grid caused by cascading failure due to mountain fire.

title_en: Active disturbance rejection control system for static optimization of central air-conditioning refrigeration station
abstract_en: The invention discloses an active disturbance rejection control system for static optimization of a central air-conditioning refrigeration station, wherein an air-conditioning load prediction unit is used for predicting load through a BP (back propagation) neural network; the central air-conditioning refrigeration station model calculation unit is used for executing one of a single model modeling mode and a multi-model fusion modeling mode; the system working point optimization unit is used for calculating the optimal working point of the system by using an optimization algorithm; and the central control refrigeration station control unit is used for tracking control by adopting an active disturbance rejection controller. The invention also discloses an active disturbance rejection control method for the static optimization of the central air-conditioning refrigeration station. The system and the method determine the optimal working point of the system closest to the actual value by accurately establishing a static model and predicting the cold load, and adopt the active disturbance rejection controller to carry out tracking control on the optimal working point of the system, thereby realizing the optimization and energy conservation of the central air-conditioning refrigeration station.

title_en: Power system scheduling method based on cascading failure prevention
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system dispatching method based on cascading failure prevention, which comprises the following steps of (1) establishing a power system cascading failure model through direct current flow calculation according to power system topology, related line parameters and constraints, (2) calculating line parameters showing cascading failure correlation in a power system according to cascading failure accident chain data and establishing corresponding power system operation constraints, (3) ensuring power quality and power safety according to power grid line and load data, establishing a dispatching method model meeting all load consumption by using the lowest power generation cost or fuel consumption, and (4) obtaining a power system safe operation optimization strategy by taking the lowest power generation cost and load shedding cost of a power generator as optimization targets. The invention can optimize the operation of the power system with the aim of cascading failure prevention, improves the toughness of the power system and improves the safety of the power system while considering the economy of the power system.

title_en: Fault alarm method and device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a fault alarm method, a fault alarm device and electronic equipment. According to the method, network fault information is sent to a plurality of public land mobile network PLMNs through a network detection end, the PLMNs forward the network fault information to a shared base station, and then when the shared base station detects that the network fault information forwarded by the faulty PLMNs is not received, the terminal corresponding to the faulty PLMNs cannot know that the faulty PLMNs enter disaster conditions, so that the network fault information is broadcast to the terminals corresponding to the faulty PLMNs, the problem of communication service can be rapidly identified by the terminals, the network service interruption time of the terminals is reduced, and the user experience is improved.

title_en: MILP method for multi-objective scheduling of cascade hydropower station with peak regulation and navigation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of hydroelectric dispatching and power grid operation, and discloses an MILP method for multi-objective dispatching of a cascade hydropower station, which takes peak regulation and navigation into consideration. The contradiction between the peak regulation of the power grid and the navigation requirements of the river channel is a prominent problem faced by the step scheduling of the hydropower navigation, and the jacking effect of interval backwater exacerbates the complexity of the problem. According to the invention, an MILP model of a cascade hydropower station group short-term multi-objective optimization scheduling considering backwater influence is established, the minimum residual load average distance and the minimum downstream tail water level average distance are taken as targets in the model, nonlinear constraint is aggregated through a function, constraint linearization is realized by utilizing a hexahedral rasterization technology and an SOS2 constraint method, and finally, a NBI method is applied to solve, so that a Pareto solution set of a multi-objective problem is obtained. The method can fully consider the influence of backwater jacking, gives consideration to peak regulation and navigation requirements, solves the multi-objective scheduling problem efficiently and obtains ideal results, and is a practical and effective method.

title_en: System for controlling the operation of wireless multicasting systems to distribute an alarm indication to a dynamically configured coverage area
abstract_en: The present Reverse 911 Alarm System implements a central alarm distribution site that is capable of generating an alarm indication to warn individuals of a hazard and propagating the alarm indication to selected individuals via their wireless subscriber devices by the use of wireless multicasting in the existing cellular communication network and/or wireless-based Local Area Networks which are operational in the coverage area of the hazard. The central alarm distribution site dynamically selects the wireless coverage area to encompass the present extent of the hazard and can also provide advanced warning to individuals located in an area that extends beyond the present hazard extent area. The present Reverse 911 Alarm System thereby integrates the operation of the wireless communication network with the 911 and Reverse 911 services to provide efficient and comprehensive distribution of alarm indications to the individuals who are impacted by an emergency situation.
assignees: MCKENNA DANIEL BERNARD;GRAZIANO JAMES MICHAEL;LAVA THREE LLC

title_en: A kind of social networks degree of belief calculation method based on evidence theory
abstract_en: A kind of social networks degree of belief calculation method based on evidence theory, including A1,60~90% are chosen from all users as training users and being trained；Training user is investigated in A2, training process when making trust decisions to the preference of attribute；A3, several first interval numbers are generated by preference of all training users to attribute；A4, second interval number is converted by the attribute of user to be assessed；A5, it is generated by first interval number and second interval number and trusts evidence；B1, the risk probability for refusing combination family is leaked by connection relationship calculating user's Content of Communication between user；B2, risk evidence is generated by risk probability；C1, the degree of belief between user is obtained to trust evidence and risk evidence progress evidence fusion.The present invention has comprehensively considered user when making trust decisions to the degree of concern for being evaluated each dimension social attribute of user and to two factors of worry of propagation path privacy compromise risk, and the result of trust decisions is made accurately to agree with the trust psychology demand of user.

title_en: Malignant data injection attack defense method based on multi-stage dynamic game
abstract_en: The invention provides a malignant data injection attack defense method based on a multi-stage dynamic game, and relates to the technical field of power information physical systems. The method comprises the steps that firstly, a game process is regarded as a double game in which an attacking party and a defending party participate, and one action of the attacking party and the defending party is regarded as a stage of the attacking and defending game process; calculating node centrality to represent the importance of different nodes of the power grid, taking the node centrality as a weight vector, and calculating the optimal load reduction amount of the power grid as the income of both attacking and defending parties; then calculating the seepage propagation probability of the malignant data propagated among the power grid nodes, and establishing a multi-stage attack and defense game model; finally, based on an improved Q learning algorithm, different learning rates are introduced into each game stage, maximum profit calculation formulas of the attacking and defending parties are redefined, Nash equilibrium solution of each game stage is solved, whether the total stage gamma of the attacking and defending game estimation is reached is judged, and if the total stage gamma of the attacking and defending game estimation is reached, an optimal defense strategy is obtained; otherwise, the next stage of attack and defense game is carried out.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;UNIV NORTHEASTERN

title_en: Water-wind-fire short-term optimization scheduling method considering wind-electricity uncertainty
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water-wind-fire short-term optimization scheduling method considering wind-power uncertainty, which constructs a multi-objective optimization scheduling model with the maximum clean energy utilization rate and the minimum thermal power unit output fluctuation on the basis of meeting water-wind-fire constraints, and the model utilizes the advantages of flexible start and stop of cascade hydropower, high climbing speed and the like to stabilize wind-power output fluctuation. Because the cascade hydropower, wind power and thermal power combined optimization scheduling problem is a highly complex mixed integer nonlinear programming problem, the overall solving difficulty is high. The method is based on a layered solving idea, the model is decomposed into a wind power dispatching layer, a hydroelectric dispatching layer and a thermal power dispatching layer, the layers are associated with each other by means of surplus loads, a solving framework integrating a neural network, interval estimation and an improved genetic algorithm with a heuristic algorithm is provided, and the model is rapidly solved.

title_en: Wind power prediction method based on combination of transfer learning and deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind power prediction method based on combination of transfer learning and deep learning, which comprises the steps of extracting historical samples of a newly-built wind power plant and peripheral wind power plants through an SCADA (supervisory control and data acquisition) system and numerical weather forecast, training BP-NN (back propagation-neural network) by using a small amount of historical samples of the newly-built wind power plants, predicting a large amount of historical samples of the peripheral wind power plants, and calculating a correlation coefficient of each historical sample of the peripheral wind power plants according to a prediction result; according to the correlation coefficient, a large number of historical samples of the peripheral wind power plant are taken as strong correlation samples, medium correlation samples and weak correlation samples; respectively using three model migration methods of sequential migration, reverse order migration, unordered migration and the like to construct a prediction model for a newly-built wind power plant and respectively giving prediction results; and finally, integrating the three prediction results by using a B-LSTM network, and outputting a final prediction result. According to the method, a prediction model suitable for a newly-built wind power plant is obtained by data mining and combining a deep learning algorithm and utilizing multi-level model migration, the prediction precision of the newly-built wind power plant is improved, and the method has popularization value.
assignees: UNIV HUAZHONG SCIENCE TECH;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Rumor propagation model establishment method with anti-rumor mechanism based on social network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rumor propagation models, and discloses a rumor propagation model establishing method with an inverse rumor mechanism based on a social network, which comprises the following steps: s1: establishing a rumor propagation model with a reverse rumor mechanism; s2: simplifying the rumor propagation model to obtain a simplified rumor propagation model; s3: obtaining the basic regeneration number of the simplified rumor propagation model; s4: analyzing the relation between the local stable condition of the boundary balance and the basic regeneration number; s5: global stability was demonstrated without rumor balance points; the S1 includes: s11: constructing an SDICR rumor propagation model with a guide extreme value, and dividing propagation nodes into an unknown person S, a hesitant person D and a propagator I. The rumor propagation model establishment method based on the social network with the anti-rumor mechanism has the advantages that the rumor propagation system rumor dissipates the balance point global stability, and therefore the model can be used as a target model for analyzing the rumors.

title_en: Robustness assessment method for electric heating comprehensive energy system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a robustness assessment method of an electric heating comprehensive energy system, and belongs to the field of energy systems. The method comprises the following steps: establishing a dynamic model according to system topology information, comprehensive tide characteristics and a cascading failure mechanism, wherein the model is based on an energy flow analysis method, and reflects an actual operation mechanism of an electrothermal comprehensive energy system by referring to a complex network theory; improving the existing complex network index, providing a new key link identification index, and quantifying the structural and functional characteristics of the system through a robustness evaluation index; and simulating the attack possibly suffered by the system, and simulating the dynamic process of the analysis system under the cascading failure according to the provided robustness assessment method to obtain a robustness conclusion. The invention comprehensively considers the structure and physical characteristics of the system and provides powerful support for improving the safe and stable operation capability of the electric heating comprehensive energy system.

title_en: Cascading failure analysis method, device and equipment for power system and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a cascading failure analysis method, a cascading failure analysis device, cascading failure analysis equipment and a readable storage medium of a power system. According to the method and the device, abstract modeling can be performed on each network node information of the power information physical system, the characteristic that the power information network and the power physical network are coupled with each other is considered, the propagation characteristic of the cascading failures in the respective networks and among the networks and the characteristics can be simulated macroscopically, and higher operation efficiency is guaranteed, so that simulation of the power information physical system and research and analysis of the power grid cascading failures are more efficient and accurate.

title_en: Cluster division-based power distribution network hybrid energy storage site selection method and terminal
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hybrid energy storage location method and a terminal of a power distribution network based on cluster division, which take the cluster of the power distribution network as a unit, calculate the key index of a node by adopting a power flow tracking algorithm, determine the topological characteristic coefficient of the node, determine the power flow direction coefficient of the node according to the branches of the node and the access point of distributed renewable energy power generation, determine the power flow propagation index of the node according to the key index, the topological characteristic coefficient and the power flow direction coefficient of the node, calculate the comprehensive electrical distance between the nodes based on a jacobian matrix, and determine the access position of hybrid energy storage based on the comprehensive electrical distance between the power flow propagation index of the node and the node, thereby determining the access position of hybrid energy storage from the two aspects of sensitivity and electrical connection tightness of the node to the distributed renewable energy power generation fluctuation, and being more reliable and accurate, thereby realizing the hybrid energy storage location more simply and effectively.
assignees: ECONOMIC RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Online generation method of operation strategy of electric hydrogen energy system based on unsupervised learning
abstract_en: The application is suitable for the technical field of power-natural gas network collaborative optimization, and provides an online generation method of an electric hydrogen energy system operation strategy based on unsupervised learning, which comprises the following steps: acquiring network structures, operation coefficients and historical scene state data of a power grid and an air grid in an electric-hydrogen-air hybrid integrated energy system, establishing an electric-hydrogen-air hybrid integrated energy system operation model taking the lowest total cost of the system as an objective function according to the data, establishing an unsupervised learning neural network based on a Transformer, constructing a physical mapping layer corresponding to the constraint of the operation model, constructing an unsupervised learning training model in cooperation with the back propagation of a loss function, acquiring real-time scene state data, applying the unsupervised learning training model to the system, and generating an operation strategy. The application can rapidly and stably realize the on-line generation of the system operation strategy on the premise of lower constraint violation degree, and ensures the cooperative coupling operation of the electric power-hydrogen-doped natural gas network.

title_en: Gradient reservoir optimal scheduling system and method based on graphic neural network and reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascade reservoir optimal scheduling system and a cascade reservoir optimal scheduling method based on a graph neural network and reinforcement learning, which overcome the limitation of the traditional algorithm by constructing a cascade reservoir optimal scheduling model based on the graph neural network and reinforcement learning. Specifically, a graph neural network architecture is adopted, a local relation between reservoirs is extracted by using a message passing neural network MPNN, a global relation is captured through a self-attention mechanism of a transducer encoder, so that a complex space-time dependency relation between cascade reservoirs is comprehensively modeled, in addition, a PPO reinforcement learning model is combined, a scheduling strategy can be autonomously learned in a dynamic environment, and a global optimal solution is gradually approximated. Compared with the traditional method, the method has remarkable advantages in calculation efficiency, global optimality and capability of adapting to complex scheduling scenes, and provides an innovative solution for solving the problem of optimal scheduling of the cascade reservoir.

title_en: Real-time earthquake motion numerical prediction method fusing fracture directivity effect
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of real-time earthquake disaster early warning of earthquake engineering, in particular to a real-time earthquake motion numerical prediction method fusing fracture directivity effect, which carries out filtering and baseline correction on a real-time observation strong vibration waveform of an earthquake table network, corrects the ground earthquake motion waveform to a bedrock site by using an empirical site effect correction model, then converts the corrected acceleration record into energy parameters, and generating a meshed bedrock seismic energy field through Kerling space interpolation, simulating a seismic energy space-time propagation process based on an RTT model by utilizing a Monte Carlo method, and obtaining a predicted seismic energy field with a plurality of time steps.
assignees: INST ENG MECH CHINA EARTHQUAKE ADMINISTRATION

title_en: Power grid line vulnerability identification method, system, medium and equipment considering cascading failure
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention relates to the technical field of power systems and discloses a method, a system, a medium and equipment for identifying vulnerability of a power grid line in consideration of cascading failures, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring data information in a power system and numbering the power grid line in sequence, and determining a cascading failure triggering criterion, a cascading failure propagation criterion and a cascading failure ending criterion according to the data information; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a fault chain set by using a cascading failure triggering criterion, a cascading failure propagation criterion and a cascading failure ending criterion, traversing the fault chain set, determining the average load loss of a system according to the weight and the load power loss of all fault chains comprising the current power grid line, determining the vulnerability index of the power grid line according to the average load loss, and sequencing the power grid lines according to the vulnerability index of each power grid line to identify high vulnerability lines, so that the vulnerability links of the power grid can be more accurately revealed, thereby effectively preventing large-scale power failure accidents and guaranteeing the safety of a power system.
assignees: YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Water-light-storage collaborative optimization scheduling method and system based on A3C multi-agent parallel mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water-light storage collaborative optimization scheduling method and system based on an A3C multi-agent parallel mechanism, which comprises the steps of constructing a water-light storage collaborative optimization scheduling system operation scene of 'perception-network-application' three layers, constructing a cascade hydropower station group joint scheduling model by taking hydropower station water balance constraint, upstream and downstream hydraulic connection, water level limitation, power generation flow limitation, hydropower station output constraint and channel constraint as constraint conditions, constructing a water-light storage daily dynamic output distribution model by taking the maximum total rewarding value of the water-light storage optimization scheduling system as an objective function, simulating the operation scene and coupling relation of water, light and a power storage station, converting the water-light storage optimization scheduling problem into a Markov process, and realizing efficient exploration and learning of strategies by an A3C algorithm to obtain the optimal scheduling method of the water-light storage optimization scheduling system. The invention can obviously promote the power consumption of the water-light storage optimizing and dispatching system, reduce the phenomena of water and light rejection and ensure the power supply in Xinjiang.
assignees: XINJIANG XINHUA YEERQIANG RIVER BASIN WATER RESOURCES AND HYDROPOWER DEV CO LTD;UNIV HOHAI;NANJING NARI WATER CONSERVANCY AND HYDROPOWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network multisource risk intelligent early warning method based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The application relates to an intelligent power distribution network multi-source risk early warning method based on artificial intelligence, in particular to an intelligent power distribution network multi-source risk early warning method based on artificial intelligence, which aims to solve the problems of low power distribution network risk early warning accuracy, high false alarm rate and difficult prospective pre-judgment in the prior art. The method comprises the steps of collecting multi-source heterogeneous data such as weather, equipment states, loads and topology and constructing a fusion matrix of unified space-time references, extracting key risk features through principal component analysis and self-encoder joint dimension reduction, constructing a dynamic risk evolution model by using a gate control circulation unit neural network to predict risk probability distribution of 15 minutes to 2 hours in the future, combining a graph convolution network with an improved Dijkstra algorithm to deduce a risk space-time propagation path, and realizing five-level risk level judgment by adopting fuzzy comprehensive evaluation and automatically releasing grading early warning information.
assignees: BEIJING ZHONGHANG RUOYI ELECTROMECHANICAL ENG CO LTD

title_en: Space-time associated transformer area voltage risk event identification method, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, equipment and medium for identifying a voltage risk event of a space-time associated transformer area, which are characterized in that a voltage risk space-time cube covering a future preset period is constructed for each dynamic cluster, the space-time cube forms a three-dimensional data structure by two-dimensional space and one-dimensional time, voltage distribution of each node in the cluster in the future period is obtained through time sequence trend calculation, voltage values are quantized into risk indexes by adopting a continuous risk scoring function to form a visualized risk space-time distribution pattern, a 3D convolutional neural network is adopted to carry out deep processing on the space-time cube, a space-time speckle pattern of low voltage risk is extracted, propagation and evolution characteristics of risks in space-time dimension are effectively captured, the space-time speckle pattern is divided into independent risk events through multidimensional connected domain analysis, characteristic parameters such as space-time boundary, risk intensity and the like are marked for each event, data authenticity of a risk identification process is ensured, risk capturing capacity is improved, and overall risk identification efficiency and accuracy are improved.
assignees: ZHUMADIAN POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Disaster guidance system using digital information display and the method thereat
title_ko: 디지털정보디스플레이를 이용한 재해안내 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster guidance system using a digital information display and a method thereof, wherein a digital information display device calculates an evacuation route by position information having surrounding topographic information and facilities information and displays the calculated information thereon to propagate a situation when receiving disaster occurrence information. The disaster guidance system using the digital information display comprises: a communication unit configured to transmit and receive the disaster occurrence information; a central processing unit configured to calculate the evacuation route by the disaster occurrence information received from the communication unit, the surrounding topographic information, and the facilities information; the digital information display device configured to display the evacuation route calculated from the central processing unit. According to the disaster guidance system and the method thereof, the digital information display not only can perform a simple information display function, but also can evacuate users more safely and rapidly to reduce risks by propagating the disaster occurrence information and the evacuation route in case of disaster.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 디지털정보디스플레이 장치가 재해 발생 정보를 수신하면 주변 지형정보 및 시설정보가 포함된 위치정보로 대피경로를 산출하고, 이 산출된 정보를 디지털정보디스플레이 장치에 표시하고, 상황을 전파하는 디지털정보디스플레이를 이용한 재해 안내 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따른 디지털정보디스플레이를 이용한 재해안내 시스템은 재해 발생 정보를 송수신하기 위한 통신부; 상기 통신부로 부터 수신된 재해 정보와 주변 지형 및 시설 정보에 의해 대피 경로를 산출하는 중앙처리 장치;상기 중앙처리장치로 부터 산출된 대피 경로를 표시하는 디지털정보디스플레이장치;를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
본 발명에 따른 디지털정보디스플레이를 이용한 재해안내 시스템 및 방법에 따르면 디지털정보디스플레이가 단순히 정보 표시 기능만 하는 것이 아닌 재해 발생 시 재해 발생 정보 및 대피 경로를 전파를 통해 보다 안전하고 신속하게 이용자를 대피시켜 위험을 줄일 수 있게 하는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Peak regulation optimization scheduling method for cascaded hydro-photovoltaic complementary power generation system
abstract_en: Disclosed in the present invention is a peak regulation optimization scheduling method for a cascaded hydro-photovoltaic complementary power generation system. The method comprises: establishing an objective function for peak regulation optimization scheduling of a cascaded hydro-photovoltaic complementary power generation system, the objective function involving taking the minimization of the maximum value of the residual load of a receiving-end power grid within a scheduling period as the objective function; establishing a cascaded hydropower constraint condition in which unit commitment is taken into consideration, and a photovoltaic power station output constraint condition in which uncertainty is taken into consideration; performing linearization processing on the constraint conditions, and according to the objective function and the constraint conditions which have been subjected to linearization processing, constructing a mixed integer linear model for the peak regulation optimization scheduling of the cascaded hydro-photovoltaic complementary power generation system; and solving the mixed integer linear model for the peak regulation optimization scheduling of the cascaded hydro-photovoltaic complementary power generation system, so as to obtain a scheduling scheme for the cascaded hydro-photovoltaic complementary power generation system. The present invention takes a unit commitment condition and a reservoir operation scheme of a hydropower station into consideration, can consume the photovoltaic output by fully utilizing the characteristic of a hydropower generating unit being easy to adjust, can meet the peak regulation requirement of a power grid, and has strong practicability.
assignees: HUANENG LANCANG RIVER HYDROPOWER INC;UNIV HOHAI;CHINA DIANJIAN GROUP GUIYANG SURVEY DESIGN & RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;UANENG GROUP TECH INNOVATION CENTER CO LTD

title_en: Minimization of service interruption
abstract_en: User equipment (UE) may detect a disaster condition, and the resolution thereof, based on broadcast information, RRC messaging, NAS messaging, the ability to connect to an allowable PLMN, and indications from forbidden PLMNs. In a disaster condition, a UE may perform an enhanced PLMN selection procedure wherein, for example, the UE will not consider PLMNs that are in a disaster situation if the disaster situation applies to a current location of the UE, prioritize forbidden PLMNs for disaster roaming connection. For disaster roaming connection, the UE may be configured by an otherwise forbidden PLMN with information about what services the UE can access and what type of authentication procedure the network is able to perform with UE. Upon detecting that the disaster condition is over, the UE move back to an allowable PLMN.

title_en: System which makes it possible to determine parameters and observe an energy network
abstract_en: System which makes it possible to determine parameters and observe an energy network without making contact with the network and at a variable distance from the latter by detecting low-frequency radio waves which are emitted by said network, are picked up by magnetic and electrical antennas, are amplified and are filtered by active filters and by digital signal processing software. This information is then corrected using information from vibration, inclination and temperature sensors located in the base of the antennas, finally obtaining the voltage, current, frequency, current direction, power factor and active and reactive power parameters. In addition to this, the system makes it possible to obtain vibration and inclination information relating to energy network structures and towers and to provide event alarms for the measured parameters. Using several of these systems makes it possible to obtain energy balance parameters, to measure transients, to determine the location where lines are physically cut off, and to measure the intensity and propagation of earthquakes. Said system includes an electric field filter, software for determining the optimum location for installing the system in the field, software for measuring the internal electromagnetic noise of the system and software for calibrating and determining parameters without the need to measure the distance between the system and the electrical line being studied.

title_en: Method for establishing command control network cascade failure model based on m-order adjacency matrix
abstract_en: The invention discloses a command control network cascade failure model building method based on an m-order adjacency matrix, which comprises the following specific steps: the method comprises the following steps: calculating each node value and node betweenness in the network; step two: calculating the initial load of the node; step three: counting the total number of the combat links; step four: calculating the number of the appointed nodes in the shortest path from the sensing node to the fire striking node; step five: calculating the fighting link betweenness; step six: calculating initial load according to the node degree and the fighting link betweenness respectively; step seven: calculating the importance of the nodes according to the degree indexes; step eight: calculating the node importance according to the fighting link betweenness; step nine: calculating the initial load of the network; step ten: and obtaining a load capacity model according to the initial load. According to the method and the device, a nonlinear load capacity model is established according to the nonlinear relation between the load and the capacity, and the cascade failure of the command control network is effectively resisted, so that the survivability of the network is improved.

title_en: Control method and system of wire nonlinear vibration controller
abstract_en: The invention relates to a control method and a system of a conductor nonlinear vibration controller, which determine output displacement based on external excitation of a transmission conductor; inputting the external excitation and the output displacement into a pre-established wire nonlinear vibration controller to obtain a control force amplitude required by wire vibration prevention; outputting feedback external excitation to the lead according to the control force amplitude, the preset frequency and a preset actuator; and realizing the control of the wire nonlinear vibration controller through power flow propagation based on the feedback external excitation force. The wire nonlinear vibration controller based on the power flow theory realizes active defense against wind vibration disasters of the power transmission line, improves the capability of the power transmission line in resisting natural disasters, ensures the operation safety of the power transmission line and improves the power supply reliability of a power grid.

title_en: Analysis method for coupling propagation mechanism of successive faults of distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an analysis method of a distribution network successive fault coupling propagation mechanism, which comprises the following steps of firstly, selecting a high-voltage transmission line with a plurality of feeder successive faults, and collecting relevant parameters of the high-voltage transmission line; step two, a high-voltage side simulation model is built, and a high-voltage side simulation model feeder line is built according to relevant parameters of the high-voltage transmission line; and thirdly, accessing an arc model on the feeder line, recording a simulation result of the arc model, and comparing the simulation result with an actual wave recording waveform and sequence record. The simulation model built by the ATP-EMTP simulation software is used for conveniently comparing the simulation result with the actual wave-recording waveform and event sequence record through selection and improvement of the arc model, and the built simulation model and parameter setting are subjected to feedback improvement according to the simulation result, so that the development history of the unstable ground fault of the system is analyzed, and the general rule of the fault coupling propagation mechanism can be given.

title_en: Power grid key branch identification method and system based on overload type cascading failure
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of power grid safety analysis, and provides a power grid key branch identification method and system based on overload type cascading failure, wherein the method comprises the steps of establishing an improved direct current flow for accounting voltage and reactive power, and rapidly estimating the voltage and reactive power of the system on the premise of ensuring convergence of regional power flow; the method comprises the steps of establishing an overload type cascading failure evolution model, carrying out large-scale cascading failure simulation on the system based on the overload type cascading failure evolution model, obtaining accident chains, load loss rates and branch loss rates corresponding to all cascading failures, calculating importance indexes of all branches according to the occurrence probability of all branches in the accident chains and the loss caused to the system, and screening out key branches.

title_en: Cascading failure blocking control method and system considering source-network-load coordination
abstract_en: The invention relates to a cascading failure blocking control method and system considering source-network-load coordination, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the space-time characteristics of element fault cascade evolution are considered, an overload leading type cascading failure simulation model is established, a failure chain is generated, and a power failure risk index is calculated; calculating time-risk comprehensive importance indexes by considering the system fault reaction capacity and coping cost performance, and determining the optimal input position of the blocking control strategy in fault development; respectively considering the rapid and flexible network topology switching characteristics and the load grading characteristics of the climbing of the gas turbine unit at the source, network and load sides, constructing a blocking control model based on source-network-load joint adjustment, and solving to obtain an optimal blocking control strategy; and controlling the power transmission network based on the optimal input position and the optimal blocking control strategy. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages of effectively relieving the power failure risk of the cascading failure, obviously improving the economical efficiency and reliability of blocking control, and the like.

title_en: Wind driven generator multi-working-condition flow field prediction method and device based on neural network
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical fields of wind power generation, artificial intelligence and hydrodynamics, and discloses a prediction method and a prediction device for a multi-working-condition flow field of a wind power generator based on a neural network. And under the condition of training the wake field prediction model for a new round, carrying out back propagation on the total loss, and optimizing the neural network parameters. In this way, a double branch loss collaborative optimization mechanism is formed. The physical information neural network is combined with the domain countermeasure neural network, and the complementary advantages of the physical information neural network and the domain countermeasure neural network are fully exerted. When the data is limited or the distribution difference is large, the wake field prediction with high precision and physical consistency can be realized.

title_en: Business-impact-oriented network security asset risk pricing and management method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of network security asset risk pricing and management, in particular to a service-impact-oriented network security asset risk pricing and management method and system, a service-resource portraits library is constructed by integrating historical service data, infrastructure resource data and external environment data, a potential interruption event prediction model is trained based on random forests or long-short term memory network LSTM, constructing a multi-objective cost optimization function comprising resource preset cost, service interruption loss cost and resource idle penalty cost, solving an optimal resource preset strategy by adopting a non-dominant sorting genetic algorithm NSGA-II or a particle swarm optimization algorithm, and performing feedback data updating model and function to form closed-loop optimization. The method and the system realize accurate prediction of risk, dynamic balance of cost and continuous adaptation of strategies, effectively ensure service continuity, reduce the overall operation cost of enterprises, and promote pertinence and effectiveness of network security asset risk pricing and management.

title_en: PH (potential of hydrogen) value predicting method of BP (back propagation) neutral network based on simulated annealing optimization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pH (potential of hydrogen) value predicting method of a BP (back propagation) neutral network based on a simulated annealing (SA) algorithm optimization. The pH value predicting method comprises the following steps: step one, selecting a sample according to a sample selecting strategy and inputting; step two, according to the BP theorem, determining the structure of the BP neutral network; step three, according to a network training strategy, applying the simulated annealing algorithm to optimize the BP network weight parameter; training the BP network by using the input sample, and determining the optimal weight and optimal hidden node number of the BP network; step four, according to the well trained BP neutral network, structuring a predicting model of the pH value. The pH value predicting method overcomes the randomness of the BP network in terms of weight selection, improves the rate of convergence and study ability of the BP neutral network. Besides, the method optimizes the selection of the training sample and the network hidden neutral element number, and improves the generalization ability of the BP neutral network. Moreover, the pH value predicting method is high in predicting accuracy of pH value and good in nonlinear fitting ability.

title_en: City gas pipeline system valve fault propagation impact evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the present invention discloses a kind of city gas pipeline system valve fault propagation impact evaluation method and system, and methods described includes setting up the network structure topological diagram of city gas pipeline system according to city gas pipeline system；Network model is set up according to network structure topological diagram；According to network model and default constraints, the corresponding first flow pressure distribution information of city gas pipeline system normal condition is obtained；Failsafe valve is simulated in network model, and according to default failsafe valve propagation rule and constraints, obtains city gas pipeline system corresponding second flow pressure distribution information under failsafe valve state；Compare first flow pressure distribution information and second flow pressure distribution information carries out failsafe valve propagation effect assessment to city gas pipeline system.The system is used to perform the above method.The embodiment of the present invention improves the accuracy of city gas pipeline system valve fault propagation impact evaluation.

title_en: Method for identifying cascading failure accident chain of wind power-containing alternating current-direct current hybrid power grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascading failure accident chain identification method for a wind power-containing alternating current-direct current series-parallel power grid, which comprehensively considers basic indexes for measuring the importance degree of a line from four aspects of wind power output level, stable state of alternating current-direct current mutual influence, load flow running condition and network global topological structure angle, calculates wind power access proportion short circuit ratio index, multi-feed-in short circuit ratio index, weighted load flow entropy index and line transmission medium index by using a correlation coefficient and an entropy weight method to obtain main and objective weights as basic weights, and linearly combines the two basic weights to obtain comprehensive weights; solving by using a gray wolf algorithm to obtain a combination coefficient, obtaining the comprehensive weight of each index, sorting according to the size of the comprehensive index value, and identifying the key transmission line as a next-level accident chain of the cascading failure; and determining a cascading accident chain according to the criterion for finishing the cascading failure prediction. The invention is helpful for predicting the chain of chain accidents and has effective guiding function on engineering practice.

title_en: Method for evaluating maximum transmission capability of direct-current tie line of asynchronous power grid
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for evaluating the maximum transmission capability of a direct-current tie line of an asynchronous power grid, which constructs a hierarchical optimization evaluation model containing a plurality of decision makers, and specifically comprises the following steps: the upper layer coordinator solves the main problem to determine the maximum transmittable power of each direct current connecting line in the normal operation state; TSO of a transmitting end power grid and a receiving end power grid on the lower layer solves the optimal power flow sub-problem under the frequency constraint; the evaluation model integrates a fast frequency suppression strategy and a slow frequency suppression strategy to ensure that a transmitting-end power grid and a receiving-end power grid do not trigger a third defense line after a direct current bipolar blocking fault occurs, and the purpose of improving the maximum transmission capacity of the direct current connecting line is achieved by utilizing the potential control capacity of the transmitting-end power grid and the receiving-end power grid. Finally, the evaluation model is solved by an accelerated target cascade analysis algorithm. The method has guiding significance for planning and scheduling operation of the large-capacity multi-direct-current-link asynchronous power grid.
assignees: ECONOMIC TECHNOLOGY RES INST STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV HUNAN;ZHENGZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID HANAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Mountain landslide detection method and device based on multi-mode data fusion perception
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain landslide detection method based on multi-mode data fusion perception in the technical field of remote sensing information processing, which uses a cascade multi-layer perceptron network and aims to solve the problems that the existing mountain landslide detection method based on remote sensing data cannot realize accurate and rapid prediction in a non-observation area due to limited observation data types and neglected structure information of neighbor grids by an existing algorithm.
