The method comprises the following steps: rasterizing registration and splicing are carried out on the multi-mode data of the observation area based on ArcGIS software, so that a raster attribute diagram of the multi-mode data of the observation area is obtained; building and training a cascade multi-layer perceptron network: the first-level network is based on a grid attribute diagram of multi-mode data, multi-mode data feature extraction and feature integration are achieved through superposition of multi-layer perceptrons, and the second-level network is based on the integrated features output by the first-level network, and prediction of whether landslide occurs in an observation area is achieved through the multi-layer perceptrons.

title_en: Method, device, medium and equipment for predicting carbon emission of coal-fired power plant
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a prediction method, a device, a medium and equipment for carbon emission of a coal-fired power plant, and relates to the technical field of carbon emission, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring target coal quality industrial analysis data; inputting target coal quality industrial analysis data into a carbon emission prediction model to obtain a carbon emission prediction result; the carbon emission prediction model is obtained through training in the following way: and combining the multi-layer sensor neural network and an error back propagation algorithm, taking sample coal quality industrial analysis data as input, taking predicted carbon emission as output, training the multi-layer sensor neural network, propagating errors between a predicted result output by an output layer of the multi-layer sensor neural network in the training process and an actual test value to an input layer, and performing iterative training to obtain a carbon emission prediction model. The carbon emission prediction model obtained by combining the multi-layer sensor neural network and the error back propagation algorithm is accurate in carbon emission prediction result.
assignees: LONGYUAN BEIJING CARBON ASSET MANAGEMENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Capsule network box-type substation fault diagnosis method based on residual improvement
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fault diagnosis method of a capsule network box-type transformer substation based on residual improvement, which belongs to the technical field of transformer substations and comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of carrying out data set processing, namely data set division and independent heat coding on fault types of the box-type transformer substation; constructing a capsule network based on residual improvement; inputting the training set and the verification set into a capsule network for training, training a residual capsule network by using a back propagation algorithm, and continuously optimizing parameters in the model by forward excitation propagation and back weight updating to obtain a trained box-type substation fault diagnosis model; and inputting the test set into a trained box-type substation fault diagnosis model to obtain a box-type substation fault diagnosis method result. The invention can solve the problem of model performance degradation caused by network deepening due to numerous data of the traditional convolution network model, effectively solve the problems of gradient disappearance and gradient explosion, accurately mine the state characteristics contained in the model, and improve the accuracy of fault diagnosis of the box-type transformer substation.

title_en: Supply chain network optimization method and equipment based on risk classification propagation and dynamic recovery
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of supply chain management and risk control, and particularly relates to a supply chain network optimization method based on risk grading propagation and dynamic recovery, which provides a supply chain risk propagation and recovery model based on a complex network theory and an optimization method thereof, wherein a supply chain model based on a supply chain network topology structure is firstly constructed, a supply chain network topology structure G= (V, E) is formed by N nodes and E edges, and each node represents an enterprise in a supply chain network; and simulating risks of each enterprise in the supply chain by using a supply chain model, and optimizing the enterprises in the supply chain based on simulation results. The method is used for simulating risk propagation dynamics among enterprises and optimizing a network structure, and improves the overall toughness and risk resistance of a supply chain network.

title_en: Landslide evolution based dynamic identification method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a dynamic identification method and a device based on landslide evolution, which relate to the technical field of landslide identification and comprise the steps of constructing a space-time similarity matrix based on a direction consistency item and a space adjacent item of monitoring point data, and constructing a matrix to represent total energy by decomposing characteristic values of the space-time similarity matrix; according to space-time similarity matrix analysis, obtaining a main energy concentration index, calculating the standard deviation of the energy concentration as a fluctuation measure in combination with a sliding time window, judging the development stage of the main energy concentration index, the fluctuation measure and a fluctuation constraint condition according to matrix representation total energy to obtain a sliding belt development stage result, training a depth feedforward neural network based on a back propagation algorithm, and inputting slope parameters, rock-soil mass parameters and the sliding belt development stage result into the trained neural network to predict a slope safety coefficient to obtain a sliding slope evolution result. The invention solves the problem of insufficient recognition precision in the slide belt forming stage.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHWEST JIAOTONG;SICHUAN TONGCHUAN ENGINEERING TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Typhoon path simulation method for coupling machine learning with multi-source marine environment factors
abstract_en: The invention discloses a typhoon path simulation method of machine learning coupling multi-source marine environmental factors, belongs to the field of typhoon disaster simulation, and constructs a typhoon full-path machine learning prediction model integrating marine environmental factors. Firstly, key sea parameters such as sea surface temperature, vertical wind shear of the atmosphere, relative humidity, absolute vorticity, vertical speed, induced airflow and the like, typhoon path and strength time sequence data are integrated, a significant factor influencing typhoon path and strength is selected by combining a P value threshold method, and then, based on a logistic regression model, a counter propagation neural network, a circulating neural network and a support vector machine learning model, a super parameter optimization scheme is combined, so that a full path four-stage optimal prediction model of typhoon in a generation stage, a movement stage, a strength evolution stage and an attenuation stage is respectively constructed. Compared with the traditional statistical model, the machine learning model provided by the invention can better capture the complex interaction mechanism between typhoons and environmental fields.

title_en: Water-electricity coupling system toughness assessment method considering drought risk evolution
abstract_en: The invention discloses a toughness evaluation method of a water-electricity coupling system considering drought risk evolution, and relates to the technical field of water-electricity coupling systems. The method comprises the steps of S1, modeling a water-electricity coupling system network, S2, modeling drought risk propagation of the water-electricity coupling network based on seepage, and S3, performing system simulation and toughness assessment on the water-electricity coupling system network based on the two models. According to the method, a heterogeneous weighted double-layer network model is built, a trans-scale dynamics modeling method is developed, a seepage theory and physical flow are dynamically combined, a disaster cascade propagation bi-directional seepage equation is built, a toughness assessment framework based on the seepage theory is provided, the laws of different coupling effects of the hydro-electric system are revealed, and scientific basis can be provided for risk assessment, toughness improvement and emergency management strategy formulation of key infrastructure.

title_en: Power line image processing method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power line image processing method, a device, equipment and a medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining an original inspection image of a power line, preprocessing the original inspection image to obtain a target inspection image, inputting the target inspection image into a target semantic segmentation model, and outputting the semantic segmentation image of the power line, wherein the target semantic segmentation model adopts a double-branch feature extraction architecture and comprises a main extraction network layer and an auxiliary extraction network layer, the main extraction network layer is formed by cascaded multi-scale convolution modules, the feature extraction end is connected with a multi-directional perception convolution module, and the auxiliary extraction network layer comprises a shallow convolution module. According to the technical scheme, the feature extraction is respectively carried out by adopting the double-branch structure in the target semantic segmentation model, so that the real-time segmentation accuracy of the power line image is ensured, the model parameter quantity and the operation quantity are obviously reduced, and the model reasoning speed is obviously improved.
assignees: XUZHOU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH CO STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;JIANGSU XUDIAN CONSTRUCTION GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent ammeter data anomaly detection and quality evaluation optimization method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for detecting abnormal data and evaluating quality of an intelligent electric meter, and relates to the technical field of intelligent power grids, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining measurement data of electric energy metering equipment and constructing a map model based on topological relation; the method comprises the steps of extracting multi-order associated features through a graph structure propagation mechanism, inputting the features and measured data into an anomaly detection model to calculate the deviation degree, judging anomalies beyond a threshold value, and calculating a data quality assessment index according to the anomaly frequency and the duration. The method and the device fully utilize network topology constraint, can improve the abnormality detection accuracy and realize accurate evaluation of the data quality of the ammeter.
assignees: STATE GRID JIBEI POWER CO LTD SMART DISTRIB NETWORK CENTER

title_en: Predicting method of wildfire propagation areas and system thereof
abstract_en: A predicting method of a plurality of wildfire propagation areas includes a network constructing step, a normalized adjacency matrix constructing step, a node ranking value calculating step, a state ranking value calculating step, a source node determining step and an occurrence probability calculating step. The node ranking value calculating step is performed to calculate a ranking value and a plurality of states of each of the nodes. The normalized adjacency matrix constructing step is performed to construct a normalized matrix. The state ranking value calculating step is performed to calculate a state ranking value and a state probability of each of the nodes. The source node determining step is performed to determine a source node of the wildfire propagation areas and the states corresponding to the source node. The occurrence probability calculating step is performed to calculate the occurrence probability of the wildfire propagation areas.

title_en: Industrial park power distribution network collaborative planning method considering multi-energy coupling characteristics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a collaborative planning method for an industrial park power distribution network considering multi-energy coupling characteristics, which comprises the following steps: s1, carrying out investigation and collection on the scale of users and the general situation of industrial development in an industrial park; s2, predicting energy consumption requirements of the industrial park; s3, establishing various energy resource output characteristic models; s4, constructing a planning scheme objective function according to the energy characteristics of the industrial park, and establishing energy resource constraint conditions; s5, analyzing and matching various resources according to the coupling characteristic analysis of the comprehensive energy resources; and S6, carrying out economic and social benefit evaluation on the comprehensive energy planning scheme to obtain a comprehensive energy collaborative final scheme. According to the method, firstly, a planning scheme objective function based on double-layer planning is constructed, on the basis, the comprehensive energy collaborative planning of the industrial park is developed more scientifically and reasonably, the comprehensive energy collaborative planning scheme can be obtained better, the problem of fluctuation of renewable energy is solved, and energy interaction and cascade utilization of the industrial park are realized.

title_en: Earthquake geological disaster and property population loss risk prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for predicting earthquake geological disasters and property population loss risks, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining recurrence periods for different segments, different cascade combinations under the limitation of sliding rate and magnitude-frequency relationship; calculating earthquake-earthquake vibration data under the earthquake action set by the potential earthquake dangerous section or the potential cascade rupture combination; calculating a prediction result of the earthquake landslide probability; refining a building macroscopic classification exposure model to a village and town street scale exposure model, and determining a seismic disaster loss model according to the seismic-earthquake vibration data; and determining an earthquake casualty population prediction model based on the deep learning network, and predicting the casualty population according to the earthquake-earthquake vibration data and the earthquake casualty population prediction model. The invention opens up the whole risk assessment process from the quantitative data of the movable faults to the earthquake disaster risk prediction result, and solves the problem that the conventional movable fault research is difficult to use in the actual disaster risk prediction.

title_en: Water surface sensing network positioning method with unknown signal propagation loss under non-line-of-sight condition
abstract_en: The invention relates to a water surface sensing network positioning method with unknown signal propagation loss under a non-line-of-sight condition, which comprises the steps of constructing a radio receiving signal intensity ranging model with distance constraint under the non-line-of-sight condition, constructing a joint estimation optimization function according to the ranging model, improving a binary chopping method based on the optimization function, jointly estimating a path loss factor and a target position, remodelling the optimization function according to the estimated target position, re-optimizing the target position, obtaining the optimized target position, and completing the water surface sensing network positioning under the non-line-of-sight condition. The invention can be suitable for the high-dynamic water surface environment, and solves the problem of positioning error increase caused by unknown path loss factor and non-line-of-sight influence in the propagation process of the water surface radio signal in the ocean.

title_en: Target detection method based on fusion of two modal images
abstract_en: The invention discloses a target detection method based on two-mode image fusion, which comprises the steps of constructing a relevant scene based on a AirSim platform to carry out simulation, collecting image data sets of different modes, constructing a bimodal image fusion network, training the fusion network according to a counter-propagation principle, simultaneously extracting features of images of two modes by using a Siamese neural network, reconstructing the features into a fusion image through deconvolution operation, carrying out inspection and evaluation on the quality of the reconstructed fusion image through quantized evaluation indexes, modifying the fusion network according to an evaluation result, directly inputting the fusion features output by the trained fusion network into a single-stage YOLOv target detection network, freezing trained network parameters of the fusion network, and training the target detection network to obtain an optimized fusion and detection network. The method is convenient to realize efficient and accurate bimodal image fusion and detection, and is beneficial to improving the target detection capability of the unmanned aerial vehicle in scenes such as emergency search and rescue.

title_en: Power transmission line inspection data asset management method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a transmission line inspection data asset management method and system, which are used for acquiring multi-mode data of a transmission line through various sensors arranged in the transmission line and surrounding environment and sensors carried by a helicopter and an unmanned plane; and generating a fusion data set by processing the multi-mode data based on the space-time correlation model. Analyzing the fusion data set by utilizing a self-adaptive feature extraction algorithm to generate a structured power transmission line data asset comprising environmental features, defect features and hidden danger features, evaluating the possibility of triggering defects by environmental conditions based on the association of the environmental features and the defect features, constructing a graph network model which takes the power transmission line as a node and sensor data as side weights according to the hidden danger features and the environmental conditions, analyzing a defect propagation path and predicting the time and space distribution of hidden dangers, generating a defect risk level early warning based on a prediction result, generating a power transmission line hidden danger distribution map by combining environmental meteorological data, and providing accurate assistance for inspection and maintenance planning.

title_en: System for propagating messages for purposes of demand response
abstract_en: A system having a utility, a communications intermediary and demand response resources. The utility may be connected to the communications intermediary via a network. The demand response resources may be connected to the communications intermediary via another network. A single dispatch destined for the demand response resources may be sent to the communications intermediary. The dispatch may be disaggregated at the communications intermediary into a multitude of dispatches which may be dispersed to their respective destined demand response resources. The demand response resources may send telemetries to the communications intermediary that aggregates the telemetries into a single telemetry. The single telemetry may be sent to the utility.

title_en: Power system cascading failure mode prediction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system cascading failure mode prediction method, and relates to the technical field of power system cascading failure mechanism analysis. The power system cascading failure mode prediction method of the invention comprises the following steps: a, the steady-state power flow of a system before an initial failure is calculated; b, the comprehensive vulnerability index is calculated; c, the initial failure is determined; d, the comprehensive vulnerability index after failure is calculated; e, the comprehensive margin index Cij(s+1) of the system after failure is calculated; f, the (s+1)-level failure is determined; and g, whether the search termination condition is met is judged. According to the power system cascading failure mode prediction method of the invention, the possible cascading failure mode of the system is predicated by combining the power grid structure and state parameters, the predication indexes are combined with the actual situation of the power system, the calculation speed is high, a cascading failure set having a serious effect on the system is worked out and analyzed, and prevention of major blackout accidents caused by cascading failure can be enhanced.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCH CONTROL CT OF GUIZHOU GRID CO LTD;UNIV SICHUAN

title_en: A kind of have meat, medicinal, the Gallus Domesticus breeding method of type at a slow speed of ornamental value
abstract_en: The invention discloses and a kind of there is meat, medicinal, the Gallus Domesticus breeding method of type at a slow speed of ornamental value, it is sheerly as breeding material with Donglan Gallus Domesticus pure lines, Gallus Domesticus of reaching the clouds pure lines and Wenchang Chicken Margarita plumage, through more than four locking selection-breeding from generation to generation, after Major Economic controls below 10%, by for generations, father and mother's generation and three grades of expanding propagation mechanism of commercial generation form a complete production network.The Gallus Domesticus of type at a slow speed of the present invention is compared with tradition Gallus Domesticus, overcome the defect that wild nature disaster is raised, father and mother improve more than 12% for egg laying performance, the commercial broiler flocks speed of growth improves more than 15%, survival rate improves more than 1.5%, feedstuff-meat ratio reduces by 0.1, has medicinal, meat and ornamental value, improves culture benefit.
assignees: LAIBIN XINCHENG COUNTY RUNHUA ANIMAL HUSBANDRY CO LTD;GE HONGWEI

title_en: Method for simulating continuous burst flood of cascade reservoir group
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for simulating continuous burst flood of a cascade reservoir group, which comprises the steps of extracting river network information, carrying out evolution calculation on flood in a river channel by adopting a holy-Venn equation and a Massa-Kyoto equation, carrying out flood detention and flood traveling outside the river channel along the topographic direction, carrying out flood regulation calculation on a reservoir, taking the whole process of dam break outflow as inflow flood of a downstream river section of a dam, and returning to the step S2. According to the method, the dam break process, the flood evolution and the reservoir regulation and storage are comprehensively considered, the Saint-Venn equation and the Mas Kyoto equation are adopted to perform evolution calculation on the flood in the river channel, and a generalized dam break process line method is adopted, so that the simulation calculation aiming at the continuous dam break of the cascade reservoir group is realized, the measurement cost is reduced, and the calculation efficiency is improved.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Node importance identification method based on complex network dependent seepage model
abstract_en: The invention provides a node importance identification method based on a complex network dependent seepage model, aiming at determining the influence of nodes in a network according to seepage characteristics and a cascade dynamics process when the network fails. The invention comprises an edge-dependent network modeling module and a real network verification module, wherein the edge-dependent network modeling module comprises the following steps: (1) constructing a network model based on an edge dependence mechanism, and introducing a weak dependence seepage model to adjust dependence strength between connected edges in the network model; (2) carrying out failure investigation on the nodes in the network model in the step 1, setting the dependence strength between adjustable parameter control nodes, carrying out a new failure judgment according to whether a new dependence edge failure exists in the network model or not, and obtaining a final value of the maximum connected component of the network model until the network model is stable; (3) and evaluating the importance of the node according to the edge dependence strength critical value and the maximum connected component which cause network crash when the node is deleted.

title_en: Fracture propagation model solving method and system considering fracture network complexity
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fracture expansion model solving method and system considering fracture network complexity f Describing the influence of the crack complexity, constructing a logging evaluation index of the plane crack complexity based on the primary weak plane development degree and the horizontal main stress difference, and calculating the length, the width and the like of the crackThe crack geometric parameters fully consider the development rule of the crack under the volume fracturing condition, the calculation result of the crack geometric parameters is more accurate than that of a two-dimensional PKN model, and reliable guarantee can be provided for fracturing design optimization.
assignees: CHINA NAT PETROLEUM CORP;CHINA PETROLEUM LOGGING CO LTD

title_en: Drainage basin cascade power plant maintenance monitoring management system and use method
abstract_en: The invention provides a watershed cascade power plant maintenance monitoring management system and a using method thereof. The drainage basin cascade power plant overhaul information sending module, the power grid production data receiving module, the public service module, the centralized control center worker workstation and the overhaul information monitoring management display module are connected with the centralized control center host, and the centralized control center host transmits data of all the modules to the drainage basin cascade power plant overhaul monitoring management database for storage. The system monitors and manages the whole process from the application of the overhaul ticket to the completion of overhaul of the watershed step power plant overhaul work, and ensures that the overhaul work does not have a task problem. All modules are managed and coordinated through a centralized control center, and the system monitors and manages the whole process from the application of a maintenance ticket to the completion of maintenance of the power plant maintenance work of the drainage basin cascade, so that no problem is caused in the maintenance work.
assignees: HUBEI QINGJIANG HYDROELECTRIC DEV CO LTD

title_en: Wind power composite prediction method based on PCA-BP-SSA algorithm
abstract_en: A wind power composite prediction method based on a PCA-BP-SSA algorithm belongs to the technical field of wind power generation, and adopts a BP neural network method optimized by principal component analysis and a sparrow search algorithm to predict wind power. The method comprises the steps of firstly obtaining historical values of various meteorological data, extracting principal component components influencing power prediction by adopting a principal component analysis method, inputting the extracted data into a BP (back propagation) neural network, constructing a training sample set, optimizing weights and thresholds of the BP neural network by adopting a sparrow search algorithm, inputting the weights and the thresholds obtained by training into the BP neural network, further training by adopting the BP neural network with a self-adaptive learning rate, and finally obtaining an optimal model. And performing inverse normalization processing on the obtained wind power prediction data to obtain a final prediction value, comparing and analyzing the final prediction value with an actual value, and evaluating the prediction performance of the optimized model. The method is more accurate in prediction, and solves the problems that the convergence speed is low and the local minimum value is easy to fall into in the training process.
assignees: ECONOMIC TECHNOLOGY RES INST STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Water surface sensor network positioning method with unknown signal propagation loss under non-line-of-sight condition
abstract_en: The invention relates to a water surface sensor network positioning method with unknown signal propagation loss under a non-line-of-sight condition, which comprises the steps of constructing a distance-constrained radio receiving signal strength ranging model under the non-line-of-sight condition, and constructing a joint estimation optimization function according to the ranging model; improving a binary chopping method based on the optimization function, and estimating the path loss factor and the target position in a combined manner; and reshaping the optimization function according to the target position obtained by estimation, re-optimizing the target position, obtaining the optimized target position, and completing the positioning of the water surface sensor network under the non-line-of-sight condition. The invention can be suitable for high dynamic water surface environment, and solves the problem of positioning error increase caused by unknown path loss factor and non-line-of-sight influence in the process of transmitting the water surface radio signal in the ocean.

title_en: Method for controlling power generation capacity of elevator-level hydropower station in real time by using water and related device
abstract_en: The application discloses a method for controlling the generating capacity of an elevator-level hydropower station in real time by using water, which comprises the following steps: establishing a hydropower station reservoir operation constraint library based on upstream hydropower station reservoir data information and downstream hydropower station reservoir data information; determining an upstream water power station water surface area and a downstream water power station water surface area based on the upstream water power station water level and the downstream water power station water level; determining the power generation amount of the upstream water power station and the delivery flow of the upstream water power station based on the water surface area of the upstream water power station and the water surface area of the downstream water power station; determining the power generation amount of the downstream water power station and the power output flow of the downstream water power station based on the power output flow of the upstream water power station and the water level of the downstream water power station; determining a step joint total power generation amount based on the power generation amount of the upstream water power station and the power generation amount of the downstream water power station; the cascade reservoir group real-time economic optimization operation of cascade combined power generation and reservoir energy storage is realized, the optimal scheduling decision can be rapidly acquired to provide a reference, and the power generation of the cascade reservoir group and the power grid demand are more fully coordinated.

title_en: District electricity prediction method based on graph multi-head attention mechanism
abstract_en: The invention relates to a district electricity prediction method based on a graph multi-head attention mechanism, which comprises the following steps: obtaining geographical position data, historical electric quantity data and historical external factor data of a cell; preprocessing historical electric quantity data, historical external factor data and geographic position data; historical external factor data includes gas temperature and electricity price; constructing a space-time diagram neural network model based on a diagram multi-head self-attention mechanism; obtaining a prediction result through a space-time diagram neural network model based on a diagram multi-head self-attention mechanism; comparing the predicted result with the true value to obtain a loss value; performing reverse error propagation through the loss value, and training the model; and predicting the future electricity consumption of the cell through the trained model. The method models the historical electricity consumption data, models the spatial relationship among the cells and the time characteristics of the historical data, and fully mines the space-time relationship in the cell electric quantity prediction problem.
assignees: STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;MARKETING SERVICE CENTER OF STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: High-resolution image building extraction method integrating local and global features
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of seismic disaster assessment, in particular to a high-resolution image building extraction method integrating local and global features, which adopts grouping convolution (ResNeXt) with the same topological structure to replace standard convolution of a backbone network ResNet in a TransUnet coding layer, and improves the capability of quickly acquiring building features under the condition of not increasing the quantity of parameters. The relative position coding mode in the depth separable convolution substitution TransUnet is adopted to implicitly construct the position information of the building feature, so that the transducer can obtain the global feature information and the local feature information of the building at the same time; the channel attention mechanism is adopted to improve the layer jump, cascade the multi-scale building characteristics, and the weight of the building characteristics in the key channel is improved by enhancing the remarkable characteristic representation in the channel dimension. And finally, carrying out a wide experiment on the GF2 image data set to verify the effectiveness and the practicability of the model.

title_en: Water quantity scheduling method and system for cascade reservoir pump station group
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of water resource scheduling, and provides a water quantity scheduling method and system for a cascade reservoir pump station group. The method comprises the steps of executing modeling of a cascade reservoir water supply system, activating a sensor network, establishing a real-time state according to monitoring data and modeling results, utilizing the modeling results to establish scheduling constraint, obtaining crop irrigation demands and establishing irrigation priorities, establishing a multidimensional objective function, carrying out water quantity scheduling adaptation optimization according to the priorities, the scheduling constraint, the real-time state and the objective function to form an optimizing result, and carrying out cascade reservoir pump station group water quantity scheduling management according to the optimizing result. The application solves the technical problems of low water resource distribution efficiency and high water shortage risk caused by unbalanced water resource supply and demand and complex scheduling constraint in the group water quantity scheduling process of the cascade reservoir pump station, and achieves the technical effects of realizing the accuracy and flexibility of water quantity scheduling and reducing the water quantity loss by introducing a multidimensional objective function and real-time state monitoring.
assignees: XINJIANG HAMI DONGTIAN WATER CONSERVANCY GROUP CO LTD;XINJIANG WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER SURVEY AND DESIGN INST CO LTD;XINJIANG HAOYUAN WATER SUPPLY CO LTD;CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Power grid secondary equipment defect identification method based on knowledge graph and Bayesian network fusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power system fault protection, in particular to a method for identifying defects of secondary equipment of a power grid based on fusion of a knowledge graph and a Bayesian network, which comprises the steps of carrying out semantic extraction on multi-source heterogeneous data to construct a defect knowledge graph, breaking through the limitation of data islands and realizing full-dimensional association analysis of equipment defect characteristics; mapping the defect knowledge map of the secondary equipment of the power grid to a Bayesian network framework, and quantifying prior probability and conditional probability of defect occurrence based on prior knowledge of historical data; and finally, providing accurate fault mode positioning by means of defect subgraph search of a knowledge graph, and completing defect propagation path prediction by utilizing probability reasoning of a Bayesian network, wherein the two are combined, so that the method can comprehensively utilize multi-source heterogeneous data of secondary equipment of the power grid to accurately describe complex relations and probability influences between defect phenomena and multi-layer reasons, remarkably improve defect identification accuracy and response timeliness, and provide support for safe and stable operation of the power grid.
assignees: SOUTHWEST BRANCH OF STATE GRID CORP OF CHINA

title_en: Multi-scale power load prediction method and system based on dynamic graph neural network
abstract_en: The application provides a multiscale power load prediction method and a multiscale power load prediction system based on a dynamic graph neural network, and particularly relates to the technical field of power load prediction. The method comprises the steps of constructing a dynamic association diagram based on a power load sequence and external factor data by nonlinear statistical measurement, dividing a multi-scale view of the power load sequence through significant period detection, inputting a multi-branch encoder to generate multi-scale feature representation, executing mixed neighborhood propagation on the dynamic association diagram to generate space enhancement features, splicing the space enhancement features and the multi-scale feature representation to obtain space-time fusion features, and decoding the space-time fusion features into future power load predicted values. In addition, the key parameters of the multi-branch encoder and the mixed neighborhood propagation are adaptively adjusted by adopting a parameter optimization algorithm. The method solves the problem of precision optimization of dynamic space-time correlation and multi-scale feature collaborative modeling in power load prediction, improves prediction precision and adaptability, and reduces prediction deviation.
assignees: UNIV XIAN SCI & TECHNOLOGY;STATE GRID SHAANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD TRAINING CENTER

title_en: Power grid operation fault prediction and abnormal trend early warning method, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid operation fault prediction and abnormal trend early warning method, equipment and medium, which are used for constructing a four-element fault sequence based on power grid multi-source data and realizing second-level fault evolution dynamic tracking. By updating the topological base diagram of the power grid in real time, the problem of model hysteresis is solved, and the accuracy of the propagation path is improved. And the electric coupling strength is introduced as the edge weight of the graph convolution network, and the electric topography of the power grid is etched in the vector space, so that the calculation is simplified and the accuracy is improved. And similarity diffusion is carried out by using the topological embedded vector, so that a high-precision influence range subgraph can be generated in millisecond level, and prediction distortion is avoided. Converting the subgraph into a local monitoring area, quickly constructing a low-dimensional fault state vector, integrating a dynamic fault propagation map, and clearly displaying fault tracing, paths and termination logic. Finally, by means of the graph attention network, the risk probability and the multidimensional influence index of the nodes are output by one key, an early warning instruction is automatically generated, and the second-level control and protection capability of the power grid is obviously enhanced.
assignees: LINYI POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: The system and method of real time multiple image sharing and displaying based on the network and broadcast
title_ko: 네트워크와 방송 기반의 실시간 다중 이미지 공유 및 전시 시스템과 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A system for sharing and displaying network or broadcast multi-images in real time and a method thereof are provided to classify several types of images into channels wherein the images are obtained in real time, thereby building a multi sharing environment and a displaying environment. CONSTITUTION: A relay program(510) transmits channeled image information to a multi monitor/display device to a client through a network. A client program(810) receives the channeled image information transmitted from the relay program to selectively display the information. A management program(910) monitors, manages, and controls channel information, frame speed information, image quality information, image source connection state, client transmission on/off information, relay equipment performance information, and on/off information through the network.
abstract_ko:
(가) 기술분야 
본 발명은 방송 개념 기반의 중계장비 구성을 핵심 개념으로 하여, 중계장비에서 네트워크 통신과 물리적 연결을 기반으로 공유 및 전시가 필요한 다양한 소스(컴퓨터, CCTV, Video Camera, 의료장치 등)로부터 실시간으로 이미지를 획득하고, 방송채널을 구성하여 실시간으로 이를 다중사용자에게 네트워크를 통해 공유하며, 다중 모니터에 전시하는 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것이다. 
(나) 해결하고자 하는 과제 
본 발명은 방송 개념과 네트워크 통신 개념을 기반으로 한 중계 장비를 구성하여 운영하는 것을 핵심으로 한다. 중계장비는 네트워크 통신을 통해 수신한 다수의 컴퓨터 화면 이미지들과 비디오 케이블을 통해 수신한 다수 다종의 장치 - 컴퓨터 및 컴퓨터 이외의 장비(CCTV, Video Camera 등) - 이미지들로 방송 채널을 구성한다. 중계장비는 구성한 채널들을 다중모니터/전시기에 선택적 표출 또는 다중 표출함과 동시에, 멀티캐스트 방식의 네트워크 통신으로도 채널 들을 공유한다. 이와 같이 중계장비를 중심으로 한 본 발명은 기존 원격공유 시스템과 다중전시 시스템의 기능을 통합 제공함은 물론 비용, 기술, 편의성, 확장성 측면의 제약 및 한계사항을 극복하고자 한다. 
중계장비를 구성하여 원격컴퓨터와 이를 공유하고자하는 클라이언트 컴퓨터를 방송 개념을 활용하여 중계함으로써, 원격컴퓨터의 직접 접속에 따른 기존 원격공유 시스템의 컴퓨터 자원/네트워크 부하 증가에 따른 다중 공유(다대다 공유) 제약을 극복하여 효율적인 다중 공유 환경을 제공한다. 중계장비에 비디오 케이블을 물리적으로 연결하여 다종의 장치에서 이미지를 획득하여 전송시에는 네트워크 통신 방식으로 전파함으로써, 컴퓨터 화면 이외의 이미지에 대해서는 이미지 공유가 불가한 기존 원격 공유 시스템의 제약을 해결하고자 한다. 또한 소프트웨어와 네트워크 기반으로 중계장비를 구성함으로써 하드웨어 장비 기반의 기존 다중 전시 시스템의 문제점 - 하드웨어 구성 관리, 확장의 제한, 비디오 케이블을 통한 화면 공유 거리 제한 - 을 획기적으로 개선하여 공유가 필요한 다수/다종의 화면을 다수의 사용자가 손쉽게 공유할 수 있도록 하는데 그 목적이 있다. 
(다) 과제의 해결 수단 
상기 목적을 달성하기 위해 본 발명은 방송 개념과 네트워크 통신 및 물리적 연결 기반의 중계장비 구성을 통해 정보를 공유 및 전시하는 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 네트워크 통신을 통해 자신의 컴퓨터 화면 이미지를 중계장비에 전송하는 에이전트 프로그램; 다수의 에이전트 프로그램으로부터 네트워크로 이미지를 수신하고, 물리적인 케이블 연결을 통해서 다종의 장치로부터 이미지를 획득하여 방송 개념 기반의 채널을 구성하고 이를 다중 모니터/전시기에 표출 및 네트워크 통신을 통해 클라이언트에게 송출하는 중계장비 및 중계 프로그램; 중계장비 및 중계프로그램으로부터 송출된 채널화된 이미지 정보를 네트워크로 수신하여 선택적으로 표출하여 볼 수 있도록 하는 클라이언트 프로그램; 중계장비 및 중계프로그램의 운영에 필요한 채널정보, 프레임 속도 정보, 이미지 화질정보, 이미지 소스 연결상태, 클라이언트 송출 On/Off, 중계장비 성능정보, 전체 On/Off 등을 네트워크로 모니터링, 관리 및 제어할 수 있는 관리용 프로그램을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
본 발명은 중계장비 및 중계 프로그램이 구동된 후 에이전트 프로그램, 클라이언트 프로그램, 관리용 프로그램이 각각 화면 전송, 화면 수신 및 표출, 중계장비 관리 및 제어를 위해 중계 프로그램에 로그인 하는 단계; 관리용 프로그램이 중계장비 운영에 필요한 채널정보 및 제어정보를 입력 및 관리하는 단계; 에이전트 프로그램이 에이전트 컴퓨터의 그래픽 출력장치로부터 이미지를 미러링(복제)하고 이를 인코딩 및 암호화 하여 네트워크 통신으로 중계장비에 전송하는 단계; 중계장비 및 중계 프로그램에서 에이전트로부터 네트워크를 통해 수신된 이미지들과 물리적 비디오 케이블에서 수신된 이미지들로 채널을 구성하고 인코딩 및 암호화하여 이를 다중 그래픽 출력장치를 통해 다중 모니터/전시기에 선택 표출 및 다중 표출하며 또한 멀티캐스트 방식으로 실시간으로 이를 송출하는 단계; 클라이언트 프로그램에서 중계장비로부터 송출된 이미지를 네트워크로 수신, 채널 목록화, 디코딩을 통해 원하는 채널을 표출하는 단계;를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
(라) 효과 등 
본 발명은 방송이라는 개념과 소프트웨어 및 네트워크 통신 기술을 근간으로 한 중계장비 와 중계 프로그램 구성을 핵심으로 한다. 이를 기반으로 실시간으로 획득한 다수, 다종의 이미지를 채널화하여 다중 공유 환경 및 전시 환경을 구성함으로써 기존 원격공유 시스템, 다중전시 시스템을 포괄하는 통합 기능의 제공과 함께 기존 시스템의 한계를 극복할 수 있다. 
본 발명은 상황실, 회의실, 교육장 등 다중 공유 및 전시가 필요한 환경에서 중계장비 중심의 네트워크 구성만으로 이를 자유자재로 공유 및 전시하게 함으로써 설치 및 구축의 용이성, 다중 정보 공유 및 전시의 편의성, 비용절감의 경제성, 유지관리 및 확장의 편의성을 제공할 수 있다.

title_en: Private network mirroring
abstract_en: Techniques for private network mirroring are described. Users can select one or more existing private networks to be mirrored in the same or different network area. Any network configuration changes made in the selected private network (e.g., “master” private network) can be propagated automatically to the mirror private network. This enables users to utilize resources in another network area for disaster recovery, ensuring that the network configuration of the mirror private network is consistent with the master private network through real-time updates. Additionally, users managing infrastructure that includes multiple private networks can select one master private network and propagate configuration changes to other private networks, reducing management overhead incurred by these multi-private network installations.

title_en: Cascade hydropower station group daily power generation plan making method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascade hydropower station group daily power generation plan making method which comprises the steps that 1. turning-on-off constraint of a power plant power generator unit is not considered, the target that the similarity degree of the power generation load of a hydropower station group and the daily typical load of a power plant is highest is used as one of optimization targets, and a cascade hydropower station group daily power generation plan is obtained through primary optimization; 2. according to the cascade hydropower station group daily power generation plan, a power plant power generator unit turning-on-off state process is prepared; and 3. power plant power generator unit turning-on-off state process constraining conditions are increased, the target that the similarity degree of the power generation load of the hydropower station group and the daily typical load of the power plant is highest is used as an optimization target, and a cascade hydropower station group daily power generation plan is obtained through secondary optimization. Power grid requirements are considered, a hydropower station power generating strategy which accords with practical situations better can be obtained, and the method is suitable for single hydropower station and cascade hydropower station group daily power generation plan making.

title_en: Online social network information propagation prediction system based on time-varying damping motion
abstract_en: The invention provides an online social network information propagation prediction system based on time-varying damping motion, which comprises: the individual characteristic data acquisition module is used for acquiring individual characteristics on the online social network nodes; the acceleration calculation module is used for calculating the acceleration of information propagation according to the individual characteristics acquired by the individual characteristic data acquisition module; the stress analysis module is used for acquiring stress conditions of information spread on the network nodes according to the acceleration calculated by the acceleration calculation module; and the data judgment module is used for judging whether the information residual energy is greater than or equal to the information preset energy threshold value. The invention can predict the hot spots of the online network events, and verifies the rationality and the effectiveness of the prediction system through numerical analysis, simulation experiment and empirical data analysis.

title_en: Evacuee guidance system and method using sensor network and directional speaker
title_ko: 센서 네트워크와 지향성 스피커를 사용한 피난 유도 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for inducing evacuation using a sensor network and a directional speaker, and a method thereof. The present invention analyzes a current status and a cause of a social disaster and establishes a gas and fire detection sensor network, an evacuation induction type directional speaker and an LED lighting system at the indoor in order to improve disaster response ability. Also, in case of indoor gas explosion, fire occurrence and flood disaster occurrence, an evacuation induction algorithm is applied to be rapidly evacuated through an early warning and a disaster situation propagation system using the directional speaker in a disaster region and a directional sound system is immediately output. In addition, the present invention displays an evacuation place on LED light of the LED lighting system and rapidly induces evacuation in the disaster region so as to be rapidly evacuated, thereby reducing casualties and maintaining a safety management system. The system for inducing evacuation comprises: a plurality of sensors; a gateway; an evacuation induction operating system; the directional speaker system (IDS); and a plurality of LED lighting systems.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 센서 네트워크와 지향성 스피커를 사용한 피난 유도 시스템 및 그 방법에 관한 것으로, 사회 재난의 발생 현황과 원인을 분석하여 재난 대응 능력을 향상시키기 위해 실내에서 가스, 화재 감지 센서 네트워크와 피난 유도형 지향성 스피커와 LED 조명 시스템을 구축하며, 실내 가스 폭발, 화재 발생, 수난 재해 발생시 재난 발생 지역에서 지향성 스피커를 활용한 조기경보 및 재난 상황 전파체계를 통해 긴급 대피하도록 피난 유도 알고리즘을 적용하여 즉시 지향성 음향 시스템을 출력하고, 대피 장소를 LED 조명 시스템의 LED 조명등을 표시하여 신속하게 대피하도록 재난 지역에서 긴급하게 피난을 유도하여 인명 피해를 줄이고 안전관리체계를 유지하는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Ultra short-term scheduling method for cascade hydropower station group sequencing based on indexes
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultra short-term scheduling method for a cascade hydropower station group sequencing based on indexes. A day-ahead power generation schedule is brought into ultra short-term scheduling; an objective function is the minimum of the maximum value of relative deviation between a calculating water level at the end of the scheduling period and an ideal water level, and the requirements of safety, timeliness, practicability and economical efficiency of the ultra short-term scheduling are met. According to the technical scheme, the ultra short-term scheduling method comprises the following steps: predicating interval incoming water and utilizing an upstream and downstream flow time-lag relationship to predicate reservoir inflow; then, utilizing a mode of determining water with power to check tail water level, and carrying out water abandoning treatment; then, computing deviation between total output and load demand; selecting relative deviation between the calculating water level at the end of the scheduling period and the ideal water level as a quantitative index, and sequencing by utilizing the index to guide the power station to increase or reduce output until the load demand and the total output are balanced. The ultra short-term scheduling method has the beneficial effects of looking ahead of future development of a power grid and providing theoretical basis for establishing an ultra short-term scheduling system of the cascade hydropower station group.
assignees: UNIV DALIAN TECH;YUNNAN ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCH CONTROL CT

title_en: Information-epidemic cooperative evolution analysis method under dynamic multi-source information and behavior response action
abstract_en: The invention discloses an information-epidemic cooperative evolution analysis method under the action of dynamic multi-source information and behavior response, which comprises the steps of firstly constructing a multi-layer time sequence network model with coupled node parts; then, an unconsciousness-consciousness-unconsciousness, susceptibility-infection-susceptibility model analysis information-epidemic propagation dynamics process is constructed; then describing the epidemic state of the node and the conversion of the information state, and deriving an epidemic threshold value beta c (ii) a Then simulating the dynamic evolution process of epidemic propagation and information diffusion; and finally, counting the proportion of the infected node and the conscious node in the network in a steady state to complete the information-epidemic disease collaborative evolution process. The invention considers the self consciousness and behavior response of individual time variation to the information-epidemic cooperative evolution influence in the multilayer time sequence network coupled with the node partDescribing the state transition of the nodes by a micro-Markov chain method, and theoretically solving the critical threshold value beta of the epidemic disease c And provides guidance for intervention and control in response to COVID-19 or other pandemic that may occur in the future.

title_en: Line active stop and network reconstruction method for preventing typhoon weather cascading failure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a line active stop and network reconstruction method for preventing typhoon weather cascading failure, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of splicing a main distribution network model, analyzing an expected failure set, constructing and selecting a power grid risk assessment, stopping and reconstruction scheme and the like, wherein risk analysis of multi-voltage-class combination is carried out on lines passing by a typhoon path, possible cascading failures are analyzed, some of the lines are actively stopped, and network reconstruction is carried out, so that power supply of residents and important loads can be ensured to the greatest extent after the line failure occurs under the typhoon condition. The method provided by the invention can effectively prevent the occurrence of large-area power failure of the power grid, has strong operability and has more remarkable popularization.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD WENZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO;RUIAN POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Method, system and device for evaluating influence of extreme weather on power generation power of power grid
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power grid security risk assessment, in particular to a method, a system and a device for evaluating the influence of extreme weather on power generated by a power grid, which are used for firstly acquiring weather cloud images and microclimate data corresponding to the extreme weather; the method comprises the steps of inputting a meteorological cloud image into a VIT prediction model to conduct prediction to obtain a first sub-decision, inputting microclimate data into a transducer prediction model to conduct prediction to obtain a second sub-decision, and finally inputting the first sub-decision and the second sub-decision into a multi-mode fusion decision machine to conduct cascade fusion to obtain probability of influencing power generation power of a power grid. The method combines the prediction results of the two modes of the weather cloud image and the microclimate data to carry out decision fusion, integrates the different dimensional information collected when the extreme weather occurs, and accurately predicts the influence of the extreme weather on the power generation power of the new energy power grid.
assignees: STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Airport apron operation risk assessment method based on complex network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an airport apron operation risk assessment method based on a complex network, and belongs to the technical field of risk control. The method comprises the steps of analyzing an apron safety report by adopting an event chain analysis method to construct a complex network, determining a risk static index of each node, simulating a dynamic propagation process of risks in the complex network based on a SIRS model, determining the risk dynamic index of each node, classifying the nodes by adopting a spectral clustering algorithm with the dynamic and static indexes of each node as characteristics, respectively calculating an average risk comprehensive value of each cluster node and determining a risk grade of each cluster node based on a quantile, acquiring a risk event of an airport apron at a certain moment, determining the risk comprehensive value and the risk grade of each risk event, and carrying out hierarchical classification management on the risk comprehensive value and the risk grade. The invention constructs a multidimensional risk assessment index system to assess the risk transmission capacity and blocking capacity of the nodes, realizes the classification and grading of the risk nodes, and can provide scientific decision support for airport managers.

title_en: Rumor propagation control method based on user emotion analysis and differential dynamic system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rumor propagation control method based on a user emotion analysis and differential dynamic system, and belongs to the field of propagation dynamics. The method comprises the steps of 1) introducing system parameters into an actual network scene to describe the propagation of rumors, constructing a differential power system, and simulating and analyzing the propagation of rumors in a social network. 2) And solving a balance point according to a differential equation. 3) And according to Lyapunov, deducing the stability of the model and providing basis for formulating a control strategy. 4) The design algorithm predicts the trend of rumor transmission and provides a method for rumor control. 5) And (3) adopting LS estimation to fit the rumor event parameters to obtain the system parameter prediction rumor event transmission trend. 6) The verification method is effective, and compared with other methods, the optimal prediction method is obtained. The invention considers the interaction of the emotion of the user and the propagation of the rumors, and agrees with the propagation of the rumors in the social network. The method predicts the transmission of rumor events by analyzing rumors, controls the transmission of rumors in real time, and reduces the transmission of rumors.

title_en: Source side electric carbon space-time coupling electric carbon emission tracing method, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of carbon metering of power systems, in particular to a source side electricity carbon space-time coupling electricity carbon emission tracing method, equipment and medium, which are used for constructing a multidimensional reference model by fusing power grid topology, generator fuel characteristics and real-time output data; the method comprises the steps of decoupling electric energy transmission and carbon propagation paths based on admittance matrixes, distributing carbon emission space distribution through tide calculation, correcting carbon emission factors in real time to capture transient characteristics, breaking static factor limitation, fusing tide distribution and dynamic factors, calculating load nodes to directly/indirectly contribute to carbon emission by adopting a power flow proportion recursion mechanism, generating dynamic carbon flow distribution patterns and traceability decision reports by connecting real-time data, accurately identifying key carbon conduction paths and responsibility main bodies, providing verifiable decision basis for low-carbon transformation, carbon transaction and scheduling optimization, and improving timeliness and operability of carbon management.

title_en: Method for predicting short-term power output of offshore floating type photovoltaic field
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for predicting short-term power output of an offshore floating type photovoltaic field, which comprises the steps of analyzing meteorological characteristic factors of a complex environment where the offshore floating type photovoltaic field is located, screening out main meteorological characteristics affecting offshore photovoltaic power generation as model input, establishing a power prediction model based on a BP neural network to predict output power of the floating type photovoltaic field, training the BP neural network through an error propagation rule based on a gradient descent method, considering an initial weight sensitivity problem existing in the BP neural network prediction model, establishing a PSO-BP prediction model based on the fact that the structure of the BP neural network prediction model is unchanged through a PSO algorithm, optimizing weights through global optimization, and finally evaluating and verifying the method provided by the invention, so that feasibility of the method is verified. The method can accurately predict the power output of the offshore floating photovoltaic field, and has certain guiding significance for photovoltaic grid connection and stable field operation.
assignees: UNIV TIANJIN TECHNOLOGY;NORTH CHINA BRANCH OF CHINA POWER CONSTRUCTION NEW ENERGY GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Enterprise risk assessment method based on multi-agent risk assessment algorithm MA-ERC
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of data evaluation, and discloses an enterprise risk evaluation method based on a multi-agent risk evaluation algorithm MA-ERC, which comprises the following steps of S1, constructing an enterprise multidimensional risk knowledge graph; S2, designing a risk assessment algorithm MA-ERC to assess initial risks of enterprises and quantify propagation risk values among the enterprises, S3, constructing an MNF-GNN model to carry out enterprise risk assessment, S4, constructing an enterprise risk assessment interpretable graph EG, combining a multi-agent architecture based on a large language model with a graph-based risk propagation algorithm to simulate the risk propagation process among the enterprises more accurately and reasonably, wherein the calculated propagation risk values can effectively improve the assessment precision of the risk assessment model, and a new idea is provided for the technical combination of the multi-agent architecture based on the large language model, a knowledge graph, a graph neural network and the like.

title_en: Dynamic safety evaluation system of electric power facility based on blasting vibration propagation characteristics
abstract_en: The invention provides an electric power facility dynamic safety evaluation system based on blasting vibration propagation characteristics, which relates to the field of electric digital data processing and comprises a sensing and data acquisition module, a physical modeling and parameter library module, a real-time evaluation and risk inference module and a feedback execution and self-adaption module, wherein the sensing and data acquisition module is used for converting on-site physical signals into high-quality data streams, the physical modeling and parameter library module is used for providing construction physical modeling and management parameter information, the real-time evaluation and risk inference module is used for mapping sensing data into system states and risk indexes through observation-model assimilation, the feedback execution and self-adaption module is responsible for driving decision execution, collecting feedback and continuously improving a system model, the system can monitor the influence of blasting vibration on an electric power facility in real time, accurately evaluate the damage degree of a structure and the running risk of the system, and provide scientific basis for safety protection and emergency decision of the electric power facility.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Multistage cascade wireless fire-fighting system linkage communication path optimization method
abstract_en: The application provides a multistage cascade wireless fire control system linkage communication path optimization method, relates to the technical field of fire alarm, and solves the technical problems that a multistage cascade star network issued fire control linkage control command path is complex and the total communication times are large in the prior art. The method comprises the steps of carrying out upward recursion statistics on linkage node numbers of each node in a communication network when a fire-fighting component to be linked exists under a wireless gateway, calculating path efficiency scores of all potential public ancestor nodes based on the linkage node numbers, selecting the potential public ancestor node with the highest score as the public ancestor node, packaging data packets according to the public ancestor node, sending the data packets to a lower node by using a wireless controller, continuing to send the data packets to sub-nodes of the lower node, clearing the linkage node numbers of the wireless gateway nodes corresponding to the packaged data packets, updating the linkage node numbers of all nodes on a path upwards, and repeating the steps until all the components to be linked are processed.
assignees: BENGBU EI FIRE ELECTRONICS CO LTD

title_en: Time-based approaches in malware simulation for responsive measure deployment
abstract_en: A computer-implemented method of simulating the propagation of malware in a network is provided. The method comprises accessing a model of the network, where the model comprising a plurality of computer nodes and where each computer node of the plurality of computer nodes is connected to at least one edge of a plurality of edges. Each edge of the plurality of edges connects a pair of computer nodes of the plurality of computer nodes. The method further comprises initiating an outbreak of the malware in the model at a predetermined source computer node of the plurality of computer nodes, and propagating the malware through the model of the network from the source computer node over a plurality of step-times. The propagation is determined based on a rate of transmission per step-time for each edge, and each step-time of the plurality of step-times corresponds to a temporal point that is universal across the network, such that at each step-time the malware propagation through the network occurs simultaneously for each edge of the plurality of edges according to the rate of transmission per step-time for each edge.

title_en: User notification for service interruption
abstract_en: System and methods for selecting customers to notify of a service interruption or outage are described. A network may receive an interruption notification indicating when a service interruption is to occur. In some examples, the interruption notification may also include a particular set of equipment, such as a base station, that will experience the interruption, such as being taken offline for maintenance or a power outage affecting the base station. A notification module determines which customers will be affected by the service interruption and transmits a notification to the customers, informing the customers of the service interruption.

title_en: Subway passenger flow regulation and control plan compilation method based on demand evolution and flow propagation
abstract_en: The invention provides a subway passenger flow regulation and control plan compiling method based on demand evolution and flow propagation, which comprises the following steps of: fusing multi-source automatic fare collection data, and extracting distribution characteristics of current commuting travel demands; according to the utility perception principle of the commuter on the passenger flow regulation and control measures, constructing a commuter departure time adjustment and trip mode transfer behavior NL model, embedding the NL model into a random user balanced distribution model, and predicting demand evolution characteristics under the passenger flow regulation and control measures; constructing a flow propagation model covering the whole travel link, and calculating the net transport energy utilization rate and the passenger delay balance degree under passenger flow regulation and control measures by using the flow propagation model and the demand evolution characteristics; and constructing a subway line network passenger flow regulation plan double-layer planning model, and outputting an optimal passenger flow regulation plan with balanced transportation energy utilization and delay balance. According to the invention, the influence mechanism of the passenger flow regulation and control measures on the individual behaviors of the commuters is revealed through big data, so that the accurate control of the controlled group scale and the regulation and control effect is realized.

title_en: Prediction algorithm for residual service life of aero-engine with convolution memory residual error self-attention mechanism
abstract_en: An aviation engine remaining service life prediction algorithm of a convolution memory residual error self-attention mechanism. The identification method comprises the following steps: preprocessing the sensor data of the aircraft engine, extracting the bottom-layer characteristics of the data through a convolutional neural network, correlating the time sequence characteristics by using a long-short-term memory network, carrying out position coding on the characteristics by using a position encoder, retraining the characteristics by using a residual error self-attention mechanism, and finally outputting the result through a full-connection layer. Aiming at the defect of the self-attention mechanism, a double-layer residual error network is introduced to inhibit the diffusivity in the back propagation of an error function, and a deep learning method of the residual self-attention mechanism is provided. The invention provides a residual error self-attention mechanism, which can effectively optimize a weight matrix, further constructs an aero-engine residual life service algorithm of the convolution memory residual error self-attention mechanism and has a promoting effect on aero-engine state monitoring.

title_en: Universal spacecraft heuristic time planning modeling and solving method
abstract_en: The invention provides a general spacecraft heuristic time planning modeling and solving method, which is characterized in that the general spacecraft model and mathematical expression thereof are provided by fully combining the characteristics and actual requirements of a space engineering task, a time constraint and an energy constraint of the spacecraft inspection detection state transition are represented by a time network structure diagram, constraint propagation and problem solving are carried out on the network structure diagram by adopting a forward pruning strategy, and the problem relaxation of a heuristic control function based on the maximum time span is designed and realized so as to improve the solving efficiency. The field model constructed by the method is more complete in expression, the complexity of planning solving and calculating is reduced by adopting a temporal network structure diagram technology, and the complexity of algorithm design is greatly simplified.

title_en: Risk transfer method for cascade hydropower junction group
abstract_en: The invention discloses a step hydroelectric junction group risk transfer method, which comprises the steps of drawing a step hydroelectric junction group risk network diagram aiming at different step compositions of a step hydroelectric junction group; based on the cascade hydroelectric junction group risk network diagram, constructing a graph neural network model, and establishing a risk transfer calculation method between different risk nodes and edges; acquiring historical water level, flow, gradient and intensity data of each step of a step hydropower junction group in a research area, and converting related data into dimensionless data serving as a graph neural network training data set; and (3) giving scenes of different water levels, flow rates and gradients, and calculating by using a graph neural network model to obtain risk values of all network nodes. The method fully digs the interaction relation of different levels of the cascade hydroelectric junction group and multiple elements in the levels, and solves the problem of insufficient consideration of the traditional risk analysis method on the interaction between factors.

title_en: Method and system for path analysis and risk identification of water infiltration outside hydropower station grotto group
abstract_en: The invention provides a path analysis and risk identification method and a system for water infiltration outside a hydropower station cavern group, which dynamically simulate the propagation path of water flow by establishing a catchment network model of the underground cavern group, the risk of external water infiltration is comprehensively evaluated, the water flow path is displayed, and comprehensive path analysis and risk identification of external water infiltration of a complex underground cavern group are realized. The method effectively solves the problems that the result of risk assessment of water seepage of the hydropower station cavern group is low in accuracy, the propagation path and the sweep range of the water flow are difficult to predict accurately, provides a scientific water flow management and protection scheme for the hydropower station, provides scientific technical support for seepage prevention design, risk management and emergency response of the hydropower station underground plant, and has strong engineering practical significance.

title_en: Recommendation engine for a cognitive reservoir system
abstract_en: Implementations described and claimed herein provide systems and methods for developing a reservoir. In one implementation, a reservoir model is received. The reservoir model includes a static model and a dynamic model. The static model includes one or more clusters of a three-dimensional volume of the reservoir and an uncertainty quantification generated using a neural network. The dynamic model includes pressure values and fluid saturation values propagated across the three-dimensional volume through a nodal connectivity of neighboring clusters. A set of input features is generated from the static model and the dynamic model. The set of input features is related to a drilling attractiveness of a target region of the reservoir using a set of rules executed by a fuzzy inference engine. A quantification of the drilling attractiveness is generated. A recommendation for drilling in the reservoir is output based on the quantification of the drilling attractiveness.

title_en: Power distribution network islanding method base on PCNN
abstract_en: The invention belongs to a power distribution network islanding method base on PCNN, belonging to the islanding filed of a power distribution network including DGs. In order to solve the problems of slow islanding speed and small power supply scope when a current power distribution network with DGs performs islanding, the invention provides a delay PCNN (DPCNN) model, fully utilizes the characteristics of zero pulse attenuation and parallel propagation of PCNN, employs each DG as a root nerve cell and performs search simultaneously, thereby greatly reducing the storage of temporary data, increasing an operation speed and meanwhile enlarging a power supply scope. The algorithm of the invention can divide islands more rapidly compared with other algorithms, and obtain more accurate schemes which are closer to reality in engineering and possess higher operationality.

title_en: Method and device for evaluating influence of electrified railway on power grid
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a device for evaluating the influence of an electrified railway on a power grid. The method comprises the following steps of: utilizing an element negative sequence equivalent model, a negative sequence current source equivalent model and a regional power grid structure parameter to establish a regional power grid simulation model; utilizing a simulation model to establish a mathematical equivalent circuit which carries out propagation when negative sequence voltage and current components pass through a power transmission line, a transformer and a circuit branch, and solving propagation coefficients according to the mathematical equivalent circuit; utilizing the propagation coefficients of the power transmission line, the branch circuit and the transformer of a practical power grid as well as negative sequence voltage and current injected into a point of common coupling by a known electrified railway to obtain the negative sequence voltage and current of each load node in an adjacent power grid; taking the negative sequence voltage and current of different busbar power supply regions of an adjacent single transformer substation of a traction substation as evaluation objects to establish an electric energy quality comprehensive evaluation model for evaluating the negative sequence influence of the regional power grid; and utilizing the electric energy quality comprehensive evaluation model to evaluate the influence of the electrified railway on the power grid.
assignees: NORTH CN ELEC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID JIBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV BEIJING JIAOTONG;STATE GRID JIBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD CHENGDE POWER SUPPLY CO;ZHANGJIAKOU POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID JINBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: A kind of water levels of upstream and downstream prediction technique of step hydropower station
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of water levels of upstream and downstream prediction techniques of step hydropower station, it includes the following steps：Step 1, input variable and output variable are chosen；Step 2, data are standardized, eliminate the influence of dimension；Step 3, input vector dimension, the LSTM numbers of plies, output vector dimension and time step are determined；Step 4, the propagated forward process and error back propagation process of LSTM；Spacer step sequentially inputs LSTM networks to propagated forward process on time, obtains corresponding output valve；Using output valve and the error sum of squares of actual value as loss function, carries out error and carry out undated parameter along time reversal propagation；Step 5, it is continuously predicted with trained model progress more moment.LSTM is applied in the water level forecast of step hydropower station, can capture upstream power station influences information to the hysteresis quality of lower station, improves precision of prediction, relatively reliable theory support is provided for the scheduling decision of science.
