title_en: Rumor propagation time-varying network model construction method and system
abstract_en: The application relates to a time-varying network model construction method, a time-varying network model construction system and a rumor propagation time-varying network model construction method, which belong to the technical field of time-varying network model research, wherein a two-dimensional grid network with the node number of N and L is set, node spacing and accumulated edge connection times sum are obtained on the basis of the space coordinates of nodes and the edge connection condition of each moment node, the edge connection preference probability of each moment active node is obtained by combining the node spacing and the accumulated edge connection times sum, and the time-varying network model is obtained by performing edge connection on the basis of the edge connection preference probability of each moment active node; by utilizing the time-varying network model construction method, a node information acquisition module, a preference probability acquisition module, an instantaneous network model forming module and a time-varying network model generating module are obtained, so that a time-varying network model construction system is obtained; and a construction method for obtaining a rumor propagation time-varying network model. Compared with the related art, the method has the effect of reducing the limitation of the time-varying network model to a certain extent.

title_en: Cascading failure evolution mode identification method and system considering influence of prevention and control measures
abstract_en: The invention provides a cascading failure evolution mode identification method and a system considering the influence of prevention and control measures, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining running state information of a power grid and obtaining the prevention and control measures after failure; taking the prevention and control measures into consideration, screening out high-probability cascading failures caused by the current failures, and calculating the risk value of the high-probability cascading failures to obtain a high-risk cascading failure set; and taking the high-risk cascading failure set as a sequence, and identifying a key evolution mode in the sequence based on pattern mining of prefix projection. Aiming at the power output adjustment, direct current modulation and load shedding measures of the generator, a planning model is established, and the model can rapidly give out an optimal power grid prevention and control strategy; calculating and sequencing cascading failure risks, and finally screening to obtain a high-risk cascading failure set; and the key evolution mode in the high-risk cascade fault set is identified, so that the weak links of the power grid prevention and control can be effectively identified. The invention considers the influence of the prevention and control measures on the cascading failure and can obviously reduce the risk value.

title_en: DC multi-grid peak shaving model for cascade hydropower station group
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of hydropower dispatching operation, in particular to a DC multi-grid peak shaving model of a cascade hydropower station group, which is a multi-grid cascade short-term peak shaving dispatching model taking DC operation constraint and hydropower and DC coupling operation constraint into consideration. The model aims at the minimum maximum value of residual loads of multiple power grids, and considers the operation constraint of a complex high-voltage direct-current transmission line and the operation coupling constraint between the direct-current line and a hydropower station. In the model solving stage, the model is converted into a mixed integer programming model through objective function linearization, hydropower operation constraint linearization and direct current operation constraint linearization. The result of the research of a giant hydropower station group in southwest areas of China is taken as an example, and shows that the model can utilize the flexibility of sharing hydropower by a high-voltage direct-current transmission line, realize multi-grid peak regulation, ensure that the direct-current transmission line runs in a safe interval, and has better practicability.

title_en: Supply chain network optimization method and equipment based on risk classification propagation and dynamic recovery
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of supply chain management and risk control, and particularly relates to a supply chain network optimization method based on risk grading propagation and dynamic recovery, which provides a supply chain risk propagation and recovery model based on a complex network theory and an optimization method thereof, wherein a supply chain model based on a supply chain network topology structure is firstly constructed, a supply chain network topology structure G= (V, E) is formed by N nodes and E edges, and each node represents an enterprise in a supply chain network; and simulating risks of each enterprise in the supply chain by using a supply chain model, and optimizing the enterprises in the supply chain based on simulation results. The method is used for simulating risk propagation dynamics among enterprises and optimizing a network structure, and improves the overall toughness and risk resistance of a supply chain network.

title_en: Method for predicting water demand using Group Method of Data Handling algorithm
title_ko: 지엠디에이치 알고리즘을 이용한 물수요 예측방법
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 통상의 물 수요 예측 방법에 있어서, 수운영 시스템에서 수요변동, 기상여건, 계절별 요인 등에 의하여 통상적인 변동사항을 반영하여 취수장, 정수장 및 가압장을 합리적으로 연계 운영함으로서 안정된 공급량을 확보하기 위해 지엠디에이치 알고리즘을 활용한 물 수요예측의 지능형 모델을 구축하는 단계, 지능형 모델을 토대로 지엠디에이치 모델기반 예측제어 기법을 활용하여 예측대상의 물수요를 산출하는 수요예측 소프트웨어를 상위 컴퓨터에 구성하는 단계, 수운영 시스템의 호스트 컴퓨터, 기상정보를 가지고 있는 데이터베이스 등과 LAN 네트워크를 통해 연결하는 단계, 수요예측 소프트웨어는 시스템으로부터 수집된 운영 데이터, 기상 DB의 데이터를 토대로 역전파 학습 알고리즘을 이용하여 수요예측 지엠디에이치 모델을 구축하는 단계 및 지능형 모델로부터 지엠디에이치 모델기반 예측제어 알고리즘을 이용하여 현재의 수요 및 기상 상태에서의 예측 수요량을 결정하는 단계로 이루어진 것을 특징으로 하는 지엠디에이치 알고리즘을 이용한 물수요 예측방법을 제공한다.

title_en: Emergemcy reacting safety guidance lamp system
title_ko: 위급상황 대응이 가능한 시선 유도등 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A guidance lamp system for dealing with an emergency is provided to recognize an emergency and implement a control operation accurately. CONSTITUTION: A guidance lamp system for dealing with an emergency comprises a management unit(110), a main controller(210,220), and a complex guide lamp(211,221). The management unit is installed in a management block(100) to provide a control command to the complex guide lamp and transmit and receive information about the result of the control command or an error. The main controller is installed inside a tunnel(200) and provided with power from a separate AC power line(201), and the main controller controls of the complex guide lamp through data communication through a separate control line(202) and The main controller reports an abnormal situation in the abnormal occurrence through a control line or wide-band wireless network to the management unit. The complex guide lamp is managed by the main controller and operated as either a guidance lamp or evacuation guide lamp according to the control.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 터널이나 지하차도 등에 나열식으로 설치하여 진행로를 안내하는 시선 유도등 시스템을 역방향 보고 채널을 포함하여 구성하고 이러한 구성을 통해서 위급상황 발생 시 그 상태의 전파와 대응을 신뢰성 있게 제공할 수 있도록 한 위급상황 대응이 가능한 시선 유도등 시스템에 관한 것으로, 전원라인과 신호라인을 분리 구성하고, 기 설정된 수의 피난 유도등 겸용 시선 유도등을 관리하며 상기 신호 라인을 통한 유선 및 별도의 무선 통신 기능을 통해 관리부와 복수 채널로 연결된 메인 제어기를 복수로 구성하도록 함으로써 안정적인 이상 상황 파악과 명확한 개별 제어 동작 및 위급 상황 시 시선 유도등을 피난 유도등으로 활용할 수 있도록 하여 기 구성된 시선 유도등 시스템의 활용성을 높이고 터널 내 안정성을 높일 수 있는 효과가 있다.
assignees: DOMYEONG D & AMP E CO LTD

title_en: Probabilistic model for cyber risk forecasting
abstract_en: A system and method are presented for forecasting the risk of cyber-attacks on targeted networks. The described technology quantifies linear and non-linear damages to network-dependent assets by propagating probabilistic distributions of events in sequence and time in order to forecast damages over specified periods. Damage-forecasts are used to estimate probabilistically time-varying financial losses for cyber-attacks. The described technology incorporates quantities and dependencies for pricing insurance, re-insurance, and self-insurance, assessing cost-benefit tradeoffs for sequenced implementation of security control measures, and detecting attacks in the targeted network.

title_en: A kind of online grid cascading failure analysis method and device based on major issue driving
abstract_en: The present invention relates to it is a kind of based on major issue driving online grid cascading failure analysis method and device, the method includes：Obtain the prediction flow data of each element in power grid；The prediction stoppage in transit probability of each element in power grid is determined according to the prediction flow data of element each in power grid；The major issue of cascading failure whether occurs according to the prediction flow data of element each in the power grid and prediction stoppage in transit probabilistic determination power grid；If so, the cascading failure path according to the current stoppage in transit probabilistic search power grid of element each in power grid；If it is not, then according to the prediction flow data of element each in the power grid and predict that stoppage in transit probability rejudges the major issue whether power grid occurs cascading failure.Cascading failure analysis is carried out to power grid based on major issue driving, prevention and control measure can be carried out to power grid using chain path analysis result, enhance the monitoring capacity of grid equipment stoppage in transit risk.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: A kind of power information physics emerging system safety situation evaluation method
abstract_en: A kind of power information physics emerging system safety situation evaluation method, the described method comprises the following steps: a. is according to the importance update abnormal point set of abnormal point: b. calculates threat propagation desired value；C. electric power CPS risk assessment；Threat propagation tree is generated by threat propagation tree create-rule；The desired value that all effective heat source nodes are constituted a threat in threat propagation tree is calculated, networks security situation assessment value is obtained.The present invention devises the real-time joint-detection system towards security threats all kinds of in electric power CPS, propose the threat situation evaluation system based on intelligent assessment algorithm, effectively improve the identification capability to all kinds of high-risk security threats occurred in real time in electric power CPS, it realizes and the macroscopic view of electric power CPS operation conditions is judged, strengthen the purpose for all kinds of high-risk security threat safeguard procedures, facilitate the operation conditions for improving electric power CPS from whole level, ensures its safe and stable operation.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO INFORMATION & TELECOMMUNICATION BRANCH;NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER UNIV BAODING

title_en: Photovoltaic module fault diagnosis method, system and equipment based on deep convolution countermeasure network
abstract_en: The invention provides a photovoltaic module fault diagnosis method for generating a countermeasure network by deep convolution, which comprises the following steps: establishing a mathematical model of the photovoltaic module; acquiring a fault image of the photovoltaic component; setting partial fault data as training samples; constructing a training model of a deep convolution countermeasure network; a generator G inputs a noise vector and outputs a pseudo image through a deconvolution layer; inputting a real sample and a pseudo sample by a discriminator D, extracting convolution characteristics through convolution operation, and obtaining the probability of the real sample; optimizing weight parameters through a back propagation algorithm, then starting the next cycle, and outputting a test image every 300 cycles; and inputting the real sample and the obtained test sample into a classifier, classifying the fault types, and realizing fault diagnosis. According to the fault diagnosis method, a large number of fault images are generated by utilizing the deep convolutional network, and a fault image database is expanded, so that the classification of faults is more detailed, and the diagnosis of the faults is more accurate.

title_en: Analysis method for fault propagation of urban rail train system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a fault propagation analysis method of an urban rail train system based on a disaster spreading propagation dynamics model, which comprises the following steps: step S110, constructing a topological network model of the urban rail train system; step S120, dividing a network community structure for the urban rail train system according to the topological network model of the urban rail train system; step S130, determining the service life distribution and the fault probability of each node in the topological network of the urban rail train system; step S140: and establishing a fault propagation model of the urban rail train system based on a disaster spreading propagation dynamic model by combining the network community structure of the urban rail train system and the fault probability of the node, and analyzing the possible fault propagation state of the urban rail train system.

title_en: Multi-parameter joint prediction method based on grid neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a grid neural network-based multi-parameter joint prediction method, which comprises the following steps: step 1, normalizing K-order measurement points by a dispersion standardization method to obtain a data representation X; step 2, extracting prediction parameters of X through an LSTM network, wherein the LSTM is trained by adopting a counter-propagation algorithm along time, h t‑k For implicit expression, including And the hidden state of the previous layer being used as the next layerInputting to form a prediction characteristic depth excavation structure; step 3, adjusting the weight of an output layer of the feedforward neural network by taking the incidence relation among the characteristic quantities extracted in the step 2 as an initial parameter, taking the feedforward neural network as a reasoning prediction layer, and outputting a prediction result; and 4, testing the state quantity of the future moment in the test set according to the prediction parameters obtained by the training data, and verifying the prediction precision. The invention can monitor the running state of the power equipment by using the multivariate data collected on line.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Electric power information physical system robustness analysis method based on reachable matrix
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for analyzing robustness of a power information physical system based on a reachable matrix, which comprises the following steps: inputting an adjacency matrix Ep of a power grid, an adjacency matrix Ec of an information grid and a dependency matrix Epc between the power grid and the information grid; determining attack nodes in the power grid, wherein the attack nodes are starting points of fault propagation, deleting fault nodes appearing in the adjacent matrixes Ep and Ec after the fault propagation based on the dependency matrixes Epc, and outputting the adjacent matrixes Ep, the adjacent matrixes Ec and the dependency matrixes Epc; updating the dependency matrix Epc, and forming an augmented adjacency matrix after attack based on the adjacency matrix Ep, the adjacency matrix Ec and the updated dependency matrix Epc; and calculating the system robustness index after the attack based on the augmented adjacency matrix. The method can reduce the modeling complexity of the mutual coupling network, clearly and intuitively express the structural characteristic change and the dynamics rule of the network connection in the system, reduce the complexity of the attack graph, and facilitate the understanding and analysis of security personnel.

title_en: Distributed computing method for collaborative perception of intelligent agent cluster situation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed computing method for collaborative awareness of an agent cluster situation. The algorithm comprises a method for confirming an information source, information transmission and cooperation; exciting dynamic construction of propagated attribute state values based on events and their types; and (3) designing a hybrid modulation process with mutual influences among attribute states. The essence of group situation collaborative perception is a process of dimension reduction-transmission-restoration of surrounding environment information, an individual firstly determines the source of battlefield dynamic information, screens main information, describes an emergency by using dimension reduction compression means, then carries out information transmission and cross verification through a local network structure of a cluster, and finally uses the received dimension reduction information to reevaluate and draw an information map of the individual. The algorithm of the invention is similar to the mechanism of biological hormone regulation and control and nerve information transmission, and provides a calculation method capable of carrying out dimension reduction processing on complex situation information and local cooperation of an intelligent agent under the condition of regional refusal of low communication.

title_en: Knowledge graph-based illegal risk prediction method for marketing enterprises
abstract_en: The invention discloses a knowledge graph-based method for predicting illegal risks of a marketing enterprise, which comprises the steps of constructing an enterprise associated party hypergraph and a Hyper-GNN hypergraph representation learning model, and incorporating risk assimilation factors of an enterprise associated party cluster into enterprise illegal predictions; improving a graph transfer algorithm propagation mechanism, defining an illegal risk diffusion range by adopting a community division algorithm, introducing enterprise benefit association closeness and a probabilistic mechanism into a graph migration algorithm, simulating graph migration paths of simulation propagation of bad risk sources among enterprises, and accurately evaluating the illegal risk degree of suspicious enterprises by means of convergence trend after deep iteration of the graph transfer algorithm; and designing a Legal-GNN neural network, fusing enterprise risk features with enterprise associated party cluster features, enhancing the difference between sparse suspicious enterprise node features and large-scale Legal enterprise node features, weakening the feature similarity degree when nodes are embedded and represented, and improving the discrimination precision of a prediction model to illegal enterprises.

title_en: SVR-SMA-based alternating current-direct current series-parallel power grid cascading failure prediction and early warning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an alternating current-direct current series-parallel power grid cascading failure prediction and early warning method based on SVR-SMA, and belongs to the technical field of safety and stability analysis of power systems. The method comprises the following steps: screening out a cascading failure characterization variable from electric data acquired by an alternating current/direct current multi-feed cascading failure receiving end power grid, and taking the cascading failure characterization variable as an input quantity of a prediction model; the coordinated optimization algorithm based on the SMA and the SVR is provided, the punishment parameter C of the SVR and the bandwidth sigma of the Gaussian kernel function are optimized through an SMA random search strategy, and an alternating current-direct current series-parallel power grid cascading failure prediction model is established; through the position relation between the normal voltage of the li-clear converter bus and the fault hyperplane and the predicted value, the cascading fault online early warning method is provided. The cascading failure early warning method and the prediction system can be used for simulating the failure condition of each converter station when the important alternating current line of the alternating current/direct current multi-feed receiving end power grid fails, and have the accuracy and the rapidness required by engineering practice.

title_en: Influence blocking maximization algorithm based on overlapping interest community detection
abstract_en: The invention provides an influence blocking maximization algorithm based on overlapping interest community detection. The method comprises a competition propagation model considering multiple factors and an algorithm based on the model and overlapping interest community detection, and is used for modeling a multi-information competition propagation process and selecting active information seed nodes in a social network. The modeling of the competition propagation process and the blocking of influence maximization are hot spots of social network analysis, the traditional model is expanded based on IC and LT, the actual propagation process is difficult to accurately describe, the traditional community-based algorithm divides communities based on a topological structure, and user interest preference is ignored. The method comprehensively considers the interest preference of the users, the information interaction time delay and the trust degree between the users, can better model the competition propagation process, expands the traditional community concept to the interest communities, improves the community detection accuracy, and guides the selection of the active information seed nodes through overlapping the interest community structure so as to achieve the expected negative information influence blocking effect in a short time.

title_en: Lightning stroke fault prediction protection method and system for primary equipment of new energy power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lightning stroke fault prediction protection method and system for primary equipment of a new energy power system, wherein the method comprises the following steps of constructing a monitoring network to obtain cloud/ground flash data, meteorological data and equipment parameters; the lightning stroke transient simulation method comprises the steps of constructing a lightning stroke space-time distribution prediction model, generating a regional lightning stroke probability thermodynamic diagram based on cloud/ground flash data and meteorological data, constructing a fusion model, receiving the regional lightning stroke probability thermodynamic diagram, equipment parameters and historical fault data, generating lightning stroke risk grades of each primary equipment, determining high-risk equipment according to a set threshold value, constructing a digital twin lightning stroke transient simulation model, calculating to obtain an overvoltage propagation path and identifying an insulation weak point, and generating an optimized lightning arrester configuration scheme through a multi-target genetic algorithm model. The prediction precision and the protection efficiency of the lightning stroke faults of the new energy power system are improved.
assignees: HUANENG QINBEI POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Shallow tunnel blasting earth surface vibration waveform prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for predicting surface vibration waveforms of shallow tunnel blasting, which relate to the technical field of surface vibration waveform prediction and comprise the steps of collecting geological, blasting and environmental parameters of historical and current blasting, and forming a standardized parameter set through three-level index storage, outlier screening and standardization treatment; the method comprises the steps of establishing a mapping relation between blasting parameters and a time domain sequence of a vibration waveform based on an LSTM neural network, predicting the current blasting vibration waveform, fusing a geological condition influence factor, an environment sensitivity influence factor and predicted waveform characteristics to generate a comprehensive safety evaluation index, dividing risks into four levels of safety, low risk, medium risk and high risk according to a matching result of the index and a multi-level safety threshold, and executing differential control to realize accurate prediction and dynamic regulation of blasting vibration risks. The invention can accurately simulate the propagation process of vibration waves in the blasting construction of the shallow tunnel, thereby better evaluating the influence of blasting.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY FIRST GROUP CO;THE SEVENTH ENG CO LTD OF CHINA RAILWAY FIRST GROUP;CHINA RAILWAY FIRST GROUP MUNICIPAL ENVIRONMENTAL PROT ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Power plant carbon footprint accounting space-time data compression and anomaly detection recovery method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power plant carbon footprint calculation space-time data compression and anomaly detection recovery method, which comprises the steps of inputting a correlation network diagram and a carbon emission space-time data sequence into an anomaly detection recovery model, extracting time characteristics of the space-time data sequence and space characteristics of power plant nodes in the correlation network diagram, constructing the time characteristics and the space characteristics into space-time fusion characteristics, modeling a dynamic matrix for describing high-order dynamic correlation relations among the nodes in a time window where the space-time data sequence is located, performing high-order graph convolution propagation on each time step of the space-time fusion characteristics based on the dynamic matrix to obtain a dynamic graph convolution sequence, decoupling trend components and disturbance components of the dynamic graph convolution sequence, respectively compressing and reconstructing the trend components and the disturbance components, fusing the trend components and the disturbance components to obtain fusion reconstruction characteristics, processing the fusion reconstruction characteristics to obtain a reconstructed carbon emission data sequence and data outliers, and repairing the data outliers by using the reconstructed carbon emission data sequence.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INST OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Electromagnetic radiation array applied to emergency rescue
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of electromagnetic radiation and antenna arrays, in particular to an electromagnetic radiation array applied to emergency rescue, which comprises a Butler matrix of a substrate integrated waveguide, wherein the Butler matrix is formed by cascading a plurality of hybrid couplers, fixed phase shifters and cross couplers, and input ports and output ports of the Butler matrix are interconnected through non-cross waveguide transmission lines. The application is based on the optimized substrate integrated waveguide Butler matrix, obviously reduces the insertion loss and crosstalk of a feed network through port rearrangement and non-intersecting wiring, effectively solves the core problems of weak anti-interference capability, short communication distance and limited network capacity in the traditional emergency communication system, and is suitable for reliable communication and detection tasks of unmanned aerial vehicles or ground mobile platforms in complex emergency environments.
assignees: CHENGDU POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Line vulnerability index-based large power grid strategic channel dynamic identification method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for dynamically identifying strategic channels of a large power grid based on line vulnerability indexes, which comprises the steps of obtaining power grid line information and establishing a reliability model of a line; calculating the vulnerability index of the line; and dynamically identifying strategic channels of the large power grid. According to the method, the line operation reliability model considering meteorological geographic factors and line tide is adopted, so that the line fault probability of dynamic change under different geographic positions, different weather conditions and different load levels can be calculated; for the lines with lower cascading failure probability of the trigger system, quickly calculating and sequencing according to the weighted vulnerability indexes provided by the text; compared with the vulnerability index based on the load rate entropy, the vulnerability index based on the load rate variance is more sensitive and visual, and the physical significance is very clear.

title_en: Low-voltage distribution network cascading failure early warning method based on risk assessment model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-voltage distribution network cascading failure early warning method based on a risk assessment model, which comprises the following steps: data acquisition and processing: collecting load data, weather data and fault data of the low-voltage power distribution network, and preprocessing the collected data; fault feature selection: adopting an improved G-ReliefF algorithm to optimally select fault characteristics of the low-voltage distribution network; and (5) cascading failure search: carrying out subsequent fault searching according to the line shutdown model and the key line model, generating an accident chain and evaluating the accident chain; fault early warning: and calculating risk assessment coefficients of the elements and the lines, determining the occurrence probability of the faults through the risk assessment coefficients, and finally carrying out comprehensive risk assessment on the faults to calculate risk grades. The method is used for predicting and mastering the safe running state of the low-voltage power distribution network, finding potential danger and judging the fault development trend so as to improve the accuracy of fault early warning and further avoid large-area power failure.

title_en: Intelligent water affair integrated platform mass data intelligent analysis processing and decision support method based on GIS and Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of operation and maintenance of water service management networks, in particular to an intelligent water service integrated platform mass data intelligent analysis processing and decision support method based on GIS and the Internet of things, which constructs a pressure anomaly propagation map and corrects a hydraulic model by marking pipe explosion monitoring points and generating an initial influence domain, reversely tracking upstream nodes, the method is used for solving the problems of large estimation deviation of the traditional pipe explosion influence range and lack of accuracy of the valve closing instruction, improving the pipe explosion emergency response efficiency, reducing the water resource waste, guaranteeing the water supply stability and being suitable for urban water affair fine management.

title_en: System and method for dynamic deployable wireless services
abstract_en: A system and method for intelligently and dynamically deploying a plurality of mobile robotic machines capable of carrying out a complex series of actions automatically to propagate wireless network connectivity comprising, at least, a mechanical framework, sensors, actuators, communications capability, an energy source, a propulsion means, a control mechanism, and a payload. The payload may comprise electronic or mechanical communication equipment to propagate services such as wireless networking services, in for example, a first responder or emergency environment, or electronic and mechanical jamming services in a military or anti-terrorism environment.

title_en: A kind of power grid Rainfall Disaster Risk Forecast Method, system and storage medium
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the meteorological disaster technical field of electric system, a kind of power grid Rainfall Disaster Risk Forecast Method, system and storage medium are disclosed；To mitigate the Rainfall Disaster that transmission line of electricity is subjected to, ability and the safe and stable operation for improving transmission line of electricity reply Rainfall Disaster are horizontal, achieve the purpose that initiative is strong, degree of intelligence is high, have a wide range of application；The present invention initializes the parameter value of limited Boltzmann machine algorithm according to training sample data collection, repetition learning and undated parameter value, the convergence for meeting training sample data collection to limited Boltzmann machine algorithm verifies the precision of prediction E of limited Boltzmann machine algorithm by verifying sample data set avg If precision of prediction E avg It is not presetting within precision, is then continuing undated parameter, until meeting precision of prediction；The power grid Rainfall Disaster prediction model based on back-propagation algorithm is further established, is finally adjusted according to parameter of the back-propagation algorithm to power grid Rainfall Disaster prediction model, and obtain Rainfall Disaster risk forecast model.
assignees: State grid hunan electric power co ltd;DISASTER PREVENTION DISASTER MITIGATION CENTER OF STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Cascade hydropower station optimal scheduling system and method and safety power grid system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optimized dispatching system and method for a cascade hydropower station and a safety power grid system, wherein the optimized dispatching method comprises the following steps: carrying out preliminary calculation on each power station of the cascade power station group through the predicted warehousing flow condition and the planned output of each power station of the cascade power station group to obtain the state of the cascade power station group; traversing the state sequence of each power station of the cascade power station group according to the time sequence, finishing the calculation of the scheduling time period if the state of the current time period of the cascade power station group meets the set requirement, and carrying out water abandoning risk assessment according to the length of the pre-abandoning time and carrying out output adjustment on the current time period if the state of the current time period of the cascade power station group does not meet the set requirement. By the scheme provided by the invention, under the condition that each power station of the cascade meets the integral operation optimization of the cascade in the whole scheduling process, the water abandoning risk is balanced, the water abandoning is relatively reasonable, the cascade hydroelectric operation is optimized, and the cascade hydroelectric energy resource is fully utilized.

title_en: Urban village risk assessment and risk factor positioning method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for risk assessment and risk factor positioning of urban villages based on deep learning, which comprises the steps of searching various risk accidents by using a crowd sensing technology, clustering each risk accident, taking the risk accident exceeding a threshold value as a risk hotspot, and acquiring risk hotspot situation data according to the urban village risk hotspot, wherein the risk hotspot situation data comprises urban village level situation data and scene level situation data; extracting the characteristics of the urban village level scenes from the urban village level scene data, and extracting the characteristics of the scene level scenes from the scene level scene data; inputting the urban village level scene characteristics and the scene level scene characteristics into the constructed trained residual error network model, evaluating the urban village risk, and positioning risk factors by adopting a layer-by-layer correlation propagation algorithm; the heterogeneous data fusion is realized, the advantages of high efficiency and low consumption are achieved, and meanwhile, higher accuracy is achieved.

title_en: Active defense method for intelligent power grid cascading failures
abstract_en: The invention discloses an active defense method for intelligent power grid cascading failures, which comprises the following steps: step 1): before disaster generation occurs, the system acquires disaster generation distribution data of the smart grid, which is affected by the smart grid; step 2): the system calculates the failure probability of the grid node or the grid element based on disaster-causing distribution data, and calculates the capacity reduction amount of the equivalent fault effect of the grid node or the element; step 3): the system predictively improves the capacity of the intelligent power grid nodes or elements according to the capacity reduction; step 4): when disaster is caused, the system acquires disaster causing data of the intelligent power grid node and judges whether the power grid node fails or not; step 5): the system executes the sequential fault defense of the power grid node or the power grid element according to the condition of whether the intelligent power grid node or the power grid element fails; the invention has the beneficial effects that: the method can effectively actively defend the cascading failure of the power grid.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECHNICAL RES INSTITUTE STATE GRID SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Intelligent analysis method and terminal for power grid monitoring signals
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent analysis method and a terminal of a power grid monitoring signal, which are characterized in that the power grid monitoring signal is obtained from an original power grid monitoring signal database, the power grid monitoring signal is encoded to obtain an encoded value, the encoded value is clustered by using a neighbor propagation clustering algorithm, the power grid monitoring signal is stored in a classification database according to the obtained clustering result, the power grid monitoring signal is effectively and accurately classified in a mode of encoding before clustering, and a monitoring person can know different types of fault conditions only from the classification database, so that the workload of the monitoring person is reduced, and the power grid monitoring efficiency is effectively improved.
assignees: ZHANGZHOU ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Product configuration changing method based on parameter network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a product configuration changing method based on a parameter network, which is characterized by comprising the following steps: constructing a product parameter information association constraint network model; constructing a change influence propagation mode of a product parameter information association constraint network model; determining a method for calculating the cost of a parameter change scheme, wherein the cost is based on the comprehensive cost of network nodes and is used for evaluating the cost and efficiency of the change scheme; generating a hierarchical tree model of the parameter network; the method is characterized in that a lowest cost driven change scheme decision method is adopted, each potential change scheme is determined according to a hierarchical tree model of the generated parameter network, and a scheme with the lowest cost is selected as a final product change scheme by comparing the costs of different potential change schemes.

title_en: Flexibility optimization scheduling method, system, equipment and medium for cascade small hydroelectric group
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flexibility optimization scheduling method, a system, equipment and a medium of a cascade small hydropower group, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining the rainfall of the cascade small hydropower group and quantifying the flexibility adjustment capacity of a hydropower station system according to the rainfall; quantifying the flexibility requirement of the hydropower station system, and quantifying the flexibility shortage of the hydropower station system in each period according to the flexibility requirement and the flexibility regulating capacity obtained by quantification; respectively carrying out uncertainty modeling on rainfall and net load of a hydropower station system to obtain a rainfall prediction model and a net load uncertainty set; based on the flexibility deficiency, the rainfall prediction model and the net load uncertainty set, an optimal scheduling model of the hydropower station system is constructed, the optimal scheduling model is solved, an optimal scheduling scheme of the hydropower station system is obtained, and a power grid terminal connected with the cascade small hydropower station group is controlled to execute the optimal scheduling scheme, so that the flexibility of the cascade small hydropower station is fully excavated, and the scheduling operation strategy of the hydropower station system is optimized.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV ZHEJIANG;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Communication power supply system evaluation method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an evaluation method and device of a communication power supply system, which relate to the technical field of communication and comprise the steps of collecting dynamic operation data, static configuration parameters and historical maintenance records in real time through a multi-source heterogeneous data collection module; the method comprises the steps of constructing a three-layer risk assessment architecture of a device level, a system level and a subsystem level, calculating subjective weights by adopting an improved fuzzy analytic hierarchy process, deploying an LSTM-GAN hybrid model to generate device degradation simulation data, establishing a deep residual convolution network, constructing a dynamic risk propagation matrix, establishing a virtual mirror image system based on a digital twin technology, generating a three-dimensional visual risk thermodynamic diagram, outputting a customized maintenance scheme, and updating a device health file through a blockchain intelligent contract. Therefore, multidimensional indexes such as voltage ripple, temperature rise rate, equipment aging curve and the like are integrated through the multisource data fusion architecture, and information island is eliminated, so that dynamic information stability under complex working conditions is ensured.
assignees: WEIFANG HANTING DISTR POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Flood avoidance path planning method based on population dynamic distribution and flood inundation risk
abstract_en: The invention provides a flood avoidance path planning method based on population dynamic distribution and flood inundation risk, and relates to the technical field of flood control engineering. The method comprises the steps of acquiring position data of a mobile terminal in real time to determine a population gathering area, analyzing population short-time migration rules, determining population migration leading directions, utilizing historical road blocking events and real-time rainfall monitoring data to construct a road flooding evolution network defining a ponding propagation boundary by combining an urban road drainage pipe network structure, identifying path nodes with traffic conflict risks through space topology analysis, determining a node avoidance sequence according to node communication stability characteristics, and adopting an ant colony search model fused with a local path direction guiding mechanism to achieve precise planning of flood avoidance evacuation paths for avoiding road flooding risk areas, so that instantaneity and reliability of population evacuation path planning under flood disaster situations are effectively improved.

title_en: Step-down mining capacity prediction method of natural gas hydrate by deep neural network
abstract_en: To provide a production capacity prediction method of decompression mining of a natural gas hydrate based on deep neural network.SOLUTION: A method for constructing a neural network model, and training, optimizing, testing and evaluating a model, using existing step-down mining test data of a multi-scale natural gas hydrate includes: collecting and pre-treating step-down mining test data of a multi-scale natural gas hydrate; constructing a deep neural network model including one input layer, three hidden layers and one output layer; optimizing a network parameter through a reverse propagation algorithm; evaluating calculation accuracy of a model using two parameters of a determination coefficient and an average relative error and obtaining a production capacity prediction model having high accuracy and small errors; and predicting production capacity of a step-down mining test of a natural gas hydrate in different scales and mining parameters, by designing and using a production capacity prediction module.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Gradient hydropower station load change real-time self-adaption method considering daily electric quantity deviation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of optimal scheduling of hydropower stations, and relates to a cascade hydropower station load change real-time self-adaption method considering daily electric quantity deviation. Because the power grid load prediction adopted in the power grid day-ahead power generation plan formulation has deviation, in order to realize load balance in actual operation, the power generation plans of partial power stations need to be adjusted in real time according to the change of the power grid load, and cascade hydropower stations are generally used as load balance power stations of the type. The invention adopts three priority criteria of a water abandoning reduction rate relative to the change of the cascade electric quantity, a daily electric quantity deviation rate exceeding the limit and a cascade energy storage improvement rate relative to the change of the cascade electric quantity to determine the output increase and decrease sequence of the cascade power station, and the cascade load increase and decrease in each time period are sequentially distributed according to the sequence. The method can give consideration to the step hydroenergy utilization rate and the power grid requirement, is easier to be accepted by step scheduling departments, and has stronger practicability.

title_en: Smart grid economic dispatching method based on integrated neural network
abstract_en: An intelligent power grid economic dispatching method based on an integrated neural network obtains power generation parameters of a power grid system, wherein the power generation parameters comprise power generation cost functions of all power generators in the system and upper and lower limits of power generator loads; generating a large data set using an existing optimal non-convex optimization algorithm; constructing a deep neural network, named EDNet, by utilizing the current data set, and learning data in the data set by using a back propagation technology so that the output of the network gradually approximates to the output part in the data set; the output of EDNet is finely adjusted by using a fine adjustment algorithm, so that an optimal solution which strictly meets the problem constraint is obtained; sequentially training M EDNet by using an Adaboost.R2 algorithm as a training strategy, and arranging the M EDNet in parallel to form E  2  DNet; the solution with the smallest power generation cost in the M optimal solutions is selected as the optimal solution of the whole integrated network. And E  2  DNet with complete training is put into use, and the economic dispatch problem of the intelligent power grid is processed on line.

title_en: Urban road network toughness measurement method under multi-layer traffic network dependence
abstract_en: The invention discloses an urban road network toughness measurement method under multi-layer traffic network dependence, which comprises the following steps of collecting space vector data of urban roads, subways and public transport networks, mapping different space layer data into a multi-layer network model formed by nodes and edges, gradually removing the road network edges and other traffic network lines connected with the road network edges, drawing a relation curve between road network structure indexes and removal proportions under the support of the connection of the rest different traffic layer networks, and comparing phase change threshold values and disaster tolerance changes of the space structures of the road networks under the support of the different traffic layer networks. The invention builds the interconnection model and the toughness measurement model of the road network and other multi-layer traffic networks, can reveal complex mechanisms of the mutual support and the destructive propagation of the road network and the traffic network, can identify key threshold values and important areas of the road space structure change under the multi-layer traffic support, and provides a technical tool for accurately measuring the toughness of the urban road network.

title_en: Power distribution network information system risk assessment method and system based on graph convolution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a risk assessment method and a risk assessment system for a power distribution network information system based on a graph convolution network, and relates to the technical field of power distribution network information physical systems, wherein the risk assessment method comprises the steps of combining time dynamic characteristics in an LSTM capturing fault propagation process to accurately assess the risk level of node voltage out-of-limit; and under the non-fault condition, the electrical characteristics of the system are learned, the evaluation precision is improved, and the risk evaluation of the information system of the power distribution network is completed. According to the invention, by introducing a combined model based on the graph rolling network GCN and the long-short-term memory network LSTM, the space-time characteristics in the information physical system of the power distribution network can be effectively captured, the risk level of node voltage out-of-limit is accurately estimated, and the accuracy and instantaneity of risk estimation are remarkably improved.

title_en: Hybrid pumping and accumulating optimized scheduling method and system considering peak regulation and risk avoidance
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of multi-objective optimization operation of a hybrid pumping and accumulating water-wind power complementary system, and discloses a hybrid pumping and accumulating optimization scheduling method and system capable of achieving peak regulation and risk avoidance, wherein historical data of a cascade watershed water-wind power station and a power grid load are obtained, scheduling initial data are generated through prediction, scheduling scene data capable of representing new energy uncertainty are generated based on the scheduling initial data and prediction errors, an optimization model is built, the optimization model is solved, scheduling instructions of the cascade watershed hydropower station and the hybrid pumping and accumulating power station are generated based on the solution of the optimization model, collaborative optimization for minimizing the power loss load risk of a hydropower side and meeting the peak regulation requirement of the power grid side is achieved through the optimization model, flexible regulation advantages of the hybrid pumping and accumulating are fully exerted, stable operation and reliability of the system are promoted, the speed and accuracy of the solution are facilitated through linearization processing, the real-time calculation efficiency of the system is guaranteed, and the scheduling decision making is more efficient.

title_en: Sewage purification methods and devices with combined effects by utilizing wetland
title_ko: 복합효과를 얻는 오수의 습지정화 방법 및 장치
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 종래에 수질만 개선하던 각종 오수정화시설에서 각각 수질개선과 환경적 복합효과가 병행되도록 습지를 이용하여 오수를 정화하는 방법 및 장치에 관한 것으로서, 4단계[30,31,50,70]의 습지장치를 구성하는 방법 및 장치와 이를 수질특성과 장치의 이용목적 등에 따라 각종 오수에 적용하도록 2단계 내지 4단계 습지장치로 각각 연계구성하는 방법 및 장치를 제공한다. 
     상기 각 습지장치는 오수의 오염물질을 습지의 동식물로 분해 교환하여 습지생태계의 먹이기초를 생성하고 생태통로로 먹이사슬을 연결하여 뭍에 자연이동하는 방법으로 정화함으로써 먹이사슬을 구성하는 생명체를 복원하고 복원된 생명체의 이동에 의해 활동영역까지 생태적 자정효과를 파급한다. 또한 정화식물에 습지에 서식하는 초목(62,64)이 포함되고 외부 식재 구와 온실의 가지 창에서 각각 외부로 확장하는 녹지로 야생동물의 접근성과 장치의 정화력을 높이고 탄산가스를 수목에 고정 장기간 누적함으로써 에너지자원을 얻고 기후온난화도 완화하도록 작용한다. 
       
     습지장치, 생태적 정화수단, 습지생물, 물질교환, 먹이사슬, 물질이동, 습지 수목(樹木), 외부식재 구, 어도 밸브, 어도 유출 관, 생태통로, 생태창문, 가지 창, 접근녹지, 대피습지

title_en: Gas sensor platform for real-time detection of various toxic chemicals and emergency alert system using thereof
title_ko: 다종 유해 화학물질의 실시간 감지를 위한 가스센서 플랫폼 및 이를 이용한 재난경보 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a gas sensor platform to detect harmful chemical materials in the air. According to the present invention, a problem of gas detectors for an existing technology which is difficult to construct a social safety network to prepare the exposure of the harmful chemical material with a high price is solved without a connecting function through a network capable of detecting the restricted specific chemical material. Provided are a gas sensor platform and a disaster warning system capable of monitoring and detecting various harmful materials in real time with a short analysis time and capable of rapidly spreading information in the occurrence of an accident by including a connecting function through a network, capable of effectively constructing the disaster warning system to prepare the exposure of the harmful chemical material with a cheap price, and capable of detecting the various harmful chemical materials in real time. The gas sensor platform comprises: a sensor array unit including a plurality of sensors to selectively detect various harmful gases; a pre-processing unit to more accurately detect the detection of the sensor array unit by concentrating the harmful gas inserted from the outside; an environment sensor unit to collect and provide information for an external environment including a temperature, a humidity, a wind direction, and a wind speed of an installation position in which the gas sensor platform is installed; a communication unit including a wireless communication module to communicate with the external apparatus; a display unit to display a detecting result of the sensor array unit and an operating state of the gas sensor platform; an input unit to input a setting for an operation or a control command; and a control unit to control the whole operation of the gas sensor platform.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 공기 중의 유해 화학물질을 검출하기 위한 가스센서 플랫폼에 관한 것으로, 본 발명에 따르면, 제한된 특정 화학물질의 검출만이 가능하고 네트워크를 통한 연동기능이 없으면서도 고가격으로 인해 유해 화학물질 누출에 대비한 사회 안전망을 구축하기 어려웠던 종래기술의 가스감지기들의 문제점을 해결하여, 짧은 분석시간을 가지고 다양한 유해물질에 대하여 실시간으로 검출 및 감시가 가능하며, 네트워크를 통한 연동기능을 구비하여 사고발생시 신속한 전파가 가능한 동시에, 저렴한 가격으로 구현 가능하여 유해 화학물질 누출에 대비한 재난경보 시스템을 효율적으로 구축할 수 있도록 구성되는 다종 유해 화학물질의 실시간 감지를 위한 가스센서 플랫폼 및 이를 이용한 재난경보 시스템이 제공된다.
assignees: UNIV KOOKMIN IND ACAD COOP FOUND

title_en: Quality control and data processing system for observation data of surface ocean current
title_ko: 표층해수유동 관측자료의 실시간 품질관리와 자료처리를 수행하는 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a device for real-time quality management and data processing of surface seawater flow observation data, which analyzes a signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) data and determines seasonal or long-term tendency characteristics of received waves for an observed sea area to determine whether to use Level 1 data, calculates an ensemble average again in a Level 1 stage except for defective data, and reproduces Level 2 and Level 3 data from low-level data through real-time QC, thus to be utilized in various fields such as pollutant (waste oil outflow, red tide, etc.) diffusion and human life search and rescue through more accurate predicted-tidal current generation and to provide various public services. According to the present invention, the device for real-time quality management and data processing of surface seawater flow observation data comprises a remote seawater flow observation unit, a central server, and a manager terminal, and the remote seawater flow observation unit comprises an HF Radar, a remote seawater flow observation server, and a communication network.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 신호대 잡음 비(SNR : Signal to Noise Ratio)의 분석 및 관측 해역에 대한 수신 전파의 계절적 또는 장기 경향 특성을 파악하여 Level 1 자료의 사용 여부를 판단하고, Level 1 단계에서 불량 자료를 제외하고 평균(Ensemble Average)을 다시 하며, Level 2 및 Level 3 자료를 하위 수준의 자료부터 실시간의 QC를 통해 재생산함으로써, 보다 정확한 조류예측생산(predicted-tidal current generation)을 통해 오염물질(쓰레기 유류유출, 적조 등) 확산, 인명 수색 구조 등 여러 분야에서 활용되면서 다양한 대국민 서비스가 가능할 수 있도록 하는 표층해수유동 관측자료의 실시간 품질관리와 자료처리장치에 관한 것으로서, 본 발명에 따른 표층해수유동 관측자료의 실시간 품질관리와 자료처리장치는 해수유동 원격 관측부, 중앙서버 및 관리자 단말기를 포함하여 구성되고, 상기 해수유동 원격 관측부는 HF Radar, 해수유동 관측 원격서버 및 통신망을 포함하여 구성된다.

title_en: Tracking, analyzing, and visualizing application delay
abstract_en: Performance metrics related to the processing and propagation of messages related to select applications are collected during a simulation of a network. Each message associated with an application is tagged, and each simulated packet that contains some or all of a tagged message is correspondingly tagged to facilitate the creation of transmit records and receive records. A post processor is configured to collate transmit and receive records of each tagged message to identify delays associated with each node that processes the message, and each link that propagates the message from node to node within the network. The processed timing information is provided to the user via an interactive user interface that allows the user to view the timing information from an application layer perspective.
assignees: MALLOY PATRICK J;LAVANNIS MAHESH;SCHNEIDER MARC;STROHM JOHN;COHEN ALAIN;SRESHTA SUKANYA;PLUN JEROME;PENDLETON STEPHEN;RIVERBED TECHNOLOGY INC

title_en: A kind of grid stability real-time predicting method based on adaptive neural network
abstract_en: A kind of generator amature angle prediction technique based on adaptive artificial neural network, comprising the following steps: data are generated using data automatic generating calculation and are stored in the database；Data in database are standardized；Pass through back-propagation algorithm training data；Realize that power grid is predicted in real time finally by the stability prediction to generator amature angle.It predicts that grid stability provides decision support when the present invention breaks down for electric system in real time, to long-term voltage stability margin in large scale electric network is improved, improves the economy and quality of operation of power networks, have great significance.

title_en: Method and system for minimizing risk of cascading failures of power grid under multi-fire disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid cascading failure risk minimization handling method and a power grid cascading failure risk minimization handling system under a multi-fire disaster.
assignees: NARI TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;State grid hunan electric power co ltd;STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;NARI GROUP CORP

title_en: Industrial network data switch
abstract_en: The invention discloses an industrial network data switch, which relates to the technical field of communication and comprises a shell, wherein a display screen for man-machine interaction operation is arranged on the shell, and the industrial network data switch also comprises a central processing unit module, a battery module, a POE module, a plug-in module, a cascade plug-in module, a PHY module, an MAC chip module, an Atmega128 module, a CPLD module, a FLASH module, a storage module, a serial communication module, an industrial field communication module and a Bluetooth communication module. The invention has certain fault resistance and can adapt to emergency situations under industrial working conditions; the access of a conventional interface and various communication protocols can be supported, data exchange is facilitated, and the universality of the switch is improved; the display screen has a display screen capable of being manually operated, is convenient for processing data, and has certain computing power.
assignees: SUZHOU HUIYUNDING TECH SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Method, system, equipment and medium for storing intelligent power grid operation information data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, and discloses a method and a system for storing operation information data of a smart grid, wherein the method comprises the following steps: step S1, collecting power grid operation data and constructing a similarity matrix of the power grid operation data; step S2, clustering power grid operation data by using a neighbor propagation clustering method; step S3, setting an X-Y plane, setting a sensor node and an IED node in a wireless sensor network on the X-Y plane, and obtaining a logic grid ID number of the IED node; step S4, updating a clustering result of the power grid operation data according to the IED node; and S5, forwarding the sensing signal to the IED node on the X-Y plane, calculating a grid ID number of the sensing signal, and storing power grid operation information data corresponding to the grid ID number. The system comprises: the intelligent electronic device comprises a data acquisition module, a data clustering module, an IED node setting module and a storage module. The application also discloses an electronic device and a computer readable storage medium.

title_en: Intelligent assessment method and system for landslide risk of tunnel peripheral area
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological material analysis, in particular to an intelligent assessment method and system for landslide risk of a tunnel peripheral region, comprising the following steps: extracting wave speed, attenuation coefficient and density parameter from the geological elastic wave data, and performing digital coding to form an initial data set. According to the method, an initial data set with high information density is constructed through geologic elastic wave data analysis, the quality and efficiency of data screening are improved, the fine observation of stress distribution and earth surface displacement in the data selection process is optimized, the capturing capacity of dynamic change of geologic conditions is enhanced, cracks and cavities in geologic media are accurately analyzed through simulating elastic wave propagation, finer geologic heterogeneity insight is provided, landslide triggering factors are calibrated more accurately by the method, high risk areas can be effectively identified and evaluated, the risk management and early warning accuracy of tunnels and key infrastructure are greatly improved, and potential geologic disaster influence is reduced.

title_en: Disaster chain prediction method and system based on infrastructure cascade failure
abstract_en: The invention provides a disaster chain prediction method and system based on infrastructure cascade failure, wherein the method comprises the steps of S1, screening and materializing extreme natural disasters, constructing extreme natural disaster scenes conforming to characteristics of a research area, S2, constructing various infrastructure single-layer network topologies, constructing a cascade failure mechanism based on coupling characteristics of multiple types of infrastructures, constructing an infrastructure multi-layer coupling network conforming to spatial distribution characteristics of the research area and actual operation logic based on the single-layer network topologies and the cascade failure mechanism, and S3, superposing the constructed extreme natural disaster scenes on the infrastructure multi-layer coupling network, and predicting a disaster chain space-time evolution process under the impact of the extreme natural disasters by taking the infrastructure multi-layer coupling network as a carrier of disaster propagation. The disaster chain prediction method and the disaster chain prediction device can predict disaster chains.

title_en: Multi-type charging station collaborative planning method considering comprehensive satisfaction of users
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-type charging station collaborative planning method considering comprehensive satisfaction of users, which relates to the field of power system planning and traffic energy infrastructure planning and comprises the following steps of constructing a charging satisfaction model based on fast charging waiting time and idle slow charging pile remaining amount according to charging behavior characteristics of fast charging users and slow charging users of an electric automobile; and solving the upper and lower cascading optimization models based on an iterative capacity expansion method of a greedy algorithm, converting an upper planning problem into a multi-round quick and slow pile filling configuration expansion problem, adjusting configuration based on the operation result of the previous round in each round of iteration until convergence conditions are met, and outputting a charging station configuration scheme meeting planning constraint, optimizing system operation cost and user satisfaction. The scientificity and the high efficiency of the layout of the charging facilities are realized.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Automatic Wireless Train Protection System based on LTE-R and Method thereof
title_ko: 열차통합무선망 기반 열차무선방호시스템
abstract_en: According to the present invention, a train wireless protection system based on an integrated train wireless network utilizes an LTE-R based system to minimize the establishment of separate infrastructure, prepares a method for accurately specifying trains subject to emergency alert propagation in consideration of the speed and characteristics of the operating line and the direction of the train, seeks a method of real-time monitoring of protection devices and local control panel status checks and notification of results, includes a real-time log collection and storage method, and a code generation method for securing security, improves reliability by enabling immediate response in an emergency through real-time condition monitoring of the conventional VHR type train wireless protection device by using the LTE-R based system, applies GPS and cell positioning technology to improve train positioning accuracy, categorizes vehicles individually, and transmits emergency alerts only to vehicles moving to an emergency situation, thereby minimizing train operation delays, thereby satisfying customer service satisfaction and ensuring train operation safety at the same time.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 열차통합무선망 기반 열차무선방호시스템에 따르면, LTE-R 기반시스템을 활용하여 별도의 기반시설 구축을 최소화하고, 운행선 속도 및 특성, 열차의 방향성을 고려하여 비상 경보 전파 대상 열차들을 정확하게 특정 짓는 방법을 마련하며, 방호 장치 및 로컬 관제 조작반 상태 점검 실시간 모니터링 및 결과에 대한 통보 방법을 모색하며, 실시간 로그 수집 및 저장 방법, 보안성 확보를 위한 코드 생성 방법이 포함되고, 종래의 VHF 방식의 열차무선방호장치를 LTE-R 기반 시스템을 활용하여 실시간 상태 모니터링을 통한 비상 시 즉각 대응이 가능해 신뢰성을 높이고, GPS와 셀 측위기술을 적용하여 열차 위치측위 정확성을 향상시키며, 차량들을 개별적으로 구분하여 비상상황이 발생한 지역으로 이동하는 차량에게만 비상경보를 송출하여 열차운행 지연을 최소화 시켜 고객서비스 만족 및 열차운행 안전성 확보를 동시에 만족시킬 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: System for monitoring fire accident of engine room in ship
title_ko: 선박 엔진룸 화재사고 감지 시스템
abstract_en: A technical task to be achieved by an idea of the present invention is to provide a ship engine room fire accident detection system that measures mist oil and predicts a possibility of a fire through video analysis based on artificial intelligence, and enables more stable and rapid identification of and response to an initial fire situation even in an event of a power failure of a power grid or sensor malfunction at the time of the initial fire. Provided is the ship engine room fire accident detection system comprising: an optical camera that takes a video and generates first video information; a thermal image camera that takes a thermal video and generates second video information and temperature rise information; a first prediction part that extracts an object of a worker from the first video information and the second video information, and predicts a possibility of a fire according to the distribution and concentration of mist oil by the first video information; a second prediction part that extracts the object of the worker from the first video information and the second video information, analyzes a behavioral pattern, and predicts the possibility of the fire according to the behavioral pattern; a third prediction part that extracts a flame pattern, a smoke pattern, and a temperature rise pattern from the first video information and the second video information, and predicts the possibility of the fire thereby; and an integrated monitoring part.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 제1영상정보를 생성하는 광학카메라(110), 제2영상정보와 온도상승정보를 생성하는 열화상카메라(120), 딥러닝기반의 제1예측알고리즘을 통해, 제1영상정보에 의한 미스트오일의 분포와 농도에 따른 화재가능성을 예측하는 제1예측부(130), 딥러닝기반의 제2예측알고리즘을 통해, 제1영상정보 및 제2영상정보로부터 작업자의 객체를 추출하고 행동패턴을 분석하여 행동패턴에 따른 화재가능성을 예측하는 제2예측부(140), 딥러닝기반의 제3예측알고리즘을 통해, 제1영상정보 및 제2영상정보로부터 불꽃패턴과 연기패턴과 온도상승패턴을 추출하고 이에 따른 화재가능성을 예측하는 제3예측부(150), 및 제1예측부(130) 또는 제3예측부(150)에 의한 화재가능성에 따라 화재경고를 전파하고, 통합가능성을 산출하여 실재 화재상황을 식별하여 화재경고를 전파하는, 통합 모니터링부(160)를 포함하여, 화재초기상황을 신속하게 판단하여 신속하게 대응하도록 하는, 선박 엔진룸 화재사고 감지 시스템을 개시한다.

title_en: Key water level control-oriented multi-target reservoir group scheduling optimization method under large power grid platform
abstract_en: The multi-target reservoir group scheduling optimization method facing the key water level control under the large power grid platform is characterized in that the water level control at the beginning of the year, before the flood, after the flood and at the end of the year is taken as an optimization target, the minimum water loss and the maximum generated energy are taken as optimization evaluation indexes, and long-series runoff optimization calculation is carried out by adopting a multi-target optimization technology. The method comprises the steps of taking the key water level as an optimization variable and a control target, then evaluating a key water level matrix sequence, then taking the key water level as the optimization variable and based on the NSGA-II multi-target calculation method of the evaluation function proposed above, and finally applying the method based on the scheduling rule of the non-inferior key water level set. The invention aims to improve the water and electricity consumption and reduce the waste water, and aims to provide a simple and feasible and easy-to-operate cascade hydropower station group dispatching operation mode by optimizing key water level control. Meanwhile, the predicted water coming and scheduling experience are considered, the application process is simple and visual, and the calculation result effectively reduces water abandon while the power generation amount is improved.

title_en: Vehicle network system harmonic time-frequency analysis method based on synchronous compression wavelet transform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vehicle network system harmonic time-frequency analysis method based on synchronous compression wavelet transformation, which comprises the steps of observing network side current and voltage signals by setting different switching frequencies and traction network equivalent parameters under the cascade operation of an equivalent traction network and a CRH5 type vehicle rectifier under the condition of considering time delay generated by a digital control circuit, and analyzing the signals by utilizing the synchronous compression wavelet transformation; the analysis result of the method has good time-frequency resolution, and the amplitude and the frequency of harmonic amplification can be effectively identified when the system has harmonic instability; the invention has convenient implementation and higher adaptability.

title_en: Lightning arrester fault judging method, device, equipment, medium and product based on LSTM
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of electric power, and provides a lightning arrester fault judging method, device, computer equipment, storage medium and computer program product based on modified LSTM. The application can accurately judge whether the lightning arrester has surface pollution fault or damp fault. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a fault data set of the lightning arrester, wherein the fault data set comprises real-time attributes, geographical position factors and monitoring data of wind, constructing a space-time correlation model according to the real-time attributes and the geographical position factors of the wind, constructing a leakage current prediction model based on LSTM (least squares) on the basis of a space-time correlation model, an average absolute error condition and a reverse propagation algorithm neural network of errors, inputting the monitoring data into the model, obtaining resistive current of the lightning arrester at the next moment and obtaining a resistive current fundamental wave and a third harmonic value, judging that the lightning arrester is a surface pollution fault if the resistive current fundamental wave and the third harmonic value meet a growth rate condition, and judging that the lightning arrester is a damp fault if the resistive current fundamental wave meets a threshold condition.

title_en: Enterprise digital management method and system based on data mining
abstract_en: The invention discloses an enterprise digital management method based on data mining, which comprises the steps of obtaining information flow data and resource allocation data, analyzing according to the information flow data and the resource allocation data to obtain an initial network diagram, carrying out cluster analysis according to the initial network diagram, carrying out path optimization to obtain a dynamic network diagram, carrying out feature extraction on the dynamic network diagram to obtain predictive analysis data, identifying nodes of a network according to the dynamic network diagram and the predictive analysis data to obtain key nodes and high risk nodes, combining the key nodes and the high risk nodes, identifying key propagation paths to obtain key propagation paths, predicting key positions where resource bottlenecks and conflicts occur based on the key nodes, the high risk nodes and the key propagation paths, and generating resource optimization suggestions. The method can identify the dynamic change of the implicit dependency of the enterprise, locate the high-risk nodes and the key propagation paths, and optimize the resource allocation.

title_en: Ambient vibration monitoring and processing method for bridge
title_ko: 교량 상시진동 모니터링 및 측정치 처리 방법
abstract_en: The present invention is to perform simultaneous control on a vibration measurement apparatus of a plurality of unspecific bridges by regularly measuring and recording vibration of a bridge, transmitting the vibration to an integrated server (40) at a remote place to integrally manage the vibration, and transmitting the vibration through a push service of a wireless network (60) when an abnormal situation like an earthquake or the like occurs. According to the present invention, not only a regular vibration measurement value of the bridge can be effectively collected and measured, but also measurement facilities installed in the plurality of unspecific bridges can be integrally controlled even when the abnormal situation like the earthquake or the like occurs, thereby collecting time series primitive information transmitted by a vibration sensor (30), and integrally managing the collected information. Therefore, the utilization of the information can be improved.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 교량의 진동을 상시 계측하여 기록함과 동시에, 이를 원격지의 통합서버(40)로 전송하여 통합관리하고, 지진 등 이상 상황 발생시 이를 무선망(60) 푸시 서비스를 통하여 전파함으로써, 불특정 다수 교량의 진동 계측 장치에 대한 동시 제어가 가능하도록 한 것이다. 
본 발명을 통하여, 교량의 상시진동 계측치를 효율적으로 수집 및 관리할 수 있을 뿐 아니라, 지진 등 이상 상황 발생시에도 불특정 다수의 교량에 설치된 계측설비를 일시에 제어하여, 진동센서(30)에서 송출되는 시계열 원시정보를 누락 없이 수집할 수 있으며, 수집된 정보를 통합 관리함으로써, 정보의 활용도를 제고할 수 있다.

title_en: Mobile firefighting system in apartment house
title_ko: 공동주택의 이동식 소방장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a mobile firefighting system in an apartment house. An objective of the present invention is to provide a mobile firefighting system in an apartment house that can prevent a door from being heated by being movably installed along a hallway of the apartment house to move to the front of a door of a household in which a fire is detected, and spray firefighting water toward the door, and can reduce time consumed for extinguishing a fire by shortening a time of moving from the firefighting system to a fire occurrence point. More specifically, the present invention relates to a detection system detecting a fire occurrence of any one household in the apartment house with a plurality of separated households sharing one hallway on each floor, and a mobile firefighting system in an apartment house provided in the hallway of the apartment house to spread the fire occurrence to surrounding areas by receiving the fire occurrence signal from the detection system that has detected the fire occurrence.
