The mobile firefighting system in an apartment house comprises: a main body which has a firefighting facility including a fire extinguisher and a fire hose therein and is movably installed along a hallway wall; a reception unit which is installed in the main body to receive the fire occurrence signal from the detection system; a filming device which is installed in the main body to transmit an image or video obtained by filming a door side of the household from the hallway; a spreading unit which is installed in the main body to spread the fire occurrence by turning on and off an LED lamp and ringing a warning sound at the same time when the reception unit receives the fire occurrence signal; and at least one rail which is formed to protrude in a longitudinal direction of the hallway wall from the other side surface of the hallway wall, has an outer surface repeatedly formed with serrated curves to guide a moving route of the main body, and is coupled to one side surface of the main body.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 공동주택의 복도를 따라서 이동가능하게 설치되어, 화재 발생이 감지된 세대의 출입문 앞으로 이동하여 출입문을 향해 소화수를 분사하여 출입문이 가열되는 것을 방지하고, 종래의 복도 일측에 고정되어 구비되는 소화장치로부터 화재 발생 지점까지 이동하는 시간을 단축하여 화재진화에 소요되는 시간을 줄일 수 있는 공동주택의 이동식 소방장치를 제공하는 것을 목적으로 하고, 상세하게는 각각의 층에 하나의 복도를 공유하는 다수의 구분된 세대들이 모인 공동주택 중 어느 하나의 세대의 화재 발생을 감지하는 감지시스템과 화재 발생을 감지한 상기 감지시스템으로부터 화재발생신호를 수신하여 화재 발생을 주변에 전파하도록 상기 공동주택 복도에 구비되는 공동주택의 이동식 소방장치에 있어서, 내부에 소화기, 소방호스를 포함하는 소방시설이 구비되되, 복도벽체를 따라서 이동가능하게 설치되는 본체; 상기 본체에 설치되어 상기 감지지스템으로부터 화재발생신호를 수신하는 수신부; 상기 본체에 설치되어 복도에서 상기 세대의 출입문 쪽을 촬영하여 촬영한 이미지 또는 영상을 상기 감지시스템으로 전송하는 촬영장치; 상기 본체에 설치되어 상기 수신부가 화재발생신호를 수신하면 LED램프를 점멸함과 동시에 경보음을 울려 화재 발생을 전파하는 전파부; 상기 복도벽체의 타측면에서 상기 복도벽체의 길이방향을 따라 돌출되어 형성되되, 외면은 톱니형상의 굴곡이 반복적으로 형성되어 상기 본체의 이동경로를 가이드하고, 상기 본체의 일측면에 결합하는 적어도 하나 이상의 레일;을 포함한다.

title_en: Power grid risk prevention and control system based on cascading failure sequence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid risk prevention and control system based on a cascading failure sequence. The power grid risk prevention and control system comprises a comprehensive importance unit, an accident severity unit and an accident risk assessment unit. The comprehensive importance unit is used for establishing the comprehensive importance factor of each element according to the structure importance factors and the state sensitivity factors of the elements in a power grid; the accident severity unit is used for carrying out processing according to the comprehensive importance factor, obtained by the comprehensive importance unit, of each element, the severity factor of the power grid running state and the severity factors of the load loss and then obtaining the comprehensive severity factor after a power grid accident. The accident risk assessment unit is used for conducting calculating according to the comprehensive severity factor to obtain the accident risk assessment factor. The power grid risk prevention and control system can completely represent the importance of different elements in the power grid and is close to the power grid practice, a risk assessment result is more reliable and more accurate, and therefore the extra manpower and material resource loss is reduced.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCES RES INST OF STATE GRID XINJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV SICHUAN

title_en: Nonlinear smearing language power distribution network node Vulnerability Assessment based on complex network
abstract_en: This application involves the nonlinear smearing language power distribution network node Vulnerability Assessments based on complex network, comprising: according to distribution network data, constructs power distribution network complex network model；It determines the importance measurement index of power distribution network node, constructs network node Assessment of Important database；Determine the parameter of fuzzy rule in power distribution network complex network model；Data clusters analysis is carried out to database using clustering method；Establish the nonlinear smearing language power distribution network node Evaluation of vulnerability model based on complex network；Carry out parameter optimization；Power distribution network node fragility is analyzed using the evaluation model after optimization；Power distribution network node is safeguarded based on the analysis results.Analysis and the accurate evaluation of power distribution network node fragility are realized using nonlinear smearing language, to be safeguarded to power distribution network node, reduce cascading failure risk, ensure the safe and stable operation of power distribution network, and then meet the power demand of user, promote the economic benefit of user power utilization quality and power grid enterprises.

title_en: Power grid vulnerability analysis method based on reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid vulnerability analysis method based on reinforcement learning, and relates to the technical field of power system safety. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, establishing a reinforcement learning model and a power grid cascading fault model, and simultaneously setting a certain proportion of circuits as key circuits; then, selecting a group of non-key lines in the power grid to be sequentially removed by using a reinforcement learning model according to the state of the power grid cascading fault model, recording the states of the power grid before and after line removal, optimizing parameters of the reinforcement learning model by taking maximum power grid damage as a target, and repeating the steps for a plurality of rounds; and finally, obtaining the attack sequence which can cause the power grid to be damaged maximally when part of the key lines can not be removed and the maximum damage which can be caused by sequential attack. The method fully considers the condition that partial elements of the power grid are additionally protected in the actual scene, and improves the search efficiency of the optimal attack sequence by using the reinforcement learning method.

title_en: Network attack damage degree quantification method for power system
abstract_en: The invention provides a network attack destruction degree quantification method facing an electric power system, which is characterized in that a network attack destruction degree quantification model is constructed based on an attack propagation probability representation method of a community structure; representing a dynamic evolution process of the network attack by the propagation of the network attack, constructing a power system penetration dependence attack graph, and determining an attack path set; designing a damage degree quantization model based on an attack path, determining an attack strategy set by constructing a network attack graph of the power system, respectively designing objective functions of an information layer and a physical layer, and constructing the damage degree quantization model by taking an attack strategy as conditional constraint; and finding an optimal strategy from the attack strategy set, and improving the artificial immune algorithm to realize model solution by utilizing a cross recombination operator to enhance the cooperation efficiency among antibodies. The method and the device realize the accurate representation of the network attack propagation probability in different conditions and at multiple angles, realize the numerical representation of the potential consequences of the network attack, and are favorable for accurately mastering the safety state of the power system.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Online determination system and method for optimal operation mode of heat pump cascade heat supply unit
abstract_en: The invention discloses an on-line determining system and a method for the optimal operation mode of a heat pump cascade heat supply unit, which adopt field operation data, take the lowest coal consumption under the conditions of fixed heat supply load and power supply load as an optimization objective function, adopt a univariate comparison method, sequentially adjust the operation backpressure of the unit and the steam pressure of middle-exhaust steam extraction to a heat pump, compare the standard coal consumption of the unit with a reference working condition, and if the standard coal consumption of the unit is greater than the reference working condition, the original reference working condition is still used as the reference working condition; if the parameter is smaller than the preset reference value, the operation working condition corresponding to the parameter is used as a new comparison reference working condition, the operation back pressure of the unit and the steam pressure of the middle-exhaust steam extraction to the heat pump are continuously adjusted, and next iteration optimization is carried out. The method takes the lowest standard coal consumption as a target function on the premise of meeting the dispatching of the power grid and the heat supply network, obtains the optimal control values of the running back pressure and the middle exhaust steam extraction pressure of the heat pump cascade heat supply unit under boundary conditions of different heat supply loads, power supply loads, return water temperatures and the like on line, and realizes the lowest running cost and the maximum profitability.
assignees: XIAN THERMAL POWER RES INST CO;XIAN XIRE ENERGY SAVING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Minimizing service disruption
abstract_en: A User Equipment (UE) may detect a disaster condition and its solution based on broadcast information, RRC messaging, NAS messaging, capability to connect to allowed PLMNs, and an indication from a barred PLMN. In a disaster condition, the UE may perform an enhanced PLMN selection procedure, wherein, for example, if the disaster situation applies to the current location of the UE, the UE will prioritize forbidden PLMNs for the disaster roaming connection without regard to the PLMNs in the disaster situation. For disaster roaming connections, the UE may be configured by the otherwise barred PLMN with information about what services the UE may access and what types of authentication procedures the network can perform with the UE. When the end of the disaster condition is detected, the UE moves back to the allowed PLMN.

title_en: Simulation-based corridor design for networked autonomous vehicles
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a "simulation-based corridor design for networked autonomous vehicles. A method for generating an infrastructure management plan is described. The method may include determining an opportunity development area for networked and automated vehicle (CAV) integrated traffic flow via a Regional Traffic Simulation (RTS) model. Regional key performance indicators associated with the opportunity development region are generated, and regional KPIs associated with local traffic in the opportunity development region are modeled using a Local Traffic Simulation (LTS) model. The method may further comprise: determining local KPIs associated with an opportunity development region; generating a tentative traffic solution associated with an opportunity development area; connecting the LTS model to the RTS model using an outer feedback loop; and determining a ripple effect of the tentative traffic solution via the RTS model. The method concludes with generating an infrastructure management plan that includes changes to the LTS model in response to confirming the improvement to the regional KPIs and the local KPIs.

title_en: Real-time scheduling decision method for cascade water light storage system considering different scenes
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascade water light storage system real-time scheduling decision method considering different scenes, which relates to the technical field of energy comprehensive utilization, and is characterized in that a water light load significant characteristic is extracted by considering the strong and weak coupling relation between water light load multi-mode time sequence data and adopting a method of combining a long-short term memory network and a self-coding technology, multidimensional water light load data distribution is fitted based on training samples, and the water light load time sequence characteristic and uncertain variable coupling relation are extracted to generate a water light load typical scene; a mixed learning model of the cascade water-light storage dispatching system is built by combining a scene generation network and a distributed near-end strategy optimization method, a dispatching task of the cascade water-light storage system is divided into learning subtasks under different typical scenes, a learning method adaptive to scene characteristics is realized, dynamic cascade water-light storage dispatching strategies under different water-light load characteristic scenes are obtained, and the adaptivity and the generalization of the dispatching method of the cascade water-light storage system under different scenes are improved.

title_en: Resource allocation method of municipal facility system based on signal game
abstract_en: The invention discloses a resource allocation method of municipal facility systems based on signal games, which aims at cascading municipal facility systems to obtain strategy sets of defensive parties and randomly generated signal sets; setting an attack strategy by a refined Bayesian game technology, launching the attack and judging the attack to generate an attack strategy set with an unknown attack strategy; determining system unit benefits, outputting specific benefit values, calculating the ratio of the specific benefit values to the previous round of benefit values, and determining whether to update each defender strategy set; after stopping updating each defending party policy set, outputting each stage of attack policy set to obtain each stage of attack policy set; according to the attack strategy set of each stage, obtaining the optimal attack resource investment and defending resource configuration of the hit unit; the game method defines strategies of both the attack and the defense and dynamically adjusts, simulates multiple attacks in deliberate attack, and provides overall optimization of attack resources and defense resources for municipal facility systems.

title_en: Energy-saving configuration method and system for self-adaptive power supply based on energy cascade utilization
abstract_en: The invention provides a self-adaptive power supply energy-saving configuration method and a self-adaptive power supply energy-saving configuration system based on energy cascade utilization, which relate to the technical field of power supply management and comprise the steps of collecting operation parameters of electric equipment, establishing an electric model and carrying out self-adaptive correction, then constructing a multi-level energy distribution matrix according to the corrected electric model, carrying out energy efficiency grading on the electric equipment, adopting a bidirectional attention mechanism to carry out space-time characteristic extraction and self-calibration network combination to generate an electric equipment priority strategy, further calculating the energy distribution proportion of each level of electric equipment, finally generating a control signal according to the energy distribution proportion, adjusting the power supply of each level of electric equipment, distributing the excess power to the electric equipment with the energy conversion efficiency being the next highest when the power value exceeds a target power threshold, and outputting an self-adaptive energy balance control instruction to adjust the operation state of the electric equipment according to a prediction control model.

title_en: Extreme scene cascading failure modeling method considering new energy uncertainty
abstract_en: The invention relates to an extreme scene cascading failure modeling method considering new energy uncertainty, and belongs to the field of disaster simulation and early warning of electric power systems. The method comprises the steps of carrying out cascading failure simulation on a power grid in the typhoon scene, determining disconnection conditions of lines at each time point based on wind-induced failure rates of the lines at each time point in the typhoon scene and forming a wind-induced failure set, traversing the wind-induced failure set, calculating cascading failure caused by wind-induced failure at each time point based on the disconnection conditions of the lines and corresponding wind-electricity output, wherein the cascading failure comprises wind-induced failure and line disconnection failure caused by one or more thermal overloads, and determining key lines in the power grid based on the cascading failure in multiple simulation. The method provided by the invention accurately evaluates the influence of the cascading failure caused by typhoons on the power grid through the simulation of the cascading failure under typhoons by double time scales (typhoons and cascading failure time scales).
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER;STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER CO;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST OF STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle distributed scheduling method and system applied to communication interruption region
abstract_en: The invention provides an unmanned aerial vehicle distribution scheduling method and system applied to a communication interruption area, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining unmanned aerial vehicle information used for the communication interruption area, and carrying out aerial networking on all unmanned aerial vehicles according to the unmanned aerial vehicle information; after networking is successful, defining coordinate sets of all unmanned aerial vehicles participating in networking, constructing a logarithmic path loss model according to the coordinate sets, obtaining signal propagation intensity of any position point of a communication interruption area according to the path loss model, constructing a signal coverage rate objective function according to the signal propagation intensity, constructing a network average link quality objective function and a node energy consumption balance objective function to obtain a comprehensive objective function, maximizing the comprehensive objective function as a target, and solving by adopting an improved particle swarm optimization algorithm to obtain the deployment position of all unmanned aerial vehicles in the communication interruption area. The invention can obviously improve the deployment efficiency and reliability of the disaster area communication system.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENT RES INST STATE GRID JIANGXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent earthquake monitoring network optimization design and real-time reconstruction system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of seismic monitoring, in particular to an intelligent seismic monitoring network optimization design and real-time reconstruction system, which comprises a seismic data acquisition module, a network evaluation module of a base Yu Liman manifold, a geodesic analysis module, a network reconstruction decision module, an execution control module and a performance evaluation feedback module, wherein the system models a seismic monitoring space into a Riemann manifold, calculates geodesic of a seismic wave propagation path through manifold convolution extraction characteristics, analyzes geodesic density distribution, accurately identifies a monitoring blind area and performs risk rating; generating a network reconstruction strategy comprising temporary site deployment and existing site parameter adjustment according to the evaluation result; the invention breaks through the limitation that the traditional monitoring network cannot accurately identify dead zones and dynamically adjust, and remarkably improves the monitoring coverage rate.

title_en: Risk early warning method and system for low-temperature rain, snow and freezing weather disasters
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of intelligent early warning and discloses a risk early warning method and system for low-temperature rain, snow and freezing weather disasters, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting multi-source data and constructing a heterogeneous diagram; the method comprises the steps of preprocessing data to obtain training and reasoning samples, constructing a graph neural network on a heterogeneous graph, carrying out joint learning on node time sequence characteristics and side relations to obtain graph representations representing cold air invasion, rain and snow zone movement and risk propagation delay, outputting road table temperature evolution, icing threshold arrival time and wire icing growth rate based on the physical guiding neural network, fusing characteristics obtained by the graph neural network with characteristics obtained by the physical guiding neural network, outputting asset-level risk scores and confidence intervals thereof, obtaining expected arrival time, and establishing early warning according to prediction results and observation results. The application provides finer and more reliable grading risk early warning, and improves the accuracy, the interpretability and the practicability of early warning.
assignees: HENAN METEOROLOGICAL OBSERVATORY YELLOW RIVER BASIN METEOROLOGICAL CENTER HENAN ENV METEOROLOGICAL F

title_en: Three-phase unbalance dynamic regulation and control method for power distribution network based on hybrid intelligent optimization algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-phase imbalance dynamic regulation and control method for a power distribution network based on a hybrid intelligent optimization algorithm, which belongs to the field of power system automation and comprises the steps of collecting current values and initial phase sequence states of each single-phase load in a power distribution area, establishing a dynamic regulation and control model with minimum three-phase current imbalance degree and minimum switching action times as double targets, solving the model based on an improved genetic algorithm of a fusion experience knowledge guiding mechanism, a pareto optimal selection mechanism and a global and local collaborative search mechanism, generating a phase-change control instruction according to the obtained optimal phase-change scheme, and issuing the phase-change control instruction to a load phase-change switch for execution. The comprehensive improvement of the algorithm in the aspects of convergence speed, solution diversity and global optimality is realized by introducing a gene library to guide the propagation process, a multi-objective selection mechanism based on non-dominant sorting and a local optimization strategy combined with tabu search.
assignees: LANZHOU POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Power management device, power management method, and program
abstract_en: An object is to generate a possibility to obtain a price without impairing convenience of a power storage apparatus while a power grid is in a service interruption state, and further provide a motivation for promoting use of the power storage apparatus. A power management system (10) includes a first administrator (11), a second administrator (12), a first estimator (13), a second estimator (14) and a determiner (15). The first administrator (11) manages a residual capacity of a power storage apparatus (21). The second administrator (12) manages interruption information regarding a power grid (30). The first estimator (13) estimates, as first power information, an amount of power that is consumed by an electric load (2) during an interruption period. The second estimator (14) estimates an estimation residual capacity that is the residual capacity at an end point of the interruption period, based on the first power information. The determiner (15) determines that a condition for participating in a power trade market is met, when the estimation residual capacity exceeds a reference value.

title_en: System for propagating messages for purposes of demand response
abstract_en: A system having a utility, a communications intermediary and demand response resources. The utility may be connected to the communications intermediary via a network. The demand response resources may be connected to the communications intermediary via another network. A single dispatch destined for the demand response resources may be sent to the communications intermediary. The dispatch may be disaggregated at the communications intermediary into a multitude of dispatches which may be dispersed to their respective destined demand response resources. The demand response resources may send telemetries to the communications intermediary that aggregates the telemetries into a single telemetry. The single telemetry may be sent to the utility.

title_en: Power transmission network reliability assessment method based on cascading failure accident chain search
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power transmission network reliability assessment method based on power grid cascading failure accident chain searching. The method comprises the following steps of (1) considering system stability constraint conditions, bus faults, transformer faults and other actual power grid factors in cascading fault accident chain search; the newly improved cascading failure loss expectation is adopted in the reliability evaluation, the existing reliability index is improved, the reliability index based on accident classification is actually provided based on the national institute's 599 code and the power grid, and a certain guiding effect is achieved on engineering practice.

title_en: Multi-step abnormal point detection method based on neighbor propagation clustering algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-step abnormal point detection method based on a neighbor propagation clustering algorithm. The invention can effectively solve the problem of dimension disaster when detecting the abnormal points, thereby avoiding the interference of redundant characteristics or excessive data noise of irrelevant characteristics to the abnormal point detection technology; meanwhile, the excessive dependence of the traditional abnormal point detection technology based on clustering or distance on the selection of the initial value is overcome, the effectiveness of the method is verified by a Virusschare and Google Play-acquired actual data aggregation cross-fold verification method, and the method has a wide application prospect in the field of network security.

title_en: Method for predicting importance degree of nodes of power system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a method for predicting the importance of the nodes of the power system, which is based on a convolution long-short-term memory network and comprises a training set construction process, a model training process and an importance prediction process; the training set construction process constructs a training set based on historical tide data of the power system nodes, the model training process uses the training set to train a prediction model to obtain a prediction model which is completed with training, and the importance prediction process uses the prediction model which is completed with training to predict the importance of the power system nodes. The method for predicting the importance of the power system nodes can rapidly and accurately predict the importance of the power system nodes, so that data guidance is provided for preventing cascading failures in advance and avoiding the occurrence of the failures.

title_en: Product supply chain risk propagation method based on complex network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a product supply chain risk propagation method based on a complex network, which comprises the following steps: and (3) a step of: complex product cooperative network construction: according to the cooperative relationship among enterprises in the complex product cooperative network process, a complex product cooperative network is constructed, a supply chain network is divided into four levels, from a part provider, a part provider and a primary provider to a main manufacturer from top to bottom, the cooperative relationship between the upper level and the lower level is set, a single enterprise can be associated with a plurality of enterprises on the upper level or the lower level, and the cross-level cooperative relationship does not exist between different levels; 2. building a complex product collaborative mechanism network risk transfer model: describing by adopting a load-capacity model in cascade failure, introducing a concept of supply chain risk flow, enabling nodes to be attacked and disabled, and redistributing the load until no other overloaded enterprises or the whole network is paralyzed in the whole complex product cooperative network, so that the cascade failure process is terminated; 3. and (5) cascading failure simulation.

title_en: Subway network key station identification method considering cascading failure, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a subway network key station identification method, electronic equipment and storage medium considering cascade failure, which simulate a cascade failure process after station failure based on a constructed subway weighted time-varying network and initial state and degree values of stations in each period, and establish a passenger flow distribution rule based on consideration of passenger origin-destination points to obtain the subway weighted time-varying network after cascade failure is caused by stations in each period. Based on node failure rate, network maximum communication rate and network passenger flow intensity entropy after each station is failed in each period, comprehensive importance of each station in each period is calculated, and key subway stations in each period are identified based on the comprehensive importance. The method and the system are used for assisting public transportation operators to identify key stations in each period in the subway network, so that decision support is provided for emergency plan making under emergencies, and scientific basis is provided for emergency operation scheduling and management of the subway network.

title_en: Earthquake isolation and shock absorption system based on tree space layout form
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of earthquake prevention and disaster reduction, and provides an earthquake isolation and shock absorption system based on a tree space layout form. The system comprises a density gradient tree layout area, a periodic lattice tree array area, a target protection area and a buffer transition zone. The density gradient layout area is positioned at the front end of the system, the density of trees is gradually increased along the propagation direction of the earthquake waves and is used for realizing impedance smooth transition and guiding wave energy to enter the array area, the trees in the periodic array area are distributed at equal intervals to form a quasi-periodic elastic structure which is used for generating Bragg scattering band gap effect and reflecting and dissipating the earthquake waves in a specific frequency section, the target protection area is used for laying buildings or infrastructures to be protected, and the buffer transition area is arranged between the tail end of the array and the target area and is used for absorbing residual wave energy and reducing echo amplification effect. The application constructs a green, low-cost and sustainable natural shock isolation system, and has good earthquake wave control effect and engineering adaptability.

title_en: Power consumption behavior anomaly identification method, system, equipment and medium based on local cascade neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, equipment and a medium for identifying abnormal electricity consumption behavior based on a local cascade neural network, which belong to the technical field of intelligent power grid abnormality detection and comprise the steps of collecting multi-mode time sequence data of a plurality of monitoring nodes in a power grid, carrying out data preprocessing, dynamically generating a suspected local area based on a real-time electricity consumption coupling relation, inputting an output node set into a first-stage local neural network, carrying out feature extraction and residual calculation, outputting an information packet, inputting the information packet into a second-stage neural network, carrying out time sequence causal discovery and abnormal conduction path research and judgment, calling a corresponding incremental normal mode dictionary based on the output suspected source node, carrying out comparison and output verification conclusion, and carrying out comprehensive research and judgment through a multi-mode evidence fusion decision engine to generate a final structured abnormal report. The invention realizes high-precision, low-delay and interpretable detection and tracing of power consumption abnormality, and particularly shows remarkable robustness and practicability in a high-noise power grid environment.

title_en: Vehicle network model modeling method and system under working condition of cutting magnetic force lines by pantograph
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vehicle net model modeling method and system under the working condition of cutting magnetic lines by a pantograph, and relates to the technical field of modeling, comprising the following steps of constructing a lumped tau-shaped circuit of a traction net in unit length based on self-impedance and earth admittance of a contact line, self-impedance and earth admittance of a steel rail and mutual impedance between the contact line and the steel rail; and cascading the lumped tau-shaped circuit with a unit length, taking dynamic electromotive force generated during train operation as an equivalent voltage source, connecting one end of the equivalent voltage source with a contact line which is in sliding connection with a pantograph in the chain lumped tau-shaped network model, connecting the other end of the equivalent voltage source with the roof end of the train model, and connecting the bottom end of the train model with a steel rail to obtain the train network model under the working condition that the pantograph cuts magnetic lines. The invention provides a modeling method of a train network model for cutting magnetic lines of force by a pantograph of a high-speed train, which can simulate and obtain the influence of the magnetic lines of force of the pantograph cutting on each line of a train and a traction power supply system under different running speeds of the train.

title_en: Narrow-band ad hoc network multi-hop link optimization deployment method integrating three-dimensional propagation modeling
abstract_en: A narrow-band ad hoc network multi-hop link optimization deployment method integrating three-dimensional propagation modeling comprises the steps of constructing a three-dimensional space visual view of a deployment area, constructing a direction topological graph based on deployed narrow-band ad hoc network base station equipment, carrying out propagation path type division and propagation path loss estimation on each node in the direction topological graph based on the three-dimensional space visual view, acquiring estimated path loss from each node to a target point, judging whether an effective overlapping area exists between each node in the direction topological graph, acquiring points to be deployed based on the estimated path loss if the effective overlapping area exists, determining the range of the points to be deployed, narrow-band ad hoc network constraint and fitness function if the effective overlapping area does not exist, outputting an optimal multi-hop link deployment scheme, carrying out deployment based on the optimal multi-hop link deployment scheme, carrying out link deployment dynamic adjustment according to monitoring results, obviously improving the estimated propagation loss accuracy, and adapting diversified scene requirements.

title_en: Method and system for separating and cleaning runoff of rainwater in water-deficient city
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of urban rainwater management, in particular to a method and a system for cleaning and diverting runoff of rainwater in a water-deficient city. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a distribution diagram of a road section easy to accumulate water and a distribution diagram of a rainwater pipe network, determining a pipeline section at risk of deposition, determining initial interception indexes according to rainfall data, determining starting shear stress according to continuous rainfall-free time, calculating effective shear stress in a pipeline in a diversion stage, calculating pollution propagation speed when the effective shear stress is not smaller than the starting shear stress, calculating predicted time for pollutants to reach a diversion node according to the pollution propagation speed, and introducing rainwater runoffs into a sewage treatment path when the predicted time and the pollution propagation speed meet requirements. According to the invention, the moving process of the lagged pollution peak is dynamically tracked and predicted through the double monitoring points, so that the rainwater recycling utilization rate is improved.

title_en: Network adaptation based on assessment of meteorological impact
abstract_en: A network-management system capable of reducing negative impacts of natural disasters on network services. In an example embodiment, in response to an indication of potential failure of one or more network resources in a meteorological event, the network controller operates to orchestrate re-hosting of affected VNFs and perform SDN-based reconfiguration of switches to adapt the traffic flows to the re-hosted VNFs. The indication of potential failure can be provided, e.g., by a specialized application capable of estimating the probabilities of failure for individual network resources based on a plurality of inputs, such as digital weather forecasts for the corresponding geographical area, geographical locations of individual network resources, tolerances of different network resources to specific environmental conditions, previous history of network damage in the same geographical area, alerts from power suppliers, etc. Upon reconfiguration, the network may beneficially have a lower likelihood of service disruptions and/or outages during the meteorological event.

title_en: Surface-layer half water retention type permeable bituminous pavement
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel surface-layer half water retention type permeable bituminous pavement structure and a preparation method thereof. The novel surface-layer half water retention type permeable bituminous pavement structure comprises a permeable bituminous surface layer and a base layer, wherein the bituminous surface layer is divided into an upper surface layer which is 25-30mm thick and a lower surface layer which is 70-90mm thick; the lower surface layer which has half road breadth in the middle of a pavement is filled with a water retention material; the base layer is divided into an upper base layer and a lower base layer; the upper base layer is a bituminous gravel base layer which is 80-120mm thick, and the lower base layer is a cascaded gravel base layer which is 180-220mm thick; the water retention material is prepared by doping 15-20wt% of slaked lime and 60-80wt% of water into a powder body material consisting of 85-95wt% of blast furnace slag powder and 5-15wt% of coal ash. According to the novel surface-layer half water retention type permeable bituminous pavement structure, a quick permeable pavement and the water retention functional material on the lower surface layer are combined together; being an auxiliary of a municipal water drainage facility, the novel surface-layer half water retention type permeable bituminous pavement structure can greatly improve the capacity of an urban road for resisting flood disasters and enhancing the traffic safety, effectively reduce the temperature of the urban road, relieve the high-temperature condensation effect of the bituminous surface layer to a certain extent, delay the bituminous aging speed and prolong the service life of the pavement.

title_en: Earthquake disaster loss prediction and evaluation method and system based on Softmax regression model
abstract_en: A seismic disaster damage prediction and evaluation method and system based on a Softmax regression model relate to the technical field of seismic disaster damage prediction and evaluation, solve the problem of how to improve the accuracy of seismic disaster damage prediction and the training speed, use different seismic disaster damage degree grades as classification labels of the Softmax regression classification model, select past seismic disaster characteristic data for training, and predict the past seismic disaster damage by using the Softmax regression classification model; inputting new earthquake disaster characteristic data and classification labels in a Softmax regression classification model; judging the classification weight of the input data belonging to each earthquake disaster damage degree grade; determining a classification label corresponding to the input data according to the classification weight, thereby determining the damage degree grade of the new earthquake disaster; compared with a Back Propagation (BP) neural network and a Support Vector Machine (SVM), the method has the advantages of stronger capability of distinguishing the earthquake disaster loss, high test precision and short test time.
assignees: HEFEI INST PUBLIC SAFETY RES TSINGHUA UNIV;ANHUI THEONE SAFETY TECH CO LTD;HEFEI CITY LIFELINE ENG SAFETY OPERATION MONITORING CENTER

title_en: Construction resource monitoring method and system for cascade development and construction of hydropower basin
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a construction resource monitoring method and system for hydropower basin step development and construction, belongs to the technical field of hydropower engineering, and the construction resource monitoring system for hydropower basin step development and construction comprises: the construction scheme acquisition module is used for acquiring a construction scheme, and the construction scheme comprises a construction period, a construction area, a transportation route, constructors and transportation vehicles; the construction resource monitoring module comprises a wireless network unit, a constructor mobile monitoring unit and a transport vehicle mobile monitoring unit, wherein the constructor mobile monitoring unit is used for acquiring the personnel position information of constructors based on the wireless network unit in the construction period, and the transport vehicle mobile monitoring unit is used for acquiring the transport track of a transport vehicle; and the data processing module is used for detecting construction abnormal behaviors based on the transportation route, the construction area, the personnel position information and the transportation track to generate a detection result.
assignees: GUONENG DADUHE BIG DATA SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Electrical equipment operation data classification method based on BP neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electrical equipment operation data classification method based on a BP (Back propagation) neural network, belongs to the field of power grid data service, relates to the technical field of BP neural network models, and particularly comprises an electrical equipment data acquisition module, a classification model building module and a data classification model application module. The electrical equipment data acquisition module is mainly used for collecting and integrating the operating data of the electrical equipment and transmitting the acquired data to the model building module; the classification model building module is mainly used for training data, determining and correcting model parameters and forming a data classification model so as to improve the generalization capability of the model; the data classification model application module applies the established model to the actual operation process to classify the data. The method has the advantages of high reliability, strong application capability, good prediction capability and the like, and can be widely applied to various classification scenes of the operation data of the power grid equipment, such as the classification of normal, abnormal and invalid data.
assignees: SOUTHWEST TRAFFIC UNIV;LIMITED COMPANY OF STATE GRID INSTITUTE OF ECONOMICS AND TECH

title_en: Power grid vulnerability assessment method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a power grid vulnerability assessment method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring data of a heterogeneous power network; acquiring a first attack cost corresponding to a transformer substation and a second attack cost corresponding to a transmission line; acquiring an alternative combined attack strategy set according to a preset initial attack cost threshold, a first attack cost and a second attack cost; carrying out simulation attack and cascade failure judgment on an attack target of the combined attack strategy to obtain an attack gain function and a task completion degree of the combined attack strategy corresponding to each attack target; and judging the attack income function and the task completion degree according to a preset task threshold value to obtain a vulnerability evaluation result. According to the method and the device, the simulation attack and benefit evaluation are carried out on the alternative combined attack strategy set under the limited cost, the target cost budgets of the power grid under different attack purposes are calculated, the actual power grid is planned according to the evaluation result, and the robustness and the accuracy of the power network evaluation result are improved.

title_en: Method and device for optimizing park energy system operation based on load clustering
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a device for optimizing the operation of a park energy system based on load clustering, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring energy consumption data of a park user; performing cluster analysis on the energy consumption data to obtain energy requirements and typical energy consumption behaviors of park users; positioning the energy grade requirement of a user according to the energy requirement and the typical energy utilization behavior; combining a preset energy grade dividing result and the energy grade requirement to obtain a corresponding energy cascade utilization energy supply structure; and constructing an energy pipe network model according to the energy cascade utilization energy supply structure, and generating an optimized operation strategy of an energy system based on the energy pipe network model. The invention can optimize the operation of the energy system.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI ENERGY INTERNET RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Aggregation method for cascade multi-time scale adjustable load
abstract_en: The application relates to a cascading type multi-time-scale adjustable load aggregation method, which realizes multi-level cascading of distributed adjustable load resources from a short time scale level to a long time scale, and avoids the problems of mass data processing and complex function design caused by single-level aggregation. In addition, the distributed adjustable load resources can meet the operation requirements of the power grid under different response scales and time scales through cross-time scale aggregation. The application is beneficial to promoting the aggregation and the utilization of distributed adjustable load resources, improving the new energy consumption capability of the power grid, keeping the power supply stable and supporting the construction of a national novel power system and the realization of a double-carbon target.

title_en: Transmission and distribution collaborative hierarchical distributed risk scheduling method for high-proportion distributed energy access
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transmission and distribution collaborative hierarchical distributed risk scheduling method for high-proportion distributed energy access, and relates to the technical field of power system scheduling optimization. The method comprises the following steps: providing a transmission and distribution collaborative hierarchical distributed risk scheduling framework, and dividing the whole power system into a transmission grid scheduling layer and a distribution network scheduling layer according to structures and functions; constructing a transmission and distribution collaborative hierarchical distributed risk scheduling model, wherein the transmission and distribution collaborative hierarchical distributed risk scheduling model comprises a transmission grid scheduling model and a distribution network scheduling model; the power generation equipment of the power transmission network dispatching layer is independently and optimally dispatched through the power transmission network dispatching model, the power generation equipment of the power distribution network dispatching layer is independently and optimally dispatched through the power distribution network dispatching model, boundary power information is exchanged, the power transmission and distribution collaborative hierarchical distributed risk dispatching model is subjected to power transmission and distribution dispatching iteration solution through a target cascading method, when convergence conditions are met, an optimal solution is obtained as a final risk dispatching strategy, centralized coordination and scattered autonomy are achieved, and the economy of the whole operation of the power grid is improved.

title_en: Risk domain control method and system based on train formation operation risk cause analysis
abstract_en: The invention provides a risk domain control method and a system based on train formation operation risk cause analysis, which belong to the technical field of train operation control and realize adjacent train state information interaction based on a train-to-train communication technology, wherein a dynamic Bayesian network is utilized to construct a risk situation propagation model and carry out sensitivity analysis and sequencing on each risk node by taking a braking anti-skid system with low efficiency and a formation inter-train communication link failure as risk sources under abnormal weather and taking a formation train collision as an accident result, a nonlinear vibration theory and a Rayleigh equation are utilized to describe vibration characteristics and microscopic evolution processes in the risk situation change, a sensitivity weight value of a node with the largest influence on the occurrence probability of a collision accident is taken as a damping coefficient of the Rayleigh equation, and the relation between a control variable and the damping coefficient is explored based on damping control, so that the risk domain is converged in an initial safety state. The invention can realize the risk domain control oriented to train formation operation from the system level angle.

title_en: Complex dynamic oil reservoir simulation method based on adaptive physical meaning neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of oil deposit engineering and discloses a complex dynamic oil deposit simulation method based on an adaptive physical meaning neural network, which comprises the following steps of 1, acquiring complex production dynamic oil deposit development data; step 2, establishing an adaptive physical meaning neural network model, initializing model parameters and setting a production regulation schedule, step 3, responding to input initial pressure data of an oil reservoir, adjusting internal boundary conditions according to the production schedule, calculating gradients by forward propagation mapping and reverse propagation, step 4, updating saturation according to the pressure data output by the model, and step 5, iteratively executing the steps 3 and 4, and continuously solving the simulation process of the whole oil reservoir by using the pressure field output by each step and the neural network parameters obtained by training as input of the next step. The invention can be rapidly adapted to the severe change of the oil reservoir under the complex production dynamic state.

title_en: Broadband oscillation suppression method, system and medium for offshore wind power soft direct grid-connected system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of stable control of power systems, in particular to a broadband oscillation suppression method, a system and a medium of an offshore wind power soft direct grid-connected system, which comprise the steps of sequentially injecting positive and negative sequence perturbation sine harmonic signals at grid-connected points of a wind turbine generator, constructing a multi-input multi-output impedance matrix, and reducing the multi-input multi-output impedance matrix into single-input single-output equivalent positive sequence impedance; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a stability margin of an offshore wind power soft direct grid-connected system based on equivalent positive sequence impedance quantification, reconstructing a fan network side converter into a matrix control structure by cascading a weighting coefficient matrix between an inner loop control loop and an outer loop control loop of the fan network side converter when the stability margin is lower than a preset margin threshold value, iteratively optimizing the matrix control structure based on impedance sensitivity, and synchronously carrying out impedance remodeling on a low-pass filter connected in series with a voltage and current feedback channel to complete broadband oscillation risk inhibition. According to the invention, broadband oscillation suppression of the offshore wind power soft-direct grid-connected system is realized through impedance modeling and matrix control strategies.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Load type virtual power plant resource pool optimization method based on industrial risk modeling
abstract_en: The application discloses a load type virtual power plant resource pool optimization method based on industrial risk modeling, and belongs to the technical field of power systems and energy Internet. The method comprises the steps of firstly constructing a resource association network based on an industry input-output relation, then simulating a dynamic propagation process of industry risks in the resource network by adopting an SIRS model, describing an evolution rule of a resource long-period adjustable capacity, further combining power grid topological faults and scheduling requirement fluctuation, constructing a short-period disturbance scene, generating a multi-time scale scene tree through combining long-period uncertainty and short-period uncertainty, clustering and extracting a typical scene set, finally constructing a double-layer random optimization model, optimizing resource pool structure selection at the upper layer, optimizing scheduling strategies at the lower layer, and introducing a resource long-period stability coefficient by the lower layer model through capacity boundary constraint to realize collaborative optimization of structure and scheduling. The application effectively improves the benefit redemption capability and the risk resistance robustness of the load type virtual power plant in a complex uncertainty environment.

title_en: System for wireless networking using duct
title_ko: 덕트를 이용한 무선 통신망 시스템
abstract_en: A radio communication network system using ducts is provided to overcome the limitations of transmission distance and propagation obstacles by applying a WiMAX radio communication technique and using ducts, installed in a building, as propagation paths. A radio communication network system using ducts comprises a main relay unit(110) and auxiliary relay units(120). The main relay unit, installed at the inner or outer side of a ventilation fan located at the top of a central duct in a building, executes radio communication. Using branch ducts, distributed from the central duct, as propagation paths, the auxiliary relay units execute radio communication with the main relay unit. Each auxiliary relay unit executes radio communication with one or more TRS(Trunked Radio System) or WiFi terminals(131,132) which are located in the building. At least one auxiliary relay unit is installed on each floor of the building.
abstract_ko:
본 발명에 따르면, 건물 최상단 중앙덕트의 환기팬 내측 또는 외측에 설치되어 무선 통신을 수행하는 메인중계수단; 및 중앙덕트로부터 건물의 지상 또는 지하의 각 층으로 분배되는 분배덕트를 전파경로로 하여 메인중계수단과 무선 통신을 수행하고, 건물의 특정 층에 위치한 하나 이상의 단말기와 무선 통신을 수행하며, 건물의 각 층에 적어도 하나 이상 설치되는 보조중계수단을 포함하는 덕트를 이용한 무선 통신망 시스템이 제공된다. 개시된 덕트를 이용한 무선 통신망 시스템에 따르면, 와이맥스 방식의 무선통신이 적용됨과 동시에 건물 내에 설치된 덕트를 무선 전파경로로 이용함에 따라 전송거리의 한계와 전파장애가 극복될 수 있음은 물론이며, 외부의 단말기와 무선통신을 수행하는 보조중계수단을 내열 설계된 공간상에 수용함에 따라 각종 사고로 인한 장비 손상문제가 감소되고 무선 통신의 상시적인 연결 유지가 가능한 이점이 있어 사고 발생시 인명 및 재산 피해를 절감시킬 수 있다.
