title_en: System for fire response and propagation system
title_ko: 화재대응 및 전파 시스템
abstract_en: According to one aspect of the present invention, a fire response and propagation system includes: a management server connected to a CCTV network and transmitting a fire warning signal; and a warning propagation means receiving the fire warning signal through the CCTV network to propagate the signal outwards. The present invention derives real-time priority of an entrance path of a fire engine by using a real-time fire road state collected from the CCTV network and fire road data stored in a fire road database. The management server transmits the fire warning signal to the warning propagation means located in the derived entrance path of the fire engine.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 측면에 따른 화재대응 및 전파 시스템은 CCTV 망과 연결되며, 화재경보 신호를 송신하는 관리서버; 및 상기 화재경보 신호를 CCTV 망을 통해 전달받아 외부에 전파하는 경보전파 수단;을 포함하며, 상기 CCTV 망으로부터 수집된 실시간 소방도로 상태와 소방도로 데이터베이스에 저장된 소방도로 데이터를 활용해 소방차 진입경로의 실시간 우선순위를 도출하고, 상기 관리서버는 도출된 상기 소방차 진입경로에 위치하는 상기 경보전파수단에 상기 화재경보 신호를 송신하는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: NINE TELECOM NET CORP;FOREDEN CO LTD;KIM SU MI

title_en: Method for identifying fragile lines in power grids based on electrical betweenness
abstract_en: Disclosed is a method for identifying fragile lines in power grid based on electrical betweenness, which comprises the following steps: constructing the power grid into a network diagram, sequentially removing lines in the network diagram, and sorting the electrical betweenness of each line from large to small; constructing a nonlinear model of complex network cascade failure considering overload and weighted edges, and respectively performing two ways of removing lines for sorted electrical betweenness, namely sequentially removing preset proportion lines and sequentially removing all lines until no new lines are removed in the network diagram; obtaining a change of generator-load power before and after each line removal, and evaluating a severity of power grid failure based on the change of generator-load power, thus completing an identification of power grid fragile lines.

title_en: Method for evaluating and improving vulnerability of electricity-gas comprehensive energy system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating and improving the vulnerability of an electricity-gas integrated energy system. Establishing a network topological structure of the electricity-gas comprehensive energy system; simulating the initial fault of the system by using a Monte Carlo algorithm according to a given initial fault proportion to obtain the initial running state of the system; establishing a fault propagation model of the electric-gas integrated energy system to obtain a fault propagation seepage equation; continuously iterating the seepage equation according to the fault propagation termination condition until the fault propagation termination condition is met to obtain the final running state of the system; and establishing vulnerability parameters of the electric-gas integrated energy system, calculating to obtain the vulnerability result of the electric-gas integrated energy system, and implementing improvement. The method can quickly evaluate and obtain the vulnerability result of the electric-gas integrated energy system, find the weak link of the electric-gas integrated energy system, and inhibit the propagation of the fault in the system by taking measures, thereby effectively improving the vulnerability of the electric-gas integrated energy system and reducing the probability of large-area breakdown of the system.

title_en: Fault propagation diagnosis method for complex electromechanical system
abstract_en: The invention provides a fault propagation diagnosis method of a complex electromechanical system, which mainly comprises the steps of constructing a topology network model facing the complex electromechanical system based on the mechanical, information and electrical connection relation among all components in the complex electromechanical system, constructing a fault propagation network of the complex electromechanical system according to historical fault data and a fault diagnosis manual of the complex electromechanical system by combining the topology network model, calculating the topology attribute and the function attribute of the complex electromechanical system, further constructing a fault step-by-step propagation diffusion model, thus obtaining a fault propagation path set, and finally constructing propagation strength calculation methods of different fault propagation paths for judging the fault propagation paths. The fault diagnosis method constructed by the invention can effectively judge which parts will be subjected to linkage influence after a certain part breaks down, and further, the series of parts can be maintained in advance to effectively prevent the spread of faults, thereby avoiding the linkage loss of economic property caused by the faults.

title_en: Apparatus, system and control method for people counting
title_ko: 피플카운팅 장치, 시스템 및 제어방법
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 피플카운팅 장치, 시스템 및 제어방법에 관한 것으로, 구체적으로는 조명 기능과 재난 감지 기능을 구비하는 피플카운팅 장치, 시스템 및 제어방법에 관한 것이다. 
또한, 본 발명은 감지 영역을 지나는 카운팅 대상을 감지하고 카운팅 대상이 사람인지 판정하여 카운팅된 사람의 수에 대한 정보를 생성함으로써, 감지 영역을 지나는 사람의 수를 카운팅할 수 있고, 감지 영역을 포함하는 소정의 범위에 빛을 비추는 조명 기능을 제공하며, 애드훅 네트워크를 기반으로 카운팅된 사람의 수에 대한 정보를 타 노드 또는 게이트웨이에 송신하도록 구비됨으로써, 실내나 실외의 구분없이 설치 및 운용이 용이하며, 건물 붕괴, 지진, 화재 및 가스 누출을 포함하는 재난 상황의 발생 여부를 감지하는 재난 감지 기능을 제공하며, 동작 전원 공급이 차단되거나 재난 상황이 감지되는 경우 보조 전원을 공급하도록 구비됨으로써, 재난으로 인해 동작 전원이 차단된 상황에서도 재난 상황이나 구조 대상에 대한 정보의 전파가 가능하다.

title_en: Orthotropic elasticity coefficient inversion method free of initial value dependence and angle dependence
abstract_en: The invention discloses an orthotropic elasticity coefficient inversion method free of initial value dependence and angle dependence. The method includes the steps that 1, the mathematic relation between the propagation wave velocity of ultrasonic waves in tissue in different directions and the medium elasticity coefficient; 2, a three-layer BP artificial neural network is established, and training is carried out; 3, in actual measurement, ultrasonic wave velocity information in the tissue is collected according to the BP artificial neural network input standard, and the elasticity coefficient of the biological tissue can be obtained through wave velocity inversion. According to the method, an orthotropic elasticity model is adopted to replace a traditional isotropic elasticity model to represent human tissue, so that the modeling accords with the truth of the human body better; by using the BP artificial neural network as a tool and adopting a special network input mode, the problems that an inversion iterative initial value must be considered in a traditional inversion method and the precision of the traditional inversion method is low are solved; it is not needed to provide the angle relation between the wave velocity and propagation direction of the ultrasonic waves and the elasticity coordinate system of the tissue in the method, and thus the method is more suitable for clinical detection.

title_en: A kind of transformer substation switch division condition detection method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of transformer substation switch division condition detection method based on deep learning, include the following steps: the first step, building transformer substation switch division mark data collection: multiple switch division visible images of collection in worksite are chosen as data set and are labeled, data set contains the switch state of " dividing ", " conjunction " two states；Second step, training neural network: select YOLOv3 network as basic network model, multiple dimensioned training is added to detect using multiple dimensioned to various sizes of target, on the basis of YOLOv3 network structure, remove the network layer of smallest dimension, residual block uses the residual error structure of ResNet, carry out twice of up-sampling, cascading layers are used for the splicing of tensor, and the up-sampling result of deep layer convolution characteristic pattern is spliced with the correspondence shallow-layer convolution characteristic pattern of identical size, expands the dimension of tensor.

title_en: Multimode oscillation on-line monitoring and early warning system based on edge calculation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-modal oscillation online monitoring and early warning system based on edge calculation, which comprises an acquisition layer, an edge node layer and a central layer, wherein the acquisition layer comprises an AD acquisition conversion module and a multi-modal synchronous phasor calculation module; the edge node layer extracts modal information and synchronous phasor data obtained by the acquisition layer, and extracts the characteristics of each modal oscillation by analyzing the multi-modal synchronous phasor data; the center layer analyzes the oscillation source and the propagation path by combining the power network topological structure according to the analysis result of the edge node layer, so that multi-mode oscillation early warning is realized. The system of the invention realizes a new electric power automatic dispatching system architecture, and breaks through the frame that all the original collected data are sent to the dispatching center and are managed and analyzed by the dispatching center system in a unified way. The method realizes the in-situ and real-time basic analysis, reduces the calculation load of a dispatching center, avoids the data problem caused by the transmission problem, and further improves the accuracy and the real-time performance of the analysis.

title_en: Genetic algorithm, system and device for planning and optimizing power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a genetic algorithm, a system and a device for planning and optimizing a power distribution network. Therefore, the method forms the initial value individuals with high environmental adaptability into the high-quality population at the initial stage of the algorithm, namely classifies the initial value individuals which have extremely strong competitiveness and are easy to propagate to the next generation in the initial population, and then optimizes the initial value individuals except the initial value individuals forming the high-quality population, thereby avoiding the phenomenon of early maturity in the traditional genetic algorithm.
assignees: YUHANG BRANCH HANGZHOU ELECTRIC POWER DESIGN INST CO LTD;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG HANGZHOU YUHANG POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;HANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Tidal current diagram layout method and device of power supply network, medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power grid systems, in particular to a tidal current diagram layout method and device of a power supply network, comprising the following steps: acquiring power grid data of a power supply network area based on a power grid map model, wherein the power grid data comprises a plurality of pieces of equipment information and line connection information; clustering the plurality of device information through an improved intimacy propagation clustering algorithm to obtain a plurality of device clusters, wherein each device cluster is provided with at least one clustering center device; determining the relative positions of the equipment clusters in the areas based on the primitive division according to the geographic position information of the plurality of clustering center equipment, and laying out the plurality of equipment clusters in the areas based on a preset layout rule to obtain a plurality of tide areas; when judging that line connection exists between any two devices positioned in different tide areas according to the line connection information, controlling the two devices to be positioned in the same straight line and performing line connection. The method can improve the accuracy, intuitiveness and identification of the layout of the tidal current diagram.
assignees: XIAN XINSHI SPACE INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Park gateway time synchronization self-holding method and system supporting no external connection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a park gateway time synchronization self-holding method and a system supporting no external connection, comprising the following steps: preprocessing historical frequency correction data for input into a neural network model; constructing a neural network model suitable for supporting time synchronization self-holding of a park gateway without external connection; the neural network model includes: an input layer, a hidden layer and an output layer; the historical frequency correction data is used as the input of the neural network, the clock frequency of the communication gateway crystal oscillator of the park is predicted by the neural network under the condition of no external connection, and the updated neural network weight is corrected by using an extended Kalman filter in the back propagation process of the BP neural network, so that the training process and fitting precision of the neural network are accelerated, the time synchronization precision of the communication gateway of the park is improved, and the time synchronization self-holding of the communication gateway of the park without external connection is supported under the condition of no external connection.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER;INFORMATION & TELECOMMUNICATION COMPANY STATE GRID SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Cascade power plant joint scheduling system and method for water surface photovoltaic power generation
abstract_en: The application provides a step power plant joint scheduling system for water surface photovoltaic power generation, which comprises a centralized control unit, a power plant unit, a reservoir unit, a water surface photovoltaic unit and a power grid; the centralized control unit is used for controlling the power plant unit and the water surface photovoltaic unit to generate power, and the power plant unit and the water surface photovoltaic unit are uniformly connected to a power grid after generating power; the power plant unit comprises an upstream power plant component, a midstream power plant component and a downstream power plant component, the reservoir unit comprises an upstream reservoir component, a midstream reservoir component and a downstream reservoir component, and the water surface photovoltaic unit comprises an upstream water surface photovoltaic component, a midstream water surface photovoltaic component and a downstream water surface photovoltaic component. The application can efficiently utilize the water surface of the reservoirs of the step power plant, the photovoltaic power generation is preferentially carried out, the step power plant carries out supplementary regulation, the utilization rate of the reservoirs of the step power plant is effectively improved, the centralized control center carries out unified dispatching operation management, the power generation benefits of the step power plant and the photovoltaic power plant on the water surface are fully exerted, and the regulation capability of the step hydropower plant is fully utilized.
assignees: HUBEI QINGJIANG HYDROELECTRIC DEV CO LTD

title_en: Optimized scheduling method and device for wind power and cascade hydropower combined system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind power and cascade hydropower combined system optimal scheduling method and device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: establishing a daily random optimization scheduling model of the wind power and step hydropower combined system based on Monte Carlo tree search, wherein the daily random optimization scheduling model is used for maximizing the generated energy of the wind power and step hydropower combined system in one day and minimizing the total fluctuation of power generation; determining constraint conditions of the daily random optimization scheduling model; defining a step hydropower station with solar regulation capacity as an intelligent body, taking a wind power and step hydropower combined system as an interactive environment, and performing discretization treatment on a state space and an action space; randomly generating wind power plant output by adopting a fractional regression long-short-term memory neural network model; and solving a daily random optimization scheduling model by using a Monte Carlo tree searching algorithm to obtain an optimal scheduling scheme. The method realizes the dual goals of maximizing the generated energy of the combined system and minimizing the total fluctuation through the Monte Carlo tree search of reinforcement learning, and remarkably improves the energy utilization efficiency and the power grid stability.

title_en: Karst landform remote sensing dynamic evolution analysis method and system thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of remote sensing image processing, in particular to a karst landform remote sensing dynamic evolution analysis method and a system thereof, which can be applied to the fields of resource management, environmental protection, geological disaster early warning and the like in karst areas; the method comprises the steps of obtaining karst landform change information through multi-time-phase remote sensing image data, constructing a space-time analysis model consisting of self-attention enhancement, a feature pyramid and a circulating neural network, combining a karst landform priori knowledge design constraint module to realize accurate prediction, enabling multi-source data fusion to improve feature capture capability, particularly achieving obvious observation advantages under complex weather conditions, enabling multi-module cascade design to accurately model space-time dynamic changes, improving prediction accuracy, introducing priori knowledge constraint to enhance feature recognition, reducing misclassification, and integrally effectively integrating multi-disciplinary technology, improving accuracy and reliability of karst landform dynamic evolution analysis and providing a powerful tool for relevant field research.

title_en: Multi-energy collaborative optimization energy saving and emission reduction system and method based on intelligent regulation and control
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent regulation-based multi-energy collaborative optimization energy conservation and emission reduction system and method, comprising an intelligent sensing layer, a dynamic analysis layer, a collaborative decision layer, a flexible interaction layer and a flexible interaction layer, wherein the intelligent sensing layer monitors stress changes, preprocesses multi-source heterogeneous data and sends the multi-source heterogeneous data to the dynamic analysis layer, the dynamic analysis layer builds a digital twin model of coupling equipment based on the multi-source heterogeneous data, quantifies interaction effects among the equipment, simulates a linkage propagation path of a single fault, combines an equipment operation limit value and a vulnerability index to generate an anti-interference capability assessment report, the collaborative decision layer generates an initial scheduling scheme and sends the initial scheduling scheme to the flexible interaction layer, then triggers a fault response mechanism through the collaborative scheduling model, synchronously starts standby equipment, the flexible interaction layer responds to power grid auxiliary service requirements in real time, receives a user side load adjustment instruction, optimizes green electricity transaction quota through a bi-directional interaction mechanism, and finally rapidly calls regional standby resources when encountering faults.

title_en: Cascading failure accident chain generation method considering second-level safety and stability standard of power system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power system cascading failure accident chain generation, and discloses a cascading failure accident chain generation method considering a second-level safety and stability standard of a power system, which comprises the steps of constructing a network model, calculating network indexes, and constructing an initial fault set by arranging circuit vulnerability indexes through objective and subjective comprehensive assignment of the indexes; and checking whether the second-stage safety, stability and control measures are triggered and corresponding countermeasures are carried out until all data of the initial fault set are deduced. According to the method, the coupling mechanism of the second-stage safety and stability measures and fault propagation of the power system is dynamically deduced, an accident chain set considering the second-stage stability control measures and cascading fault evolution characteristics is generated, and simulation support is provided for constructing a power grid safety risk knowledge graph and optimizing a power grid defense system.

title_en: End-to-end flow field flood risk influence forecasting method based on physical constraint
abstract_en: The invention discloses an end-to-end river basin flood risk influence forecasting method based on physical constraint, in particular to the technical field of meteorological hydrologic forecasting and artificial intelligence, which comprises the steps of S1, acquiring multisource space-time data of a target river basin, constructing a river basin diagram structure after space-time alignment and meshing, S2, constructing an end-to-end deep learning network comprising a self-adaptive multi-mode feature extraction module and an influence prediction module, and training the network by utilizing a loss function fused with physical constraints to obtain a flood risk influence prediction model, wherein the physical constraints at least comprise water balance constraints. According to the invention, the key problems of error accumulation, poor physical consistency and scarcity of disaster samples in the traditional cascade forecasting mode are solved by deeply embedding the physical mechanism into the data driving model, so that the forecasting precision and reliability are remarkably improved.
assignees: ANHUI INST OF METEOROLOGICAL SCIENCES ANHUI ECOLOGICAL METEOROLOGICAL AND SATELLITE REMOTE SENSING C

title_en: Critical infrastructure blueprint selection for optimized response to state changing conditions
abstract_en: Critical infrastructure (CI) blueprint selection for optimized response to state changing conditions includes defining a hierarchy of interdependent CI elements of a community in a digital twin and receiving characterization data for different nodes of the digital twin. A fingerprint is generated for the hierarchy based upon the characterization and a blueprint which corresponds to the fingerprint retrieved from a data store, the blueprint defining a set of parameters to be applied to different computing elements of different nodes in the hierarchy determined to minimize a cascading effect of a state changing condition in one of the nodes. Finally, the set of parameters of the retrieved blueprint is applied to corresponding computing elements of the digital twin and a state changing condition is simulated in the digital twin in a selected node so as to compute the cascading effect of the state changing condition to other nodes dependent upon the selected node.

title_en: Risk analysis method and system for power grid forest fire disaster concurrent cascading failure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a risk analysis method and a system for power grid mountain fire disaster concurrent cascading failure, wherein the method comprises the following steps: according to the mountain fire real-time monitoring and early warning result, calculating the affected power transmission line and the mountain fire tripping probability of the power transmission line; constructing an initial fault combination according to the mountain fire trip probability of all the affected power transmission lines; calculating a deterministic cascading failure line set under the initial failure combination; generating a probabilistic cascading failure line set of a failure combination on the basis of the deterministic cascading failure line set according to the operating characteristics of the power transmission line and the protection elements thereof; calculating a power grid risk index under the condition of the fault combination aiming at each fault combination; and calculating the risk degree of each transmission line according to the risk indexes of the power grid. According to the method, the power grid concurrent cascading failure combination under the mountain fire disaster can be quickly obtained, so that the risk degree of each power transmission line is calculated.

title_en: Multi-index power grid node vulnerability assessment method integrating structural hole characteristics
abstract_en: A multi-index grid node vulnerability assessment method integrating structural hole features considers topological characteristics to select node degree and cluster coefficient indexes; selecting low-power risk factors, node voltage out-of-limit risks and node electrical betweenness indexes in consideration of electrical performance; selecting loss load indexes by considering the cascading failure results; and selecting PageRank, leaderRank, HITs indexes based on the ranking of the feature vectors, and comprehensively ranking the grid nodes from the 9 evaluation indexes in the four aspects. Constructing a power grid key node ordering algorithm based on LittNet ordering learning considering structural hole characteristics, firstly randomly generating initial weight coefficient values of all node indexes, and obtaining initial scores of all nodes by using a scoring function h (x); and then substituting the index weight coefficient into a linear neural network model, updating the index weight coefficient by a gradient descent method, controlling a loop by using iteration times until the obtained index weight coefficient value reaches a stable state, outputting the weight coefficient value at the moment, and finally obtaining the scores of all nodes of the power grid according to a scoring function h (x) for sequencing.

title_en: Wind-solar-water-multifunctional complementary day-ahead risk scheduling method considering output stability
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind-solar-water multi-energy complementary day-ahead risk scheduling method considering output stability, which comprises the steps of predicting a power grid next day load process, a wind power plant and photovoltaic power plant next day output process, a cascade hydropower station warehouse-in runoff and an interval inflow process; a scene reduction algorithm is adopted to obtain a typical load process and probability thereof, and a typical wind-light combined output process and probability thereof; establishing a future power generation planning model of a risk-controllable wind-light-water complementary system with three targets; step four: and constructing a double-layer nested optimization framework to solve the model. The invention can effectively cope with the uncertainty of load prediction and wind-light output prediction under the condition of ensuring the stability of the output of the system.

title_en: Tunnel lining defect change characteristic intelligent inversion method, system and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent inversion method, system and storage medium for tunnel lining defect change characteristics, which comprises the following steps: geological radar data acquisition is carried out on the tunnel lining region to be tested in a plurality of different time periods, and B-scan data of the tunnel lining region to be tested in a plurality of time periods are obtained; respectively carrying out synthetic aperture focusing algorithm processing on the B-scan data of each time period to correspondingly obtain focusing B-scan data, and forming two-dimensional B-scan data pairs corresponding to each time period of the tunnel lining region to be tested; respectively inputting two-dimensional B-scan data pairs corresponding to each time period into a trained neural network model; the neural network model is formed by cascading a phase slice inversion module and a phase slice inversion module through a four-dimensional inversion module; and outputting a dielectric constant model corresponding to each time period by the neural network model to obtain the change characteristics of the defects of the tunnel lining region to be tested. The invention realizes the dynamic detection of the diseases in the region to be detected and can greatly improve the working efficiency and inversion stability.

title_en: Multi-energy coordination rapid scheduling method based on quantum neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-energy coordination rapid scheduling method based on a quantum neural network, and belongs to the technical field of micro-grid operation. The multi-energy coordination economic dispatch model considering the hydraulic power, wind energy and solar energy is defined, and multi-class operation constraint of the cascade hydropower is considered. A quick synchronous machine information prediction model based on QNN is constructed, and the model realizes quick prediction of the state and the output of the synchronous machine in a day according to the actual measurement data of new energy and load. A closed loop hot start framework of the QNN and multi-energy coordination optimization scheduling model is constructed, QNN decision information is transmitted to an initial optimization model, and the solved optimal solution is fed back to QNN learning evolution, so that a high-quality optimization scheduling result is obtained rapidly.

title_en: NOx emission prediction method based on physical neural network ensemble learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a NOx emission prediction method based on physical neural network ensemble learning, which comprises the following steps of 1, establishing a physical prediction model according to a physical rule generated by diesel engine NOx, 2, collecting test data by using a diesel engine bench, carrying out data normalization on the collected data, training a feed-forward neural network by using normalization data to obtain a neural network prediction model by adopting a back propagation method, 3, fusing the physical prediction model of the step 1 and the neural network prediction model of the step 2 by a method of constructing a fusion loss function, constructing the physical neural network prediction model, training the physical neural network prediction model by adopting a back propagation method, and 4, fusing the models of the steps 1-3 by adopting an ensemble learning combination strategy to obtain an ensemble learning model, and predicting the emission amount of NOx by using the ensemble learning model. The method has higher prediction accuracy, and reduces the cost and difficulty of data collection.

title_en: Method and device for relieving natural disaster risk of power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a natural disaster risk relieving method and device for an electric power system, which comprises an hour-level composite cascade event set generating module, a risk relieving module, a distributed resource evaluating module, a natural disaster influence module and a power grid control module, wherein the hour-level composite cascade event set generating module is used for generating an hour-level data set under various natural disaster scenes, capturing cascade effects of different disasters, providing data support for risk influence quantification of the electric power system and strategy generation of the risk relieving module, the distributed resource evaluating module is used for evaluating availability and power generation potential of distributed resources in a three-level area, analyzing the power generation potential of the distributed resources during various natural disasters by combining weather and disaster factors, the natural disaster influence module is constructed, the influence of the various natural disasters on the electric power system is simulated based on the hour-level composite cascade event set, the damage degree of the disasters on loads, power generation facilities, power transmission and distribution lines and the like is analyzed, the risk relieving module is constructed, a disaster emergency scheme is formulated for an area with the risk influence on the basis of a three-level collaborative mechanism, the power generation potential of the distributed resource evaluating module is used, and the power grid is quickly restored and stably operated by scheduling various distributed resources, repairing the power grid and load adjusting.

title_en: Graph theory-based electric CPS vulnerability assessment method and system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of power system application, in particular to a graph theory-based power CPS vulnerability assessment method and a graph theory-based power CPS vulnerability assessment system, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing an unauthorized network topology model of a power CPS network, and acquiring nodes of the power CPS network, connecting edges among the nodes and load voltage data of the nodes; the method comprises the steps of obtaining load abnormality of each node of a power CPS network, obtaining voltage recovery responsiveness of each node of the power CPS network, obtaining operation robustness of each node of the power CPS network, obtaining communities and associated communities of each community in the power CPS network, obtaining voltage abrupt change time sequences of each node in the power CPS network, obtaining cascading failure degree of each community in the power CPS network, obtaining cascading criticality of each community in the power CPS network, obtaining vulnerability factors of the power CPS network and evaluating the vulnerability of the power CPS network. The application reduces the risk of damaging the safety of the power system.

title_en: Temperature regulation and control system applied to water-cooled air conditioner of machine room
abstract_en: The invention discloses a temperature regulation and control system applied to a water-cooled air conditioner of a machine room, and relates to the technical field of temperature regulation and control. The system comprises a coupling analysis module, a cooperative control module, a dynamic regulation and control module and a correction module. The heat flow propagation model is constructed by collecting temperature distribution and power consumption data of the cabinet in real time and utilizing the graph neural network, and the refrigerant flow velocity and the tail end air outlet temperature set value are output. And (3) combining efficiency curves of the water pump, the fan and the compressor, optimizing total energy consumption, equipment service life and refrigeration stability of the system by using a non-dominant sequencing genetic algorithm, and generating a control instruction. And verifying thermodynamic constraint conditions and generating a refrigerant distribution priority matrix according to the layout and regulation and control instructions of the machine room, and ensuring the coordination response of the equipment. And comparing actual data with simulation data through the digital twin platform, and reversely correcting the edge weight of the heat flow propagation model to optimize the system performance. The system can realize accurate regulation and control of the machine room environment, improve the energy efficiency and the service life of equipment, and ensure the refrigeration stability.

title_en: Underground pipe network defect intelligent identification and early warning method and system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention provides an underground pipe network defect intelligent identification and early warning method and system based on deep learning, which relate to the technical field of pipe network detection and comprise the steps of acquiring multi-source data by adopting a pipeline detection robot and preprocessing; the method comprises the steps of mapping features to manifold space, constructing a similarity matrix, carrying out geometric difference weighted fusion, constructing an associated matrix, calculating space distance and mechanical strength, carrying out iterative propagation to generate a defect feature map, acquiring an evolution sequence by adopting a self-adaptive sliding window, determining influence factors based on inverse fact intervention, calculating state transition probability and determining an optimal maintenance scheme. The invention improves the accuracy of pipe network defect identification and realizes the intellectualization of pipeline state prediction and maintenance decision.

title_en: The disaster broadcasting PA in public facility, the remotely functioning A/V smart broadcasting device, a closed network system
title_ko: 공공 다중이용시설 재난재해 동보방송 구내방송장치(PA)와 원격 협업기능 A/V(Audio/Video) 스마트 방송장치 및 폐쇄자가망 시스템
abstract_en: When a civil defense alarm terminal which can be remotely controlled by the Korea Air and Space Operations Center (KAOC) or a multi-use facility control server receives emergency broadcast broadcasting data (disaster alert, disaster risk, air strike, CTRN, text to speech (TTS) data) for inside/outside public buildings such as schools, public institutions, or the like including the Article 33 (3) of the Framework Act on Civil Defense, and the Article 55-2 of the Enforcement Decree of the same Act (propagation of civil defense alerts) of buildings subject to alarm propagation, emergency broadcast is made through a multi-use facility alert terminal.
abstract_ko: 한국항공우주작전본부(KAOC: Korea Air and space Operations Center)에서 원격제어가 가능한 민방위 경보단말기 또는 민방위기본법 제33조 제3항, 동법 시행령 제55조의2(민방위 경보의 전파) "경보전파 대상 건축물"을 포함하는 학교, 관공서 등 공공 건축물 내/외부에 대해 비상방송 방송데이터(재난경계, 재난위험, 공습, 화생방, TTS(Text To Speech) 데이터)를 다중이용시설 통제서버가 수신하면, 다중이용시설 경보단말기를 통해 비상방송을 한다.

title_en: Multilayer forest fireproof monitoring center
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multilayer forest fireproof monitoring center. The multilayer forest fireproof monitoring center comprises an alarm, a plurality of bottom-layer monitoring centers, a remote monitoring system, a top-layer monitoring center and a plurality of interlayer monitoring centers. The top-layer monitoring center is equipped with a top-layer alarm server, a cascade server and a top-layer network switch cabinet which are connected orderly and mutually. Each interlayer monitoring center comprises an interlayer alarm server and an interlayer network switch, the interlayer alarm servers are connected with the interlayer network switches, and the interlayer network switches are connected with the top-layer network switch cabinet mutually. Each bottom-layer monitoring center comprises a video control server, a bottom-layer alarm server and a bottom-layer network switch, and the remote monitoring system is connected with the bottom-layer network switches via a network. The bottom-layer network switch, the video control server and the bottom-layer alarm server are connected orderly and mutually, the alarm and the bottom-layer alarm servers are connected, and the bottom-layer network switches are in redundancy connection with the interlayer network switches. The multilayer forest fireproof monitoring center realizes the scientific decision, and is strong in response capability and high in operation efficiency.
assignees: CHENGDU JINGLIN ELECTRONIC TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Space RQD based on laser scanning and BQ inversion optimal threshold ttSolving method
abstract_en: Space RQD based on laser scanning and BQ inversion optimal threshold t t Solving method, belonging to RQD t The field of anisotropy resolution, comprising the steps of: (1) three-dimensional laser scanning of the structural surface is rapidly acquired; (2) drawing a structural plane polar diagram and a trend rose diagram; (3) calculating the rock mass based on the BQ index; (4) three-dimensional fracture of rock massGenerating and sectioning a gap network model; (5) RQD t Drawing an anisotropy map; (6) solving method of optimal threshold t based on BQ inversion; (7) space RQD t And (5) solving the method. The invention combines three-dimensional laser scanning, a neighbor propagation algorithm, a BQ theory, a fracture network model, a generalized RQD theory and a conic curve equation to realize RQD t Solution of the optimal threshold t and RQD under the optimal threshold t t Elliptic curve and anisotropic ellipsoid rendering. The method is clear, and the obtained optimal threshold value t, elliptic curve and anisotropic ellipsoid can reflect the RQD of the real rock mass t Anisotropic characteristics, suitable for rock RQD t The spatial anisotropy of (a) is solved.

title_en: Lightning arrester fault judgment method, device, equipment, medium and product based on LSTM
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of electric power, and provides a lightning arrester fault judgment method and device based on modified LSTM, computer equipment, storage medium and computer program product. The method and the device can accurately judge whether the surface pollution fault or the damp fault occurs to the lightning arrester. The method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining a fault data set of the lightning arrester, wherein the fault data set comprises real-time attributes of wind, geographic position factors and monitoring data, constructing a space-time correlation model according to the real-time attributes of the wind and the geographic position factors, constructing a leakage current prediction model based on an LSTM (local pulse train) based on the space-time correlation model, an average absolute error condition and an error back propagation algorithm neural network, inputting the monitoring data into the model, obtaining resistive current of the lightning arrester at the next moment, obtaining a resistive current fundamental wave and a third harmonic value, judging the lightning arrester to be a surface pollution fault if the resistive current fundamental wave and the third harmonic value meet a growth rate condition, and judging the lightning arrester to be a damp fault if the resistive current fundamental wave meets a threshold value condition.
assignees: CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CORP EXTRA HIGH VOLTAGE POWER TRANS CO KUNMING BUREAU

title_en: Real-time forest fire spreading simulation method, fire extinguishing decision method and early warning system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a forest fire spreading real-time simulation method, a fire extinguishing decision method and an early warning system. The invention provides a forest fire spreading real-time simulation method, which specifically comprises the following steps: inputting topographic data (slope direction, gradient and combustible type distribution) of a forest fire spreading simulation area, and establishing a grid network according to the topographic data; selecting the geographical position of the fire point, and calculating the coordinates of the fire point in the grid network from the position of the fire point; starting to perform spreading simulation in the grid network from the ignition point, simulating the propulsion of the fire scene range based on a shortest path algorithm and a boundary epitaxial extension method, and obtaining the ignition time of the grid network; and visually displaying according to the firing time of the grid network. Methods are then presented according to this propagation method to aid in direct and indirect fire extinguishing decisions, respectively. Finally, a forest fire spreading simulation and early warning system is provided based on the method, and an auxiliary decision function is provided for forest fire extinguishment.

title_en: Power generation plan analysis method for power grid direct-regulation basin cascade hydropower station
abstract_en: The invention provides a power generation plan analysis method for a grid direct-regulation basin cascade hydropower station, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of grid-connected unit number limiting factor design, climbing period factor design, unit start-stop variable factor design, duty record template factor design, unit start-stop and grid-connected unit number criterion design, automatically acquiring power generation plan related data from a related system according to fixed data reading frequency, and obtaining hydropower station power generation plan change conditions, unit start-stop advice and initial duty record through designed system core algorithm logic calculation. The method can solve the problems that the hydropower station in the river basin cascade is not timely in scheduling connection, and the scheduling flow is not standard in the execution process of the power generation plan.

title_en: Method and system for predicting illegal gold absorption and storage melting risk of enterprise
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for predicting illegal gold absorption and storage melting risks of enterprises, which belong to the technical field of data processing, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting a financial institution collection to be monitored, an individual depositor collection and a plurality of enterprise entities; acquiring transaction information and enterprise information of an enterprise entity; establishing a knowledge graph; combining the higher-order graph neural network, and extracting a dynamic sub-graph of the knowledge graph according to the transaction information; determining initial propagation nodes of the dynamic sub-map based on the average value of the network centrality index; performing risk propagation on the initial propagation node based on the improved SIR algorithm to acquire a risk propagation path; combining the risk propagation path with paths in the dynamic sub-map to obtain a combined risk propagation path, and calculating the predicted risk probability of each sub-path in the combined risk propagation path; and carrying out early warning on the risk propagation path comprising the sub-path under the condition that the predicted risk probability is larger than the risk probability threshold. The manual intervention is reduced, and the monitoring accuracy and the real-time performance are improved.
assignees: ZHEJIANG ZHELIXIN CREDIT REPORTING CO LTD

title_en: Cross-space cascading failure monitoring method and system for information physical system of active power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention provides a cross-space cascading failure monitoring method and system for an active power distribution network information physical system, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting ADNCPS real-time operation data, and carrying out index calculation and classification according to a cascading failure monitoring index system, wherein the cascading failure monitoring index system at least comprises a plurality of basic indexes and operation environment indexes; judging whether the information physical system of the active power distribution network enters an abnormal working state or not based on a pre-established ADNCPS running state migration model and the classified indexes; and taking the historical operation state of the active power distribution network information physical system as a reference, and determining an operation state evaluation result of the active power distribution network information physical system by utilizing a multi-objective planning method. According to the invention, the running environment index is considered in the running state evaluation flow of the information physical system, and meanwhile, the relevance and the fluctuation between balance indexes can be considered by solving by adopting a multi-objective planning method, so that the accuracy of an output result is ensured.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG

title_en: Risk propagation analysis method for production line design change
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of production lines, and particularly relates to a risk propagation analysis method for design change of a production line. According to the invention, a first production line parameter association network is established according to production line information by acquiring the production line information; setting initial load and node capacity of each node in the first production line parameter association network; taking the production line change data as input of a second production line parameter association network, and calculating the change risk of the production line by the second production line parameter association network according to the production line change data to obtain a change propagation result; and analyzing the robustness of the second production line parameter association network through the normal state rate of the nodes in the second production line parameter association network by changing the propagation result to obtain an analysis result. Compared with the prior art, the method and the device can effectively analyze the dynamic process of the design change propagation, and learn the influence of the dynamic change propagation on each part of the production line, thereby better optimizing the production line.

title_en: Optimized scheduling method, equipment and storage medium for cascade hydropower station
abstract_en: The application discloses an optimized dispatching method, equipment and a storage medium of a cascade hydropower station; establishing an optimized Markov model, learning the optimized Markov model by adopting an unsupervised learning algorithm, and regressing the model according to the characteristic of joint Gaussian distribution so as to obtain a runoff forecasting result in the cascade hydropower station; establishing an optimized dispatching model, wherein the optimized dispatching model uses a reinforcement learning method, utilizes related data of the cascade hydropower stations and a runoff forecasting result, and aims at the hydropower with the lowest running cost and the greatest water and electricity consumption; and training and updating strategy neural network parameters of the intelligent agent to converge to obtain the cascade hydropower station optimized scheduling strategy in the scheduling period. And the economic, safety and real-time requirements of the scheduling plan of the cascade hydropower station-power grid system under the variable flow are met.
assignees: POWERCHINA HUADONG ENGINEERING CORP LTD;HANGZHOU HUACHEN ELECTRIC POWER CONTROL CO LTD;UNIV ZHEJIANG

title_en: Construction method based on dynamic evaluation model of petroleum engineering safety risk
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of model construction, in particular to a construction method based on a dynamic risk assessment model of petroleum engineering safety. The method comprises the following steps: obtaining geological data of a petroleum engineering area; carrying out multidimensional sensor deployment on geological data of the petroleum engineering area to generate a petroleum exploitation sensor deployment network; acquiring environmental sensing data based on an oil exploitation sensor deployment network to obtain standard oil exploitation environmental acquisition data; carrying out oil exploitation geographic elevation conversion on the standard oil exploitation environment acquisition data to generate oil exploitation geographic elevation data; and carrying out multi-level petroleum exploitation influence evaluation based on the petroleum exploitation geographic elevation data to generate petroleum exploitation multi-level influence data. According to the invention, the dynamic sensing and instant response capacity of the petroleum engineering safety risk is improved by carrying out data integration, dynamic monitoring and risk propagation path analysis on the petroleum engineering stage data and carrying out petroleum engineering safety risk assessment.
assignees: DONGYING GUANGNIAN PETROLEUM TECH CO LTD

title_en: Large power grid cascading failure electromagnetic transient simulation scene construction method, system and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a large power grid cascading failure electromagnetic transient simulation scene construction method, and discloses a system and a medium with the large power grid cascading failure electromagnetic transient simulation scene construction method, wherein the large power grid cascading failure electromagnetic transient simulation scene construction method provides a cascading failure scene constructed by cascading failure simulation scenes of primary and secondary system automatic modeling and splicing of a large power grid, and compared with the cascading failure scene based on tide data or electromechanical transient simulation data, the cascading failure scene construction method has higher precision, and can meet the modeling requirements of novel power system cascading failure scenes containing a large number of power electronic equipment. The full-grid electromagnetic transient modeling efficiency and the scale of the large power grid are remarkably improved, and an effective simulation means is provided for accurate reproduction of the large power grid cascading failure evolution process.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Disaster multisource situation intelligent perception management and control method and system
abstract_en: The application relates to a disaster multisource situation intelligent perception management and control method and system. The method comprises the steps of collecting hydrological weather and topographic data, generating a standardized data set through space-time alignment and abnormal cleaning, constructing a directed topological graph containing node and edge attributes based on the extracted river network topological relation, further designing a graph neural network model, obtaining a flood dynamic route prediction model through physical constraint loss function training of an embedded water balance principle, inputting real-time hydrological data into the model to conduct graph convolution operation, predicting the water level, flow and split ratio change of each node in a future period, and finally combining a digital elevation model to conduct submerged simulation analysis to generate a flood control scheduling scheme and risk early warning information. The method realizes the deep fusion of a physical mechanism and data driving, effectively captures the flood propagation rule under the topological constraint of the river network by using the graph neural network, obviously improves the calculation efficiency while guaranteeing the prediction precision, and provides real-time and reliable decision support for flood disaster prevention and control in complex river network areas.
assignees: YELLOW RIVER INSTITUTE OF HYDRAULIC RES

title_en: Smart fire detector
title_ko: 스마트 화재감지장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smart fire detector capable of notifying a fire occurrence in real time even in the middle of the night and absence and enabling rapid escape by checking an accurate ignition position, by coupling a wireless ad-hoc network module to a single type fire alarm to allow fire information to be shared in real time between devices. The smart fire detector comprises: a fire detection module for detecting fire; a sensor module for acquiring a monitoring image, voice information and ignition position information; a fire information sharing means for acquiring the ignition position information, the monitoring image, and the voice information through the sensor module when a fire is detected by the fire detection module, generating fire occurrence information by combining the acquired fire position information, the monitoring image, the voice information, and the fire detection information, controlling the fire occurrence information to be wirelessly transmitted to a nearby smart fire detector by using a bio-mimetic ad-hoc network algorithm, and generating fire alarm by receiving the fire occurrence information transmitted from surroundings; and a control module for wirelessly transmitting the fire occurrence information generated in the fire information sharing means, and receiving the fire occurrence information wirelessly received to transmit the same to the fire information sharing means.
abstract_ko: 단독형 화재경보기에 무선 애드혹 네트워크(Ad hoc network) 모듈을 결합하여 기기 간에 화재 정보를 실시간으로 공유하도록 함으로써, 심야 및 부재시에도 화재발생사실을 실시간 통보하고, 정확한 발화위치 확인으로 신속한 대피가 이루어지도록 한 스마트 화재감지장치에 관한 것으로서, 화재를 감지하는 화재감지모듈, 감시 영상과 음성 정보 및 발화 위치정보를 획득하는 센서모듈, 화재감지모듈에 의해 화재가 감지되면, 상기 센서 모듈을 통해 발화 위치 정보와 감시 영상 및 음성 정보를 획득하고, 획득한 발화 위치 정보와 감시 영상과 음성 정보 및 화재 감지 정보를 조합하여 화재발생정보를 생성하고, 생체모방 애드혹 네트워크 알고리즘을 이용하여 화재발생정보를 주변 스마트 화재감지기에 무선 전파하도록 제어하며, 주변에서 전파된 화재발생정보를 수신하여 화재 경보를 발생하는 화재정보 공유수단 및 화재정보 공유수단으로부터 생성된 화재발생정보를 무선으로 전송하고, 무선으로 수신한 화재발생정보는 수신하여 화재정보 공유수단에 전달하는 관제 모듈을 포함하여 스마트 화재감지장치를 구현한다.

title_en: Prediction method and device for clearing price of auxiliary service for peak regulation based on deep learning
abstract_en: Disclosed is a prediction method and device for a clearing price of an auxiliary service for peak regulation, including: acquiring continuous N days of historical data of clearing prices of an auxiliary service market for peak regulation and respectively moving data of original clearing prices forwards by 1, 2, . . . k days, so as to obtain D−1, D−2 . . . D−k data columns; performing first-round training and prediction by adopting a BP (Back Propagation) neural network, a BP neural network optimized by a PSO (Particle Swarm Optimization) algorithm and an LSSVM (Least Square Support Vector Machine), and forming a BP-expansion column, a PSO_BP-expansion column and an LSSVM-expansion column; training the BP neural network by taking first N−k days of time points and D−1, D−2 . . . D−k clearing prices, the BP-expansion column, the PSO_BP-expansion column, the LSSVM-expansion column and the original clearing prices as training data; and performing prediction for the clearing price.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER;STATE GRID ELEC VEHICLE SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Systems and methods for a synthetic infrastructure model for vulnerability, failure, and future transition planning
abstract_en: A computer-implemented SynF (Synthetic Infrastructure) model is designed to estimate the location and characteristics of urban water and power distribution networks, estimate how those networks are interconnected and connect to buildings and transportation systems, and assess how failures propagate within and across the systems. The model was designed using Phoenix metro area cities but has been extended to other cities.
assignees: CHESTER MIKHAIL;AHMAD SK NASIR;JOHNSON NATHAN;HOFF RYAN;UNIV ARIZONA STATE

title_en: Stability judgment method for extracted online social network data
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for judging stability of extracted online social network data, which comprises the following steps: s1, E 0 ＝(1,0,0) T Initial state, balance point when no information is transmitted; at the step of S2, the method comprises the steps of, a termination state, a balance point after information has passed through the entire network; s3, in On the premise that the information reaches the equilibrium point of a temporary stable state in the competition propagation process

title_en: Storage battery life prediction method based on optimized multilayer residual BP (back propagation) depth network
abstract_en: A storage battery life prediction method based on an optimized multilayer residual BP depth network comprises the following steps: s1, collecting real-time data of storage batteries in working states in the energy storage power station, and constructing an index system; s2, preprocessing the data according to the established index system, and initializing a multi-layer residual BP deep learning network; s3, solving a predicted value by forward propagation of a residual error network; s4, substituting the cost function into the cost function, calculating the network error, judging the error condition, if the requirement is not met, performing the step S5, and if the requirement is met, performing the step S6; s5, determining an error gradient, adjusting weight learning, and then turning to the step S3; s6, completing network learning to obtain a storage battery life model, and turning to the step S7; and S7, finishing the calculation. The method can predict the service life of the storage battery with high precision, and is helpful for guiding the scheduling scheme of the energy storage power station charging station, so that the running reasonability and the economical efficiency of the electric vehicle charging station with the energy storage system are effectively ensured.

title_en: Trade data processing method and system based on blockchain
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of blockchains, in particular to a blockchain-based trade data processing method and a blockchain-based trade data processing system. The method comprises the steps of obtaining real-time trade data and historical trade data, conducting standardized processing on the real-time trade data to obtain standard trade data, constructing a trade blockchain network based on the standard trade data, conducting trade product flow direction identification on the basis of the trade blockchain network to obtain circulation link data, generating dynamic demand data based on the circulation link data, conducting supply and demand perception modeling on the dynamic demand data to construct a dynamic supply and demand perception model, conducting node capacity bottleneck calculation on the trade blockchain network by utilizing the dynamic supply and demand perception model to generate node capacity bottleneck data, generating delivery efficiency data based on the node capacity bottleneck data, conducting risk propagation analysis on the delivery efficiency data to generate risk transfer path data. The method realizes efficient trade data processing.

title_en: Multi-network cascading failure propagation prediction method based on heterogeneous graph neural network under disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-network chained fault propagation prediction method based on a heterogeneous graph neural network under a disaster, which comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source data of the disaster, electric power, communication and traffic networks, constructing a four-layer heterogeneous graph model, defining multi-type interlayer edges, establishing a mapping relation between disaster physical quantity and physical node health states, predicting initial fault states at disaster impact time, defining multi-scale multi-mechanism propagation rules based on the interlayer edges, simulating chained fault processes, constructing a space-time heterogeneous graph neural network model, stacking a heterogeneous graph neural network module and a gating circulation unit module, adopting a double-head prediction layer to predict node continuous running states and discrete functional states in an autoregressive mode, carrying out post-processing on a state time sequence output by the model, and reconstructing a cross-domain chained fault propagation path through a causal attribution algorithm. The invention can accurately simulate the whole evolution process from disaster occurrence to multi-network cascading failure, and realize multi-scale failure prediction and causal analysis.

title_en: Broadcasting system for school
title_ko: 원격제어 및 우선순위방송 기능과 행사장방송수단을 구비한 교내방송 시스템
abstract_en: A school broadcasting equipped with a remote control and priority broadcasting function, and the venue broadcasting policy is provided to increase the quality and efficiency of the education by controlling the reception of broadcast data. A central controller interface is connected to A controller and internet network for the reception of the broadcast data through the internet connection and remote control. A fire receiver receives fire occurrence signal from a fire alarm control station. An A/V(Audio/Video) mixer(170) mixes broadcast data of the sound sources and the images inputted from a memory or a venue broadcasting policy. A prioritization selection unit selects broadcast data. A central matrix unit transmits broadcast data selected in the prioritization selection unit to the broadcasting output unit.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 원격제어 및 우선순위방송 기능과 행사장방송수단을 구비한 교내방송 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는 강당이나 시청각실 등과 같은 행사장에서 행해지는 강연, 연극, 축제 등의 행사를 행사장에 설치된 카메라 및 마이크를 통해 촬영하고 이를 행사장에 설치되어 있는 행사장방송수단이 가공처리하여 필요로 하는 교실로 송출하고, 인터넷접속을 통해 외부 통신매체로부터 방송데이터를 수신 받을 뿐만 아니라 외부에서 교내방송 시스템에 접속하여 원격제어가 가능하고, 화재 등의 비상상황에서는 방영되고 있는 방송을 차단하고 비상상황을 알리는 비상방송이 송출되도록 하는 우선순위방송 기능을 구비하고, 화재 발생시 신속한 대피와 화재진압을 위해 중앙방송수단은 교내의 소방설비들을 전체적으로 제어하는 화재수신기로부터 화재발생신호를 수신 받고 이를 우선순위방송으로 알리고, 화재수신기와 송수신하지 않고 단독으로 화재발생을 감지하여 알리는 단독경보형 화재감지기가 감지한 화재신호는 각 교실에 설치된 방송출력수단이나 행사장에 설치된 행사장방송수단이 수신받아 중앙방송수단으로 전송하고, 이를 전송 받은 중앙방송수단은 우선순위방송을 알려 화재발생 사실의 신속한 전파를 통한 화재피해를 최소화 할 수 있도록 한 원격제어 및 우선순위방송 기능과 행사장방송수단을 구비한 교내방송 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
     	본 발명의 원격제어 및 우선순위방송 기능과 행사장방송수단을 구비한 교내방송 시스템은 영상 및 음원의 방송데이터를 출력하는 TV 및 스피커를 포함하는 각  교실의 방송출력수단과,  영상 및 음원의 방송데이터를 입력받고 가공처리하여 이를 필요로 하는 교실의 상기 방송출력수단으로 전송하는 중앙방송수단과,  카메라 및 마이크를 통해 촬영되는 행사장(예; 강당, 시청각실, 스튜디오실 등)에서의 행사 영상 및 음원의 방송데이터를 입력받고 가공처리하여 이를 상기 중앙방송수단 또는 방송출력수단으로 전송하는 행사장방송수단를 포함하는 교내방송 시스템에 있어서,  상기 중앙방송수단은 중앙방송수단을 전체적으로 제어하는 중앙제어부와, 인터넷접속을 통한 방송데이터의 수신 및 원격제어를 위해 상기 중앙제어부와 연결되고 인터넷망에 접속되는 중앙 인터넷인터페이스부와, 상기 중앙제어부에 연결되고 사용자 조작을 위한 중앙 입력부 및 디스플레이부와, 상기 중앙제어부에 연결되고 교내 소방설비들을 전체적으로 제어하는 화재수신기로부터 화재발생신호를 전송받는 화재수신부와, 상기 중앙제어부에 연결되고 중앙방송수단의 운영을 위한 프로그램 및 방송데이터가 저장되는 중앙 메모리와, 외부의 오디오기기나 비디오기기, 상기 인터넷인터페이스부, 상기 메모리 또는 상기 행사장방송수단으로부터 입력되는 영상들과 음원들의 방송데이터를 믹싱하는 중앙 A/V믹서와, 상기 중앙 A/V믹서에서 우선 출력할 방송데이터를 선택 제어하는 중앙 우선순위선택부와, 상기 우선순위선택부에서 선택된 방송데이터를 필요로 하는 교실의 상기 방송출력수단으로 전송하는 중앙 매트릭스부를 포함하여 이루어진 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Networking method and communication system of emergency communication network for mining area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a networking method and a communication system of an emergency communication network for a mining area, which enable each downstream node to select a superior node with the shortest path and the strongest received signal for communication, and gradually reduce the transmitting power of each downstream node to the lowest level capable of being communicated, thereby being capable of flexibly and quickly establishing a low-power-consumption communication network; the problem of mutual interference between terminal access and network cascade channels is effectively solved by adopting a multi-radio frequency communication mode, so that the network communication rate and the uninterrupted transmission capability of comprehensive data services are improved. Therefore, the implementation of the embodiment of the invention provides a high-quality scheme for the construction, maintenance and use of the emergency communication network for the low-power-consumption mining area, and provides powerful communication guarantee for emergency rescue in mining area accidents.

title_en: Large power grid disturbance propagation characteristic evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention provides a large power grid disturbance propagation characteristic evaluation method. According to the method, energy conveying evolution characteristics and disturbance track large power grid disturbance propagation characteristics are combined for evaluation; firstly, according to the transient total energy change characteristics after the fault, the disturbance propagation process after the fault is divided into a transient energy injection stage, a transient energy conservation stage and a transient energy step-by-step attenuation stage; then, an evaluation object is determined according to the transient energy change characteristics in each stage; a time-domain simulation method is used for simulation calculation; in addition, relevant items of the transient energy are selected from the simulation result in different stages, and are defined as an observation index; influence factors for generating the disturbance are judged; an influence factor set is generated, so that the key factors for influencing the transient energy propagation are obtained; the evaluation of the large power grid disturbance propagation characteristics is realized.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;ECONOMIC TECHNOLOGY RES INST STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: RQD based on laser scanning, RQD and optimal thresholdtAnisotropy solving method
abstract_en: RQD based on laser scanning, RQD and optimal threshold t Anisotropy solving method, belonging to RQD t The field of anisotropy resolution, comprising the steps of: (1) three-dimensional laser scanning of the structural surface is rapidly acquired; (2) drawing a structural plane polar diagram and a trend rose diagram; (3) rock mass calculation based on RQD indexes; (4) generating and sectioning a rock three-dimensional fracture network model; (5) RQD t Drawing an anisotropy map; (6) solving method of optimal threshold t based on RQD inversion; (7) RQD t And (3) an anisotropy solving method. The method combines three-dimensional laser scanning, a neighbor propagation algorithm, an RQD theory, a fracture network model, a generalized RQD theory and inversion calculation to realizeRQD t And solving the optimum threshold t and the anisotropy, and provides a RQD based on laser scanning, the RQD and the optimum threshold t And (3) an anisotropy solving method. The method is clear and suitable for rock RQD t The anisotropy of (2) is solved.

title_en: Digital power transformer health state fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method
abstract_en: The application discloses a digital power transformer health state fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method, which comprises the following steps of 1: selecting evaluation indexes influencing the state of the digital power transformer and carrying out hierarchical division; step 2: dividing the evaluation states of the digital power transformer; and step 3: classifying the evaluation indexes according to the priority and the degradation direction; and 4, step 4: respectively establishing evaluation index membership functions of various categories, determining the weights of evaluation indexes of different levels through a BP (back propagation) neural network, and obtaining a fuzzy evaluation matrix; and 5: and carrying out fuzzy operation by adopting a fuzzy evaluation matrix, and normalizing the operation result to obtain a final evaluation result. According to the method, the evaluation index and the evaluation level are determined according to the influence on the health state of the digital power transformer, and different weights are configured, so that the evaluation result is more reasonable and accurate, the digital power transformer can be effectively evaluated, and the reliability is higher.
assignees: MARKETING SERVICE CENTER OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV SOUTHEAST

title_en: Power transmission and transformation transformer equipment fault prediction analysis method under extreme meteorological condition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for predicting and analyzing the faults of power transmission and transformation transformer equipment under extreme meteorological conditions, which comprises the following steps: step 1, collecting fault data of a power transmission and transformation transformer which occurs under various extreme meteorological conditions, and presetting fault types; step 2, preprocessing data parameters; step 3, establishing a deep learning network; step 4, updating the gradient and optimizing the parameters by using an error back propagation algorithm, and training a neural network; step 5, predicting faults, and verifying the accuracy of the neural network; the method solves the technical problems that the existing fault prediction model has certain deviation under extreme meteorological conditions in the fault prediction of the power transmission and transformation transformer equipment in the prior art, the fault prediction accuracy of the existing fault prediction model is influenced by the extreme meteorological conditions, and the existing fault prediction model is not applicable under the condition.

title_en: Three-dimensional assembly model change propagation influence evaluation method based on feature driving
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional assembly model change propagation influence evaluation method based on characteristic driving, which specifically comprises the following steps: step 1, establishing a characteristic assembly relation network of a three-dimensional assembly model; step 2, selecting the part relation network in the step 1 to evaluate the influence of part change; and 3, selecting the characteristic assembly relation network in the step 1 to evaluate the characteristic change propagation influence. The method comprehensively considers 4 aspects of importance of the part assembly topological structure, characteristic change propagation paths, characteristic change propagation indexes and characteristic change propagation evolution rules, and comprehensively analyzes and evaluates the characteristic change propagation influence of the three-dimensional assembly model; when the geometric topological shape of the three-dimensional part model is changed, the influence of the part and the characteristic granularity layer on the part can be comprehensively evaluated, and a foundation is provided for the change propagation decision and control of the three-dimensional assembly model.

title_en: BIM-based subway station congestion analysis method, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: BIM-based subway station congestion analysis method, electronic equipment and storage medium belong to the technical field of subway operation. In order to perform congestion analysis on a subway station by using a BIM technology, the invention sets operation nodes of the subway station based on the theory of a complex network to construct a subway station network; acquiring operation data of operation nodes of the subway station to obtain an operation data time sequence of the operation nodes of the subway station, performing data correction and normalization processing on the operation data of the operation nodes of the subway station to obtain operation time sequences of all the operation nodes of the subway station, and performing correlation analysis of the operation nodes of the subway station and congestion propagation process analysis of the operation nodes of the subway station to obtain correlation lag parameters among the operation nodes of the subway station; and setting subway station operation nodes to optimize measures, performing simulation analysis in a BIM model, and performing optimization adjustment on congestion of the subway station operation nodes. The analysis process of the invention is reasonable and effective.
assignees: SHENZHEN URBAN TRANSP PLANNING CENTER CO LTD

title_en: Typical adjustable resource optimization method and system for power grid adjustment scene
abstract_en: A typical adjustable resource optimization method and system for a power grid adjustment scene comprises the steps of carrying out step extraction on operation data according to historical operation data of different adjustable resources, setting typical scene response characteristics according to response characteristic differences of the adjustable resources in different power grid adjustment scenes, constructing an adjustable resource response potential evaluation index system for the power grid adjustment scenes and calculating various evaluation indexes, constructing an adjustable resource comprehensive evaluation model according to matching degree differences of multi-type adjustable resource response characteristics and power grid adjustment requirements, realizing comprehensive evaluation of the adjustable resource response potential in a specific scene, adopting a combined evaluation and neighbor propagation algorithm to carry out rapid grouping and optimization on the adjustable resources according to the combination of the adjustable resource response characteristic combination and the comprehensive evaluation model, realizing classification and optimization of adjustable resource groups with different response potentials, and analyzing user demand response potentials and optimizing energy management and demand response strategies according to classification and optimization results.
assignees: NANJING UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY;ELECTRIC POWER RES INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD

title_en: Control method for cascade H-bridge photovoltaic grid-connected inverter under unbalanced power grid working condition
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electric energy quality control, in particular to a control method of a cascade H-bridge photovoltaic grid-connected inverter under an unbalanced working condition of a power grid, which comprises the steps of S1, establishing a direct current side total voltage control method to obtain a reference value of an active current component required to be injected into the power grid by the inverter, S2, establishing a current positive and negative sequence inner loop control method to track positive and negative sequence current instructions to obtain positive and negative sequence voltage modulation signals, S3, generating a negative sequence current feedforward term based on a negative sequence current injection method, merging the feedforward term into calculation of a direct current side voltage control output value to complete phase-to-phase power balance control, and S4, carrying out carrier phase-shifting modulation based on a phase-shifting angle which changes in real time to complete phase-to-phase power balance control. The invention can better solve the problem of unbalanced power of the cascade H-bridge photovoltaic grid-connected inverter under the unbalanced working condition of the power grid, and ensures that the inverter safely and stably provides three-phase balance current.
assignees: UNIV SHIHEZI;TBEA XINJIANG SUNOASIS CO LTD

title_en: Method for calculating propagation influence intensity of multi-source adaptability modification of product based on path coupling
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for calculating the propagation influence intensity of multi-source adaptive modification of a product based on path coupling, and belongs to the technical field of engineering modification.
