According to the method, a product adaptability change propagation network is constructed according to propagation influence relations among product parts, coupling nodes and coupling paths of multi-source adaptability change propagation are identified, the correlation of structural change attribute changes of corresponding parts caused by the coupling nodes when the coupling nodes are influenced by different change source propagation is determined, the direct propagation influence intensity of a front end node of the coupling paths on a rear end node during multi-source change is calculated, and the product multi-source adaptability change propagation influence intensity is calculated according to the correlation of the coupling paths, the direct propagation influence intensity of the coupling nodes and the change complexity of the parts. The invention can effectively identify the coupling nodes and the coupling paths with multisource adaptive modification, can improve the design efficiency of products, reduce modification cost and provide basis for the adaptive modification in the personalized customization process of the products.

title_en: Dynamic visual data-based power quality assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic visual data-based electric energy quality assessment method and a dynamic visual data-based electric energy quality assessment system, which relate to the technical field of electric energy assessment of a power distribution network. And extracting voltage sag characteristics by wavelet transformation, combining LSTM mining harmonic time sequence characteristics, capturing environmental space distribution by CNN, and constructing a multidimensional characteristic matrix. And then, inputting a TCN-GAT model to fuse space-time characteristics, calculating node voltage sensitivity, harmonic propagation weight and risk index, and outputting the electric energy quality comprehensive score. And triggering visual analysis and knowledge graph matching according to the comprehensive scores of the electric energy quality to realize abnormality diagnosis and strategy generation. According to the method, through multi-dimensional feature fusion and space-time analysis, the evaluation accuracy, the instantaneity and the interpretability are improved, and an intelligent scheme is provided for power distribution network dispatching and fault prevention and control.
assignees: JINAN ZIRUI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Social information networking monitoring and early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a social information networking monitoring and early warning method and system, and relates to the technical field of information early warning; the method comprises the steps of obtaining semantic similarity of cross-time semantics according to feature vectors and feature weights extracted from multi-source information by a distributed semantic model, obtaining an event association strength network according to the information source weights and the semantic similarity, obtaining risk propagation indexes for evaluating the influence of an information propagation path on risk amplification according to the distribution characteristics of depths of network nodes in the event association strength network, generating early warning comprehensive indexes for monitoring social information networking according to the risk propagation indexes, the information source weights, the semantic similarity and the association strength among events in the event association strength network, and determining early warning grade results corresponding to the early warning comprehensive indexes according to preset threshold intervals. The method and the system can improve accuracy and timeliness of social information networking monitoring and early warning.
assignees: YUESHENGDA TIANJIN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Deep migration learning-based flue gas waste heat cascade utilization system optimization method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flue gas waste heat cascade utilization system optimization method based on deep transfer learning, which comprises the steps of firstly constructing a flue gas waste heat system simulation model under multiple working conditions based on EBSILON simulation platforms to generate simulation data sets covering key operation parameters of the flue gas waste heat system under different loads, environmental conditions and the like, then constructing a deep neural network pre-training model based on the simulation data, adding linear and nonlinear calibration networks based on the simulation data, performing super-parameter updating on the calibration network by utilizing on-site operation data, transferring the pre-training model to a characteristic space adapted to the operation data, and dynamically adjusting flue gas bypass parameters by combining a genetic algorithm based on the super-parameter updating model to realize the maximum utilization of waste heat resources. The invention not only overcomes the limitation of scarce on-site effective operation data samples on model training, but also improves the overall energy efficiency of the system through intelligent regulation and control.

title_en: Urban data fusion event early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of smart city safety and emergency management, and provides a city data fusion event early warning method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a physical environment time sequence data set, a city facility asset data set and an API call behavior log data set; the method comprises the steps of establishing a dynamic digital twin map based on the data set, positioning initial risk trigger nodes based on the dynamic digital twin map and a physical environment time sequence data set, performing graph traversal search to establish a potential risk propagation path set based on a sliding time window abnormality detection mechanism, quantitatively evaluating and generating an early warning event set by adopting a chained probability model, calling a natural language generation function based on a high risk event, matching an optimal emergency plan from an emergency plan knowledge base, and analyzing the optimal emergency plan to generate a scheduling instruction in combination with a natural language early warning message visualization early warning scene. The invention constructs an event early warning and response mechanism oriented to the urban system, and is suitable for intelligent urban early warning emergency management.
assignees: SHANGHAI PINGTUO INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire-fighting communication anti-interference relay device and method for energy storage system
abstract_en: The invention is applicable to the technical field of battery energy storage communication, and provides an anti-interference relay device and method for fire control communication of an energy storage system, wherein the anti-interference relay device comprises a signal processing module, a signal processing module and a power supply module, wherein the signal processing module is used for carrying out anti-interference processing on a received model; the system comprises a signal amplifying and shaping module, a cascade interface module, a fire signal detection and communication module, a signal processing module and a signal processing module, wherein the signal amplifying and shaping module is used for carrying out gain adjustment and waveform shaping on signals, the cascade interface module is provided with a double CAN bus interface and is connected with an upstream relay device and a downstream relay device based on ring network topology and used for outputting shaped signals and realizing cascade expansion and redundant communication of the relay device, the fire signal detection and communication module is used for marking fire data as the highest priority and transmitting the fire data to the signal processing module when fire signals are detected, and the signal processing module is enabled to schedule and forward the fire data preferentially through an improved token ring communication protocol. The problems of large signal attenuation, weak interference resistance, poor expansibility and insufficient emergency communication capability of the traditional relay device in a complex industrial environment are solved.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RESEARCH INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Cascade machine learning-based hydrate region seabed landslide risk assessment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydrate region submarine landslide risk assessment method based on cascading machine learning, and belongs to the technical field of marine geological disaster prediction. The landslide risk prediction method comprises the steps of firstly obtaining historical landslide data, hydrate occurrence data and various environmental characteristics of a research area, preprocessing, constructing a hydrate occurrence data set based on local hydrate data and the environmental characteristics, training a neural network model fused with physical constraints, predicting occurrence depth of all-area hydrate and generating a distribution map, finally fusing the predicted depth serving as a key characteristic with the environmental characteristics, constructing an enhanced landslide data set, training an integrated learning model by adopting a dynamic weight integration strategy based on a geological landscape unit, and finishing landslide risk prediction. According to the invention, the prediction bottleneck caused by the scarcity of the hydrate data is effectively solved through the cascade architecture, the rationality and the robustness of the model are improved through physical constraint, and the high-precision and interpretable evaluation of the submarine landslide risk of the hydrate region is realized.

title_en: Cold chain risk source priority screening method and system based on missing link inference
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cold chain risk source priority screening method and system based on missing link inference, and relates to the technical field of cold chain risk source identification and screening. Firstly, constructing an initial circulation network based on cold chain tracing data, identifying and deducing a missing link, complementing the network according to a triple principle, secondly, executing reverse risk tracing on a polluted terminal node, calculating initial risk values of all upstream nodes based on a multi-path risk accumulation principle, then dynamically correcting the propagation weight of the missing link based on a risk value result of the upstream nodes, eliminating a higher risk value caused by link inference errors through a self-adaptive mechanism, and repeatedly executing the risk tracing and the link correction process until the risk values of the upstream nodes are converged to generate a priority screening sequence of a cold chain risk source.

title_en: Method and device for training service quality evaluation model
abstract_en: Disclosed are a method and device for training a service quality evaluation model, wherein the method comprises: collecting machine performance data, network feature data and quality monitoring data of a service node according to a fixed period; determining a feature value based on the machine performance data and the network feature data; determining target quality data based on the quality monitoring data; using the feature value and the target quality data; and using a training set to construct a service quality evaluation model. In the present invention, by means of associating indicators, such as machine performance data and network feature data, with service quality through the feature engineering function of a deep neural network itself, combining a back-propagation algorithm for training, and fitting a nonlinear relationship therein, the time consumption of artificial feature engineering can be reduced, and the accuracy of service quality evaluation can also be improved.

title_en: Earthquake damage prediction and prevention system and method thereof
abstract_en: An earthquake damage prediction and prevention system for determining an impact or damage caused by an earthquake to objects associated with different geographical locations. A central unit with a filter module selects and collects earthquake related data of a plurality of network units. At least one impact ratio table is stored with a first data structure for storing geographical and/or topographical data coordinates of the different geographical locations. The geometric distances of the geographical locations from a hypocenter/epicenter are generated by an intensity calculation module with a coordinates processor. Local intensity values based upon the generated geometric distances and a given earthquake magnitude of a stored parameterization including variable weight parameters are generated by a propagation calculation unit of the intensity calculation module, whereas the generated geometric distances are stored assigned to the corresponding geographical locations by a second data structure of the impact ratio table. At least one of the variable weight parameters and/or at least one impact ratio for different earthquake intensity levels indicative of the impact or damage caused by an earthquake to the object and/or at least one object parameter defining earthquake exposed structures of the object are received from a plurality of users. By an index calculation module the impact index for the geographical locations is generated by determining in each case from the impact ratio table the impact ratio for the local intensity at the respective geographical location, and the impact ratios are added up weighted in each case by the weighting factor assigned to the respective geographical location.

title_en: Minimization of Service Interruptions of Core Network Failure
abstract_en: Techniques are disclosed for the minimization of service interruptions for core network failure. One example includes a method in which a disaster control function (DCF) receives, from an access and mobility function (AMF), an address of a base station managed by the AMF. The DCF detects an interruption of services provided by the AMF. The DCF transmits, to the base station and using the address, a message indicting the interruption of services provided by the AMF.

title_en: Cascade failure simulation method, equipment and storage medium based on weighted dependent network
abstract_en: The invention provides a cascade failure simulation method, equipment and storage medium based on a weighted dependent network, wherein the cascade failure simulation method comprises the following steps: acquiring a cascade failure model based on a weighted dependent network, wherein the cascade failure model comprises a plurality of network layers, and each network layer is provided with a plurality of nodes; setting initial load according to node strength of the node and node strength of neighbor nodes, and setting node capacity of the node according to a nonlinear relation between the node capacity of the node and the initial load; and simulating a cascade failure process by adopting the cascade failure model, wherein the cascade failure process comprises interlayer cascade failure and intra-layer cascade failure, and in the simulation process, load redistribution is performed according to the residual capacity and importance of neighbor nodes of the failure node. The technical scheme of the invention can improve the robustness of the cascade failure model, thereby improving the simulation effect on cascade failure.

title_en: Method for predicting cascading faults of power grid of graph neural network based on physical information guidance
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of power system cascade fault prediction, and relates to a method for predicting a grid cascade fault of a graphic neural network based on physical information guidance, which comprises the steps of obtaining operation data of a cascade fault, inputting the operation data of the cascade fault into a trained grid cascade fault prediction model, and obtaining a prediction result; the grid cascading failure prediction model comprises a co-embedded graph neural network and a structure coding module, wherein the data enhancement is carried out by utilizing the structure coding based on multi-step random walk matrix and node degree representation considering the line attribute of the grid, the capability of capturing topology information is improved, the co-embedded graph neural network is utilized to promote the interaction of grid nodes and grid lines, the accuracy of grid cascading failure prediction is improved, the node-side interaction aggregation function of the co-embedded graph neural network is changed through the power transmission distribution factor of the grid, the description capability of the complex interaction relation of the actual grid is improved, and the accuracy of grid cascading failure prediction is improved.

title_en: Dynamic control method for water level lower limit of cascade hydropower station for supporting power grid supply protection
abstract_en: The invention provides a dynamic control method for a lower limit of a water level of a cascade hydropower station for supporting power grid supply protection, and belongs to the field of multi-energy power system planning. The method is based on prediction data of the annual runoff represented by the dead water and the new energy output, and the supply-keeping period is set on the premise of meeting hydropower operation parameters and constraints. In order to ensure the water and electricity bearing supply and demand in the period, a 'electricity-based water fixing' algorithm which is used for coupling a fourth-order Dragon-grid-tower method and a success-failure search method is innovatively adopted to solve the required power generation flow. And further, combining the water balance principle, calculating an initial reservoir capacity through reverse iteration, determining an initial water level lower limit by utilizing a piecewise linear interpolation method, and finally correcting according to the operation constraint. And in the simulation period, dynamically updating the lower limit of the water level by adopting a rolling calculation strategy to form a complete dynamic control curve of the lower limit of the water level. The method has the remarkable advantages of simple and convenient solution, convenient parameter adjustment, high calculation efficiency, quick response to the real-time power grid supply protection instruction and the like through the direct reverse recursion physical process.

title_en: Disaster alarm broadcasting system reflecting climate disaster information and wireless alarm terminal for it
title_ko: 기후 재난 정보를 반영한 재난 경보 방송 시스템 및 이를 위한 무선 경보 단말기
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster warning broadcasting system reflecting climatic disaster information, and a wireless warning terminal thereof. According to the present invention, the disaster warning broadcasting system comprises a plurality of fine dust sensor devices and wireless terminals installed at a different place in a living zone. The disaster warning broadcasting system automatically switches and transmits normal broadcasting, guidance broadcasting, and emergency warning broadcasting step by step in accordance with the fine dust concentration measured by the fine dust sensor device and a national measurement network. When a warning signal is transmitted from the wireless warning terminals, the disaster warning broadcasting system propagates a disaster occurrence situation of a predetermined place to surrounding living zones, and automatically switches and transmits emergency warning broadcasting. Accordingly, correct life-contact type information of a real living zone, not observatory atmospheric information by the national measurement network, can be confirmed and thus, disaster warning broadcasting reflecting an environment and climatic disaster information of the living zone is provided, thereby quickly and correctly transmitting correct life-contact type disaster situation.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 기후 재난 정보를 반영한 재난 경보 방송 시스템 및 이를 위한 무선 경보 단말기에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 재난 경보 방송 시스템은 생활 구역의 서로 다른 장소에 복수 개의 미세먼지 센서 장치들과 무선 경보 단말기들을 설치한다. 재난 경보 방송 시스템은 미세먼지 센서 장치 및 국가 측정망을 통해 측정된 미세먼지 농도에 따라 단계별로 일반 방송, 안내 방송 및 비상 경보 방송을 자동 절체하여 송출한다. 또 재난 경보 방송 시스템은 무선 경보 단말기들로부터 경보 신호가 전송되면, 특정 장소의 재난 발생 상황을 생활 구역의 주변에 전달하고 비상 경보 방송을 자동 절체하여 송출한다. 본 발명에 의하면, 국가 측정망에 의한 측정소 대기 정보가 아닌 실제 생활 구역의 정확한 생활 밀착형 정보를 확인할 수 있도록 하고, 이를 통해 생활 구역에 대한 환경 및 기후 재난 정보를 반영하여 재난 경보 방송을 제공함으로써, 생활 밀착형의 재난 상황을 정확하고 신속하게 전달할 수 있다.

title_en: Alarm broadcasting system based on fm signals
title_ko: Fm신호를 기반으로 하는 경보 방송 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system including a disaster warning device based on FM (Frequency Modulation) frequency, which is spaced apart from a predetermined distance from an event location on a road. The system includes a main device connected to the disaster warning device and connected to be capable of communicating with a network; and the disaster warning device including first to nth directional transmission antennas based on FM. The present invention can prevent accidents in advance by clearly transmitting to vehicles a dangerous situation in a tunnel and a situation in a foggy area using an FM frequency band starting from a point 500 m from a tunnel entrance and a foggy area.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 도로의 이벤트 위치로부터 미리 설정된 거리에 이격 배치되는 FM(Frequency Modulation) 주파수를 기반으로 하는 재난경보장치를 포함하는 시스템으로서, 상기 재난경보장치와 연결되며, 네트워크와 통신 가능하도록 연결된 메인장치; 및 FM을 기반으로 하는 제1 내지 제n 지향성 송신안테나를 포함하는 상기 재난경보장치; 를 포함하고, 상기 재난경보장치는, 미리 설정된 FM 주파수 대역으로 각각 구성된 제1 내지 제m 채널의 외부방송신호를 수신하는 FM 수신안테나; 상기 FM 수신안테나를 통해 수신된 상기 제1 내지 제m 채널에 대한 외부방송신호의 전파세기를 측정하는 전파감지부; 및 상기 이벤트에 대한 미리 설정된 음성신호를 FM 주파수로 변조하여 경보방송신호를 출력하는 전파출력부로서, 상기 제1 내지 제m 채널 각각의 전파세기보다 더 큰 전파세기를 독립적으로 출력하도록 상기 채널별 이득을 조정하고, 조정된 상기 이득을 기반으로 상기 제1 내지 제m 채널에 경보방송신호를 상기 외부방송신호에 겹쳐서 출력하는, 전파출력부; 를 포함하는, 시스템을 제공한다.

title_en: Probabilistic model for cyber risk forecasting
abstract_en: A system and method are presented for forecasting the risk of cyber-attacks on targeted networks. The described technology quantifies linear and non-linear damages to network-dependent assets by propagating probabilistic distributions of events in sequence and time in order to forecast damages over specified periods. Damage-forecasts are used to estimate probabilistically time-varying financial losses for cyber-attacks. The described technology incorporates quantities and dependencies for pricing insurance, re-insurance, and self-insurance, assessing cost-benefit tradeoffs for sequenced implementation of security control measures, and detecting attacks in the targeted network.

title_en: A kind of cascading failure recognition sequence system and method
abstract_en: A kind of cascading failure recognition sequence system, comprise: trend fault detection analysis module, weather conditions fault detection analysis module, circuit resultant fault probabilistic module, described trend fault detection analysis module is used for the Line Flow probability of malfunction under the impact of analytical calculation Line Flow; Described weather conditions fault detection analysis module is used for the weather conditions failure rate under analytical calculation inside even from weather; Described circuit resultant fault probabilistic module, for comprehensive described Line Flow probability of malfunction and described weather conditions failure rate, computational scheme resultant fault probability.Cascading failure recognition sequence system of the present invention, becomes running status and outside environmental elements when considering inside, proposes the scheme that searches out failure path in electrical network.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCES RES INST OF STATE GRID XIN;UNIV SICHUAN

title_en: Complex seam network reconstruction method based on event point and crack propagation double-field coupling
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of unconventional oil and gas reservoir production increase transformation, and discloses a complex fracture network reconstruction method technology based on event point and fracture expansion double-field coupling, which comprises 3 key methods and technologies such as a fracturing event point effectiveness studying and judging method based on double-field coupling, an event point fracture reconstruction technology based on space and stress constraint, hydraulic fracture dynamic parameter explanation based on event point space distribution and the like.
assignees: CNPC CHUANQING DRILLING ENG CO;CHINA NAT PETROLEUM CORP

title_en: Power demand prediction method based on multi-dimensional gray-neural network hybrid coordination
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power demand prediction method based on multi-dimensional gray-neural network hybrid coordination, which comprises the following steps: forming a multi-dimensional grey prediction model by taking the power demand original data sequence E as a characteristic sequence and taking the key influence factor sequence as a related factor sequence; accumulating the power demand data sequence and the related factor sequence to generate a new sequence, estimating the new sequence by using a least square method to obtain a prediction result sequence E of the total power demand DM (ii) a Obtaining E and E DM Residual error epsilon between the two, and B-P back propagation network prediction is carried out on epsilon sequence to obtain epsilon AN (ii) a Obtaining epsilon and epsilon AN Of a sequence of differences epsilon 2 With historical power demand residual sequence ε 2 B-P back propagation network prediction is carried out as the sequence of influencing factors, and the result is epsilon 2AN (ii) a Will E DM 、ε AN 、ε 2AN And adding to obtain a prediction result sequence. The invention can make up the deficiency of a single prediction algorithm and can consider a plurality of key factors simultaneously.
assignees: STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Method for evaluating stability of multi-layer urban group comprehensive passenger transport network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating the stability of a multilayer urban group comprehensive passenger transport network, which comprises the following steps: step 1: constructing a traffic district-traffic subnet multi-layer city group comprehensive passenger transport network model; step 2: simulating the stability cascade failure of the multi-layer urban group comprehensive passenger transport network; and step 3: and simulating and analyzing the network stability under the condition of sudden increase of passenger flow of the key nodes. The invention has the advantages that: the urban internal traffic is considered, an urban comprehensive passenger transport network model closer to the reality is constructed, a plurality of practical influence factors of networks of different layers are fully considered for weighting, the capacity of the passenger transport traffic network for dealing with emergency is enhanced, the capacity limit of stations and different overload degrees of nodes are fully considered, the node state is closer to the congestion degree of the practical stations, the conditions of surge and cascade failure of node passenger flow are considered, a network stability measure index is provided, and the capacity of the network for dealing with emergency such as station failure, surge of passenger flow and the like is enhanced.

title_en: Non-optimal cause tracing method, system and storage medium for sewage treatment process
abstract_en: The invention provides a non-optimal cause tracing method, a system and a storage medium for a sewage treatment process. The non-optimal cause tracing method comprises the following steps: acquiring non-optimal process data of a sewage treatment process to screen a plurality of candidate variables causing non-optimal states; sequentially selecting two candidate variables, establishing a simplified model only containing the past information of the two candidate variables and a full model containing the past information of all the candidate variables, calculating residual errors of the simplified model and the full model, constructing a Grignard index according to the residual errors, and judging whether causal relationship exists between the two candidate variables or not until causal analysis between the candidate variables is completed; constructing a network structure according to the causal analysis result to determine a route with practical process meaning in the network structure; determining a conditional probability table of variable nodes of each candidate variable based on the network structure; and acquiring input evidence of the evidence node, and updating the conditional probability table by using a sum-product belief propagation algorithm to determine non-optimal cause variables causing non-optimal states.

title_en: Power transmission line partial discharge detection method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power transmission line partial discharge detection method, which comprises the following steps: s1, acquiring an original power transmission line electrical signal, and dividing the original power transmission line electrical signal into a training sample and a test sample; s2, inputting training samples into the multi-scale one-dimensional convolutional neural network in batches, setting a threshold value, a multi-scale one-dimensional convolutional neural network structure and the convolutional kernel size of the multi-scale one-dimensional convolutional neural network structure, propagating forward layer by layer to obtain characteristics of the training samples, and calculating to obtain errors of expected output and actual output; s3, back-propagating errors from output to input, and fine-tuning network parameters layer by layer; s4, repeating the steps S2 and S3 until all training samples are completed, calculating the precision of the network on the test samples, if the precision is greater than a set threshold value, obtaining an ideal network, otherwise, returning to the step S2; s5, outputting the precision of the ideal network on the test sample. The invention solves the problem of partial discharge diagnosis of the power transmission line and achieves better effect under the arrangement of different frequency data and different convolution kernels.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Blasting parameter determining method based on 3D printing jointed rock
abstract_en: The application provides a blasting parameter determining method based on 3D printing jointed rock, which comprises the following steps: acquiring on-site surrounding rock joint characteristic information according to geological survey; generating different joint densities based on Monte-Carlo method according to surrounding rock joint characteristic informationThe three-dimensional discrete joint fracture network model is used for obtaining a joint fracture rock digital model containing a joint fracture network by using three-dimensional modeling software; based on the digital model of the joint fracture rock, manufacturing discrete fracture rock with different joint densities; developing an SHPB test to explore the influence rule of the joint density on the dynamic strength of the discrete fracture rock, and obtaining a relation between the joint correction coefficient and the joint density; determining radial sigma at a remote explosion source r based on stress wave propagation theory and rock stress wave attenuation law  r  And tangential stress sigma  θ  The method comprises the steps of carrying out a first treatment on the surface of the And calculating the radius of the blasting crack area according to the tangential stress condition at the distance r from the blasting source and the joint correction coefficient, and determining the blasthole distance according to the stress wave and blasting gas combined action theory.
assignees: HUNAN ROAD & BRIDGE CONSTRUCTION GROUP CO LTD;UNIV CENTRAL SOUTH

title_en: TEM inversion method based on nearest unit multi-head attention and multi-scale coding mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a TEM inversion method based on a nearest unit multi-head attention and a multi-scale coding mechanism, which comprises the following steps: improving the encoder module based on the visual transducer ViT having multiple heads of attention; constructing an input cascade patch module; constructing a mark position code embedding module; improving the decoder; the method comprises the steps of combining and connecting an input cascade patch module, a mark position coding embedding module, an encoder and a decoder to construct a TEM inversion converter network model; and training a TEM inversion converter network model, and predicting the ground electric structure and landslide water-bearing layer structure of the unknown ground by using the TEM inversion converter network model. The built TEM inversion converter network model has the advantages of good imaging accuracy and high speed, and can finely detect the shallow structure within the depth range of 100 meters.

title_en: Landslide surge near-far field propagation evolution coupling method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide surge near-far field propagation evolution coupling method and a system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: simulating near-field motion of a particulate body landslide by adopting particle discrete elements and smooth particle fluid dynamics; taking the simulated near-field motion as an initial boundary condition, and calculating far-field motion of the landslide of the bulk body; based on the drag force and the buoyancy, the near-far field propagation evolution of the landslide of the particulate body in the motion and water entering process is completed. According to the invention, through fine numerical simulation of key areas, the propagation path, speed and influence range of landslide surge can be predicted more accurately. This is critical for disaster early warning and risk assessment. Meanwhile, the model disclosed by the invention can be used for considering the topography, geology, hydrologic conditions and the like in more detail, so that the landslide surge simulation reality is improved. In addition, the invention can evaluate the potential influence of landslide surge on coastal structures, residential areas and key infrastructure by simulating different scenes, and provide dangerous analysis for rescue and planning.

title_en: Assembly line rapid reconstruction method based on forward modification network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid reconstruction method of an assembly line based on a forward modification network, which summarizes the multi-domain conduction principle of 'product similarity-system configuration similarity-system execution similarity' of a man-machine cooperation assembly line, and uses five dimensions of 'function-structure-behavior-execution-performance' to describe the physical and logical reconstruction connotation of the man-machine cooperation assembly line, comprehensively considers each layer of the assembly line, and improves the comprehensiveness and coordination of the whole design. In the flexible production line design process taking the production line rapid deformation design as a core, the optimal production line change scheme can be more scientifically and objectively selected by adopting a parameterized node network model and an alignment theory, and the time period from information induction to scheme implementation is shortened. And constructing a mathematical model with the change propagation risk, the change propagation time and the change propagation cost as comprehensive targets according to the actual production condition of enterprises, so as to realize fine management and cost optimization and reduce cost.

title_en: Pollution tracing system and method based on drainage system water quality and water quantity monitoring analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pollution tracing system and a pollution tracing method based on drainage system water quality and water quantity monitoring analysis, which particularly relate to the technical field of water quality and water quantity monitoring, wherein water quality and water quantity parameters are collected in real time through a distributed sensor network, a denoising processing and anomaly detection algorithm are combined to ensure data quality, a multivariate dynamic analysis method and a space-time correlation model are utilized to identify anomaly change characteristics of pollutant concentration, a nonlinear superposition effect correction model is constructed to eliminate false peak interference at a junction, a real pollution source is positioned, a pollution propagation process is simulated based on a diffusion path and flow characteristics by combining a geographic information system and a drainage basin model, the geographical position of the pollution source is accurately determined, and finally, a tracing result is visually output to a user terminal to generate a pollution tracing report, scientific treatment advice and multi-level alarm signals are provided, and effective technical support is provided for pollution treatment and emergency response.
assignees: KUNMING INST OF ECOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENTAL SCIENCES

title_en: Real-time supervision system of intelligent box-type substation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent monitoring of power equipment, in particular to a real-time supervision system of an intelligent box-type transformer substation, which comprises a multi-source data acquisition module, a voiceprint fault diagnosis module, an antitheft space-time prediction module, a cooperative arbitration module and a database; the fault classification unit takes MobileNetV as a model, classifies real-time voiceprint characteristics after training, identifies fault types, the anti-theft space-time prediction module creates an LSTM model to output a vibration baseline value and calculates real-time deviation, analyzes a vibration propagation path by means of a graph convolution network to obtain a space abnormality index, further calculates a comprehensive threat value, and the collaborative arbitration module divides rule types according to TAS and the voiceprint fault types.

title_en: Dynamic identification method, system, equipment and medium for key transmission line
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic identification method, a system, equipment and a medium of key power transmission lines, which comprise the steps of modeling wind power output data by adopting a first statistical model to generate a first time sequence, establishing a time sequence cascading failure diagram considering wind power output fluctuation according to the first time sequence, establishing a maximum influence theoretical model based on the time sequence cascading failure diagram, analyzing fault influence propagation paths and identifying the key power transmission lines, acquiring fault influence degree of each key power transmission line by adopting a first influence calculation algorithm and quantifying the effect in a fault propagation process, and screening the key power transmission lines by adopting the first line identification algorithm and combining the maximum influence theoretical model to acquire a final identification result. According to the method, through innovatively integrating time sequence modeling, dynamic network analysis and intelligent optimization algorithm, accurate identification and risk assessment of the key power transmission line in the wind power fluctuation environment are achieved.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG;UNIV CHONGQING

title_en: Wind-solar power station energy storage capacity configuration method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind-solar power station energy storage capacity configuration method and system, wind power generation power prediction is respectively carried out by using a model based on a convolution neural network and a long-short-period memory network based on historical related data of each wind power station, photovoltaic power generation power prediction is respectively carried out by using a reverse propagation neural network model based on a genetic algorithm based on historical related data of each photovoltaic power station, total prediction power of a wind-solar power station is obtained based on a wind power generation power prediction value of each wind power station and a photovoltaic power generation power prediction value of each photovoltaic power station, energy storage capacity optimization configuration is carried out according to an actual load state and the total prediction power of the wind-solar power station, so that the accuracy of wind-solar power station power prediction is effectively improved, and energy storage capacity optimization configuration is carried out according to an actual load state and the total prediction power of the wind-solar power station, the accuracy and reliability of configuration are improved, and the accuracy and reliability of energy storage capacity configuration are improved.
assignees: ECONOMIC RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Dynamic population flow-based labor force heat exposure supply chain loss assessment method
abstract_en: A labor force heat exposure supply chain loss assessment method based on dynamic population flow belongs to the field of industrial chain risk assessment and decision support. The method comprises the steps of calculating urban population weighted wet ball black ball temperature WBGT indoors and outdoors, calculating daily production LOSS rates of different labor intensity industries according to WBGT in combination with heat exposure-reaction functions and air conditioner coverage, calculating labor exposure direct economic losses indoors and outdoors, constructing labor flow adjustment coefficients containing population migration compensation effects based on labor daily flow dynamic data, calculating corrected production LOSS rates, calculating supply chain cascade economic losses of labor heat exposure through a complex supply chain network model based on an adaptive main body according to the corrected production LOSS rates, obtaining policy gain according to total LOSS LOSS' -LOSS after implementation of adaptive measures, and further evaluating economic effectiveness of applied measures.

title_en: Cascade hydropower station accident evolution key node and path identification method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascade hydropower station accident evolution key node and path identification method, which comprises the steps of collecting basic data of a target cascade hydropower station, preprocessing data of the cascade hydropower station accident text, determining association relations among accident factors, classifying, constructing a cascade hydropower station accident evolution network model by adopting a complex network method, constructing an accident propagation probability model by combining network topology characteristics and accident factor point mutual information indexes, calculating the cascade hydropower station accident propagation probability by combining a Bayesian network, operating the cascade hydropower station accident evolution network model, identifying a key path in accident propagation, introducing a node recovery function, and identifying the key node in accident propagation. The key risk nodes and the evolution paths thereof in the emergency process of the cascade hydropower station accidents can be accurately identified, the risk management and control precision of the cascade hydropower station is improved, the risk of cascade accident diffusion is reduced, and the overall safety management and control level is improved.

title_en: Intelligent supervision management and control system for engineering construction number
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent supervision and control system for engineering construction numbers, and relates to the technical field of engineering construction supervision. The system comprises an information acquisition module, a data fusion layer module, an analysis monitoring module, a built-in progress calculation and prediction unit, a deviation judgment unit and a digital modeling unit, wherein the information acquisition module is used for acquiring equipment states, images and environmental data, the data fusion layer module is used for cleaning, aligning and Kalman filtering fusion of multi-source data to generate multi-mode construction data streams, the analysis monitoring module is used for updating the progress states based on XGBoost models and analyzing node dependency relations by utilizing a graph neural network, calculating deviation propagation risk coefficients and generating a grading deviation signal by combining three-level judgment conditions, and the management and control layer module is used for executing grading response according to the grade of the deviation signal and feeding execution effect data back to the front end module to realize model optimization and closed loop iteration. The invention realizes intelligent perception, risk prediction and self-adaptive management and control of the construction process, and improves the instantaneity, accuracy and autonomy of engineering supervision.
assignees: BEIJING ZHONGKE GUOJIN ENGINEERING MAN CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Hydraulic engineering risk intelligent regulation and control method based on expert balance
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of hydraulic engineering risk management, and discloses an intelligent hydraulic engineering risk regulation and control method based on an expert equal rights. The method comprises the steps of constructing a dynamic global risk network, abstracting facilities and environments into nodes and connections, and defining a basic risk unit. And calculating the real-time risk field intensity under the current network topology by scanning the acquired unit characteristics. When the field intensity exceeds the threshold value, an expert equal rights is triggered to make a decision, the risk contribution degree analysis is performed on the related units, and equal rights regulation coefficients are generated according to the risk contribution degree analysis and mapped into specific regulation instructions. And before execution, evaluating the control conflict through virtual deduction, and completing final control according to the result. The method can accurately quantify the dynamic propagation and aggregation effects of risks in the network, realize cooperative regulation and control based on contribution degree traceability, and improve the overall coordination of risk coping and the rationality of measure allocation.
assignees: HENAN WATER CONSERVANCY SURVEY CO LTD

title_en: Power prediction method and system for wind farm, and storage medium
abstract_en: The present application relates to a power prediction method and system for a wind farm, and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: setting a wind farm turbine site in a wind farm to collect the wind speed of an area where a wind turbine is located, and to collect other meteorological data in the wind farm; on the basis of collected data, reconstructing airflow distribution within the range of the wind farm; on the basis of the reconstructed airflow distribution within the range of the wind farm, predicting future airflow distribution of the wind farm; selecting a turbine site point, and selecting from the predicted future airflow distribution a predicted wind speed value corresponding to the turbine site point; and converting the predicted wind speed value corresponding to the turbine site point into a power prediction value. Compared with the prior art, the present application can effectively predict the power change of wind farms within 1-15 minutes, so as to bring significant safety and economic benefits to countries and regions having weaker power grids as well as to scenarios where wind farms directly supply power to load sides, and can effectively position and track wind flow propagation motion trajectories without accumulating a large amount of historical data.

title_en: Cognitive scoring of asset risk based on predictive propagation of security-related events
abstract_en: A method (and system) of scoring asset risk including modeling an interdependence of risks of a plurality of entities within a network by modeling the network as a graph connecting different entities, the different entities are selected from a group of a user, a device, a credential, a high-value asset, and an external server, the graph being defined as a set of vertices comprising the user, the device, the credential, the high-value asset, and the external server and a set of edges represented by an N-by-N adjacency matrix with each pair of the entities sharing a relationship and applying a Belief Propagation (BP) algorithm for solving the inference problem over the graph by inferring the risk from the entities own properties and surrounding entities with the shared relationship in the adjacency matrix, the Belief Propagation algorithm obtains risk information related to each entity of the plurality of entities.

title_en: The emulation mode and device of power grid cascading failure
abstract_en: The invention discloses the emulation modes and device of a kind of power grid cascading failure.Wherein, this method comprises: carrying out stability analysis to power grid, the critical failure element in the power grid is determined；Based on the critical failure element, the cascading failure sequence of the power grid is generated；Based on the cascading failure sequence, full dynamic simulation is carried out；By simulation result, the state of the power grid after cascading failure occurs is determined.The present invention solves the technical issues of heavy workload of power grid cascading fault simulation.

title_en: Near infrared spectrum modeling method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a near infrared spectrum modeling method, which comprises the steps of establishing a plurality of identical one-dimensional convolution neural networks as sub-networks in negative correlation learning, adding a negative correlation penalty term after an error function of each sub-network, using the composite error function to reversely propagate the sub-networks to carry out parameter iterative optimization adjustment on each sub-network, realizing convergence of each sub-network by carrying out parameter iterative optimization adjustment on each sub-network, and finally optimizing the converged sub-network to obtain the constructed near infrared spectrum; the method has the advantages that the one-dimensional convolutional neural network is used as a basic model, the one-dimensional convolutional neural network is combined with a negative correlation learning method, and the model is trained and converged by the negative correlation learning method, so that the model has higher precision, the training convergence is faster, and the required modeling time and computer resources are less.

title_en: Reservoir group adaptive scheduling method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reservoir group adaptive scheduling method and system, and belongs to the field of water resource utilization. The initial population is generated in the search space, the fitness value of each individual in the population is evaluated, the optimal position and the global optimal position of the individual in the population are updated, global exploration is carried out by adopting a global exploration strategy in a co-evolution algorithm so as to improve the population convergence rate, and local search is carried out by adopting a local development strategy in the co-evolution algorithm so as to improve the individual precision. And updating the individual positions in the population through iterative evolution, and outputting the individual corresponding to the global optimal solution as a final solution after reaching the search stopping condition. The example proves that the method has good convergence rate and search precision, can coordinate the relationship between exploration and development, effectively solves the problem of cascade reservoir group scheduling, and remarkably improves the economic benefit of the whole power grid.

title_en: Event-driven risk assessment calculation method for information physical system of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention provides a risk assessment and calculation method for a power distribution network information physical system based on event driving. And then, based on a cross-space cascading failure evolution model, providing and establishing a distribution network operation quantitative risk assessment index. Finally, a risk assessment calculation method of the power distribution network information physical system based on event driving is provided. The invention standardizes a risk assessment calculation method of a power distribution network information physical system, extracts key elements of the power distribution network cross-information-physical space cascading failure, provides description of risk conduction of different levels and propagation and mapping relations of risks among different levels, and provides a calculation assessment method of the risk of the power distribution network information physical system based on an event driven model.

title_en: Thermal data analysis method based on convolutional neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of data processing, in particular to a thermal data analysis method based on a convolutional neural network. The method comprises the steps of marking tag values of all different cause faults of thermal data, dividing the tag values into a training set and a testing set, constructing a convolutional neural network model, inputting the training set into the convolutional neural network model to conduct forward propagation and backward propagation to adjust parameters of the convolutional neural network model, obtaining a trained convolutional neural network model, inputting the testing set into the trained convolutional neural network model to conduct prediction, conducting forward prediction and softmax operation, taking the maximum probability value in the probability value as a final prediction value, and conducting imaging on accuracy of the testing set. The invention analyzes the massive thermal data by establishing the convolutional neural network model, thereby not only realizing the supplement and early warning measures when the DCS system fails, but also carrying out further excavation on the thermal data.

title_en: Method and system for identifying weak links of power grid in high-proportion new energy region
abstract_en: The method and the system for identifying the weak links of the regional power grid of the high-proportion new energy source judge that the power grid has the cascading failure if the connecting line has direct current when the capacity of the regional power grid is the same in order of magnitude as that of the external power grid and the short circuit ratio is more than 3; if the connecting lines have no direct current, reducing the number of fault connecting lines to perform stability control calculation, and determining weak links of the regional power grid according to a calculation result; when the magnitude of the regional power grid capacity is smaller than that of the external power grid capacity, performing stability control calculation according to the influence of the capacity of the accessed thermal power generating unit on the regional power grid trend direction, wherein the stability control calculation comprises the following steps: when the regional power grid sends power flow to the external power grid, performing stable control calculation of transient power angle stabilization, main transformer or line overload and outlet section bayonet; when the regional power grid flows down the grid, performing stable control calculation of transient power angle stabilization, main transformer or line overload, grid section opening and transient voltage and steady voltage; and determining the regional power grid weak links according to the calculation result. The invention improves the efficiency and quality of stability control analysis.

title_en: Quick visualization method and system for earthquake emergency information
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data visualization, in particular to a method and a system for quickly visualizing earthquake emergency information. The method comprises the steps of obtaining earthquake monitoring real-time data, dividing population density distribution of a seismic area and key facility positions based on the earthquake monitoring real-time data in a grid mode, generating a seismic area sensitivity matrix, dynamically simulating a seismic wave propagation process based on the earthquake monitoring real-time data and the seismic area sensitivity matrix, generating fluctuation propagation time sequence data, identifying earthquake medium topography and topography vector data of the earthquake monitoring real-time data, and respectively evaluating topography fluctuation and geological stability to obtain earthquake topography fluctuation index data and earthquake geological stability scoring data. According to the invention, through a data visualization technology, quick and accurate evaluation and visualization of earthquake hazard distribution are realized, so that the earthquake emergency response efficiency and the scientificity of disaster rescue decisions are improved.

title_en: Road water damage disaster rapid identification method and system based on remote sensing image analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid recognition method and a rapid recognition system for highway water damage disasters based on remote sensing image analysis, which belong to the technical field of remote sensing image analysis and disaster detection, wherein the method comprises the steps of extracting a change region of a remote sensing image before and after the disaster through a multi-scale differential twin network change detection module; identifying five types of water damage types, namely roadbed impact damage, pavement collapse, side slope collapse, retaining wall collapse and bridge and culvert damage through a cascade attention water damage semantic segmentation network; calculating a damage degree grade by fusing morphology, spectrum and spatial characteristics through a multidimensional damage degree cooperative evaluation module; the traffic state is judged and the rush repair priority report is generated through the traffic influence self-adaptive quantification module, so that the rapid identification, accurate classification and comprehensive evaluation of the road water damage disasters are realized, and technical support is provided for the post-disaster rush repair and conservation decision.

title_en: Large-power-grid key line identification method based on FP-growth algorithm
abstract_en: The invention provides a large-power-grid key line identification method based on an FP-growth algorithm. The method is characterized by comprising the following steps: obtaining a line active relation/dependence matrix by utilizing a DC power flow method, and establishing a line breaking probability model based on a power grid operation state, a line power flow constraint condition and the line active relation/dependence matrix; performing a Monte Carlo simulation for cascading failures based on the line breaking probability model, and generating a cascading failure set; and, on the basis of the FP-growth algorithm, excavating a frequent item for the cascading failure set, and determining a key line. Through an application of the technical scheme, a few lines having sharp changes in line active power flow can be identified and controlled in a short time at an early failure stage, and the technical scheme has great significances for inhibiting the cascading failures and guaranteeing safe and stable operation of an electric power system.
assignees: STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV WUHAN

title_en: City gas pipeline system failure propagation effect appraisal procedure and system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the present invention discloses a kind of city gas pipeline system failure propagation effect appraisal procedure and system, and methods described includes：The network structure topological diagram of city gas pipeline system is set up according to city gas pipeline system；Network model is set up according to network structure topological diagram, network model includes the connection matrix of informational table of nodes, side information table and node；According to network model and constraints, the first flow pressure distribution information of city gas pipeline system normal condition is obtained；The simulating system failure in network model, and according to fault propagation rule and constraints, obtain the second flow pressure distribution information under city gas pipeline system is nonserviceabled；Compare first flow pressure distribution information and second flow pressure distribution information carries out fault propagation impact evaluation to city gas pipeline system.The system is used to perform the above method.The embodiment of the present invention improves the accuracy of city gas pipeline system failure propagation effect assessment.

title_en: Runoff simulation method and system based on SOM-BPNN model
abstract_en: The invention relates to a runoff simulation method and system based on a SOM-BPNN model, belongs to the technical field of runoff simulation, and aims to capture various features of runoff and improve the runoff simulation precision. The method comprises the following steps: multi-source data acquisition and processing; screening key influence factors; building an SOM neural network clustering model; constructing a SOM-BPNN runoff simulation model; and (4) runoff simulation. The method comprises the steps of firstly, carrying out unsupervised clustering on a sample data set by using an SOM model, and constructing a back propagation artificial neural network model according to the clustered sub-sample set to carry out runoff simulation. According to the method, two artificial neural network models are coupled together, the clustered sub-sample set is beneficial to back-propagation of the artificial neural network for multi-aspect feature learning of complex data, the runoff simulation precision of traditional machine learning can be further improved, and effective auxiliary decision means and solid theoretical basis can be provided for watershed water resource planning, flood control, disaster reduction and comprehensive treatment.
assignees: INST GEOGRAPHIC SCIENCES & NATURAL RESOURCES RES CAS

title_en: Emergency generator car configuration method and computer network system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of emergency repair of electrical equipment, and discloses an emergency power generation car configuration method, which comprises the following steps: 1. collecting records of multi-source data cases aiming at historical disaster sites, and selecting and determining a power failure emergency repair correlation factor; 2. determining the optimal emergency power generation vehicle configuration strategy for each case; 3. training a power generation vehicle configuration strategy selection model network based on a multilayer back propagation neural network by using sample data; 4. acquiring real-time data of a disaster site; 5. and inputting the multidimensional information data acquired in real time at the power disaster site into the model to obtain the optimal configuration of the emergency power generation car in real time. The invention also provides a computer network system which comprises an emergency power-generating car configuration module and a processing circuit, wherein the emergency power-generating car configuration module is stored with the power failure emergency repair correlation factor, and the processing circuit can call the emergency power-generating car configuration module to execute the emergency power-generating car configuration method. The method and the system can achieve the real-time acquisition of the optimal power generation vehicle configuration strategy, guide the field emergency command decision and improve the emergency repair efficiency.
assignees: DONGGUAN POWER BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: WM-SEIR information propagation model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a WM-SEIR information transmission model, which comprises an information transmission modeling module and an information transmission module which are connected with each other; the information propagation modeling module is used for realizing a social network which uses a directed weighted graph to represent a WeChat friend circle, each node represents a user in the social network, and the weight value of each edge represents the relationship strength between two users; according to the situation of a social network user, all nodes in the node set V are endowed with labels, and the labels are divided into an unknown state S, a latent state E, a propagation state I and an immune state R; the information transmission module is used for realizing real-time information transmission in the social network and updating the labels of the nodes in real time in the information transmission process. The invention introduces a plurality of important factors which influence the information transmission of the users in real life, such as information value, relationship strength among the users, subjective transmission willingness degree and the like, combines the SEIR model with the actual information transmission of the friend circle network, and better describes the actual information transmission process of the WeChat friend circle network.

title_en: Power distribution network weak link identification method based on cascade combination scoring
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of identification of weak links of power distribution networks, and discloses a method for identifying weak links of a power distribution network based on cascade combination scoring. The method mainly comprises the following steps: based on analyzing the problems existing in the power distribution network in actual operation, an evaluation index for representing the weak links of the power distribution network is established; giving out a calculation formula matched with each grading index, and constructing a calculation model of each single index; and determining corresponding cascade combination evaluation scores according to the calculation index model, and realizing quantification of the problem degree. The method can objectively analyze the existing problems in the power distribution network, comprehensively score each feeder line of the power distribution network, and assist relevant practitioners in the power industry to formulate a power distribution network weak link optimization transformation scheme.
assignees: SHANGRAO POWER SUPPLY BRANCH COMPANY STATE GRID JIANGXI ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;UNIV SHANGRAO NORMAL

title_en: Electric power knowledge graph construction method based on text enhancement and double-channel triplet extraction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for constructing an electric power knowledge graph based on text enhancement and double-channel triplet extraction, which comprises the following steps: 1. preprocessing data; 2. text represents an enhanced pre-training model; 3. the model is extracted based on the triplets of the two channels. The pre-training model of the method adopts a BERT model, and words in BERT input are embedded into spliced external knowledge. Then, the entity relation extraction model mainly extracts entity sets in the entity decoding stage, then fuses decoding results of the better in the relation set prediction network stage, and extracts relation triples in the data. Through joint decoding, the entity type can provide important information for relation extraction so as to obtain accurate prediction of the entity and the relation, avoid error propagation, solve the problems of redundancy, poor generalization and the like. Compared with the current latest mainstream method, the method has higher accuracy and F1 value and has excellent overall performance.
assignees: INFORMATION COMMUNICATION COMPANY OF STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Dynamic carbon emission factor prediction method based on data driving
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data-driven dynamic carbon emission factor prediction method, which comprises the following steps: historical load data, non-low-carbon power supply and distributed new energy historical power generation power data are obtained, a power distribution network topological structure and power supply and load access positions are identified, and a main network access carbon potential is calculated; synthesizing various power supplies and loads, generating power grid tide data in a simulation mode, and generating a label of a training sample according to an improved dynamic carbon emission factor calculation method; constructing an initial sample set according to the generated label and the history data; extracting a time sequence dependency relationship of the multivariate time sequence based on the Fea2Vec framework; dividing an initial sample set into a training set, a verification set and a test set, carrying out training by taking a Fea2Vec-BiLSTM model, and cutting off the training process when the error of the test set is converged; and obtaining a prediction result through a forward propagation process. The invention can predict the dynamic carbon emission factor of the hour-level area of the future day and provide data support for the low-carbon energy utilization mode.
assignees: XUZHOU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH CO STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: New energy output medium-long term random scene generation method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for generating a medium-long-term random scene of new energy output, and belongs to the field of power grid operation scheduling. The method for generating the medium-long term random scene in the new energy output comprises the steps of reducing dimensions of a historical daily scene to extract significant features of the historical daily scene, clustering a historical day show scene significant feature set by adopting a neighbor propagation clustering algorithm, dividing the generated day show scenes into corresponding clusters, simulating evolution characteristics among different categories of the daily scene based on a Markov chain, and generating the medium-long term random scene through Monte Carlo simulation. The invention can accurately fit the probability distribution, time sequence characteristics and spatial correlation of the medium-long term scene of the new energy output, and can provide effective data support for the medium-long term power transaction and operation mode formulation.

title_en: Unmanned intelligent patrol equipment cooperative scheduling method and system in photovoltaic power generation scene
abstract_en: The invention provides a cooperative scheduling method and a system for unmanned intelligent patrol equipment in a photovoltaic power generation scene, which relate to the technical field of intelligent patrol of photovoltaic power stations and comprise the following steps: task priority classification and time sequence association analysis are carried out based on a dynamic self-adaptive neural network and a sequence predictor, a task dependency graph is constructed, a candidate task allocation scheme is generated based on a deep reinforcement learning framework, the candidate scheme is optimized by combining a collaborative decision system constructed by a multi-objective genetic algorithm and a graph injection force mechanism with the aim of minimizing the completion time, energy consumption and maximizing the coverage rate, the task allocation constraint is updated by utilizing a confidence propagation network, abnormal conditions are judged by a Bayesian inference algorithm, and finally an optimal scheduling scheme is output, so that the inspection efficiency of the photovoltaic power station can be effectively improved, the energy consumption is reduced, and the inspection coverage rate is improved.

title_en: Automatic monitoring and early warning method for water environment
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic water environment monitoring and early warning method which comprises the steps of constructing a space model of a water environment change state, simulating a water power and water quality space distribution field of river nodes, obtaining historical water quality pollution data of a river basin node relation network, calculating a time interval when pollutants in an upstream river basin node reach a current river basin node based on the space model of the water environment change state, taking the historical water quality pollution data of the upstream river basin node at a starting point of the time interval as input, taking the historical water quality pollution data of the current river basin node at an ending point of the time interval as output, obtaining a trained feedforward depth neural network, and predicting the water environment data of the current river basin node at the next moment by taking the trained feedforward depth neural network as input. The invention can more accurately simulate the propagation process of pollutants in the water body, and improves the accuracy and reliability of water quality prediction.
assignees: YUNNAN ACADEMY OF ECO ENV SCIENCES

title_en: Emergency team informatization management system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of chemical safety and emergency management, and discloses an emergency team informatization management system and method, wherein the emergency team informatization management method comprises the steps of constructing a multi-level Bayesian network model, showing the condition dependence of chemical accident evolution chain event nodes, establishing an uncertainty propagation analysis model, quantifying an accident risk transfer rule, developing multi-dimensional node influence evaluation, comprehensively considering structural importance, propagation characteristics and dry pre-feasibility, identifying optimal intervention points according to the evaluation, constructing an intervention scheme by combining resource constraint, intelligently simulating, evaluating and optimizing intervention effects and assisting an emergency team iteration strategy.

title_en: Unmanned plane marshalling dynamic human body real-time three-dimensional reconstruction method based on 3D Gaussian sputtering
abstract_en: The invention relates to a real-time human dynamic three-dimensional reconstruction method of unmanned aerial vehicle marshalling based on 3D Gaussian sputtering, belonging to the technical field of computer vision and unmanned aerial vehicle coordination. The method comprises the steps of deploying unmanned aerial vehicle grouping carrying RGB-D cameras, constructing a forward link communication network, conducting parameter calibration, predicting human motion trend through a self-adaptive Gaussian distribution model, dividing an observation area, optimizing unmanned aerial vehicle paths, conducting incremental parameter fusion through a gradient sharing fusion algorithm, generating local dense point clouds in real time, constructing an unsupervised space-time segmentation model, distinguishing static background and dynamic human body areas, designing a 3D Gaussian weight weighting algorithm to optimize point cloud density, enhancing shielding area integrity, optimizing Gaussian parameters through a differential rendering frame, generating a high-precision surface grid, and conducting denoising restoration through a cascading filtering network to achieve real-time three-dimensional reconstruction of the dynamic human body. The invention obviously improves the reconstruction speed and the integrity of the shielding area, and is suitable for the fields of emergency rescue, film and television manufacture and the like.

title_en: Node electricity price joint probability prediction method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power system electricity price prediction and discloses a node electricity price joint probability prediction method which comprises the steps of constructing a dual-state monitoring system, simultaneously tracking physical states and market fluidity indexes of a power grid to generate physical constraint state vectors and market fluidity state vectors, designing critical early warning indexes through nonlinear combination of physical constraint degrees and fluidity levels, introducing a state space mapping algorithm to divide a physical fluidity state space into a stable region, a metastable region and a critical region, constructing refined representation of a system state, tracking physical constraint changes to influence market fluidity by influencing behaviors of market participants based on a propagation mechanism model of a directed causal graph, and modeling extreme price distribution by applying condition extremum theory aiming at the identified critical state.
assignees: XIAN GUANGLIN HUIZHI ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Sewage system traceability analysis and intelligent monitoring method, system, equipment and storage medium based on graphic neural network
abstract_en: The invention provides a sewage system traceability analysis and intelligent monitoring method, system, equipment and storage medium based on a graph neural network, and belongs to the technical field of environment monitoring and artificial intelligence. The invention aims to solve the technical problems of low efficiency, low precision, difficulty in processing multi-source data, improper monitoring network and the like of the existing pollution tracing method of the sewage system.
