The method comprises the steps of constructing a sewage system knowledge graph integrating multi-source heterogeneous data such as water quality and water quantity, adopting a multi-scale graph neural network model to learn pollution propagation characteristics based on the knowledge graph, carrying out pollution path backtracking by combining a physical model such as flow conservation after a pollution event occurs so as to identify a pollution source, carrying out uncertainty quantification on a backtracking result by introducing Bayesian inference so as to evaluate the credibility of the backtracking result, and finally carrying out dynamic optimization on the layout of monitoring points based on criteria such as information gain and the like. The invention can realize the rapid and accurate positioning of the pollution source and is suitable for the intelligent supervision of the urban sewage system.
assignees: ZHEJIANG BAINUO SHUZHI ENVIRONMENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Cascade water-light complementary scheduling method for distribution network system with multiple uncertainty of water-light load
abstract_en: The invention provides a cascade water-light complementary scheduling method of a distribution network system with multiple uncertainty of water-light load. Belongs to the field of power system dispatching optimization. The method comprises the steps of combining a cascade hydropower station power generation model, a photovoltaic power generation model and a distribution network system model, establishing a cascade water-light complementary power generation joint optimization scheduling model, converting the cascade water-light complementary power generation joint optimization scheduling model into a two-stage robust optimization model, performing linearization treatment, decomposing the two-stage robust optimization model into a main problem and a sub-problem, relaxing the decomposed sub-problem and constructing a new objective function to obtain an infeasible test sub-problem, and iteratively solving the main problem, the sub-problem and the infeasible test sub-problem to obtain a daily scheduling plan. The invention considers the multiple uncertainties of the natural water supply and the photovoltaic output of the small hydropower station, digs the power generation flexibility of the cascade hydropower station to realize the improvement of the photovoltaic digestion capacity, and realizes the efficient solution of the model by providing a linearization method and a sub-problem feasibility test method of the hydropower model.
assignees: UNIV TSINGHUA;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER CORP

title_en: Power supplying device for store
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To assure power supply to important apparatuses such as refrigeration/freezing facility even during service interruption caused by earthquake in a convenience store or a supermarket which is indispensable to the local eating habits.  <P>SOLUTION: A photovoltaic power generating device and a power storage device are provided in a store, and a central processing unit is provided in the central control section which manages the store. A detector which detects the administrative data including the degree of illumination in the store, the temperature of a refrigeration/freezing facility and the electric energy used, and a control section which collects the measurement data of each detector and controls the store facility are provided in the store, and the data collected at the control section is transmitted over a transmission path to the central control section.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Signal tower and integration system of signal tower the same
title_ko: 시그널 타워 및 그 통합시스템
abstract_en: A signal tower improving visibility and integration system thereof are provided to monitor a spot condition and a location about a corresponding manufacturing facility by automatically propagating after recognizing a state of emergency about a manufacturing facility through the signal tower. A signal tower improving visibility installs a plurality of lamps in a main body of a manufacturing facility to indicate colors according to an operation state, and includes a frame(22) and a display device. The frame is formed by dividing a display window(20). The display device is installed so that a color and character be indicated by a control signal of a computer on the display window of the frame.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 제조설비의 작동상태를 색깔 및 문자로 표시하는 시그널 타워 및 그 통합시스템에 관한 것으로서, 반도체, 엘시디 등 기타 제조설비에 대한 현재의 작동상태를 색깔 및 문자로 표시하여 시인성을 높이고, 화재 등 비상 상태시에는 소방대 및 관리자에게 자동으로 알리고, 입구에 설치된 위치 확인 모니터의 영상을 통해 현장을 확인할 수 있도록 하는 것을 목적으로 한다. 
     이를 위하여 본 발명은, 제조설비의 작동상태를 특정 색깔의 점등을 통해 나타내도록 제조설비의 본체에 다수의 램프로 구성되어 설치되는 시그널 타워에 있어서, 표시창이 분할되어 형성된 프레임과, 상기 프레임의 표시창에 컴퓨터의 제어 신호에 의하여 색깔 및 문자가 표시되도록 설치되는 표시장치를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
     본 발명에 의하면, 반도체나, 엘시디 등 기타 제조설비에 대한 작동 상태가  색깔 및 문자로 표시되도록 하여 관리자 및 작업자가 정확히 빨리 인식하는 효과가 있다. 
       
     문자, 컴퓨터, 시그널 타워, 램프

title_en: System for uhd disaster broadcasting
title_ko: Uhd 재난 방송 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a ultra high definition (UHD) disaster broadcasting system for quickly spreading disaster situations using UHD broadcasting signals, which includes: a UHD disaster broadcast receiving device for receiving a UHD broadcast signal from a broadcasting network; and a peripheral device for transmitting various types of information in a building to the UHD disaster broadcast receiving device, wherein the UHD disaster broadcast receiving device includes: a UHD broadcast receiving unit for confirming the presence or absence of disaster broadcast data from the UHD broadcast signal; a control unit for generating caption image data and audio signals based on the disaster broadcast data from the UHD broadcast receiving unit; an image display unit for displaying disaster-related subtitles based on the subtitle image data from the control unit; and a sound output unit for outputting a disaster-related sound based on the voice signal from the control unit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 UHD 방송 신호를 이용하여 재난 상황을 신속히 전파할 수 있는 UHD 재난 방송 시스템에 관한 것으로, 방송망으로부터의 UHD 방송(Ultra High Definition) 신호를 수신하는 UHD 재난 방송 수신 장치; 및 건물 내의 각종 정보들을 상기 UHD 재난 방송 수신 장치로 전송하는 주변 장치를 포함하며, 상기 UHD 재난 방송 수신 장치는, 상기 UHD 방송 신호로부터 재난 방송 데이터의 존재 유무를 확인하는 UHD 방송 수신부; 상기 UHD 방송 수신부로부터의 재난 방송 데이터를 근거로 자막 영상 데이터 및 음성 신호를 생성하는 제어부; 상기 제어부로부터의 자막 영상 데이터를 근거로 재난 관련 자막을 표시하는 영상 표시부; 및 상기 제어부로부터의 음성 신호를 근거로 재난 관련 음향을 출력하는 음향 출력부를 포함한다.

title_en: Method and apparatus to reduce service interruption in communication system
abstract_en: A method of a user equipment (UE) is provided. The method includes identifying a disaster condition for a first network, identifying whether the UE is in a registered state and a connected state over a first access based on the identified disaster condition, and performing a disaster roaming based on an identification that the UE is not in the registered state and the connected state over the first access.

title_en: Maintaining computational flow in a data-dependent constraint network
abstract_en: Presented are methods for determining computational flow for a data-dependent constraint network that are especially useful for modeling and trading off alternative configurations in a single computational environment, during design analysis and optimization of an engineering system. These methods leverage a preexisting constraint management system that uses a bipartite graph of variables and constraints to model an engineering system and employ logic formulae based world sets to determine the applicability of the constraints to different system configurations. These methods ensure that a data-dependent constraint network is in a consistent state, and are the essential foundation for other techniques that rely on a consistent constraint network to produce computational plans for propagating values and uncertainties through the constraint network during tradeoff analyses.

title_en: Power grid side combined energy storage robust planning operation method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of multi-energy complementary power generation, in particular to a power grid side combined energy storage robust planning operation method, device, equipment and medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of considering various costs of combined energy storage including step pumping and storage and electrochemical energy storage, and establishing a capacity configuration model of the combined energy storage; the method comprises the steps of taking the lowest running cost of a system as a target, taking the running constraint of cascade extraction and storage and electrochemical energy storage and the line trend constraint into consideration, establishing a running optimization model of the system, establishing a combined energy storage distribution robust planning-running double-layer model comprising the steps of establishing uncertainty of wind power and photovoltaic output probability distribution and converting the linearization model, and solving the double-layer model by adopting a column constraint generation algorithm to obtain a combined energy storage planning running method. According to the invention, the capacity of the combined energy storage under the coordination of the source network and the charge storage can be determined, the system operation can be optimized, the waste electric quantity is reduced, the peak regulation pressure of the thermal power is relieved, the frequent start and stop of the thermal power and hydroelectric generating set are reduced, and the result is robust.

title_en: Earthquake monitoring data analysis method and system based on big data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of earthquake monitoring, in particular to an earthquake monitoring data analysis method and system based on big data, comprising the following steps of analyzing the spatial relationship between a station and the earthquake based on the spatial distribution information of an observation station, and judging the change characteristics of the main seismic wave band at each station, and adjusting event distribution and frequency band response by combining the continuity of a propagation path, the depth change of a seismic source and the trend of heat flow density to obtain a frequency band response optimization set. According to the invention, by automatically matching the station sequence with the seismic event propagation path and combining the structural band with the heat flow change trend, synchronous judgment of event characteristics, space partition and trend classification is realized, a data period updating mechanism promotes a monitoring network to adapt to change in real time, frequency band response distribution is automatically adjusted, continuity and sensitivity of trend identification are continuously enhanced, structural richness and risk identification capability of seismic monitoring data are comprehensively improved, and capability of adapting to complex scenes is endowed to seismic observation.

title_en: Multi-hop ad hoc network equipment cascade test device based on passive device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of performance test of ad hoc network equipment used in fire fighting and rescue fields of fire fighting and rescue teams, in particular to a multi-hop ad hoc network equipment cascade test device based on a passive device. Including shielding case lid and shielding case, testing arrangement inside be equipped with two arm bridge I, two arm bridge II, two merit divide ware I, two merits divide ware II, the ad hoc network equipment that awaits measuring, the one end of attenuator is connected with N type radio frequency adapter I on the shielding case, the outside load of shielding case is connected with N type radio frequency adapter II on the shielding case. The frequency of the first power divider I is 350-2700 MHz, and the frequency of the second power divider II is 800-2700 MHz. The power of the first double-arm bridge I is 800 plus 2700MHz, and the power of the second double-arm bridge II is 350 plus 1000 MHz. The ad hoc network equipment to be tested is connected with the network switching interface on the shielding box body through the network cable.
assignees: SHENYANG FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM

title_en: Low-heat-release low-toxicity weather-resistant environment-friendly flame-retardant looped network cable for rail transit
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of cables, in particular to a low-heat-release low-toxicity weather-resistant environment-friendly flame-retardant looped network cable for rail transit, which comprises a wire, a looped network layer and an outer protective layer, wherein the wire is made of stranded tinned copper wires, an insulating layer is wrapped on the upper surface of the wire, the insulating layer is made of crosslinked polyethylene, the looped network layer is wrapped on the upper surface of the insulating layer, and the looped network layer is made of polyimide woven mesh tubes. Through the cable, the wires of the stranded tinned copper wires are guaranteed to have good conductivity, meanwhile, the corrosion resistance, oxidation resistance and flexibility of the wires are further improved, and the upper surfaces of the wires are wrapped with the insulating layers of the crosslinked polyethylene, so that the cable has good electrical insulation performance and heat resistance, and is suitable for insulation requirements in a high-temperature environment. The aluminum oxide material of the flame-retardant layer can effectively improve the flame retardant property of the cable, ensure that the cable can slow down the fire and delay the flame propagation when a fire disaster occurs.
assignees: JIANGSU RUNHUA CABLE SHAREHOLDING CO LTD

title_en: Cascade outage recognition and risk evaluation method of power grid
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of safety protection of a power system, and in particular relates to a cascade outage recognition and risk evaluation method of a power grid. The cascade outage recognition and risk evaluation method comprises the following steps of: obtaining power grid historical fault information, determining a power gird anticipated accident list, determining a cascade fault propagation and evolution mechanism, determining possibility, ponderance and a risk measurement value of a power grid cascade fault, and establishing a cascade fault recognition and risk evaluation model. According to an actual physical propagation process and a mathematical property of the power grid cascade fault, credibility measurement and total load loss of accident occurrence possibility and ponderance are established by a credibility theory, and are solved by adopting a fuzzy simulation method and load flow calculation, and the contradiction between simulation precision and sampling frequency in the traditional method is solved. Simulation analysis on a WSCC 9 node testing system proves that the method has correctness and robustness, is little in dependence of a sample, and has important theoretical significance and practical significance in preventing large-area power failure accidents of a power grid.
assignees: ZIYANG COMPANY SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV SICHUAN;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Power grid development assessment method with economical efficiency and security considered
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power grid development assessment method with economical efficiency and security considered. The method comprises the steps of collecting initial state data of a power grid to be researched; conducting evolution simulation on the development state of the power grid based on the initial state data of the power grid; conducting statistics on relevant information of newly-built power plants, transformer substations and lines and simulating cascading failures of the power grid based on an obtained power grid evolution simulation result, calculating the construction cost of the power grid based on the statistics information, and obtaining the load loss information of the cascading failures of the power grid based on the simulation of the cascading failures of the power grid; calculating the outage cost of the power grid to obtain the total outage cost of power grid evolution; calculating the development cost of the power grid according to the construction cost of the power grid, the outage cost of the power grid and additionally-supplied load profit; changing the control parameters of evolution simulation of the development state of the power grid and obtaining power grid development cost values under different evolution simulation control parameters through calculation; making an assessment according to the principle that the lower a power grid development cost value is, the more reasonable power grid development is under the corresponding development speed.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE POWER ECONOMIC RES INST;UNIV TSINGHUA

title_en: Power system short-term load prediction method based on IEEMD-BPNN (improved ensemble empirical mode decomposition-back propagation neutral network)
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power system load prediction, and particularly relates to a power system short-term load prediction method based on an IEEMD-BPNN (improved ensemble empirical mode decomposition-back propagation neutral network). The power system short-term load prediction method includes: step 1, using IEEMD to decompose non-steady-state and nonlinear historical power load data to acquire a series of stable intrinsic mode function (IMF) components and a tendency allowance; step 2, removing first-order IMF components (IMF1) acquired in step 1; step 3, using a BPNN to predict IMF components and tendency allowances, at each order, acquired in step 1 and step 2 respectively; step 4, using the BPNN for nonlinear combining of the IMF components and the tendency allowances, at each order, acquired in step 3 to acquire a final power load prediction result.

title_en: Mechanical method for detecting abnormality based on potential feature coding
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of mechanical method for detecting abnormality based on potential feature coding.A kind of mechanical method for detecting abnormality based on potential feature coding of the present invention, comprising: data prediction: pre-processing vibration signal data, including Fourier transform and normalization；Forward-propagating: the signal pre-processed is inputted into first full convolutional network, data are encoded.Beneficial effects of the present invention: this method lacks problem for exceptional sample, utilize the feature mining ability of depth network, the data distribution for learning normal signal sample, is re-encoded by encode to signal-decoding-, and signal is transferred to progress data distribution comparison in latent space.

title_en: Method for simulating continuous wave lidar sensor
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for simulating sensor data of a continuous wave CW light detection and ranging lidar sensor, comprising the steps of: generating a light ray set including at least one light ray based on the CW signal 51, each light ray in the light ray set having an emission start time (T _0) and an emission duration (T); for each ray of the set of rays, propagating the ray in a simulated scene including at least one object; calculating for each ray in the ray set a signal contribution 71 of the propagating ray at the detection position in the simulated scene; generating an output signal 73 based on mixing the CW signal 51 with the calculated signal contribution of the concentrated light; and at least one of storing and outputting the output signal. The present invention provides analog data corresponding to a full waveform signal of a CW lidar sensor. The provided sensor data also enables additional information to be determined, such as object shape and object class, and object orientation. In addition, the sensor data also includes artifacts present in the real lidar data that originate from physical characteristics of the lidar sensor and the environment and are not present in the point cloud type data, such as multiple reflections of the lidar beam. Thus, sensor development can also be improved by taking this artifact into account. The present invention accurately simulates how a real CW lidar sensor works and thus accurately reproduces the output of a real CW lidar sensor. The provided high-quality data is complete and accurate for the real world, and has high value for developing a signal processing algorithm, training a neural network, performing virtual verification and the like.
assignees: SIEMENS IND SOFTWARE AND SERVICES B V

title_en: Fire risk prevention and control method for complex electrical equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire risk prevention and control method for complex electrical equipment, which comprises the following steps: (1) Constructing a complex electrical equipment system risk side topological network model by combining historical electrical fire accidents and the working principle of the physical structure of the equipment, and forming a coupling relation among risk points and basic attribute distribution of the risk points; (2) Calculating a risk propagation Score value among risk points according to a generalized risk fuzzy sorting theory, and quantifying coupling strength among risks; (3) And constructing a complex electrical fire prevention key path generation algorithm considering the risk propagation characteristics to form a key propagation path set, thereby realizing the prevention and control of the fire of the complex electrical equipment. The method can clarify the accident link of the electrical fire of the complex electrical equipment and realize the accurate prevention and control of the system risk situation. Experimental results show that the method has a good prevention effect and can effectively block fire of complex electrical equipment.

title_en: Explosion-proof wireless emergency communication method and system
abstract_en: The application discloses an explosion-proof wireless emergency communication method and system, and relates to the field of emergency communication positioning. The method comprises the following steps: the control end sends an initialization instruction with unique emission frequency to the emergency communication device, and after each time of sending the initialization instruction, the control end receives the registration instructions returned by a plurality of emergency communication devices; the control end selects the transmitting frequency corresponding to the initialization instruction with the largest number of the register of the emergency communication device and the smallest register delay as the system transmitting frequency; and setting the wireless transmission frequency of all the network devices as the system transmission frequency. According to the method, the system transmitting frequency with the strongest signal penetrability can be found according to different environments to carry out networking by the self-developed transmitting frequency determining mode, so that positioning data under the disaster condition can be uploaded through high penetrability wireless signal cascade. When in post-disaster emergency rescue, the application scene range can be obviously enlarged, the reliability of signal transmission is greatly improved, and the communication quality is higher.
assignees: WUHAN QIHUAN ELECTRICAL ENG CO LTD

title_en: Method for trading medium-and-long-term electric power markets of hydropower enrichment power grid with compatible excitation
abstract_en: The invention provides a medium-and-long-term electric power market trading method for a hydropower enrichment power grid compatible with excitation, which is characterized by comprising the following steps of: the method is characterized by adopting the purposes of maximum individual power generation benefit and minimum power grid side electricity purchasing cost; firstly, optimizing and dispatching the hydroelectric system by taking the minimum output of the hydroelectric system as the maximum target to obtain the guaranteed electric quantity; then, ensuring that the electric quantity is split into basic electric quantity, intra-provincial electric quantity and east-west electric quantity to participate in corresponding market transaction respectively, and adopting a reinforcement learning algorithm to carry out cyclic iterative solution; and finally, selecting different incoming water frequencies, and analyzing the power supply stability under different forms and different guaranteed electric quantities. The method has guiding significance for the problems of default, insufficient water resource utilization and the like caused by unreasonable competition of the cascade power stations, uncertain natural water supply and mismatching of the winning power quantity, and provides effective advice and direction for medium-long term transaction modes of the hydropower enrichment power grid.

title_en: High-credibility functional resonance analysis method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-credibility functional resonance analysis method and a system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: qualitative depiction of system functions, analysis of coupling dependency relationships and drawing of network function diagrams; the underlying changes in function are analyzed according to simple and complex variability, and the variability propagation is subdivided into five variability phenotypes; generalizing k=pi, combining semantic evaluations of five phenotypes with numerical variables, refining granularity of a propagation factor, and obtaining coupling variability between an upstream function and a downstream function; taking the base 10 logarithm of the global system variability, combining the simple variability and the complex variability, and analyzing the uncertainty of the global system variability by calculating the global system variability interval value. Compared with the prior art, the invention qualitatively refines the semantic evaluation criterion; quantitatively refining the granularity of the propagation factors and providing a general formula; the number of intervals on the result reflects the change direction and fluctuation range of the system variability under different attributes well.

title_en: Power distribution network measurement data super-resolution sensing method based on transfer learning
abstract_en: The application relates to a power distribution network measurement data super-resolution sensing method based on transfer learning. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a high-frequency time sequence, preprocessing to obtain training sample data, constructing a cascade model based on a graph attention network and a transducer network, inputting the training sample data and an incidence matrix into the cascade model, pre-training the cascade model, enabling the incidence matrix to represent a topological connection relation of a power distribution network, dividing the pre-trained cascade model into a learner part and a decision maker part, performing migration learning training, and reserving model parameters reaching a training target to obtain a final super-resolution perception model, wherein the learner part comprises all layers except the linear output layer of the transducer, the decision maker part comprises the linear output layer of the transducer, and inputting real-time measurement data into the super-resolution perception model to obtain a super-resolution measurement generation result.

title_en: System for realizing national standard superior service disaster recovery fast recovery by utilizing Redis record cascade and equipment information
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for realizing a national standard superior service disaster recovery rapid recovery system by using Redis record cascade and equipment information, which comprises the steps of constructing a Redis storage management system to record the cascade and the equipment information, and rapidly judging recovery links or waiting to register on line according to the Redis information when the service is restarted abnormally. The first time of searching the shared equipment information adopts multithreading to put in storage, so that the efficiency is improved. And comparing the Redis with the reported information at the time of secondary retrieval, performing difference processing, and checking consistency at fixed time. The lower level searches the resource information to the upper level synchronously, and by means of the Kafka component, the database and the Redis are accurately operated according to the information content, so that the data synchronization is ensured to be complete in time. The steps work cooperatively, so that the problems that the conventional national standard cascade service realizes disaster recovery and quick recovery when facing various emergency conditions such as service faults, network anomalies and the like, improves the overall performance, disaster recovery capacity and data accuracy, and meets the requirements of a video monitoring system on efficient, stable and reliable operation and accurate resource sharing are solved.

title_en: Electric power construction process early warning method and system based on high-precision three-dimensional model
abstract_en: The invention discloses an early warning method and system for an electric power foundation construction process based on a high-precision three-dimensional model, and relates to the technical field of electric power foundation construction, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting multi-source data of an electric power foundation construction site and constructing the high-precision three-dimensional model comprising equipment space coordinates, construction time sequence labels and environmental parameters; the method comprises the steps of inputting a space-time diagram into a space-time diagram convolution network, outputting a risk propagation probability matrix of a three-dimensional space and a construction time sequence dimension, identifying high-risk nodes and associated construction stages, dynamically marking root coordinates and a risk diffusion range in a high-precision three-dimensional model, generating an early warning instruction containing a visual path, a root report and a treatment priority, and pushing the early warning instruction to a terminal through an edge node in real time. The method is based on a layered space-time attention-physical constraint graph convolution network, dynamically distributes inter-node cross-stage association weights, optimizes convolution kernel parameters in combination with physical connection strength, and remarkably improves space-time association of high-risk node identification.
assignees: GUANGDONG SENXU GENERAL EQUIPMENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Wind farm diagnosis method and system for multi-mode feature fusion and fault propagation analysis
abstract_en: The application relates to a wind power plant diagnosis method and system for multi-mode feature fusion and fault propagation analysis, which belong to the technical field of wind power equipment fault diagnosis, wherein visible light, infrared and LiDAR multi-mode data of wind power plant equipment are cooperatively collected through an unmanned aerial vehicle group, and a weighted fusion feature vector is generated by adopting a dynamic gating mechanism to fuse YOLOv extracted local features, a Transformer extracted thermodynamic feature and PointNet ++ extracted spatial structure features. And identifying the fault type, the position and the confidence coefficient by fusing the feature vectors through a multi-task neural network, and embedding a material failure model optimization diagnosis result of the wind power equipment. And positioning a fault source and an influence range by combining the power grid topology model and a fault tracing algorithm. And finally, generating a maintenance decision according to the fault propagation evaluation result.
assignees: HUANENG HENAN CLEANING ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: Multifunctional cascade multi-network converged communication guarantee system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of communication guarantee, in particular to a multifunctional cascade multi-network fusion communication guarantee system which comprises a central console, a plurality of groups of leakage cable communication lifesaving illumination lines and a plurality of groups of wire coils, wherein one end of the central console is cascaded with the wire coils through the leakage cable communication lifesaving illumination lines, cascade expansion is realized between adjacent wire coils through the leakage cable communication lifesaving illumination lines, the leakage cable communication lifesaving illumination lines are wound on the wire coils, and the leakage cable communication lifesaving illumination lines can be optionally wound and unwound according to actual demands during use. The multifunctional cascade multi-network fusion communication guarantee system solves the problems of communication coverage, multi-service data transmission, guiding illumination, power supply coordination and the like in a closed environment and a complex environment through wired and wireless multi-mode fusion communication, a wide-frequency-band cable leakage transmission technology and an integrated design, improves the fire rescue efficiency and the self safety, guarantees the smooth communication of various devices of firefighters, and achieves no communication.
assignees: LANYUAN TIANDUN BEIJING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Causal graph neural network grid cascading failure prediction method supporting multi-source heterogeneous data fusion
abstract_en: The application discloses a causal graph neural network grid cascading failure prediction method supporting multi-source heterogeneous data fusion, which relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence and comprises the steps of preprocessing grid parameters, calculating the preprocessed grid parameters to obtain importance scores between nodes and edges in a grid, constructing causal subgraphs and deviation subgraphs based on the grid parameters and the importance scores, generating unbiased samples based on the causal subgraphs and the deviation subgraphs, training a graph neural network by using the unbiased samples and cascading failure simulation data sets to obtain a target graph neural network, and sending the grid parameters to be predicted to the target graph neural network to output a grid cascading failure prediction result, so that the limitation of relying on experience rules or preset physical models is avoided, the accuracy and the reliability of predicting the time and the range of cascading failures in the grid are improved, and the safety of the grid is improved.
assignees: UNIV CHONGQING POSTS & TELECOM;MARKETING SERVICE CENTER OF STATE GRID CHONGQING ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Coupling and clustering analysis and decision-making tree based short-term power generation scheduling method for cascaded hydroelectric station group
abstract_en: A coupling and clustering analysis and decision-making tree based short-term power generation scheduling method for a cascaded hydroelectric station group. An electric quantity matching relationship between upstream and downstream power stations is determined with linear regression; based on this, a typical contribution curve of each power station is obtained by clustering massive actual data, and classification training is performed on factors affecting power generation scheduling such as a planned daily electric quantity, a reservoir water level and a power grid characteristic, and a typical contribution process, so as to construct a cascaded power generation scheduling decision-making library, facilitating quickly determining a combined scheduling scheme for the upstream and downstream hydroelectric stations using the decision-making tree method; and finally, a constraint correction policy is introduced for fine tuning of contribution, so as to ensure the feasibility of a result. By means of the method, a cascaded hydroelectric station power generation scheduling plan can be quickly obtained according to a power generation boundary condition; there is good practicability, and a new technological approach is provided for short-term power generation scheduling of "one-reservoir and multi-cascade" cascaded hydroelectric stations.

title_en: A kind of system and method transmitting information based on street lamp
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of system and methods transmitting information based on street lamp, the system for transmitting information based on street lamp includes at least a master control street lamp and at least a controlled street light, for the master control street lamp for receiving an information and exporting a signal to the controlled street light, the controlled street light issues described information according to the signal.Based on the street lamp as communal facility as communication media, the publication of information is realized by the transmission of signal between street lamp, widely distributed, quantity is more, expands while information plays range and improves the redundancy for propagating information.Further, due to information, information is propagated in a manner of optical signal, is accelerated spread speed, is reduced property loss caused by disaster.

title_en: Real-time minimum face detection method based on pretreatment mechanism
abstract_en: The invention mainly relates to the problem of target detection in the field of artificial intelligence. Aiming at the problem of extremely small face in a complex environment, a cascading type face detection method is provided, and the method mainly comprises two neural networks and a pretreatment mechanism. Firstly, a first neural network, namely SSD, is used for detecting a pedestrian confidence frame, then the region is transmitted into a pretreatment mechanism, the mechanism automatically predicts the region of interest of the human face through the length and the width of the confidence frame, and the region of interest is subjected to image pyramid processing, and as the input size of the second network is fixed, the algorithm enables the second human face detection network to detect human faces with different sizes. The method provided by the invention can accurately and effectively detect the minimum face in a plurality of complex environments, and can be potentially used and integrated in the fields of public safety detection, face recognition and the like.

title_en: Method for evaluating stability of multi-layer urban group comprehensive passenger transport network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating the stability of a multilayer urban group comprehensive passenger transport network, which comprises the following steps: step 1: constructing a traffic district-traffic subnet multi-layer city group comprehensive passenger transport network model; step 2: simulating the stability cascade failure of the multi-layer urban group comprehensive passenger transport network; and step 3: and simulating and analyzing the network stability under the condition of sudden increase of passenger flow of the key nodes. The invention has the advantages that: the urban internal traffic is considered, an urban comprehensive passenger transport network model closer to the reality is constructed, a plurality of practical influence factors of networks of different layers are fully considered for weighting, the capacity of the passenger transport traffic network for dealing with emergency is enhanced, the capacity limit of stations and different overload degrees of nodes are fully considered, the node state is closer to the congestion degree of the practical stations, the conditions of surge and cascade failure of node passenger flow are considered, a network stability measure index is provided, and the capacity of the network for dealing with emergency such as station failure, surge of passenger flow and the like is enhanced.

title_en: Peak regulation optimization scheduling method for cascade water-light complementary power generation system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a peak regulation optimization scheduling method of a cascade water-light complementary power generation system, which comprises the following steps: establishing a peak regulation optimizing and scheduling objective function of a cascade water-light complementary power generation system by taking the minimum residual load maximum value of a receiving end power grid in a scheduling period as an objective function; establishing a step hydropower station output constraint condition considering unit combination and a photovoltaic power station output constraint condition considering uncertainty; linearizing the constraint conditions, and constructing a mixed integer linear model for peak regulation optimization scheduling of the cascade water-light complementary power generation system according to the objective function and the constraint conditions after linearizing; and solving the mixed integer linear model of peak regulation optimization scheduling of the cascade water light complementary power generation system to obtain a scheduling scheme of the cascade water light complementary power generation system. The invention considers the unit combination condition and reservoir operation scheme of the hydropower station, can fully utilize the characteristic of easy adjustment of the hydropower unit to consume the photovoltaic output, meets the peak regulation requirement of the power grid, and has strong practicability.

title_en: Economic dispatching method for cascade hydropower, photovoltaic and full-power variable-speed pumped storage
abstract_en: The invention discloses an economic dispatching method for cascade hydropower, photovoltaic and full-power variable-speed pumped storage, which is used for carrying out economic dispatching and optimal allocation among the cascade hydropower, photovoltaic and full-power variable-speed pumped storage according to the running state, water supply mode and running state of each unit; the method is based on a combined operation system consisting of step hydropower, photovoltaic and full-power variable-speed pumped storage, wherein the step hydropower, photovoltaic and full-power variable-speed pumped storage units are all converged in the same transformer substation; according to the cascade hydropower, photovoltaic and full-power variable-speed pumped storage combined operation system, the system is connected into an alternating current power grid in a region after converging, and according to the operation condition of a circuit connected with the cascade hydropower and photovoltaic combined operation system and the alternating current power grid, a grid-connected state and a grid-off state are set; the cascade water and light accumulation combined operation system is provided with three water supply modes, including a water-rising mode, a water leveling mode and a water-withering mode. The method has the advantages of reducing the operation cost and improving the economic benefit.

title_en: Disaster response method that is based on the machine to machine
title_ko: 사물지능통신을 기반으로 하는 재난대응방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster response method based on machine to machine. The disaster response method includes the following steps: (S100) collecting surrounding situation information for disaster prevention by regional groups; (S110) analyzing and checking the collected surrounding situation information for disaster prevention by regional groups; (S120) setting an accident danger circle (r1); (S130) generating a danger propagation evasion-based shortest path (MR); and (S140) displaying the danger propagation evasion-based shortest path (MR) and transmitting the same to a terminal for an affiliated person, thereby minimizing the loss of life even after the occurrence of a calamity accident.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 유해화학가스 확산, 원유유출, 플랜트폭발, 방사능누출사고 등의 다양한 인재사고의 확산으로 인한 피해범위의 광역화와 누적적 장기화로 인한 불특정 다수의 주민과 생물환경에 심대한 영향을 주는 인적재난에 대해, 빅데이터를 기반으로 사고상황 발생 전부터 지속적으로 체크함으로써, 고확산, 고위험이 수반되는 유해화학물질의 관리를 체계적으로 수립 및 해당 지역 주민들에게 안내하여 사고발생 전부터 해당 지역 주민들에게 신속하게 대응 및 대처할 수 있게 안내하여 야기될 수 있는 위험성을 극소화시킴과 더불어 실제로 재난사고가 발생한 상태에서 지역 소속자들이 그 재난사고가 발생된 지역을 인지하고, 그 재난사고가 전파되는 지역을 회피하면서 안전한 지역까지 최단경로로 이동하게 안내하여 줌으로써, 재난사고 발생후에도 인명피해를 최소화시켜주는 사물지능통신을 기반으로 하는 재난대응방법에 관한 것으로, 재난대응서버(300)에서 사물지능 방재센서부(100)로부터 생성되는 산업시설 주변지역의 상황을 감지한 정보인 지역별 방재용 주변상황정보를 수집하는 단계(S100)와; 상기 재난대응서버(300)에서 재난분석엔진(320)을 운영하여, 상기 수집된 지역별 방재용 주변상황정보를 분석하고, 그 분석된 값이 이상 없음, 사고발생 예측상황감지 및 사고발생 감지 중 어느 것인지 확인하는 단계(S110)와; 상기 수집된 지역별 방재용 주변상황정보의 분석된 값이 사고발생 감지인 경우 상기 재난대응서버(300)에서 재난사고대응 안전이동경로 생성엔진(330)을 운영하여, 그 사고가 감지된 방재용 주변상황정보를 전송한 해당 사물지능 방재센서부(100)를 인지하며, 산업시설 주변지역 소속자용 단말(200)들로부터 산업시설 주변지역 소속자 위치좌표정보들을 전송받고, 산업시설 주변지역 사물지능 방재센서 위치 안내용 지도 목록정보 DB(316)에서 산업시설 주변지역 사물지능 방재센서 위치 안내용 지도정보를 추출하여 그 추출된 산업시설 주변지역 사물지능 방재센서 위치 안내용 지도정보 상에 상기 사고가 감지된 방재용 주변상황정보를 전송한 해당 사물지능 방재센서부(100)를 중심으로 사고위험반경(r1)을 설정하는 단계(S120)와; 상기 재난대응서버(300)의 재난사고대응 안전이동경로 생성엔진(330)에서, 상기 추출된 산업시설 주변지역 사물지능 방재센서 위치 안내용 지도정보 상에 상기 사고가 감지된 방재용 주변상황정보를 전송한 해당 사물지능 방재센서부(100)로부터 안전한 지역을 나타내는 안전지역(SZ)을 선정한 후 상기 전송된 산업시설 주변지역 소속자 위치좌표정보들을 참조하여 상기 추출된 산업시설 주변지역 사물지능 방재센서 위치 안내용 지도정보 상의 사고위험반경(r1)의 외(外)에 위치하는 소속자들을 인지하며, 그 인지된 해당 소속자들의 위치에서 상기 안전지역(SZ)까지 최단으로 이동하는 경로인 위험전파 회피기반 최단경로(MR)를 생성하는 단계(S130)와; 상기 재난대응서버(300)의 재난사고대응 안전이동경로 생성엔진(330)에서, 상기 추출된 산업시설 주변지역 사물지능 방재센서 위치 안내용 지도정보 상에 상기 검색된 위험전파 회피기반 최단경로(MR)를 표시하고 이를, 상기 사고위험반경(r1)의 외(外)에 위치하는 소속자들의 산업시설 주변지역 소속자용 단말(200)들로 전송하는 단계(S140);를 포함하되, 상기 위험전파 회피기반 최단경로(MR)의 생성은, 상기 재난대응서버(300)의 재난사고대응 안전이동경로 생성엔진(330)에서, 상기 산업시설 주변지역 사물지능 방재센서 위치 안내용 지도정보 상의 사고위험반경(r1)의 외(外)에 위치하는 상기 산업시설 주변지역 소속자용 단말(200)을 소유한 소속자 위치인 산업시설 주변지역 소속자 위치좌표에서 안전지역(SZ)까지 이동가능한 경로를 모두 검색하는 단계(S1301)와; 상기 재난대응서버(300)의 재난사고대응 안전이동경로 생성엔진(330)에서, 상기 검색된 모든 이동경로 중 제일 짧은 이동거리를 갖는 이동경로를 선택하는 단계(S1302)와; 상기 재난대응서버(300)의 재난사고대응 안전이동경로 생성엔진(330)에서, 상기 선택된 이동경로 중 해당 소속자 산업시설 주변지역 소속자용 단말(200)의 산업시설 주변지역 소속자 위치좌표에서 상기 선택된 이동경로를 따라 안전하게 이동 가능한 거리를 확인하기 위한 안전이동거리(SD)를 상기 선택된 이동경로에 기설정된 간격으로 분할표시하는 단계(S1303)와; 상기 재난대응서버(300)의 재난사고대응 안전이동경로 생성엔진(330)에서, 상기 선택된 이동경로에 분할표시된 안전이동거리(SD) 중 첫 번째 안전이동거리(SD)를 중심으로 안전여부 확인반경(r2)을 표시하는 단계(S1304)와; 상기 재난대응서버(300)의 재난사고대응 안전이동경로 생성엔진(330)에서, 상기 표시된 안전여부 확인반경(r2)이 상기 사고위험반경(r1)과 중첩되는지 확인하는 단계(S1305)와; 상기 안전여부 확인반경(r2)이 상기 사고위험반경(r1)과 중첩되지 않은 경우 상기 재난대응서버(300)의 재난사고대응 안전이동경로 생성엔진(330)에서, 상기 선택된 이동경로 중 소속자가 위치하는 산업시설 주변지역 소속자 위치좌표에서 사고위험반경(r1)과 중첩되지 않은 안전여부 확인반경(r2)이 표시된 해당 안전이동거리(SD)까지 안전하다고 판단하는 단계(S1307)와; 상기 선택된 이동경로에 분할표시된 안전이동거리(SD) 중 안전여부 확인반경(r2)이 표시되지 않은 안전이동거리(SD)가 존재하는지 확인하는 단계(S1308)와; 상기 선택된 이동경로에 분할표시된 안전이동거리(SD) 중 안전여부 확인반경(r2)이 표시되지 않은 안전이동거리(SD)가 존재하지 않은 경우 상기 재난대응서버(300)의 재난사고대응 안전이동경로 생성엔진(330)에서, 상기 소속자가 위치하는 좌표에서 안전하다고 판단된 해당 안전이동거리(SD)를 경유하여 상기 안전지역까지 연결하여 이루어진 경로인 상기 위험전파 회피기반 최단경로(MR)를 생성하는 단계(S1309);로 이루어지고, 상기 재난대응서버(300)의 재난사고대응 안전이동경로 생성엔진(330)에서, 상기 표시된 안전여부 확인반경(r2)이 상기 사고위험반경(r1)과 중첩되는지 확인하는 S1305단계에 있어서, 상기 안전여부 확인반경(r2)이 상기 사고위험반경(r1)과 중첩된 경우 상기 재난대응서버(300)의 재난사고대응 안전이동경로 생성엔진(330)에서, 해당 소속자가 보유한 산업시설 주변지역 소속자용 단말(200)의 산업시설 주변지역 소속자 위치좌표에서 안전지역(SZ)까지 검색된 모든 이동가능한 경로 중 다음번째로 짧은 이동거리를 갖는 이동경로를 선택하는 단계(S1306); 이후, 상기 재난대응서버(300)의 재난사고대응 안전이동경로 생성엔진(330)에서, 상기 선택된 이동경로 중 해당 소속자 산업시설 주변지역 소속자용 단말(200)의 산업시설 주변지역 소속자 위치좌표에서 상기 선택된 이동경로를 따라 안전하게 이동 가능한 거리를 확인하기 위한 안전이동거리(SD)를 상기 선택된 이동경로에 기설정된 간격으로 분할표시하는 S1303단계로 순환되며, 상기 선택된 이동경로에 분할표시된 안전이동거리(SD) 중 안전여부 확인반경(r2)이 표시되지 않은 안전이동거리(SD)가 존재하는지 확인하는 S1308단계에 있어서, 상기 선택된 이동경로에 분할표시된 안전이동거리(SD) 중 안전여부 확인반경(r2)이 표시되지 않은 안전이동거리(SD)가 존재하는 경우 상기 재난대응서버(300)의 재난사고대응 안전이동경로 생성엔진(330)에서, 안전여부 확인반경(r2)이 표시되지 않은 다음번째 안전이동거리(SD)를 중심으로 안전여부 확인반경(r2)을 표시하는 단계(S1310)와; 상기 표시된 안전여부 확인반경(r2)이 상기 사고위험반경(r1)과 중첩되는지 확인하는 단계(S1311)와; 다음 번째 안전이동거리(SD)를 중심으로 상기 표시된 안전여부 확인반경(r2)이 상기 사고위험반경(r1)과 중첩되지 않은 경우 상기 재난대응서버(300)의 재난사고대응 안전이동경로 생성엔진(330)에서, 상기 첫 번째 이동경로 중 첫 번째 안전이동거리(SD)에서 다음번째 안전이동거리(SD)까지 안전하다고 판단하는 단계(S1312)와; 상기 선택된 이동경로에 분할표시된 안전이동거리(SD) 중 안전여부 확인반경(r2)이 표시되지 않은 안전이동거리(SD)가 존재하는지 확인하는 단계(S1313)와; 상기 선택된 이동경로에 분할표시된 안전이동거리(SD) 중 안전여부 확인반경(r2)이 표시되지 않은 안전이동거리(SD)가 존재하지 않은 경우 상기 재난대응서버(300)의 재난사고대응 안전이동경로 생성엔진(330)에서, 상기 소속자가 위치하는 좌표에서 안전하다고 판단된 해당 안전이동거리(SD)를 경유하여 상기 안전지역까지 연결하여 이루어진 경로인 상기 위험전파 회피기반 최단경로(MR)를 생성하는 S1309단계로 진입하고, 상기 선택된 이동경로에 분할표시된 안전이동거리(SD) 중 안전여부 확인반경(r2)이 표시되지 않은 안전이동거리(SD)가 존재하는 경우 상기 재난대응서버(300)의 재난사고대응 안전이동경로 생성엔진(330)에서, 안전여부 확인반경(r2)이 표시되지 않은 그 다음번째 안전이동거리(SD)를 중심으로 안전여부 확인반경(r2)을 표시하는 단계(S1314)와; 상기 표시된 안전여부 확인반경(r2)이 상기 사고위험반경(r1)과 중첩되는지 확인하는 단계(S1315)와; 그 다음 번째 안전이동거리(SD)를 중심으로 그 표시된 안전여부 확인반경(r2)이 상기 사고위험반경(r1)과 중첩되지 않은 경우 상기 재난대응서버(300)의 재난사고대응 안전이동경로 생성엔진(330)에서, 상기 첫 번째 이동경로 중 소속자가 위치하는 좌표에서 그 다음 번째 안전이동거리(SD)까지 안전하다고 판단하는 단계(S1316)와; 상기 선택된 이동경로에 분할표시된 안전이동거리(SD) 중 안전여부 확인반경(r2)이 표시되지 않은 안전이동거리(SD)가 존재하는지 확인하는 단계(S1317)와; 상기 선택된 이동경로에 분할표시된 안전이동거리(SD) 중 안전여부 확인반경(r2)이 표시되지 않은 안전이동거리(SD)가 존재하지 않은 경우 상기 재난대응서버(300)의 재난사고대응 안전이동경로 생성엔진(330)에서, 상기 소속자가 위치하는 좌표에서 안전하다고 판단된 해당 안전이동거리(SD)를 경유하여 상기 안전지역까지 연결하여 이루어진 경로인 상기 위험전파 회피기반 최단경로(MR)를 생성하는 S1309단계로 진입하고, 상기 선택된 이동경로에 분할표시된 안전이동거리(SD) 중 안전여부 확인반경(r2)이 표시되지 않은 안전이동거리(SD)가 존재하는 경우 상기 재난대응서버(300)의 재난사고대응 안전이동경로 생성엔진(330)에서, 안전여부 확인반경(r2)이 표시되지 않은 그 다음번째 안전이동거리(SD)를 중심으로 안전여부 확인반경(r2)을 표시하는 S1314단계로 순환되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Fire-fighting apparatus using communication facility of apartment house
title_ko: 공동주택의 통신 시설을 이용한 소방 안전 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire safety apparatus using a communication facility of an apartment house which allows a person recognizing a fire when the fire occurs in an apartment house to quickly and easily spread the occurrence of the fire to people inside each household in the corresponding apartment house and then escape out of the corresponding apartment house to greatly lower the risk of loss of the life of the person spreading the occurrence of the fire and allow the people inside the corresponding apartment house to check a fire emergency warning accurately spread by other people inside the apartment house and an intercom in the corresponding household without considering malfunction of a fire alarm and then quickly evacuate. According to the present invention, the fire safety apparatus using a communication facility of an apartment house comprises an apartment house firefighting server, a first communication module, a second communication module, a household intercom, and an outdoor bell unit. The outdoor bell unit includes a case, a forward/reverse rotation motor, a decelerator, a rotary plate, a doorbell switching part, a fire emergency switching part, a pushbutton, a bell function display lamp, and a control part.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 공동주택의 화재 발생 시 그 사실을 인지한 사람이 해당 공동주택 내 각 세대의 재실자들에게 화재 발생 사실을 매우 신속하고 용이하게 전파 후 해당 공동주택의 외부로 빠져나올 수 있도록 함으로써, 화재 발생 사실을 전파하는 사람의 인명피해 위험성이 크게 낮아지는 동시에 해당 공동주택의 재실자들은 화재경보기의 오작동 등을 고려함 없이 타 재실자들 및 해당 세대 인터폰을 통해 정확히 전파되는 화재 비상 경보를 확인 후 신속하게 대피에 나설 수 있도록 한 공동주택의 통신 시설을 이용한 소방 안전 장치에 관한 것으로서, 본 발명에 따른 공동주택의 통신 시설을 이용한 소방 안전 장치는 공동주택 소방서버, 제1 통신모듈, 제2 통신모듈, 세대 인터폰 및 그 실외 벨 유닛을 포함하여 구성되고, 상기 실외 벳 유닛은 케이스, 정역회전모터, 감속기, 회전판, 초인종 스위칭부, 화재 비상 스위칭부, 누름버튼, 벨 기능 표시램프 및 제어부를 포함하여 구성된다.

title_en: Flange Cover for Back Fire Prevention
title_ko: 역화방지용 플랜지 커버
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 파이프 배관의 플랜지 연결부를 감싸도록 설치되어 누설되는 화학물질 또는 유체를 특정 방향으로 유도함으로써 플랜지 연결부를 외부 충격 및 환경으로부터 보호하고 폭발 환경에 대비한 역화방지기를 적용하여 화재발생시 파이프 배관을 통해 화재가 전파되는 것을 방지하여 인명과 시설물을 보호할 수 있도록 한 역화방지용 플랜지 커버에 관한 것으로,  
파이프 배관(100)의 플랜지 연결부가 수용되는 공간을 형성하며 양단이 막혀 있는 원통 형상의 바디(10); 파이프 배관(100)이 수용되도록 바디의 양측에 구비되는 배관수용부(20); 바디(10)의 하측에 구비되어 외부의 화염이 바디(10)의 내측으로 전파되지 않도록 차단하는 역화방지기(50);를 포함하고, 상기 바디(10)와 배관수용부(20)는 반으로 분할 형성되어 연결부재에 의해 일체화되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Cascade reservoir random optimization scheduling method based on deep Q learning
abstract_en: A cascade reservoir random optimization scheduling method based on deep Q learning comprises the steps of describing a reservoir warehousing diameter process: establishing a Markov decision process MDPS model; establishing a probability transition matrix: establishing a cascade reservoir random optimal scheduling model; determining a constraint function of the model: introducing a deep neural network, extracting runoff state characteristics of the cascade reservoir, and simultaneously realizing approximate expression and optimization of a target value function of a dispatching model; applying reinforcement learning to reservoir random optimization scheduling; establishing a DQN model; and solving the cascade reservoir random optimization scheduling model by adopting a deep reinforcement learning algorithm. The random optimized dispatching method for the cascade reservoir based on the deep Q learning realizes the random optimized dispatching of the cascade reservoir, so that the generator set is fully utilized in the dispatching period, the power consumption requirement and various constraint conditions are met, and the annual average power generation benefit is maximum.

title_en: Substation power utilization analysis system and method
abstract_en: The application relates to a substation power utilization analysis system and method. The system comprises a front-end sensor and a data server, wherein the front-end sensor and the data server are in communication in a wireless mode, the front-end sensor is used for detecting electric energy parameters of the transformer substation and sending the electric energy parameters to the data server, and the data server is used for analyzing the electric energy parameters based on a BP (back propagation) neural network, establishing a power grid fault early warning model and predicting the load of the transformer substation according to the power grid fault early warning model. The front-end sensor and the data server are communicated in a wireless mode, the use cost can be reduced, communication lines do not need to be laid, the safety of the transformer substation is improved, the electric energy parameters of the data server are subjected to data analysis modeling, a fault early warning model based on the electric energy parameters is obtained, the model can be used for predicting the load of the transformer substation, faults are pre-judged in advance, so that solving measures can be taken in time, and the use reliability of the power utilization analysis system of the transformer substation is improved.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Comprehensive intelligent management platform for mulberry field
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive intelligent management platform for a mulberry field. The platform gathers data such as job progress, resource consumption, quality detection, weather and the like, dynamically adjusts weight parameters according to the growth stage and the external environment, and completes risk classification. And by constructing the operation cooperation network, identifying the central node and the fragile link, carrying out negative event propagation deduction, and realizing real-time hierarchical early warning by combining a rule engine. The system comprises an edge gateway and a scheduling unit, supports breakpoint continuous transmission and automatic generation of a treatment scheme, forms an evaluation-early warning-scheduling-feedback closed loop, and is suitable for mulberry fields of different scales.
assignees: SICHUAN ACADEMY OF AGRICULTURAL SCIENCES SPECIAL ECONOMIC AND PLANT RES INSTITUTE OF SICHUAN ACADEMY;NANCHONG SHENGRUI AGRICULTURE CO LTD;SICHUAN NANCHONG TAOYUAN BIOCHEMICAL RES AND DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Legal contract risk monitoring and early warning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a legal contract risk monitoring and early warning method, which particularly relates to the technical field of risk early warning, and aims to construct a multi-contract risk propagation network by identifying propagation clauses in a plurality of legal contract texts, generate a multi-contract propagation path topology network model by adopting a graph theory algorithm, output a cascade trigger mechanism for identifying inter-contract risk propagation clauses by utilizing time sequence causal analysis, obtain propagation path sensitivity grading data by carrying out sensitivity grading on each risk propagation path, integrate the cascade risk propagation links and the propagation path sensitivity grading data, construct a contract network risk propagation comprehensive assessment model, output a comprehensive risk assessment result, and compare the comprehensive risk assessment result with a preset risk early warning threshold rule to generate corresponding risk prompt information.

title_en: Rapid screening method for high-risk cascading failures
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid screening method of high-risk cascading failures, which belongs to the technical field of cascading failure screening of electric power systems and comprises the steps of collecting real-time operation data and off-line stored historical failure data from a power grid dispatching system, obtaining power grid core data in different formats, preprocessing the power grid core data, unifying data formats, adapting simulation tools, constructing a failure screening model by defining accident chain constitution, ending conditions and influencing factors, and reducing the failure searching range. According to the rapid screening method of the high-risk cascading faults, the efficiency is remarkably improved through multiple optimization, on one hand, the fault searching range is limited on a core power supply path of a power supply side-load side, invalid fault combinations of non-key branch lines are eliminated, the calculation space is greatly compressed, on the other hand, the influence degree of the faults is quantized based on a link condition function, only links with influence values exceeding a threshold value are continuously searched, and meaningless path extension is avoided.
assignees: KAIFENG POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Method and medium for acquiring water flow propagation time in dead water period and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water conservancy and discloses a method, a medium and electronic equipment for acquiring the propagation time of water flow in a dead water period, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring initial data of a research area; the initial data comprises river basin topography data, river network water system boundary data, inflow position data and inflow data, and the initial data is input into a medium-low water level radial flow evolution model to perform simulation calculation so as to obtain the water flow propagation time in the dead water period. The method accurately describes the hydrologic power process in the dead water period of the research area, predicts available water resources of all river sections in the river basin, provides quantitative basis for water distribution, is beneficial to optimization of the dead water period scheduling schemes of water conservancy projects such as reservoirs, sluice gates and the like in the river basin, predicts the effect of the water replenishing scheduling scheme, and aims at solving the key problems in the management of the river basin in the dead water period.
assignees: HUNAN INST OF WATER RESOURCES AND HYDROPOWER RESEARCH

title_en: Underground radio network integrated repeater system by digital
title_ko: 디지털 지하 무선망 종합 중계장치
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An underground digital integrated radio network repeater is provided to relay a digital signal according to a division amplification method in a channel by converting a public wave broadcast signal into a digital signal. CONSTITUTION: An apparatus management unit(150) monitors operation states according to signals detected from an AM(Amplitude Modulation) digital multiple channel repeater, an FM(Frequency Modulation) digital multiple channel repeater, a DMB(Digital Multimedia Broadcasting) repeater, and an external wireless communication repeater. An output combination unit(170) combines signals inputted from the external wireless communication repeater, the DMB repeater, and FM digital multiple channel repeater in order to transmit the signal using one transmission cable. An AM transmission unit transmits the signal inputted from the AM digital multiple channel repeater. An FM transmission unit transmits a signal inputted from the output combination unit.
