abstract_ko: 본 발명은 디지털 지하 무선망 종합 중계장치에 관한 것으로서, 전파차단지역 및 전파음영지역에 AM/FM 방송 및 지상파 DMB 방송의 공중파 방송신호를 디지털신호로 변환하여 채널별 분리 증폭방식으로 각 채널을 구분하여 중계함으로써 중계되는 전파의 질을 향상시킬 뿐만 아니라 외부 무선통신 주파수를 중계하고 비상상황 발생시 AM/FM 방송 및 지상파 DMB 방송을 통해 비상방송을 할 수 있도록 하며 원격지에서 중계장치를 종합적으로 제어 및 감시할 수 있다.

title_ko: 원자력 시설에서 핵 물질의 인-시투 처리 및 격납을 위한 비상 시스템 및 방법
abstract_ko: 비상 사태 동안 방사능 물질(M)을 안전하게 격리시키는 시스템 및 방법(10)은, 물질(M)을 안전하게 격리시키기에 충분한 깊이와 근접하여 위치된 보어홀(20)을 포함한다.  일 실시예에서, 어떠한 외부 전원도 필요하지 않다.  또 다른 실시예에서, 증기 폭발을 생성할 위험 없이 고온의 물질(M)이 안전하게 격리될 수 있는 건조한 구멍을 생성하기 위해 하부(25)에서 절연 배리어를 가지는 완전히 케이싱된 보어홀(20)이 사용된다.  일 실시예에서, 오염된 물(W)을 격리시키는데 사용되는 실시예에서, 보어홀 케이싱(21)은 천공되고, 천공(23)은 물(W)이 쉽게 흐를 수 있는 투과성 영역을 가로지른다.  또 다른 실시예에서, 중력 균열은 보어홀(20)의 하단부(25)에 위치되며, 방사능 물질(M)은 중력 균열에 진입한다.  밀도가 큰 슬러리 또는 유체는 방사능 물질(M)과 혼합되어 방사능 물질(M)이 처리됨에 따라 중력 균열을 생성 및 전파할 수 있다.

title_en: Optimized control method for water level between upstream reservoir and reverse regulation reservoir dam thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optimization control method for water level between an upstream reservoir and a counter-regulation reservoir dam thereof, which is characterized in that a plurality of neural networks are trained based on historical operation data, the working condition matching closest to the historical working condition is searched according to the current working condition, the neural network corresponding to the working condition matching is selected, and the prediction of the water level after the upstream reservoir is loaded on the dam and the water level before the counter-regulation reservoir dam is realized; and on the basis of forecasting the water level behind the upper reservoir dam and the water level in front of the reverse regulation reservoir dam, performing optimal control trial calculation on the water level between the cascade reservoirs by taking the flow of the upper reservoir dam as a variable, and realizing the maximum total output of the cascade. The cascade hydropower station cascade power generation control method fully utilizes the historical operation data of the cascade hydropower station, solves the complex problem of water level control between the reverse regulation reservoir and the upper reservoir dam, and can provide a solution for optimizing and controlling the water level between the dams to provide cascade power generation benefits.

title_en: Method for identifying abnormal data of power system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for identifying abnormal data of an electric power system, which comprises the steps of taking normal data of the electric power system as a training sample, and training a neural network; inputting data to be detected into the trained neural network to obtain a residual sequence; clustering residual training based on an affine propagation clustering algorithm; and judging abnormal data according to the characteristics of each category and the intra-category distance. The invention utilizes the chaotic particle swarm algorithm to train the neural network, and simultaneously adopts the affine propagation clustering algorithm to realize data clustering, thereby obviously reducing the calculated amount, simultaneously not depending on sampling distribution, and effectively improving the accuracy of identifying abnormal data of the power system.

title_en: Power distribution network blocking scheduling method
abstract_en: The application discloses a power distribution network blocking scheduling method, which is applied to a central controller of a multi-energy system and comprises the steps of obtaining system information, load requirements and energy market information of the multi-energy system; performing target optimization according to system information, load demand and energy market information under constraint conditions to determine equipment output and interactive power information of the multi-energy system, and reporting the interactive power information to a power distribution network dispatching center; and receiving safety constraint information sent by the distribution network dispatching center when the distribution network is blocked and judging the existence of the interactive power information and the node information of each node under the distribution network, and performing target optimization according to the safety constraint information to obtain the corresponding equipment output. The method can effectively solve the problem of reverse blocking of the power distribution network while realizing cascade utilization of energy. The application also discloses a power distribution network congestion scheduling method applied to the power distribution network scheduling center, a central controller and the power distribution network scheduling center, and the power distribution network congestion scheduling method, the central controller and the power distribution network scheduling center have the technical effects.

title_en: Non-invasive load decomposition method based on cascade width learning and sparrow algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-invasive load decomposition method based on cascade width learning and sparrow algorithm. The method uses a light-weight width learning algorithm, solves the technical problems of complex structure, extremely time-consuming training and high requirement on computing resources of a non-invasive load decomposition network based on deep learning, and can obtain the running state and detailed power information of target equipment at the same time. In addition, the cascade width learning load decomposition network is constructed by improving the connection mode of the width learning characteristic nodes, and network parameters are optimized by using a sparrow search algorithm, so that the load decomposition precision is improved. Compared with the traditional non-invasive load decomposition method based on deep learning, the method of the invention greatly reduces training time while guaranteeing decomposition precision, has simple network structure, is convenient for being integrated with embedded equipment for use, and provides algorithm support for popularization of non-invasive load decomposition.

title_en: Geological disaster knowledge graph construction method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of knowledge graph construction, in particular to a geological disaster knowledge graph construction method and system based on artificial intelligence; the method comprises the steps of extracting a geological semantic triplet set by using a semantic physical collaborative type preprocessing method to construct a three-layer semantic ontology graph, generating a space section structure chain and a time sequence state chain by using a double-chain type space-time graph construction method to construct a double-chain coupling graph structure, carrying out node state propagation calculation by using a disturbance perception graph neural network mechanism to obtain a risk state prediction result of a landslide structure unit layer under each time node, generating a landslide risk propagation path chain by using a reverse causal path chain reconstruction method, and migrating propagation parameters and response rules in a historical landslide graph structure into the double-chain coupling graph structure to construct a double-chain coupling space-time geological disaster knowledge graph. According to the invention, landslide state prediction and causal path reasoning are realized through the double-chain diagram structure and the disturbance perception diagram neural network.

title_en: Method for online prediction of quiescent voltage stability limit of electric system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for online prediction of the quiescent voltage stability limit of an electric system. The method is composed of a sample dimension reduction method based on a Lasso method, a sample selection method based on a self-organizing feature map, and an error back propagation type neural network. According to the method, a large number of random training samples generated by the electric system in an offline simulation mode are preprocessed through the self-organizing feature map and the Lasso method, the Lasso method is used for reducing the number of dimensions of input variables, the self-organizing feature map is used for reducing the number of the training samples, and then offline training and online prediction are carried out on the quiescent voltage stability limit of the electric system by means of the error back propagation type neural network. The method can effectively improve offline training efficiency and the online prediction effect of the error back propagation type neural network.

title_en: Method and system for evaluating energy utilization flexibility of comprehensive energy system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for evaluating the energy utilization flexibility of an integrated energy system. The method comprises the following steps: step S1, establishing a comprehensive energy system mapping model based on the physical characteristics of the energy equipment and the energy network topological structure; step S2, establishing uncertainty test sets of supply and demand ends according to historical operation data of the comprehensive energy system and historical load data in a supply area, and generating energy demand and energy supply pairs of demand ends under all the test sets; step S3, respectively calculating the flexibility of different energy flows according to the generated energy demand and energy supply pairs; and step S4, determining the overall energy utilization flexibility of the comprehensive energy system based on the fuzzy analytic hierarchy process. The invention can provide guidance for the cascade utilization of energy and the optimization of operation scheduling of the comprehensive energy system, enhance the interaction of the supply and demand ends and reduce the adverse effect caused by the uncertainty of the system.

title_en: Method for evaluating and improving vulnerability of electricity-gas comprehensive energy system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating and improving the vulnerability of an electricity-gas integrated energy system. Establishing a network topological structure of the electricity-gas comprehensive energy system; simulating the initial fault of the system by using a Monte Carlo algorithm according to a given initial fault proportion to obtain the initial running state of the system; establishing a fault propagation model of the electric-gas integrated energy system to obtain a fault propagation seepage equation; continuously iterating the seepage equation according to the fault propagation termination condition until the fault propagation termination condition is met to obtain the final running state of the system; and establishing vulnerability parameters of the electric-gas integrated energy system, calculating to obtain the vulnerability result of the electric-gas integrated energy system, and implementing improvement. The method can quickly evaluate and obtain the vulnerability result of the electric-gas integrated energy system, find the weak link of the electric-gas integrated energy system, and inhibit the propagation of the fault in the system by taking measures, thereby effectively improving the vulnerability of the electric-gas integrated energy system and reducing the probability of large-area breakdown of the system.

title_en: Intelligent auxiliary maintenance flow analysis method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent auxiliary maintenance flow analysis method and system, comprising the following steps: analyzing the influence factors of the maintenance, taking the analysis service communication channel as a main line, completing multiple analysis, and analyzing each link one by one to obtain the influence range in the maintenance; analyzing the current running state of the maintenance influence service one by one according to the fault influence service analyzed before maintenance and by combining the real-time alarm of the current network manager, and determining whether the maintenance is started or ended; and analyzing the collected warning information generated by maintenance based on the completed maintenance project, comparing the project plan to judge the execution condition of the project, automatically producing a warning comparison report to obtain a work operation quality report, and completing maintenance flow analysis. The invention assists the maintenance decision-making personnel to quickly and comprehensively determine the influence range of maintenance, and provides data support for maintenance decision-making; the maintenance implementing personnel are assisted to know the real-time situation, and unplanned service interruption is avoided; and carrying out post analysis on the quality of the maintenance engineering.
assignees: GUANGDONG ELECTRIC POWER COMMUNICATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Risk target identification method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data analysis, and provides a risk target identification method, a risk target identification device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The risk target identification method comprises the following steps: obtaining abnormal behavior data from preset behavior data, wherein each piece of abnormal behavior data carries a data identifier, and a part of data identifiers carry risk labels; constructing a relational graph by taking each data identifier as a vertex based on the abnormal behavior data; screening out relation subgraphs with risk labels from the relation graphs, and carrying out label propagation on each relation subgraph based on the risk label of each relation subgraph; and calculating a risk value of each relationship subgraph after the label is propagated, and identifying the data identification of the relationship subgraph with the risk value higher than a threshold value as a risk target. According to the method, the hidden risk relation network can be quickly and effectively identified from the mass preset behavior data through graph calculation and big data analysis, and the wind control interception capability is improved.
assignees: CTRIP TRAVEL INFORMATION TECH SHANGHAI CO LTD

title_en: Urban road network capacity reliability evaluation method considering cognitive uncertainty
abstract_en: The invention provides an urban road network capacity reliability evaluation method considering cognitive uncertainty, which comprises the steps of constructing an urban road network into a undirected network, and selecting road real-time capacity as a performance parameter of a road; determining the random distribution of the road capacity and the uncertain distribution of the threshold value of the road capacity; calculating the balanced congestion index of the urban road network under any time step based on the capacity of all edges in the road network, the capacity threshold of the nodes and the load characteristic of each node, thereby constructing a fault propagation model; and constructing an uncertain measure when the balanced congestion index of the road network is smaller than the threshold value of the balanced congestion index of the road network based on the fault propagation model, completing the modeling of the urban road network capacity confidence reliability model, and calculating the road network confidence reliability under any time step. The method is based on the reliability-confident theory, aims at evaluating the reliability of the capacity confident of the road and the road network, and is used for better guiding the design, planning, management, control and emergency treatment of the urban road network.

title_en: Photovoltaic panel fault identification method based on cascade region convolutional neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a photovoltaic panel fault identification method based on a cascade area convolutional neural network, which is used for collecting images of photovoltaic panels of a photovoltaic engineering village level and a household level distributed power station; classifying the collected images, and carrying out fault and defect label processing on various images; the images of the photovoltaic panels are in one-to-one correspondence with fault and defect labels, and are divided into a training set and a verification set; taking images of village-level and user-level distributed power station photovoltaic panels as input of a cascade area convolution neural network, and taking corresponding fault and defect labels as output of the cascade area convolution neural network to obtain a trained cascade area convolution neural network model; checking whether the trained cascade region convolutional neural network model meets the requirements or not through a verification set; the defect fault identification is carried out on the data image acquired in real time through the trained cascade region convolution neural network model, the photovoltaic panel image can be automatically identified, the fault type of the photovoltaic panel can be judged, and the fault region can be marked.
assignees: LIAOYANG POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Three-dimensional model quantitative retrieval method and system for multi-mode underwater image
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional model quantitative retrieval method and a system for multi-mode underwater images, comprising the steps of collecting the underwater images, inputting a graph attention network model and outputting a three-dimensional model retrieval result; the figure attention network model comprises a two-dimensional image data set and a three-dimensional model library for constructing an underwater image; establishing an image feature extraction network and a model feature extraction network to obtain feature vectors of a two-dimensional image and a three-dimensional model, mapping the feature vectors into the same high-dimensional space, establishing an adjacency matrix and establishing a graph structure; obtaining a feature vector after graph embedding by using a self-attention mechanism and a graph annotation force network, and updating model parameters through back propagation of a loss function; obtaining a three-dimensional model retrieval result by the underwater image to be tested through the trained graph annotation force network; the invention can realize three-dimensional model retrieval on the underwater optical image or sonar image and the shielding image with partial effective characteristics of the underwater image, and is beneficial to the application of the three-dimensional model quantitative retrieval in the fields of submarine environment detection and underwater search and rescue.

title_en: Method and device for solving failure of ventilation network air quantity and air quality under condition of external fire
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for resolving failure of air quantity and air quality of a ventilation network under the condition of external fire, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an unsteady state ventilation network settlement mathematical model, a flue gas dispersion-diffusion unsteady state mathematical model, a heat exchange propagation unsteady state mathematical model and an oxygen consumption-migration unsteady state mathematical model; and combining a thermal diffusion coefficient and a flue gas diffusion coefficient calculation model, coupling an unsteady state ventilation network calculation mathematical model, a flue gas diffusion-diffusion unsteady state mathematical model, a heat exchange propagation unsteady state mathematical model and an oxygen consumption-migration unsteady state mathematical model, constructing a multi-field coupling network calculation mathematical model and a calculation method of air quantity-air temperature-oxygen concentration-flue gas concentration in the ventilation network in a fire period, and forming a wind network air quantity and wind quality failure calculation model and a calculation method in the fire period. The method can realize quantitative prediction of the failure result of the wind quality of the wind network system in the fire period, and perfect the intelligent ventilation and disaster emergency wind control theory and technology of the mine.
assignees: MEIKE TONGAN BEIJING INTELLIGENT CONTROL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Adaptive power distribution network power flow analysis method and device based on enhanced ELM model
abstract_en: The method builds an enhanced ELM model on the basis of an extreme learning machine, and builds a new hidden layer for the enhanced ELM model at each stage so as to expand the neural network structure of the extreme learning machine; the method comprises the steps that through modification of a loss function of a power distribution network power flow model, in a counter-propagation stage of neural network structure training of a multi-layer extreme learning machine, step length and gradient update in a neural network parameter optimization process of the multi-layer extreme learning machine are guided by the power distribution network power flow model, and network parameters of an adaptive power distribution system are obtained; and (3) under an evolution scene, self-adapting the neural network parameters of the multi-layer extreme learning machine by using an incremental learning mode, and characterizing the random variable distribution change of the power distribution system by using the self-adapting neural network parameters of the multi-layer extreme learning machine. The invention can improve the nonlinear fitting capability of the original neural network, effectively update network parameters and improve the self-adaptability of model parameters.

title_en: Method for evaluating importance degree of coupling network node of supply dependent system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating importance of a coupling network node of a supply-dependent system, which can characterize failure risk of the node, guide dynamic risk control of the supply-dependent system and can be used as a key decision basis of the supply-dependent system for coping with cascade failure. The method comprises the following specific steps: constructing a double-layer supply dependent system coupling network model, and establishing a multiple supply-dependent coupling relation between coupling network layers; in the cascade failure process of the coupling network model of the supply dependent system, designing a node importance index for representing the node failure risk, namely node pressure; calculating the pressure, degree centrality, medium centrality, approximate centrality and H index of nodes in the network according to the state parameters of the network; and (3) using node pressure, degree centrality, medium centrality, near centrality and H index to give an importance assessment of the nodes of the coupling network of the supply dependent system.

title_en: Day runoff prediction method based on multi-feature fusion and two-dimensional time convolution network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a day runoff prediction method based on multi-feature fusion and a two-dimensional time convolution network, which comprises the following steps: performing feature mining and feature fusion on hydrologic and meteorological multisource data of a target river basin, and constructing a multisource fusion feature matrix as input of a space-time feature extraction stage; extracting space-time characteristics of the multisource fusion characteristics; and constructing an overall network framework model, determining training parameters of the network, and training and predicting. The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows: adopting a double-layer routing attention mechanism to perform feature fusion on the internal mode features and the screening features, and focusing key information in the multi-source features; introducing residual connection to enhance information flow and gradient propagation, relieving gradient vanishing problem in deep network, and preserving original characteristic information while extracting key detail characteristics; the fused multi-source signature sequence is considered as a two-dimensional signature for dilation convolution, rather than as a one-dimensional sequence of multiple channels, to enhance the ability of the network to capture fine-granularity information.

title_en: Generated power prediction method, storage medium, electronic device, and program product
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a power generation prediction method, a storage medium, electronic equipment and a program product, and relates to the field of power generation control. The method comprises the steps of obtaining meteorological data of a photovoltaic station, inputting the meteorological data into a trained power generation prediction model to obtain power generation output by the power generation prediction model, wherein the power generation prediction model is of a back propagation neural network structure, a characteristic attention mechanism layer and a regularization mechanism layer are embedded in a hidden layer of the power generation prediction model, the weight attention mechanism layer is used for increasing input characteristic weight of a prediction result output by the power generation prediction model, and the regularization mechanism layer is used for preventing the power generation prediction model from being subjected to over fitting.

title_en: Equipment asset management and control method, system and medium based on cyclic neural network
abstract_en: The application discloses a device asset management and control method, a device asset management and control system and a device asset management and control medium based on a cyclic neural network, which mainly relate to the technical field of device asset management and control and are used for solving the problems that the existing scheme lacks the capability of dynamic adjustment according to the actual requirements of devices, mainly focuses on management and control of single devices and neglects the systematicness and the integrity of asset management. The method comprises the steps of scaling initial sample data to the same preset numerical range to obtain training sample data, adding influence factors among equipment assets as marking data to the training sample data, completing training of a circulating neural network by using the training sample data, optimizing the trained circulating neural network through back propagation to obtain a final circulating neural network, obtaining actual operation data of current equipment assets, inputting the actual operation data into the final circulating neural network to obtain output management and control data and influence factors on other equipment assets after processing according to the management and control data.

title_en: Smart power grid load prediction system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power load prediction, in particular to a smart grid load prediction system and a smart grid load prediction method. According to the method, the load change rate is extracted, the load increment and the load flow proportion are calculated, the load dynamic coupling relation is described, the voltage phase angle deviation is calculated by combining the power grid topology, the connectivity of a load prediction area is enhanced, the response capacity of a model to sudden fluctuation is improved based on the forward load propagation delay adjustment parameter, the load slope is analyzed by combining weather data, the temperature and humidity sensitive interval is set, the extreme weather adaptability is enhanced, the input parameter is optimized by utilizing the load coupling correction value, the data distortion is reduced, the long-term prediction stability is improved, the load dynamic adjustment, the weather influence modeling and the input optimization precision are improved, and the accurate support is provided for power grid dispatching.
assignees: SHENZHEN KAISHENG UNITED TECH CO LTD

title_en: Electric power knowledge graph multi-tenant cluster management system based on cloud primordia
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of tenant management, and provides a cloud-protogenesis-based power knowledge graph multi-tenant cluster management system which comprises a multi-tenant cluster, a cloud protogenesis platform and a central dispatching center, wherein the multi-tenant cluster manages power grid data and distributed computing resources of tenants through a data access unit and a tenant management unit, the cloud protogenesis platform generates a power knowledge graph through a knowledge modeling unit and a data extraction unit, and the central dispatching center determines a fault propagation path and key equipment through a knowledge fusion unit, an inference computing unit and a service interface unit, generates a fault diagnosis result, feeds back the fault diagnosis result to the tenant management unit and triggers tenant alarms or operation and maintenance instructions. According to the invention, through the cooperative work of the multi-tenant cluster, the cloud primary platform and the central dispatching center, the accuracy and the efficiency of fault diagnosis of the substation equipment are effectively improved.

title_en: Mine ecological risk prediction method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention provides a mine ecological risk prediction method and system based on artificial intelligence, which are characterized in that multisource ecological monitoring data are collected through a distributed sensor network deployed in a mine area, a space-time alignment treatment is carried out to generate a space-time correlation feature set, a pre-trained ecological risk prediction model is called to predict features to generate a risk conduction mode set comprising a risk propagation path, a starting node, a propagation direction and strength, an ecological risk evolution network is constructed based on the risk conduction mode set, the topological structure and time sequence dependency relationship of risk nodes are displayed, a risk early warning instruction set comprising a risk classification result and an ecological restoration strategy is generated according to the ecological risk evolution network and is sent to an ecological management platform, so that mine ecological risks can be comprehensively and accurately predicted, effective risk early warning and ecological restoration strategies are provided, and mine ecological safety is guaranteed.
assignees: SICHUAN INST OF NUCLEAR GEOLOGICAL SURVEY

title_en: Source-charge collaborative carbon reduction method and system considering social association of users
abstract_en: The invention discloses a source-load collaborative carbon reduction method and system considering user social association, which comprises the steps of firstly building a source-load collaborative carbon reduction model, taking wind-solar uncertainty and a carbon transaction mechanism into consideration by a source side, and taking carbon emission responsibility into consideration by the load side, and visually apportioning and responding to low-carbon requirements, combining a same group effect principle and a demand response context in social psychology in the low-carbon demand response of the load side, providing a load side same group influence propagation model to quantify the user social association, taking same group influence as one of influence factors of user behavior decisions, and building a user response model considering the social association by using a linear regression method. Finally, online learning of user response model parameters by using maximum likelihood estimation technology is proposed to cope with randomness of user response behavior. The method is beneficial to improving the source-load synergistic carbon reduction efficiency by utilizing a social network, realizes effective reduction of the carbon emission of the two sides, and has good application effect.

title_en: Geological disaster monitoring and early warning system based on rock-soil body microseism sensing network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster monitoring and early warning system based on a rock-soil body microseism sensing network, in particular relates to the technical field of geological disaster early warning, and is used for solving the problems of insufficient positioning accuracy and poor early warning reliability caused by neglecting formation heterogeneity in the existing seismic source positioning method; the method comprises the steps of obtaining geological exploration data of a monitoring area, constructing a three-dimensional heterogeneous stratum model containing cracks and faults, simulating a distortion propagation path of micro-seismic waves in an anisotropic medium, generating a waveform feature library, extracting time-frequency domain energy distribution of actual signals, matching the time-frequency domain energy distribution with the feature library, dynamically correcting equivalent wave velocity field parameters, combining sensor coordinates and a corrected wave velocity field to calculate a propagation time difference matrix, constructing a nonlinear equation set taking wave velocity deviation as constraint, solving seismic source space coordinates, finally generating dynamic early warning signals based on the distribution relation of the seismic sources and the stratum model, and remarkably improving seismic source positioning precision and early warning accuracy in a complex rock environment.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES;XINJIANG GEZHOUBA DASHIXIA WATER CONSERVANCY PROJECT DEV CO LTD;XINJIANG XINHUA YEERQIANG RIVER BASIN WATER RESOURCES AND HYDROPOWER DEV CO LTD;XINJIANG UYGUR AUTONOMOUS REGION TARIM RIVER BASIN CHEERCHEN RIVER WATER CONSERVANCY MAN CENTER

title_en: Underground pipe network defect intelligent identification and early warning method and system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention provides an underground pipe network defect intelligent identification and early warning method and system based on deep learning, which relate to the technical field of pipe network detection and comprise the steps of acquiring multi-source data by adopting a pipeline detection robot and preprocessing; the method comprises the steps of mapping features to manifold space, constructing a similarity matrix, carrying out geometric difference weighted fusion, constructing an associated matrix, calculating space distance and mechanical strength, carrying out iterative propagation to generate a defect feature map, acquiring an evolution sequence by adopting a self-adaptive sliding window, determining influence factors based on inverse fact intervention, calculating state transition probability and determining an optimal maintenance scheme. The invention improves the accuracy of pipe network defect identification and realizes the intellectualization of pipeline state prediction and maintenance decision.
assignees: NINGBO MUNICIPAL ENG CONSTRUCTION GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Method for inhibiting cascading failure of power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for inhibiting cascading failures of a power system, which comprises the steps of formulating a first strategy and a second strategy by judging the scale of the cascading failures, wherein the first strategy is a reinforcement learning algorithm based on a feature separation technology and a PPO (point-to-point) improvement algorithm, and the second strategy is combined with the first strategy based on imitation learning. The invention can obviously improve the dispatching efficiency for solving the cascading failure of the power system, can provide intelligent auxiliary decision for a power grid dispatching center and improves the emergency response capability of large-scale power grid faults.

title_en: Disaster broadcasting wireless relay system that compensates for synchronization signals and improves broadcasting quality of radio shaded areas
title_ko: 동기신호를 보상하고 전파음영지역의 방송품질을 개선한 재난방송 무선중계시스템
abstract_en: The present invention provides a disaster broadcasting wireless relay system that compensates for a synchronization signal in a wireless section where data loss may occur and improves broadcasting quality in a radio shadow area so as to improve the reliability of disaster broadcasting. The disaster broadcasting wireless relay system that compensates for a synchronization signal and improves broadcasting quality in a radio shadow area comprises: a disaster broadcasting receiving device having an FPGA module for noise reduction to reduce noise caused by the surrounding environment when receiving a disaster broadcasting RF signal, and converting a digital demodulated signal from which the noise has been removed into Internet packet data and outputting the same; a main relay device that receives the Internet packet data output from the disaster broadcasting receiving device through a wired network and outputs the same as a short-range wireless signal; a sub-relay device that receives the short-range wireless signal output from the main relay device, modulates the same into a synchronized disaster broadcasting RF signal, and outputs the same; and a user terminal having a disaster broadcasting reception communication module for receiving the disaster broadcasting RF signal output through the sub-relay device.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 동기신호를 보상하여 불확실성을 갖는 무선구간의 신뢰성을 향상시키고 전파음영지역에 용이하게 재난방송을 전달할 수 있도록 하는 동기신호를 보상하고 전파음영지역의 방송품질을 개선한 재난방송 무선중계시스템에 관한 것으로, 전파음영지역의 건물내부에 설치되며 재난방송용 RF신호를 수신하는 경우에 주변환경으로 인한 노이즈를 저감시키기 위한 노이즈 저감용 FPGA모듈을 구비하여 노이즈가 제거된 디지털 복조신호를 인터넷 패킷 데이터로 변환하여 출력하는 재난방송 수신장치, 상기 건물내부를 구성하는 층별로 설치되고 상기 재난방송 수신장치에서 출력되는 인터넷 패킷데이터를 유선망으로 수신하여 근거리 무선신호로 출력하는 메인중계장치, 상기 메인중계장치가 설치된 층에 적어도 하나 이상 설치되며 상기 메인중계장치에서 출력되는 근거리무선신호를 수신하여 동기화된 재난방송용 RF신호로 변조하여 출력하는 서브중계장치, 및 상기 서브중계장치를 통해 출력되는 재난방송용 RF신호를 수신하기 위한 재난방송수신용 통신모듈을 구비하는 사용자 단말기;를 구비한다.

title_en: Method and apparatus of using drive test data for propagation model calibration
abstract_en: A method using drive test data for propagation model calibration includes: step  1 , obtaining original drive test data; step  2 , selecting the data from the drive test data according to predefined conditions as effective drive test data; and step  3 , extracting the effective drive test data to form a data file used for propagation model calibration. An apparatus using drive test data for propagation model calibration includes: a drive test data obtaining module, configured to obtain the drive test data in the regions to be calibrated; an effective drive test data generation module, configured to generate effective drive test data from the drive test data according to predefined conditions; and a data file generation module, configured to extract the effective drive test data to form a data file used for propagation model calibration. The present invention utilizes drive test data of existing networks to largely decrease the CW test work and reduce the network building cost. It is believed that the calibrated model can relatively accurately reflect the propagation characteristics in the field. Furthermore, base stations can be optimally allocated.

title_en: A kind of modularization energy-storage system evolution analysis method based on Complex Networks Theory
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of modularization energy-storage system evolution analysis method based on Complex Networks Theory, object in modularization energy-storage system is abstracted as the node in modularization energy-storage system network model, interaction in modularization energy-storage system between object is abstracted as the company side between network node, using two subnetwork model building module energy-storage system network models, the physical significance of modularization energy-storage system network model is clear, is easy to engineering staff's operation and realizes；For under conditions of total monomer battery node quantity is constant, modularization energy-storage system has voltage responsive ability (cascaded structure), two kinds of current-responsive ability (parallel-connection structure) basic evolution modes, define Evolution Evaluation index, it can effectively find evolution of system structure rule, the reason of influencing modularization energy-storage system structure evolution and key factor are disclosed, targetedly to propose that modularization energy-storage system optimization design provides scientific basis.

title_en: Short-term load prediction method of multi-model fusion neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a short-term load prediction method of a multi-model fusion neural network, which comprises the following steps: data acquisition and preprocessing are carried out to obtain a data set; segmenting a data set into a training set and a verification set; independently constructing various models based on a back propagation algorithm, and training the models by using an input vector sequence of a training set; training a top-level DNN model using the outputs of the plurality of individual models as inputs; fusing the independently trained model and the top DNN model for fine tuning; verifying the trained model by using a verification set, adjusting model parameters by comparing the precision and the error of the test set and the verification set, and selecting the model with the best performance of the verification set as a training result by training for multiple times; and (4) running the model in the actual environment, and adding the latest data into the training set to train the model again when the predicted value and the actual value have larger deviation. The invention adopts the modes of independent training and combined tuning, reduces the deployment complexity, has better precision than a single model, and has good practical value.

title_en: Method and device for repairing missing power load data based on cascade convolution self-encoder
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for repairing missing power load data based on a cascade convolution self-encoder. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring original power load data without loss, establishing a loss mask generation model, simulating and generating a grading sub-mask, and generating simulated incomplete data by combining the original power load data; preprocessing the original power load data, the simulated incomplete data and the graded sub-masks to serve as a training set, establishing a cascade convolution self-encoder network, and training the cascade convolution self-encoder network; and after the incomplete power load data to be repaired and the corresponding grading sub-masks are preprocessed, inputting the data into the trained cascade convolution self-encoder network to obtain the repaired power load data. The method disclosed by the invention can be used for repairing the incomplete power load data, and higher repairing precision is realized.

title_en: Visual analysis method and system for simulation verification of safety event of power system
abstract_en: The invention provides a visual analysis method and a visual analysis system for simulation verification of a safety event of an electric power system, and provides a multi-level and omnibearing visual scheme from data, a model and knowledge aiming at the visual presentation problem of multidimensional heterogeneous information under a safety event simulation verification scene of an electric power industrial control system. Based on the visual view of the basic data and priori knowledge of analysts, a network domain model and a physical domain model are constructed, so that the internal rule and logic relation in the information can be deeply explored; the obtained knowledge is extracted and generalized from two perspectives of attack and defense, abstract knowledge is quantized, and knowledge propagation understanding is facilitated. Through visual display of the original information, the process information and the analysis result information, the operation situation in the simulation verification process of the safety event is comprehensively perceived, and the safety analysis capability and the efficiency of decision-making and disposal of the problems are improved.

title_en: Multi-disaster power distribution network elasticity assessment method considering fault linkage
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-disaster power distribution network elasticity evaluation method considering fault cascading, which comprises the following steps: step S1, modeling various disaster feature failure rates; step S2, based on sequential Monte Carlo simulation, the time sequence characteristics of the element in the disaster process are reserved, and an element running state model formed by a basic range fault rate and a characteristic fault rate is established; s3, analyzing the nonlinear association degree of the trend state characterization quantity sequences of the lines and the nodes in the N-1 scene set and the N-2 scene set through the gray theory, and establishing a coupling relation between fault scenes; s4, establishing a LLD index, an SEDT index and an economic index which comprehensively consider the load loss degree and the maximum frequency change rate of the active unbalance initial moment to form a weighted elasticity-economic space evaluation system, and carrying out elasticity evaluation by measuring the composite entropy weight Euclidean distance between the scene cluster center and the perfect elasticity point; the fault linkage in the disaster process can be prevented and inhibited, and the elasticity of the power transmission network in extreme weather is improved.

title_en: Emergency communication sensing equipment system efficiency evaluation method based on neural network
abstract_en: The invention provides an emergency communication perception equipment system efficiency evaluation method based on a neural network, and belongs to the technical field of efficiency evaluation. In order to reflect the actual combat effectiveness of the emergency communication perception equipment system more reliably, the neural network-based emergency communication perception equipment system effectiveness evaluation method is provided. According to the method, after the entropy value of each efficiency evaluation index is calculated, the efficiency evaluation index with a larger entropy value is selected, so that the efficiency evaluation index is screened, and the dimension of the efficiency evaluation index is further reduced by combining a principal component analysis method. And finally, setting weight parameters by adopting a back propagation algorithm, and constructing a BP neural network efficiency evaluation model. The method has the advantages of high judging accuracy, high timeliness and small calculated amount, and can also effectively avoid blindness, subjectivity and prejudice when the weight parameters are manually set.

title_en: IES-CPS system information-physical combination expected fault generation method, device, storage medium and computing equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an IES-CPS system information-physical combination expected fault generating method, a device, a storage medium and a computing device, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing an IES-CPS information expected fault set and a physical expected fault set; setting a physical expected fault and determining an information fault propagation mode by combining the current system operation mode; according to the determined information fault propagation mode, the operation control strategy and the network layered coupling model under the current fault are used for searching an information transmission path; an information expected failure is set in an information transmission path, and the set physical expected failure constitutes an information-physical combination expected failure. The invention comprehensively considers the multi-network layered coupling relation of the sub-energy system in the analysis IES-CPS system to generate the information-physical combination expected faults, analyzes the safety of the IES-CPS when the combination faults occur, and can obtain the severity of the faults through the safety analysis result so as to screen out key nodes or serious faults.

title_en: Hurricane path prediction method and system based on cyclic neural network
abstract_en: The invention provides a hurricane path prediction method and a hurricane path prediction system based on a cyclic neural network, which comprise the steps of carrying out gridding treatment on a defined hurricane path area, calculating the moving distance and the moving angle of each coordinate point to be used as data enhancement, using a three-layer long-short-period memory network as a trunk cyclic neural network of a prediction model, carrying a Dropout layer with a proportion coefficient of 0.1 on the trunk network for the long-short-period memory model, using a full-connection layer activated by a hyperbolic tangent function as an output layer, using a momentum-based gradient descent algorithm RMSProp for model training, and using a grid ID prediction layer and coordinate correction two parts as the output layer of the prediction model to form final hurricane coordinate prediction. In the prediction stage, the forward propagation of the model is only relied on based on the cyclic neural network reasoning prediction, and the correlation search is not needed to be carried out on a historical database, so that the performance of hurricane path prediction is greatly improved.

title_en: Double-layer collaborative optimization method for expressway fixed and mobile charging facilities
abstract_en: The invention discloses a double-layer collaborative optimization method for a highway fixed and mobile charging facility, which comprises the following steps: constructing an optimization model framework, the optimization model framework comprising: an upper layer collaborative site selection optimization model and a lower layer collaborative capacity optimization model; the upper layer cooperates with the site selection optimization model to optimize the position of the charging station and determine the position and time of the charging demand of the deployment TMC; the lower cooperative capacity optimization model optimizes the capacities of TMC and FC of candidate sites, and improves the utilization rate of FC; and carrying out equivalent linearization treatment on the nonlinear problem by adopting a large M method, converting the equivalent linearization treatment into a mixed integer linear programming model, and adopting target cascade analysis to realize the data exchange process between the upper layer and the lower layer. The invention improves the utilization rate of the expressway charging facility, enhances the flexibility of the charging facility, can effectively acquire the space-time distribution of the charging demands of TMC and FC, completes the collaborative optimization of the charging facility, and provides new choices for charging station operators and electric automobile users.

title_en: Elasticity evaluation method for AC/DC series-parallel power information physical system under cooperative attack
abstract_en: The invention discloses an elasticity evaluation method of an alternating current-direct current hybrid power information physical system under a collaborative attack, which is used for constructing a multidimensional heterogeneous model of the alternating current-direct current hybrid power information physical system according to an actual information network framework and completing matrixing modeling of the alternating current-direct current hybrid power information physical system based on a method of an incidence matrix. And then, based on a matrixing modeling method, information physical cooperative attack is constructed, so that diversified cooperative attack can be carried out on the multidimensional heterogeneous model, and cascade fault diffusion is caused. Finally, a new elastic index, namely a cascading failure recovery index CFRI, is provided, wherein the index considers the factors such as the node number, branch number and load quantity of the system during the cascade failure diffusion so as to evaluate the disconnection capability and recovery capability of the AC/DC series-parallel power information physical system in the face of the cascade failure. The method can effectively complete the elasticity evaluation of the AC/DC series-parallel power information physical system under the cooperative attack, and reduce the influence of an attacker on the power grid to the greatest extent.

title_en: Airport apron operation risk assessment method based on complex network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an airport apron operation risk assessment method based on a complex network, and belongs to the technical field of risk control. The method comprises the steps of analyzing an apron safety report by adopting an event chain analysis method to construct a complex network, determining a risk static index of each node, simulating a dynamic propagation process of risks in the complex network based on a SIRS model, determining the risk dynamic index of each node, classifying the nodes by adopting a spectral clustering algorithm with the dynamic and static indexes of each node as characteristics, respectively calculating an average risk comprehensive value of each cluster node and determining a risk grade of each cluster node based on a quantile, acquiring a risk event of an airport apron at a certain moment, determining the risk comprehensive value and the risk grade of each risk event, and carrying out hierarchical classification management on the risk comprehensive value and the risk grade. The invention constructs a multidimensional risk assessment index system to assess the risk transmission capacity and blocking capacity of the nodes, realizes the classification and grading of the risk nodes, and can provide scientific decision support for airport managers.

title_en: Integrated management system for industrial gas supply facility
title_ko: 산업용 가스공급 설비 통합 관리 시스템
abstract_ko:
본 발명은, 가스 누출을 감지하는 복수 개의 가스 감지 모듈, 화재를 감지하는 복수 개의 화재 감지 모듈, 지진을 감지하는 지진 감지 모듈, 감시 대상 영역을 촬영하는 복수 개의 영상 촬영 모듈을 포함하고, 감시 대상 영역에 설치되어 가스 누출, 화재 및 지진 발생에 관련한 이벤트 정보를 수집하고, 수집한 이벤트 정보를 통신망을 통해 전송하는 정보 수집부; 통신망을 통해 상기 정보 수집부에서 전송한 이벤트 정보를 수신하여 가스 누출, 화재 및 지진 발생 여부를 평가하고, 가스 누출, 화재 또는 지진이 발생한 것으로 평가한 경우 이벤트 정보 및 이벤트 대응 방법을 포함하는 알림 정보를 생성하여 전송하는 관리 서버부; 및 관리 서버부에서 생성한 알림 정보를 수신받는 개별 단말부;를 포함하는 산업용 가스공급 설비 통합 관리 시스템을 제공한다. 
본 발명에 따른 산업용 가스공급 설비 통합 관리 시스템은 감시 대상 영역에서 누출되는 다양한 종류의 가스를 단시간에 검출 및 판별할 수 있고, 화재 및 지진 발생 여부를 판별할 수 있어 산업용 가스공급 시설을 안전하게 관리할 수 있고, 가스 누출, 화재, 지진을 포함하는 이벤트를 통신망을 통해 신속히 전파하도록 하여 인명 및 재산 피해를 최소화할 수 있다.

title_en: Short-term power prediction method for renewable energy
abstract_en: The invention provides a short-term power prediction method of renewable energy, which comprises the steps of acquiring prediction sample data, determining a neural network prediction model structure and corresponding parameters, constructing a neural network prediction model, optimizing the weight and the threshold of the neural network prediction model through a particle swarm algorithm, inputting the prediction sample data, calculating the error of an output result of the neural network prediction model, comparing the error with an error requirement, and if the error of the output result does not meet the error requirement, adjusting the parameters of the neural network prediction model according to the back propagation of an effective error until the error of the output result meets the error requirement; and if the error of the output result meets the error requirement, the neural network prediction model outputs a short-term power prediction value. According to the invention, the weight and the threshold of the neural network prediction model are optimized through the particle swarm optimization, so that the influence of the instability of training data on the prediction result of the neural network prediction model is reduced, and the prediction precision of short-term power is improved.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD SHUANGCHUANG CENTER;SHAOXING POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;SHENGZHOU POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Knowledge graph construction method for solid rocket engine test
abstract_en: The invention provides a knowledge graph construction method for a solid rocket engine test, which aims to solve the problems that the traditional flat storage type solid rocket engine test related data based on a relational database cannot be effectively mined, analyzed, fully utilized and the like. The steps are as follows: s1: building a neural network infrastructure by extracting test data information; s2: the test data information extraction neural network propagates forward; s3: the test data information extracts neural network errors to be back propagated; s4: the test data information extracts the neural network weight and bias update. Compared with the existing flat storage form based on the relational database, the knowledge graph construction technology in the field of solid rocket engine test can achieve the degree of autonomous data management, and the unstructured data and the semi-structured data are subjected to structure visualization processing, so that the direct association mining analysis capability of the data is greatly enhanced, and the complex implicit relation in the solid rocket engine test is intuitively displayed.
assignees: INNER MONGOLIA AEROSPACE POWER MACHINERY TESTING INST;UNIV NORTHWESTERN POLYTECHNICAL

title_en: Electrical coordination hub planning optimization method considering advanced adiabatic compressed air energy storage
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric coordination hub planning optimization method considering advanced adiabatic compressed air energy storage, belonging to the technical field of comprehensive energy system planning optimization; the electric coordination hub planning optimization method considering advanced adiabatic compressed air energy storage comprises the following steps: constructing a city-level electric coordination hub multi-energy cascade utilization frame, a multi-energy equipment model and an advanced heat-insulating compressed air energy storage refinement model; constructing an urban-level electric collaborative interconnection system model of regional combined cooling heating power and regional inter-electric ring network coupling; linearizing and dimension-reducing nonlinear items in an urban electric coordination hub multi-energy cascade utilization frame, a multi-energy equipment model, an advanced heat-insulating compressed air energy storage refined model and an urban electric coordination interconnection system model; based on the city-level electric coordination hub after dimension reduction and the city-level electric coordination interconnection system model, a city-level electric coordination hub planning optimization model considering advanced heat-insulating compressed air energy storage is built.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV SOUTHEAST

title_en: Method and device for building and predicting load prediction model of power distribution network
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to the field of power systems, and in particular, to a method and apparatus for building and predicting a load prediction model of a power distribution network. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a power consumption load data set and an influence factor data set; extracting a power utilization characteristic set from the power utilization load data set; performing multi-level hierarchical clustering on the electricity utilization feature set to obtain electricity utilization aggregation information; establishing a training sample set according to the electricity consumption aggregation information, the electricity consumption load data set and the influence factor data set; constructing a neural network model cascaded with a group intelligent optimization algorithm to optimize the weight and the threshold of the neural network model; and training the neural network model by using the training sample set, and taking the trained neural network model as a power distribution network load prediction model. According to the embodiment of the specification, the electricity load prediction accuracy of the power distribution network, which is continuously changed along with the development of the emerging industry, can be improved.
assignees: STATE GRID JIBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;ECONOMIC TECHNOLOGY RES INST STATE GRID JIBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Device is established to complicated electromagnetic environment of improved generation has
abstract_en: The invention provides an improved complex electromagnetic environment constructing device and an operation method, comprising the following steps: the system comprises a three-dimensional visualization module, a data processing module, a geographic data updating module, a topography measurement calculation module, an electromagnetic signal and geographic topography database; the data processing module comprises: the device comprises a far-field electromagnetic power measuring module, a near-field electromagnetic signal measuring module and an input module; the geographic data updating module acquires the geographic information of the topography of each region through a network, converts the geographic information into geographic longitude and latitude data and surface topography data, and inputs the geographic longitude and latitude data and the surface topography data into a geographic topography database; the terrain measurement calculation module is used for converting the terrain geographic information measured in the field into geographic longitude and latitude data and surface morphology data and inputting the geographic longitude and latitude data and the surface morphology data into the geographic morphology database; the three-dimensional visualization module generates a three-dimensional topography for display and an electromagnetic radiation propagation map superimposed on the three-dimensional topography.
assignees: GUOKE DIANLEI BEIJING ELECTRONIC EQUIPMENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Distribution line fault feature association method based on information fusion
abstract_en: The application provides a distribution line fault feature association method based on information fusion, which comprises the steps of obtaining wave recording data of a distribution line; extracting mutation information in the wave recording data by a wavelet technology; performing reduction on the mutation quantity information; and inputting the protocol information into a fuzzy Petri network for fault diagnosis. The method has the advantages of high reliability and good fault tolerance, contains time sequence information, provides accurate protection and breaker information for the optimized fault diagnosis model of the main station when the power grid has complex faults, is greatly beneficial to improving the overall diagnosis precision, occupies few bandwidth and other resources, accurately judges the fault position and the fault property, judges the action behavior of line protection, provides a manual fault analysis report for emergency dispatching, and assists a dispatcher to rapidly complete fault processing and avoid occurrence of line cascading faults.
assignees: PUER POWER SUPPLY BUREAU OF YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Mine emergency communication system
abstract_en: The invention provides a mine emergency communication system which comprises network management equipment, a downlink laser communication access device, a cascade laser communication device, an uplink laser communication access device and the like, wherein the network management equipment is used for establishing a communication network, and the downlink laser communication access device is communicated with the uplink laser communication access device in a laser wireless mode under the relay support of the cascade laser communication device, so that a laser wireless backbone communication link is established, and communication service is provided for underground wireless terminal equipment. The system has the advantages of high bandwidth of a wired communication system and easy deployment of a wireless multi-hop network communication system, solves the problems of low bandwidth, short distance and the like of the conventional wireless multi-hop network emergency communication system, can be widely applied to coal mines and non-coal mines, and has important application value in the aspects of improving the technical level of mine emergency communication, improving the mine disaster rescue efficiency, reducing casualties and property loss and the like.

title_en: Cascade water light storage system optimal scheduling method and system considering receiving end load and frequency safety
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of multi-source power system optimal operation, and discloses a cascade water light storage system optimal scheduling method and system considering the load and frequency safety of a receiving end. The method comprises the steps of considering coordination optimization potential between direct current output power and water light storage complementation, constructing an optimization adjustment mode of direct current output power according to water and electricity retention requirement of a power grid at a transmitting end and load peak regulation requirement of a power grid at a receiving end, carrying out source load matching on the direct current output power and the load at the receiving end, defining indexes to quantify and evaluate the matching degree of the direct current output power and the load at the receiving end, calculating active and reactive losses of a line and a converter station, combining frequency safety of system operation, aiming at minimizing system operation cost and light abandoning punishment, providing a long-term optimization scheduling model in a cascade water light storage system, and solving through a column and constraint generation algorithm. The invention ensures the stable output of the direct current output power, improves the operation efficiency and stability of the whole power system, and can avoid the potential frequency safety problem after accidents happen.
assignees: STATE GRID ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD;UNIV SICHUAN;SOUTHWEST BRANCH OF STATE GRID CORP OF CHINA

title_en: E-commerce supply chain anti-outage decision system based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of logistics supply and discloses an e-commerce supply chain anti-outage decision system based on multi-source data fusion, which comprises a heterogeneous graph network construction and risk prediction module, wherein the heterogeneous graph network construction and risk prediction module is used for constructing a heterogeneous graph network representing the relationship of the e-commerce supply chain based on multi-source data and predicting an outage risk propagation path by utilizing a time sequence sensitive graph annotation force network; the invention builds an abnormal composition network and realizes a time sequence sensitive graph annotation force network, so that the system can accurately capture cascading effect and risk propagation paths in a complex supply network, improve the prediction accuracy of the fault cargo risk propagation path and greatly reduce false alarm and missing alarm.
assignees: SHENZHEN ECVV NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent algorithm-based high-voltage transmission line safety assessment method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power system safety, and discloses a high-voltage transmission line safety assessment method based on an intelligent algorithm; the method comprises the steps of constructing a database through multi-source data acquisition and fusion processing, analyzing the relevance of meteorological conditions and an icing formation mechanism by using a deep learning model, excavating an evolution rule of the correlation, carrying out multi-scene simulation and sensitivity analysis by combining physical characteristics and topographic information of a power transmission line, and establishing a line icing risk partition assessment system. According to the method, the mechanical strength and the ice coating thickness critical value of a circuit are calculated based on a mechanical model, a grading early warning threshold standard is formulated, a time sequence prediction algorithm and a risk propagation model are constructed to realize intelligent early warning, and an anti-icing resource optimal allocation and self-adaptive generation of a deicing scheme are adopted to form an anti-icing strategy. The invention effectively improves the capacity of the high-voltage transmission line for resisting ice coating disasters and enhances the safe and stable operation level of the power grid.
assignees: JIANGSU HAIHONG POWER ENGINEERING CONSULTING LTD BY SHARE LTD

title_en: Pig farm flow yield early warning method and system integrating space-time diagram network and knowledge enhancement
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pig farm flow yield early warning method and system with a fused time-space diagram network and knowledge enhancement, which comprises the steps of connecting a blue ear disease risk knowledge map of each pig farm at each historical moment according to the affiliated organization and geographic position, extracting an inter-field relationship topological diagram reflecting pig farm-organization-city relationship, generating intra-field embedding of event subgraph fusion time weights in each pig farm by utilizing a diagram attention network, learning the inter-field relationship topological diagram and the intra-field embedding by utilizing the diagram attention network again, generating inter-field embedding with space propagation risk, acquiring time sequence trend by inputting a long-short term memory network after splicing the inter-field embedding and the historical abortion rate of each pig farm, respectively predicting abnormal abortion rate risk probability and specific abortion rate value of three time windows in the future, and judging and early warning. According to the method, risk events in and among pig farms are comprehensively considered, so that the dependence relationship of the flow rate at each moment is captured, and the accuracy of pig farm blue ear disease risk early warning is improved.

title_en: Cascade reservoir group flood emergency dispatching method and system integrating dynamic risk assessment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of hydraulic engineering and emergency management, and discloses a cascade reservoir group flood emergency dispatching method and system integrating dynamic risk assessment, wherein the method comprises the steps of utilizing a set forecast product of numerical weather forecast to drive a hydrologic model to generate a flood set, calculating the instantaneous dam-overflow risk probability of each reservoir, and constructing a risk chain type propagation network model to evaluate the overall accident probability of a system in a dynamic risk assessment stage; and in the intelligent decision support stage, triggering is performed when the overall failure probability of the system exceeds a risk threshold, similar historical cases are searched by adopting a graph neural network based on a water conservancy domain knowledge graph, and an optimal treatment scheme is generated and recommended through a multi-attribute utility evaluation model. The invention realizes dynamic quantification of risks, accurate identification of systematic risks and intellectualization of emergency decisions, solves the problems of static isolation of traditional risk assessment and dependence of emergency decisions on experience, and improves flood control emergency response capability of a cascade reservoir group.

title_en: Hypergraph structure-based fault diagnosis method and hypergraph structure-based fault diagnosis system for multiple physical field transformers
abstract_en: The invention provides a hypergraph structure-based fault diagnosis method and system for a multi-physical-field transformer. The method comprises the steps of collecting multiple physical fields of a transformer in the operation process, forming a multi-channel data matrix, establishing a transformer multi-physical field coupling simulation model, simulating normal working conditions and multiple fault working conditions by adjusting related parameters, outputting simulation data, generating a hypergraph structure based on the simulation data by adopting a proximity relation method, obtaining a node set, a hyperedge set and a hyperedge weight matrix, mapping actually collected multi-physical field signals to a hypergraph, carrying out propagation calculation on node characteristics by utilizing a hypergraph convolution network, obtaining low-dimensional embedded vectors of all channels, carrying out characteristic splicing to form global characteristic vectors, and finally outputting corresponding fault categories. According to the invention, a stable hypergraph topological structure is constructed in an auxiliary way through simulation data, and the efficient fusion of the characteristics of multiple physical fields is realized by combining with real data, so that the lightweight fault diagnosis of the transformer is realized under the condition of reducing the sensor and the computing resources.

title_en: System for integrated management of reservoir having colalpse sensing function
title_ko: 붕괴 감지 기능을 갖는 저수지 통합 관리 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an integrated management system for a reservoir with a collapse detecting function and, more specifically, to an integrated management system for a reservoir with a collapse detecting function, which enables a user to grasp a collapse state and a collapse possibility of a reservoir bank in an initial stage by installing a collapse detector on the reservoir bank to rapidly report an emergency situation online or via a mobile communication network and to establish countermeasures. According to the present invention, the integrated management system for a reservoir with the collapse detecting function includes: a water level measuring device for measuring a water level in the reservoir; an overflowing rate measuring device for measuring the amount of water overflowing to an overflow path of the reservoir bank; a reservoir management device for collecting and transferring information measured by the water level measuring device and the overflowing rate measuring device; a manager server receiving information transmitted from the reservoir management device and grasping the state of the reservoir by processing the information and transferring the graphed state of the reservoir; a manager terminal receiving information related to the state of the reservoir transmitted by the manager server; and a warning broadcasting device broadcasting in accordance with a signal received from the manager server. The integrated management system also includes the collapse detector for measuring change in a slope of the reservoir bank. The reservoir management device transfers the information on the change in the slope, which is received from the collapse detector, to the manager server, and the manager server determines the collapse state and the collapse possibility based on the received information on the change in the slope and transfers the information thereof to the manager terminal and the warning broadcasting device.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 붕괴 감지 기능을 갖는 저수지 통합 관리 시스템에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 저수지 둑에 붕괴 감지기가 구비되어 저수지 둑의 붕괴 가능성 및 붕괴 여부를 조기에 파악할 수 있도록 함으로써 위급상황에 대하여는 온라인이나 이동통신망을 통하여 신속하게 전파하고 그에 대한 대책수립이 가능하도록 한 붕괴 감지 기능을 갖는 저수지 통합 관리 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따른 붕괴 감지 기능을 갖는 저수지 통합 관리 시스템은, 저수지 수위를 측정하기 위한 수위 측정기와, 저수지 둑의 여수로로 넘치는 물의 양을 측정하기 위한 여수량 측정기와, 상기 수위 측정기 및 여수량 측정기에 의해 측정된 정보를 수집하여 송신하기 위한 저수지 관리기와, 상기 저수지 관리기로부터 송신된 정보를 수신하여 해당 정보를 처리하여 저수지 상태를 파악하고 이를 송신하는 관리자 서버와, 상기 관리자 서버에 의해 송신된 저수지 상태와 관련된 정보를 수신하는 관리자 단말기와, 상기 관리자 서버로부터 수신된 신호에 따라 이를 방송하는 경고 방송기를 포함하는 저수지 통합 관리 시스템에 있어서, 상기 저수지 둑 경사면의 변화를 측정하기 위한 붕괴 감지기가 더 구비되고, 상기 저수지 관리기는 상기 붕괴 감지기로부터 수신된 경사면 변화에 대한 정보를 상기 관리자 서버로 송신하고, 상기 관리자 서버는 수신된 경사면 변화에 대한 정보로부터 붕괴 가능성 및 붕괴 여부를 판단하여 이에 대한 정보를 관리자 단말기 및 경고 방송기로 송신하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

abstract_en: An emergency bell integrated enclosure consists of a total of eight emergency bell cameras of a 360-degree monitoring fixed camera function for preventing a dead zone by consisting of a high-focus camera and a low-focus camera as a group an upper end of an enclosure and installing a camera set for monitoring all directions at 90 degrees on four sides. The emergency bell integrated enclosure comprises: a switch hub; a power unit; a broadcasting device; a video storing memory; and an Eve SERVER. The Eve SERVER and a Bob SERVER communicate through an unlicensed frequency wireless communication device. A photographing video of a monitoring camera for crime prevention is transmitted to an integrated crime prevention center through the switch hub to facilitate real-time monitoring. The photographing video of the emergency bell camera is stored in the video storing memory. In a wireless integrated enclosure, wireless cameras of four low-focus cameras for monitoring all direction at 90 degrees are installed in the upper end of the enclosure. The Eve SERVER and the Bob SERVER communicate through the unlicensed frequency wireless communication device. When an emergency bell button is operated by inserting the emergency bell button into a front surface of a wireless integrated enclosure, the Eve SERVER communicates with an Alice SERVER inside an integrated crime prevention center after connecting the Bob SERVER to a network through an unlicensed frequency wireless network.
abstract_ko:
비상벨 일체형 함체는 외함 상단에 고초점거리 카메라 및 저초점거리 카메라 2대 1조로 구성되어 90도 전방위를 감시하는 카메라 세트를 4면에 설치하여 사각방지용 360도 감시 고정카메라 기능의 총 8대의 비상벨 카메라가 설치된다. 
비상벨 일체형 함체는 스위치허브, 전원부, 방송장치, 영상저장 메모리, Eve SERVER를 포함하여 구성되어, Eve SERVER와 Bob SERVER는 비면허주파수 무선통신장치를 통하여 통신하고, 방범용 감시카메라의 촬영영상은 스위치허브를 통해 통합방범센터로 전송하여 실시간 감시하고, 비상벨 카메라의 촬영영상은 영상저장 메모리에 저장된다. 
무선 일체형 함체는 외함 상단에 각 90도 전방위를 감시하는 저초점거리 카메라 4대의 무선 카메라가 설치되고, Eve SERVER와 Bob SERVER는 비면허주파수 무선통신장치를 통하여 통신한다. 
무선 일체형 함체 전면에 비상벨 버튼이 삽입되어, 비상벨 버튼 작동시 Eve SERVER는 비면허주파수 무선자가망을 통해 Bob SERVER와 네트워크망 연결 후 통합방범센터 내부 Alice SERVER와 양방향 통화로 개통한다.
