title_ko: 재난 로밍 방법, 장치 및 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 출원의 실시예는 단말 디바이스의 서비스 중단을 감소시키고, 서비스 중단을 최소화하며, 사용자 경험을 향상시킨, 재난 로밍 방법, 장치 및 시스템을 제공한다. 자세한 내용은 다음과 같다. 단말 디바이스는 저장된 재난 로밍 공공 육상 모바일 네트워크(public land mobile network, PLMN)에 관한 정보에 기초해서 제1 PLMN을 결정한다. 재난 로밍 PLMN에 관한 정보는, 단말 디바이스가 재난 로밍을 수행하는 것을 허용하는 적어도 하나의 PLMN의 식별 정보를 포함한다. 제1 PLMN은 적어도 하나의 PLMN 중 한 PLMN이다. 단말 디바이스는 제1 PLMN에 등록 요청 메시지를 송신하되, 등록 요청 메시지는 재난 로밍 표시 정보를 포함하며, 재난 로밍 표시 정보는 단말 디바이스가 재난 로밍 등록을 수행하도록 요청했음을 표시한다. 단말 디바이스는 제1 PLMN에 의해 송신되는 등록 수락 메시지를 수신한다.

title_en: Communication method and communication apparatus
abstract_en: The present application provides a communication method and a communication apparatus. The method comprises: receiving a registration request from a terminal device, the registration request being used for requesting registration to a first core network device; and sending first request information to a second core network device on the basis of the registration request, the first request information being used for requesting to start disaster roaming. The first core network device is located in a first network, the second core network device is located in a second network, and the first network and the second network share an access network device. The present application provides a disaster roaming mechanism under the architecture of a shared network, reducing the service interruption time of a terminal device, and facilitating improvement of the communication reliability.

title_en: Recommendation engine for a cognitive reservoir system
abstract_en: Implementations described and claimed herein provide systems and methods for developing a reservoir. In one implementation, a reservoir model is received. The reservoir model includes a static model and a dynamic model. The static model includes one or more clusters of a three-dimensional volume of the reservoir and an uncertainty quantification generated using a neural network. The dynamic model includes pressure values and fluid saturation values propagated across the three-dimensional volume through a nodal connectivity of neighboring clusters. A set of input features is generated from the static model and the dynamic model. The set of input features is related to a drilling attractiveness of a target region of the reservoir using a set of rules executed by a fuzzy inference engine. A quantification of the drilling attractiveness is generated. A recommendation for drilling in the reservoir is output based on the quantification of the drilling attractiveness.

title_en: Fault tree map generation
abstract_en: A method for Fault Tree Map generation employs to transformation of Fault Trees of production installation, specific installation, technical system (Hardware and integrated Hardware/Software) to new Fault Tree diagram (Fault Tree Map), which permits drastically compact the Fault Tree depiction and facilitates performing of the Fault Tree qualitative analysis, including evaluation of combination of latent failures and evident failures, repeated events and critical events position influence, and failure propagation potentiality, besides facility of localization of each Fault Tree logical Gate and relevant failures in the fault tree printed report. Generation takes place using special symbols, which permit to reflect the Fault Tree logic, present all Fault Tree failures with graphically identification of the failure type, and show the failure repetition and also the failure critically (importance) to Fault Tree Top Event probability. The method presents exceptional advantages to analysis of large-scale, extended Fault Trees, allowing vastly decrease the time of analysis and elevate the analysis quality and Fault Tree perception, including for specialists, who are not the Fault Tree authors.
assignees: VLASSOVA OLGA ALEXANDROVNA;BAKOWSKI ANTONIO;CARDOSO JR JAURES;MARTINAZZO ALDO

title_en: Forest fire detection method based on cascade network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a forest fire detection method based on a cascade network, which is characterized in that a smoke flame detection network comprising a global feature extraction network and a local feature extraction network is designed by an MC-YOLOv5s structure, forest fire local images and suspicious mist local images are detected aiming at forest shooting images, primary forest fire detection is realized, and according to the conditions that the forest fire local images do not exist and the suspicious mist local images exist, the preset meteorological element values of a forest area when the suspicious mist local images are shot are combined, a smoke classification network of an SCN structure design is further applied, classification analysis is carried out aiming at the suspicious mist local images, and secondary forest fire detection is realized by distinguishing smoke or mist, so that forest fire false alarm phenomena are effectively avoided, and forest fire detection precision is improved.

title_en: Intrinsically safe power distribution network diagnosis analysis and grid planning method
abstract_en: The invention provides a power distribution network diagnosis analysis and grid planning method based on intrinsic safety, which comprises the steps of firstly obtaining planning information of a target power distribution network, then establishing a source network load storage collaborative planning model according to the planning information, then applying random faults to the target power distribution network, and evaluating intrinsic safety indexes of the target power distribution network under the faults, wherein the intrinsic safety indexes are determined by a tide overload coefficient, a cascading failure coefficient and minimum node inertia, and finally optimizing the source network load storage collaborative planning model according to the intrinsic safety indexes to obtain an optimal planning scheme of the target power distribution network. And calculating an intrinsic safety index through the combination of the tidal current overload coefficient, the cascading failure coefficient and the minimum node inertia, and further optimizing the planning of the target power distribution network based on the intrinsic safety index on the basis of minimizing the cost, so that the power distribution network can be ensured to effectively prevent and cope with accident risks.

title_en: Cascade reservoir group joint scheduling rule optimization method based on big data samples
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascade reservoir group joint scheduling rule optimization method based on big data samples, which comprises the steps of collecting and sorting reservoir group scheduling basic data; generating a big data random runoff sample set by using a deep convolution to generate an countermeasure network; constructing a reservoir group joint optimization scheduling cloud parallel model and a cloud computing cluster; constructing a joint scheduling rule input factor and a decision variable sample set; constructing a multi-input multi-output cascade reservoir group joint optimization scheduling rule model by adopting a random forest regression algorithm; and performing scheduling operation simulation on the trained scheduling rules, and evaluating scheduling operation results. According to the invention, the large data sample is efficiently obtained through the deep convolution generation countermeasure network and the Spark-based cloud parallel computing technology, and the multi-input multi-output type dispatching rule is optimized based on the large data sample, so that the application precision and generalization capability of the cascade reservoir group joint dispatching rule are improved, and the large-scale high-dimensional reservoir group optimized dispatching and refined management are realized.

title_en: Distribution network and micro-grid distributed collaborative planning method and system based on improved target cascading analysis method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed collaborative planning method and system for a power distribution network and a micro-grid based on an improved target cascading analysis method. The method comprises the steps of taking the topology and safety constraint of a power distribution network into consideration, taking the minimum total cost of the power distribution network planning as a target, establishing an upper-layer power distribution network planning model, taking the aggregate capacity of a micro-grid to various internal resources into consideration, taking the minimum total planning cost of the micro-grid as a target, establishing a lower-layer multi-micro-grid planning model, and solving a micro-grid collaborative planning model by adopting an improved target cascade analysis method. Aiming at the power grid planning problem in the future multi-planning main body background, the invention plays a role in integrating various distributed energy sources by the micro-grid, coordinates planning resources of the micro-grid and the power distribution network, and reduces the planning cost of each planning main body. The method has the advantages that the power generation resources in the power distribution network and the micro-grid can be reasonably planned, collaborative planning is realized only by a small amount of information on the premise that global equipment information is not needed, the privacy of information of each planning main body is protected, and meanwhile, the economy of each planning main body scheme is improved.

title_en: Intelligent control method and system for new energy transmission and distribution collaborative consumption
abstract_en: The invention discloses a new energy transmission and distribution collaborative consumption intelligent control method and a system, which relate to the technical field of new energy, and comprise the steps of collecting real-time monitoring data of each node in an electric power system and preprocessing; and constructing a complex network model of the power grid according to the adjacency matrix, calculating the power weight of each power transmission line, and storing all data into a relational database and managing. According to the method, the nodes and the edges of the power system are accurately modeled, the adjacency matrix is constructed, the topological structure of the power grid and the power flow of the power transmission line are comprehensively reflected, the load and the running state of the power grid are accurately estimated, errors in the traditional method are avoided, the propagation process of faults in the power grid is simulated in real time by calculating the degrees, the clustering coefficients and the expansion series of the nodes and combining the propagation dynamics model, the speed and the range of the fault propagation are predicted, multi-stage early warning is further realized, the accuracy of evaluating the vulnerability of the power grid is improved, and the stability and the emergency response capability of the power grid are enhanced.

title_en: Underground space protection evaluation system and method based on BIM and multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The underground space protection evaluation system based on BIM and multisource data fusion comprises a data input layer, an evaluation engine layer and a result output layer, wherein the data input layer, the evaluation engine layer and the result output layer are sequentially used for data transmission and processing, the data input layer is configured to construct a three-dimensional BIM model, an association rule base based on an attack mode and a damage path of a terrorist attack parameter base and a real-time environment data stream based on multisource sensor data fusion, the three-dimensional BIM model integrates geological survey data, topographic survey, structural parameters and civil air defense engineering data through a space topology modeling technology, the evaluation engine layer is configured to receive the three-dimensional BIM model, the association rule base and the real-time environment data stream of the data input layer, a key damage propagation simulation result and a vulnerability analysis result are generated through explosion dynamic response simulation and space topology network analysis, and the result output layer is configured to generate a three-dimensional space classification map, a dynamic design adjustment suggestion and a model self-examination report based on the damage propagation simulation result and the vulnerability analysis result of the evaluation engine layer.

title_en: Production equipment of Hua diao chicken
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a production facility of chicken is drunk to hua diao, close the upper cover on the body including body and lid, can dismantle to be connected with the base body bottom, the base top is open structure with the bottom, the base includes main part and support, main part and support be the integrated into one piece structure, a plurality of archs of body bottom fixedly connected with, protruding and base contact cooperation, the utility model discloses a production facility of chicken is drunk to hua diao through fixed connection support on the base, makes the burning things which may cause a fire disaster concentrate more in the body bottom, through protruding and the base contact cooperation of body bottom, makes the speed and the efficiency of heat propagation higher to reduce the stewing time of chicken is drunk to hua diao.

title_en: High-voltage energy storage power unit supplied without power outage
abstract_en: The utility model provides a high-voltage energy storage power unit supplied without power outage, which belongs to the technical field of power electronics, and comprises: the device comprises an uncontrolled rectifying module, an inversion module, a DCDC module and a battery cluster. The uncontrolled rectifying module and the inversion module can realize variable frequency operation of a rear-stage load motor, and the DCDC module and the battery cluster can realize energy storage and release. The high-voltage energy storage power unit can realize energy flow among the uncontrolled rectifying module, the inversion module and the DCDC module according to the state of the main power grid. The utility model can drive the motor to perform variable frequency operation after a plurality of units are cascaded, and simultaneously realizes the storage of the energy of the power grid or the release of the stored energy to the inversion module, thereby ensuring the continuous uninterrupted operation of the load after the power failure of the main power grid.
assignees: SHANDONG WINDSUN ELECTRONICS SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Identification method for complex power grid self-organization critical state
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for identifying a self-organization critical state of a complex power grid in the technical field of power system cascading failure prevention. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring actual load loss of a power grid in a random fault; calculating the cumulative probability of the random fault of the power grid according to the actual load loss of the random fault of the power grid and the set load loss amount; performing regression analysis on the set load loss and the accumulated probability so as to determine whether the power grid is in a self-organization critical state; and when the power grid is in the self-organization critical state, calculating the expected load loss value of the power grid and determining the relative probability of the power grid having load loss faults. The method can accurately judge whether the current power grid is in a self-organization critical state or not and the probability of the current power grid in cascading failure, calculate the load loss after the cascading failure occurs, and simultaneously estimate the relative probability of large-scale load loss power failure accidents.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV NORTH CHINA ELEC POWER

title_en: A kind of Unit Combination optimization method and device based on crossover algorithm in length and breadth
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of Unit Combination optimization method based on crossover algorithm in length and breadth, this method comprises the following steps：Object function and the constraint of power system unit based on Operation of Electric Systems network minimal, set up the Optimized model of Unit Commitment；According to the potential solution of Optimized model, population is initialized, initial set state matrix and initial unit output matrix is obtained；Based on initial set state matrix, successively using binary system crossover algorithm BCSO and crossover algorithm CSO iteration progress lateral cross and crossed longitudinally operation in length and breadth, the filial generation of generation and parent competition in length and breadth, the optimization solution of Unit Commitment is obtained.The technical scheme provided using the embodiment of the present invention, can enable particle individual information rapidly to be propagated in population, convergence rate is maintained while global convergence ability is greatly enhanced.Optimize device the invention also discloses a kind of Unit Combination based on crossover algorithm in length and breadth, with relevant art effect.

title_en: Short-term wind speed interval multi-objective optimization prediction method and system based on random sensitivity
abstract_en: The invention discloses a short-term wind speed interval multi-objective optimization prediction method and system based on random sensitivity, which comprises the steps of firstly adopting a back propagation training mode to pre-train a neural network, then improving the random sensitivity to be suitable for a special prediction mode, namely a prediction interval, and then combining two important indexes of the prediction interval: the accuracy rate and the width of interval coverage and the constructed random sensitivity for predicting the interval are used as three objective functions, and a multi-objective genetic optimization algorithm NSGA-III is used for optimizing the pre-trained neural network, wherein the random sensitivity can be used for calculating the anti-interference capability of the model on the surrounding samples added with random disturbance; and after training is finished, carrying out heuristic selection on the pareto optimal population finally obtained. The method provided by the invention can be used for different network structures and has high expandability; by utilizing multi-objective optimization and a special optimal solution selection scheme, the number of hyper-parameters is greatly reduced, and the method has good practical application value.

title_en: Automatic searching and early warning method, device and equipment for power grid cascading failure
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method, a device and equipment for automatically searching and early warning cascading failures of a power grid, belonging to the technical field of risk early warning of power systems, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring initial fault information of a target power grid; calculating the line load rate, the electrical betweenness and the on-off influence value of each line of the target power grid; and according to the line load rate, the electrical betweenness and the on-off influence value of each line of the target power grid, and a dispatcher experience elicitation and a non-public cause cascading failure search strategy, starting a preset system cascading failure search rule through periodic triggering and/or non-periodic triggering, performing enumerated automatic search on a power flow transfer path after initial multiple failures of the power grid occur, taking a branch with heavier load and larger transfer factor in the transfer path as a candidate cascading failure, finding out a dangerous path set possibly causing the power grid cascading failure from the candidate cascading failure, obtaining a target power grid cascading failure prediction path, and performing early warning on the target power grid cascading failure prediction path to reduce loss.
assignees: POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL BRANCH OF INNER MONGOLIA POWER GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Establishment method of comment analysis model based on social network rumor propagation
abstract_en: A method for establishing a comment analysis model based on social network rumor propagation comprises the following steps: classifying the population, and determining a rumor dynamics propagation mechanism according to the classification result; constructing a rumor propagation model with a comment mechanism according to the rumor propagation mechanism; carrying out global kinetic analysis on the rumor propagation model to obtain a basic regeneration number function determining the kinetic property of the system; according to the basic regeneration number function, whether a global stability point of the rumor propagation model exists is judged, if yes, the rumor propagation model is taken as a target model, and the invention considers the promotion and popularity of new mechanisms such as barrage, message leaving, praise and the like under the current network environment, thereby improving the problem existing in the traditional rumor propagation mode and further enabling the rumor propagation model to conform to the actual situation.

title_en: Multi-factor-based hydropower station generator deduction oil level prediction method
abstract_en: A hydroelectric power station generator deduction oil level prediction method based on multiple factors comprises the following steps: obtaining original data through a sensor, and then obtaining an original factor data matrix R and an original oil level matrix D; carrying out dimensionless treatment on the original factor data matrix R and the oil level original matrix D; obtaining a standardized factor data matrix X; weighting the standardized factor data matrix X; establishing an oil level prediction model, and training the oil level prediction model by using a three-layer back propagation neural network; inputting training samples to calculate errors; judging whether the oil level prediction model is trained; and if the training is completed, predicting by using the oil level prediction model. The method improves the accuracy and efficiency of deducing the oil level, uses multidimensional factors to establish a temperature prediction model, and avoids the influence on the historical trend analysis of the oil level; therefore, the oil level prediction result is more reasonable and accurate. The operation reliability of the hydropower station generator set can be effectively improved.

title_en: Hydrogen-containing comprehensive energy system optimal scheduling method and system considering auxiliary service
abstract_en: The application discloses an optimization scheduling method and system of a hydrogen-containing comprehensive energy system considering auxiliary service, wherein the method is used for performing optimization scheduling on the hydrogen-containing comprehensive energy system considering the provision of electric auxiliary service, and comprises the following steps: the hydrogen energy cascade utilization is considered, and the hydrogen-containing comprehensive energy system model is established; considering providing frequency modulation and standby auxiliary services for an external power grid, and establishing an operation model of the comprehensive energy service provider containing the auxiliary services; taking maximum operation profit as a target, and taking an auxiliary service model and a green license-carbon transaction mechanism into consideration to establish an optimal scheduling model of the hydrogen-containing comprehensive energy system; and carrying out global optimal solution on the optimal scheduling model to obtain the optimal auxiliary service providing quantity and the optimal scheduling scheme of the comprehensive energy system. The application can solve the problem that the existing other comprehensive energy system scheduling models can not consider hydrogen energy utilization and can not consider providing electric auxiliary service outwards.
assignees: JINGMEN POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;HAINAN RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF ZHEJIANG UNIV;HUBEI JINGNENG POWER TRANS AND TRANSFORMATION ENGINEERING CO LTD;JINGMEN SHENGHE ELECTRIC POWER SURVEY AND DESIGN CO LTD

title_en: Three-dimensional geoelectromagnetic forward modeling method for pre-training model cyclic transfer learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional geomagnetic forward modeling method for pre-training model cyclic transfer learning, which solves the problem of time consuming forward modeling in the prior art and comprises the following steps: randomly generating a three-dimensional ground model; forward computing is carried out on the three-dimensional ground model to obtain three-dimensional forward response data; constructing a three-dimensional deep learning network for extracting self-attention mechanism features; inputting training sample pairs into a three-dimensional deep learning network extracted from self-attention mechanism features, adopting cyclic sharing network weights, combining three-dimensional forward modeling response data of any parameter in any polarization direction, adopting back propagation to calculate gradients, and updating parameters of the three-dimensional deep learning network through an optimizer; establishing nonlinear mapping between the three-dimensional ground model and three-dimensional forward response data of any parameter of any polarization direction to obtain a trained three-dimensional deep learning network; and inputting the verification sample pair into the trained three-dimensional deep learning network to obtain three-dimensional geoelectromagnetic forward data.

title_en: Water-wind-solar short-term risk scheduling method considering remaining water resource utilization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water-wind-solar short-term risk scheduling method considering the utilization of remaining water resources, which is characterized in that a water-wind-solar complementary system day-ahead risk scheduling model considering the comprehensive utilization of remaining water resources is constructed by considering the power discarding and load losing risks of the water-wind-solar complementary system and the peak regulation targets of a power grid under the condition of uncertainty of wind and photoelectric output through a response function of the current state of a constructed cascade reservoir and the comprehensive utilization targets of remaining water resources, and the day-ahead power generation scheduling model of the complementary system is constructed by considering the stability requirements of the system output.
assignees: UNIV XIAN TECHNOLOGY;SPIC HUANGHE HYDROPOWER DEV CO LTD;POWERCHINA NORTHWEST ENG CORP LTD

title_en: Method and system for path analysis and risk identification of water infiltration outside hydropower station grotto group
abstract_en: The invention provides a path analysis and risk identification method and a system for water infiltration outside a hydropower station cavern group, which dynamically simulate the propagation path of water flow by establishing a catchment network model of the underground cavern group, the risk of external water infiltration is comprehensively evaluated, the water flow path is displayed, and comprehensive path analysis and risk identification of external water infiltration of a complex underground cavern group are realized. The method effectively solves the problems that the result of risk assessment of water seepage of the hydropower station cavern group is low in accuracy, the propagation path and the sweep range of the water flow are difficult to predict accurately, provides a scientific water flow management and protection scheme for the hydropower station, provides scientific technical support for seepage prevention design, risk management and emergency response of the hydropower station underground plant, and has strong engineering practical significance.
assignees: THREE GORGES JINSHA RIVER YUNCHUAN HYDROPOWER DEV CO LTD;CHANGJIANG INST SURVEY PLANNING DESIGN & RES CO LTD

title_en: Betweennesss algorithm-based local energy shortage risk cascade effect evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for evaluating a local energy shortage risk cascade effect based on a Betweennesss algorithm, and relates to the field of energy resource management, wherein the method comprises the following steps of S1, obtaining energy pressure indexes of all areas and energy dependency of all departments, calculating according to the energy pressure indexes to obtain energy shortage probability, and calculating according to the energy shortage probability and the energy dependency of all departments to obtain initial energy shortage risk; S2, combining the initial energy shortage risk with a multi-region input-output model to construct a virtual energy shortage risk transmission network, and S3, evaluating and identifying key transmission nodes of the local energy shortage risk cascade effect in the virtual energy shortage risk transmission network based on Betweenness algorithm. The method has the advantages of wide application range and high calculation mode, fills the blank of the prior research, and can provide effective method and data support for improving the toughness of the trade network for coping with the energy shortage risk.

title_en: Remote correlation feature mining method, system, equipment and medium for flood cascade
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote correlation feature mining method, system, equipment and medium for flood cascade, which relate to the technical field of flood disaster assessment and comprise the steps of constructing a cascade flood database through extreme flood events, constructing a plurality of directed complex networks, inputting time information of cascade flood into the directed complex networks, analyzing the outflow and inflow of the flood by using single variable pairs and cross variable pairs of the flood, carrying out flood synchronization on precipitation and runoff, precipitation and flow and between runoff and flow, representing a flood cascade phenomenon, extracting network indexes of flood propagation features, network clustering and synchronization strength in the flood cascade phenomenon, and taking the network indexes as remote correlation features of the flood cascade. The invention adopts a complex network analysis method to clarify flood propagation and synchronization mechanism, comprises a plurality of hydrologic variables such as precipitation, runoff and flow, and the like, and researches reveal some remarkable characteristics, and compared with other networks, the flood network related to runoff shows higher connectivity.

title_en: Power distribution network operation risk control method based on Bayesian optimization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network operation risk control method based on Bayesian optimization, which comprises the following steps of S1, utilizing power distribution network multi-source operation data to establish a node-side double-space coupling dynamic diagram, S2, based on the dynamic diagram, generating space-time embedded vectors through self-supervision tasks of multi-level space-time interaction of nodes and node neighborhood, S3, constructing a risk sensitive network with multi-scale dynamic clustering, predicting risk propagation tracks, S4, utilizing the risk propagation tracks to form a risk evolution link which is continuous and dynamic in a cross period and divide power distribution network risk control subdomains, S5, evaluating subdomain risk dynamic evolution, constructing a joint optimization state space, S6, constructing a distributed bidirectional information cooperation link between the neighborhood, S7, monitoring decision convergence conditions in real time and carrying out path switching. The invention improves the real-time performance and accuracy of the risk control of the power distribution network and ensures the safe and stable operation of the power distribution network.
assignees: ZHEJIANG ZHUORUIWEI INTELLIGENT MFG CO LTD

title_en: High-fidelity reconstruction method and system for synchrotron radiation diffraction spectrum
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-fidelity reconstruction method and a high-fidelity reconstruction system for a synchrotron radiation diffraction spectrum. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a broadband light diffraction spectrum phi  pink  of a sample, extracting spectral intensity information characteristics, obtaining a monochromatic light diffraction spectrum phi  mono  of the sample, extracting spectral peak position information characteristics, inputting the extracted characteristics into a spectral information fusion network after splicing, wherein the spectral information fusion network comprises a plurality of multi-scale information fusion networks and a single-layer convolution network which are connected in cascade, each stage of multi-scale information fusion network firstly processes input data D into a plurality of characteristic images with different resolutions and respectively inputs the characteristic images into a spectrum sensitive attention network, carrying out characteristic extraction on the characteristic images output by each spectrum sensitive attention network after layer-by-layer aggregation, adding the characteristic E with the input data D, inputting the characteristic E into a next stage of multi-scale information fusion network, obtaining a characteristic F by the characteristic F output by the final stage of multi-scale information fusion network through the single-layer convolution network, and adding the characteristic F with phi  mono  to generate a predicted spectrum.

title_en: Electrical equipment remote monitoring and fault diagnosis system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention provides an electrical equipment remote monitoring and fault diagnosis system based on the Internet of things. According to the invention, a self-adaptive acquisition strategy is adopted through a multi-source heterogeneous sensor network, an edge computing node calculates a signal entropy value in real time, when abnormal chaotic signals are found, acquisition frequency is automatically improved, beidou grid code space labeling is started, a power frequency interference and environmental noise are separated by combining an attention mechanism of an LSTM-CNN hybrid network, a standardized vector is output, the problem that a traditional filtering algorithm is easy to lose fault characteristics is solved, a cloud server builds a device component fault graph model through a graph neural network, an improved message transfer algorithm is utilized to analyze node coupling relations, a device three-dimensional model and a signal propagation path reverse thrust algorithm are combined, accurate positioning of hidden faults such as transformer winding turn-to-turn short circuits is realized, a digital twin dynamic mapping device real-time state is realized, a maintenance knowledge graph generates three-dimensional visual maintenance guide based on monitoring evidence, and maintenance decision efficiency is remarkably improved.

title_en: Wind power soft direct delivery system hardware-in-the-loop equivalent modeling and simulation method and device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of new energy simulation, and discloses a method and a device for modeling and simulating the hardware-in-the-loop equivalent of a wind power system through flexible direct delivery, wherein the modeling method comprises the steps of modeling a converter of a wind power unit in a form of a switching function, performing equivalent modeling on a wind power station collecting wire based on a constant power loss principle, modeling an alternating current delivery circuit in a multi-pi cascade structure with multiple resistor and inductance parallel branches, modeling each bridge arm of a flexible direct current converter station in an average value model, modeling a receiving end power grid in a controlled voltage source and equivalent RLC impedance, and constructing a hardware-in-the-loop equivalent model of the wind power system through flexible direct delivery based on the modeling model. According to the invention, through respectively carrying out equivalent processing on each part, model simplification is carried out, simulation requirements are reduced, meanwhile, the simulation precision and accuracy of the whole system can still be ensured, and finally, the rapid and accurate simulation of wind power through the flexible direct current grid-connected system is realized, so that the real-time simulation requirement of hardware in the ring is met.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Time-based approaches in malware simulation for responsive measure deployment
abstract_en: A computer-implemented method of simulating the propagation of malware in a network is provided. The method comprises accessing a model of the network, where the model comprising a plurality of computer nodes and where each computer node of the plurality of computer nodes is connected to at least one edge of a plurality of edges. Each edge of the plurality of edges connects a pair of computer nodes of the plurality of computer nodes. The method further comprises initiating an outbreak of the malware in the model at a predetermined source computer node of the plurality of computer nodes, and propagating the malware through the model of the network from the source computer node over a plurality of step-times. The propagation is determined based on a rate of transmission per step-time for each edge, and each step-time of the plurality of step-times corresponds to a temporal point that is universal across the network, such that at each step-time the malware propagation through the network occurs simultaneously for each edge of the plurality of edges according to the rate of transmission per step-time for each edge.

title_en: Enhancements for minimization of service interruption
abstract_en: A user equipment (UE) is configured to identify a disaster condition applies to a first public land mobile network (PLMN), select a second PLMN for disaster roaming services, wherein one or more tracking areas (TAs) of the second PLMN are in a forbidden list stored locally at the UE and wherein the second PLMN and the first PLMN have a roaming agreement for disaster roaming services and register with the second PLMN for disaster roaming services in the one or more TAs of the second PLMN from the forbidden list.

title_en: A kind of wireless cognition network frequency spectrum access method based on two-stage poll
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of wireless cognition network frequency spectrum access method based on two-stage poll, the present invention is using two-stage polling system technology as core, to improve the availability of frequency spectrum, it is starting point to reduce user's frequency spectrum access delay, provide in cognition network after user access authorization frequency range, the preferential multiuser channel sharing policy of authorized user.Roll-call access control mode based on reservation can be prevented effectively from collision, for delay sensitive business in emergency communication, on the premise of authorized user's proper communication is ensured, only to there is the user of business demand to distribute channel, it is that cognitive user and authorized user provide QoS and ensured in terms of propagation delay time, network throughput.And sent using the information of the Method of Scheduling Parallel control cognitive user based on reservation, it can avoid conflicting and improving channel utilization, in addition, the fairness in channel between authorized user's priority and cognitive user can be effectively ensured using two-stage roll-call access control method.

title_en: Real-time forest fire spreading simulation method, fire extinguishing decision method and early warning system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a forest fire spreading real-time simulation method, a fire extinguishing decision method and an early warning system. The invention provides a forest fire spreading real-time simulation method, which comprises the steps of inputting topographic data (slope direction, gradient, combustible material type distribution) of a forest fire spreading simulation area, real-time wind direction and wind speed, building a grid network according to the topographic data, selecting the geographic position of a fire point, calculating the coordinates of the fire point in the grid network from the position of the fire point, performing spreading simulation in the grid network from the fire point, simulating the propulsion of a fire field range based on a shortest path algorithm and a boundary epitaxial extension method, obtaining the fire time of the grid network, and performing visual display according to the fire time of the grid network. Methods are then presented according to this propagation method to aid in direct and indirect fire extinguishing decisions, respectively. Finally, a forest fire spreading simulation and early warning system is provided based on the method, and an auxiliary decision function is provided for forest fire extinguishment.

title_en: Assembly line rapid reconstruction method based on forward modification network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid reconstruction method of an assembly line based on a forward modification network, which summarizes the multi-domain conduction principle of 'product similarity-system configuration similarity-system execution similarity' of a man-machine cooperation assembly line, and uses five dimensions of 'function-structure-behavior-execution-performance' to describe the physical and logical reconstruction connotation of the man-machine cooperation assembly line, comprehensively considers each layer of the assembly line, and improves the comprehensiveness and coordination of the whole design. In the flexible production line design process taking the production line rapid deformation design as a core, the optimal production line change scheme can be more scientifically and objectively selected by adopting a parameterized node network model and an alignment theory, and the time period from information induction to scheme implementation is shortened. And constructing a mathematical model with the change propagation risk, the change propagation time and the change propagation cost as comprehensive targets according to the actual production condition of enterprises, so as to realize fine management and cost optimization and reduce cost.

title_en: A method of the identification of fraud clique and Risk of Communication prediction based on complex network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of identification of fraud clique and Risk of Communication prediction technique based on complex network, comprising the following steps: obtain individual attribute；Determine the attribute value unique encodings of the body attribute and nonbody attribute；Data filtering；The data structure establishing storage and calculating；Connected graph is established, the body attribute value and nonbody attribute value are abstracted as node, the attaching relation of body attribute value and nonbody attribute value is abstracted as to the side for connecting the node, the node and side form connected graph；Illustraton of model is obtained according to the connected graph；According to the data structure computation model parameter；The identification of fraud clique and risk of fraud propagation forecast are carried out according to the model parameter.The present invention carries out hierarchical to illustraton of model according to the knowledge computation model parameter of graph theory, and according to known fraudulent user, to reach accurately identification fraud clique and prediction purpose that risk of fraud is propagated.
assignees: ZHONGAN ONLINE P&C INSURANCE CO LTD

title_en: A kind of pumping plant unit diagnostic method based on depth forest and oneself coding
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of based on depth forest and from the pumping plant unit diagnostic method of coding, is related to hydraulic fault diagnosis technology field.This method, Feature Conversion is carried out to the original vibration signal first with more granularities scanning of depth forest, then unsupervised feature learning is carried out from coding structure using multilayer, obtain the feature vector with fault signature, training step by step for supervision is carried out in the cascade forest of feature vector substitution depth forest described in finally obtaining with fault signature, final classification is obtained as a result, completing pumping plant unit intelligent diagnostics.Using depth forest model, deep neural network is avoided applied to the complicated theory analysis in fault diagnosis field, cumbersome tune ginseng process；Using multilayer from encoding, it is big to avoid dimension in cascade forest training, time-consuming big problem；The limitation of manual features extraction and the problem that shallow-layer machine learning diagnostic accuracy is low are avoided, the end-to-end intelligent trouble diagnosis from primary monitoring data is realized.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: High-voltage cascade energy storage device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-voltage cascade energy storage device which comprises a high-voltage switch station cabinet, an incoming line cabinet, a starting cabinet, a reactance cabinet, an energy storage container, an EMS monitoring cabinet and a PCS main control cabinet, wherein an energy storage system, a PSC cabinet, a fire-fighting cabinet and a ventilation system for ventilating and radiating the container are arranged in the energy storage container, the energy storage container is connected with the EMS monitoring cabinet and the PSC main control cabinet after passing through the respective PCS cabinet, a plurality of energy storage containers are connected with the power storage container through the starting cabinet and the incoming line cabinet switch station cabinet at 10KV bus side after passing through the reactance cabinet, and a fireproof isolation wall is arranged among the energy storage containers. The energy storage container disclosed by the invention is designed with various ventilation structures, the problem of uneven heat dissipation of the battery pack in the container is solved, a certain number of energy storage units are connected in series at the alternating current side, and a 10kV power grid is directly connected without a transformer, so that the dispatching performance of a large-scale energy storage power station is improved.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD JIAXING POWER SUPPLY CO;JIAXING HENGCHUANG ELECTRIC POWER DESIGN AND RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Typhoon disaster power distribution network tower fault prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for predicting faults of a power distribution network tower in typhoon disasters, wherein real-time collected meteorological station data are input into a trained power distribution network tower fault prediction model based on a BP (back propagation) neural network, so that an output result of the neural network is obtained, and whether the tower has a trip fault or not is predicted; the training sample of the power distribution network tower fault prediction model based on the BP neural network comprises the following steps: selecting partial fault and non-fault samples from the new fault sample set and the non-fault sample set; the new fault sample set is formed by oversampling an original fault sample by adopting an SMOTE method; the new non-fault sample set is formed by undersampling the original non-fault sample by adopting an OSS method; the method can accurately predict the fault tripping of the power distribution network tower in the typhoon disaster occurrence process, can provide reference for typhoon disaster defense such as first-aid repair material allocation, rapid first-aid repair after failure and the like, and has certain theoretical value and engineering value.
assignees: NARI TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;NARI GROUP CORP;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Aero-engine multiple fault diagnosis device based on self-association neural network
abstract_en: The invention provides an aeroengine multiple fault diagnostor based on an auto-associative neural network, which comprises eight auto-associative neural networks; searching an optimal self-association neural network structure by the eight self-association neural networks according to the standard which is closest to the input and has the best noise reduction performance, and then keeping the structure to adjust the weight of the network according to the simulation data of the normal model and the fault model and the improved back propagation algorithm; and judging the fault condition of the engine according to the relation between the residual error and the set threshold value. The invention can effectively diagnose and isolate faults of the aircraft engine, can diagnose and isolate faults of a single component and faults of a plurality of sensors at the same time, can effectively avoid economic loss caused by the reasons of flying stop and the like, and can avoid unnecessary component replacement; the engine can be effectively ensured to have higher stability and reliability, the safe operation of the engine is ensured, the performance of the engine is fully exerted, and the safety and the performance of the airplane are improved.

title_en: Explosion diameter inversion method based on transient flow
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for realizing the inversion of the diameter of a burst pipe, in order to realize the location of the burst pipe in a pipe network, a high-frequency SCADA system is applied to monitor a pressure abnormal signal in the pipe network, and on the basis of the location of the burst pipe, a total monitoring signal is decomposed into branch monitoring signals from each propagation path according to the propagation characteristics of transient flow; inverting the propagation path and characteristics of the transient flow, namely taking the reciprocal of the local loss and the frictional resistance loss in the original propagation process to obtain gain, inverting the excitation signals from each path, and superposing the excitation signals to form a total inversion excitation signal; and according to the relation between the detonation excitation signal and the detonation diameter, the excitation signal takes the maximum amplitude, the detonation diameter takes the maximum value, and the detonation diameter is calculated. The comparison of the diameter of the detonation calculated by the method with the actual diameter of the detonation and the instantaneous flow attenuation method proves that the positioning precision of the method is higher, and the method can effectively solve the problem of the diameter inversion of the detonation.

title_en: Multi-provincial power grid weekly operation planning method
abstract_en: The application relates to a multi-provincial power grid weekly operation planning method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring boundary data for calculating the operation period of the power grid; creating a long-period optimized scheduling model according to the boundary data, and obtaining day boundary data of a future week through the long-period optimized scheduling model; and performing multi-day rolling optimization calculation on the day boundary data of the next week to obtain a daily power generation and transmission plan. Compared with the prior art, the method and the device can divide the problem of the work-out of the power grid weekly operation plan into two processes of long-period unified optimization calculation and multi-day rolling optimization calculation, and differential modeling is adopted in a long-period unified optimization model and a day-ahead optimization scheduling model, so that the accuracy and the solving efficiency of the model are ensured, the feasibility and the safety of the multi-provincial power grid operation considering cascade hydropower are improved, and the actual application requirements are met.
assignees: CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO

title_en: Neural network-based prediction method for basic electricity charge of large industrial power
abstract_en: The invention discloses a neural network-based prediction method for basic electricity charge of large industrial power, which comprises the following steps of: (1) firstly, carrying out statistical preprocessing on historical electric load data of an enterprise; (2) secondly, carrying out normalization processing on the load data, and converting the load data into an input vector on a [0,1] interval; (3) then, an error back propagation algorithm neural network model is constructed according to the input vector and the required output vector; (4) after the training and the test are finished, putting the test into use, selecting the maximum value of the output result and carrying out normalization reduction; (5) and converting the predicted load value into a predicted value of the basic electricity fee of the demand. The neural network has a three-layer structure, 12 input layer neurons, 25 intermediate layer neurons, and 12 output layer neurons. After the basic electric charge is predicted through the neural network, the enterprise can reasonably select the payment mode of the basic electric charge, so that the electric charge expense is effectively reduced, and the production cost is reduced. The method has the advantages of high prediction accuracy, good stability and the like.
assignees: BEIJING GUIKE WEIDA ELECTRIC POWER ENERGY SAVING SCIENCE AND TECH LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Simulation method for simulating cascading failure state of power grid under typhoon disaster effect
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulation method for simulating a power grid cascading failure state under the typhoon disaster action, which comprises the steps of firstly establishing a circulating wind field model and a traveling wind field model of typhoon according to a typhoon data set, then establishing a typhoon space-time distribution model, then drawing a power grid element vulnerability curve to obtain the damage probability of the power grid element under different wind speeds, abstracting a working state set of the power grid element into a Markov state, and constructing a state transfer model of a power system to generate a failure power grid element set of the power system at different moments under the typhoon action; the invention considers the space-time characteristics of typhoon disasters, combines the vulnerability analysis of power grid elements, provides a power grid fault sampling simulation method, can realize the real-time prediction of the fault state of each element and partition of the power grid, accurately simulates the influence of extreme typhoons on the power grid, provides an effective reference basis for the normal operation and the real-time maintenance of the power grid in disasters, and is suitable for wide popularization and use.
assignees: STATE GRID ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD;UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Reservoir group multi-energy complementary scheduling method and system for coping with uncertainty of new energy
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reservoir group multi-energy complementary scheduling method and system for coping with uncertainty of new energy. Comprising the following steps: firstly, collecting a long-sequence scene set of the historical output and the predicted output of new energy, and accordingly generating a future actual output expected scene on the basis of analyzing the output error of the new energy; secondly, constructing a scheduling model which is integrated with decision variables, objective functions, constraint conditions and the like of the coupling cascade hydropower station and the new energy output scene; then, according to hydropower station water regime information and new energy output situations, a high-performance self-adaptive group evolution algorithm is adopted for solving, and a multi-energy complementary scheduling scheme meeting operation requirements is rapidly obtained; and finally, continuously updating the new energy history prediction and actual output database to form a long-term and rolling multi-energy complementary scheduling scheme decision system. The method can comprehensively consider the uncertainty factor of the new energy, improve the reliability of the multi-energy complementary scheduling scheme of the cascade reservoir group, reduce the running risk of the power grid and has remarkable comprehensive benefit.

title_en: Cascading failure blocking control method and system considering source-network-load coordination
abstract_en: The invention relates to a cascading failure blocking control method and system considering source-network-load coordination, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the space-time characteristics of element fault cascade evolution are considered, an overload leading type cascading failure simulation model is established, a failure chain is generated, and a power failure risk index is calculated; calculating time-risk comprehensive importance indexes by considering the system fault reaction capacity and coping cost performance, and determining the optimal input position of the blocking control strategy in fault development; respectively considering the rapid and flexible network topology switching characteristics and the load grading characteristics of the climbing of the gas turbine unit at the source, network and load sides, constructing a blocking control model based on source-network-load joint adjustment, and solving to obtain an optimal blocking control strategy; and controlling the power transmission network based on the optimal input position and the optimal blocking control strategy. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages of effectively relieving the power failure risk of the cascading failure, obviously improving the economical efficiency and reliability of blocking control, and the like.

title_en: Electric power network robustness prediction method based on improved BP neural network
abstract_en: The invention provides a power network robustness prediction method based on an improved BP neural network, which comprises the following steps of; step one, acquiring system operation data, selecting and further abstracting fields affecting system robustness, and calculating to obtain corresponding index data reflecting an index evaluation system; and secondly, optimizing the weight and the threshold of the BP neural network by using a chaotic mapping self-adaptive whale optimizing algorithm CA-WOA. To find the initial parameters with better training effect; step three, after the parameters transmitted by the CA-WOA are received, the BP neural network is further adjusted by adopting forward propagation and backward propagation so as to achieve a better training effect, and finally, a predicted value of robustness of the power dispatching data network is obtained; the invention uses the chaotic mapping self-adaptive weight whale optimization algorithm to optimize the neural network training and complete the prediction work of the robustness of the power dispatching data network; a set of feasible solutions is provided for power network robustness prediction research.
assignees: UNIV FUZHOU;GREAT POWER SCIENCE AND TECH STOCK CO LTD STATE GRID INFORMATION & TELECOMMUNICATION CORPORATION

title_en: Power system operation mode identification method, system and medium based on data driving
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system and a medium for identifying an operation mode of an electric power system based on data driving, which comprise the following steps: acquiring time sequence production operation data in a preset historical time period of the power system; inputting the time sequence production operation data into an improved neighbor propagation clustering model for clustering to obtain an operation mode clustering result; selecting key influencing factors representing the characteristics of the load sequence and taking the key influencing factors as time sequence load characteristics; according to the time sequence load characteristics, predicting to obtain a prediction result; calculating total daily load, daily load rate and peak-valley difference of the daily load corresponding to the target date according to the prediction result, and taking the total daily load, the daily load rate and the peak-valley difference of the daily load as daily load characteristics; and based on the mapping relation between the daily load characteristics and the typical operation mode labels, establishing a future power grid operation mode identification model, and carrying out future typical operation mode identification. The method can well overcome the defect that the typical operation mode is formulated based on experience, and can accurately analyze and identify the typical operation mode of the power grid.
assignees: UNIV SICHUAN;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER CORP;STATE GRID SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Hydropower cluster division method suitable for hydropower enrichment power grid power dispatching
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydropower cluster division method suitable for power dispatching of a hydropower enrichment power grid. The method comprises the following steps: dividing the scale of the hydropower station to obtain hydropower station scale data; dividing the adjustment capacity of the hydropower station to obtain hydropower station adjustment capacity data; carrying out three-level cluster division on the hydropower station to obtain third-level cluster data of the hydropower station; acquiring a hydraulic topology structure diagram with installation scale attributes and adjustment capability attributes; and obtaining a final hydropower cluster division result, and calculating the power generation capacity of the hydropower cluster according to the final hydropower cluster division result. The method is suitable for not only serial cascade hydropower station clusters, but also cross-basin cascade hydropower station clusters developed in parallel, and comprehensively considers the attribute of the power section, the attribute of the dispatching main body, the attribute of the investment main body, the attribute of the regulation, the attribute of the hydraulic connection and the attribute of the installation scale of the hydropower station, and is more suitable for dividing hydropower clusters of the electric power dispatching of the hydropower enrichment power grid.

title_en: Intelligent emergency disposal method for hydrogen leakage explosion accident of hydrogen adding station
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of safety emergency treatment of a hydrogenation station, and discloses an intelligent emergency treatment method for hydrogen leakage explosion accidents of the hydrogenation station, which is realized by constructing an intelligent emergency response system and combining an accident domino effect network evolution model; the method comprises the following steps of accident evolution analysis, intelligent auxiliary decision making, emergency resource allocation, real-time monitoring and feedback. The intelligent algorithm based on real-time data analysis, simulated evolution and risk assessment automatically generates an optimal emergency treatment strategy, provides decision support for emergency commanders, ensures quick and accurate decision, can accurately extract the risk factor most prone to secondary accidents, avoids emergency response temporarily in the accident process, improves predictability and timeliness of accident control, and reduces personnel, property loss and influence to the greatest extent.
assignees: SHAANXI COAL NEW ENERGY TECH CO LTD;SHAANXI COAL INDUSTRY XINNENG HYDROGEN ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Oil-gas pipe network running state risk perception early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a risk perception early warning method and a system for the running state of an oil-gas pipe network, wherein the method comprises the steps of fusing multidimensional features of the running state of the pipe network according to real-time running data of the oil-gas pipe network to generate a space-time feature matrix; the method comprises the steps of inputting a space-time feature matrix into a deep Gaussian process model, carrying out probabilistic modeling on abnormal features in the running state of a pipe network, outputting a risk feature vector with confidence, constructing a three-dimensional risk concentration distribution field according to the risk feature vector, predicting the propagation path and the diffusion trend of the risk concentration distribution field, constructing a self-adaptive early warning threshold generation model based on the generation of an countermeasure network aiming at a prediction result, generating a multi-level early warning threshold changing along with the running state of the pipe network, and realizing risk perception early warning of the running state of the oil-gas pipe network according to the comparison result of the real-time risk feature and the early warning threshold. By utilizing the embodiment of the invention, dynamic risk assessment and self-adaptive early warning can be realized, and the safety and emergency response capability of the pipe network are enhanced.
assignees: JIAXING YAHANG INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Cable bridge fault diagnosis method based on sensor network and related equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a cable bridge fault diagnosis method and related equipment based on a sensing network, which comprises the following steps of carrying out vibration monitoring on a cable bridge to obtain dynamic response data, obtaining an abnormal vibration time period sequence through time window segmentation and abnormal identification, tracking a vibration propagation path according to the abnormal vibration time period sequence, positioning a fault source region, generating a bridge weak link distribution map by combining structural stress concentration analysis, carrying out fault grade judgment according to the map, and outputting maintenance decision advice, thereby solving the technical problems that most schemes still stay in a static parameter acquisition stage, lack an effective analysis mechanism for dynamic vibration response, and are difficult to accurately identify the occurrence position and evolution trend of bridge abnormal behavior.
assignees: FOSHAN CHANCHENG HUANQIU ELECTRIC PORCELAIN ELECTRICAL APPLIANCE MAT CO LTD

title_en: Multistage scheduling method considering cascade hydroelectric layering optimization and flexibility constraint
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multistage scheduling method considering hierarchical hydropower layered optimization and flexibility constraint, which mainly comprises the steps of 1, generating a multi-path uncertainty scene by combining Latin hypercube sampling based on a joint probability prediction model of a bidirectional time convolution network-a bidirectional long-short term memory-attention mechanism and Gaussian process regression, 2, constructing a middle-term scheduling model, generating through adjusting structure identification and capability boundary, describing an adjustable section of a system, 3, designing a decoupling type multi-target daily scheduling model, introducing a structure tag to identify an adjusting path form, 4, constructing a confidence domain rolling scheduling model, embedding a seasonal tag mechanism to realize dynamic correction, 5, establishing a cross-stage feedback mechanism, adjusting a linkage middle-term and daily path, and uniformly constraining an expression structure. The method has the beneficial effects that the adjustment capability, the operation stability and the resource cooperative efficiency of the multi-energy system under uncertain scenes are remarkably improved.

title_en: Intelligent management method for electric power marketing archives
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent management method of an electric power marketing archive, which comprises the steps of receiving archive data through an electric power data acquisition interface, identifying an electric price feature code in a matched archive based on a real-time electric price policy, injecting a version calibration mark into unmatched data, constructing an electric power consumption anomaly prediction model based on a user historical load mode and an environment factor, generating a dynamic illegal gold parameter based on a user behavior portrait and a rule base when responding to a query request, generating a quantum key distribution path based on a power grid topological structure, implementing cascade encryption along a physical connection node, dynamically associating user operation authorities with a power grid operation risk signal, automatically disabling core operation in a high risk state, analyzing the archive data in a safe isolation environment, driving line loss optimization, electric charge tracing and fault pre-judging service flow in real time, and updating the archive based on service output. The invention improves the safety, reliability and operation efficiency of the power marketing archive management.
assignees: DIGITAL RES BRANCH OF INNER MONGOLIA POWER GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Power consumption management peak avoidance method based on multi-objective planning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power system management and discloses a power management peak avoidance method based on multi-objective planning, which comprises the steps of constructing a power system heterogeneous graph network structure, defining an uncertainty characterization model on the graph structure, constructing an uncertainty propagation dynamics model, realizing an uncertainty propagation algorithm perceived by the graph structure, constructing a robust optimization framework perceived by the graph structure, realizing a multi-level risk partition management strategy and finding out an uncertainty complementation effect.
assignees: XIAN GUANGLIN HUIZHI ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Low-altitude economy oriented vertical take-off and landing facility unmanned aerial vehicle image location method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a low-altitude economy oriented image location method and system for a vertical take-off and landing facility unmanned aerial vehicle, and belongs to the technical field of image data processing and modeling. According to the method, oblique photogrammetry and laser radar scanning are carried out on a building roof through an unmanned plane to obtain high-overlapping-rate image and laser point cloud data, a live-action three-dimensional grid model and an obstacle surface three-dimensional model are constructed after pretreatment, a preliminary layout scheme is screened according to the clearance height of a roof available area based on the model, then airspace safety simulation and noise propagation simulation are carried out on each scheme, a minimum interval distance and noise intensity distribution diagram is calculated, and a final site selection scheme is screened according to airspace safety and noise constraint. The invention realizes the automation and the accurate site selection of the vertical take-off and landing facilities in the complex roof environment.
assignees: SHANGHAI RUIQIAO CIVIL ENG CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Construction environment abrupt change risk field prediction method fusing geological meteorological data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a construction environment abrupt change risk field prediction method for fusing geological meteorological data, which belongs to the technical field of construction engineering risk prediction and comprises the steps of obtaining geological data, meteorological data and construction progress data of a construction area, and generating graph data containing multi-modal characteristics after structuring the multi-modal heterogeneous data. The invention adopts the space-time self-adaptive graph neural network prediction model based on the attention mechanism, can dynamically calculate and distribute weights of different characteristics according to the real-time environment and construction data, and captures the space-time propagation relationship of risks among geographic nodes by utilizing the message transmission mechanism of the graph. The method can deeply fuse data of different modes, realizes accurate prediction of abrupt change risk of construction environment, triggers corresponding early warning according to the risk level, improves the accuracy and timeliness of risk prediction, and provides scientific support for intelligent decision of construction engineering.
assignees: BEIJING HUALIAN ELECTRIC POWER ENG CONSULTING CO LTD;ENGINEERING MAN BRANCH OF STATE GRID JIBEI ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY LIMITED;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Forestry environment monitoring system for fire alarm
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of forest fire alarm, and discloses a forest environment monitoring system for fire alarm. The environment sensing module of the system acquires multidimensional environment parameters of a forest area in real time by means of a distributed sensor network. The fire risk feature extraction module performs multi-scale feature fusion on the parameters, extracts key fire risk features and generates a three-dimensional fire risk feature tensor. The fire propagation deduction module builds a fire propagation dynamics model according to the forest land topography digital elevation model and the historical fire data, and inputs a fire characteristic tensor to calculate a fire diffusion rate and a direction angle. The monitoring strategy optimization module dynamically adjusts the sampling frequency and the space density of the sensor according to the fire diffusion rate, and enables an infrared spectrum scanning mode for a high diffusion rate region. And when the fire spreading rate exceeds a preset threshold value, the emergency response triggering module generates a multi-level linkage control instruction set comprising unmanned aerial vehicle routing inspection path planning and fire-proof isolation belt activation schemes.
assignees: RIZHAO CHAOLI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD;Jinan State owned Liubu Forest Farm

title_en: Temperature-tide security domain mapping-based two-stage planning method for power grid side energy storage under sea-wind access scene
abstract_en: The invention relates to a two-stage site selection and volume determination method for power grid side energy storage under a sea wind access scene considering temperature influence on a tide security domain, which comprises the steps of adopting a temperature trend prediction model combining LSTM and TCN; the method comprises the steps of calculating a temperature variable capacity expected coefficient by adopting a Gaussian mixture model, reconstructing a tide security domain, adopting a typical source-holiday track clustering method, establishing a random optimization scene set of source-load space-time coupling, establishing a power distribution network energy storage, locating and capacity-fixing planning layer model with the maximum comprehensive effect as a target, establishing a power distribution network energy storage, locating and capacity-fixing operation layer model with the minimum voltage fluctuation square sum as a target, establishing a DistFlow multi-period optimal tide model under a sea wind access scene, solving the planning layer by adopting second order cone relaxation, and carrying out secondary optimization charge-discharge and capacity configuration strategy by adopting a target cascade algorithm on the basis of an anchor planning layer locating and capacity-fixing decision variable by the operation layer. The method can be used for effectively collaborative planning and operation targets and realizing comprehensive optimal configuration of energy storage at the power grid side.

title_en: Cognitive scoring of asset risk based on predictive propagation of security-related events
abstract_en: A method (and system) of scoring asset risk includes determining, using a processor, a risk value for each entity of a plurality of entities within a network and ranking each risk value.

title_en: Oracle RAC database disaster recovery switching drilling method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an Oracle RAC database disaster recovery switching drilling method, which comprises the following steps: s1) firstly, carrying out early-stage preparation check on the data synchronization condition between production and disaster recovery databases, the database backup execution condition, the key parameters of the databases related to switching, the database monitoring ports and the disaster recovery network state; s2), checking preparation before switching, and terminating subsequent planning if the switching condition cannot be met; s3) executing role switching between the production library and the disaster recovery library; s4) service checking and operation after switching; s5), providing service through disaster recovery system, if need to do switch-back test, continuing to prepare before switch-back, judging to meet switch-back condition, then making database role switch-back, and making service check and operation after switch-back. The invention can ensure that the production and disaster recovery databases can be normally switched during the disaster recovery drilling, reduce the service interruption time and avoid various error problems which are easy to occur in the disaster recovery drilling process.

title_en: Urban rail transit epidemic propagation risk quantitative evaluation method and system
