abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for quantitatively evaluating urban rail transit epidemic propagation risks, which comprise the following steps: taking each urban rail transit station as a center, acquiring cell distribution data of peripheral traffic hubs, hospitals and confirmed or suspected cases; calculating station-level epidemic propagation risks of all stations according to the passenger flow congestion degree of urban rail transit stations, distribution data of peripheral traffic hubs, hospitals and districts with confirmed or suspected cases and corresponding input risk values; calculating the line level epidemic propagation risk passing through each station according to the station level epidemic propagation risk of each station; and calculating the overall network epidemic propagation risk of the rail transit line according to the station level epidemic propagation risk of each station. The invention comprehensively considers factors such as land property and passenger flow scale around the site, establishes a dynamic quantitative evaluation method for the propagation risk of the point-line-network multi-level integrated urban rail transit system, and provides quantitative basis for the refined and normalized epidemic situation prevention and control.

title_en: Analysis method for fault propagation of urban rail train system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a method for analyzing fault propagation of a urban rail train system based on a disaster propagation dynamic model, which comprises the following steps: step S110, constructing a topology network model of a urban rail train system; step S120, dividing a network community structure for the urban rail train system according to a topological network model of the urban rail train system; step S130, determining service life distribution and fault probability of each node in a topological network of the urban rail train system; step S140: and constructing a fault propagation model of the urban rail train system based on the disaster propagation dynamics model by combining the network community structure of the urban rail train system and the fault probability of the nodes, and analyzing the possible fault propagation state of the urban rail train system.

title_en: SAR image change detection method based on mixed convolution
abstract_en: The invention discloses a SAR image change detection method based on mixed convolution, which mainly solves the problems that the prior art is difficult to extract global information of an image and a reliable label training network is lacked under the condition of no labeling label, and the method comprises the following steps of constructing three-channel input and initial labels; building a graph convolution enhanced convolution network GECN formed by cascading a feature extraction module, a progressive fusion module and a label updating module, training by using three channel input and label pairs GECN, and inputting tested SAR images to a trained GECN to obtain a change detection result. The method and the device acquire the multiscale characteristics of local and global information of the SAR image through the characteristic extraction module, improve the characteristic extraction capability of GECN networks, acquire more reliable tag training GECN networks through the tag updating module, improve the generalization performance of GECN networks, and can be used for urban planning layout, natural disaster assessment and military dynamic reconnaissance.

title_en: Three-dimensional earthquake simulation method based on residual Fourier neural operator
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional earthquake simulation method based on a residual Fourier neural operator. A data-driven deep learning seismic wavefield simulation technique embedded in physics is presented. The method embeds a fourier wave propagation operator structure into a convolutional neural network structure, alternately performing wave propagation simulation in a spatial domain and a wave number domain. Because the network structure conforming to the wave field propagation mode is adopted, and the wave field propagation mechanism implicit in the data can be automatically satisfied, the method greatly improves the efficiency of the deep learning earthquake simulation method, reduces the requirement of the deep learning earthquake simulation method on the training data quantity and the training time, and can strengthen the generalization performance of the deep learning model. Compared with the classical finite difference numerical solution, the method has higher operation efficiency, occupies less storage space, is not constrained by the size of the space grid and the time step, and is more suitable for the seismic wave simulation requirement of large-range high-frequency complex medium.

title_en: Foam injection system for extinguishing fires and preventing smoke propagation in case of tunnel fires
title_ko: 터널 화재시 질식소화 및 연기전파 방지를 위한 발포폼 분사 시스템
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 터널 화재시 질식소화 및 연기전파 방지를 위한 발포폼 분사 시스템에 관한 것으로; 터널 안의 화재발생 유무를 감지하는 화재감지수단과, 발포제와 물을 일정비율로 혼합하는 혼합기와, 상기 발포제와 물의 혼합반응에 의해 발생되는 발포폼을 배출하되 터널에 설치되는 발포폼 분사노즐과, 상기 발포폼 분사노즐로의 발포폼을 강제이송하는 이송펌프와, 상기 화재감지수단을 통해 화재감지신호가 입력되면 상기 혼합기와 이송펌프를 구동하여 상기 발포폼 분사노즐로 발포폼을 배출하도록 제어하는 제어기로 구성되는 것을 특징으로 한다.  
본 발명에 따르면, 터널 내에서 밀폐공간을 형성하여 질식소화를 유도함에 따라 A급인 일반화재, B급인 유류화재, C급인 전기화재 이외에 금속화재 가스화재 등을 모두 소화할 수 있음은 물론, 밀폐공간을 형성함에 따라 화재연기 및 온도 전파 발생이 적이 터널내 시설물 피해를 최소화할 수 있다. 특히, 본 발명은 터널의 개방된 공간에서는 화재지점의 양측을 완전 밀폐하여 질식소화를 유도하고, 완전밀폐가 불가능한 지역은 제연경계벽을 형성할 수 있도록 운영함으로써 인명과 재산피해를 최소화할 수 있다.

title_en: Disaster indoor communication system having function of providing position information and the communication method thereof
title_ko: 위치정보 제공 기능을 구비한 실내 재난 통신 시스템 및 실내 재난 통신 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an indoor disaster communication system having a function of providing location information and an indoor disaster communication method therefor, which enable indoor disaster communication to be performed without disconnection even when a disaster, such as sinking, fire, or the like, occurs in a structure, such as a ship, building, or the like, having a complicated internal structure. The indoor disaster communication system having a function of providing location information comprises: a wireless network unit which includes a plurality of wireless network nodes configured to perform communication by selectively using radio wave communication and sound wave communication so that a communication method is changed into sound wave communication when sinking occurs during performance of the radio wave communication, and which provides local area communication service within a structure; a location identification unit which includes location information transmitters each configured to be installed within the structure and to transmit location identification information for location identification when a user terminal is disposed within a preset range from a corresponding location information transmitter; a user terminal which transmits the location identification information to a disaster management server after receiving the location identification information, and in which a disaster management application, configured to output a location transmitted by the disaster management server in response to the location identification information, is installed; and the disaster management server which provides a location information provision service. In this case, the location information provision service extracts information about a location at which a location information transmitter corresponding to the received location identification information has been installed within the structure after the location identification information has been received from the user terminal and transmits the information about the location to the user terminal, or the location information provision service computes a location of the user terminal and transmits the computed location to the user terminal.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 선박 또는 건물 등의 복잡한 실내 구조를 가지는 구조물의 침몰, 화재 등의 재난 상황에서도 통신의 단절 없이 실내에서의 재난 통신을 수행할 수 있도록 하는 위치정보 제공 기능을 구비한 실내 재난 통신 시스템 및 실내 재난 통신 방법에 관한 것으로, 상기 위치정보 제공 기능을 구비한 실내 재난 통신 시스템은, 무선전파통신을 수행하는 과정 중 침수가 발생한 경우 음파통신으로 통신을 변경하도록 무선전파통신과 음파통신을 선택적으로 수행하는 다수의 무선네트워크노드들을 구비하여 구조물 내에서의 로컬영역 통신서비스를 제공하는 무선네트워크부; 상기 구조물 내에 설치되어 사용자 단말기가 기 설정 거리 내로 인접되는 경우 위치식별을 위한 위치식별정보를 송출하는 위치정보송신기들로 구성되는 위치식별부; 상기 위치식별정보를 수신한 후 재난관리서버로 전송하고, 재난관리서버에서 송신된 상기 위치식별정보 대응 위치를 출력하는 재난관리앱이 탑재되는 사용자 단말기; 및 상기 사용자단말기로부터 상기 위치식별정보를 수신한 후 수신된 위치식별정보에 대응하는 상기 구조물 실내의 위치정보송신기 설치 위치 정보를 추출하여 상기 사용자 단말기로 전송하거나 상기 사용자 단말기의 위치를 연산하여 상기 사용자 단말기로 전송하는 위치정보 제공서비스를 제공하는 재난관리서버;를 포함한다.

title_en: Methods, apparatus, and systems using closed access group (CAG) support in minimization of service interruptions (MINT)
abstract_en: Methods, apparatus, and systems are disclosed. A method, implemented by a Wireless Transmit/Receive Unit (WTRU) may use a first Public Land Mobile Network (PLMN) not affected by a disaster condition and a second PLMN affected by a disaster condition. The method may include: receiving from a CAG cell of the first PLMN, broadcast information indicating: (1) that the CAG cell supports disaster inbound roaming (DIR) of WTRUs associated with the second PLMN and (2) that the CAG Cell accepts CAG-supporting disaster inbound roamers; selecting the CAG cell of the first PLMN based on the broadcasted information; and sending a Registration Request message including information indicating a DIR indication and an identifier of the second PLMN. The method may further include receiving new CAG information associated with the first PLMN; and initiating a cell (re)selection procedure using the new CAG information associated with the first PLMN.

title_en: A kind of comprehensive energy is provided multiple forms of energy to complement each other the gridding coordinated planning method of system
abstract_en: A kind of gridding coordinated planning method for system of being provided multiple forms of energy to complement each other the present invention relates to comprehensive energy, comprises the following steps：Obtain power network present situation and energy resources utilize conditional information；Demonstration area grid Preliminary division and load and comprehensive energy requirement forecasting, GIS-Geographic Information System mesh generation revision of option；Constraints and space truss project principle are formulated, builds comprehensive energy cooperative development basic model, set objectives rack coordinated planning scheme；Each forcasted years and distant view year target net scheme is formulated, carries out comprehensive energy collaborative planning operation management service platform construction；Carry out assessment of economic benefit, propose demonstration area power distribution network synthesis energy cooperative development operational mode.The present invention is more scientifically and rationally planned garden, the more excellent scheme of integrated energy planning can be obtained, coordinated planning is carried out using the gridding method of GIS-Geographic Information System, realizes energy interaction and cascade utilization, peak load regulation network pressure is reduced, improves the digestion capability to clean energy resource.
assignees: GRID PLANNING RES CENTER OF GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD;GUANGDONG POWER GRID DEVELOPMENT RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Method, device and equipment for quantitatively evaluating risks of cascading failures of power grid
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method, a device and equipment for quantitatively evaluating risks of power grid cascading failures, belonging to the technical field of risk evaluation of power systems, wherein the method, the device and the equipment obtain risk factor data of target power grid cascading failures, and the risk factor data comprises the following steps: grid structure, target power grid power supply structure and target power grid overall tide distribution information; determining the occurrence probability of each risk factor and the grade of the consequences generated after the cascading failure occurs based on a preset model and risk factor data; according to the occurrence probability of each risk factor and the grade of the consequences generated after the cascading failure occurs, quantitative evaluation is performed on the risk of the target grid cascading failure, so that the risk of the grid cascading failure is evaluated, early warning is performed on the risk, loss is reduced, and the problem to be solved urgently in the prior art is solved.
assignees: POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL BRANCH OF INNER MONGOLIA POWER GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Electric power material emergency supply prediction method based on dynamic network link
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of computers, and particularly relates to a power material emergency supply prediction method based on dynamic network link. The method is based on encoding discrete historical data of a supply chain network, based on time sequence state characteristics and graph structure characteristics of dynamic network links, the time sequence states of nodes are updated through a plurality of historical interaction increments, and tasks of dynamic link prediction are completed by combining graph structure information generation node representation, so that all processes from alignment cascade processing of the features, feature fusion and dynamic node embedding generation to dynamic network link prediction are realized, and supply and demand relation changes of electric power materials under the condition that emergency possibly occurs in the future can be predicted.
assignees: MAT COMPANY OF STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Heterogeneous monitoring data fusion method in photovoltaic power station based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deep learning-based heterogeneous monitoring data fusion method in a photovoltaic power station, which comprises the following steps of 1, obtaining system operation data of the photovoltaic power station system and various heterogeneous monitoring data in the power station, deleting erroneous data in the system operation data, carrying out denoising treatment, 2, carrying out variance automatic weighting treatment on the various heterogeneous monitoring data in the power station, carrying out weight adjustment on the various heterogeneous monitoring data according to the importance of the monitoring data, and 3, inputting the processed various heterogeneous monitoring data into a deep learning algorithm LSTM circulating neural network according to the front-back sequence, training a loss function in the deep learning algorithm, and then setting network parameter setting in the LSTM circulating neural network by using back propagation, so as to obtain a deep learning model for data fusion.
assignees: CHINA YANGTZE POWER CO LTD;CHANGDIAN XINNENG CO LTD;NANJING NARI RELAYS ENG TECH

title_en: Enterprise digital management method and system based on data mining
abstract_en: The invention discloses an enterprise digital management method based on data mining, which comprises the steps of obtaining information flow data and resource allocation data, analyzing according to the information flow data and the resource allocation data to obtain an initial network diagram, carrying out cluster analysis according to the initial network diagram, carrying out path optimization to obtain a dynamic network diagram, carrying out feature extraction on the dynamic network diagram to obtain predictive analysis data, identifying nodes of a network according to the dynamic network diagram and the predictive analysis data to obtain key nodes and high risk nodes, combining the key nodes and the high risk nodes, identifying key propagation paths to obtain key propagation paths, predicting key positions where resource bottlenecks and conflicts occur based on the key nodes, the high risk nodes and the key propagation paths, and generating resource optimization suggestions. The method can identify the dynamic change of the implicit dependency of the enterprise, locate the high-risk nodes and the key propagation paths, and optimize the resource allocation.
assignees: BEIJING BEIWEI SANSHIDU NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for identifying generation and influence of sudden natural disaster fault scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for identifying generation and influence of sudden natural disaster fault scenes, belonging to the technical field of disaster risk assessment and toughness modeling of an electric power system; the method comprises the steps of calculating damage probability of each node by combining with the geographical coordinates of the nodes, generating an initial fault set by using a Monte Carlo sampling method, defining a node state vector, performing fault cascade propagation simulation until the node state vector reaches a stable state, respectively identifying an electric power failure area, a communication uncontrolled area and a traffic blocking area, and outputting the initial fault set, the stable state and the three areas together as simulated disaster scene samples to finish identification. The invention solves the problems of difficult multi-network cascade fault propagation and system interruption identification under the influence of complex disasters, supports the automatic generation of samples and the accurate identification of disaster influence areas, provides data support for the follow-up, and can be used for the evaluation of multi-network fusion and resource scheduling.

title_en: Rainy season forest coverage area monitoring serialization method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of monitoring geological disasters of covered areas of rainy seasons, and provides a rainy season forest covered area monitoring serialization method based on deep learning, which aims at solving the problems that radar interference images of rainy seasons are difficult to obtain effectively and slope risk monitoring is easy to break, the method superimposes topography and water system to define a slope area and a management partition, utilizes the interference images of the dry seasons to extract abnormal areas and form an area deformation mode, associates slope according to the coverage proportion and the water flow relation, the method comprises the steps of constructing a layered causal network consisting of slope surfaces, observation and driving factor nodes, establishing a time updating model taking a deformation mode as a priori, determining time response based on satellite positioning monitoring points, determining a transfer relation by combining rainfall grids and road excavation information, setting an alarm threshold value, calculating risk states of each slope surface along causal connection propagation in a radar interference image unavailable period in a rainy season, and outputting regional hierarchical management and control information.
assignees: UNIV CHENGDU;The First Geological Brigade of Sichuan Province

title_en: Multi-source risk identification method and device for foundation pit
abstract_en: The application discloses a foundation pit multisource risk identification method and device, which realize quantitative description of dynamic association relation among risk factors by constructing a dynamic risk propagation network, fusing multisource monitoring data and adopting a causal and related joint modeling method, break through the limitation of a traditional static analysis model, realize real-time identification and trend prediction of risks in the foundation pit construction process and ensure the safety of foundation pit construction. Further, the embodiment of the application combines the node centrality analysis and the weighted path identification mechanism, quantitatively identifies the key risk factors and the high risk propagation channel, and improves the stability and traceability of the risk identification result through the time aggregation mechanism, thereby obviously enhancing the accuracy and engineering adaptability of foundation pit risk control.
assignees: UNIV TSINGHUA;GUANGZHOU METRO GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Propagation trend deduction method and system based on multi-agent cooperation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence and discloses a propagation trend deduction method and a propagation trend deduction system based on multi-agent cooperation; the method comprises the steps of constructing a social network environment with a plurality of agents, defining image vectors for the agents, generating a social adjacency matrix, enabling an internal cognitive module of each agent to be responsible for processing internal states of the agents, enabling an external behavior module to define parameterized actions of the agents for interaction with the social network environment and other agents, enabling an embedded vector obtained based on the internal states and external information of the agents to serve as input of a decision model, integrating a social context bias matrix into an attention mechanism of a decision encoder of the decision model to reflect social local atmosphere, generating an internal position based on the embedded vector, and outputting external actions in combination with the social environment to drive propagation simulation and trend deduction. The method has remarkable advantages in the aspects of processing multi-modal information, describing individual heterogeneity and realizing large-scale prospective prediction.
assignees: UNIV SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY CHINA;PEOPLE CN CO LTD

title_en: Power demand prediction method, equipment and medium for power distribution network based on big data analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power demand prediction method, equipment and medium for a power distribution network based on big data analysis, which belong to the technical field of power demand prediction and comprise the steps of dividing the power distribution network into a plurality of power nodes, collecting power data of the power nodes, and screening to obtain power abnormal nodes; the method comprises the steps of collecting demand information of power abnormal nodes, extracting to obtain power demand events according to the demand information, obtaining event information of the power demand events, evaluating to obtain propagation effect conditions of the power demand events according to the event information, collecting real-time prediction demand values of the power abnormal nodes, determining power change values of other power nodes in combination with the propagation effect conditions, collecting real-time environment data of the power nodes, predicting to obtain basic power demand values according to the real-time environment data, and superposing the power change values to obtain real-time power demand values. The method and the system improve the accuracy of power demand prediction of the power distribution network based on big data analysis.

title_en: Flange Safe Ring for Back Fire Prevention
title_ko: 역화방지용 플랜지 쉴드
abstract_en: A flange shield for backfire prevention comprises: a belt-shaped ring member (10) provided on each of two facing pipes (100); an insert member (20) provided on the inner surface of the ring member (10) to block fluid leaking to the outside of a gasket provided on a flange connection unit; a fastener locking member (30) provided on an end unit of the ring member (20); and a metal fire prevention device (50). The flange shield for backfire prevention of the present invention can effectively block leakage of fluid through the gap between the ring member and the flange.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 파이프 배관의 플랜지 연결부를 감싸도록 설치되어 플랜지 연결부에서 누설되는 화학물질 또는 유체의 확산을 차단하여 유해 화학물질에의 노출 및 폭발에 따른 인명사고 발생을 방지함과 아울러 폭발 환경에 대비한 역화방지기를 적용하여 화재발생시 파이프 배관을 통해 화재가 전파되는 것을 방지하여 인명과 시설물을 보호할 수 있도록 한 역화방지용 플랜지 쉴드에 관한 것으로,  
마주하는 두 파이프 배관(100)에 각각 구비되어 개스킷을 개재하여 결합되는 한 쌍의 플랜지(110) 사이로 누설되는 유체를 차단하도록 상기 플랜지(110)의 외면에 밀착되며 양단이 서로 겹쳐지도록 형성되는 띠 형상의 링부재(10); 플랜지 연결부에 구비된 개스킷의 외측으로 누설되는 유체를 차단하도록 상기 링부재(10)의 내면에 구비되어 상기 플랜지(110) 사이에 위치되는 삽입부재(20); 상기 링부재(10)의 양단이 겹쳐진 상태로 조여 고정하도록 상기 링부재(20)의 단부에 구비되는 매미고리 잠금부재(30); 및 외부의 화염이 플랜지 연결부 사이로 전파되지 않도록 매미고리 잠금부재(30)의 반대쪽에서 링부재(10)에 설치되는 금속재질의 역화방지기(50);를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Method and system for realizing disaster recovery and switching
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for realizing disaster recovery and switching, wherein the method comprises the following steps: judging whether synchronous switching conditions are met or not according to service quality test result of a data access link between the front end or the back end after the disaster recovery and the switching and the back end or the front end without the disaster recovery and the switching of a network device for the network device performing the disaster recovery and the switching at one of the front end and the back end; and performing synchronous switching on the back end or the front end without the disaster recovery and the switching of the network device according to synchronous switching rules when the judgment result is that the synchronous switching conditions are met. With the help of the invention, not only the unnecessary switching between the FE (front end) and the BE (back end) can be avoided, but also the service performance of the system can be ensured through automatic synchronous switching between the FE and the BE, and the service interruption time caused by manual switching can be further avoided.

title_en: Cascade hydropower station optimal scheduling system and method and safety power grid system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optimized dispatching system and method for a cascade hydropower station and a safety power grid system, wherein the optimized dispatching method comprises the following steps: carrying out preliminary calculation on each power station of the cascade power station group through the predicted warehousing flow condition and the planned output of each power station of the cascade power station group to obtain the state of the cascade power station group; traversing the state sequence of each power station of the cascade power station group according to the time sequence, finishing the calculation of the scheduling time period if the state of the current time period of the cascade power station group meets the set requirement, and carrying out water abandoning risk assessment according to the length of the pre-abandoning time and carrying out output adjustment on the current time period if the state of the current time period of the cascade power station group does not meet the set requirement. By the scheme provided by the invention, under the condition that the whole operation optimization of the cascade is met in the whole scheduling process of each power station of the cascade, the water abandoning risk is balanced, the water abandoning is relatively reasonable, the cascade hydroelectric operation is optimized, and the cascade hydroenergy resources are fully utilized.

title_en: Power quality analysis and identification method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deep learning-based power quality analysis and identification method, which comprises the steps of collecting a power signal to be detected, randomly dividing the power signal to be detected into a training sample set and a test sample set, inputting the training sample set into a long-short-period memory network LSTM model for training, obtaining a trained LSTM model, and inputting the test sample set into the trained LSTM model for testing power quality disturbance classification. According to the invention, the long-short-time memory network is used as a model for classifying the electric energy signals, and the model is trained through the Softmax function and the back propagation algorithm, so that the model can be quickly converged, the characteristic extraction by human intervention is avoided, the electric energy quality signal classification is directly realized, the error is reduced, the recognition precision is improved, and the practicability is higher.

title_en: Risk platform identification and risk propagation prediction method in bulk commodity transaction market
abstract_en: The invention discloses a risk platform identification and risk propagation prediction method in a bulk commodity transaction market, according to characteristics of bulk commodity transactions, a risk platform is identified, and a platform possibly affected by risk propagation is predicted. The method is suitable for supervision and service of the electronic commerce transaction market of a large number of commodities, establishes a transaction network by analyzing historical transaction data, screens abnormal transaction modes according to the topological characteristics of the abnormal transaction modes, and determines a affiliated risk platform. And according to the relevance of commodity overlapping among the platforms, a maximum relevance network is established, a risk source platform is taken as a starting point, and the path and the range of risk propagation are predicted, so that not only is the risk platform identified, but also the platform possibly affected by the risk propagation is predicted, and the risk propagation path and the range are excavated. The risk platform identification and risk propagation prediction are performed, and the risk platform identification and risk propagation prediction method can be used for reference of risk prevention of a transaction platform and institutional soundness reference of a supervision department.

title_en: Multi-energy complementary scheduling method and system for cascade hydropower station
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-energy complementary scheduling method and a system for a cascade hydropower station, comprising the following steps: constructing a wind, light, water and fire storage optimization scheduling model of the hybrid power station; the wind, light, water and fire storage optimization scheduling model of the hybrid power station is used for acquiring wind, light and water-based running parameters of the cascade hydropower station in a mode of the hybrid power station based on input data; constructing a wind, light, water and fire optimal scheduling model of the non-mixed power station; the wind, light, water and fire optimization scheduling model of the non-mixed power storage station is used for acquiring wind, light and water-based operation parameters of the cascade hydropower station in the non-mixed power storage station mode based on input data; comparing the wind-light water-based operation parameters in the mixed power station mode with the wind-light water-based operation parameters in the non-mixed power station mode, determining the value and the action of the mixed power station, and determining whether the mixed power station is started for electric energy scheduling according to the value and the action of the mixed power station; so as to better improve the wind and light absorbing capacity and improve the running quality and reliability of the power grid.

title_en: Typhoon path and strength prediction method based on multi-mode fusion network model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a typhoon path and strength prediction method based on a multi-mode fusion network model, and belongs to the technical field of meteorological monitoring. The method comprises the steps of obtaining position coordinates, central wind speed and central air pressure of typhoons and analysis data of wind fields and potential heights of typhoons in a central area, constructing a multi-mode fusion network model driven by the data and physics together, constructing a loss function of the multi-mode fusion network model, updating parameters of the multi-mode fusion network model through counter propagation to obtain a trained multi-mode fusion network model, inputting data in a test set into the trained multi-mode fusion network model, and outputting typhoons paths and intensities. The method analyzes the space-time characteristics of the dynamic association relation and the potential height field in the wind field, provides effective physical constraint for typhoon path and strength prediction, is used for typhoon path and strength prediction, and can improve the accuracy of typhoon path and strength prediction.

title_en: Water-light-storage collaborative optimization scheduling method and system based on A3C multi-agent parallel mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water-light storage collaborative optimization scheduling method and system based on an A3C multi-agent parallel mechanism, which comprises the steps of constructing a water-light storage collaborative optimization scheduling system operation scene of 'perception-network-application' three layers, constructing a cascade hydropower station group joint scheduling model by taking hydropower station water balance constraint, upstream and downstream hydraulic connection, water level limitation, power generation flow limitation, hydropower station output constraint and channel constraint as constraint conditions, constructing a water-light storage daily dynamic output distribution model by taking the maximum total rewarding value of the water-light storage optimization scheduling system as an objective function, simulating the operation scene and coupling relation of water, light and a power storage station, converting the water-light storage optimization scheduling problem into a Markov process, and realizing efficient exploration and learning of strategies by an A3C algorithm to obtain the optimal scheduling method of the water-light storage optimization scheduling system. The invention can obviously promote the power consumption of the water-light storage optimizing and dispatching system, reduce the phenomena of water and light rejection and ensure the power supply in Xinjiang.

title_en: HSS (home subscriber server) data disaster tolerant algorithm based on artificial intelligence and neural network
abstract_en: An HSS (home subscriber server) data disaster tolerant algorithm based on an artificial intelligence and neural network includes: firstly, newly adding four zone fields for an HSS database, wherein the zone fields include a user registration status change frequency, a PPR transmission frequency, a RTR transmission frequency and predicted user types after BP (back propagation) neural network study; when optional one of the user registration status change frequency, the PPR transmission frequency or the RTR transmission frequency exceeds a preset neuron threshold value, adding a user into a specific list by a HSS database to trigger backup algorithm, wherein the backup algorithm refers to an artificial intelligence and neural network algorithm. The HSS data disaster tolerant algorithm based on the artificial intelligence and neural network has the advantages that zones frequent in service handling can be designed individually by means of analysis and discovery of some HSS data variations, for example: server performances of the zones are improved and data of the zones are backed up to two or more than two adjacent zones so that risks are avoided.

title_en: Ultra-wideband gallium nitride device small-signal model and parameter extracting method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultra-wideband gallium nitride device small-signal model and a parameter extracting method thereof. Three interconnected capacitor and cascaded inductor network structure forms are adopted for the grating end, the source end and the drain end of the small-signal model respectively, and the small-signal model comprises 18 parasitic parameters and 10 intrinsic parameters; the parasitic parameters comprise outer layer parasitic capacitance Cpgi1, Cpdi1, Cgdi1 and others, parasitic inductance Lgi1, Ldi1, Lsi1 and others and parasitic resistance Rg, Rd and Rs; the intrinsic parameters comprise intrinsic capacitance Cgd, Cgs and Cds and intrinsic resistance Rgs, Rgd and Rds, wherein an intrinsic current source Ids is equal to Gm plus ta as parameters in ViGme-j omega ta. The model can accurately describe the characteristics of a high-frequency device, has wider application frequency band and can adapt to a W frequency band as the highest; by the utilization of the parameter extracting method, the model parameters can have good stability within the frequency range of 0.2-110 GHz.
assignees: XU YUEHANG;UNIV ELECTRONIC SCIENCE & TECH CHINA

title_en: Dynamic simulation method for ground wire current of power distribution system of data center
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic simulation method for ground wire current of a power distribution system of a data center, which is used for calculating the ground wire current of the whole topological network through simulation after obtaining the ground wire current characteristic and the circuit topological structure of end-use electric equipment (namely leaf nodes), so as to promote the cognition and the mastering of the distribution rule of the ground wire current of the power distribution system, be conductive to studying and judging the rationality of the ground wire current value, further improve the operation safety of the data center, and further effectively solve the problem that the distribution characteristic of the ground wire current of the data center cannot be determined and the propagation rule of the distribution characteristic cannot be mastered in the prior art.
assignees: NAT COMPUTER NETWORK & INF SECURITY MANAGEMENT CT

title_en: Short-term wind power prediction method based on improved deep forest
abstract_en: The invention relates to a short-term wind power prediction method based on improved deep forest, which comprises the following steps: splicing time sequence data in the numerical weather forecast data to form multidimensional time sequence data, adding a wind power label to the multidimensional time sequence data to form a data set, and dividing the data set into a training set and a test set; inputting the training set into an improved deep forest, performing network training, and forming time sequence identity mapping of numerical weather forecast data and wind power forecast data; the improved deep forest is formed by combining a multi-granularity scanning layer and a stacking layer and connecting the multi-granularity scanning layer and the stacking layer with a cascade forest; inputting the test set into the trained network, and outputting short-term wind power prediction data. According to the invention, the self-adaptive feature extraction beneficial to wind power prediction is carried out on the multidimensional input data by combining the stacking layer with the multi-granularity scanning layer, the wind power information under the complex weather condition can be effectively extracted, the effectiveness of feature extraction prediction is improved, and the prediction accuracy is high.

title_en: Method and system for realizing earthquake early warning simulation based on earthquake table network and WEBGL
abstract_en: A method for realizing earthquake early warning simulation based on an earthquake table network and WEBGL comprises the following steps: s100, acquiring seismic platform network data, monitoring station data and three-dimensional geologic body modeling data; s200, constructing a three-dimensional geologic body model according to a preset rule according to the acquired three-dimensional geologic body modeling data; s300, acquiring a seismic surface wave and a bulk wave result according to the acquired seismic station network data and the monitoring station data; s400, combining the obtained seismic surface wave and bulk wave results with the construction of a three-dimensional geologic body model to achieve the effect of simulating seismic wave propagation. According to the method, based on the combination of the Chinese seismic platform network monitoring data and WEBGL, comprehensive calculation analysis is carried out according to the stratum structure and medium attribute in the acquisition area and the detection data returned by the monitoring station terminal, the diffusion rate and the diffusion distance of the seismic point surface wave and the body wave are calculated respectively through a built-in calculation formula, the real-time seismic position and the diffusion range are finally displayed, and early warning and reference are provided for the earthquake prevention, control and disaster relief work of the area.
assignees: WUHAN ZHIBO CHUANGXIANG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and equipment for identifying, early warning and positioning key line of cascading failure of power transmission network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a line identification technology of an electric power system, in particular to a key line identification, early warning and positioning method and equipment for cascading failure of a power transmission network, wherein the method obtains characteristic data at a plurality of historical moments according to a tide transfer model to generate a power transmission network characteristic data set; constructing an LSTM-based power transmission network security situation prediction early warning model, inputting a time sequence power grid state into the security situation prediction model established by the invention, performing data preprocessing through ADASYN oversampling and other steps, and dividing a training set and a verification set; and then calculating the dimension input at each time point, inputting the generated data into an input layer of the LSTM network for calculation, and finally outputting results such as whether cascading failure occurs at a specific moment in the future, the position of the failure and the like. The invention can early warn and judge the region in advance for the cascading failure caused by the tide transfer, thereby effectively improving the lean management and control level and providing reliable decision support for the lean operation and maintenance of the transmission network.
assignees: UNIV WUHAN;STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Urban illumination control integration gateway system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of urban illumination control, and provides an urban illumination control fusion gateway system which comprises a multi-mode sensing network module, a causal reasoning diagnosis module, a survivability topology reconstruction module, a physiological adaptation dimming module and a disaster chain blocking module. The multi-mode sensing network module collects structural displacement, environmental data and weather forecast of the lighting facility through the unmanned plane, the ground nodes and the weather radar. The causal reasoning diagnosis module analyzes the aging reasons of the facilities through causal graph modeling. The survivability topology reconstruction module optimizes the power supply network topology. The physiological adaptive dimming module generates a color temperature-brightness parameter according to the people stream and the atmospheric optical characteristics. The disaster chain blocking module identifies disaster propagation nodes and triggers reinforcement instructions. The invention can improve the reliability, energy conservation and safety of the lighting system and optimize the comfort and emergency response capability of urban environment.
assignees: ZHANGZHOU ELECTRONIC INFORMATION GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Cascade hydropower span power supply capacity pricing method and system for responding peak regulation demand of receiving end power grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pricing method and a pricing system for cascade hydropower span power supply capacity in response to peak regulation demands of a receiving end power grid, and belongs to the field of hydroelectric generation. The method comprises the steps of dividing the electricity price peak-to-valley period of a receiving end, drawing up a feasible time-sharing electricity price scheme set, then establishing a cascade hydroelectric multi-province power generation model, finally inputting the time-sharing electricity price scheme into the cascade hydroelectric multi-province power generation model, calculating an output force curve of the cascade hydroelectric for 24 hours, calculating two evaluation indexes of electricity purchasing cost and peak regulation effect of the receiving end power grid, optimizing the time-sharing electricity price scheme through a non-dominant sorting algorithm, setting index weight, defining a preference function, and selecting a scheme with the smallest preference function value as an optimal time-sharing pricing scheme. Under the condition of meeting the maximum generating income, the invention effectively promotes the response of the peak shaving requirement of the power grid of the receiving end, realizes the balance of the self-generated power and the electric quantity of the sending end and the receiving end at the level of hours, has controllable purchasing cost of the power grid of the receiving end, and realizes win-win of the power plant and the power grid of the receiving end.

title_en: Petroleum and petrochemical fire control interlocking control equipment based on SIS
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of petrochemical fire control, in particular to an interlocking control device for petrochemical fire control based on SIS, which comprises a sensing fusion unit for acquiring optical fibers, radars, acoustics, event cameras and dual-band images, and generating a characteristic tensor and an attitude matrix through multi-scale synchronization and gating sparse fusion. The prediction and risk assessment unit utilizes the graph neural network space-time model and generates countermeasure correction output disaster prediction data, a propagation potential energy matrix and risk entropy. The interlocking control unit builds a binary optimization model by taking the minimum action number and the residual potential energy as targets, obtains a minimum action set by means of quantum annealing and minimum and maximum game, and writes the minimum action set into the memristive programmable logic array to generate an interlocking instruction stream. The execution and feedback unit controls the two-phase flow injection device, the robot team and the heat shielding device to finish treatment, and the feedback event flow is used for model increment learning and action deviation correction. The invention realizes millisecond cascade lock triggering, redundant action drop and obviously reduces the fire spreading radius.
assignees: SHANGHAI ANCHEN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Complex supply chain network toughness simulation method and system under climate risk impact
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for simulating network toughness of a complex supply chain under climate risk impact, and relates to the field of climate risk assessment. The method comprises the steps of quantifying the impact proportion of climate risks to local areas, measuring the impact degree by adopting the proportion of different climate risk impact degrees, constructing a complex supply chain network, taking countries and areas related to the upstream and downstream links of the supply chain as nodes, taking corresponding trade amounts as edges, analyzing key node characteristics of the complex supply chain network by adopting node degree, node strength and core degree indexes, carrying out toughness test on the complex supply chain network in different climate risk disturbance modes, and measuring the impact category and toughness change of the complex supply chain network toughness under the climate risk impact by combining cascade failure simulation. According to the method, the weak links in the supply chain network are accurately identified through analysis of key indexes such as node importance, link reliability and the like under the climate risk impact, and quantitative support and policy inspiring are provided for pointedly formulating risk coping strategies.
assignees: INST GEOGRAPHIC SCIENCES & NATURAL RESOURCES RES CAS

title_en: Data management method and system for water and electricity river basin overhaul
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data management method and a system for water and electricity watershed overhaul, and relates to the technical field of data management.A full-quantity overhaul data analysis of target overhaul equipment is obtained, and a longitudinal overhaul quality improvement rate reference value and a transverse overhaul quality improvement rate reference value are established by combining a reference overhaul period quantized quality improvement rate deviation, so that the problems of scattered overhaul data and lack of a unified analysis reference are solved, and the evaluation accuracy and consistency are improved; the method comprises the steps of screening target associated equipment through work associated attributes, presenting the associated relation among the equipment by combining an associated mapping table, realizing collaborative management of the overhaul state of the hydropower basin equipment, avoiding cascading failures, predicting the quality improvement rate of the next overhaul period through a long-short-period memory network model, generating a predicted overhaul key associated data table, matching the predicted overhaul key associated data table with the current data table, extracting key overhaul equipment information, generating an early warning suggestion table, solving the problem of overhaul plan hysteresis, realizing prospective judgment, providing basis for active maintenance and reducing the risk of fault shutdown.

title_en: Geological disaster early warning method based on troposphere delay decoupling
abstract_en: The application discloses a geological disaster early warning method based on troposphere delay decoupling, which relates to the field of geological disaster monitoring and navigation positioning, and comprises the steps of multi-modal data space-time synchronous acquisition; the method comprises the steps of performing geological decoupling on a troposphere delay component, converting atmospheric noise into a geological signal, constructing delay-catastrophe parameter dynamic mapping, performing terrain self-adaptive reference station dynamic reconstruction, performing virtual GNSS reference point network with the same height as a monitoring point by using Digital Elevation Model (DEM) dynamic reconstruction, performing three-dimensional reconstruction on a disaster risk field, fusing delay mapping factors and ground surface deformation data to generate a multi-dimensional risk field, constructing an early warning threshold self-evolution mechanism, and constructing a multi-cascade control early warning decision. The method can improve the accuracy of geological disaster early warning and provide intelligent technical support for disaster prevention and reduction.
assignees: NO 230 RESEARCH INST OF NUCLEAR INDUSTRY

title_en: SAFETY SYSTEM OF SUBWAY WORKERS USING LOW-POWER LONG RANGE COMMUNICATION LoRa
title_ko: 저전력 장거리 통신 LoRa를 이용한 지하철 근로자 안전 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a safety system for subway workers and, more specifically, to a safety system configured to safely evacuate subway workers using a low-power long range communication network (LoRa). In a system capable of preventing any accident from occurring in a subway through a LoRa (10), there is a step of recognizing an RF tag (20) using a smartphone (40) and primarily transmitting the recognized RF tag (20) to an RFID device (30). The smartphone is configured to primarily recognize the RF tag. A situation is transmitted to a central management center (50) and a subway that is in service at the same time when the situation is recognized. When the RF tag is recognized, a screen door is opened. Adversely, when a user is in an inner side of the screen door before the subway starts, the screen door is automatically opened through a system programed in the central management center, and thus, the user can safely evacuate. When the subway arrives at the previous station, the situation is transmitted to the smartphone (40) through the LoRa (10) so that it is possible to propagate the situation to the user. However, in order to prepare a case when a user does not know a notification, the central management center (50) is caused to recognize the situation so that the screen door can be automatically controlled. Therefore, it is possible to prevent any possible accident from occurring in the inner side of the screen door.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지하철 근로자 안전 시스템에 관한 것이다. 더욱 상세하게는 저전력 장거리 통신망 LoRa를 이용하여 지하철 근로자를 안전하게 대피시키는 것에 관한 것이다.LoRa(10)를 통한 지하철 안전 사고 예방이 가능한 시스템에 있어서, 스마트폰(40)으로 RF태그(20)를 인식하여 RFID 장치(30)로 1차 상황 전송이 가능한 단계이다. 스마트폰은 RF태그를 먼저 인식시킨다. 인식과 동시에 중앙관리실(50)에 상황을 전달하며 운행중인 지하철에도 동시에 상황을 전달한다. 이때 RF태그에 인식을 할 경우 스크린도어가 열리나 반대로 지하철이 출발하기 전에 사용자가 스크린도어 안쪽에 있을 경우 중앙관리실에서 프로그램된 시스템을 통해 자동으로 스크린도어가 열림으로써 사용자가 안전하게 대피할 수 있도록 하는 것이다. 상기 LoRa(10)을 통해 지하철이 전역에 도착할 경우 상기 스마트폰(40)으로 상황을 전송하여 사용자에게 상황을 전파가 가능하다. 하지만 사용자가 알림을 모를 경우를 대비하여 동시에 중앙관리실(50)에도 상황을 인지하도록 하여 스크린도어가 자동으로 제어 가능하게 할 수 있는 것을 특징으로 한다 이로 인해 스크린도어 안쪽에서 일어나는 사고를 사전에 방지할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Soft measurement method for cascade polymerization reaction of high-density polyethylene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a soft measurement method for high-density polyethylene cascade polymerization reaction, which comprises the steps of preprocessing data by using a data correction technology and a data mining technology, searching for rules from production data and analysis data, establishing an intelligent soft measurement model and a high-density polyethylene product unit consumption model by using a function connection neural network, optimizing a function connection neural network structure by using a regularization method, improving the modeling precision of the function connection neural network, and finally forming the intelligent soft measurement method for the high-density polyethylene reaction process. The technical scheme provided by the invention has the characteristics of quick response time and high modeling precision, and helps to ensure the safe production of the high-density polyethylene, improve the quality of polymer products and save the production cost. The regularization-based function connection neural network provided by the invention optimizes the weight by setting the regularization parameters, thereby reducing network errors and improving modeling precision and calculation speed.

title_en: Edge coupling-based dependent network seepage analysis method and analysis system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of complex network seepage phase change behavior analysis, and discloses a dependent network seepage analysis method and an analysis system based on edge coupling, wherein the dependent network seepage analysis method based on edge coupling comprises the following steps: constructing an edge-edge dependent network model; establishing a theoretical analysis frame of the edge-edge dependent network model by adopting a self-balancing probability theory; and analyzing the seepage phase change behavior and the seepage threshold of other edge dependent network models under the condition of facing random failure based on the constructed theoretical analysis framework. The method adopts a self-balancing probability theory to establish a theoretical analysis frame of the model, can directly write out a state equation after the system is stable without tracking the cascade failure process, and has the advantages of intuition and conciseness. The method analyzes the phase change behavior and the seepage threshold value of the model under the condition of random failure based on the theoretical framework, and has a reusing meaning for understanding the robustness of the edge coupling network in the real world.

title_en: Landslide surge near-far field propagation evolution coupling method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coupling method and a coupling system for near-far field propagation evolution of landslide surge, wherein the coupling method comprises the steps of simulating near-field motion of a landslide of a particulate body by adopting particle discrete elements and smooth particle fluid dynamics, calculating far-field motion of the landslide of the particulate body by taking the simulated near-field motion as an initial boundary condition, and completing near-far field propagation evolution of the landslide of the particulate body in the motion and water entering process based on drag force and buoyancy. According to the invention, through fine numerical simulation of key areas, the propagation path, speed and influence range of landslide surge can be predicted more accurately. This is critical for disaster early warning and risk assessment. Meanwhile, the model disclosed by the invention can be used for considering the topography, geology, hydrologic conditions and the like in more detail, so that the landslide surge simulation reality is improved. In addition, the invention can evaluate the potential influence of landslide surge on coastal structures, residential areas and key infrastructure by simulating different scenes, and provide dangerous analysis for rescue and planning.

title_en: Method and device for establishing short-term probability prediction model of comprehensive energy load polymer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for establishing a comprehensive energy load polymer short-term probability prediction model. The method comprises the steps of preprocessing and dimension reduction of collected historical data of the comprehensive energy load aggregate, grouping the dimension reduced data by adopting an affinity propagation clustering algorithm based on comprehensive similarity, extracting centroid characteristics of each group as representative load characteristics, inputting the representative load characteristics into a prediction model, and constructing a comprehensive energy load aggregate short-term probability prediction model fused with a Copula self-adaptive correlation analysis, a cross characteristic-time diagram neural network and a mixed density network. According to the invention, the accuracy of the short-term probability prediction of the comprehensive energy load aggregate is effectively improved through a dynamic coupling relation mining and space-time characteristic joint learning mechanism.

title_en: Multidimensional information fusion evaluation method for intelligent product quality security risk
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-dimensional information fusion evaluation method of intelligent product quality safety risk, which comprises the steps of calculating raw material production data aggregation degree and deviation degree, carrying out anomaly identification to obtain an anomaly result, calculating a potential hardware risk coefficient, calculating a first influence degree, correcting the potential hardware risk coefficient to obtain a hardware risk coefficient, carrying out data quality evaluation and cross enhancement to obtain a software integration risk coefficient according to user feedback matching anomaly result and feature enhancement to obtain risk characteristics, constructing a risk correlation propagation network and an intelligent product quality safety risk evaluation model, and inputting multi-dimensional information of an intelligent product to be evaluated into the intelligent product quality safety risk evaluation model to obtain an intelligent product quality safety risk evaluation result. The method not only can promote the comprehensiveness, the dynamics and the accuracy of the risk evaluation of the intelligent product, but also has important significance for improving the reliability of the intelligent product and the industry risk management and control level.

title_en: A Risk Management System for Monitoring and Prediction of Hazardous Chemical Substance Risk Situations utilizing Machine Vision
title_ko: 머신비전을 활용한 유해화학물질 모니터링 및 예측을 위한 위험관리시스템
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 유해화학물질 취급 현장의 위험을 관리하는 자가 진단 및 자율 대응 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명의 위험관리시스템은 Wi-SUN Mesh 네트워크 기반 지능형 센서 네트워크부, 영상 데이터 수집부, 중앙 처리 서버를 포함한다. 중앙 처리 서버는 IoT 센서의 시계열 데이터, CCTV 영상의 공간적 특징, 네트워크 상태 데이터를 융합하여 확장된 상태 벡터를 생성하는 다중 소스 데이터 융합부와, 디지털 트윈 환경에서 강화학습을 통해 누적 위험 회피 보상을 최대화하는 최적 대응 정책을 자율 학습하는 강화학습 기반 자율 대응 결정부, 및 실시간 컨텍스트 정보를 반영하여 동적 표준 운영 절차(SOP)를 생성·전파하는 전자 SOP 실행 및 상황 전파부를 포함한다. 
본 발명은 위험 예측 기반 선제적 통신 관리를 통해 골든타임 내 안정적 대응을 보장하며, 사전 정의된 시나리오에 의존하는 종래 기술의 한계를 극복하여 복잡한 재난 상황에서도 진정한 자율 대응을 가능하게 한다.

title_en: Evaluation method of operational risk of electric system
abstract_en: The invention provides an evaluation method of an operational risk of an electric system. The method comprises the following steps: (1) risk evaluation index system of the electric system is established; (2) the index in the index system is calculated; (3) and evaluation to the operational risk of the electric system is performed according to the calculated value of the index. According to the evaluation method of the operational risk of the electric system, the risk evaluation is performed on potential incidents that endanger the operational safety in the electric system like an out-of-limit flow, an out-of-limit voltage, an out-of-stability voltage and cascading faults so that the safe and stable operation of a power grid is ensured.
assignees: EAST CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;UNIV SHANGHAI JIAOTONG

title_en: Accident chain mode based distributed power flow controller location method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an accident chain mode based distributed power flow controller location method. The method comprises the following steps of taking power flow misconvergence or power angle oscillation and divergence as the end conditions of an accident chain, and scanning cascading failure accident chains from the whole network; establishing a multi-dimensional index system for representing the influence degree of each accident chain, including a voltage deviation index, a frequency deviation index, a power flow balance degree index and an active load loss rate index; carrying out quantitative assessment on the influence of each accident chain by a gray comprehensive evaluation method; and finally, defining and recalculating the line importance index by combination of the accident chain influence comprehensive evaluation index and the prediction index of each link of the accident chains, and completing the distributed power flow controller recommendation location according to the sorting result of the indexes. According to the location method, the gray comprehensive evaluation is introduced to the influence analysis of the accident chains, so that the characteristic of a small number of the accident chain samples of the power grid is satisfied, and a reference can be provided to the pre-planning of the location of the distributed power flow controller.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Prediction algorithm for residual service life of aero-engine with convolution memory residual self-attention mechanism
abstract_en: An aviation engine remaining service life prediction algorithm of a convolution memory residual error self-attention mechanism. The identification method comprises the following steps: preprocessing the sensor data of the aircraft engine, extracting the bottom-layer characteristics of the data through a convolutional neural network, correlating the time sequence characteristics by using a long-short-term memory network, carrying out position coding on the characteristics by using a position encoder, retraining the characteristics by using a residual error self-attention mechanism, and finally outputting the result through a full-connection layer. Aiming at the defect of the self-attention mechanism, a double-layer residual error network is introduced to inhibit the diffusivity in the back propagation of an error function, and a deep learning method of the residual self-attention mechanism is provided. The invention provides a residual error self-attention mechanism, which can effectively optimize a weight matrix, further constructs an aero-engine residual life service algorithm of the convolution memory residual error self-attention mechanism and has a promoting effect on aero-engine state monitoring.
assignees: PLA CHINA STRATEGIC SUPPORT FORCE AEROSPACE ENG UNIV

title_en: Water supply system scheduling agent decision method
abstract_en: A water supply system scheduling agent decision method comprises the following steps: 1) collecting the actually measured monitoring data of the water delivery engineering, including the water level, the flow and the opening and closing conditions of the gate. The sample data is divided into a training set, a testing set and a prediction set. 2) And constructing a BP neural network model, which consists of an input layer, a hidden layer and an output layer. 3) And inputting the sample data of the training set into a BP neural network model, wherein the training process comprises an information propagation process and an error propagation process. 4) And (3) outputting a regulation decision step 3) to obtain a relatively ideal BP neural network model, carrying out inverse normalization processing on the output result in an interval [0,1] of the output result of an output layer to obtain the opening value of the gate, and outputting the regulation decision of the gate. The invention can reflect the interrelationship and the interaction among all elements of the water delivery system; the valve opening value can be predicted through factors such as water level, target flow and the like, the result is reliable, and reference can be provided for actual scheduling management; the water transfer decision is more intelligent and accurate, and the operation management of the actual engineering is facilitated.

title_en: Fault alarm method and device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a fault alarm method, a fault alarm device and electronic equipment. According to the method, network fault information is sent to a plurality of public land mobile network PLMNs through a network detection end, the PLMNs forward the network fault information to a shared base station, and then when the shared base station detects that the network fault information forwarded by the faulty PLMNs is not received, the terminal corresponding to the faulty PLMNs cannot know that the faulty PLMNs enter disaster conditions, so that the network fault information is broadcast to the terminals corresponding to the faulty PLMNs, the problem of communication service can be rapidly identified by the terminals, the network service interruption time of the terminals is reduced, and the user experience is improved.

title_en: Complex power grid fragile flow transfer capturing method based on fluctuation process
abstract_en: The invention discloses a complicated power grid fragile energy transfer capturing method based on a fluctuation process, which comprises the steps of obtaining a power flow transfer distribution factor matrix and a line disconnection distribution factor matrix; converting the power grid topological graph into a node-branch mapping graph by adopting a graph theory method; defining a node connection strength matrix; acquiring an inter-node electric coupling strength matrix; acquiring a normalized electric coupling dielectric center index and an improved structure hole index; constructing node weakness energy; establishing a node capacity model, and selecting an initial fault point; acquiring node fragile energy of each node after energy transmission according to the fluctuation energy attenuation transmission process of the stimulus waves and the response waves; acquiring a set comprising a fault sequence, the number of fault stages and the number of fault nodes according to the time and space relation of the out-of-limit generated energy; the method can quickly and accurately identify the fragile line under the cascading failure, and effectively avoids the cascading failure by applying key protection and reinforcement to the identified fragile line.

title_en: Cascading failure simulation method, equipment and storage medium based on weighted dependent network
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, equipment and a storage medium for simulating cascade failure based on a weighted dependent network, wherein the method for simulating cascade failure comprises the following steps: acquiring a cascade failure model based on a weighted dependent network, wherein the cascade failure model comprises a plurality of network layers, and each network layer is provided with a plurality of nodes; setting the initial load of the node according to the node strength of the node and the node strength of the neighbor node, and setting the node capacity of the node according to the nonlinear relation between the node capacity of the node and the initial load; and simulating a cascade failure process by using the cascade failure model, wherein the cascade failure process comprises interlayer cascade failure and in-layer cascade failure, and in the simulation process, carrying out load redistribution according to the residual capacity and importance of the neighbor nodes of the failure node. The technical scheme of the invention can improve the robustness of the cascade failure model, thereby improving the simulation effect of the cascade failure.
assignees: PEOPLE'S LIBERATION ARMY NATIONAL UNIVERSITY OF DEFENSE TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Source network load storage collaborative planning method and system considering multi-main-body hybrid game
abstract_en: The invention relates to a source network charge storage collaborative planning method and system considering multi-main body mixed games, wherein the method comprises the following steps of establishing a power distribution network collaborative planning model considering source network charge storage main body master-slave-collaborative mixed games, wherein the power distribution network collaborative planning model is a double-layer model and comprises a power distribution network operator, an upper layer master-slave game sub-model of other main bodies and a lower layer laminated game sub-model between source charge storage side main bodies; and solving the collaborative planning model of the power distribution network by adopting a solving strategy combining a target cascading analysis method and a self-adaptive coefficient alternating direction multiplier method to obtain an optimal planning scheme of a newly-built and distributed power supply and an energy storage device of the circuit. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of realizing efficient configuration and coordinated utilization of the source network charge storage resources, improving planning reliability and the like.
assignees: UNIV SHANGHAI JIAOTONG;STATE GRID ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD;STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ECONOMIC AND TECHNICAL RES INSTITUTE

title_en: Power distribution station house monitoring method, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution station room monitoring method, a device and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining power distribution station room electromagnetic interference intensity distribution and line real-time state data, and determining a sensor type selection scheme by combining equipment working conditions; the fault traveling wave arrival time difference, the line model parameters and the wave speed difference are used for calculating a fault propagation path, determining the position of a fault point and generating a positioning result, associating the sensor type selection and the fault positioning, judging whether the fault point is in a layout area or not, primarily judging the fault type, generating a recovery path candidate scheme based on real-time state data and the fault positioning result, fusing the fault traveling wave characteristics and the recovery path line state parameters, establishing a comprehensive evaluation model, taking power supply recovery efficiency and load loss rate as optimization targets, and determining an optimal recovery path scheme. The method has the following effects that the rapid and accurate positioning and intelligent power supply recovery of the faults of the power distribution network are realized, and the running reliability and efficiency of the power distribution network are improved.
assignees: STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CO ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;LANZHOU POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Method for predicting generated power
abstract_en: The application discloses a method for predicting generated power, which relates to the technical field of electric power and is used for improving the prediction accuracy of the generated power in a wind-solar storage system. The method comprises the steps of obtaining predicted environment data, wind power generation equipment parameters and photovoltaic power generation equipment parameters, determining first predicted power generation power according to the predicted environment data, the wind power generation equipment parameters and the photovoltaic power generation equipment parameters, inputting the predicted environment data into a trained power generation power prediction model to obtain second predicted power generation power, establishing the power generation power prediction model based on a long-short-term memory network LSTM model and a genetic algorithm-back propagation GA-BP neural network model, and carrying out weighted summation on the first predicted power generation power and the second predicted power generation power to obtain predicted power generation power.
assignees: XINXIANG POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Emotion network propagation dynamic model based on SIRS and emotion propagation simulation method using same
abstract_en: The invention relates to an emotion network transmission dynamic model based on SIRS and an emotion transmission simulation method using the same, wherein an original traditional virus transmission model is improved, a dynamic equation of the SIRS transmission model is provided, the stability of the model is proved, and compared with the classical SIRS virus transmission, simulation experiment result analysis is carried out on each emotion density change, so that the model can better reflect emotion transmission characteristics. The invention integrates the subjective psychological concept of emotion with social network behaviors, and the model accurately reflects the reasonable mapping of the subjective psychological concept of emotion and the social network behaviors. Can be used for the emotion propagation evolution process of similar negative public sentiment events.

title_en: Short-term optimized scheduling method and system for cascade reservoir group
abstract_en: The invention discloses a short-term optimized dispatching method and a short-term optimized dispatching system for a cascade reservoir group, which belong to the field of cooperative optimized dispatching of water-fire power stations, and are characterized in that the fitness of each individual in an initial population is obtained, and the positions of an optimal fitness individual, a suboptimal fitness individual and a third optimal fitness individual in the population are updated; then updating the positions of all individuals in the population and generating a temporary population; screening the population by adopting a variation strategy based on the population and the temporary population obtained after updating all individual positions of the population; and the self-adaptive boundary strategy is adopted to effectively prevent the population from falling into local optimum. And updating all individual positions in the population through iteration, and outputting the individual position with the optimal fitness as the optimal scheduling process of the cascade hydropower system after the stop condition is reached. The method has the advantages of high convergence speed, high solving precision, strong optimizing capability, capability of effectively avoiding being trapped in local optimal solution and the like, can well coordinate the water-fire power station cooperative scheduling among the power grids, improves the economic benefit, and has very high practical value.

title_en: Flow monitoring-oriented supply chain intelligent tracking system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a supply chain intelligent tracking system oriented to flow monitoring, which relates to the technical field of supply chain intelligent management and is used for solving the problems of flexibility and risk resistance of supply chain breakpoint management; the method comprises the steps of collecting original data from supply chain link points, combining time sequence, classification characteristics and high-dimensional data processing technology, generating effective characteristics, constructing a breakpoint prediction model through a gradient lifting decision tree, identifying and evaluating breakpoint risks, constructing a supply chain network topological structure, recursively calculating propagation paths and influence ranges of the breakpoint risks, determining affected node sets, combining prediction results to formulate adjustment and recovery strategies, optimizing resource allocation and logistics routes, quickly recovering key nodes, ensuring continuity of the supply chain, upgrading early warning mechanisms to dynamically monitor risks, and accordingly improving management flexibility and risk resistance of the supply chain.

title_en: Intelligent fire-fighting-oriented AI driving resource scheduling method and system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of public service data processing, and provides an intelligent fire-fighting oriented AI driving resource scheduling method and system.
