The invention can fully utilize the data of the existing information system, effectively identify the risk propagation path and the hot spot area, improve the early warning accuracy and the self-adaptive capacity, and provide scientific basis for emergency decision of the emergency.

title_en: Interface protocol between alarm terminal and alarm system for building
title_ko: 건물용 경보단말과 통제시스템간 인터페이스 프로토콜
abstract_en: Provided are a communication method using an interface protocol between an alarm terminal for a building and a building alarm terminal control system and a system thereof. According to one embodiment of the present invention, the communication method comprises the following steps of: allowing an alarm terminal of a predetermined building to use an alarm terminal connection primitive to be connected to the building alarm terminal control system; when the building alarm terminal control system is connected, allowing the alarm terminal of a building to use an alarm terminal registration primitive to perform a registration procedure; and when an alarm is issued, allowing the building alarm terminal control system to use an alarm data transmission primitive to transfer alarm data to the registered building alarm terminal. Accordingly, when a disaster occurs, a disaster alarm is automatically propagated to a plurality of unspecified persons inside a multiuse facility, thereby promoting emergency evacuation of the plurality of unspecified persons who exist in a room inside the multiuse facility. Moreover, an alarm system based on a common alarm protocol, which is a domestic/overseas standard, is provided to alarm propagation in the multiuse facility, thereby contributing to establishment of a standard-based multiuse facility alarm propagation system.
abstract_ko: 건물용 경보단말과 건물용 경보단말 통제시스템 간 인터페이스 프로토콜을 이용한 통신 방법 및 시스템이 제공된다. 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른, 건물용 경보단말과 건물용 경보단말 통제시스템 간 인터페이스 프로토콜을 이용한 통신 방법은 특정 건물용 경보단말이, 경보단말 연결 프리미티브를 이용하여 건물용 경보단말 통제시스템과 연결하는 단계; 상기 건물용 경보단말이, 상기 건물용 경보단말 통제시스템에 연결되면, 경보단말 등록 프리미티브를 이용하여 등록 절차를 수행하는 단계; 및 상기 건물용 경보단말 통제시스템이, 경보가 발령되면, 경보 데이터 전송 프리미티브를 이용하여 경보 데이터를 상기 등록된 건물용 경보단말에 전달하는 단계;를 포함한다. 이에 의해, 재난 발생 시, 다중이용시설 내의 불특정 다수의 사람에게 자동으로 재난 경보를 전파하여, 다중이용시설 내에 재실 중인 불특정 다수의 사람들의 긴급 대피를 도모할 수 있으며, 다중이용시설 내의 경보 전파를 위해 국내외 표준인 공통경보프로토콜 기반의 경보 시스템을 제공함으로써, 표준기반의 다중이용시설 경보 전파 체계 수립에 기여할 수 있다.
assignees: THE REPUBLIC OF KOREA MINI INTERIOR

title_en: Electric power information physical system cascading failure prediction method based on risk element theory
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for predicting cascading failure of a power information physical system based on a risk element theory, which comprises the following steps: 1. correcting the power grid community partition result by a Prim algorithm; 2. constructing a power information physical system; 3. constructing a risk transfer function of the fault, and calculating the initial fault probability of the line and the initial failure probability of the information node to form an initial fault set of an accident chain; 4. selecting a fault stage, and when corresponding fault on-off information is uploaded to a dispatching center, the dispatching center issues a corresponding control command; 5. sequentially selecting a fault line and a failure node in the next fault stage according to a subsequent risk transfer function; 6. and traversing the initial fault set, repeating the steps 4-5 until the end condition is met, recording accident chain data and outputting. The method can dynamically describe the development process of the interactive propagation of the faults in the power grid and the information grid in the power information physical system, thereby providing theoretical guidance for the prevention and control of the cascading faults of the power information physical system.

title_en: Power grid cascading failure risk assessment method considering relay protection refusal influence
abstract_en: The invention provides a power grid cascading failure risk assessment method considering the relay protection refusal influence, and belongs to the technical field of power grid operation risk assessment. The method comprises the following steps: s1, selecting a target system, considering the influence of the running environment and running state of the relay protection equipment, and establishing a failure probability model of the relay protection equipment; s2, obtaining the action rejection probability of each relay protection device in the target system according to the action rejection probability model of the relay protection device established in S1; s3, obtaining the state probability of the target system according to the primary failure probability of the target system and the action rejection probability of each relay protection device; and S4, performing risk assessment on the cascading failure of the target system according to the improved state space segmentation method.

title_en: Multi-energy complementary combined cooling heating power micro-grid frame and modeling method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-energy complementary combined cooling heating power micro-grid framework and a modeling method thereof. The invention relates to the technical field of a multi-energy complementary combined cooling heating power micro-grid, which is a comprehensive energy network system which integrates various energy supply equipment, loads, energy conversion devices, cold-heat electric energy storage devices and the like and is provided with a protection device. The multi-energy complementary micro-grid can supply multiple energy sources such as cold, heat and electricity simultaneously, different energy sources can be mutually converted or utilized in a cascade mode, and the energy utilization efficiency in an area is improved to the greatest extent. Compared with the traditional energy supply mode of the micro-grid, the multi-energy complementary micro-grid has obvious advantages.

title_en: Wind power prediction method based on weighted fuzzy clustering
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind power prediction method based on weighted fuzzy clustering, which comprises the following steps: 1, selecting weather features with strong correlation based on a gray correlation theory; dividing the key meteorological feature set into data sample subsets by using a feature weighted fuzzy C-means clustering algorithm, and adopting back propagation neural network classification modeling; and 3, calling a model most similar to the characteristics of the current period to perform power prediction, and determining the wind power output of the model by utilizing a membership function to synthesize a plurality of prediction models for perfecting the belonging relation of boundary data. According to the method, the matching degree of meteorological features and the sample subset is enhanced from two angles of classification modeling and feature matching, potential connection is excavated from wind power signals with random fluctuation, and the prediction accuracy of a wind power model is improved.

title_en: Method for calculating fault tolerance performance of interdependent circuit network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for calculating fault tolerance performance of an interdependent circuit network, and belongs to the fields of fault tolerance, robustness and reliability of the interdependent circuit network. Most dependent networks are not fragile in the real world. Therefore, in order to find a more accurate model to explain the mechanism of the actual cascading failure, the relation between the fault-tolerant distribution and the interdependent network robustness is deeply determined, so that the problem of calculating the fault-tolerant performance of the interdependent circuit network is solved. The fault tolerance of the combined circuit calculated by the invention changes the circuit structure or the node capacity in the circuit in real time, maximizes the fault tolerance of the combined circuit and increases the robustness and stability of the combined circuit.

title_en: Fire extinguishing bomb throwing strategy simulation method and system based on neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire extinguishing bomb throwing strategy simulation method and system based on a neural network, comprising the following steps: s1: collecting historical fire scene parameters and fire extinguishing bomb throwing strategy parameters as an original data set, and carrying out normalization or single-heat coding treatment on each parameter in the data set to obtain a preprocessed data set; s2: oversampling the preprocessed data set by using a data enhancement algorithm to obtain an enhanced data set; s3: training the self-coding network based on the enhanced data set, and obtaining the encoded data set by using the self-coding network after training; s4: constructing a fire extinguishing bomb throwing strategy generating network based on the coded data set and calculating a forward propagation process; s5: and constructing a loss function, training a fire extinguishing bomb throwing strategy generation network, and simulating the fire extinguishing bomb throwing strategy by using the trained fire extinguishing bomb throwing strategy generation network. The invention can provide a comprehensive, efficient and intelligent fire extinguishing bomb throwing strategy simulation solution.

title_en: Cascade water light and light storage complementary planning and scheduling method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a cascade water light storage complementary planning and scheduling method and system, which belong to the field of operation control of electric power systems, and comprise the steps of calculating target electric quantity of a cascade water light storage complementary system in each unit time period to be transmitted to a power grid according to total guaranteed electric quantity of the cascade water light storage complementary system in a unit time period in a scheduling period, calculating total regulated electric quantity of the cascade water light storage complementary system in any unit time period according to the total guaranteed electric quantity and total water light resource electric quantity of any unit time period, determining regulated electric quantity of each reservoir according to the total regulated electric quantity and preset quota coefficients corresponding to each reservoir in the cascade water light storage complementary system, and determining water level change quantity of each reservoir according to the regulated electric quantity and a potential energy analysis formula of each reservoir. According to the invention, the distribution scheduling model based on the reservoir power generation potential energy analysis expression is established, so that the reservoir optimization scheduling is converted from the traditional high-dimensional nonlinear programming problem into the algebraic solving problem, and the efficiency and stability in calculating the water level variation of the reservoir are improved.

title_en: Seismic damage estimation method and system for electric power system
title_ko: 전력계통의 지진 피해 예측 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for estimating damage to an electric power system on an earthquake scenario which is input. The method for estimating damage to an electric power system includes: a step of estimating electric power system component dependence in accordance with connection information on an electric power system from a network topology model in which database including connection information on the electric power system to be estimated, component position information, and component initial service supply information comprises a set of individual cells; a step of estimating a maximum ground acceleration of the electric power system component in accordance with the position information on the electric power system component and an earthquake scenario which a user inputs; a step of estimating common cause damage of the electric power system component in accordance with the estimated maximum ground acceleration; a step of estimating series damage of the electric power system component in accordance with the estimation of the common cause damage and the dependence of the electric power system component; and a step of estimating a final service providing rate of the electric power system after an earthquake based on initial service supply information of the electric power system component and estimation of the series damage.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 입력된 지진 시나리오에 대한 전력계통의 피해를 예측하는 방법에 관한 것으로, 평가 대상 전력계통의 연결정보, 구성요소 위치정보, 구성요소 초기 서비스 공급정보를 포함하는 데이터베이스가 개별 셀의 집합으로 이루어진 네트워크 토폴로지 모델로부터 전력계통의 연결정보에 따라 전력계통 구성요소 의존도를 평가하는 단계, 사용자가 입력한 지진 시나리오와 상기 전력계통 구성요소의 위치정보에 따라 상기 전력계통 구성요소 최대지반가속도를 추정하는 단계, 상기 추정된 최대지반가속도에 따라 상기 전력계통 구성요소의 공통원인피해를 평가하는 단계, 상기 전력계통 구성요소의 의존도와 상기 공통원인피해 평가에 따라 상기 전력계통 구성요소의 연쇄피해를 평가하는 단계 및 상기 연쇄피해 평가와 상기 전력계통 구성요소의 초기 서비스 공급정보로부터 지진 이후 전력계통의 최종 서비스 제공 가능도를 예측하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Transmission System of Fire Alarm Propagation and Escape Road at Apartment
title_ko: 아파트 화재 발생 시의 화재 발생 경보 전파 및 대피로 제공 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for disseminating a fire alarm and providing an evacuation route when a fire breaks out in an apartment building. The system for disseminating a fire alarm and providing an evacuation route, according to the present invention, comprises: an apartment management server; a user smart terminal for each household; a rooftop entrance digital door lock module; a fire detection module; and an Internet network or a wireless communication network. According to the present invention, when a fire breaks out in a collective residential area, it is possible to quickly provide a fire alarm to the upper floor, lower floor, and next door of a corresponding apartment house number, such that residents can evacuate.
abstract_ko: 본 발명 각 세대가 지정한 사용자 스마트 단말기 고유 정보와 사용자가 거주하는 아파트 메인 출입구와 거주 층을 나타내는 호수 정보 및 해당 옥상 출입문 디지털 도어락 모듈의 고유 정보 및 각 세대별로 설치되는 화재 감지 모듈 고유 정보를 등록받아 저장하고, 임의의 화재 발생 아파트 호수를 기초로 대피로를 미리 설정하여 이미지 형태로 저장하며, 아파트의 어느 호수에서 화재가 발생하여 해당 화재 감지 모듈로부터 화재 감지 정보를 수신하고, 수신된 화재 감지 정보를 기초로 해당 동 해당 호수의 화재 발생 경보를 생성하며, 해당 동 해당 호수 화재 발생 정보를 기준으로 기 등록하여 저장된 사용자 스마트 단말기 전화 번호 정보를 그룹핑하며, 그룹별로 기 설정하여 저장된 대피로 정보를 해당 그룹핑된 해당 사용자 스마트 단말기 전화 번호로 해당 동 해당 호수 화재 발생 경보와 함께 제공하고, 화재 발생 경보를 해당 동 해당 호수가 속하는 해당 옥상 출입문 디지털 도어락 모듈로 전송하는 아파트 관리 서버와, 아파트 관리 서버에 저장 등록되는 것으로 화재 발생 시에는 해당 동의 해당 화재 발생 호수를 기준으로 아파트 관리 서버에 의하여 그룹핑되며, 그룹별로 아파트 관리 서버로부터 해당 동 해당 호수 화재 발생 경보와 대피로 이미지 정보를 수신하여 제공하는 해당 아파트 동별, 호수별 각 세대의 사용자 스마트 단말기와, 아파트 각 동의 메인 출입구 계단 상부 끝단에서 옥상으로 출입하도록 옥상 출입문에 설치되는 것으로 아파트 관리 서버로부터 해당 동의 해당 호수 화재 발생 경보를 수신하여 도어의 록킹을 해제하도록 제어하여 옥상으로 주민이 대피하도록 하는 해당 동의 해당 호수가 속하는 옥상 출입문 디지털 도어락 모듈 및 아파트 각 세대에 설치되는 것으로 다수의 화재 감지 센서가 연결되어 화재 발생시에 화재 감지 정보와 고유 정보를 아파트 관리 서버로 전송하는 화재 감지 모듈로 구성된 것을 특징으로 하는 것이다.

title_en: A kind of ultra wide band gallium nitride device small-signal model and its parameter extracting method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of ultra wide band gallium nitride device small-signal model and its parameter extracting method, the small-signal model is respectively adopted three interconnection capacitances and cascade inductance network structure type, including 18 parasitic parameters and 10 intrinsic parameters in grid, source and drain；Parasitic parameter including outer layer parasitic capacitance Cpgi1, Cpdi1, Cgdi1 etc., stray inductance Lgi1, Ldi1, Lsi1 etc., dead resistance Rg, Rd, Rs；Intrinsic parameters include intrinsic capacity Cgd, Cgs, Cds, intrinsic resistance Rgs, Rgd, Rds, intrinsic current source Ids=ViG m e ‑jωta In parameter Gm and ta.The model can be with accurate description high-frequency element characteristic, so that model has broader application frequency band, highest can be applied to W frequency ranges；The parameter extracting method can have good stability with implementation model parameter in the frequency range of 0.2 110GHz.

title_en: Key line identification method and device for cascading failure of power system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for identifying a key line of cascading failures of a power system, belonging to the field of cascading failure risk analysis and stability research of the power system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: performing cascading failure direct current power flow simulation on the power system to acquire failure chain data required by identification; decomposing the fault chain data into states at different moments to form a state network; based on a state network, solving a line risk value of a line fault in the state of the cascading faults at different moments by using an SARSA algorithm; and determining the line corresponding to the line risk value exceeding the given threshold value as the critical line of the cascading failure. The method can realize high-risk fault line identification based on cascading fault data, and carry out risk mitigation, prevention and control on cascading faults at different moments so as to guarantee safe and stable operation of the power system.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Multi-distribution network collaborative distributed optimal scheduling method and system based on target cascading method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-distribution network collaborative distributed optimal scheduling method and system based on a target cascading method, and relates to the technical field of comprehensive energy system and power system transmission and distribution collaboration. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring operation data and interaction data of a power transmission network and a power distribution network; constructing a transmission network optimization scheduling model and a distribution network optimization scheduling model; carrying out coupling solution on the power transmission network optimization scheduling model and the power distribution network optimization scheduling model by utilizing a target cascading algorithm; and carrying out optimal scheduling on the power transmission network and the power distribution network according to the solving result. According to the invention, power interaction between the power transmission network and the power distribution network is considered, coupling power exchange between the power distribution network is also considered, an optimal scheduling model of a plurality of power distribution networks and the power transmission network is established, analysis and optimization are carried out, and more efficient power use and more stable power network operation are ensured.
assignees: TAIAN POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Bayesian network-based fault diagnosis method for complex system in nuclear power plant
abstract_en: The application discloses a Bayesian network-based fault diagnosis method for a complex system in a nuclear power plant, which is based on a dynamic fault tree and utilizes a conversion rule to construct a dynamic Bayesian network model of the system, and specifically comprises the following steps: establishing a dynamic fault tree; constructing a system dynamic Bayesian network model by using the conversion rule; determining a conditional probability table of the Bayesian network; calculating to obtain a diagnosis result. The application combines dynamic fault tree analysis with Bayesian network, describes the fault behavior and fault propagation of the system by utilizing the dynamic fault tree model, then converts the fault behavior and fault propagation into the Bayesian network model, realizes fault diagnosis of the nuclear power plant system by means of probabilistic reasoning and learning, has large calculated amount by combining complex T-S dynamic gate description rules and dynamic fault tree algorithms, and solves the problem of complex calculation of the dynamic fault tree by utilizing condition independence assumption and bidirectional reasoning algorithm to calculate node failure probability and posterior probability in the dynamic Bayesian network.

title_en: Photovoltaic power station set time power prediction method based on network model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for predicting the set time power of a photovoltaic power station based on a network model, which comprises the following steps of 1, counting historical data of factors influencing the set time power of the photovoltaic power station according to a set period according to the sequence of the historical time, deleting error data in the historical data, and finally obtaining sample data of photovoltaic power prediction according to a normalization method, 2, carrying out salient operation on the factors influencing the set power of the photovoltaic power station by utilizing an ant colony algorithm to assist a BP neural network model, carrying out deep learning on weighted historical data of various factors by utilizing the BP neural network model, and carrying out forward propagation from an input layer to an output layer.
assignees: CHINA YANGTZE POWER CO LTD;CHANGDIAN XINNENG CO LTD;NANJING NARI RELAYS ENG TECH

title_en: Submarine cable risk dynamic assessment method and system based on multi-modal deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a submarine cable risk dynamic assessment method and system based on multi-mode deep learning, and belongs to the field of marine infrastructure operation and maintenance. Aiming at the problems of incomplete data coverage, incomplete generation scene, low evaluation reliability and the like in the prior art, the method comprises the steps of 1) constructing a multi-source heterogeneous data set containing six types of data such as geology, ocean, ships and biology, adopting space-time grid coding to realize data alignment, 2) designing a physical constraint generation countermeasure network, generating risk scene data conforming to a hydrodynamic rule through Navier-Stokes equation constraint, 3) creating a layered space-time fusion network (HST-transform), combining CNN spatial feature extraction, a time sequence attention mechanism and a dynamic memory module to realize multi-mode fusion, 4) establishing a mixed uncertainty quantization frame to distinguish cognitive uncertainty and inherent data noise, and 5) integrating a digital twin platform to realize risk propagation simulation and inverse fact intervention analysis. According to the invention, the rare risk event detection rate is improved by 62%, the evaluation accuracy rate reaches 91.7%, and compared with the traditional method, the false alarm rate is reduced by 34%, so that submarine cable breakage accidents can be effectively prevented.

title_en: Intelligent scheduling system for power grid safety guarantee of multi-source data analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent scheduling system for power grid safety guarantee of multi-source data analysis, which comprises an air-ground sensing layer, a multi-source data fusion engine, an extreme weather decision closed loop module, a power grid immune engine and an intelligent execution terminal, wherein the air-ground sensing layer is used for collecting meteorological data, equipment state data and power grid operation data, the multi-source data fusion engine is used for carrying out space-time alignment and feature extraction on multi-source heterogeneous data to generate a power grid panoramic state matrix, the extreme weather decision closed loop module is used for deducing a disaster propagation path through federal learning based on the power grid panoramic state matrix and outputting a scheduling control instruction, the power grid immune engine is used for receiving the power grid panoramic state matrix, simulating a hidden fault chain through a digital twin body and dynamically generating a protection device correction strategy, and the intelligent execution terminal is used for executing the scheduling control instruction and the protection device correction strategy and feeding back a physical power grid state to the digital twin body. According to the invention, through multi-source data fusion and an intelligent algorithm, panoramic sensing, disaster pre-judgment, dynamic protection and strategy optimization of the power grid are realized, and the safety guarantee capability is improved.
assignees: GUONENG CHANGZHOU POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: smart home service platform system and method
title_ko: 스마트 홈 통합 플랫폼 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: According to the present invention, a smart home integration platform system comprises: a database server which stores data including in-house system identification information, in-house data and analysis information, event occurrence information, and emergency situation information for a plurality of subscribers; a data analysis server which receives and analyzes the in-house data provided from the in-house system, stores the in-house data and analysis information in the database server, based on the analysis information, detects an emergency in a house in which the in-house system is installed, generates emergency notification information based on the detection and outputs the emergency notification information to the outside; and an intelligent emergency system which provides emergency notification information to predetermined client systems or terminals corresponding to the in-house system identification information included in the emergency notification information so as to propagate an emergency situation when the emergency notification information is provided from the data analysis server, and generates response information for the emergency situation according to a request from the client system or the terminal and stores the response information in addition to the emergency situation information. In particular, the intelligent emergency system generates report information upon request from the client system or the terminal after the emergency situation is propagated and transmits the report information to a social safety network service provider system. According to the present invention, smart home services can be provided stably and efficiently.
abstract_ko:
본 발명에 따르는 스마트 홈 통합 플랫폼 시스템은, 다수의 가입자에 대한 댁내 시스템 식별정보, 댁내 데이터 및 분석정보, 이벤트 발생정보, 응급상황 현황정보를 포함하는 데이터를 저장하는 데이터베이스 서버; 댁내 시스템으로부터 제공되는 댁내 데이터를 제공받아 분석함과 아울러 상기 댁내 데이터 및 분석정보를 상기 데이터베이스 서버에 저장하고, 상기 분석정보를 토대로 어느 한 댁내 시스템이 설치된 댁내의 응급상황을 검지하고 그에따른 응급상황 통지정보를 생성하여 외부로 출력하는 데이터 분석 서버; 및 상기 데이터 분석 서버로부터 응급상황 통지정보가 제공되면, 상기 응급상황 통지정보에 포함된 댁내 시스템 식별정보에 대응되게 미리 정해진 클라이언트 시스템 또는 단말기들로 응급상황 통지정보를 제공하여 응급상황을 전파함과 아울러 상기 클라이언트 시스템 또는 단말기로부터의 요청에 따라 응급상황에 대한 대응정보를 생성하여 상기 응급상황 현황정보에 부가하여 저장하는 지능형 응급 시스템;을 포함한다.  
특히 상기 지능형 응급 시스템이, 상기 응급상황의 전파후에 상기 클라이언트 시스템 또는 단말기로부터의 요청에 따라 신고정보를 생성하여 사회안전망 서비스 제공자 시스템으로 전송;함을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Earthquake damage prediction and prevention system and method thereof
abstract_en: Proposed is an earthquake damage prediction and prevention system (1) for determining an impact or damage caused by an earthquake to objects associated with different geographical locations (A,B,C,D). A central unit with a filter module selects and collects earthquake related data of a plurality of network units. At least one impact ratio table (151) is stored with a first data structure for storing geographical and/or topographical data coordinates of the different geographical locations (A,B,C,D). The geometric distances of the geographical locations (A,B,C,D) from a hypocenter/epicenter (2) are generated by an intensity calculation module (104) with a coordinates processor. Local intensity values based upon the generated geometric distances and a given earthquake magnitude by means of a stored parameterization comprising variable weight parameters are generated by means of a propagation calculation unit of the intensity calculation module (104), whereas the generated geometric distances are stored assigned to the corresponding geographical locations (A,B,C,D) by means of a second data structure of the impact ratio table (151). At least one of the variable weight parameters and/or at least one impact ratio for different earthquake intensity levels indicative of the impact or damage caused by an earthquake to the object and/or at least one object parameter defining earthquake exposed structures of the object are received from a plurality of users. By means of an index calculation module (105) the impact index for the geographical locations (A, B, C, D) generated by determining in each case from the impact ratio table (151) the impact ratio for the local intensity at the respective geographical location (A, B, C, D), and adding up the impact ratios weighted in each case by the weighting factor assigned to the respective geographical location (A, B, C, D).

title_en: Asset and project management platform for service industries
abstract_en: An asset and project management platform for field service industries includes a delegation of work hierarchy having a pool of field service industry providers for performing a field service build out, upgrade, or repair of a new or an existing infrastructure is disclosed. Work orders and corresponding data files are associated with the pool of field service industry providers and the field service build out, upgrade, or repair of the new or existing infrastructure. A data file management system provides data cascading and reverse cascading protocols and permissions for information exchange of data files across the delegation of work hierarchy. The platforms include labor, materials and the application of labor and materials management systems for organizing labor, materials, and the application of labor and materials for the field service build out, upgrade, or repair of the new or existing infrastructure corresponding to one or more work orders.

title_en: A kind of time-based initial stage power grid cascading fault simulation emulation mode
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of time-based initial stage power grid cascading fault simulation emulation modes comprising is formulated influence of the fuel factor to route of circuit overload, respectively the parameter of analysis circuit；When being modeled to electric network fault, consideration cascading failure, rather than influence of the single failure to system；It is proposed electric network fault overload severity index；Consider the influence that load curve changes with time to system；It recalculates the trend of network, and using calculated result forms overload index to differentiate whether route because of the passage of time leads to the m times failure, traffic overload during electric network fault is monitored to realize with this；The present invention is Study on Power Grid Planning personnel optimization electric network composition, promotes power grid anti-disaster ability and provides help, can be more comprehensively more acurrate, and finer description electric network fault evolution process early period provides reference for Study on Power Grid Planning and researcher.

title_en: Method, device and medium for measuring survivability of living material supply network considering cascade failure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a living material supply network destructiveness measurement method, device and medium considering cascade failure, the method comprises the steps of obtaining basic data of a target area, preprocessing the basic data, dividing the target area into grids, wherein the basic data comprise mobile phone signaling data, POI data, urban road data and administrative data, constructing a supply-demand network according to the mobile phone signaling data and the POI data based on the preprocessed administrative data, calculating service amounts of supply points in the supply-demand network, constructing the supply network according to the service amounts of the supply points and the preprocessed urban road data, finding main supply points corresponding to low-toughness communities in the supply-demand network based on community toughness sorting, formulating an attack strategy, and measuring destructiveness of the supply network service efficiency under the attack strategy based on a cascade failure model. The method provides references for the urban living material supply and guarantee system and urban management under sudden heavy disasters.

title_en: Prediction method, system and prediction terminal for effective period of photovoltaic power generation
abstract_en: The invention provides a prediction method, a prediction system and a prediction terminal for a photovoltaic power generation effective period, which relate to the technical field of distributed new energy, and are used for collecting and acquiring data information of a distributed photovoltaic power station in a prediction area and carrying out normalization processing; establishing an undirected graph with weights to consider spatial correlation among the distributed photovoltaic power stations; determining a neighbor power station set of each power station by adopting a graph convolution neural network; adopting a back propagation neural network to process missing values and abnormal values in the system; based on the data information of the distributed photovoltaic power station in the system, performing four-rule operation to obtain the operated characteristics of the data information; and establishing a prediction model by utilizing an integrated learning strategy, and executing a prediction process on the power generation effective period based on the prediction model. The method can help energy management personnel to better predict the available time period of new energy power generation, thereby optimizing energy supply and use plans and improving energy utilization efficiency.

title_en: Method for predicting CGBoost of susceptibility to common-earthquake landslide
abstract_en: The invention provides a common-earthquake landslide susceptibility prediction CGBoost algorithm, equipment and storage equipment, which construct a common-earthquake landslide influence factor set according to a common-earthquake landslide disaster-tolerant environment and disaster-inducing characteristics; crossgat is proposed based on GAT, simplified attention, and cascading aggregation; integrating CGBoost networks according to Crossgat and XGBoost: coupling 2 branches Crossgat and XGBoost for integrated learning, and extracting associated characterization of the inside of a slope unit, between slope units and between a prediction index and the susceptibility; inputting the same-earthquake landslide influence factor set into CGBoost network, carrying out self-adaptive weighted fusion on the associated features to obtain high-level features with rich and high discrimination degree, converting the high-level features into the probability of the vulnerability, carrying out the prediction of the vulnerability of the wide area, and grading the vulnerability of the wide area according to the probability of the vulnerability. A common-earthquake landslide susceptibility prediction device and a storage device are used for realizing a common-earthquake landslide susceptibility prediction CGBoost algorithm. The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows: the method is applied to the newly-generated large earthquake event in future, and the quick emergency landslide susceptibility prediction after earthquake is realized.

title_en: Method and device for rapidly calculating traffic noise map, electronic equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid calculation method, a rapid calculation device, electronic equipment and a rapid calculation medium for a traffic noise map, wherein the rapid calculation method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of forming a noise source file through multi-source data, converting a building contour shape file into a building binary image, then obtaining an initial noise map grid matrix through a road network and the building contour shape file in a receiving point sound pressure level prediction stage, establishing an initial noise propagation matrix for each road section according to atmospheric attenuation, angle attenuation and road section limited correction coefficients, calculating building density noise attenuation through a Bresenham algorithm, calculating front building noise shielding attenuation according to the building contour shape file, and finally carrying out mapping and acoustic energy superposition on the noise propagation matrices of all road sections according to the initial noise map grid matrix in a result aggregation stage to obtain a road traffic noise map with a complete research area, wherein the method can be widely applied to the technical field of data processing.

title_en: Novel physical information neural network method for solving seismic wave equation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of earthquake engineering, in particular to a novel physical information neural network (gs-PINN) for solving a seismic wave equation, which comprises the steps of establishing the novel physical information neural network, dividing configuration points required by network training, determining the form of incident waves, developing network training, namely acquiring a solution of a one-dimensional seismic wave fluctuation equation, wherein the first layer of hidden layer of each sub-network is composed of two sub-networks, the parameters of which are untrainable parameters, the values of which are determined by the propagation direction of the seismic wave, and the rest parameters are trainable parameters, so that the network can automatically meet the one-dimensional seismic wave fluctuation equation, the network is effectively prevented from being trapped into local optimum, the training difficulty is greatly reduced, and a powerful technical support is provided for solving the one-dimensional seismic wave fluctuation equation.

title_en: Determination of seismic notification to reduce seismic notification time of earthquake early warning system for artificial earthquake and natural earthquake
title_ko: 인공지진 및 자연지진에 대한 지진조기경보 시스템의 지진통보시간을 단축하기 위한 지진통보 결정방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an earthquake notification determination method performed in an earthquake early warning system for artificial earthquakes and natural earthquakes, which collects earthquake information measured in real time at each earthquake observatory through an integrated earthquake observation network, which comprises: a step of receiving new earthquake information renewed when a combination of new Assoc. observatories is added while a trigger observatory increases as a P-wave phase propagates from an epicenter (S100); and a step of quickly notifying an earthquake when the new earthquake information has a noticeable reliability and is determined as a quick earthquake notification by a logical condition considering spatial characteristics of the earthquake observatory and the magnitude of energy of P waves and S waves.

title_en: Fault hazard index calculation and vulnerability assessment method for smart power grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fault hazard index calculation and vulnerability assessment method for an intelligent power grid, which comprises the following steps of: constructing a dependent coupling network topology model of the smart power grid in an abstract mode according to the power grid and the information network; acquiring a fault element set according to the node fault of the power grid and the node fault of the information grid, and acquiring a fault hazard index of a node according to the fault element set; obtaining coupling secondary fault propagation of the node according to the interactive propagation of the fault and the bidirectional coupling of the smart grid, and obtaining a coupling secondary fault hazard index of the node according to the coupling secondary fault propagation of the node; and acquiring a node secondary comprehensive fault hazard index according to the node fault hazard index and the node coupling secondary fault hazard index, and acquiring a node vulnerability evaluation index according to the node secondary comprehensive fault hazard index. The method considers the coupling of the smart grid and the interactive propagation of the fault, and the obtained system vulnerability analysis result is more visual and accurate.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECHNICAL RES INSTITUTE STATE GRID SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Thermal power generating unit control system modeling method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure provides a method, a device, equipment and a medium for modeling a thermal power generating unit control system, belongs to the technical field of data processing, and specifically comprises the following steps: collecting a time sequence data set; converting a transfer function model corresponding to a thermal power unit control system into a discrete form of a state space model with an uncertain item through a neural ordinary differential equation network to obtain a state equation; inputting the state variable and the input variable into a state equation to obtain an approximate value of first order differential; normalizing the approximate value, inputting the normalized approximate value into an ordinary differential solver, and calculating a predicted value; and (4) performing back propagation on the predicted value, and iteratively training weight parameters in the neural ordinary differential equation network until convergence, so as to obtain a prediction model corresponding to the thermal power unit control system. According to the scheme disclosed by the invention, the neural ordinary differential equation network is taken as a basis, the state space model of the system is combined, and the state equation structure knowledge is introduced to model the system, so that the prediction accuracy and the adaptability after modeling are improved.

title_en: Scheduling method, device, equipment and medium of water-wind-storage complementary power generation system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power grid dispatching and discloses a dispatching method, a device, equipment and a medium of a water-wind-storage complementary power generation system, wherein the method is used for constructing a target optimization model by taking the minimum system operation cost and the maximum system stable operation index as targets; constructing constraint based on power balance constraint, generator set output constraint, reactive power constraint, regional load constraint, node voltage constraint and cascade hydropower station constraint of the generator set; solving the target optimization model to obtain an optimal solution conforming to constraint conditions; forming a scheduling scheme based on the optimal solution to complete power scheduling according to the scheduling scheme; therefore, a group of optimal solutions which can ensure the stable operation of the system and enable the operation cost of the system to be the lowest are obtained, and further, a scheduling scheme can be formed according to the optimal solutions to finish the scheduling work of the power.
assignees: YANGTZE RIVER THREE GORGES GROUP IND DEVELOPMENT BEIJING CO LTD;CHINA THREE GORGES CORP

title_en: Power grid dynamic knowledge graph link prediction method for quantum walk and quantum thermodynamics
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for predicting dynamic power grid knowledge graph links of quantum wander and quantum thermodynamics, which relates to the technical field of defect diagnosis and dynamic graph representation learning of main equipment of a power system, and comprises the steps of collecting relevant data of dynamic power grid knowledge graphs, including states, connection relations and time stamps of power grid equipment, constructing a data set, and dividing the data set into a training set and a testing set; constructing a power grid dynamic knowledge graph link prediction model based on quantum migration and quantum thermodynamics, wherein the model comprises a quantum migration perception encoder and a temperature perception mixed expert model decoder; training the model by using training set data, and optimizing model parameters by a back propagation algorithm to obtain a trained model; and evaluating the trained model by using the test set. The method can accurately predict possible faults of the power grid equipment in the future and improve the stability and safety of the power grid.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID SHANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Auxiliary decision-making method and device for distribution network based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distribution network auxiliary decision-making method and device based on artificial intelligence, which relate to the technical field of distribution networks, wherein the method comprises the steps of decomposing a signal of a current corresponding to each network element in a target distribution network topological graph, converting the signal into an initial space-time characteristic graph, substituting a preset network for fault detection, carrying out depth-first search by taking a fault position as a starting point if the fault detection is fault, generating a target fault influence area, determining the final fault probability of the network element according to each network element in the target fault influence area, and carrying out scheme decision according to the final fault probability of each network element. The signal decomposition and the modal component extraction can more accurately capture the tiny fault signals, then convert the initial modal components into space-time characteristic diagrams, better reflect the state change of the power distribution network before and after the fault, accurately predict the spreading range of the fault by combining the fault influence area, and improve the fault processing efficiency when the fault is propagated in the face of the power grid topology.
assignees: DONGXU LANTIAN SMART ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Ground satellite signal distributed cooperative processing method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a distributed cooperative processing method and a system for ground satellite signals, which relate to the technical field of communication, wherein the method comprises the steps of extracting a user MAC address hash value, an emergency priority code and a frequency spectrum occupation matrix from a synchronous network to generate a triplet feature vector; the three-tuple feature vector is transmitted through a double-layer Mesh network, two reference target points with fixed geographic coordinates on the ground of a disaster area are selected, three-dimensional coordinates of the two reference target points are obtained, a space reference straight line is constructed, the vertical projection distance from each node to the space reference straight line is calculated according to real-time position data of each node, a node offset parameter is generated, a refraction correction coefficient of a signal propagation path is dynamically generated based on a comparison result of the node offset parameter and a preset threshold value, and when the offset exceeds the threshold value, a piecewise linear interpolation method is adopted to increase correction weight. The invention can realize high-reliability low-delay emergency communication coverage.
assignees: BEIJING SIGONG HUIZHI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power transmission network fault positioning system based on edge agent cooperation decision
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power transmission network fault positioning system based on edge agent cooperative decision, and belongs to the technical field of power system fault diagnosis. The system comprises a token relay communication module, a consensus arbitration module and an unknown event cognition module, wherein the token relay communication module is used for carrying out orderly token directional relay transfer among edge intelligent agents according to the physical propagation direction of fault energy wave fronts, the consensus arbitration module is used for diagnosing and arbitrating the health degree of a preliminary positioning conclusion through joint evaluation of decision entropy and physical space correlation so as to inhibit error consensus caused by systematic deviation, and the unknown event cognition module is used for stopping positioning and generating a structured characteristic sketch report when detecting an unknown fault in a semantic gap with a local knowledge stock. The invention fundamentally improves the reliability, robustness and safety of fault location by constructing a complete-flow ordered cooperative mechanism.

title_en: Safe Evacuation System for optimal evacuation in case of emergency and the method therof
title_ko: 비상시 안전 유도 표시 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to safe guidance display system and method in case of emergency and, more specifically, to a system and method which display an evacuation route using a digital information display or a laser light to help people in a space to be safely evacuated in case of emergency such as the occurrence of a disaster. The safe guidance display system in case of emergency according to the present invention comprises: a scanning unit which recognizes the type of emergency and location; a storage unit which stores information on evacuation routes; a central processing unit which calculates the risk of each evacuation route based on information on the type of emergency and the location which are recognized by the scanning unit, and information on the evacuation routes which is read from the storage unit, and generates a safe evacuation route through the calculated risk; a display unit which displays the evacuation route generated by the central processing unit; and a situation broadcasting unit which broadcasts the evacuation route generated by the central processing unit by voice or lighting. According to the present invention, the safe guidance display system and method guides people to the optimal evacuation route and quickly evacuates them from a facility, which is used by many people, when an emergency occurs.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 비상시 안전 유도 표시 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 재난 발생 등 비상시 해당 공간에 있는 사람이 안전하게 대피를 유도할 수 있도록 디지털 정보 표시장치나 레이저 조명을 이용하여 대피로를 표시해 주는 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따른 비상시 안전 유도 표시 시스템은 비상 발생 종류와 위치를 인지하기 위한 검지부,대피 경로의 정보를 저장하고 있는 저장장치부, 검지부로부터 인지한 비상 발생 종류와 위치 정보 그리고 저장부로 무터 읽어 들인 대피 경로 정보를 바탕으로 대피 경로별 위험도를 계산하고, 계산된 상기 위험도를 통해 안전 대피 경로를 발생하는 중앙처리장치, 중앙처리장치에서 발생한 대피 경로를 표시하기 위한 표시부, 중앙처리장치에서 발생한 대피경로를 음성이나 조명으로 전파하기 위한 상황전파부를 포함하는 것이다. 
본 본발에 따른 비상시 안전 유도 표시 시스템 및 방법은 비상시 안전 유도 표시 시스템 및 방법에 의하면 다중 이용자가 이용하는 시설에서 비상 발생 시 최적의 대피 경로를 안내 받아 신속하게 대피하여 이용자의 안전을 확보할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Air Quality Information Sharing System and Method of Multi-use Facilities
title_ko: 다중이용시설의 공기질정보 공유시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an air quality information sharing system of a multi-use facility and a method thereof, and, more specifically, to a system which enables residents or users (visitors) of a multi-use facility like an indoor car park to receive and share rapidly transferred measured air quality data and a method thereof. An embodiment of the present invention provides the air quality information sharing system of the multi-use facility comprising: an air quality sensor installed at places of the multi-use facility to periodically measure and output air quality items listed in indoor air quality related rules; an air quality management server collecting and analyzing air quality data outputted by the air quality sensor and controlling an on-site output device to output the air quality data; and the on-site output device installed on the spot of the multi-use facility and outputting air quality related environmental information to the users and the residents of the multi-use facility in various manners by controlling the air quality management server, digitizing and displaying the air quality data to enable the users to see the air quality, and inducing guidance and evacuation by sound (voice) or lighting (flickering) in the case that the measured value (air quality data) is higher than a reference or a state of the air quality exceeds a reference which has a harmful effect on a physical body.

title_en: Method for modeling and optimizing cascade failure survivability of airspace sector network
abstract_en: The invention defines the cascade failure of the airspace sector network, adopts an improved capacity-load model, combines a network topological structure with the actual work of the airspace management, considers the flow and the airspace structure to define the load of the network nodes of the airspace sector, and defines the capacity of the node of the sector which is more in line with the actual situation of the airspace management. And establishing a model according to the cascade failure process of the airspace sector network, and determining a critical threshold value and a sector abnormal rate as a measure index of the cascade failure survivability of the airspace sector network. And optimizing the cascade failure survivability of the airspace sector network by optimizing a load redistribution mode, and providing a strategy of adjacent load redistribution and local load redistribution based on the residual capacity. Taking a central and south control sector network as an example to perform an analog simulation cascade failure process, analyzing to obtain that a sector node which is close to a large-load capacity sector node and has a small value and strength is easy to become a failure bottleneck, and simultaneously finding out a congestion bottleneck node; further simulation verifies that the critical threshold value and the abnormal sector rate can be reduced by both optimization strategies.

title_en: Automatic searching and early warning method, device and equipment for power grid cascading failures
abstract_en: The invention relates to an automatic searching and early warning method, device and equipment for power grid cascading failures, belonging to the technical field of risk early warning of power systems, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring initial fault information of a target power grid; calculating the line load rate, the electric betweenness and the break-off influence value of each line of the target power grid; according to the line load rate, the electric betweenness and the break-over influence value of each line of the target power grid, and a sequential fault searching strategy which is inspired by dispatcher experience and is not caused, a preset system sequential fault searching rule is started through periodic triggering and/or non-periodic triggering, enumeration type automatic searching is carried out on a power flow transfer path after initial multiple faults of the power grid occur, branches with heavy load and large transfer factors in the transfer path are used as candidate sequential faults, a dangerous path set which possibly causes the power grid sequential faults is found out, a target power grid sequential fault prediction path is obtained, early warning is carried out, and loss is reduced.

title_en: Power grid planning method considering cascading failure risk
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power grid planning method considering cascading failure risk, which is characterized by comprising the following steps of: step 1: obtaining model parameters in a power grid; step 2: calculating an economical index, a safety index, a adequacy index and a flexibility index; step 3: establishing an evaluation index system based on each index by adopting an analytic hierarchy process; step 4: and establishing a power grid planning model and solving to obtain an optimal planning scheme. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages of improving the utilization rate of new energy, improving the capability of the power grid to cope with cascading failures, and the like.

title_en: BIM-based subway station congestion analysis method, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: BIM-based subway station congestion analysis method, electronic equipment and storage medium belong to the technical field of subway operation. In order to perform congestion analysis on a subway station by using a BIM technology, the invention sets operation nodes of the subway station based on the theory of a complex network to construct a subway station network; acquiring operation data of operation nodes of the subway station to obtain an operation data time sequence of the operation nodes of the subway station, performing data correction and normalization processing on the operation data of the operation nodes of the subway station to obtain operation time sequences of all the operation nodes of the subway station, and performing correlation analysis of the operation nodes of the subway station and congestion propagation process analysis of the operation nodes of the subway station to obtain correlation lag parameters among the operation nodes of the subway station; and setting subway station operation nodes to optimize measures, performing simulation analysis in a BIM model, and performing optimization adjustment on congestion of the subway station operation nodes. The analysis process of the invention is reasonable and effective.

title_en: Full-polarization programmable antenna unit
abstract_en: The full-polarization programmable antenna unit comprises a digital amplitude phase programmable matching network module and a horn-type radiation antenna module, wherein the digital amplitude phase programmable matching network module comprises a T-shaped power divider, a 90-degree directional coupler, an FPGA control module and two 360-degree digital phase shifters, and the amplitude is realized by mutually cascading the power divider, the 360-degree phase shifters and the 90-degree directional coupler, and the FPGA control module is used for realizing programmable regulation. The amplitude and phase modulation of two polarization components of the antenna unit can be realized through the digital amplitude phase programmable matching network module, specifically, the programmable matching network module for feeding is connected with the antenna radiator through the radio frequency coaxial line, so that the full polarization programmable capacity is greatly improved, the polarization loss can be reduced and the polarization interference capacity can be improved through polarization change in a complex and changeable electromagnetic environment, and the method can also be applied to application scenes such as polarization imaging in combination with related algorithms in the aspect of polarization information identification.

title_ko: 에어커튼기기를 이용한 제연방법 및 그 장치
abstract_ko:
본 고안은 아파트 및 업무용건물등 고층건물(이하"고층건물"이라한다)의 화재시 발생되는 연기 및 유독가스(이하"연기"라고 한다)를 차단하여 연기가 제연구역인 특별피난계단부속실 및 계단실로 전파되는 것을 방지하여 화재시 안전하고 신속히 대피할수 있도록 하는 고층건물의 부속실에 대한 제연방법 및 그 장치에 관한 것 으로서, 종래의 제연방식은 고층건물에 있어서 화재시 화재감지기등에 의해 화재발생이 감지될 경우 자동 또는 수동으로 옥상(또는 지하층)에 설치된 송풍기가 작동하여 옥외의 신선한 공기를 건물내 각층의 제연구역에 설치되어 있는 부속실로 공급하여 부속실의 공기압이 거실 또는 복도(이하 "거실"라고 한다)보다 높은 공기압을 유지토록 하여 화재가 발생한 거실의 연기가 부속실로 들어오지 못하도록 하는 부속실급기가압방식으로 되어 있었다. 
     이러한 방식이 유효하게 작동되기 위해서는 소방법령에 의거 부속실과 거실간의 차압을 40～60파스칼로 유지하여야 하고 이를 위해서는 각층의 제연구역 출입문이 닫혀 있어야 한다. 그러나, 아파트등 대다수 고층건물 거주자들의 화재안전에 대한 인식부족 및 관리소흘 등으로 인하여 상시 닫힌상태로 유지하고 출입시에만 일시적으로 개방하여야 하는 제연구역의 출입문을, 출입편의를 위해 상시 개방하여 놓거나, 또는 제연구역 출입문 부근에 물건등을 적치하여 출입문이 잘 닫혀지지 않게 하는등의 현행 관리실태는 부속실급기가압방식에 있어서 커다란 문제점으로 지적되어 왔다. 
     그리고 종래의 제연설비는 피난을 위하여 제연구역의 출입문이 일시적으로 개방되는 경우에 방연풍속(0.5～0.7m/s)을 유지하기 위하여 부속실에 보충해야할 공기량(이하 "보충량"이라고 한다)은 소방법령상 부속실이 20 이하인 경우에는 1개층이상, 20 초과시에는 2개층이상의 보충량을 반영토록 규정되어 있으나, 국내 소방시설설계업계에서는 특별피난계단제연설비 설계시 소방법령상 최소기준인 부속실이 20 이하인 경우에는 1개층, 20 초과시에는 2개층에 대한 보충량만을 반영하여 관행적으로 설계하였고 그대로 시공 되었다. 이는 실제 화재시 아파트등 고층건물에 거주(또는 통행)하는 다수의 인원(다중)이 화재경보에 접하여 특별피난계단을 이용하여 피난할 경우 혼잡성,급박성,공포감 등으로 인하여 여러개의 층에서 제연구역의 출입문이 동시다발 또는 지속적으로 개방되어있을 개연성을 도외시하는 심각한 오류를 범하고 있는 것 으로서 화재시의 현장상황을 반영하지 않은 탁상공론에 불과한 것 이었다. 
     따라서 본 고안은 상기와 같은 현행의 불합리한 제연방식을 개선하기 위하여 종래의 부속실급기가압방식과 다른개념의 제연방식인 에어커튼기기에 의한 연기차단방식을 새로운 제연방식으로 안출하게 되었다. 즉, 종래의 고층건물 부속실 급기가압제연시스템에서 급기용송풍기(옥상 또는 지하층) 및 급기댐퍼(각층)를 삭제하고 그 대신에 각층의 제연구역경계부분(부속실출입문내측 상단)에 외기 취입구, 수직·수평급기덕트와 연결된 에어커튼기기를 설치한 것 으로서 화재시 화재감지기등에 의해 화재발생이 감지될시 자동 또는 수동으로 각층의 에어커튼기기가 작동되어 에어커튼기기에서 토출되는 공기압에 의해 제연구역 경계부분에 에어커튼(공기막) 이 형성되며 이 에어커튼(공기막)이 화재시 거실에서 발생된 연기를 부속실로 들어오지 못하도록 차단하고, 아울러 에어커튼기기 작동과 동시에 옥상에 설치된 배출용송풍기가 작동하여 화재층 거실의 벽 또는 천장에 위치한 배출댐퍼가 개방되어 피난을 위하여 화재층 부속실출입문이 개방되었을시 거실측으로 유입되는 공기량을 수직배출덕트를 통해 옥상(옥외)으로 배출하므로서 화재층에 대한 공기공급을 억제하여 연소의 확대를 방지하는 제연방식 및 장치에 관한것이다.

title_en: A kind of full-automatic strike-machine test system of superpower laser
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of full-automatic strike-machine test system of superpower laser, including power meter A, power meter B, absorb bucket A, absorb bucket B, light splitting piece A, light splitting piece B, laser, laser output port, cut off circuit, water cooling unit, distribution box, monitor, humidity sensor, photodetector, cigarette propagated sensation sensor and mixed-media network modules mixed-media, computer is connected with power meter A, absorption bucket A is respectively equipped with behind light splitting piece A and light splitting piece B and absorbs bucket B, photodetector is connected by cutting off circuit with laser, laser is provided with laser output, laser is connected with water cooling unit, monitor respectively with humidity sensor, cigarette propagated sensation sensor connects with mixed-media network modules mixed-media, distribution box respectively with monitor, laser connects with bucket A is absorbed.When the present invention solves high-power laser test, laser power meter can monitor the extra disaster that water, electricity etc. may trigger easily by the risk of high power damage, so as to realize full automatic test system.
assignees: TIANJIN DONGFANG RUI LASER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Network chain effect research method is produced under bumpy weather based on transmission dynamics
abstract_en: The present invention relates to workshop chain effect analysis technical fields, it is that network chain effect research method is produced under a kind of bumpy weather based on transmission dynamics, using the manufacture node in production system as node, process relation between production activity is to connect side, the parameter in propagation model is determined according to the production network of foundation, the coupling parameter of task inflow and outflow, using the linear theory of 5W2H analytic method combined process, assessment judgement is carried out to strength of turbulence according to delay time at stop and economic loss, disturbing influence degree is divided into slight perturbations, moderate disturbance, severe disturbs and four kinds of serious disturbance, node different in network is selected as source node is propagated to be activated, correlation between production network topology structure and propagation of disturbance kinetic characteristics is furtherd investigate, it is unique chain to disclose job shop under bumpy weather Propagation law.The present invention provides effectively reference and foundation for the even running control of workshop.

title_en: IDR (inverse discrete cosine transformation) -based combined cooling, heating and power supply micro-grid and active power distribution network joint optimization scheduling method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a combined optimization scheduling method for a cooling, heating and power combined microgrid and an active power distribution network, which takes IDR (Integrated Demand response) into account. Firstly, modeling the combined cooling heating and power microgrid equipment; then respectively establishing an active power distribution network optimization scheduling model and a combined cooling heating and power microgrid scheduling model considering IDR; the randomness of new energy and the cooling, heating and power loads in the combined cooling, heating and power micro-grid is processed by using opportunity constraint planning; and finally, an IATC (Improved adaptive Target scheduling, Improved Target Cascading method) is used for solving a combined optimization scheduling model of the combined cooling, heating and power supply microgrid and the active power distribution network, wherein the combined optimization scheduling model takes IDR into account. The method provided by the invention can effectively improve the energy utilization rate, reduce the system operation cost and obtain the optimal economic dispatching result of the active power distribution network and the combined cooling heating and power micro-grid on the basis of protecting the privacy of the respective areas.

title_en: Social network privacy risk assessment model based on evolutionary playing and propagation dynamics
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of privacy protection. The method comprises the steps of firstly evaluating importance degree of privacy information of a user through a privacy risk evaluation model, then constructing relation dynamics based on a graph evolution game theory, quantifying strategy or behavior change of heterogeneity of a complex network structure to different user groups, constructing a dynamic evolution mechanism of user privacy information propagation based on an infectious disease infection model, and finally dynamically adjusting state transition among different user groups by combining a user edge relation change rate of the evolution game theory and an infection rate of a user privacy information propagation dynamic model. In summary, the improved infectious disease model effectively reduces the transmission of private information in the social network, so that the privacy security of users in the social network is protected.

title_en: Multi-energy coordination rapid scheduling method based on quantum neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-energy coordination rapid scheduling method based on a quantum neural network, and belongs to the technical field of micro-grid operation. The multi-energy coordination economic dispatch model considering the hydraulic power, wind energy and solar energy is defined, and multi-class operation constraint of the cascade hydropower is considered. A quick synchronous machine information prediction model based on QNN is constructed, and the model realizes quick prediction of the state and the output of the synchronous machine in a day according to the actual measurement data of new energy and load. A closed loop hot start framework of the QNN and multi-energy coordination optimization scheduling model is constructed, QNN decision information is transmitted to an initial optimization model, and the solved optimal solution is fed back to QNN learning evolution, so that a high-quality optimization scheduling result is obtained rapidly.
assignees: STATE GRID SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER CORP

title_en: Power station key equipment temperature prediction method based on multi-source heterogeneous data fusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power station equipment temperature prediction, and provides a power station key equipment temperature prediction method based on multi-source heterogeneous data fusion, which comprises the following steps of collecting multi-source heterogeneous data of a hydropower station, preprocessing the multi-source heterogeneous data, extracting features, selecting features and fusing the features to obtain temperature prediction fusion features; the method comprises the steps of performing super-parameter optimization on an initial back propagation neural network through an improved underwater foraging optimization algorithm to obtain an optimized back propagation neural network, inputting temperature prediction fusion characteristics into the optimized back propagation neural network to obtain a temperature prediction value, comparing the temperature prediction value with a temperature actual value, and generating a temperature prediction table when the error of the temperature prediction value is in a preset range. The method can find out temperature abnormality in time, is beneficial to early warning of equipment faults, generates the temperature prediction table, is suitable for processing complex multi-source heterogeneous data, and enhances the accuracy of temperature prediction.

title_en: Post-disaster power distribution network island division method and system considering fault propagation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a post-disaster power distribution network island division method and system considering fault propagation. The method comprises the steps of firstly, detecting and identifying node and line damage conditions through multiple rounds, constructing a node and line damage state detection model considering fault propagation, then combining the node and line damage condition detection models to construct a post-disaster power distribution network island division model facing fault propagation isolation, and finally, carrying out linearization treatment on the constructed model to reduce solving difficulty and combining solving to obtain an optimized power distribution network island division and node power supply strategy. According to the technical scheme, fault propagation is considered in the island division process of the power distribution network, a fault area can be effectively isolated, and the safety and the effectiveness of a power supply recovery scheme of the power distribution network after disaster are improved.
assignees: UNIV NANJING SCI & TECH;NARI TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Cascade hydropower station cloud native application assembly method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascade hydropower station cloud primary application assembly method, in particular relates to the technical field of intelligent power grid dispatching and resource management, and aims to solve the problems that how to assemble a platform through cloud application under a cloud primary architecture, realize high-efficiency circulation and real-time response of full power grid data by using a distributed data processing and intelligent optimization algorithm, and ensure expandability and flexibility of a system. By combining a Yun Yuansheng architecture-based intelligent scheduling system with real-time data stream processing, deep learning and machine learning algorithms, dynamic prediction and intelligent scheduling optimization of power grid load are realized. The method can effectively solve the core problems of lack of real-time response and intelligent scheduling in the prior art, and ensure that the system can adjust the power grid load distribution in real time when the power grid load fluctuates or the number of power stations increases. The method has higher response speed and accuracy, and can dynamically adjust the scheduling strategy according to real-time data feedback, thereby improving the efficiency and stability of power grid operation.
assignees: SHANGHAI INVESTIGATION DESIGN & RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Multi-scene whole station fault self-healing method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-scene whole station fault self-healing method and system, and belongs to the technical field of power systems. The method comprises the steps of calculating attention weight of a scene to determine a scene recognition result, calculating multi-step propagation accumulated faults to determine a fault equipment set, calculating shortest paths from a transfer power supply point to a decompression target point through an improved Yen algorithm to generate a candidate scheme set, constructing a multi-objective function of each path in the candidate scheme set, solving to obtain a non-dominant optimal solution set, comprehensively scoring the non-dominant optimal solution set by using an entropy weight method to generate a sequencing scheme sequence, calculating similarity of graph structural features of the sequencing scheme sequence and graph structural features of a historical scheme to determine multi-criterion confidence scores of the scheme, and selecting the scheme with the confidence scores higher than a set threshold as a final fault self-healing scheme. The invention improves the load recovery speed of the whole station of the main network fault distribution network, improves the co-processing efficiency of the main network fault distribution network, and improves the risk coping capability.
assignees: STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER RESEARCH INST CO LTD;STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID NARI NANJING CONTROL SYSTEM CO LTD;BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER ECONOMIC TECHNOLOGY RESEARCH INST CO LTD

title_en: Bulk logistics optimization system and method based on digitization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bulk logistics optimization system and method based on digitalization, wherein the system comprises an intelligent logistics control center, an Internet of things data acquisition layer, a supply chain knowledge graph engine and a blockchain trusted memory system, wherein multi-mode logistics data are acquired through multi-protocol access, a pareto optimal path solution set is generated through a reinforcement learning algorithm after standardized processing, dynamic risk assessment and optimal scheduling are realized by combining a graph neural network risk propagation model, and key information is stored and intelligent contracts are executed through a blockchain alliance chain. The method solves the problems of traditional logistics visualization limitation, path optimization lag and risk management and control deficiency, realizes full-link transparent management, dynamic self-adaptive optimization and prospective risk prevention and control, remarkably improves logistics efficiency, reduces operation cost, and can be widely applied to large-scale commodity cross-border trade logistics scenes.
assignees: PUSAN TECH DEVELOPMENT SICHUAN CO LTD

title_ko: 비행기구들을 보강하기 위한 시스템 및 방법
abstract_ko: 공기 보다 가벼운 리프트에 기초한 많은 시스템들에 적용 가능하고, 구조적 지지 및 네트워크 상호 연결을 위한 안전 장치가 되어 있는(fail-safe) 비행기구 시스템이 논의된다.  발명은 보강 구조 및 최적 연결부와 통합 구조(보강 및 통합 구조(2))를 구비한 시스템으로서, 안전 장치가 되어 있는 설계를 가지는 수소 셀 또는 수소 셀들을 보강하는 시스템을 기재한다.  이론적 구조는 폭발력들을 견디기에 충분히 강하고, 충격파 손상 및 화재의 전파를 피하고, 수소 셀 또는 셀들(1)은 자동적으로 자기 제어되고, 리프트 강도 및 다중 파라미터 제어를 획득하도록 독립적으로 작동한다.

title_en: A Safe Room With Steam Room And Stress Relief Function
title_ko: 찜질방과 스트레스해소 기능을 설치한 세이프 룸
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a safe room for safe evacuation from disasters such as earthquakes, fires, and invasion of burglars and, more specifically, to a safe room with stress relief functions such as a steam room and a karaoke room, in which incombustible materials are installed on a front side of the inside of the safe room, and oxygen cylinders and water bottles are installed and a pressure measuring device for the oxygen cylinders and a charging device for batteries are installed. In the event of a fire, it is important for evacuees to survive safely. According to Korea fire law, emergency escapes are allowed in public facilities capable of accommodating people and in buildings having a certain size or more, and installation of space for devices is mandatory. Thus, a safe room to evacuate in the event of a disaster and a safe room used for various purposes in normal times are required. The purpose of the present invention is to provide a safe room, which is used, in a daily life, for purposes such as steam rooms, karaoke rooms, and disease prevention rooms, and evacuees wait for rescue from the outside when the evacuees cannot quickly escape in the event of an earthquake or disaster and to provide a safe room, which evacuees can notify of a location thereof using radio waves in special situations where the evacuees cannot move from a fire scene, can wait for safety guards while receiving oxygen, can preserve life from invasion of robbers, and can wait for rescue from the outside.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 지진이나 화재, 강도의 침입 등의 재난으로부터 안전하게 대피하기 위한 세이프 룸에 관한 것이며, 보다 상세하게는, 내측의 전면이 불연재가 설치되며, 산소통과 생수; 상기 산소통의 압력측정 장치와 배터리의 충전장치 등이 설치되며, 찜질방, 노래방 등 스트레스해소 기능이 설치된 세이프 룸에 관한 것이다. 
이처럼 화재 발생 시 대피 자는 안전하게 생존하는 것이 중요하기 때문에 우리나라의 소방법 상에 사람을 수용할 수 있는 공공시설은 물론, 일정 크기 이상의 건물에는 비상 탈출을 할 수 있고, 그 장치의 공간 설치가 의무화 되어 있어, 재난 시 대피할 세이프 룸이 필요함과 동시에 평상시 다른 용도로 활용 효과가 가능한 다목적 세이프 룸이 필요하다. 
본 발명의 목적은 일상에는 찜질방 또는 노래방, 질병 예방 실 등의 목적으로 활용하다가 지진 또는 재난 시신속한 탈출이 불가능할 경우, 안전한 곳에서 외부로 구조를 기다릴 안전한 세이프 룸을 제공하며, 화재현장에서 이동할 수 없는 특수 상황에서 자신의 위치를 전파로 발생시키며, 산소를 공급받으면서 안전요원들을 기다리는 한편, 강도의 침입으로부터 생명을 보존하며, 외부로부터 구조를 기다릴 수 있는 세이프 룸을 제공하는 데 있다.

title_en: Ship-cabin chain fire-disaster alarming priority assessment method
abstract_en: The invention provides a ship-cabin chain fire-disaster alarming priority assessment method which comprises the following steps: acquiring the fire situation information obtained by the combustible gas detectors and the detectors for sensing the temperature and the smoke of all the ship cabins adjacent to the ship cabin with fire disaster; reading the fire-disaster danger level information of the ship cabin with fire disaster; pre-processing the fire situation information obtained by the detectors and the fire-disaster danger level information of the ship cabin in a normalizing way; and sending the processed data to a three-layer feedforward error back propagation neural network for processing to obtain the chain fire-disaster alarming priority assessment results of each ship cabin, namely the primary alarming probability, the intermediate alarming probability and the advanced alarming probability. The comprehensive, early, accurate and reliable automatic alarming of the ship fire-disaster alarming system is realized, the purpose of reducing the wrong and neglected alarming rate is achieved, and the probability that the ship cabins can be subjected to chain fire-disaster to lead to the heavy loss of the ship is reduced.

title_en: A kind of transformer analysis method for reliability based on enlistment age and load level
