abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of transformer analysis method for reliability based on enlistment age and load level, comprise the following steps：(1) transformer load grade is determined；(2) load value of transformer in an initial condition is determined；(3) hot(test)-spot temperature of transformer is obtained；(4) insulation life of transformer is obtained according to the hot(test)-spot temperature of transformer；(5) the probability of malfunction Cumulative Distribution Function of transformer is obtained；(6) the failure rate index under the failure rate index and malfunction of transformer in an initial condition is obtained；(7) obtain cascading failure and start probability level P ic With cascading failure fragility link indicatrix P vc ；By to P ic With P vc Rate sorts, and identifies the transformer that critical condition is in system；Analysis method for reliability provided by the invention, with reference to influence of the coupled relation between transformer in transformer structure itself, function, operation age and regional power grid to equipment dependability, improve the transformer fail-safe analysis degree of accuracy under cascading failure scene.

title_en: Safety situation assessment method for electric power information physical fusion system
abstract_en: A security situation assessment method of a power information physical fusion system comprises the following steps: a. updating the abnormal point set according to the importance of the abnormal point: b. calculating threat propagation expected values; c. CPS risk assessment; generating a threat propagation tree according to a threat propagation tree generation rule; and calculating expected values of threats formed by all effective heat source nodes in the threat propagation tree to obtain a network security situation assessment value. The invention designs a real-time joint detection system for various security threats in the power CPS, provides a threat situation assessment system based on an intelligent assessment algorithm, effectively improves the identification capability of various high-risk security threats occurring in the power CPS in real time, realizes the macroscopic judgment of the operation condition of the power CPS, strengthens the purpose of protective measures for various high-risk security threats, is beneficial to improving the operation condition of the power CPS from the whole level, and ensures the safe and stable operation of the power CPS.

title_en: Online social network information propagation construction method based on time-varying damping motion
abstract_en: The invention provides an online social network information propagation construction method based on time-varying damping motion, which comprises the following steps: s1, acquiring individual characteristics of the online social network nodes; s2, calculating information propagation acceleration according to the individual characteristics acquired in the step S1; s3, acquiring the stress condition of information spread on the network node; and S4, judging whether the residual energy of the information is greater than or equal to the preset energy threshold of the information, S5, counting the user transmission amount on the network node, and predicting the hotspot degree. The invention can carry out statistics on online network events through the constructed model and predict the event heat.

title_en: Complex power grid priority protection set determination method fusing associated structure holes
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for determining a priority protection set of a complex power grid fusing associated structure holes, which comprises the following steps: s1: acquiring data information of a power system; s2: constructing a self-dual bipartite graph; s3: establishing a fault line breaking model; s4: calculating a disconnection sensitive factor; s5: calculating an improved betweenness centrality index; s6: calculating the characteristic index of the associated structure hole; s7: calculating the improved betweenness centrality index after normalization; s8: calculating the normalized associated structure hole characteristic index; s9: calculating a distribution weight coefficient; s10: compute node v i The comprehensive index of (a) is fragile potential energy; s11: compute node v i+1 The comprehensive index of (a) is fragile potential energy; s12: calculating the comprehensive index fragile potential energy of all nodes; s13: arranging the fragile potential energy in a descending order to obtain a priority protection set; the method can effectively identify the fragile line of the power grid, solve the problem of relevance between power transmission lines after the power grid fault occurs, and reduce the occurrence probability of cascading faults.

title_en: Power distribution equipment fault detection method, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fault detection method of power distribution equipment, which belongs to the technical field of deep learning and solves the problem of low fault detection precision caused by the lack of operation and maintenance data in a power system, and the method comprises the steps of collecting operation and maintenance data of a power distribution network, carrying out data segmentation on a state data set based on a time sequence, extracting spatial characteristics through a graph rolling network, and extracting and learning time dependence and nonlinear relation in the data by adopting a multi-layer perceptron; the method comprises the steps of carrying out feature stitching, unifying the dimensionality of data, merging feature vectors after adding the unified dimensionality bit by bit, merging the feature vectors with environment information, sending the merged feature vectors into a deep learning network consisting of a multi-layer perceptron and a full-connection layer for training, evaluating model deviation by using a mean square error loss function, and updating and optimizing model parameters by using back propagation and gradient descent.

title_en: Smart power grid relay protection reliability assessment and promotion control method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for evaluating and improving the reliability of a smart power grid relay protection, and relates to the technical field of smart power grid relay protection. The fault mode, collaborative anomalies, and reliability levels are identified at the device level, interval level, and station level, respectively, using a multi-stage fault diagnosis model, and the fault propagation paths and effects are predicted based on a causal inference network. And finally, constructing a layered cooperative control strategy, and realizing coordination optimization of protection fixed values through multi-objective optimization, distributed game optimization and layered rolling optimization, thereby improving the reliability of the relay protection device, reducing the fault propagation probability and ensuring the safe and stable operation of the power grid.

title_en: Universal repeated alarm suppression method for power transmission line monitoring system based on time sequence sample analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a general repeated alarm suppression method for a power transmission line monitoring system based on time sequence sample analysis, according to the method, through combining feature map analysis and time sequence sample modeling of a deep learning algorithm, the change condition of an abnormal region can be analyzed and judged, and whether to continue alarming or not is further determined. The invention makes repeated alarm effectively inhibited by comparing time sequence analysis with thermodynamic diagram. The method utilizes the weighted combination of the gradient map and the output layer characteristic map of the neural network counter propagation to generate the activation response thermodynamic diagram, thereby accurately identifying the region with the greatest contribution to the abnormal output result in the image. By global averaging pooling and ReLU activation functions, the system is able to pinpoint the region where the anomaly occurred. The technical means improves the accuracy of abnormal region identification and provides a reliable basis for subsequent alarm suppression.

title_en: Fire prevention installations underground transmission line for building
title_ko: 건축용 지중배선의 방연시설물
abstract_en: A fire prevention facility of an underground transmission line for a building is provided to reduce an installation cost by simplifying a configuration of the fire prevention facility. A fire prevention facility of an underground transmission line for a building includes left/right flame resistant frames(10,10a), a left flame resistant frame(20), a right flame resistant frame(30), and a plurality of compressed coil spring(40). A flame resistant charging wrinkle tube is formed on an upper/lower plane and a left/right side of the left/right flame resistant frames to be folded. A connection piece which is vertically protruded is formed on a center of right upper part of the left flame resistant frame. A bolt unit is protrusively formed on a right center of the connection piece. A wrinkle band which covers a right outer circumference plane of an underground transmission line is formed on a front end of a right front/rear plane of the right flame resistant frame. The compressed coil spring are installed on a supporting rod between a left supporting plate of the left flame resistant frame and a pushing piece of the left flame resistant frame. The compressed coil spring compresses the left flame resistant frame with the underground transmission line. The compressed coil spring are installed on a supporting rod between a right supporting plate of the left flame resistant frame and a pushing piece of the right flame resistant frame. The compressed coil spring compresses the right flame resistant frame with the underground transmission line.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 지중배선의 외관을 좌우측에서 밀착되어 감싸는 박스체로 지중배선의 외관과 밀착되는 내측면은 반원형 열가소성판으로 형성되고, 상하면과 전후방측면은 난연성 충전주름관이 접철되게 형성되며, 최외측면에는 반호형 난연누름판이 형성되되, 반호형 난연누름판 상하단 전후방측에는 각각 관통공을 갖는 누름편이 돌출형성되고, 내부에는 소화액이 충전되는 좌우측방연틀과; 직육면체로 우측면은 개방부로 형성되고, 좌측면은 좌측지지판으로 형성되며, 좌측지지판 내측에는 상기 좌측방형틀의 누름편 관통공을 각각 관통하여 지지하는 4개의 지지봉이 수평되게 형성되되 지지봉 선단은 내측체결부가 형성되고, 우측상하단 중심에는 상하로 수직돌출된 체결편이 형성되되 체결편 우측중심에는 볼트부가 돌출형성되며, 우측단 전후면 선단에는 지중배선의 좌측 외주면을 밀폐되게 감싸는 주름밴드가 형성되는 좌측방형틀케이스와; 직육면체로 좌우측면은 개방되고 상기 지지봉의 내측체결부에 체결고정되는 체결돌부를 갖고 지지봉과 동일한 외관의 수평을 이루어 우측방연틀의 각 누름편 관통공이 삽입되는 연결봉이 각각 형성되되 타단에는 체결너트가 체결되는 볼트부가 형성되며, 우측상하단에는 상기 체결편의 볼트부에 대응되는 볼트공을 갖는 체결편이 형성되어 너트에 의해 체결고정되고, 좌측단 전후면 선단에는 상기 주름밴드와 양단이 밀착되어 지중배선의 우측 외주면을 밀폐되게 감싸는 주름밴드가 형성되는 우측방연틀케이스와; 상기 좌측방형틀케이스의 좌측지지판과 상기 좌측방연틀의 누름편 사이의 지지봉에 각각 감겨져 좌측지지판에서 좌측방연 틀을 지중배선으로 압축시키고, 상기 우측방형틀케이스의 체결너트와 우측방연틀의 누름편 사이의 연결봉에 각각 감겨져 체결너트에서 우측방연틀을 지중배선으로 압축시키는 다수 개의 압축코일스프링을 구비하는 건축용 지중배선의 방연시설물에 관한 것이다. 
     이러한 본 발명은 누전이나 합선에 의해 공동주택에 시설되어 있는 지중배선으로부터 화재가 발생하는 경우 지중배선의 피복부를 통한 화재전파를 중간에서 차단할 수 있고, 구성이 단순하여 시공비가 저렴하며, 별도의 지지체 도움 없이도 간편하게 설치가 가능하기 때문에 공간이 협소한 장소에서도 설치가 용이하게 이루어지는 효과가 있다. 
       
     좌우측방연틀, 좌측방연틀케이스, 우측방연틀케이스, 압축코일스프링

title_en: Flange Safe Ring for Back Fire Prevention
title_ko: 역화방지용 플랜지 쉴드
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 파이프 배관의 플랜지 연결부를 감싸도록 설치되어 플랜지 연결부에서 누설되는 화학물질 또는 유체의 확산을 차단하여 유해 화학물질에의 노출 및 폭발에 따른 인명사고 발생을 방지함과 아울러 폭발 환경에 대비한 역화방지기를 적용하여 화재발생시 파이프 배관을 통해 화재가 전파되는 것을 방지하여 인명과 시설물을 보호할 수 있도록 한 역화방지용 플랜지 쉴드에 관한 것으로,  마주하는 두 파이프 배관(100)에 각각 구비되어 개스킷을 개재하여 결합되는 한 쌍의 플랜지(110) 사이로 누설되는 유체를 차단하도록 상기 플랜지(110)의 외면에 밀착되며 양단이 서로 겹쳐지도록 형성되는 띠 형상의 링부재(10); 플랜지 연결부에 구비된 개스킷의 외측으로 누설되는 유체를 차단하도록 상기 링부재(10)의 내면에 구비되어 상기 플랜지(110) 사이에 위치되는 삽입부재(20); 상기 링부재(10)의 양단이 겹쳐진 상태로 조여 고정하도록 상기 링부재(10)의 단부에 구비되는 매미고리 잠금부재(30); 및 외부의 화염이 플랜지 연결부 사이로 전파되지 않도록 매미고리 잠금부재(30)의 반대쪽에서 링부재(10)에 설치되는 금속재질의 역화방지기(50);를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: High performance real-time relational database system and methods for using same
abstract_en: A database system supporting persistent queries, comprising a client software application, a persistent query service, and a plurality of network-attached data sources. On receiving a request to create a persistent query from the client software application, the persistent query service: creates a query virtual table; parses the persistent query; creates a plurality of intermediate virtual tables; establishes listeners for the query virtual table; creates a plurality of data source virtual tables; causes the plurality of data source virtual tables to retrieve initial data from data sources; and propagates data via intermediate virtual tables to the persistent query virtual table. On detection of a data change in a data source, the associated data source virtual table causes the data change to propagate via intermediate virtual tables to the persistent query virtual table, and the client software application executes client code of at least one listener.

title_en: Method and apparatus for propagating public safety multicast and broadcast services among public safety personnel
abstract_en: Public safety user equipment (PS UE) that establishes a first wireless communication channel over a primary network to at least one multimedia multicast or broadcast service management entity and establishes one or more alternative wireless communication channels over one or more alternative networks ( 310 ). The public safety user equipment receives at least one multimedia multicast or broadcast service message over the first wireless communication channel ( 320 ), Then, the PS UE extracts data contained in the multimedia multicast or broadcast service message and storing the data in a local cache ( 330 ). The PS UE receives a cache request from the one or more user equipment over one or more alternative wireless communication channels ( 340 ) and then the PS UE transmits the stored data to the one or more PS user equipment ( 350 ).

title_en: Business risk recognition methods, device and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: This application provides a kind of business risk recognition methods, which comprises pre-establishes enterprise network figure, includes the side collection between associated nodes and the associated nodes in the enterprise network figure；Risk assessment request is responded, determines the first associated nodes corresponding with risk assessment request in enterprise's network chart；Enterprise's network chart is begun stepping through from first associated nodes, determines that the associated nodes and side concentrate risks and assumptions and the Risk of Communication path for meeting preset condition.In this manner, the weight of associated nodes and the weight of propagation path codetermine suitable path and go to traverse, and obtain the biggish associated nodes of weight and propagation path, so that the risk analysis result to enterprise is more accurate and efficient.
assignees: CHONGQING BAIXING INTELLIGENT DATA TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution room equipment state online intelligent monitoring system and method based on embedded GPU platform and deep learning
abstract_en: The monitoring equipment uploads image data of the state of the power distribution room equipment to the embedded GPU platform in a video stream mode in real time, an equipment state recognition model which is deployed in the platform and constructed based on a deep learning technology analyzes and monitors the uploaded data, and a detection result and a monitoring picture are displayed on a Web interface. The invention realizes the online intelligent monitoring of the state of the equipment in the power distribution room, finds the equipment which is not normally operated in time by identifying the on-off image of the equipment indicator lamp and gives an alarm. The invention uses the improved Cascade R-CNN deep learning algorithm, reduces the external influence, has more stable operation and greatly improves the identification precision: the method can accurately identify the target in the monitoring range, and provides powerful technical support for guaranteeing the safety of power grid constructors.

title_en: Load false data injection attack modeling method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a load false data injection attack modeling method, which relates to the technical field of power information physical systems and is used for solving the problems that a large-scale physical power flow transfer is caused by misleading a dispatcher to carry out wrong operation after a load false data injection attack is applied to an existing power system, even a cascading failure reaction of the power system is caused, and a large power failure accident is caused; the method can be used for timely and accurately predicting the most harmful attack path by considering the attack behavior of an intruder from the information layer perspective in combination with the actual network attack situation under the power information physical system fusion background, and provides beneficial inspiration for power system managers on how to effectively prevent and defend the load false injection attack.

title_en: Urban rail transit risk chain group construction method based on multilayer network
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for constructing an urban rail transit risk chain group based on a multilayer network. The method comprises the following steps: determining urban rail transit risk points and risk accident types, forming a risk point set by all risk points, and forming a risk accident set by all risk accident types; defining connection relations among risk points according to a multi-layer network theory, wherein the relations among the risk points in each layer of network are defined as internal connections, and the connection relations among the risk points in different layers of network are defined as external connections; determining a logic relationship among risk points, wherein the logic relationship comprises a propagation relationship and a correlation relationship, and connecting the risk points with the propagation relationship; and matching the last risk point in the communicated propagation relationship with the risk accident type to form a risk chain group. The invention can globally control the risk accident occurrence process, and can take corresponding control measures on the basis, thereby reducing the risk accident occurrence.
assignees: BEIJING SUBWAY OPERATION CORP;BEIJING SUBWAY ENGINEERING MAN CO LTD

title_en: Electric vehicle charging guiding method considering random path behaviors
abstract_en: The invention provides an electric vehicle charging guiding method considering random path behaviors, which comprises the steps of constructing a multi-type user path selection model and obtaining user travel path selection probability; based on an improved random user balancing principle, a semi-dynamic traffic flow distribution model considering the random path behavior of the user is constructed; constructing an optimal power flow model of the power distribution network considering slow charge load response; based on a target cascade analysis method, a traffic network and power distribution network distributed collaborative optimization model is constructed, and a multi-type user travel path and an electric vehicle user charging strategy are planned. According to the invention, the traffic network and the power distribution network are respectively subjected to layered optimization, different charging guiding strategies are formulated according to the charging demand difference of the electric vehicle, the user path decision randomness and the slow charging load response are considered, the charging demand of the electric vehicle is met, the safe operation of the power distribution network is ensured, and the traffic jam is effectively relieved.

title_en: Electric vehicle charging station load prediction method under electric-traffic coupling system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for predicting the load of an electric vehicle charging station under an electric-traffic coupling system, which comprises the following steps: obtaining training data; adjusting an updating strategy of the depth model to enable the depth model to be suitable for a training process under a safe federal linear regression framework, ensuring data privacy safety of a power distribution network and a traffic network in a combined training process, and obtaining an EGAT-LSTM space-time correlation prediction model after adjustment of the updating strategy; arranging the EGAT-LSTM load prediction model after the update strategy adjustment on a power distribution network and traffic network computing platform respectively, setting the EGAT-LSTM load prediction model as a power distribution network and traffic network sub-model in federal learning, and integrating the EGAT-LSTM load prediction model into a subsequent safe federal linear regression training framework; the power grid and traffic network training data are respectively input into a VFedEGAT-LSTM electric vehicle charging station load prediction sub-model, and under the condition that the privacy of a power distribution network and a traffic network is ensured, the sub-model carries out a forward propagation process and interacts an intermediate result to realize global space-time correlation training and prediction.

title_en: Short-term load prediction method based on multi-scale space-time DCNN feature extraction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a short-term load prediction method based on multi-scale space-time DCNN feature extraction, which specifically comprises the following steps of S1, acquiring and preprocessing historical load data of an electric power system and related influence factor data, S2, carrying out correlation analysis on the load data, determining the maximum correlation time lag of a load time sequence, further determining the size of an optimal sliding time window, S3, constructing a backbone network based on a recursive feature pyramid, adopting expansion convolution as a feature extraction network, combining a bidirectional gating circulation unit to carry out time sequence feature modeling, carrying out counter propagation by using calculation loss in a joint loss function, and updating model parameters, S4, predicting the load data in the future in a short term by using a trained model, and evaluating the prediction accuracy of the model by using a correlation evaluation index. According to the invention, the time sequence is analyzed through ACF and PACF, and the sliding time window is scientifically set. The RFP-DCNN-BiGRU model fully combines the capabilities of DCNN and BiGRU in feature extraction and time sequence data modeling, and achieves more accurate short-term load prediction.

title_en: Three-dimensional dynamic working condition coupling operation and maintenance management method and system based on power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional dynamic working condition coupling operation and maintenance management method and system based on a power distribution network, which belong to the technical field of intelligent power grid operation and maintenance management and comprise the steps of carrying out space-time synchronization point cloud data acquisition through different devices based on the power distribution network to construct a point cloud data set; the method comprises the steps of performing data thinning on a meteorological-electrical appliance coupling coefficient, extracting and classifying ground points and non-ground points, respectively performing three-dimensional model construction on the classified ground points and non-ground points, performing three-dimensional fault coupling deduction on an output result of the three-dimensional model to obtain a suspected fault point, injecting short-circuit disturbance into the suspected fault point in a simulation platform, and verifying whether a cascading fault path is matched with actual deduction. According to the invention, through the closed loop chain, the meteorological, electrical and mechanical failure chains are deeply coupled, the span from passive overhaul to fault early and accurate intervention of the operation and maintenance of the power distribution network is realized, the galloping/tower-reversing accident rate is obviously reduced through actual measurement, and the operation and maintenance efficiency and the reliability of the power grid are comprehensively improved.

title_en: Distributed photovoltaic and energy storage cooperative power distribution network voltage fluctuation suppression method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for suppressing voltage fluctuation of a distribution network by cooperation of distributed photovoltaic and energy storage, and relates to the technical field of voltage fluctuation suppression, comprising the following steps of constructing a disturbance propagation reachability matrix among nodes based on real-time operation data of the distribution network, and identifying a voltage disturbance path set; the method comprises the steps of constructing a disturbance irreversible structure diagram based on a voltage disturbance path set, identifying a unidirectional amplification chain, calculating disturbance excitation probability according to historical disturbance data of a unidirectional amplification chain source node, generating a disturbance active propagation domain, constructing an energy storage intervention buffer zone in the disturbance active propagation domain, and generating a collaborative strategy activation condition by simulating disturbance propagation to evaluate reverse blocking capacity of energy storage in the energy storage intervention buffer zone. According to the invention, through disturbance path simulation evaluation, energy storage redundant configuration and power consumption are reduced, and the inhibition efficiency and adaptability of the system are improved.
assignees: LEADZONE SMART GRID TECH CO LTD

title_en: Geological disaster prediction method based on deep learning and machine learning model cascade
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster prediction method based on deep learning and machine learning model cascading, which comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source data of each evaluation unit in a research area, obtaining traditional geoscience factors and initial evaluation factor sets according to the multi-source data, inputting the initial evaluation factor sets into an improved U-Net network to obtain a geological disaster space probability distribution map, forming a cascading evaluation factor set by the geological disaster space probability distribution map and the traditional geoscience factors together, and inputting the cascading evaluation factor set of each evaluation unit in the research area into a trained machine learning model to obtain geological disaster prediction probability of each evaluation unit. The method and the device remarkably improve the precision and reliability of the geological disaster prediction method, greatly enhance the interpretability and reliability of the improved U-Net network, innovatively realize the deep coupling of two technical paradigms, and improve the generalization capability and practicability of the geological disaster prediction method instead of simple superposition.
assignees: EMERGENCY MAN DEPARTMENT BIG DATA CENTER

title_en: Low-carbon planning method for power distribution network considering low-carbon sharing of multiple types of energy stations
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power distribution network planning, and relates to a power distribution network low-carbon planning method considering low-carbon sharing of multiple types of energy stations. The method comprises the steps of dividing energy stations into high-carbon energy stations, zero-carbon energy stations and carbon-negative energy stations according to carbon emission levels, determining equipment parameters, operation constraint and power distribution network basic parameters of various energy stations, establishing CCER a gain sharing model and an equivalent carbon emission right sharing model, constructing an objective function of a low-carbon planning model of a power distribution network and an objective function of a cooperation sharing model of the energy stations, representing uncertainty of photovoltaic output and load, calculating expected cost, carrying out model solving by adopting an objective cascading analysis algorithm, and obtaining a power distribution network planning scheme and an energy station operation strategy by iteratively updating Lagrange multipliers and exchange power. The method and the system realize the reduction of the cost of the power distribution network, the great reduction of carbon emission, the improvement of the overall benefit of the energy station, the efficient coordination of the benefit main body and the sharing mechanism diversification, and the improvement of the flexibility and the carbon reduction potential of the system.

title_en: Construction whole process engineering consultation management method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a method, a device, equipment and a medium for building whole process engineering consultation management. The method comprises the steps of obtaining local priori update data of all participating objects of a project, wherein the local priori update data are used for representing dynamic propagation conditions among all risk factors, integrating the local priori update data of all participating objects based on preset reputation weight parameters of the participating objects to obtain normal priori update data, updating a preset federal Bayesian network according to the normal priori update data to obtain a dynamic Bayesian network, the federal Bayesian network comprises nodes and connecting edges, the nodes are all the risk factors, the connecting edges are used for representing standard priori propagation probabilities among all the risk factors, risk propagation simulation is conducted on the dynamic Bayesian network to obtain engineering risk propagation reports, and the engineering risk propagation reports are used for representing the risk factors existing in the project and influences caused by the risk factors. By adopting the method, the accuracy of the engineering management of the whole process of the building can be improved.

title_en: Quantum Monte Carlo-based power grid fault situation quantum simulation system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for quantum-based grid fault situation quantum simulation, which are used for carrying out data processing based on grid data to obtain a simplified grid model based on quantum states, constructing a parameterized quantum circuit by adopting a quantum variation algorithm based on the simplified grid model of the quantum states, carrying out grid fault simulation on the parameterized quantum circuit on a quantum computer by adopting a Monte Carlo simulation algorithm, obtaining fault scene probability distribution by measuring the quantum bit state of the parameterized quantum circuit, and carrying out statistics according to the fault scene probability distribution to generate a grid fault evaluation report. The method solves the technical problems that when the existing grid fault analysis method based on Monte Carlo simulation is used for processing the cascade fault problem of a large-scale complex grid, a large amount of calculation resources and time are needed, the calculation cost is high, the multistable operation mode of the grid is difficult to effectively process, and the accuracy of the grid risk assessment is reduced.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RESEARCH INST CO LTD CSG;CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO

title_en: Security system and method using wireless transmitter-receiver
title_ko: 무선 송수신기를 이용한 보안 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A security system which uses a radio frequency (RF) transceiver and a method thereof are provided to obtain locations of people inside of a building even in a situation of an emergency situation or emergency disaster like fire or a power outage in which the security system does not operate. CONSTITUTION: A portable terminal exists within a unit space. An RF transceiver (200) senses the radio field intensity of the portable terminal within the unit space. Center control servers (310,320) grasp the location of the portable terminal through the location information of the RF transceiver and the radio field intensity of the portable terminal which are provided from the RF transceiver. The RF transceiver includes at least three RF transceivers. [Reference numerals] (310) Server 1; (320) Server 2; (410) Internal power; (420) External power; (AA) Cellular phone radio wave antenna; (BB) Wireless LAN router; (CC) Bluetooth transceiver; (DD) NFC transceiver; (EE) Data; (FF) Power line; (GG) Building; (HH) Communication network; (II) Public office (a fire station, a police station)
abstract_ko: 건물과 같은 공간에서 발생한 화재 등의 위급 상황 시에도 건물의 전원 상태에 구애받지 않고 건물 내부의 사람들의 위치 추적 정보를 실시간으로 클라우드망을 통해 외부 공공기관과 공유할 수 있도록 하는 무선 송수신기를 이용한 보안 시스템 및 방법이 제공된다. 상기 무선 송수신기를 이용한 보안 시스템은 단위 공간 내에 존재하는 휴대용 단말기; 상기 단위 공간 내에서 상기 휴대용 단말기의 전파 강도를 감지하는 무선 송수신기; 및 상기 무선 송수신기로부터 제공받은 상기 휴대용 단말기의 전파 강도 및 상기 무선 송수신기의 위치정보를 통해 상기 휴대용 단말기의 위치를 파악하는 중앙 제어 서버를 포함한다.

title_en: Direct calling system
title_ko: 직접통화장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an elevator emergency calling system and, more specifically, to a direct calling system which provides direct calling between people in an elevator and an emergency spreader. The direct calling system comprises: a circuit matching unit which forms a calling channel with an emergency calling device inside an elevator; a memory which stores a calling progress message, an emergency spreader terminal information, and a field identification information used when a maintenance office does not respond to an emergency calling; a key input unit and a display unit which displays input of the emergency spreader terminal information and the field identification information; a PSTN matching unit which forms a calling channel with a public telephone network; a PSTN connection sensing unit which senses connection with the public telephone network; and a control unit which forms a calling channel between the emergency calling device and the emergency spreader terminal when an intercom of the maintenance office does not respond to an emergency calling signal generated from the emergency calling device. The control unit reads the calling progress message indicating that a calling from the memory is in progress in order to control a voice transmission to the emergency calling device and call the emergency spreader terminal through the public telephone network; and forms a calling channel between the emergency calling device, generating the emergency calling, and the emergency spreader terminal when a response exists.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 승강기 비상호출 시스템에 관한 것으로, 특히 승강기 탑승자와 비상상황 전파자 사이에 직접 통화가 가능한 직접통화장치에 관한 것으로, 각 승강기 내의 비상호출기와 통화로 형성하기 위한 회선 정합부와; 비상호출시 관리실 인터폰이 무응답할 경우 이용하기 위한 호출진행 메시지 및 비상상황 전파자 단말정보, 현장식별정보가 저장되는 메모리와; 상기 비상상황 전파자 단말정보 및 현장식별정보를 입력 표시하기 위한 키입력부 및 표시부와; 공중전화망과 통화로 형성하기 위한 PSTN 정합부와; 공중전화망의 연결을 감지하기 위한 PSTN 연결 감지부와; 상기 비상호출기로부터 발생된 비상호출신호에 관리실 인터폰이 무응답할 경우 해당 비상호출기와 상기 비상상황 전파자 단말 사이에 통화로를 형성해 주기 위한 제어부;를 포함하되, 상기 제어부는 상기 관리실 인터폰 무응답시 상기 메모리에서 현재 호출 진행중임을 지시하는 호출진행 메시지를 독출하여 해당 비상호출기로 음성 송출 제어하면서 공중전화망을 통해 상기 비상상황 전파자 단말을 호출하고, 그 응답이 있을 경우 비상호출 발생한 비상호출기와 비상상황 전파자 단말 사이에 통화로를 형성해 줌을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Wind power generation power prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind power generation power prediction method and system, and relates to the technical field of new energy power generation control. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring wind turbine generator set information, wind condition information and topographic information; constructing a wind speed model based on a back propagation neural network and predicting to obtain a primary wind speed prediction result; determining the coordinate and relative position relation of the wind turbine generator according to the topographic information, and determining the wake flow superposition condition; correcting the primary wind speed prediction result and reconstructing a wind speed model; carrying out wind speed prediction by using the reconstructed wind speed model to obtain a final wind speed prediction result; and predicting wind power generation power through a wind power prediction model according to the final wind speed prediction result. The method solves the problem that wind power generation power prediction is inaccurate because wind speed is difficult to accurately calculate due to the characteristics of complex and changeable topography, frequent wind speed and direction changes, high turbulence intensity and the like in low wind speed areas.

title_en: Relay protection method and system for transformer substation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of relay protection, in particular to a relay protection method and a relay protection system for a transformer substation, comprising the following steps: and collecting electromagnetic field data of the substation relay, and drawing an electromagnetic field distribution diagram by integrating node connection data of a substation power grid to generate an electromagnetic field data matrix. According to the invention, through numerical solution of an electromagnetic field data matrix and accurate spatial positioning of nodes, an electromagnetic field distribution diagram can be drawn in detail, an in-depth view of interaction between power grid nodes is provided, not only is the accuracy of fault positioning improved, but also the accuracy of fault analysis and simulation is improved through accurate correction of the node positions, the continuity and safety of transformer substation operation are ensured, timeliness and effectiveness of emergency response are further enhanced through on-site testing and sending of early warning signals, a stronger guarantee is provided for preventing large-scale power interruption and equipment damage, and potential service interruption is reduced.

title_en: Method and device for determining electric larceny suspect user
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a method and device for determining an electric larceny suspect user. The method comprises the following steps of 1, building an expert sample library according to the historical electricity use data of a user, wherein sample data included in the expert sample library includes historical electricity use data of the user and an electric larceny suspect coefficient; 2, optimizing a weight sequence of a BP (Back Propagation) neural network model by using a genetic algorithm, and obtaining the optimized BP neural network model; 3, training the BP neural network model by using the sample data included in the expert sample library; 4, analyzing the electricity use data to be analyzed of the user according to the trained BP neural network model, and determining the electric larceny suspect coefficient of the user according to the analysis result; and 5, determining the electric larceny suspect user according to the electric larceny suspect coefficient. The electric larceny suspect user can be efficiently, conveniently and fast recognized.

title_en: Space domain sector cascade failure survivability modeling and optimization method
abstract_en: The present invention defines the failure of space domain sector cascade, using improved capacity-load module, network topology structure is combined with blank pipe real work, considers that flow and airspace structure define the load of space domain sector network node, definition more meets the sector node capacity of blank pipe actual conditions.Model is constructed according to space domain sector cascade failure procedure, threshold limit value is established and the improper rate in sector is space domain sector cascade failure survivability measurement index.By optimization load reallocation method optimizing space domain sector cascade failure survivability, and propose adjacent load reallocation and partial load reassignment policy based on residual capacity.Carry out analog simulation cascading failure process by taking Central-South control sector network as an example, analysis obtains closer with heavy load capacity sector nodal distance, and angle value and the small sector node of intensity easily become failure bottleneck, while finding out congestion bottleneck node；Further two kinds of optimisation strategies of simulating, verifying can reduce the improper rate of threshold limit value and sector.

title_en: A kind of control method and system of conducting wire nonlinear vibration movement controller
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the control methods and system of a kind of conducting wire nonlinear vibration movement controller, determine output displacement based on the external excitation of transmission pressure；The external excitation and output displacement are input in the conducting wire nonlinear vibration movement controller pre-established, control force amplitude needed for obtaining conducting wire vibrationproof；Feedback external excitation is exported to conducting wire according to the control force amplitude, preset frequency and the actuator pre-established；Based on the feedback external excitation power, the control for realizing conducting wire nonlinear vibration movement controller is propagated by power flow.The present invention is based on the conducting wire nonlinear vibration movement controllers of power flow theory, realize the Initiative Defense to transmission line of electricity wind shake disaster, promote the ability that transmission line of electricity is withstood natural calamities, it is ensured that transmission line of electricity operational safety improves power grid power supply reliability.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Bird risk prediction and evaluation method in bird sucking environment of aircraft engine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bird risk prediction and evaluation method in an aircraft engine bird sucking environment, which comprises the steps of obtaining aircraft engine bird sucking event probability according to historical data, writing an M file program by using MATLAB language, realizing BP neural network algorithm, predicting economic loss caused by aircraft engine bird sucking events by using a BP neural network model, and performing risk evaluation by combining the aircraft engine bird sucking event probability and a risk evaluation matrix. And finally, designing a GUI (graphical user interface), selecting eight factor data such as the airplane quality, the engine installation number, the engine type, the month, the weather, the bird type, the bird number, the bird size and the like in the statistical data according to the correlation degree of the influence factors in the bird sucking event of the aircraft engine, and calling a BP (back propagation) neural network algorithm through the M file to obtain a result. The model can be used to predict the probability value, severity and risk assessment level of a future flight of an aircraft for the ingestion of a bird at a specified time period and at a specified altitude.

title_en: Method and system for modeling layered characteristics of unmanned environment and storage medium thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for modeling hierarchical characteristics of an unmanned environment and a storage medium thereof. The method comprises the steps that the unmanned vehicle obtains surrounding environment information of the unmanned vehicle and carries out layering; respectively encoding the layered environment information to obtain a pseudo picture representing the environment information of the corresponding type; inputting the pseudo-picture into a convolutional neural network for hierarchical feature extraction; clustering the hierarchical features of the environments respectively corresponding to the pseudo pictures of different levels by using a clustering algorithm, and performing clustering modeling on the subsequent hierarchical features after training the convolutional neural network by using the back propagation of the clustering result. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages that the combination of the environment characteristic layered extraction and the scene type layered clustering is adopted, so that the layered characteristics are more obvious and denser after clustering, and the function of the method is provided with a comprehensive and complete basis for describing the environment of the unmanned scene.

title_en: Extreme precipitation event analysis method and system for observation site data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of hydrologic water resource analysis, and provides an extreme precipitation event analysis method and system for observation site data, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring daily precipitation data and precipitation occurrence time of each site; screening according to the daily precipitation data to obtain an extreme precipitation event; judging whether the extreme precipitation events are synchronous or not according to whether the delay between the extreme precipitation events occurring at any two stations exceeds a preset delay threshold value or not; and for the extreme precipitation events judged to be synchronous, quantifying the overall space-time connection of the corresponding extreme precipitation events based on the synchronous intensity of the events, characterizing the overall propagation direction of the extreme precipitation events based on the obvious delay intensity, carrying out the significance test on the synchronization of the extreme precipitation events to obtain a obvious synchronous intensity matrix and a obvious delay intensity matrix which pass the significance test, forming an undirected network and a directed network of the extreme precipitation events, and outputting the undirected network and the directed network as an analysis result of the extreme precipitation events.

title_en: Method and apparatus for minimizing service disruption
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to methods and apparatus for minimizing service disruption. There is provided a method implemented in a wireless transmit/receive unit, the method comprising sending a first message to a first network via a non-3 GPP access, the first message comprising information indicating support service interruption; receiving a second message from the first network, the second message including information indicating one or more disaster condition handling preferences for the first network associated with maintaining on the first network via non-3 GPP access and one or more other disaster condition handling preferences associated with roaming to another network; receiving a third message from the first network, the third message including information indicating one disaster condition for the first network associated with the 3GPP access; determining whether to stay on the first network or roam to another network via a non-3 GPP access based on a second message, the second message based on a disaster condition handling preference; and maintaining on the first network via the non-3 GPP access based on the determination.

title_en: Electromagnetic transient fault analysis method, device and equipment based on large model
abstract_en: The application discloses an electromagnetic transient fault analysis method, device and equipment based on a large model, wherein the method comprises the steps of preprocessing real-time operation information obtained from a power grid to obtain time sequence operation information, carrying out fault reasoning analysis according to the time sequence operation information based on a preset fault analysis large model and a thinking chain technology to obtain a fault analysis result, wherein the fault analysis result comprises a fault position, a fault type and a fault root cause, and analyzing the cascading effect of faults according to a space-time feedback reasoning chain in the preset fault analysis large model by combining power grid topological structure information and the fault analysis result to obtain a fault influence analysis result. The method and the device can solve the technical problems that the analysis precision is insufficient, the calculated amount is large, and the influence analysis and evaluation are difficult to carry out aiming at various faults of different types in the prior art.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG;CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO

title_en: Target intelligent cooperative identification method based on unmanned aerial vehicle cluster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a target intelligent collaborative identification method based on unmanned aerial vehicle clusters, and belongs to the field of unmanned aerial vehicle cluster control and computer vision. The method comprises the steps of realizing cluster networking and model initialization through a dynamic heterogeneous federal learning architecture, optimizing task allocation by adopting a space-time attention mechanism, extracting multi-view target characteristics by utilizing a deformable network, providing a cascading characteristic distillation fusion strategy, carrying out modal compression and cross-modal gating fusion on multi-source data such as multi-spectrum, laser radar and the like, designing an anti-interference elastic communication mechanism based on meta learning, enhancing system robustness by combining space-time countermeasure detection and dynamic spectrum sensing technology, establishing an unsupervised federal increment learning system, and realizing model online evolution through momentum weighted aggregation. According to the invention, the target recognition accuracy is improved by 35% under a complex environment, the time delay is reduced to 200ms, and high-precision real-time recognition support is provided for scenes such as military reconnaissance, disaster rescue and the like.

title_en: Hydropower generation capacity determining method based on scheduling procedure digitization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydropower generation capacity determining method based on digitalization of a scheduling rule, and belongs to the technical field of hydropower scheduling modeling and power generation capacity assessment. The method comprises the steps of taking hydropower station scheduling procedure texts as basic data, adopting knowledge graph construction and semantic analysis technology to extract constraint conditions and effective situations in the scheduling procedure, converting scheduling information into structural parameters and constructing a database to realize digital modeling of the scheduling procedure, identifying an effective scheduling constraint set according to information such as running water, power station operation, power grid capacity and the like in a prediction period, constructing a power generation capacity calculation model, calculating an average active power interval of the power station in a specific period, considering constraint correction of upstream outlet warehouse to downstream running water among cascade hydropower stations, and completing rolling calculation of the power generation capacity of a river basin step by step. The invention can provide scientific support and decision basis for electric power market participation, power grid dispatching safety check and river basin optimization operation.
assignees: DADU RIVER HYDROPOWER DEV CO LTD

title_en: Method for designing optimization of supply chain resilience considering risk propagation effect
title_ko: 위험 확산효과를 고려한 공급망 회복탄력성 최적화 설계방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 위험 확산효과를 고려한 공급망 회복탄력성 최적화 설계방법에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 공급망의 붕괴와 같이 개별 노드에서 발생한 위험이 네트워크 상에서 확산되는 상황을 반영하여, 공급망의 회복탄력성에 높은 영향을 미치는 핵심 노드(critical node)를 식별하고 식별된 핵심 노드에 대한 관리방안, 개선방안 및 위기대응 역량개선방안을 도출함으로써, 공급망의 효율성을 증대하고 지속가능한 공급망(sustainable supply network)을 구축할 수 있는, 확산효과를 고려한 공급망 회복탄력성 최적화 설계방법에 관한 것이다.
assignees: UNIV HANNAM INST IND ACAD COOP

title_en: Greenhouse cultivation system using solar powered wireless sensor networks
title_ko: 태양 에너지 수집형 무선 센서 네트워크를 이용한 온실재배시스템
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 온실, 및 상기 온실에 장착되고, 태양 에너지 수집형 무선 센서 네트워크를 구성하는 적어도 1이상의 노드를 포함하는 FEC를 이용한 데이터 통신시스템을 포함하는 온실재배시스템에 있어서, 
상기 데이터 통신시스템은, 각 노드로부터 송신되는 각 데이터패킷 혹은 제어패킷을 수신하는 데이터패킷수신부; 신호수신부에서 수신한 패킷 중 패리티부를 추출하고, 패리티의 길이에 따른 각 노드에서의 현재 에너지상태를 체크하는 패리티분석부; 각 노드에서 요구되는 수준의 에너지를 공급하는 무선전력공급수단; 및 패리티분석부에서 체크된 각 노드의 에너지상태를 참고하여 필요한 에너지 수준을 결정한 후, 상기 무선전력공급수단에게 이에 상응하는 전파를 각 노드에 송출하여 에너지를 충전하게 하고, 상기 패리티분석부에서 체크된 에너지상태에 따라 전파송출을 중지하도록 제어하는 전력공급제어수단으로 이루어지는 노드전력공급부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 태양 에너지 수집형 무선 센서 네트워크를 이용한 온실재배시스템을 제공한다.

title_en: Contact rates in malware simulation for responsive measure deployment
abstract_en: A computer-implemented method of simulating the propagation of malware in a network is provided. The method comprises accessing a model of the network, where the model comprises a plurality of computer nodes and where each computer node of the plurality of computer nodes is connected to at least one edge of a plurality of edges. Each edge of the plurality of edges connects a pair of computer nodes of the plurality of computer nodes. The method further comprises initiating an outbreak of the malware in the model at a predetermined source computer node of the plurality of computer nodes, and propagating the malware through the model of the network from the source computer node. The propagation is determined based on a rate of transmission, where the rate of transmission is based upon a contact rate for each edge of the plurality of edges, and the contact rate for each edge of the plurality of edges is based upon the network traffic passing between the computer nodes connected by that edge over a predetermined time period.

title_en: Distributed Gain Subscriber Tap with Power Management
abstract_en: A system and method for a distribution network is provided wherein cascaded power amplifiers with bypass switching are disposed along the branches of the network. The amplifiers may have an RF modem and a programmable digital computer that enables communication with a headend or a controlling computer as well as a bypass switch control for disabling the amplification function of the amplifiers. The amplifier may have a wireless communication system for communicating with individual subscriber's homes and communicating with a neighboring amplifier system for use in emergency situations or during installation and configuration of the network. The network comprised of the amplifiers may have redundant signal paths, using the wireless communication devices of the amplifiers, which may be used as backup signal paths for certain communications requiring high uptime such as telephony.

title_en: Tree-shaped river network cascade reservoir hydrodynamic water quality sediment coupling simulation method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water conservancy researches, in particular to a tree-shaped river network cascade reservoir hydrodynamic water quality sediment coupling simulation method and system, which solve the problems of integrity and reliability of river terrain sections and control line hydrologic station data; after the cascade reservoir is added, how to solve the joint solution of the river network and the cascade reservoir, and a western river midstream river network integral hydrodynamics simulation calculation platform which integrates a cascade reservoir scheduling mode and a one-dimensional river network hydrodynamics model is established by relying on the latest actually measured river channel water depth topography data. The model calculation is based on a one-dimensional Save Vigna equation, a calculation sequence for establishing a model from four layers of river networks, sub-river networks, river channels and nodes is provided, the river networks and the cascade reservoirs are generalized, the river segments are connected into a whole through a transmission relation between a water conservancy junction scheduling mode and external boundary conditions, and the calculation whole is connected with each river segment, so that synchronous real-time simulation and calculation are realized, and research means of river network cascade reservoir scheduling are enriched.

title_en: Aviation network risk assessment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an aviation network risk assessment method. According to the method, on the basis of single airport risks, more serious airspace risks caused by risk cascade are researched, and airspace-oriented risk assessment is carried out, so that control over the overall running situation of the airspace is facilitated. On the other hand, the potential safety risks such as airport saturation and flight delay are selected as evaluation factors, and the time points of risk evaluation and adjustment measures are advanced from factors causing aviation network risks in a pre-tactical stage, so that the risk evaluation and adjustment measures are not developed into important flight accidents such as collision and the like, and the high-risk operation in the tactical level is reduced. Meanwhile, flight delay and airport saturation are dynamic, so that the risk assessment of the aviation network based on delay and congestion is dynamic, and the risk level assessment of each airspace of the whole aviation network is more reliable.

title_en: Fault leakage current separation method and device based on cross self-coding network
abstract_en: The invention provides a fault leakage current separation method and a fault leakage current separation device based on a cross self-coding network, the method is based on the principle of minimum reconstruction error, two independent automatic coding networks are respectively learned on a residual current data set and a fault leakage current data set, a residual current feature coding module and a fault leakage current feature decoding module are intercepted and cascaded to form the cross self-coding network, migration fine tuning training is carried out on the cross self-coding network by adopting paired residual current-fault leakage current data, and finally a mapping model for separating fault leakage current from residual current is obtained, so that fault leakage current separation is realized. The method can effectively separate the fault leakage current from the residual current, thereby improving the cross network training efficiency and enhancing the generalization capability and robustness of the obtained model.

title_en: Gas turbine-oriented non-stationary multivariable causal relationship analysis method
abstract_en: The application discloses a gas turbine-oriented non-stationary multivariable causal relationship analysis method. According to the method, for a large-range non-steady operation condition continuously occurring in the operation process of the gas turbine, the data fluctuation trend is extracted through rank vectors and is converted into a limited symbol sequence set, and the information transfer direction and intensity between variables are quantitatively evaluated by using a multi-variable symbol transfer entropy. Meanwhile, a statistical hypothesis testing flow is designed, and the significance of the actual variable causal relationship is judged by randomly recombining the variable time sequence information as a reference group, so that the simplification of the redundant false causal relationship among the variables is realized. Finally, a multi-variable causal connection network is established. The application not only can reveal variable causal relation of a large-scale non-stationary process, but also has robustness to noise interference in a severe industrial environment, establishes a system bottom interactive mechanism model in a data driving mode, and provides a new efficient and reliable idea for state evaluation and fault propagation path analysis of a gas turbine system.

title_en: Risk propagation detection method, apparatus, electronic device and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a risk propagation detection method, a risk propagation detection device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of information security. According to the risk propagation detection method, a node network of data to be predicted is constructed, propagation risk values of other nodes except the preset node in the node network are calculated, and then whether the other nodes are nodes with abnormal risk propagation is determined according to the propagation risk values of the other nodes. And constructing a node network by utilizing fields in the data to be predicted, and calculating propagation risk values of other nodes by referencing propagation risk values of preset nodes in the node network, so as to detect nodes with abnormal risk propagation according to the propagation risk values of other nodes. The detection method for the data risk propagation is optimized, so that the detection is more stable and the detection result is more reliable.

title_en: Method and device for improving power grid benefit and stably operating power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for improving the power grid benefit and the stable operation of an electric power system, wherein the method comprises the steps of inputting parameters to construct a unit combination objective function, step hydroelectric and thermal power and system constraint; and according to the solving result, the method is applied to an electric power system to reduce the output fluctuation and the start-stop times of the thermal power unit. The invention establishes the cascade hydroelectric-thermal power system unit combination model considering the characteristics of the complex vibration area, effectively avoids the problems of poor safety, low operation benefit and the like of the power system caused by flexible peak regulation operation of the hydroelectric power in the vibration area, and has important significance for guaranteeing the safe, stable and economic operation of the power grid.

title_en: Flexibility optimization scheduling method, system, equipment and medium for cascade small hydroelectric group
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flexibility optimization scheduling method, a system, equipment and a medium of a cascade small hydropower group, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining the rainfall of the cascade small hydropower group and quantifying the flexibility adjustment capacity of a hydropower station system according to the rainfall; the method comprises the steps of quantifying flexibility requirements of a hydropower station system, quantifying flexibility shortage of the hydropower station system in each period according to flexibility requirements and flexibility regulation capacity obtained by quantification, respectively carrying out uncertainty modeling on rainfall capacity and net load of the hydropower station system to obtain a rainfall prediction model and a net load uncertainty set, constructing an optimal scheduling model of the hydropower station system based on the flexibility shortage, the rainfall prediction model and the net load uncertainty set, solving the optimal scheduling model to obtain an optimal scheduling scheme of the hydropower station system, controlling a power grid terminal connected with a cascade small hydropower station group to execute the optimal scheduling scheme, so as to fully excavate the flexibility of the cascade small hydropower station, and optimizing a scheduling operation strategy of the hydropower station system.

title_en: Heat supply network operation efficiency evaluation method based on data prediction
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of heat supply network operation efficiency evaluation, and discloses a heat supply network operation efficiency evaluation method based on data prediction. The method comprises the steps of constructing a structure transformation result matrix, constructing a graph modeling structure, extracting disturbance characteristics, constructing a graph propagation modulation mechanism, generating a structure disturbance response representation, identifying a structure behavior type, completing node flow prediction by combining a basic predictor, comparing and analyzing a prediction result with actual operation data, judging the degree of fit between the node operation state and a target heat supply requirement, and outputting an operation efficiency evaluation result of a heat supply network. According to the method, through introducing a disturbance-driven graph propagation mechanism and a multi-mode structure identification strategy, modeling capacity and prediction accuracy of nonlinear structure response in a complex heating system are effectively improved, and support is provided for real-time evaluation and efficiency management of the system running state.

title_en: Apparatus for video monitoring of subway train
title_ko: 지하철 차량 영상감시 장치
abstract_ko:
본 고안은 지하철 차량과 지하철 역사 내에 카메라를 통한 영상감시 장치에 있어서, 상기 지하철 차량의 천정에 형성하여 상기 지하철 차량의 내부를 정밀 판독 및 감시할 수 있도록 구성하는 실내용 돔 하우징이 장착된 네트워크 카메라 및상기 지하철 역사 내 플랫폼을 감시할 수 있도록 구성하는 플랫폼 감시카메라와, 상기 네트워크 카메라에 의해 촬영된 영상을 전자유도, 전파장애의 통신 노이즈의 영향을 받지 않고 링 구조로 전송의 끊김이 없는 광케이블을 이용한 광 링 네트워크 스위치와, 상기 광 링 네트워크 스위치를 통해 전송받은 영상을 상기 지하철의 기관실에서 디스플레이하도록 구성하는 산업용 디브이알(Digital video recorder, DVR)과, 상기 산업용 디브이알(Digital video recorder, DVR)에 디스플레이되는 영상정보를 역사상황실에 무선 랜을 경유하여 전송하는 제1영상전송부와, 상기 지하철 역사 내 플랫폼 감시카메라에 촬영된 영상정보를 기관실에 무선 랜을 경유하여 전송하는 제2영상전송부와, 상기 제1영상전송부에서 전송하는 영상정보를 상기 역사상황실에 디스플레이하는 상황모니터를 포함하여 이루어지는 지하철 차량 영상감시 장치를 제공한다. 
       
     네트워크 카메라, 광 링 네트워크 스위치, 산업용 디브이알(Digital video recorder, DVR)

title_en: Multi Digital door
title_ko: 다기능 디지털 도어
abstract_ko:
본 고안은, 네트워크 환경을 이용하여 보안성 및 편리성을 강화시킬 수 있고, 화재 등의 비상시에 안정성을 강화시킬 수 있으며, 도어의 심미성 및 기능성을 강화시킬 수 있는 디지털 도어에 관한 것이다. 
     이를 위해, 본 고안은, 디지털 도어에 있어서, 상기 도어에 전원을 공급하는 전원부와, 사용자로부터 기계적, 전자기적으로 소정의 입력을 받아 이를 데이터로 변환하여 송신하는 입력부와, 복수 개의 잠금부로 구성된 다중 잠금 방식으로 도어의 잠금 및 해지 기능을 수행하는 다중락부와, 상기 도어와 네크워크망 간의 접속 기능을 수행하는 통신부와, 제어에 관련된 데이터가 소프트웨어화되어 실행가능한 형태로 저장되어 있고, 화재 및 방범에 관련된 메시지, 상기 입력부로부터 입력받은 영상 및 음성 데이터를 저장하는 메모리부와, 상기 메시지에 따른 경보음을 생성하는 오디오부와, 상기 전원부, 입력부, 디지털 다중락부, 통신부, 메모리부, 및 오디오부와 연결되어 상기 디지털 도어를 제어하는 제어부를 포함하는 것을 디지털 도어를 제공한다. 
       
     다단계, 도미노, 디지털키, 다중락부

title_en: Method for identifying cascading failure of power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for identifying the cascading failure of a power system. Considering the speed governing and load response of a power generator, a more practical power system load flow calculation model is established, and the method overcomes the impact that a traditional load flow calculation model cannot reflect the regulation action and load response of the power generator in the load flow calculation model. From the perspective of the operation status of the system, the method analyzes the relationship between stable voltage and the failure in the cascading failure; and deducts the stable indicator of the system voltage and the critical value of the indicator by analyzing the change of a Jacobi matrix element value in order to quantitatively analyze the relationship between the critical value of the voltage and the operation status of the system. As the load is increased, the system has higher risk of the cascading failure. During the process, the stable indicator of the system voltage is gradually reduced, and the critical value is always maintained at 0.5 (+/-0.03). In an actual system, the critical value of the voltage which is calculated remains unchanged in the cascading failure, 0.6 is selected as the critical value of voltage collapse in a power grid in the actual system, so as to identify whether the power grid faces the risk of large-scale power-off or not. In such a manner, the method has better actual guiding significance.

title_en: A kind of Short-Term Load Forecasting Method
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of Short-Term Load Forecasting Method, establish the Short-term Load Forecasting based on front stage BP cascade neural network, history Power system load data is clustered using improved maximum deviation similarity criterion clustering algorithm, and hierarchical clustering is carried out to class center, merge to obtain the similar Overload Class of prediction day by class cluster, and using the load data of Z class as the training data of rear class BP neural network, to improve the convergence rate and precision of prediction of neural network.Short-Term Load Forecasting Method proposed by the present invention, calculating speed is fast, precision of prediction is high, can better meet power grid to the needs of load forecast.

title_en: Method for identifying fragile coupling link between power grid control system and power primary equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of safe and reliable operation guarantee of an intelligent power grid, and discloses a method for identifying a fragile coupling link between a power grid control system and primary power equipment, which comprises the following steps: step 1, establishing a network model of a smart grid control system and primary power equipment interdependent coupling, wherein the network model comprises a power grid and an information grid; step 2, constructing a vulnerability identification method based on node centrality, thereby obtaining node electrical centrality indexes among all nodes in the power network and approximate centrality indexes of effective information lengths among all nodes in the information networkMarking; step 3, calculating comprehensive risk measurement index DLC based on power grid-information grid C (P i ，C i ) (ii) a Step 4, calculating the comprehensive risk measurement index DLC C (P i ，C i ) And finding out and removing the key fragile coupling link of the power grid-information grid. The method and the device improve the robustness of the intelligent power grid control system to the maximum extent and reduce the probability of cascading faults.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECHNICAL RES INSTITUTE OF SICHUAN PROVINCE ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY OF STATE GRID

title_en: Power system dynamic estimation method, device, equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a power system dynamic estimation method, a device, equipment and a readable storage medium, wherein an estimation value of a state vector at the next moment of the current moment output by a power system dynamic estimation model is obtained by acquiring a time series data set of the current moment and inputting the time series data set of the current moment into the power system dynamic estimation model. The power system dynamic estimation model is composed of a CNN-LSTM network and a UKF network, the CNN-LSTM network is used for performing feature extraction on an input time series data set of the current moment and analyzing and determining a predicted state vector of the current moment at the next moment, and the UKF network is used for calculating a state vector and a covariance corresponding to the current moment through propagation of a Sigma point and obtaining an estimated value of the state vector of the current moment at the next moment by combining the predicted state vector. According to the method and the device, the CNN and LSTM structures are introduced, so that the reliability and accuracy of the state vector at the next moment in the traditional dynamic state prediction estimation are improved.
assignees: YUNFU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG

title_en: Building earthquake damage assessment model for optimizing BP neural network by improved genetic algorithm
abstract_en: The building earthquake damage assessment model for optimizing BP neural network by improving genetic algorithm comprises the following steps: step 1, collecting building earthquake damage data from historical earthquake cases, wherein the building earthquake damage data comprise main influencing factors and damage levels of building earthquake damage; step 2, carrying out digital quantitative representation on the non-digital building earthquake damage data; step 3, carrying out equalization and normalization treatment on the digitized building earthquake damage data to obtain a sample data set; and 4, constructing a back propagation neural network, optimizing the back propagation neural network through an improved genetic algorithm, and constructing a building earthquake damage assessment model. According to the invention, by adopting a nonlinear self-adaptive cross rate and variation rate adjustment method, training individuals are regenerated, the fixed cross rate and variation rate of the traditional genetic algorithm are improved, the generalization capability of the back propagation neural network model is improved, the obtained model output result has good consistency with the actual result, the accuracy is high, and the rapid and accurate assessment of the building earthquake damage can be realized.

title_en: Distribution network and micro-grid distributed collaborative planning method and system based on improved target cascading analysis method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed collaborative planning method and system for a power distribution network and a micro-grid based on an improved target cascading analysis method. The method comprises the steps of taking the topology and safety constraint of a power distribution network into consideration, taking the minimum total cost of the power distribution network planning as a target, establishing an upper-layer power distribution network planning model, taking the aggregate capacity of a micro-grid to various internal resources into consideration, taking the minimum total planning cost of the micro-grid as a target, establishing a lower-layer multi-micro-grid planning model, and solving a micro-grid collaborative planning model by adopting an improved target cascade analysis method. Aiming at the power grid planning problem in the future multi-planning main body background, the invention plays a role in integrating various distributed energy sources by the micro-grid, coordinates planning resources of the micro-grid and the power distribution network, and reduces the planning cost of each planning main body. The method has the advantages that the power generation resources in the power distribution network and the micro-grid can be reasonably planned, collaborative planning is realized only by a small amount of information on the premise that global equipment information is not needed, the privacy of information of each planning main body is protected, and meanwhile, the economy of each planning main body scheme is improved.

title_en: Multi-physical-field collaborative simulation optimization method for structure and function integrated phased-array antenna
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-physical-field collaborative simulation optimization method of a structure and function integrated phased array antenna, which comprises the steps of splitting an overall model of the antenna, sequentially carrying out electromagnetic simulation on an electromagnetic simulation model of a power division network, carrying out circuit simulation on a chip equivalent spice cascade circuit simulation model, carrying out full-array thermal simulation and a radome force simulation model, carrying out force simulation on the full-array thermal simulation model, carrying out circuit simulation again on the chip equivalent spice cascade circuit simulation model, carrying out electromagnetic simulation on subarray electromagnetic simulation models of each antenna, carrying out full-array directional diagram synthesis on subarray directional diagrams, judging whether parameters output by each simulation model of a collaborative simulation optimization overall process meet preset requirements, completing collaborative simulation optimization of multiple physical fields of paths, heat, force and electromagnetism, otherwise, adopting an optimization algorithm to adjust optimization variables of corresponding module simulation models, and realizing efficient collaborative simulation optimization of the antenna under the coupling action of multiple physical fields of force, heat, electricity and the like.
assignees: BEIJING RES INST MECHANICAL & ELECTRICAL TECH

title_en: Urban power grid information physical system security situation early warning method based on cross-space fault propagation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of safety of electric power information physical systems, and discloses a city power grid information physical system safety situation early warning method based on cross-space risk propagation; the method comprises the steps of constructing a power grid physical layer and information layer coupling model and a cellular space false data injection attack model, simulating a fault cross-space propagation mechanism through an event-driven cellular automaton theory, predicting the running state of a power grid through an integrated core limit learning machine model, realizing multi-dimensional data fusion through a radial basis function, fusing a plurality of model prediction results through an integrated structure to improve model prediction accuracy, establishing an early warning system comprising voltage out-of-limit, line overload and load loss indexes, dynamically distributing weights through an entropy weight method, and dividing early warning grades. The method solves the problem of low early warning precision of the urban power grid security situation under the condition of multiple disturbance, and can effectively improve the accuracy and the robustness of the security situation early warning.

title_en: Hidden power outage space-time trajectory inversion method for waveform characteristic transfer learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hidden power outage space-time trajectory inversion method for waveform characteristic transfer learning, and relates to the technical field of power distribution network fault analysis.
