The method comprises the steps of collecting three-phase voltage and current waveform data before and after a fault, conducting filtering and noise reduction processing, extracting a plurality of transient characteristics to construct feature vectors, mapping the characteristics to power grid topological nodes through an attention mechanism, establishing a power failure risk probability model, conducting space-time propagation on the power grid topology by using a graph convolution network with initial risk probability as input to obtain a node dynamic risk probability matrix, generating a space-time power failure track set through threshold judgment, finally exporting the track to a GIS platform, and adjusting a visual mark according to the number of users. The invention breaks through the dependence of the switch signal, realizes the dynamic tracking and track inversion of the hidden power failure, and effectively improves the rush-repair efficiency and the power supply reliability of the power distribution network.
assignees: HONGHE POWER SUPPLY BUREAU YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Coal mine disaster early warning method based on multi-source data fusion and space-time diagram network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal mine disaster early warning method based on multi-source data fusion and a space-time diagram network. The method comprises (a) collecting multisource heterogeneous monitoring data, (b) constructing an anisotropic space-time diagram of a geologic-physical dual constraint, (c) training the diagram using a geologic-physical anisotropic space-time diagram neural network whose diagram volume lamination is designed to learn simultaneously And And (d) predicting disaster risk by using the trained model and generating early warning. According to the invention, geology and physical priori knowledge are taken as constraints to be incorporated into the topological structure of the GNN model, so that the model can follow a physical rule, and disasters (propagation) under anisotropic geological conditions are predicted, thereby being beneficial to improving the accuracy and timeliness of early warning.

title_en: Drainage pipe network water quality diffusion prediction method and system based on directed topology network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a drainage pipe network water quality diffusion prediction method and system based on a directed topology network, and relates to the technical field of water quality monitoring. Aiming at the defects of the traditional water quality analysis method, the method comprises the steps of collecting water quality monitoring related data of a drainage pipe network, integrating the data into a standardized data set trained by an adaptation model after pretreatment and characteristic engineering screening, constructing a directed topology network model, introducing a water quality diffusion mechanism, fusing the data, enabling the network model to truly reflect the propagation rule of water quality among different nodes along with water flow, constructing a prediction model, training and optimizing the prediction model based on the standardized data set, comparing and verifying the prediction result of the prediction model with synchronous actual monitoring results, evaluating the accuracy and reliability of the model, predicting the water quality by using the drainage pipe network water quality diffusion prediction model qualified in evaluation, displaying the water quality prediction result of the prediction model by using a visualization tool, and synchronously displaying a water quality diffusion analysis report.
assignees: INSPUR SMART CITY TECH CO LTD

title_en: System for monitoring accident through image analysis based on deep learning in ship
title_ko: 딥러닝기반 영상인식을 통한 선박 내 사고 감지 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a system for detecting accidents in a vessel based on deep learning-based image recognition, the system comprising: CCTV cameras (110) installed in an engine room, a wheelhouse, a crew room, an air-conditioning room, a pump room, a warehouse, a lounge, a cargo hold, and at a bow and a stern of an upper deck of a vessel, respectively, to capture images and generate image information; a network video recorder (NVR) (120) configured to receive the image information from the CCTV cameras (110) and record the image information in an internal database; an image analysis server (130) configured to analyze the image information through a deep learning-based image analysis algorithm to identify whether a hazardous situation occurs in the vessel and a level of occurrence thereof and to generate hazard information; and a monitoring server (160) configured to monitor the image information in real time, receive the hazard information, transmit a warning broadcast through an onboard broadcasting server (210), and transmit warning information to corresponding smart terminals (150) of a crew, an administrator, and passengers, respectively, wherein the system analyzes CCTV images to detect hazardous situations in the vessel and disseminates the same to the crew and the administrator, and is interworked with firefighting equipment in the vessel to enable initial suppression.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 선박 내 기관실과 조타실과 승조원실과 공조실과 펌프실과 창고와 휴게실과 화물창과 상부데크의 선수 및 선미에 각각 설치되어 영상촬영하여 영상정보를 생성하는 CCTV(110), CCTV(110)로부터 영상정보를 전송받아 내부 데이터베이스에 기록하는 NVR(Network Video Recorder)(120), 딥러닝기반의 영상분석 알고리즘을 통해, 영상정보를 영상분석하여 선박내 위험상황 발생 여부 및 발생 수준을 식별하고 위험정보를 생성하는 영상분석서버(130), 및 영상정보를 실시간 모니터링하며, 위험정보를 전송받아 선내 방송 서버(210)를 통해 경고방송을 전파하고, 선원과 관리자와 승객의 해당 스마트단말기(150)로 경고정보를 각각 전송하는, 모니터링서버(160)를 포함하여, CCTV 영상을 분석하여 선박 내 위험상황을 감지하여 선원 및 관리자에게 전파하도록 하고, 선박 내 소화장비들과 연동하여 초기 진압이 가능하도록 하는, 딥러닝기반 영상인식을 통한 선박 내 사고 감지 시스템을 개시한다.

title_en: Reducing Wireless Device Service Interruptions
abstract_en: Apparatuses, systems, and methods for reducing wireless device service interruptions. An indication of a disaster condition may be provided to a wireless device. The disaster condition may affect a home public land mobile network of the wireless device. The wireless device may perform cell selection in a manner influenced by the indication of the disaster condition. This may include considering cells associated with a forbidden public land mobile network for the cell selection, or excluding cells associated with the home public land mobile network of the wireless device that are unavailable, for example due to the disaster condition, among various possibilities.

title_en: System which makes it possible to determine parameters and observe an energy network
abstract_en: System which makes it possible to determine parameters and observe an energy network without making contact with the network and at a variable distance from the latter by detecting low-frequency radio waves which are emitted by said network, are picked up by magnetic and electrical antennas, are amplified and are filtered by active filters and by digital signal processing software. This information is then corrected using information from vibration, inclination and temperature sensors located in the base of the antennas, finally obtaining the voltage, current, frequency, current direction, power factor and active and reactive power parameters. In addition to this, the system makes it possible to obtain vibration and inclination information relating to energy network structures and towers and to provide event alarms for the measured parameters. Using several of these systems makes it possible to obtain energy balance parameters, to measure transients, to determine the location where lines are physically cut off, and to measure the intensity and propagation of earthquakes. Said system includes an electric field filter, software for determining the optimum location for installing the system in the field, software for measuring the internal electromagnetic noise of the system and software for calibrating and determining parameters without the need to measure the distance between the system and the electrical line being studied.

title_en: Method and device for using drive test data for propagation model revision
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for applying drive test data to the propagation model tuning, which comprises: step 1, obtaining the original drive test data; step 2, selecting the data satisfying the preset conditions, as valid drive test data, from the original drive test data; step 3, extracting the valid drive test data to form a data file for the propagation model tuning. The invention also provides a device for applying drive test data to the propagation model tuning, which comprises a drive test data acquisition module adapted to obtain the drive test data from a region to be tuned; a valid drive test data generation module adapted to generate valid drive test data from the drive test data based on the preset conditions; and a data file generation module adapted to extract the valid drive test data to generate a data file for the propagation model tuning. Based on the test data of the existing network, the invention can greatly reduce the test operation of CW, save the cost of network construction, and ensure that the tuned model can accurately show the local propagation characteristics, thereby optimizing the configuration of base station.
assignees: CHINA MOBILE GROUP DESIGN INST;CHINA MOBILE COMM CORP;CHINA MOBILE GROUP FUJIAN BRANCH CO LTD

title_en: Nonlinear fuzzy language power distribution network node vulnerability evaluation method based on complex network
abstract_en: The application relates to a nonlinear fuzzy language power distribution network node vulnerability evaluation method based on a complex network, which comprises the following steps: constructing a complex network model of the power distribution network according to the data of the power distribution network; determining an importance measurement index of a power distribution network node, and constructing a network node importance evaluation database; determining parameters of fuzzy rules in the complex network model of the power distribution network; performing data clustering analysis on the database by adopting a clustering method; establishing a nonlinear fuzzy language power distribution network node vulnerability evaluation model based on a complex network; optimizing parameters; analyzing the vulnerability of the power distribution network nodes by adopting the optimized evaluation model; and maintaining the power distribution network nodes according to the analysis result. The method has the advantages that the non-linear fuzzy language is adopted to realize analysis and accurate evaluation of the vulnerability of the power distribution network nodes, so that the power distribution network nodes are maintained, the cascading failure risk is reduced, the safe and stable operation of the power distribution network is guaranteed, the power consumption requirements of users are met, and the power consumption quality of the users and the economic benefits of power grid enterprises are improved.

title_en: Prediction method for cascading failure sequence of power transmission network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a prediction method of a power transmission network cascading failure sequence, which comprises the following steps of firstly, randomly selecting a line of a non-generator outgoing line and a transformer line in a power transmission network as an initial failure line in the cascading failure sequence, wherein the number of failure stages is set to be 1; secondly, counting the number of the overload lines; thirdly, judging a fault line of the next stage, and adding 1 to the number of fault stages; and fourthly, disconnecting all the determined fault lines, judging the running state of the generator, stopping prediction if the power transmission network is disconnected and the generator is in an unsafe running state, outputting the cascading failure sequence, or stopping prediction if the failure series number of the cascading failure sequence reaches the predictable maximum sequence number of 5, and outputting the cascading failure sequence, or else, discharging all the determined fault lines, repeating the steps from the second step until the prediction is stopped, and outputting the cascading failure sequence. The invention relates to a prediction method of a cascading failure sequence of a power transmission network, which can predict all possible cascading failure sequences of the power transmission network in advance.

title_en: DI-SCIR-based double-layer coupling social network public opinion propagation model construction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for constructing a double-layer coupled social network public opinion propagation model based on DI-SCIRs, which comprises the steps of firstly, based on a traditional SCIRs model, considering dynamic time variability and direct immunization of the number of network users, and combining with real network public opinion propagation conditions to formulate public opinion propagation rules; secondly, providing an interlayer strong coupling connection method based on LBRank; and finally, according to the public opinion propagation rule, a state transition probability is provided, a differential equation of the public opinion propagation model is established, and a final propagation model is generated, so that the public opinion propagation process in the double-layer coupled social network can be more effectively and accurately reflected.

title_en: Multi-micro-network cooperative scheduling method based on master-slave cooperative game and target cascading analysis
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of power system dispatching, and relates to a multi-micro-grid cooperative dispatching method based on master-slave cooperative game and target cascading analysis, which utilizes the cooperative dispatching problem of power resources and carbon emission of a multi-micro-grid system to construct a double-layer master-slave cooperative game framework, wherein an upper-layer power grid operator coordinates the power dispatching and operation strategy of a micro-grid alliance based on tide analysis, voltage regulation and carbon emission control; the method comprises the steps of realizing power transaction and resource sharing of each micro-grid of a lower micro-grid alliance through cooperative game, dynamically adjusting the power of a connecting wire by introducing an Andersen acceleration method based on a target cascade analysis algorithm, combining the processing constraint of an augmented Lagrange penalty function, optimizing the decoupling iterative process of the upper layer and the lower layer, accelerating convergence, effectively solving the problem of low efficiency of multi-main-body cooperative optimization, ensuring stable system power and reasonable distribution of electric energy resources, and providing technical support for the operation of a multi-micro-grid system.

title_en: Typhoon wind field simulation method and system capable of adaptively enhancing complex terrain influence and site linkage effect
abstract_en: The invention relates to a typhoon wind field simulation method and a typhoon wind field simulation system capable of adaptively enhancing complex terrain influence and site linkage effect, wherein meteorological observation site data, low-resolution typhoon wind field data and high-resolution terrain data are acquired through a data acquisition and standardization preprocessing module, and standardization processing is carried out; A site space position diagram and a characteristic correlation diagram are built based on observation site data, a multi-scale wind-topography characteristic fusion module extracts neighborhood wind fields and topography information, a space linkage network prediction module predicts fusion characteristics and observation values, a typhoon field model training module minimizes L2 loss of prediction noise and real noise through counter propagation optimization parameters, a target lattice point is inserted into a station point diagram in a typhoon field reconstruction module to construct edges and calculate wind components, reconstruction of the typhoon field is achieved, and the problem that complex topography and site linkage effect expression in an existing typhoon field simulation method is insufficient is solved.

title_en: Seismic Infrasound Analysis Method and Computer Program Media
title_ko: 음원 자동화 분석 방법 및 이를 수행하는 컴퓨터 프로그램을 가진 기록매체
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an automatic sound source analysis method, and more specifically, to a method for collecting sound sources such as earthquake vibration, atmospheric sound, underwater sound, etc. which are physical phenomena occurring in a threat force or other specific targets and activities in a computer network system to monitor, analyze, report, and disseminate an abnormal symptom related to the sound source, and a recording medium having a computer program performing the same. The present invention can collect the sound sources such as the earthquake vibration, the atmospheric sound, the underwater sound, etc. which are physical phenomena occurring in the threat force or the other specific targets and activities. The present invention can continuously monitor an abnormal symptom of the targets or activities of the threat force for twenty four hours. The present invention can collect information independently while having a high level security by using a method for analyzing, reporting, and disseminating the physical phenomena occurring in the threat force or the other specific targets and activities.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 음원을 자동으로 분석하는 방법에 관한 것으로, 보다 자세하게는 컴퓨터 네트워크 체계 안에서 위협 세력이나 기타 특정 표적과 활동 등에서 나타나는 물리적 현상인 지진동, 대기음향 및 수중음향 등의 음원을 수집하여 음원관련 이상 징후를 감시하고 분석하여 보고 및 전파하는 방법 및 이를 수행하는 컴퓨터 프로그램을 가진 기록매체에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명은 위협 세력이나 기타 특정 표적과 활동 등에서 나타나는 물리적 현상인 지진동, 대기음향 및 수중음향 등의 음원을 수집할 수 있다.

본 발명은 위협 세력이나 기타 특정 표적과 활동 등에서 나타나는 물리적 현상을 분석하여 보고 및 전파하는 방법을 이용하여 고도의 보안성을 갖추면서도 독립적인 정보 수집을 할 수 있다.

title_en: A kind of continual method of access for realizing NFS
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of continual method of the access for realizing NFS, the concept of cluster and failure transfer is applied, by the failover functionality of the file system of service end in NFS and Pacemaker software collective effects.Realize the failure transfer of NFS, and be avoided that the NFS of conventional individual version causes service disruption because of network problem or machine self problem, by the method and by all space transfers of the NFS of this failure to other machines, this process is realized by pacemaker and managed, and the failure transfer that can safely and efficiently realize, and ensure not losing for data.The present invention realizes that NFS can realize High Availabitity in existing cost, reduces the data disaster caused by NFS failure.
assignees: ZHENGZHOU YUNHAI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of power-system short-term load forecasting method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of power-system short-term load forecasting methods based on deep learning.First, obtain the data such as historical load, week type, festivals or holidays, weather information, and it is normalized and encodes etc. after pretreatment as input feature vector, further feature to the deepness belief network Level by level learning being made of the limited Boltzmann machine of stacking and is extracted using contrast divergence algorithm, finally the parameter of entire depth belief network is finely adjusted using back-propagation algorithm, i.e., load forecasting model is constructed by off-line training.On-line prediction is carried out to the load after electric system 24 hours, obtains prediction load.The present invention improves the precision of power-system short-term load forecasting.

title_en: Automatic avoidance method for high-water-head irregular multiple restricted areas of main flow cascade hydropower station group
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of hydropower dispatching operation, in particular to an automatic avoidance method for a high-water-head irregular multi-restricted area of a main flow cascade hydropower station group. The technical scheme is as follows: on the basis of mathematical definition of unit limited area constraints, an automatic analysis technology subdivision is carried out on an irregular limited area by using a Hertel-Mehlhorn convex subdivision algorithm, and then a convex optimization theory and an extraction planning theory are adopted to carry out modeling on a subdivided result. The method can automatically avoid irregular multiple restricted areas, and achieves the effect of automatic modeling and solving. The method has important significance for responding to the new situation that the hydropower output changes frequently under the marketization condition in the future in response to the differentiated and automatic scheduling application of the power grid.

title_en: Wind power prediction method based on secondary modal decomposition and cascade deep learning
abstract_en: The application discloses a wind power prediction method based on secondary modal decomposition and cascade deep learning, which comprises the steps of firstly acquiring original wind power data and wind speed data, preprocessing the acquired data, decomposing the wind power and wind speed time sequence into a series of relatively stable subsequences by using the secondary modal decomposition, carrying out effective modal decomposition on the wind power signal, then extracting implicit characteristics of a coupling relation between the time subsequences generated by decomposition and the wind speed by using a convolutional neural network-gated circulation unit prediction model (CNN-GRU), further extracting time correlation among the time subsequences, and finally outputting a predicted value of the wind power.
assignees: YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Two-step ring-opening planning method and system for receiving-end alternating current electromagnetic looped network containing direct current feed-in
abstract_en: The invention provides a two-step ring-opening planning method for a receiving-end alternating current electromagnetic looped network containing direct current feed-in, which is used for carrying out priority classification and sequencing on optimization targets according to importance difference to form a two-step optimization framework. The first step aims at the target of 'avoiding direct current cascading failure' with obvious stronger importance and priority, and the second step aims at other ring-solving targets by taking the result generated in the first step as a constraint condition. The method can be used for the electromagnetic ring network loop-splitting planning of the alternating current-direct current hybrid power grid, comprehensively considers the new electromagnetic ring network loop-splitting requirement related to direct current, and achieves the aims of avoiding direct current cascading faults, controlling short-circuit current level, tide, load balance and the like.

title_en: Short-term personal load prediction method, system, equipment and terminal for privacy protection
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of data security, and discloses a short-term personal load prediction method, a system, equipment and a terminal for privacy protection.A user load data collection stage for privacy protection is that a user collects short-term load data of an intelligent power grid, randomly splits the data and uploads a ciphertext to a training model training server; in the training preprocessing stage, a security protocol is utilized between training model training servers to generate a private computation auxiliary data matrix multiplication triple; in the safe forward propagation stage, the load predicted value is safely calculated by using the encrypted historical data; in the safe reverse propagation stage, according to the difference between the real value and the predicted value, calculating new parameters of the prediction model in a private manner, and iterating for multiple times; and stopping iteration, obtaining load prediction model parameters under ciphertext training, and sending the load prediction models of the two parties to a user for actual prediction. The privacy protection scheme provided by the invention is efficient in the aspects of calculation, communication overhead and the like of the user and the server.

title_en: Information association propagation and non-association propagation realization method based on threshold model
abstract_en: The method for realizing information association propagation and non-association propagation based on the threshold model comprises the following steps: (S1): constructing a random network; (S2): distributing initial thresholds to all nodes in the network, setting the initial states of all nodes in the network to be S states, and randomly selecting one node as a first-generation information transmission source; (S3): information is propagated according to a threshold model mechanism, and first-generation and second-generation relevance information is propagated from one node; (S4): information is propagated according to a threshold model mechanism, and one-class and two-class non-relevance information propagation is performed from one node; (S5): calculating the occupation of the number of non-S-state nodes in the network in the total number of the nodes after the propagation is finished as a final cascade range; the invention provides a method for realizing information association propagation and non-association propagation based on a threshold model, which is proposed by combining threshold change under two conditions: the strategy implementation of the relevance information and non-relevance information transmission can ensure that the second generation information almost completely occupies the network when the second generation relevance information is transmitted; when one-class and two-class non-relevance information is spread, the two-class information occupies most of the network, and the occupancy rate is smaller as the satisfaction degree of a user on the one-class information is higher.

title_en: Parallel oil and gas pipeline domino effect risk analysis method based on Bayesian network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a parallel oil and gas pipeline domino effect risk analysis method based on a Bayesian network, which comprises the steps of determining a source pipe, and distributing source pipe nodes and other nodes in the Bayesian network; determining an upgrading vector according to the type of the pipe transmission medium and the failure mode; evaluating the strength of an upgrade vector sent by a target pipeline receiving source pipe; calculating the accident upgrading probability of the target pipeline; evaluating the probability of domino accidents of the target pipeline; judging whether the target pipeline continuously transmits the domino effect or not to obtain a domino accident sequence of the multi-pipe parallel system; and simulating different domino accident scenes and evaluating the failure probability of the multi-pipe parallel system. The method can solve the problems that a domino risk analysis method for parallel oil and gas pipelines does not exist in the prior art, and the domino risk in the multi-pipe parallel oil and gas pipeline system cannot be quantified, and achieves the purposes of establishing a domino effect risk analysis method special for the parallel oil and gas pipelines and providing scientific support for risk decisions of oil and gas pipeline builders and operators.

title_en: Wind power cluster power ultra-short-term prediction model establishment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind power cluster power ultra-short-term prediction model establishment method, wherein the model establishment process comprises the following steps: calculating the relevance among the nodes by considering historical wind power data of a plurality of wind power stations so as to construct a wind power cluster map; step 2: based on the wind farm nodes in the step 1, determining node neighborhood weights by using an attention score calculation method so as to extract spatial features; step 3: based on the space information captured in the step 2, mining the association of the wind power sequence in the time dimension, and based on the principle of a gating circulating unit, establishing a space-time characteristic fusion propagation model; step 4: outputting a wind power cluster power result based on the model established in the step 3, correcting a fully-connected network weight value, and finally outputting a predicted power vector time sequence of the wind power plant cluster; the method can excavate the time and space relation of the wind power clusters, and can realize the real-time efficient utilization of the space-time characteristics and the improvement of the prediction effect.
assignees: PUYANG POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Load identification method based on dynamic threshold
abstract_en: The invention discloses a load identification method based on a dynamic threshold value, which comprises the following steps: acquiring electricity consumption data of an electric power user, and detecting switching events of all loads in the electricity consumption data; extracting voltage-current track images of each load according to voltage and current data of preset periods before and after the switching event of each load; respectively identifying each voltage-current track image according to a preset load identification network model to obtain a load category corresponding to each voltage-current track image; wherein the load identification network model is trained by back-propagating a weighting function of supervised loss and unsupervised loss; the unsupervised loss is calculated by selecting a voltage-current track image meeting a preset standard in combination with a dynamic threshold; the dynamic threshold is obtained by dynamically adjusting the first threshold of each load according to the learning effect of each load. The method provided by the invention realizes more accurate identification of the load category through semi-supervised learning.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Long-term intelligent prediction method for wind-induced response of super high-rise building structure during typhoon passing
abstract_en: A long-term intelligent prediction method for wind induced response of a super high-rise building structure during typhoon passing is characterized by comprising the following steps of calculating structural wind induced vibration response corresponding to a target super high-rise building, training a cascading forward BP neural network model by adopting a Levenberg-Marquardt algorithm, predicting incoming flow wind field information of the target super high-rise building by utilizing an AI-driven transform weather prediction model and a linear typhoon model, inputting the incoming flow wind field prediction information and corresponding structural modal parameters into the trained cascading forward BP neural network model, and rapidly predicting structural wind induced vibration responses of the super high-rise building at different positions under different future time conditions. The method can rapidly, flexibly and reliably realize long-term prediction of wind vibration response of the super high-rise building structure during typhoon passing, and provide references for prediction and early warning of the structural vibration state of the super high-rise building during typhoon, thereby improving the urban related emergency response capability and realizing transition from passive emergency to decision forward.

title_en: Method and device for establishing short-term probability prediction model of comprehensive energy load polymer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for establishing a comprehensive energy load polymer short-term probability prediction model. The method comprises the steps of preprocessing and dimension reduction of collected historical data of the comprehensive energy load aggregate, grouping the dimension reduced data by adopting an affinity propagation clustering algorithm based on comprehensive similarity, extracting centroid characteristics of each group as representative load characteristics, inputting the representative load characteristics into a prediction model, and constructing a comprehensive energy load aggregate short-term probability prediction model fused with a Copula self-adaptive correlation analysis, a cross characteristic-time diagram neural network and a mixed density network. According to the invention, the accuracy of the short-term probability prediction of the comprehensive energy load aggregate is effectively improved through a dynamic coupling relation mining and space-time characteristic joint learning mechanism.

title_en: Financial risk analysis early warning system and method
abstract_en: The application relates to a financial risk analysis early warning system and a financial risk analysis early warning method. The system comprises a stock right relation network construction module, a high management relation network construction module, a double-layer network fusion module and a risk analysis early warning module, wherein the stock right relation network construction module is used for collecting and processing stock right relation data of a local financial institution and constructing a network topology taking the financial institution as a node and the stock right relation as edges, the high management relation network construction module is used for collecting and processing social relation data of a high management of the local financial institution and constructing a weighted network taking the high management as a node and the social relation as edges, the double-layer network fusion module is used for fusing the stock right relation network and the high management social relation network to generate a double-layer complex network large diagram, and the risk analysis early warning module is used for analyzing a conduction path and a propagation rule of financial risks in the double-layer network and carrying out quantitative evaluation and early warning on the financial risks faced by the local financial institution. The scheme provided by the application can carry out deep fusion on the data of the equity relationship and the social relationship, and effectively meets the comprehensive and accurate monitoring and early warning requirements of the supervision department on the financial risk.

title_en: Risk grading method for fusion of tunnel seismic wave data and geological information
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster early warning, in particular to a risk classification method for fusion of tunnel seismic wave data and geological information, which comprises the following steps of S1, collecting amplitude, frequency response and propagation delay information of multi-time-phase seismic waves of a tunnel, identifying abnormal response events, extracting spatial propagation paths of the abnormal response events by combining a tunnel structure, and generating a seismic wave induction response event chain set; S3, calculating trend activating factors by counting the liveness, the derivative direction and the time sequence trend of the structural units in the conduction diagram, and generating a risk level map with predictability and evolution capability. According to the method, the dynamic, accurate and predictive hierarchical assessment of the tunnel structure risk is realized by constructing the seismic response event chain and the structure conduction network, fusing multi-source geological information and introducing trend activating factors.
assignees: MCC WUKAN ENG CONSULTING HUBEI CO LTD;MCC WUKAN ENGINEERING TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Water network dynamic risk assessment method and system based on space-time diagram convolution
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water network dynamic risk assessment method and system based on space-time diagram convolution, and relates to the field of intelligent monitoring of water networks. The method comprises the steps of constructing a water network diagram structure, obtaining static and dynamic properties of physical nodes and pipe sections, generating virtual nodes in response to external events, calculating pollution propagation probability and influence weight, generating a dynamic adjacency matrix through self-adaptive diagram learning based on water quality and time sequence water flow data, calculating leakage risk values through space-time separation convolution, and calculating time-varying stability index assessment risks by fusing design efficiency reference values, real-time network efficiency and the like. The system comprises a data acquisition module, an event response module, a graph structure construction module, a risk calculation module and a stability evaluation module. The method solves the problems of static hysteresis and insufficient scene coverage in the traditional evaluation, improves the risk prediction precision and emergency response efficiency, and is suitable for real-time risk monitoring of various water networks.

title_en: Photovoltaic power prediction method and system based on variation modal decomposition and time sequence modeling
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of photovoltaic power prediction, in particular to a photovoltaic power prediction method and a system based on variation modal decomposition and time sequence modeling, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a photovoltaic power sequence and meteorological observation data corresponding to the photovoltaic power sequence, and filling a missing value and carrying out normalized mapping treatment; the method comprises the steps of performing multi-scale decoupling on a processed power sequence through variation modal decomposition to obtain a plurality of modal functions, screening the plurality of modal functions by combining correlation contribution degree evaluation to obtain effective modes, constructing a time-varying modal weight function according to correlation between the modes and a current power state, introducing a cross-modal shared convolution kernel structure into a time sequence convolution network to dynamically weight and fuse the effective modes in different time scales, explicitly embedding the modal weight function into a conditional quantile prediction model, and predicting photovoltaic power by using the trained conditional quantile prediction model. According to the invention, the fine depiction of the dynamic characteristics of multiple time scales of the photovoltaic power and the uncertainty propagation rule is realized.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO RESEARCH INSTITUTE;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER RESEARCH INST CO LTD;BEIJING XIQING ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Large-scale network information propagation calculation method and device based on distributed platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a large-scale network information propagation calculation method and a device based on a distributed platform, and the implementation steps of the invention comprise that a configuration network is constructed according to network parameters, an information propagation model is constructed, the parameter setting of the network and the information propagation model is selected according to the requirement, the information format, the individual attribute, the message transfer function, the message fusion function and the message processing function are configured, the network, the information format, the individual attribute, the message transfer function, the message fusion function and the message processing function are input to carry out iterative calculation through the parallel distributed platform, and nodes with propagation activities in the network containing propagation records and the connected edges thereof are screened out to obtain the propagation records and output the propagation records. The invention has the advantages of strong parallel computing capability, strong user customization capability, good transmission computing universality and adaptability, and simple and efficient development process, can greatly reduce the development difficulty of parallel distributed computing, and does not need to additionally consider the problem of parallel distributed storage.

title_en: Power grid cascading failure element failure probability evaluation method and system under fire disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for evaluating the failure probability of a power grid cascading failure element under fire disaster, which take power flow transfer, state defects of components of the cascading failure element at the current stage and the rejection of the cascading failure element at the previous stage caused by the high-resistance state of a fire point into account, calculate the failure probability of the cascading failure element, and are more accurate compared with the traditional method.

title_en: Power grid node classification method and computer readable medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power grid node classification method and a computer readable medium, wherein the power grid node classification method comprises the following steps: step 1: calculating the propagation strength through the physical properties and the propagation probability of the power grid nodes; step 2: calculating the network condensation degree based on the power grid segmentation; step 3: establishing a fuzzy representative point clustering model based on the condensation degree; step 4: calculating an objective function value of the fuzzy representative point clustering model based on the condensation degree and judging whether an error condition is met, if yes, executing the step 5, otherwise, returning to the step 1; step 5: sorting objective function values to obtain a clustering center; step 6: and carrying out cluster division according to the cluster center to obtain a power grid node classification result. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of high classification accuracy, capability of providing theoretical support for power grid planning and the like.

title_en: Mountain fire prevention integration system, mountain fire prevention apparatus and mountain fire prevention integration server
title_ko: 산불 방지 통합 시스템, 산불 방지 장치 및 산불 방지 통합 서버
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A mountain fire prevention integration system, a mountain fire prevention apparatus, and a mountain fire prevention integration server are provided to establish an optimal suppressing measure. CONSTITUTION: A forest fire prevention integration server(110) stores and generally manages local forest fire prevention related information. A forest fire prevention client device(130) communicates with an integration server and comprises an input part, an information loading part, a calculation part, and a countermeasure planning part. The input part inputs the outbreak of a forest fire region related information through a user interface. The information loading part loads forest fire prevention related information from the forest fire prevention integration server. [Reference numerals] (110) Forest fire prevention integration server; (120) Network; (130) Forest fire prevention client device
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 산불 예방 자원 및 산불 진화 자원 정보를 도면화하여 전략적 산불 방지 계획을 수립할 수 있는 산불 방지 통합 시스템, 산불 방지 장치 및 산불 방지 통합 서버를 개시하고 있다. 산불 방지 통합 시스템은 전자 지도 - 전자 지도는 컴퓨터의 기억장치에 좌표, 면적, 등고선 간격 및 방위각을 시간과 기상자료를 포함하여 저장됨 - 상에 지역별 산불 방지 관련 정보를 저장하고 통합 관리하는 산불 방지 통합 서버; 및 상기 통합 서버와 통신하는 산불 방지 클라이언트 장치를 포함하되, 상기 산불 방지 클라이언트 장치는 사용자 인터페이스를 통해 산불 발생 지역을 입력하였을 때, 상기 산불 발생 지역 및 상기 산불 발생 지역의 주변의 산불 방지 관련 정보를 상기 산불 방지 통합 서버로부터 로딩하여 상기 로딩된 정보를 이용하여 상기 산불 발생 지역과 관련된 산불 진화 종합 정보를 계산하고, 상기 계산의 결과를 근거로 최적의 산불 진화 대책을 수립한다. 따라서, IT 기반 체계적 산불 진화 대응으로 산불 상황실 상황 전파, 인력 및 장비의 효율적 배치 등 전략적 산불 진화 대응 능력을 향상시킨다.
assignees: REPUBLIC OF KOREA EASTERN NAT FOREST OFFICE

title_en: Method for short-term generation scheduling of cascade hydropower plants coupling cluster analysis and decision tree
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of hydropower scheduling, and relates to a method for short-term generation scheduling of cascade hydropower plants coupling cluster analysis and decision tree. Linear regression technique is adopted to determine a matching relationship of energy production between upstream and downstream hydropower plants. With the relationship, typical generation curves of each hydropower plant can be clustered from lots of historical data. These typical generation curves and impact factors of generation scheduling such as planned daily electricity, reservoir level, and power grid characteristics, are together trained to obtain decision-making library for generation scheduling of cascaded hydropower plants. Thus, the decision tree method can be used to rapidly determine an operational scheme for generation scheduling of cascaded hydropower plants. Finally, a correction strategy for operation constraints is introduced to ensure feasibility of the operation scheme. The invention can quickly obtain generation schedules of cascade hydropower plants.

title_en: A kind of generation method of the extensive contingency sets of AC-DC hybrid power grid N 2
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of generation method of the extensive contingency sets of AC-DC hybrid power grid N 2, main line sample is filtered out from AC-DC hybrid power grid, forms substance failure collection；The circuit sample that substance failure collection is obtained in step 1 is clustered using neighbour's propagation algorithm, determines cluster result；Calculate the degree of correlation of the twin failure set formed by all kinds of internal any two circuit samples and the twin failure set formed by the circuit sample inside any two class；Relevance threshold is set, filters out the twin failure set that the degree of correlation meets or exceeds relevance threshold, generates the contingency sets of N 2.The present invention can generate the contingency sets of N 2 of extensive AC-DC hybrid power grid under off-line state, include the accident scenes of N 2 such as dual AC fault, DC Line Fault, alternating current-direct current failure.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO WEIFANG POWER SUPPLY CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV SHANDONG

title_en: Electric power system toughness assessment method considering time delay cascading failure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating toughness of a power system by considering time delay cascading failure, which specifically comprises the following steps: (1) sampling line faults, setting the line faults as initial faults of the system, and establishing a cascading fault simulation model frame considering time sampling; (2) according to the power grid line and the load data, establishing load shedding constraints aiming at each broken line condition for the framework in the step 1; (3) establishing a line fault recovery time model for the frame in the step 1 by referring to a fault recovery mode of the power grid in actual operation, and establishing power grid constraint considering the motor climbing rate; (4) and sampling a plurality of accident chains, integrating the change of the total load rate of the power grid along with time, and realizing toughness evaluation aiming at a certain determined power grid under fault impact. The cascading failure evaluation method can achieve cascading failure typical mode evaluation aiming at the power grid system by taking the development of cascading failures in time as an aim, so that reference is provided for power grid cascading failure loss prevention.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECHNICAL RES INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID JIANGSU POWER CO LTD

title_en: Power grid construction progress and safety identification method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deep learning-based power grid construction progress and safety identification method, which comprises the following steps of: preprocessing a capital construction project image and making a data set; zooming the data set, and sequentially inputting the data set to the recognition model according to the set number of images; performing forward propagation calculation on the input through the identification model, and calculating a loss value according to a forward propagation result and a real frame in the labeled image; calculating the gradient of each weight matrix and the bias parameter of the recognition model by the loss value respectively, and updating the recognition model; if the updated recognition model is not converged or does not reach the maximum training frequency, performing forward propagation calculation on the input again through the updated recognition model, and stopping training the recognition model until the updated recognition model is converged or the maximum training frequency is reached; identifying the image of the infrastructure project by using the trained identification model; the intelligent construction site monitoring system can accurately monitor the construction site progress, provides decision basis for a construction site, and realizes automation and intelligence of the intelligent construction site.
assignees: GUANGZHOU CITY SAI HAO INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-target optimal power flow calculation method and terminal based on cascading failure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-target optimal power flow calculation method and a terminal based on cascading failures, which calculate the power grid risk based on the action characteristics of distance type backup protection of a power system, so that the power grid risk degree of the current power grid to the cascading failures can be reflected by combining the action characteristics of the distance type backup protection on the basis of analyzing the cascading failure expression form. The power generation cost is defined by considering the power grid economy of cascading failures, equation constraint conditions and inequality constraint conditions are set for the initial failures of the power system, a multi-target optimal power flow model is built by combining the power grid danger degree, the minimum power generation cost, the equation constraint conditions and the inequality constraint conditions, the advantage complementation of the system safety and the economy can be achieved, the power generation cost can be reduced, and meanwhile, the power grid safety margin is improved, so that an optimal power flow calculation result considering both the safety and the economy is obtained.
assignees: STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD YONGAN POWER SUPPLY COMPANY;SANMING POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network state characterization method based on graph mask reconstruction
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power systems, in particular to a power distribution network state characterization method based on graph mask reconstruction, which comprises the following steps: s1: modeling a topological structure of the power distribution network as an abnormal pattern; s2: reconstructing a path by a path mask predictor; s3: reconstructing node attributes by a node attribute mask predictor; s4: and optimizing the model. The power distribution network state calculating method based on the heterogeneous graph mask modeling can accurately model topological relation and state variables of the power distribution network, the model can capture complex graph structures containing semantics, node attributes and edges of a more efficient predictive graph, the state of the power distribution network can be rapidly and accurately calculated through a pre-trained graph neural network model, power distribution topological data of the power distribution network are abstracted into heterogeneous graph structures, and the method has high efficiency, intuitionistic and flexible performance data and higher accuracy in a state estimation task compared with a back propagation network and a convolution neural network.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD INFORMATION & COMMUNICATION BRANCH;STATE GRID SMART GRID RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Virtual power plant optimized operation method for polymerizing electric vehicles and carbon capture
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optimized operation method for a virtual power plant for polymerizing an electric automobile and carbon capture. The method comprises the steps of S1, simulating user charging load through analyzing electric vehicle user behaviors, providing a virtual power plant operation strategy, S2, aiming at peak Gu Chalv and virtual power plant income, clearing wind power, photovoltaic output and electric vehicle discharge to market in the future, using a GAs turbine to bear basic load, wind-light prediction deviation and electric vehicle charging demand, S3, considering seasonality of wind power and photovoltaic output, avoiding prediction deviation penalty through compensation, decomposing peak frequency band and GA optimization counter-propagation neural network BP by using a chaos theory set empirical mode, namely GABP, carrying out seasonality prediction on the GABP, adopting a carbon trapping system to reduce carbon emission and participating in carbon market transaction, and S4, finally, comparing simulation on ordered and disordered charging and discharging through a calculation example, and verifying effectiveness and practicability of the provided strategy.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID SHANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Method for carrying out risk early warning analysis on food safety by simulating propagation and diffusion of heavy metals in environment through complex network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for carrying out risk early warning analysis on food-derived food safety by simulating the propagation and diffusion of heavy metal pollution in the environment through a complex network, which uses the complex network to build an atmosphere-soil pollutant interaction complex network model and considers the propagation dynamics of heavy metal among nodes, the method comprises the steps of carrying out propagation behaviors such as propagation in the atmosphere and the soil, atmospheric sedimentation, migration in the soil and the like, combining a network topological structure with a propagation dynamics model among nodes to form an atmosphere-soil pollutant interaction complex network model, realizing effective combination of physical driving and data driving, and providing more accurate and reliable risk early warning. According to the invention, through network topology structure analysis, the key nodes are identified to pay attention in risk management and control, and the node food safety risk is quantified through diet exposure evaluation, so that uncertainty caused by only relying on qualitative analysis or rough estimation is avoided, and decision basis is provided for developing targeted food safety risk prevention and control work.

title_en: Transmission and distribution collaborative low-carbon economic dispatching method and system based on target cascading method
abstract_en: The invention provides a transmission and distribution cooperation low-carbon economic dispatching method based on a target cascading method, which comprises the steps of establishing a transmission and distribution layered dispatching framework, analyzing interactive power characteristics under typical load output, setting decoupling variables of a transmission and distribution network by combining a physical coupling relation, constructing related criteria of transmission and distribution cooperation consistency based on the target cascading method, and constructing a transmission and distribution cooperation low-carbon optimization model based on the target cascading method by combining constraint conditions such as voltage constraint, tide constraint and the like according to the transmission and distribution layered dispatching framework and considering an electric carbon coupling calculation method. According to the invention, the transmission and distribution collaborative low-carbon economic dispatching method based on the target cascade method is applied to the transmission and distribution collaborative dispatching, so that the influence of the dynamic carbon emission factor on the purchase and sale power of the transmission network and the distribution network is considered, and compared with the traditional transmission and distribution collaborative dispatching, the transmission network layer can be guided to purchase clean electric energy, and the carbon emission of a traditional unit is reduced.
assignees: UNIV WUHAN;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Enterprise digital operation real-time data analysis method based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses an enterprise digital operation real-time data analysis method based on multi-source data fusion, which relates to the technical field of data processing and solves the technical problems that firstly, an enterprise comprehensive benefit index is difficult to analyze and predict, secondly, a knowledge graph is difficult to embed into a vector space to construct a dynamic graph neural network, then, an equipment abnormal offset, a supply chain abnormal offset and customer activity are difficult to analyze, a risk matrix is constructed, a comprehensive benefit index descending propagation path is identified, service link resources are difficult to dynamically allocate according to an analysis result of the risk matrix, and finally, the data analysis result is difficult to visually display. According to the invention, by collecting and preprocessing enterprise multisource data, a three-dimensional vector space and a dynamic graph neural network are constructed, enterprise benefits and risks are predicted by combining multiple technical analysis, resources of a business link are dynamically allocated, and a data analysis result is visually displayed.
assignees: DUJINZHEN BEIJING INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Low-altitude safety emergency system based on large model application
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of low-altitude safety emergency, and discloses a low-altitude safety emergency system based on large-model application. The system comprises a low-altitude state sensing module, a dynamic state prediction model is constructed based on historical flight data, a low-altitude target track coordinate sequence, radar echo and communication signal characteristics are collected in real time, and theoretical security state values are output. The multi-source data fusion analysis module performs three-dimensional difference analysis on theoretical and actual measurement situation values, and relates to time domain trend deviation, airspace coverage deviation and event sequence matching degree to generate a target level difference feature matrix. The risk propagation path deduction module inputs the matrix into a geographic topology analysis network, and generates a probability thermal distribution map of the abnormal risk propagation path by combining airspace node communication parameters and target positions to locate a risk influence area. The intelligent treatment strategy generation module enables high-frequency monitoring to the high-probability area according to the graph configuration parameters, and applies communication disturbance test to the adjacent targets.
assignees: BEIJING ZHONGKE CHENJI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Knowledge-graph-based safety production risk identification method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a safety production risk identification method and a system based on a knowledge graph, which relate to the technical field of safety production risk identification, and the invention adopts a graph neural network to generate embedded representation by acquiring entity nodes and relationship edge data of the knowledge graph and extracting feature vectors, calculating node weights by using an attention mechanism to determine a risk mode, traversing the associated paths to generate a risk propagation sequence, fusing time sequence features to update entity states and determine a dynamic propagation path, extracting key node subgraphs to adjust edge weights to optimize the risk mode, and finally identifying a complete risk propagation chain by iteratively querying and integrating environmental features. The method and the system realize dynamic tracking of equipment, personnel and environmental network risks and cross-dimension cascading risk identification.
assignees: BAIYIN POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Fault traveling wave positioning method and system for power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power distribution network fault positioning, in particular to a power distribution network fault traveling wave positioning method and a power distribution network fault traveling wave positioning system, wherein a distributed traveling wave sensing unit synchronously collects transient signals and extracts initial traveling wave arrival time; the method comprises the steps of constructing a self-adaptive wave speed model based on line physical parameters to calculate equivalent propagation speed, dynamically generating a traveling wave propagation tree according to a real-time switch state to determine an effective monitoring path, determining a preliminary fault point by adopting an optimization algorithm based on the propagation path and actual arrival time, calculating a consistency index of the traveling wave polarity of adjacent nodes, starting a multi-hypothesis tracking mechanism in a preliminary point neighborhood when the consistency index is lower than a threshold value, carrying out confidence weighting evaluation by combining a traveling wave attenuation model, and outputting an accurate positioning result. According to the invention, through the cooperation of dynamic topology mapping, self-adaptive wave speed correction and multi-source closed loop verification, the precision, reliability and self-adaptive capacity of fault positioning in a complex power distribution network environment are obviously improved, and the operation and maintenance requirements of rapid self-healing are met.
assignees: ZHANGJIAKOU POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID JINBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LIMITED

title_en: SAR change detection method based on deep learning classification comparison
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for detecting SAR change by comparing after deep learning classification, which comprises the following steps: and respectively extracting the depth features of the SAR images at two moments before and after the disaster by using the characteristic that the MDPS-CNN has two network channels and can have different weights. Meanwhile, the texture features and the gray features of the original SAR image at two moments are obtained, and then the texture features, the gray features and the depth features are fused in the MDPS-CNN network. In addition, in order to make a balance under the conditions of different depth layers and high accuracy guarantee for specific SAR images, the MDPS-CNN adopts segmented back propagation to optimize a network so as to automatically select a proper number of layers. And classifying the two groups of fused images by using a threshold method. And finally, comparing the obtained two classification images with the water area change to obtain a final water area change detection image.

title_en: Risk quantitative assessment method, device and equipment for grid cascading failure
abstract_en: The invention relates to a risk quantitative evaluation method, a device and equipment for grid cascading faults, which belong to the technical field of risk evaluation of power systems. Grid structure, target power grid power supply structure and target power grid overall tide distribution information; determining occurrence probability of each risk factor and the grade of a result generated after occurrence of cascading failure based on a preset model and risk factor data; according to the occurrence probability of each risk factor and the grade of the consequences after the occurrence of the cascading failure, the risk of the cascading failure of the target power grid is quantitatively evaluated, so that the risk of the cascading failure of the power grid is evaluated, early warning is carried out, loss is reduced, and the problem to be solved in the prior art is urgent.

title_en: Water supply quantity prediction method, device and storage medium based on water quantity-water pressure coupling
abstract_en: The invention relates to a water supply quantity prediction method, water supply quantity prediction equipment and a storage medium based on water quantity-water pressure coupling, and belongs to the technical field of water supply quantity prediction and deep learning. By constructing IAMformer network, introducing multi-head sparse attention layer based on EMD distance in encoder and decoder, inputting the historical data of water supply quantity and instantaneous flow and holiday information into encoder to obtain main characteristic Q of water supply quantity prediction, inputting pressure data into decoder to obtain pressure auxiliary characteristic A capable of fusion, inputting both characteristics into main and auxiliary attention layers in decoder to make main and auxiliary attention matrix calculation and fusion to obtain fusion characteristic, outputting predicted water supply quantity by full connection layer, and back-propagation optimizing and updating model parameters according to composite loss function of water supply quantity loss and pressure loss. The invention can reduce the indirect influence of the water pressure prediction error on the water supply quantity prediction, and can reduce the complexity of an algorithm model and improve the robustness of the model.

title_en: Knowledge graph-based shield risk tracing method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a shield risk tracing method based on a knowledge graph, and belongs to the technical field of shield risk analysis. Determining a set of entities Sum relation set The method comprises the steps of constructing a mode layer of a knowledge graph, preprocessing document data to obtain a processed text, extracting knowledge triples meeting requirements, outputting structured knowledge triples according to a preset format, aligning entities to obtain normalized knowledge triples to construct the knowledge graph, calculating the membership degree of nodes based on the knowledge graph, combining the posterior probability of the nodes to obtain the posterior probability of the nodes, deducing potential risk propagation paths and relationship strength based on the posterior probability of the nodes in the knowledge graph, and realizing dynamic analysis and prediction of a knowledge network. The invention realizes the structural association of risk factors through the knowledge graph, and combines the fuzzy Bayesian inference to quantify uncertainty, thereby solving the problem that the traditional method is difficult to process complex causal relationship and information ambiguity.

title_en: Central monitoring and management system for detecting dangerous substances
title_ko: 위험물 유출 센트럴 모니터링 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a central monitoring system for detecting leakage of hazardous substances, which centrally and comprehensively controls leakage detection and response measures for a number of scattered hazardous facilities. According to the present invention, the central monitoring system for detecting leakage of hazardous substances comprises: an alert means (10) installed in a hazardous facility to detect leakage of hazardous substances and transmitting a detection result to a terminal means (20) and a central control center (30); the terminal means (20) carried by a user who works in the hazardous facility, detecting whether a hazardous substance is leaked, and automatically transmitting a detection result to other terminal means (20) and the central control center (30); and the central control center (30) receiving the leakage result of hazardous substances from any one or more of the alert means (10) and the terminal means (20) and issuing a countermeasure. Accordingly, an initial situation is transmitted upon leakage of hazardous substances and a situational trend is continuously checked even after issuance of countermeasures and an instruction for actively responding to changes in the situation is issued, thereby providing an effect of minimizing damage caused by the leakage of hazardous substances.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 산재해 있는 다수의 위험시설물에 대한 위험물 유출감지 및 대응조치를 중앙에서 종합적으로 통제할 수 있는 위험물 유출 센트럴 모니터링 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 위험시설물에 설치되어 위험물의 유출 여부를 감지하고, 상기 감지결과를 단말수단(20) 및 중앙관제센터(30)에 송신하는 경보수단(10), 상기 위험시설물에 근무하는 사용자가 휴대하며, 위험물의 유출 여부를 감지하고, 그 감지결과를 타 단말수단(20) 및 중앙관제센터(30)에 자동으로 송신하는 단말수단(20) 및 상기 경보수단(10) 및 단말수단(20)의 어느 하나 이상으로부터 위험물 유출 여부를 수신하고 그 대응조치를 발령하는 중앙관제센터(30)를 포함하여 구성되고, 위험물 유출 시 최초의 상황전파 및 대응조치 발령 이후에도 상황추이를 지속적으로 파악하고, 상황변화에 적극 대응토록 지시함으로써 위험물 유출에 따른 피해를 최소화할 수 있는 효과가 기대된다.

title_en: Mining coal and rock impact prevents coal rock dynamic disaster technology and equipment
abstract_en: Patent of the present invention discloses a kind of mining coal-rock-impacting body and prevents the technology and equipment of coal rock dynamic disaster.Radially be integrated in tubular equipment multiple air hammer components by the technology, using impactor component radial impact the wall of a borehole；The high intensity stress wave of generation is propagated in coal and rock, and tension and compression, failure by shear are caused to coal and rock；Finally make a range of Fracture Networks Rapid development around drilling, make the effective release of coal and rock, promote desorption of mash gas and seepage flow, reduce coal seam gas-bearing capacity, the stress in release coal body prevents coal and gas prominent, bump etc. from preventing coal rock dynamic disaster.
assignees: CHINA UNIVERSTIY OF MINING & TECH BEIJING;UNIVERSAL SAFETY TECH (BEIJING) CO LTD

title_en: Distribution transformer short-term load prediction method based on Internet of things intelligent sensing technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distribution transformer short-term load prediction method based on an Internet of things intelligent sensing technology. Firstly, data cleaning and completion are completed through correlation coefficients, a per-unit curve of power consumption data is obtained through per-unit processing, then, a per-unit curve of similar days is obtained through clustering by an affine propagation algorithm and combining, finally, a per-unit curve of a to-be-measured future day is obtained through weighted summation, and a complete to-be-measured daily load curve is obtained after the per-unit curve is combined with a base value, so that the whole distribution transformation short-term load prediction work is completed. The method is applied to the same-class data of other distribution transformers for calculation and analysis, can make up the deficiency of the lean operation and maintenance status of the low-voltage distribution network, provides support for the reactive compensation strategy control scheme of the low-voltage distribution network, provides basis for the updating of low-voltage equipment and the transformation of a low-voltage distribution system, and has the advantages of low material and labor cost, high accuracy and good operability.
assignees: HUADIAN ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Power information physical system modeling method and system considering multilayer coupling
abstract_en: The modeling process is divided into three parts, namely a power network, a communication network and an information network, based on the idea of information physical fusion, and an uplink/downlink communication channel model responsible for information transmission is established for the monitoring and control functions of the power dispatching automation system and serves as a core component of the communication network. The power grid, the communication network and the information network are associated through establishing an inter-network interface model, a power information physical system integration model considering multilayer coupling is further obtained through derivation, a multilayer coupling association mechanism of the power CPS is determined, and therefore the power information physical system integration model considering multilayer coupling is established. The method has important significance for exploring researches in aspects of cyber attack risk propagation mechanism, cascading failure evolution process, security analysis, vulnerability assessment and the like of the CPS.

title_en: Power grid operation scene division method and system and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system and a storage medium for dividing operation scenes of a power grid, aiming at the problem of low transmission efficiency caused by mutual coupling of multistage cascade power transmission channels of the power grid, identifying a high-load key section of the power transmission channel based on historical power flow operation data, mining the time-space correlation factor of the key section, and clustering and grading by establishing a correlation evaluation model and calculating a channel limited index so as to divide the operation mode of the whole target power grid. The method can obtain a relatively ideal power grid operation mode division result, provides data and theoretical support for formulation of a scheduling mode and an operation scheme, and has wide popularization value and application prospect.
assignees: NARI TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;NORTHWEST BRANCH OF STATE GRID CORP OF CHINA;NARI GROUP CORP

title_en: Modeling method, simulation method and system of self-media message propagation simulation model
abstract_en: The invention provides a modeling method of a self-media message propagation simulation model, which comprises the following steps: s1, constructing a scale-free network initial model for simulating a message self-media propagation platform based on a cellular automata model, wherein the scale-free network initial model comprises a plurality of nodes, and one node is added after each unit time; and S2, taking the nodes in the scale-free network initial model as the crowd, and configuring the state conversion rules of the scale-free network initial model in the message transmission process based on the infectious disease model to obtain the self-media message transmission simulation model. Based on the modeling method and the simulation method based on the scale-free network self-media message propagation model, provided by the invention, the message propagation process under the scale-free network model is subjected to simulation description by adjusting the characteristic indexes of the network topological structure, so that the difference analysis of the same message propagated on different self-media platforms is realized, and the message propagation analysis efficiency is improved.

title_en: Method, system and storage medium for lightening power scheduling model under meta-universe
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method, a system and a storage medium for lightening a power scheduling model under a metauniverse, which comprise the following steps of carrying out intelligent data reduction on a three-dimensional model based on a self-adaptive face-reduction compression technology of deep learning by combining an advanced texture mapping and curve thinning algorithm so as to optimize model details and reduce data quantity, simultaneously keeping key characteristics, dynamically adjusting display details of the power grid model according to the visual angle of an observer through cascade loading and visual rejection of the power grid, realizing model resource management and dynamic scheduling by asynchronous loading and rendering, and realizing quick loading and rendering of the model by applying a multi-detail level technology and a progressive loading technology by combining an intelligent preloading and prediction mechanism, and realizing fine resource allocation and detail management. The invention can realize the light-weight processing of the power dispatching meta-universe three-dimensional model and achieve the aims of real-time efficient rendering and rapid interaction of meteorological data, power grid operation information and plant station equipment models.
assignees: STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;BEIJING YONGSHANG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fly-by-wire system security analysis method and device, terminal equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application is applicable to the technical field of system safety analysis, and provides a fly-by-wire system safety analysis method which comprises the steps of establishing a Bayesian network structure corresponding to a system according to a fly-by-wire system structure, establishing a nominal model and an expansion model corresponding to the system by using a Simulink simulation tool, establishing directed edges according to a system signal transmission direction to determine causal relation, generating a fault combination, injecting the fault combination into the expansion model, monitoring the response of a next layer subsystem, determining a fault propagation relation according to the response of each layer subsystem, finally combining the fault probability corresponding to the fault propagation relation with the fault probability of each layer node to obtain a condition probability table of each layer node, and obtaining the occurrence probability of leaf node events according to the condition probability table. According to the application, all fault combinations do not need to be traversed, the sample size is greatly reduced, the problem of state space explosion is avoided, the workload of analysts is effectively reduced, and the analysis efficiency is improved.

title_en: Multi-tenant architecture-based wind power plant cloud platform management method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of new energy wind power operation and maintenance, in particular to a wind power plant cloud platform management method based on a multi-tenant architecture.
