And constructing a three-dimensional decision model based on the fan power predicted value, the network delay coefficient and the tenant priority weight, dividing the resource partition by adopting an improved K-means algorithm, and generating a resource allocation topological graph. And constructing a fault processing sandbox in the trusted execution environment, performing fault propagation analysis by using a graph neural network model, and outputting equipment control parameter correction and a scheduling path. And combining the dynamic reconfiguration logic mapping relation and the bandwidth weight to generate a resource scheduling instruction, thereby completing the closed-loop control link. The method can realize the intelligent scheduling and fault self-adaptive handling of the resources of the multi-tenant wind power cluster, and improves the real-time performance, the credibility and the fine management level of the system operation.
assignees: SHANDONG ENERGY SHENGLUNHUAALASHANMENG NEW ENERGY CO LTD;YUNDING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Urban physical examination accurate analysis method and system based on AI multi-modal data collaboration
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data analysis, in particular to an urban physical examination accurate analysis method and system based on AI multi-modal data cooperation, comprising the following steps of constructing a self-adaptive fractal space-time grid, and mapping an urban multi-modal data source into a space-time coding vector with fractal dimension; the method comprises the steps of establishing a physical field driven collaborative resonance network, extracting abnormal collaborative modes exceeding a normal resonance threshold, calculating a modal entropy chain value according to the real-time metabolic rate of an urban system, generating an optimal weight matrix through an unbalanced thermodynamic model, fusing the abnormal collaborative modes and the dynamic weight matrix, and generating a space-time causal map showing fault origins and propagation paths by using a causal discovery algorithm. According to the invention, the multi-mode data collaboration and causal analysis technology is utilized, so that the emergency response capability of the urban system in the face of sudden faults is improved, the stability of urban operation is ensured, and the space-time causal map provides comprehensive visual information for the fault propagation process.
assignees: HUNAN JINBU ZHIRONG INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Urban toughness assessment method based on multidimensional data analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a city toughness assessment method based on multidimensional data analysis, which relates to the technical field of city toughness assessment, and the method comprises the steps of integrating geographic information and multisource heterogeneous data of an Internet of things sensor, and constructing a city subsystem network diagram through standardization and vectorization; the method comprises the steps of utilizing a graph neural network to learn the dependency relationship among nodes, generating a quantized interaction matrix, identifying high-risk links and weak points, dynamically updating interaction strength by combining real-time sensor data and an attention mechanism, simulating a crisis propagation path, calculating a system toughness score, and finally generating a city toughness diagnosis report through a visualization tool. The method and the system realize effective fusion of the multi-source data and quantitative analysis of interaction among subsystems, and improve accuracy and instantaneity of urban toughness assessment.
assignees: NINGXIA HUI AUTONOMOUS REGION BASIC GEOLOGICAL SURVEY INST NINGXIA HUI AUTONOMOUS REGION GEOLOGICAL

title_en: Method for measuring position hierarchically, system and apparatus therefor
title_ko: 계층형 측위 방법과 그를 위한 시스템 및 장치
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A hierarchical positioning method, a system for same and apparatus thereof are provided to provide a positioning service regardless of outdoor or indoor, based on the position of a user. CONSTITUTION: A terminal(110) transmits collection information. The collection information includes at least one of the following; GPS(Global Positioning System) information, wireless LAN(Local Area Network) propagation environment information, base station electric wave environmental information, and local district network information. Positioning apparatus(130) transmits map data to the terminal based on the result information from the analysis of the received collection information. The positioning apparatus calculates current position information of the terminal, using the collection information. The positioning apparatus provides the calculated current position information to the terminal. [Reference numerals] (110) Terminal; (120) Communication network; (130) Positioning apparatus; (140) Data base
abstract_ko:
본 발명의 일 실시예는 계층형 측위 방법과 그를 위한 시스템 및 장치에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명의 일 실시예는 GPS 정보, 무선랜 전파 환경 정보, 기지국 전파 환경 정보 및 근거리 통신 정보 중 적어도 하나 이상의 정보를 수집한 수집 정보를 전송하는 단말기; 및 수신된 상기 수집 정보를 분석한 분석 결과 정보에 근거하여 상기 단말기로 맵 데이터를 전송하고, 상기 수집 정보를 이용하여 상기 단말기의 현재 위치 정보를 산출하고, 산출된 상기 현재 위치 정보를 상기 단말기로 제공하는 측위 장치를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 계층형 측위 시스템을 제공한다. 
본 발명의 일 실시예에 의하면, 산재해 있는 실외 또는 실내 정밀 측위용 데이터베이스를 하나의 장치에서 계층적으로 분류한 후 단말기의 현재 위치에 따라 제공할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Ship automatic broadcasting system
title_ko: 선내 자동 방송 시스템
abstract_en: An objective of the present invention is to provide an inboard automatic broadcasting system capable of clearly transmitting warning information from a long distance through a communication network without noise, and allowing a sailor to recognize and cope with a dangerous situation and an accident occurrence source when an alarm is generated and to avoid the dangerous situation to make an emergency escape by allowing a converted digital voice signal to include accident occurrence source information, corresponding emergency zone information, corresponding dangerous situation information, countermeasure instruction information, and emergency escape information. The inboard automatic broadcasting system comprises: a sensor unit; a monitoring server; an inboard broadcasting server; a plurality of IP speakers; an inboard network broadcasting unit; and a TCP/IP-based communication network, thereby replacing any one of the IP speaker and the analog speaker in case of an error thereon to propagate an emergency situation. According to the present invention, when an alarm is generated, a sailor can recognize and respond to a dangerous situation and an accident occurrence source and avoid the dangerous situation to make an emergency escape, and a network-based system can enable inboard broadcasting through satellite communication even on land.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 항해정보와 환경정보와 모션정보와 선내상황정보를 계측하는 센서부(110), 계측값을 모니터링하고 분석하여 경고정보를 생성하는 모니터링서버(120), 이벤트신호에 따라 네트워크 제어 음원소스(137)를 추출하여 TTS 프로그램 모듈(138)을 통해 경고정보를 디지털음성신호로 변환하는 디지털음성변환모듈(139)로 구성되어, 스케쥴방송과 마이크방송과 전화방송에 해당하는 디지털음성신호 및 경고정보에 해당하는 디지털음성신호를 비상구역정보에 포함된 해당 방송구역 또는 콜 스테이션(134)에 의해 선택된 해당 방송구역으로 전송하는, 선내 방송 서버(130), 선내 방송 서버(130)에 연결되어 디지털음성신호를 출력하는 다수의 IP 스피커(140), 증폭된 음성신호를 출력하는 다수의 아날로그 스피커(153)로 구성되는, 선내 네트워크 방송부(150), 및 센서부(110)와 모니터링 서버(120) 사이, 모니터링 서버(120)와 선내 방송 서버(130) 사이, 선내 방송 서버(130)와 IP 스피커(140) 사이, 및 선내 방송 서버(130)와 선내 네트워크 방송부(150) 사이를 유무선 네트워크로 연결하는 TCP/IP 기반의 통신망(160);을 포함하여, IP 스피커(140) 또는 아날로그 스피커(153) 중 어느 하나의 오류시에 대체하여 노이즈없이 비상상황을 전파하도록 하는, 선내 자동 방송 시스템을 개시한다.

title_ko: 서비스 중단의 최소화
abstract_ko: 사용자 장비(UE)는, 브로드캐스트 정보, RRC 메시징, NAS 메시징, 허용가능 PLMN에 접속하는 능력, 및 금지된 PLMN들로부터의 표시들에 기초하여 재난 조건, 및 그의 해결책을 검출할 수 있다.  재난 조건에서, UE는 향상된 PLMN 선택 절차를 수행할 수 있으며, 여기서 예를 들어, UE는, 재난 상황이 UE의 현재 위치에 적용되는 경우 재난 상황에 있는 PLMN들을 고려하지 않고, 재난 로밍 접속을 위해 금지된 PLMN들을 우선순위화할 것이다.  재난 로밍 접속을 위해, UE는, UE가 어떠한 서비스에 액세스할지 그리고 네트워크가 UE와 어떠한 유형의 인증 절차를 수행할 수 있는지에 관한 정보로 달리 금지된 PLMN에 의해 구성될 수 있다.  재난 조건이 종료되었음을 검출할 시에, UE는 허용가능 PLMN으로 다시 이동한다.

title_ko: 버퍼 수치 전파를 스트리밍하기 위한 방법 및 시스템
abstract_ko: 시스템, 방법 및 컴퓨터 판독 가능 매체의 명령어는 클라이언트 머신에서, 궤도 시뮬레이션을 위한 사용자 선택 구성 매개변수를 획득하는 단계; 네트워크 연결을 통해, 클라이언트 머신으로부터 원격 시스템에 궤도 시뮬레이션을 위한 제1 구성 매개변수 세트를 전송하는 단계 - 여기서 제1 구성 매개변수 세트는 사용자 선택 구성 매개변수를 포함함 - ; 네트워크 연결을 통해, 클라이언트 장치에서 원격 디바이스로부터 궤도를 따르는 포인트를 포함하는 궤도 데이터 스트림을 수신하는 단계 - 여기서 궤도를 따르는 포인트는 제1 구성 매개변수 세트에 기초하여 원격 시스템에 의해 결정됨 - ; 및 디스플레이에서, 궤도 시뮬레이션의 동적 렌더링을 표시하는 단계 - 여기서 궤도 시뮬레이션은 궤도 데이터 스트림에 기초함 - 를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Power grid development assessment method with economical efficiency and security considered
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power grid development assessment method with economical efficiency and security considered. The method comprises the steps of collecting initial state data of a power grid to be researched; conducting evolution simulation on the development state of the power grid based on the initial state data of the power grid; conducting statistics on relevant information of newly-built power plants, transformer substations and lines and simulating cascading failures of the power grid based on an obtained power grid evolution simulation result, calculating the construction cost of the power grid based on the statistics information, and obtaining the load loss information of the cascading failures of the power grid based on the simulation of the cascading failures of the power grid; calculating the outage cost of the power grid to obtain the total outage cost of power grid evolution; calculating the development cost of the power grid according to the construction cost of the power grid, the outage cost of the power grid and additionally-supplied load profit; changing the control parameters of evolution simulation of the development state of the power grid and obtaining power grid development cost values under different evolution simulation control parameters through calculation; making an assessment according to the principle that the lower a power grid development cost value is, the more reasonable power grid development is under the corresponding development speed.

title_en: Air pollution treatment method based on air pollution propagation mode
abstract_en: The invention discloses an air pollution treatment method based on an air pollution propagation mode, which comprises the following steps: (1) according to meteorological data and air pollution data, aiming at each air monitoring station at each moment, constructing an air pollution transportation modeling based on sampling simulation between the air pollution transportation modeling and the surrounding air monitoring stations, and obtaining an air pollution transportation example; (2) according to the air pollution transportation example, connecting the air pollution transportation examples which are continuous in space and time by adopting an algorithm of breadth search to form a large amount of air pollution propagation networks; (3) carrying out frequent sub-graph mining on a large number of air pollution propagation networks, and extracting frequently-occurring pollution propagation paths to obtain an air pollution propagation mode; (4) and adopting corresponding air treatment measures according to the air pollution propagation mode. The air pollution treatment method can adopt corresponding air treatment means according to the air pollution propagation mode, and improves the air treatment effect.

title_en: Seismic oscillation peak acceleration prediction method based on second-order neuron deep neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a seismic oscillation peak acceleration prediction method based on a second-order neuron deep neural network, belongs to the field of seismic engineering, and aims to solve the technical problem of low accuracy of seismic oscillation prediction. The earthquake motion peak acceleration prediction method comprises the following steps: selecting a seismic magnitude, a projection distance, a shear wave velocity, an area, a covering layer thickness, a fault type and a period as input parameters in a data set, wherein the corresponding seismic oscillation peak acceleration is a target parameter; establishing a deep neural network comprising three hidden layers, wherein neurons are second-order elements, a hyperbolic tangent function is adopted as an activation function, a mean square error function and an Adam self-adaptive optimization function are adopted for back propagation, and an average absolute error function is taken as an evaluation function; thirdly, training a deep neural network model; and fourthly, predicting the peak acceleration. The invention adopts a multi-input structure and a second-order neural network, which can not only improve the precision of predicting the earthquake motion peak acceleration, but also ensure the applicability of a deep neural network model.

title_en: Building construction fire-fighting detection method and system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-fighting detection method and a fire-fighting detection system for building construction based on the Internet of things, which relate to the technical field of electric digital data processing and specifically comprise the steps of dividing areas and grading the sensitivity of the areas of a building construction site according to manual marking results; the method comprises the steps of carrying out node cluster grouping and node energy coefficient calculation according to environment data collected by a wireless sensor network, completing leader node election through energy coefficient sequencing, carrying out video recording on a fixed monitoring area to obtain video data and sending the video data in real time, establishing an environment data set, carrying out probability screening according to a confidence level probability model obtained through D-S model calculation, obtaining a fire judgment result through probability screening of a confidence interval, processing the video data through a frame difference method, extracting image characteristics, obtaining the fire judgment result according to a back propagation neural network and a fixed threshold detection method, carrying out on-site acousto-optic alarm, cloud platform alarm reminding and sending notification to a fire department based on the fire judgment result, and completing fire detection and early warning.

title_en: Urban infrastructure risk assessment method oriented to storm disaster chain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a storm disaster chain-oriented urban infrastructure risk assessment method which specifically comprises the following steps of S1, uniformly coding urban infrastructure elements, S2, constructing a correlation network among urban infrastructure nodes, S3, constructing an urban storm disaster chain network, S4, simulating a secondary disaster risk caused by a storm disaster, S5, simulating an infrastructure risk caused by a storm disaster chain, S6, assessing cascade fault conduction of the infrastructure node risk, S7, and realizing real-time risk display based on uniform identification codes. According to the urban infrastructure risk assessment method for the storm disaster chain, support is provided for dynamic emergency decision making of multi-disaster linkage by considering the infrastructure node risk caused by the storm and the secondary disasters, so that the precise infrastructure node risk pre-judgment of timing and fixed points is realized, and the establishment of specific emergency decision making and the targeted resident disaster risk prevention are facilitated.

title_en: Power grid voltage sag source positioning method and device
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a device for positioning a power grid voltage sag source, and relates to the field of positioning of power grid voltage sag sources, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining voltage and current waveform data of monitoring points during power grid voltage sag; the method comprises the steps of inputting voltage and current waveform data of monitoring points in a grid voltage sag into a trained graph attention network to obtain the position of a grid voltage sag source, wherein the graph attention network comprises an input layer, a cascaded graph attention layer, a pooling layer and an output layer, a multi-head attention mechanism and a voltage sag amplitude are introduced into the graph attention layer, the voltage sag amplitude is determined by the voltage and current waveform data, the graph attention network is trained by adopting an improved loss function and comparison learning, and the improved loss function introduces the grid voltage sag source judgment based on instantaneous disturbance power quantity and disturbance energy into the loss function. The application improves the accuracy of positioning the power grid voltage sag source.

title_en: Method for determining real-time alarm for local target earthquake early warning using mechanical learning
title_ko: 기계학습을 이용한 지역대상 지진조기경보를 위한 실시간 경보 결정 방법
abstract_en: According to the present invention, a method for an early warning of a local target earthquake by using machine learning by collecting seismic observation data from seismic observatories of a seismic observation network in real time to detect a P wave propagating from an epicenter, and advancing an alarm time point as much as possible and minimizing a false alarm when issuing a warning about an analysis result based on the machine learning includes: detecting the P wave arriving at an observatory close to the epicenter (S100); calculating an earthquake motion observation value for a predetermined time period before and after an arrival time point of the detected P wave (S200); calculating a feature vector from the earthquake motion observation value to determine whether the P wave is a P wave generated from an earthquake by classification through a machine learning model trained in advance (S300); calculating a characteristic value of the P wave from the earthquake motion observation value to predict a maximum earthquake motion magnitude at an observation point through a maximum earthquake motion prediction formula, and determining whether a prediction result is greater than or equal to an alarm criterion (S400); detecting a P wave arriving at another seismic observatory of the seismic observation network during or immediately after the steps S100 to S400 (S500); determining whether an observed position of the P wave detected at another seismic observatory falls within a predetermined distance section from an observation position of the observatory close to the epicenter (S600); determining whether an arrival time of the P wave detected at another seismic observatory falls within a predetermined time interval before and after the arrival time of the P wave that is initially detected (S700); and determining issuance of an early warning for an earthquake by using a determination result (S800).
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 기계학습을 이용한 지역대상 지진조기경보를 위해 지진관측망의 지진관측소들에서 실시간으로 지진 관측자료를 수집하여 진원으로부터 전파되는 P파를 탐지하고 기계학습을 기반으로 분석한 결과를 경보할 때, 경보 시점을 최대한 앞당기고, 오경보를 최소화하는 방법으로서, 진원으로부터 가까운 관측소에 P파가 도달하여 탐지하는 단계(S100); 상기 탐지된 P파의 도달 시점을 기준으로 전후 일정 시간 구간에 대한 지진동 관측값을 산출하는 단계(S200); 상기 지진동 관측값으로부터 특징 벡터를 산출하여 사전에 학습된 기계학습 모델을 통한 분류로 지진으로부터 발생한 P파인지 판정하는 단계(S300); 상기 지진동 관측값으로부터 P파의 특성값을 산출하여 최대 지진동 예측식을 통해 관측 지점의 최대 지진동 크기를 예측하고, 예측 결과가 경보 기준 이상인지 판정하는 단계(S400); 상기 단계(S100 내지 S400)가 진행되는 동안 또는 직후 지진관측망의 다른 지진관측소에 P파가 도달하여 탐지하는 단계(S500); 상기 다른 지진관측소에서 탐지된 P파의 관측 위치가 상기 진원으로부터 가까운 관측소의 관측 위치와 일정 거리 구간 내에 속하는지 판정하는 단계(S600); 상기 다른 지진관측소에서 탐지된 P파의 도달 시점이 최초 탐지된 P파의 도달 시점을 기준으로 전후 일정 시간 구간 내에 속하는지 판정하는 단계(S700); 및 상기 판정 결과를 이용하여 지진조기경보의 발령을 결정하는 단계(S800); 를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: System for informing risk information in disaster areas using augmented reality
title_ko: 증강현실을 활용한 재난지역의 위험정보 알림 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a danger information notification system in a disaster area using augmented reality. The purpose of the present invention is to promote the safety of the people by transmitting image information to which augmented reality is applied to dangerous facilities in the event of a disaster such as flood, flooding, landslide, heavy snow, fire, earthquake, and tsunami so that the danger information can be intuitively understood and grasped. According to an embodiment of the present invention, disclosed is a system for notifying risk information of a disaster area using augmented reality, which comprises: a field disaster information acquisition unit acquiring field location information and field image information of a corresponding disaster area when a disaster alarm occurs; an AR disaster image information generation unit applying AR content to the field image information to generate AR disaster image information on which AR content is projected; and an AR disaster image information propagation unit identifying a subject located in the corresponding disaster area based on the field location information and propagating the AR disaster image information to a mobile communication terminal of the identified subject.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 증강현실을 활용한 재난지역의 위험정보 알림 시스템에 관한 것으로, 해결하고자 하는 과제는 홍수, 침수, 산사태, 대설, 화재, 지진, 해일 등 재난 발생 시 위험 시설물 등에 대하여 증강현실을 적용한 영상정보를 전파하여 위험정보를 직관적으로 이해 및 파악할 수 있도록 함으로써 국민의 안전을 도모하는데 있다. 
일례로, 재난경보 발생 시 해당 재난지역의 현장위치정보 및 현장영상정보를 각각 획득하는 현장재난정보 획득부; 상기 현장영상정보에 AR 콘텐츠를 적용하여 AR 콘텐츠가 투영된 AR 재난영상정보를 생성하는 AR 재난영상정보 생성부; 및 상기 현장위치정보를 기반으로 해당 재난지역에 위치하는 대상자를 식별하고, 식별된 대상자의 모바일통신단말로 상기 AR 재난영상정보를 전파하는 AR 재난영상정보 전파부를 포함하는 증강현실을 활용한 재난지역의 위험정보 알림 시스템을 개시한다.

title_en: Mechanism and data hybrid driven generation type countermeasure network soft measurement modeling method
abstract_en: The mechanism and data hybrid driven generation type countermeasure network soft measurement modeling method comprises the following steps: sampling from auxiliary variables to obtain data q, sampling from random noise to obtain data z, inputting q and z into generator to be identified composed of mechanism model and data driving error compensation model to obtain generated sample Will generate a sample Inputting the real sample x into a discriminator, and reversely propagating the obtained loss to obtain an optimal generator parameter; taking out the optimal generator as a trained soft measurement model to enable the optimal generator to be used as a soft measurement modelThe interpretability of the model is analyzed by using a method for manipulating latent variables, the model is compared with a single-driven soft measurement model, the prediction performance of the model is analyzed, and the limitations that a static model cannot capture dynamic characteristics among data, a mechanism-driven soft measurement model has modeling errors, data-driven soft measurement is difficult to utilize label-free data and the interpretability is poor are overcome.

title_en: Photovoltaic system fault warning method based on BP neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photovoltaic system fault warning method based on a BP (back propagation) neural network, which screens out training data by establishing the BP neural network of a distributed photovoltaic system, and further warns output characteristic abnormity in the operation process of the distributed photovoltaic system in a region.
assignees: DATANG HAINAN ENERGY DEV CO LTD;NEW ENERGY BRANCH OF DATANG HAINAN ENERGY DEV CO LTD;DATANG SANYA FUTURE ENERGY RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Risk minimization multipath routing calculation method for power grid key control service
abstract_en: The invention discloses a risk minimization multipath routing calculation method for a key control service of a power grid, which comprises the following steps: step a: establishing a risk minimization disjoint double-route optimization model under the condition of natural disasters, and setting objective functions and constraint conditions; step b: and calculating risk values of all disjoint double routes under the condition of natural disasters, and selecting the double route with the minimum risk value as an optimal result to be output. Aiming at key control business of a power grid, a risk minimization disjoint double-route optimization model under the condition of natural disasters is established, a multi-route active defense method is researched, and the route survivability of the multi-route active defense method is improved; the method solves the problem that natural disasters bring great difficulty to fault defense, weakens the dependent coupling relation between the power grid and the communication network, improves the capability of resisting initial faults, enhances the survivability of routes in the cascading process, and inhibits the further propagation of cascading faults.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD WENZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Urban intelligent management system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an urban intelligent management system, which belongs to the technical field of urban intelligent management and comprises a cloud control platform, an image acquisition module, an image processing module, a road network management control module, a cascade tracking module, a positioning module, an alarm feedback module and a log detection module, wherein the cloud control platform is used for verifying manager information and carrying out corresponding data display and function control according to a manager operation instruction; the invention can collect and forecast traffic flow information in each period in real time, ensures the accuracy of traffic signal control, does not need to manually maintain traffic flow, is beneficial to saving resident travel time, can perform full cross-equipment matching, avoids the condition of missed detection, greatly improves the accuracy of target detection, is convenient to use, reduces the difficulty of target analysis, and improves the working efficiency.
assignees: CHENGDU QINGYANG BIG DATA CO LTD

title_en: Space complex network collapse method based on cascade failure
abstract_en: The invention relates to a space complex network collapse method based on cascade failure, which relates to the technical field of space complex networks and solves the problems that the current space complex network collapse method does not consider the change of a topological structure to cause the material flow change in a network, and the network collapse effect cannot be accurately reflected. Comparing the evaluation index values obtained by the method with those obtained by other complex network disintegration methods, the method has better disintegration effect in the real network.

title_en: New energy power equipment operation risk assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power equipment risk assessment, and discloses a new energy power equipment operation risk assessment method and a system, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a scene basic event of a fault of a power system of a power distribution network accessed by new energy; the method comprises the steps of screening key scenario events from the scenario basic events through an expert trust propagation-decision laboratory analysis method, inputting the key scenario events into an interpretation structure model for analysis to obtain a scenario level diagram of key fault events, carrying out scenario analysis and deduction on the scenario level diagram to obtain a power system fault probability prediction result, and analyzing the power system fault probability prediction result to obtain the influence degree of different power equipment running states on power system faults. The invention evaluates the risk degree of the power equipment faults on the operation of the power system, comprehensively considers the interrelation among the equipment and the overall operation condition of the system, and provides support for the emergency management decision of the power system.

title_en: Intelligent substation relay protection operation risk identification method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for identifying relay protection operation risks of an intelligent substation, the method comprises the steps of constructing a protection association matrix aiming at a main wiring diagram of the intelligent substation, constructing a Petri network of each protection and a coupling relation library and a coupling state library of information transmission of the Petri network, searching each adjacent protection of original protection, setting a primary equipment failure, sequentially enumerating the pressing plate error switching of the corresponding protection, which violates an operation rule, sequentially calling the normal action Petri network and the abnormal action Petri network of the original protection and each adjacent protection to conduct deduction, exhausting the action deduction of all the adjacent protection, recording each protection action after deduction, forming an event chain, obtaining an extra-tripping breaker set, and taking the extra-tripping breaker set as an expansion result of a linkage fault caused by a protection risk point. According to the invention, adjacent protections of the original protections can be searched, the risk of the protection pressing plate throwing and retreating errors is identified through deduction analysis, and the development and the expansion range of cascading failures caused by the protection pressing plate throwing and retreating errors are obtained.
assignees: INST ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCES STATE GRID CHONGQING ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CHONGQING ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY EHV BRANCH;STATE GRID CHONGQING ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV SOUTHWEST JIAOTONG;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Wheat gluten production quality assessment method based on machine learning
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of quality evaluation, and particularly relates to a wheat gluten production quality evaluation method based on machine learning. Firstly, flour and water are mixed according to a proportion to prepare dough, visual images of wet gluten and cleaning liquid are collected when the dough is cleaned, and core attention areas are extracted through image pretreatment, enhancement, morphological operation and differential screening. Based on this region, the wet gluten color index and starch granule dispersion are calculated, and the optimum value is obtained by changing the ratio of flour and water with the minimum value of the two as an objective function. An improved cascade neural network model is constructed, an input layer fuses optimal indexes, dispersion and production process parameters, a cascade structure processes prediction quality through a BP neural network and a convolution neural network, and the neural network parameters are determined by an improved firefly algorithm. The method solves the problems of low efficiency, poor consistency and the like of the traditional manual evaluation, realizes objective and accurate evaluation, and meets the requirement of industrial production on quality control.

title_en: Reservoir dispatching method and device based on multi-target reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reservoir dispatching method and a device based on multi-objective reinforcement learning, which belongs to the technical field of reservoir dispatching and comprises the steps of constructing a data set according to preprocessing data, inputting a group of training space state data into a preset multi-objective deep reinforcement learning network, outputting predicted space state data, updating parameters of the multi-objective deep reinforcement learning network based on a back propagation mode according to a loss function, and taking the predicted space state data as new training space state data to obtain an updated target deep reinforcement learning network, inputting the training space state data of other groups in the training space state data into the updated target deep reinforcement learning network according to the training space state data of the plurality of groups to obtain a trained multi-target deep reinforcement learning network, inputting the space state data acquired in real time into the trained multi-target deep reinforcement learning network, and outputting a real-time optimized reservoir dispatching strategy. The invention realizes rapid and accurate reservoir dispatching.
assignees: MINISTRY OF WATER RESOURCES PEARL RIVER WATER RESOURCES COMMISSION TECH CONSULTATION GUANGZHOU CO LT

title_en: Transparent fusion perception visualization scene construction method and system for low-voltage power distribution network
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of intelligent power grids, and provides a method and a system for constructing a transparent fusion perception visualization scene of a low-voltage power distribution network, wherein the method and the system comprise the steps of synchronously acquiring voltage, current and equipment state data by utilizing power line carrier communication, an intelligent ammeter and a power distribution terminal, and establishing a circular queue with time marks aligned; the method comprises the steps of constructing a tree topology structure based on three-phase attributes, generating a connection matrix, dividing users into visual levels with different transparencies through electric distance calculation, realizing gradual change coloring and special effect warning of an overload circuit through combining current saturation mapping, fusing physical positions and electric parameters through polar coordinate system conversion, generating dynamic particle flows to intuitively display current distribution, and analyzing a voltage distortion propagation path through waveform similarity backtracking when voltage is in sag, positioning disturbance sources and triggering pulse diffusion animation. The transparent fusion sensing of the running state of the low-voltage distribution network is realized, the real-time early warning of line overload and the second-level positioning of disturbance sources are realized, and the intelligent operation and maintenance efficiency is improved.

title_en: Urban underground rail transit network earthquake response deterministic physical simulation method and equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deterministic physical simulation method and equipment for earthquake response of an urban underground rail transit network, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a hybrid earthquake source model based on movable fault parameters and kinematic parameters of a target area, integrating deterministic slippage components with low wave numbers and stochastic slippage components with high wave numbers on fault fracture surfaces by the earthquake source model, and generating a broadband earthquake wave field source reflecting the physical process of the earthquake source; the method comprises the steps of taking a constructed seismic source model as input, combining a regional crustal velocity structure model, simulating the propagation of seismic waves in a layered geological medium by utilizing a frequency-wave number domain method, calculating to obtain a seismic vibration space-time field, establishing a finite element model of an urban underground rail transit network, applying the seismic vibration space-time field as non-uniform seismic vibration input to the finite element model, and solving to obtain the dynamic response of the whole underground rail transit network in the seismic process through dynamic time-course analysis. The invention can reproduce the complete physical chain from the source break to the structural response.

title_en: Internet of Thing (IoT) and Cyber Security Technique based Plant Emergency Monitoring and Communication Network
title_ko: IoT 및 암호화 통신보안 기반을 이용한 원자력발전소 플랜트 통제시스템 및 이를 이용한 감시통제 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to nuclear power plant emergency monitoring and Wi-Fi communication technology employing Internet-of-Things technology and an encryption communication security technique and, more specifically, to a system employing FPGA-based hardware and driven with lithium-ion batteries, thereby making a contribution to the minimization of the range and influence of an incident by promptly transmitting necessary information to an emergency situation room through the attachment of a modularized IoT device when the function of an existing monitoring facility is stopped in case of an emergency in a plant. Therefore, in the present technological field, when every power source of the plant is disabled and even a wired communication network cannot be connected, a near field communication network such as Wi-Fi is autonomously formed to necessarily provide information, and, moreover, hardware-based FPGA technology having a recovery force to minimize influences from a cyberattack by a hacker, or a local electromagnetic interference situation during a data transmission procedure can be applied.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 사물인터넷 기술과 암호화 통신보안 기법을 적용한 원자력발전소 비상상태 감시 및 와이파이 통신 기술에 관한 것으로서, FPGA를 이용한 하드웨어를 채택하고 리튬-이온 지로 구동하는 것을 특징으로 하여, 플랜트에 비상상태가 발생하여 기존의 감시설비의 기능이 정지되었을 때 모듈화된 IoT 기기를 부착하여 비상 상황실에 필요한 정보를 제때에 전송하여 사고의 파급범위와 영향을 최소화하는데 기여하는 시스템에 관한 것이다. 따라서 본 기술분야에서는 플랜트의 전원이 모두 불능상태가 되고 유선 통신망마저 연결되지 않을 때 와이파이와 같은 근거리 통신망을 자체적으로 구성하여 정보를 제공하는 것이 필수적이며, 아울러 데이터 전송과정에서 해커에 의한 사이버 공격이나, 국부적인 전자파 장애 상황에도 영향을 최소화할 수 있는 회복력을 가진 하드웨어 기반의 FPGA 기술을 적용하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: High performance real-time relational database system and methods for using same
abstract_en: A database system supporting persistent queries, comprising a client software application, a persistent query service, and a plurality of network-attached data sources. On receiving a request to create a persistent query from the client software application, the persistent query service: creates a query virtual table; parses the persistent query; creates a plurality of intermediate virtual tables; establishes listeners for the query virtual table; creates a plurality of data source virtual tables; causes the plurality of data source virtual tables to retrieve initial data from data sources; and propagates data via intermediate virtual tables to the persistent query virtual table. On detection of a data change in a data source, the associated data source virtual table causes the data change to propagate via intermediate virtual tables to the persistent query virtual table, and the client software application executes client code of at least one listener.

title_en: Terminal mobility management method and device using nas
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a 5G or 6G communication system for supporting higher data transmission rates. The present disclosure may provide a device and method for managing the mobility of a terminal in a wireless communication system. Disclosed is a method for selecting a PLMN or SNPN, in a process of confirming service disruption of a first communication provider communication network and utilizing service of a second communication provider communication network, on the basis of capability information about the ability of a terminal in a wireless communication system to utilize a communication network of a provider that the terminal is not subscribed to in a disaster situation.

title_en: Modeling method, device, equipment and medium for thermal power generating unit control system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure provides a modeling method, a modeling device, modeling equipment and modeling media for a thermal power generating unit control system, which belong to the technical field of data processing and specifically comprise the following steps: collecting a time sequence data set; converting a transfer function model corresponding to a thermal power unit control system into a discrete form of a state space model with uncertain terms through a neural ordinary differential equation network to obtain a state equation; inputting the state variable and the input variable into a state equation to obtain an approximation value of first-order differentiation; normalizing the approximation value, inputting the normalized approximation value into a normal differential solver, and calculating a predicted value; and carrying out back propagation on the predicted value, and iteratively training weight parameters in the neural ordinary differential equation network until convergence to obtain a predicted model corresponding to the thermal power unit control system. According to the scheme, the system is modeled by combining the system state space model and introducing state equation structure knowledge based on the neural ordinary differential equation network, and the prediction accuracy and adaptability after modeling are improved.

title_en: Regional power grid capacity expansion planning method, device and equipment considering hydropower station cooperation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a regional power grid capacity expansion planning method, device and equipment considering hydropower station cooperation, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring unit data of a target regional power grid, wherein the unit data comprises cost data and parameter data; based on the cost data and a preset cost rule, constructing a capacity expansion planning model of the target regional power grid; according to the parameter data and the cascade hydropower station attributes, constraining the capacity expansion planning model to obtain constraint conditions of the capacity expansion planning model; and calculating a capacity expansion planning model based on constraint conditions, and characterizing the obtained calculation result as an optimal configuration strategy of the target regional power grid. The invention can realize the determination of the optimal configuration combination of conventional power generation, energy storage and intermittent renewable energy under the condition of meeting the preset variable new energy permeation target, and effectively reduce the total cost of the water-wind-solar-energy-storage combined power generation system; by considering the time correlation of the natural inflow and the forced outflow of the hydropower station, a high-fidelity rule curve is constructed for the hydropower station.

title_en: Interphone relay management method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of wireless communication, in particular to a method and a device for managing interphone relay, which comprise the following steps: based on the environment monitoring equipment, the topography and the environment data of the relay station are collected, the attenuation degree of the interphone signal under various environments and transmission distances is analyzed and calculated, and a signal attenuation analysis result is obtained. According to the invention, the influence of various environmental factors and transmission distance data on signal attenuation is analyzed, the signal gain and frequency are adjusted in real time, the signal compensation parameters are calculated, the signal transmitting power and the signal propagation path are adjusted, the signal transmission quality and the communication stability are improved, accurate and rapid signal transmission is realized in a complex and wide coverage area, the overall quality and the coverage area of the signal are enhanced, the communication access priority is adjusted by analyzing the equipment characteristics and the communication behaviors, the emergency communication requirement is responded quickly, the efficiency and the response speed of a communication system are improved, and the adaptability and the reliability of a radio communication network are enhanced.

title_en: Nuclear power key index prediction device based on optimal deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nuclear power key index prediction device based on optimal deep learning, which comprises a sodium iodide spectrometer database, a data acquisition and preprocessing module, a one-dimensional CNN-LSTM cascading model module, a multi-target self-adaptive particle swarm optimization algorithm module and a nuclear power key index prediction and online correction module. The method realizes online prediction and parameter optimal online optimization, can robustly and swiftly predict the nuclear power key indexes in the running process of the nuclear power facility, does not need to manually design prediction features or rules, overcomes the defects that the conventional nuclear power key index prediction device is low in precision and easy to be influenced by human factors, and the prediction model is easy to mismatch, so that the prediction effect is poor and even the system is crashed, and improves the prediction efficiency and accuracy of the long-term online running of the nuclear power key index prediction in the radiation environment.

title_en: Accident Prevention System And Method For Military
title_ko: 병영생활 안전사고 예방 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and method for preventing an accident in the barracks to notify an emergency occurring in the barrack life regarding an individual or a unit to a unit control room or to other units by coupling a signal generation device. The system includes: the signal generation device which is coupled to the identification tag worn by a soldier to generate an emergency signal notifying the dangerous situation of the soldier; a plurality of repeaters which are installed on the boundary of the barrack and the inside and outside of the barrack, and builds an independent communications network in order to sense and propagate the emergency signal from the signal generation device; and a situation propagation device which is installed in the control room to output the emergency signal of the signal generation device being transmitted through the communications network.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 군인의 인식표에 신호를 발생시킬 수 있는 신호 발생 장치를 결합하여 병영 생활 중 발생할 수 있는 개인별 혹은 부대별 위급 상황을 부대 상황실이나 타 부대에 전파할 수 있는 병영생활 안전사고 예방 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로서, 본 발명의 실시 예에 따른 병영생활 안전사고 예방 시스템 및 방법은, 군인이 착용하는 인식표와 결합되어 착용 군인의 신상에 이상이 있음을 알리기 위한 비상 신호를 발생시키는 신호 발생기, 신호 발생기의 비상 신호를 감지 및 전파하기 위하여 영내 및 영내와 영외의 경계에 설치되어 자체 통신망을 구축하는 복수의 중계기, 통신망을 통해 전송되는 신호 발생기의 비상 신호 표출을 위해 상황실에 설치되는 상황 전파 장치를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Floor drain structure of apartment building
title_ko: 공동주택용 바닥 배수시설
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a floor drain structure of an apartment to process water on the floor of an apartment (parking lot, rooftop, etc.) by maximizing water containing capacity and preventing flooding of the floor of an apartment by rapidly draining out water by changing a drain in accordance with an amount of water. A floor drain structure of an apartment according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: a drain duct (10) having left and right vertical units, a partitioning wall in the center, an upper layer drainage path (11) and a lower layer drainage path (12) separated by the partitioning wall and a bottom unit on the bottom and a through hole formed in the partitioning wall to connect the upper layer drainage path to the lower layer drainage path; a drain unit connected to at least one between the upper layer drainage path and lower layer drainage path to drain out waste water collected to the upper layer drainage path and lower layer drainage path to a sewage system; and a grating (20) coupled to an upper part of the drain duct to be able to be separated. The drain duct comprises: a plurality of duct bodies (130) including an ′H′-shaped cross section by the left and right vertical units and partitioning wall in the center and serially connected one another; a bottom plate (14) coupled to the bottom unit of the duct bodies to form the lower layer drainage path; and a socket (15) including a bottom support unit formed in an opened manner upward to support the bottom plate at the bottom and left and right support units extended from both sides of the bottom support unit to block a leakage by covering the left and right vertical units of the duct bodies from the outside and connect the duct bodies.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 공동주택용 바닥 배수시설에 관한 것으로, 담수용량의 극대화를 통해 공동주택(주차장, 옥상 등) 바닥의 물을 처리하고, 물의 양에 따라 드레인의 변화를 주어 신속한 배수를 통해 공동주택 바닥의 침수를 방지함을 목적으로 한다. 
본 발명에 의한 공동주택용 바닥 배수시설은, 좌우 수직부와 중앙의 격벽 및 저부의 바닥부에 의해 상기 격벽을 중심으로 하여 상층 배수로(11)와 하층 배수로(12)가 상하로 구획되고, 상기 격벽에 상기 상층 배수로와 하층 배수로를 연결하는 통공이 형성되는 배수 덕트(10)와; 상기 배수덕트의 상층 배수로와 하층 배수로 중 일측 이상에 연결되어 상층 배수로와 하층 배수로에 집수되는 오수를 하수계통으로 드레인하는 드레인부와; 상기 배수덕트의 상부에 분리 가능하게 결합되는 그레이팅(20)을 포함하고, 상기 배수덕트는 좌우 수직부와 중앙의 격벽에 의해 "H" 단면으로 이루어지며 연쇄적으로 연결되는 복수 이상의 덕트 본체(13), 상기 덕트 본체들의 저부에 결합되어 하층 배수로를 형성하는 바닥판(14), 상부를 향해 개방 형성되어 상기 바닥판을 저부에서 지지하는 바닥 지지부와 이 바닥 지지부의 양측에서 각각 상부로 연장 형성되어 상기 덕트 본체들의 좌우 수직부를 외부에서 덮어 누수를 차단하는 좌우 지지부로 이루어져 이웃하는 덕트 본체들을 연결하는 소켓(15)을 포함한다.

title_en: System, method and program for building and managing a network of underground communal areas in preparation for disaster situations
title_ko: 재난상황을 대비한 지하공동구의 네트워크 구축 및 관리 시스템, 방법 및 프로그램
abstract_ko: 본 개시는 재난상황을 대비한 지하공동구의 네트워크 구축 및 관리 시스템에 관한 것으로, 지하공동구의 전파환경 사전조사 결과를 기반으로, 해당 지하공동구에 최적화된 와이파이 연결장치 이격 거리, 설치 위치, 채널을 결정할 수 있는 네트워크 구축 및 관리 시스템을 제공하는 효과를 제공한다.
